title: Let's celebrate together - tennax you
content:
Christmas sweet cakes, 2k words
——
【tenna】
"Merry Christmas!"
"Merry Christmas! My dear star! ”
You blinked, wanting to ask Tenna what kind of Christmas gift she would prepare for you, but seeing him preparing a Christmas Eve feast, you felt too embarrassed to ask. You tugged at your clothes, shifted restlessly at your desk, then slumped over the table, staring blankly at Tenna's back.
Tenna was busy in the kitchen for a while, then brought you several steaming dishes. You saw him taking off his cooking gloves, muttering, "Ah...... We're still missing the Christmas roast chicken and the little cakes I prepared for you. Maybe it's better to just go buy them ......"
You blink and raise your hand: "Ah...... Yes, today should be "Happy Christmas Eve!" Let's finish dinner first and go out shopping together later! ”
"Ah, of course no problem! But maybe you think the dinner preparation wasn't thorough enough...... I should have gone out to buy it earlier. "Even though you can't see his eyes, you can still sense a hint of annoyance in Tenna's tone.
And you just shook your head cheerfully: "Of course not! Tenna can spend Christmas Eve with me tonight, so I'm already very happy tomorrow's Christmas!" "You don't have any other demands; you just want to be with the one you love."
"Is that so...... That's wonderful! Actually, just being with you makes me feel satisfied. Tenna's nose blossomed, and he wanted to say more, but his emotions surged so much that he didn't know what to say first, so he just stepped forward and hugged you tightly. So you hugged him tightly and gently kissed him twice on his TV screen.
He always wants to prepare more and better things for you. After all, Tenna never knows if he truly deserves your affection. Even though you always tell him he doesn't need to do so much for you, that as long as you maintain the status quo, you already like him, and that no matter what, you love him, he still wants to give back this affection, wanting to do more than you do.
So sometimes when you look at him, you feel like a patrol dog that's about to be given to you after taking something good. Other times, you even get the illusion that you're about to be overwhelmed by his love.
However, this is just an exaggerated description!
After enjoying this dinner with the sound of wind, you pulled Tenna out together. He became about as tall as you, and then put on the same scarf as you. You walked out of the room head-to-head and shoulder to shoulder, squeezing out the door and onto a street full of colorful lights.
You've visited several shops. Maybe because it was a bit late, many of their Christmas roast chicken and cakes were already sold out. You saw Tenna's screen turn black again, and he hung his head gloomily: "If I'd known, I should've gone to buy them earlier...... Or maybe I should have prepared these earlier! ”
He thought, maybe it's better to prepare Christmas roast chicken and small cakes for you myself. Even though you're wrapped in scarves and warm now, you still have to brave the cold wind and rush between different shops.
And you just smiled, exhaled a breath of white air, and patted the TV casing of Tenna, whose furry hat you also wore with a fluffy hat, with your glove-wrapped hand—and even drilled two holes to let those antennas out: "Ah...... It's okay, as long as we're walking together, sharing a happy and joyful time is enough! Actually, I don't care about roast chicken or cake or anything like that...... As you spoke, your voice slowed down and lowered too, because your gaze was drawn to the people in the distant square.
The square was filled with people holding hands and dancing to a melodious waltz. You hesitated to glance at Tenna, then at the scarf tightly binding you together, and finally smiled as you took his hand: "It doesn't seem like I can dance like this now...... Then let's spin a few times! ”
"Ah, actually, you could just untie your scarf first and put it back on later...... I don't mind that, sweetheart." Tenna hurriedly explained. To be honest, although he was really reluctant and just wanted to stay with you forever, that way, he could still hold your hand tightly and look at your radiant smile. That would be nice too.
But you just tilted your head slightly, looked at him, and smiled again: "It's okay—if you untie it, maybe we'll get separated. I don't want to be separated from Tenna." As you spoke, you tapped the TV screen again. Of course, you sensed a hint of unease and anxiety in his tone. Of course, you chose to indulge him, but honestly, that's what you thought too. You don't want to be separated from him!
Maybe your idea is a bit childish, but you don't really care.
He paused, then put his arm around your shoulder and cleared his throat twice: "...... Alright, sweetheart, I'll do whatever you say. ”
You smiled and put your arm around his shoulder, or rather, hugged him tightly. Then you spun around the square to the music of a waltz, a bit swaying a bit—either you pulled him or he said, and in the end, you both burst out laughing and left the square shoulder to shoulder, panting.
Where else are you going after leaving here? To be honest, you haven't decided yet, but you still pull Tenna to keep going from one shop to another, and finally manage to buy a small cake. To be honest, the cake is very small. Tenna probably finished it in one bite, and now it's just barely enough for you two to share. But that's the last piece of cake left in the shop. Honestly, you guys are pretty lucky—even though you didn't sell Christmas roast chicken, one small cake is enough.
Tenna's wires stiffened again, and you rubbed his wires, successfully seeing him shiver. You used the store's knife to cut open the small cake and handed it to Tenna.
"Alright, alright...... Come eat some cake! We're very lucky today! I hope next year will be the same, just as lucky as today, blessed and joyful! "You've already returned home, and at the table, you shared the half piece of cake with Tenna.
Just then, the midnight bell rang, and with twelve neat beats, the sound of fireworks exploding outside erupted.
Tenna took the little cake, flowers sprouting from his nose again, the antenna shook twice for some reason, and he said again, "Dear, Merry Christmas." ”
"Merry Christmas!"

title: Late Night TV Show 1
content:
Tennax, you, hmm, all character settings belong to me (? ）
With the Persona 4 fusion setting, it's okay if you don't know Persona 4! I'm just a pure Photoshop fan.
——
"At midnight on a rainy night, looking at my own face on the unturned TV, I would see another person's image." It is said that this is what the future lover looks like.
…… This is the rumor that has been making waves in the class lately. Although I don't believe it, it's been raining continuously these past few days, and my curiosity keeps growing. I always feel that even if I give it a try, it's no big deal—just satisfying my curiosity and thirst for knowledge. Even if I remain ignorant all this time, it's not a bad thing—but some questions always attract people to dig deeper.
In short, unfortunately, you really are a very curious guy.
Outside, a muffled thunderclap had been heard and the heavy rain was sparse. Raindrops from the eaves kept hitting the uneven ground, gathering into puddles. Perhaps in such weather, turning on the TV and then napping to the sound of the program was the best choice. But at this moment, you were just staring blankly at your own face reflected on the screen. In the pitch-black night, the second hand ticked, approaching midnight.
When the second hand hits exactly the number 12, you see a horizontal line on the TV screen that is tuned for FM to flash and light up, reflecting the image in your pupils. You widen your eyes, surprised that the rumor about late-night TV is actually true. You're curious about who will appear next, and you don't want to miss a single thing.
—So what is this? You fall silent as you watch an ad on the screen, accompanied by inexplicably explosive music. What appears to be a ...... The shadow of a TV person? Could it be some kind of headgear...... At the end, a scene like 'Welcome to Mr. (Ant)tenna' TV show was played.
It seemed like there wasn't much to see. You rubbed your temples, which were aching from staying up late, turned and went back to sleep, naturally missing the next scene. After the commercial ended, a scene of a female student appeared, then the TV screen closed again, plunging into a pitch-black silence.
The next morning, there was no rain, and since it was a rare holiday, you just zoned out. After all, for some reason, the fog in town had been getting heavier lately. Although it didn't really affect travel...... But it was still inconvenient. After an ordinary day, it started raining again at night.
Anyway, it's boring, and it's raining again. Should I watch some late-night TV? You hesitate for a moment, then decide to sit in the living room with your pillow hugging your pillow, staring eagerly at the pitch-black TV screen. Your face is reflected on the screen, the second hand hits midnight again, and it's the same ad as yesterday. You're a bit disappointed.
But you still insisted on watching it today. You're very persistent. What if the commercial is just an appetizer for some show preview, and the main episode actually comes later?
Unfortunately, after this commercial ended, the TV screen returned to pitch black, only reflecting your face. The lightning flashed by, making your face look deathly pale.
You scratched your head in frustration, not even knowing why it was happening. You felt frustrated, and probably subconsciously, felt it shouldn't be like this. So you took two steps forward, squatted down, and stared blankly at your face on the TV screen. As you looked, you noticed the screen had turned into a vortex—could it be malfunctioning?
You instinctively reach out your hand, but it passes straight through the TV screen and enters the whirlpool. Then comes an irresistible suction, as if trying to drag you in completely. You widen your eyes and try to pull your hand back—but unfortunately, you don't have enough strength and end up being dragged in.
When you cover your head dizzy and open your eyes, you find yourself sitting on the sofa, holding a controller, with a TV viewer sitting next to you, excitedly talking about something.
Oh, there's someone next to me...... Wait, TV person?? You instinctively tilt your head and look at him, confirming that this is the same TV person you saw in the commercial—probably, definitely.
Calm down and think about it: you crossed over to this world because you touched the TV. You can be sure this isn't your original world—after all, how could a TV person really appear? Haha. Is heaven punishing you for not sleeping properly to show up on late-night TV? That's not scientific!
So if he touched the TV screen again, he should be able to go back, and there happened to be a TV next to him...... Uh, it was the TV person, but he looked quite tall, so he probably had to climb up himself......
While you were thinking, the game character was, of course, AFK and untouched, and that TV person—probably a host—saw you stunned for a long moment without moving, hesitantly asking, "Uh...... My dear star, is there something wrong? Are you hungry or thirsty? Here is fragrant cake and drinks—everything you want—or if you need something else—"
Before he could finish, you dropped the controller and looked serious: "Wait a moment, I need to confirm something." ”
The TV quietly shut up, instinctively lifting the corners of its mouth high as if guilty. If it had eyes, it would probably be blinking wildly too. Unfortunately, it has no eyes, so you have no idea which way it's looking.
And you didn't care about his slightly guilty expression at this moment. You just tugged at his clothes to make sure they were still sturdy, then pulled his clothes up and tapped the TV screen with your hand.
In that moment, his screen turned completely black, and his nose retracted—or disappeared? You don't know, all you know is the hard TV screen beneath your hand, because after a couple of taps, it made a dull sound, nowhere near the alluring vortex you had when you arrived.
It means you definitely can't get back through this TV screen. You're a bit disappointed, but you didn't have high expectations at first. After all, if it were that simple, you probably wouldn't even be here anymore.
The TV crew's voice was stammering, tinged with a hint of panic, but they still tried their best to act as if nothing was happening, even speeding up their speech: "Oh—my little star, did you run into some kind of little furry problem? Some annoying but not big problems? It's okay, maybe you'll find the answer on TV. Trust me, TV has everything you want, and the show you want will be broadcast on TV—"
He was still muttering, "You think this guy talks a lot—judging by the ads you saw before, maybe this guy's name is Tenna?"
Anyway, you politely asked, "Mr. Tenna, I'm going to start playing this game. Could you please be quiet for a while?" ”
"Oh...... Uh, you actually know my name? Ah, I haven't even introduced you to what you need to do in the game yet—"
You interrupted him again: "None of that matters. Besides, I want to try it myself. Maybe I can figure it out on my own." ”
Tenna didn't dare make a sound. Anyway, he quieted down, probably staring intently at the screen in front of him. You didn't really mind.
You just feel as if a raging war is raging! In short, just treat this place as an RPG or adventure story game—just clear it and then reach the next scene!
In short, your expression becomes serious and you start to immerse yourself in the game, since those who want to win never have a smile on their faces.
For a small town lacking entertainment, this game is still eye-opening. At least it incorporates fighting and puzzle elements. Although the puzzle parts are simple, most of it is just Q&A.
In short, you quickly collect the first key, and with two left, you can open the door, something like that.
Tenna couldn't sit still and started applauding enthusiastically: "Look at our star, these problems are really easy for her!" She collected the first key so quickly—after that, I doubt anything will trouble you! ”
You coughed twice, touched your nose, and slightly looked away. Although it still felt a bit noisy, you couldn't really say anything when people complimented you. To be honest, you felt a bit embarrassed. At the same time, Tenna was praising you from the side, making you look like a peerless genius or a one-of-a-kind immortal with extraordinary abilities, which made you feel a bit embarrassed.
If you keep talking, it will get outrageous. Anyway, you cough heavily twice: "Alright, Mr. Tenna, I know I'm very strong, you don't need to say any more." ”
…… As for the previous ones, you just can't accept them without a conscience.
"Oh, anyway, you're amazing—no wonder you're my star." After saying this, he fell silent again.
You might actually be a bit curious why he keeps calling you that—but, well, so what if you know the answer? You also know, none of this is real. Maybe the happiness of this moment is real.
Because you really are happy now—in other words, you're feeling a bit carried away.
However, the next key is a bit trickier. You control your character to the front door, and opening it will probably reveal the key—though you don't know why the key is inside, probably for the sake of a puzzle.
There is a Huarong Road puzzle on this door. It takes you some effort to retrieve the key containing the door from the only exit, open the door, and then obtain the second key.
"Oh my god, you solved this puzzle in just a short time! It actually took me half an hour to solve this puzzle I had carefully designed!" Tenna's antenna twitched back and forth. I don't know if it's just your imagination or if he's just too excited, but you think he looks a bit higher than before...... A bit taller?
"Ahem, it's nothing to worry about." Honestly, if I keep praising you endlessly, you'll feel really embarrassed......
But you don't know what to say to stop him, so fine, just pretend you didn't hear him!
Ignoring your excitement, you're heading toward the next location. Honestly, you feel like this game is packed with a lot of content; otherwise, why would the next scene be a book, and you have to collect all sorts of materials to forge a key!
…… You suspect you've been set up by this game. It's a little trick to extend playtime and prevent refunds—definitely true. You glance at Tenna out of the corner of your eye. Unfortunately, you can't see anything—after all, he has no eyes and always wears the same smile.
Well, for some reason, even though you've probably arrived in another world, you don't feel sleepy, so just hurry up and finish it!
The game character runs toward the first collectible. This is fine—just help with the gathering task, and the NPC will give you the corresponding item, even though this NPC looks like just a bouncing dice.
The first collectible is in the backpack. When you get to the second item, the NPC regretfully tells you that this item is currently unavailable and may need to help him collect something first, then make another one.
So after collecting, is it still collecting? You sneered. Although you were holding back your anger, you still worked hard and went to collect. Fortunately, there were no more tasks this time, so you just had to run around and get the items properly.
With that, you can get the second collectible smoothly. The NPC happily gives you a saxophone segment, but as for collecting other items...... Actually, Tenna translated it for you.
He was probably watching your expression cautiously, while trying to keep his voice high: "My dear star, it's a pity he doesn't have any materials left! Maybe you'll need to find all the materials elsewhere first......"
In short, you didn't answer that question, just puffed out your cheeks and controlled the game characters.
The third collectible, which is the last one, is in a secret room, so at least you don't have to run errands for NPCs. But—why?! The door to this secret room is a rotating puzzle. Once you solve it, the next door is a piece-together puzzle, which isn't difficult. The next door is actually a pure white puzzle?
You have reason to suspect there are more puzzles ahead—not endless, but definitely draining your patience and energy.
You put down your game controller and sighed, "I'm a bit tired. Can I stop playing for now?" I want to rest for a while. ”
"Oh what—you don't want to play anymore? Is the game not fun? Should I switch to a different one for you? Or should I play a different show for a while? Anything is fine—" The antenna bounced again, and you thought it was actually pretty fun, like something startled and startled.
"No—I mean, I don't want anything, I just want to be alone, do nothing, find a sofa quietly? Or a bed? Lie down for a while." "You dragged out the sound, emphasized the pitch, emphasized those few words, you believe he definitely heard it, it was clear and clear."
He was quiet for a moment, then spoke rapidly: "Oh, sure, can I do something for you? As long as I can prepare anything, I've got it on my side. Just make a suggestion—"
You sighed, but patiently repeated, "I don't want anything." ”
"And, I don't know how I came to this world...... Playing games is fun, but I still have to go back to class...... You scratch your head in frustration.
Tenna's screen turned black again. This time, you couldn't see anything, but his voice sounded like he was still laughing, or maybe ...... A bit hysterical?
"You're leaving here? You just need to keep watching TV shows here and keep laughing—are you happy in that world? Isn't it better to stay here? ”
His hand gripped your shoulder tightly. Honestly, you didn't feel well, and you instinctively pressed down on that black screen.
Then you widen your eyes because you see very clearly that on the black screen, the area your hand touches has the same vortex, just like when you arrived. The vortex has the same attraction, pulling you in. You think, maybe through this vortex you can go back.
Tenna seemed stunned too, his hand instinctively loosened, and you gritted your teeth, pulled his hand away, and without hesitation, reached your other hand into the whirlpool.
Before leaving, you only had time to say one more thing: "I am indeed very happy, but—"
Before he could finish, the world spun around—he went back and sat down on the ground.
You press your temples and realize it's only been ten minutes—even though you feel like you've been in there for at least an hour or two.
Staring at the pitch-black TV screen, you still feel shaken. No matter what, you hurry back to your room and sleep.
Of course, the next day you go to class drowsy, and they seem to be chatting about the girl who appeared on late-night TV a couple of days ago, who seems to be a senior from the same school.
Then why is it that what you see is a TV commercial? You just can't figure this out.
Of course, you don't know that the TV commercial actually covered up the murder trailer.
After class, luckily, the high school course wasn't very long. You were about to go to Junis's store to buy something to cook. Just as you were picking out cabbage, you could see boys in the same class whispering something. In front of them was a row of large LCD TVs—after all, Junis was considered one of the town's big stores.
Even though there was no one else around, you still saw them dive into the TV, and the shape of the vortex was exactly the same as the one you'd encountered before.
After hesitating for a moment, you decide to check on TV. You also want to figure out what's really going on.
You found a TV in a different direction, just enough to block your view, and slipped in—it seemed to be the scene of the town, shrouded in white mist, nothing like what you saw that day.
If the TV comes in, you can get out relying on it, right? Turning around, you see three stacked TVs there, all old models. For some reason, you think of the TV at home and the Tenna from last night.
Maybe this isn't a dream, you think.
But when you get home and look at that TV, you hesitate for a moment, just wipe off the dust as usual, and pretend nothing happened.
What exactly are you thinking? You don't know either.

title: Late Night TV Show 2
content:
Tennax, you, hmm, all character settings belong to me (? ）
With the Persona 4 fusion setting, it's okay if you don't know Persona 4! I'm just a pure Photoshop fan.
——
The next day, you still go to school as usual, no different from usual. The only difference is that the senior who appeared on the late-night TV show was found dead hanging from a utility pole, just like a female anchor from a while ago.
Your hand holding the lunchbox trembled, and luckily you didn't fall.
—You recall the completely different world you saw on TV. If it were that foggy world, this would be understandable.
So, did the commercial I saw on TV before, Mr. Tenna, also die because of it? Did he also die because of the late-night TV program previews? Do you think the answer to this question is certainly no? Come on, these are two completely different worlds—how could this happen?
But you wavered, hesitating. Because apart from the game room that day, you hadn't seen anywhere else, and you couldn't be sure the two worlds were completely different—maybe you just hadn't seen them yourself. Honestly, you don't know. To know the exact answer, you'd have to go to that world again.
…… Haha, I guess I was overthinking it. It must be two different worlds. Why did I think he was in danger, and why worry? After all, he definitely wasn't a real person.
Probably.
I worked hard to adjust my mood, spent my class time unremarkably, participated in club activities, went home, had dinner, finished homework, washed up, and went to bed.
This has been the case for several days in a row. Even though you've tried hard to adjust and told yourself that none of this is a problem, you still become increasingly anxious.
…… After all, it's better to fear the unlikely outcome than the ten-thousand-case. So, what about the unexpected? You feel restless because of this.
Another girl in the class has disappeared. You planned to stay out of it, but while shopping at the Junis store, you see your classmates slipping into the TV.
Biting your lip, you take a deep breath. You walk forward in a daze, only to bump into the shelf ahead. Your body falls forward with inertia, and everything goes black before you. In the final scene, you only notice yourself falling into the whirlpool inside the TV.
Cabbages were scattered all over the floor. When you pressed your temples and stood up, you noticed the cabbages were still scattered beside you, and behind you were the same three TVs as before.
Rubbing your tailbone, you look around and prepare to leave, but suddenly pause.
…… This was not the foggy space. Unexpectedly, there was only silence and a faint howling cold wind, and along the narrow road, the phantom of a TV floating in the air.
Maybe it's intuition? You guess you've fallen into that world again. You walk forward, gently push open the door crack, and the blinding light makes you squint your eyes first.
When you recover, wipe away your tears, and look forward again, you only see that huge TV person—well, Mr. Tenna—standing in front of him are a bunch of NPCs you've seen in the game before, and it looks like Tenna is loudly scolding the staff.
Should I leave on my own? Or should I push open the door and walk out? No, no, no, no, I can't really choose to open the door—
You try to close the door and leave, but at that moment, a red one—you think it's probably called pippins—suddenly jumps up, then runs toward the door and pushes it open.
And so, you suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
Run away and then return to those three TVs. Is it still possible to return to your original world? You don't even need to think, just turn around and run. In short, you even covered your face, though doing so probably doesn't help......
But in any case, you start hypnotizing yourself that everything is fine. Unfortunately and desperately, just as you are about to reach the finish line and hope and endless anticipation arise, your shoulder is grabbed, and then hope shatters crisply, with a snap.
You are desperate, truly desperate as a wolf or tiger, always following you like a shadow.
…… Or maybe you just feel a slight fear at this moment? Why is it fear? Panic, confusion, or embarrassment?
You don't know, but you just froze in place, not daring to move, and of course, didn't dare to turn around. You instinctively showed that V-shaped cat-like mouth, feeling cold sweat dripping from your forehead onto the floor. No need to think about it—if he let go, you'd definitely be collapsed on the floor.
No, no, no, this isn't some horror game at all. What exactly are you afraid of, why do you feel guilty? You're still lost in your thoughts, when you hear a somewhat muffled voice behind you.
Or maybe there was a faint, barely noticeable tremor? Normally, you wouldn't notice, but now your nerves are tense, so it's easy to notice.
“…… Now, can you turn around? ”
Out of the corner of your eye, you catch a Pippins making faces at you. You want to sneer, and if you heard correctly, those guys behind you must have let out a sigh of relief!
Helpless, you sighed, puffed out your cheeks, and your voice was muffled, clearly not very happy: "Then could you please let go of my hand first?" ”
You feel the heavy pressure on your shoulders disappear. Even though you haven't turned around yet, you can still imagine the unease and confusion behind you, accompanied by anxious voices: "Oh, I'm really sorry, my star, I just didn't expect ......"
For some reason, you feel like laughing, and luckily you didn't really give out and sit down!! Your image has been preserved, and you can still put on a calm and serious persona in front of Tenna!
You take a deep breath, close your eyes, and suddenly turn around.
You hear his stunned, held breath, the fading sound, the fading footsteps.
You feel the footsteps grow louder and draw closer to you, then your body is tightly embraced, and you fall into a heavy yet warm embrace.
You feel like you can't breathe, open your eyes expressionlessly, and it's wonderful.
His hand seemed to be trembling. You don't know why this happened—can it really have such a big impact after just a few days away?
In any case, you still spoke. Although you coughed several times before speaking, you were so oppressed that you couldn't say anything.
Before you could speak, Tenna's hand loosened and she took a few steps back, unable to tell what he was feeling because the screen went black again.
"Oh, sorry, sorry, it's just that too much time has passed! The game time is about to skyrocket. Hurry up and finish the last round, my star?" ”
That deliberate, high-raised smile again. You can't quite tell what's going on, but since you're here, it's already here...... Let's double-check if there's anything wrong.
Heaven and earth, honestly, you're just afraid that death warning will happen right before your eyes, Mr. Tenna.
No matter what, you don't want to see someone you've interacted with die right in front of you.
Really, that's all.
"Then let's go to the game room first. But let me make it clear: if I'm tired, I'll come rest in the lounge." "Look around here, at least there's a sofa here where you can lie down—you're not picky anyway.
You can clearly see Mr. Tenna, walking ahead, stiffen for a moment, then speed up his speech: "Oh, that's not it—I promise this will definitely be an amazing experience!" You'll get so excited you won't want to stop at all, let alone be so tired you can rest! ”
…… But gaming always gets tiring, right? You really want to say this, but after thinking it over, you might as well forget it and just quietly follow behind.
Haha, at worst it's just a matter of death—better forget that.
Soon, you arrive at the game room. You find the game controller you used last time still there, the walls around you seem a bit old, and you have no idea how much time has passed. The game screen does show a certain duration, which is truly sky-high. At least, you have no intention of calculating how long it is.
Picking up the controller, you still stop at the piece you had puzzled last time. But for some reason, the puzzle you unlocked earlier also went back. You diligently solved the earlier puzzles and looked at the next one—hmm, this time it's the Huarong Road puzzle, it's fine, you're really used to it.
Fortunately, after solving this puzzle, there are no more doors ahead. However, as you control the character and move forward, you'll notice there's still a long road ahead. It's obvious there are other gates ahead, but now all these doors are open. The truth is, it's hard to guess what they're actually going on.
No doubt, Tenna definitely deleted the puzzles from the end. Got the keys. Now there were three keys. Go back and open the tightly locked door, and the game character would enter a new world. This level was basically complete.
The further you go, the darker it gets, but the further you go, there is light. As you control the game character and walk forward, standing at the only bright spot, you can see the torch hanging on the wall. It seems to be a cave, and you can even hear the dripping of water.
Then, not just an illusion, the game's speakers echoed with the roar of monsters, the approaching footsteps, and suddenly a loud, tense and thrilling music playing.
Out of the corner of your eye, you can see Tenna nervously uneasy, probably wondering if you actually like this kind of game. However...... But a chase isn't easy! Anyway, the lights around here are so bright, and there's a Tenna sitting nearby—what is there to be afraid of!
You confidently control your character to run, but there are too many forks ahead, and you always end up in dead ends. Then comes the ghost face and the jumping face. Honestly, at first you were startled by that ghost face, your heart pounding hard many times. But after dying so many times, you become numb. You just memorize the route skillfully, hoping your next escape will go more smoothly.
Haha, being so skilled is truly sad. You're finding joy in hardship thinking that.
Tenna, standing nearby, had been playing on a pitch-black screen since earlier, and I don't know if it's just your imagination, but do you think his figure is ...... Seems to be gradually shrinking?
After you finally get through this chase, the game prompts you to complete the QTE within the time limit and seal three demons, or you'll die.
You ignite the flames of battle with a blank expression. Although it's not overwhelmingly excited, your stubbornness is just here. You must pass this level!
But unfortunately, you have met death once again.
You grit your teeth and prepare to try again. Although you're startled by the ghost face attack once more, it's all fake anyway—it's nothing, right?
Suddenly, your shoulders felt heavy. When you turned around, you realized that Mr. Tenna, who was originally twice your size, had somehow shrunk to your size. The TV's head was resting on your shoulder, and the antenna was drooping. For some reason, it felt like he actually didn't dare to watch such a terrifying game scene.

title: Did the archaeologists dig up a real CRT?
content:
Tennax, you, OOC counts as mine, 3k short play
The inspiration comes from SG's digging (? ) But it has a bit of a snail girl vibe (hmm...... ）
——
Resting your chin on your hand, you look at the replica archaeological soil blocks you take out of the box in front of you, feeling a bit troubled. To be honest, you don't even know why you impulsively bought this—maybe it was because of the description on the box. Although you've always kept your distance from them, this time seeing those exquisite vintage items on them still couldn't resist buying them.
Well, after all, they all look great. You really like collecting these useless but beautiful little items. As for where to store them and where to tidy them up later, that's a matter to decide later!
So when you roll up your sleeves, you feel like you're wearing those red ribbons that represent hard work and hard work. Of course, you really do want to work hard now.
You pick up the small chisel that comes with the soil clod you, and then start digging. But it's really exhausting, and the area is a mess. You think you'll have to clean thoroughly once you're done. Now you regret it—if you'd known, you would've just bought one—it wouldn't have cost so much. Why waste time and energy here? You don't really like this kind of work either.
But hard work pays off! After your relentless efforts, you managed to dig open that inexplicably hard clod of earth, revealing the object buried inside.
You take out that tiny item and take a look, then fall into deep thought. Honestly, it's nothing like the dazzling look on the promotional image. Stunning and extraordinary, it's just a grayish, shrunken CRT model. To be honest, you even feel a bit disappointed, but you still neatly place that tiny CRT model on the table, clean up the useless dust, wash up, and go to sleep, but...... You always have the illusion that the CRT model you placed is flashing when the lights are off?
You glanced over there, but unfortunately, you didn't notice anything unusual. You had no choice but to close your eyes and quietly lie down on the bed and fall asleep.
A dreamless night, but you feel like you always feel restless. This description doesn't seem quite right. Basically, you feel like there's a heavy sensation on your body? It's as if something is pressing down on you, or maybe it's just something heavy holding you? But when you rub your eyes and sit up in bed, there's nothing on the bed or beside you, so you start to suspect you're just feeling allergic.
And maybe it's just your imagination, but when you get dressed and stand up to walk past your desk, you always feel that the CRT model is no longer where you originally placed it. But it's a subtle feeling—after all, it's still there. You just always feel as if it's been displaced a bit.
If all of this was just your imagination, and you were just overthinking it, now you can't fool yourself. Actually, you smelled a delicious aroma outside in the bedroom just now, and at the time thought it was just a hallucination caused by hunger. Now you can't convince yourself anymore. You stare blankly at the bedroom door and look outside, only to find breakfast already set on the table—a meal that looks beautiful, aromatic, and tastes delicious. Probably not knowing your taste, you even prepared a little of everything.
Now it's great—you don't have to prepare your own breakfast, and you can even finish it quickly before heading to school. But who exactly made this breakfast? You sniffed carefully, and the fragrant aroma filled your nose—probably non-toxic. Only after confirming did you feel at ease and start eating. Your stomach, which had been flattened and even aching from hunger, was quickly warmed up, and you even felt a bit full. Reluctantly, you put down the sweet bread and grabbed your backpack to go to school.
…… At noon and evening, when you come back, the food is still piping hot on the table. Could it be that some kind snail girl has come to help you with these things? It's just that you don't believe in such myths, but after thinking for a long time, you can't think of anyone you know who might do such a thing.
After all, you don't have many close friends, and your parents are generous enough to let you rent a place elsewhere. But you don't really know how to cook, so just heating up a meal for yourself is enough.
Now it's great—you don't even have to worry about what you should eat—just follow the dishes this unknown person makes and decide your day's meal! This even cures your decision paralysis. In short, you gratefully put your palms together and say goodbye, though you don't even know who you're praying to.
Only then did you start and happily enjoy the meal.
…… Now you look at everything before you in a somewhat flustered way. You realize you were just thinking too well. Cooking and cleaning were one thing, but why did she even wash your underwear? You watched the underwear hanging on the rack, swaying in the wind, slowly petrify. Then you patted your face, trying hard to wake yourself up.
Alright, so be it, so you don't have to do anything yourself. That's actually a good thing......
But then something even stranger happened. After you finally got used to the food that appeared on the table for no reason, to the inexplicably clean and tidy floor and clothes, and after a while, the weather turned cold. You were anxiously calculating whether you should add more clothes and lay out a thicker quilt. But by the next day, you found the clothes folded and placed at the bedside. When you came back, you found that all the sheets and duvet covers on the bed had been changed—obviously thicker.
You fell silent for no reason, instinctively looking around, but unfortunately, you couldn't see anything unusual—only the CRT model on the table was suspiciously and subtly shifted.
Taking a deep breath, you pat the trench coat you just put on today and decide to hold off for now. At the same time, that curiosity grows day by day. Before, you could pretend not to know and calmly enjoy the service, but now—well, you really want to know who is doing this.
So, even though it was the weekend and you didn't have classes, you still pretended something was going on, grabbed your backpack, and headed out, then hid not far away, quietly watching your house.
Through the window, you see the CRT model on the table jump off the table...... Then it turns into a TV person who's unknown tall, almost reaching the ceiling. Wait, ...... TV person?
You thought blankly for a moment, then quickly accepted the setup. After all, this incident was less impactful than the reality of the CRT model coming to life. In other words, maybe you just misread it. Unfortunately, you rubbed your eyes and realized there was really no difference—everything was the same.
Alright, maybe you just got the hidden model! You comforted yourself like this, then Kan Ze, that TV guy, walked out, picked up a broom that was very small to him, diligently helped sweep and mop the floor, and then went into the kitchen, looking like he was hesitating about what to do.
After hesitating for a moment, you tiptoed back and suddenly opened the door. The TV guy who had been in the kitchen was caught red-handed by you. His body stiffened, and then, trying to run straight back to your room, he turned back into that tiny CRT model, pretending nothing had happened and that you hadn't seen anything.
You hurried forward, then grabbed his arm, trying not to let him slip back—forgive you, his hand was just too big, you couldn't hold on.
"So, you've been the one doing all these things these days?"
He hesitated for a moment, but still turned his back to you, but nodded.
"Oh...... So, what's your name? "After all, you can't call her that by 'TV person' or something, that's just too rude!
"Ah, me? I'm Mr. Tenna, the most popular host! Uh...... Although I probably don't think that's the case now. "When asked for his name, he instinctively straightened up, his voice rising, and turned to face you. Maybe it was just my imagination—otherwise, you'd think he could hold a microphone in his hand."
You nodded: "Alright, I understand. So why have you been doing these things these days, Mr. Tenna?" Although I also like the feeling of these things being mysteriously done, don't you need nothing in return? ”
He was probably stumped by your question, not responding in the first few minutes, and you patiently waited for his answer. After all, you still had plenty of time and didn't mind spending that little time.
“…… After all, I have to thank you for rescuing me from where I used to be! You know, I was trapped there for a long time......
As he starts rambling about his past experiences, you get a bit distracted and realize, 'So he really got a hidden version for himself.'
But driving the hidden model feels pretty good?
"But what kind of return do you think you need...... Maybe I don't need too much? I just need you to keep looking at me, always watching me. Always ...... Always letting your gaze be on me. ”
Originally, you were supposed to look up at him, but now, Tenna is looking you in the eye. I don't know why he can still shrink back, but he's probably saying things with utmost seriousness.
You tilted your head slightly, as if thinking for a moment, then watched him grow more and more nervous and helpless, his hands behind his back probably pinching his fingers or clothes, feeling uneasy.
So you smiled faintly, held his hand, and shook it twice: "Sure, of course you can. I'm watching you all the time, and I will in the future. Actually, I've been watching you all along...... Actually, I've been watching you all along. ”
Now, you are seated at the table and begin enjoying today's lunch. It will be like this in the future.
End.

title: Adventurerror1 (tennax you)
content:
You feel dizzy and lightheaded; you clearly remember that you seemed to have just fallen asleep...... Logically, you should have fallen into darkness and then woke up, but why is it that now, when you fall into the darkness, a new light appears before your eyes?
It's simply baffling...... You muttered, thinking this way, but you ended up saying it out loud. After you said it, you were stunned. You tentatively moved your arms and legs, and it actually moved freely according to your will. It didn't look like a dream; instead, it felt like you had entered another world, because...... Because when you looked down, you realized you had changed into a different outfit.
It was a set of light armor, looking like medieval knightly decorations, mostly white with some deep blue fabric accents...... It felt like some hero's outfit had been combined with the noblewoman's attire, which looked a bit odd. Then you noticed a sword sheath at your waist, and when drawn, it was a rather rustic longsword. Not only that, you also heard surrounding music that seemed to be Celtic-style surrounding view?!
Obviously, your complaint was overheard, and then you heard a 3D surround sound echoing endlessly, kind of ...... It was like some kind of broadcast voice, probably trying to sound tense, but still carrying a slightly sticky smell. You even seemed to hear a hint of grievance: "How is this weird...... This is a scene I carefully crafted! ”
You startled and instinctively look around, trying to figure out where the voice was coming from. Unfortunately, it looked like some kind of initial character spawn location...... It was just an empty wooden cabin with nothing at all.
“…… Who are you? "You tried hard to stay calm, and now you don't even know where you are.
And that voice was very lively, seeming somewhat excited: "Ah... this honorable, shining people of light, I am MR.(ANT)TENNA!! Very pleased to meet you, I just knew that there would definitely be people of light who would like my game!"
You feel like he can keep rambling...... For some reason, that's just how you feel, so you quickly raise a hand to make a pause gesture: "Stop, stop, stop...... Stop talking, now tell me, where am I? ”
The voice faltered for a moment, sounding a bit frustrated because you interrupted it, so much so that the volume was lowered: "...... This is the dark world generated from the game I developed. I sincerely thank the guest who created this dark fountain—namely—you!" As his words fell, I wonder where the spotlight inside this cabin came from, shining on you.
You show a half-moon eye, point at yourself: "Me?" And what's with your sudden light? This doesn't make sense at all......
As your words fell, the surroundings seemed to quiet down. You almost thought this guy had disappeared, just as you were about to say something...... The voice rang out again, this time with a tone of panic: "It seems the data was called incorrectly...... This should have been the backstage for welcoming guests! Not this little cabin, where did this cabin even come from...... His voice grew quieter, sounding a bit like a rambling. You wanted to ask more questions, but you couldn't help but say, "Is your game reliable? Do you really know how to design games?" ”
The volume suddenly rose: "Of course I will!! How simple is that? It's just integrating several data points and calling them up......! ”
In fact, Tenna...... was sweating profusely as he accessed the data in front of him, which he had no idea what it was. Well, although he could understand a little, he was not sure about the actual effect. He was only judging what the code was used for based on the situation on site.
He didn't follow the purple girl's advice, was taken to their territory, nor sent to a new home. He just ...... Stayed here, ignored by anyone. But he couldn't let himself remain unnoticed forever, so he started trying to piece together those seemingly old-fashioned codes. Maybe after the new show airs, the People of Light will return. Look, a Citizen of Light has already appeared!
“…… Alright, you said you could do it, so why do you say this dark world was created by me? "You sighed, deciding not to dwell on the game's issues, since your initial spawn location has already ...... Uh, it's changed. Specifically, the backstage scene Tenna mentioned is stuck with the current cabin scene, and it looks like it's been molded through. Although you can write code...... But you wouldn't tell Tenna exactly what he wrote wrong.
"As long as you pierce the earth with willpower, you can create a dark fountain...... That's probably what it looks like, and you did it in your dream! "His voice sounded cheerful, but after you listened, all you knew was...... Uh, you really brought yourself into this place now.
Your mouth twitched as you coldly watched the scene before you freely mold the mold, then turned into a cabin. In the end, you couldn't help but say, "Oh my god, do you even know how to code?" ”
"I will, of course I will! Just change this string of code!" ”
Along with his words, you also hear the sound of keyboards tapping, followed by a puzzled face because he probably pressed Enter, and the small cabin around you disappeared...... The next second, you fell into the dark underground with a puzzled face. And he probably didn't set up an air wall, nor did he know what he did. In any case, you kept falling, the surroundings pitch black, and with gravity, you kept slowly spinning around.
You couldn't help but raise your voice: "You—this—fixed—a bug, right!!" "You really doubt how you could create such a dark world, even though you really want to play games, because being alone at home every day is too boring, and you really want someone to play with you...... But, but no one told you you'd end up like this?! You don't want to play a game full of bugs either?!
"I-I'm fixing it...... Uh, um, what does a bug mean? "That voice still lingers around you, making you feel like some kind of game narration, and his voice sounds a bit panicked.
You cross your arms, this time showing a deadpan gaze: "You don't even understand what a bug is?" You...... Are you an antique? ”
…… It felt as if the other side had been stabbed, and for a moment, they didn't say a word.
You take a deep breath: "Alright, a bug is ...... Hmm, it means an internal fault in a program. Because a bug itself means a little bug, it's like a bug inside the program that has bitten a hole. You should understand this meaning, right? ”
Tenna's voice still sounded a bit disappointed: "I...... Got it, well, really got it...... Right, um, what's your name? "He spoke a bit awkwardly, changing the subject, and you still fell expressionlessly into this pitch-black pit.
"Me?" Y/N。 Isn't it more important to get me out of this state than the trivial issue of my name? Is your game just a program that keeps making me fall? That's really boring." "Being stuck in this situation all the time has made you a bit angry, and your words have become a bit stiff. After saying that, you start to regret it again; your tone seems a bit too harsh, and the other side ...... It has nothing to do with you, you don't need to say that.
But before you can make amends, Tenna has already spoken. His voice sounds a bit awkward, yet he deliberately laughs loudly: "Ahahahaha...... This is just a small accident! Dear star, our game is definitely not like this; there are still many exciting things ahead worth exploring! "Along with this sentence was the sound of him rapidly tapping on the keyboard.
"Since it's just a minor accident, could you put me back on the ground again?" You said calmly.
“…… I don't know how to do this, what should I do? "At this moment, his voice was so soft, it was as if he was speaking right next to your ear. You instinctively turned your head to look, but you didn't see anyone beside you. You really wondered where Tenna was.
"You can just design a death routine for the drop, or send my character's target directly to the starting point. Your voice is still calm, and you even yawned...... Wait, can you yawn even in your sleep?
You listen to Tenna tapping on the keyboard, then his voice turns frustrated: "Seems useless...... I clearly wrote death programs for you. ”
You press your temples, feeling your head throbbing up and down...... You honestly have no idea why this guy writes game programs—it's obviously bad.
"Alright, if it doesn't work, just rewrite my coordinates to the starting point. You know how to write this, right?" But you were still patient, since if this was a dark world you created, not just a dream...... Uh, then you probably don't need to expect to wake up right away. If you can move freely, that means your old practice of forcing yourself to wake up through physical movements is no longer effective...... So you have to find a way to find the end, so you should be able to leave.
You didn't hear his voice, only a string of keystrokes. Then, your vision blurred, and you glanced over. Finally, you stopped falling. Behind you was that wooden house, and you seemed to have returned to your birthpoint.
…… Well, the adventure has probably officially begun.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror2 (tennax you)
content:
You look around at the surroundings. After leaving the cabin, you're greeted by a vast forest...... Hmm, it looks pretty well in line with the setting, but when you turn back to look at the cabin, you can't help but twitch your mouth, because you see that backstage and cabin are still mixed together as if they've been molded, making it look like Tenna is doing her best to modify the code—just don't know what she actually made.
So you can't help but complain: "Do you still need to keep modifying the spawn code code?" It looks like you've already written a mess. ”
That voice quickly answered you: "I...... Uh, of course, I'll be able to fix it soon! Don't worry, Y/N! "As he spoke, you felt as if his typing speed on the keyboard had gotten faster...... After all, his speed had been very slow before, sounding like he was typing letter by letter, and you didn't even know how long it took him to finish writing this program.
"Alright, then what do you plan to change it to?" You crossed your arms and asked leisurely.
"Change it to ...... Change it to, still the little cabin from the beginning." You seem to hear him sigh...... Probably in a bad mood, feeling a bit down, as he pressed the last button, only the cabin remained before you.
You shrugged, turned around, and walked toward the forest...... It looked like there was only a single passageway, and as you set out, you asked, "Well, this looks like an RPG, so what's my mission?" "After all, you've looked around now, and it doesn't seem like a typical game with a guide box or anything...... Your field of vision is empty, nothing at all.
Normally, the game would at least display a quest guide in the top left corner, right?
"Ah...... Ah, right, I forgot to tell you the task! Why doesn't this scroll guide pop up on its own? I've clearly written the program...... Tenna's second half of his sentence sounds like he was talking to himself, and he really did call a...... A scroll that looks like a hologram for you.
You show your half-moon eyes and watch the scroll slowly scroll upward. The story is quite old-fashioned, probably about a long, long time ago, there was a saint or something...... Then the scroll got stuck.
It's stuck?? Does the holographic image get stuck too?? You widened your eyes in disbelief, pointed at the scroll in front of you, and began loudly questioning Tenna: "What do you mean? Why is the holographic image still freezing? Hey, hey, is the network not working well or what? It can't be that your code is wrong again......"
You hear him chuckle awkwardly: "Uh, that's right...... I wrote it wrong again, but I designed this holographic screen to be touchscreen! So you can scroll down yourself, as long as you finish reading this scroll, that's enough! "His voice sounded a bit guilty, but more likely...... Excited? You don't know exactly what he's getting excited about, just speechlessly showing half-moon eyes and manually dragging the scroll down. You don't know what kind of spelling he made a mistake, but the area that should be displaying the image next is completely gone, just a bunch of mosaics...... And for some reason, the scroll has all sorts of messy, even constantly jumping WordArt and bizarre puns...... In short, you put in a lot of effort and half a day of time, and finally managed to interpret this story.
Probably a long, long time ago, the land was ravaged by the Demon King—then heaven sent a saint to descend to earth, seal the Demon King, and leave behind a sacred relic to protect the survival of the kingdom. But recently, the seal was loosened and the Demon King emerged. The Demon King had four great apostles under his command, and one of them stole the kingdom's sacred relic. The monsters began to invade the human world. At this moment, a hero stepped forward, about to reclaim the relic and eliminate the Demon King...... And the hero entrusted with a great mission and obtained the holy sword is you, the participant in the game.
After reading this scroll, you pulled out your sword and looked at it. No matter how you looked at it, it was just an ordinary sword...... You couldn't help but ask, "So where is the Holy Sword? Don't tell me...... Uh, the sword in my hand is the Holy Sword? And where am I going next? Could it be that I'm going straight to the Demon King to fight? Where is the Demon King? ”
As you spoke, you swung the sword in your hand again. Clearly, it was just scrap metal.
"Uh...... Wait, I didn't give it to you directly? "His voice was a bit flustered, and you heard the sound of typing on the keyboard again, probably ...... Yeah, he was probably checking the code he had written. You ignored him and just walked forward on your own, then you heard his voice again: "Oh, I get it...... The scroll I gave you seems to be incorrect. That holy sword wasn't handed to you directly; you had to visit the king first. The king only handed it over to you after he confirmed your abilities. After all, the holy sword is a treasured treasure among them...... He rambled on, and you nodded absentmindedly, continuing forward through this seemingly endless forest.
"Alright, so which direction is my current destination?" You haven't even done a single quest guide, so having no map function is one thing...... And according to what you said, the Holy Sword is also a sacred artifact? So what exactly was stolen from them? Or am I the Demon King? "Your questions are a string of things, since you really can't understand what he's thinking...... If you had to judge, it's that the game code and story he wrote are basically just bugs.
You hear that voice and cough twice: "Well, actually, it's been stolen...... It's part of a TV, which is part of me! ”
…… For a moment, you don't know whether to first complain that the game's creator is just a TV, or if the stolen part of it is just a part of it.
You just keep your half-moon eyes and dryly ask, "Alright, so what exactly was stolen?" ”
"It's the antenna on top of the TV—that would make the signal reception better." In fact, this country is actually technologically advanced, and everyone in the kingdom loves watching TV. If they can't watch TV, people in this country would feel life is worse than death. And the king preserved Fa Zheng, one of the top technologies in television development. Without this antenna, the country would be doomed! ”
…… You feel like this story was just made up by him, and thinking this way, you simply ask: "So this story was actually made up by you, right?" ”
You hear him seem to choke for a moment, then awkwardly chuckle twice: "How could that be?" ”
But in fact, Tenna was a bit guilty; this story was just something he made up...... But he did have a model of this country; he just needed to modify the treasure, turn it into a TV...... Yes, he really hoped everyone could love TV and watch it. Isn't that a very simple wish?
While thinking this, he revised the code to replace the traditional medieval country that existed in this RPG world with a model of a modern city he had just collected.
"Alright, then tell me, without an antenna, scientists in this country can still rebuild it, right?" You shrug.
He paused, then spoke rapidly, "It's the Demon King. Another apostle under the Demon King has abducted all the scientists in this kingdom!" ”
You honestly don't know how to comment on this story, just complaining, "Ah, then honestly, just rescue all these scientists, right?" Speaking of which, for scientists, is that really ...... Uh, is there really no security at all? Logically, scientists with such top-notch technology should be well protected, right? ”
"Uh, one of the Demon King's apostles is skilled at disguise, taking on the appearance of another person, and even mimics every move...... He transformed into a high-level security staff member at the institution where the scientists worked, then issued an emergency evacuation order and immediately took all the researchers away! "It sounds like he's just racking his brains to write stories, his voice stammering. You've walked a long way forward before he finally answers your question completely.
For some reason, you think listening to him make up stories like this is actually quite fun...... At least you want to tease him a little, so you continued, "Alright, so what comes next? What's next?" ”
Maybe it's because you didn't question it...... Tenna stopped racking his brains to make things up; he just continued stammering, "Uh...... Well, that, anyway, the Demon King kidnapped these scientists too! That's about it, Hero, let's set off now!! ”
"Yeah, I'm on the way, but you don't have a single task guide. Where am I supposed to go?" You shrugged again. Tenna glanced at the code he wrote and your current state, hesitating for a moment...... Uh, he really didn't write a task guide. He awkwardly tapped the code and added an arrow...... He was manually controlling it.
"Yes, let's head in this direction!" He declared confidently, the arrow pointing toward the kingdom. He thought, this is definitely the right thing to do!
And you glance in the direction the big red arrow points to...... Well, very good, it's actually tall bushes and trees.
With crescent eyes, you point at these plants: "Do you mean I want to fly over them?" ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror3 (tennax you)
content:
Tenna glanced at what you said, then at the direction the arrow pointed to, cleared her throat twice, and adjusted the position of the arrow she was holding...... Well, he just fiddled with it with his hand, then whispered, "Alright, this direction must be fine now!" He said this with absolute confidence, but you can't say whether what he said was true or false...... After all, you don't know how to go, and this arrow, which seemed to have been manipulated by someone, now pointed toward the path you came from.
You mutter, "Is this the right direction?" "This is clearly the route you came from, isn't it?" Even though you think that, you don't directly criticize Tenna.
Tenna just swore confidently, "Just follow the arrow, that's absolutely right!" ”
You remain skeptical, but still follow the direction the arrow points to. In the end, you do arrive at your destination—the little house at the spawn point. Well, this isn't the place you wanted to reach?!
You looked exasperated: "Congratulations, you used your navigation to bring me back to the spawn point. Where should we go now? Could it be that the so-called Demon King is actually inside this shabby little cabin?" You spoke with a half-mocking tone, Tenna's voice sounding a bit flustered: "Ah, that's not it...... Yes, I set the location wrong. Wait a moment, I'll reset the navigation!" "You heard the sound of frantically typing on the keyboard...... Hmm, you have no idea what Tenna is doing, but you watch as the arrow keeps being fiddled with, then points in another direction.
You turn around, good, this time it seems to be the right direction...... It points to a nearby path. Even so, before stepping forward, you still double-check: "Are you sure this direction is correct?" ”
"Definitely right! No problem at all. If you don't believe me, Y/N, try it!" His voice was filled with cheers.
You shrugged, neither agreeing nor disagreeing, just changing the subject: "Alright, I'm a bit hungry now. Can you tell me where I can eat?" Look, the food bar you set has already dropped to thirty. "You pointed to the bottom right corner of your screen...... Uh, or rather, the bottom right corner of your vision, after that arrow appeared, the task index finally appeared in the upper left corner. Of course, the bottom right also showed health value, mana value, and satiety value, similar to a normal game...... But normal games don't have a food rating value.
"There are no ingredients in the forest that can restore satiety...... Uh, wait a moment, I'll write some code. "Tenna's antenna drooped. Normally, by this time you'd have arrived in the kingdom, which naturally has restaurants and such, but you...... Despite his misguided navigation and a series of operations, he was still stuck at the spawn point.
You crossed your arms and waited for a moment, then a set of tables and chairs appeared in front of you, with a set meal on it. You couldn't tell what this was, all you knew was...... Uh, that set meal actually had a long ice cream cone standing upright, looking like a nose...... Although it should be an ice cream cone, it was placed upside down, oozing a lot of pinkish-purple liquid, and there was a very strange smiling face on it. You silently stared at the lunch he had conjured, making a puzzled sound: "Is this thing really edible?" ”
"Of course—of course you can eat! Don't worry, just enjoy it to your heart's content, it tastes great!" His voice sounded a bit urgent, with a hint of guilt...... Hmm, you probably didn't get it wrong.
Anyway, still skeptical, you roll your eyes and then enjoy the ...... Well, lunch.
Then you hear his voice, almost like a full, announcer: "Y/N enjoyed her lunch, and she was determined to set out again to set out on the journey to defeat the Demon King. She knew that by following the arrow's guidance, she could get one step closer to the Demon King—"
You can't stand it anymore and reach out to make a pause gesture: "Stop, stop, stop, why are you starting to be a narrator?" ”
“…… This was exactly the job I wanted to do...... But there were quite a few unexpected things before," Tenna's voice sounded very soft, then he raised his voice, "but I think this feels really comfortable!" See, with the narrator's guidance, your adventure will definitely go much more smoothly! ”
“…… Not necessarily, but maybe. "You shrugged, remaining skeptical, and simply got up and walked forward. This time, it seemed you were walking on the right path, because you saw that the arrow pointed ahead to a wide area.
Tenna's voice sounded even more enthusiastic. You suspected he just liked playing this way, but you had no proof: "Y/N followed the arrow along the wide forest road. The arrow's guidance was flawless, with no mistakes at all. Just follow the directions to complete your task and you'll receive a reward—" And he seemed to boast about how good his navigation skills really were.
You stayed silent, but decided to interrupt him, and couldn't help but complain, "Why do you always sound like your narrator is praising yourself...... Uh, and what exactly are you talking about rewards? ”
"No, no, no, I'm just realistically evaluating the system I made—uh, about this, the rewards, that's a secret!" Tenna certainly wouldn't tell you that the reward he gave the Light Folk was the right to watch TV forever—well, of course, he could give himself to the Light Citizens, but of course, he wouldn't tell you the truth.
Your half-moon eyes just shrugged: "Alright." ”
Narrator...... That is, Tenna. After a brief quiet, you keep walking forward. Then you notice a monster suddenly emerging from the nearby bushes. It looks like something Tenna mentioned as a monster. You try to dodge, but are pulled into battle.
…… And it seems to be a turn-based battle. You find it a bit strange, but you're on the initiative, so you raise your sword, instinctively wanting to strike—and then the tip bursts forth with flames.
Your sword casts a fireball, landing straight on the monster, and then you KO the monster—you win.
You glanced at the sword in confusion: "Uh...... This design is pretty nice, like casting spells with a sword. "You sincerely praised Tenna, since this was your first time trying to be a mage with a sword.
But for some reason, Tenna's voice sounded muffled: "That's not what I meant...... The sword should just be a sword, right? Ah, I wrote the code wrong. "His voice sounded a bit awkward.
Your eye twitched as you walked forward and asked, "What did you write wrong?" ”
“…… I wrote the list of skills that can be used with the sword as the list of skills that can be used with the staff...... "It sounds like some kind of sincere attitude of admitting fault."
You sighed, "Alright, this is pretty interesting...... You don't need to revert it, let's do it this way." As you spoke, you swung the sword in your hand, and the tip of the sword spat out another burst of flame. Immediately after, your sword tip sprayed a stream of water, extinguishing the spark. You noticed that using spells consumes mana, but mana regenerates over time.
You walk forward carelessly, as if there are no other obstacles ahead, the view ahead opens up, and you—as you move forward, you kick a stone.
The system says your HP is -1, and before you can complain that it also takes health, you're pulled into battle. Now, you're facing a rock.
…… You fell silent. You didn't hear Tenna's voice, probably because he was too guilty to speak. Then you spoke: "What on earth is going on?! Am I so fragile that I get paronychia just from kicking a stone? Why do I still lose health?! Does that mean I kicked ten stones and I'm dead?! After all, I only have 10 health points!! And why can stones pull me into battle? What exactly did your code say? Do I automatically enter battle when I'm injured?! "Your voice is a bit frantic, after all, you have no idea how to defeat a stone.
"Yes, uh... sorry, it was my code that was wrong. I wrote it so that losing health would automatically trigger combat, but with stones as enemies... ah..." tenna found the code he had written, and tenna felt a bit guilty and didn’t dare to make a sound. He had classified stone creatures as enemies, but he didn’t distinguish between ordinary stones and stone creatures, so ordinary stones were also judged as enemies. However, he had written their health values and the code to defeat them based on stone creatures, and as for ordinary enemies... of course, he hadn’t written any code for that.
He awkwardly didn't dare to speak, and for now didn't dare to say any more nonsensical narration, while you cast Fireball, Water Orb, and Lightning spells...... Hmm, a series of spells, but it seemed to have caused no damage to the stone. The stone, still a stone, still standing there.
"Alright, I know this must be another bug you wrote up. I don't care about that anymore, but can you give me a way to defeat it? Or just write it down? If this keeps up, I'm afraid I'll starve to death." You said sarcastically, and Tenna's awkward laughter reached your ears: "Wait, wait, I'll write you a Noble Phantasm that can defeat enemies invincibly. It'll be in your backpack soon......"
You opened your backpack and checked, and sure enough, there was an extra piece of paper. You took it out and glanced at it, then couldn't help but recite: "...... I love TV. ”
And then the battle was won? You quit the fight?? You have no idea what's going on.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror4 (tennax you)
content:
A gust of wind blew by, only ruffling your messy hair and the small stones in the forest that, for some reason, were carried by the wind... And yet you heard tenna's voice acting, and you felt he was hardly even acting. His voice was exaggerated, with an inexplicable sense of joy: "Y/N, with the help of MR.(ANT)TENNA, successfully defeated the monster in front of them! As expected, tenna, who gives all the instructions, knows everything, has foresight, and is certainly a master in this world! And Y/N is also wise and mighty..."
You can't help but interrupt him: "Stop, stop, stop, stop bragging like this. Can't we just focus on solving the challenge in front of us?" ”
“…… Oh. "You see a muffled text appear in the air, and his voice sounds muffled, probably...... It's because you interrupted him, and he seems unhappy.
You shrugged, not really minding the matter, just sheathed your sword and continued forward. On the road ahead, you didn't encounter any other monsters. The arrow pointed straight ahead, and the area ahead grew even more spacious, until you left the forest and stood at the edge of the soil...... Because you saw a city ahead, but you had to first overcome the obstacle before you could get there.
Calling them obstacles is just a few jumping fun. You used to always play 2D parkour, but this is your first time playing 3D...... You feel a bit eager to try, but just as you walk toward the edge of the cliff, you see the arrow suddenly descending for some reason.
You silently stared at the arrow, then silently at the city ahead. Finally, you pointed at the arrow and asked, "What does this mean? Does it mean I'm going into the water?" Although my armor isn't heavy, I can't float up in the water. Wouldn't I be drowning...... You muttered to yourself. Tenna, who had been busy rewriting code for the objects in the city you were about to reach, quickly turned to look, only to realize that the code he had written for the arrow was timed...... When the time came, the arrow naturally fell.
Tenna cleared her throat twice, choosing to manually hold the arrow to direct the signal. The arrow pointed forward again: "Ahem, this was just a small accident. It's fine now......"
Then he suddenly raised his voice, and his voice shifted to a loud voice: "Y/N knows the arrow's direction is absolutely correct. As long as you follow the arrow's direction forward, you can reach the kingdom, obtain the holy sword, and then set out to defeat the Demon King—"
You raised a hand to ask, interrupting him: "Wait, so I'm the only one going to hunt the Demon King? Do I not even have teammates?" ”
Tenna's voice faltered for a moment, then he changed his pitch, switching to a low, sneaky tone and quietly asked you, "Uh, then, what other team members does a hero need?" He whispered, probably not wanting to ruin the grand atmosphere he had created in his previous broadcast voice.
"At best, it's a swordsman responsible for physical damage, a mage for magic damage, a heavy knight for holding damage at the front, and a mage for healing. That's how this is usually done in typical RPGs...... Uh, of course, I can handle the first three tasks by myself, but I don't have healing spells, so at least give me a healer teammate, right? "You sound pretty convinced and analyzed it for him. Anyway, you're a swordsman who deals magic damage now...... Uh, I'm not sure if this is a universal weapon.
"Uh...... Alright, I understand. "Tenna's voice sounded a bit guilty. Listening to him tapping on the keyboard, you couldn't tell what he was doing.
But tenna...... In fact, he was working on the town code he hadn't finished writing earlier. He was turning all the paintings in the townspeople's homes or the wall decorations into TVs...... Hmm, he would definitely fix them before you arrive in town!
Then he cleared his throat and continued in that broadcast tone: "Our warrior Y/N will be appointed by the king in the kingdom about to arrive ahead, and will have his own teammates in the hero squad—this is also the second member of our hero squad. Let's look forward to it!" ”
His voice had a hint of cheering, and you were indeed curious about who the team member he mentioned was...... Is it a Light Clan from the same world as you, or, like Tenna mentioned, a Clan of Darkness in the current world, or is it just a character from the game?
But regardless, the most important thing is to enter earlier and reach the opposite bank of the river...... Arrive at that city. So you look at several grassy platforms above the rushing water ahead. Although you don't know exactly how Tenna did it, you still take a deep breath, move forward, then jump and land—even though it's your first time playing 3D parkour, you know you can land precisely above your destination.
But right after, your vision went black, and then a bright red message 'GAME OVER' appeared before you. Your temples twitched involuntarily. In fact, you didn't fall into the river. Who knows how you died?! Then your vision blurred, and when you looked again, you returned to the spawn point, still in front of the same forest. Looking back, it was the little cabin from the starting point...... Yes, you were instantly back at your starting point.
Take a deep breath, then another deep breath, trying to stay calm. You tell yourself not to get too worked up, that getting angry isn't good for your health...... Well, then you hear Tenna being very cautious. A nervous apologetic voice: "That ...... Y/N, I'm sorry, the code you used to fall in the cabin earlier—I wrote 'death' as 'whereabouts', but for some reason, it didn't work at the time, and instead it worked now...... So you just died......
You pat your forehead and exhale, saying, "It's nothing, but why did I come back here after resurrecting?" "Damn it, this is already the third time you've set out from the spawn point!!
"Uh...... "Hey, I clearly wrote a save point ...... at that spot just now." It was Tenna's voice muttering to himself, along with the sound of typing. You crossed your arms and waited for his answer, then you heard Tenna's voice: "Ah, I wrote the code wrong. I have to stay there for 5 minutes to save...... Sorry, I'll make a timely save for you. If you need to save, just tell me, and I'll save it for you......" His voice sounded a bit submissive, but he also put up a holographic screen floating in front of you, ...... Above it was a strange image of a TV screen, no eyes, only a strangely long nose that looked like it was sticking out its tongue.
You fell silent, not knowing why you thought this image resembled the face you had for lunch today...... Uh, maybe Tenna just liked this look, and you convinced yourself like that. Then you sighed, put your hands on your hips, and asked, "Alright—So, could you take me to the cliff from earlier?" I don't want to run any further, and I think I should have dinner now. Look, my fullness has dropped again. "As you spoke, you pointed to the hunger indicator in the lower right corner of your vision, which showed you are currently at 50 fullness.
You didn't hear Tenna's voice, only the sound of keyboard typing, then your vision blurred, followed by the gentle sound of flowing water—well, you opened your eyes and found yourself back at the very spot where you had just been about to jump.
Immediately after, a table and a chair appeared in front of you, with a steaming hot dish on top. It looked similar to the meal you had at noon, except this time it wasn't shaped like a nose, but a big smile. You took a bite; the dish was salty and tasted pretty good—after you finished, your fullness level returned to 90. Looks like you'll need to eat properly three meals a day, even though eating in the game doesn't feel much of a big deal.
You rub your stomach, stand up again, and look at the small platforms ahead, just in case you ask again: "I'll ask again, I have a save here for a save file, right? And you changed the code that dropped it to be dead, right?" ”
"I've changed, I've changed. This time there will definitely be no problem, just rest assured...... You hear Tenna's voice almost nagging.
Then he raised his voice again: "Y/N has once again arrived at the edge of the raging stream. She is certain that following the arrow's guidance, after she jumps over, she can reach the other shore, reach the kingdom, and begin her true adventure—" As you spoke, you also heard the sound of the arrow......
