Uh, I don't know if it's just my imagination, but you keep feeling that the arrow's nose just got a bit bigger. You sigh and still jump forward. Luckily, this time you didn't fall and die. Unfortunately, your running start wasn't enough, and you fell straight into the river, then were washed away by the river...... GAME OVER。
You fell silent, but luckily the save point was here. Then you heard Tenna's voice again: "Oh my god, we really weren't paying attention and fell into the river...... Hero, you have to remember, if you run out of money, you can jump twice in the air, as long as you keep moving in the right direction—"
But you interrupted him again, rolling your eyes: "Got it, got it, you really don't feel pain talking while standing...... This time, there's absolutely no problem!" You half complained, then started running up again, jumping off, and this time finally managed to cross the raging stream and reach the other side.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror5 (tennax you)
content:
When you reach the outside of the city, you take another look. It looks like a medieval castle...... That's probably how it is—it's hard to tell the difference. You guess it's probably just like any RPG—ordinary kings, ordinary villages, ordinary people...... You've seen too many of these games before, so now, you just can't muster much interest. But because you clear this game, you have to figure out your way back, and you're genuinely curious about what the story is like later in Tenna's story. In the end, you still stand in front of the two guards at the city gate.
They raised their spears to block the city gate: "Stop! Who are you?" "Only then did you notice that there was a TV head mark above the gate for some reason...... Uh, well, since Tenna said before that everyone in this kingdom is passionate about television, you can understand that too.
You didn't hear Tenna's voice, and you just made up a reason: "I am a hero—the hero who came to help you recover the sacred relic stolen by the Demon King. I think you should let me in." As you spoke, you drew the sword at your waist and gestured to prove your identity as a hero.
You seem to think something is off about them. You hear the sound of keypads, then the two guards exchange glances and say in unison, "Without the clearance documents, we can't let you through!" ”
…… You suspected that the phrase was used as punctuation by them, but you had no proof. You just tugged at the corner of your mouth, pulled out the paper from the package that said 'I Love TV,' and showed it to them. The two guards read the note, put away their guns, and stood on either side of the city gate, respectfully bowing to you: "So it's the esteemed Hero, I Love TV, welcome to this kingdom. I Love TV. We hope the hero can help us eliminate the Demon King I Love TV soon."
…… Now you can be sure that the words 'I Love TV' have indeed become their punctuation marks, though you don't know what exactly happened. You put away the note and walked toward the city gate, complaining, "Are you a crazy fan of CRT TVs or something?" The image above the city gate is the image of the CRT TV, and you changed their punctuation marks to "I Love TV" too...... You really are scary. ”
You hear him just laugh twice, and his voice is still filled with joy and joy, especially cheerful: "Ah, of course not. Isn't it only natural that I love TV and stuff? They're just doing what they take for granted!" "Of course, Tenna seems a bit too happy. You think he's a bit too happy...... You don't really know why he's acting like this, but you just twitch the corner of your mouth and keep walking forward, the big arrow pointing inside.
But as soon as you enter the city, you notice something odd—all the buildings in this kingdom are modeled after a CRT TV, big or small, basically the same thing. Even the palace castle area is modeled after a CRT TV, just stacked with several TVs of various sizes. The interior probably looks like a normal castle, but it's actually quite fun—this completely overturns your expectations before entering the city. Since you find it quite funny, you can't help but laugh. You think, this game is actually quite interesting...... You're really curious about what bugs will happen next...... No, what else could possibly happen?
You keep walking forward and discover that the crops are also planted with CRT TVs—planting CRT TVs won't get you a bunch of CRT TVs, and there really is an obedient NPC standing nearby watering them, though the badge on this NPC's chest also says 'TV'. You think TVs shouldn't let water in, since you can hear the crackling of electricity—and for some reason, the arrow next to you keeps pointing at this NPC.
"Do you think planting a TV will make a TV grow...... Tell me, did you change the code or make a mistake?" You showed half-moon eyes and quietly asked Tenna, "Good, it seems this NPC hasn't been disturbed by you...... Hmm, you cross your arms, waiting for Tenna to give you an answer.
You listen as Tenna quietly replies to you as well: "I didn't make a code error, I just changed it like this. In a kingdom obsessed with TV, everything should be TV!" ”
…… But wouldn't that mean people would die? People don't live by watching CRT TV. You grumble in your heart, but in the end, you still couldn't say it out loud. You just stepped forward and started talking to the NPC: "Sir, may I ask if the CRT TVs you planted are edible?" "Anyway, the world has already been rewritten by him into something unknown. You might as well give up struggling and come ask this NPC instead."
The old man immediately straightened up when he heard your question, showing a particularly proud expression. At the same time, you also wore a somewhat puzzled expression because you heard what he said: "Oh!" Of course, all of these are edible. I improved the original pumpkin varieties to turn them into the appearance of CRT TVs, so these CRT TVs taste like pumpkins, while those CRT TVs have a different color—the watermelon flavor, and these ...... These branches and leaves hanging on the racks, these little CRT TVs, all smell like grapes. I love them, so I changed the appearance of all these crops to look like TVs. TVs are amazing—they broadcast new programs every day. It's because I watch TV every day that I can grow bountiful harvests year after year. Plus, with TV, I've learned more planting techniques and cooking methods. These are all so practical and perfect for me. Adults, you can try the taste of these crops too...... He started talking nonstop, and as you watch these almost identical CRT TVs, you don't know how he managed to tell them apart. He even praised the TV for a long time—Tenna must be a fan of CRT TVs, right?!
In the end, you interrupted the old man's endless talk: "Stop, stop, stop...... Alright, I understand. Then sir, can I come over to your house for a while? I'm really curious how these crops are made into dishes. ”
The NPC was very enthusiastic: "Of course, let's go now! I think you'll definitely love the taste of these CRT TVs! Oh, and I'll also turn on the TV at home to show you...... I love TV, and I believe you'll love it too! He said this as he carried the hoe toward a household. You twitched the corner of your mouth and followed him into a room that looked like a CRT TV. Fortunately, the room was spacious. He turned on the CRT TV on the counter, which happened to be watching the cooking show. Then the old man slipped into the kitchen. Soon, he brought out a small bowl and handed it to you. Filled with tiny CRT TVs, the old man warmly said, "Look, my grapes are growing really well. Sir, you should eat some too. I guarantee you'll fall in love with the TV after you finish eating." ”
You completely ignored the second half of this NPC's sentence, clearly Tenna had added some strange program to it...... You don't know exactly what it is, and then you pick up a CRT TV with a conflicted expression and put it in your mouth...... These CRT TVs all have that taro-colored exterior, and surprisingly, the taste is actually quite good—definitely juicy...... Uh, grapes with a sweet and sour flavor.
You stayed silent, mechanically maintaining the same motion: tossing that thing—whether it should be called grapes or a CRT TV...... Uh, until the old man brought out a few more dishes, and you glanced at them—good news, all pixelated, through which you could see a glimpse of the CRT TV...... The old man looked happy, while you just kept moving mechanically and ate the food. Hmm, you did taste the pumpkin, and the dish next to it seemed to have winter melon ribs...... Well, at least your appetite improved! You finished your meal mechanically, then said goodbye to the old man and walked out of his house hand and foot.
Only when you're sure the NPC shouldn't hear do you quietly ask Tenna, "What are you thinking? The crops from those CRT TVs are actually edible?" Don't you think that's a bit strange...... Anyway, I feel terrible right now. "You mumble and complain, not very happy. Even though you admit the taste is pretty good, it's just too strange!
"But it looks great, you have to admit that, and people here all love eating CRT TV crops...... They clearly taste great, what's so strange about that!?" "He's probably arguing his case, even though you can't see any reason.
You still want to argue with him, but you happen to pass by an abandoned appliance recycling station and casually kick into an abandoned CRT TV.
Then a mechanical notification sounds in your ear: "The CRT TV has joined the Brave Squad and become your teammate. Let's congratulate you!" From now on, let's work hard and fight side by side! ”
Your expression is completely cracked. Putting aside why there are abandoned CRT TVs in this country—you certainly don't know this is an Easter egg Tenna wrote, because even if he's abandoned now, he has no home, and he can't find his way home.
The first thing you want to loudly question is: "Why can a CRT TV become my teammate?!! "And this really is a bulky TV that can't move. You can't leave your teammate for more than 25 meters, meaning you have to figure out how to move along with this CRT TV."
"Are you doing this on purpose or not? You must have written the wrong code again?!!" You start to lose your mind, because after trying it, you can't even lift this bulky TV.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror6 (tennax you)
content:
You stared angrily at the TV, clearly unhappy...... You heard Tenna's panicked voice: "Uh, I did write code for your teammate NPC...... Wait, I wrote this code on this TV...... He really did it unintentionally...... He originally planned to write a castle guard as your teammate, but when he was coding, he probably serially wrote it to the TV above the trash bin.
His voice gradually faded, since he did feel a bit guilty...... He hadn't written the code wrong on purpose; he was just not careful: "How about I swap your teammates?" ”
“…… Whatever, just remove this teammate for me. I don't really need that." You refused so easily, as if all your previous expectations for teammates had completely disappeared...... Although maybe it's a good thing that these expectations have disappeared.
You hear the sound of keyboard tapping again, and after a while, Tenna's voice comes back up, sounding a bit awkward: "Uh, um...... I think I can't delete a teammate from your team anymore. You just need at least one teammate in your team to be able to do it. ”
You feel the veins on your forehead throb, and you don't understand how this has become so troublesome now—"Alright, just delete the teammate or replace them. Anyway, just move this old, useless TV away!" ”
“…… Oh, I get it. "You don't know why Tenna's voice suddenly turned depressed, but he knows it clearly...... He's actually just an old TV at the recycling station, something nobody wants, just an old TV...... Until today, he finally got the only audience he'd seen for countless days, and only today, the only Light Citizen. He didn't know if you'd want to experience this game, and he felt anxious—because he didn't know what you'd think of him or the game he created. Maybe...... Maybe you don't really like this game, otherwise why would you keep arguing with him?
His mood was a bit low, but you didn't know. You just crossed your arms and waited, while Tenna looked at the code he could barely understand, and thought—he intended to come to your side.
He wants to get close to the People of Light, or rather...... He longs for your evaluation, he wants you to still need this place, to write this code. Even if you might not need it, that doesn't matter—he just hopes ...... To occupy a small, small place in your heart.
So Tenna hesitated for a moment, his fingers trembling a little, nearly typing characters several times, but in the end, he typed the entire line of code...... He entered his own string of code, meaning he replaced the old TV beside you with himself. Tenna swallowed hard, feeling an indescribable gravity. Then, the view went pitch black and brightened again, and you were surprised to find a TV person standing right in front of you.
Tenna turned on the screen and found himself standing in front of the abandoned recycling station. He had replaced the TV and stood in front of you. He scratched his head awkwardly, wanting to say something, but after your initial surprise, your expression turned indescribable.
After all...... He now looks like a strange TV person, and for some reason, he still ...... At least you have to look up at him, you think he's at least 1.5 times your height, and of course, maybe even more.
Moreover, on his body...... It was actually a blue-and-pink bubble dress?! And he was holding a slender staff in his hand, which somehow looked like a TV head at the top...... It was a pink staff. In short, you only had a complicated expression.
Watching you remain silent for a long time, he spoke first: 'Uh... um, since I can't remove your teammates from your team, I decided to be your teammate myself! Yes, I am MR.(ANT)TENNA! I believe you absolutely can't wait to watch TV——' Damn, what exactly is he talking about? He didn't even know what nonsense he was babbling about... Maybe, maybe, uh, right, he just wants to break this awkward atmosphere, that's all, nothing wrong with that!
Tenna awkwardly stopped moving, and you saw cold sweat still streaming down his screen...... Although whether a TV actually sweats or not, you think that's better discussed later. You look at Tenna's screen, slowly scanning his entire body. He probably hasn't noticed your gaze yet, just asking you in confusion, "Why do you keep looking at me? My dear star, what's wrong with me?" ”
Your expression grew even more complicated...... Why does this guy's voice even have that kind of sound effect? You thought it was just the microphone quality was bad, but it turns out it's really like this......
You were silent for a while without answering his question. Tenna looked even more nervous and uneasy. The antenna above his head drooped, and the screen turned off. You finally couldn't hold back and spoke up: "It's not impossible, right...... But judging by how you call yourself, you're male, right? Why are you wearing a dress...... You hesitate to speak, pointing at Tenna's clothes. He instinctively glances down in the direction you point, then cups his own TV head with both hands.
"Oh my god, I forgot, the teammates I designed for you are healers, and they join wearing the default healer outfits. You know, most of them are women. I just used outfits from other games without changing them—wait for me to switch back......" He hurriedly slipped out. You have no idea where he ran off to, but I think he was in a TV-shaped room up ahead.
You showed your half-moon eyes; he looked taller and more muscular than you, and with that outfit, you almost squeezed through it...... It was really strange. But since it looked like he had punched you seven times in the head, you still tried hard not to laugh out loud.
…… At least after he emerged, the outfit looked normal. It looked about brownish-yellow, quite luxurious and noble, at least well-fitting, but he was still holding that staff.
He hesitated for a moment and said, "Hmm...... I definitely wouldn't wear that outfit. This outfit is my own, so it should look pretty nice. Ah, since I'm still a healer, I'm still holding this staff......
It sounded like he was about to go on and on again, but you quickly interrupted him: "Stop, stop, stop...... So can your staff cast spells normally? "You think of your sword again, and you really doubt whether the game system he designed is actually normal.
Tenna was stunned for a moment, then quickly replied, "Of course there's no problem. Healing magic is just healing magic! If you don't believe me, take a look!" As he spoke, he raised the staff and chanted a spell you didn't even know what it was, then you felt yourself lightweight...... Come on, you haven't lost any health at all. You stared at Tenna with half-moon eyes as a green glow surrounded you.
After casting this spell, he seemed very nervous. Cold sweat dripped down the screen again, while he seemed to be gripping the staff tightly...... Hmm, he did look a bit girly, and you wanted to laugh again. But you touched your nose and didn't laugh out loud, just suppressing a laugh and said, "Alright, I get it. Very useful. Even though my health is full." ”
"Uh...... Well, fine, I'll show you the demonstration later. Tenna lowered his hands in disappointment, his antenna drooping, and the dark screen looked like it was about to drip ink...... Or maybe it was just tears. Either way, he was probably struck by your words again.
You touch your nose, still a little embarrassed, but looking at him, you remember—you still have one question you hadn't asked earlier.
“…… Also, I used to think it was some weird thing, but now I realize the food you gave me was your face?! "You really can't help but want to complain about this. One more thing...... You used to think Tenna was just a simple ...... Yeah, a hot-blooded fan of CRT TVs, but when you meet him, you realize he's not even an enthusiast—he's just a TV!
"And why are you a TV person? I thought you just loved TV very much...... But when we met, you realized you were actually a TV person? "You shrugged as you spoke, really not understanding what Tenna really was.
"Ah...... Uh, the thing I gave you before was called a TV meal. Isn't it delicious?! As long as it's tasty, that's enough, as long as you like TV more—I, um, I'm a Dark Civilian from a CRT TV in the Light World, so that's exactly what I look like...... Don't you like it? "His hands were behind his back, looking a bit down...... Uh, it seems like he really wasn't in a good mood, because you saw Tenna's body shrinking, and now he's gradually getting smaller than you...... It looks like he's about to become the size of a pet dog.
You looked at him with a bit of a headache, not sure if it was just an illusion, but you seemed to see a rain cloud falling over his head, as if it was raining continuously.
“…… It's not that I don't like it, the previous one was really delicious too. You look like this...... I'm just a little surprised, not that I dislike you. Actually, this look is pretty nice, at least...... Hmm, square and cute? "You rack your brains, trying to comfort him.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror7 (tennax you)
content:
After hearing your words, he seemed to pull himself together a little, but...... Tenna was still facing away from you. He had just grown a bit bigger, and his voice still sounded a bit hesitant, but there was no crying anymore. His voice sounded more like he was testing him: "Really?" ”
"Of course it's true. I'm not in the habit of lying...... Hmm, you really do look pretty cute like this. I just haven't met the Dark People before, so I'm so surprised...... You said this, letting out a slight breath.
He finally turned around to face you, but Tenna still hung her head, her antenna drooping. For some reason, you found his question strange, because suddenly he asked awkwardly, "Then, then would you ...... Will you like me like me forever, forever? Will you ever need me?" ”
You're really a bit confused; you don't know why Tenna would ask that...... You just nodded and then shook your head: "Well, if that's how you are...... I'll probably always like you, but I don't necessarily need you forever. How should I put it? After all, not everything needs a ...... Uh, the help of a TV. "You've organized your words. Although you roughly know what to say to make Tenna happy, you don't want to lie to him. You're just telling the truth.
You watch as his figure shrinks again. He just sits darkly on the screen, replying awkwardly: "...... Oh. ”
You blinked at him, wondering if you should say something to comfort him, when you heard his voice again. His speech was so fast that you could barely hear what he was saying: "I know, no one will like me forever, no one will need me forever...... I know about this, haha. ”
"But...... But you wouldn't even want to trick me once? Y/N。 I ...... I don't know, well, maybe you just prefer it that way. ”
"So you really do hate this place, hate the game I made, right? After all, if it weren't for me, you would have left this world long ago—you always act like you hate this game, always say my game is terrible...... I—I know what I do is terrible, really bad. If you want to hate it, that's only right, right, it's your ......" His voice sounded a bit like a murmur to himself. You have no idea why Tenna suddenly became like this, into such an emotional breakdown...... Tenna turned to run away, but you instinctively rushed over and grabbed his hand.
"I...... Uh, I don't mean I really dislike your game. Although I always complain, I'm not saying you're terrible...... It's just that this game is different from the ones I've played before," you sighed as you said that. You're not very good at comforting people; you're just doing your best to soothe him.
"How should I put it...... I don't want to lie, I don't want you to hear a lie, that's all. I'm just telling you the truth about my thoughts, that's all...... Well, actually, I'm very willing to keep playing this game. "You thought for a long time, stammering as you finished speaking. Tenna fell silent, turned his head, and the screen lit up again. He looked at you, but the corners of his mouth curved downward, still looking gloomy.
“…… Are you telling the truth, or are you lying? ”
You sighed and stepped forward: "Of course it's true...... I told you I didn't want to lie. Hmm, just look into my eyes and you'll know if I'm lying. "After saying that, you looked up and stared at Tenna.
Tenna looked at you, gazing into your eyes. Your eyes sparkled, and you didn't mean to lie...... He understood, just shook his head and nodded: "I...... I understand, I know you're not lying. ”
You quietly watch him, and Tenna awkwardly turns her head again. After a while, you hear his voice, as thin as a mosquito's buzz: "...... Thank you." ”
"Mm...... If there's no problem, shall we keep moving forward? "You walk up to Tenna, turn to look at him, and Tenna nods. He obediently follows behind you, even though ...... Well, he knows what story he's written himself, but still follows you into the castle. When you reach the castle gate, you look at the castles arranged in the shape of the TV, but fall into a suspicious silence, then you turn to look at Tenna.
"Although I ...... Forget it, Tenna, I don't really know why you designed it this way, but don't you really think it's weird? There's a kind of eerie ugliness vibe. "You said, taking a look at the door. Honestly...... You don't understand why you're standing here. If it weren't for the questbar in the upper left telling you to go to the castle, you wouldn't have wanted to come here at all.
"But don't you think that's cute? And this design fits perfectly with the idea that everyone in the kingdom loves TVs...... How fitting is that?! "Tenna is arguing with you.
"Anyway, the country I designed looks like this. If you don't like it, there's nothing you can do...... I can't change the design again." He insisted so firmly, but his mood seemed to be sour. His head hung low, his antenna drooped, and you looked at his hands behind his back, only sighing.
"I never said I didn't like it...... It's just that this design is indeed a bit strange. "As you walked forward, you saw ...... The password written at the castle entrance. Of course, there was also a password lock nearby, and above the castle entrance hung a note of paper. When you lifted it open, you saw a nine-grid number written on it.
You fell silent, glanced at the password lock hanging on it and the prompt above, then glanced at Tenna beside you, and after a moment of silence, asked, "You...... Why set the password at the castle entrance?" "If you remember correctly, this is the pigsty code, and because there's a comparison table, it's quite easy.
"Does this make it look more like a game? It's a bit difficult." You watch Tenna stick out her tongue, acting cute.
You were silent for a moment, then shook the paper in your hand and couldn't help but complain, "How is it difficult...... Your password prompt is already hanging on it." After saying that, you fiddled with the password lock and entered 1479. With a click, the castle door opened.
Tenna followed behind you, aligning his fingers and whispering, "I thought...... That's quite difficult, already ......" After all, if it were him, he definitely wouldn't have figured out the password right away. He would have to study for quite a while to figure out what the password really was.
"Where is it...... It's actually pretty simple. Look at the grid in the upper left corner, which is 1, and so on. "As you spoke, you pulled Tenna toward the castle. You thought the castle's facilities would be perfect, but all you saw was the TV-shaped window, the TV-shaped sofa, and the TV wall painting...... Alright, the chandelier is TV-shaped too. You fell silent. You gave Tenna a fair suggestion: "...... Why don't you replace the indoor facilities? The TV's appearance is one thing, but why do the sofa decorations have to be TV-shaped...... Also, replace your TV-shaped vegetables and stuff!! Although the taste is good, watching one CRT TV after another makes it hard to get started...... "To be honest, it does sound a bit bland and tasteless." You really don't know which angle to start with.
“…… But the taste is great, proving that the taste of the CRT TV is also excellent, proving that no matter where you are, the CRT TV can be effective." "Tenna is arguing with you again."
"A CRT TV can be used as a painting or ornament, and it can also serve as window glass...... Ah, a CRT TV can also be used for sitting and as a seat or sofa. Of course, a CRT TV can also serve as a table to hold things, or rather, ...... A CRT TV can also be used as a chandelier because the screen is very bright! ”
"From this perspective, CRT TV can replace everything in life...... Except for CRT TV, nothing else is necessary!" He said confidently, sounding very reasonable at first, though you know it's just a twisted theory.
“…… Better to give it up. With so many CRT TVs as furniture, the whole house is so heavy—it's practically multiplied. "You showed half-moon eyes, complaining about what Tenna said.
"And with so many CRT TVs, it's inconvenient...... What if it overheats and explodes?! "Although you think that's unlikely, you still have to bring it up.
"Ah, what if it does explode...... No, it definitely won't explode. The quality of CRT TVs is very good, so it won't be as poor quality as the phones loved by the Light Folk now, which easily explode when connected to wires......" He said this, but still felt a bit uncertain.
"Hmm...... But if it doesn't explode, what if water gets in? "You walk forward while casually chatting with Tenna.
“…… Uh, it got wet. At most, it just won't be able to play TV programs anymore, it's nothing serious......" he said, but the antenna drooped again. He didn't look very upset, and not only that, you can see it shrinking even more.
"It's just that I can't watch TV shows anymore...... There are other uses; the People of Light definitely won't throw away the old TV...... "He seemed to be muttering to himself, and you think he seemed a bit obsessed, so he could only sigh and add another sentence.
"Alright, none of the above will happen...... Hmm, let's hurry and meet that king. ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror8 (tennax you)
content:
You grab Tenna's hand and run ahead, but he's still muttering, "But if something unexpected happens...... The CRT TV will definitely stand in front of the owner, the first to protect them! Whether it's a fire, typhoon, flood, or a natural disaster, or if a stranger breaks into your home or encounters a murderer or robber, the CRT TV is definitely the most reliable assistant...... "He rambles on, and you can't help but interrupt him: "Alright, alright, what you're saying sounds like you're cursing the family that owns a CRT TV...... Can't you say something nice? ”
"Besides, it's just a bulky TV...... Where does the owner get the ability to protect the owner? The owner should at least protect the CRT TV from harm, since repairing the appliances would cost a lot of money." You couldn't help but keep complaining.
Tenna was quiet for a while, so long you thought he couldn't even speak...... Or maybe he disappeared, or if they weren't still holding hands, you'd really think so. You turned to look at Tenna in confusion, startled—for some reason, his screen had turned dark at this moment. Although he obediently followed behind you, ...... But his antenna drooped, and his head hung low, clearly unhappy.
Just when you want to say something else—he suddenly looks happy again, just excitedly saying, "Alright, alright—yes, a CRT TV is very useful for the families who own it! It can play programs during family gatherings, liven up the whole party atmosphere, and give families with only children a chance to play—the CRT TV is their best toy! Of course, if needed, anyone can find their favorite programs on the CRT TV—" His screen was lit, but you always felt he was forcing a smile—after all, cold sweat was dripping down his screen, and his volume suddenly turned up, his voice somehow sharp and even harsh—after all, he spoke very fast.
You interrupted him helplessly: "Alright...... Alright, well, I know CRT TVs are useful, everyone needs them, I get it." That sentence sounded more like a perfunctory explanation—well, you already found what he said a bit funny, after all, nowadays...... Times have changed so fast, old TVs have long been replaced with LCD TVs. Of course, you don't really need TVs anymore; you mostly use computers or mobile phones...... These facilities are far more advanced than CRT TVs.
But think about it, Tenna probably doesn't want to hear such things.
You pulled Tenna into the palace, but you heard Tenna's seemingly cautious voice: "Th-then, people will always need a CRT TV, right?! Including you?" "It seems a bit urgent again...... That's probably how you judge it.
You didn't turn around, just nodded helplessly and answered Tenna's question: "That's right...... Although CRT TVs are already outdated for us, having a TV like this at home and occasionally watching nostalgic shows isn't a bad idea—though some people probably don't like it. But...... Well, if it were like you now, I don't think anyone would dislike you, right? At least I don't dislike you. "You really mean the truth...... Well, although he is a bit noisy, you don't dislike him. After all, you do enjoy lively moments, and it seems that after hearing your answer, he was in a better mood. Anyway, you saw flowers blooming at the tip of his nose again.
"Oh...... Oh, thank you, Y/N. I knew there would still be some of the People of Light who needed an old TV—like you! "He was very happy, but still let you pull him toward the throne—you just vaguely saw someone above. Of course, the castle isn't very big, but before long you arrive before the king, and then you watch the person on the throne fall silent—well, this person, uh, maybe not human, you don't even know what it is, looks like a microphone—or rather, a headpiece with a microphone.
You were silent for a moment, tugged at Tenna's sleeve, and quietly asked, "Are you sure...... Is this guy the king? ”
"Of course! Mike is my best partner, my best subordinate—he certainly has no objections to being king! "Tenna was proud, although ...... Although none of his subordinates were here now, and everything here was just his fiction.
You glanced at Tenna with a complicated expression, then stepped forward two paces, hesitated to speak, knelt on one knee, and said to the king: "...... Honorable king, I heard that the nation's sacred relic was stolen, so I came specially to prepare to defeat the demon king and reclaim the relic. ”
The person on the throne—just like Tenna—began to shout loudly: "Oh, dear hero—we've been anxious for days, and finally you've arrived. Now, we won't have to fear anymore! Next, I will bestow the holy sword upon the only hero—of course, before that, you must prove you are a hero worthy of great responsibility! ”
"So, how do you prove it?" You were quite patient in asking this question, and this ...... The microphone head didn't keep you waiting long; he just asked loudly.
"What is our slogan? Once you pass this test, you can prove you are the tru, only brave one! ”
And your mouth twitched—Oh my god, you never expected the so-called trial to be so simple?! Or rather...... Hmm, you never expected the so-called trial to be so ridiculous. Anyway, you twitched your mouth as you remembered what you'd encountered since you entered this city...... This is completely different from the Celtic-style forest you saw at first—this place is just a TV town?!
In short, in the end, you still stiffened your face and read out the lines in a dry tone: "...... I love TV." ”
The microphone head above nodded, hands on hips, looking very satisfied: "Excellent, that's it! We love TV—you've passed the test, come and take your holy sword!" He snapped his fingers, followed by the rumbling sound of the door opening—you stared at the door behind the throne as it opened, and then the guy with the microphone hood led you around.
"Let's move forward. The Holy Sword is just ahead. I'm looking forward to hearing the good news that you have successfully defeated the Demon King and brought back the sacred relic!" He announced, making room for you, so you and Tenna headed toward this ...... You walked toward the pitch-black so-called treasure trove, with only a CRT TV-shaped chandelier hanging on the wall. Other than that, there was nothing else. You had no idea how far you had gone before finally reaching your destination—in front of a large door.
Then you see...... Uh, the door has a password, still a four-digit electronic screen, and next to it is the same pigsty code marker, except this time there is no note on the door.
…… You look at the electronic screen, dig through the numbers 3712, and then the door opens with a bang. Of course, along with the sound of the door opening, you also hear Tenna clapping. You can't tell if he's doing it on purpose or genuinely—"Y/N is amazing, cracking the password so easily!" Effortlessly, I feel the journey ahead won't be difficult at all! ”
“…… Your hint is on the wall ahead, did you forget? Of course it's easy, not difficult. "You whispered, cleared your throat twice, and moved forward, then you saw...... Hmm, the ...... stuck in the head on the stone platform. A staff???
Wasn't it supposed to be a holy sword? Why a staff?? You pulled out the staff with a TV-shaped tip and instinctively opened the skill list to glance at it...... Hmm, normal attacks, heavy attacks, spiral spinning slashes...... Alright, it's the sword skill list.
“…… I know you wrote the code wrong, but can the code still turn a sword into a staff?" "That's way too illogical...... Uh, it's not that it can't be used, but you casually swing the staff and leave sword marks on the stone platform.
…… Hmm, looks like it can still fire sword and blade damage from a distance...... You hold this staff and choose to replace the sword you're carrying first.
Tenna chuckled awkwardly twice. You turned to look at him, and cold sweat was dripping down his screen again: "Uh...... Ahem, isn't this just perfect? After all, a hero should use a sword! And I'm also good at swordsmanship! I've already maxed your swordsmanship to LV.999! ”
You checked your skill panel...... All the slashes and charged attacks were maxed out just as Tenna said, but you still showed half-moon eyes and shook your staff: "Hmm, hmm...... But this is just a staff, not a sword. Instead of using a staff instead of a sword, you might as well swap the skill lists for these two...... Well, this is pretty fun. ”
As you spoke, you swung your staff and unleashed a slash that struck the wall opposite, leaving a deep sword mark...... Then you drew your sword and slashed at the stone platform ahead, using an ice spell. The stone platform also left a sword mark, which was frozen in place.
"Hmm, I won't change it. This way works pretty well." You put away the sword and swapped it back for a staff, nodding in satisfaction, while Tenna just stared blankly on the screen, expressionless.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror9 (tennax you)
content:
You glanced at Tenna in confusion, not knowing why he was wearing that expression now.
"Tenna, what's wrong?" You've never seen him like this before.
He snapped back to reality and switched back to his usual smile, just grinning and saying, "Ah, it's nothing...... It's just that you didn't blame me for writing this bug, which surprised me...... As he spoke, his voice dropped again. You glanced at him and tilted your head slightly: "Hmm, of course I don't mean to blame you—well, actually, the bug you wrote is really interesting. If it weren't for it, I probably wouldn't be standing here at all." "You said this to praise Tenna and make him feel a bit better, but for some reason...... He didn't seem that happy? You can't see his expression, only his nose on the screen—hmm, exactly like a TV meal—no difference. You look at him with a bit of confusion, and all you hear is his somewhat disappointed voice, or rather, a forced smile.
"Ah...... Is that so? But a bug is a bug. You probably hate bugs too...... He still showed little expression, just lowered his head with his hands behind his back, clearly unhappy.
“…… I really hate bugs, but honestly, nobody likes bugs, right?" You tilted your head and said, "You really think so. If you played games seriously, no one would like these things." If it's just a fun challenge...... Well, that doesn't really matter. Of course, now you don't treat this as a serious game; it's like a fun game, so you can find joy in these bugs.
Or rather...... Games are meant to bring joy. Games are meant to make people feel happy and happy.
"That's it, so I think you hate these bugs, and now you're like this...... I'm really surprised. "He seemed to be muttering to himself, and you blinked at him without saying much. Do you think saying anything now is useless?"
But suddenly, he threw out another question—uh, of course, you are still here and haven't moved forward.
"So...... Y/N, do you really like this game? My game is full of bugs, so I knew no one would genuinely like it. But without you, other people of light would have discovered it...... There will always be people who like this game, people will appreciate it, and appreciate me, this old guy. I know you might have just been lying before...... His voice trembled, his body shaking constantly, as if he couldn't accept your answer—hmm, or rather, he already knew what the answer would be.
He pressed his head down, and for a moment the screen went blank again: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry...... I didn't mean to let you experience such a bad world, nor did I mean to let you see such a terrible world and my bad self...... "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry......" He spoke quickly, and you stared at him in a daze. I don't know why Tenna suddenly broke down emotionally, and he kept retreating.
And you...... You instinctively took a step closer to him, but Tenna stepped back again, his voice dropping: "...... I messed up again, sorry, I didn't mean to do this. ”
After saying that, he turned to run away. You instinctively grabbed his hand, and you didn't know what was wrong with him, or why he suddenly had an emotional breakdown, but you thought...... You should still tell him what you're thinking.
“…… I don't think this world is imperfect, nor do I think you're terrible. Even though it's all ridiculous, but...... But I really like all of this, because only you can create this world, only you can create such a world. In fact, I'm really happy. If it's just a regular RPG without bugs...... That's very ordinary, it's boring, because bugs exist. You created these bugs, and the world you created made me happy, so...... That's why I stayed in this world because the game you created made me want to keep playing. It's a very interesting world, so...... I think you, who created this world, are also a very interesting person. Ah, no, a TV personality. "You carefully consider your words as you speak to Tenna, and you watch as his footsteps stop, and he just stammers.
“…… Really, really? ”
“…… Of course it's true. I really like this world, I really like this game." As you spoke, gently holding his hand and walking forward, he obediently followed your lead toward the exit.
“…… Alright. Y/N, you truly love this game, and I'm really happy. He smiled again, but this time, a small flower bloomed at the tip of his nose. Hmm, he really looked happy.
You smiled and nodded: "Yeah, if I didn't like this game, I wouldn't have stopped playing it long ago...... Or rather, I would have left long ago. If you hadn't created this game, I don't think I would have continued to play it. ”
But for some reason, Tenna's voice was muffled, almost tinged with tears...... His screen was still blank, probably not wanting you to notice anything: "I get it—let's move forward!" He once again showed his usual smile, but this time he walked quickly ahead, while you shook your head helplessly and followed behind him.
Tenna's steps were a bit light; he thought, when he heard your voice just now...... His heart, the heart pounding in his chest, was pounding rapidly at that moment...... At that moment, his heart was pounding for you. It was also at that moment that Tenna was certain, maybe...... Apart from you, no other Lightfolk would say such things.
At first, he subconsciously paid attention just because you were a citizen of light, instinctively wanting to know you better, to get closer to you...... But now, things are different. Just because you exist, Tenna wants to get a little closer to you.
It's just that your presence is completely different to him...... To him, it holds a different meaning. He touched his chest, thinking that whenever he thought of you, his heart was pounding...... He thought, he, he, he, he...... It seems like he's fallen in love with you.
Even though the world isn't perfect, Tenna can honestly tell herself that the world is terrible, but...... But you like this world, you like this game, which means you really like it, right?
The corners of his lips couldn't help but curl up, and he just took advantage of the fact that you hadn't come out of it to open the game's operating system and editing interface, quietly changing the terrain ahead. At the same time, he edited a contract. The contract was long, and most of the large clauses were written in large letters about how Tenna would treat Y/N...... Only on the very top was a few small words written "Romantic Relationship Contract."
Meanwhile, he added several clauses in small print to the middle of that long list of clauses: after a month of entering into a romantic relationship, the marriage must be formed; Once the relationship is confirmed, Y/N cannot stop Tenna from getting close to him; Once the relationship is confirmed, the clause cannot be reversed; Once the relationship is established, Y/N cannot leave Tenna.
He quietly finished drafting the contract and put it away before you could leave. You saw Tenna standing with her back to you, her hands acting a bit sneaky. You tilted her head slightly to look at him and softly asked, "...... tenna？ What's wrong with you? ”
He turned to face you, but...... Hmm, cold sweat was still dripping from his screen, clearly looking a bit guilty.
His voice grew louder, probably to hide his guilt, and he shouted loudly, "Nothing...... It's nothing! I'm just waiting for you to come out, I'm getting a bit impatient! ”
You glanced at him with some confusion, not sure what secret he was hiding...... Well, it didn't matter anyway. You shrugged and kept walking forward: "Alright...... Hmm, who told you to walk so fast? By the way, do you have no map left? This map looks no different from the previous one, right?" As you spoke, you pointed to the forest ahead. It really looked exactly like the one you saw when you first appeared in this game.
"Ah...... Uh, well...... Hmm, ahem, this forest is different. It's called the Dark Forest! "Tenna cleared his throat and began to introduce it grandly, but cold sweat was still dripping from his screen.
You looked at him with half-moon eyes, really not understanding what Tenna meant, but you still followed his lead: "Alright, then tell me, where is the darkness in this forest?" ”
"To put it simply, it's like evil demons in the dark forest—once you go in, you can't get out—and not only that, you can't touch those weeds either! If you do, you'll bleed uncontrollably—hmm, and when your blood stains the land, you'll become the new nourishment for the land along with that blood! Uh, that's just flower fertilizer." "He said the last sentence as if he were whispering, acting like he was whispering, and his voice suddenly quieted.
You look at him helplessly and shake your head: "Mm...... Alright, the dark forest is terrifying. I understand, I'll be careful. ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror10 (tennax you)
content:
Yet you still look at the area in front of you with a bit of helplessness. This forest looks no different from your spawn point. You suspect Tenna doesn't know how to design maps at all, just uses other maps, so the map here repeats the previous one. After all, the forest is lush and green, clearly showing you'll get lost once you walk in, and the grass is covered with thorns—so this is exactly the same as the previous forest, you quietly complain to yourself.
But even so, you still didn't tell Tenna about it...... After all, you already decided from now on that you'd better not complain to Tenna about the game's bugs anymore. You still remember those things just now, you know, Tenna probably wouldn't like hearing those things either.
You just said, "Alright, alright, looks like we need to be careful as we move forward!" "You decide to have some fun with Tenna instead."
"Of course, we need to be careful, or we might be attacked by enemies who don't know where we are." Tenna shook his head as he spoke, clearly quite proud of the scene he had designed. You glanced speechlessly at Tenna, said nothing more, and just continued walking forward.
—But sure enough, you ran into an enemy. This time, the monster was the same as the one you encountered at your spawn point—a black saxophone player, looking like it couldn't speak. You pulled out your staff and decided to attack, but before that, Tenna crawled over to your side. He was still smiling, though for some reason he stood with his hands behind his back, looking a bit guilty...... You looked at him, and Tenna just smiled and said, "Let me introduce you formally. This is Shadow Guy, my former employee—uh, this is just a character I generated based on the game." His voice gradually faded.
Probably because this is a turn-based battle, it doesn't matter if you just stay here and don't move. Then you looked at Tenna and asked, "...... So, where are their people? Uh, wait, what about their stuff? "You think about it and think about how the Dark People define it.
Tenna's voice only grew quieter. He stood with his hands behind his back, nose curved downward, and the corners of his mouth drooping, looking unhappy: "...... They're not here. All of this now is just the image I created in the game." He didn't seem like he wanted to talk more about this topic.
You casually fired a slash, and the monster dodged twice, then ran off in the opposite direction and disappeared from your sight. You casually asked, "So...... Hmm, are you the only one here?" "You think this question doesn't seem very good, but you feel Tenna's emotions seem to need an outlet, so you still ask."
“…… Yes, I'm the only one here, and when I woke up, I was right here. I don't know why...... I don't know why only I was thrown into the trash heap. Why me? Why me? "He still wore that unhappy expression, but...... But his voice had a hint of hysteria, even a bit more tearful. You were startled by him, really not knowing what was wrong with him, so you could only cautiously take two steps closer and tentatively stand on tiptoe to rub the TV's head.
"I don't know either, but I think no one deliberately abandoned you...... They might just ...... Didn't catch up to you." You chose your words carefully and said, "Honestly, you don't know why Tenna ended up in this situation...... In other words, you don't know much about what's happening around here. After all, you're just a light-born who just returned home from vacation and returned to your hometown town.
“…… But the People of Light have already abandoned me. I don't understand why we can never go back to the past." He murmured, the screen turning pitch black again. You glanced at him with concern, but he seemed fine...... Well, well, maybe he really does seem fine.
You just kept walking forward, casually saying, "Because the past is already the past, and even more longing is just the past. What we can see and yearn for is only the future." You walked ahead, leaving Tenna behind, naturally unaware that Tenna was watching your back from behind.
Yes, what he longs for is the future...... And what he is looking forward to now is precisely the future with you. What he is looking forward to is a future with you; what he longs for now is a future where he can always be with you, always, forever.
Because he knows you still need him, because he knows that to you, he's not a useless old guy, because he knows he likes you, and you like this game, so you like him too—Tenna is so certain about it.
A smile returned to his face, and he walked forward holding the microphone staff, quickly following you. At that moment, you noticed that the same cabin was ahead—well, you don't even know why there's another cabin here. You had planned to ignore the house and keep walking, but Tenna flashed right in front of you, blocking your path. You saw him with his hands behind his back, cold sweat on his face—even though he was still trying hard to keep smiling.
"Oh, Y/N, my dear superstar! I think there might be something in this room you desperately need. Do you want to go in and take a look?" "Alright, actually, it's something he desperately needs...... Once you walk into this room, he'll be able to trick you into signing the contract.
You tilted your head to look at him in confusion, then looked at the cabin, and without hesitation, shook your head: "No." ”
If you can keep moving forward, why bother entering some small cabin for no reason...... You definitely don't want to experience the endless fall when you first arrived in this world.
"Uh, but I guarantee the things in this room will greatly help you move forward. Are you really not going to take a look?"
“…… I don't think there's any need to look; it's not a bad thing to look at it now. "You thought for a moment and said this. Honestly, you really don't know...... Uh, what exactly is inside? And the more Tenna says this, the more alert you become, and I have a bad feeling about it.
"Why?" That thing only makes you stronger, and I don't think there's anything wrong with that. "Tenna's face seemed to sweat even more, and he looked ...... Uh, even more guilty. You stared at him suspiciously, but clearly, you didn't see anything.
You hesitate for a moment about whether to be honest—well, just minutes ago you were reminding yourself not to complain about Tenna's bugs in the future, but now you've broken down: "The reason is simple, it's just ...... It's just—do you remember when I first arrived in this world, you broke that cabin, so I kept falling down, and you couldn't even fix that bug. ”
Tenna forced a laugh: "Isn't that ...... Well, the rest is fixed later, so you can walk naturally, no problem at all—I'll just place it right at the spawn point for you." He tried to gesture incoherently, but in the end gave up.
And you just dragged out your words: "Yeah, you fixed that bug—but what if I walk into the room now and there's another bug inside?" I definitely don't want to experience the feeling of falling endlessly in the dark again. ”
"Uh, um...... I promise there won't be any bugs this time. It's just a simple cabin, nothing more! Tenna tried to defend himself, but once again he put on a smile, as if ...... Well, just like having a normal conversation with you.
You shrugged: "Oh, okay, I get it—but I still won't go in." Saying that, you bypassed Tenna and walked straight ahead. You passed the cabin, but in the distance, there was still a cabin.
You turned to Tenna, full of questions, and asked, "Did you set the map wrong?" However, Tenna just shook his head without hesitation, dismissing your view. You remained silent, unconvinced, and continued walking forward. But ahead, it was still the same forest, the same cabin, as if you'd encountered some kind of strange wall.
You fell silent, not knowing why it was like this, and could only walk forward with a puzzled face—the fourth time, the fifth time, still the same scene, as if trapped here.
…… Alright, at this point, it looks like we have to go into that cabin. You sigh and glance at Tenna: "Alright, I believe you...... Looks like I have to go inside that cabin and see for myself now." ”
Tenna straightened up, a big smile on her face: "Right? I told you, my instructions were definitely correct—Y/N must follow Tenna's instructions to get on the right path, and it's always been like this from the beginning until now!" ”
You nodded perfunctorily with a couple of 'mms' and walked toward the cabin, with Tenna following behind you.
The cabin looked quite normal...... But for some reason, the room was no longer empty; instead, there was a table inside. And on that table were several sheets of paper...... Curious, you walked over to take a look, and the first thing you saw was a sheet of paper covered in arrows. You couldn't tell whether the arrows were pointing in the direction or something else, just showing half-moon eyes and putting the paper away first.
Then you see a thick stack of papers underneath, with the characters printed so large that you can't help but read aloud: "Good partner...... Contract??? ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror11 (tennax you)
content:
Scrolling further down, almost every sheet of paper had a contract printed on it, written in large characters...... Hmm, after flipping through several pages, there were all treaties and such. The general meaning was that Tenna would treat Y/N with lots of good things and something like that. You quickly lost interest and just flipped straight to the last page. On it, it said the promised person was Tenna, and there was an empty space below, probably reserved for you to write your name.
You look at the thick contract, frown, and look at Tenna: "...... I thought we were already good partners? Turns out we're not?" As you spoke, your eyebrows raised high as you looked at Tenna with her hands behind her back, looking guilty—though he still looked at you with a radiant smile.
"Ah, this is—a contract! It's just to help our relations department get a step further. Don't you want to confirm a few things?" His smile grew even brighter, but for some reason, you couldn't help but feel a bit guilty...... Maybe it's not just your imagination or anything. Maybe he really does think so, but he's still a bit guilty.
You stared intently at Tenna, but he just kept smiling, and that smile grew even brighter. He even said, "Well, anyway, the terms on the contract are all good for you. Signing it isn't a bad thing—no, no, it's definitely a good thing! You have to believe me, this contract is definitely beneficial for you!! "As he spoke, he started waving the microphone staff wildly—hmm, he looked really anxious.
You really didn't have the patience to flip through each page of the contract to see what was written on it, but you always felt Tenna's reaction was suspicious—so you still skimmed through the papers and glanced at the contents, feeling there was nothing bad about you......
You hesitated for a moment, but still signed your name in the blank space: "Alright, alright...... I understand. It's signed. Now you should be satisfied, right?" As you spoke, your voice rose slightly. You raised your eyebrows and glanced at Tenna. To be honest, you didn't really care if there were other things written in the contract—anyway, for you, it wouldn't cause you any loss, probably, you guess that's how it is.
Tenna just hugged the thick stack of papers to his chest. For some reason, you saw a flower blooming on his nose—oh my god, you have no idea why he was so happy, and then you don't know what he did. In short, he put away that stack of contracts, but I don't know where he put them. While you were still puzzled, he stepped closer to you, leaned in close, and stood tightly beside you, hands behind his back, looking a bit nervous...... Even though he still wore a smile, he just lowered his head slightly and quickly kissed your cheek.
You covered your cheeks, instinctively widening your eyes—oh my god, no matter how much you planned, you never knew Tenna would do this! You were still a bit confused and could only mumble, "You...... Why did you do this? ”
He was probably feeling a bit guilty, cold sweat dripping from the screen, and he himself turned his head away to stop looking at you, only quietly saying, "Well...... This is written in the contract! You can't go back on your word! ”
"When did I agree to that condition? I don't remember seeing it in the contract." You're a bit puzzled. Even though you hadn't looked closely at the contract, you had just skimmed through it carelessly...... Are you sure you've never seen such a condition?
Tenna just pulled out a piece of paper and loudly read it to you: "Article 135: Tenna must not refuse Y/N's condition and must help Y/N overcome all difficulties and obstacles on the journey. At the same time, Y/N cannot refuse Tenna's request for intimate contact!" After saying that, he handed you the paper.
Take a look, and the line in front is printed in bold, large font, while the conditions for intimate contact or anything like that...... are typed in font as fine as a mosquito's blade, and they're deliberately written in bold, large font, afraid people will see the same thing.
Your eye twitched, feeling like Tenna had played you...... So you said, "Show me the first copy of this contract." "You feel like this doesn't seem like a good partnership contract...... Even though you've never been in a relationship, you know a little about it, right?! Really...... It's really hard to imagine.
Tenna obediently pulled out that piece of paper to show you. You took it and glanced at it carefully. Sure enough, you saw a line of small characters on it—"Romantic Relationship Contract."
Tenna just shyly clasped his hands behind his back, still smiling and saying, "Um...... Anyway, my dear star, you agreed! Y/N, you agreed to become a romantic relationship with me, so now we're lovers!" He said, gesturing with his finger.
Your eye twitched again—You, well, you never expected Tenna to do this?! You never thought about dating him or anything. Although you said you liked the game and thought he was fun, you only treated him as a friend. You never said you wanted to be his boyfriend or anything?!
So you raise your hand: "Wait...... I didn't agree to be with you. Can I go back on this contract or anything? Honestly...... If I'd known, I should've read carefully before signing. "You regret it a bit. To be honest, you didn't sign this contract voluntarily—really.
"Of course not—oh my god, Y/N, my dear Y/N, are you really willing to abandon this old TV? Are you really willing to abandon me? My Y/N, do you really want to refuse this clause?" His antenna was bent, and the screen turned pitch black, as if muttering to himself.
"Oh...... If you really hate this clause, then just follow your wish! Reject it, resist it, reject me, hate me! Anyway, it doesn't really matter anymore...... Anyway, it doesn't matter anymore, just treat me like trash, throw me into a corner of the trash, throw it into the garbage heap! "He said this, turning his back to you, looking very dejected, even a bit flattered. Honestly, that's not what you meant...... But now, you couldn't think of anything good to comfort him. The words you had planned for a moment, you hesitated, but in the end, swallowed them down.
You just cautiously said, "I don't hate you, I'm just...... I just, really just treat you as a friend, and I just thought this contract was a good partnership or something...... So, now you're telling me this contract can't be regretted...... I can't break the contract? "You tentatively asked him, and at that moment, Tenna finally turned his head, but he still kept his head down, the screen pitch black. He looked at you anxiously, a bit dissatisfied not getting the answer he wanted, but hearing your words made him laugh uncontrollably.
"Sorry, Y/N, I'm too emotional...... Did I cause you a lot of trouble all day? He mumbled, as if awkwardly avoiding the earlier question and clumsily changing the subject—but in fact, Tenna was indeed changing the subject, and at the same time, he felt a bit guilty and anxious. What if—what if you dislike him because of how many times he had emotional breakdowns that day? What if you get tired of him? He had no choice; after all, he was just an old TV that had lost all its viewers......
"How could I hate you? If I did, I would have stayed far away from you long ago...... Well, but, you really have had a few emotional breakdowns today. It's not good. If you keep having emotional breakdowns, I think...... Hmm, your core must be hurt too, right? I don't know what exactly you went through to become like this, so I won't point fingers at you from my perspective. Anyway...... Yeah, I don't hate you, nor do I mean to reject you, nor do I hate this contract. I'm just too surprised...... I, uh, I never intended to abandon you or anything. If you want to refuse, I won't sign from the start; if you want to abandon you, I will leave the game from the start. So you don't have to be so anxious...... I don't mean to leave you. ”
As you spoke, you scratched your cheek, feeling a bit flushed too—oh my god, you have no idea how you ended up saying something like that. You were clearly just standing from a friend's perspective, but what you said sounded so ambiguous. Honestly, that's not really good......
But Tenna turned to look at you again. His screen lit up, fresh flowers sprouting from his nose again, and he just grinned foolishly. Finally, he pulled out another piece of paper and loudly read: "Article 185: Tenna will never leave Y/N, will never abandon Y/N, will always be with Y/N. As an exchange, Y/N will never leave Tenna, and Y/N cannot go back on their decision to sign this contract." "Take a look, very good. The last line in exchange is still in small print."
That just seems a bit off...... You rubbed your forehead and said, "Alright, just tell me all the hidden clauses in the contract. It's fine, I have no intention of breaking it. Since we've signed the contract...... I'll keep my promise. ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror12 (tennax you)
content:
"Uh...... Well, I'll start reading it. First, Article 75: Tenna will always be Y/N's best friend! Tenna will always be Y/N's most loyal partner. Of course, after signing the contract for a month, Y/N will enter into marriage with Tenna. "Tenna recited while carefully sizing up your expression. His antenna was bent; although he was smiling, cold sweat was still dripping down the screen, and he looked at you awkwardly.
And you just shrugged: "Go on." You glanced at the paper he had just thrown down...... Hmm, sure enough, that line of marriage and all that was just a small line of small text stuck above the big letter.
To be honest, you really were set up by Tenna. You crossed your arms and looked at him, while Tenna just forced a smile. Cold sweat was pouring down his face. He pulled out two more sheets and glanced at them: "And the ones I just read to you, so I won't repeat them. Let me check the ...... below." He took out a new sheet, and this time his screen went completely black. You were a bit puzzled about what he had written and were about to speak, but at that very moment, Tenna had already spoken, speaking nervously and interrupting your thoughts.
"This ...... Article 201: Tenna will provide any assistance to Y//N. Tenna will help Y/N clear the game and adjust the game according to Y/N's requests. However, in exchange, Y/N must always stay in this game and cannot leave. ”
He read this clause, and the screen lit up again, but...... It was just a white screen, nothing special. Of course, there was no expression at all.
Tenna's antenna drooped again, and you couldn't help but widen your eyes when you heard the clause: "You...... So now, I have to stay in this game forever. Can't I leave?" He clasped his hands behind his back, the antenna bent. Fine, he didn't really want to answer your question, but in the end, he still spoke.
"Yes, my dear star, you must always stay here, by my side." His voice sounded righteous and confident, and you almost laughed at his anger.
"Oh my god...... Although I said I want to keep my promise, I don't mind signing this contract, I...... I don't mind dating you or anything like that, even though I've never been in a relationship, so what do you mean by setting such a clause? You know perfectly well that I'm a citizen of light, and I can't stay here forever. You know I wanted to leave, but now you've stripped me of my right to leave, is that right? I...... I never expected your contract to be so despicable. If I'd known earlier, I definitely wouldn't have signed it! "Now you're really a bit angry—honestly, you don't mind what happened earlier, do you? You don't mind that random marriage just now, but you don't mind this matter.
But you hate, hate that someone takes away your freedom in the name of loving you, you hate Tenna, which is supposed to be a trade but means you can only stay in this place for life—you hate this inexplicable restriction imposed on you. Well, you know, maybe it's just that he's a bit uneasy...... After all, ever since you met him, he's already had several emotional breakdowns throughout the day, and you don't mind comforting him, because you really like this place. Of course, you're also curious about what Tenna is like to design this game.
…… It's just that he...... Tenna, he shouldn't have done that. Maybe he thinks you have a good temper and will never get angry. But everyone gets angry sometimes.
You sneered and ignored him, letting him staring at the screen in the dark, wanting to say something. You simply walked to the door of the cabin, closed it with a heavy sound, and then took a deep breath, trying to figure out how to walk the path—first to the left, then right to the cabin three times in a row, then twice to the left, and finally to the right. If you reach a patch of grass, that should be your final destination. You judged the note in your hand and finally walked left first.
Tenna originally wanted to reach out and hold you back, but...... But you slammed the door hard and left. Tenna stared helplessly at the door, and in the end, he just turned his back, his figure slumped away...... Yes, yes, he really did trick you into signing this name, or maybe ...... Forcing you to stay.
…… Even though he didn't think that way at first—he just wanted to trick you into signing the contract, so that you could naturally have some intimate contact after marriage...... Naturally, this clause is perfectly normal—you can only stay by his side forever, forever, forever.
But he didn't expect you to be this angry. Tenna originally didn't want to tell you all these hidden terms, but...... However, he didn't want to go against your request.
His antenna drooped, and he left the cabin gloomily. Naturally, he saw you in the distant grass...... And he instinctively walked toward you.
He is the creator of this game, this world, and of course won't be trapped by this little ghost wall. Tenna stands behind you again, hands behind his back, a smile on his face once more. He wants to say something to you, but he speaks: "Um, my dear star, Y/N...... I, I just hope you won't leave me. ”
However, you paid no attention to Tenna, just hesitated as you stared at the grass ahead, feeling that there must be some kind of puzzle ahead...... And sure enough, you saw a note among the grass.
You saw it...... Well, this note fell on a tree, which means now you have to climb the tree.
Tenna was still trying to speak to you: "I don't want you to leave this world, Y/N. After all, besides you, who else would want to see my old, uninspired TV?" I know. Maybe you think the world is new now, but once you've seen the whole scenery, you'll definitely hate this place...... I, I...... Yeah, I know, you'll definitely want to leave here in the future. And if you stop caring about me, what should I do? Haha, I'm just a TV that can't do anything—" He said, forcing a smile, cold sweat running down his face. You hadn't wanted to talk to him at first, but after hearing his words, you couldn't help but argue.
"I haven't refused your clause that I want to be with you forever—in fact, I don't reject being with you, nor do I hate the world you've created, nor do I hate you. But I hate that you restrict my freedom of choice, I hate that you lock in my future like this. I don't want my future to be something I can see right through at a glance." The more you talked, the smaller Tenna's body became, until he was the size of a pet dog. You lowered your head to look at Tenna, wanting to say more, but seeing him like this, you just couldn't say anything more.
In the end, you just pinched your brow: "...... Forget it, you help me get that thing up on the treetop first." You directed Tenna to grow back big, and he happily ran around. The screen bloomed again, and he lifted you up so you could reach the note at the treetop.
You picked up the note, then opened it and saw a string of arrows with unknown meanings...... Well, at least you know what it means.
Following the direction indicated by the arrow, you first went left, passing the cabin three times, then twice to the right, once to the left, and finally twice to the right—once again arriving at the end of the forest, where the weeds weeded. This time, a new figure appeared in the grass, just like the one you encountered not far from the spawn point—a black monster.
Tenna just droops his antenna and follows behind you...... He doesn't look very happy. Of course, he knows you're not happy either, so he doesn't dare say anything to disturb you. Tenna also sees the shadow guy ahead, and you just swing down with your staff, delivering a slash. Unexpectedly, the monster doesn't flee immediately; instead, it pulls out a saxophone and plays a tune, then ...... Uh, you pull out your initial weapon—the sword—and cast a fireball spell on the monster, causing the surrounding grass to start burning—and of course, the monster couldn't take it anymore. It fled backward and left the place, and as it left, a small piece of paper, probably like a piece of paper, ended up in your hand, looking like some dropped object.
You examined it carefully...... This was probably an incomplete piece of paper, because there was indeed a string of text engraved on it, but as ...... Uh, the edge of this paper was torn off, and you don't know where the password in the latter half went.
You put the paper away, planning to keep moving forward, but just then, you hear Tenna's voice again: "Um, Y/N...... My dear star, I...... I'm sorry for what happened before. "You glanced at him. He was still with his head down, hands behind his back, his voice static, sounding a bit awkward and noisy.
“…… I don't need your apology. After all, I've signed that contract, and there's no way I'm leaving here." You snorted coldly, turned your head, and didn't intend to pay him any more attention, but you heard his voice again: "...... I'm really sorry, I—I guarantee you'll still have a chance......" He spoke in a quieter voice.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror13 (tennax you)
content:
"You've already written it all in black and white, what chance do I have left?" You snorted coldly. You didn't want to pay attention to Tenna, who had been nervously following behind you with her hands behind her back, but you watched as his figure shrank bit by bit. In the end—you can't quite say why, but in any case, you still feel a bit reluctant. You don't know if you really like this seemingly clueless big guy, you don't know...... Do you really have some feelings for him in love? You can't figure it out yourself, after all, you've never been in a relationship!
“…… Forget it. You tell me, what other chances do I have? You should know I won't stay here forever, right?" You glanced at Tenna, watching him turn back on and look at you on the screen...... Honestly, you didn't know what to say, and your voice became a bit stuck as you looked at him. You cleared your throat and continued, "Of course, I won't break the terms of the contract. I'll find a way to stay with you forever...... Well, that's about it. I haven't figured out exactly what to do yet." "After all, you don't really know what the Dark People really mean...... Well, but since you've already agreed, a promise is a promise. You won't break the written contract terms, and of course, you won't ...... You won't go back on what you just promised Tenna.
You felt a bit embarrassed, cleared your throat, and turned away: "Anyway...... Except that I can't stay in this world forever, everything else is fine. ”
"Including marriage?" You hear Tenna suddenly ask from behind you.
"Including marriage—uh, wait, this marriage should be what I was thinking, right? Can a citizen of light and a citizen of darkness really get married? And...... Why do you want to marry me? You clearly know that if you're just a citizen of darkness, you can't do everything marriage requires, right? Ah, wait, skipping the previous question, so what exactly is the opportunity you're talking about? ”
Keep walking forward; fortunately, this grassland doesn't cause much harm...... But if you go further, it's still grassland, and you don't know when it will end.
“…… When the game ends, you'll have this chance......" Tenna whispered vaguely, sneaking a glance at you, then finally lowering his head, "As for marriage—you know, my dear star, my dear Y/N, at least I can do these things." As he spoke, he suddenly hugged you from behind, and you widened your eyes—oh my god, you've never had such close contact with anyone? Before you could react and push him away, Tenna leaned in to your cheek and gently kissed your cheek.
His voice grew a bit nervous: "I...... At least I can still do these things, Y/N, you don't mind these things, do you? I ...... It's because I like you so much that I gave you this contract. I suppose you like me too, right? "Even his movements reveal caution and shyness. You watch as his hands are once again behind his back. Though he's smiling, cold sweat is dripping down his face—maybe he's just guessing, betting on your attitude.
You hesitated for a moment, shook your head, and nodded again: "I actually—don't dislike him?" At most, I'm a little surprised. "After all, he didn't act particularly offensively...... Well, so you don't mind too, and you don't mind him doing this...... You don't know why he likes you, but you're certain that although you like him a little, it's definitely not about love.
So you shook your head and, after a brief pause, continued, "But...... But, I do like you a little, but it's definitely not about love, probably...... Probably, I just see you as a very good friend...... You hesitate to choose, thinking about how to say it, but Tenna interrupts you.
Fresh flowers appeared on his nose again, looking very happy. He leaned in a little closer to you again: "Oh, so that means—you like me too! No matter what, no matter what kind of relationship it is, as long as you like me, that's enough! You don't dislike me, you really like me, so we can get married!" ”
You don't know where Tenna's twisted logic comes from, and you certainly don't know. Although Tenna appears very happy on the surface—inside, he is actually very nervous. His mechanical heart is pounding, he looks at you, nervously clasping his hands behind his back—he doesn't know, he doesn't know how you will react.
Well, actually...... He wants to know too. He really wants to know your answer.
Anyway, you were just stunned for a moment...... You sized up Tenna; he really meant what he said, but he was clearly still a bit nervous.
You rubbed your forehead, suspecting Tenna actually didn't know...... Regarding the definition of marriage and partner, you couldn't help but speak up again: "...... I don't know why you like me. But anyway, marriage isn't as simple as you think? Marriage requires love, intimacy, commitment...... Well, just because we like each other doesn't mean we get married, and you can't say that, I really ...... Just treating you as a friend ......" By the end, your voice gradually faded because you felt a bit guilty. Do you consider someone you can hug and kiss as a friend? People of Light generally don't call this a friend......
“…… I like you, I love you...... Y/N, just because...... Uh, the target is you, the only thing I like is you...... Tenna's voice was soft, hesitating, probably not knowing what to say, "I like you, Y/N, because you want to appreciate this world, because you want to appreciate me, because—because you want to stay and experience this game, because you want to be by my side...... I can't possibly see you as a pure friend, because when I realize I've fallen in love with you—I, every moment, want to be a little closer to you...... I want to hug, I want to kiss, I want you to look at me, I want you to be by my side every moment...... I know very well, I've fallen in love with you." His voice grew quieter and quieter, turning black again—he, he didn't know what else he could say to you, he just muddled out all his true feelings.
You look at Tenna seriously, you—you, you don't know what kind of expectations you hold, you don't know if you like this TV person in front of you, want to kiss him, hug him? You think for a moment, and the answer is—it doesn't matter.
