You don't care that he loves you, nor do you really know what kind of feelings you have for him...... But you really don't dislike him; you comfort him, you ...... You're willing to let him kiss and hug you. Does this kind of relationship count as liking? You don't know.
But you still moved a little closer to Tenna, hesitated for a moment, and finally stood on tiptoe and gently kissed him on the screen. Your voice was soft, a bit muffled: "...... Alright, I agree. But you have to find a way to make me fall in love with you. ”
Tenna instinctively bounced in place, he—he didn't expect you to respond to him, he was just too happy! You watched Tenna's screen turn pink—after a while, he smiled silly, a flower blooming on his nose, he danced with his arms and legs, and finally he pounced over and hugged you tightly, his voice full of joy, silly, shouting loudly: "Oh, Y/N, I really, really—I love you so much!! Of course, I will absolutely make you fall in love with me—truly, I will make you love me from the bottom of your heart, truly and sincerely!" Oh my god...... Oh my god, this is so wonderful...... I, I really like you......" he said, but his voice couldn't help but sound a bit sobbing, almost like he was sobbing.
Really, he ...... How afraid he is that you will hate it all, leave him recklessly, leave this place, recklessly ...... When he wakes up, he will never see you again, and he will never have the chance to see you again. He is also very afraid that you will reject all of this, after all...... All of this is what he gained by deceiving you, like honey carefully stolen, only to be exposed by you not long after. He is afraid you will leave here, leave his side, reject all this senseless love—but Tenna knows you eventually softened and let him get close to you, so—so he will only get a little closer, a little more, never satisfied.
You frowned, wanting to push Tenna away. After all, her warm body was uncomfortable with her body pressed against you...... But in the end, your hand still didn't push him away. Instead, you placed it on his head and gently patted it.
“…… Hmm, I get it. Then you have to keep your word. You have to work hard to make me like you—okay, alright, so how do we walk from here? We can't just stay in this grassy patch forever, can we?" "You changed the subject, turned your face away, and for some reason, your face turned a little red...... You, alright, you don't dislike Tenna's closeness, you even think he's a bit cute, but that probably doesn't count as love, right?
At this moment, Tenna's body stiffened for a moment. He forced a dry laugh and said, "Uh, um...... That! Exactly...... Haha, I forgot to set Mike for the map—the king inside the castle just now. Normally, he'd give you a map to tell you where the apostles and demon lords you want to eliminate are......
TBC.

title: Adventurerror14 (Tennax you)
content:
You, who had originally planned to set off, couldn't help but show a dead fish eye when you heard this: "...... Huh? So, normally, as a hero, I don't know where to go next, so—so I can only wander around this continent? That really goes along with your wishes, isn't it? I can stay here forever." Although we had just talked things out, you still felt a bit resentful, so you couldn't help but nudg Tenna.
Tenna just shook her hand anxiously: "It's not like that, it's not like that—although the king hasn't told you, the all-powerful narrator will tell you what to do next!" ”
You were about to complain that the narrator was actually read by him himself, but then a red arrow popped up...... Pointing straight ahead, Tenna cleared her throat and switched back to that formal broadcast voice: "Ahem hmm—Y/N has once again embarked on her own journey. Just now, she successfully killed the first Apostle and obtained part of a string of passwords!" Next, Y/N will embark on the path to face the second Apostle! ”
…… You really want to complain, even though he's right next to you, he insists on using this kind of narration...... It feels like, how should I put it...... It feels like he's singing a grand play alone on a stage that hasn't even been set up, yet he continues to give narration with complete enthusiasm.
"And the second apostle is located deep in the mountains, where snow covers all year round, and the mountains never receive sunlight, and the mountains are shrouded in darkness all day—"
You finally interrupted him: "Alright, I know where he is, in the middle of a snowy mountain...... But, uh, is it really that easy to deal with an apostle?? The enemy I just fought was an apostle?? "You really don't get it. You thought things would be that hard to solve...... But it turns out this so-called apostle is no different from a small monster.
Tenna cleared his throat and cleared his throat twice, clearly aware of just how unreasonable his previous design was. He clasped his hands behind his back and laughed, "Ahaha...... Maybe that apostle was just too busy with training. Of course, that apostle was just here to practice first! Hmm, the next apostle won't be so easy to deal with! "He said this with such conviction. You looked at him with full suspicion, but Tenna just nervously clasped her hands behind her back, still smiling, but...... Hmm, after a while, he turned his face away in a drenched sweat.
"Alright, then the next Apostles will probably get tough...... Now tell me, where the direction of the snowy mountain is, and where are we heading now? "You stared at him with half-moon eyes, arms crossed, while Tenna suddenly straightened up, her antenna upright, looking very serious and serious.
Immediately after, the narrator's familiar voice rang out again: "Ah...... Well, you just need to follow the arrow straight ahead! Y/N knows that as long as you keep following the arrow's guidance and keep moving forward, as long as you keep moving forward, you can reach your destination...... Y/N knows that as long as you keep moving forward, as long as you follow the narrator's guidance, you will never go wrong! ”
“…… Uh, alright, I get it. Just keep moving forward, but why do you have to play the narrator when you're standing next to me? "You ruthlessly interrupted him.
Tenna's face was sweating even more. He trembled, hands behind his back, looking guilty: "Ah, this is to help you feel more immersed—cough, cough, otherwise how could this game even be called a game!" ”
"It wasn't really a proper game...... Wait. "You walked forward as you spoke, and then ...... Then, to your surprise, you found that ahead, there was also a patch of green grass, but it turned out to be a lush green swamp??
Your body keeps sinking, and you turn around to try to return to the grass you just went, only to see a prompt pop up in front of you, telling you that you are currently in a challenge and cannot exit for now.
You felt the veins on your forehead bulge again, but you calmly asked, "So what's going on here? How did a good grassland turn into a swamp—without even any hints?? This looks like grass, right? Is this some kind of iwanna game?? It's just a trap, deliberately making people step into this pit?? "Well, you really can't stay calm forever—oh my god, your body is still sinking, just not drowned in this swamp yet.
"Uh...... I, um, Y/N, don't rush, I'll check it out now! "Tenna, sweating profusely, opened his compilation window. Great...... He saw that he had entered a string of code at the time, intending to let the hero directly see this swamp. But somehow, he had entered the code incorrectly, including the swamp in the grassland's code, meaning ...... Hmm, this swamp is now hidden beneath the grass.
"Uh, um, I wrote it wrong! Sorry, Y/N, I'll find a way to get you up right away......" Tenna muttered as she spoke, but ended up walking into the swamp herself, and her body seemed to sink even faster.
You stared speechlessly at Tenna beside you...... Oh my god, why is it like this? Soon, you saw the swamp had sunk up to near his chest.
"Oh, wait, oh my god, why am I sinking myself too?!" Tenna held his head, drenched in sweat, and in the end, he simply switched back to the black screen. He was really...... Really! Oh my god, logically he had set it up for himself. Normally, he shouldn't be sinking, right??
You crossed your arms and looked at him with crescent eyes: "How would I know...... What on earth are you doing?! Oh my god...... And you're sinking even faster. Looks like you'll be completely down in a while. "You let out a schadenfreude laugh. After all, you're all in the swamp now, and you can't move forward. The only difference is whether you die sooner or later.
"I...... No, wait, I wrote it wrong again...... Tenna opened the code panel, frowning worriedly, his screen going blank—he realized he had reversed the previous symbolic code. Logically, he shouldn't have sunk into the swamp, since he had created the swamp isolation code for himself, but...... Uh, he wrote it backwards, which means the swamp is now rapidly devouring him.
He tapped on the keyboard, but obviously, the swamp isolation code was useless; it could only slow his death. Then he glanced at you again, and then he had a sudden idea—well, maybe this isn't a good thing, after all, he wrote that code that accelerates the devouring on you.
Tenna, on the other hand, wouldn't be swallowed by the swamp for a while, but he put his hands together and bowed to you: "Ah, um...... Ahem, sorry, I wrote the code for accelerated death on you. Please return to the grass first, then figure out how to save me......
You stared at him blankly, about to say something to accuse Tenna, but you sank too fast. When you opened your mouth, you ate a mouthful of swampy mud, and all you could do was make gurgling sounds.
…… Very good, you die, then you come back to life.
…… Then you found yourself reborn in front of that small cabin from before?? You ...... Oh my god, you forgot to let Tenna save you in time, but being reborn in this place still left you feeling an indescribable sense of helplessness. Fortunately, you still remember how you got here before, so you quickly walked over and returned to the edge of that swamp.
You weren't in a hurry to save Tenna, just crouched down, resting your chin on your hand and watching him. Your voice was a bit faint: "Tenna...... Thanks to you, I wasted another ten minutes searching for my way back and you didn't save me...... "It sounded a bit like a vengeful spirit stealing souls." Tenna shivered, smiling awkwardly, cold sweat dripping down the screen: "Uh, um...... I didn't do this on purpose! Uh, well, actually I forgot to set up instant save for you. Right now, I'm still using auto-save...... I'll change it for you right away, right away! But you have to get me out of this swamp first, right? He gave an awkward smile, and you shrugged, making no other moves, just resting your chin on your hand and watching him.
"Hmm, hmm...... I see you're perfectly fine, not sinking in. Looks like you probably don't mind staying in the swamp forever, right? "Of course, you never really planned to do that. You were just teasing him.
Tenna also wore a bitter face: "Ah, Y/N, my dear Y/N, please be kind and save your dear boyfriend...... Trust me, I've already written the swamp immunity code for you. Just come down and take me out!" ”
Hearing the term 'boyfriend' made you shiver instinctively; you still weren't used to the fact of dating Tenna...... Oh my god, even though you had already agreed. But since Tenna said the code was changed and you planned to give it a try, you stood up again and tentatively walked toward the swamp. This time it really felt like walking on grass—you didn't step on any damn swamp again. Actually, you wanted to ask Tenna if she couldn't just change the terrain directly? But then you thought about it, since he was still in the swamp, you gave up.
You walk on flat ground, your steps brisk, and you walk across the street, completely ignoring Tenna's burning gaze at you—after all, he doesn't have eyes!
So Tenna turned the screen to the dark and just stared blankly in your direction. When you turned to look at him, you always felt he looked a bit pitiful...... You couldn't help but crouch down again at the other end of the swamp, propping up your head and looking at him, asking, "Can't you walk out yourself?" ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror15 (tennax you)
content:
Hearing this, he perked up a bit again, and the antenna was upright, but he still had a black screen, clearly not in a good mood...... Even so, he spoke to you in a pitiful tone: "Um...... Well, of course I can't get out myself, because I'm already in the swamp. The rule here is that if you fall into it, you can't get out...... "This is the underlying code of this swamp, and he can't modify it."
You were a bit speechless when you heard this, propping your head up and looking at him: "Is that so...... Then why was there some challenge when I fell just now? Didn't you say you couldn't get out?" "You actually didn't care much about this question; you were just asking him in a slightly teasing tone.
Tenna's voice was just stammering: "Um, um—I wrote the code wrong. I didn't expect that being stuck in the swamp and unable to act was its underlying code, so I wrote a challenge system before......" The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became.
“…… Alright, I'll bring you up. So, why are you giving me this game full of bugs? "You let out a sigh of relief and still walked into the swamp to pull Tenna out, unable to help but complain. The process of pulling Tenna out was surprisingly smooth...... Maybe the swamp was powerless against your code and simply crashed! But to prevent Tenna from being swallowed by the swamp again, even though he was a bit heavy for you, you reluctantly gave him a princess carry and held him in your arms. His feet barely touched the surface of the swamp, barely dropping, and Tenna instinctively wrapped his arms around your neck, his voice growing a bit sharp: "Wait, wait, wait, Y/N, are you sure you want to do this...... still a bit nervous. After all, he never expected that your first hug would be a princess carry he gave you......
And you just shook your head helplessly, feigning deep emotion as you said, "Of course I can do this. Otherwise, do you want me to drag you out of this swamp?" "Of course, you can carry him on your back, or use your arms to carry him away...... Well, but that would be too exhausting for you. Princess carrying, now is much more convenient.
"Of course not...... But for Y/N, that's pretty heavy, right? "Tenna shook his head sharply, then opened a panel, mumbling to himself, and ...... He lightened his weight, so at least you could barely feel his weight anymore, which made you marvel. Tenna then looked at you nervously, and of course, he hugged your neck tightly. The whole big TV crew seemed to be curled up in your arms, clinging to you and not daring to let go at all. His antenna hung down, and his screen went blank—then he broke out in a cold sweat, as if carefully observing you.
"Besides, Y/N doesn't say he just likes the way the world is now, so I didn't change it......" His voice grew quieter and quieter, and the screen went black again. He just carefully curled up in your arms. I don't know if it was just your imagination, but it felt like his figure had shrunk a little too.
"......" You paused for a moment, feeling like you were shooting yourself in the foot. You—well, you told Tenna you preferred the current world because it was fun...... But always having bugs and such made everything look messy and chaotic. Although you didn't mind how chaotic it was, you really enjoyed this somewhat chaotic but actually very interesting scene...... But that doesn't mean you can accept everything. But...... Well, you don't expect Tenna to modify anything, after all, it's just a game, and it's a TV. Expecting a TV to develop a game is a pipe dream......
So you cleared your throat twice and decided to skip the topic: "Alright, alright, got it...... Honestly, some bugs are really annoying. "After all, it's just a waste of your time...... Of course, you're still willing to keep playing!
And you watch Tenna shrink a little further. By now, you've already come ashore, but...... As Tenna is gradually shrinking, and finally curled up in your arms into a tiny one, you don't dare put him down for now. Listening to his sobbing, you just find it a bit troublesome...... But in the end, you still lower your head, hurriedly kiss his forehead, then cough twice: "Ahem...... I'm not saying bugs are annoying and you don't want to play with them...... Look, I'm still standing here safely, and I'm still willing to keep moving forward. It's just ...... But to be honest, the time spent with you solving these bugs is more fun...... If I hadn't had you by my side, running into a game with so many bugs, honestly, I wouldn't want to experience it either." As you said this, even your cheeks grew hot. You always felt like it wasn't really the right thing to say...... It felt like it was a bit ambiguous, and when Tenna heard that, she almost bounced out of your arms. He had grown into a huge one, beaming with a silly smile, a flower blooming at the tip of his nose, while he was just pressing down on you, pressing you down onto the soft grass.
You were still a bit dazed, but at this very moment, Tenna's kiss had already fallen, gently landing on your cheek, then on your lips. His antenna wobbled, and his voice was cheerful: "Oh, so my dear star, you really do like me, that's why you want to play games with me!" Y/N, I really like you, because only you ever say things like that to me...... At the end, he leaned close to murmuring to himself, just hugging you, his TV head rubbing against your neck. Your body stiffened, and you instinctively tried to push him away. At that moment, the warm breath he exhaled by your ear made your cheeks burn hotter and your body stiffen.
It's just ...... When you heard his words, you did feel a bit puzzled. You're wondering, do you really like him? You can't figure it out either...... In short, you just don't dislike him, nor do you dislike the world, and it seems you're even somewhat indulgent of him...... Does that count as liking him? You can't figure it out either.
You just tilted your head slightly and muttered, "Alright, alright, I know. Get up first...... If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have experienced this game...... But that doesn't mean I like you as much as you like me...... That doesn't mean it's about this. "You think about it and feel it's better to say it that way. Maybe, as Tenna said, you do like him, but that affection hasn't reached the level of true love—not enough to marry him, to be with him forever, to be with him until his final days...... You're pretty sure it's not that far yet.
…… Although if asked about it, you would still agree to Tenna, because you don't mind the behaviors mentioned above.
"Anyway, get up first. Aren't we supposed to hunt down the next apostle? Why don't you tell me how to get there?" As you spoke, you gently patted the TV head that had been buried in your shoulder and neck. Only then did Tenna reluctantly stand up, regaining his smile and looking quite happy. Then, that red arrow, which seemed somewhat out of place with the surroundings, appeared again—accompanied by Tenna's unusually cheerful voice.
"Ah—brave hero Y/N saved Mr. Tenna from deep in the swamp! This is an act worthy of praise. Of course, we'll talk about the prize later," Tenna said, lowering her voice again, as if whispering something to you. You couldn't help but squint your half-moon eyes, crossing your arms. You want to see what else this guy can say...... Hmm, he really went on, "As long as you follow the red arrow, you'll find the location of the next Apostle!" The red arrow's instructions are never wrong, and Mr. Tenna's instructions are never wrong!! Oh, and as for the next stop...... It's on the snowy plain, and walking takes about five days. "He lowered his voice again to inform you of this.
You look at the grass ahead—looking around, it's still grassland. You really don't understand how it would eventually turn into a snowy plain, but in the end, you still take Tenna's hand and set off.
Then your vision goes black—because Tenna pulls out a huge black sign with big white characters and blocks it in front of you. The sign says 'Five Days Later'—oh my god, is this just a rough cutscene? Your eyes instinctively widen, while Tenna just chuckles twice, hands behind his back, probably feeling a bit guilty...... After all, you break out in a cold sweat on his screen again, and then he kicks the placard away. You realize the scene before you is no longer that grassy field, but a ...... A vast snowfield.
You were a bit dazed, but the cold wind hitting your face made you shiver first, and you sneezed several times in a row. But you didn't set out with your luggage—of course, you only wore thin clothes suited to the weather just now.
At that moment, Tenna was also pressed close to you, his body trembling as well, and he was just shivering, speaking righteously: "Um...... Um, CRT TVs can't withstand the cold! So I'm going to act together with you, Y/N! ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror16 (tennax you)
content:
You hugged yourself tightly, then looked at Tenna, who was trying to get close to you—oh my, he looked nothing like you were trembling. Although he said he was cold, he didn't seem that cold at all.
You took a deep breath, then another—You, oh my god, you can't even imagine how cold Tenna must be when she says she's cold, but definitely not as cold as you...... You whisper to yourself, but eventually move a little closer to Tenna's direction, because you really are cold.
"Alright, alright...... But I'm cold too. You don't look as cold as I am. What should we do now? "You pouted as you spoke. Honestly, you don't really like how things are now...... You stood there shivering, clutching your clothes, saying that your cold Tenna acted as if nothing had happened.
"Oh, my dear Y/N, I can carry you and walk with me, so you won't feel cold at all!" Tenna's voice was full of excitement, and he looked genuinely happy—oh my, you can't even imagine how happy he would be.
You hesitated as you looked at Tenna, wondering if this would really keep you warm. But before you could hesitate for long, he suddenly scooped you up—in a princess carry. You couldn't tell if it was revenge for what you had done to him earlier; in any case, you just instinctively wrapped your arms around Tenna's neck.
But Tenna...... Obviously, Tenna wasn't thinking that far; he simply wanted to get close to you. He even slightly pulled open his clothes, letting the CRT body, which was cooling off, move closer to you. Although the cold wind was indeed unbearable...... But, well, you really weren't cold at this moment, since Tenna's body was warm—not to be able to freeze or anything...... It's hard to imagine what a CRT TV would look like if it were frozen, especially since this was Tenna.
But being held by him still made me feel a bit embarrassed, even though Tenna was already walking forward with a silly smile, and a flower was still blooming on the tip of his nose...... There was even a flower blooming!
"Oh...... Wait, Tenna, is it still convenient for you to hold me like this? I don't think it would be very convenient, since I still have to move forward...... "You say it dryly, but you'll regret it once you say it. You really think this isn't a suitable topic for opening remarks."
But Tenna's voice remained relaxed and a bit excited, as if none of this meant much to him right now: "Don't worry, Y/N, your weight means nothing to me—and I'm glad I can be useful to you. Besides, we're heading in the same direction—so it won't hold you back!" As he spoke, he waved his hand, and the red arrow appeared again, this time pointing ahead. Tenna just walked forward excitedly, even joking you in his arms. I wasn't sure if it was just your imagination, but you only felt the smile on his face grow a little bigger...... Uh, maybe it's just your imagination.
"But...... I'm the player responsible for clearing this game, the hero who has accepted the mission...... I—I don't really think you can help me deal with the enemies ahead or all those messy puzzles. ”
You keep complaining, honestly...... Although the puzzle he set is simple, it's still worth playing with and can kill some time.
But Tenna just shook her head in disagreement: "I'll leave the puzzle to you. As for the journey, leave it to me!" He was clearly in high spirits, and you couldn't say anything more...... He simply handed the matter over to Tenna, who happily led you forward.
He stepped on the snow, which creaked and the cold wind howled...... You always felt Tenna seemed to walk slowly, but his speed wasn't fast, as if he was carefully cherishing the time spent with you.
And in the cold environment, you feel a bit sleepy too, and you can't help but yawn...... Leaning against Tenna's chest, his chest feels a bit hard, but more so it's an indescribable softness. And whether it's intentional or not, now it's a bit bulging...... Clearly, when you looked at him before, it wasn't like this.
But in any case, you yawn, adjust into a fairly comfortable position in his arms, and then you fall asleep leaning against Tenna.
Tenna looked at you sleeping in his arms, carefully lowered her head to kiss your forehead—then the flower blooming on his nose grew even bigger, and he happily held you forward, even deliberately slowing his pace a little more—well, after all, he couldn't wake you up! If he did, you'd definitely be unhappy.
Of course...... There's one more thing, he ...... That was his selfishness—he wanted to be with you, even longer...... He kept staring at you, holding you carefully as he walked through this icy and snowy land.
Your body heat is also warming his body, and ...... Because you're in his arms, Tenna just feels her screen getting hotter, and her whole body is heating up too. So...... So of course, he doesn't feel cold anymore. Because when you're in his arms, he doesn't feel cold at all.
Unfortunately, this long journey seemed distant and would eventually have an end—Tenna paused, because ahead lay an air wall. He reached out and gently stroked it, hmm...... Actually, he didn't know what other levels could be set up in the snow, so he set them as air walls. Anyway, they could still block the player's path.
In a way, what you said is indeed correct...... Because, because he really ...... He couldn't fully complete this game, couldn't debug it properly, which led to a bunch of errors and bugs...... But you were the first player to arrive in this world, the first Light Citizen to experience this game, so in a way, you should also be considered a test player, right? Anyway, Tenna picked up the password slip from the ground, then stuffed it into your arms, and whispered, "Wake up, Y/N...... We've arrived." Of course, his voice was very soft, clearly not wanting you to hear clearly.
And you're still half-asleep, lost in your own sleep, not waking up because of his calls...... Honestly, that voice is just too faint, too soft. Seeing that he didn't wake you, Tenna was even happier. That meant he could spend a little more time with you, and when you woke up, he could tell you, yes...... He called you, but you just haven't woken up!
He sat down holding you by the snow, gently wrapping you up in his arms. His TV head rested on yours, and his smile was sweet...... Oh my god, oh my god, it was quiet now, but his heart was surging. He could clearly feel his heart pounding because of you, even if it was just a mechanical heart.
So the smile on his face grew even sweeter. He gently rubbed his head against yours, then carefully kissed your forehead. He really liked it...... If only time could stop at this moment forever.
Unfortunately, that's impossible. Even though Tenna was so cautious and didn't make any moves, you still rubbed your eyes and stretched, because you finally woke up from your sleep—the first thing you saw was Tenna pressing up to the big white screen in front of you—well, of course, he was smiling, otherwise you might have been scared out of his wits.
You stood up from his embrace. At this moment, you weren't particularly cold—probably the lingering warmth Tenna had left behind. Tenna looked at her empty embrace and felt nothing but a sense of loss...... How wonderful it would be if I could stay with you all the time.
"Why are you stopping here and not leaving?" You looked ahead, still a snowy plain with no end in sight, and couldn't help but ask a question. Tenna instinctively reached out her hand to stop you.
"No, it's up ahead......" He wanted to say something to stop you from moving forward, but you walked straight ahead as if you didn't care, and then Tenna's words were interrupted with a bang.
…… You hit that air wall—it was your head that hit it first. You gasped, clutching your forehead, and took two steps back, tearfully looking at the annoying air wall, touching it with your hand: "So there was an air wall...... Why didn't you say so earlier! And why did you set up an air wall in the game?! ”
Tenna broke out in a cold sweat and stood up as well, hands clasped behind his back, his eyes darting: "Um...... Um, this isn't ...... You didn't even have time to listen to me and crashed into me! I was just about to tell you this...... Now he was holding his head back and chest out, looking extremely proud.
"And the reason there's an air wall here is because I really don't know how to design the mechanisms in the snowy plain. So I set it as an air wall...... The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became, and he kept looking up at you. Now, he felt very guilty again, and the screen turned pitch black once again.
You crossed your arms, watching Tenna shrink bit by bit, and finally just shrugged: "Alright...... But my forehead still hurts a bit. If only you had just grabbed me......
“…… It's simple—just blow it on and it won't hurt!" Tenna suddenly became cheerful again.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror17 (tennax you)
content:
You blink, not having time to retort, and Tenna is already holding your head—his TV screen is leaning in, but this time it's not a kiss. He's just carefully holding your head and gently blowing air on your forehead—well, the CRT TV really does blow hot air. Your thoughts drift for a second, and then your cheeks become hot—oh my god, the breath he blows is warm, but his movements are so gentle...... Oh my god, oh my god, you cry out inside, but your face is just blank. Then, your cheeks start to heat up and become hot too.
Tenna cupped your face, the TV screen facing you. He looked at your cheek, then gently kissed yours, but then softly said as if you didn't know anything...... "Uh, but it's bright red and easy to kiss......" he muttered softly, while you stared blankly at his screen, then shoved him away—of course, not forcefully, but Tenna still seemed hurt and suddenly stepped back, clutching his chest, his expression turning completely blank—only after a moment, he laughed awkwardly again, while cold sweat still dripped down his screen.
Of course, his voice sounded a bit aggrieved: "What's wrong, Y/N? Why did you just push me away? Old TVs are easy to fall and get hurt......" He muttered, and you cleared your throat twice, turned your head slightly, and didn't explain anything to him...... Well, actually, you didn't know how to explain either. You just hurriedly and awkwardly changed the subject.
"Uh...... Well, it's nothing. Speaking of which, there's a wall of air up ahead. What do you plan to do? What should I do to get over it? "As you spoke, you stood on tiptoe and hopped a couple of times, trying to feel the boundary of this wall of air, but unfortunately, a wall is just a wall...... Anyway, you haven't found the boundary; you've only touched one wall.
Tenna perked up again. He bent down to pick up the paper that had fallen because you had fallen to the ground and handed it back to you, then nervously turned his hand behind his back. He ...... Well, he really did feel guilty, because he set ...... Well, anyway, it's not anything good.
Curious, you take the paper and look at it, while hearing Tenna say, "This ...... I didn't know what to set up, so I set up this air wall. Actually, it should be the gate you can only pass through after completing the decryption!" As he spoke, he gestured with his hand, as if that would explain exactly what was ahead. And you couldn't help but show a deadpan eye: "...... Alright, so where is the place where you enter the password for decryption? There's only this air wall up ahead, at least it looks like it's the only wall in front...... You mutter, but in the end, you still take the note Tenna handed you and glance at it. Hmm, it has several lines of strange arrows drawn on it...... But if it's like the previous puzzle, just walking back and forth in a few directions, that probably doesn't feel right. You marked a few numbers following the direction the arrow walked......
"Ah, just let me enter the password. Y/N, just tell me what the password is!" Tenna patted her chest again, confidently assuring you of this...... It's hard to say how this actually happened, but for now, there's no choice but to do it.
So you just kept a half-moon eye watching Tenna, then announced a number: "8652." ”
You watch Tenna step forward and poke something on the password door, then the door swings open with a bang—and Tenna starts dancing animatedly: "Y/N really is amazing, this puzzle really won't be a problem for you! I knew it!" ”
You gestured to stop: "Stop, stop, stop...... There's no need to praise me to the point of exaggeration, cough cough. "You started to lose your blushing, your ears turned bright red, and Tenna noticed this. Then he picked you up—"Oh my god, Y/N, did you feel cold after standing in the snow for so long...... It's all my fault. I didn't notice this and made you feel cold in the snow for ages......" As he spoke, the antenna drooped, clearly feeling guilty about it.
You quietly glanced away. Honestly, you felt a bit embarrassed to say you were just shy just now, so you muttered, "No, it's nothing...... It's just that I don't feel cold. "You don't want to explain what exactly happened to you just now.
Tenna just pulled herself together and returned to that silly grin: "Oh, that's good! Let's keep moving—the second apostle is just ahead! We'll reach our destination soon! As for Y/N, to prevent you from losing heat in the snow...... I have to hold you, so you can stay a little warmer! He said happily, and a flower bloomed again at the tip of his nose. You doubted Tenna's intentions...... Maybe he had some selfish motives, but I have to admit, this really does warm me a lot.
And...... Your head rests against his chest, which seems a bit hard. After all, he's just a household appliance, but when you rest your head on it, it just feels soft...... And it's very comfortable, with a warm feeling. I have to say, his chest really is surging and surging, and you feel a bit ashamed of yourself...... But as you rocked in his embrace, you quickly felt sleepy again, so you couldn't help but yawn, curling up at Tenna's chest, then closed your eyes and fell asleep with each rocking motion.
When you regained consciousness, you realized you were still in Tenna's arms...... But for some reason, at this moment, he was sitting in the snow, just like when you two hit the air wall before. You rubbed your eyes and sat up in his arms, still sleepy, your tone a bit gentle, or rather, soft. At least when Tenna heard it, the whole screen instantly turned red.
"Hmm...... Why did we stop here? Why didn't you wake me? "As you spoke, you gently tapped Tenna's screen again, then looked around. You were still on this snowy plain...... But you noticed that ahead was no longer empty, but instead a tightly locked church door.
"Well, I saw you sleeping soundly, I called you and didn't wake you up...... Only now did I wake you up." Tenna muttered, cold sweat once again sliding down his screen—hmm, maybe he was a bit guilty, or maybe he wasn't telling the whole truth. You looked him up and down, while Tenna just turned her head away and didn't look at you anymore.
"Alright—" Your tone dragged out, your voice lazy, but in any case, you accepted his explanation. But now, you looked again at the church entrance. It was a combination lock, and next to it was a note with a note similar to the arrows in front.
…… You really doubt it, really doubt whether Tenna didn't seriously design the puzzle, or else this puzzle is exactly the same as the previous one?
But in any case, you carefully count the numbers according to the direction of the arrow in the puzzle, and tell Tenna the password: "This password is 3791." Then you enter the four-digit code into the lock and the church doors suddenly open—and Tenna is applauding you.
His tone was cheerful: "Oh, I knew these puzzles couldn't possibly stump Y/N—sure enough, Y/N solved the puzzle with ease!" He happily raised both hands and waved them, then even picked you up and spun you around a few times...... Uh, well, even though you don't really like Tenna doing this, you can't help but smile at him. At least for this moment, you're still happy, just haven't forgotten what you wanted to say.
“…… So, why do you like designing the same mechanism so much...... This isn't difficult at all, you know? It's just the same logic as the password for that air wall before. "You couldn't help but complain.
Tenna gave a couple of awkward laughs: "I...... I still hope the puzzle is simple, so the advancing hero won't mind that our puzzle is too difficult...... The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became, and you just crossed your arms. He put you back down on the snow, and you kept watching him in that position.
Finally, his screen turned pitch black again. Then he turned around, the antenna drooping, his body swaying, even with a sob in his voice: "Alright...... Alright, I actually thought this puzzle was already very difficult? But for you, it still seems very simple...... I—I don't know! I don't know what kind of puzzle would be difficult for the people of light right now! Maybe my perspective and perspective no longer fit the current world! His voice sounded a bit dejected, and his figure grew smaller and smaller. You scratched your head helplessly, not knowing why Tenna's emotions broke down again. But in the end, you half-squatted down, gently patted Tenna's head, stroked his antenna, then softened your voice and said, "Actually, your puzzle is quite challenging...... But for me, it's not too difficult." ”
"After all...... Well, I've played a lot of puzzle games and such! So your design is simple for me, but I guarantee that for some people, these puzzles will be difficult! ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror18 (Tennax you)
content:
“…… Is that so? Should I make the puzzle a bit simpler? "Tenna stopped crying...... But his figure was still small, still with his back to you. You felt a bit helpless, but just repeated.
"I mean, for some people, it will be very difficult...... You don't need to change the puzzle's difficulty; this is already very appropriate! "You hurriedly added another sentence, since these words were just your way of trying to calm Tenna...... If, if he really lowered the puzzle's difficulty or something, wouldn't this game be even less difficult?!
"Ah...... Then that's good enough now. Alright, I understand." Tenna finally grew up again. He turned around, seeming deep in thought...... You, uh, you don't really understand what he actually understood. Anyway, you see him show that look of sudden realization, and in the end, you can only scratch your head.
"So, alright, shall we keep moving forward?" You cleared your throat twice and took the lead in walking forward. Only when you stepped through the newly opened church door—did you notice that ahead was also a snowy plain?? Everything looked the same...... With crescent moon eyes, you glanced back at what this so-called church was, and then you saw...... It was just a paper sign, which looked quite proper, but its back was completely blank, with nothing inside.
You take a deep breath, then another, trying hard not to sound mad, just as you seem ordinary: "Tenna, tell me, are you out of funds? So this church is just a simple door??" "You thought you could finally reach the interior, at least to get warmer—but then a gust of wind blew by, you instinctively shivered, hugging yourself tighter again. All of this reminded you that you were still in the snowy plain now.
Tenna gave a dry laugh: "Uh, hmm...... Yes, it's just a door! Y/N, you know, this is a game I developed independently, so I don't have any funding at all......" As he spoke, he lowered his voice, as if whispering, "So I have a lot of maps that I reuse, it's just ...... "I just happen to have no extra church models to refer to......" he whispers to you, and then an even stronger gust of wind blows by—the church front model, which had been standing upright, finally fell down with that sound.
You fell silent, staring at the blank model backboard lying in the snow, then turned to glance at Tenna. He smiled guiltily, and the cold sweat on his screen grew even stronger...... You—think about what you originally wanted to say, but after all this fuss, you forget what you really meant.
You twitched your lips: "Then the quality of your model reference is really poor...... It's already going down—what's going on? I suggest you fix your in-game map model before officially launching the game...... Of course, your complaint was overheard by Tenna. He suddenly nodded at you, his face wearing that smile again...... You don't understand what he's laughing at, but you generously thought of it. It's good you were the one who came to experience this game! If it were someone else trying this game, they would definitely not want to continue playing in the next second, just wanting to quit. Only you would be willing to keep playing in a situation full of bugs!
So you tilted your head back slightly and snorted—well, even though the cold wind blew the next second and you shivered instinctively, this time you were smarter. You hid directly in Tenna's arms, hugging him tightly, your head rubbing instinctively against his chest twice, then your body stiffened and you hurriedly let go again.
Tenna looked surprised, but the tip of his nose instinctively bloomed with flowers—you coughed dryly, trying hard to dispel the awkward atmosphere, but looked around: "Uh...... Um, it's too cold, I instinctively snuggled into your arms...... After all, it's warmer there. Sorry, I did these things instinctively...... You reflect on yourself, but Tenna just excitedly interrupts you.
"It's okay, after all, we're boyfriend and girlfriend, we're a couple!" So no matter how close the touch, it's never too much—I, I really liked how you were just now. Can we do it again? "Although it was a question, he had already taken the initiative...... He had already taken two steps forward, then took the initiative to hug you. His TV head even rubbed against the top of your head, your body stiffening slightly—you still aren't used to close contact, and you might not get used to it for a long time...... But Tenna just held you, rubbing his head against your head, then next to your neck. The warm TV head was right next to you. At least for now, you didn't feel cold at all—it was so hot you almost broke out in a sweat.
You hesitate for a moment, but still reach out and hug him back...... Is this how couples should be? Then you think, you seem to be quite used to it, even somewhat fond of it...... Hugging Tenna. Is this the kind of affection Tenna has for you? You're not very sure, but in any case, you don't mind Tenna's actions...... You, you kind of want to do it too.
Tenna, receiving your response, just hugged her a little tighter. His TV head rubbed against your shoulder, while he carefully leaned in to kiss your neck...... A wet yet warm kiss landed on your neck, while his head kept arching. Maybe seeing you didn't stop his movement, he boldly leaned upward, then again, kissing your cheek, carefully rubbing the screen against yours.
You narrowed your eyes slightly, coughed dryly twice, and Tenna immediately didn't dare move anymore. His screen turned pitch black again, just pitifully rubbing against your neck...... You sighed, gently tapped his TV head, then hesitated for a moment, finally closed your eyes, carefully cupped his head, and kissed his lips. Then you immediately let go, turned away, not wanting Tenna to see the blush on your face or the burning heat in your ear.
Tenna, who received your kiss, was stunned for a moment, and the screen instinctively turned pink—he was savoring the kiss you had just given him, though it was faint, as if nothing had happened...... But he still remembered your soft lips, his slightly moist lips, and the blush on your cheeks as you hurriedly turned away—he couldn't help but move closer to you, eagerly following behind. Instinctively, his nose bloomed with flowers again, and he just asked cheerfully, "Y/N, Y/N, did you just kiss me?" Dear Y/N, could you kiss me one more time, just once......" He leaned in behind you and asked. You felt a bit annoyed, but in the end, he didn't mean to refuse—he just let him follow.
You just coughed dryly twice, then kept walking briskly while saying, "Ahem...... "It's just your imagination. I didn't kiss you, and of course I can't kiss you again—absolutely impossible!" You said this righteously. Although Tenna's antenna drooped slightly, he couldn't help but continue, "Alright, my dear Y/N...... Just pretend you didn't do that, so, so...... Can I kiss you once, just one kiss? "His voice dropped, just whispering to you, while you just continued to firmly refuse him.
"No—but—to—" You drowned out your voice as you answered his question, and even found a fairly legitimate reason, "We...... Ahem, but we still have to go hunt down the Demon King and the remaining three apostles. How can we waste time on romance! Let's wait until we finish our mission, then use the rest of the time to romance! ”
Even though that's what you say...... You know it yourself, you know it yourself...... Well, it's just, how should I put it...... You're just feeling embarrassed, so you're lying! Of course, you're not worried about wasting a little time halfway!
With that, you hurried forward again. Tenna hung his head, but he still followed behind you, his mind now filled with thoughts about you rejecting him...... But after walking a little longer, you finally saw two enemies standing in the snow ahead—wait, two enemies? Their heads looked like dice, but, just...... They were two colors—one red and one green—and you felt a tangible question mark popping up on your head.
So you can't help but turn to Tenna and ask, "This ...... What exactly are these two enemies going on? Don't tell me that the so-called Second Apostle actually has two people?? ”
Tenna glanced at the situation before her, cleared her throat twice, and explained, "Ah...... Actually, the Second and Third Apostles—they know you defeated the First Apostle so easily, so—they want revenge! At the same time, because they fear your strength, both the Second and Third Apostles have stepped in! "As he spoke, he switched back to that narrator-like voiceover, but cold sweat was streaming down his screen, clearly feeling guilty.
Your eye twitched, and you really didn't know what to say. In the end, you only asked the question you cared about most: "Alright, so...... Hmm, what about the Fourth Apostle? ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror19 (tennax you)
content:
"Ah, that Fourth Apostle......" Tenna's voice suddenly became stammering. You looked at him in confusion, and then, as if he had made up his mind, he leaned close to your ear and whispered in a very quiet manner, "Ah...... That Fourth Apostle usually doesn't leave seclusion. He's the top fighter under the Demon King, and most people are defeated by the first three apostles, so—there's no need for him to show up. ”
You glanced at Tenna, tilted your head, crossed your arms and looked at him, a bit speechless: "Tell me, did you just make up these settings?" ”
Tenna really did lower his head at this moment. Feeling a bit guilty, he clasped his hands behind his back. Cold sweat was dripping from the screen, but he had to keep his smile on his face.
"Uh...... Alright, you're right! "He looked around but still refused to look at you, "After all, I haven't finished this game yet...... But I definitely want the People of Light to experience my game!! So, there are some things I had to make up on the spot...... The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became, and you understood why the later stages were so simple, with basically nothing at all...... The truth is, Tenna didn't write it.
So you can't help but show a half-moon eye—fine. If he didn't write it, so be it; you're just here to play casually—fine! But if he really can develop a truly exciting game, you'll really like it! It's not that you don't like the current game......
You move forward two steps, and naturally, you enter the battle with those two dice. You pull out that sword again, after all...... Hmm, if you cast the spell directly, it's a bit more convenient.
So you first cast a Fireball spell—though for some reason, it was designed as a turn-based battle. The red die got injured, and then the green die seemed to do something, and all the injuries on the red die disappeared—at the same time, the red die's head spun to a six, and you were attacked too...... Well, anyway, it was an indescribably intense attack. At this moment, Tenna waved his staff and automatically restored your health bar.
You show your crescent eyes and choose to switch to another attack method. You slash at the green dice, and then the green die is injured, but the red die continues attacking you—you more or less understand that the green die is for healing, so it's no wonder the Second and Third Apostles stay together, since one of them has almost no combat ability. You choose to use slashing to kill the green die one by one, about three or four times. The red dice hits you quite painfully, but Tenna heals you, so you can hold on. After the green die falls, you use fireball spells and similar spells to defeat the red dice.
Now it's clean in front of you.
You beat those two dice, and as they escaped, two sheets of paper were left behind. They looked like they could be pieced together with the notes you got from the first apostle you defeated earlier, but still, I couldn't figure out what was on them...... Well, in the end, the words you couldn't understand were mixed together.
You were a little confused...... But because of the recent battle, you weren't cold anymore. You looked back at Tenna, who looked cheerful and was still recording the narration for this part of the story.
"Our brave and great warrior Y/N fears no dangers ahead. After solving the puzzle, he defeated the two who appeared together, determined to do everything they can to defeat Y/N's Second and Third Apostles! With my help, Y/N indeed defeated these two terrifying creatures! And next—Y/N must keep moving forward, our journey goes on, and the Fourth Apostle and that evil demon king are waiting for us ahead!" He gestured excitedly...... Or rather, gesturing and gesturing, and with his voice, a red arrow appeared once again ahead...... Pointing straight ahead of you. You half-moon looked at Tenna, who only shifted slightly, a bit guilty as he clasped his hands behind his back, but not much, since he was now showing a bright smile.
He reached out his hand to you: "Alright, my dear star, shall we move forward now?" ”
Although you always have a lot to say and want to complain about this game, in the end, you still end up with Tenna...... You keep moving forward.
Tenna grinned, and you suddenly had a bad feeling—then he pulled out another big black sign with ten days to go...... Alright, that replaced the cutscene. Then he kicked the sign again, sending it flying, and then you switched to another map. You stared at the familiar grassy field before you and fell silent...... Ah, the only difference might be that this is just grass, and you don't see that cabin.
You don't even know what to say...... Oh, and one more difference is that the sky here looks darker, you ...... Well, anyway, it's different from how it looked in the forest before.
"Is there any difference between here and the places we've been before?" You couldn't help but ask the question—oh my, is there really any difference between these two places? You must think Tenna couldn't come up with any extra maps, so she simply started reusing the previous maps.
Tenna just cleared his throat and said solemnly, "Ahem, of course it's different. After all, this is—the Dark Forest!" Legend has it that this forest is terrifying. When night falls, you hear terrifying howls, and even wolf packs appear and attack humans...... But that's just legend! To let our stars enjoy this game, we only recreated the Dark Forest scene model, not the wolf packs from it! " He said, gesturing and gesturing, yet cold sweat kept dripping down his screen...... To be honest, you're already used to it.
You just put your hands on your hips, looking at Tenna, tilting your head slightly. Maybe because you two had been quiet for a while, Tenna once again brought up the red arrow, this time pointing only ahead.
“…… I think the only difference between this place and before is that it's daytime here, and this is nighttime...... "You still can't help but complain, and for now, you still don't dare to go forward. After all, the map is the same. Who knows if this place will be the swamp from before!"
"So...... Is there still a swamp in this grassland? "You decided to ignore that question above. It won't really affect your journey anyway, probably......
"Of course, you can walk on this grassland with peace of mind. I guarantee there's nothing left! And this isn't just switching between day and night; I did do a little extra or something...... Tenna patted her chest and assured you, but as the time went on, his voice sounded a bit aggrieved...... His antenna drooped, and the screen drooped, so for a while he didn't dare look at you.
"Alright, alright...... Oh, I get it. Adjusting the time and scenery of the entire game scene is really tough, isn't it? That way, Tenna is really impressive! "You said with a smile. By now, you were used to this old guy always having some inexplicable moods, so you simply stood on tiptoe and patted his head, then cupped his TV head and gave him a kiss on the screen."
Then you quickly put your hand down, walked past Tenna, and to avoid being too embarrassed, you made up for it, saying, "Ahem, hmm, anyway...... Yeah, as a reward and compliment, I gave you a kiss! "Now you don't just laugh it off like last time, after all, last time you moved quickly, but this time...... Yeah, it's obvious, it's exactly what happened right in front of you.
So Tenna eagerly followed behind you, mumbling, "Mm...... Um, that...... I... I want to ask for another reward, is that okay? Can you give me another kiss...... "Oh my god, he really loves that soft feeling on your lips. He really likes you so much that his heart is pounding so hard that the mechanical heart in his chest is pounding right now...... So much so that he can't wait to lean in and kiss your cheek.
You didn't respond to him, and Tenna just leaned in and kissed your cheek...... You turned your face away, pressed your lips together, and said nothing. Alright, you know your ears are burning now, and Tenna must have seen it too...... You're also panicking, thinking, Oh my God, how did you just get so bold and do something like that?! Oh my god...... Could it be, could it really be that you have fallen for him? You don't know...... You don't know how you feel right now—it's a complete mess, absolutely terrible.
And now, the two of you have fallen into an awkward silence. Tenna, who didn't get your answer, lowers her head in disappointment, and you turn your head away, not daring to look at Tenna for a while.
Breaking this silence was the sudden sound of battle music—looking ahead, it was the same dark monster you encountered when you left the spawn point, playing strange saxophone music.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror20 (tennax you)
content:
This kind of monster is actually quite easy to fight...... Hmm, you pull out that staff again, but thinking something might not be right, you pull out the sword again and choose to swing it with a fireball. Immediately, the pitch-black guy turns and flees, completely powerless to fight.
You struck a cool pose and retracted the sword—uh, or you could call it a staff sword! You took it upon yourself to give it a name. And Tenna applauded enthusiastically from the side: "Oh, oh—Y/N is amazing! With just one move, he defeated a monster whose strength was on par with an apostle! Now let's keep moving forward. I guarantee the Fourth Apostle is right ahead!" He said this while happily waving his hands and legs, gesturing wildly. At the same time, that red arrow appeared again, now pointing ahead.
You silently glanced at the arrow, then at Tenna, and finally voiced your genuine question: "I mean...... Actually, Apostles are just minor monsters, right? It's not that hard at all, right? "Honestly, that's definitely not difficult at all...... Uh, but honestly, you don't even know how Tenna adjusts this power balance.
"Ahh...... No, fighting apostles is much harder than fighting mobs! Really! If you don't believe me, Y/N, try it and you'll see! "Those apostles in front aren't really hard to beat, do they...... You showed half-moon eyes, but in the end, you didn't say anything more. Seeing Tenna's guilty expression, even more cold sweat trickled down his screen—probably because you kept staring at him.
In the end, you just shrugged, grabbed the staff-sword, and walked forward again, while Tenna followed behind you with her hands behind her back...... After a short while, another monster jumped in front of you. Your eyelids twitched, and this time, just like the two apostles you faced last time, it was a dice-like object...... Well, it was just a red dice, and you couldn't help but breathe a slight sigh of relief.
You raised your staff sword again—continuing to cast spells. This time, the dice only took one hit and ran away, and it ran very fast. Your eyes twitched slightly, and it was really hard to say anything else...... Or rather, you didn't even know what to say.
You simply put away your staff and sword, casually asking, "So...... Uh, this place only fights monsters, so there's no need for puzzles? "Tenna suddenly nodded.
"I think our game doesn't have enough combat elements...... Anyway, that's why I've added a lot of combat elements! "He waved high, proudly showing how impressive he was, as if he had added a lot of new features.
"Ah...... Uh, I get it, but your monster designs aren't that difficult...... "You muttered to yourself, these monsters are just fragile, and you killed them all in one hit.
"After all, the main element of this game isn't even like that......" Tenna's voice suddenly grew very soft. Anyway, you didn't hear clearly. You looked at him in confusion, and his TV screen just twisted a little, glanced at you awkwardly, then turned his head away...... Uh, his screen seemed to have turned pink.
You don't know what's wrong with him, tilting your head slightly: "What's wrong with you, Tenna?" Honestly, I still suggest you add some monsters to the earlier stages too...... Otherwise, it would seem too easy. "You gave your opinion honestly, completely unaware that Tenna was lost in thought.
Actually, the original adventure was quite normal...... But ever since you signed that contract, everything changed. Tenna never finished the game, and because of last-minute changes, they deleted all sorts of unnecessary elements.
…… In other words, from the official journey onward, this game is no longer just a simple adventure game; it just wants to accompany you through the game's journey, it just wants to be with you...... It wants to be with you. So, it arbitrarily turns this game into a romance game between you and him, with no affection, no options, nothing at all...... It just wants to walk this journey with you properly.
So, just as the adventure was about to reach its end, he became even more reluctant to let go...... He—he knew...... Tenna knew that he still had to let you leave this place. Just thinking about it made his heart feel empty, but clearly, the Dark People shouldn't have a heartbeat...... But, but no matter what, when facing you, he already had that heart.
"Ah, nothing! I was just thinking about your suggestion earlier! I think your suggestion is very useful. You really should add some monsters to the front! And some other puzzles and such!" He gestured, forced a smile, and finally put on his hands behind his back, lowered his TV head, the antenna dropped, and the screen turned pitch black.
“…… Y/N, I just want to know...... He hesitated, probably unsure whether this question should be asked, and you tilted your head to look at him, unsure what hesitation was about. On the road ahead, you encountered another monster—hmm, the same type as the NPC in front of the castle. This time, you were also swinging your staff sword, but the opponent wasn't attacked.
With no other choice, you pulled out your sword staff and then knocked the unknown monster's head hard with the small TV at the top—it hurriedly ran away too.
"What do you want to know?" You casually put your sword staff away in your backpack and asked.
Tenna hesitated for a moment, but finally answered your question: "I just want to know...... "You, do you really like ......?" He stammered, looking like he couldn't finish his sentence again, and looked like he stopped halfway through and stopped talking.
You tilt your head, then turn seriously and look up at him, looking straight at him: "What is it...... Are you asking what I like? "For some reason, your heartbeat suddenly quickens...... You always feel that something isn't quite right. No, it seems very wrong...... But what does it matter? Even when facing that inexplicably beating heart, despite holding some unknown emotion...... Even though you don't even know what that unknown feeling is. Even though it's so unfamiliar, you instinctively want to escape, to avoid this question.
But...... But, well, that's all you can do, right? Do you think maybe you shouldn't run away from this question...... Maybe, maybe only by facing it can you ...... Truly, never disappointing anyone—maybe that's what it is.
So you took the initiative to step forward, moved a little closer to Tenna, took a deep breath, and quickly said, "Ah, you asked if I really like this game, this world?" Of course I do, after all, I never had the chance to experience a physical game before—and with you by my side, I think this journey is quite interesting. You are asking...... Are you asking if I like you, the one who created this world? That's ...... Of course I do. Only you can create such a world, and only you...... Only you have given me a completely different experience, so I like this place, and I like ...... I like you...... Your heart is pounding, and your speed seems to be getting faster and faster...... By the end, you start to stammer, and your voice gradually fades. For some reason, your cheeks feel a little flushed...... It doesn't seem right, it doesn't seem right. You rack up your thoughts: do you like Tenna the way she likes you? Do you want to kiss him, hug him, smile at him, or just look at him?
…… The answer seems yes, because you're happy when you see Tenna, happy when you see his smile, and you don't want to see him sad...... You—you'll also think about taking the initiative to kiss and hug, or maybe take it further...... Alright, you can't think about it any longer! You simply hold Tenna tighter, who is standing there in a daze. You don't dare look at his screen anymore, nor do you dare to see your reflection reflected on it—after all, you know your face must be bright red and burning hot right now. Ultimately...... You're just strangers you've only known each other for about a day, but you know you're already unable to pull yourself ...... Immersed in this warm yet somewhat amusing moment, lost in the journey with him.
You hesitated for a moment, then closed your eyes and kissed Tenna's cheek a few times, kissing him randomly and without any order, naturally kissing the corner of his lips.
"Hmm, cough, cough...... Cough, ahem, anyway, anyway...... That's my answer, don't ask me that question anymore. "You muttered softly, hugging Tenna heavily...... Oh my god, how did you do something so bold?! That's simply ...... That's just too bold, too ...... Too ...... You can't say a word.
You just feel Tenna gently touching your head, you feel as if tears are falling on his screen—otherwise, how could it have wet your cheek? Tenna hugs you just as tightly, and you feel his TV screen rubbing against your profile, muttering, "Oh, Y/N, I really like you, my dear Y/N...... Thank you, thank you for telling me all this...... I, oh my god, I love you so much...... I'm absolutely, absolutely, absolutely the guy who loves you the most in the world...... So, so I hope you like me the most too, okay? ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror21 (tennax you)
content:
You mumbled, not knowing how to respond to Tenna's words—I like him the most, can you really do that? You don't know either...... You just, you just held Tenna's hand, silently hugged him, and kissed him on the screen...... Maybe he thought that meant you agreed, so when he let go of his embrace, you saw his antenna gently swaying back and forth, and a silly smile appeared on his screen...... His mouth opened into a big shape, and flowers appeared at the tip of his nose again, grinning foolishly, only knowing how to hold your arm and swing it back and forth.
You just let him do as he pleases...... After all, the road ahead isn't troublesome, but somehow, after advancing a certain distance, you encountered ...... Hmm, the same as the guards at the city gate, that guy? Blue, kind of like a remote control, but you can't quite say what it is...... You pulled out your staff sword and cast a spell at the guy opposite you. You cast a fireball spell at him, and the guy's figure flickered but didn't leave the place. You hesitated for a moment, then cast another Freezing spell. But this time, the opponent wasn't attacked; instead, the attack backfired at you—now your body was trembling, and although the attack wasn't painful, you found it quite strange. So you drew your sword staff and struck at the guy—hmm, this time you hit him again. You guess he probably needs both a physical attack and a magic attack.
Meanwhile, Tenna was passionately explaining to you: "Our brave hero has encountered the last apostle, the fourth apostle, who is also the last apostle blocking the way before the Demon King. As long as we defeat him, we can advance toward the Demon King's castle!" Of course, of course—it looks like our hero and this apostle are locked in a tense battle. Ah, it seems like it's hard to deal with this apostle. I wonder if our hero can win this battle smoothly? Let's wait and see—"
His announcement was finally interrupted by you, unable to hold back any longer: "Enough already, tenna...... Hurry up and help out, where's your healing spell? If you don't keep watching, I'm going to get killed by the enemy?? ”
"Oh...... Uh, I'll be right there, Y/N, it won't take long! Tenna instinctively trembled twice, quickly switching to a guilty expression—well, cold sweat was dripping down his screen, then he waved his microphone staff, successfully restoring your health bar. The inexplicable injuries on his body didn't matter anymore...... Well, those wounds have healed now, and you're finally satisfied. So you switched back between magic and physical attacks, and after about five or six attempts, you finally defeated the apostle. For some reason, he doesn't attack you proactively...... But if you hit the wrong attack, you'll be backfired.
Overall, it wasn't a particularly difficult battle. You picked up the slips of paper that had fallen with the apostle as he fled, and finally pieced together with the other notes into a single piece of paper—though the language on it was still unreadable, even though it was in English, you couldn't make out the words.
That sentence is: ualex ukzmibczm ukdv ujsyv upikw ukp uwkh utvyupun, uwzr upikw ucv urssr, udqg uxlvii upikw ukp uwkh ulclupun?
…… There's always a letter 'u' at the front, which looks like it's being deleted, and the remaining part looks like Caesar cipher—but, but what digit encryption is it? You ponder for a while but don't quite understand, since no matter how many letters you use to convert, other words always make mistakes, and none of them seem right.
…… If you can't figure it out, you might as well stop thinking about it for now. You decide to think about it later, so you leave the note on your person, then look at Tenna, hands on your hips, and ask, "Alright, so we're about to set off for the Demon King's City now. How do we get there?" ”
Tenna coughed dryly twice, waving her staff: "Wait a moment, we'll reach our destination soon—" Then everything went black again. You stared expressionlessly as Tenna pulled out a sign with big white characters on a black background. This time, the sign said fifteen days later, serving as a cutscene—then a familiar sound like an explosion rang out. Tenna kicked the sign away, and you found yourself standing inside the familiar TV city—TV City??? But the houses here looked rather sparse...... Well, of course, those farmlands and recycling stations were gone too. You silently turned to look at Tenna: "...... Can you explain to me what's going on now? Why was the promised Demon King City actually a TV city? Ah, not even a single change...... Is this just a replica of a TV city? ”
Tenna cleared her throat twice and waved her hand to answer your question: "That's not it. This is the Demon King's City—the residents of the TV City live in peace and prosperity, and life is good. The residents inside the Demon King City are terrified because the ruler is a Demon King—these commoners don't dare leave their homes. So, as you can see, inside this Demon King City, there are only houses and nothing but houses. Of course, we must defeat this disturbing Demon King, free these innocent victims, and obtain the secret treasure once seized by the Demon King—no, the sacred relic—so we just need to keep moving forward!" He said this while raising both hands in a gesture, and at the same time, the red arrow pointing ahead appeared again...... You glance at Tenna, who seems to be smug about his design. He probably thinks he's done very well.
And you just sighed, "Uh...... Alright, so can you tell me why these houses look just like those in TV City? "At most—at most, there are some differences in color. Well, you can't even tell what kind of color difference these houses have??"
Tenna stopped what he was doing, stood with his hands behind his back, but still managed a smile: "Well, well, well...... ah." As he spoke, he suddenly lowered his voice, whispering in your ear, "Well, I heard that in the current world of light, people call this kind of thing called Duwei...... I think he must be my Duwei......
He wasn't quite sure either. You looked at him with half-moon eyes, not knowing where Tenna had learned that word and started misusing it...... Uh, fine, as long as he's happy, that's what matters. You shrugged, ignored him, and just kept walking forward.
You both remained quiet, only the sound of footsteps remaining, and after walking for a short while, you saw a castle ahead—well, still the same as the castle in TV City, looking somewhat like a television, with a TV on the castle's main gate...... You were already used to it; this was where you entered your password.
But this time, there were no more hints on the door. You recalled the piece of paper you got from defeating the apostle before, maybe...... Is that the answer to that thing? The electronic screen on the door now asked for five-digit English numbers, and now you had no clue.
Tenna came over at this moment, pretending to be surprised as she shouted, "Ah, Y/N has gathered all the clues obtained from defeating the Apostle—in other words, Y/N has found the answer to this puzzle code!" I believe this puzzle is nothing to our clever and resourceful Hero—so, Hero, please keep moving forward! "He waved his hands, summoning several red arrows this time, circling the castle's gate, all pointing at it.
You just haven't figured it out...... You have no clue about this answer. You look at Tenna, who seems very expectant, smiling at you, and you...... Maybe you want to tease him, or something.
You said, "Hmm, but I haven't figured out this password yet...... So, Tenna, my dear boyfriend, can you tell me exactly what the password is? "Saying this, you gave Tenna a slightly pitiful expression...... Hmm, although your expression is a bit stiff and you aren't very used to this approach.
Tenna froze in place, and you watched his screen turn red, then dark, even breaking out in a cold sweat—you looked at him in confusion, while he just laughed heartily, turned his face away, and his voice sounded a bit flustered: "I can't ...... I can't do this, Y/N, I can't just tell you the answer directly! But...... But what I can tell you is, this string of text first needs to remove the repeated 'u' at the beginning! And then...... And this is just a simple Caesar code! I know...... If I could connect to that so-called internet, I could probably find the corresponding one directly...... The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became.
You paused for a moment, but hearing him say that, you actually remembered something...... In the world of light, you can find tools for encrypting and decrypting the Caesar cipher directly online...... But now, in the game world, you naturally don't have such convenient tools anymore.
"Alright, actually, I can see that myself...... Why don't you tell me what encryption method this Caesar cipher is?" You crossed your arms, slightly looking up at him, while Tenna seemed conflicted, clasping her fingers behind her back. His screen lit up again, but cold sweat was still dripping down.
"Ah...... Haha, I thought this was a piece of cake for you, very simple! ”
TBC.

title: Adventurerror22 (tennax you)
content:
You showed your half-moon eyes again, looking at him like that, muttering, "No, if you don't tell me what the encryption method is, what am I supposed to do...... I've tried myself and nothing is wrong. We're almost at the end anyway, my dear boyfriend, can't you just tell me the answer directly?" After saying that, you stared at him—well, you're not really used to saying that, but once you have it, there's a second, practice makes perfect.
Sure enough, after Tenna heard you call him that, the screen turned red again, and he instinctively turned away, no longer facing you...... You always felt like he was showing that silly smile again, and his nose was blooming at the tip, but you wouldn't run up to him to expose him.
Tenna cleared her throat twice and answered your question loudly: "Alright, my girlfriend, I can tell you a little trick to crack this puzzle...... But I won't tell you what the answer is! Hmm, ahem, this puzzle does seem difficult for you...... Basically, it's about removing the 'u' at the very beginning of each word in this sentence, then using the number of digits in each remaining word, which is ...... That's their encryption condition! For example, if the first word has four digits, the number of encrypted bits is four, and so on...... When encrypting, you use four letters counted backward, so when decrypting, you just count the four letters forward! As he spoke, he gestured with his hand behind your back, and now you finally understood and looked at the string of letters...... Hmm, ualex ukzmibczm ukdv ujsyv upikw ukp uwkh utvyupun, uwzr upikw ucv urssr, udqg uxlvii upikw ukp uwkh ulclupun? If you remove the first letter, it becomes alex kzmibczm kdv jsyv pikw kp wkh tvyupun, wzr pikw cv rssr, dqg xlvii pikw kp wkh lclupun?
So, if you use the encryption method of the Caesar cipher, it would be ...... What creature has four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening?
It's the riddle from the Sphinx...... Well, the one Oedipus faces in legend, but of course, that's all legend, probably not true...... It's a question about which animal has four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs at night. It might have seemed difficult before, but this riddle and its answer are almost household names. After all, the answer is human, that is...... You confidently enter these five letters into the electronic screen, and with a click, the castle door opens, and you enter the ...... once again. Yes, inside the castle of the Demon King's Castle. I have to say, the castle of the Demon King's castle and the castle of the TV City are the same, which almost made you mistaken......
You muttered to Tenna, "Tell me honestly, do you really have no map models left, so you keep reusing old ones...... Oh, and also, uh...... Although after watching for a while, I strangely think they look pretty good, don't you really think that anything shaped like a TV looks ugly? "You said this while pointing to the TV-shaped window next to you, the TV-shaped wall painting, the TV-shaped sofa, and the TV-shaped chandelier...... Tenna just scratched her head and chuckled twice.
He gestured excitedly again: "You said this looks great, everyone loves TV—yes, so everything here is TV-shaped!" Of course, of course...... Well, I'm thinking, maybe it really doesn't look very good, I know, but...... But only then does it seem like everyone loves TV. "The more he spoke, the softer his voice became, and you felt like he was a bit obsessed thinking that...... You watch him with his hands behind his back, the screen lowered. Although he smiled, you always felt like he wasn't trying to smile...... More than that, he probably wanted to cry more.
You turned to look at him, gently standing on tiptoe and holding his TV head. Your voice was soft: "If you want to cry, then cry out loud—it's okay, I won't dislike you just because you cried...... Besides, I'm your girlfriend, so what can't you tell me? So, what's going on? Just tell me." You said, looking at him seriously, naturally ...... You watched his screen turn red again, then pitch black, and he seemed a bit at a loss...... He gestured all sorts of messy things, but finally the screen lit up, he smiled again, and that flower was in full bloom.
"Ah...... Um, that...... I was thrown at the garbage dump, I thought...... I thought no one would look at me anymore, no one would like me anymore...... My employees once abandoned me too, so this world, like this...... I did it, I was just ...... I just hope, whether real or fake, there will always be someone watching me, loving TV, never abandoning me...... No longer letting me go to the garbage dump. ”
He smiled as he spoke, but cold sweat still dripped down his face, and he gestured with his hands, as if trying to save face: "Ah, um, I know this is self-deception, right? — And even so, there are still ...... a CRT TV.
