I can't fool myself about everything, that's the truth." The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became...... It became less obvious, and his figure gradually shrank.
You sighed, stepped forward again to hug him, and whispered, "...... No, if you don't want to face reality, even if it's just to deceive yourself...... That's a very effective method. But I'm here...... You gave me that contract, didn't you? You wanted me to stay by your side, right? I will honor that contract...... Of course, I will stay by your side. "As you spoke, your voice choked with emotion...... You could feel tears streaming down your cheeks.
"But...... But I tricked you into signing it, so it must be fake. "Tenna whispered, and his screen went pitch black again.
"It's true...... I did it voluntarily. I want to be with you forever, I want to stay by your side. "Yes...... After all, you do like Tenna, you like him. This is an undeniable, irrefutable, and indisputable fact.
Tenna wanted to ask, wanted to ask if you would leave this world, would you stay here forever...... But, but he didn't dare to ask. He was already very satisfied just to receive your promise and answer at this very moment...... He would rather time stop forever at this moment so that you wouldn't have to face this final question again, and he could deceive himself by telling himself that you would always stay in this place...... That way, he could tell himself that you will love him forever. Even though he never received your answer.
So, in the end, he just said nothing. You could only feel the tears streaming down his face wetting your shoulders and your clothes. You helplessly patted his back, then patted his TV head, and spoke softly to him.
"Alright, alright...... Hmm, I'm here, don't cry anymore, I'm by your side...... If we keep crying, we won't have time to defeat the Demon King. "You just casually made a point, because as you listened to his crying growing louder, your heart kept getting a little restless...... And you felt your cheeks burning badly; just now, it really was ...... Still too impulsive, you silently despised yourself in your heart, after all, you never intended to say those words before.
“…… Yes, yes, so our brave hero Y/N uses his intelligence to crack the door code and finally steps into the Demon King's castle! The Demon King's castle is eerie and terrifying, chilling to the bone—but our hero Si is fearless and never will. She bravely steps into the Demon King's castle, following the arrow's guidance until she finds the Demon King and defeats him, then retrieves our sacred relic! "Tenna spoke, gesturing and gesturing, seeming a bit excited again. You shook your head helplessly and said nothing. That red arrow appeared ahead of you once again, and you and Tenna followed the arrow forward...... Well, you really don't know what's so scary about this castle. It looks exactly like the castle in TV City!
You helplessly follow the arrow's directions and keep moving forward...... Well, now you finally see the throne, and also see the one sitting on it...... Is that a red dice?
You look at Tenna and whisper, "Didn't he serve as an apostle before? Now you've dragged him here to play the demon king?" ”
Tenna just hurriedly waved at you: "Ah no, no, no, that's not it. These aren't the same people—in fact, there are a lot of pippins in this world, and they all like to gamble and don't respect my boss at all......" You always feel like he's mumbling the latter half of his sentence as if he's off the right tune, then he raises his voice, "These pippins really hate me, so they teamed up to escape from TV City! But they copied the TV City's style and built this city—and even stole my antenna! Of course, it's a backup backup." "After all, the antenna on his head is still sitting there fine."
You glanced at Tenna with half-moon eyes, then finally looked at the pippins on the throne. After thinking for a moment, unsure where else to go, you cleared your throat twice and stepped forward, raising your voice.
"Hero Y/N pays respects—today, I will duel you, the shameless Demon King, to reclaim the sacred relic of TV City and eliminate the evil forces, so that the people within this Demon King City can live in peace!" As you spoke, you stylishly swung your sword, pointing it at the pippins sitting high above, while Tenna quietly applauded from the side.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror23 (tennax you)
content:
At first glance, that pippins actually looked pretty ...... Uh, imposing and imposing, or rather, quite impressive, but when he bounced around on the spot, everything fell apart. He just grinned and said, "Oh, a new challenger. Let's see if you can beat me—I bet no one can get through here!" As he spoke, he seemed to be sneaking glances at Tenna. You have no idea what's going on with this guy......
But Tenna just turned away with her hands behind her back, humming an off-key tune, like, hmm...... Anyway, she wasn't really in tune, definitely off-key, because you're pretty familiar with this song—Tenna hadn't even sung the high notes right now.
You took a deep breath, decided not to bother with their eyebrow dispute, and just raised your voice: "Alright, no matter what, today I will definitely defeat you!" ”
With that, you decided to cast a spell with your staff sword...... But as you cast the spell, this guy dodged your attack and shouted, "Stop, stop, stop! Don't fight—our fighting style is different!" ”
You looked at the pippins in confusion, and sure enough, they had put away their weapons. You asked, "What is it?" Hmm...... Let me be clear, no matter what, I will defeat you. ”
You seem to see cold sweat dripping down Tenna's screen—it seems like this part might not be very well designed? Before you can finish thinking, you first listen to that pippins say, "Hmm—our ultimate challenge is the cold joke challenge. If you can answer three of my five questions smoothly, I'll let you pass!" ”
…… Cold joke challenge?? Your eyelid twitched. You never expected something like this even if you killed him. No wonder Tenna looked so guilty...... Maybe he couldn't come up with any new puzzles or fighting methods, so he chose to bring out a cold joke...... You grumbled inwardly, just putting your weapon away in your backpack. Looking at the pippins in front of you, you crossed your arms: "Alright, then what's your question? Bring it on!" ”
Anyway...... It won't be a difficult problem to solve.
"So, listen carefully, the first question is—why is A lower than C?" That pippins danced joyfully on the stage, waving his hands, while you stared at a text box in front of you that could input four characters and fell silent—how could that not fit the game design! But...... Well, it's barely acceptable.
You think for a moment and finally give your answer: "...... Because of ABCD? ”
“bingo！ Correct, so the next question—an hour and a half—is? ”
This isn't some kind of cold joke challenge, what should this be...... Uh, a brain teaser challenge, right? Even though you think that, you still don't say it out loud, just wonder how to answer the question...... Hmm, hmm...... Honestly, what's an hour and a half...... 90 minutes? But the input box in front of you prompts you to enter five Chinese characters.
"So...... Three and a half hours? "You pondered for a while before finally giving your answer. That pippins was still bouncing on the table, just smiling.
"Correct answer—so the next question: what is Mickey Mouse's grave?" This time, the answer prompt is three Chinese characters...... Well, Mickey Mouse is Mickey, and Mickey's grave is the tomb...... So it's Mickey's tomb, which is Michelin?? What a bizarre pun joke...... You have half-moon eyes, a bit helpless, but in the end, you still answer this question.
"The answer is Michelin?" Honestly, you're not quite sure either...... But judging by the smile on Pippins' face, you probably got it right.
"Correct answer—alright, since you answered three questions, I'll let you pass from here! Honestly, this is the first time I've met someone who can answer three questions correctly...... pippins sighed, and the vault door opened...... Hmm, it looks almost identical to the structure of the TV city! You keep your half-moon eyes and pull Tenna toward the vault...... Hmm, ahead is still the dark dark vault, with only the TV-shaped chandelier hanging on the wall bringing a touch of warmth...... That's probably how it is.
"Honestly, why would you design a cold joke challenge for the Demon King...... You couldn't help but complain to Tenna, who just clasped his hands behind his back and gave a silly smile.
"Because I think if it's always fighting, the game content feels too dull—well, don't you think cold jokes sound pretty funny!" He said, gesturing with his hands.
You honestly shake your head: "I don't think so, and this is basically a brain teaser...... Actually, once you get the hang of it, it's really not that hard anymore.
"Ah...... But I think the bad joke is really funny! Tenna was clearly a bit disappointed; his antenna drooped again, and the screen turned pitch black.
"I don't think so......" But seeing Tenna's figure shrinking bit by bit, you hurriedly corrected herself: "Uh, alright—to be honest, cold jokes are actually a bit amusing, they really are a bit hard for me!" ”
Alright ...... Actually, this was just an excuse you came up with on the spot to appease Tenna, actually...... Well, you really think cold jokes are boring, but to you, they just don't challenge you at all.
"Really? So Y/N, would you like to hear me tell the rest of the bad jokes?" Tenna's screen lit up again—oh my god, you don't even know when Tenna suddenly became interested in cold jokes?? Maybe it's just because he's always been bored to just be here with just one TV...... You don't know what's wrong with Tenna, but you still go along with what he said.
"Well, I'm very interested, so tell me what the other two cold jokes are." You continued asking.
Tenna gestured with both hands, clearly looking a bit excited: "So—why is a flower funny?" After saying that, his screen lit up, maintaining a silly grin, probably waiting for you to ask him why...... You really did follow his lead.
"So why is that?" Although you think you probably already have the answer......
"It's because it's a joke! Ahahaha...... This is just too funny...... After saying that, he first burst out laughing happily, maintaining that silly grin, shaking it nonstop, one hand still clutching his stomach, the other waving his ...... Maybe he wanted you to calm down? You were pretty calm, you just stared at him in silence...... To be honest, you didn't even know what was funny about this joke, so you just kept your expression on the same level of honesty.
But seeing Tenna almost burst out laughing, you finally decided to give him some face—he looked up sadly at your lack of reaction, and the screen went dark: "Uh...... Y/N, isn't this funny? "He asked you cautiously.
"Huh?" Oh, it really is pretty funny. I was just thinking about it for a moment...... You still forced a smile for him, but...... Hmm, Tenna still looked a bit gloomy. He wasn't very happy, just looked at you with his hands behind his back. The smile on the screen disappeared, leaving only the cold sweat dripping down, and in the end, it was just a blank screen.
He seemed to be trying to save face: "Uh...... Haha. Maybe this joke isn't that funny! Let's hear the next joke! What happens if Coca-Cola is left out too long? "He spun around in place, looking a bit anxious...... You want to tell him this is completely unnecessary, just...... Well, you know very well that even if you talk to him like this now, Tenna will only keep feeling anxious.
You just politely said, "So why?" ”
"Then it turns into Pepsi—Pepsi, decoration, haha, sounds like strange things, right? Sounds really are a strange thing, making me feel like I can keep saying a lot more, saying a hundred things doesn't matter—" He actually cheered up again, waving his arms and legs on the spot, not sure why he looked so happy...... You looked at Tenna, but didn't really notice his cold joke. You just followed his smile, as if infected by his smile and laughed too—you know very well that you laugh because of him, not because of some joke, but because Tenna was just happily shouting.
"Oh, Y/N, you're laughing too. I told you these jokes are funny! Television is meant to bring joy, so—so when you're not happy, turn on the TV and have a laugh!" He gestured, and you kept walking until you stopped in front of a big door...... Well, this door also looked like it needed a password to unlock, except for a strange sheet music and no other hints.
"What's going on with this door?"
Why not just ask Tenna directly?
"Oh...... This is a voice-controlled gateway. You just need to sing the corresponding notes on the note on it! This is the final hurdle! "He sounded somewhat elated.
You shrugged and sang into the score—then the passage fell silent, and the door didn't open. You frowned and looked at the door, but Tenna stepped forward: "Oh my dear Y/N, your singing isn't accurate at all. Let me do it! Let me show you!" ”
Then he confidently hummed the tune—but, his high notes still didn't rise, forced to drop the key. Just as you were about to say Tenna's singing was completely inaccurate, the treasury door suddenly burst open.
TBC.

title: Adventurerror24 (tennax you) (end)
content:
You close your mouth, widen your eyes at Tenna—oh my god, oh my god! Is this door just like that?
"Is it really a high note? You didn't even sing it when you sang it for me...... you muttered, doubting the accuracy of his words.
"Of course, definitely high notes—I just haven't sung in a long time, so it's just a bit unfamiliar!" Tenna hurriedly gestured and gestured, and finally his shoulders drooped, his antenna drooped, and he turned away in dejection.
"Uh...... It seems I made a mistake during the recording. When recording the password here, I used the same pitch as before, so...... So the system only recognized that pitch...... "That's why it opened the door for Tenna."
Your eye twitched, and in the end, you just shrugged helplessly: "Alright, alright, I get it, I get it...... Uh, so as long as we move forward, that's our ultimate goal, right? ”
At this, Tenna immediately perked up, waving his hands once again: "Yes, yes, yes! Our reliable hero Y/N overcame five trials and defeated six enemies, finally defeating the super evil Great Demon King, defeating the four cruel and evil disciples under the Demon King, liberating the people of TV City, and finally about to unleash the sacred relic of TV City—that is—the TV antenna!" He gestured, and the red arrow appeared again, pointing ahead. You sighed helplessly and stepped forward...... After some distance, you finally saw the exact same stone platform, but unlike before, this time it was a TV antenna placed on top. Tenna stepped forward first and raised the antenna.
He spoke in a very proud and confident tone: "Ah, this is it—our greatest sacred relic, the television antenna! With it, we have hope for television worldwide. With it—we can revive the era that belongs to television!" ”
He wanted to keep talking nonstop, sounding like a beautiful dream, and you couldn't help interrupting him: "Stop, stop, stop, so...... You said before that when you reach the end of the journey, you'll discover...... What is the way to leave this world? ”
Although this doesn't necessarily mean you will leave this world, you still have many things to do, you have family and friends, you are not alone...... So, it's okay to go out and then come back.
Tenna stopped moving, stopping the originally intense and extravagant performance, and his screen went black again...... You always felt he seemed unhappy, or rather gloomy, and instinctively moved closer to him, but Tenna simply turned and walked out of the vault.
“…… Go further and you'll see. His voice was so deep you could barely hear it. You thought this was the exit...... But there was still ...... A door was open.
You hesitated for a moment, then followed Tenna out. You stood again in the forest exactly like the starting point, and you saw the small cabin in the corner...... Well, at this very moment, not far away, you also saw a black ...... rising into the air. What did it look like? A fountain? You didn't know what it was, just instinctively looked at Tenna.
At that moment, Tenna turned around and stood in front of you. Immediately, battle music played—you had entered the fight, your pupils contracted as you instinctively drew your sword...... Uh, the staff sword. But your hands trembled, unwilling to cast a spell on Tenna, and you didn't understand what was happening.
Tenna's voice was choked with tears, hesitant and slow...... But in the end, she was resolute.
“…… I'm the last boss! Yes, yes—after the adventure, our hero Y/N discovered that the companion who had followed him all the way had actually chosen to turn around and face him, no longer letting Y/N go forward or go home. For our hero Y/N, this was probably a very annoying obstacle—but only this last boss remained, and the only one standing in Y/N's way was me! "As he spoke, he summoned the red arrow aimed at him.
You instinctively want to say something more...... But Tenna kept talking, seemingly trying not to cry: "And the condition to defeat me is—" He seemed to be teasing on purpose, not finishing right away. He raised his voice, only to lower it the next second.
His voice was even a bit muffled: "...... Say you love me, Y/N. Please tell me, you love me—that's the condition for clearing the level." "As long as ...... As long as you say that, he's willing to let you go back. He lowered his TV screen, not wanting you to see the tears falling from his screen, and even turned his back to you...... But you still saw it.
You open your mouth, then close it again, and you really don't know what to do...... Do you love him? You haven't thought about this question. You're just certain that you do like Tenna, but does liking mean you love? You...... You don't know, you don't know, but...... Maybe, at least at this moment, you really want to shout those words, at least at this moment, you're certain this is your true feeling, this is what you genuinely want to tell Tenna.
So you hesitated for a moment, but finally softly said, "...... I love you. ”
He stood still, as if savoring it for a moment, but in the end he didn't dare face you, just stepped aside and said in a muffled voice, "...... Yeah, I love you too, so...... So you should go. Hurry up. "He knows, Tenna knows, he'll definitely regret it soon. He's just a selfish old TV guy, he can't be that selfless, he can't truly love you and fulfill your wish—how much he wants to be with you forever, how much he wants to stay by your side, how much he wants you to stay here forever. He just, he just...... He just softened at this moment. Maybe it's just because of love, or maybe...... He's just afraid, afraid you'll be disappointed.
You silently passed by Tenna, who was standing sideways and refusing to face you, and silently walked toward the pitch-black fountain ahead...... A flash of white light flashed by, and you finally snapped out of this long sleep. Only then did you realize you were sleepwalking again—you were at the junkyard. Instinctively, you took a step and immediately kicked a CRT TV that had popped out of the garbage station. You looked down and realized, this must be Tenna—no, it must be Tenna.
You carried the TV home. Although your parents were a bit surprised that you suddenly brought a CRT TV back, they didn't ask much. You turned on the TV, and the screen displayed your previous game world. The only difference was, Tenna's image didn't appear in the screen.
You sighed, smiled, and hugged the TV...... Eventually, you fell asleep, thinking, maybe you could see Tenna again in your dreams.
You woke up from the dream, stepped out from the darkness behind you, and saw Tenna still standing in the spot where you had left earlier. At this moment, he was crouching down, probably muttering to himself...... But as he wiped his screen, it looked like he was crying.
You quietly walked forward, then hugged him from behind, your voice tinged with laughter: "Alright, guess who came?" ”
He didn't even turn to look at you—but his voice was full of surprise: "Y/N! I thought, I thought...... You'll never come back......" he whispered, not daring to look back at you, afraid you were just his imagination.
"Of course I'll come back, after all, we signed the contract back then...... We're going to get married, hmm...... And I'll be with you forever...... Your voice gradually faded, and you felt a bit embarrassed to face it...... Only then did you remember, you still had to get married.
"Yes—get married! Y/N, my dearest one, I like you the most. Please marry me!" Tenna's antenna straightened up again, gently shaking it. He turned around and tightly held your hand. His screen lit up again, and a large flower appeared at the tip of his nose—though it sounded like a question, he simply pulled out a ring and slipped it onto your hand, with a TV-shaped diamond at the tip...... Hmm, it looks a bit strange, but it suits Tenna's taste quite well.
You sighed helplessly and hooked your finger at him: "Mm, mm, I'm marrying you...... But I didn't bring any rings or anything. "After thinking for a moment, you simply wove a small wreath ring from fallen branches, leaves, and petals for him, then slipped it onto his finger.
"Alright, now our wedding is complete! Speaking of getting married in the game...... Hmm, is there any bonus? ...... "You start overthinking, wanting to pull up your own panel to check, but this game is so basic, it doesn't even have a single panel!"
Tenna's body stiffened, and he hurriedly added two attributes: "Yes, yes, after marriage, physical attack increases by 15%, and magic attack increases by 15%!" He added these two attributes to the pause screen display in the game...... You shrugged. You were just saying it offhand, but you hadn't expected Tenna to add it to you. You held Tenna's hand and walked forward.
"Alright, attributes and all that don't matter anyway. You're here anyway—hmm, shall we continue our adventure? By the way, where are we heading to our next stop...... By the way, did you not even finish the map? ”
"Y/N, where do you want to go—I can make a map on the spot!"
"Alright, alright, leave it to me to do it...... Don't worry, I come every day, though I only come in my dreams......" His voice gradually faded, probably walking away.
Your journey seems to have never ended.
END.

"[Insert and point to the red arrow in front right]
(After some distance, you finally see the identical stone platform, but unlike before, this time it has a TV antenna placed on it. Tenna steps forward first and lifts the antenna.) ）
[YN and Tenna pixel portraits automatically move forward]
[Tenna pixel portrait in front of yn]
"Ah, it's this—our greatest sacred relic, the TV antenna! With it, we have hope for televisions worldwide. With it—we can revive the era that belongs to television!" "[Switch to Tenna character art, gesture]
"Stop, stop, stop, so...... You said before that when you reach the end of the journey, you will find ...... What is the way to leave this world? ”
(Although this doesn't necessarily mean you will leave this world, you still have many things to do, you have family and friends, and you are not alone...... So, it's okay to go out and then come back. ）
[Switching to Tenna Portrait, Black Screen]
(Tenna just turned around and walked toward the vault)
“…… Go further and you'll see. *Sound effect reduced

Well, just now, not far away, you also see a black ...... rising into the air. What does it look like? A fountain? )【Yn and Tenna's pixel portraits automatically move to the right】
[Switch maps: Forest + cabin, flip left or right]
[Switch BGM: 8bit Dracula's Castle - Lunzi Remix - Lunzi Remix]
(At that moment, Tenna turns around and stands in front of you. Then, battle music plays—you enter the fight, your pupils shrinking as you instinctively draw your sword...... Uh, the staff sword. But your hands tremble, unwilling to cast a spell on Tenna, and you don't understand what is happening. ）
“…… I am the last boss! Yes, yes—after a journey of adventure, our hero Y/N discovered that the companion who had followed him all the way had finally chosen to turn around and face him, no longer letting Y/N go forward or let Y/N go home. For our hero Y/N, this was probably a very annoying obstacle—but only this last boss remained, and the only one standing in Y/N's way was me! "[Insert red arrow aimed at tenna]*crying voice [Switching tenna's character art and sweating coldly]
"And the condition to defeat me was—"*sound effect increased."
“…… Say you love me, Y/N. Please tell me, you love me—that's the condition for clearing the level. *Sound effect reduced [Switches to Tenna portrait, turns antenna drooping until tears]
(As long as ...... As long as you say this, he'll be willing to let you go back. ）
(You open your mouth and then close it, but you really don't know what to do...... Do you love him? You haven't thought about this question. You're just certain that you do like Tenna, but does liking mean you love him? You ...... You don't know, you don't know, but ...... Maybe, at least at this moment, you really want to shout those words, at least at this moment, you're certain this is your true feeling, this is what you sincerely want to tell Tenna. ）
· I love you
“…… I love you. ”
“…… Well, I love you too, so...... So you go. Hurry up. ”
(He knows, Tenna knows, he'll definitely regret it soon.) He's just a selfish old TV guy, he can't be that selfless, he can't truly love you and fulfill your wish—how he wishes to be with you forever, how much he wants to stay by your side, how much he wants you to stay here forever. He just, he just...... He just softened at this moment. Maybe it's just because of love, or maybe...... He's just afraid, afraid you'll be disappointed. ）
· Sorry
(You hesitate for a moment, and you realize you still can't do it...... You, do you really love him? Do you like him? You don't know...... Even if you like someone, is it love? You don't know either. ）
“…… Sorry. ”
(Finally, finally, you watch as his figure gradually shrinks...... )【Switch to Tenna character art, shrink】
“…… I understand, Y/N, you go, you go......
(You silently passed by Tenna, who was standing sideways, unwilling to face you, and silently walked toward the pitch-black fountain ahead...... ）
[Switch to black background]
[Switch to White Background]
(A flash of white light flashed by, and you finally woke up from this long sleep. Only then did you realize that you were sleepwalking again—you were at the garbage station right now.) ）
[Scene: Garbage heap]
(You instinctively take a step forward, then kick a CRT TV that has popped up from a garbage dump.) You look down and realize, this must be Tenna—no, it must be Tenna. ）
(Just...... The TV's screen was completely shattered, and the antenna was broken too. ）
(You hesitated for a moment...... In the end, you still didn't bring the TV back from the junkyard. It was completely broken)
(You went back home. Your parents were used to your occasional sleepwalking at night and didn’t say much.)
(You returned to your normal life, but... you never saw him again, and never returned to that game world dream.)
*Black screen with white large text: 【BAD END: Shattered Dream】

[Switch to black background] [Switch BGM Summer Color: Hanabi (ver 8bit)]
(You came home holding the TV. Although your parents were a bit surprised that you suddenly brought a CRT TV, they didn't ask much. ）
(You turned on the TV, and on the screen appeared the game world you had explored before. The only difference was that Tenna's image was nowhere to be seen.)
(You sighed, smiled, hugged the TV... and eventually fell asleep, thinking that maybe you could see Tenna again in your dream.)
[Scene: Forest + Small Cabin Flips Left and Right]
(You woke up in a dream and walked out from the darkness behind you, seeing Tenna still standing in the spot you had left. At this moment, he was squatting down, muttering something... but as he wiped his screen, it looked like he was crying.)
[YN pixel art moves from left to right]
(You quietly approached him and then hugged him from behind.)
"Y/N! I thought, I thought... you would never come back..."
(He didn’t dare to look back at you, fearing that you were just a hallucination.)
"Of course I’ll come back, after all, we signed the contract... to get married, um… and, and to be with you forever..."
"Yes—marry! Y/N, my dearest, I love you the most, please marry me!" [Switch to Tenna's portrait, flowers bloom]
(He immediately took out a ring and put it on your hand, with the top shaped like a TV diamond.)
"Hmm, hmm, I’ll marry you... though I didn’t bring any rings or anything."
(You thought for a moment and decided to make a small wreath ring for him using falling branches, leaves, and petals, and then placed it on his finger.)
"Alright, now our wedding is complete! Speaking of which, getting married in the game... hmm, will it give any bonuses or something..."
(You idly thought about opening your stats panel, but the game was so rudimentary that it didn’t even have a panel!)
"Yes, yes, after marriage, physical attack increases by 15%, and magic attack also increases by 15%!"
"Alright, stats don't really matter anyway, as long as you’re here—mmm, let’s continue our adventure, shall we? By the way, where’s our next stop... did you even finish making a map?" [YN and Tenna pixel art move to the right]
[Switch to black background]

(Your journey seemed as though it would never end.)

title: [Merge] Adventurerror (tennax you)
content:
You feel dizzy and lightheaded; you clearly remember that you seemed to have just fallen asleep...... Logically, you should have fallen into darkness and then woke up, but why is it that now, when you fall into the darkness, a new light appears before your eyes?
It's simply baffling...... You muttered, thinking this way, but you ended up saying it out loud. After you said it, you were stunned. You tentatively moved your arms and legs, and it actually moved freely according to your will. It didn't look like a dream; instead, it felt like you had entered another world, because...... Because when you looked down, you realized you had changed into a different outfit.
It was a set of light armor, looking like medieval knightly decorations, mostly white with some deep blue fabric accents...... It felt like some hero's outfit had been combined with the noblewoman's attire, which looked a bit odd. Then you noticed a sword sheath at your waist, and when drawn, it was a rather rustic longsword. Not only that, you also heard surrounding music that seemed to be Celtic-style surrounding view?!
Obviously, your complaint was overheard, and then you heard a 3D surround sound echoing endlessly, kind of ...... It was like some kind of broadcast voice, probably trying to sound tense, but still carrying a slightly sticky smell. You even seemed to hear a hint of grievance: "How is this weird...... This is a scene I carefully crafted! ”
You startled and instinctively look around, trying to figure out where the voice was coming from. Unfortunately, it looked like some kind of initial character spawn location...... It was just an empty wooden cabin with nothing at all.
“…… Who are you? "You tried hard to stay calm, and now you don't even know where you are.
And that voice was very lively, seeming somewhat excited: "Ah... this honorable, shining people of light, I am MR.(ANT)TENNA!! Very pleased to meet you, I just knew that there would definitely be people of light who would like my game!"
You feel like he can keep rambling...... For some reason, that's just how you feel, so you quickly raise a hand to make a pause gesture: "Stop, stop, stop...... Stop talking, now tell me, where am I? ”
The voice faltered for a moment, sounding a bit frustrated because you interrupted it, so much so that the volume was lowered: "...... This is the dark world generated from the game I developed. I sincerely thank the guest who created this dark fountain—namely—you!" As his words fell, I wonder where the spotlight inside this cabin came from, shining on you.
You show a half-moon eye, point at yourself: "Me?" And what's with your sudden light? This doesn't make sense at all......
As your words fell, the surroundings seemed to quiet down. You almost thought this guy had disappeared, just as you were about to say something...... The voice rang out again, this time with a tone of panic: "It seems the data was called incorrectly...... This should have been the backstage for welcoming guests! Not this little cabin, where did this cabin even come from...... His voice grew quieter, sounding a bit like a rambling. You wanted to ask more questions, but you couldn't help but say, "Is your game reliable? Do you really know how to design games?" ”
The volume suddenly rose: "Of course I will!! How simple is that? It's just integrating several data points and calling them up......! ”
In fact, Tenna...... was sweating profusely as he accessed the data in front of him, which he had no idea what it was. Well, although he could understand a little, he was not sure about the actual effect. He was only judging what the code was used for based on the situation on site.
He didn't follow the purple girl's advice, was taken to their territory, nor sent to a new home. He just ...... Stayed here, ignored by anyone. But he couldn't let himself remain unnoticed forever, so he started trying to piece together those seemingly old-fashioned codes. Maybe after the new show airs, the People of Light will return. Look, a Citizen of Light has already appeared!
“…… Alright, you said you could do it, so why do you say this dark world was created by me? "You sighed, deciding not to dwell on the game's issues, since your initial spawn location has already ...... Uh, it's changed. Specifically, the backstage scene Tenna mentioned is stuck with the current cabin scene, and it looks like it's been molded through. Although you can write code...... But you wouldn't tell Tenna exactly what he wrote wrong.
"As long as you pierce the earth with willpower, you can create a dark fountain...... That's probably what it looks like, and you did it in your dream! "His voice sounded cheerful, but after you listened, all you knew was...... Uh, you really brought yourself into this place now.
Your mouth twitched as you coldly watched the scene before you freely mold the mold, then turned into a cabin. In the end, you couldn't help but say, "Oh my god, do you even know how to code?" ”
"I will, of course I will! Just change this string of code!" ”
Along with his words, you also hear the sound of keyboards tapping, followed by a puzzled face because he probably pressed Enter, and the small cabin around you disappeared...... The next second, you fell into the dark underground with a puzzled face. And he probably didn't set up an air wall, nor did he know what he did. In any case, you kept falling, the surroundings pitch black, and with gravity, you kept slowly spinning around.
You couldn't help but raise your voice: "You—this—fixed—a bug, right!!" "You really doubt how you could create such a dark world, even though you really want to play games, because being alone at home every day is too boring, and you really want someone to play with you...... But, but no one told you you'd end up like this?! You don't want to play a game full of bugs either?!
"I-I'm fixing it...... Uh, um, what does a bug mean? "That voice still lingers around you, making you feel like some kind of game narration, and his voice sounds a bit panicked.
You cross your arms, this time showing a deadpan gaze: "You don't even understand what a bug is?" You...... Are you an antique? ”
…… It felt as if the other side had been stabbed, and for a moment, they didn't say a word.
You take a deep breath: "Alright, a bug is ...... Hmm, it means an internal fault in a program. Because a bug itself means a little bug, it's like a bug inside the program that has bitten a hole. You should understand this meaning, right? ”
Tenna's voice still sounded a bit disappointed: "I...... Got it, well, really got it...... Right, um, what's your name? "He spoke a bit awkwardly, changing the subject, and you still fell expressionlessly into this pitch-black pit.
"Me?" Y/N。 Isn't it more important to get me out of this state than the trivial issue of my name? Is your game just a program that keeps making me fall? That's really boring." "Being stuck in this situation all the time has made you a bit angry, and your words have become a bit stiff. After saying that, you start to regret it again; your tone seems a bit too harsh, and the other side ...... It has nothing to do with you, you don't need to say that.
But before you can make amends, Tenna has already spoken. His voice sounds a bit awkward, yet he deliberately laughs loudly: "Ahahahaha...... This is just a small accident! Dear star, our game is definitely not like this; there are still many exciting things ahead worth exploring! "Along with this sentence was the sound of him rapidly tapping on the keyboard.
"Since it's just a minor accident, could you put me back on the ground again?" You said calmly.
“…… I don't know how to do this, what should I do? "At this moment, his voice was so soft, it was as if he was speaking right next to your ear. You instinctively turned your head to look, but you didn't see anyone beside you. You really wondered where Tenna was.
"You can just design a death routine for the drop, or send my character's target directly to the starting point. Your voice is still calm, and you even yawned...... Wait, can you yawn even in your sleep?
You listen to Tenna tapping on the keyboard, then his voice turns frustrated: "Seems useless...... I clearly wrote death programs for you. ”
You press your temples, feeling your head throbbing up and down...... You honestly have no idea why this guy writes game programs—it's obviously bad.
"Alright, if it doesn't work, just rewrite my coordinates to the starting point. You know how to write this, right?" But you were still patient, since if this was a dark world you created, not just a dream...... Uh, then you probably don't need to expect to wake up right away. If you can move freely, that means your old practice of forcing yourself to wake up through physical movements is no longer effective...... So you have to find a way to find the end, so you should be able to leave.
You didn't hear his voice, only a string of keystrokes. Then, your vision blurred, and you glanced over. Finally, you stopped falling. Behind you was that wooden house, and you seemed to have returned to your birthpoint.
…… Well, the adventure has probably officially begun.
TBC.
You look around at the surroundings. After leaving the cabin, you're greeted by a vast forest...... Hmm, it looks pretty well in line with the setting, but when you turn back to look at the cabin, you can't help but twitch your mouth, because you see that backstage and cabin are still mixed together as if they've been molded, making it look like Tenna is doing her best to modify the code—just don't know what she actually made.
So you can't help but complain: "Do you still need to keep modifying the spawn code code?" It looks like you've already written a mess. ”
That voice quickly answered you: "I...... Uh, of course, I'll be able to fix it soon! Don't worry, Y/N! "As he spoke, you felt as if his typing speed on the keyboard had gotten faster...... After all, his speed had been very slow before, sounding like he was typing letter by letter, and you didn't even know how long it took him to finish writing this program.
"Alright, then what do you plan to change it to?" You crossed your arms and asked leisurely.
"Change it to ...... Change it to, still the little cabin from the beginning." You seem to hear him sigh...... Probably in a bad mood, feeling a bit down, as he pressed the last button, only the cabin remained before you.
You shrugged, turned around, and walked toward the forest...... It looked like there was only a single passageway, and as you set out, you asked, "Well, this looks like an RPG, so what's my mission?" "After all, you've looked around now, and it doesn't seem like a typical game with a guide box or anything...... Your field of vision is empty, nothing at all.
Normally, the game would at least display a quest guide in the top left corner, right?
"Ah...... Ah, right, I forgot to tell you the task! Why doesn't this scroll guide pop up on its own? I've clearly written the program...... Tenna's second half of his sentence sounds like he was talking to himself, and he really did call a...... A scroll that looks like a hologram for you.
You show your half-moon eyes and watch the scroll slowly scroll upward. The story is quite old-fashioned, probably about a long, long time ago, there was a saint or something...... Then the scroll got stuck.
It's stuck?? Does the holographic image get stuck too?? You widened your eyes in disbelief, pointed at the scroll in front of you, and began loudly questioning Tenna: "What do you mean? Why is the holographic image still freezing? Hey, hey, is the network not working well or what? It can't be that your code is wrong again......"
You hear him chuckle awkwardly: "Uh, that's right...... I wrote it wrong again, but I designed this holographic screen to be touchscreen! So you can scroll down yourself, as long as you finish reading this scroll, that's enough! "His voice sounded a bit guilty, but more likely...... Excited? You don't know exactly what he's getting excited about, just speechlessly showing half-moon eyes and manually dragging the scroll down. You don't know what kind of spelling he made a mistake, but the area that should be displaying the image next is completely gone, just a bunch of mosaics...... And for some reason, the scroll has all sorts of messy, even constantly jumping WordArt and bizarre puns...... In short, you put in a lot of effort and half a day of time, and finally managed to interpret this story.
Probably a long, long time ago, the land was ravaged by the Demon King—then heaven sent a saint to descend to earth, seal the Demon King, and leave behind a sacred relic to protect the survival of the kingdom. But recently, the seal was loosened and the Demon King emerged. The Demon King had four great apostles under his command, and one of them stole the kingdom's sacred relic. The monsters began to invade the human world. At this moment, a hero stepped forward, about to reclaim the relic and eliminate the Demon King...... And the hero entrusted with a great mission and obtained the holy sword is you, the participant in the game.
After reading this scroll, you pulled out your sword and looked at it. No matter how you looked at it, it was just an ordinary sword...... You couldn't help but ask, "So where is the Holy Sword? Don't tell me...... Uh, the sword in my hand is the Holy Sword? And where am I going next? Could it be that I'm going straight to the Demon King to fight? Where is the Demon King? ”
As you spoke, you swung the sword in your hand again. Clearly, it was just scrap metal.
"Uh...... Wait, I didn't give it to you directly? "His voice was a bit flustered, and you heard the sound of typing on the keyboard again, probably ...... Yeah, he was probably checking the code he had written. You ignored him and just walked forward on your own, then you heard his voice again: "Oh, I get it...... The scroll I gave you seems to be incorrect. That holy sword wasn't handed to you directly; you had to visit the king first. The king only handed it over to you after he confirmed your abilities. After all, the holy sword is a treasured treasure among them...... He rambled on, and you nodded absentmindedly, continuing forward through this seemingly endless forest.
"Alright, so which direction is my current destination?" You haven't even done a single quest guide, so having no map function is one thing...... And according to what you said, the Holy Sword is also a sacred artifact? So what exactly was stolen from them? Or am I the Demon King? "Your questions are a string of things, since you really can't understand what he's thinking...... If you had to judge, it's that the game code and story he wrote are basically just bugs.
You hear that voice and cough twice: "Well, actually, it's been stolen...... It's part of a TV, which is part of me! ”
…… For a moment, you don't know whether to first complain that the game's creator is just a TV, or if the stolen part of it is just a part of it.
You just keep your half-moon eyes and dryly ask, "Alright, so what exactly was stolen?" ”
"It's the antenna on top of the TV—that would make the signal reception better." In fact, this country is actually technologically advanced, and everyone in the kingdom loves watching TV. If they can't watch TV, people in this country would feel life is worse than death. And the king preserved Fa Zheng, one of the top technologies in television development. Without this antenna, the country would be doomed! ”
…… You feel like this story was just made up by him, and thinking this way, you simply ask: "So this story was actually made up by you, right?" ”
You hear him seem to choke for a moment, then awkwardly chuckle twice: "How could that be?" ”
But in fact, Tenna was a bit guilty; this story was just something he made up...... But he did have a model of this country; he just needed to modify the treasure, turn it into a TV...... Yes, he really hoped everyone could love TV and watch it. Isn't that a very simple wish?
While thinking this, he revised the code to replace the traditional medieval country that existed in this RPG world with a model of a modern city he had just collected.
"Alright, then tell me, without an antenna, scientists in this country can still rebuild it, right?" You shrug.
He paused, then spoke rapidly, "It's the Demon King. Another apostle under the Demon King has abducted all the scientists in this kingdom!" ”
You honestly don't know how to comment on this story, just complaining, "Ah, then honestly, just rescue all these scientists, right?" Speaking of which, for scientists, is that really ...... Uh, is there really no security at all? Logically, scientists with such top-notch technology should be well protected, right? ”
"Uh, one of the Demon King's apostles is skilled at disguise, taking on the appearance of another person, and even mimics every move...... He transformed into a high-level security staff member at the institution where the scientists worked, then issued an emergency evacuation order and immediately took all the researchers away! "It sounds like he's just racking his brains to write stories, his voice stammering. You've walked a long way forward before he finally answers your question completely.
For some reason, you think listening to him make up stories like this is actually quite fun...... At least you want to tease him a little, so you continued, "Alright, so what comes next? What's next?" ”
Maybe it's because you didn't question it...... Tenna stopped racking his brains to make things up; he just continued stammering, "Uh...... Well, that, anyway, the Demon King kidnapped these scientists too! That's about it, Hero, let's set off now!! ”
"Yeah, I'm on the way, but you don't have a single task guide. Where am I supposed to go?" You shrugged again. Tenna glanced at the code he wrote and your current state, hesitating for a moment...... Uh, he really didn't write a task guide. He awkwardly tapped the code and added an arrow...... He was manually controlling it.
"Yes, let's head in this direction!" He declared confidently, the arrow pointing toward the kingdom. He thought, this is definitely the right thing to do!
And you glance in the direction the big red arrow points to...... Well, very good, it's actually tall bushes and trees.
With crescent eyes, you point at these plants: "Do you mean I want to fly over them?" ”
TBC.
Tenna glanced at what you said, then at the direction the arrow pointed to, cleared her throat twice, and adjusted the position of the arrow she was holding...... Well, he just fiddled with it with his hand, then whispered, "Alright, this direction must be fine now!" He said this with absolute confidence, but you can't say whether what he said was true or false...... After all, you don't know how to go, and this arrow, which seemed to have been manipulated by someone, now pointed toward the path you came from.
You mutter, "Is this the right direction?" "This is clearly the route you came from, isn't it?" Even though you think that, you don't directly criticize Tenna.
Tenna just swore confidently, "Just follow the arrow, that's absolutely right!" ”
You remain skeptical, but still follow the direction the arrow points to. In the end, you do arrive at your destination—the little house at the spawn point. Well, this isn't the place you wanted to reach?!
You looked exasperated: "Congratulations, you used your navigation to bring me back to the spawn point. Where should we go now? Could it be that the so-called Demon King is actually inside this shabby little cabin?" You spoke with a half-mocking tone, Tenna's voice sounding a bit flustered: "Ah, that's not it...... Yes, I set the location wrong. Wait a moment, I'll reset the navigation!" "You heard the sound of frantically typing on the keyboard...... Hmm, you have no idea what Tenna is doing, but you watch as the arrow keeps being fiddled with, then points in another direction.
You turn around, good, this time it seems to be the right direction...... It points to a nearby path. Even so, before stepping forward, you still double-check: "Are you sure this direction is correct?" ”
"Definitely right! No problem at all. If you don't believe me, Y/N, try it!" His voice was filled with cheers.
You shrugged, neither agreeing nor disagreeing, just changing the subject: "Alright, I'm a bit hungry now. Can you tell me where I can eat?" Look, the food bar you set has already dropped to thirty. "You pointed to the bottom right corner of your screen...... Uh, or rather, the bottom right corner of your vision, after that arrow appeared, the task index finally appeared in the upper left corner. Of course, the bottom right also showed health value, mana value, and satiety value, similar to a normal game...... But normal games don't have a food rating value.
"There are no ingredients in the forest that can restore satiety...... Uh, wait a moment, I'll write some code. "Tenna's antenna drooped. Normally, by this time you'd have arrived in the kingdom, which naturally has restaurants and such, but you...... Despite his misguided navigation and a series of operations, he was still stuck at the spawn point.
You crossed your arms and waited for a moment, then a set of tables and chairs appeared in front of you, with a set meal on it. You couldn't tell what this was, all you knew was...... Uh, that set meal actually had a long ice cream cone standing upright, looking like a nose...... Although it should be an ice cream cone, it was placed upside down, oozing a lot of pinkish-purple liquid, and there was a very strange smiling face on it. You silently stared at the lunch he had conjured, making a puzzled sound: "Is this thing really edible?" ”
"Of course—of course you can eat! Don't worry, just enjoy it to your heart's content, it tastes great!" His voice sounded a bit urgent, with a hint of guilt...... Hmm, you probably didn't get it wrong.
Anyway, still skeptical, you roll your eyes and then enjoy the ...... Well, lunch.
Then you hear his voice, almost like a full, announcer: "Y/N enjoyed her lunch, and she was determined to set out again to set out on the journey to defeat the Demon King. She knew that by following the arrow's guidance, she could get one step closer to the Demon King—"
You can't stand it anymore and reach out to make a pause gesture: "Stop, stop, stop, why are you starting to be a narrator?" ”
“…… This was exactly the job I wanted to do...... But there were quite a few unexpected things before," Tenna's voice sounded very soft, then he raised his voice, "but I think this feels really comfortable!" See, with the narrator's guidance, your adventure will definitely go much more smoothly! ”
