But this time, there were no more hints on the door. You recalled the piece of paper you got from defeating the apostle before, maybe...... Is that the answer to that thing? The electronic screen on the door now asked for five-digit English numbers, and now you had no clue.
Tenna came over at this moment, pretending to be surprised as she shouted, "Ah, Y/N has gathered all the clues obtained from defeating the Apostle—in other words, Y/N has found the answer to this puzzle code!" I believe this puzzle is nothing to our clever and resourceful Hero—so, Hero, please keep moving forward! "He waved his hands, summoning several red arrows this time, circling the castle's gate, all pointing at it.
You just haven't figured it out...... You have no clue about this answer. You look at Tenna, who seems very expectant, smiling at you, and you...... Maybe you want to tease him, or something.
You said, "Hmm, but I haven't figured out this password yet...... So, Tenna, my dear boyfriend, can you tell me exactly what the password is? "Saying this, you gave Tenna a slightly pitiful expression...... Hmm, although your expression is a bit stiff and you aren't very used to this approach.
Tenna froze in place, and you watched his screen turn red, then dark, even breaking out in a cold sweat—you looked at him in confusion, while he just laughed heartily, turned his face away, and his voice sounded a bit flustered: "I can't ...... I can't do this, Y/N, I can't just tell you the answer directly! But...... But what I can tell you is, this string of text first needs to remove the repeated 'u' at the beginning! And then...... And this is just a simple Caesar code! I know...... If I could connect to that so-called internet, I could probably find the corresponding one directly...... The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became.
You paused for a moment, but hearing him say that, you actually remembered something...... In the world of light, you can find tools for encrypting and decrypting the Caesar cipher directly online...... But now, in the game world, you naturally don't have such convenient tools anymore.
"Alright, actually, I can see that myself...... Why don't you tell me what encryption method this Caesar cipher is?" You crossed your arms, slightly looking up at him, while Tenna seemed conflicted, clasping her fingers behind her back. His screen lit up again, but cold sweat was still dripping down.
"Ah...... Haha, I thought this was a piece of cake for you, very simple! ”
TBC.
You showed your half-moon eyes again, looking at him like that, muttering, "No, if you don't tell me what the encryption method is, what am I supposed to do...... I've tried myself and nothing is wrong. We're almost at the end anyway, my dear boyfriend, can't you just tell me the answer directly?" After saying that, you stared at him—well, you're not really used to saying that, but once you have it, there's a second, practice makes perfect.
Sure enough, after Tenna heard you call him that, the screen turned red again, and he instinctively turned away, no longer facing you...... You always felt like he was showing that silly smile again, and his nose was blooming at the tip, but you wouldn't run up to him to expose him.
Tenna cleared her throat twice and answered your question loudly: "Alright, my girlfriend, I can tell you a little trick to crack this puzzle...... But I won't tell you what the answer is! Hmm, ahem, this puzzle does seem difficult for you...... Basically, it's about removing the 'u' at the very beginning of each word in this sentence, then using the number of digits in each remaining word, which is ...... That's their encryption condition! For example, if the first word has four digits, the number of encrypted bits is four, and so on...... When encrypting, you use four letters counted backward, so when decrypting, you just count the four letters forward! As he spoke, he gestured with his hand behind your back, and now you finally understood and looked at the string of letters...... Hmm, ualex ukzmibczm ukdv ujsyv upikw ukp uwkh utvyupun, uwzr upikw ucv urssr, udqg uxlvii upikw ukp uwkh ulclupun? If you remove the first letter, it becomes alex kzmibczm kdv jsyv pikw kp wkh tvyupun, wzr pikw cv rssr, dqg xlvii pikw kp wkh lclupun?
So, if you use the encryption method of the Caesar cipher, it would be ...... What creature has four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening?
It's the riddle from the Sphinx...... Well, the one Oedipus faces in legend, but of course, that's all legend, probably not true...... It's a question about which animal has four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs at night. It might have seemed difficult before, but this riddle and its answer are almost household names. After all, the answer is human, that is...... You confidently enter these five letters into the electronic screen, and with a click, the castle door opens, and you enter the ...... once again. Yes, inside the castle of the Demon King's Castle. I have to say, the castle of the Demon King's castle and the castle of the TV City are the same, which almost made you mistaken......
You muttered to Tenna, "Tell me honestly, do you really have no map models left, so you keep reusing old ones...... Oh, and also, uh...... Although after watching for a while, I strangely think they look pretty good, don't you really think that anything shaped like a TV looks ugly? "You said this while pointing to the TV-shaped window next to you, the TV-shaped wall painting, the TV-shaped sofa, and the TV-shaped chandelier...... Tenna just scratched her head and chuckled twice.
He gestured excitedly again: "You said this looks great, everyone loves TV—yes, so everything here is TV-shaped!" Of course, of course...... Well, I'm thinking, maybe it really doesn't look very good, I know, but...... But only then does it seem like everyone loves TV. "The more he spoke, the softer his voice became, and you felt like he was a bit obsessed thinking that...... You watch him with his hands behind his back, the screen lowered. Although he smiled, you always felt like he wasn't trying to smile...... More than that, he probably wanted to cry more.
You turned to look at him, gently standing on tiptoe and holding his TV head. Your voice was soft: "If you want to cry, then cry out loud—it's okay, I won't dislike you just because you cried...... Besides, I'm your girlfriend, so what can't you tell me? So, what's going on? Just tell me." You said, looking at him seriously, naturally ...... You watched his screen turn red again, then pitch black, and he seemed a bit at a loss...... He gestured all sorts of messy things, but finally the screen lit up, he smiled again, and that flower was in full bloom.
"Ah...... Um, that...... I was thrown at the garbage dump, I thought...... I thought no one would look at me anymore, no one would like me anymore...... My employees once abandoned me too, so this world, like this...... I did it, I was just ...... I just hope, whether real or fake, there will always be someone watching me, loving TV, never abandoning me...... No longer letting me go to the garbage dump. ”
He smiled as he spoke, but cold sweat still dripped down his face, and he gestured with his hands, as if trying to save face: "Ah, um, I know this is self-deception, right? — And even so, there are still ...... a CRT TV. I can't fool myself about everything, that's the truth." The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became...... It became less obvious, and his figure gradually shrank.
You sighed, stepped forward again to hug him, and whispered, "...... No, if you don't want to face reality, even if it's just to deceive yourself...... That's a very effective method. But I'm here...... You gave me that contract, didn't you? You wanted me to stay by your side, right? I will honor that contract...... Of course, I will stay by your side. "As you spoke, your voice choked with emotion...... You could feel tears streaming down your cheeks.
"But...... But I tricked you into signing it, so it must be fake. "Tenna whispered, and his screen went pitch black again.
"It's true...... I did it voluntarily. I want to be with you forever, I want to stay by your side. "Yes...... After all, you do like Tenna, you like him. This is an undeniable, irrefutable, and indisputable fact.
Tenna wanted to ask, wanted to ask if you would leave this world, would you stay here forever...... But, but he didn't dare to ask. He was already very satisfied just to receive your promise and answer at this very moment...... He would rather time stop forever at this moment so that you wouldn't have to face this final question again, and he could deceive himself by telling himself that you would always stay in this place...... That way, he could tell himself that you will love him forever. Even though he never received your answer.
So, in the end, he just said nothing. You could only feel the tears streaming down his face wetting your shoulders and your clothes. You helplessly patted his back, then patted his TV head, and spoke softly to him.
"Alright, alright...... Hmm, I'm here, don't cry anymore, I'm by your side...... If we keep crying, we won't have time to defeat the Demon King. "You just casually made a point, because as you listened to his crying growing louder, your heart kept getting a little restless...... And you felt your cheeks burning badly; just now, it really was ...... Still too impulsive, you silently despised yourself in your heart, after all, you never intended to say those words before.
“…… Yes, yes, so our brave hero Y/N uses his intelligence to crack the door code and finally steps into the Demon King's castle! The Demon King's castle is eerie and terrifying, chilling to the bone—but our hero Si is fearless and never will. She bravely steps into the Demon King's castle, following the arrow's guidance until she finds the Demon King and defeats him, then retrieves our sacred relic! "Tenna spoke, gesturing and gesturing, seeming a bit excited again. You shook your head helplessly and said nothing. That red arrow appeared ahead of you once again, and you and Tenna followed the arrow forward...... Well, you really don't know what's so scary about this castle. It looks exactly like the castle in TV City!
You helplessly follow the arrow's directions and keep moving forward...... Well, now you finally see the throne, and also see the one sitting on it...... Is that a red dice?
You look at Tenna and whisper, "Didn't he serve as an apostle before? Now you've dragged him here to play the demon king?" ”
Tenna just hurriedly waved at you: "Ah no, no, no, that's not it. These aren't the same people—in fact, there are a lot of pippins in this world, and they all like to gamble and don't respect my boss at all......" You always feel like he's mumbling the latter half of his sentence as if he's off the right tune, then he raises his voice, "These pippins really hate me, so they teamed up to escape from TV City! But they copied the TV City's style and built this city—and even stole my antenna! Of course, it's a backup backup." "After all, the antenna on his head is still sitting there fine."
You glanced at Tenna with half-moon eyes, then finally looked at the pippins on the throne. After thinking for a moment, unsure where else to go, you cleared your throat twice and stepped forward, raising your voice.
"Hero Y/N pays respects—today, I will duel you, the shameless Demon King, to reclaim the sacred relic of TV City and eliminate the evil forces, so that the people within this Demon King City can live in peace!" As you spoke, you stylishly swung your sword, pointing it at the pippins sitting high above, while Tenna quietly applauded from the side.
TBC.
At first glance, that pippins actually looked pretty ...... Uh, imposing and imposing, or rather, quite impressive, but when he bounced around on the spot, everything fell apart. He just grinned and said, "Oh, a new challenger. Let's see if you can beat me—I bet no one can get through here!" As he spoke, he seemed to be sneaking glances at Tenna. You have no idea what's going on with this guy......
But Tenna just turned away with her hands behind her back, humming an off-key tune, like, hmm...... Anyway, she wasn't really in tune, definitely off-key, because you're pretty familiar with this song—Tenna hadn't even sung the high notes right now.
You took a deep breath, decided not to bother with their eyebrow dispute, and just raised your voice: "Alright, no matter what, today I will definitely defeat you!" ”
With that, you decided to cast a spell with your staff sword...... But as you cast the spell, this guy dodged your attack and shouted, "Stop, stop, stop! Don't fight—our fighting style is different!" ”
You looked at the pippins in confusion, and sure enough, they had put away their weapons. You asked, "What is it?" Hmm...... Let me be clear, no matter what, I will defeat you. ”
You seem to see cold sweat dripping down Tenna's screen—it seems like this part might not be very well designed? Before you can finish thinking, you first listen to that pippins say, "Hmm—our ultimate challenge is the cold joke challenge. If you can answer three of my five questions smoothly, I'll let you pass!" ”
…… Cold joke challenge?? Your eyelid twitched. You never expected something like this even if you killed him. No wonder Tenna looked so guilty...... Maybe he couldn't come up with any new puzzles or fighting methods, so he chose to bring out a cold joke...... You grumbled inwardly, just putting your weapon away in your backpack. Looking at the pippins in front of you, you crossed your arms: "Alright, then what's your question? Bring it on!" ”
Anyway...... It won't be a difficult problem to solve.
"So, listen carefully, the first question is—why is A lower than C?" That pippins danced joyfully on the stage, waving his hands, while you stared at a text box in front of you that could input four characters and fell silent—how could that not fit the game design! But...... Well, it's barely acceptable.
You think for a moment and finally give your answer: "...... Because of ABCD? ”
“bingo！ Correct, so the next question—an hour and a half—is? ”
This isn't some kind of cold joke challenge, what should this be...... Uh, a brain teaser challenge, right? Even though you think that, you still don't say it out loud, just wonder how to answer the question...... Hmm, hmm...... Honestly, what's an hour and a half...... 90 minutes? But the input box in front of you prompts you to enter five Chinese characters.
"So...... Three and a half hours? "You pondered for a while before finally giving your answer. That pippins was still bouncing on the table, just smiling.
"Correct answer—so the next question: what is Mickey Mouse's grave?" This time, the answer prompt is three Chinese characters...... Well, Mickey Mouse is Mickey, and Mickey's grave is the tomb...... So it's Mickey's tomb, which is Michelin?? What a bizarre pun joke...... You have half-moon eyes, a bit helpless, but in the end, you still answer this question.
"The answer is Michelin?" Honestly, you're not quite sure either...... But judging by the smile on Pippins' face, you probably got it right.
"Correct answer—alright, since you answered three questions, I'll let you pass from here! Honestly, this is the first time I've met someone who can answer three questions correctly...... pippins sighed, and the vault door opened...... Hmm, it looks almost identical to the structure of the TV city! You keep your half-moon eyes and pull Tenna toward the vault...... Hmm, ahead is still the dark dark vault, with only the TV-shaped chandelier hanging on the wall bringing a touch of warmth...... That's probably how it is.
"Honestly, why would you design a cold joke challenge for the Demon King...... You couldn't help but complain to Tenna, who just clasped his hands behind his back and gave a silly smile.
"Because I think if it's always fighting, the game content feels too dull—well, don't you think cold jokes sound pretty funny!" He said, gesturing with his hands.
You honestly shake your head: "I don't think so, and this is basically a brain teaser...... Actually, once you get the hang of it, it's really not that hard anymore.
"Ah...... But I think the bad joke is really funny! Tenna was clearly a bit disappointed; his antenna drooped again, and the screen turned pitch black.
"I don't think so......" But seeing Tenna's figure shrinking bit by bit, you hurriedly corrected herself: "Uh, alright—to be honest, cold jokes are actually a bit amusing, they really are a bit hard for me!" ”
Alright ...... Actually, this was just an excuse you came up with on the spot to appease Tenna, actually...... Well, you really think cold jokes are boring, but to you, they just don't challenge you at all.
"Really? So Y/N, would you like to hear me tell the rest of the bad jokes?" Tenna's screen lit up again—oh my god, you don't even know when Tenna suddenly became interested in cold jokes?? Maybe it's just because he's always been bored to just be here with just one TV...... You don't know what's wrong with Tenna, but you still go along with what he said.
"Well, I'm very interested, so tell me what the other two cold jokes are." You continued asking.
Tenna gestured with both hands, clearly looking a bit excited: "So—why is a flower funny?" After saying that, his screen lit up, maintaining a silly grin, probably waiting for you to ask him why...... You really did follow his lead.
"So why is that?" Although you think you probably already have the answer......
"It's because it's a joke! Ahahaha...... This is just too funny...... After saying that, he first burst out laughing happily, maintaining that silly grin, shaking it nonstop, one hand still clutching his stomach, the other waving his ...... Maybe he wanted you to calm down? You were pretty calm, you just stared at him in silence...... To be honest, you didn't even know what was funny about this joke, so you just kept your expression on the same level of honesty.
But seeing Tenna almost burst out laughing, you finally decided to give him some face—he looked up sadly at your lack of reaction, and the screen went dark: "Uh...... Y/N, isn't this funny? "He asked you cautiously.
"Huh?" Oh, it really is pretty funny. I was just thinking about it for a moment...... You still forced a smile for him, but...... Hmm, Tenna still looked a bit gloomy. He wasn't very happy, just looked at you with his hands behind his back. The smile on the screen disappeared, leaving only the cold sweat dripping down, and in the end, it was just a blank screen.
He seemed to be trying to save face: "Uh...... Haha. Maybe this joke isn't that funny! Let's hear the next joke! What happens if Coca-Cola is left out too long? "He spun around in place, looking a bit anxious...... You want to tell him this is completely unnecessary, just...... Well, you know very well that even if you talk to him like this now, Tenna will only keep feeling anxious.
You just politely said, "So why?" ”
"Then it turns into Pepsi—Pepsi, decoration, haha, sounds like strange things, right? Sounds really are a strange thing, making me feel like I can keep saying a lot more, saying a hundred things doesn't matter—" He actually cheered up again, waving his arms and legs on the spot, not sure why he looked so happy...... You looked at Tenna, but didn't really notice his cold joke. You just followed his smile, as if infected by his smile and laughed too—you know very well that you laugh because of him, not because of some joke, but because Tenna was just happily shouting.
"Oh, Y/N, you're laughing too. I told you these jokes are funny! Television is meant to bring joy, so—so when you're not happy, turn on the TV and have a laugh!" He gestured, and you kept walking until you stopped in front of a big door...... Well, this door also looked like it needed a password to unlock, except for a strange sheet music and no other hints.
"What's going on with this door?"
Why not just ask Tenna directly?
"Oh...... This is a voice-controlled gateway. You just need to sing the corresponding notes on the note on it! This is the final hurdle! "He sounded somewhat elated.
You shrugged and sang into the score—then the passage fell silent, and the door didn't open. You frowned and looked at the door, but Tenna stepped forward: "Oh my dear Y/N, your singing isn't accurate at all. Let me do it! Let me show you!" ”
Then he confidently hummed the tune—but, his high notes still didn't rise, forced to drop the key. Just as you were about to say Tenna's singing was completely inaccurate, the treasury door suddenly burst open.
TBC.
You close your mouth, widen your eyes at Tenna—oh my god, oh my god! Is this door just like that?
"Is it really a high note? You didn't even sing it when you sang it for me...... you muttered, doubting the accuracy of his words.
"Of course, definitely high notes—I just haven't sung in a long time, so it's just a bit unfamiliar!" Tenna hurriedly gestured and gestured, and finally his shoulders drooped, his antenna drooped, and he turned away in dejection.
"Uh...... It seems I made a mistake during the recording. When recording the password here, I used the same pitch as before, so...... So the system only recognized that pitch...... "That's why it opened the door for Tenna."
Your eye twitched, and in the end, you just shrugged helplessly: "Alright, alright, I get it, I get it...... Uh, so as long as we move forward, that's our ultimate goal, right? ”
At this, Tenna immediately perked up, waving his hands once again: "Yes, yes, yes! Our reliable hero Y/N overcame five trials and defeated six enemies, finally defeating the super evil Great Demon King, defeating the four cruel and evil disciples under the Demon King, liberating the people of TV City, and finally about to unleash the sacred relic of TV City—that is—the TV antenna!" He gestured, and the red arrow appeared again, pointing ahead. You sighed helplessly and stepped forward...... After some distance, you finally saw the exact same stone platform, but unlike before, this time it was a TV antenna placed on top. Tenna stepped forward first and raised the antenna.
He spoke in a very proud and confident tone: "Ah, this is it—our greatest sacred relic, the television antenna! With it, we have hope for television worldwide. With it—we can revive the era that belongs to television!" ”
He wanted to keep talking nonstop, sounding like a beautiful dream, and you couldn't help interrupting him: "Stop, stop, stop, so...... You said before that when you reach the end of the journey, you'll discover...... What is the way to leave this world? ”
Although this doesn't necessarily mean you will leave this world, you still have many things to do, you have family and friends, you are not alone...... So, it's okay to go out and then come back.
Tenna stopped moving, stopping the originally intense and extravagant performance, and his screen went black again...... You always felt he seemed unhappy, or rather gloomy, and instinctively moved closer to him, but Tenna simply turned and walked out of the vault.
“…… Go further and you'll see. His voice was so deep you could barely hear it. You thought this was the exit...... But there was still ...... A door was open.
You hesitated for a moment, then followed Tenna out. You stood again in the forest exactly like the starting point, and you saw the small cabin in the corner...... Well, at this very moment, not far away, you also saw a black ...... rising into the air. What did it look like? A fountain? You didn't know what it was, just instinctively looked at Tenna.
At that moment, Tenna turned around and stood in front of you. Immediately, battle music played—you had entered the fight, your pupils contracted as you instinctively drew your sword...... Uh, the staff sword. But your hands trembled, unwilling to cast a spell on Tenna, and you didn't understand what was happening.
Tenna's voice was choked with tears, hesitant and slow...... But in the end, she was resolute.
“…… I'm the last boss! Yes, yes—after the adventure, our hero Y/N discovered that the companion who had followed him all the way had actually chosen to turn around and face him, no longer letting Y/N go forward or go home. For our hero Y/N, this was probably a very annoying obstacle—but only this last boss remained, and the only one standing in Y/N's way was me! "As he spoke, he summoned the red arrow aimed at him.
You instinctively want to say something more...... But Tenna kept talking, seemingly trying not to cry: "And the condition to defeat me is—" He seemed to be teasing on purpose, not finishing right away. He raised his voice, only to lower it the next second.
His voice was even a bit muffled: "...... Say you love me, Y/N. Please tell me, you love me—that's the condition for clearing the level." "As long as ...... As long as you say that, he's willing to let you go back. He lowered his TV screen, not wanting you to see the tears falling from his screen, and even turned his back to you...... But you still saw it.
You open your mouth, then close it again, and you really don't know what to do...... Do you love him? You haven't thought about this question. You're just certain that you do like Tenna, but does liking mean you love? You...... You don't know, you don't know, but...... Maybe, at least at this moment, you really want to shout those words, at least at this moment, you're certain this is your true feeling, this is what you genuinely want to tell Tenna.
So you hesitated for a moment, but finally softly said, "...... I love you. ”
He stood still, as if savoring it for a moment, but in the end he didn't dare face you, just stepped aside and said in a muffled voice, "...... Yeah, I love you too, so...... So you should go. Hurry up. "He knows, Tenna knows, he'll definitely regret it soon. He's just a selfish old TV guy, he can't be that selfless, he can't truly love you and fulfill your wish—how much he wants to be with you forever, how much he wants to stay by your side, how much he wants you to stay here forever. He just, he just...... He just softened at this moment. Maybe it's just because of love, or maybe...... He's just afraid, afraid you'll be disappointed.
You silently passed by Tenna, who was standing sideways and refusing to face you, and silently walked toward the pitch-black fountain ahead...... A flash of white light flashed by, and you finally snapped out of this long sleep. Only then did you realize you were sleepwalking again—you were at the junkyard. Instinctively, you took a step and immediately kicked a CRT TV that had popped out of the garbage station. You looked down and realized, this must be Tenna—no, it must be Tenna.
You carried the TV home. Although your parents were a bit surprised that you suddenly brought a CRT TV back, they didn't ask much. You turned on the TV, and the screen displayed your previous game world. The only difference was, Tenna's image didn't appear in the screen.
You sighed, smiled, and hugged the TV...... Eventually, you fell asleep, thinking, maybe you could see Tenna again in your dreams.
You woke up from the dream, stepped out from the darkness behind you, and saw Tenna still standing in the spot where you had left earlier. At this moment, he was crouching down, probably muttering to himself...... But as he wiped his screen, it looked like he was crying.
You quietly walked forward, then hugged him from behind, your voice tinged with laughter: "Alright, guess who came?" ”
He didn't even turn to look at you—but his voice was full of surprise: "Y/N! I thought, I thought...... You'll never come back......" he whispered, not daring to look back at you, afraid you were just his imagination.
"Of course I'll come back, after all, we signed the contract back then...... We're going to get married, hmm...... And I'll be with you forever...... Your voice gradually faded, and you felt a bit embarrassed to face it...... Only then did you remember, you still had to get married.
"Yes—get married! Y/N, my dearest one, I like you the most. Please marry me!" Tenna's antenna straightened up again, gently shaking it. He turned around and tightly held your hand. His screen lit up again, and a large flower appeared at the tip of his nose—though it sounded like a question, he simply pulled out a ring and slipped it onto your hand, with a TV-shaped diamond at the tip...... Hmm, it looks a bit strange, but it suits Tenna's taste quite well.
You sighed helplessly and hooked your finger at him: "Mm, mm, I'm marrying you...... But I didn't bring any rings or anything. "After thinking for a moment, you simply wove a small wreath ring from fallen branches, leaves, and petals for him, then slipped it onto his finger.
"Alright, now our wedding is complete! Speaking of getting married in the game...... Hmm, is there any bonus? ...... "You start overthinking, wanting to pull up your own panel to check, but this game is so basic, it doesn't even have a single panel!"
Tenna's body stiffened, and he hurriedly added two attributes: "Yes, yes, after marriage, physical attack increases by 15%, and magic attack increases by 15%!" He added these two attributes to the pause screen display in the game...... You shrugged. You were just saying it offhand, but you hadn't expected Tenna to add it to you. You held Tenna's hand and walked forward.
"Alright, attributes and all that don't matter anyway. You're here anyway—hmm, shall we continue our adventure? By the way, where are we heading to our next stop...... By the way, did you not even finish the map? ”
"Y/N, where do you want to go—I can make a map on the spot!"
"Alright, alright, leave it to me to do it...... Don't worry, I come every day, though I only come in my dreams......" His voice gradually faded, probably walking away.
Your journey seems to have never ended.
END.

title: Marked1 (dntx you) (18+)
content:
Tenna noticed you early on. Logically...... TV World is a big place, and there shouldn't be a staff member there, but you handle everything very well and are very friendly to everyone.
For you, this is certainly necessary and natural, since at the end of the day, you're just a beta—if you don't work hard, you'll always be a low-level beta, and you'll never be anything. If you're not friendly enough to others...... Ultimately, you're just a beta...... If you're not friendly enough to them, in the end, you'll just be excluded. Of course, what you do is always just right—after all, you don't want to attract jealousy and get targeted.
Of course, you don't know your boss is secretly watching you. He's always watching you—no matter who you're talking to, you'll always smile, and no matter who you're with, you're always gentle, kind. He knows that many of your employees really like you, and they're even considering marrying you. After all, you're a beta—whoever you marry is a good match.
—But Tenna wasn't satisfied, he was very dissatisfied, and of course he saw you, of course...... Although he was usually very cold, without a doubt, he still felt a bit moved by your behavior. Maybe it was because you showed just the right amount of tenderness when facing him, or maybe because your work efficiency was unquestionably high, maybe ...... Or maybe it was just a bit tacky, and his realization fell on you, but it couldn't be transferred away. Yes, without a doubt, he ...... Probably love at first sight, or rather, attracted by lust.
You rejected other employees' proposals. After all, you just wanted to quietly be a beta. Like most betas, you wanted to find a well-behaved OMEGA to marry—after all, just thinking about having a sweet, soft person, whether husband or wife, waiting for you at home, made life feel more hopeful.
…… But why did things turn out this way? You couldn't figure it out, because right now, you and Tenna were locked in a room. It was obvious there was a setup, because you were suddenly called to Tenna's office to deliver some documents—probably for tomorrow's evening news program—but when you entered Tenna's office, you saw Tenna going through her sensitive period, even her screen turning red. Instinctively, you wanted to open the door and leave, thinking you needed to bring the boss some suppressant, but the door was locked.

Next came another pippins' voice, a bit floaty: "Ah, wouldn't it be nice to be late and get scolded by Mr. Tenna?" His voice was a bit floaty, clearly looking forward to it.
Your mouth twitched. Anyway, this was probably an abandoned room, fairly clean, but no one had come to see. You could still hide here for a while. As you thought this, you heard Zapper's voice again: "Quiet, quiet." Mr. Tenna told us to gather there. ”
Immediately, all the pippins quieted down. Shadow Guy played a tune symbolizing joy, but of course, it soon stopped. You listened as the grand footsteps gradually faded away, finally breathing a slight sigh of relief. That book didn't describe what these employees looked like...... Nor did it describe what the original TV WORLD was like; you only knew a bit about Tenna. To confirm whether you had truly wandered into that book, you hesitated for a moment, then quietly peeked out of the room. After looking around and confirming that no Dark People were left behind, you slowly walked in the direction they had left. The end of the road seemed to be a large door, and you heard rustling sounds coming from inside. So you didn't dare open it for now, only glancing at the label on the door to confirm it was probably a lounge. Then you heard the noisy voices of the Dark People inside, followed by Tenna's voice—you were sure you hadn't mistaken him, since it was almost exactly the same as described in the book, with a deliberately hoarse and deep tone.
You hear Tenna say, "Today we're going to perform the first show at 10 a.m. This show features the weather couple starring the lead dancers, while Zapper and Shadow Guy handle the music and backup dancers." ”
You blinked, secretly pressed against the door, and kept eavesdropping. The room was very quiet, with only Tenna's voice left. He continued to instruct, "Then, at three in the afternoon, you pippins will be in charge of the lead roles, the game board part. Don't mess it up." ”
Then came the joyful cheers of the pippins. You glanced at the clock hanging on the wall—it was nine o'clock, meaning the show was about to start.
When there were no more sounds in the lounge, you quietly opened the door to take a look. Fortunately, there was no one inside. You still remembered which direction those Dark People had left, and you wanted to confirm whether you had truly entered that book. So you opened the door to the studio. The hallway was spacious, and no one was there—you walked along the corridor, passing through another backstage preparation hall, and then quietly arrived at the audience seats below the theater stage.
At this point, no other Dark People had come over. You found a seat at the highest point and hid behind your seat, so no one would notice you—anyway, that's what you thought, and of course you did it. You just hid there, your legs went numb from squatting. Then you saw the lights on the stage come on, the weather couple appeared, Tenna made an appearance, and besides that, quite a few shadow guys came down to sit in the seats below.
As the melodious music started, the couple began to dance. Zapper and Shadow Guy took the stage for the backup dancers and music, while Tenna was expressionless, reciting some kind of poem, sounding completely emotionless—oh my god, it's normal for a show like this to have zero ratings. But the Shadow Guys sitting in the audience started applauding and even tossing flowers, while Tenna naturally showed that arrogant smile, confidently accepting all the applause from the audience.
You were stunned—if you ask you, none of the praise from the audience was sincere, but Tenna still carried the praise, the corners of her mouth curling down again, simply leading the staff off the stage, while the Dark People on stage gradually dispersed, leaving the venue. For a moment, there was only one ...... A sense of darkness and loneliness surrounded you.
You swallowed hard, and you could be sure that guy was exactly the Mr.Anton Tenna you had seen in your book. After all, the color description was the same, the expression described—the arrogant smile and the expressionless look—was exactly the same too—there could be no mistake, that was indeed the tenna just as you had seen in your book. It's just that you didn't know whether you had actually entered that book, and you also didn't know... what your identity actually was right now. If you had really entered that book, then who was really the Y/N, you or the one who came later who was the Y/N? If it wasn't that book, then where exactly had you arrived? Could you return to the world you were in before?
…… No matter what, you think your urgent priority is to return to the world you once had. Although that world wasn't very beautiful, at least you still had some hope of survival. Here, you're unfamiliar with the place and don't even know where to go.
The more you think about it, the more you realize you're a bit hungry...... Hmm, looks like you need to find a way to get to the kitchen here. There's a clock hanging on stage. You glance at it—it's eleven thirty. So you knock on your numb legs, stand up, open the door again, and return to the backstage area. As you walk forward, you hear sounds coming from the lounge room—it seems the weather couple is talking about something. You don't dare go in for a moment, but you don't know which room to go to, so you can only hide behind the door when they push open it, praying that no one will see you—well, still, no one really sees you, probably no one would notice behind the door.
You watched those people leave, seemingly heading to the backstage studio. Seeing that no one was in the lounge, you breathed a sigh of relief and went back in, returning to the door leading to the staff passage. Then you tried it out and finally found the kitchen when you pushed open the eleventh door.
There was still leftover breakfast pie in the kitchen, with a nose-shaped ice cream cone stuck in it. You couldn't care about that much—just eat it first. Once you got rid of the pie, you finally stopped feeling hungry. You felt much better. You breathed a sigh of relief, looked at what else was in the kitchen, grabbed a few pieces of bread to hide as emergency food, and then hurriedly slipped out of the kitchen. You just saw pippins in the corridor, hoping they hadn't noticed you. Anyway, you slipped back into the staff dormitory where you had just appeared, lay quietly on the bed, and numbly thought maybe you could sleep a bit longer before heading back. Unfortunately, you slept through the whole afternoon and still couldn't go back. You had to sit up, preparing to explore some ways to leave the Dark World. Maybe once you leave this Dark World, you can return to the world you used to belong.
Just then, you hear footsteps, and at the same time, pippins are speaking: "If you ask me, this world really is wonderful...... Thanks to that dark fountain created by the knight, none of us could have appeared here normally. ”
"Yes, I just heard that recently the People of Light sealed the dark world where the king resides...... I wonder if one day we will face such an ending. ”
You heard that pippins' voice seem to tremble slightly: "I heard those Citizens of Light who came were fierce, even crushing them all to dust and wiping them out...... Some of the Dark Folk managed to escape by luck, but now no one knows where they went. ”
"Anyway, don't worry too much...... I heard Mr. Tenna made some kind of deal with the knights. We'll definitely get away unscathed when the time comes." The voice grew more distant, and I had no idea where those pippins had gone, while you found yourself lost in thought.
Hmm...... If I find that so-called dark fountain, will I be able to find a way to escape? You don't know any other method now, so you can only try this one.
So later, when they all turned off the lights—probably asleep—you gently pushed open the lounge door and looked up at the locked door—the only place you hadn't been to was here. You took off your hairpin, said goodbye, and tried it out. You hadn't hoped for it, since you hadn't learned it before—except to your surprise, the lock was actually unlocked.
You swallowed hard, walked over the wall with the huge screen, unlocked the password lock ahead, and then continued forward...... It was a field of snow. As you looked around, you saw something in the distance that looked like a fountain. Suddenly, you felt a bit excited—you had found your way home! So you couldn't wait to move forward, without even looking ahead, and then you loaded a hard object.
You rubbed your forehead and stepped back two paces—you saw the huge figure clearly—it was Tenna. Damn it, you never wanted anyone from TV WORLD to discover you...... At that moment, Tenna also turned around. His screen was pitch black, but when he saw you, his voice still turned somewhat surprised: "People of Light?" ”

"Then...... Um, I already secretly watched your show today, and I even ate the pie left from the kitchen......" You stammered, but unexpectedly, Tenna's mood grew even more excited.

His voice gradually calmed down, and he released the hand tightly gripping your arm, letting go, just coughing lightly twice, the antenna gently hanging down.

But to calm him down, you still tried hard to recall the morning show and gave what you considered a fair evaluation.
Tenna sat back down under the Christmas tree, his voice softening a bit: "So, do you think the People of Light will like this show? Will it get high views?" ”

But when you look at the screen he opens, although the corners of his mouth curve downward, ...... It's obvious that you see a hint of anticipation on his screen, probably because he's in a good mood and can achieve your goals. You say against your conscience, "Hmm, I think this show is very elegant, the music is beautiful, and it's a classic that lasts forever. I believe many people of light will like this show, and I think the view count won't be low." ”
So you watch as the corners of his mouth quickly lift, but immediately after, Tenna turns off the screen, his tone trying to stay calm, cold, and serious: "Is that so?" That's good. What about the remaining two shows? What do you think? ”
You hesitated for a moment, but still honestly said, "I haven't watched the other two shows...... I—I'm a bit hungry...... You stammered and found an excuse for yourself, after all...... You really don't know what the other two shows are like, and finding the kitchen as an excuse might help you avoid Tenna's problem.
He didn't say anything, but for some reason, you felt like his figure had shrunk a bit...... It wasn't your imagination, but he really did become smaller than you. You helplessly hugged your legs and sat on the snow too, unexpectedly, not very cold...... Maybe Tenna did something about it.
"Uh...... But, but after eating, you can still go back and watch the show. I understand what it feels like to be hungry—it must be really uncomfortable...... His voice stammered, growing quieter and quieter, and for some reason, crystal-clear tears were still rolling down his dark screen.
You widen your eyes, not quite understanding why he is like this—oh my, Tenna is even more fragile than in the novel you've read...... Maybe it's because he's still in the TV WORLD and hasn't been tempered so much, hasn't developed such a cold and tough personality, even though he still prefers coldness now. His cold tone and expression, but in private...... His emotions still easily show.
You hurriedly leaned in to wipe the tears from his screen, but at that moment, you couldn't really say you wanted to go home...... Watching him sob silently, you couldn't help but feel a bit anxious. You admitted you had softened, so you couldn't help but hug him as his smaller figure shrank, and the tears on the screen soaked your clothes...... You thought to yourself that no one had ever given you a hug when you were crying. It was just subconscious—you once hugged your brother when he cried, or else you'd get scolded by your parents—you had hugged your weak sister too, because you hoped she would be happy and joyful after receiving your embrace. And now, you think the same.
So you couldn't help but whisper, just like you once hugged your younger siblings, "Don't cry, don't cry...... Your sister will help you block all the pain, all the hurt, all the sorrow and suffering. Just live happily and happily, don't cry, don't cry......" As you spoke, you gently patted Tenna's head. After all this was done, you let go again, feeling that your earlier behavior was a bit childish. That kind of thing is suitable for children, but not really for Tenna...... It was probably a TV that had existed for who knows how many years.
His screen was no longer wet, but once again showed that cold, downward-curving expression at the corner of his mouth. His figure also grew a bit, he grabbed your arm, then relaxed a bit and asked stiffly, "Why did you just hold me?" ”
"Uh...... That's what I use to comfort my younger siblings...... I saw you cry, so tiny now......" You hesitated and said, because Tenna's screen went dark again, and you didn't dare to continue. His arm loosened, and you sat back two paces.
Tenna thought...... So that's how the People of Light do, so as a sister, that's how they do? Your embrace is so warm and soft, your voice so gentle that it made him relax involuntarily...... How much he wishes to stay in your arms a little longer, but...... But you let go, and it seems you think you just made a mistake. And of course, he couldn't say he liked your embrace...... He had long known that he couldn't just say his preferences out loud, or he'd just be attacked with something to blame.
Tenna just lowered her head, and you listened to his low, hoarse voice: "...... If you were my sister, would you make me happy forever?" He just murmured softly, mixed with the cold wind, you barely heard a word, only barely hearing the words 'happiness and joy.'
So you smiled: "Mm...... I'll make sure you are happy." Even though you know you won't always do this, even though you know...... You're just deceiving him, you feel a bit guilty, and then you watch Tenna's body return to its original shape, looking like he's in a good mood again. But you just lower your eyes, your fingernails involuntarily digging into your palm...... Looking at him like this, you despise yourself even more. You clearly can't do it, so why give him hope? Isn't this just like the parents you hate the most? Always promising you, but when the time comes, you act as if nothing happened.
…… You don't know if you can do it. You don't dare look him in the eye, because your eyes are filled with guilt. Then you hear his stiff yet still unmistakably joyful voice: "Well then, come watch my show tomorrow. I hope...... You can give me some feedback. ”
"Mm...... I'll be there tomorrow. "You stammered.
"That's great...... Ahem, hmm, you should rest now. Let me take you to a resting place. "Tenna said as she stood up and slowly walked outside. You hesitated and glanced again at the dark fountain in the distance, but in the end, you had no choice but to follow Tenna's footsteps.

Tenna simply turned the screen back on, returning to his expressionless expression. He didn't look at you—maybe to hide his emotions or afraid of being exposed, he simply said dryly, almost as if commanding, "Alright, you can sleep here tonight." ”
You blinked, but still decided to pretend not to understand and asked, "Then where are you sleeping?" ”
"I'm sleeping here." As he spoke, he pointed to the bed and turned off the screen again.
You widened your eyes. Oh heavens, didn't we just meet today? How come we're going to share a bed the next second?! Something doesn't seem right...... But Tenna visibly just turned into a tiny one, unable to get on the bed. After hesitating for a moment, you still carried him to the bed, then he shrank into the corner on his own, though the screen was still off, and the remaining large area looked like yours.
In this situation, you wouldn't be able to ask him any more questions...... He looked too weak, too fragile, completely different from the image you remembered from that book...... If you hadn't confirmed his name, you'd have thought you had entered another book. But...... Even if you did enter that book, what would you do? If you helped Tenna now, would that ...... Replace the female lead who later took her place? Is this really the right thing to do? If...... But if, you help him, comfort him, can you really guarantee you can do everything? You don't know,
But in the end, you still kneel on the bed, gently hugging the tenna, your fingers touching his screen—those wet tears...... You think for a moment, sit cross-legged, let him sit on the bend of your legs, gently pat his head, hum the exact same song, and softly wish him happiness and joy.
And this Tenna just silently shed tears. After an unknown amount of time, his screen turned back on, the corners of his mouth still curved downward, and he just gently tugged at your sleeve: "So...... So you'll watch my show forever, right? His voice was so urgent and so pale. You looked at little Tenna, unable to reveal the truth, and finally just tilted his head slightly and said.
"Yes, I hope you can always be happy. I'll stay to watch your show." As you spoke, you patted his head again, feeling guilty and guilty—you kept talking about promises you might never keep, and deceiving him...... That wasn't your true intention; you just hoped his mood would improve.
You couldn't hear his crying anymore, and you just gently patted his back. You stared at his dark screen, confirmed he was probably really asleep, then carefully laid him on the pillow, covered him with the blanket, and you just picked up another blanket and lay down on the sofa to fall asleep.
Early the next morning, the first thing to sound was actually a knock at the door. You rubbed your eyes and went to open the door, only to find a microphone helmet that was noticeably shorter than yours—you were stunned for a moment, and the other person was probably stunned too. Then they bypassed you and entered the room, starting to call out to Tenna: "Boss, it's your wake-up time now." ”
Then, you see the small figure curled up on the bed grow again, until it becomes his usual size—he still doesn't turn on the screen, just responds in a hoarse voice: "Mm, Mike." ”
"Boss, I noticed there's a stranger in your room. She might affect your career...... You know, according to our reasoning, only by maintaining enough ruthlessness and sharpness can you lead your staff well, and only then can more people of light pay attention to you. They won't look down on you or hurt you. After all, aside from Mike, no one cares about your old TV, right? So we should just kick her out......
You originally wanted to refute this rambling Mike...... Because what he said sounds completely wrong to you. Why do you have to do that to attract others? But he said he wants to drive you away...... Maybe it can bring you back to the world of light? So you didn't say anything more.
You just calmly sit on the sofa and look at Tenna, his dark screen staring at you—maybe he's looking at you, but you can't be sure, you just hear his cold voice: "I know, but I need the People of Light to help me judge the quality of the show." ”
"But boss, show us your performance, and we'll just help evaluate it......" Mike was still talking, but Tenna interrupted him.
"Enough, my show still needs to be watched by the Lightfolk. So...... I demand that this Lightviller stay, and you must treat this Lightbringer well. "His voice was still stiff, but you noticed a slight difference in that hardness—it seemed he wasn't quite used to speaking like that.
But you can tell that if he doesn't do this...... he'll just get pushed and criticized by these employees. You're not sure you can bear to watch this happen...... Then Tenna turned his back and ordered him to leave: "Enough, anyway, you can leave first." ”
The guy named Mike walked out looking frustrated, and you wanted to follow him out, but Tenna turned around and called out to you.
"Um, you stay." His voice softened a little.
You stopped in a daze, and in the end, just turned around and sat back down on the sofa.
Tenna looked at you, hesitating: "You, that ......"
Maybe he wanted to ask your name? Anyway, you interrupted him first, saying, "I'm Y/N." ”
"Yeah, Y/N. You heard what I just said. What do you think?" Tenna had been listening to the opinions from TV WORLD employees before...... Of course, part of the reason was that he truly felt he needed to become like this—he felt he was cold enough, sharp enough to avoid any more harm. And the other part...... He was listening to the advice of those employees, trying to become more ruthless. After all, it sounded like no one cared about him anymore—except for those employees.
There were only a few days left...... In short, this was how Tenna felt: just a few days away, and he would completely become the image the people of darkness had said, exactly the kind of image they hoped for—and what he himself hoped for. However, in the remaining days, he still wavered. Once this period of hesitation ended, he planned never to go under that Christmas tree again.
…… It's just that yesterday he saw you, a citizen of light.
You paused for a moment, then began to organize your words: "Mm...... Um, I think what he said does make some sense. You need to be a bit colder, at least ...... Don't easily show your emotions, right? "You're not sure if what you said is right or wrong; you only know his screen is off, and he turns around again, asking with a calm and unemotional tone.
"So, do you think what he said is right?"
You quickly shook your head, then noticed he had his back to you. You couldn't tell if he was afraid of seeing your expression or afraid of being seen by you. You just hurriedly said, "Of course not." ”
"Then what do you think we should do?" His voice remained calm. You were still thinking about how to answer his question when Tenna suddenly turned around, and his screen lit up—a glinty sensation, accompanied by a swirling black and blue circle that formed a vortex.
His voice was calm, tinged with nervousness: "How about this? Is this okay? As long as we do this, we can keep all the Lightfolk here...... He was just speaking bluntly.
You feel distracted. In that instant, you seem to hear many voices: your siblings asking you longingly, your parents kindly saying they love you, and their voices saying they will always take care of you—in that instant, you realize it's all an illusion, something impossible to happen, it's just...... You still have something to look forward to.
So you shake your head, trying to wake yourself from this beautiful dream, and at the same time, you push Tenna's TV head away. Your cheeks are pale, cold sweat drips from your forehead, and after you push Tenna away, he just turns off the screen, silent, as if wanting to say something but ultimately not speaking.
He just hung his head on the TV, counting on his fingers, seeming a bit nervous, but there was no sign of it on his face.
You let out a long breath and quickly shook your head: "No...... It's not like that, you can't do that. I won't like it, and the other Lightfolk who discover the truth won't like it either." You whispered this fact.
“…… Like? I don't need their affection; I just hope they can look at me, that more and more people will look at me." Tenna's voice was still very calm, but you could sense a hint of a calm madness in it...... Oh my god, it seems this tenna is indeed a bit more fragile than the one I read in my book, but my colleague also seems even crazier.
You didn't know what to say, so in the end, you just quietly stepped forward, took Tenna's hand, and softly said, "Mm...... Alright. If you just want others to keep watching you, then doing this is wrong. At least you can't do that to me, or I'll just keep my distance. ”
Tenna took your hand upon hearing this. His TV head still didn't look you in the eye. He simply asked, "So...... What do you have to do to stay?" His voice was tense. If you suggested leaving, Tenna would probably try to hypnotize you again, making you feel that everything here is beautiful and you never want to leave again.
You hesitated for a moment, or told a lie. You don't know if it was to calm him down or to gain greater benefits from Tenna—at least to let you explore freely in this world.
"As long as you don't treat me like this, I'll stay forever." You spoke softly, telling the lies you already knew. You felt guilty, guilty, knowing you couldn't do it, and that you would break that promise...... But you still chose to do it.

It is to fulfill the wishes of those customers before they fully bloom.
And now, after fulfilling the last customer's wish, you're about to die. You know, this is your deadline. There are fewer and fewer new arrivals, and you hear that the flower bloom disease is gradually being cured, with no new cases this year. So you plan to close the store completely after completing this order.
As for your flower...... It is a poppy growing in the socket of your right eye. The flower has been eating away at your eyeball, but now that socket is empty, you feel the plant's roots and stems are about to spread to your brain.

You kneel beside this corpse. Although it's not that you don't welcome ordinary customers, ordinary people are not sent to you, but rather to another funeral home for cremation.
But you still gently lift the white cloth and push aside the pure white chrysanthemums surrounding you.
Pitch-black and shattered screens, broken wires, bent antennas, missing arms. This is a TV transformed into a dark citizen, and you get that impression.
