Even though he doesn't know how you'll handle this situation, he's already prepared his ultimate move: if you show you don't want to stay any longer and want to leave, he'll directly hypnotize you—that's the most effective way to control you, and he can guarantee it will work for you.
And now, you were both silent, as if waiting for the other to speak. In the end, Tenna spoke first, her tone as calm as possible: "What do you think of yesterday's hypnosis therapy? Was it effective?" ”
You rest your hands on your chin, looking at Tenna, still smiling—yes, yes, because your mother told you to keep smiling at all times: "I think yesterday's hypnotherapy was great, suited me well, and worked well because, in fact, it really was useful for me." "At least for now, the person you're somewhat interested in has become him, although ...... It's only a little interest, not very strong, but for you, it's already a lot.
"So, how do you feel about staying here? Do you feel comfortable?" He continued to ask.
"Yes, I feel quite comfortable here. The environment here is nice, and talking to you helps me relax, so I really enjoy staying here." This is your honest words. Although you think some of it is due to the deliberate influence of the subconscious repeating words, honestly, you don't mind staying here.
Tenna just nodded slightly, then changed his tone and started to get into your daily life: "So, do you feel comfortable staying in this small town now? Do you like staying here?" ”
This time you were silent for a moment, because honestly, it didn't matter where you stayed, so you just shook your head and nodded: "It doesn't matter, stay here...... I think it's irrelevant. Whether I like it or not, I have to stay here, so my answer is simply that it doesn't matter. I don't feel comfortable, nor do I feel uncomfortable, that's all. ”
Tenna's hands, which had been clenched and resting on the table, couldn't help but tap their palms—he hadn't expected you to give such an answer: you're a tricky target, but precisely because of that, he was even more interested in you. He really wanted to know if he could capture your attention and focus all your attention on him. He also wanted to know—if you were caught up in this kind of emotion, would you still have that kind of penetrating power that seemed to see right through someone? No matter how you feel about him, Tenna knew very well that his goal was to capture your attention, to possess you...... He wanted to have you, even though he couldn't quite explain what kind of feelings he truly had.
So he was silent for a while, then asked another question: "So, have you ever thought about finding an emotional anchor? Or sharing your feelings...... For example, going into a relationship, finding an intimate lover, and so on. ”
You shook your head, just once again lifting the corners of your mouth: "No, I'm not interested in this kind of thing. There's no need." ”
You don't know why Tenna is asking this—possessing your body isn't enough, does he want to possess your soul too? For some reason, at this moment, you suddenly feel that all of this is completely boring...... It's as if you already know the ending, you already know what Tenna might do next, so this time, you just stand up directly. You seem to have lost all interest, the smile on your face disappearing, and you turn to walk toward the door, your voice just mechanical: "I'm a bit tired. Let's stop here for today. I might come back in the future, or maybe I won't. Sorry." "It's hard to guarantee your interest will last.
TBC.

title: Hypnotherapy 6 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna's expression changed instantly. He gripped the armrest of the chair tightly with both hands and, in a low, almost shouting voice, said, "Who allowed you to leave?" ”
Your steps paused, and you thought you must have misheard—but it seemed Tenna did say the same thing. You weren't sure, but anyway, the right to leave wasn't something he could give you, and the decision to leave wasn't something he could define—in short, you just wanted to leave this place. So you only paused for two seconds, then walked forward without caring about anything. Tenna stared at your back with a somewhat gloomy expression, though his screen just darkened. But anyone could tell his mood wasn't very good.
His legs are broken. If it weren't for this, if it weren't for this, he could have chased after you now and blocked your way, instead of just reaching out in vain to grab your back, and then—with a loud bang, he fell to the ground, completely uncarried. But if you could turn around and look at him, or even walk back, then his fall would be worth it. That chair, which was basically a wheelchair, had long since disappeared because of his fall, and you listened to the loud noise behind you, unable to help but stop and glance back.
You saw Tenna collapse to the ground without any dignity. It seemed the loud crash just now was caused by him falling...... In fact, you could just ignore it, because you just stared at him coldly, feeling nothing. But you know, he's still your psychologist, so both emotionally and logically, you probably need to help him—even though his fall didn't affect you at all, after weighing the options, you decided to walk over and help him up, even though he looked heavy. So you still turn and walk toward Tenna. You crouch down and drape one of his arms over your shoulder. Almost his entire weight is pressed on you, and it is indeed very heavy. But you still grit your teeth and help him sit back into his wheelchair. Then you turn to leave, but at that moment, Tenna suddenly grabs your hand. You turn to look at him in confusion and see a familiar black-and-white vortex glowing above his screen, spinning and circling as if drawing your eyes. For a moment, you can't look away, and your consciousness gradually blurs—only in that instant do you realize Tenna was deliberately luring you back; he was just...... He was deliberately luring you here.
Immediately after, Tenna hugged you, who was unconscious, still wide open but vacant. He looked at you, wrapped his arms around your waist, and you sat on top of him without resistance.
Tenna's voice was soft and deep, but it echoed clearly throughout the room. His mood was still poor, but holding you again, having you, still lifted his spirits. So now he just held you, repeating the same words: "Without my permission, you can't leave this room, you can't leave my side." ”
At least at this moment, his mood was still fairly calm.
And you nodded as well, repeating his words: "Mm, I understand. Without Tenna's permission, I won't leave your side." Although this works in hypnosis, Tenna isn't sure if it will affect your true psychological existence—he realizes that what he desires now is not just to control you hypnotically; he longs to control NIIT in normal times as well, because perhaps that means that for you, he is an extremely important presence that cannot be ignored, and will occupy the only meaningful part of your dull life. Just thinking about this makes Tenna feel extremely excited.
So, pure hypnosis might not be feasible...... Tenna thought this, but aside from that, you seemed uninterested in the other side of him, including the things he placed on the table today. It seemed you weren't interested either, but you still seemed to smile slightly.
“…… What do you like? What do you like? Y/N。 Thinking this, he began to ask you this question, because he knew that under hypnosis, you would definitely give the real answer. But you just remained silent, as if hesitating, making Tenna start to wonder if the hypnosis wasn't strong enough. In the end, you just shook your head.
"Whatever, it doesn't matter, anything is fine." You said that. No matter what it is, to you, it's just about the same.
Tenna just found it a bit unbelievable—how could a citizen of light have no preferences at all? Kris and the others all have some preferences, even though the records he recorded about them might have become quite different...... But at least it proves they do like something, but you... don't like anything?
He couldn't help but ask again, "Is there anything you like to eat?" Even he has his own preferences...... Of course, he wouldn't casually reveal his preferences, but he never expected you would answer him like that.
You were silent for a moment, then quickly shook your head and said, "Anything is fine, I don't have a preference." ”
Tenna frowned. He had to admit, things had become a bit tricky now. He had originally wanted to start with your hobbies, hoping to attract your attention or spark your interest...... But now, you said nothing.
Maybe that's enough—if you put all your interest on him, that's enough—in that case, Tenna came up with an interesting idea, so he softened his tone and began to say in a kind of persuasive tone: "Alright, I get it...... So, you'll like everything I give you...... Right? You'll like it. ”
This time you just tilted your head. Although you were hypnotized, you still asked, "Why?" ”
"Because everything about me makes you interesting, doesn't it? You want to explore the reasons behind all this...... You find me interesting, and you find everything I've given you interesting, so you like everything I give you." In fact, Tenna wasn't sure if saying that would be useful—he wasn't sure if you'd be interested in everything he gave you as he said in his hypnosis.
And at this moment, you just repeated: "I understand. I will be interested in the intangible or tangible things Mr. Tenna has brought me, whether it's emotion or objects...... I will appreciate the feelings you give me." ”
"Very good. What do you think of the candy and cookies I gave you earlier?"
"I used to find it boring, but now I find it delicious. Thank you, Mr. Tenna, I really like what you gave me."
"Very well, then you won't remember what happened during this hypnosis process. All you need to do is remember. I just want you to calm down a bit."
"Alright, I won't remember what happened before. That's something I shouldn't remember." You answered obediently.
Tenna raised his eyebrows, feeling satisfied. He leaned back against the wheelchair's backrest, holding you as you obediently straddled his lap, feeling very satisfied—today's hypnosis went smoothly, probably because the time was short, but he was a bit unwilling because nothing seemed to be achieved during this hypnosis. Then he looked at you and gave a big command: "Now, kiss me." And you nodded, indeed following Tenna's command, kissing on his screen.
"Kiss my lips." He ordered you. You kissed his lips, and at that moment, Tenna pressed down on your head, continuing the kiss. His lips sucked on your lips without hesitation, while his tongue licked yours. He entangled your lips until you were out of breath.
…… But he's not satisfied. He feels that just like this isn't enough. You just sit there dazed, just letting him do as he pleases. While that's certainly what satisfies Tenna, he's not satisfied with that. He wants you to be more proactive—he wants you to kiss his lips, sit on top of him, and do all of this on your own—and now, all you do is look at him with that obedient expression.
So Tenna couldn't help but click her tongue: "Tsk, seduce me again...... You shameless girl, since you like this kind of thing so much, then just take the initiative and sit on top of me." "Although you don't have that kind of thought, all of this is just Tenna's personal imagination, nothing more than a fantasy."
And you didn't react much, just tilted your head and looked at him in confusion. Tenna snorted again, told you to get off him, sit back down opposite him, then snapped your fingers and said coldly, "Alright, wake up." ”
And so, your consciousness awakened from the chaotic darkness. You only knew that hypnosis had just happened, and Tenna only remembered that it was just to calm you down...... You knew things weren't that simple, but now you just sat there in a daze, looking at Tenna across from you. You really didn't want to leave now...... Or perhaps, you felt it—you couldn't leave here.
You didn't say much, just quietly gazed at Tenna before asking, "So now, can I leave here?" ”
Tenna just took out a candy and handed it to you: "Have some candy before you go." ”
TBC.

title: Hypnotherapy 7 (dntx you)
content:
You were silent for a moment, but didn't say much...... You know, you know very well that this candy is just an illusion, a test. You know, although he probably didn't do anything to you, he planted a hint in you, which is why you asked him if you could leave. Now it seems his answer to you was obviously no. As for why he insisted you stay...... You couldn't figure out that answer either.
You just took the candy, peeled open the wrapper, and stuffed the fruit candy into your mouth to savor the flavor. That candy was still the same as the one you had at first—so sweet, even a little cloying. You didn't know why Tenna prepared this flavor, but unlike last time, you didn't mind or get bored. Instead, you felt in a good mood, even a little joyful...... You liked this candy, you liked the faint sweetness it brought as it melted in your mouth, or rather, because ...... subconsciously liked Tenna, so that's why you only liked this candy now.
You bit through the hard fruit candy with your teeth, but Tenna still clasped her palms together, cupped her fists on the table, and to you...... It was a bit funny, or maybe he was just a little nervous.
“…… This candy tastes pretty good. I think I should really like it." Finally, after a moment of silence, you said this. Tenna pulled back her tightly closed palm; it seemed the hypnosis had worked, at least that's what he thought. He couldn't help but feel a bit of pleasure and excitement—he knew very well that you'd definitely come to this place again, he ...... Just within his controllable range, it gave you some options of interest, nothing more.
Tenna just nodded modestly: "Mm, as long as you like it. I hope you can relax your mood now." He said this with grandiosity, and even though you all know it well, that sentence was just a lie.
"Yes, thank you, doctor. I did relax a bit. I really like your candy. I'm just curious about one thing, Mr. Tenna, why do you want me to stay here so badly?" "You just have this question, and you're also curious about what answer he'll give you...... Both times he hypnotized you, the answer he gave you was that he wanted you to stay by his side, but personally, you feel that whether you stay with someone or who stays with you, it's actually a very meaningless thing...... So, you can't really understand what Tenna is thinking.
Tenna paused. He hadn't expected you to ask this question so directly—and in fact, he hadn't found a perfect answer to this matter. He didn't know why he did it, because he only knew that he wanted to do it, that he wanted you to stay here, that he wanted you to stay by his side—to possess you, to possess you. That was his goal from the very beginning, so...... If he really wanted to give a suitable reason, he wouldn't even know what to give you.
So he was silent for a while, then finally gave his answer. He knew he couldn't avoid your question, or else the previous scene would repeat itself—he wasn't sure the current method would still work.
"You should stay by my side." In the end, he simply gave his answer with confidence.
"Why?" And you simply had a question. You asked this question, even though you didn't imagine you deserved a perfect answer.
“…… There's no reason, it's just my thoughts. Besides, you should stay with normal people." He couldn't come up with a suitable excuse either. At this point, all he could do was make things up and try to get by. And you...... Of course you know, he's just lying.
“…… Are you a normal person, Mr. Tenna? No need to pretend in front of me anymore. We both know that your refined and refined appearance is just an illusion. Please show me your true self." You said this. Although you don't have memories of the hypnosis, you know that the tone he spoke to you during hypnosis is completely different, or rather, the aura he exudes is also completely different. Because at this moment, you see Tenna lift the TV screen, probably staring at you, and then the cold atmosphere surrounding him begins to shatter...... In its place is a cold, somewhat fierce expression. He lifted the corner of his mouth, but the smile he showed was intimidating no matter how you looked at it. He simply said, "Oh?" "Then Y/N, do you really like it when I talk to you like this?" ”
And you just shake your head, because of course you don't like it—you just don't like disguise. Disguise is certainly interesting...... But even though you can see through the disguise, you still pretend not to understand, even having to accept the insincerity of this disguise—that's something you just can't get used to.
"No, I just think...... I should be talking to the real you, not a fictional person. Besides, Tenna, your mind isn't very normal to begin with, is it?" As you said that, Tenna just snorted coldly, which was basically tacit acceptance of your words. The identity of a psychologist was just a fabricated approach to you; in reality, he was probably someone who needed to see a psychologist...... Yes, and the person he chose to provide psychological support was you, even though at first he didn't want to admit it.
"Yeah, you saw me, and then what?" That's all I can talk to you like before. Are you satisfied?" Tenna just asked with a half-smile. He looked at you, clearly knowing that speaking like that would only make you dislike him, so he naturally gave up.
You just shook your head, and you didn't mean to expose Tenna...... Yeah, but at least he spoke like this much more normally, not always putting on airs: "Hmm, actually, that's not what you really think, is it...... But it's okay, I don't care about that." As you spoke, your voice paused, then became a bit helpless.
"Aren't you the psychologist? Why is it now that I'm the one doing your therapy?" "You really don't understand why things have come to this point. You were just showing you Tenna's original appearance."
"You were the one who exposed me and said I had psychological issues. Now that things have come to this, of course you have to take responsibility for my counseling." He simply said this in a matter of course. In his heart, you were supposed to help him, and that was beyond doubt—that was his conviction. Besides, in his impression, psychological counseling was just a casual chat...... So, isn't it all the same? After all, it was just a chat.
“…… Alright, let's just chat casually for now, let's talk about your situation...... Well, let me be clear in advance, this is just for counseling, not that I really want to know you. "Although this sentence is somewhat to cover up the truth...... But in reality, you really aren't very interested in how others have past, nor do you want to know about these matters. And now, all you can do is sit across from Tenna and listen to his story. At least not for you, but for you, your pressure suddenly decreases.
Tenna's face was tense and expressionless, and you didn't care that his TV screen was now pitch black. You just glanced at his legs still unattached in the wheelchair: "First, I'm a bit curious...... Why did your legs break? Hmm...... Sorry, this question might make you a little sad, because a broken leg would be inconvenient no matter what. ”
“…… The Howling Knight cut it down. Since you managed to reach Castle Town, you should know who the Howling Knight is. I don't need to introduce him further, right?" He leaned back against the back of his wheelchair, his voice tinged with mockery—or rather, self-mockery.
"Of course I know...... But why would he do this? Did you have a grudge against him? "You asked, but regarding this matter, it was obvious that Tenna didn't seem to want to say more, and he just mumbled vaguely, "Sort of." ”
So you don't ask too much about this question: "So, are you planning to reattach your leg?" ”
"Of course, my legs have to be fixed. If not, how am I supposed to pin down on you? How could I hold you back?" His words became more casual, or rather, with a hint of contempt and mockery. What was originally just something to say during hypnosis, now he said it out loud...... It was almost a clear hint written on his TV screen, and he just grinned at you.
Your movements paused, then you looked up again to scrutinize him...... Hmm, you didn't expect him to say it so directly, but you didn't intend to press the issue. You just spoke softly, replacing it with a completely unrelated, completely unrelated question: "Alright, I'm curious too—how did you develop this kind of personality?" Logically, the People of Darkness should all be friendly to the People of Light...... But your personality is completely different. ”
Hmm...... Although his answer just now clearly expressed his desire for you, you just felt it didn't matter, and even found his way of speaking quite amusing. It's rare to see someone who shows such a clear desire. Uh, maybe even the Dark People are like this, showing even more persistence toward what they crave.
"Why should I tell you? This has nothing to do with you." He shrugged.
TBC.

title: Hypnotherapy 8 (dntx you)
content:
"Hmm, if you think it's unnecessary, then it's not necessary...... Alright, this time I'm really leaving. Do you have anything else to say? "You just shrugged. You know Tenna is probably still hiding something from you, but unfortunately, you're still not interested...... You know, you know, the things he doesn't want to tell you are probably important, but now you've just pushed off the chair and stood up again. At least for now, you're looking Tenna in the eye.
Tenna looked at you too: "...... Then can you push me out for a walk?" "He's just trying every way to get closer to you. Honestly, he really dislikes his current state, but if it can make you feel even a little sympathy, maybe it's worth it." You nodded, and as he said, walked behind the wheelchair and pushed him out of the room. Although there wasn't much to see in Castle Town...... You walked along the streets of Castle Town with no interest in anything around you.
But at that moment, Tenna instead shouted, "Stop, right here, stop, then push me inside." His tone still carried a hint of bossiness, even though you weren't his subordinate either...... But you were happy to follow his orders and do something for him. After all, you had just heard him talk to you like that, so it was a bit novel.
You pushed him into that café—there were other Dark People inside, including former TV world employees. The shadow guys and zappers moved away as soon as they saw Tenna arrive. You pushed Tenna to a window seat. He was in a wheelchair and didn't even need a seat, so you pulled the seat away with a casual gesture.
"You, sit across from me." Then you planned to leave...... You weren't interested in the café, but Tenna said again in a commanding tone, so you pulled off the chair opposite him and sat down. Now you were sitting face to face with Tenna again...... Well, this was the first time in such a noisy environment.
Yes, although this is a café and normally it should be quiet here, it's not quite noisy. Probably because of the Dark People, you frowned uncomfortably, but fortunately, you can ignore the noise. Tenna, on the other side, seemed to notice your actions or something else, but coldly glanced around...... The Dark People didn't know if it was fear or something, but in any case, it suddenly quieted down. At least your ears felt much quieter. You looked up at Tenna again, who was just flipping through the Easter egg Ren Wu had just brought over, staring at the names of coffee and desserts written on it. To be honest, it was Tenna who did what happened just now, but he didn't want you to find out, nor did he want you to use it to say anything—really, it was just a small favor.
But you propped your chin up and looked at him. Although Tenna was now off the screen and showed no emotion, he was just flipping through the menu, but his gaze had lingered on that page for a long time without moving. You raised your eyebrows. To be honest, this guy was actually quite interesting...... He must be nervous now. You know he was feeling nervous because of what just happened.
So you drew out your voice and said, "You ......"
Tenna just quickly said without even looking up, "I just think those Dark People are noisy, that's all." "It's not because of you that I warned those guys."
You blinked. Honestly, you suddenly realized that maybe leaving that little hypnosis room was actually quite interesting to be with...... After all, it seemed that what he was thinking didn't match what he said at all.
"I didn't say anything." You blinked innocently and said, "Well, it's not your fault. You just spoke a bit slower. Of course, you admitted you had been deliberately slowing down just now." You think about it, you really wanted to be with him because of the hypnotic hints, and even just watching what he did was just cute...... Even though you didn't think that way entirely. If it weren't for the hints he hypnotized you with, you probably wouldn't have felt anything at all, and would have just found what he was doing boring. Although the hypnosis didn't have much effect on you, and most of you were just half-willingly reluctant, you had to admit it did have an impact. It did change part of your senses and part of your perspective. If it were the old you, you wouldn't have done this at all. And you just find that things become more interesting...... You really want to know how things will develop in the end.
Tenna finally lifted his head. His screen lit up again, but he just stared at you coldly. The corners of his mouth curved downward, clearly unhappy. He understood that he had been played by you: "So what were you just trying to say?" Although after saying that, his head lowered again.
"I was just going to ask what you planned to order. After all, you've been glued to the menu and stared at that page for ages, and in the end, you still didn't order anything." You shrugged, looking completely innocent no matter what, while also scolding Tenna for misunderstanding him and saying that.
Tenna clicked his tongue lightly: "Alright, I'll have iced Americano and mango mille-feuille. You order." After saying that, he pushed the menu toward you. Actually, he didn't even look at what was on it; those two names were just something he said offhand. You flipped through the menu. You didn't like very bitter things, so you quickly picked out. But holding onto the menu, you casually said, "There's no mango mille-feuille on the menu. Maybe Mr. Tenna, you just want this too much...... Or can we ask the shop next door to order a custom order?" "You remember the manager of the neighboring shop is a master pastry chef...... Anyway, the people from the Happy Gang have introduced the layout of Castle Town to you.
“…… Then let's have a chiffon cake." He didn't answer your question, just tilted his head and snorted coldly, clearly still looking unhappy, though you don't even know what he was angry about...... He looked like he was angry.
You handed the menu to Renwu, who returned to your table. Soon, the saka butler placed the corresponding coffees and pastries on your table. You ordered caramel macchiato and tiramisu, took a casual sip. Hmm, the sweetness and bitterness were just right, just the flavor you liked, so you couldn't help but take another sip. Tenna, sitting across from her, frowned and picked up the iced Americano...... It looked like he was just taking a careful sip, then his entire TV screen wrinkled. Immediately after, the screen went off, and his hand holding the iced Americano trembled. It seemed like he really hated the taste. But after a while, when he turned the screen back on, Tenna still wore that same cold expression, looking a bit ready to face death...... He picked up the iced Americano, took another small sip, then repeated what had just happened—the process of the screen going black and then turning it back on.
Hmm, it's clear that drinking this is really painful for him...... You nod thoughtfully, propping your chin up and nibbling your tiramisu, then watched Tenna's performance. You don't know how much time has passed, because now you look at the iced Americano in Tenna's hand—it's only taken a small bite...... The chiffon cake has already been finished by him. Now, holding the iced Americano, he hasn't moved for a long time, just staring expressionlessly at the iced Americano.
You find this a bit funny, so you should laugh too...... Hmm, this might be a bit disrespectful to your psychologist, so in the end, you still push your caramel macchiato, which you've only taken a small sip of, toward Tenna: "Looks like you don't like that, you don't like bitter ones?" Then drink this, and give me the iced Americano. "You said this, propping your chin up, honestly...... You don't care what you drink.
Tenna paused, then put the iced Americano back on the table. He looked at you. Although his expression didn't change, you could tell he was a bit puzzled: "...... I've already had this drink." "The implication is, do you want to drink his water?" He doesn't really mind drinking what you've drunk, or rather, it's exactly what he's been hoping for...... He's still looking forward to sharing it with you.
You just shrugged, pretty indifferent: "It's not like we've never had saliva exchanged before...... Ah, so basically, you pulled me and kissed me, so of course I don't care. If I did, I would've left long ago." Your words were casual as you just took the iced Americano and took a casual sip. Uh, the taste was indeed strange, but at least you could still accept it.
Tenna stared at you for a while...... If you were willing to trade with him, of course he was happy, but he wouldn't show even a little, but...... However, this matter was insignificant to you, which made Tenna feel unwilling. In other words, to you, he was just insignificant; you didn't care at all—and naturally, you didn't accept all of this just because you accepted him. He was very unwilling; Tenna knew he had to do something...... If what he wanted was your genuine feelings, then things couldn't just be like this.
…… He hoped the next hypnotherapy would succeed, he thought.
TBC.

title: Hypnotherapy 9 (dntx you)
content:
Drinking coffee, yet your thoughts differ, but you aren't really thinking about anything; you're just thinking about what tomorrow will bring. Tomorrow is a very interesting word for you—tomorrow, tomorrow. Maybe everyone looks forward to tomorrow, everyone imagines what tomorrow will be like, everyone thinks that maybe when tomorrow comes, something will come true, but you don't believe in it, or rather, it means nothing to you.
It's just ...... Maybe something unexpected will really happen tomorrow. You look at Tenna thinking that way, and you're curious about what else he'll do tomorrow—you're just curious about that.
So, after finishing this afternoon tea, you said goodbye to him. Your tone was light, though that was mostly just an act. The real you were just expressionless: "Well then, Mr. Tenna, see you tomorrow." You said this, stood up, and prepared to leave. Tenna opened his mouth, trying to persuade you to stay. Of course, at this moment, he couldn't find any excuse; he couldn't find a reason to keep you going—so in the end, he just watched you walk away unwillingly, away from the café. He watched your back, but you didn't even glance back at him. He could only watch your back until your figure disappeared from his sight. The other Dark People in the café became noisy again, making Tenna's mood terrible. The noise made him even more irritable, but he didn't say anything more. He just sat in the dark, slammed his coffee cup onto the table, and then drove his wheelchair out of the café himself. The other Dark People were startled by Tenna's sudden move, but they only dared to look at Tenna's figure and didn't dare say another word. They simply watched as Tenna left. Only after Tenna's figure disappeared from their sight did they dare to start talking loudly again. Tenna, too, just sullenly steering his wheelchair back to his room—or rather, the consultation room—even though you had already confirmed that that room wasn't the clinic, he wasn't a real psychologist, and he was just an impostor, nothing more. Yes, he's just a fake trying every possible way to get close to you. In his heart, he spat himself on himself—and felt a bit smug. At least he succeeded, didn't he? That's enough—it's much better than trying so hard but still unable to get close to you.

Hmm, anyway, he smelled a bit fishy, but it was definitely not suitable for you. He was frustrated for a moment, thinking he should have made something better, but the first attempt still failed.
He grabbed your wrist forcefully, a bit too hard, and you even felt your wrist was already red...... After all, he was holding you in pain, but you didn't dare say anything more. Tenna just pulled you up and walked toward the door on his own: "Let's go out for a bit." He didn't explain his intention for this. Your body trembled, and you instinctively thought it was because of what you had just done that upset Tenna...... So you said nothing, just followed behind him gloomily. Tenna didn't care about you, just pulled you into the car, and then he took you to a Western restaurant.
You were a bit dazed, while Tenna just pulled you to sit by the window. Soon after, the waiter came over to your table. Tenna grabbed the menu the waiter handed over and glanced at it, then handed it to you directly: "Order whatever you want." His voice was still full of casual ...... But as you calmed down a bit, you felt like you understood something—he seemed to bring you out for lunch because you hadn't actually eaten much...... Something like that. So you pursed your lips and carefully formed a smile, then you started flipping through the menu, smiling as you chatted with the waiter beside you—well, let's have beef stew with red wine, seafood baked rice, and finally a fruit tart......
Tenna watched you smiling as you talked to the waiter, and for some reason, she suddenly felt a bit irritable...... You belong to him, and your smile should belong to him too. But for some reason, he never saw you smile at him, but instead at a waiter you had no connection to. He was irritable, and once again, a Venus flytrap appeared at the tip of his nose. His knuckles impatiently tapped the table, making a crisp sound. You instinctively looked at Tenna. You didn't know why the Venus flytrap appeared on his nose, but you thought he looked irritable—maybe because you chatted with the waiter for too long and was delaying his time. So you quickly dismissed the waiter, cautiously glanced at Tenna, and smiled with a hint of flattery and apology: "Sorry, we've talked for a while. I think I've taken up your time. Sorry......"
Tenna's mood grew even more irritable. Even though you smiled at him, that's not what he wanted—and he didn't understand why you kept apologizing.

title: Luxury Desire 4 (dntx you)
content:
He interrupted you bluntly: "I don't like hearing apologies." "What he wants isn't your apology; he just wants your genuine smile." And you pause, instinctively lowering your head and shrinking back again...... He doesn't want to hear an apology, so what exactly does he want to hear? You don't understand, you just shrink back and say.
“…… Alright, I get it. Tenna ...... first. tenna。 Isn't that right...... Ah, no, just ignore what I said...... "The more you talk, the quieter you get, the more panicked you feel...... You really don't understand—what exactly does Tenna need to be satisfied with?
Tenna's lips curved slightly; he was upset because of you, or rather, very unhappy. You are his wife...... You should just look at him, why have you never looked at him all this time?
So he said, though it sounded like a command to you: "Lift your head and look at me, always keeping your head down. Where did you get such a petty habit?" As he said this, you nervously looked up at Tenna...... His screen was on, but the Venus flytrap that had just appeared at his nose disappeared. Seeing you look up, he finally showed a satisfied smile—yes, the perfect smile with eight teeth. You couldn't help but freeze for a moment when you looked at that smile, the same smile you had when you first saw him...... But now, he was completely different.
You sit there timidly, looking at him timidly. Although he's still a bit dissatisfied with how you are, he actually likes you a lot—soft, fragile, something he can manipulate and manipulate at will...... What belongs to him, he likes this concept. Since you've already become his wife, it's only natural...... You are his property. So he only gives you orders as a matter of course.
The waiter quickly brought the food out. He had come back to prepare it for you after eating, so of course he wasn't hungry at all. Everything on the table naturally belonged to you...... You probably thought he would be hungry, so you ordered a bit extra. Then, holding your fork and knife, you excitedly started cutting steak—then you looked at Tenna, who was sitting idly with his chin propped up, swallowed nervously, and said, "Um...... Tenna, I didn't know what flavor you liked, so I picked some ...... for you on my own." Tenna glanced around the dishes on the table, but none of them tasted to his liking...... But it was clear you preferred a lighter flavor.
He responded with a casual 'mm'; you couldn't tell his attitude, just lowered his head and nibbled on the steak in small bites. Tenna just kept staring at you...... Other than that, he didn't have much else to look at, and all he wanted was to look at you. He stared at your mouth as you swallowed the steak bit by bit, thinking for a moment that you really didn't eat enough, no wonder you were so thin, and sometimes thinking...... Your mouth is so small, so when you swallow his member, how will you stretch out? You'll look pitiful, your eyes reddened as you beg for mercy...... Even though that only deepens his desire for you. He was lost in thought, while you sat there with your legs together, a bit nervous. You didn't know why Tenna kept looking at you, but you could always sense his burning gaze...... You quietly lifted your head to glance at him. He rested his chin on his hand expressionlessly and looked at you, not looking annoyed...... Was he just staring at you...... You didn't know, he just properly finished the meal you had planned for yourself, then put down the fork and knife.
You obediently put your hands on your knees, then timidly said, "T...... Tenna, aren't you going to eat? "Or are you saying the food you ordered doesn't suit his taste at all?" Thinking this way, you feel a bit disappointed again...... You don't know what he really likes. Yeah, it's normal to come to please Tenna without any preparation, and end up with nothing...... Your mood is a bit down. Tenna glances at your plate of steak and baked rice, which you have eaten cleanly, and just puts the plate on his side of yours.
"You ordered it yourself, and you finished it yourself." He said this.
And you stared blankly at the four or five plates in front of you—oh my god, you can't eat that much! But when you quietly glanced up, all you saw was Tenna crossing her arms and staring at you, so you stammered and lowered your head again, picking up your fork and knife again, but this time, your movements were even slower...... Until you finished another plate of grilled lamb chops, you quietly looked up at Tenna and whispered in a voice as soft as a mosquito...... I can't eat anymore...... This is too much for me...... As you spoke, your face quietly flushed. Reaching this point was not something you could have imagined, but thinking about it with a low mood was indeed ...... You didn't ask Tenna for his opinion and took it upon yourself to order these dishes.
…… Well, if it had been said between the beds, that sentence would have piqued his interest. But now, Tenna just quickly glanced at the plates in front of him, then waved his hand to call the waiter: "Then pack it up and take it home. You have to finish your own food first." He said this as he took you home and put these things in the fridge, then glanced at the time...... The meeting time had completely passed, and there was nothing else to do today. Tenna looked at you again—by comparison, you looked even more petite when standing.
"Is there anywhere you want to go?" He thought, since it's the weekend, accompanying you to pass the time is fine...... Hmm, let's build some feelings. Tenna also knew that you two weren't close, but he had already decided you would be his wife for the rest of his time, so...... It's better to build some feelings, even though he thought it should be enough now.
You paused, looked up at Tenna, unable to believe what you had just heard, and instinctively let out a sigh.
But Tenna was still somewhat patient...... Well, although he scratched his TV case, maybe a little impatient, he still repeated to you: "Is there anywhere you want to go?" ”
“…… So, bookstore, is that okay? I ...... I want to go buy some books...... You muster the courage to make your proposal, but you shrink back...... You, you think if Tenna looks unhappy, you should make a different proposal...... You don't know where Tenna likes to go. Of course, you're also not sure if it's safe to reveal your preferences.
But you saw Tenna just smile again after hearing it, and now she seemed a bit more softened and less scary. As for Tenna...... Ah, he was just a little happy to learn about one of your preferences.
"Alright, then let's go to the bookstore. Although I don't think there's much to see there...... If you want to go, go ahead." He shrugged, returning to his expressionless expression, while your previously excited mood plummeted to rock bottom. You bitterly thought that you really shouldn't have mentioned the bookstore...... No one would like a bookstore, right?
Even so, Tenna still drove to the bookstore...... The TV world and the cyber world are different, and of course, the bookstore is different too. You stared at the tall bookshelf and quietly swallowed...... You really don't know why the shelves here are so tall. At your height, you can only pick the books in the bottom row; beyond that, you can't reach them. You look eagerly at the books above, then at Tenna beside you...... If it were him, he could easily grab the books on top of his mouth. You pursed your lips, hesitated for a moment, then tugged at the corner of his shirt—hmm, maybe the pressure was too light, so Tenna didn't notice you. You took a deep breath and tugged at his shirt more tightly. At this moment, Tenna finally lowered her head to look at you, and naturally noticed your slightly pitiful expression.
And he also heard your pitiful, pleading voice: "Um...... Tenna, I can't reach the book on top. Could you ...... help me get it? The one with the blue spine. "As you spoke, you pointed and said, Tenna was quite pleased with your expression and words, so he easily helped you take the book and handed it to you.
You actually didn't expect Tenna to listen to you—you stammered, "Th-that...... Thank you......" As you spoke, you held the book and flipped through it like a treasure. But in the next second, you felt a shadow cast on you. You looked up in confusion and saw Tenna bent over, his figure cast before you. Instinctively, you felt a sense of pressure, so you closed the book in your hand and stared at him blankly and timidly.
But once again, he showed that standard smile with eight teeth showing off, which looked a bit scary to you. He just asked you, "Thank me?" No need, but how do you express your gratitude? "Since you're already married...... From Tenna's perspective, there's no need to say thank you or other formalities, but since you did...... Then he wouldn't mind asking for something else in return.
You stared blankly at Tenna, not knowing what he really wanted...... You, you didn't dare do that, maybe Tenna didn't like it? In fact, when you first heard his words, seeing him standing so close, you were wondering whether to give him a kiss. But now...... You only dared to put down the book in your arms, gently grabbed his hand and shook it twice: "Exactly...... But I think I should thank you...... "After all...... It's just a contract marriage. You two aren't that close.

title: Luxury Desire 5 (dntx you)
content:
Even though you were so cute shaking his hand...... Tenna still felt that wasn't enough. He wanted more, like you giving him a kiss or something. But it seemed like you wouldn't give it to him. He just clicked his tongue and shook off your hand, his voice stiff: "I don't need your thanks." He snorted coldly as he spoke. You awkwardly hugged the book in your arms and read it for a while, not knowing why, which annoyed him again...... You had no choice but to nervously open the book in your hand again and read for a while. It was a subject you liked, and a smile appeared on your brow, the corners of your mouth curling up. You looked at the book with a bit of joy.
Tenna saw you showing a pure smile because of this book, and felt even more annoyed—oh, well, now he knows what books you like, but does that matter? Of course not, after all, what's more important now is that you're damn smiling at that book...... You two should be the real couple. He became even more irritable for no reason, a venus flytrap sprouting at his nose again, while he was just a dark screen, no one could see his expression.
Your peripheral vision caught sight of his expression and couldn't help but startle you...... Oh my god, maybe he's been annoyed by staying here too long. You hurriedly close the book and carefully tug at his sleeve. You instinctively wanted to apologize, but remembered he didn't like hearing it, so you forced yourself back and cautiously said, "Um...... Tenna, I-I have other books to buy. Let's hurry over first, okay?" You tugged at his sleeve, and when Tenna lowered his head in the dark of the screen, you instinctively let go of his clothes. You don't know if he doesn't like you like it this way...... After all, he still looks like he's in a bad mood. But Tenna just forcefully grabbed your hand and walked toward the bookshelf you had just been glancing at out of the corner of his eye. Then he let go, and you stood there in front of the bookshelf in a daze.
You think he's probably getting impatient...... Otherwise, why would he be holding on so painfully and walking so fast? But you didn't dare say anything, so you turned to look at the bookshelf. The book you wanted was still very high, but you couldn't reach it, so you tugged at Tenna's sleeve: "Um...... Tenna, can you help me get that book......" As you spoke, you pointed to a book on the shelves.
"Why should I?" But this time, Tenna didn't help you take the book down. Even though his screen was back on, he just kept a downward smile, looking unhappy. You shrank back and puffed out your cheeks slightly...... Well, there was really no reason for him to help, after all...... You two aren't familiar either...... Thinking this, you went to move the ladder over there, but as you turned your back to Tenna, you secretly wiped away the tears welling up in your eyes. You...... Oh my god, oh my god...... You don't want it to be like this, but Tenna treats you like this, and you still feel a little sad.
You huffed as you moved the ladder over, then climbed up, trying to take down the book you had just eyed. You stood on tiptoe and reached out to reach for the book, but before that, a hand had already taken it down—it was Tenna. When you looked back, his screen had closed again, but for some reason, he showed that somewhat mischievous smile. Your eyes were still a little red, and you instinctively wanted to snatch the book from his hand. You sniffled, your voice still nasal: "Give it back to me!" "You stood on tiptoe to grab the book in his hand, but Tenna just raised her hand high, so you couldn't get the book. Not only that, you staggered and fell off the ladder—you instinctively closed your eyes, not daring to imagine how much pain it would hurt to fall like that. You were caught in an embrace, and your nose hit the hard machine and it hurt a little. You heard Tenna's casual and slightly teasing voice: "Ah, so you wanted to throw yourself into my arms...... Your trick was pretty good, but unfortunately, it didn't work on me." ”
You opened your eyes and saw Tenna's smile at that moment, with a hint of arrogance, almost as if it was mocking you...... You blinked, feeling a bit sad, but you thought, maybe you ...... You're getting used to him talking like this; you just want to get the book back from his hands. You tiptoe to reach the book, while Tenna just lifts it a little, swinging back and forth in a spot you can reach by jumping a bit higher, while you never get the book. You get tired from dancing and look at Tenna, feeling a bit wronged: "Tenna, can you give me that book?" "That's a book you finally got your eye on......
Tenna's voice was just lazy and casual: "No, if you want it, just get it yourself." "It doesn't matter if you climb on top of him or whatever happens...... Or, or just a kiss from him, he'll be willing to give you the book. After all, you're husband and wife, so it's fine to have some fun...... It's just for fun. He just wants to vent his emotions through this book, nothing more.
But you only took two steps back and left his embrace. Tenna's embrace was empty—he was unhappy, so he turned off his screen again, and you sniffed, then turned around and climbed the ladder again. You couldn't think of a way to get that book from his hands, so you might as well just take another one...... But if you take another book, Tenna snatches it from you again, and you get a new one, just like that...... Until the book you wanted to read is completely taken away, and you look at Tenna, who stands there holding the book as if nothing happened. Hmm...... You could say it's revenge. He's at odds with you, and if he doesn't want you to get the book, then you shouldn't have it.
You sniffled and climbed down the ladder...... You stood firmly in front of Tenna. Actually, you were a bit scared, but in the end just lowered your head and asked, "...... Tenna, what will it take for you to give me the book?" "You know, he's the lord of this world, so going to the shop owner won't help you...... You can only, if it really doesn't work, beg Tenna. But at first, it clearly shouldn't have been like this.
Tenna lowers her TV screen to look at you. Actually, she's already thought of what to say—she wants to say that just one kiss is enough...... Or she might take the initiative to smile at him and say a few nice things, but—maybe still a bit awkward. She still remembers how you didn't look back before, so she just answers your question stiffly: "Guess for yourself." ”
You're at a loss. How do you know what Tenna really wants? You've only known each other for less than a day...... In the end, you just cautiously grabbed the corner of his shirt, seeing he didn't react, so you timidly grabbed his sleeve: "...... I really want to read that book, Tenna, please, give me that book...... I... I can do anything...... You said pitifully, feeling a bit guilty, not knowing if this would work.
Tenna was barely happy to hear your voice...... But that's not what he wanted, and he didn't understand why you kept talking to him like that. Sometimes it was fine, but seeing you pitiful was kind of fun, but you were already married...... He didn't want you to treat him like this. And you only saw his screen light up again, a venus flytrap sticking to his nose. You shrugged and trembled a little. You didn't know what was upsetting Tenna again...... Tenna just said in a flat, flat voice: "Anything goes?" ”
"Ah...... Yes, that's right. "You were stunned for a moment, then hurriedly nodded.
You hear him snort coldly, then smile again: "Alright. Then when I call you to do something, don't go back on your word." For some reason, you felt his mood suddenly improved a lot, and he took down a book for you, putting the rest back on the shelf.
You held the book and opened it like a treasure, flipping through it. You didn't have any other books to buy now. You closed the book and quietly breathed a sigh of relief as Tenna returned to his expressionless face. He was probably in a good mood now, but you couldn't let him get annoyed any longer! That would go against your original purpose...... You quickened your pace and hurried toward the cashier. You thought, this time you saved Tenna time, so he definitely wouldn't feel annoyed anymore. Tenna watched your hurried back, the screen went black again, and he was very annoyed, very unhappy...... You avoided him like a venomous snake, afraid of him? Clearly, right now, you two are husband and wife.
You put those two books on the checkout counter and glanced back, only to see Tenna with a black screen. You were startled, not knowing what had upset him again. You quickly pulled out your wallet to pay, stammering to the manager, "Um, that...... I want to pay." Then you gently pushed the book forward, and at that moment, Tenna walked over to your side. The manager looked at Tenna, instinctively trembling, but Tenna just took out a paper with the count and threw it on the table: "Using dark coins won't work. Alright, I'm paying. Let's go." Saying that, he picked up the two books, grabbed your wrist, and hurried out.
You were a bit dazed, but Tenna tightly held your hand as you walked out. He grabbed it so hard it hurt, and you tried to pull your hand away, trying to defend yourself: "Um...... I can walk fast on my own, you don't need to hold onto me! ”
Tenna didn't let go of your hand; he just glanced over at you, then slowed his pace a little. He belatedly realized that compared to him, you were so thin and small, so naturally you couldn't walk fast.

title: Luxury Desire 6 (dntx you)
content:
You don't understand why his steps have slowed a bit, but he's still holding your hand tightly. You know your hand hurts, and it's definitely a bit bruised from being pinched. But now, you don't have to run out of breath to keep up with his pace. You're just following behind him, moving a bit faster, so you can keep up with his pace.
So you can only watch his back, because no matter what, you can't surpass Tenna to get ahead, and you wouldn't dare to do it. But as you watch his back, thinking about him slowing down a bit, you can't help but think, maybe...... Maybe you can tell him, maybe he really will...... What you have to say?
So you timidly spoke up: "Um...... Tenna, it hurts, my hand ...... It hurts...... As you spoke, your voice grew quieter and quieter, and the little courage you had painstakingly built up faded away. Oh my god...... Oh my god, you have no idea where you got the nerve to speak like that.
“…… Very delicate. "You only heard such a cold remark, and instinctively lowered your head, a wave of bitterness rising in your heart. You knew it, you knew it...... He would definitely be upset hearing you say that, but you did feel the pressure in his hand soften, probably...... At least it didn't seem like he was tightening your grip, as if he was about to break your hand.
Tenna was just thinking that maybe she had been a bit too strong just now. After all, seeing you run off to pay on your own made him a bit unhappy. But...... He hadn't expected you to be so unbearable in pain as well. But fine, since you're his wife now, of course he'll be understanding. Since you say it hurts, he'll loosen up a bit. He doesn't want his wife to be too sad.
But after that, none of you spoke. Tenna felt a bit irritated—why is it so quiet, and he can't see you? You can't only respond when he speaks, right? Why is it so hard to hear your voice?
He suddenly stopped in his tracks, wanting to say something, but after hesitating for a long time, you finally managed to squeeze out one sentence—you mustered up all your courage to speak. Oh my god, you don't even know how long you were just overthinking before you finally agreed to speak.
"Um...... Tenna, what do you like to eat? I ...... I thought, as a thank you, I'd like to have something to eat...... "The more you spoke, the quieter your voice became, because you noticed Tenna's steps had stopped. Instinctively, you wondered if he was upset because of your suggestion, and you looked up at him uneasily...... But Tenna didn't pay attention to you, but at that moment, a smile appeared on his screen—the standard smile of showing his teeth. You couldn't tell how he was really feeling, but you knew that at least he seemed to be in a good mood right now.
"I don't need a thank-you gift or anything. But I do like pudding." You rarely heard Tenna soften his tone a bit, speaking to you in a normal manner. Although you were a bit discouraged by his first sentence, you cheered up because of the latter half...... You gently held Tenna's hand and carefully held his hand. This time, he didn't leave; instead, you took the initiative to walk ahead. Think about it, since he said he likes pudding, why not take him to the dessert shop—
"Then...... Then, let's go to that dessert shop not far away. Perfect...... Perfect, Tenna, are you hungry? I think it's about time...... Your voice was a bit stammering, and you didn't dare look back at Tenna. You were thinking, oh my god, how could you be so bold, how could you ...... Suddenly having such courage, you're walking down the street with a lord, and you're even ahead of him...... Oh my god, how dare you do something like that?
Tenna didn't say much. He was a little happy, and the corners of his mouth lifted a little. Although he could only watch your back and couldn't look you in the eye, he was still somewhat dissatisfied, but...... But as long as he could look at you openly, he felt happy. After all, right now, in his eyes, there was only you.
After a little while, you arrived at the dessert shop and stood at the entrance. You actually became timid again, just lowered your head and cautiously said, "Um...... Um, how about you go in first...... "I-I don't know where you like to be ......," you cautiously took two steps back, letting Tenna stand in front. Tenna turned off her screen, just tugged your wrist, then sat down in a corner seat. Of course, you were inside, he was outside. The spot he sat in just enough to block the outside gaze directed at you, and besides, he was sitting here, so no one dared to look at him.
You staggered a bit from his tug, and when you sat down, you were still a bit dazed, just staring blankly at Tenna. Tenna pushed the menu on the table toward you: "Why are you looking at me? My screen doesn't show the menu." Of course, if you want to keep staring at me, that's fine...... "As long as you want." His tone was calm, just gently tapping the table with his knuckles. You hurriedly grabbed the menu, not daring to say anything more to Tenna...... You instinctively wanted to apologize, but instinctively swallowed your words. At this moment, you just look at the menu, swallow hard, and want to eat all the desserts listed on it, but worry you won't be able to eat it all......
Tenna just tapped the table lightly with her knuckles, looked at you, turned off his screen, and just stared at you. Your focused gaze was beautiful too—if it were on him, it would be even better...... Of course, this was fine now—he could quietly watch you for a while. But that silence was quickly broken. Although the lord was still sitting here, you were here to eat. The waiter nervously walked toward you, probably seeing you looking at the menu, then started asking about your order. You looked up and instinctively smiled, then started chatting with the waiter. I don't know what you said, but you smiled even brighter, and the waiter laughed too. Tenna found the smile on your faces a bit glaring. He kept a blank expression, but the tip of his nose still sprouted with venus flytraps. You noticed this out of the corner of your eye, hurriedly finished ordering, then turned back to look at Tenna, but soon after, he lowered his head again. His expression was so cold that you really didn't dare look at him.
Tenna felt even more annoyed. His knuckles tapped irritably on the table a few times, and then you heard his cold voice: "Lift your head, always looking down, so pathetic. What kind of behavior do you look like?" Who would think you're my wife when you go out like this? "As he said this, you had no choice but to look up at his screen. At some point, the venus flytrap disappeared again. Staring at that cold screen, you still didn't dare look him in the eye, just darting your eyes around. Finally, as if you'd seen something beautiful, you stared blankly at the flowers on the table next door.
…… He doesn't know why you just refuse to look at him, but it seems you seem to like flowers a bit. Since that's the case, I'll bring you some flowers later—maybe you'll be a little happier...... Of course, he feels you've always been a bit unhappy, but he doesn't understand what exactly makes you unhappy. Isn't being his wife something to be happy about? He's willing to give up time to be with you—isn't that something to be happy about? He doesn't know what you still feel unsatisfied with. But at that moment, desserts were served. Besides the sweet ones, there were also some with bitterness, sourness, and saltiness. Tenna wasn't a big fan of those, so she just pushed the desserts toward you, then stuffed a spoon into your hand and said succinctly, "Eat." Her tone carried a hint of command, sounding cold and heartless.
Your body shrank slightly, your hands trembling involuntarily, but there were indeed some of your favorite desserts...... You quietly glanced up at Tenna and saw him holding that small spoon to scoop pudding. The screen showed a rare yet gentle smile, probably quite happy...... Only then did you relax and eat the dessert in front of you. Of course, your appetite was small, so after only two you couldn't finish it, only staring longingly at the table of pastries.
"I...... I can't eat anymore, but, I...... Want to try the taste, okay? S-Don't worry, if you can't finish it and pack it back, I'll finish it...... You put your hands together and muster your courage to speak, while Tenna just glanced at you in confusion.
"If you want to eat, just eat it. No need to tell me. It's your own business." He said as he casually dug into the dessert in front of him. Of course, for him, finishing a small piece of pastry was just a matter of one bite. You mumbled a soft 'Oh', carefully scraped off a small piece of the remaining pastry with a spoon and stuffed it into your mouth, then squinted your eyes slightly and showed that blissful smile. Tenna propped his chin up and looked at you, thinking about what was coming next...... Maybe he could take you to every dessert shop more often. He actually loved seeing you smile like that.
Of course, after each small bite, you obediently rested your hands on your knees, not daring to move, just blinking and looking up at Tenna, then quickly lowering her head. Tenna took a small bite of the dessert you had eaten and then poured it into her own mouth.

title: Lavish Desire 7 (dntx you) (18+)
content:

But just as you were about to leave with your tray, Tenna called out to you: "Wait, what are you planning to do?" ”
Your shoulder trembled. You didn't know why Tenna suddenly asked you this question, but you still answered honestly, "Ah, I want to...... Go clean up these dishes. ”

You heard his slightly impatient voice, and then your body instinctively trembled: "Are you stupid? There's a dishwasher right here, you don't need to wash them." ”

"I'm sorry, Mr. Tenna, but I don't know how to be a tour guide at all. I suggest you go find someone else instead." You politely refused again, and then you stopped caring about him. You kept reminding yourself that the only person you should care about is yourself—what does that have to do with you? Even though you can't help but inquire about the TV world, what does that world really have to do with you? You force yourself not to think, not to care, not to recall everything there. You just unconsciously walk toward a nearby bookstore, and just a short while further is the shopping street. It's normal for a bookstore to be here.
Tenna didn't say anything more. He knew he was talking to you, and from now on, he probably wouldn't get a response from you either. He just quietly followed you beside you, watching you walk into the bookstore, so Tenna followed you in—the bookshelf wasn't that tall, but even if you stood on tiptoe, it was hard to reach the book on the top shelf. You bounced in place a couple of times, barely reaching the edge of the shelf. Just as you were about to grab a ladder nearby, a hand reached out and handed you the book you had been trying to take. You glanced over—it was Tenna. He silently maintained the posture of handing you the book, ignoring the hand reaching in front of you, just went straight to the ladder, climbed up, and took another book down.
Every bookshelf that followed looked like this...... You ignored Tenna, as if he didn't exist at all, just grabbed the books you wanted, went to check out on your own, and paid with your own dark coins.
Tenna lowered her head to look at the handful of books in her hand, and in the end, she just stuffed them back onto the shelf. He ...... He didn't understand. Clearly, this was more convenient, so why didn't you take the books in his hands, but instead went out to carry a ladder? Why did you pretend not to see him? He was very unwilling, but as you hurried out of the bookstore, he still followed behind you, and then walked side by side with you again. You were naturally tired carrying so many books, and Tenna simply reached out his hand to you, though his voice was still dry.
"These books are too heavy. Take them for me." He said this, which was only natural for him—the husband should be helping his wife carry things, but they were no longer husband and wife.
You just glanced at Tenna in surprise. You really didn't know why he came to the cyber world to find you, but you didn't mind—after all, it was his own business and had nothing to do with you. You just forced a smile and shook your head: "Thank you for your kindness, Mr. Tenna, but these books are mine. I have no reason to give them to an outsider." You deliberately emphasized the words "outsider," but Tenna acted as if she hadn't heard him, just persistently reaching out her hand toward you.
"Not an outsider. No matter what...... We all, at least have some connection. "He doesn't know how to refute you; he's never managed such a relationship, and he has no concept at all. Of course, he doesn't know...... Now that you're saying this, you're putting him in a position where even a friend can't be made. Indeed, you just want to stay as far away from him as possible...... You don't care what you two have left now.

title: Luxury Desire 18 (dntx you)

But what you want to say might be the place you used to live together, that home, so you just replied without looking back. He probably knows what you meant by that...... It's just, just, he ...... Tenna didn't want to take it as what he thought he meant, so he deliberately followed your lead. He didn't know if he was trying to fight for an impossible possibility, or if he simply wanted to say a few more words to you.
"Hmm, so that means you're not going back to your place...... Will you come back to my place?" His voice was very soft. In fact, Tenna hadn't really wanted to say this out loud, but he was desperately hoping to get an answer from you, desperately hoping for some hope.

You were just casually scooping dessert into your mouth with a spoon...... Honestly, you didn't even know what you were daydreaming about—probably just daydreaming. Of course, you didn't notice Tenna swapping the half-eaten pudding in front of you with your tiramisu, just instinctively digging it in, only realizing something was off when you tasted it.
Tenna ate the tiramisu, frowning slightly. It was somewhat bitter and not very pleasant to him...... But sneaking around like this did taste your saliva, and the taste made him feel a bit sweet...... Well, maybe it was just his imagination, but Tenna really wanted to get to know you.
You looked at the pudding frowning, then at Tenna, who was eating tiramisu with a tense face...... As if nothing had ever happened. You just ordered another serving of tiramisu and started eating on your own, naturally not noticing the expression on the screen stiffening for a moment.
He was getting a bit annoyed again—did he really not want to have any connection with him? Was he just—rejecting him? Even if it was happening right in front of you, would you still pretend not to see it?
Well, he didn't know either, and Tenna knew too—he had no reason to be angry now...... He took another bite expressionlessly, now only the bitter taste lingered in his mouth—a feeling of heartbeat, he knew very well. He was just...... Unwilling, very unwilling.
After you finished eating, you wiped your mouth and paid the bill, ignoring Tenna and just picking up the bag of books he had just placed on the chair and heading out. Tenna also took out some dark coins and paid the bill—in his world, he always used points, and now, he just followed behind you, reaching out to hold yours—or just picking up the books, but you changed your posture. Now you were walking down the street carrying the books. Although the books were heavy, you thought it was okay, and holding them felt okay. And after walking a bit further, you would be at your doorstep. You stop at your own doorstep, take out your keys, open the door, turn to glance at Tenna, and nod politely: "Alright, Mr. Tenna, thank you. I'm home now, you don't need to follow me." With that, you slammed the door shut, and Tenna could only hear a rumbling sound. He stood helplessly at your door, then simply turned off the screen and walked away.
You put the book on the bookshelf at home, then carefully opened it at the door and looked around. After confirming that Tenna, that big guy, was gone, did you finally happily walk out the door. This time, your destination was the commercial street—and you had no idea that Tenna was quietly leaning against the wall watching you, ...... Well, or rather, he was following and spying on you.
You just happily walked into one of the clothing stores. Previously, in the TV world, you didn't have many clothes to change into, but now you need to buy many outfits. You first picked a loose sand-colored trench coat. Nothing special, just so loose that even your hands were covered by the sleeves. It might not look great, but it was very comfortable to wear, so naturally, you bought it.
Then you set your sights on a blue-and-white dress—blue as the centerpiece, white as the accent, forming the pattern of roses on top and the white pleats. Tenna watched you happily spinning around in place wearing the dress, instinctively swallowing hard...... Oh my god, oh my god, you're so beautiful, he almost wanted to gouge out the eyes of Addison, the clerk who was staring at you the whole time! That was clearly something he could see...... If only he had bought you more clothes back then, Tenna couldn't help but feel a bit annoyed.
He just watched you walk back into the fitting room with the clothes, this time wearing a jacket with a cape...... In short, it was very beautiful—all black but accented with red and yellow, as if reborn from the ashes. Of course, it was a tight suit. You frowned, looking like you didn't like it, so that Addison quickly brought you another set, hmm...... Also a black cape, but this time a loose jacket, lined with a loose white shirt accented with blue and purple gemstones, the cloak also adorned with gemstones, and of course, a gold chain as decoration. You probably still really liked this outfit, so you packed it up too.
Tenna, on the other hand, stared at you intently—well, he didn't have eyes, he just kept watching you, wanting to see you wear the clothes he designed, or maybe just clothes he bought...... He could just throw Mike to design them, and he could design a matching outfit for him. But right now, I'm afraid that's not possible.
And you just picked out another outfit again, not knowing what Addison said to you, but you laughed happily, while Tenna felt so jealous she was going crazy—because he saw it, he saw it, the dress you wore when you walked out of the fitting room was clearly a pure white wedding dress. He ...... Oh my god! Why did you wear a wedding dress? Are you planning to marry someone else and become someone else's wife? That was something he would never allow that. But you looked so beautiful in your wedding dress...... At that moment, Tenna belatedly realized that although they had exchanged rings at the time, they actually didn't have a formal wedding...... He had never seen you in a wedding dress. He suddenly realized...... He once had many things he could have gained but lost, just like he is now. He desperately wants to stand with you, desperately wants to declare you his wife, but...... But he really has nothing to do with you anymore.
And when you're in the shop, it always feels as if a burning gaze is always focused on you, making you a bit uneasy, but when you turn your head to look, you see nothing.

title: Luxury Desire 19 (dntx you)
content:

And you just changed into other clothes by yourself, completely unaware of what Tenna had done after leaving. He didn't go to find the Queen as he had planned; he simply returned to the TV world. He was unwilling to accept it...... He didn't know why you treated him like that now. He only felt that his mechanical heart seemed to have stopped beating, only emptiness. In his heart, there was one missing person—you.

Every night, he has to wait a long time before falling asleep, and the next day, he is always filled with anger. That anger only fades a little when he looks at you, but you don't want to look at him anymore, while Tenna can only follow behind you, firmly behind you—of course, it's always on weekends.
