You sighed and took the initiative to say, "Alright, I'm hungry. Let's go have breakfast first." ”
He nodded.
So you sat at the dining table, enjoying your meal as usual, spending the morning as usual, while you sat on the sofa reading a book. The only thing that struck me was that Tenna hadn't gone out today.
Or maybe you took a whole week off? You didn't think much about it, just complained a bit before heading out in the afternoon: "I feel so sleepy today...... I don't want to go out anymore. Can I just go back and sleep?" ”
Tenna shook her head decisively: "No, if you take too much time for a nap at noon, you won't be able to sleep at night...... Well, and you have to go out for a walk somehow...... He seemed to be muttering something under his breath.
You blinked, curious about what he was talking about, but you didn't try to probe, just pretended to sigh deeply: "Ah, well, I knew you'd say that...... Besides, I knew you must be hiding something from me. Sigh, you're really disheartened...... And you even pretended to be disappointed and wiped your eyes, but you weren't crying at all.
"No...... Of course not! Everything I do is based on you, as long as you're doing well. I'm definitely not hiding anything from you! "Tenna explained flusteredly, quickly waving in front of you.
And you just blinked and calmly asked, "Are you really not hiding anything from me?" ”
…… Tenna fell silent and didn't wave his hand anymore. He was stammering, clearly having something he couldn't say.
You didn't press further, just shrugged. Alright, if you want to keep it from you, then let it be. It's really nothing.
But you still added, "Actually, it's okay to hide something from me, or to lie. As long as you say it, I'll believe it, okay?" Anyway, don't always look like that—smile more. ”
You wrapped your arms around his arms with both hands, gently rocking them, and Tenna hesitated for a moment before nodding.
"Alright...... Anyway, one day I'll tell you. "He seems to have made up his mind, and you actually don't really care what he said about a certain day, or what he wants to tell you.
You just hugged his arm and walked around the TV world twice as usual, then went back and continued watching TV.
Today, the TV was broadcast with a different program. After all, after watching that previous film, you curled up on the sofa with the lights off, switched channels with the remote, and clicked on another movie. What did you think...... Mulholland? Honestly, you didn't quite understand this film, since the timeline was quite chaotic. Could it be some movie related to the butterfly effect? But this movie seems quite famous. Although you didn't fully understand it, you still watched it with great interest.
At dinner, the table served foie gras with pasta and pan-seared black pepper steak. After enjoying the meal and relaxing for a while, it was time to rest again.
You were about to pour the medicine into your mouth, but Tenna suddenly grabbed your hand: "Uh...... I wonder, shouldn't you have some water first? "He stammered a little.
You glanced at him in confusion: "Ah, is it still the same rule?" But I think it's probably okay not to follow the rules above......
Tenna hesitated for a long time, and you didn't continue your actions, just patiently waiting for him to speak.
"But I think following those rules is actually good for you."
"But isn't it a bad thing to not follow the rules?" You smiled like that, but still took a sip of water to soothe your throat before swallowing the pill.
Tenna returned to her silence, just watching your movements and insisted once more: "Actually, I think it's better not to break those rules......"
After taking your medicine, you're ready to go to bed, but when you hear this, you still glance at Tenna and tilt your head slightly: "Mm...... Really? By the way, why are you so insistent that I have to follow those rules? ”
“…… Because I think doing that would be safer. In short, these rules can help you avoid danger, right?" As he spoke, his voice rose upward, probably as if he himself wasn't quite sure about it.
You frowned slightly. For some reason, whenever he talked about avoiding danger, you felt as if fragments of something flashed through your mind. But you couldn't really tell what exactly he remembered, since you had no memory of those memories at all.
But you still took a deep breath: "I don't think I'm safe if I don't do that...... But since that's what you're thinking, fine! I'll still try hard to follow the rules!" Saying this, you lie down on the bed, blinking at Tenna with sparkling eyes, waiting for him to read you a bedtime story just like yesterday.
Tenna had no choice but to pull another book from the shelf and read it to you—this time a book called 'Narrow Gate.' Honestly, although the ending is sad, you still quite like the book...... After all, before that, it was purely a love story, but because of personal views, it ended sadly.
Perhaps, as the book says, when corresponding, what you long for is the unknown figure on the other end of the letter, the person you truly recognize, the person you think you fully understand and fully understand, and thus the love deepens. But when you actually meet, you suddenly choke up, not knowing how to begin, and face someone both strange and familiar, falling into a state of melancholy, which can suddenly calm that unfamiliar yet passionate love.
In short, as you keep daydreaming, you fall asleep and suddenly wake up in the pitch-black middle of the night. You can still see the dark shadows outside, and naturally sense Tenna lying beside you, as if she too is in a deep sleep, while you suddenly sit up in bed, not knowing the reason or explanation, only a fleeting flash of panic and inexplicable ...... Anger?
What are you angry about? You don't know. After hesitating for a moment, you put on your clothes, your heart pounding, and only you can hear your heartbeat—almost drowning out the rest—but you can still catch your own soft footsteps. Anyway, you open the door, finally turn around to glance at the bedroom, glance at Tenna lying there, swallow hard, and still close the door and leave.
As for where exactly to go? You don't know either. Maybe it's a strange opportunity, since normally you don't wake up in the middle of the night, but now you've decided to explore what happens if you break the first rule.
Honestly, Tenna didn't even know what he was thinking at the time...... In short, his first feeling was definitely lingering fear, so much so that he wanted to hold you tightly and not let go, but he was also afraid that holding too tightly would hurt you, or even more seriously, it could be suffocating, and in the end, he didn't dare hold too tight.
But he was indeed confirming your presence, touching you gently, feeling you. Tenna was certain you were still standing here safely, now in his arms. The nightmare from last night and the fear just now were just his illusions—despair, the accumulation of panic, just an illusion of fear at that moment. So all of that dissipated like a wisp of smoke, and now, once again, he was firmly and genuinely realizing the reality he was in—the reality you still existed in.
Even though it was just forced smiles, Tenna could still feel that panic and nervousness dissipate after catching you, replaced by a sense of relief. So, during mealtime, he couldn't help but keep staring at you, afraid that if he suddenly lost sight of you, he would face danger again. Maybe he was just overthinking it, just overly nervous? Maybe that's just how it is—in any case, Tenna would never allow danger to happen near you.
Even in the kitchen, with the sound of running water making it impossible to hear your footsteps or the very faint sound of you flipping a book, he still quietly lowered the water flow and straightened the antenna to try hard to capture your sound and feel your presence. So he could still hear your footsteps clearly—your footsteps, the movement of you sitting on the sofa, the way you took a book off the sofa and then started turning pages. He could even imagine what the scene would look like from these sounds.
In short, only when she truly feels that you are always by his side will Tenna breathe a little easier. Even so, he speeds up the dishwashing, and once it's all over, he steps out of the kitchen and immediately spots you.
Only then would he feel content—at least it proved that this perfect family is still perfect today.
He also sat on the sofa, quietly watching your movements, then stared blankly at your profile. The antenna hung down, and he didn't know what he was thinking—or maybe he wasn't thinking at all.
And when you see Tenna, you smile and grab his hand—in other words, you put your hand into his palm, continuing to read, just picking out some clips you like and reading them to Tenna.
But to be honest, Tenna didn't listen carefully. He just stared intently at your opening and closing mouth, not knowing what you were thinking. No matter what, in the end, all those words seemed like fleeting smoke.
In the end, you stopped and glanced at Tenna suspiciously: "Did you hear that?" ”
But before you could finish your next question, Tenna was the first to feel an impulse. In short, he gently kissed your lips, probably to silence you, or maybe just wanted to taste that softness in that moment.
But as soon as they touched and they broke up, Tenna finally felt embarrassed at first, because he knew he was interrupting his reading, so he pretended nothing had happened and cleared his throat twice.
"Nothing happened just now. Just keep reading your book."
You glanced at Tenna quietly, but didn't say much, just subconsciously touched your lips. Maybe you didn't even notice a blush floating on your cheeks. In any case, you quickly lowered your head and continued reading. After that, there was silence, no more voices spoken, but you still held his hand. In any case, Tenna felt a trace of comfort in it.
Then came the noon and afternoon walks and TV time. Tenna was happy to play the show for you, and the pace was pretty fast—the movie was finished before nine, so he got the chance to watch you walk into the room before nine, but then felt a bit disappointed—after all, it meant the brief entertainment time had passed.
But he quickly perked up, though he always panicked when you pressed him. Fortunately, you didn't keep pressing, and he breathed a sigh of relief but was also anxious—what if one day you expose these lies yourself?
Moreover, he feels a bit guilty toward you. Tenna really doesn't know if it's better to choose to hide it because of this, even though his original intention was to hope you would trust and follow all this.
But what kind of consequences would this kind of self-concealment have if you found out? Tenna didn't dare to imagine for now.
In any case, he couldn't resist your gaze and still pulled a book from the shelf to read aloud to you. He remembered this book too, one you really liked. Although he didn't know why you liked it, the people who once loved each other, who once had feelings for each other, gave up love because of their insistence on the gods and words, even self-doubt, erasing the existence of love.
If he were to make the choice, he clearly loved him, unquestionably in love, so why doubt himself? He just needed to express all his feelings, let another being understand and know his love, and naturally, there would be no self-doubt or even the process of erasing such love.
…… Just as he has always loved you, he sincerely does these things for you, hoping you can find happiness without knowing all this. For him, this may be the most sincere wish, and also the most eager desire.
Tenna heard your breathing from deep sleep, put the book back on the shelf, then quietly opened the covers to keep you from the chill, and crawled in to hold you as you fell asleep.
The dark sleep was probably more peaceful. Tenna now felt no fear surrounding him, and you were nestled in his arms. In short, he hadn't dreamed anything; it was just that suddenly in the middle of the night he woke up startled. Seeing the same darkness, Tenna realized this was roughly the same time he had woken up before to get the capsule ball ready—and his arms were empty, and you didn't know when they might disappear.
An indescribable sense of panic swept over him again. Tenna hurriedly got up, crawled out of bed, opened the bedroom door, and ran out. He didn't know whether he was afraid something would happen to you in such a dark night, or afraid that something might happen because of it. He didn't know if he could find you in this direction. After losing your trace, he was at a loss, not even knowing where to see you again.
Tenna first went to the stage to take a look, but it was completely empty; He comforted himself that maybe he had just walked the corridor twice, but when he ran over to look, it was still empty. This made the panic in his heart grow even more intense, even burning his heart. He looked forward from the backstage and passed the empty music stage, the cooking show seats long empty, and the inexplicable cage space—every step forward made his heart sink and grow more restless. He always felt like he might discover something he least wanted you to see.
In short, when he reached the very last spot, the heart that had been hanging and swaying was now completely dead. Tenna even looked at your back in despair, staring blankly at the pile of capsule toy shells—especially the one at the front, covered with a soft mat, with your name written on it.
Tenna didn't even dare make a sound; he even thought about going back and pretending nothing had happened, falling asleep with a nervous heart—but unfortunately, you still heard his footsteps.
So you turn to look at Tenna, point at the capsule shell, and raise your voice slightly: "So, this is for me?" ”
Tbc.

title: "Perfect Family" 5
content:
Tennax you, OOC counts me as me
This post feels like a bit of a chronological account, but I actually quite like it. The story is so long, it's all because I've been watching the group demons lately......
——
Tenna instinctively let out a couple of awkward laughs, wanting to put his hands behind his back. After all, it seemed like cold sweat was forming in his palms. Maybe even if he took them out, he'd just nervously rub them. But after a while, he still pressed his palms together to his mouth, probably thinking about how to explain everything to you.
And you just wait patiently, since you're not in a hurry at all. You're not very tired or want to go back to sleep; in fact, you're excited. You think, maybe it's okay to just wait here until dawn. You have plenty of patience, and of course, you still have time.
In the end, you still hear Tenna stammer and speak: "Oh...... But darling, don't you think the environment inside the capsule toy shell is nice? ”
Alright, the moment he said it, he regretted it. He really shouldn't have said that. What exactly was he saying!
You couldn't help but laugh, probably amused by his frantic excuse and finally coming up with a clumsy excuse: "Hmm, I have to admit, the environment here is pretty good...... But I definitely wouldn't like it, because this place is too cramped. It's way too lonely, and there's no freedom or personal rights left. If I were to live in a place like this, I'd rather end my life—in any case, I probably won't have any desire to survive anymore." ”
As you spoke, you shrugged and patiently explained to Tenna. After all, you were worried he wouldn't understand, and if he really lost his mind and tried to do something, it would be a disaster if he had to figure something out. After all, you didn't want to see this guy end up in a state where no one believed anything others said—that would be a real problem.
Tenna opened his mouth and stammered. Now he understood why everything was rewound when he locked you in the capsule shell before—it turned out it was because you no longer had the will to survive. So, how exactly is this so-called death rewind mechanism determined? Tenna didn't understand either.
"Uh...... So, darling, should we go back and get some sleep first, and deal with this when we wake up? ”
You shake your head, relaxed, and cross your arms: "I'm not sleepy yet, and if I have some lingering questions, I won't rest well either." So why don't you just tell me the answer, or the truth? Hmm...... I actually know you're hiding something from me. I don't really care. I originally thought you would be willing to tell me one day. ”
You sighed, "But I probably can't wait any longer now, since I've already seen this." "As you spoke, you pointed at the capsule shell.
"—So, you better tell me the truth. Of course, no matter what you say, I'll believe you. Hmm...... I won't blame you, so what exactly is it? "After saying that, you quietly look up at Tenna, waiting for his answer.
Tenna fell completely silent. The antenna drooped, and the power cord behind her stopped shaking but fell to the ground. Dark tears streamed down the screen.
You were silent for a moment, your gaze gradually lowering until you finally looked down at the ground, as you saw Tenna shrink until standing on the ground and only a tiny lump remained.
So you have no choice but to crouch down and look at your boyfriend who has suddenly shrunk for no reason, softly saying, "Are you feeling sad?" Or you can choose not to tell me yet...... It's okay for me to guess a little longer for a while, since our relationship is still the same as before. ”
You've softened your heart. Seeing him like this, you really think it's okay not to press further. After all, you still want to see the person you love happy every day, just to be happy. As for everything else, you can't worry about it and can solve the problem slowly later.
Anyway, problems can always be solved.
Tenna's voice now was tinged with sobs: "Oh...... But since you're asking like that, I have no choice but to tell you......
You were silent for a moment, then raised your tiny tenna and looked you in the eye. You lowered your voice, softened your tone: "Mm...... Alright! Then just tell me. Anyway, I respect your decision. Do whatever you want. If there's a problem, we have to solve it together, right? ”
As you spoke, you reached out and pressed the head of the shrunken TV. Well, you could rub it around as you like, so while daydreaming, you pressed the antenna several times.
"Well then...... I think, first of all, darling, you have to make sure you believe what I say. "The crying and sobs have quieted down a lot. Tenna's emotions seem to have calmed down, but he's still a small one. Maybe he's afraid that if he grows bigger, he'll suddenly crush you."
And you still look him in the eye, repeating once more, emphasizing: "Well, I know, I said it too, no matter what you say, I will believe it, I believe everything you say." ”
He seemed to have finally stopped sobbing, and maybe he'll continue this process later—you don't know.
Tenna stared at your serious expression for a while. To be honest, he was a bit hesitant. He didn't know if laying everything out was good or bad, but now that he had chosen to tell you everything, he had no other choice.
So after hesitating for a while, he finally spoke: "...... So, darling, what if I told you that when you run into danger, my time will turn back? I can only prevent you from getting into danger. I'm really scared. What if you slip out of my sight and something unexpected happens? What if I can't always protect you......"
You raised your eyebrows. Honestly, at first, when he said this, you really didn't want to believe it, but since you had already promised to believe him, you still took it all seriously. Since that's the case, the capsule shell over there has room to explain.
So you nodded: "So that's why you prepared that capsule shell for you?" ”
Tenna's voice was a bit stammered: "Yes...... Yes. I think if you had stayed there all the time, maybe you wouldn't have encountered danger. ”
And you calmly explained, "It's that there's no more danger from outside, so at this moment, I am the greatest danger. I wouldn't want to live in a place like that. Even if it cost me death, I would leave it." ”
"Yes...... Yes, I understand that now. "Tenna's antenna drooped again, looking like he was about to sob again.
You pressed your forehead a bit troubled: "Alright, anyway, I'm still standing here perfectly fine right now. I haven't encountered any danger you mentioned, and nothing unexpected has happened to take me away from you. Even so, I will try my best to get back to you. Of course, I believe you will try your best to come to me, don't you?" Anyway, stop being so downcast. ”
He seemed to be still sobbing: "Oh...... Sweetheart......"
You patted his head again: "Anyway, don't be too nervous, don't be too anxious, don't age even faster. Of course, even if you age, I won't abandon you anymore...... But still, I hope you can stay well and always be fine." After saying that, you carefully placed him on the ground and only stood up after squatting down to make sure he was okay.
Just as you were about to walk back, Tenna suddenly grew huge and suddenly hugged you tightly.
His voice still carried a hint of tears, but now it carried a hint of joy and happiness, as if he was floating in bliss: "Oh, sweetheart! I really like you...... I love you so much...... Anyway, I really like all the things you say......" He seemed a bit incoherent.
And you just couldn't bear it anymore, nudging his tightly embraced arm: "Yeah, yeah, I know I love you too, so...... Let go first...... You're holding me too tight! I'm struggling to breathe! "You screamed out loud in the last two sentences.
Only then did Tenna react, hurriedly let go of you, then pressed your shoulder, anxiously sizing you up and down: "Oh, no, are you okay?" "She looked her up while nervously gesturing with her hand."
"Phew, of course I'm fine, and I didn't trigger any time rewind just now...... Anyway, let's go rest first and study this tomorrow, okay?" You rubbed your brows, then grabbed Tenna's hand and led him back. Of course, rather than holding hands, it was more about putting your hand in his palm, and Tenna happily held your hand as we walked back.
Now, you've returned to your room again. You lie on the bed and have been feeling sleepy for a while. Honestly, getting up in the middle of the night is a bit of a stretch. In short, you don't actually feel much sleepy right now, so you regret having a sudden outburst earlier. If it weren't for that, your drowsiness would have been even more obvious.
Tenna shrank to about the same size, then hugged you tightly. Luckily, this time you didn't feel suffocated, only the warmth of your body remained.
You sighed, then turned around to face his screen, then patted his head: "Alright, I'm right here, I won't go anywhere else. Are you really that nervous?" ”
In the darkness, you barely managed to regain your sight, then you looked at Tenna and hesitated for a moment, nodding.
"So are you going to keep watching me and make sure I'm here? Don't you even need to rest? Oh my god." You couldn't help but laugh. But you didn't know exactly where his eyes were, so now trying to close his eyelids was actually a bit difficult.
…… Well, and you don't know if he's actually asleep, or if he'll keep staring at you and keep that posture.
So you just tapped his screen and gently kissed him: "Mm...... Alright then, if you want to maintain this state, I can't stop you, but you have to understand, you also need to relax and rest, okay? ”
"Of course I know, it's fine. I'm Tenna, so even if I stay on standby all night without rest, it's fine."
You patted your head: "Alright, then I guess you used to be on standby and never rested, just staring at me the whole time." Alright, alright...... Even if I pin you down on the bed, you wouldn't get a proper rest! ”
After saying that, you take a deep breath: "Alright, anyway, I can't sleep right now, so why don't we just talk about that question from earlier?" I think...... Is it really that simple? ”
You feel Tenna's body stiffening, his hand tightly gripping your shoulder, clearly not very happy for you to discuss this issue.
"Hmm, maybe on the surface, things really do seem simple...... Alright, anyway, you have to understand, I don't die just because I encounter a little danger, otherwise I wouldn't be alive until now. Of course, I don't always run into danger, and besides, isn't it because you're here? I believe you'll definitely find a way to eliminate those dangers, and of course, I'll be careful too. I don't want you to keep worrying about me. ”
As you spoke, you let out a slight breath, but you still couldn't read Tenna's expression, because he was still a pitch-black screen. His body seemed to tremble, as if he was struggling to endure some emotion.
You hesitated for a moment, then finally spoke: "Alright, so when I wake up, do you want to give it a try?" What you mentioned about rewinding—after all, I really have no memory at all. I'm afraid I won't be able to preserve that memory myself, so I'll have to rely on you. ”
“…… No, can we ...... Don't try? Really, dear, as long as we maintain the status quo, just follow the same steps as before. If there are any other problems, let me solve them all, okay? ”
"Do you still want to maintain a superficial perfection? Actually, so-called perfection has never been something that can last forever," you chuckled, "So, if there's a problem, solve it, because we both have responsibilities to each other. I can't just stand by and watch you fall into anxiety, panic, and unease, just as you can't just watch me get hurt and face danger. Our family doesn't rely solely on you to sustain, so when necessary, rely on me too." Trust me, maybe when we face problems together, problems can be easily solved." As you spoke, you took his hand, cupped it with both arms, and then placed them on your chest.
You solemnly said, "Whether it's love, passion, or simply responsibility and habits, in any case, I want to maintain our connection and hope this family can always survive." ”
“…… So, get some rest. No matter what, when I wake up the next day, I still hope to see a tenna who is forever happy and joyful. "You said softly.
He can easily feel the sound of your heart beating in your chest. That passionate heart may now be pounding passionately for him. His tears dripped from the screen again, soaking the pillow below, and his voice was choked: "Alright...... Alright, then I'll try tomorrow. Anyway, good night......"
You looked at him with satisfaction, smiled, and gently wiped the tears from his face with your hand: "Well then, good night. I hope you don't think about anything, don't be nervous or anxious, and at least for now, rest well." ”
Then you gently hugged him back, burying your head in his shoulder. Honestly, after saying so much, you were actually a bit sleepy yourself, so after a while you fell asleep, and all he could hear was your shallow breathing.
After a moment of silence, Tenna still held you tightly, then also fell into a pitch-black sleep.
By the next morning, still at a familiar time, you groggily woke up, hearing the sounds of cooking outside and the faint sound of running water. You knew Tenna was making breakfast for you. Probably because you woke up in the middle of last night, you were still a bit sleepy. In any case, you still wanted to rest a little longer, so you mumbled as you hugged the blanket and turned over, half-closing your eyes in a daze, planning to rest a little longer.
But after lying down for a while, you hear the noise outside quiet down, and after a few minutes, you feel a hand covering your eyes.
"Time to get up, my sweetheart." You heard Tenna's soft yet slightly excited voice.
"I haven't slept enough, I want to sleep a little longer......" you muttered and complained in a low voice.
Tenna seemed a bit troubled and didn't speak for a long while. You had no idea what he was doing, but you just rubbed your head against his palm, planning to sneak a little more sleep while you could.
But your little thoughts were interrupted by Tenna: "Alright, sweetheart, there's definitely enough time. You can't sleep anymore, you'll just get sleepier the more you sleep......" Saying this, he couldn't help but reach out and pat your head. Of course, his other hand still covered your eyes, but he mercilessly opened the curtains.
Now you can only enjoy the dazzling lights. Reluctantly, you get up, rub your eyes, and grumble as you change your clothes before leaving the bedroom, sitting at the dining table watching the steaming hot breakfast.
Today...... Well, besides the usual bread, jam, and bacon, there's also a small plate of koluli, probably baked in the morning—at least that's what you can guess.
You should just obediently finish the bread and sausage bacon before picking up a fork and taking a piece of it. Keluli popped it into her mouth, chewing while showing a delighted look and squinting her eyes slightly: "Hmm, delicious...... I didn't expect you to have time to prepare this. I thought you might actually be in the mood......
You see Tenna's fingers moving a few times on the table, probably nervous and a little spasm: "Of course, this was specially prepared for Sweetheart, though I really don't feel like it...... But after hearing what Sweetheart said, I couldn't help but feel overjoyed, so I thought, I must prepare this for you, just as a gift. ”
You thought for a moment, then put down your fork: "Actually, it's okay if you don't prepare anything. That's exactly what I wanted to tell you, after all, I've always loved you. So no matter what, it doesn't matter. No matter what you do, I still love you...... Well, if it's too much, then it's not counted. ”
You couldn't help but laugh as you spoke.
Tbc.

title: "Perfect Family" 6
content:
Tennax, you, OOC belongs to me
…… This YN photo seems a bit hellish......
"Look, my heart, my ribs, my spine, my skin, my flesh, everything of me—all belong to you, including my soul."
——
Tenna didn't say anything more, maybe because of your words, his heart was overjoyed. In any case, he didn't even know where to put his hands. It wasn't until a while that he finally regained his wandering thoughts and some reason. So he just watched your movements with a hint of nervousness, watching you finish the keluli on that small plate, then instinctively placed his hands on his knees, waiting for your next announcement.
You put down your fork and cleared your throat: "Alright, after breakfast...... Hmm, wait, let's wait a bit longer, at least after you finish washing the dishes, right? Let's wait until we all have free time before we experiment!" You said happily, clapping your hands.
For some reason, Tenna felt a sigh of relief, as if the time for sentencing was about to be postponed. But he knew it was only a delay; in fact, moments like punishment have always existed, so his mood remained heavy. He simply nodded, picked up the dishes, tidied up, and headed to the kitchen.
And although he kept praying time would slow down and give him a chance to think a bit longer, his thoughts were completely chaotic. No matter how unwilling, the remaining bowls were washed clean, leaving the sink empty.
He stared blankly at the gloves, at the dripping water droplets. It was just the usual ticking sound, yet it felt like the countdown of an hourglass, like a tolling death knell. In any case, in the end, Tenna carefully took off her gloves, dragged her somewhat heavy steps out of the kitchen, and immediately spotted you sitting on the sofa.
Tenna tugged at the corner of her mouth, almost forgetting how to speak, but in the end, she regained her voice, looked at you cautiously, and asked in a low voice, "So...... Darling, what do you plan to try? ”
You look at Tenna, think for a moment, then sit on the sofa and spread your arms toward Tenna, exposing your chest without any defense. You still wear a cheerful smile: "Hmm, actually I've already thought about this issue. I think if that's the case, a near-death experience is probably more convincing and lets people feel the truth. And if it's just a near-death experience, even without looking back, there is still a way to save it...... It's just that I still can't overcome the pain. I don't dare to do that, but I can entrust myself to you." ”
"Because I trust you, and I'm willing to ...... In short, I think you can definitely control the degree, and honestly, I'd rather die at your hands." You thought for a moment, then added with a smile. Of course, you knew how much impact this statement would have on Tenna, but after careful consideration, this was the only way you could come up with it.
But no matter what, these are your true words. You genuinely want Tenna to take control of your body, and you truly trust him, believing that no matter what, the immense pain will disappear just by seeing him.
Tenna was truly stunned, because he never imagined you'd come up with such a plan. Just thinking about you dying in front of him made his heart ache, wishing he could die with you, and watch you die by his hand, or do such cruel things yourself? No matter what, Tenna felt he absolutely couldn't do that.
So he stammered, instinctively retorting, "No, that's impossible. How could I possibly do something like that?" His voice even carried a sense of panic.
And you just quietly looked at him, sighed, then suddenly stood up and took his hand: "But...... I only feel that I would rather die by your hand. Alright, maybe that's not quite right. Maybe I'd be willing to die for you? "Saying this, you couldn't help but laugh out loud again.
Tenna just hurriedly interrupted you, even suddenly kneeling in front of you. In short, now you were looking at each other in eye contact: "No...... Don't say things like that, darling. We clearly promised to protect this family. How could you leave me...... ”
After saying this, his screen flickered for a while, probably with garbled text, then turned pitch black. You see dark tears flowing down the screen, as if the entire screen is dissolving away.
You blinked, trying to think for a moment: "...... Hmm, actually, if I died for you, then I would just be dying. It's not that I don't love you anymore. Maybe even if I become a ghost or ghost, I'll still come back to you. Alright, this kind of thing doesn't matter...... Maybe it's my wording. It looks like I scared you, even though I really think so. ”
You knelt before him, lifted your head, gently wiped away his tears with your hand, then took one of his hands and touched your own body.
You whispered, "Look, my heart, my ribs, my spine, my skin, my flesh, everything of mine—all belong to you, including my soul. So I want to leave everything to you to decide." As you spoke, you gently placed his hand on your face, then turned and softly kissed you.
“…… Well, actually, I just want to tell you that I'm willing to do anything for you, so of course trying death is fine too." You looked at Tenna without saying anything, but her tears fell even harder, quickly changing her words again.
"Alright, I'm not asking you to actually kill me yourself—I just hope you can help me do something I probably can't do because I lack courage. It's just that your presence gives me courage, nothing more." Take a deep breath, and you try your best to polish your words so they don't sound so terrifying.
Although Tenna's mood has improved a bit now, just thinking about your initial actions still makes him feel scared and sobs again. Honestly, this is the most terrifying thing for him so far. He can't bear losing you, can't tolerate time without you, not even for a moment.
So he just sobbed and said, "No, sweetheart, my dear, I'm actually willing to do anything for you. As long as you ask me, I will gladly fulfill it. I belong entirely to you, but this matter absolutely cannot be done, absolutely impossible." ”
Oh my god, do you want him to personally hurt you? Tenna found such a thing hard to imagine, or rather, it was something she wouldn't even dare to imagine. He just wants to carefully protect you, to help you avoid all crises, to see you happy forever. If the only crisis is brought upon you, how can he have the face to continue existing in front of you? Would he shamelessly ask you to live with him and keep this family alive?
In short, it's impossible, absolutely impossible.
You were silent for a moment, gently wiping the tears from his screen, and asked one last time: "Really not?" ”
You see Tenna's head suddenly shake violently, strongly rejecting your proposal, and in the end, you still stand up helplessly and gently say, "Alright, then I won't force you. I'll think of another way...... There will always be another solution. ”
You said this, but you hadn't really thought of any other solution. Before, you only wanted Tenna to leave a wound on your wrist. After all, you wouldn't dare try that move yourself, but you thought Tenna could probably do it, probably. But he couldn't do it either.
Actually, you can understand how he feels, just as you don't want to see him hurt either. You don't want to see his death, no matter who caused it. He should just stand there perfectly fine, always full of vitality. Of course, maybe only occasionally, he needs to rest well. Only in that moment, all it takes is a lasting embrace, and just a moment when our hearts are close is enough.
Although often this hug lasts all night.
You think, when you see his death, even if it's just a possibility, your heart breaks. You will absolutely stop that possibility from happening. You absolutely do not want to see him die.
…… Even if it means exchanging your own death for his survival, such a thing is possible. Of course, all of this now is just a vague thought in your mind. You are just lost in thought, thinking about this as you walk toward your room.
…… Then, you forget the threshold at your room's door, tripping over it, instinctively leaning forward, your eyes wide as you stare at the ground within reach.
Tenna saw this too. Without even bothering to gather his scattered emotions, he got up and ran toward you, instinctively wanting to hug you, at least to keep you from falling to the ground.
Maybe at that moment, a miracle happened, or maybe it was just a simple illusion. In any case, who knows what it was? All you felt was a dazed sensation in front of you, followed by a twisted sensation—a blank space. When you came to, you were at the door, lifting your foot, not yet stepping down, nor stepping on the doorframe.
You dazedly put down your foot, instinctively turning your head to meet Tenna's gaze, who was about to run toward you.
Tenna also understood that you seemed to have noticed something. Her anxious steps slowed down, just stammering her lips as she stood in front of you, facing your eczema without speaking.
You looked up at Tenna, took a deep breath, and asked, "Just now, was it the kind of time reversal you mentioned?" ”
Tenna nodded. There was no need to hesitate about this kind of thing. In fact, he was actually desperately hoping you would realize its importance.
You let out a soft moan. In fact, you still felt it was a bit absurd. Just moments ago, you were seriously thinking about how to experiment and verify it, but in such an absurd situation, you experienced the feeling of time rewinding, easily avoiding possible danger.
In the end, you still scratched your hair. To be honest, your thoughts were a bit messy now, just like your hair was still a bit messy. You simply took Tenna's hand and sat down together on the sofa, and Tenna followed your movements and sat down beside you.
“…… Ah, so now I can also experience the feeling of time rewinding. "You were still a bit dazed. After sitting down and looking at your hands, you didn't know what you were thinking.
Tenna nodded and added, "Besides, you never kept those memories during the previous backward period, but now you do......"
He was clearly still a bit worried, since Tenna wasn't sure if this should be considered a good thing. And why did he retain memories? What exactly was the principle behind it? Could it be that because you knew about the existence of time reversal, you could sense it all?
This way of thinking doesn't seem unreasonable, but Tenna always finds this matter a bit unbelievable. You just turn your head to look at Tenna, place your hand on his, and pat him with a hint of reassurance: "Alright, preserving memories isn't a bad thing. Maybe it's my eagerness to experiment and the truth that made me remember all of this myself. So it's understandable, and if you can't figure something out, don't dwell on it anymore. Maybe after some time, these problems will be solved, and you won't even need to think much more." You nodded as you spoke, confirming your own idea.
“…… Maybe that's what you mean, but dear, I'm just afraid you'll leave me because of it. "Tenna placed her other hand on yours, then tightly held yours, or rather, wrapped in his palm.
You didn't really mind that, just shrugged and gently patted his back with your other free hand: "It's okay, I've told you, even if I really die, I'll always love you. Even if I become a ghost, I'll come back to find you." So, there's no need to be afraid of this. However...... Actually, preserving memories does have its benefits. ”
You smiled and spoke, but then your screen turned pitch black again, tears streaming down your face. If you tried to catch it by speaking now, you'd surely catch many droplets, like the sadness spreading beside him, like the spreading silence and cold water, enough to make you drown.
You take a deep breath, lift your upper body, stand on tiptoe and kiss the tears on the screen, and softly say, "Alright, I won't say the word 'death' anymore. I will absolutely do my best to avoid the possibility of death, okay?" ”
You see Tenna suddenly nod.
So you chuckled softly and rested your head on his chest. Alright, you wanted to give him a hug, but your current posture was a bit awkward, making the hug feel strange. In short, you just buried yourself in his chest and muffled as you said, "Mm...... Look, it's good that I remember these memories from the time of rewinding. That way, I know I might encounter danger, and I can avoid future dangers that might be risky. So the existence of these memories is also very good. ”
"And actually, you know very well, right? It's just that those things won't let me die so easily! I'm not some fragile porcelain vase that needs your constant protection and care. I'm a person, perfectly intact, staying in your arms. See, I really exist. There's no way I could suddenly die or disappear, unless something happened that I couldn't avoid—ah, I hope the memories of time rewind at that time can help me escape this accident." You smiled, climbed onto Tenna's back, and then hugged him again. After all, at some point he let go of his hand—probably while you were whispering those words against his chest.
In fact, he can feel the breath you blow on his chest when you speak, and the slight tremor in your chest as you utter every word. In short, he couldn't help but let go. He was indeed listening attentively to your words, wanting to argue something, but he just stammered, waiting for you to finish.
Then he felt your hands wrapped around his neck, pressing your head against his TV. He couldn't see your expression clearly, just instinctively wrapped his arms around you and hugged you. Of course, Tenna was already trying hard to suppress his emotions, but some tears still fell and soaked your clothes.
You didn't really mind, just softly said, "So, you see, this is actually quite good. Don't worry so much anymore. Trust me, isn't it great to know in advance and avoid danger and such?" ”
He was still sobbing, his voice broken and broken: "But if you do this, you inevitably feel the panic and fear before time rewinds, those unavoidable moments of pain and fear, the despair at that moment......" He was somewhat incoherent.
And you just pat his head again: "Well, because of fear, you can further avoid the possibility of danger. Feeling panic and fear leaves a mark in your memory, so I remember it and pay attention next time. For example, in what happened just now, I will definitely pay attention to that threshold next time." ”
Tenna was silent for a moment, then muttered a complaint: "But your memory is terrible. Have you forgotten how many times you almost hit your head on the shelf?" ”
You coughed awkwardly and lightly: "Ahem! That's exactly why I need you to stay by my side all the time. Look, you've taken good care of me, and only you know what. That fear and despair must have built up in your heart, right? But for now, I'll help you share all of this." ”
“…… Anyway, trust me? ”
Tenna was silent, then you felt his head move and nodded.

content:

It should be ending soon. Anyway, this chapter is only 3k shorter than before. I wrote 3k for the word count (not really).
——
You let out a gentle breath, put on a smile again, and finally let go of him. Because this time you were kneeling on his lap, you could maintain a position of looking up at him.
You softly said, "Then let's settle it this way. Trust me, maybe this could actually be a miracle." Maybe this is already a miracle now, isn't it? This is our good fortune. ”
"Maybe...... But how can you guarantee that one day I won't lose you because of this? "You waited a while before hearing Tenna's muffled voice. Clearly, he had been struggling with this issue all along, but now much better than before, no longer so anxious.
You pretend to be deep and think carefully about this question, then say, "Well, actually I feel that words can no longer persuade you, and I can't prove anything with weak words, so let's see what I do!" I will still prove it to you! ”
You said this with conviction, yet you just stared at you like Tenna's pitch-black screen, never stopping. Maybe he was staring at you, maybe he was judging your words, but you didn't really care; you just wanted to say what you wanted to say.
Actually, Tenna had been thinking about what he should do since things were in this situation—should he let you stay outside and keep facing potential dangers, or let you stay in a place absolutely safe where he can see you at all times? He had to admit, the latter thought really tempted him, because now he wouldn't have to worry about not being able to follow you all the time.
After all, Tenna still needs to watch over you every moment to feel at ease.
So he hesitated for a moment, looked at your serious and serious expression, and still asked, "Then, dear, what if I still think you should stay somewhere absolutely safe?" ”
You raised your eyebrows, a suspicion forming in your mind, but you couldn't help but ask, "What place are you talking about?" ”
Tenna's screen was still pitch black. You couldn't see his expression clearly, nor did you know what he was thinking. In fact, you could say he was openly staring at you right now. You stared at his screen, and he was staring at you; neither of you knew what the other was thinking—no, maybe you already knew what the other was thinking and doing.
So you look at Tenna, who remains silent but still determined, and scratches your head in frustration: "Ah...... I know, you're just talking about the capsule shell, but I don't think locking me up would make it a completely safe place. But if that's what you think, I'd agree to give it a try. ”
"Well, but this time I did it voluntarily, so I can't possibly do anything suicidal...... Don't worry! "You smiled as you spoke, pressing your forehead against Tenna's screen.
His screen lit up again, and you could see a small flower even sprouting from his nose. Clearly, he was extremely excited right now.
"Oh, darling, you're serious, aren't you? Then let's go over now!" Tenna was truly excited. When he made this suggestion, he already felt it was absurd and had a premonition. You might even firmly reject him, since you really dislike that kind of place. But in the end, you still made your choice and willingly followed his ideas and suggestions.
To be honest, he even felt a bit flattered......
You stared in shock, eyes wide open. You hadn't expected Tenna to be so excited—he was even standing up right in his arms holding you! And he was taking big steps—he figured he'd be in a moment to reach the pile of gacha balls. You felt a bit of a headache and tapped Tenna's TV screen.
"So you're going to just use it as my commuter......?" You asked, a bit uncertain.
"Mm, of course, it's not impossible! That's a good suggestion, sweetheart. After all, if I let you down, you might face danger, so maybe not letting you leave my side is a better choice...... "Unexpectedly, Tenna didn't even need to think and gave this answer, and he was even quite pleased about it. Maybe your greater dependence might actually be a good remedy for him."
"Alright, so are you going to keep holding a capsule toy shell and go around with you?" You imagined that scene and couldn't help but burst out laughing, covering your mouth and laughing, gasping for breath. It was rare for you to be laughing so happily.
Tenna was stunned, her steps pausing for two seconds, muttering to herself, "I never thought about this at all......"
"Then you can think about it now...... In short, I think this is absolutely inappropriate! Maybe you could think of another way? "You suggested.
"Uh...... So maybe, when I can see you, I'll hold you together, and when I can't see you, I'll stay inside that capsule shell? His voice rose up, clearly not sure about the answer himself, or maybe he was just asking for your opinion. In fact, he was still a bit dazed. He never imagined you might agree to his request, but you did agree—and without hesitation.
"Hmm, so you're really busy right now, so busy you can't even see me before you plan to put me inside the capsule toy shell?" You asked with a smile. In fact, you know Tenna probably has nothing going on right now. If he hadn't gone out this morning, he'd have stayed by your side all day. That's almost an accepted fact for you, even though we've never spoken about it.
"No, uh, I'm not busy at all! I can be by your side all the time, but I always have busy moments, maybe tomorrow......" His voice stammered again, and his steps slowed, clearly hesitating about whether he should go.
"Hmm...... Alright, whatever you think is up to you. But since you don't have anything to do, could you put me down for now? Actually, as long as you can see me all the time, then it's okay if I don't stay inside that capsule shell, right? "As you spoke, you poked Tenna's shoulder, then tapped his screen, and asked with a hint of curiosity and confusion.
"Uh...... Alright, my dear sweetheart, but you have to make sure I can see you at all times. "Tenna was eventually convinced by you. Actually, after thinking it over, he realized that doing that wasn't realistic. After all, as long as he wasn't seeing you all the time, he felt uneasy, or even if we were apart, he would get irritated. Before, when he stood on stage, he would also be separated from you and feel irritated, but it was just because the lively atmosphere and music on stage kept covering up those restless thoughts.
But maybe it's just that you're just confused by you. Even though you didn't say anything, he would still respect your opinion. So Tenna easily listened to your opinion.
So he squatted down and laid you on the ground. Before he could stand up, you actually leaned in, first wrapped your arms around his neck, then gave him a hug. Although maintaining that hug posture would be a bit odd.
"Alright...... Then I'm going to give you a big hug. Well, whenever you need it, I'll always give you it. If possible, I want to give you a basket of hugs! ”
Tenna hesitated for a moment, then hugged you back, then lifted her head and kissed your forehead: "Then...... Then I'll give my sweetheart a kiss in return. As long as you need it, it will always be yours, and I'll give you a basket of kisses. ”
Although he didn't really know what that sentence meant—maybe it was just a scene from a movie you saw on TV before. But that restless, beating heart did feel much better.
At this moment, Tenna just wanted to maintain this quiet posture with you, yet you could hear two hearts beating. But obviously, this couldn't last long, because lunchtime was almost here!
For the next period, just as you agreed, Tenna didn't mention the capsule shell anymore. But he also felt uneasy when you disappeared from his sight. So now, your anxiety and restlessness have become his regular audience. Now, as long as he stands on stage, you have no choice but to sit in the audience. But his show is indeed interesting, at least for you. Maybe it's just your personal opinion.
After all, if you feel good watching him, watching everything he does feels good. So every time the show ends, you give him a warm round of applause. As long as Tenna sees you in the audience, eyes still sparkling as he watches him, following every move he makes, he feels very happy, even his heart swelling and feeling happy because of it. Although he was anxious about whether you might not like these things, seeing you look at him with such interest every time made Tenna stop thinking about those questions. He just thinks about doing something else to make you happier.
You don't really know what Tenna is thinking; all you know is that every day after coming back, his mood seems better than before, so you feel happy for him.
Until one day, you see three ...... No, one of them is the People of Darkness, so only two of the People of Light stand on stage, while you stay below watching Tenna host the show, watching from the beginning to the end until those three disappear into the capsule toy shells you know.
