title: "Perfect Family" 8 (end)
content:
Tennax, you, OOC is mine
This chapter has ended, and it's quite short, so in any case, the writing style might have changed a bit (maybe?) ) Also, the logic is probably a bit weak
Also, this YN really will sacrifice himself ()
——
Somehow, you always have a bad feeling. Of course, even in this situation, Tenna hasn't forgotten to call your name, so you still follow him in the end. You just keep quiet, wanting to know what exactly that ominous feeling in your heart is all about.
You followed Tenna past the front stage, seeing the stage fall into darkness and silence after it closed—you were very familiar with this silence, because it had been like this for a long time. Tenna kept glancing back at you from time to time to check if you were following, to confirm he could see you all along.
Although you're curious how he'd react if he suddenly disappeared at this moment and couldn't see him, you didn't intend to do so.
You don't want to proactively cause him to feel anxious, as that would only lead to guilt and guilt, so just maintain the status quo.
Until you pass through door after door and enter the snowy field where the cold wind howls and snowflakes drift. You wrap yourself tightly and stand beside the tree, looking up at the sky—it's just pitch black. Then you look toward that similarly dark, unknown doorway. Out of the corner of your eye, you notice Tenna is also uneasy—or rather, he actually wants to escape from here. He may not want to face what comes next, but he knows he has to do it, that he has no choice.
So you quietly took two steps toward Tenna's direction, then slipped your hand into his tightly held palm as comfort. You saw that although he was bowing his head, he still held your hand tightly, wrapping it tightly in his palm.
…… Then, you saw the figures of those three people appear at the doorway, so you quietly pulled your hand out and just hid behind the tree. Because you felt that maybe you shouldn't be standing here. To be honest, you don't have any other abilities, so it's better not to get in the way here.
But maybe it's only natural...... Tenna still failed, maybe he had his own sense of self-awareness—this was a doomed failure, so before it all began, he wanted to escape. And you saw it all in full, and belatedly realized that maybe leaving with him back then would have been a better choice? No, maybe he didn't want to leave either.
Because you see him so happy now to hand out the ultimate prize that was supposed to be on the treetop—then you widen your eyes, unable to believe what you've just seen. You see a pitch-black shadow appear behind Tenna at some point, raising its blade and pointing it at him.
You have to do something. Whatever it is, but maybe everything will be too late in a flash. Suddenly, something comes to mind. You pull out the knife you've hidden on yourself when you've been feeling uneasy, and don't dare hesitate for a moment, slashing straight toward your neck. As you raise the blade, you run toward the distance, still too close to it.
Because only death brings rebirth, and at this moment, you overcome the fear and pain brought by death, so you know none of this will happen again, only rebirth. You even do all this with a smile and relief. You remember the pain of dying and the feeling of near suffocation, then your vision goes black and blank. When you come to your senses, you are standing not far away, still holding the knife to your neck, blood dripping from the scraped skin, wetting the blade.
You look up in a daze, still unsure if you've truly succeeded. If not, you'll have to try again—then you see Tenna's screen go black again, with tears falling continuously. He kneels in the snow, hugs you tightly, and knocks the knife from your hand.
Tenna, in fact, from that moment of blurred before his eyes and the moment he felt the familiar distortion of time and space, suddenly understood that you had encountered danger again—no, more like choosing death, because in that instant, in the pitch-black reverse, he truly saw your fate, smiling as blood flowed, soaking every inch beneath you, staining the pure white snowflakes red, while you lay there peacefully, your body gradually turning cold. Then, in the very next second after rewinding in time, he noticed the knife you were holding against your neck. He couldn't care about anything else; his only thought now was to run over, hold you tight, and stop your movements.
He was even a bit annoyed that he had prepared this dagger for you earlier, since he was afraid you might be in danger and gave it to you. But now, it was you who brought danger upon yourself.
The falling blade missed, and then the trio shouted something and rushed forward. You weren't interested, and you didn't listen anymore. You just looked at Tenna, who was hugging you tightly, gently wiped the tears from his face, and then smiled with pure joy: "So I succeeded on the first try? That's great." Don't cry, look, we're all standing here perfectly fine now, nothing happened at all. ”
"But what if that time-space rewind function just fails? What if it happens to ...... What if all of this fails? I can't bear losing your future......" His voice was still choked with tears, confused, and even gasping for breath—clearly, he was crying even harder.
You could only pat his head: "It's okay, didn't I succeed?" Besides, I can't bear to lose your future. If I hadn't done anything just now, maybe I would have just watched you die—just thinking about it scares me. That's why I thought of doing this. Maybe my sudden death alone could actually bring us a future where we both survive together. ”
"But if you do that, nothing happens, and you die for no reason—" Tenna was still shaken, emphasizing the possibility.
But you just interrupted him slowly: "Is that so?" Alright then, let's both step into death together. Maybe a shared death is another kind of rebirth. I don't care about that; I just want to always be with you. "As you spoke, you cupped Tenna's head, pressed your forehead against his screen, and looked at him intently. Even though you didn't know if you were looking into his eyes, it didn't matter.
Tenna seemed stunned, or maybe just silent. In any case, he didn't speak for a while, leaving only silence surrounding you. Of course, there was also the distant sounds of battle as background music.
After a long silence, he finally tugged at your collar: "No matter what, let me see your wound first......"
You let him do as he pleased, though honestly, you still feel a bit guilty.
Tenna was stunned once again. He saw the uneven colors of skin beneath the newly formed bloodstains. Some of the skin tones were already very close to the original, but near the scar, there were still quite a few that were clearly recognizable—they were newly formed skin. Or rather, the wounds had already endured countless times, the cuts had been cut countless times, leaving deep wounds. Only this time the wounds were shallow, and they would probably heal in a little while.
He began to blame himself, wondering why he had never noticed before—yet he never had such a close look at your neck before, nor noticed skin color, so naturally he wouldn't notice the patchwork of skin marked by death and rebirth.
Maybe, without his knowledge, you would have died countless times already, yet now you still stand in front of him, even looking at him with a puzzled gaze.
So he starts to feel afraid. Tenna hugs you tightly again, but you don't understand and just hug him back.
You ask softly, "What's going on?" ”
He hesitated for a moment, then hesitated deeply, then asked in a trembling voice, "Without my knowledge...... Have you died many times? ”
You cleared your throat twice, feeling a bit guilty, and replied uncertainly, "Didn't I say before? Trading my own death for a new life for us is a very worthwhile thing......
So what you said about experimenting before was just a disguise; you can't suddenly show that you already knew about it. But you do fear the pain that death brings. You really didn't have memories before; you just guessed through subtle shifts in the position of things and started trying on your own. So every death feels like an adventure to you. And now, you don't know why Tenna entered this cycle with you, still retaining memories.
But all these adventures are the sacrifices that should be made to protect this family, to maintain perfection.
“…… Th-is it worth it? "You heard Tenna's voice. Although he probably didn't want to accept it, he still trembled as he asked, perhaps confirming something.
So you nod without hesitation: "Of course it's worth it. Because I love you, I can't bear a future where we can't coexist, I can't bear to see our current family destroyed. If it's just a possible adventure, and there won't be any other danger besides that, why not give it a try? I don't think there's anything wrong with that. Of course, maybe it's just that I've been working hard for the future where we coexist, even if it's just a risky death. ”
Maybe you just piled up countless deaths just for this one success? Honestly, you don't even remember. You can't even remember why you died, only barely remembering it was probably for Tenna. But now it's best to succeed on one try; otherwise, you'd have to pile up new wounds on top of the same ones.
In short, you are now holding each other tightly in this snowy field, leaning on each other's warmth, and then celebrating the birth of a perfect family.
End.
…… I'm not sure if this explanation is good; maybe it's a bit forced. Actually, I hadn't thought of such a story at first, so maybe the logic was somewhat lacking. Anyway, celebrating my completion (. ）

title: Forced buying and selling 1 (tennax you)
content:
You usually stay at home and seldom go out... Anyway, the salary you earn is enough for you alone, but occasionally earning a little extra money wouldn't be bad — that's why you started thinking about that CRT TV lying in the junkyard. After all, even though the wires seemed broken and were only fixed later, most of the internal components are probably fine, and if you take them out and sell them separately, you could still make some extra income!
This CRT TV is just way too heavy... Anyway, you can't move it on your own. Luckily, your home has that kind of small trolley used to make it easier to carry packages regularly, but even so, you still had to put in a lot of effort to get the TV onto the trolley, and then spent quite some time dragging it all the way back home. You wiped the sweat off your forehead and decided to rest in your own room for a while; what to do with the TV can be dealt with later... You dragged your tired body back to your room, then collapsed directly onto the bed, scrolling through your phone to pass the time while resting.
Just lying there like that, maybe an hour passed, or maybe two hours... You didn't check the time; you just heard a sudden crackling noise coming from the living room, and it was quite loud... and it was still continuing. You figured, could it be that a mouse got into your house to gnaw on your appliances? So reluctantly, you got out of your bed and walked out of the bedroom, not wanting to spend a big sum just to fix an appliance... But the first thing you saw as you stepped out of the bedroom door was someone standing in your living room, next to a messy pile of scattered little things from your house... Above his head—roughly above, or you might say above the TV—was the blanket you draped over the sofa, and he had unfinished ribbons you bought hanging on him. This guy looked very tall; standing up, he almost reached your ceiling, and he could probably still be considered a living creature... You looked up to see, was this a TV person? His head looked like a television, and when you turned, the CRT TV you had painstakingly brought back was indeed gone!
That blanket was probably a bit in the way. At least at first, the TV person had his back to you, then after fiddling for a bit, he took the blanket off from above and then revealed a silly grin looking at you… or probably looking at you, since by now the TV head was bent down towards you. And he had no eyes, which was fine; that way he wouldn’t be exposed to radiation… you thought absentmindedly. Then you glanced at the little cart next to you—empty, without the CRT TV you had brought back hoping to make a little extra money. Then you looked at the big guy in front of you, clutching his head and letting out a heart-wrenching scream: 'My money!!'
The TV just happened to start talking, and its tone sounded quite cheerful: 'Oh, are you my new owner? I'm glad you could bring me back from the junkyard—' but its voice was drowned out by your heart-wrenching screams.
He was stunned for a moment, then turned around, his whole body becoming shriveled, roughly about your height, even slightly shorter than you, because he kept flattening more, swaying from side to side, his tone filled with a sense of frustration.
"Oh... you don't welcome me coming to your house?" As she spoke, her voice grew weaker and gradually quieter. You were curious whether this TV still felt as heavy even when it became smaller... but you didn't want to try it yet, after all, if that happened, the one who would become all flat would be you.
Anyway, you automatically got the equation. This guy is the CRT TV you brought back earlier, after all, you don't have a TV at home! Not at all!
"Uh, of course I’d welcome a TV into my home… after all, selling it could earn some money, but in your current state, it looks like you’d just end up costing me money…" You said, taking out your phone, opening the calculator, and starting to calculate how much more it would cost for daily meals and transportation if the other party were a human like you, how much it would cost to maintain if it were an appliance, and if it were both human and appliance at the same time—such expensive costs! Much more expensive than raising yourself! Oh, no, it’s impossible for it to be both a human and an appliance…
You were just babbling: 'If I had known, I wouldn't have picked it up. Being greedy for small gains leads to big losses... Now it will cost a lot of money to properly fix a TV...' You weren't thinking about calling the police; after all, the police can't do anything about a TV person anyway... You were just sincerely looking at tenna, who was still standing in place, deflated, staggering slightly.
"Can I ask you to leave my house and go somewhere else? I can't afford a TV. Ah, if you want, you could go to the police station and get some kind of vagrant allowance, or you could go out and look for a job, maybe find one with food and lodging provided..." But before you could finish your rambling, this TV person, like a small cannonball, grew a little, becoming just big enough to cover you, and then held you in their arms—you hadn't even reacted to what was happening, instinctively wanting to push them away, but they were way too heavy for you—oh my god, oh my god, you were now forcibly hugged by this TV, and tears were dripping from their eyes, quickly wetting your shoulders. You were a little stunned, only able to hear their sobbing, and it was super loud, hurting your ears—oh my god, you hadn't even tested the soundproofing of your house, but now you definitely need to buy some soundproofing material or something..."
"Oh my god, my new owner, are you going to abandon me?! You can't throw me away. I thought when you picked me up from the junkyard, it meant that you wanted a TV... You definitely need a TV, I'm very useful! I can report the weather for the next week for you, I can broadcast entertainment programs for you, I can keep you warm when you're cold, and I can play all kinds of music and various programs, surely there will be something you like!" He cried and sobbed, holding you tightly, not willing to let go at all.
"You... you let go of me first..." You pushed against his chest, standing firm, hoping he would let go on his own... Unfortunately, he seemed to hold you even tighter.
"No, I won't let go. If I let go, you'll definitely take me to the police... I, I don't want to be a stray TV. I'm very useful, you can take me in, right? I'm very useful, you surely need a new TV, I'm very useful... Don't throw me away. Since you picked me up from the junkyard, you have to be responsible for me, be my new owner..." He cried while holding onto you, and you didn’t even know where all his tears came from. In any case, you felt that a thin layer of water had already formed on your floor... Yes, it was all from his crying.
You feel like it's getting a bit difficult to breathe, but he probably hugged you while crying and got a little overwhelmed. He even held you while sitting on the sofa, hugging you tightly, and that heavy TV head buried into your shoulder... your shoulder... it hurts so much...  
You take a deep breath... alright, you couldn't do it. Breathing is really difficult, and you can only say with effort, 'I... I can't catch my breath...'
Only then did his hand loosen a little, but he kept repeating over and over: 'I am useful... don't throw me away, don't abandon me, you will definitely like me...'
You pressed your forehead and felt a bit of a headache... Oh my, it seems this TV is speaking nonsense and its state of mind is a bit abnormal... Let's let it calm down a bit first. So now you can finally take a deep breath: 'Alright, alright, I won't send you to the police... But honestly, you really could try to get a job and support yourself...' Before you could finish speaking, he hugged you tightly again.
"...I'm just a television, I can't find a job. Yes, I can work for you. You must really need a television, right? You definitely won't refuse, right? You surely need me to work for you, right?" His antenna was also wobbling, and now it drooped again. Clearly, he was probably nervous.
"...Can you... let me go first, this thing I don't even know the name of... oh right, I don't even know your name, but never mind, it's not important..." You feel a bit dizzy, probably because you're a little short of oxygen.
"No... no, you will definitely throw me away..." He even looked wronged... You had no idea what exactly he was feeling wronged about, so you could only painfully reach out and pat his TV head... My god, it looks like he's determined to stick around with you, and you don't even know who he really is.
…And probably he won't let you go unless you agree with him.
“...I understand, I will hire you, including food and accommodation, but your workload will be very heavy. And I won’t pay you extra wages! I don’t have money, so if you want money, go find another job!” You said this all in one breath, then gasped for air. At this moment, his antennae stood straight up, and his nose even poked out... a flower??? Anyway, he seemed very happy, and finally he let you go.
"Oh, I knew it, my new master must need a TV—it's okay, it's okay, I'm happy to work for you! Even if I have to pay you, it's fine!" As he said this, he raised both hands and started cheering. And you did catch the key words.
"You have money? Give it to me." You reached out your hand rudely, and this unknown television person turned their TV head aside, probably feeling a bit guilty.
"...I have no money, haha."
TBC.

title: Forced Selling and Buying 2 (tennax you)
content:
You couldn't help but roll your eyes: "If you don't have money, what are you talking about...... Honestly, if you're out of money, can't you go out and earn some money to bring back to me, or just buy a lottery ticket and win a big prize to give it to me? Then I wouldn't hesitate to keep you. Ah, it's because you're useful, definitely not because of money...... "You're patching yourself up, after all, saying that makes you seem very greedy, and the TV guy in front of you listens to it and looks pitiful and pleading...... His screen goes black, and all you can see are tears falling down, while he grips your arm and shakes it back and forth, his voice tinged with tears.
"Don't abandon me...... I don't have any money right now, are you still willing to keep me here? Honestly, I'm very useful! I can play you a weather forecast, all kinds of entertainment programs, and even a six-o'clock show I can even set it up to five for you—" But before he could finish, you interrupted him.
"Ah, you can now watch the weather forecast on your phone, and you can even see reports on the weather for the next ninety days, entertainment programs, and so on...... Now you can get early screenings. Even if the theater hasn't shown it yet, as long as I buy it, I can watch it in advance on my computer. Of course, I don't like watching movies or TV dramas, nor am I really into variety shows—after all, they don't seem very interesting. Ah, this probably isn't the main point...... You said this while taking out your phone and turning on the weather forecast to show him. You saw the TV guy wilted again, his antenna drooping, clearly not very happy, and his figure was swaying.
You just turned on your phone's calculator and said, "Hmm, but that way, it looks like I can save you the money I give you every month. Then you have to cook for me and clean up. That way, I can save time, and with that time, I can do more orders and buy more groceries. I guess you can afford the appliance maintenance costs......" You mutter, staring at the small screen on your phone, while he keeps staring at you, watching the faint white light shine on your face. Suddenly, you feel a bit annoyed—oh my god, since you've already agreed to let him stay, he must be the only appliance in this house! He can do weather forecasts and stuff too, so why should you look at that phone?!
So he slapped the small electronic screen to block it. You were a bit dazed, instinctively looking up at him, while he gripped the small phone with both hands and took it from yours. His voice was a bit stammering: "You...... You can't stare at this screen anymore! You just need to look at my screen. I can do anything, I'm very useful! I'm well-behaved too—really, you can have only me, just me! "He looked a bit tough but weak inside, but excitedly turned the screen back on, the antenna shaking as he smiled at you foolishly. He knew his actions were a bit out of line—but, he really couldn't stand you staring at something else.
You blinked twice in confusion and reached out your hand to him: "Uh." I get it. Since you say you're well-behaved, can you give me back your phone? Also, I can keep you, but you can't take my phone—and you can't take any other appliances either! After all, you can't replace a rice cooker for cooking, can't replace a refrigerator to freeze food, or replace a washing machine to wash a lot of clothes at once...... You grumbled, wanting to snatch the tiny phone in his hand, but he raised his hand so high that you couldn't even touch it even if you jumped up.
"I-I-I...... Of course I can! I can cool and heat, I can help you do laundry, I can do many things! So it's enough that I'm the only one in your home! "He said anxiously, the antenna shaking as he raised his hand not wanting you to touch him, but now you're on the sofa, and you collapsed onto him, pressing down on him to stand up on the sofa, then naturally took back your phone—but for some reason, when you looked down, this guy's screen wasn't black or white, but instead turned red??"
You looked at him in surprise, but in the end, you reached out your hand: "Alright, then give me all the money you spent on those appliances, and I'll move them all away. You're the only one left at home." Of course you know he definitely can't come up with the money—besides, you can't possibly do this kind of hard work. How heavy are those appliances? Why would you move them out for no reason!
So his antenna drooped again: "...... I don't have money, you know ......"
You counted on your fingers, then used your phone's calculator to calculate: "Okay, so you have to be my free laborer...... Uh, since you just took my phone, I have to add a rental fee for you. So for the next week, you have to listen to me—whatever you want to eat, you can do it, got it?" As you spoke, you patted his chest and chest without hesitation, then finally got off his body and sat cross-legged beside him. For some reason, you felt he seemed a bit unhappy, especially since his screen was dark again, and he was still trying to get a little closer to you. You didn't even know what he meant, so just pretend you didn't see it at all.
"Alright, of course I'll listen to my new master. I'm very well-behaved...... I'm obedient and capable. Trust me, I will never let you down, and I will never make you regret it!" He patted his chest and promised. You exhaled, and the matter was almost resolved. It was only then that you remembered you might have forgotten something.
So you slap your forehead: "Ah, I almost forgot. Now let's formally introduce myself. I'm Y/N, and I don't even know your real name...... Alright, although it's fine if I keep calling you TV person, I don't think you like me calling you that. Of course, if you're happy with how I address you, you can tell me, but I have to say, I definitely won't use some overly harsh forms of address. And of course, don't call me by nicknames, and don't expect me to call you by them...... We're not that close yet......
"So, does that mean once we're closer, I can use other names for you? Ah, Y/N—it sounds like a good name, I really like it, and I believe you'll like my name too, I am MR.(ANT)TENNA! Your best, most caring TV, your best friend, partner, and family! Well, of course, you can just call me tenna directly, and if you like, it's also okay to call me by other names!" tenna... hmm, this television person, whose name you finally now know, has finally told you what his name actually is.
Ah, wait, it sounds like an antenna person...... Thinking this, you said it out loud, frowning in confusion: "Your name...... Can I call you antenna person? That sounds like the word 'antenna' just has an extra 't'...... Honestly, I'm curious why you have that name, but thinking about it, you're a CRT TV makes sense—after all, there are indeed two antennas above your head for receiving signals. Ah, wait, I got off track, that's not the point...... You gave an awkward smile, and only when you came back to your senses did you realize you had just talked to Tenna for a long time.
You cleared your throat, ready to change the subject, but then you heard Tenna speak proudly: "Yes, yes, the antenna above my head. I'm proud of that. I use these two antennas to receive wireless signals. Of course, if someone wants to contact me, they can send signals directly to my antenna, so I can receive signals freely—" He said, excitedly gesturing his hand. You looked at him, not knowing why he could always maintain such high energy. Although you talk a lot because you're always alone, you're actually not someone who likes socializing...... You rubbed your forehead and made a gesture to be quiet, signaling him to quiet down. Tenna really did quiet down and didn't say anything more, just timidly looking at you—probably looking at you.
"Alright, I understand. But if I were to call you, which number should I dial? That way, would your antenna hear it?" Speaking of which, the signals we use now are all connected to the base stations. Can you connect with the signal base stations in this world? Well, anyway, when you appeared here, I knew you weren't from this world. After all, TVs don't turn into people in this world...... You muttered to yourself, feeling a bit hungry. You couldn't help but open your phone and glance at it. Hmm, it was indeed close to dinner time. Honestly, you didn't expect to talk for so long; it seemed time passed without you noticing.
"Ah...... I'm not really sure either. After all, I've never given my employees their phone numbers or anything. In short, they all act like they already know...... "Tenna got stuck, and you dug out an old phone from the coffee table drawer—maybe a senior phone—since it only retained the function for making calls and texting. You handed the phone to Tenna."
"Alright, here is my contact info, so we can make calls. Anyway, the SIM card is my secondary card, so you don't need to recharge it...... Oh, but remember to charge it. If you don't charge it, your phone won't work—it's just a brick......
TBC.

title: Forced Selling and Buying 3 (tennax you)
content:
Tenna, however, was unwilling to accept the phone, which surprised you. Instead, he sounded confident: "I can reach you just by my antenna. My antenna is my best achievement, uh...... One of them! In short, I don't need your phone. Of course, when we're together, I don't need your phone. As long as you have me, that's enough! "He argued confidently. You glanced at him speechlessly, shrugged, and put the phone back into the coffee table.
"Alright, if you don't want to, then don't. But for now, go cook first. It's almost dinner time. Oh, and by the way, today I want to have red wine stewed beef. You can look for some ingredients in the fridge—we've got these ingredients anyway...... You directed Tenna to cook for you. He walked toward the kitchen in the direction you pointed, and you naturally returned to your room. Oh heavens, this order is almost done! You really don't want to ...... Hmm, postpone all this until tomorrow, because you have a feeling that if Tenna gets a bit free, she'll definitely come bother you, and then you won't be able to do your job well.
You hurriedly finished the work, and after finishing, you stretched lazily and headed outside again. Just then, Tenna, wearing an apron and heat-resistant gloves, came out holding a tray, looking very virtuous. You looked at the delicious-looking dinner he set out on the table with great interest, and Tenna immediately asked you to take credit, hands on hips, looking very excited.
"Look, Y/N, I did pretty well, right? I told you I was very useful and wouldn't cause you any trouble. Try it, it will definitely taste great!" He puffed out his chest as he spoke, looking very proud and confident. You were amused by him and indeed tasted a flavor to see how it was. Then you nodded seriously, "Hmm, it really tastes great. I like this flavor." "As you spoke, you even gave him a thumbs-up, and Tenna was clearly pleased with your praise. You watched him jump up and down with joy, as if he didn't even notice how heavy he was. The floor started pounding, and you worried it might suddenly collapse. Luckily, it didn't, and ...... Hmm, a flower even bloomed on the tip of his nose. You don't even know why a TV blooms, but it looks like a real flower. Forget it, he's not from the same world as you anyway, so why care so much? Thinking this, you can rest easy and continue eating your dinner. Tenna paces around on his own, probably feeling he has enough, then puts on a silly smile, with that flower still on his nose, and then sits down across from you, holding the TV head with both hands, smiling at you. At first, you intended to ignore him, but his gaze was so intense that you felt like you were sitting on pins and needles, so you couldn't help but look up at Tenna: "...... What's wrong with you? Why are you staring at me all the time? I don't think there's anything good about my face, and besides, you don't need to eat? Even though you don't look like you're alone...... Uh, you're just a TV, but running a TV also needs energy, right? What exactly is your energy? "Your questions are one after another, and Tenna just looks at you with a silly smile. Hearing this, his head tilts slightly, then his antenna shakes excitedly, and his smile grows even wider.
"Ah, Y/N, are you really concerned about me? No, no, you really are caring about me. I knew you definitely cared about me, I knew I was different to you, I knew I was very important to you—" And you were speechless, and you just casually said you cared about him, so how did it turn into definitely caring about him? He was very important to you. You didn't know what kind of logic he had, but you just couldn't understand it. But to say he didn't care at all was impossible, after all, this was a living TV that suddenly appeared in your home! Of course you would be curious!
You couldn't help but interrupt him: "Stop, stop, stop, stop, I don't care what you're thinking. I just want to know if you've eaten. If you haven't, what is your energy source...... Honestly, after all, you're not a person but a TV. It's normal for me to be curious, right? ”
He finally stopped talking, but still repeated as if unwilling to give up: "Ah...... But Y/N, you really do care about me, otherwise why would you ask this question? Of course, alright, I'll tell you the answer—I already ate it in the kitchen, when I tried making this dish! Y/N, don't worry, of course, my energy comes from food, but most of the time I still need to be plugged in, when I was a TV. Of course, I'm not just a TV now, so I don't need to plug it in! He happily rambled on, and you had no idea why he spoke so much. Anyway, you rubbed your brow in frustration and quickly finished the dinner, wanting to hide in your room for some peace.
"Alright, alright, you talk a lot...... I'm done eating, then I'll head back first. Remember to tidy up these dishes and make sure the house is clean. Other than that, there's nothing else. After you're done with these things, it's your time to rest. You can do whatever you want! "Of course, you didn't realize that because you haven't communicated with people outside for a long time, you can't help but talk a lot. In this regard, you and Tenna are just as good.
Tenna just cleared her throat: "Mm, I understand. I promise to complete the task, Y/N!" But my dear star, don't you like me talking...... Uh, although I probably can't change it anymore, if you don't, I can talk less often. I don't want you to feel annoyed......"
Unfortunately, by now you had already entered the study, and of course you didn't hear Tenna's voice. Tenna's antenna, which didn't respond, drooped. Although he knew you just hadn't heard, that didn't stop him from feeling wronged...... Besides, talking too much wasn't his fault; he just stayed in the garbage dump with no one talking to him, so he was bored—and you talked a lot. He guessed you probably wouldn't talk to anyone else anyway, but that was fine, so he could enter your life with peace of mind.
So he pulled himself together again, diligently tidying up the dishes and cleaning the room. It was only about nine o'clock, which was resttime—meaning his new little owner had time to watch TV! Tenna's antenna was reinforced. He tidied up, uh, then excitedly dashed into the study—uh, but before entering, because he had walked too fast and not high enough, his TV's head hit the doorframe with a loud bang. You startled him, instinctively turned to glance at him, then just saved the current work on the computer and walked to the door. You saw Tenna rubbing her own screen, her lips drooping as she looked pitiful. Only then did you barely breathe a sigh of relief: "Looks like you didn't hurt yourself, but it must have hurt a lot. I just heard your footsteps walking over. By the way, how did you deal with your injuries before?" Normally, a wound like this should have turned a bit bruised, but you didn't look like you were hurt at all, just fine...... "Yeah, at least you don't have to pay for appliance repairs. As for the door frame...... You turned to look. Luckily, Tenna hadn't hurt it and was still there, perfectly fine. You breathed a slight sigh of relief.
Tenna rubbed her TV screen, pitifully crouching in front of you. Now that he's squatted down, he's about the same height as you, and he just mumbled vaguely, "Ah...... In my world, healing magic existed, so when you got hurt, just one healing spell was enough! Hmm, unless it's something like a broken arm or leg, then you have to reattach that part first...... Ah, right, I heard that just blowing on it will make it hurt, so could you blow on me for some breath? "Even though he has no eyes, you always feel like he's looking at you with anticipation...... Your lips twitched, and Tenna pointed to the spot where he had just bumped into the screen. Then his antenna drooped, and he obediently rested his hands on his knees, looking at you pitifully. You hesitated for a moment, but in the end, you couldn't take that intense gaze anymore. You had to bend down slightly, then cupped his screen with both hands and blew a couple of breaths on that spot where you couldn't see the wound but Tenna kept saying it hurt—hmm, his antenna was standing upright again, and for some reason, the tail of his antenna was wagging behind you, provocatively...... He seemed to be in a good mood, almost hugging you and rubbing against you...... You first took two steps back when his hands reached out, but that didn't stop Tenna from hugging you all at once. His TV head rubbed against your shoulder—this TV was just too heavy...... You felt the weight on your shoulder, feeling a bit overwhelmed, but Tenna just cheerfully said, "Oh thank you, Y/N, my dear star, now I don't hurt anymore—oh my god, seriously, I really want to thank you. My injury healed in no time, so I wanted to invite you to watch the show on my TV. I promise you'll love it!" ”
TBC.

title: Forced Selling and Buying 4 (tennax you)
content:
Your hand paused, and you hesitated for a moment. After all, your work was not actually finished. Although it didn't matter if you finished tomorrow, you just had the habit of finishing today's tasks today—well, this was probably a good habit. But in that case, you started to wonder if tenna's work should also be counted in this category. In other words, you should also finish today's tasks, but that would cause a conflict between your two tasks......

You casually scanned his room, and if there was no passage, you turned off the lights and left—after all, suddenly coming to someone's room always made you feel a bit guilty, as if you were inspecting.
Then your gaze froze, you froze in place, eyes wide as you stared at a wall—the wall was covered with photos of you, from childhood to adulthood, and ...... even, even photos of you bathing and getting out of the bath?!
TBC.
Although...... Why are these photos of you growing up? You clearly feel like you've settled here in the house just a couple of years ago...... But no, I can't recall the memories from before, only a layer of fog shrouded me. It's really strange. But why......
Forget it, you think it's better not to think about this for now. Is this guy a voyeur! He saved all your photos! And...... And there are photos of you just out of the bath—that's just too perverted!
You casually glanced at these photos, and finally your gaze froze on the spot. On it was a picture of little you, smiling, standing beside you...... It looked like a photo of your very old grandmother taking a group photo. You stood in front of a TV covered with a white dust cover, smiling brightly. For some reason, you suddenly felt sad...... But you remembered nothing.
Most of the photos seem to be from the past two years—you cry, laugh, get angry, rejoice, but without exception, the same TV casually appears in the corners of the photos.
You were silent for a moment, then tried to turn and sneak away—just pretend you didn't see it, since peeking into someone's room is never something to say out loud.
But when you turn around, you bump into a sturdy figure. Tears instinctively welled up in the corner of your eye from the pain. Just as you looked up to accuse him, you realized it was the real person in the room.
He sits with the screen going dark, fiddling at the doorframe, looking down at you, looking down. You can't help but feel a bit scared, take two steps back, and he steps back two more steps toward you.
And at this very moment, you stand firm—what's the need to be afraid? He was the one who made the mistake! You overlooked that you had a guilty conscience and barged into his room.
"Damn...... What are you doing? Is the meal ready? "You put your hands on your hips and chose to press him directly.
"It's ready. I thought you'd be waiting." Tenna said. But when he came out carrying the food, he couldn't see you. So...... That's why he thought, I have to go find you. He felt panicked, because Tenna understood that if you were gone, you must have gone to find the passage back to the world of light. Fortunately, he locked the door firmly, and luckily, he found that only his own door was open.
If it were another room...... He probably wouldn't be able to stop your resolve then. He wouldn't want you to see those things anymore. Some things are best known only to him, for example...... These photos.
“…… Isn't it boring to just wait there the whole time? I was just wandering around casually, and when I saw your room, I got a bit curious and came in to take a look. You didn't lock the door, so isn't that just letting me look around! "You raised your voice and kept shouting. You know you might be a bit in the wrong, but even if it's unreasonable...... You still have to look like you're not at a disadvantage!
"Well, but peeking into my room—don't you find it boring?" He bent down, adding even more pressure. You instinctively took two steps back, then sat down on his soft bed, with Tenna's arms resting on either side of you. Even if you didn't want to look at him, you were forced to stare at him.
Your gaze darted around: "Yes, I'm really bored, I admit it—but you've kept all the photos from childhood, and—and even photos of me after a bath, even a photo of me in my underwear right after waking up in the morning—you, how did you even take those pictures, you pervert!" As you spoke, you became even more justified, starting to type on his screen to vent your anger.
And ...... He could keep such highly private photos—who knows if this perverted TV had already seen everything! No, no, he shouldn't have imagined it like that...... And even if he saw everything, what did it matter! Anyway, everything he shouldn't have done was his fault!
"Yes, it was your guardian who made the album. I just moved those photos to my room." He admitted it straightforwardly—of course, in reality, only those ordinary photos recording beautiful memories and the past were taken before, only a dozen or so photos. The other photos...... Were all taken by him out of selfish motives.
"Guardians? Not mine...... Parents? "You always feel ...... It seems like some answer is about to come out. You feel a bit of a headache, as if a flash of inspiration strikes you in an instant, but you can't catch that spark of inspiration, nor do you know what is shrouded behind the fog—it's just a subconscious sadness, an instinctively feeling ...... Empty.
"Of course not. You still treat those two conscientious guys as your guardians." Tenna sneered.
You instinctively want to say not to let him speak about your parents like that—but you hesitate, and in your heart you stop him from saying so. So, deep down, you think the same way?
Tenna had no intention of continuing the conversation, just changed the subject: "Aren't you going to eat yet? How much longer are you going to keep pestering me here? Or...... Can I understand it as you just like to keep pestering me? ”
That sentence seemed to carry a hint of ambiguity...... You instinctively widened your eyes and patted his TV head: "What kind of talk is that? I don't like it! I-I'd rather be alone forever...... I wouldn't choose you! "You're a bit careless."
Well, actually, you're just saying the opposite. You really like it, really like it...... But it also feels a bit sour and swollen, and your heart feels a little sore. You don't know, is it that tangled love always ends like this? What exactly do you want? You don't understand.
He snorted coldly, "Oh, then who said as a kid that when they grew up, they wanted to treat TV as their bride?" ”
Unconsciously, his tone ...... actually carried a hint of grievance. You were a bit shocked to recognize this. You realized it too...... The TV in that photo was Anton Tenna.
If you think this way, you might indeed say the same. After all, at that time, the whole family was ...... probably just you, your grandmother, and this TV.
“…… Anyway, there's no way I said it!" You said in a sulk. Even though you know it was definitely something you said as a child—what kind of scene was it then? What story did it actually happen? You couldn't remember anything at all.
“…… It's exactly what you said. "His tone suddenly turned a bit sinister, and his words sounded so dazed that you couldn't help but shiver.
"It can't be me who said it!" You lifted your neck, sticking to your own story. At this point, of course, you refused to admit it either.
"You said it." His voice remained calm, but now tinged with anger, and his speech sped up considerably.
"Impossible!" You're still holding on. Anyway, he wouldn't do anything to you...... You know, you've always known.
Tenna stopped talking. You thought it was all over. You looked up to ask him to let you go, but he just bit your lip, his sharp teeth cutting your lip. You cried out in pain, frowned, whimpered twice, and pushed his screen with your hand.
But it didn't work. He just held you tightly, your head resting on the soft bed, and his large tongue rubbed against your cracked lips, gently licking the bitten spot. A faint bloody smell spread, and the sticky saliva wet your lips. You stammered, feeling a bit uncomfortable, and couldn't help but bite your tongue tip.
His tongue took over your mouth, blocking it completely, and his tongue was recklessly teasing the depths of your mouth. Tears welled up in your eyes, your eyes red. You knew Tenna could definitely see your expression—he was just deliberately going on! Was this revenge for your earlier denial?
An even stronger smell of blood spread out. He was still licking your mouth, making you a bit dizzy—probably not very good at breathing. You pitifully stammered twice, and only then did he mercifully let go of your mouth. The sticky silver threads hung by your mouths, connected together. You coughed twice, feeling a bit uncomfortable deep in your throat.
"Alright...... Alright, I said it! Alright! Ugh...... You shouted loudly, unable to hold back two more sobs. Along with that discomfort, you actually felt a bit wronged...... What exactly are you feeling wronged about? You don't know, but at least you don't want to talk to Tenna right now. You mean what you say!
So after saying this, you fell silent again and firmly said nothing.
Tenna just responded with a satisfied "Mm." So now, it's your mealtime. ”
He waited for a while, and you didn't answer him.
Tenna laughed bitterly in anger. He really did laugh a few times, and you couldn't help but shrink back a few times. You kept worrying that this guy might do something again, so you couldn't help but press your bitten lips, only to feel more and more wronged.
"Ha, you're not saying anything now? Who knows what you really mean? Who would guess what you're really thinking?" He couldn't help but complain, but bent down, picked you up, dragged you out of the room, locked the door, and headed toward the lounge.
You pursed your lips and swung your legs, signaling you to come down and walk on your own, but Tenna just held your leg with her other hand and said coldly, "Don't move." ”
You feel a bit guilty, your body a bit stiff, and you really can't do anything else.
Tenna carried you quickly to the lounge, where you ordered the food you just ordered...... Not all of them, but at least a few dishes were brought out and placed on the table, looking quite delicious.
TBC.
You are placed at the end of the table by Tenna, just looking at him in frustration.
“…… Why don't you just ignore me? Who told you to mind me, who told you to care about my thoughts, who told you to ...... "Who told you to love me?" You wanted to say this, but when you opened your mouth, you couldn't get it out. You just awkwardly closed your mouth, lowered your head, and stared blankly at the steaming hot food in front of you.
Tenna sat across from you, handed you the bowl and chopsticks, and said coldly, a bit annoyed, "Yeah, who told me to love you?" ”
He could say that out loud...... Because you probably wouldn't care, but after hearing his words, your body just shrank back, and you still showed no other reaction.
…… See, you really don't care. Even if he says it so confidently, he doesn't know if you truly feel that way, if you truly love him, or if you ...... You still care? He sneered inwardly, as if mocking, but deep down, there was still a bit of grievance he couldn't put into words.
“…… Why do you love me?" You whispered, unconsciously poking the plate with your chopsticks—this was your habit when daydreaming. Tenna just used her other pair of chopsticks to serve you food, and soon, your bowl was piled high with food, as big as a small mountain, full and full.
Looking at this bowl of food, you can't help but get a little distracted, feeling ...... It seems that a long, long time ago, someone would have done this for you, but who exactly was it? No matter what, you just can't remember.
And Tenna just said, "I don't know. Are you satisfied with this answer?" ”
His voice was still icy cold, like dark clouds hanging over you. You didn't dare look up at him and just mumbled, "...... That's not really a reason, right? So do you have a reason?" ”
Maybe...... Maybe love doesn't need a reason, just as you love Tenna, it seems you don't need a reason either. Even though you never directly admitted it, nor agreed to it. You just...... Still staying here.
Because it seems you have nowhere else to go besides this.
"So if you love me, is there a reason for that?" he said.
You thought for a moment, put down your chopsticks, and started counting on your fingers: "I think there is. You'll always be with me. Even if it makes me angry, it's reluctant, and I can forgive you. Also...... Hmm, the food you make looks really delicious...... But aside from that, you couldn't find any other reason, so you timidly looked up at Tenna.
But—but why did he subconsciously say that Tenna would always be with him? You clearly felt that you only saw Anton Tenna after entering the Dark World, clearly ...... He remembered that there really was such a TV in the Light World, but it seemed only in the past two years.
"Is that a reason?" Tenna asked.
You were silent for a moment: "...... Maybe that's not really a reason." "Love seems to be something that doesn't need a reason, and the so-called reason is just evidence you find to convince you that you love him, or that you discover he loves you."
Maybe, in fact...... That's not really that important.
You pick up a slice of garlic pork, dip it in sauce, and put it in your mouth. It's a familiar taste...... You seem to have tasted this sauce for a long time. Why do you feel like crying the moment you taste it? That flavor makes you nostalgic, as if recalling the taste that was once beautiful and warm, as if ...... Being able to let go of all pretenses and throw yourself into this warm embrace, letting go of all sadness and sensitivity.
You bit your lip, tears uncontrollably streaming down your cheeks. You sniffed, staring at the screen that was lit up, but still wearing a sour face waiting for your evaluation. Tenna cautiously said, "This smell...... Could it be that you're my mom? ”
As soon as you say it, you regret it. How could a TV person be a human mother? What are you thinking! You even want to punch yourself so you can lose your memory from earlier.
Tenna couldn't help but sneer, "What do you mean I'm your mom?" ”
He just made the whole table of dishes the way you used to love, and didn't expect any kind of comment—even though he was indeed looking forward to it. But he never expected to hear you say that!
"No, it's just, this smell is very familiar......" It's as if, long, long ago, this was the very scent that had accompanied you...... As you spoke, you picked up another bite of eggplant and put it in your mouth. Indeed, it tasted exactly like the one you remembered, but no matter how you thought about it, you couldn't retrieve even a tiny bit from that foggy deep sea of memories.
"I can't possibly be your mother." He said, unusually calm, his tone still fairly calm—uh, of course, you can't ignore the suppressed anger beneath his words, seemingly ...... And a bit aggrieved.
You fell silent. But no matter how much you searched your memories, there was nothing more to say. You only remembered that in these years, the TV was still with you at home.
So...... "Did we know each other before?" "You think about this question, but memories can't give you the answer."
"Does it matter whether you know him or not?" Tenna just asked you back.
Maybe it's important, maybe not. In fact, one of the reasons you want to return to the world of light is that you believe that once you go back, you can recover those memories from the past. In some way, you always have this feeling.
You slowly gnaw on the vegetables piled up like a small mountain, pondering for a moment, then nodding and shaking your head: "Yes, memories of the past...... will be important. But the present and future matters are also very important. ”
If you are someone with no past, could you just be a hollow person?
"I... I want to recover my past memories. No, I absolutely must recover my past memories, so I must return to the Luminal World once more." After quickly finishing your meal, you put down your chopsticks, looked directly at Tenna, and mustered the courage to speak. This time, you have truly made up your mind; you want to reclaim your memories.
Whether painful or beautiful, that is your past. If forgetting them is just a temporary escape... then now you should remember, you should face them.
Tenna stared at you, and even if you couldn't see his eyes, you could feel his burning gaze fixed on you.
His tone was heavy, tinged with some disdain: "Even if the memories you recover include things that caused you unbearable pain, things you would rather forget?"
You hesitated for a moment, but ultimately nodded firmly: "Yes. If it truly is very painful... then I cannot forgive the perpetrators. But I must put these things down and move forward." At the end, you let out a soft laugh.
Choosing not to forgive is okay too.
"Even if... you’ve once experienced happiness, only to eventually lose it?" He said these abrupt words, and you nodded and shook your head at the same time.
"Yes... joyous memories cannot last forever; a brief moment of happiness is enough to savor for a lifetime," you said softly with your head lowered and a smile.
But Tenna only stared at the top of your head. He wanted to question you: what about him? What about the old TV you once left behind in your memories if you move forward? What about the old TV that has always been with you if you forgive those past events? If... you are willing to accept your current family, were his words about being the only family left to you a complete lie?
He wanted to question you, to stop you at any cost, to stand between you and the truth. But... perhaps deep down, he was still unwilling to do so.
So in the end, he only took a deep breath: "...If you really want to know the truth, then come with me. Of course, I don't think relying on your fragile psychological endurance, you can fully accept that truth." He couldn’t resist mocking you again. Perhaps, with this sentence, it could make you hesitate for a moment, delaying your pursuit of the truth.
You just puffed up your cheeks and, pouting, poked him on the back: "No way, I'm not as fragile as you say — and, and! Even if I can’t accept it right away, maybe after some time, I will."
After all, time always washes away sorrow and grievances, even though there will still be sadness and grievances, more and more memories will eventually fill in the old pain.
"You really are fragile," Tenna repeated, saying little else. He walked ahead quickly, and you hurried to catch up, nearly unable to keep up with him. But in the end, he suddenly stopped. You, rushing forward, collided into his back with a thump, and physiological tears welled up in your eyes. You covered your forehead and looked at Tenna turning around with grievance: "It hurts..."
He let out a cold snort: "Endure the pain. Are you blind? Don’t you realize we’ve arrived?"
"How would I know? You didn’t say anything. Should I just guess what you’re thinking?" You glared at him angrily.
Tenna said nothing, turning away, and dryly said: "Next time I’ll tell you."
Then he pushed the door open and walked inside. You recognized it as the room you had come out of not long ago. You took a deep breath and followed. Tenna was standing in front of the photo wall, his back to you.
TBC.

title: down
content:
For some reason, you suddenly feel a bit uneasy, along with a sense of unease rising along with it—it seems to be a subconscious emotion, as if instinct is preventing you from understanding the truth. Perhaps all of that has become a past you don't want to explore.
But...... You can't just be someone who only has the present and the future; you want to know, urgently want to know what kind of past you have.
Tenna lowered his head and looked at you, expressionless: "Do you want to look in order from front to back, or from back to front?" Although either way, the meaning to him is the same, and he might ...... He just hopes he can leave more impressions in your heart. He doesn't want you to forget him; he's afraid that once your memories are overwhelmed by past memories, all that remains is ...... Those past that belong only to you.
“…… Let's go from the back to the front. After all, when I was younger, I probably wouldn't remember clearly." You murmured, after all, recent memories are the freshest and most memorable. You want to first understand your current situation.
Tenna said no more, just led you to the right, then pointed to a photo—your sleeping face lying in bed: "This is a photo of the crime I left behind." ”
You hesitated for a moment, then nodded: "So...... I just need to put my hand on it, right? Is this some kind of photo recording the movie? ”
Tenna nodded as well: "Yes, all these photos are on video. You can just watch them directly." His voice was suppressed, unusually calm, making you feel a bit uncomfortable.
But you still felt timid and didn't dare touch the photo directly. In the end, after hesitating for a moment, you still grabbed Tenna's hand and whispered, "Then...... Can you come with me to see it? ”
Tenna's screen turned pitch black, and he lowered his head to look at you. Actually, he was surprised; he hadn't expected you to make such a request. After all, he was already prepared. Maybe after looking at this photo, you would abandon him, completely abandon him, forget him. That's why he kept you here all the time, because...... He didn't want to. He didn't want to be forgotten by you, he didn't want to be left where you were, nor did he want to watch you stubbornly stay there. You two clearly only have each other left.
"Why?" In the end, he just tried to speak in an incredibly calm voice, and you couldn't detect the slight, almost immeasurable tremors hidden beneath that voice.
"There's no reason. If you really want to find a reason...... That's probably my intuition. My intuition tells me...... It seems that if you stay with me, I'll feel at ease." You whispered, afraid Tenna would hear. After all, you're so restless, you don't want to admit you love Tenna, and you've never confirmed what he said. Even though your actions are almost certain, if you don't say it directly, nothing counts!
“…… Do whatever you want." He finally turned his head in a hurry, after all, he didn't want you to see the screen suddenly lighting up and the handful of flowers uncontrollably appearing at his nose. To be honest, he was indeed overjoyed.
You put your hand into Tenna's hand, then took a deep breath and reached out to touch the photo. In an instant, your thoughts seemed to be drawn far away, to a place you could never measure. That was just a moment, but the next second, you landed in reality, back into the familiar world of light. You seemed like just an observer, or perhaps the girl lying in bed. Now you could calmly and objectively observe all of this. Probably...... It was because no extra emotions flowed in your heart. You only felt a strange, heavy sadness in China, as if silent underwater.
The girl slowly got up, changed her clothes slowly, and opened the door, ready to leave. Her sister was sitting on the sofa, giggling and watching the LCD TV, and your parents were also sitting on the sofa keeping her company.
When they saw you come out, they just glanced up and greeted you briefly. Your mother said indifferently, "Get up and prepare your own breakfast. Your sister is greedy this morning and ate half of your portion. There's nothing you can do about the remaining half. Your dad and I will take care of it." ”
But your father just instinctively frowned and muttered, "You're up so late again. Can you get up earlier next time? You need to develop good living habits...... Otherwise, what will you do about your future work? And many of your classmates went out to work part-time jobs right after the college entrance exam. Can't you learn from them? Why are you just lazing around at home all day? ”
"Count on us to give her money. When you went to college, we only gave you fifteen hundred a month. If it's not enough, don't ask us—we don't have any more money for you." Your mother frowned and glared at her with disgust.
You feel that the girl from back then tries to say something to refute them, but in the end remains silent, just keeps her mouth shut and walks alone to the kitchen to prepare breakfast. After breakfast, she just sits there in a daze.
You look at it all, clutching your chest, feeling that indescribable sadness: "...... Is this my past? Why do you ...... See so much? ”
Tenna pointed to the only appliance in your room that could be considered entertainment—an old TV: "That TV is me. I heard everything." "As for those scenes...... They were just his imagination, added later to the footage.
"I see...... Actually, I think it's okay if they just say that. "If you lower your head, if it were just like this, it might just be simple complaints and nagging, but you would genuinely feel a bit sad.
"But what if you say it every day, and it's like this every day? I told you long ago, they're heartless and treacherous, and you insist on verifying it yourself." Tenna snorted coldly. Actually, he was a bit uneasy too, after all...... He wasn't sure what kind of attitude you would have toward his old TV after you got those memories.
"Seeing is believing, hearing is false." You gave an awkward smile.
The girl from before hugged her knees, silently shedding tears, then turned on the TV. She pressed the remote, turning the volume down to a very low level, probably not wanting to disturb anyone outside. She locked the door, blocking out the laughter and joy outside. The TV was very old and had almost no channels left. No matter how hard I pressed the switch button, I couldn't find a channel I liked, so in the end, I switched to a black-and-white sound movie broadcast.
This movie...... You always feel like you've watched it many times because the plot is very familiar, but no matter how you search, you can't find any memories related to it. It just feels like you can immediately tell how the story will develop next.
You murmured, "Next...... It should be the story where the male lead confesses to the female lead, then the male lead rushes to the battlefield, and the female lead waits in desperation. ”
And what happens next in the film is exactly what you expected. The only difference is that the female lead receives news of the male lead's death and decides to remarry, but unexpectedly, he returns afterward—the plot seems a bit melodramatic.
Tenna also complained, "I don't even know why you liked watching these melodramatic TV shows back then." ”
“…… Maybe it's precisely because these melodramatic dramas are so fake that I can laugh or cry without restraint." That's how you guessed your own thoughts back then. Tenna lowered her head and glanced at you. You were indeed watching the show intently, but the next second, shouting came from outside the door.
"It's lunchtime! Y/N, come out here!" ”
She shouted as she understood as a response, then turned off the TV, opened the door, and walked out.
My mother complained, "You know roughly when we eat. Next time, can't you come out early and wait?" "Every time, we have to call you." ”
Your father glances at you sideways: "Alright, hurry up and wash your hands and get ready to eat. Seriously, every time I have to wait for you for five or ten minutes. The food is about to get cold." ”
There wasn't a single dish on the table that you liked, nor any dish that tasted familiar. You finished the meal in a bland, hurried out, said 'I'm done,' then closed the door and went back to your room, shutting out your parents' scolding from outside.
You rubbed your chin, looked at them in disappointment, and shook your head: "Ah...... So you're not my mom. ”
If only he had. Or...... If only this TV were your family. Although his words can be harsh and his actions sometimes hurt...... But at least, there are many more things that are less heartbreaking.
You were startled by your own thoughts. How could a TV possibly be your own family? You laughed at yourself for being too ridiculous, expecting too much to the point that in the end, you got nothing.
"Of course I can't, it's your mom." Tenna emphasized every word. He was probably annoyed by being called that by you, and you couldn't help but shrink your neck.
After returning to her room, the girl hugged her knees tightly and sat on the bed again, turned on the TV, and continued from where she had paused. This was probably one of the few entertainment activities she had.
Then, the scene ends here. You blink in a daze, stand in front of the photo wall, and reach out. Sika's consciousness tries to touch the other photo beside you, but Tenna grabs her hand.
"It's this one. Are you out of your mind? You can't even figure out the order." Following the red line posted on the photo wall, there really is another photo below, and the one you just touched...... Coincidentally, it doesn't connect to any photo, not with any red thread at all.
You awkwardly said, "I thought the closest was ......."
But you still follow Tenna's words and move on to the next photo.
TBC.
You closed your eyes, and after that wave of dizziness passed, you ...... again. You stood on that familiar ground. This time, you clearly realized that this seemed to be the house you were living in now.
But why are the walls pitch black? Why does furniture decoration always feel a bit out of place? You never thought about these issues before, but now—you know the truth.
Because even if it was just a shadow, you could feel the scorching heat; the rising flames were like surging waves threatening to swallow you whole. Standing in this sea of fire, you just kept floating and sinking, watching the fire with some stiffness. Instinctively, you wanted to run away, but couldn't move at all. You could only instinctively lean toward Tenna beside you, because for some reason—he seemed very cold.
And you could only barely regain some consciousness by him, and naturally saw your parents anxiously running out the door with your sister, but they didn't pay attention to the tightly shut room, as if no one cared about you.
You fell silent, lowering your gaze, your other hand grabbing Tenna's sleeve, your voice trembling: "Can you ...... Can you leave this memory? I... I don't want to keep watching...... "You don't want to keep dwelling on painful memories, nor torment yourself with past pain and sorrow. Besides, you already understand what happens next."
The girl leaned against the only still-cold television, not touched by the scorching heat, crying helplessly until the metal casing was also stained by the flames. With nowhere to go, wrapped in flames and choking smoke, she fainted, until firefighters arrived, extinguished the house's flames, and rescued you. The TV was also scarred by the flames. But from then on...... You could no longer care about anything else; most of the time, you just sat there blankly, unresponsive.
And what comes next? You can't remember the specifics clearly, but you don't want to keep watching.
Tenna silently glanced at you, then irritably covered your eyes with his hand: "Alright, if you don't want to watch, then don't. But we can't leave until this memory is finished playing." ”
You shook your head and nodded, burying your head in his huge hand, letting tears silently slide down before wetting Tenna's gloves. He was silent for a while, the screen pitch black, and he had no idea what he was thinking. In the end, he just looked up at the tightly closed door, and then at you inside the room.
…… At least now, he can stand beside you, and he can do what he used to do but just stand by blankly and do nothing. He doesn't care—he doesn't care how you see it, or how others see it. After all, it's just an unimportant thing, and Tenna knows he'...... To you, maybe it's just a TV.
So does he really feel indifferent? No, he's unwilling to accept it. Anton Tenna won't let all this happen, so he gently rubs your face with his palm, then softly holds your hand with his other hand, pulling you into his arms. Tall and broad, the embrace a bit cold, but you can almost hear the heart beating within the machine, as if ...... You can feel just how warm his heart is.
You don't mind this embrace; in fact, you're a bit flattered. You might think Tenna wouldn't do that.
But you just reached out and carefully hugged him as well. You could hear the girl's suppressed crying in the room, and uncontrollably, more and more tears welled up in your eyes. At first, you just sobbed softly, Anton Tenna awkwardly reached out to pat your head, then gently patted your back. Then you couldn't help but start crying out loud, as if you wanted to vent all your past emotions, helplessness, and grievances together, because you know, now...... At least one TV is truly listening to you cry. You know you're no longer alone, no longer having to endure all this alone.
If ...... If only he could always be by your side. Even though you were startled by your thought, because you knew that if he returned to the world of light, he'd just be an ordinary TV and wouldn't be able to interact with you.
