No one restarts the ship, and no one brings back your corpse, so...... You can only restart the game, and this game counts as your loss.
You sniff, trying to comfort yourself that it was all okay—after all, this was only the first round, and you just needed to start one more round. But the next second, you noticed your perspective changed to another character, who pressed a button, transported your corpse back to the ship, and started the ship, which meant you could proceed to the second level.
But...... Wait, where did this person come from? You widened your eyes, your body trembling uncontrollably. Could it be haunted? You couldn't help but ask, "Who... who are you?" Your voice was still trembling.
Maybe it's just your imagination. You seem to see the TV's antenna slightly shake, and when you rub your eyes and look again, the antenna remains the same. Instead, the TV screen goes black, then a mosaic flashes, and then the screen lights up with characters of varying sizes, like characters taken from various news reports and other programs. You barely piece together the words the TV shows you: "anton...... tenna？ ”
You seem to see the TV's antenna trembling slightly. If it's a ghost, then you're really quite scared. After all, you've heard plenty of stories, and you definitely don't want to be involved with ghosts. Otherwise, what would Grandma do if she was left here all alone? But if it were just this TV...... Although the phenomenon was a bit strange, you could still accept it, since the TV had been with you for a long time—at least that's what you think.
"So...... Are you the TV you have? "But to be safe, you still asked a bit more. What if it's just a haunted trick trying to trick you? Even though if the potion is sincere about tricking you, you probably have no way to do it......
The TV screen was black-and-white mosaic again, and then a big hook pattern flashed on the screen. Anyway, you breathed a sigh of relief and were quite excited—your TV was conscious! Of course, you knew this couldn't be told to others, but since it was a little secret between you and your family—you had to admit, you still felt a bit nervous.
So you ask again, "Can you play games with me?" This time, the TV just redraws the matching hook. You excitedly shout 'yes,' and then the TV screen switches back—it's the same game as before. The difference is you have a teammate, but they probably won't talk to you.
You still chose the factory from earlier. You still have some resentment toward the slime that trapped you. This time, Tenna was the one who got off the ship with you, but you entered the factory directly from the entrance, while he detoured outside the factory and entered through another secure entrance.
You excitedly start licking the room—no, it's just collecting supplies. This time, you find the same surprise box as last time, an abandoned TV, and a countdown that starts counting down as soon as you pick it up...... It shows something called a bomb.
Then, before you even realize it, there was a loud boom—your character was blown to death.
You widened your eyes, staring blankly at your fallen body and the changing camera angles, quickly shouting, "Tenna!" Tenna！ "Hurry back to the spaceship, I'm already dead. You can't die anymore......"
He also carried a few things down and returned to the spaceship. It looked like a toy dog and a battery box. Then he finally started the ship and flew away. His corpse was summoned back by him, and it was time to choose the next location.
After a glance, you still feel a lingering fear, and decide not to choose a factory again. Instead, you choose another place with a higher mortality rate and resource rates—an abandoned villa.
When you arrive, you excitedly rush down: "Alright, I don't believe there's anything in this room that can stop me!" You grab the shovel and run off excitedly. Tenna's character follows you calmly into the villa.
Hmm...... Gift boxes, discarded cards, battery boxes, and even an abandoned TV here...... You muttered, but in the end, you struggled to carry the valuable abandoned TV outside. Then, you heard a clicking sound from the first floor of the villa, like some kind of wood twisting. You went out to take a look and saw it was a soldier patrolling there—apparently called the Nutcracker. You were startled and instinctively stood there, but the Nutcracker aimed its gun at you. Before you could react, you saw Tenna already behind the Nutcracker, swung a shovel a few times, stunned him, and knocked him to the ground, ending your crisis.
You exhale, beaming with joy: "Thank you, tenna! I thought I was going to die there...... Good thing you're here! ”
The screen didn't switch, only showing lines of character by word after a long time. I don't know if it was some kind of good word pieced together from some news report: "It's okay." This is what I should do. ”
“…… Then you have to keep protecting me all the time. I really don't want to die for no reason anymore." You said coquettishly. While you were there, you ran out with Tenna and threw the things back on the spaceship. You don't want to die and still have nothing to retrieve, making a wasted trip.
The TV was quiet, with only the hum of the heat. You might think it wouldn't answer you, but in the end, a line of text slowly popped up on the screen: "Mm, I will always protect you, forever." ”
Forever.
You don't know, you just gave a silly smile to this TV: "Yeah, it's a deal!" Pinky swear, hanging for a hundred years, no change—wait, you can't pinky that. "You stuck out your tongue, a little embarrassed.
At that moment, your ship started up again, and the TV screen went pitch black again. Then, a grin flashed across the screen, leaving you a bit stunned. Instinctively, you leaned over and gently patted Tenna's shell: "Stop laughing, it's so scary!" ”
So the TV put away that smile, leaving only the game screen, and the antenna seemed to bend down a bit...... Maybe it felt a bit wronged?
Either way, you remember that was the first real conversation between you and your home TV.
TBC.
Since then...... You always take advantage of grandma being away to talk to the TV by yourself. After all, you don't dare talk when someone else is around—what if they think you're crazy? But when you're bored, you still turn on the TV and play games with Tenna. He becomes your silent companion, and all of this feels like a secret between you two.
However...... It still happens occasionally
After all, even though you're a bit weak, you love playing and really enjoy puzzle games. Many single-player puzzle games are played by just one person. You struggle to control the console and spin the screen, but no matter how hard you try, you can't find a real way to clear the level. At this point, Tenna seems to be unable to take it anymore. Somehow, he picked out a red circle and placed it in the spot where you couldn't find the right spot after searching for ages.
You were a bit unhappy, and grandma wasn't home either, so you pouted and spoke up: "Why do you need to hint me!" I just wanted to think it over myself, and only when I figured out the answer would I be the happiest...... If you hint me now, wouldn't that ruin everything! ”
The TV screen went black, then turned bright white, struggling to type one character after another: "But...... I think you should need help? If you can't see it all along...... I think I should have hinted you instead. ”
At this moment, Tenna spoke in a polite tone, but you pouted, threw away the game controller, and started rolling on the floor throwing a tantrum: "I don't care, I don't care, I don't care, I don't like it anyway, it's all your fault! Why did you suddenly give me a hint? I never asked you for it!" ”
The TV was silent, only the hum of the cooling was heard. You wondered if you'd gone too far, and feeling guilty, you straightened up and was about to apologize, only to notice its antenna was bent. The screen was trying hard to type a line as fast as possible: "...... Sorry, next time I'll wait until you ask me." ”
You blinked, not expecting him to say that, and couldn't help but feel even more justified. You nodded as if it were only natural: "Yes, that's right! Don't give me a hint before I asked, or it makes me look silly......" You whispered, "Tenna might have heard that, or maybe she didn't. You're not sure."
This little episode passed quickly. You continued playing the game with great enthusiasm, eager to know how the game would end. But after smoothly clearing the room, you got stuck again. Holding the prop in your hand, you didn't know what to do for a moment. You clicked on each object carefully and tried to observe it, but still couldn't find the right direction. The game had no prompts, and the TV was quiet, just like an ordinary object.
You're a bit annoyed and can't help but start pointing and pointing again: "Tenna, why didn't you give me any hints? I just searched for ages and still couldn't find the answer......
The TV screen flashed for a moment, then slowly typed a line: "But...... You just told me I didn't need to remind you? ”
You cleared your throat twice, realizing you did say that earlier, and changing it now would seem a bit shameless—but you don't care! Anyway, this is your TV, so of course you need to know your preferences!
So you pursed your lips again: "I don't care, you can tell, right? I'm not in the mood to study this now, so you should give me a hint, right?" Just now...... Hmm, I was still interested in continuing to study that puzzle, so you shouldn't have given me a hint! ”
You spoke so confidently, but the TV probably didn't know how to respond. For a while, no new text appeared on the screen, almost making you anxious enough to go back up and film the TV again, until it slowly pieced together a yes.
So you nod in satisfaction, but still pat the TV with your hand: "Yeah, I knew it—you're my best friend!" Hmm...... Probably the only friend? ”
The TV's antenna stood upright again, slowly typing some characters on the screen, finally piecing together into one word: Forever?
And you definitely nodded: "Forever!" Hmm...... Speaking of which, "forever friends" is a bit strange, isn't it? I've never had friends...... But as long as we can always be together, that's enough, right? I roughly know—friends, family, lovers, all that...... As long as we can always be together, that's enough. "As you spoke, your eyes curved with a smile and you reached out both hands to give the TV a hug. You really don't know how to distinguish these words, nor how to properly express this kind of feeling.
But you know, at least you feel joy for it, and that's enough.
As for everything else—you don't care at all! No matter what your identity is, you'll always be together, right?
You shout that TV should be your bride because you hear other classmates say that if you get married, you'll be closer and spend your whole life together. You think you'll be together for life...... But you're curious—you really want to be closer, which is why you say that.
In short, you always like to act mischievous with Tenna, venting all the childish charm you've hidden from being mature onto him. You're happy, and Tenna seems happy too—well, you can't really tell the mood on TV, but every time you play around with him, you always lean over and kiss his screen.
Grandma occasionally kisses your cheek, so you copy the example and kiss Tenna too. But every time you kiss him and touch his screen, you'll find it gets even hotter.
Over time, Tenna became skilled at reading your expressions. He didn't even need you to say a word to know roughly what your next move would be, and skillfully displayed the prompts you needed on the screen.
Occasionally, when rushing homework and encountering problems you don't understand, you pester Tenna to show the solving process on the screen, assuming he can solve these childish problems.
…… Then, at that moment, a line of text will appear on his screen, blankly asking: "Why don't you solve it yourself?" ”
You confidently put your hands on your hips and said, "Because I don't know how!" ”
Ahem, although you say this is just child's play, it's precisely because you can't solve it that you ask Tenna!
The TV fell silent for a moment. You stared nervously at the screen, and then, Tenna, somehow managed to extract those symbols, actually displayed the problem-solving process on the screen. You scanned it and immediately understood, so you quickly wrote it down.
"I knew you could solve problems! Next time I come across a question I can't handle...... I'll come to ask you directly! "You said happily, writing down the answers to the last few fill-in-the-blank questions. Honestly, it's actually okay to take it over and ask your other classmates, but for you...... Building good relationships with others is really hard. You don't really want to talk to others, but just sitting here talking with Tenna is a very comfortable thing.
Sometimes you wonder if it's just your imagination, but when you look at the problems that can only be solved under Tenna's guidance, you firmly believe they are not hallucinations.
You originally thought that such a relaxed and joyful day, with a bit of monotony, would keep repeating.
Until that day.
Grandma...... Suddenly, that day you collapsed. When you cryed and rushed your grandmother to the hospital, you found she had already passed away. The hospital also sadly notified your family that your loved one had passed away.
You carried the small urn home, crying until you fainted. When you woke up again, a strange couple came to your door, saying they were your parents and wanted to take you back. It turned out your grandmother knew she didn't have much time left, so she went to the place where she found you, asked around for a long time, and finally found your biological parents. She handed you over to them.
You hold the TV, unwilling to leave alone with them, insisting on bringing it with you.
“…… A broken TV? What's the use of this thing? "Your mother raised her eyebrows high, looking surprised.
"This is my only family...... you sniffled and cried.
"Family?" "Is this the only thing?" Are you ......?" Your mother hesitated, your heart sinking. You thought, I really did think you were crazy.
Your father tried to smooth things over: "Forget it, if the child likes it, just take it home. It's just a TV after all. The child doesn't have many companions here, and after going back, he'll be fine for a while." ”
In the end, you still bring the TV back with you and solemnly put it in your room. You still chat with Tenna, but you have to be very careful when you do, after all...... You definitely don't want others in the family to find out.
But no matter how careful you are, you can't stop the child's curiosity. Parents usually go out to work, and you relax a bit while chatting with Tenna. After transferring to this school, you still don't have many friends, and even after entering high school, it's the same—you seem to be isolated without leaving a trace. Thin threads don't matter, as long as Tenna is with you.
You hugged your knees and sat on the floor, watching the door warily to make sure that little sister wasn't eavesdropping at the door before daring to talk to Tenna, quietly complaining about her recent life: "...... Honestly, the recent physics test is way too hard. I can't even answer the last two questions......
After a moment, the TV screen slowly typed a line: "So you admit it. Did you make yourself stupid before?" ”
“…… I didn't admit it! Besides, my liberal arts grades are always very good, so maybe I'm ...... Just not really suited for calculations or anything...... You blushed and denied it, then your voice grew quieter and quieter.
But suddenly, a voice came from the doorway, filled with surprise: "Wow, sister is actually talking to the TV!" ”
Your pupils contracted slightly. You instinctively stood up to stop her, but she had already run to the open-door door and threw herself into mother's arms: "Sister is talking to the TV she brought back!" ”
TBC.
In that instant, you felt as if all your blood was rushing and nothing but coldness remained, and your mind was completely blank. Instinctively, you stood up and blocked the TV behind you. Before you could say anything, your mother walked straight up and slapped you across the face, making your face twist and leaving you stunned.
She said with a tone of heartbreak, "How do I have a crazy daughter like you? If you want to go crazy, go ahead. Don't lead your sister astray, okay?" ”
You opened your mouth, not knowing what to say, just instinctively said, "I don't have ......."
Before he could finish, your father interrupted him. He frowned, "Enough, forget about whether you have it or not. Don't you know how to pretend better?" ”
Your face turned pale as you stared in disbelief at your father and mother, while they simply gathered around your sister and started caring for her, slamming the door shut with a heavy thrust. You slid slowly to the floor as if exhausted, kneeling on the ground, your knees aching, but you couldn't care about that—after all, the grievances and pain in your heart were far more painful than your physical pain.
You don't know why your parents do this, you don't understand, only the TV, still keeping a bit of warmth behind you, lets your cold body draw some strength from it.
Gradually, you shift into sitting on the ground with your hands hugging your knees, chatting idly with the TV: "I...... Are you really sick? ”
Tenna was very excited, typing several big words on the TV screen quickly: "No, you didn't!! ”
You softly hummed in response, even if you didn't need to look at the screen to know the answer. You just whispered, "...... You don't need to comfort me anymore. I know that to them, to this world, I am abnormal. ”
"......" You hear some crackling sounds. Maybe Tenna is piecing together characters again, but you don't care, nor do you know what he's actually written.
You just say to yourself, "...... If only I could live in another world." But that's only if—in such a world, how could there be another world? All the education you've received has taught you this.
You still didn't look at the answer on the TV screen, just sat there with your back to the screen, dazed. Your parents didn't call you out to eat, and you didn't pay much attention, just gradually drifted off to sleep.
When you woke up again, you were awakened by the heat, followed by thick black smoke that made you cough a few times, tears welling up in your eyes. The room was very hot; you could almost see waves of heat flowing, but there was no fire burning inside—it looked like it was burning outside. It looked like there was a raging fire outside the door, and you had no chance of escaping from this room. As the carbon dioxide increased, your vision darkened. You could only hold the still-cold Tenna to try to cool down, but amid the thick black smoke, you still lost consciousness.
…… When you wake up again, you are in the hospital. You don't recognize anyone, not even the person who claims to be your parents. The doctor said you fainted, and when you fell, there was blood congestion in your brain, which affected your memory.
Your parents moved you to another home, but you refused. For some reason, you insisted on staying in the old room, and you just felt...... What was truly important to you? In the end, they left you here to live alone. You always sat in the room, lost in thought. You did see characters on the TV, probably asking how you'd been lately, but you only treated those as hallucinations after a fire. After all, how could the TV be conscious? You always treated it as your own delusion and never paid attention to what was said on TV.
Gradually, the TV also quieted down, no longer making any noise.
In fact, you don't really understand why you live. You are just living, just learning, just moving forward. You don't understand the meaning of this until you get into university and on the day you receive your admission letter, curiously stepping into your bedroom, which is somehow filled with black smoke.
—Then, you came into this world, and from the moment you saw him, you fell irresistibly in love with Tenna. But you never had the courage to say this somewhat bittersweet feeling.
He always mocks you, and you always forgive him even though you cry, and then you repeat the same process over and over. Perhaps it's time to break this cycle.
After all, now that you've stepped out of the exit, you're standing again in your room, looking at that TV that was once abandoned, with its antenna wrapped in bandages after your careful repairs, and through the reflection on the screen, you see yourself.
Then you slightly bent down and hugged the TV.
“…… Tenna, long time no see." Your voice choked with emotion. You sniffled, wanting to cry, but mostly guilt. So you had ignored Tenna for so long, missed so many words from him in the past, but you felt his antenna gently touch you, then you lowered your hand and looked at his screen.
“…… Just a minute ago, we parted ways. Did your memory have trouble again? ”
You break into a smile through your tears, wipe your own tears, and even though he's become like this because of neglect in previous years—it's okay, Tenna is Tenna.
"I didn't, I just ...... Talking about myself at fifteen, and with you, long time no see. ”
After saying this, the TV screen went pitch black again, and then he slowly typed a few words.
“…… Long time no see. So, are you here to fulfill your promise back then? ”
You know what he's talking about—he's talking about the promise you made to always be together, the promise you made to make TV the bride.
And you nod vigorously, wiping away your tears: "Yes, I've come to fulfill my promise, I love you...... tenna。 As you spoke, your voice quieted and your face turned red, but you awkwardly lowered your head and scratched your own face.
You touch the outer shell of the Tenna, and it seems a bit hot too.
"Alright." This time, he quickly agreed to your request.
You rummage through your closets and find a poorly fitting black suit in the house. Put it on, then find a white tulle dress and veil, and cover Tenna with a wedding dress. This is a mismatched bride TV, a wedding that is also out of place. After all—this isn't a proper marriage, nor a serious audience, only you two take it seriously.
You cleared your throat and simply went ahead to deliver a piece of completely made-up wedding vows: "Whether in health or in sickness, whether in wealth or in poverty, whether in happiness or in sorrow, I will always be by Tenna's side. I vow to present all the beauty and joy to you and me. I vow to cherish this relationship, whether it be friendship, love, or family affection. I vow... to always be with Tenna, because this is a unique, special television on which I have invested infinite feelings. Because this will be my only friend, family, and lover."
After saying this, you hurriedly hung a relatively large, crude plain ring on Tenna's antenna. Forgive yourself—you had been searching for these items for a long time.
Then you kissed Tenna.
He seemed to be stunned for a moment, and then text quickly flashed across the screen in various combinations: "Whether in health or in sickness, whether in aging or in poverty, Anton Tenna will always be by Y/N's side. Anton Tenna is and will only be Y/N's family, friend, and lover."
You waited until the characters finished flashing, then put a ring on your own left ring finger as well. Then, feeling a bit embarrassed, you scratched your cheek and leaned in to kiss Tenna again. You could feel his screen and casing heating up, while you just smiled sincerely, removed the mismatched veil, and then put it on your own head.
After a while, you saw another line of text appear on the TV screen: "...I love you. I love you with all my heart."
And you just nodded, because you had known this truth for a long time, and you smiled as you said: "I love you too."
Then you touched the TV's antenna, finally reconciling all your inner knots, and walked briskly toward the entrance of the dark world. It was time to go back—it was time to see the true other side of your lover.
With this thought, you quickened your pace and ran through the gate of the dark world, then fell into an embrace.
You looked up to see it was Anton Tenna, still with a tense, expressionless face, and you noticed that his left ring finger was wearing that somewhat large ring. You thought these plain rings were probably bought by your fifteen-year-old self during a youthful crush—ah, indeed they were, because back then you were nervously planning how exactly you would marry the television.
You just smiled and tiptoed. Tenna still looked unhappy, but he obediently lowered his head. You put the veil on his head, looking a bit mismatched.
You just smiled, lifting your eyebrows: "Tenna... how about we have another wedding?" This time there would be an audience: all the employees of the TV world would be spectators at this wedding.
Tenna just silently nodded, staring down at you, then coughed twice. He lowered his head to bite your lips, lightly sucking twice before letting go, and hugged you tightly, as if you might run away in the blink of an eye.
You, on tiptoe, held the TV's head in both hands and kissed the screen, smiling: "Mm, I love you too."
END.

title: Trainee Boyfriend 1 (tennax you)
content:
You rested your chin on your hand, watching the CG on the screen—Tenna proposing to the protagonist...... After quickly finishing the story, you closed the game. Honestly, this was a very fun otome game recommended by your best friend to you recently. Although your interest in otome games isn't great, you downloaded it after her strong recommendation.
But you regret playing it for just a while...... After all, it doesn't seem much different from other otome games, except for an extra option to input personal dialogue. You guess the built-in AI might have replied to your words, but you quickly lose interest.
After all, playing otome games is always like this: choosing the right options, the right gifts, the right actions, and coincidental timing can smoothly boost affection. After all, every game character set up has their own set of values and preferences. Rather than saying the male lead in an otome game falls in love with you, it's more accurate to say he falls in love with the self who disguises himself and matches his preferences.
So you quickly got bored and figured out the preferences of this TV head named tenna, quickly finished the strategy, and planned to quit immediately. Although you don't know why if you choose to type dialogues yourself, no matter what you say, it will increase your favorability, but later you don't bother to talk anymore. You're naturally a quiet person who doesn't like to talk much.
So you choose the option based on the preferences you previously guessed. And now, you close the game window and plan to uninstall it. You uninstall successfully, then you hold your phone, planning to go out for lunch and complain to your best friend that the game isn't that fun at all.
Before leaving, you glanced at the dusty appliances sitting in the corner...... You bought them out of boredom, probably with a CRT TV or something else. You originally planned to play games on it, but it turned out computers suited your preferences better—at least they weren't that heavy.
You lowered your head and typed rapidly on your phone, then walked out of the room, casually made yourself some instant noodles, and brought it home, planning to sit in front of the computer to eat.
You were startled as soon as you walked into the room, nearly spilling your instant noodles. Fortunately, you remembered that the mess would be hard to clean if you did, so you didn't let go. You just pretended to stay calm as you looked at tenna, who had suddenly appeared in your room, crouching yet still looking very tall, and seemingly feeling wronged.
…… And when you walk in, it shrinks to about the size of other pet dogs, then slowly walks up to your side, seemingly wanting to rub against your leg. In the middle of summer, your legs do feel like a cold metal sheet now. But actually, it does dissipate heat.
You cover your forehead with your free other hand, feeling a bit of a headache and trouble. In fact, at first you wondered if you were dreaming, but it turned out you pinched your own face—it hurt.
So it probably wasn't a dream. You kept a calm face, but your mind was blank. You brought the noodles over and set them on the table, then lowered your head to look at Tenna.
“…… Mr. Tenna, I think I've already unlocked your ending—it's a perfect ending." "That's exactly what you don't understand the most. After all, you have OCD. You haven't cleared any of the other bad endings, only this one perfect ending."
Tenna looks up at you. Actually, he has many questions he wants to ask, like saying that at first you were still talking to him and he was happy to be able to communicate with you, but why did you end up choosing those options instead...... He can only watch you through the narrow screen, unable to take any action. Even those conversations are preset, so all he can see is your increasingly uninterested expression, feeling inexplicably anxious.
He wants to ask why you stopped talking to him, why you only quickly got through the ending, or even stop looking at him, he wants to ask why you just uninstalled the game......
But in the end, You just asked, "...... You just uninstalled the game, so what about our married life? ”
While eating the noodles, you almost choked up when you heard this. Luckily, you swallowed it with difficulty, or you would have sprayed the noodles on the computer screen. But the price was that after eating, you still coughed dryly many times.
A glass of water appeared beside you. You glanced at Tenna, who had suddenly grown larger, but said nothing more. You just took the cup and drank a sip, barely suppressing the choking sensation.
Only then did you clear your throat and say, "Does this game system even have a post-marriage mode?" "You're genuinely confused. You didn't see it when downloading, nor did you see it when you cleared the ending. You just returned to the big screen after the happy end message appeared."
He fell into an awkward, subtle silence, and you patiently waited for a moment before he finally spoke: "No, but can you come back and see me a bit more?" "Just being watched a little longer by you makes Tenna feel satisfied."
You looked at him carefully for a while longer, eating instant noodles while mumbling a bit unclearly, "Why should I go back to see you more often?" ”
“…… I thought you liked me a lot." He lowered his head, clearly thinking so, since his voice sounded very dejected and his figure was shrinking.
You were genuinely surprised at this moment. Although watching him shrink made you feel a subtle pity, you still asked, "Why should I like you?" ”
Honestly, you just find this character fairly cute and don't have much to dislike, so you're willing to understand his ending. But if you say you like him, you can't quite say how much you like him.
But you can also understand why he has that idea, so you say, "Well, I understand why you think that way, but I don't think it's necessary." ”
"After all, in the end, the choices I made were just options that matched the character's preferences and pleasing them. I just created a virtual and hypocritical image you might like. You don't need to question the real me, nor do I have to like you." You said calmly, taking another sip of water.
You see his screen suddenly turn pitch black—maybe he's lost in thought. But you're not in a hurry. After waiting a while, his screen lights up again. You see his lips seem to move, but after a while, he finally utters a complete sentence: "But...... I've always seen it. I like you, I like the real you. ”
"I don't understand why you like me...... There must be some reason for this kind of longing, right? "You tilted your head and asked this question.
Tenna hesitated for a moment, but finally shook his head. In fact, he didn't understand the reason either. He only knew that he loved the feeling of being watched by you. As long as you kept watching him, he felt satisfied. But over time, he wasn't satisfied with just watching. You looked at him, and he looked at you. He wanted more touch, wanted to touch the real you, wanted to talk to you, not just watch you through a narrow screen.
In fact, it was only after you uninstalled the game that he suddenly realized he had this privilege. Using that old CRT as a medium, he came into this world, sat across from you, and had this conversation with you.
You found it a bit amusing, and for some reason, he looked a bit nervous at this moment. You clearly couldn't see his eyes, but his fingers resting on his knees kept fidgeting, probably feeling uneasy.
Then you cleared your throat and said solemnly, "Alright, I still don't understand why you like me. But I want to tell you something seriously...... Just because you like me doesn't mean I have to like you. Whether I like you or not is my natural and genuine choice. In fact, I chose you as my game strategy target just because you look pleasing to the eye. Maybe I have some affection, but it's far from liking you. ”
You watch Tenna lower his head, lowering it more and more, and you watch him shrink again, eventually becoming the size of a pet dog, silently pressing against your calf. You seem to feel a bit moist...... Probably from the direction of the screen. So even TVs can cry? You wonder this in a daze.
"But the fact that you like me has nothing to do with me, so I won't ask about it anymore............ But I think I can still give you a chance." "You thought about it and felt a bit unwilling, because for some reason, you can't be sure that this affection and love truly exist. You only want a definite love that can be confirmed. If not, then it's better never to have it.
After hearing this, Tenna grew bigger again, sitting across from you, looking at you longingly. You just felt that at this moment, you should describe him that way.
You solemnly reached out a hand to him: "You can try and make me like you too. Or at least, let me feel your love...... Come to think of it, I don't even know what this counts as. Maybe it's called an apprentice boyfriend? "You thought for a moment.
Tenna quickly reached out a hand, his palm large, tightly wrapping your hand inside, unwilling to let go.
"Of course, I'm willing to do it." He said this, and you couldn't help but laugh a little, feeling like he spoke like a wedding vow. Then, as if noticing he was holding too hard, he hurriedly let go again.
But you just took his hand and gently shook it, looking relaxed: "Alright, then, trainee boyfriend, nice to meet you." ”
Tbc.
I don't know if I'll continue writing this post, but if not, it would actually be nice to stop here (glance distracted).

title: Trainee Boyfriend 2 (tennax you)
content:
Calling it an intern, calling it a boyfriend, in reality, you're never used to having someone else at home—and a TV personality. After you finish, you quickly start rummaging through your slightly cold noodles. You're still a bit hungry, and you've only just eaten a few bites—just as you were about to pick up the noodle bucket, Tenna reached out and took your noodles away.
You looked at Tenna. He had been smiling, but now seeing you looking at him with a blank expression, he just clasped his hands behind his back and lowered his head slightly: "Oh...... Darling, I don't know if I can call you that. But...... But since we're in this relationship now, I think I can't let you eat such unhealthy stuff anymore. "As he spoke, you heard a sound—you saw that your bucket of instant noodles had been thrown into the trash by Tenna.
You silently glanced at the bucket of instant noodles, then looked up at Tenna. Your tone was calm, but there was a hint of curiosity: "Hmm...... So you're planning to make me something to eat yourself?" You asked, and Tenna just nodded happily. He raised his head high on the TV again, and you saw a flower blooming from his nose, exactly like when you saw him happy in the game.
Then he wandered to the kitchen to prepare something for you...... You didn't say anything more, just opened your phone to check if any romantic characters from the game had appeared. It turned out you hadn't found anything, so you didn't believe it and simply posted a message.
[Poster: I once played a dating game following a friend's advice. Now this protagonist who was being conquered suddenly jumps out and says he wants to win me over. What should I do? 】
[First floor: Are you joking, OP...... Daydreaming too much? How could a paper person possibly become real? 】
[Second floor: The most important thing now is to eat pasta mixed with No. 42 concrete. 】
[Third floor: Not sure, but I suggest you discuss with this character and let him return to the game. 】
[Fourth floor: Probably just riding the hype. There have been a lot of domestic otome games lately............ Maybe they're advertising some game, like promoting interactivity or something similar. 】
[Poster: This isn't an advertisement, it's real, it's a TV personality...... I don't even know how his consciousness became real on the items in my home......]
[Fifth Floor: OP, are you shipping on it? Either you're shipping on it, it's just shipping it—there's no other possibility.]
[Sixth floor: I still think the original poster is advertising......]
[Original poster: This really isn't an ad, and I didn't use any drugs......]
……
[100th floor: Then OP, you should think about how to get along well with this guy! Maybe the person who comes out of the strategy game will be some ruthless killer or criminal...... OP, be careful. 】
You put down your phone because you hear the crisp sound of dishes on the dining table.
You walk over and take a look. Tenna is nervously rubbing his hands, clearly not quite used to it...... Well, cold sweat is even dripping down his screen. You know, he's like this in games too—whenever he prepares something for you, he always shows a very nervous state before you can see it...... There's really nothing to do to persuade him.
You look at the table, where a simple fried egg, a bowl of pasta with ketchup, and a steak topped with plenty of black pepper sauce are all set up in the game—well, it's basically the same setup in the game, a simple but truly filling lunch.
You sit down and pick up your knife and fork to try to cut the steak, but after a long while, you still can't succeed. Tenna snatches the knife and fork from your hand: "Oh darling, let me do it instead......" He says this, and you start to break out in a cold sweat on his screen again, looking extremely nervous.
You watch Tenna effortlessly cut the steak into small pieces, exactly like the method you told him to do in the game. Then Tenna looks at you anxiously, probably waiting for your opinion. You watch as his antenna bends and hangs down, the tail of the wire behind him sways anxiously, and he just asks urgently, "What do you think?" ”
You didn't answer him, just picked up a piece of steak and chewed it. Then you instinctively frowned—oh my god, there's way too much black pepper sauce, that sticky texture and salty flavor filling your mouth, and not only that...... The steak must be overcooked, no wonder you couldn't cut it just now...... But Tenna's grip was stronger, so of course he cut it off. You chewed for a while before finally finishing the steak, then glanced at the table and hurriedly gulped down the milk—this was probably Tenna had just brought it, warm, and the taste was just right, at least you were willing to drink it.
You took a few deep breaths, watching Tenna, unable to get your answer, her antenna drooping even lower, just hanging above the screen. His screen was pitch black, and it seemed his figure had shrunk a little.
You hesitate for a moment—in the game, you always lie to him saying it tastes good, even though every prompt tells you it tastes terrible. But after all, you haven't really eaten it, so you always choose to lie to him. And now...... Well, you choose to be honest, since now he's trying to win your love, he wants to win you over: "It tastes terrible. First, the black pepper sauce on the steak was oversprinkled, making it especially salty, and because there's too much sauce, it's thick and sticky." Then there's the steak, you cooked it over...... Oh, or maybe you even got a bit burnt? That's really ...... A rare texture, well, at least this kind of song has a very fresh texture. "You bluntly shared your comment, and after hearing your comment, Tenna still stood with his hands behind his back, his head seemingly lowered...... And it seemed he was getting smaller and smaller.
You heard Tenna's snoring voice: "But...... But didn't you always say I made delicious food before? ”
"The past is the past, and the present is now. I'm playing games, and to win you over, of course I'll pick the option you like...... But now, I don't need to win you over; it's just that simple. If you just like me saying nice things...... Then I suggest you go back. "You blinked and said, although you think such words sound a bit heartless...... But, however, this kind of development will be good for both of you.
Tenna curled up to a tiny one, about the size of a pet dog, then slowly lifted his foot and walked over to your side. Although his voice was very quiet at the moment, you could hear him clearly, since the room was very quiet at this moment—"No, I...... I won't go back. I've told you, what I love is the real you, or rather, what I want to love is the real you...... I won't leave you. So...... Please, don't ...... Leave me behind......" As he spoke, his voice grew softer and softer, and you rested your chin on his hand as you looked at Tenna, who was carefully tugging at your pant leg, and finally couldn't help but sigh.
You can't help but ask, "What exactly do you like about me? Why do you love me?" I'm really curious...... I really don't understand why you're so persistent. "Alright, seeing him like this, you can't help but feel a bit soft-hearted...... Indeed, the moment you close the game, you resolutely abandon him, so it's probably normal for him to want to be by your side just to ask for something.
“…… No reason, I just want to love you." He said, somewhat stammering...... At least you felt his voice sounded a bit muffled.
"How could there be no reason? What exactly do you love about me? I don't think there's anything cute about me...... You frown, biting into the hard steak, finally finishing the whole piece. Then you start to fry the egg. The egg is a bit burnt, though the taste is okay...... Hmm, you added a bit too much sugar. Could it be that this guy really thinks he likes sweets?
"I love all of you, for no reason." Tenna emphasized. And you look down at him, and it doesn't seem like he's lying, even though you don't really believe it...... Maybe ask him later, but you don't believe it...... There will be people who love you for no reason. But you didn't say it out loud, just responded coldly.
After a pause, you spoke again: "And then...... This fried egg is a bit burnt. Next time, pay attention to the heat. Also, I'm not that fond of sweets, so you can use less sugar. ”
"But...... But in the game, didn't you say you liked sweets...... His voice sounded a bit anxious and trembling, and you just sighed.
"Because there are only four options: sour, sweet, bitter, and salty, and I prefer spicy food...... Hmm, you didn't include that option among your options. "As you spoke, you shrugged. Although it was too sweet for you, you still ate the fried egg, and finally you picked up the bowl of pasta. Fortunately, the texture of the pasta was pretty good...... Hmm, you didn't pour too much ketchup.
So you nod in satisfaction: "But this bowl of pasta tastes pretty good, I like it." ”
For some reason, Tenna's body had grown again, almost the same size as you, but he was still staring at the screen in darkness, head down.
Even after you finished the food on the table and you didn't hear him speak...... You had to turn your head to glance at him, but Tenna suddenly clenched her fist and said, "I...... Darling, I'll try my best to understand your preferences...... Next time, next time I'll definitely do better! ”
Well, you shrug and let him be.

title: Trainee Boyfriend 3 (tennax You)
content:
After all...... What you eat doesn't make much difference to you. Even so, to fill your stomach, you still finish the food on the table—after all, you've always had this habit, and of course, it's really just to fill your stomach; aside from that, it doesn't really matter to you.
So...... So actually, you don't have to be too picky about food tastes. After all, the difference is whether it's more suitable for your taste.
Tenna sat opposite you, his antenna drooping, the screen still pitch black, as if he'd done something wrong, hands behind his back, afraid to look up at you—he'd been in this posture since his size had just grown, and you really couldn't figure out what he was thinking, since his screen was off now.
So you cleared your throat and tentatively asked, "I'm done eating?" ”
At that moment, Tenna's body trembled. He instinctively straightened the antenna, but still didn't dare to turn on the screen. The pitch-black screen was just pointed at you, and then he mumbled, "Oh...... Darling, you... are you done eating? " He said this while lowering his head to look at the table, seemingly even more surprised, since you had heard his tone rise.
"You...... You actually finished it all? So...... So you still like my cooking? "He asked tentatively, probably just a test, since you heard his voice so cautious, tinged with panic, as if beneath it was a bit of a ...... A slight surprise?
For Tenna, it was a surprise—after all, you raised your opinion, you thought his cooking tasted bad, and Tenna was planning to make you another serving...... He certainly hadn't imagined such an outcome.
He ...... He was so happy, his heart was blazing with joy. He couldn't help but open the screen again, pressing his hands together beside his head, smiling, and his nose tip once again showing flowers.
You blink at his smile, not understanding why he looks so happy now...... You just can't stand this kind of taste. Of course...... You don't want to waste food, after all, you bought all these ingredients with your own money!
So you just tell the truth: "I just don't want to waste food, it's that simple." "This really is your true feeling."
But Tenna still looked very happy—it seemed he misunderstood your meaning, or rather...... Hmm, maybe he came to another wrong conclusion because of the current situation? That's your guess, but you don't really know what Tenna was thinking. You just think he ...... Well, that actually makes him seem a bit naive, like he's not very smart.
But then again, he's just a TV—how much thinking ability could he possibly have? Thinking about it this way, you'll be at ease—it's normal for Tenna to seem a bit dumb.
You put down your hand, set the knife and fork on the empty plate, and cleared your throat: "Alright...... I don't know what you're thinking, but...... Hmm, I think you could go clean up these dishes and clean them up. "You calmly finished saying this. After all, the one trying to please you now is Tenna—well, you don't think you need to do anything more. I have to admit, this kind of life is much happier than living alone...... No wonder those men all want to find a good wife and good mother who can serve them.
However, having a TV personality who can serve you doesn't sound like a bad thing......
Tenna got up as instructed, picked up the bowls and plates, and walked toward the kitchen. But after putting them down, you didn't hear anything...... Hmm, the sound of running water—you just heard Tenna's footsteps. He walked out of the kitchen again, then returned to that smiling expression, but with his hands behind his back, he seemed a bit nervous. He looked up at the screen and glanced at you, then lowered his head again: "Um...... So, darling, I want to ask you, do you like me a little more? ”
You were a bit confused—it was just a meal, what was he expecting? But you did feel good because of his service, so after thinking for a moment, you nodded: "Hmm, not bad, I guess." ”
"So, do you love me even a little?" His voice only grew more urgent, and he was desperate to get that answer.
You paused for a moment and didn't answer him. Tenna simply turned off the screen again, the antenna drooped, and his figure slowly shrank. In a low voice, he said, "Alright, don't pay attention to what I just said...... After all, what I made was really bad. It's normal that you don't like it, darling......" As he spoke, his figure grew smaller and smaller, once again about the size of a pet dog. Then he came over and grabbed your pant leg, just lowering his head and looking completely unresponsive: "Anyway...... Anyway, darling, if you want to scold me, just do it. After all, I really am the one who did the wrong thing...... Sorry, darling...... I will strive to do better next time......
But his wet screen also soaked your pants...... And your ankle—you always found it a bit funny, but in the end, you didn't say anything about it, just softly said, "Mm. I didn't say I didn't like you, nor did I say I wanted to scold you...... Oh, of course, that's not exactly liking you. But it's not exactly dislike, right? "You thought about it and tried to organize your words. To be honest...... You're not very good at communicating with people like that, or maybe you don't like it at all. After all, mechanical people who can't speak human language are easier to deal with.
Tenna's figure seemed to grow a bit, but his voice was still small, or even somewhat pale and weak. For some reason, his figure looked swaying—well, you clearly remember he was still heavy.
"So...... So, do you like me a little more? "He was still fixated on the answer to that question.
You really don't know...... What exactly does liking and love really feel like? But if being happy because of his actions can be called liking...... Then surely you do like him a little, right? After all, you're actually quite happy.
Though it's not exactly that happy.
So you hesitate for a moment and reply, "I guess I like you a little more...... Yeah. Just a little. "Speaking of which, you suddenly want a little milk tea...... Hmm, the association is too rich, but you can definitely try it this afternoon.
"Just how much you like me, just a little...... But how much is a little bit, really? "His figure returned to his usual size, and Tenna's screen turned back on, lighting up with flowers. But the flower quickly disappeared, and he just cautiously continued to ask you.
You fell silent, asking how many there are...... Hmm, then it should be possible to convert it into specific values...... That way, it's easier for you to calculate. To be safe, you still take a look—there are no boxes or bars on his head, and from your perspective, you don't have any of that either.
"Uh...... Then let's get +2 affection. "You hesitated for a moment, then said to him dryly.
Tenna's antenna wobbled, probably in a good mood: "Oh...... I get it. Does that mean when my affection reaches 100, it means my dear really loves me? ”
You blink, for no reason, your voice a bit hesitant: "Yes...... Right? ”
“…… Darling, can your answer be a bit more certain...... You must be loving me, right?! " As he spoke, the screen went completely black, and he was lying on your knee, tilting his head back, the dark screen facing you too. You looked at him, feeling like he was probably just pretending to be pitiful...... You watched the end of that socket sway back and forth, then carefully wrap around your leg.
In the end, you still sighed: "Alright, if it really ...... If this number reaches 100, it means I've fallen in love with you. Is that enough? "As you spoke, you gently patted Tenna's TV head.
He really wants to say it's not enough, he really wants to say that even at that point, you can still love him a little more, he really wants to say...... He really wants to hear you say you love him, hear you say you will love him forever, repeating this over and over — he never gets tired of listening! Of course, Tenna just wants to confirm your feelings.
But he ...... Getting this answer from you was enough to make him happy for a long time, so he turned on the screen, held his head high, and even the flowers on his nose swayed. He hummed a tune out of tune as he walked toward the kitchen, followed by the sound of running water—well, it sounded like he was probably washing the dishes. You thought, picked up your phone, and started casually scrolling through social media messages, hmm...... Of course, the key was to check the websites where you posted before; none of the next ones seemed interesting......

title: Trainee Boyfriend 4 (tennax you)
content:
Just then, Tenna finished washing dishes and the like, nervously coming out of the kitchen. You saw him take off his apron, then nervously hung his head over the TV, lost in thought. You put down your phone and couldn't help but cover your mouth and yawn: "Ah—oh, are you done with this?" Find a place to rest first...... Yeah, I happen to have a guest room at my place, so you can stay there." "You look around and settle on Tenna's place to live." To be honest, you still don't feel much about dating right now...... Well, you're just two people under the same roof with nothing to do with each other, that's all.
"Darling...... I—I'm your boyfriend. I think I should live with you...... Tenna just hesitated and paced back and forth a few steps, then sat down on your sofa. He was truly nervous and uneasy...... After all, he didn't know how to make you like him a little more, how to become a qualified boyfriend, how to restore that so-called favorability to your level—even though it probably never was at first.
“…… Oh right, oh, then go back and put the things in my room. "You paused, cleared your throat twice, and instinctively blushed a little, then turned your head away. To be honest, you're really not used to this...... You just realized this guy was your boyfriend, since in the game, you two had both ended up getting married.
"Mm. Then...... And then, darling, how can I make you like me a little more? "Tenna nodded, watching you turn your head to look at your phone again. He just felt jealous—why do you have to keep staring at your phone all the time? Most of the things you're obsessed with, you can do yourself." He didn't quite understand, but as he watched the back, he mustered up his courage and asked.
You had just casually flipped through your phone to find a novel to pass the time, but when you heard Tenna's question, you turned to glance at him. Tenna just awkwardly placed her hands on her knees. His screen was pitch black, and his antenna was drooping, clearly in a bad mood. You didn't quite understand what was wrong with him, but regarding his question, you thought carefully and then gave him an answer.
"Ah...... Then probably, you need ...... Well, you need to look it up online and see what good boyfriends are like. "You thought hard for a moment, then answered Tenna. To be honest, you've never been in a relationship before, so of course you don't know what to do about this.
And to your surprise, you see Tenna shrink even more, turning into a small one sitting on the sofa, just muttering, "Internet ...... What is it? Phone...... I don't know how to use this. Y/N, is this really important? "His voice became trembling, cautious, and tinged with a hint of frustration, but in short, he didn't look very happy.
Look at him—he's still sitting on the sofa and gently patting Tenna's head: "A network is a network, it's the internet, and it can connect most people with just a few cables...... A kind of, um, a facility? "You think about how to explain it. After all, these are everyday things for you, so you don't need to fully understand the principles, just know how to use them."
But for Tenna, that's probably not the case, so you should patiently explain a bit. After all, it just looks like an old TV decades older than today.
Tenna just nodded half-understandingly, but you could tell he probably didn't quite understand, and for some reason, you felt he seemed even more dejected, just sitting there hugging his legs, doing nothing else...... Hmm, the antenna was also dangling, and you seemed to hear faint sobbing. You saw the tears on his screen soaking his pants.
You didn't know how to comfort someone, or rather, you weren't good at these things. You just patted his head and softly said, "Let me teach you how to use a phone. Do you want to learn?" You said cheerfully, taking out your phone and placing it in front of Tenna. But Tenna still didn't react; he was still ...... He looked the same, but you felt his sobbing sound seemed a bit quieter.
You don't think you're that familiar yet, so you haven't done anything too outrageous. You just gently touch his antenna again and dryly repeat, "Uh...... Anyway, do you want to learn?" "As you spoke, you persistently placed your phone in front of him."
Tenna's TV head finally lifted. His screen flickered, a blue bar malfunctioned, and then he turned it back on and mumbled, "...... Study." ”
He thought, he still needs to know how to use these devices, he can't be completely clueless...... Otherwise, just by looking at things like this, he might want to win you over...... Tenna knew he longed for your love, but he was still doubtful, sudden, or maybe guilty. He couldn't be sure what kind of feelings you had for him, since it was just as you thought. But there was no box above your favorability showing up. He could only guess your expression. At least for now, Tenna believed that if he did, you'd definitely be happy.
You didn't notice what Tenna was thinking. You just rummaged through the coffee table drawer and took out a spare phone from the coffee table's drawer and handed it to Tenna. This is your backup phone...... It's just right for Tenna to use, and the number is your sub-number.
"You use this first. This is my phone too...... Yeah, but it's still a bit different from the phone I'm using now. "You fiddled with it, and luckily, the phone still had power, so you turned it on smoothly. You stuffed the small phone into Tenna's big palm. Watching him carefully hold the phone with those big hands, you couldn't help but laugh out loud.
Tenna suddenly looked up at you. His screen had lit up and the antenna had come back off, but now his screen clicked off again, and the antenna drooped. You thought he must have misunderstood something, so you quickly waved your hand and explained, "I just found your clumsy look funny...... I just found it kind of cute, or something. As long as you understand, that's good." "You cleared your throat and cleared your throat twice. Although Tenna didn't react much, you still felt he didn't fully believe you...... Anyway, you let out a soft sigh and then started explaining to Tenna how to use the phone.
You gestured on your phone: "This is the volume button. The top one increases the volume, the lower one lowers the volume. Then, under this longer button, the smaller one is the one where a short press unlocks or locks the phone screen, while a long press lets you turn off or restart the phone." You gestured, then watched Tenna awkwardly repeat following your instructions, reopening the screen and pressing fingerprint unlock.
"Anyway...... Nowadays, phones all have a password set and can unlock with fingerprint. So you can later set up your fingerprint to enter your fingerprint. Of course, you can also unlock with facial recognition, which requires you to enter your facial information in the settings. ”
Tenna responded softly, clearly looking a bit downcast. You were hesitating about saying something to cheer him up...... But Tenna just asked gloomily, "So, the setting is...... What? ”
It seems like he's really listening attentively. You glance at Tenna and don't keep asking about his emotions. Maybe he doesn't like your questioning...... Well, how much does that have to do with you? Thinking this, you gently shake your head to clear those thoughts, then explain to him with your phone. You open your phone and swipe a bit: "Settings, as the name suggests, is software that adjusts all aspects of your phone. You can set network connections or Bluetooth in the settings...... Besides that, there are other settings related to the phone itself, like screensavers and wallpapers, password settings, phone memory, and some button settings. That's basically it. "You actually explained things to Tenna in detail. I think you probably didn't miss anything...... Hmm, and Tenna carefully swiped his phone twice, pointing to the top modes and asked you.
"What about these...... What are these? Data networks, other networks, airplane mode, and WLAN...... Are there any differences among them? "Tenna said, finally turning on the screen, but you still looked like he wasn't in a good mood, just curling his lips...... His head was still bowed, and you seemed to see his screen melting, tears dripping down...... I don't know if it's just your imagination.
In short, you just patiently explained: "A data network refers to a network connected to a signal base station using a SIM card. The specific usability depends on the plan purchased from your phone number carrier and the amount of data you have left. For other networks, you can enable hotspots, which is essentially turning your phone into a signal base station for other devices. Airplane mode defaults on all external connection functions, essentially isolating the device. Finally, WLAN is a local area network...... For example, if I turn on a WiFi at home, my phone can connect to it, which is like having a small signal base station at home. ”
“…… What is traffic? What is a signal base station, and what is a local area network? "Tenna asked cautiously, feeling that his questions seemed a bit too many...... If you're willing to teach him, that's already good, but he still couldn't help pushing his luck.
TBC.

title: Trainee Boyfriend 5 (tennax you)
content:
You glanced sideways at Tenna. In fact, all of this counts as ...... Some of the vocabulary modern people have learned without any formal guidance? Even if you don't understand it, you can still grasp the general meaning. So you're a bit annoyed; you're a bit lazy to explain to Tenna what all this actually is...... But in the end, you still sigh and say expressionlessly, "Data is the signal base station that your SIM card connects to the signal base station, which means how much network connection can be used. This means the signal base station assists with network connections and provides network connections, while a local area network means ...... A local network connection." You roughly explained, but Tenna just nodded half-understandingly, looking like he still didn't quite understand.
You didn't plan to say more, just exited the settings and returned to the phone screen, intending to say something more to Tenna, but Tenna just hesitantly asked, "I still...... I don't quite understand what those words mean. Y/N, can you say it to me again? "Although his screen was lit up, the antenna hung down listlessly, clearly showing he wasn't in a good mood, or rather...... Well, he was just innocent, a little nervous.
You glanced at him, feeling even more impatient, but still opened the settings again, took a deep breath, and tried to stay calm as you continued explaining: "To put it simply, traffic is how long you can still use the network when connected via a data network. Signal base stations are where the transmitting network helps connect signals between people. Local area networks mean network interconnection within a local area. That's about it." ”
Tenna just nodded, and you felt that the size of his earlier body seemed to shrink even more...... You didn't quite understand what was going on with him; it seemed like it was because he still didn't quite understand. You opened your mouth, unsure what else to say, while Tenna just turned his head in panic. He knew he had asked you twice in a row, and he could sense the irritation on your face. Tenna did his best to understand what all this meant...... Just, just...... He tried his best, but still only half understood. He felt a kind of panic, and only this kind of panic...... He was afraid that if he kept asking, you'd completely annoy him. He was afraid you'd think his demands were too much or too much trouble, and Tenna didn't want to cause you any trouble...... Tenna just wanted to love you and receive your love, but now, after he appeared here, he finally understood.
He was completely cut off from this world; now, he seemed to understand it completely.
…… Maybe Tenna doesn't really understand you either, but that thought was quickly dispelled by him. He knew very well that he absolutely knew you very well. There couldn't be anyone who knew you better than he did. Holding on to this perhaps self-comforting and exaggerated thought, Tenna turned to look at you again. He didn't know how much patience you had, but you looked expressionless now, obviously still a bit ...... Patience? He asked again awkwardly, "I... I still don't really understand...... He didn't really understand what you were saying, didn't really understand what the connected network was, or what the world was really changing or happening.
You look at Tenna and take another deep breath, comforting yourself that this is just an old CRT TV that knows nothing...... Because you saw a flower popping up from his nose and a smile on his face, he said happily, "Oh, I get it...... Thank you, Y/N, I get it!" Tenna was immersed in the joy of finally mastering a bit of modern technique and method. You touched your nose, snorted coldly, but couldn't help laughing.
Think about it, although teaching him was tough, annoying, and impatient, seeing him learn actually felt pretty good—a kind of ...... A sense of pride and joy spread in my heart.
So you put on a smile, crossed your arms, raised your eyebrows, and said, "Hmm...... I'm actually pretty happy, so my affection +3. "In that case, who knows when I'll reach 100...... But you don't really mind. You don't think Tenna has truly understood real life, and that once you understand reality, you'll keep going.
And since he emerged from your game and wants to cling to you, you feel you should take some responsibility...... So, you don't mind wasting a little time with Tenna.
After all, besides that, it seems you don't have much else to do. You know this well, so you just look at Tenna calmly, waiting for his reaction—maybe a bit of anticipation...... You don't know why you're curious about how he'll react if his affection level increases. Maybe it's just to pass the time.
…… After all, being alone here is still a bit too lonely.
"Oh my god...... Dear Y/N, does this really make me feel good? I'm flattered...... Oh, I knew you, you're my favorite Citizen of Light! "He put his hands together next to the TV's head, showing that even a slightly silly smile.
You might want to ask him whether he prefers the way he appears in the game, or if he prefers you through the screen. But you don't ask him that question. Think about it, you won't get a satisfying answer anyway...... Asking him is pointless.
"Well, because I found the process a bit annoying, but I was actually quite happy." You were honest, and after exiting the settings screen, you finally returned to the main screen.
"These are the icons of the application software, and the app itself is equivalent to ...... Hmm, is it the same as the TV show you air? An app contains something similar to a show. "You thought about how to explain it to him, and in the end, you thought this explanation was okay, so you adopted it.
Then you pointed to the phone icon below: "This icon looks a lot like the handset of those old-fashioned rotary phones, right?" Hmm...... You can use this software to call anyone, just enter the phone number. "As you spoke, you demonstrated the numeric keypad for him.
You pick up your phone again and call this one: "And if a call comes in, if it's green, it's answered; if it's red, it's rejected." It's simple. ”
"Next to this is a text message. I added myself to my contacts list. You can try sending me a message yourself." You said this while opening the messaging app for Tenna.
His fingers poked awkwardly at the top of the screen, swiping and trying hard to recognize every tiny letter. His fingers were a bit stiff, and after much effort, he finally typed a word to send to you—it was "honey."
At the same time, your phone vibrates. You open the screen and show him: "Look, now I've received your message. If it's inconvenient to call, I can send a text...... After all, no one uses voicemail these days. ”
"The one next to me is the browser...... Simply put, it's like your quiz show? You give a question, and it gives the answer. However, it will give many answers, and you need to figure them out yourself. When I said before, asking you to look up online how to be a good boyfriend was also to check the browser. "Anyway...... Hmm, I don't know if you understood. If you didn't, just tell me. I don't know if you enjoyed this process either...... "You were still trying to organize your words, but Tenna interrupted you first, shaking his head, and several flowers popped up from his nose.
"I'm happy, I'm really happy...... I love you so much, Y/N, darling...... You're so wonderful. Even if I don't understand at all, you're still willing to tell me......" As he spoke, his voice grew quieter and softer. The antenna still wobbled, but his expression gradually faded until it finally turned into a smile.
You leaned back on the sofa, no longer looking at Tenna, just fiddled with your phone, and casually asked, "Do you really like me?" ”

You want to ask him again, what exactly does he like...... You think that saying he likes you through the screen and wants to be by your side is a joke, but in the end, you still don't ask. You just lower your eyes and ask again, "What exactly do you like about me?" ”
"Do you need a reason to like someone...... Y/N, I just like you, that's all, no reason." He replied, maybe he's in a pretty good mood? You glanced at Tenna out of the corner of your eye; his antenna was shaking, and you didn't say anything more.
Tenna nervously looked at your profile, his fingers stiff, but he still opened the browser and unfamiliarly typed a few words into the search box: What makes a good boyfriend?
