title: Trainee Boyfriend 6 (tennax you)
content:
[A qualified boyfriend needs to be loyal, respectful, caring, communicate smoothly, and provide a sense of security and support in daily life.]
Core principles
Loyalty and devotion: Remain loyal in relationships, avoid flirting with the opposite sex, respect your partner's feelings and boundaries—this is the foundation for sustaining a long-term relationship. Respect and appreciation: Respect your partner's choices and personality, appreciate their strengths, and allow them to be the best version of themselves, rather than trying to control or possess them. Honesty and trust: Communicate honestly, don't hide important information, and trust your partner to avoid conflicts caused by misunderstandings
Daily behavior recommendations
Express care and love: Often tell her you miss her, give small gifts or create surprises at the right moments, expressing feelings rather than just material things
Give a sense of security: respond promptly to messages and treat her with dedication, making her feel that you care about her presence and feelings; Thoughtfulness and companionship: focus on her during dates without distractions; accompany, comfort, and guide her when she's feeling down; Moderately share life: help with household chores or daily chores like cooking, laundry, or shopping, showing responsibility and care; Finances and romance: spend money within your means, occasionally create romance and small surprises to keep the relationship warm
Mindset and growth
Understanding and tolerance: Learn to ease conflicts, avoid confrontation, and remain calm and patient when problems arise; Grow together: Support each other in life and career, encourage each other to develop themselves, and gain strength and happiness in the relationship; Focus on inner needs: Prioritize her feelings, meet her emotional and psychological needs, and make her feel cherished and cared for
By following these principles and actions, you can become a qualified boyfriend, making your relationship more stable and healthy, while also allowing both parties to find happiness and growth in their relationship. 】
This was the first search Tenna found after searching online...... He thought carefully several times, hesitated, probably trying to figure it out...... Well, what had he already accomplished, and what still needed more effort. Loyalty and such, he definitely had it—after all, in this world, he only knew you, and as for the rest...... He would take care of the housework; he only hoped you would see his efforts, and then you would love him even more. Or rather...... Just falling in love with him was enough.
As for the rest, respect her...... Care for her, maybe...... He still needs to consider whether he still has money to use in this world. If he doesn't have money, he can't surprise you, give you little gifts, or take you out on dates. Tenna kept thinking about this. He wasn't very skilled at opening other apps on his phone; he desperately needed to know what these apps you hadn't told him were really for.
Then he discovered—for some reason, all the currency stored inside the game system had been transferred to a payment app. He wasn't very clear about how to use the payment software, but he could see the balance, which was exactly the same as the balance he had in the game.
Tenna opened the browser again, not very skillful, typed the name of the app, then started browsing the messy pages to figure out how to use this thing for payment. When he finally understood, he also heard you getting up. Tenna hurriedly looked up and realized you had just walked toward the kitchen. He also stood up in a panic, carefully holding his phone as he walked toward the kitchen, raising his voice to call your name: "Y/N, Y/N...... Let me prepare dinner too! ”
Through the kitchen, your voice sounded a bit hazy and muffled to Shangqiu, while he only heard your casual tone: "No need—I want something savory, and if you don't eat our instant pizza soon, it'll spoil." "You refused his request. Well, if you keep it any longer, it'll expire—you paid for that!! If you don't finish it, you'll feel bad. There happened to be two portions left, and Tenna was here today, so just open the package and pour it onto a plate, waiting for the microwave to heat up, and that's it."
Soon, you walk up to the table with a plate of pizza in one hand, placing one in front of Tenna and another in front of yourself, then sit down and start eating quickly.
Tenna was eating that pizza too, trying to gauge your taste and considering what kind of flavor you'd prefer, while Tenna only ate about half of it before taking it again. You finished the whole pizza before noticing the untouched pizza in front of Tenna.
You blinked, puzzled: "What's wrong? If you don't want to eat, then give me the remaining half portion. I still haven't eaten enough...... Hmm, don't waste food...... "After all, you bought it with your own money. Making money isn't easy these days."
"No, I was just wondering if you like this flavor more...... Tenna stammered, looking at you, recalling an answer he had searched online before, saying to often say nice things, like complimenting your partner...... He hesitated for a moment, the antenna dangling above his head. His screen showed no other expression, and finally he hesitated and said, "Um...... This pizza is just right. Y/N is really good at using tools...... He racked his brains to come up with this sentence. Well, he really didn't know what to say to you so you'd be happier. Tenna realized that, in a way, he seemed to ...... He didn't understand you at all.
It seems he has never truly understood what the real you are like, what his preferences are, or what his personality is. But he keeps looking at you through the screen, always ...... What he loves is you on the other side of the screen, just like Tenna's answer to you, probably because liking you is for no reason. He loves you without any reason.
You paused for a moment, then burst out laughing. You noticed Tenna's expression turning a bit tense, his nose and antenna drooping, probably thinking you were upset by this answer, but you just shook your head and said, "Yeah, I'm not unhappy...... But this is just pre-made food, I'm just heating it up. You really don't need to find a way to praise me." As you spoke, you laughed again, laughing several more times. Seeing you so happy, Tenna also smiled foolishly, laughing along with you, and a flower bloomed again on the tip of his nose. The antenna shook casually with delight. He thinks, he really likes the way you speak. There's no particular reason, he just likes you—when he sees you happy, he's happy too.
So he holds his TV head and laughs with you, looking silly, but at least you think he really is ...... Hmm, how should I put it? A bit clumsy. You get up and walk over, casually pat him on the head, and say, "Alright, stop grinning foolishly...... After finishing work, you rest at night. Oh, right, affection +5, right? You look pretty cute when you smile. ”
Hearing this, the corners of Tenna's mouth only curled up even more, but he still cautiously asked, "What about the initial ......?" How much is it? ”
You yawned and waved your hand casually: "Ah, of course it's zero, so your affection level is 10 now, hmm...... Good luck? At this level, you should just be a somewhat familiar stranger...... "At the end, you muttered to yourself, muttering for a moment. You really couldn't quite figure it out, since you're not really curious about what the different stages of affection are like.
Tenna heard your words clearly, so his antenna couldn't help but drop again. He turned off the screen, sat down listlessly, then stood up, silently carrying the plate to the kitchen to wash it briefly.
You were half-reclining on the sofa, playing on your phone. Only when you heard footsteps did you glance toward the kitchen door. You didn't know why Tenna had become so listless again, walking over to sit by the sofa, her feet barely touching the floor.
You glanced at him curiously, only to realize the screen had somehow gotten wet again. You didn't know what to say, so you sat up straight and tapped the TV's head: "Alright, though I don't know what's going on with you now...... Well, but, keep smiling? Just be a little happier. ”
Obviously, this sentence didn't seem to have any effect. Instead, the TV became even smaller, curling up beside you, like a doll you could just hug and ravage at will—of course, you wouldn't do that, nor would you be interested. You just pressed your temples, feeling that the work mind you'd finally put down for the holiday was about to regrow—come on, at this moment he looked just like a moody, very demanding client!!
You had no choice but to casually tap his TV screen again, then pat the top of his head, and rub the antenna twice: "Alright...... It's about time to rest. Since that's the case, I think you should sleep on the sofa tonight. The guest room hasn't been tidied up yet...... You grumble, and just thinking about tidying up the guest room tomorrow gives you a headache.
But just as you got up to walk toward your room, you felt the hem of your clothes tugged. You turned around in confusion and saw it was Tenna. He had turned the screen back on, but it was still wet, with sparkling tears sliding down the screen. You hesitated for a moment, tilted your head, not knowing what Tenna was trying to do.
Then you hear his slightly gloomy voice, but for some reason, it carries a hint of persistence: "I...... We've already reached a married ending in the game, so I think we should sleep in the same bed. ”

title: Trainee Boyfriend 7 (tennax you)
content:
…… You don't quite understand why a stranger who is just a familiar one would want to share a room with you. You can't really treat those things from the game as reality, can you? Although you wouldn't be scared by his appearance, and you didn't think it was a big deal to suddenly have a TV person at home...... But you still gave Tenna a strange look, scanned him up and down again, then repeated: "The guest room isn't ready yet. How about you rest on the living room sofa for the night?" You pretend you didn't hear that sentence, but Tenna just lowered her expression, lowered her head, and let the antenna hang down, looking rather pitiful.
After a moment of silence, you simply raised your hand, first showing one finger, and said, "First, quickly tidy up the guest room and go to sleep first." Then you raised a second finger, "Two, sleep on the living room sofa," and finally raised a third finger. "Third, I have specially granted you the privilege of sleeping on the floor in my room." "As you spoke, you held your head high—after all, you truly thought this was your remarkable gift. You thought it over for a long time before finally giving this merciful answer!"
Tenna's antenna was set up again. Without a moment's hesitation, he hurriedly spoke, as if afraid you'd take it back any moment and regret his proposal: "I...... I'm going to sleep on the floor in your room, darling, I don't want to be too far from you......" His voice was a bit sticky, and you weren't quite used to it. You just gave him a rather strange look, walked into your own room, and pulled out two quilts—one laid on the floor, the other covered with him. Tenna followed closely behind you into the room.
Just as you turned around to say something, you almost bumped straight into Tenna. He was right behind you, almost bumping into his abdomen—yeah, after all, he's much taller than you. You pouted, hurriedly stepped back two paces, rubbed your ears that had turned red for some reason, and put your hands on your hips to announce, "Alright, then you'll rest here tonight—well, I'm warning you, don't come near my bed even a single step!" You flicked your fingers as you announced, then sat down on the bed, turned your back to Tenna, changed into pajamas, and casually flopped onto the bed, closed your eyes, and got ready to sleep.
Tenna's nose couldn't help but bloom with flowers again. Just being able to stay here and see you was enough—he was sitting on the floor, just enough to see you clearly. Maybe he felt uncomfortable facing his screen, so you muttered and turned over again. Tenna turned off the lights for you, and he also turned off his own screen, just cautiously staring at you in the darkness—he didn't want to sleep, as if he had, and when he woke up the next day, he'd realize it was all just a dream, that you had never truly appeared before him. In the darkness, he couldn't help but stare intently in your direction, even though the darkness made it impossible to see anything.
It wasn't until a while, after quite a while, that Tenna finally caught your silhouette again in the darkness. Listening to your shallow breathing, he guessed you were probably sound asleep—even though you had warned him not to come near your bed, he couldn't help but want to get closer. So he first secretly moved his bed. Originally, it was just from a distance, just close to the window, but now, he was getting closer and closer to your bed. Although he could still only see your back and couldn't see your expression, he ...... still satisfied.
But in such a pitch-black night, he couldn't sleep. He stared quietly at your screen, maybe only a few dozen seconds, maybe just a few minutes—after all, Tenna didn't know how much time had passed; he only knew he had been watching your back, listening to your shallow breathing. Even if...... He didn't know if he would wake you; he still instinctively softened his movements—because he didn't want you to wake up. Tenna slowly stood up, trying to crawl onto the bed.
But just as he made a move, his legs landed on the bed, causing the bed to sink in. You muttered, not knowing what he was saying, and rolled over directly. Tenna instinctively stopped moving, holding his breath. He was afraid you would wake up, but maybe he was also somewhat hopeful, because if you did—you'd realize that he really was the husband you had seriously won over, and of course he should hold you as you fell asleep.
But you just turned over and continued to immerse yourself in your sleep, never waking up. Tenna felt a bit regretful, but also a little happy. He climbed onto your bed completely, though still a little distance away. He just lay by the bedside, watching your peaceful sleeping face, instinctively curling his lips in a silly smile, while flowers appeared at the tip of his nose, but no one noticed.
Your sleeping face...... Your cheeks were fair with a faint blush. He noticed your eyelashes occasionally fluttering unconsciously, and your bright lips gently parted and closed, as if mumbling something. Tenna swallowed hard, wishing he could bite your lips right now...... He thought, that must be his favorite scent. But he didn't dare to do it yet. He only dared to quietly shift a little toward you while still sound asleep. Seeing you still unconscious, he moved closer to you, just a few steps away, until his screen was almost pressed against your cheek. He closed the screen again, just staring blankly at you, waiting for your warm breath to hit his screen—then he felt the entire TV screen grow hot, the antenna bent unnaturally, and finally it cautiously hung down on your head. Trembling, he reached out and hugged you. He didn't use any force, just held you weakly. Watching you sleep soundly in his arms, Tenna already felt deeply satisfied. He felt the mechanical heart in his chest floating lightly, almost leaping out of his chest—he was willing to give his heart, willing to give you everything, as long as you were willing to accept it.
You didn't wake up. Your eyelids blinked twice. Tenna nervously pulled her hand back, but it quickly turned over and lay flat. Only then did Tenna dare to put his hand on you again. He wanted to hold you tightly, but only half-heartedly. He carefully watched your expression. Seeing no reaction, he relaxed a bit and gently placed his arm on top of you. His screen lit up again for a moment. The corners of his mouth lifted into a smile he hadn't before, and he quickly turned off the screen. Afraid the screen would wake you, he just lay on his side beside you, awkwardly wrapping one arm around you, neither loose nor tight...... But he couldn't help but tighten a little more so you wouldn't escape from his embrace. Tenna leaned in, his screen pressed against your cheek, and he felt the mechanical heart in his chest beating faster—and he just leaned in, daring to lean in, gently pressing the screen against your cheek. He looked at your lips, and in the end, he simply let himself fall asleep holding you in his arms with satisfaction—his hands instinctively tightened, afraid that if he let go, everything would be gone.
As for you...... You had a nightmare all night. At first, you just slept in a daze, but at some point, you had a dream—a dream where you were wrapped tightly in a warm, heavy blanket like a zongzi. Instinctively, you frowned and turned over several times, trying to escape this environment, but unfortunately, you couldn't. You were still tightly wrapped in these scorching leaves.
When you struggle and finally wake up from the alarm ring, you groggily open your eyes and find Tenna tightly holding you in an awkward position. You laugh at his exasperation—no wonder you have those dreams, it's all because of this guy. You clearly told him not to come near your bed, but you don't even know when this guy got on top.
Anyway, you shoved Tenna's screen and arm, threatening as you said, "Get up! Didn't you say you wouldn't let me sleep in my bed?! I'm going to take off your affection points!" "Just thinking about your favorability makes you more alert. At least you have this way, otherwise you wouldn't even know what to do with this guy."
Of course, Tenna was already awake; he was just pretending to sleep...... He was anxious but wanted to hold you a little longer, and now he let go, feeling wronged. The screen became wet, the antenna drooped, and he muttered to himself, "Um...... I, I miss you so much...... Dear ......" he said, but he still hadn't gotten out of bed. You were furious, pushing his chest to keep him away from you, and then your body stiffened—because you felt something hot, hard pressing against your thigh. Your face flushed red. You grabbed your clothes and stood up, glaring fiercely at Tenna: "You, you, you, you...... Your favorability has hit zero! ”
With that, you dashed to the bedroom door, slammed it hard, got dressed, and got ready to head to the office to continue your busy day's work. Tenna carefully opened the bedroom door and came out. He saw you had already packed your things, a slice of bread in his mouth, a bag slung over his shoulder, and was about to pick up his shoes and leave. He didn't know where you were going; he was just a bit flustered—he wanted to regain the favorability he had just lost, so he took advantage of your distraction to become a small one and slipped into your bag.

title: Trainee Boyfriend 8 (tennax you)
content:
Of course, you didn't notice this. You hurriedly put on your shoes, slipped on your bag, and headed out, squeezing onto the subway to get to the office. The subway was very noisy inside. You took out your phone and Bluetooth headphones to listen to music, closed your eyes for a moment, and didn't notice any strange movements in your bag. Tenna curled up inside your bag, listening to the sounds outside, feeling a bit nervous—he quietly poked his head out to take a look, but it turned out he didn't recognize this kind of thing...... What on earth is this? It seemed to be something shuttling through, but it was so crowded that Tenna didn't know how much time had passed before he realized you had lifted the strap of your bag and gotten off the train.
You hurried to the office, clocked in for work, and greeted colleagues passing by: "Ah, good morning." ”
The male colleague nodded as well: "Mm, Y/N, good morning." ”
Listening to you greet your male colleague, Tenna instinctively felt a bit wronged—he, he...... Why can't you get such a gentle response from you? Why is your attitude toward him always a bit cold? Why does he now feel even softer when he listens to your voice? Why can't you talk to him like that?
The colleague just continued, "The boss demands that we see that planning proposal today. Y/N, I'm afraid you'll have to work overtime again." ”
You rubbed your shoulder that felt a bit sore for some reason, forcing a smile: "Ah, I know, it's fine, just changing the plan...... I'm already very skilled, I get it. Thanks for the reminder." ”
After greeting and taking the elevator, you arrived at your workstation. Your workstations all had separate partitions. Although there were no private rooms, the partitions were already very focused on privacy and privateness. You opened the computer at your workstation and turned it on. Just as you were about to take out your bag and take out the USB drive saved from some of the weekend planning projects, you saw the little TV person in your backpack. You paused for a moment, then met the black screen on the little TV's head. Your expression was a bit cold and speechless. Tenna hesitated for a moment but decided to pretend to be a doll and remain motionless, just sitting there as if it were a toy you had casually brought out.
You couldn't help but laugh a little in exasperation—you remember very clearly that you never took such a stuffed animal out; rather, you never brought anything extra.
So you just reached out and pinched it, staring at it expressionlessly. You were sure it was metallic and very hard when squeezed, and after you squeezed it, Tenna was like a tiny voice doll, softly pinching her voice and saying, "I LOVE YOU."
You shivered involuntarily and looked around. Fortunately, there weren't many people on your floor. You took out Tenna and placed it on the table, gritting your teeth as you said, "Stop pretending, you must be Tenna." You lowered your voice to avoid attracting attention, and then you watched as the tiny Tenna, who looked like a doll ornament, silently turned his hands behind his back, lowered his head to the TV, and drooped the antenna. You saw tiny droplets of water fall onto your desk—as if he was feeling so wronged. You silently glanced at him, but finally reached out to pat his head. Your hand was now much bigger than his—you said dryly, "You can stay here, but if someone else comes, you have to pretend to be a toy ornament...... Don't let anyone notice you're alive, got it? ”
He nodded eagerly, then sat down on the few books stacked on your desk. You saw the little screen light up again, a tiny flower once again appearing at the tip of his nose, but it didn't fall. You glanced at him worriedly, making sure he wasn't moving much and looked like a decoration, and only then did you finally get back to your work.
You open the PPT you're halfway through, start modifying it, add new pages, and soon you're back in Excel to start creating data reports...... Of course, you still need to create bar charts, but fortunately, with Excel, you'll be able to do it quickly. Tenna watched your fingertips move rapidly across the keyboard, then control the mouse to click all sorts of buttons. He was dazzled and couldn't understand a thing—Tenna couldn't help but feel a bit frustrated. He had thought, if you were here to work, maybe ...... Maybe he could help in some way? But as it turned out, you probably didn't need his help—you could do it well on your own, and he couldn't understand at all.
If he can understand even a little bit...... And then help you with a little thing, that's fine, but he can understand every word, yet when put together, he can't fully grasp what it means.
He sat awkwardly on those books, watching you type away. He wanted to say something, but then a colleague suddenly poked his head over, so Tenna had to keep standing still, pretending she was just a doll ornament.
"Sis, I have a bit of a problem I don't know how to solve it. How should I prepare this year's earnings report...... Hey, when did you get such a little thing on your desk? It's so cute." "It's a little girl, with a slightly round face. She looked at Tenna on your desk and couldn't help but poke her. She remembered your instructions and just sat here without moving."
You casually said, "Consolidate the revenue data, tally each department's earnings separately, and then make a report—ah, I brought this ornament today. After all, work hours are too boring, and having a stuffed animal with me makes me feel better." As you spoke, you poked Tenna too, then tapped his TV head with your fingertip. His antenna instinctively relaxed naturally—but your colleague was still watching, so Tenna had to keep her stiff posture. He was very happy to be touched by you, but now he could only sit there motionless.
"Alright, I get it now. Thank you, sis—this little ornament is quite interesting. I want to buy one for fun too. Sis, where did you get it?" The little girl, quite curious, poked Tenna twice more cautiously. Fortunately, Tenna was still perfectly still and hadn't given away.
"And it actually feels like it's metal, not plastic...... If it's metal, it should be heavy, right? Hmm...... That's rare. I remember most ornaments like this are made of plastic. ”
"After all, plastic is convenient for coloring and patchwork...... There are also metal ones, but they're rare, since metal is much harder to cut and polish compared to others. I just bought this randomly on Tao. If you ask the store, I can't remember either...... You smiled and made up a lie on the spot. Of course, this thing isn't some toy ornament, but your TV person's turn into a character—and not only that, this TV person actually came out of a game. If you tell the truth, you're afraid Tenna will soon be taken away for research.
That little girl still looked like she wanted to buy the same style after taking a photo, but you just put on the usual smile you usually use at work and put away the tenna: "I don't really want to use the same style as others...... You'd better go look for it yourself on TaoTao. ”
So she put away her phone in disappointment and sat back down. You quietly exhaled, took out Tenna again, and then took a photo to check the search results on Tmall for reference. After all, if someone really came to question you about this later, you'd have to come up with some excuse. The search results showed that Tmall really did ...... There were similar ornaments, probably merchandise from that game company, but made of PVC plastic. You glanced at Tenna sitting on your book, pretending to be obedient, and fell silent for a moment...... At worst, you could tell someone you really like this character, so you customized it specifically according to the in-game version.
Well, in any case, it shouldn't cause much trouble...... You put your phone away again, simply immersing yourself in your work once more. But this time, before you could get busy for long, you heard Tenna's voice, faint and tinged with caution: "Um...... Darling, can I help you with anything?" You glanced at him. The little TV guy sat there cautiously, the screen lit up, but his nose was crooked, and the antenna hung askew. He hesitated nervously, his hands seemingly gripping the cover tightly, and you could see that he had already scratched the cover with fine creases. You hesitate for a moment, think about how he behaved with his phone yesterday, then glance at Tenna, and finally sigh slightly irritably.
You stretched lazily to relieve your fatigue, but said emotionlessly, "...... You don't know how to operate a computer, do you? I think it's fine if you don't cause me trouble...... I'll check tomorrow, and you can't go out with me anymore. Also, you struggled so hard trying to learn to use your phone yesterday...... I can't guarantee you won't forget anything again, just don't cause me trouble, okay? "The life you're looking at now is already troublesome enough, and you really don't want these things to get worse...... Sigh, although you didn't mean to blame him—you were just stating the facts—Tenna still looked even more downcast, lowering his head once again.
“…… I understand, I'm useless to you...... I'm nothing worth mentioning. Indeed, you probably need someone who can help you share some of the burden...... I—I'm not suited for ......."
…… I feel like if I didn't say anything more, this guy could run up to the institute platform by himself tomorrow. You scratched your hair, sighed, and patiently said, "I told you not to cause me trouble, but I never said I didn't want you...... By the way, it seems you never tacitly agreed to our subordinate relationship...... Forget it, anyway, as long as you sit here, I'll feel much better. Just remember that. ”

title: Trainee Boyfriend 9 (tennax you)
content:
You see that little TV guy lift his head again, as if looking at you with hope, but you can't see his eyes—yet his expression remains that pitiful one, his voice tinged with a hint of loneliness, yet also a hint of hope: "That ...... So, Y/N, does this mean you like me? "He said cautiously, and you honestly have no idea why he felt that way. Isn't it just that he hates you and you like me?" You scratch your head, and in the end, you can only sigh and say.
"I don't like you, but I don't mean I hate you...... After all, to me, you're just a stranger." You mumbled softly, afraid someone else would hear, but Tenna could still hear everything clearly. You saw his screen go black, his whole body shrinking into a ball, hugging his knees as he sat there. Soon, you heard the ticking of his ears again...... Hmm, this guy is crying again.
You shook your head helplessly, stopped looking at him, and continued to focus on your work—after all, you were really busy, and after finishing this PPT, you still had several reports to complete. The tasks your boss gave you were really too much. At first, his crying was very soft, but then, perhaps sensing you paid him no attention, his crying gradually grew louder, his sobs heavier, and a hint of grievance—probably not very happy...... In the end, you helplessly turned to look at the tiny Tenna curled up on your book cover, picked him up, and covered his screen, whispering, "What if you cry quietly and others notice us later?" I don't want you to be exposed like this...... Well, but, fine...... I'll give you +20 favorability. "You sighed and could only say to him helplessly. To be honest...... You were a bit angry at first and didn't plan to give him any more favorability, but as you said, knowing someone to accompany you while you work makes you feel much better.
…… And the way he cries is actually quite cute. Of course, you won't tell Tenna about this, or he'll cry again.
You let go of his screen, and this time it was Tenna who asked you a question: "Then...... Why, why do you want to give me a better impression? I didn't help at all, and maybe I'm just a burden to you...... You probably don't like me staying here either......" The more he spoke, the softer his voice became, the antenna drooping, but his screen lit up, occasionally dripping water droplets. He cautiously looked up at you, then lowered his TV's head again.
You sighed and gently wiped the tear stains from his screen with your fingertips: "Yes, you did cause me trouble...... It's just that I'm still willing to help you solve problems. Besides, I told you, as long as you're still here, my mood at work will improve. Because my mood has improved, so I've increased your favorability. The answer is that simple. ”
You said these things easily, and then you saw Tenna's antenna stand upright again. He must be very happy...... Even if you only said a few words. You turned around and continued your work. Fortunately, the next few reports and similar submissions were not recalled or modified. You nodded in satisfaction, finally able to leave work on time today.
You put this tenna, who had been staring at you for hours with the doll ornament, into your bag...... You had actually noticed his gaze long ago; this guy had probably been staring at you for several hours straight. But you didn't pay him any attention. Now that you're clocking in after work and walking out of the company building, Tenna actually crawled out of your bag. He was just hanging around the edge of the bag, staring at you eagerly, boldly staring at you. You looked at the little TV guy speechlessly, but in the end, you just reached out and patted his head: "Alright, being noticed by others isn't a good thing. You should wait inside the bag for a while." ”
So, just like in the morning, the subway journey was still on the way, swaying on it, but this time it was completely different...... His heart was full of anticipation—he looked forward to coming home with you, to having dinner with you, and to falling asleep in the same room with you.
You have no idea what this guy is thinking, but you finally open the door and exhale as you head back. Then you turn on the light, then open your backpack. Looking at Tenna, pretending to be a doll and pretending to be a doll, you just sigh softly. Then you grab Tenna out of your bag, place him on the sofa, and say irritably, "Alright, we're home. You can transform back now—tomorrow, I definitely won't let you go to the company with me again!" ”
Tenna grew bigger just as you said, his hands propping up on the sofa. Hearing this, the antenna drooped again, looking somewhat uninterested: "Then...... Darling, do you hate me coming along? Darling......"
But you rolled your eyes: "Of course I hate you...... How should I put it, you just came to the company with me and you're just causing me trouble...... You looked at Tenna's darkened screen, looking like she was about to cry again, and quickly added.
"Stop, stop, stop, I don't mean to hate you. I just really dislike trouble, you understand?" You put your hands on your hips and said. Seeing Tenna nod obediently, you finally let out a sigh and walked toward the kitchen with peace of mind, hmm...... Let's have some noodles today. You poured in some leftover MSG and stuff as well, and placed two bowls of ramen on the table. Although you weren't very good at cooking, you could easily and effortlessly cook a simple noodle. You looked very pleased at the noodles you had cooked, which seemed to be perfect in color, aroma, and taste...... Uh, at least they really did smell quite fragrant.
You really don't know what Tenna is thinking—in fact, although he's just a TV avatar of the Dark People, he still has some scheming...... Even if he knows that if he says it, you might just roll your eyes and say he's thinking stupid things. But to win your favor, he has no choice.
If pretending to be wronged could get your attention, he'd rather cry every moment...... But you'd be disgusted, so Tenna didn't dare use that trick too much. But he did cry from time to time, constantly asking, as if testing your limits, testing if you might ever feel you could take it anymore, testing ...... How far would you tolerate him? But on one hand, he was desperately eager to prove it, desperately hoping to know that you cared about him, even if just a little...... Even just a little. As long as you still cared a little about him, that was enough.
…… After all, Tenna still doesn't know what he really means to you.
He just wants to get a little closer to you, and even closer, at all costs.
Of course, you have no idea what this guy is thinking. You just pick up two bowls of ramen and place them on the table, pick up a pair of chopsticks yourself, place another on the bowl opposite, and then call out for Tenna to come eat: "Alright, Tenna, let's have dinner." ”
He sat down opposite you as instructed, then picked up the pair of chopsticks, the antenna drooping—hmm, after all, he didn't know how to use chopsticks. He just cautiously looked up at you, then imitated your posture and grabbed the chopsticks. But for his big hands, the two tiny bamboo sticks were just too hard to handle. Tenna watched you cautiously, tried again, and tried hard to use the chopsticks like you, but he still failed. Watching his posture, you couldn't help but sigh again. You didn't know why Tenna was trembling again, just smacking his lips irritably, then pulling the stool back to his side. Then you grabbed his hand—oh my god, you even grabbed his hand tightly with both hands! You couldn't help but glare at him and mutter, "Don't hold on so tightly, relax a bit...... Yes, that's how you hold it." You looked at Tenna with satisfaction as she finally picked up the right chopsticks.
Then you continued directing him: "Then press hard with your index and middle fingers, and hold your thumb without moving...... Then you watch Tenna shake one hand, split his chopsticks very apart, and one even falls off.
You patiently taught him several more times...... But Tenna still failed; he couldn't even pick up a single noodle. You watched as Tenna's antenna drooped, the entire TV person shrank again, the screen closed, and all you could see were tears streaming down the screen. You listened to his sobbing: "Um...... Am I really useless? I can't learn this either...... Yes, sorry, darling...... Sorry for making you go to such lengths......
You scratched your head and shrugged: "No need to apologize. It's normal not to learn how to use chopsticks...... I really didn't mean to blame you, so you don't have to keep treating me like this." You said that as you walked back to the kitchen, picked up a fork, and handed it to Tenna.
"Anyway, rolling up noodles with a fork is fine too. There are many ways to solve the problem...... No need to dwell on what just happened. "You said casually, since using chopsticks and such is really a hassle for foreigners...... It's normal if he doesn't know how to use them.
"You don't have to always apologize to me. Hearing you apologize all the time annoys me too...... And you don't have to always belittle yourself. I mean no looking down on you." "Although you know he's already an outdated CRT TV...... Well, you remember the in-game description says this. But you don't feel anything. Even though some things are phased out, they always play their part somewhere suitable.

title: Trainee Boyfriend 10 (tennax you)
content:
"Anyway...... Remember, stop acting like this all the time, and stop always whining to me, or else ...... Otherwise, your favorability will drop to a negative mark! "You thought about what to say, and in the end, you just said it fiercely, keeping your hands on your hips, while Tenna just obediently nodded to show she understood, and his antenna couldn't help but droop again...... So he can't cry freely in front of you anymore?
"Of course you can, but I just want you to be truly sad when you cry...... I'm not very good at reading emotions or anything, so if you cry, it means you really feel sad. That's all, I don't want me to misunderstand your feelings." You rubbed your nose and replied, and only then did Tenna realize she had involuntarily asked that question. He really stopped crying, only occasionally giving you a pitiful glance. His bowl of noodles was quickly finished. You glanced at him suspiciously, then walked to the kitchen, cleaned up the bowls, chopsticks, and forks, and put them in the sink. Then you walked out again, just slumped onto the sofa, thinking about nothing...... You just wanted to rest well after a tiring day.
You lay there, and after a while, you felt the sofa sink in one spot. You looked up and saw Tenna walking over, his hands still on his knees, quietly looking a bit conflicted, just sitting there.
Seeing that he hadn't moved for a long time, you simply closed your eyes again and casually asked, "Tenna, is there something you need?" ”
He seemed to have been hesitating for quite a while, at least for half a day without hearing his voice, before he cautiously and hesitantly asked, "Um...... Darling, what do you want to ...... What do you want to do? "He didn't want to just sit here quietly all the time; this silence made him feel embarrassed, making him turn his head to look at you again and again, making him unable to ...... He couldn't help but want to hold you tightly, so that this world wouldn't be just for himself.
He ...... He looks at you, he looks at you helplessly, he turns off his screen, maybe so you won't notice his burning gaze anymore, maybe so he won't disturb you...... He won't annoy you.
And of course, you noticed his gaze, though it wasn't particularly intense...... It was still a very obvious gaze that was hard to ignore. And you just collapsed exhaustedly on the sofa, while Tenna carefully cupped your head and rested it on his lap—to be honest, you instinctively frowned, because his thighs were just too uncomfortable for you. Although they were a bit soft, they were basically hard. After all, this was a television turned into ...... Of course, he had a lot of metal elements all over his body.
Tenna noticed your furrowed brows. He carefully placed his palm under your head, at least his gloves were very soft...... And they were quite large. Leaning against his soft gloves, your expression involuntarily relaxed again.
Your voice sounded tired and slow: "Ah, I don't want to do anything...... Don't ask me, I'm exhausted." Although you feel a bit better now, you still don't want to say much. You just want to rest well, to relax for a while and then go to bed.
Tenna carefully smoothed your furrowed brow with her other hand. You vaguely felt that this position was too intimate, maybe not quite right...... But honestly, there was nothing uncomfortable, and besides, you were too tired to move anymore, so this was just right. So you didn't say much, just twisted your body to a more comfortable position, then rested your head comfortably on his hand.
Tenna spoke even softer, stammering, "I...... Darling, rest well, well...... How about I play some music for you, darling? Maybe you'll be a bit more relaxed. ”
You actually think it's about the same, so you just nod indifferently. After all, you just want to rest for a while, and he just plays some soothing music for you—who would have thought Tenna turned on the screen, switched to the music channel, and was playing a passionate song? Maybe it's too much of a love song...... The melody is pretty addictive, but you have no energy or interest to study it, so you just open your eyes, look at him with a mournful look, and barely breathe, say, "Don't play this kind of tune...... It sounds so tacky." And it's that kind of inexplicable trend...... It's probably the kind of style that middle-aged and elderly people like. You always feel like this kind of song is a bit like Phoenix Legend...... Anyway, it's not for you.
Tenna frantically cradled his TV head with one hand. The screen lit up with a big pause button at the top, then he started searching for channels he could still play, finally finding a music channel that no one usually asked to listen to—he had pulled out his entire inventory, although he found only a dozen or so soothing songs...... Come on, he hadn't been able to connect to the internet for long. Even now, he couldn't get in and could only play songs he had downloaded before.
So he reopened the play button on the screen and turned down the volume a bit. When you first heard the music, your mouth twitched, after all...... Uh, piano pieces can be considered pure music, right? You don't even know how many people still enjoy piano music these days......
But the relaxation effect of these songs is indeed quite good. Lying there, your tense nerves relax a bit, you close your eyes, and even feel a bit drowsy and drowsy.
Gradually, you really did fall asleep...... But you didn't sleep soundly, since it wasn't in your own bed. You furrowed your brows slightly and muttered, half-awake, half-awake, feeling as if you were gently and carefully picked up, probably placed on the bed, and then lost consciousness and fell asleep completely.
You don't know, Tenna turned off the music, just propped his head up with his hands, gazing obsessively at your sleeping face by your bedside. Once again, a flower popped up from his nose—well, he admires you, he looks at you, he loves you, at least he's telling himself that his heart is beating, that he has always loved you, every moment.
He pressed his bouncing chest, lifting a bright, even slightly silly smile. A few more fresh flowers appeared at his nose. He quietly plucked the flower from his nose and stuck it on top of his head. When he picked it, the flower hadn't yet withered.
Then he turned off his screen, also turned off the lights in the room, and closed the bedroom door. With yesterday's experience, this time he climbed onto your bed with practiced habits. After confirming your breathing was shallow and occasionally a bit heavier, he couldn't help but move a little closer to you. Then he reached out and hugged you. At first, he just held you gently, but then his movements intensified. He couldn't help but slowly tighten his embrace until you frowned in your sleep. Only then did he carefully loosen a little, looking at your peaceful sleeping face. Tenna gently kissed your forehead, then carefully stuck out his tongue to lick your lips.
There shouldn't be any taste at all...... But maybe it was the tension and sweetness in his heart that had set all this down; he always felt that the taste coming back from his tongue was that kind of sweet aroma. Tenna carefully swallowed hard, watching your collar become unintentionally messy from falling asleep and turning over, at your exposed fair skin and the faintly visible cleavage...... Even though he had already unlocked the parental lock, his thoughts still raced toward places that seemed impossible to play.
In the end, he carefully lowered his head to confirm you were still asleep, then carefully kissed your collarbone, gently licking it...... Then he kissed your fair, tender breasts, but he didn't dare do anything more. He just gently licked your lips again, as if savoring the marrow, then softly bit down. Only then did Tenna nervously let go, making sure there were no traces left, secretly delighted, hugging you again, and falling asleep as well.
You keep feeling like you're having the same dream as yesterday...... Uh, it doesn't seem exactly the same either. This time, sitting there, not only was a thick quilt wrapped around you, but a stove was burning right across from you. For some reason, Sparks sometimes licked your lips against your body. Although they were slightly warm, they weren't hot or restless—instead, they were damp...... It was really strange.
You couldn't help but mutter a couple of words in your sleep. Even though you didn't know what it was, when you groggily opened your eyes, you found Tenna still holding you tightly. You couldn't help but kick him and curse, "You pervert, who told you to sleep in my bed?!" ”
But thinking about what happened last night, and how he told you to relax and rest for a while—no wonder you looked so energetic today, your movements were a bit lighter. But he was just too heavy, and when you kicked him, your own foot hurt a little.
Tenna woke up too, let go of you, the antenna drooped again, the screen went black, and she obediently knelt on your bed.
Seeing him like this, you couldn't say anything harsh anymore, so you pouted and tilted your head: "You...... Forget it, goodwill -5 in favorability. ”

title: Trainee Boyfriend 11 (tennax you)
content:
Hearing this, his antenna shook again, looking quite pleased—Tenna was indeed secretly pleased. He thought this time you'd reset his favorability to zero, but it seemed you just picked it up high and gently put it down...... So does this mean he can do even more extreme things? Does this mean...... He can get a little closer to you? He doesn't know; he just turned on the screen and looked at you eagerly.
You glared at him, changed your clothes, and walked out of the room, ignoring the burning gazes behind you—you didn't want to pay attention to him, so you just went to the kitchen, warmed up a sandwich, stuffed it into your mouth, finished it all, and then headed out to rush to work.
Of course, this time you still remember to open your bag to check, and sure enough, inside your bag you see a tiny TV person—Tenna, hugging her knees and curling up, turning off the screen, antenna hanging down, like an exceptionally well-behaved doll. You sigh, take the doll out and place it solemnly on the counter nearby, speaking in a fierce whisper, "You can't go to work with me, you understand?" You know, I don't like dealing with trouble, so don't come and cause me trouble. ”
After saying that, you turned around, closed the door, and rushed to catch the subway. Little did you know, Tenna was tugging at your pant leg and following you out. Although you felt a bit unusual, you were in a hurry and didn't notice right away, while Tenna was carefully climbing up your clothes. When you passed security and finally squeezed onto the subway, you turned around and saw tiny Tenna sitting on your shoulder.
Fortunately, you got on the last compartment, which was empty. You glanced around, then looked at Tenna and whispered, "Why did you still follow me?" "You clearly took him out of your bag...... Looks like next time you need to check more carefully, or rather, watch him at home before closing the door.
"I...... I want to be with you, with my dear......" Tenna explained quietly. He was a bit nervous, and he knew his presence might cause you trouble...... Although this wasn't his intention, besides always being by your side, he couldn't think of any way to gain favor for now. Call him foolish, call him just stubborn...... Or maybe he just has some inexplicable worry. He is jealous of your colleagues and can openly be with you, while he can only pretend to be a little toy. He's afraid that you'll fall for someone before you even fall in love with him, so what should he do?
You really don't know what Tenna is thinking, but if you did, you'd complain a bit—why is his mind full of romance and romance? You just frowned, finally stuffed him back into your bag, and lowered your voice: "Alright, come to work with me...... But remember, don't cause me any trouble." You said casually, the subway arrived at your destination, you got off, walked a bit before arriving at the company and clocked in for work.
Today, you're the only one at your workstation in your area, because it's rare that everyone else is on the afternoon shift, and you're the only one working full-day...... But your salary is a bit higher, but this makes the work exhausting. For some reason, your boss won't let you switch to just half a day, probably because they recognize your work ability.
All I can say is, if you'd known, you would've performed a little worse...... You resigned yourself to opening your computer, but luckily there wasn't much work in the morning, only two or three financial reports to finish.
Tenna quietly slipped out of your bag, and of course noticed there was no one else around. Along with it was a sense of joy—meaning that whatever he did wouldn't cause you any trouble, right? He skillfully climbed up your clothes and finally sat on your shoulder. He stared at the computer, feeling like he still couldn't understand. You glanced at him, and Tenna sat there obediently, probably just to keep you company. You didn't say anything more.
You are simply skillfully using the software's features to quickly consolidate the data and then create a statistical chart.
Then you breathe a sigh of relief, close the spreadsheet, and get ready to start the next report. At that moment, Tenna actually speaks up. His voice is small, but he's speaking in your ear, so you can hear it clearly.
He stammered, "Um...... Darling, I think I understand now. I want to help you with this job. Is that okay?" His tone was also very cautious, since Tenna didn't know if you would agree, or how you'd feel when you heard that. You turned to glance at Tenna; his screen was off, his antenna drooping, and he was poking the fingers of both hands, looking very guilty. You glanced at the table in front of you and roughly estimated—well, the form itself isn't too difficult. If it's just for him to practice, it's a good idea. Besides, you don't have much work this morning, so even if he makes a mistake, you can handle it in time.
Tenna, who hadn't gotten a response for a while, thought you were rejecting him, since all he could do was silence. He lowered his head in disappointment, carefully making sure you didn't hear his crying. He knew that to you, he was a useless old thing...... After all, he was just an old CRT TV, useless to you, and he knew that...... He wanted to think about something more, but at that moment, you spoke up: "Hmm, then you should give it a try." ”
As you spoke, you took the little TV guy off his shoulder and placed him in front of the computer. Of course, you paid attention to the position of the surveillance camera and blocked it—so no one would notice he was helping you.
Tenna was still a bit confused. He had been wallowing in self-pity, thinking you'd definitely reject him, but at this moment, you put him in front of the computer, and he ran over holding the mouse—to be honest, he's still about the same size as a mouse, yet he still couldn't help but ask you, "Um...... Darling, is it okay? ”
You shrugged, pretending to be the same as usual, just bringing along an intern who couldn't do anything: "It's fine, if you want to learn, I'm free right now, so you can learn. Just keep your current size...... Otherwise, I won't be able to hide it when it grows up." ”
As you spoke, you glanced casually at the surveillance cameras scanning back and forth above, then slightly changed your posture to cover them.
Tenna swallowed nervously, looking at the data and text on the table, and finally, at the last row where the total amount was to be converted, he obediently asked you, "Do you have ...... calculator?" ”
You open the calculator on the computer, then watch Tenna struggle to press those numbers, trying to add them up. You cross your arms and watch as he finally finishes calculating and filling in the numbers. You rub your forehead, take the mouse, and demonstrate it to him again.
"You can use the summation function directly. Just click 'Insert' in the toolbar on the table, select the summation option, and then pull the data you want to sum up," you said, demonstrating again how to pull the function range and how to insert functions.
He seemed to have probably understood...... Because he had indeed pulled a summation function into the blank box below, but the area he pulled was actually ...... the line he had already calculated above.
You stopped him again: "The result of this sum is the result of each row...... So just pull the function for each row, and the bottom right corner of the box will show a plus sign when you hover it down. Just drag down directly, and the function will be applied automatically. "After saying all this, you demonstrated it to him and let Tenna do it himself. You thought your explanation was pretty clear, and there wasn't anything confusing during the demonstration. Fortunately, Tenna probably understood it...... After all, when he finished the table next, at least this part didn't have any more problems.
And you just smiled and applauded him. After all, he had learned something new—and Tenna was delighted, the antenna wobbling as a flower bloomed at the tip of his nose. Then he picked the flower and handed it to you. The small flower wobbled again, and then it actually grew to about the size of an ordinary flower. He held the flower and looked at you: "Darling...... Thank you, please accept this flower! And then...... Then I helped you out, then...... Can you like me a little more? He nervously asked you. You took the flowers he handed you and casually placed them in the empty vase on the table. Then you looked at him, frowning as if pondering carefully, making Tenna swallow nervously again. Then you smiled and said, "Ah, then goodwill +1." ”
If you call it a little, then it's just a little...... You wouldn't give too much, and besides, he wasted about fifteen minutes on something you could finish in less than half a minute. If you don't take advantage of his favorability, that's already pretty good.
He hung his antenna in disappointment, continuing to handle the next line of tasks. But then, he couldn't do it anymore, so he cautiously turned around and poked your arm: "Um...... Darling, I, I don't understand this......
You glanced at it. This required filtering out the weakest item in each project. After thinking for a moment, you said, "You can use that filtering function directly, and naturally, it should be framed in that line...... However, the displayed result must be replaced with the result you entered above, and to ensure the results displayed afterward remain unchanged, an exclamation mark must be added...... "You explained."
Tenna half understood, half understanding, feeling like she still didn't quite understand...... Maybe, maybe after unlocking the parental lock, she would hear more clearly. After hesitating for a moment, he still unlocked his own parental lock.

title: Trainee Boyfriend 12 (tennax you)
content:
Of course, you had no idea what he was doing, just kept talking to yourself: "Ah, of course, if another table needs these results, you can also filter them into this one, just like this......" He remembered the secret kiss a few nights ago, and the screen involuntarily turned red again.
Your lips...... Kissing them was soft and delicate, and it really tasted great...... This is simple—just apply the function and let the computer process the data......"
As you spoke, you looked at Tenna again. Although you had no eyes, you couldn't tell if he was distracted. You just frowned as you watched him turn pink for some reason, and gently asked, "Tenna...... Are you listening? ”

If he could keep it on him, he would be even more delighted—he longed for your hand to touch, caress him, or rather...... caressing him. If your hand could gently stroke his head, he couldn't imagine how comfortable that would be...... Although it was indeed his thought, he had originally planned to keep it hidden deep in his heart—he looked at you anxiously, while you frowned, though a bit confused, still reached out to pat his head. You had no idea why he thought of this...... But you gently patted his head with two fingers, cleared his throat, and turned away: "Is this good enough?" ”
For a moment, you feel like a clingy pet insisting on playing with its owner...... Tenna was gently patted by you, and a flower couldn't help but bloom on his nose—he was overjoyed, since he never expected you would agree to his request. Oh my, this was just unimaginable......
So he couldn't help but keep asking further, "Darling...... I really like you. Your lips look so soft. Can I kiss you?" He didn't know how he ended up like this after unlocking the family lock...... But Tenna was already infatuated with you. He wanted everything about you, and he couldn't wait to have everything about you.
He stared at you, noticing your cheeks seemed a bit flushed. When you heard his words, you couldn't help but roll your eyes, turned around, and poked him hard with your finger: "You filthy pervert! So you weren't really listening to me just now, did you?" ”
“…… No, I, my dear...... Sorry, but I was listening to what you said...... His antenna drooped again, putting on that pitiful look. You vented your anger and poked him several times with your index finger before finally calming down. Then you crossed your arms and looked at him.
"In that case, just do what I just told you and try making it yourself." You said, and Tenna slowly crawled down, struggling to grab the mouse and began slowly piecing together the table patterns as you had taught him before...... It really was no different from what you said before. You checked carefully before letting Tenna go, picking him up and putting him back on your book to sit down: "Alright, you should stay here. I'll finish the rest myself." ”
As you spoke, you quickly finished the report and started the next. Tenna looked at your profile, which looked a bit reflective in the computer screen's glare, and couldn't help but swallow again. Your cheeks and expression looked so serious and earnest. He really liked it—if only he could kiss him a few more times...... Of course, you wouldn't agree, right? Thinking of this, Tenna's antenna drooped again.
He swung his legs, not daring to make a sound, since you were busy with ...... If you'd be willing to take a few more looks at him after finishing all this, and luckily, after you finished your current tasks, you did look at Tenna again. After all, you had extra work this morning. You simply pulled Tenna down and started fiddling with him casually. You grabbed his arm and casually arranged it into other shapes, as if you were really playing with a toy you could tinker with. You started fiddling with his legs, finally arranging it like a duck and placed it on your desk.
You couldn't help but laugh when you saw him; that pose was a bit funny and a little cute...... Tenna looked at you and smiled, cautiously asking, "Darling, are you feeling a little happier? Then...... Do you like me a little more?" He looked at you, looking like if you said it weren't for him, he would really cry in this position.
Actually, you think he is indeed quite foolish...... Well, you wouldn't say he's especially foolish, he's not very smart, but this way of looking is still quite cute. At least you don't dislike him, and you probably do like him a little...... After all, you feel happy about it.
But with the mindset of teasing him a little, you deliberately shook your head regretfully and said, "No, because you're too stupid...... It's already good if you don't hate you even more." That sentence was half true, half false; you really did harbor a little intention to dislike him...... Just a little, because he did cause you trouble, but you thought it was fine, and you weren't angry.
Then you see his antenna droop. He is indeed maintaining the duck-like posture, but his hands begin to wipe the now black, wet screen. Yet large teardrops continue to fall and fall onto your desk, sounding like he is crying loudly. No matter how hard he tries to hold back, he still can't help but cry.
You pursed your lips, watched him cry loudly, and wondered if you had gone too far...... Then you reached out and gently patted his head: "Don't ...... Don't cry. Even though you're a bit slow, you really made me much happier, so...... Affection +9, I guess. "You don't know how to comfort this big guy...... Oh, now he's a little guy, so all he can do is speak his true feelings. Tenna's sobs gradually faded, and you saw his screen light up again. His tears still hung on the screen, and he was cautious, his voice still tinged with tears.
Tenna asked, "Really?" ”
"Really, really...... Your silly look is cute too, and I really like you a little more. "You patted his head again, then pulled him aside so he wouldn't interfere with your work anymore, after all...... He'd be better off sitting here as a mascot.
Unfortunately, the morning was quite quiet, but by the afternoon, when other departments came to work, the workload suddenly surged. Although Tenna wanted to say something to you, you were too busy to intervene, and besides, he didn't want to disturb you, so he could only quietly sit nearby and watch.
As for you...... Haha, another day of overtime. You just munched on a sandwich for dinner and got back to work. Tenna wanted to say something, but he could only quietly watch you until you actually got off work and took him home by subway. Neither of you said anything else. When you got home, Tenna had returned to normal size, and you just washed up quickly and collapsed onto the bed. For a moment, Tenna could only hear your heavy breathing, clearly exhausted today.
…… He felt a bit guilty—he couldn't help at all, and even wasted your time. He could only sit there in a daze, watching your work get anxious for you, but he couldn't help at all. Even though you didn't say that, he ...... No, at least your mental state seems pretty good, doesn't it? Tenna thought, you really are happy.
Feeling down, he made himself a sandwich too, then skillfully turned off the lights in your room and lay down on your bed. He gazed at your quiet sleeping face, and in the end couldn't help but snuggle up and hug you tightly—even though he was warm and probably not comfortable for you, Tenna looked at you and couldn't help but shower you with countless kisses. He wanted to kiss you, to embrace you—he wanted to have everything about you...... He reaffirmed once again that he truly liked you. Tenna held you, carefully licking your lips, looking at your slightly messy clothes and the fair skin exposed, and couldn't help but swallow again...... He couldn't help but bury his head and gently bit down on the equally exposed Zhu Rui, while at the same time, he felt the object beneath him growing hot and scorching...... He knew it was because he couldn't help but stand up. Tenna looked at you pitifully, even if you wouldn't react at all...... And he held you tightly, that thing carefully rubbing between your legs. Fortunately, probably because you were too tired, you didn't wake up.

He stared blankly at the white sticky substance dripping from the edge of your damp panties, then trembled as he reached out his hand, thinking...... He thought, since you're still not awake after all this, maybe even if I change your underwear, you won't wake up. With this hopeful mindset, he reached for your underwear, trying to pull it off.
Your sleep has never been very peaceful...... At first, it just felt a bit damp and hot, and the sensation on your body was like being in a sauna. Instinctively, you glance over and see your thighs and underwear covered in a white, viscous liquid that is obviously hard to describe. Tenna is still pulling down your underwear, already up to your knees—your face flushes instantly. You quickly sit up, grab the cup beside you, and wrap your lower body up. You feel both embarrassed and annoyed. Oh my god, you had no idea Tenna would do this—
“ANT TENNA！！ I'm going to reduce my favorability to -10,000 points!! "You shouted angrily, wildly throwing pillows and other things from the bed at him, then took off the dirty underwear beneath you, dried the white liquid from your legs, and tossed it aside. For a moment, you just threw whatever was at hand. Tenna covered his head with both hands but didn't dare say a word, because he really did something wrong. You threw the medicine box, lamp, and cup from the nightstand at Tenna. For a moment, the room was filled with crisp or dull sounds of smashing. Finally, you threw the dirty pair of underwear at Tenna as well. The underwear hung on Tenna's antenna, crookedly upside down on his screen. You were stunned for a moment, your face turning even redder. You couldn't tell if it was from anger or embarrassment...... Anyway, when you pushed him out of your bedroom, he didn't resist, so you didn't use much force. You're still covered with a blanket on your lower body, which is really inconvenient. You plan to throw this annoying perverted scoundrel out of the house tomorrow—nothing he says to you will help!!
You stormed angrily toward the bathroom in the room, quickly rinsed your thighs, then put on a new pair of underwear and lay down on the bed. Feeling a bit agitated, you tossed and turned several times before barely falling asleep, not very soundly.
Meanwhile, Tenna was on the other side...... After you pushed him out the door, he took off his shorts and instinctively leaned in to smell you...... Then his screen changed color to a nearly pink color. He obediently put your underwear in the bathroom and tried to push it open at your door, but it wouldn't open. He tried to recall the lock-picking techniques he'd seen, trying to use the hairpin from the bathroom cabinet to open the door, but clearly, he failed. He tried to sneak in through your bedroom window, but just in case, the window was locked tightly...... His antenna drooped, leaving Tenna very frustrated, while at the same time, a feeling of guilt, nervousness, and timidity took over his heart...... He knew he shouldn't do that, and he knew that if you found out, you'd definitely be furious, but...... But he just couldn't hold back; he wanted to get close to you so much that even the way you were angry and cursed and blushed just now, Tenna instinctively wanted to bite into him...... He felt that at this moment, everything was probably delicious.
But maybe, he still can't get close to you...... He shrank down and crouched outside your bedroom door, hugging his knees again. He knew he was wrong, he knew he should apologize to you, he didn't know if you would forgive him, nor ...... Would you still let him stay by your side? He didn't know if that pale apology would be useful...... His tears slid down the screen, dripping onto the floor, and he cried silently. He ...... He regretted it, Tenna thought, he shouldn't have thought about testing your limits...... He wished he could hold you tightly and fall asleep.
Tenna reopened the parental lock in his mind. He knew that the situation he had turned like this was mostly due to the parent mode he had turned off in his mind. Of course, Tenna had to admit that part of it was indeed ...... He wanted it so badly, he wanted to kiss you so much, he ...... He wanted so much, to show you his love no matter what.
He hugged his knees and curled up at your bedroom door, growing smaller and quieter as he fell asleep. When he woke up startled, dawn was breaking, and he instinctively got up and ran to the kitchen, preparing a hearty breakfast for you—a crispy scone, bread spread with strawberry and blueberry jam, a perfectly cooked glossy soft-boiled egg, two crispy sausages, and a cup of steaming black tea.
Tenna curled up again at your doorstep and sat down, hugging his knees like a small pet dog. His screen was pitch black, tears kept flowing, and his voice was faint, just a faint sob...... He hoped that after you got up, seeing this breakfast table would lift his mood, but he was also afraid you would never forgive him again, not even knowing he was ...... Should you leave your home right now? He thought, maybe if you're angry, it's because you don't want to see him again.
And when you yawned, you sat up in bed and didn't feel very good...... Hmm, although you weren't as angry anymore, you still cared a lot about what happened last night. You told yourself you had to toughen up, and no matter what, you had to kick him out no matter what.
But when you open the bedroom door to step outside, you kick a slightly hard, crisp metallic object. You glance down and see it is Tenna, shrunk into a ball, quietly sobbing while holding yourself.
…… Well, I have to say, because of his crying, you really did soften a little. But then you remind yourself not to be soft-hearted—then you hear Tenna's voice: "I'm sorry...... Sorry, truly very sorry, dear...... I shouldn't have done that...... I guess you might not like it, but I really couldn't hold back. Sorry, sorry, I'm really sorry, I just want you to ...... Maybe you can feel better, but it seems like I was too selfish...... He kept apologizing to you, saying all sorts of nonsense until you couldn't understand...... Well, I can only say that no matter what, it doesn't sound very smart.
You want to say something, but you turn to look at the steaming breakfast on the dining table, but the words you want to say are held back.
