title: Trainee Boyfriend 14 (tennax you)
content:
You don't have time to savor what breakfast tastes like. You just stuff those two slices of bread into your mouth and hurriedly eat the fried egg. Then you look at Tenna, who is sitting nervously hugging her knees at your door, and finally nods, your tone still soft: "Yeah, it tastes pretty good, but I have to go to work, so I won't have time to savor it carefully." ”
Originally, you planned to throw him out of your house as soon as he came in the morning, but you knew very well that a TV person who looked completely different from others would probably only be sent to a lab for dissection or something if caught. Plus, surveillance is very advanced nowadays; you might accidentally find your own home while investigating, and then you might be arrested and questioned, which would make things especially complicated...... It might even delay you for a long time. After thinking it over, you decided to leave Tenna at home for now.
…… It's definitely not that you've softened your heart; you just think that throwing Tenna out would cause more trouble.
His screen lit up, and it looked like he was in a good mood because he had received your comment...... Well, you don't know how this guy can be so easily happy, because at that moment, you see flowers blooming again on the tip of his nose, and he must be in a good mood.
You shrugged, then walked to the door, picked up your handbag, put on your shoes, and got ready to leave—but before leaving home, you deliberately opened your bag to take a look, then grabbed Tenna, who had somehow slipped into your bag, and placed it on the counter just in case. Before leaving, you checked yourself again, then pulled the shrinking Tenna off your pant leg, sleeve, and even the one sitting on your shoulder. Before closing the door, you glanced at it to confirm he was indeed staying at your home, finally breathed a sigh of relief, and was about to close the door.
Just before closing the door, you heard Tenna's words, and he timidly asked, "Um...... Dear, I, can't I go to work with you? ”
You took a deep breath and tried to stay calm, saying, "No. If you come with me, you'll only cause me trouble...... There have been a lot of people at the company these days, and I don't want you to be caught and taken to the lab for dissection." "That's true. There are indeed a lot of messy people in the company these days, so you won't be causing trouble for yourself."
Tenna's antenna drooped, and he looked as if he had been flattened, just staggering in place. Even his voice became hoarse: "Alright, I understand. My presence is a trouble for you. I can't go with you and cause trouble anymore......" With that, he flattened his way into the room.
You have no idea how he's ended up like this again. Helplessly, he scratched his head and said, "I'm not saying you're a nuisance to me...... It's just that some things are better left unaddressed if I can, you understand? ”
You don't know if he understands, but he seems to not, since he's still a bit flat, just nodding.
You sighed, not knowing what to say, just closed the door and left. You rushed to work by subway, but because talking with Tenna delayed you for a while, you almost arrived at the company right on time to check in. There were a lot of people visiting the company today. After all, the higher-ups were signing some big contract, so you didn't have much work to do. At least you didn't work overtime today and left on time.
You stretched lazily, walked tiredly to your doorstep, opened the door, and yawned. As soon as you opened the door, a wave of aroma greeted you...... It smelled like grilled lamb chops, but you actually had no appetite after a day at work. Then you noticed a gift box on the entrance counter. Curious, you picked it up, and Tenna, still stained with a few drops of oil on the screen, poked out from the kitchen. You saw him wearing a pink heart-shaped apron, though you had no idea where he found it.
And his voice was delighted: "Darling, welcome home!" I ...... "That, that's the gift I prepared for you, because I'm still very sorry about what happened last night......" As he spoke, his voice gradually quieted. You noticed his screen brightness seemed to be dimmed, probably not very enthusiastic. Anyway, he hurried back into the kitchen. Curious, you opened the gift box and took a look. Inside was a piano-style music box, which was indeed quite delicate and beautiful...... Hmm, although you didn't particularly like this thing. After turning the sound, you could see the piano keys were pressed down, which was quite nice.
You sit at the dining table, casually setting the music box aside, while Tenna, wearing large cooking gloves, excitedly brings your grilled lamb chops to the table. Then he places a plate of crispy, fluffy pie on the table and sits across from you, looking eagerly anticipating your evaluation, since he is holding his head with both hands and grinning at you.
You swallowed back what you wanted to say and tried a piece of grilled lamb chop first. It really tasted good, very light, without much pepper or chili, just to your taste, with just a bit of cumin on top. So you gave Tenna a thumbs-up, showing you were very satisfied with the taste of the grilled lamb chop. You watched Tenna's antenna sway, and then a tiny flower appeared at the tip of his nose again. He was grinning foolishly, probably very happy.
You took another bite of the pie, and once again you couldn't help but furrow your brows—oh my god, it's hard to say what this tastes like, it's heavy, a bit sweet, even a bit sticky. Seeing Tenna's expectant expression, you feel too embarrassed to spit out the sweet pastry and swallow it with difficulty.
Then you gave Tenna a thumbs-down and said with difficulty, "Hmm...... Here, um, it's really bad. I should have told you, I don't like sweets anymore, right? ”
Tenna's screen instantly went off again, his tone a bit panicked: "But...... But this is my specialty...... In the past, my subordinates would always praise my delicious food......
“…… But what if they say your cooking isn't good? What would you do?" Your tone was flat.
"Then I'll dock their salaries heavily, and their monthly performance evaluation will be zero." Tenna said without hesitation. He really would do that, since he never thought anything he made tasted bad, since he had done it using exactly the same steps as Torriel...... He just added a bit more sugar.
"See, that's exactly why anyone dares say your cooking isn't good?" You sighed and shrugged. Maybe after being lectured a couple of times, Tenna felt a bit guilty, but Tenna involuntarily shrank. He lowered his head, his hands obediently resting on his knees, anxiously waiting for your evaluation.
"Very sweet, very greasy, terrible, really not to my taste...... But that doesn't mean your cooking isn't tasty, it's just that it doesn't suit me. Maybe next time you can add less sugar. "You made your judgment fairly and objectively, while Tenna just let out a gloomy 'oh,' probably still not very happy.
You blink, pick up the music box beside you, and with a hint of teasing, ask, "Also, who told you I like music boxes?" "Although it's actually quite fun, and you really like it just as a decoration...... But that doesn't mean you really like music boxes.
Tenna said dryly, "But in the game, when asked what you like, you say you like music boxes...... So he spent a long time searching and found scattered woodworking tools in your room. He painstakingly checked tutorials to carve this music box, and he even broke several prototypes.
You couldn't help but laugh and cry: "That's because none of your four options are what I wanted to choose. I can only pick the one I like the most...... Think about all your options, right? Books? Forgive me, I stopped liking reading after I started working. Game discs? Hmm...... I'm not some game-loving otaku, why would I like this? I like anything Tenna gave me? It's not like I like something you gave me...... There are some things I just can't like, no matter what. "After you finish, you sigh, and as you spoke, Tenna's figure shrank smaller and smaller, until finally, he curled up in his chair like a tiny one, looking very dejected.
You don't want him to end up like this; you just want to make things clear...... You couldn't help but sigh again, stiffly picking him up and lightly patting his head: "Alright, it's not that I don't like your gift. Actually, I do quite like it. So, my favorability has changed to Zheng Ju." You glanced at the guest room next to you. You didn't tidy up, so I guess Tenna hasn't tidied up either...... You don't really need to tidy up for him. That's probably how it is. You walked into your own room, put Tenna back on the floor he had made, looking expressionless, while you just got into bed. Turning around, you said dryly, "The guest room isn't tidyed up. You should just sleep here for now." ”
It's definitely not that you've softened your heart.
You turned off the light, and Tenna curled up there tiny. To be honest, after hearing your answer, he was still happy...... Listening to your gradually gentle breathing, he couldn't help but hold his breath. His body returned to its original size, and then he couldn't help but gently climb onto your bed, hands on his chest. He nervously lay in the corner of the bed, but his tail involuntarily reached toward you.

title: Trainee Boyfriend 15 (tennax you)
content:
Tenna wanted to stop his tail, but it kept shaking, not really obeying his commands. Instead, it excitedly wrapped around your ankles, and he couldn't help but hold his breath—after all, if you woke up, things would get even more complicated. He couldn't explain why he was in your bed...... Nor could he explain what that wire tail was doing.
Fortunately, you probably slept deeply, so he could only hear your shallow, steady breathing. Tenna held his breath and moved a little closer to you, and you happened to turn over, turning your face to face Tenna. He stared at your cheek, involuntarily taking a deep breath. He looked at you, doing his best to outline your features, then carefully turned over and gently reached out to hug you. He didn't dare do anything more, in fact...... At this moment, just being able to hold you tightly was already enough for him. He didn't dare ask for more, just slightly tightened his grip and gently pulled you into his arms.
You probably felt hot and mumbled something softly in your sleep, while Tenna's body just stiffened. He ...... He almost thought you were about to wake up, but seeing you showed no sign of waking, Tenna happily leaned in and gently kissed your forehead, then obediently turned off his screen, stuck the flower that had popped out from the tip of his nose into your head, and then fell asleep.
You didn't dream at all, but for some reason, you always felt hot. When you woke up, sure enough, you saw Tenna holding you, curled up in his arms...... You figured he probably hadn't done anything, otherwise you would have woken up. You just silently sat up and rolled your eyes at Tenna—well, this guy immediately knelt obediently beside you as soon as you got up, looking like he was letting you scold him. Alright, but after you said it, he didn't change...... Uh, but he's your probation boyfriend, so this is probably normal—what the heck, you didn't agree.
But in the end, you just lightly kicked him, got dressed, got out of bed, and your voice was light: "You pervert...... Forget it, goodwill score -5. "This punishment is just light. No matter what, he'll probably still sneak up and hug you tightly. Aside from being a little warm, there's nothing less to it...... Well, after all, summer is really hot.
You walk out of the bedroom, casually wrap a sandwich for yourself, and send breakfast to your meal, while Tenna continues to follow closely behind you, as if you can't disappear from his sight even for a second. You don't care about that, but on the eve of leaving, you take Tenna, who had slipped into your bag again, put him on the counter, and stop him from climbing onto your clothes. You can't help but sigh, "I'll try to come back on time tonight, okay?" I won't keep you waiting long. No matter what you say to you going to work with me, it won't be convenient." After saying that, you closed the door, making sure Tenna was still in the room—you only closed it after making sure he was still in your line of sight.
Indeed, there weren't many tasks today, and you left work on time.
After you left, Tenna awkwardly took out his phone, opened the chat window, tapped on the keyboard with a single finger, hesitantly wanting to send you a message, but...... But he didn't want to disturb you, didn't want to annoy you, didn't know if he could send messages to harass you, so in the end, he deleted all the characters he typed, stared blankly at the blank chat window, and gave up.
Maybe it's better to think about what to give you today...... He can't go out to buy anything, so he looks over the remaining items in your room and finally decides to combine yesterday's leftover scrap with the wood left in the room.
He struggled to scrap several more prototypes, and finally managed to make something he was satisfied with...... A super miniature doll shaped like Tenna. Then he carefully colored it with acrylic paint you found at home. Although it wasn't particularly beautiful, it was definitely ...... Enough, at least Tenna was very pleased looking at the model. He pulled out a gift box and stuffed the small puppet-shaped doll inside. Then he placed the gift box where you could see it as soon as you walked in and went to the kitchen to figure out what to make for you today.
…… As usual, he made a pie, but he tried to sprinkle as little sugar as possible. He hoped today's pie would suit your taste—of course, today it was apple pie. Besides that, he made two grilled steaks, sprinkled a little black pepper, and finally made a serving of pasta.
After finishing all this, he restlessly waited for you to come home. You promised to leave work on time today, so he sat on the sofa, looking up at the door. Sure enough, at six o'clock, you arrived home on time. Exhausted, you put down your backpack and changed into indoor shoes. You naturally noticed the gift box placed on the counter. Curious, you opened it and took a look—it was...... It was a small model of Tenna, a wooden doll. Although Tenna's craftsmanship was average, it showed that the puppet was carefully made, or rather, he had done his best. But...... Hmm, the puppet's color scheme and size were exactly the same as when Tenna was a little girl, making it hard not to suspect he wanted to pass it off as real. You stared at the puppet for a while, then looked at Tenna, who was eagerly watching you, waiting for your answer. You saw his antenna standing upright, gently shaking, and the screen shining brightly at you.
You looked down at the puppet again, then carefully placed it in the small pocket on the side of your bag, so it wouldn't roll together with other things inside and break it. Then you walked up to Tenna, unsure what to do, but seeing Tenna like that every night, she probably really liked hugging you. You hesitated for a moment, then gently hugged him and softly said, "Mm...... Thank you, I really like this gift. Goodwill +20, I guess." "You were indeed quite happy to receive this gift, even though you don't know why you were so happy, and ...... Also, you don't understand why you still seem to have a strange feeling in your heart.
You want to let go, but Tenna won't let go. Instead, he hugs you tightly, his voice trembling with excitement and trembling, speaking very quickly, as if repeating the same words over and over: "I like you...... Darling, as long as you're by my side, I'm happy. I like you...... I like you, and I love this hug. Darling, you're just so good...... He was rambling, sounding ...... Well, he really was repeating the same words.
You felt a bit lost. You didn't know why Tenna reacted that way, just instinctively patted his back. He just held you, seemingly holding you tighter, as if rubbing his head against your shoulder and neck before finally letting go. You saw a silly smile on his screen, and a dazzling ...... bloomed at the tip of his nose. Why is it a rose? You widened your eyes at Tenna, then just picked the rose and handed it to you, a bit embarrassed, saying, "This is for you...... Darling, do you like me a little more? ”
You accepted the rose and casually placed it in the vase on the table. Maybe you wouldn't even need to buy flowers separately for decoration. You just patted Tenna's head, patted her twice, and casually said, "Yeah, I do like you a bit more. Affection +5." "Affection is originally just a measure of your own desires. If you were to say it, it's more like mood value...... But after hearing that, Tenna happily shook the antenna and headed toward the kitchen, the end of the wire behind her swaying rapidly.
Tonight's dinner tasted pretty good, at least just to your taste—not too sweet or cloying, not too salty or fishy, just a light and light flavor you wanted. You finished your dinner comfortably and silently gave Tenna a thumbs up. Of course, you didn't hold back on compliments, since you secretly looked up how to maintain a stable relationship...... Although he's the one winning you over, you've indeed benefited, so you think it's only right to give him some emotional value in return. And so, you convince yourself.
"Hmm, tonight's dinner tastes pretty good...... Affection +10, I guess." You said that at this level of affection, you probably get along well with friends. After dinner, you casually browsed your phone for a while before returning to your room to lie down. After Tenna finished cleaning the dishes, he arrived at your room. He carefully climbed onto your bed and lay down not far from you. You glanced at him but ignored Tenna's behavior. Seeing that you didn't object, Tenna couldn't help but move toward you again. He reached out to hug you, but you blocked his hand and gently pushed him away, causing his antenna to droop again and he collapsed weakly.
…… Anyway, even if he falls asleep, he'll still pick you up. Thinking this, you forced yourself not to look at him again. Tenna probably realized your current cold attitude, so he shrank even smaller, just clinging to his knees listlessly. His screen was off, and his tail was tightly wrapped around you.

“…… Yes, I will never leave you, I will always belong to you...... I will love you forever, Y/N, Y/N, darling, I really love you so much...... All of this is beyond what I could have imagined before...... He murmured, also grabbing your left hand and putting that ring on your finger. You nodded gently in return.
"Alright...... Now you can relax, right? It's a promise, I'll always love you......" You gently patted Tenna's head, and he just gasped.
"Oh my god, I'm so happy, oh my god...... I, I, Y/N, Y/N......" He kept calling your name, once again deeply buried that member inside you, as if trying to completely blend you into his, as if he wanted to take over everything about you, as if ...... As if all of this belonged to him.
"You're mine now, you're completely mine......" he murmured, repeating himself, holding your body and rubbing against you. His head rubbed against your shoulder and neck, and that member rubbed back and forth inside your passage.
“…… Mm-hmm, I'm yours." You decided to fulfill Tenna's wish and said that. But Tenna just hugged you tightly. You saw a silly smile on his screen, and flowers bloomed at the tip of his nose again.
"Then let's do what we're supposed to do on our wedding night, Y/N." He said this cheerfully. You reacted for a second to what was going on, but the next second, his kiss shut your mouth.
END.

title: Trainee Boyfriend Merger (1)
content:
You rested your chin on your hand in boredom, watching the CG on the screen—Tenna proposing to the protagonist...... After quickly finishing the story, you closed the game. To be honest, this was a very fun otome game recommended to you by your best friend a while ago. Although your interest in otome games isn't great, you still downloaded it after her strong recommendation.
But you regret playing it for just a while...... After all, it doesn't seem much different from other otome games, except for an extra option to input personal dialogue. You guess the built-in AI might have replied to your words, but you quickly lose interest.
After all, playing otome games is always like this: choosing the right options, the right gifts, the right actions, and coincidental timing can smoothly boost affection. After all, every game character set up has their own set of values and preferences. Rather than saying the male lead in an otome game falls in love with you, it's more accurate to say he falls in love with the self who disguises himself and matches his preferences.
So you quickly get bored, figure out the preferences of this TV head named Tenna, and soon finish the strategy, planning to quit altogether. Although you don't know why if you choose to type dialogues yourself, no matter what you say, it will increase your favorability, but later you won't bother to talk anymore. You're naturally quiet and don't like to talk much.
So you choose the option based on the preferences you previously guessed. And now, you close the game window and plan to uninstall it. You uninstall successfully, then you hold your phone, planning to go out for lunch and complain to your best friend that the game isn't that fun at all.
Before leaving, you glanced at the dusty appliances sitting in the corner...... You bought them out of boredom, probably with a CRT TV or something else. You originally planned to play games on it, but it turned out computers suited your preferences better—at least they weren't that heavy.
You lowered your head and typed rapidly on your phone, then walked out of the room, casually made yourself some instant noodles, and brought it home, planning to sit in front of the computer to eat.
But as soon as you walked in, you were startled—you almost spilled instant noodles. Luckily, you remembered the floor would be hard to clean up, so you didn't let go. You just forced yourself to stay calm and stared at Tenna, who suddenly appeared in your room. Even when she squatted, she still looked tall and looked aggrieved.
…… And when you walk in, it shrinks to about the size of other pet dogs, then slowly walks up to your side, seemingly wanting to rub against your leg. In the middle of summer, your legs do feel like a cold metal sheet now. But actually, it does dissipate heat.
You cover your forehead with your free other hand, feeling a bit of a headache and trouble. In fact, at first you wondered if you were dreaming, but it turned out you pinched your own face—it hurt.
So it probably wasn't a dream. You kept a calm face, but your mind was blank. You brought the noodles over and set them on the table, then lowered your head to look at Tenna.
“…… Mr. Tenna, I think I've already unlocked your ending—it's a perfect ending." "That's exactly what you don't understand the most. After all, you have OCD. You haven't cleared any of the other bad endings, only this one perfect ending."
Tenna looks up at you. Actually, he has many questions he wants to ask, like saying that at first you were still talking to him and he was happy to be able to communicate with you, but why did you end up choosing those options instead...... He can only watch you through the narrow screen, unable to take any action. Even those conversations are preset, so all he can see is your increasingly uninterested expression, feeling inexplicably anxious.
He wants to ask why you stopped talking to him, why you only quickly got through the ending, or even stop looking at him, he wants to ask why you just uninstalled the game......
But in the end, he just asked, "...... You uninstalled the game directly, so what about our married life?" ”
While eating the noodles, you almost choked up when you heard this. Luckily, you swallowed it with difficulty, or you would have sprayed the noodles on the computer screen. But the price was that after eating, you still coughed dryly many times.
A glass of water appeared beside you. You glanced at Tenna, who had suddenly grown bigger, but didn't say much. You just took the cup and took a sip, barely suppressing the choking sensation.
Only then did you clear your throat and say, "Does this game system even have a post-marriage mode?" "You're genuinely confused. You didn't see it when downloading, nor did you see it when you cleared the ending. You just returned to the big screen after the happy end message appeared."
He fell into an awkward, subtle silence, and you patiently waited for a moment before he finally spoke: "No, but could you come back and see me a bit more?" "As long as you watch me a little longer, Tenna feels satisfied."
You looked at him carefully for a while longer, eating instant noodles while mumbling a bit unclearly, "Why should I go back to see you more often?" ”
“…… I thought you liked me a lot." He lowered his head, clearly thinking so, since his voice sounded very dejected and his figure was shrinking.
You were genuinely surprised at this moment. Although watching him shrink made you feel a subtle pity, you still asked, "Why should I like you?" ”
Honestly, you just find this character fairly cute and don't have much to dislike, so you're willing to understand his ending. But if you say you like him, you can't quite say how much you like him.
But you can also understand why he has that idea, so you say, "Well, I understand why you think that way, but I don't think it's necessary." ”
"After all, in the end, the choices I made were just options that matched the character's preferences and pleasing them. I just created a virtual and hypocritical image you might like. You don't need to question the real me, nor do I have to like you." You said calmly, taking another sip of water.
You see his screen suddenly turn pitch black—maybe he's lost in thought. But you're not in a hurry. After waiting a while, his screen lights up again. You see his lips seem to move, but after a while, he finally utters a complete sentence: "But...... I've always seen it. I like you, I like the real you. ”
"I don't understand why you like me...... There must be some reason for this kind of longing, right? "You tilted your head and asked this question.
Tenna hesitated for a moment, but finally shook his head. In fact, he didn't understand the reason either. He only knew that he loved the feeling of being watched by you. As long as you kept watching him, he felt satisfied. But over time, he wasn't satisfied with just watching. You looked at him, and he looked at you. He wanted more touch, wanted to touch the real you, wanted to talk to you, not just watch you through a narrow screen.
In fact, it was only after you uninstalled the game that he suddenly realized he had this privilege. Using that old CRT as a medium, he came into this world, sat across from you, and had this conversation with you.
You found it a bit amusing, and for some reason, he looked a bit nervous at this moment. You clearly couldn't see his eyes, but his fingers resting on his knees kept fidgeting, probably feeling uneasy.
Then you cleared your throat and said solemnly, "Alright, I still don't understand why you like me. But I want to tell you something seriously...... Just because you like me doesn't mean I have to like you. Whether I like you or not is my natural and genuine choice. In fact, I chose you as my game strategy target just because you look pleasing to the eye. Maybe I have some affection, but it's far from liking you. ”
You watch Tenna lower her head, lowering it more and more, and you watch him shrink again, eventually becoming the size of a pet dog, silently leaning against your calf. You seem to feel a bit moist...... Probably from the direction of the screen. So the TV can cry too? You wonder about it absentmindedly.
"But the fact that you like me has nothing to do with me, so I won't ask much about it...... But I think I can still give you a chance." You thought about it and felt a bit unwilling, because for some reason, you couldn't be sure that this affection or love truly existed. You only wanted a definite love that could be confirmed. If not, then it would have been better if it never existed.
After hearing this, Tenna grew bigger again, sitting across from you, looking at you longingly. You just felt that at this moment, you should describe him that way.
You solemnly reached out a hand to him: "You can try and make me like you too. Or at least, let me feel your love...... Come to think of it, I don't even know what this counts as. Maybe it's called an apprentice boyfriend? "You thought for a moment.
Tenna quickly reached out a hand, his palm large, tightly wrapping your hand inside, unwilling to let go.
"Of course, I'm willing to do it." He said this, and you couldn't help but laugh a little, feeling like he spoke like a wedding vow. Then, as if noticing he was holding too hard, he hurriedly let go again.
But you just took his hand and gently shook it, looking relaxed: "Alright, then, trainee boyfriend, nice to meet you." ”
Calling it an apprentice, calling it a boyfriend, you really aren't used to having someone else at home—and even a TV personality. After you finish, you quickly start rummaging at your slightly cold instant noodles. You're still a bit hungry, and you've only just eaten a few bites—just as you were about to pick up the noodle bucket, Tenna reached out and took your noodles away.
You looked at Tenna. He was smiling, but now seeing you looking at him with a blank expression, he just clasped his hands behind his back and lowered his head slightly: "Oh...... Darling, I don't know if I can call you that. But...... But since we're in this relationship now, I think I can't let you eat such unhealthy things anymore. "As you spoke, you heard a noise—you realized it was Tenna throwing your bucket of instant noodles into the trash.
You silently glanced at the bucket of instant noodles, then looked up at Tenna. Your tone was calm, but there was a hint of curiosity: "Hmm...... So you're planning to make me something to eat yourself?" You asked, and Tenna just nodded happily. He raised his head high on the TV again, and you saw a flower blooming from his nose, exactly like the happy look you saw when you saw him in the game.
Then he wandered to the kitchen to prepare something for you...... You didn't say anything more, just opened your phone to check if any romantic characters from the game had appeared. It turned out you hadn't found anything, so you didn't believe it and simply posted a message.

You put down your phone because you hear the crisp sound of dishes on the dining table.
You walk over and take a look. Tenna is nervously rubbing her hands, not really used to it...... Well, cold sweat is even dripping down his screen. You know, he's like this in games too—whenever he prepares something for you, he always shows a very nervous state before you can see it...... There's really nothing to do to persuade him.
You look at the table, where a simple fried egg, a bowl of pasta with ketchup, and a steak topped with plenty of black pepper sauce are all set up in the game—well, it's basically the same setup in the game, a simple but truly filling lunch.
You sit down and pick up your knife and fork, trying to cut the steak. But after a long struggle, you still can't succeed. Tenna snatches the knife and fork from your hand: "Oh dear, let me do it instead......" he says, while you look at his screen, cold sweat starts to roll down your face again, looking extremely nervous.
You watch Tenna effortlessly cut the steak into small pieces, exactly as you told him in the game. Then Tenna looks at you somewhat anxiously, probably waiting for your feedback. You watch as his antenna bends and hangs down, the end of the wire behind him sways restlessly, and he just asks urgently, "What do you think?" ”
You didn't answer him, just picked up a piece of steak and chewed it. Then you instinctively frowned—oh my god, there's way too much black pepper sauce, that sticky texture and salty flavor filling your mouth, and not only that...... This steak must be overcooked, no wonder you couldn't cut it just now...... But Tenna was quite strong, so naturally, she cut it off. You chewed for a long time before struggling to finish the steak, then glanced at the table and hurriedly picked up the glass of milk and gulped it down—this was probably Tenna's just brought the milk, warm and just right, at least you were willing to drink it.
You take a few deep breaths, watching Tenna, whose antenna hangs even lower because she hasn't gotten your answer, just hanging above the screen. His screen is pitch black, and his figure seems to have shrunk a little.
You hesitate for a moment—in the game, you always lie to him saying it tastes good, even though every prompt text tells you it tastes terrible. But after all, you haven't really eaten it, so you always choose to trick him. And now...... Well, you choose to be honest, because now he's trying to win your love, he wants to win you over: "It tastes terrible. First, the black pepper sauce on the steak is oversprinkled, making it especially salty, and because there's too much sauce, it's too thick and sticky." Then there's the steak, you're overcooking...... Oh, or maybe you even got a bit burnt by the pan-sea? That's really ...... A rare texture, well, at least this kind of song has a fresh texture. "You bluntly shared your comment, and after hearing your comment, Tenna still stood with her hands behind her back, her head seemingly lowered...... And it seemed her figure was getting smaller and smaller.
You hear Tenna's hesitant voice: "But...... But didn't you always say I made delicious food before? ”
"The past is the past, and the present is now. I'm playing games, and to win you over, of course I'll pick the option you like...... But now, I don't need to win you over; it's just that simple. If you just like me saying nice things...... Then I suggest you go back. "You blinked and said, although you think such words sound a bit heartless...... But, however, this kind of development will be good for both of you.
Tenna shrank into a tiny one, about the size of a pet dog, then slowly lifted his foot and walked over to your side. Although his voice was very soft at the moment, you could hear him clearly. After all, the room was very quiet at this moment—"No, I ...... I won't go back. I've said it before, what I love is the real you, or rather, what I want to love is the real you...... I won't leave you. So...... Please, don't ...... Leave me behind......" As he spoke, his voice grew softer and softer, and you propped your chin on your hand as you looked at Tenna, who was carefully tugging at your pant leg, and finally couldn't help but sigh.
You can't help but ask, "What exactly do you like about me? Why do you love me?" I'm really curious...... I really don't understand why you're so persistent. "Alright, seeing him like this, you can't help but feel a bit soft-hearted...... Indeed, the moment you close the game, you resolutely abandon him, so it's probably normal for him to want to be by your side just to ask for something.
“…… No reason, I just want to love you." He said, somewhat stammering...... At least you felt his voice sounded a bit muffled.
"How could there be no reason? What exactly do you love about me? I don't think there's anything cute about me...... You frown, biting into the hard steak, and finally finished the whole piece. Then you started to fry the egg. The egg was a bit burnt, though the flavor was still okay...... Hmm, you added a bit too much sugar. Could it be that this guy really thinks he likes sweets?
"I love you completely, no reason." Tenna emphasized. And you look down at him, and it doesn't seem like he's lying, even though you don't really believe it...... Maybe I'll ask him later, but you don't believe it...... There will be people who love you for no reason. But you didn't say it out loud, just responded coldly.
After a pause, you spoke again: "And then...... This fried egg is a bit burnt. Next time, pay attention to the heat. Also, I'm not that fond of sweets, so you can use less sugar. ”
"But...... But in the game, didn't you say you liked sweets...... His voice sounded a bit anxious and trembling, and you just sighed.
"Because there are only four options: sour, sweet, bitter, and salty, and I prefer spicy food...... Hmm, you didn't include that option among your options. "As you spoke, you shrugged. Although it was too sweet for you, you still ate the fried egg, and finally you picked up the bowl of pasta. Fortunately, the texture of the pasta was pretty good...... Hmm, you didn't pour too much ketchup.
So you nod in satisfaction: "But this bowl of pasta tastes pretty good, I like it." ”
For some reason, Tenna's body had grown again, almost the same size as you, but he was still staring at the screen in darkness, head down.
Even after you finished the food on the table, you still didn't hear him speak...... You had to turn your head to glance at him, but Tenna suddenly clenched her fist and said, "I...... Darling, I'll try my best to understand your preferences...... Next time, next time I'll do even better! ”
Well, you shrug and let him be.
After all...... What you eat doesn't make much difference to you. Even so, to fill your stomach, you still finish the food on the table—after all, you've always had this habit, and of course, it's really just to fill your stomach; beyond that, it doesn't really matter to you.
So...... So actually, you don't have to be too picky about food tastes. After all, the difference is whether it's more suitable for your taste.
Tenna sat opposite you, his antenna drooping, the screen still pitch black, as if he'd done something wrong, hands behind his back, afraid to look up at you—he'd been in this posture since his size had just grown, and you really couldn't understand what he was thinking, since his screen was off now.
So you cleared your throat and tentatively asked, "I'm done eating?" ”
At that moment, Tenna's body trembled. He instinctively straightened the antenna, but still didn't dare to open the screen. The pitch-black screen was just pointed at you, and then he mumbled, "Oh...... Darling, you... are you done eating?" He said this as he looked down at the table, seemingly even more surprised, since you had heard his tone rise.
"You...... You actually finished it all? So...... So you still like my cooking? "He asked tentatively, probably just a test, since you heard his voice so cautious, tinged with panic, as if beneath it was a bit of a ...... A slight surprise?
For Tenna, it was a pleasant surprise—after all, you raised your opinion, you thought his cooking tasted bad, and Tenna was planning to make you another one...... Of course, he never imagined such an outcome.
He ...... He was so happy, his heart was blazing with joy. He couldn't help but open the screen again, pressing his hands together beside his head, smiling, and his nose tip once again showing flowers.
You blink at his smile, not understanding why he looks so happy now...... You just can't stand this kind of taste. Of course...... You don't want to waste food, after all, you bought all these ingredients with your own money!
So you just tell the truth: "I just don't want to waste food, it's that simple." "This really is your true feeling."
But Tenna still looked very happy—it seemed he misunderstood you, or rather...... Hmm, maybe he came to another wrong conclusion because of the current situation? That's your guess, but you don't really know what Tenna was thinking. You just think he...... Well, that actually makes him seem a bit naive, like he's not very smart.
But then you think about it—he's just a TV, how much thinking ability can he have? Thinking about it this way, you'll be at ease—it's normal for Tenna to seem a bit dumb.
You put down your hand, set the knife and fork on the empty plate, and cleared your throat: "Alright...... I don't know what you're thinking, but...... Hmm, I think you could go clean up these dishes and dishes. "You calmly finished speaking. After all, the one trying to please you now is Tenna—well, you don't think you need to get involved anymore. I have to admit, this kind of life is much happier than living alone...... No wonder those men all want to find a good wife and mother who can serve them.
However, having a TV personality who can serve you doesn't sound like a bad thing......
Tenna got up as instructed, picked up the bowls and plates, and walked toward the kitchen. But after putting them down, you didn't hear anything...... Well, the sound of running water—you just heard Tenna's footsteps. He walked out of the kitchen again, then returned to that smiling expression, but with his hands behind his back, he seemed a bit nervous. He looked up at the screen, then lowered his head: "Um...... So, dear, I want to ask you, do you like me a little more? ”
You were a bit confused—it was just a meal, what was he expecting? But you did feel good because of his service, so after thinking for a moment, you nodded: "Hmm, not bad, I guess." ”
"So, do you love me even a little?" His voice only grew more urgent, and he was desperate to get that answer.
You paused for a moment and didn't answer him. Tenna simply turned off the screen again, the antenna drooped, and his figure slowly shrank. In a low voice, he said, "Alright, don't pay attention to what I just said...... After all, what I made was really bad. It's normal that you don't like it, darling...... As he spoke, his figure grew smaller and smaller, once again about the size of a pet dog. Then he came over and grabbed your pant leg, just lowering his head and looking completely unresponsive: "Anyway...... Anyway, darling, if you want to scold me, just do it. After all, I really did not do well...... I'm sorry, dear...... I will strive to do better next time......
But his wet screen also soaked your pants...... And your ankle—you always found it a bit funny, but in the end, you didn't say anything about it, just softly said, "Mm. I didn't say I didn't like you, nor did I say I wanted to scold you...... Oh, of course, that's not exactly liking you. But it's not exactly dislike, right? "You thought about it and tried to organize your words. To be honest...... You're not very good at communicating with people like that, or maybe you don't like it at all. After all, mechanical people who can't speak human language are easier to deal with.
Tenna's figure seemed to grow a bit, but his voice was still small, or even somewhat pale and weak. For some reason, his figure looked swaying—well, you clearly remember he was still heavy.
"So...... So, do you like me a little more? "He was still fixated on the answer to that question.
You really don't know...... What exactly does liking and love really feel like? But if being happy because of his actions can be called liking...... Then surely you do like him a little, right? After all, you're actually quite happy.
Though it's not exactly that happy.
So you hesitate for a moment and reply, "I guess I like you a little more...... Yeah. Just a little. "Speaking of which, you suddenly want a little milk tea...... Hmm, the association is too rich, but you can definitely try it this afternoon.
"Just how much you like me...... But how much is a little bit, really? "His figure returned to his usual size, and Tenna's screen reopened, lighting up with flowers. But the flower quickly disappeared, and he cautiously continued to ask you.
You fell silent, asking how many there are...... Hmm, then it should be possible to convert it into specific values...... That way, it's easier for you to calculate. To be safe, you still take a look—there are no boxes or bars on his head, and from your perspective, you don't have any of that either.
"Uh...... Then let's get +2 affection. "You hesitated for a moment, then said to him dryly.
Tenna's antenna wobbled, probably in a good mood: "Oh...... I get it. Does that mean when my affection reaches 100, it means my dear really loves me? ”
You blink, for no reason, your voice a bit hesitant: "Yes...... Right? ”
“…… Darling, can your answer be a bit more certain...... You must be loving me, right?! " As he spoke, the screen went completely black, and he was lying on your knee, tilting his head back, the dark screen facing you too. You looked at him, feeling like he was probably just pretending to be pitiful...... You watched the end of that socket sway back and forth, then carefully wrap around your leg.
In the end, you still sighed: "Alright, if it really ...... If this number reaches 100, it means I've fallen in love with you. Is that enough? "As you spoke, you gently patted Tenna's TV head.
He really wants to say it's not enough, he really wants to say that even at that point, you can still love him a little more, he really wants to say...... He really wants to hear you say you love him, hear you say you will love him forever, repeating this over and over — he never gets tired of listening! Of course, Tenna just wants to confirm your feelings.
But ...... Getting this answer from you was enough to make him happy for a long time, so he turned on the screen, lifted his head high, and even the flowers on his nose swayed. He hummed a tune out of tune as he walked toward the kitchen, followed by the sound of running water—well, it sounded like he was probably washing those dishes. You think of it, pick up your phone, and start casually browsing social media messages, hmm...... Of course, the key is to check the websites where you posted before; the next ones don't seem to be interesting......

"Mm. Then...... And then, darling, how can I make you like me a little more? "Tenna nodded, looking at you and then turning to look at your phone. He just felt jealous—why do you have to keep staring at your phone all the time? Most of the things you're obsessed with, you can do yourself. He didn't quite understand, but as he watched the back, he mustered up his courage and asked.
You had been casually scrolling through your phone to pass the time with a novel, but when you heard Tenna's question, you turned to glance at him. Tenna just awkwardly rested her hands on her knees, his screen pitch black, and his antenna drooping, clearly in a bad mood. You didn't quite understand what was wrong with him, but when it came to his question, you thought carefully and then gave him an answer.
"Ah...... Then probably, you need ...... Well, you need to look it up online and see what good boyfriends are like. "You thought hard for a moment, then answered Tenna. Honestly, you've never been in a relationship before, so of course you don't know what to do about this.
And to your surprise, you find Tenna's figure shrinks even more, turning into a small one sitting on the sofa, just muttering, "Internet ...... What is it? Phone...... I don't know how to use this. Y/N, is this really important? "His voice became trembling, cautious, and tinged with a hint of frustration, but in short, he didn't look very happy.
Look at him—he's still sitting on the sofa and gently patting Tenna's head: "A network is a network, it's the internet. With just a few cables, most people can be connected...... You rested your chin on your hand, watching the CG on the screen—Tenna proposing to the protagonist...... After quickly finishing the story, you closed the game. Honestly, this was a very fun otome game recommended by your best friend to you recently. Although your interest in otome games isn't great, you downloaded it after her strong recommendation.
But you regret playing it for just a while...... After all, it doesn't seem much different from other otome games, except for an extra option to input personal dialogue. You guess the built-in AI might have replied to your words, but you quickly lose interest.
After all, playing otome games is always like this: choosing the right options, the right gifts, the right actions, and coincidental timing can smoothly boost affection. After all, every game character set up has their own set of values and preferences. Rather than saying the male lead in an otome game falls in love with you, it's more accurate to say he falls in love with the self who disguises himself and matches his preferences.
So you quickly got bored and figured out the preferences of this TV head named tenna, quickly finished the strategy, and planned to quit immediately. Although you don't know why if you choose to type dialogues yourself, no matter what you say, it will increase your favorability, but later you don't bother to talk anymore. You're naturally a quiet person who doesn't like to talk much.
So you choose the option based on the preferences you previously guessed. And now, you close the game window and plan to uninstall it. You uninstall successfully, then you hold your phone, planning to go out for lunch and complain to your best friend that the game isn't that fun at all.
Before leaving, you glanced at the dusty appliances sitting in the corner...... You bought them out of boredom, probably with a CRT TV or something else. You originally planned to play games on it, but it turned out computers suited your preferences better—at least they weren't that heavy.
You lowered your head and typed rapidly on your phone, then walked out of the room, casually made yourself some instant noodles, and brought it home, planning to sit in front of the computer to eat.
You were startled as soon as you walked into the room, nearly spilling your instant noodles. Fortunately, you remembered that the mess would be hard to clean if you did, so you didn't let go. You just pretended to stay calm as you looked at tenna, who had suddenly appeared in your room, crouching yet still looking very tall, and seemingly feeling wronged.

You cover your forehead with your free other hand, feeling a bit of a headache and trouble. In fact, at first you wondered if you were dreaming, but it turned out you pinched your own face—it hurt.
So it probably wasn't a dream. You kept a calm face, but your mind was blank. You brought the noodles over and set them on the table, then lowered your head to look at Tenna.
“…… Mr. Tenna, I think I've already unlocked your ending—it's a perfect ending." "That's exactly what you don't understand the most. After all, you have OCD. You haven't cleared any of the other bad endings, only this one perfect ending."
Tenna looks up at you. Actually, he has many questions he wants to ask, like saying that at first you were still talking to him and he was happy to be able to communicate with you, but why did you end up choosing those options instead...... He can only watch you through the narrow screen, unable to take any action. Even those conversations are preset, so all he can see is your increasingly uninterested expression, feeling inexplicably anxious.
He wants to ask why you stopped talking to him, why you only quickly got through the ending, or even stop looking at him, he wants to ask why you just uninstalled the game......

While eating the noodles, you almost choked up when you heard this. Luckily, you swallowed it with difficulty, or you would have sprayed the noodles on the computer screen. But the price was that after eating, you still coughed dryly many times.
A glass of water appeared beside you. You glanced at Tenna, who had suddenly grown larger, but said nothing more. You just took the cup and drank a sip, barely suppressing the choking sensation.
Only then did you clear your throat and say, "Does this game system even have a post-marriage mode?" "You're genuinely confused. You didn't see it when downloading, nor did you see it when you cleared the ending. You just returned to the big screen after the happy end message appeared."
He fell into an awkward, subtle silence, and you patiently waited for a moment before he finally spoke: "No, but can you come back and see me a bit more?" "Just being watched a little longer by you makes Tenna feel satisfied."
You looked at him carefully for a while longer, eating instant noodles while mumbling a bit unclearly, "Why should I go back to see you more often?" ”
“…… I thought you liked me a lot." He lowered his head, clearly thinking so, since his voice sounded very dejected and his figure was shrinking.
You were genuinely surprised at this moment. Although watching him shrink made you feel a subtle pity, you still asked, "Why should I like you?" ”
Honestly, you just find this character fairly cute and don't have much to dislike, so you're willing to understand his ending. But if you say you like him, you can't quite say how much you like him.
But you can also understand why he has that idea, so you say, "Well, I understand why you think that way, but I don't think it's necessary." ”
"After all, in the end, the choices I made were just options that matched the character's preferences and pleasing them. I just created a virtual and hypocritical image you might like. You don't need to question the real me, nor do I have to like you." You said calmly, taking another sip of water.
You see his screen suddenly turn pitch black—maybe he's lost in thought. But you're not in a hurry. After waiting a while, his screen lights up again. You see his lips seem to move, but after a while, he finally utters a complete sentence: "But...... I've always seen it. I like you, I like the real you. ”
"I don't understand why you like me...... There must be some reason for this kind of longing, right? "You tilted your head and asked this question.
Tenna hesitated for a moment, but finally shook his head. In fact, he didn't understand the reason either. He only knew that he loved the feeling of being watched by you. As long as you kept watching him, he felt satisfied. But over time, he wasn't satisfied with just watching. You looked at him, and he looked at you. He wanted more touch, wanted to touch the real you, wanted to talk to you, not just watch you through a narrow screen.
In fact, it was only after you uninstalled the game that he suddenly realized he had this privilege. Using that old CRT as a medium, he came into this world, sat across from you, and had this conversation with you.
You found it a bit amusing, and for some reason, he looked a bit nervous at this moment. You clearly couldn't see his eyes, but his fingers resting on his knees kept fidgeting, probably feeling uneasy.
Then you cleared your throat and said solemnly, "Alright, I still don't understand why you like me. But I want to tell you something seriously...... Just because you like me doesn't mean I have to like you. Whether I like you or not is my natural and genuine choice. In fact, I chose you as my game strategy target just because you look pleasing to the eye. Maybe I have some affection, but it's far from liking you. ”
You watch Tenna lower his head, lowering it more and more, and you watch him shrink again, eventually becoming the size of a pet dog, silently pressing against your calf. You seem to feel a bit moist...... Probably from the direction of the screen. So even TVs can cry? You wonder this in a daze.
"But the fact that you like me has nothing to do with me, so I won't ask about it anymore............ But I think I can still give you a chance." "You thought about it and felt a bit unwilling, because for some reason, you can't be sure that this affection and love truly exist. You only want a definite love that can be confirmed. If not, then it's better never to have it.
After hearing this, Tenna grew bigger again, sitting across from you, looking at you longingly. You just felt that at this moment, you should describe him that way.
You solemnly reached out a hand to him: "You can try and make me like you too. Or at least, let me feel your love...... Come to think of it, I don't even know what this counts as. Maybe it's called an apprentice boyfriend? "You thought for a moment.
Tenna quickly reached out a hand, his palm large, tightly wrapping your hand inside, unwilling to let go.
"Of course, I'm willing to do it." He said this, and you couldn't help but laugh a little, feeling like he spoke like a wedding vow. Then, as if noticing he was holding too hard, he hurriedly let go again.
But you just took his hand and gently shook it, looking relaxed: "Alright, then, trainee boyfriend, nice to meet you." ”
