Even though you're all in Tenna's office, of course you don't know that you're now covered in Tenna's fcake scent, as if you're his property.
"I'm the boss, I'm the lord of this world. Of course, what I want is up to me."
Of course, Tenna just said this as if she didn't care. You looked at him with some suspicion, but Tenna just smiled at you as usual. You think there really wasn't anything wrong with that...... So after hesitating for a moment, you still signed the contract. Of course, after signing, Tenna took the contract and put it away. You have no idea where he hid it again.
Then he hugged you tightly: "That's great, my dear Y/N. Now you and I are officially married—hmm, looks like we're late. Let's head to the company now." His words were full of indifference. You couldn't tell how much he cared about this...... Actually, it was because you felt like you were going to be late that you hurriedly got up to go to work. Now you weren't in a hurry, just being held by Tenna's hand as you walked toward the company. He openly took your hand and walked into the office area. For a moment, all the employees looked at you with different expressions. Of course, some cakes even ran far away because they sensed Fork's presence.
Tenna didn't care about those employees. He simply announced on his own, "From today on, Y/N is your boss's wife. From now on, seeing her is like meeting me. After all, we're all your bosses, so as long as you know about this, that's enough." After saying that, he led you back toward the office on his own.
You were a bit embarrassed at first, you wanted to cover your face or something...... But Tenna spoke so loudly and so fast that you didn't even have time to cover your face, only hearing him announce these things......
You wanted to sit back down at your seat, but before you could react, Tenna wrapped her arm around your waist and said casually, "We're already married, so from now on, your desk won't be that one." ”
"So, then, then...... So where are you now?" "You're stammering a bit, since you can't figure out the situation either. Anyway, ever since you walked into the company, your head has been down, because your cheeks are flushed red at this moment.
"Here." Tenna patted his thigh, probably signaling for you to sit on or something...... Right? That's probably what he meant. You probably didn't think wrong, since he was just curling his lips, and that big smile was already on his screen. You thought for a moment, but in the end, timidly, sat down on Tenna's lap, and then he immediately grabbed your waist. His movements were so fast you couldn't even figure out when he reached out. By the time you realized it, he was already holding you.
And not only that, his hands were holding tightly. Your cheeks flushed as you looked at the tables displayed on the computer screen in front of you—these must be your work for today. You took a deep breath and threw yourself into your work, but at the same time, Tenna gently caressed all over your body. His hands were mischievous, gently stroking your skin through a thin layer of clothing, making your body tremble involuntarily. You twisted your body, trying to stop Tenna's movements. Of course, he just kept going, completely unaware of your resistance, though in fact, you didn't really resist at all.
But even so, you sped up to finish what you were doing, then turned around and straddled Tenna. This time, you leaned in and bit his lips, after all, this was your reward—you were simply asking for your own reward—of course, your movements were gentle, since you hadn't intended to bite him right away. You just gently rubbed your tongue against his lips, licking the sweet liquid that seeped from between them. Even the somewhat cloying liquid was eagerly sucked into your mouth. You enjoyed this slightly sweet taste, savoring it, gently closing your eyes and becoming intoxicated—oh my god, you loved this taste so much that you couldn't help but slip your tongue into his mouth again, licking the liquid secreted back and forth. Your tongue brushed against his teeth, then licked his tongue, hooking that huge tongue until suddenly your tongue mixed together, dancing together.
You couldn't help but stammer, and of course, Tenna was also gasping, and his voice was loud. You seemed to hear the staff knocking on the door, but soon after, the sound faded away. Tenna pressed your head, seemingly dissatisfied with your momentary distraction, and you quickly regained your own interest in the kiss. Your lips sucked on his lips, licking again and again, making a faint wet sound. Eventually, you were dissatisfied with just tasting these flavors. You pulled open his clothes, buried your head in his neck, and gently left one lip mark after another. You bit his skin, the soft yet hard skin beneath—you gently licked the blue-red liquid flowing out, feeling like you were a bit drunk again, just a little dizzy. Tenna just gently pressed your head, your tongue licking over the small wound, while Tenna lowered her head to look at you. He was very satisfied, truly very satisfied, he loved it all—oh my god, oh my god, this was just too satisfying. He enjoyed the feeling of being devoured by you in this moment, because at that moment he could feel that he was completely yours—and at this moment, he realized that you also belonged completely to him, because everything between you two would belong to each other, because you two were just each other's possessions.
You have no idea what Tenna is thinking. You just lie on his chest, gently sucking the sweet, greasy blood flowing from it. Then you move forward, pull open Tenna's clothes, gently lick the skin on his chest, and then bite those two nipples, at least those nipples to him. You hear him moan softly, and you just bite the skin above his heartbeat once more, quietly listening to the sound of his heartbeat. Only in this moment do you feel an unparalleled satisfaction—that emotion is hard to dissipate, impossible to forget.
Your head was still buried in your neck, while Tenna just picked you up by herself. Then, he walked out of the office door, openly carrying you as he passed by all the staff amid the hesitant hesitations of the staff, heading in his own direction—after all, some things are just not good for things to happen outside.
Of course, you surely know what Tenna is pulling you to do, so you just lift your head and kiss Tenna's screen.
END.（？ ）

title: Gambler 1 (dntx you)
content:
Heaven have a mercy—you were just wandering out for a walk after settling in the Dark World. How could you see a TV person lying on the edge of a cliff, looking like he's lost his legs?
Moreover...... It looked like he was left here and no one was going to care about him anymore. Although you don't like meddling, you can still be considered kind-hearted. After thinking it over, you went home and brought out a cart to move him onto it, then struggled to pull it carefully. After all, you saw this was a TV person, who knows there might be many intricate parts on his body. You wouldn't dare to bump him around.
After finally carrying him home, you look at the large TV he's unconscious and the two broken legs you brought back, feeling a bit worried. Fortunately, your parents forced you to study science, so you know how to repair computer circuits, so naturally you can repair TVs too. So you dig through the CRT user manual you've collected out of boredom, connect the wiring on his broken leg, finally put on the insulation tape, and then clapp, lie back on the bed, hum in satisfaction, and you're done! Reward yourself with a nap!
Half-awake, you frowned because you heard a sobbing sound like crying—not loud, but definitely enough to keep you awake. You angrily opened your eyes to see what was disturbing your peaceful sleep, but you realized the sound was coming from your side. Turning to look, you realized...... It was the TV person you brought back, now shrunk into a tiny ball, big enough to hold in your arms, and still whimpering continuously.
You gently moved a couple of times closer. He was probably still lost in his own emotions, still sobbing and sobbing, curling up into a small ball. The pitch-black screen was wet, with tears still dripping down.
You're a bit worried. You know about the existence of the People of Darkness, but no one tells you what to do if someone else cries. You know, your parents will just slap you, complaining that your crying is too loud, that you've cried too much and that your family's good fortune is gone. But you won't do that, because hearing those words won't make you happy, so you won't do that.
You racked your brains for a long time, but in the end, you gently placed your hand on his shoulder and tentatively asked in a low voice, "Hello?" ”
The TV seemed to pause for a moment, but it was still sobbing, its voice broken and intermittent: "I...... I can't give you anything, why, should ...... Save me? ”
You look at him in distress, so you reach out and pat his head again. You think, when you cry, getting a pat on the head would make you happy—maybe he would do the same.
"Hmm...... I don't want anything, I just don't want to see a perfectly fine person die there...... Ah, for the Dark People, it's damage, right? "You nodded, your voice very soft. You really didn't think about anything when you brought him back.
"But if you say that, does that mean there's nowhere to go...... Then you can stay here for now, pay me the rent first, and pay me later, that's fine......" You kept nagging, thinking about how you'd always behaved, probably because you had no way out, and you would rack your brains trying to figure out what to do next. But you saw that he didn't make a sound, just curled up and sobbing, while his screen was flooded with even bigger tears.
You scratched your head, so you took a piece of candy from the bedside table, spread it to his lips, and whispered softly, "Don't cry, eat something sweet. You have to be happy." ”
He didn't answer your question, just silently swallowed the candy. You don't even know where his screen opened to swallow the candy, but you saw him stop whimpering, though the screen was still a bit damp, and you finally breathed a sigh of relief.
You see this little TV person sit up from his soaking wet bed, the dark screen staring at you, showing no other reaction. You simply sit cross-legged on the floor too, because squatting all the time would be exhausting.
You waved a finger in front of him: "Alright, you should be more alert, right? Now I'm going to start questioning." ”
You see the little TV guy nodding.
You hugged your knees and asked first, "So who exactly are you, and how should I address you?" ”
“…… Anton Tenna, you can call me whatever you like. You...... Where did you find me? "His voice trembled slightly.
You shrugged: "Ah, on a cliff. You should be able to tell I'm a citizen of light, or a human, right?" ”
Tenna nodded lightly, but then asked, "Then...... Why does that Light Tribe choose the Dark World? His voice was muffled, the antenna dropped, and his body seemed to tremble slightly. You don't understand why he reacted this way. Is it strange for the Light Tribe to appear in the Dark World?
But you just smiled indifferently and shrugged: "Ah, how did it turn into you asking me a question?" Alright, I have to tell you, I ...... It was because I didn't want to have any more contact with my parents that I went to the underworld. ”
Your words were relaxed, but when you said it, you couldn't help but zone out a little. You remembered that day—the day you completely decided to move to the Dark World. After all...... You're not short of money. You can go wherever you want; you belong to yourself.
"But what exactly happened to cause you to be so seriously injured?" You looked at Tenna's legs with a curious look. Clearly, they were now able to move freely.
“…… I struck a deal with the Howling Knights, the deal fell through, and that's it. "His emotions seemed to have stabilized somewhat. In any case, the screen was still pitch black, but he wasn't crying anymore.
You sized him up, then nodded thoughtfully: "...... Who is this? Never heard of him, but he probably wouldn't chase you to kill you, right? ”
Tenna shook her head, but then asked urgently, "Have you heard of TV WORLD?" ”
You frowned and thought for a moment, then shook your head as well: "I haven't heard of it. All I know is that the place where we live now is called Castle Town. Is that a place very important to you? If so, I'll help you find out later." ”
Tenna nodded but shook her head again, her tone gloomy: "...... That world has probably already been sealed. ”
You didn't quite understand the word, but seeing his downcast expression, you didn't press further. Instead, you opened a nearby drawer and took out two more candies—one opened and put in your mouth, and the other was opened and fed to Tenna. This time, he ate them without hesitation.
You smiled helplessly: "Alright...... Although I still don't know exactly what the situation is, I think you need to stay here for a while. Wait until you find your next place before leaving. ”
As you spoke, your mouth was mumbling a bit hard to hear because you had that candy in your mouth. You felt Tenna's body tremble, then he nodded stiffly.
You stood up and gently picked him up. Well, he really does feel light in your arms. The apartment you rented happens to have a guest room, and you moved in a couple of days ago just finished tidying up. I didn't expect you'd need it today. Tenna seemed even stiffer in your arms. You didn't pay him any mind, just put him on the bed and softly said, "Alright, I think you need to rest for a while. I'll be leaving now." Then you gently closed the door.
You don't know what Tenna made again, but you happened to be a bit thirsty, so you made yourself some floral tea. After a few sips, you put the teapot and teacup on the table, walked to the guest room door, and shouted loudly, "If you're thirsty, there's something on the table to drink!" ”
You heard Tenna respond from inside the room, then ignored him and went back to your room to lie back on the bed and go back to sleep. When you woke up again, you rubbed your eyes and glanced over. You realized it was almost dinner time, so you quickly opened the door and went out to make a simple dinner. Although you couldn't cook, you could at least heat up the semi-prepared dishes.
But as soon as you reached the living room, you heard the sounds of stoves and smoke coming from the kitchen, along with a faint smell of cooking oil. You hurried to the kitchen—what if this guest temporarily staying at your house blew up your kitchen?
But your worries seemed unnecessary, because as soon as you walked into the kitchen, you saw Tenna, now about the same size as before, wearing an apron and heat-resistant gloves, carrying a plate of roasted lamb leg.
You stopped in your tracks, stared at him wide-eyed, and said, "Huh?" You instinctively let out a soft "ah."
Tenna bypassed you and placed the grilled lamb chops on the table. You instinctively turned to stare at him, and Tenna looked back at you. His screen lit up, though his expression seemed a bit cold, and for some reason, his voice sounded a bit tough but weak inside: "What, can't I go into your kitchen?" ”
You shake your head: "That's not ......." But as you say this, all you see is Tenna's back. He walks into the kitchen again, while you sit at the dining table, a bit confused, feeling that something is off.
Next, Tenna placed several plates on the table and brought over the knife and fork. He sat across from you. Neither of you made the first move, but instead fell into an eerie silence.
While you were still struggling with what to say, you heard Tenna's voice: "This is ...... To repay you for saving me today and making you dinner, don't count on me anymore. ”
You sighed, thinking to yourself that you never intended to have him make dinner, and you didn't expect any payment, but on the surface, you just nodded: "Alright, alright." ”
You hesitated for a moment, but finally decided to cut a piece of roasted lamb leg and eat it. You bought this and kept it in the fridge, worrying about what to do. Today, Tenna finished making it, and of course you gladly accepted it.
“…… Also, for the next while, I probably really will be staying here. "Tenna hesitated for a moment, or perhaps hesitated, but his voice still sounded cold.
You just nodded again: "Alright, alright, I know. I'll pay rent for now......." But before you could finish, Tenna interrupted you.
"No, I think...... Although you saved me, I shouldn't repay you like a beast of burden. You're the one who should be a beast of burden. "He said seriously, his face grave.
You whisper, "I didn't make you work like a beast to repay me...... but you felt like Tenna had just glared at you.
So you changed your tune: "Alright, alright, then either I'll be like a beast of burden, or you'll be a horse, right? Let's play a game." As you spoke, you put down your knife and fork, clapped your hands excitedly, and said, "Heavens have had it—after all these years, you've never played a proper game with anyone."
"What game?" He asked briefly. He considered himself a game show host, skilled at any game.
You waved your finger as if teasing her, feeling like Tenna glared at you again, then cleared her throat and said, "It's simple. It's just a bet every day. Whatever you want, the winner can order the loser to do anything, and within that day—sounds fair, right?" ”
"What if the loser refuses to comply?" Tenna crossed his arms, probably thinking the proposal was feasible, but he needed to clarify everything.
"That's simple. If the loser refuses to comply, then the winner will have to work like a beast of burden for the rest of their life." You clapped your hands and announced. Honestly, you never came up with such a shameless idea before. But Tenna insisted on saying something like that. How could you not play a game with him?
Tenna seemed to hesitate for a moment, then gritted his teeth and nodded at you: "Alright." ”
You tilt your head: "Then this game officially starts tomorrow. As for today—well, I saved you, so I asked you to help wash the dishes and such. Isn't that too much?" ”
Tenna gritted her teeth, looking a bit furious: "...... Not too much. ”
"It's settled then. I swear—swear it's a suction swearing, and you won't change for ten thousand years!" As you spoke, you extended your pinky to Tenna. Tenna hesitated for a moment, then extended her pinky too. Compared to him, his body was really big—even his hands were several times bigger than yours. You just smiled and pinky promised him, then began enjoying the dinner.
After eating, Tenna would clean up after all—so you just messed up mutton fat and similar items on the table, watching Tenna grit her teeth as she tidied up, while you just leisurely drank a cup of floral tea, tidied yourself up a bit, and after passing the night, you went back to your room.
You're still smiling when you sleep, after all—you've already started looking forward to what tomorrow will be like.
TBC.

title: Gambler 2 (dntx you)
content:
You wake up in the morning, your eyes loosening as you scratch your messy hair, grab a casual piece of clothing, open the door, and head out, planning to grab some kind of breakfast—until you realize there's a TV sitting at your own dining table that you snap out of it. This isn't just your own home. You shiver, smooth your hair, and seeing Tenna still eating breakfast, you can't help but swallow at the aroma. You simply sit across from him, weakly waving your hand and saying, "Let's make a bet now, bet on rock-paper-scissors, best of three." ”
Tenna put down her knife and fork on the screen, hesitated for a moment, then placed her hand on the table. His voice was still very low, maybe just imagining it, but it seemed a bit hoarse.
"So...... The daily betting should be decided by someone else, otherwise it's not fair enough. "Tenna said, obediently following your countdown to rock-paper-scissors. As expected, you won. Tenna watched the screen go dark. If the screen were still lit, his expression would probably have cracked."
You wave your hand and lie face down on the table: "Alright...... I'm now ordering you to prepare breakfast for me and serve it first...... Then you close your eyes and enter standby mode.
Tenna gritted her teeth, still made breakfast for you, then slammed it heavily on the table. The sound was loud and startled you. You suddenly sat up, groggily staring at Tenna, mumbling, "What's wrong? What's wrong?" ”
"It's nothing, it's just that the breakfast you wanted is ready." Tenna said through gritted teeth.
You scratch your head and finally wake up a bit, then a delicious aroma wafts into your nostrils. You giggle twice and nod to Tenna: "Ah, thank you for making breakfast for me!" "And you ignore Tenna's murderous gaze as she stares at you, eat breakfast like a storm, then burp. You wave your hand, signaling Tenna to clear the dining table."
Naturally, he gritted his teeth and went to clean up everything, and after breakfast, you finally felt refreshed, planning which novel to read first today.
But before you could decide, Tenna sat down opposite you again. His screen lit up, and he looked a bit bitter and deeply resentful. He cautiously asked, "So what am I supposed to do next?" ”
You yawned, not quite understanding why he acted like this, but if you wanted to tell him something...... There wasn't much to tell him about, right? After thinking for a moment, you jumped up and rummaged through the nearby drawer for a comb, then handed it to Tenna: "Then help me comb my hair...... My hair is too long, combing it is such a hassle." You complained, and your long hair was always tangled, and you didn't have the strength to hold onto it, so every time you combed it, it hurt. Over time, you got used to your hair running all over and about. After all, you lived alone, and no one would criticize you.
Maybe it's just your imagination, but you keep feeling as if you hear Tenna breathe a sigh of relief. You don't care about it anymore, just take out another hair tie and hand it to Tenna: "Just help me tie it up, whatever you want to do anyway......" You watch Tenna silently stand up holding the comb, then you feel your hair being lifted. He probably used the comb to pull it down to the knot, and your scalp is being pulled. Flustered, you reach out to hold his hand, tears almost welling up in your eyes.
"Ouch, ouch, ouch, ouch...... That's not it. If you find a knot or a hard comb, grab the hair on top and slowly comb it through. That's how ...... "You scoop up a handful of hair with a pitiful look, then shape your fingers into a comb and comb it down.
"And you're way too strong...... you muttered, mourning your still-aching scalp.
Tenna said nothing, just followed your instructions, picked up a lock of hair, and slowly combed it down. He was indeed quite strong, holding the lock and smoothing it out for you, without even causing your scalp to ache at all. You sighed in relief, feeling your hair tied back up, and the back of your neck felt refreshing—it was truly comfortable.
"Yeah, that's right—thank you, it's been a long time since I've felt this refreshing." As you spoke, you cheerfully flicked your ponytail and then slapped Tenna hard.
Your body stiffened, then mechanically turned around, looking at the expressionless Tenna and chuckled twice: "Um...... Sorry, I didn't mean to. ”
Tenna just looked down at you expressionlessly, then said gruffly, "It's okay, I won't feel pain anyway. Maybe I do...... You will also think it doesn't matter." ”
You quickly waved your hand: "How could that mean you don't care...... You still owe me rent! Of course I wouldn't just abandon you." As you spoke, you stroked your high ponytail, then lay back comfortably and sprawled out on the sofa.
"What else do you want me to do?" His voice sounded stiff, reluctant, and lacking any emotion. You were worried about what to do next, but seeing Tenna, you couldn't help but stroke your chin: "Well...... Hmm, first of all, lunch and dinner are all in your hands! "You don't know how to cook, so having someone who can cook now is perfect."
Tenna nodded. His pitch-black screen was still staring at you, looking rather scary—at least you shivered.
"Then...... Go to the bookshelf next door. Yes, this one. Just pick up any book and read it to me. "You gesture at the nearby bookshelf and instruct Tenna to bring down a book for you.
Tenna glanced at it; the title of the book was ...... "The Proud Empress and Her 108 Male Favorites in Her Harem."
He silently sits next to you holding the book and mechanically starts reading. You listen while pointing and saying, "Don't sound like a mechanical voice...... Read with more emotion! Yes, the queen's lines should be a bit more domineering. The number one male favorite has a 'green tea' type, his lines can be read in a way that makes me feel a bit pitiful, and the second male favorite is the tsundere type...... Hmm, the flavor is just right. Just read it like this...... As you say that, you yawn again, lean back on the sofa with your eyes closed, listening to Tenna read aloud beside you. His voice becomes a bit more emotional, and the deliberately rough tone is gone. It actually sounds quite kind...... You thought about it casually. Except for lunch and dinner when he was away for a while, Tenna read this book to you the rest of the time. You even made a pot of floral tea to soothe his throat. Before you knew it, the day had just passed like this.
Tenna was still a bit incredulous...... He thought he would really work like a beast of burden for you, but you only asked for some conditions that he didn't even consider. He gave you a complicated look and urged you that it was time and time to sleep.
“…… There's still a little left to finish. Why don't you read it to the end, or let me read it myself too...... You immediately opened your eyes, wanting to reach for the book Tenna was holding, but unfortunately he lifted the book up, and he was so tall that even if you jumped onto the sofa and stood on tiptoe, you couldn't reach it. All you could do was look at Tenna with a puff of anger.
Although his screen was lit, the corners of his mouth always curved downward, and his voice remained cold: "No, I'm going to sleep." He knew from the family TV that he couldn't play any more programs for kids at the time, and now of course he understood.
"I...... I'm the winner today, so you have to listen to me and give me back that book! ”
You were so angry you nearly jumped off the sofa, but Tenna reached out to support you before you sat back down.
And Tenna did hand you the book as you requested. Excited, you took it and saw that it was a math book Tenna had pulled out from somewhere. You immediately deflated: "How could this be...... I'm talking about the book you're reading today! ”
His lips straightened, and for some reason, you could see a hint of innocence: "But I've already given you the book you wanted." ”
After saying that, he added, "You need to rest early, or what if you don't have the energy to read the follow-up tomorrow?" His voice softened a bit, though it still sounded a bit stiff and stiff.
You pouted, unhappily tossing the book onto the sofa and heading toward the bedroom: "Alright...... I'm going to bed. "You look listless, but you really are tired. Otherwise, you'd be arguing with Tenna for eight hundred rounds!"
But it was a dreamless night. You walked out of the bedroom yawning with messy hair, your nose wafting again. When you reached the dining table, you realized that besides Tenna's breakfast, you also had yours. You pulled out a chair and sat down in surprise, clapping: "Wow, you actually made breakfast for me. Thank you, tenna—" You squeezed your throat, your voice turning sweet and sweet.
Tenna ignored him and kept cutting the fried egg, her voice still icy: "It's nothing, I just helped you toast a bit." There were plenty of empty spots in the bread machine. ”
You blinked, looking at the fried egg sandwiched between the two slices of bread, and the sausage, bacon, and scones on another plate. You thought to yourself, this was no easy task, but you didn't say much. Instead, you picked up the two slices of bread and stuffed your mouth until it was full, your cheeks puffed up, and you stammered, "It's your turn to decide today. What kind of bet are we going to play?" ”
Tenna put down her knife and fork. He had already finished his meal, just stared at your movements, and casually said, "Gomoku." ”
You bite into the bread, blinking your eyes. Gomoku...... Your skills are pretty poor, after all, you can't even beat the machines. Although you feel a bit weak, you still nod vigorously: "Alright, Gomoku is Gomoku!" ”
You got up a bit early today, yawned, and continued leisurely eating breakfast. Suddenly, Tenna stood up behind you, and then you felt your hair being pulled up, followed by the sound of combing it. You blinked in confusion, not quite understanding why Tenna was doing this.
So you asked too: "I...... I'm not the winner, why are you helping me comb my hair?" "Why do you feel a bit flustered?"
Then you hear his stiff voice: "If we calculate by 24 hours, yesterday's bet isn't over yet, so I still have to help you with the work." ”
You let out a couple of 'oh oh' sounds and suddenly understood. The anxious heart finally settled down again.
After you finished eating, Tenna went to tidy up the dishes, while you squatted down and rummaged through the living room drawers. Finally, you found a set of Gomoku in one of the drawers.
Calling it Gomoku is actually just a modified version of Go. If you're not very good at Go, this black and white piece piece can just be used as Gomoku.
You enthusiastically place the board on the table, with black pieces on your side and white stones opposite you.
Seeing Tenna walk out of the kitchen, you start greeting him: "This way, Tenna." ”
"Baizi goes first—you go first, I'll give you a step!" You shook your head and said proudly, though you actually felt a bit guilty too, because you're not good at that. You just follow his plan and move around randomly.
Tenna places a white piece in the center of the board, you follow closely behind, placing a black piece next to that one, Tenna places another white piece horizontally next to that one, and you rack your brains—then place another black piece next to that white piece.
It's clear you really don't want to lose, because you use all your strength to chase and block the possibility of a five-stone streak, but until the very end, you still make a mistake. You watch Tenna drop the last white stone, while the five white stones at the angle form a line.
You let out a wailing: "No—" Then you collapsed listlessly onto the table.
Tenna seemed to be in a better mood, his screen lit up, and he was even smiling—though grinning with his big white teeth was a bit scary.
Then Tenna began to issue today's rules: "First, you make lunch and dinner today." ”
You nod listlessly, mourning the delicious food that ran away before it even reached your stomach. Honestly, Tenna's cooking is really delicious...... Although he always carries the plate with a sour face, as if he's owed him money for eight lifetimes and hasn't paid it back, you never dare praise him and just eat it like a storm.
"Then, you have to call me Master." Tenna crossed his arms, knowing he couldn't lose in the game—and yet you were still sighing that you really couldn't beat bots. Isn't Tenna also bots? Well, you wouldn't dare say something like that.
Hearing this, you look up at him in surprise. You didn't expect him to have such a hobby, but it wasn't difficult for you. You blurted out your lips and said, "Alright, Master." ”
This time, Tenna was a bit surprised. He thought you couldn't do it—he was still thinking about that loser's saying, 'If you can't meet your demands, you'll be a loser forever.'

title: Gambler 3 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna looked at you with that strange, curious gaze, while you just stared at him innocently. You hadn't failed to meet his demands, so thinking that way, you might as well just stare at him with your head held high.
In the end, Tenna was the first to withdraw his gaze. Although his screen was lit, he no longer smiled, still curling the corner of his mouth.
You couldn't help but ask, "What's wrong? You don't look very happy?" ”
But you heard Tenna answer you stiffly: "It's nothing, this has nothing to do with you. Also, you should call me Master." ”
Well, you touch your nose and don't mind his cold tone. After all, you've heard more than ten times before, even worse than this. You don't care how he talks to you, so you just keep smiling.
"Oh, okay, Master, may I ask why you're in a bad mood?" You said this while pretending to bow to Tenna, but now it was his embarrassment, just turning to look at you, his mouth still flat.
But in his stiff voice, there was still a hint of stubbornness: "I'm just feeling a bit unwell, that's all. Come and massage my shoulders." ”
You smiled and snapped your fingers: "Alright." Then you stood behind Tenna and started diligently massaging his shoulders. You've done this kind of work plenty before, because at home you always have to massage your tired parents' shoulders, and whenever they're upset, they'll beat and scold you. You still have some scars on your body that haven't fully faded...... Not only that, on rainy days, the places where you were hurt can still hurt a bit.
Anyway, for now, you just tried a little and roughly what kind of pressure to use, then started massaging Tenna's shoulders while saying, "If you don't feel the strength is enough, you have to tell me." ”
Tenna let out a muffled 'mm' because he realized your strength was just right. He couldn't find a single mistake, so in the end he could only dry and say, "Not bad, but my whole body aches." "The implication was that you should give him a full-body massage, and you immediately understood, tapping Tenna's shoulder while speaking attentively."
"Then I need Master to lie down on the bed before I can provide you with a massage." You said with a cheerful smile.
…… Tenna originally thought you would refuse, so he could find an excuse to make you his lifelong servant, because he thought your technique felt quite comfortable, and it wouldn't be a bad idea to be his lifelong servant.
Hearing this, he reluctantly stood up and walked toward his room, then lay face down on the bed with his back to you and asked, "Like this?" ”
You snapped your fingers again: "Bingo!" Master, where else does it hurt? I'm offering a one-day maid service. If you want a massage, just let me know anytime~" You were almost ready to change into a maid outfit, and Tenna coughed several times when she heard your words. He was clearly embarrassed, and you don't understand why he was the one who asked for a massage, so why did he end up feeling embarrassed again?
However, Tenna took off her upper body, then turned her back to you and continued lying on the bed, her voice still a bit dry: "My shoulders and neck, as well as my waist and back." ”
You nodded. You're very familiar with this. When you massaged your family before, you even studied the acupoints used in traditional Chinese medicine, so you simply got into bed, sat on his back, and continued massaging his shoulders.
Tenna clearly sensed your movements too. He had his back to you, so you couldn't see his screen clearly, only hearing his somewhat hurried and somewhat shy voice: "You, you, you......"
"What's wrong with me?" You were completely baffled and could only keep massaging his shoulders. Honestly, this half-mechanical, half-soft body was really hard to manage, but luckily your grip was still quite strong.
You hear Tenna let out a muffled groan, then whisper, "...... It's nothing." He thought you'd be embarrassed, but in the end, it was him who felt embarrassed to watch. Tenna thought that if you noticed this, you'd definitely laugh at him, so in the end, he didn't say anything more. Only he knew his screen was getting a bit hot.
You puffed out your cheeks gently and reminded her, "If Master feels unwell, you can always let me know." Then you started massaging other acupoints on your shoulders and neck, the ones you usually feel sore. When you heard Tenna groan again, he said nothing, so you guess...... Hmm, probably not feeling unwell! Then you continue!
You massaged the acupoints around your shoulders and neck to make sure that muscle had completely relaxed, then straddled the side, knelt on the bed, and began massaging down along your spine. You heard Tenna moan twice more, and at this moment, you were pinching his waist, gently kneading it. Your gaze wandered, and you hesitated to glance at his buttocks, then whispered, "Um...... As for the waist muscles, there are some corresponding acupoints in the buttocks. Do you need me to help massage them?" ”
Tenna moved his waist a bit, not quite accustomed to it. Under your massage, he really did feel much better. He felt his screen was still burning hot, and his voice was a bit dry, as if he was trying to escape: "Th-then it's not necessary." However...... My antenna also needs a massage to relax and relax. ”
You blinked, looking at his full buttocks with some regret, sighing to yourself that you couldn't go up and touch them. Then you straddled him again, grabbed his two antennas, and gently massaged them: "Mm...... I've never done this kind of thing before. If you feel uncomfortable, please let me know. ”
He responded with a low hum, and based on your usual massage experience, you gently massaged his antenna, then slightly increased the pressure to help it relax. You also felt the two antennas really loosened, and at the same time, you heard deep breathing.
You let go, turned your head to glance at Tenna, and only then confirmed that he was indeed asleep—probably because he was completely relaxed. You let out a gentle breath, and it seemed he had finally relaxed—this was great. So you carefully got off him, then walked out of his room, closed the door, and left. He didn't come out the rest of the day, maybe because he was sound asleep. You skillfully grabbed the instant food from the fridge to finish your lunch and dinner, and the second day of the bet passed by quietly.
On the third morning, when you come out yawning, you'll find the breakfast prepared for you still on the table, and Tenna is sitting across from you.
You were a bit curious and asked, "Why did you still prepare breakfast for me?" ”
"I'm the winner. Whatever I want to do is up to me." He replied stiffly. You shrugged, not really minding his answer—basically, he just wanted to cook for you.
So you sat down to enjoy breakfast, while Tenna only sat back down after breakfast to tie up your hair with a comb.
You shook your hair, thinking about twenty-four hours had passed, so you snapped your fingers excitedly: "It's the third day, today it's my turn to propose a game project!" You said that, looked up at the window, and today was rainy, rain was dripping down, even your leg bones hurt a little. You thought you had to win this bet today—otherwise, you wouldn't want to endure the pain to get things done.
So you withdrew your gaze from the window, took out a tablet, and handed it to Tenna. You also held a tablet, which was full of 2048 interfaces. You stood with your hands on your hips and looked at Tenna: "You should know 2048, right? Today we're going to compete on this. Whoever scores higher wins!" ”
Of course Tenna would do this. This was a retro mini-game from before, and he believed he could win, so he nodded in agreement. You all started the game together, and after synthesizing 168, you didn't stop, then it was 256,512...... Despite Tenna's superb gaming skills, he still got stuck after synthesizing 512, and the game ended. Tenna looked at your screen a bit unwillingly. You'd played this game many times—after all, you hadn't played any other games before, so you managed to synthesize 1024. You wanted to keep going, but as you looked at Tenna's pitch-black screen, you felt a sense of melancholy, so you cleared your throat twice and swiped a few times on the screen, ending up losing.
Of course, you're the winner. Tenna lost, so he has to obey your orders. Tenna lowered her head again, as if somewhat humiliated, and said, "Alright, what orders are you today?" ”
You sat down on the sofa and breathed a sigh of relief. Your legs were already sore and weak, but you just clapped your hands and said, "Well, just come over and warm my legs. It's raining and my legs are feeling a bit uncomfortable." ”
Tenna reluctantly sat down next to you, and you naturally crossed your legs on his thighs. Compared to his size, you were indeed quite small. His legs seemed to have warmed up under his intentional help, and you sighed comfortably, leaning back with a pillow and starting to instruct Tenna: "Hmm, help me take the books off the bookshelf." ”
Tenna did as told, took down the book you hadn't finished reading before, and you tugged at your pant leg and put it back on Tenna's lap. Tenna looked at your legs; the screen was still pitch black. He saw two ugly scars on your legs and reached out to tentatively touch them.
You naturally felt it too, looking at those two scars, and said indifferently, "Ah, it's an old problem...... A few years ago, when there was an earthquake in my house, I was trying to save my brother's leg and got crushed by a fallen beam. Both legs were fractured. My parents didn't take it seriously and just bandaged me to fix it a bit. I went to see a doctor later...... My bones were already a bit crooked, and without timely treatment, it hurt on rainy days. "You said this casually, probably just wanting someone to share your grievances and pain over the years. It doesn't matter who it is.
Tenna remained silent, looking at her legs. After you repaired them in time, they were already perfectly intact, though they were still wrapped with insulating tape and would probably take some time before they came off. He looked at you again, his tone somewhat obscure: "So back then, ......"
You waved your hand: "I admit, I do feel a bit sorry for your broken leg...... But no matter where it's broken, as long as you're not completely dead, I'll save you. I don't think a person can die so easily...... You muttered, watching Tenna want to say something more, so you covered your face with the book in your hand.
"Alright, I'm going to read now. Please stop talking and disturbing me, okay?" After saying that, you pretended to start reading.
Tenna looked at the book in your hand and paused for a moment, hesitating to speak, but finally said, "...... You picked up the book upside down." ”
You coughed twice and tossed the book aside, then sneaked a glance at Tenna: "Well, and you'll still be the one who prepares lunch and dinner today." You emphasized that you don't want to eat pre-made meals anymore. Then you nodded while watching TV, happily continuing your reading.
By lunchtime, you've finished reading the book and put it back on the shelf. Because Tenna has been warming your legs all morning, your legs aren't much more comfortable, but the scars on your back—some light, some heavy—start to ache again.
You finished your lunch listlessly, and Tenna noticed your appetite had decreased a lot. He wanted to ask you but stopped herself, thinking he had no obligation to care for you. He just glanced at you occasionally while eating.
After finishing the meal, you listlessly rummaged through the drawer and pulled out some ointment, then collapsed onto the sofa. You handed the ointment to Tenna and said weakly, "Can you treat the wound on my back...... My hands can't reach me." Then you lay face down on the sofa with your back to him, exposing your back covered in wounds of various sizes. That back, which should have been covered with fair skin, now only had old scars, some brand new. Some wounds looked like they had been there for many years, while others looked like they had only appeared recently. Tenna sat darkly on the screen, opened the ointment, then gently squeezed out a little, gently and carefully applying it to the scars on your back. She bypassed the bra pocket, let out a soft hiss, and some wounds still hurt a little, some just because of the rain. After applying the ointment, you felt much better.
You put down your clothes, sat up cheerfully again, and stretched: "Phew, this feels much better now. Thank you, tenna—"
"No need to thank me, this is what I should do." His voice was still stiff. You glanced at him, only to find that for some reason he turned his head away and stopped looking at you.
TBC.

title: Gambler 4 (dntx you)
content:
"Mm, yes, yes—" Your voice still sounded a bit cheerful. After all, you were the winner today, so you started directing Tenna.
"I didn't finish reading that book yesterday...... Can you start reading from the page tucked in the bookmark?" As you spoke, you hugged your knees, blinked, and sat on the sofa looking at Tenna with innocence. Tenna was silent for a moment, then coldly went to the bookshelf and took the book you were pointing to. After taking it down, he glanced at the cover...... Uh, the title on the cover of this book was 'Wrong Carriage, Right Groom.'
He sat next to you, his voice a bit dry. To be honest, he didn't know...... What kind of messy entertainment culture is the world of light playing now? Tenna remembers that when TV was popular, the shows were still serious stuff. Why was every book you gave him not so serious?
You just brought a plate of freshly washed, still cold grapes from the kitchen and placed them on the table. Although Tenna's voice was a bit dry, after listening to it for a whole day, you still thought it was good for reading. You sat cross-legged on the sofa, listening to him read with great interest, tossing a grape into your mouth. Watching Tenna, still dry with a book reading, casually picked up a grape and held it to his lips, he ate it without hesitation.
You stared at him, finding it a bit novel, and although he was probably eating grapes...... But it seemed like his reading voice hadn't changed much? You tossed another grape into your mouth, chewed it, and handed another one to Tenna's mouth, which he ate again. You rubbed your chin, examining the purple grape and purple Tenna...... You always felt the colors were about the same. Hmm, if he weren't a machine incarnate of the Dark People, you think he would definitely be a delicious big grape...... Then your gaze fell on the antenna. If only it were something edible, it would be sweet and sour, definitely delicious......
You were lost in thought, not even realizing what Tenna was reading, and Tenna sensed a burning gaze falling on her. He frowned and looked at you, noticing you were still absentmindedly staring at his head...... An antenna? He didn't know what was so interesting about that.
Anyway, Tenna put down the book in her hand, frowning as she looked at you. You couldn't help but feel his expression was really unpleasant, so you couldn't help but shrink your neck. Tenna's voice was stiff: "Why are you staring at my antenna all the time?" As he spoke, his antenna trembled slightly, and your gaze shifted slightly with the antenna's movement. Hearing his words, you snapped back to reality, and you couldn't help but give a dry laugh, scratching your head as you looked at Tenna's screen. Even though you couldn't see his eyes...... But you felt like his screen was about to project a murderous gaze, and you awkwardly looked away.
But you couldn't help but add more: "I was wondering, isn't your antenna color pretty much like a grape...... So is your antenna edible?" "Although you're not that curious about this question, you just want to see how Tenna would react if she asked it.
…… Then he just droops the corner of his mouth, picks up a grape, and roughly stuffs it into your mouth. You instinctively chew it, but naturally, you can't say a word.
His voice still sounded emotionless: "Didn't you touch the antenna yesterday? If you want to eat it, you can give it a try." You always feel there's a hint of sarcasm in his words...... You're not sure.
Then Tenna added, "If you don't want to hear it, then forget it. I won't keep reading it to you. Even if I say it hoarsely, no one will listen." His words were a bit cold. Anyway, you shivered and waved your hand repeatedly.
"No, no, no, keep reading...... I really won't zone out and look around! "As you spoke, you were still wondering what antenna would taste like...... Uh, but you didn't have the guts to do that, because Tenna looks like one punch could kill three of you, and you wouldn't dare to try it lightly.
But this novel is good for passing the time, but listening to others read it is a bit boring...... It's also a bit hypnotic. You yawn, hug your knees, and try to stay awake to keep listening. But soon, your eyelids start to fight up and down. His dry voice reading this is really a bit too hypnotic.
You fell asleep leaning against the sofa cushion, finally falling asleep to the hypnotic sounds—listening to your steady breathing, Tenna stopped reading and glanced at you. He silently looked at you, his antenna drooping a bit. In the end, he put the book on the coffee table, then took out a quilt and gently covered you, then began eating the remaining grapes on your plate.
As he ate, his brows furrowed—in short, it was just a concrete wrinkle on the TV screen. The grapes were way too sour, and he didn't know how you ended up buying them. Tenna thought he should go shopping with you next time. He'd seen your fridge before, and those ingredients were just usable, not particularly great—anyway, Tenna decided that next time you wouldn't go, he'd drag you along. At worst, he'd win the bet and then ask you to go for a while. It seemed like you weren't that active either.
After finishing the grapes, he even washed the plate himself, then started picking out ingredients to prepare lunch. He figured you probably wouldn't wake up at noon, only made one for one person, and it was just steak. If you woke up, you could still make it in time. Sure enough, you didn't wake up at noon and were still sound asleep.
At night, Tenna thought for a moment to take out some frozen lamb chops from the fridge, grilled them briefly, sprinkled a bit of cinnamon powder and fennel as seasoning, then stood expressionlessly in front of you, looking down at you, watching your drooling sleep, took a deep breath, and finally restrained himself by shaking your shoulder and whispered, "Get up for dinner." ”
But you haven't woken up yet. It seems your soul is wandering in a dream, not knowing where to go. Tenna shook your shoulders more forcefully, her voice a little louder: "Get up and have dinner!" ”
…… But you still didn't wake up. You just frowned, probably feeling a bit noisy and turning over to cover your ears. Tenna's screen went completely black. He grabbed your shoulders and shook it hard, then gritted his teeth and whispered in your ear, "Get up, eat, dinner." He spoke clearly, word by word and phrase, and you were finally snapped awake by Tenna's voice. You instinctively pushed him, then checked the time on your phone and realized it was already evening. You muttered, then looked at Tenna and started to grin awkwardly.
"Ah...... Did I sleep for that long? It's already evening, thank you, tenna......" After you finished, you looked at Tenna's still-dark screen and instinctively shrugged, an awkward smile on your face. You carefully stood up and walked toward the other end of the table. Hmm, you obediently sat at the other end of the table, not having eaten lunch. You were already starving, so you grabbed the grilled lamb chops and started eating heartily, even giving Tenna a thumbs up.
Tenna just sat across from you with the screen pitch black. Then his screen finally lit up, though he still tugged at the corner of his mouth. You slumped your shoulders, a little afraid of his behavior, and didn't say anything more, just kept eating the lamb chops.
Tenna saw your swift speed and said, "You've already eaten, so what am I supposed to eat?" His voice carried a hint of annoyance, though it was a bit cold. You bit into the lamb chop and blinked at him, only then realizing he was crossing his arms and staring at you, not taking a single bite.
So you gave an awkward smile and pushed the remaining lamb chops toward him. Although you ate quite a bit, there was still plenty left on this plate. You guessed this was Tenna prepared for himself. You were almost full and even burped. Facing his slightly dim screen, you just forced an awkward smile and then gave him a thumbs up: "Mm, you made it delicious, very delicious!" I love your cooking! ”
You don't know if it's just your imagination, but you always feel like you've heard a triumphant snort, but all you can do is watch Tenna slowly and gracefully finish the lamb chops. Still, his sharp teeth bite at the chops quickly, and you always feel like the next time his teeth will bite at your meat...... Forget it, better not worry about all this nonsense.
Anyway, you just cut a bit more watermelon to eat, which just helps cut through the greasiness. In just a short while, Tenna finished off the remaining lamb chops, then casually picked up a piece of watermelon and started eating.
While eating, he complained to you, "This watermelon tastes pretty good. The grapes you prepared earlier were just too sour. Do you know how to buy anything?" ”
You scratch your head, think for a moment, and say, hmm...... Although your parents often send you out shopping, after eating the vegetables you bought twice, they never ask you to help with groceries again. So you just nod and shake your head: "I can buy things, but I don't know how to buy groceries. If I buy the wrong thing, my parents will scold me and won't let me buy ......." I don't really know what they were thinking, but they probably really wanted a son. Unexpectedly, they had a younger sister, so she started doing the chores at home that you couldn't do.
Tenna looked at you silently, as if she remembered something. He seemed a bit hesitant, and in the end, he just picked up his bowl and plates and went to the kitchen, his voice cold and indifferent: "Forget it, next time we go to the supermarket, I'll go with you." Got it? ”
You nodded eagerly, sat on the sofa waiting for Tenna for a while, and when Tenna came out of the kitchen, you raised your hand: "I remember you didn't seem very well...... Want me to give you a massage?" ”
Tenna took off her apron to make up her gloves. His expression was still very sour, and he looked at you. For once, you felt that expression on his face probably made you a bit hard to understand...... So you scratched your head and gave him a couple of awkward laughs.
"You won today, so just rest well. Why are you still thinking about me?" He didn't look at you, his voice still cold and a bit sarcastic.
You stroked your chin, then nodded as if it were only natural: "Alright, then I'll order you to lie on the bed with your back to me!" You can't see his screen, nor do you know what his expression looks like. In short, you see Tenna's body seem to stiffen for a moment, and then you don't know why he even lies on the bed with a hint of stiffness and humiliation......
Basically, you just straddled his back, almost bursting out laughing like a big villain—well, that was probably a bit rude. You just seriously stroked his antenna before starting the massage, and also gave a brief massage to his shoulders and neck. When you let go, you realized Tenna was already asleep. You let out a gentle breath, carefully left his room, quietly closed the door, and then stretched lazily to tidy up and rest in your own room.
You stretched lazily; you slept a bit too much during the day, but at night you actually found it hard to fall asleep...... You lay on the bed, staring blankly at the ceiling, then vaguely seemed to hear the room on Tenna's side...... A little crying?
Anyway, he didn't know how much time had passed before Tenna woke up from the darkness. In the pitch-black environment, even the smallest emotions were magnified. Tenna sat up, his screen pitch black, hands covering his face. He remembered how you used to talk about your broken legs during the day as if it didn't matter, showing the scars on your back. He remembered the tough things he had said to you, and finally remembered the hands you had gently caressed on his antenna before falling asleep.
His screen was pitch black, and then large tears rolled down from the top of the screen. Tenna felt a bit heavy inside, and whenever he thought of your scars, he felt even more sentimental—but then he remembered your smile, remembered your warm hand. He felt the heart in his chest beating slightly, as if it was moving a little faster.
He let the tears roll down, and let his body slowly shrink, until the drops soaked the bedding, until those drops dripped and mixed with Tenna's voice producing a faint sob.
Are you sure you haven't misheard...... After all, when you opened the door and quietly approached Tenna's room, all you heard was increasingly violent whimpering.
You knocked carefully on the door, but there was no response from inside. Tenna shivered and instinctively shrank under the covers, thinking maybe the blanket could cover his crying. Unfortunately, standing at his door, all sounds were very obvious. You sighed and shouted, "Then I'm coming in." You waited a while, but still didn't answer.
So you push open the door.
