title: Gambler 5 (dntx you)
content:
The room was pitch black, and you weren't sure if turning on the light was appropriate, so you just shone a flashlight on your phone. On the bed, you saw a small lump lifted from the covers...... Hmm, the blanket was wet and there was a sobbing. You knew Tenna was probably in that spot. You hesitated for a moment, but still turned on the light, so at least you could see clearly—you heard the sobbing seem to stop for a moment, then quieter, and you just carefully put down your phone, knelt on the bed, hesitated for a moment, and slowly opened the covers.
You encountered no resistance, so you saw Tenna, crying, exactly the same as the day you found him. His screen was pitch black, with big drops of tears dripping down, soaking the sheets, and the antenna hanging down from the screen. You kept feeling that tonight, his bed probably wouldn't be suitable for sleep...... But the most important thing was to calm his emotions first.
You scratched your head, still not understanding why he acted like this. You just bent down and gently hugged him. Unexpectedly, he was holding him very lightly, his tears soaking your clothes. You carefully picked him up, knelt on the bed, placed Tenna on your lap, stared at his screen, gently patted his head, rubbed his antenna, and your voice softened, softly asking, "Tenna, what's wrong?" ”
But he just lowered his head to the TV, buried his head in your chest, tears soaking your shirt, but he wouldn't say a word, just kept sobbing. You think maybe he's lost the strength to speak because of his constant crying, because you used to be like that too. So you just gently stroke his head, rub his antenna, and gently pat his back. You say nothing, just kneel here, waiting for him to cry.
Tenna knew that tenna could feel the warmth on the top of the head and the back, and also feel the softness on your chest. He carried a bit of sadness and guilt, along with some embarrassment and anger—he thought about how despicable he was at this very moment, being comforted by you despite it clearly being his own fault. He was also angry at being discovered by you; he did not want anyone to find out about his vulnerability. He wanted to always appear strong in front of others.
So he couldn't lift his head, just burying himself in your chest and crying. You hesitated a little, not knowing what to do, so you could only quietly guess: "Is it because of the bet? Did what I made you unhappy about it? Then I'll apologize to you......"
But Tenna just leaned against your arms and shook her head slightly.
You feel a bit helpless and can only keep guessing: "That's because ...... Because you don't like this kind of life? Sorry, I can only give you this kind of living environment right now......
You know this is wrong, and you shouldn't put yourself aside to please others. But your life and past only give you this ability. You can only subconsciously look for reasons within yourself when at a loss, and try every way to meet others' needs when they're dissatisfied.
But Tenna still just shook his head. You heard his whimpers gradually calm down, probably because his emotions had calmed down. You barely noticed, feeling relieved, thinking that letting go would allow you to go back and rest—but to your surprise, Tenna suddenly grew larger, returning to the same size as usual. He held you tightly, the heavy TV head carefully resting on top of your head, but didn't directly apply any force to you.
You felt as if he was still shedding tears, because in his stunned moment, a few tears seemed to fall onto your hair. You were held in his arms, or rather, pressed in his arms—except for the dim darkness, you could see nothing else.
It's your first time having such close contact with someone else. Even though they're just a member of the Dark Tribe, you can't help but blush. You reach out your hands, trying to push him away, and whisper, "What are you doing...... Tenna, let me go...... This is, um, this is the order of a winner! ”
Only then did Tenna reluctantly let go of you. Even though his screen was still pitch black, he lowered his head straight to look at you. You always sensed an even more intimidating gaze in it. You forced yourself to tremble and instinctively smiled: "So what's wrong with you, Tenna?" Can't sleep? ”
His antenna was still dangling, but there was no water stain on the screen. He simply spoke dryly, "It's nothing, just thinking of some sad things." ”
This sentence was true. He remembered the wounds you had suffered, of your calm and indifferent statements, of you still smiling even in such situations, of you who could still smile when faced with his harsh and rude words and demands...... Tenna admitted he didn't want others to see him in such a terrible state, but if it were you, maybe it wouldn't matter, after all...... It seemed you told him everything that had happened to you.
…… He even feels a bit envious of you, or maybe even jealous. He doesn't understand why, doesn't understand why you can still laugh so freely, doesn't understand why, despite having experienced similar things before, you and he have taken two different paths. At that moment, he suddenly feels a desire...... He suddenly has a desire to have you, to protect you. If it's the complete opposite, tenna...... After this jealousy, he still hopes you can keep going like this.
After all, you proved to him that even so, you can still exist, and even so, you can still smile.
You looked at him uncertainly, reached out to touch the TV screen, but it was still cold, and his antenna was still drooping. You had no choice but to ask again, "Is that ...... Did you have a nightmare?" ”
His screen suddenly lit up, startling you, but his lips were just pressed together, showing no other expression. Instead, the TV's head nodded heavily at you: "Yes, I had a nightmare...... "This is a bit hard to admit, but it is indeed a pretty good lie."
"My bed...... It looks like I can't sleep on it, so can I sleep in your room for the night? I'll shrink down and won't bother you." His expression didn't change, after all, Tenna was seriously lying to you. He was a bit nervous because he wasn't sure if you would expose him, and he didn't know if you would discover the truth behind the lie.
You hesitated, glanced at Tenna, then tilted your head to size him up. Tenna only felt more nervous, the mechanical heart in her chest pounding, and his face only grew darker. He kept his lips pressed together and said dryly, "If you don't agree, then forget it. This bed can be cramped and sleepable." ”
You glanced at the bed—almost half of it was soaked. You could tell he was crying hard, but in the end, you sighed: "How can you sleep on a bed like this...... This isn't how I treat guests. Go sleep in my room. At worst, I'll tidy up and sleep here first." ”
Tenna's heart sank for a moment. You still see him as a guest—but in fact, ever since the bet began, he's always wanted to be the master here, or rather, your master. Well, after tonight, this feeling grew even stronger. For him, maybe having this identity at least protected you from any other harm...... He knew this idea was pretty foolish.
He stared at you for a while, then finally replied dryly, "Oh." He couldn't think of anything to persuade you to sleep with him...... Anyway, he just walked into your room, picked up your blanket, and pulled it over himself. Then he couldn't help but imagine you holding him as he fell asleep—after all, the whole bed was filled with your scent and warmth. Tenna then shook off the thought. He didn't understand why he had it, but he tossed and turned on the bed, still unable to shake the thought out of his mind. In the end, Tenna just drifted off restlessly.
On the other side, you simply grabbed a quilt and a sheet to pad your bed and fell asleep, since you've been feeling sleepy lately...... Uh, maybe your period is coming; it usually happens around this time.
The next morning, you sat up dazedly on the bed. After a moment of reaction, you finally realized you were in Tenna's room. You patted your face, which was flushed for some reason, got dressed, got out of bed, opened the door, and walked out. Breakfast was still prepared and now laid out on the table.
You yawned, sat at the front of the table, spread jam on bread, and started eating, while Tenna silently picked up a comb and stood behind you, tying your hair into a high ponytail. Then he sat across the table, staring at you. You always felt like he was watching you eat, and couldn't help but eat a bit faster.
After dinner, you clapped your hands: "Ahem...... Hmm, so today's bet has begun. What do you want to play? "Anyway, you can play whatever you want. You know after these few days that neither of you will make any excessive demands, so you can rest assured..."
Tenna thought for a moment and offered a suggestion: "Then let's play chess." He used to always play this game...... He had played it when he was a dreamer, because there were only so many games on TV. Kids could play chess, but unfortunately, as they grew up, they stopped liking those games.
Your expression fell again, after all, you were completely unskilled at this—if in Gomoku, you could rack your brains to chase and block them, trying to arrange your own formations, but in chess, you could just admit defeat, because you simply don't know how to do it, you just move aimlessly.
Of course, you still know the basic rules...... But you still looked pitifully at Tenna: "Can we not play chess? I just admit defeat right away...... I don't want to be bullied." As you spoke, you put your hands together and blinked at Tenna.
Tenna was clearly enjoying it. He crossed his arms and laughed, but when he smiled, the sharp teeth in his mouth also showed...... He actually looked somewhat intimidating. You shrugged, your starry eyes showing up. You thought Tenna's attitude was probably about to let you go.
But right after, you hear a very cold "No." ”
You look at Tenna in disbelief, and the frown on the TV screen is just raised, and you think he's probably doing it on purpose—whether he did it or not, you think he did it on purpose.
So you have to hang your head and take out the chessboard at home, place it on the table, and Tenna calmly says, "What if you win this round?" ”
You pouted, head down, sitting in your chair: "I don't think I can win......" you muttered quietly, but still casually stepped forward with a pawn while Tenna told you to go first.
Tenna also moved forward with a pawn, and you carefully let that pawn take a step forward—then his elephant attacked and directly devoured your horse.
You stared wide-eyed at the chessboard: "I told you, I can't win—" You never won in bot battles before, always getting checkmated after just a few steps. Now, sitting across from you is a TV and a large machine—there's even less chance you can win.
Tenna just insisted, "Just a little more." He never intended for you to lose...... In chess, he was pretty easy at letting go, able to feed you and help you win. He felt a bit guilty, because later he wanted to use some method to make you want to defy his orders, and then he could be your master forever—so for the next few days, Tenna planned to let you win.
You blinked, feeling wronged, and had no choice but to take out another horse and jump a little. Tenna now quietly started moving the minions, as if the previous move was just an illusion. You played randomly according to the rules of chess. I wonder if it was just your imagination, but you always felt that some of Tenna's pieces were placed in positions that could easily be captured. You looked up at him with some suspicion, but Tenna's face was pitch black, expressionless, and she looked unwilling. Only then did you place a piece half-believingly.
Until the end, there were hardly any pieces left on the board, only the pawn you had taken out at the start. For some reason, it hadn't been captured. That pawn reached the end of the board, and you happily took out the queen you had previously been eaten by Tenna's horse and placed it on the board: "Mutiny, promoted to Queen!" Hmph, I still know about that! "You happily put your hands on your hips, but unexpectedly, Tenna lights up the screen and smiles at you."
You involuntarily tremble, thinking he has some shady trick waiting for you, but at this moment, your queen is about to die. The king standing alone on the chessboard can't help but widen your eyes: "I...... I won, I won? "You still can't believe it.
Tenna just nodded, his voice dry: "Hmm, you won." "And he showed some unwillingness—so you wouldn't get suspicious."
Of course, he was indeed unwilling to accept it. After all, his chess was terrible, and Tenna tried every possible way to perform himself, exhausted to help you win.
TBC.

title: Gambler 6 (dntx you)
content:
You unconsciously put aside your excitement and look at Tenna's pitch-black screen, still a bit uneasy, asking, "But you were the one who proposed chess...... There's no way you'd lose, right?" "After all, you think if you make a proposal, you'll probably do it yourself, even though when you play chess, he surprisingly feels like he's a match for you, the lousy chess basket...... But isn't it a TV? Minesweeping, spider cards, chess, and so on are the most common sports without internet connection. Logically, he should be very good at these things......
Tenna's screen was still dark, since he didn't want you to notice he was lying. His voice was stiff, just as cold as the previous days: "I don't usually play this, and my users don't like playing these little games." ”
Of course, he's lying. You look at him suspiciously, but Tenna just keeps the screen in black. From his usual stiff words, you can't tell he's lying. Anyway, you've won. It seems pointless to investigate why you won. It's better to think about what kind of orders to give the loser.
So you really thought for a moment: "Alright then...... Let me think about what I should do next. Got it, why don't you be my manual worker!" You clenched your left hand and tapped the palm of your right hand, a bit excited.
The TV's head tilted slightly, his voice rising slightly with a hint of confusion: "Manual labor?" ”
"Just help me get things and stuff...... Help me out, after all, you see, I'm such a delicate and frail woman. You look much bigger, and you must be strong. "As you spoke, you gestured exaggeratedly, making yourself look very, very small, and then making Tenna look very big.
Tenna couldn't help but laugh. He thought you looked pretty amusing, but of course, he couldn't say it out loud, so halfway through his laughter he turned into a cold snort. If the room weren't so quiet, you'd probably wonder if you misheard that laugh.
"Alright, how should I help you?" But unexpectedly, he was actually easy to talk to...... Maybe it was because he lost today; you thought Tenna would be furious after hearing such a request.
Of course, you don't know that Tenna is thinking of letting you win these past few days, fulfilling your wishes, and then letting you lose something like that later. You just gestured excitedly: "Ah, because I just moved to the Dark World...... It's tough, I still have to buy two sets of bedding, they're heavy, and there are utensils and such...... If you hadn't come, of course I'd have enough for you, but since you're living at my place now, of course you need to buy more things to bring back...... And the ingredients stocked up in the fridge will be used up in the next few days. Come pick some more with me! ”
"Oh, and you also prepared today's lunch and dinner." You added another sentence as you spoke.
Tenna nodded, and his screen finally lit up again, though the corners of his mouth remained flat and his voice was flat: "Any other requests?" ”
You glanced at Tenna in surprise, after all, you hadn't expected him to look so easygoing today...... You thought he would help you with a sour face, but to your surprise, his expression was quite calm.
You just shook your head: "Not for now...... If you have any new requests, I'll let you know. Let's head to the supermarket now!" You waved your hand and walked out the door first, while Tenna followed behind you toward the supermarket. The supermarket wasn't far from your home. You picked up a shopping cart and had Tenna push it. You actually forgot what you had agreed on to buy earlier, and instead gathered over to the book display area, happily flipping through the covers and introductions to see which ones you could buy.
Tenna pushed the cart over to take a look and found that most of the books here were collections of cold jokes, brain teasers, and a bunch of romance novels that seemed to be favorites among middle and high schoolers...... In short, he had never read any of these.
He silently lowered his head as he looked at you, while you were still engrossed in the books, even crouching down to open them and read intently. Tenna glanced again at the electronic clock hanging above the supermarket and had to remind you, "It's already been half an hour, Y/N. Are you still here to read?" ”
You were a bit absorbed in it, and hearing his voice startled you. You hurriedly closed the book, almost jumping up. Seeing Tenna still standing there, the screen pitch black, you patted your chest and gasped, muttering a little complaint, "You scared me to death...... You scared me so much...... Then you tossed the unfinished book, along with several books on the shelf, into the shopping cart, and you looked at Tenna and chuckled twice.
"Um...... The plan has changed! Buy some more books to take home. I think these books are actually quite good. "You clapped your hands and prepared to walk forward, but Tenna called out to you.
"If I remember correctly, you haven't finished reading those books at home yet...... If you buy more books, will you finish reading them?" His screen lit up, and you saw a big question mark flashing, and you couldn't help but cough twice.
"It's nothing...... Eventually, we'll finish reading it all day. Let's go buy some daily necessities or something." As you said that, you tried to pull the shopping cart away, but Tenna was even stronger—you couldn't even pull it! You turned around a bit annoyed, wanting to order Tenna to help you push the cart properly, but looking at his screen, there was still a big question mark at the top. Not only that, he kept asking you.
"Are these books useful for you?"
"It works, I'm just passing the time......" You pursed your lips, and it was only when reading these books that you briefly forget the pain in real life, selectively forget those things, and escape the sorrow that lingers for years. What is replaced by a superficial but pure sense of happiness is yours.
Tenna just tilted his head on the TV, looking skeptical, and even the antenna above his head was swinging back and forth. You couldn't help but glance along with his antenna, knowing he wasn't very convinced. You cleared your throat twice and said, "So do you know why A is lower than C?" ”
…… He really wasn't very good at these things. Tenna searched through his memories of hosting TV shows and found that there really wasn't an answer to the question, so he honestly shook his head.
And you put your hands on your hips and proudly said, "I know, because of ABCD! That's the point of these books! ”
After saying that, you walked off proudly, and Tenna had no choice but to follow behind with the shopping cart. He really didn't quite understand...... He looked at the books in the cart. Most of them seemed to be stories about love or novels. Tenna wondered, do you want a romance? He didn't know the answer to that question. He just followed behind you coldly, quietly, and said, "I don't think memorizing these old jokes is useful." ”
You walk ahead, not turning to look at him, just slightly lowering your head and chuckling self-deprecatingly. Yes, you know immersing yourself in all this is just self-deception...... But you still say, "It's not really useful...... Well, but making people feel happy is already very useful. ”
After that, you were silent for quite a while, until you took Tenna to the daily necessities section. Looking at the cups, towels, and toothbrushes hanging on the shelves, you thought about how you had given Tenna the spare set you prepared for yourself...... So you picked out another set according to your preferences, then looked at Tenna: "By the way, pick out some things too, for the ones you'll need at home—the current set is a backup, so pick another set as a backup." ”
Tenna looked at the items you put in the shopping cart and picked out a set of styles and shades that matched your understanding. You looked a bit puzzled and glanced at Tenna: "In that case, our stuff will be mixed together. Are you sure?" ”
Tenna kept the screen black and said nothing, just nodded. You nodded thoughtfully, then turned to the stationery section to get a set of name stickers and put them in the shopping cart. Of course, Tenna wouldn't tell you that he did have some thoughts about one day mixing them up with you...... But that thought wasn't very strong; he just seemed compelled to pick an item you understood, then asked himself why he did it.
…… But it's normal for the master and servant to use the same thing, Tenna convinced herself just like that.
You have no idea what the big TV behind you is thinking. You just pull your shopping cart to the toiletries section ahead, pick out a shampoo and body wash, then look Tenna up and down, hmm...... Completely bare, probably without shampoo, but you still step aside to let him look at the shelf: "Is there any body wash you want, or rather, um...... Toothpaste, or anything else?" ”
Tenna glanced through it, then shook her head: "I can use the same thing as you." After all, that means he and you have the same scent...... It also means there's a connection between you. Although Tenna didn't understand why he suddenly had such an idea.
You nodded thoughtfully, then walked over to the home goods section. You huffed and hugged down a set of bedding sets. Tenna hurried to take them for you, then simply stuffed them into the shopping cart. He glanced at them and picked up the same set as yours.
You looked at Tenna with that slightly strange gaze, but in the end, you said nothing. You glanced at the shopping cart piled high with things and hesitated for a moment: "Hmm...... There are so many things. How about we settle the bill first and then head back? ”
Tenna had no objections, just nodded, and you dragged Tenna to pay. Of course, you paid for all of this—you probably didn't have any dark coins on this TV, since you picked it up. But because it's all exactly the same thing, when you pay for it and when you walk down the street, other Dark Folk give you those ambiguous looks—well, of course you gave Tenna all these things. I don't know why the other Dark Folk are looking at you like that. Tenna is clearly your limited edition servant for today!
So you angrily lowered your voice and said, "It's all your fault. Who told you to buy the same style as me......" You muttered under your breath, after all, this was the first time you'd ever enjoyed such a striking feeling. In contrast, Tenna seemed to have gotten used to all this.
"Because it looks good, so there's no other reason. Besides, I don't know how to pick things. Since you picked one, then there's no problem." He was carrying something, and you couldn't see his expression. Basically, you just heard his cold, hard voice. You pouted, but fine, you couldn't argue with that reason—so you had to let him be.
"Honestly, it seems it's better not to go out with you next time......" You kept muttering, but Tenna interrupted you. For some reason, his voice even sounded a bit urgent.
"If you don't come out with me, who else do you want to go out with?" Aren't I your laborer? Tenna didn't realize that her voice sounded urgent and aggressive to you. He just instinctively felt a bit nervous and couldn't help but ask the question.
You were startled by him again, and you didn't realize he was so nervous. You just muttered even more quietly, "Aren't you...... Are you the only one working for me because you lost today's game? Then you might not lose in the future, and you might not live at my place anymore...... Of course, I'll hum and take the things back myself. "As you spoke, you pouted and snorted.
Tenna had no idea what was really going on; tenna only knew that the mechanical heart in his chest seemed to suddenly fall into an abyss—why was there this dull, or perhaps bitter, sensation? Why did he suddenly feel so unwilling? He only curled the corners of his mouth downward, his voice still cold: "Yes, I did not voluntarily become your laborer, nor did I voluntarily stay in your house."
You didn't realize he was being sarcastic, so you just continued on your own: "Yeah, you didn't do it willingly...... Don't worry, I know, it's just this once. After this time, I won't let you do this kind of work anymore. Once you find the place you want to go, then leave my place...... You keep rambling. Honestly, after thinking that Tenna will leave one day, you instinctively feel empty, as if sad and lost. But you only blame this feeling on the sadness of losing someone you can talk to. You haven't thought much about it, since it's only been a few days...... There's not much deep feelings between you two, are there?
Anyway, you and Tenna returned home. You directed Tenna to put things where they belonged, then took Tenna back to the supermarket.
TBC.

title: Gambler 7 (dntx you)
content:
This time, you pulled Tenna along, loaded up the shopping cart, and headed straight to the fresh produce sales area. Honestly, you really don't have much ...... Most of the tips for choosing fresh produce are based on luck, which leads to some things not tasting and others that taste terribly good.
You gestured to Tenna with your hands pressed together: "Please, Mr. Tenna, help me buy something!" Not only that, you stared at him with sparkling eyes, knowing you could order him around today...... But you still did it. Well, after all, if you lose the next bet, you don't want Tenna to make things too hard for you.
Tenna was clearly enjoying it. He snorted coldly, grabbed a food bag, and began picking through the fruits and vegetables on display. He couldn't help but say, "So what if I leave in the future, what will you do?" He didn't know what answer he wanted to get...... All he knew was that after hearing your answer now, his heart felt heavy, as if even his mechanical heart was about to stop beating. It was just uncomfortable.
You just scratched your head and said with some confusion, "Before you leave, I'll learn how to pick vegetables...... Or I'll just keep buying a little randomly like before." "After all, now you see Tenna picking out vegetables that look fresher and better, and you really don't understand how he chooses...... Anyway, you just can't understand.
Tenna turned her head to glance at you. You looked up at him in a daze. His screen was lit, but you hadn't seen him smile today. It seemed like he kept pouting, his lips curved downward.
Then he turned his head, and all you could hear was his cold, ruthless voice: "I won't teach you." ”
…… He doesn't quite understand, but at least he knows he doesn't want to leave your side, or at least as long as you don't leave him, that's enough. That feeling, that thought grew stronger, as long as he could truly become your master...... There would be no more issues like leaving or not leaving, nor would there be such foolish conversations like now. You're so fragile, you clearly need to be well cared for to survive...... You clearly need better protection to avoid other dangerous things happening; he deserves to be your master, because only by being your master can he ensure he protects and takes good care of you.
You don't understand why Tenna's mood worsened after hearing your answer. He didn't even wait for you, just pushed the shopping cart straight ahead. You had to jog to catch up, since Tenna was so big that to you, his step was almost as big as your three-step pace.
You barely took a few steps before you were out of breath, because of those injuries. Even after healing, your physical condition wasn't great, and your sports results were even worse. You could only quietly call out to him, "Tenna, Tenna, slow down, I can't keep up with ......."
He still didn't look back at you, just stopped to wait for you. You finally caught up, just about to say something to Tenna, but he quickened his pace and walked forward again. This happened several times until you were completely out of breath and couldn't say a word. Only then did Tenna stop, then opened the slot at the back of the shopping cart that could be pushed open and put you inside.
You were a bit confused. You didn't know why Tenna was doing this, just staring blankly up at him. All you could see was Tenna's chin—well, his screen still seemed pitch black, the antenna drooping, and he still looked like he wasn't in a good mood. You shrugged, not daring to say anything more, but you watched as Tenna put watermelon and grapes into the shopping cart, then pushed you to check out.
It was only then that he finally bent down to look at you. Then he reached out and seemed to gently pat your head. You looked a bit dazed, not sure if you were mistaken, because the next moment you saw Tenna pick up the fruits, vegetables, and meats to pay for the bill. When the cashier announced the price, you instinctively wanted to take out the dark coins on your body to pay, but Tenna just held your hand and pulled out a bank card to pay. Apparently, because he was once a dark world lord, the cashier's expression changed, he even gave you a discount, then bent down to watch you leave.
You feel a bit dazed, but at that very moment, Tenna suddenly bent down to look at you. His pitch-black screen stared at you, and you couldn't help but shiver again, staring at him blankly. Then you heard Tenna's somewhat hoarse voice—or rather, it seemed he was just pretending to be hoarse.
“…… Now I'm your servant. Just order me around, but don't treat me with such a pity-looking attitude." His voice was dry, with a hint of pretentious fierceness—at least you could tell that he was probably just sounding scary, which made you want to laugh. But seeing him so serious, you just nodded with a serious expression.
Only then did he lift his head, probably feeling that his earlier words had been too sharp, so he softened his tone a little, but it still sounded stiff.
"Anyway, just order me directly. There's no need to speak to me so softly. ”…… Otherwise, he might really be unable to resist tormenting you, making you talk to him like that forever. He admitted that during the time he deliberately let you catch up, he unknowingly felt satisfied hearing your voice and breathing. He felt he couldn't let this continue.
You nodded, half understanding. After all, you'd rested enough. This time, you brought Tenna, carrying bags and various groceries, back home. Then you busied yourself getting ready to take a shower—to relax. Plus, you'd just been sweating a lot. You folded your clothes, put them on your bed, turned on the heater, and then went into the bathroom. Tenna, following your instructions, put all the things she bought into the fridge, then sat on the sofa. The antenna was tangled together, and of course he could hear the sound of water rushing from the bathroom—or rather, ever since he changed the antenna...... He could hear every sound more clearly, including the off-key songs you hummed in the bathroom.
His antenna drooped, and he couldn't help but cover it with his palm, so he couldn't hear the sounds in the bathroom that stirred his imagination. Because of this, it took him quite a while to hear your voice.
You banged on the bathroom door, not knowing how you could forget about it. In any case, you just blushed, touched the burning heat on your cheeks, and finally knocked on the bathroom door: "Um, that!" Tenna，tenna？ ”
He vaguely heard you calling his name, finally let go, raised his voice, and asked, "What's wrong?" ”
You cleared your throat. Probably because there was a door between you, your voice sounded muffled and a bit muffled: "Um...... I forgot to take my bath towel. Can you help me get it? That big bath towel in my wardrobe! ”
Only then did Tenna get up and head toward your room. He immediately spotted your change of clothes on the bed, and of course, underwear and the like...... He quickly turned his head around with the screen pitch black, opened your wardrobe, rummaged through your wardrobe, and took out a long bath towel.
Then he walked to the bathroom door and gently knocked, his voice sounding a bit awkward, though you didn't notice: "I brought it over, your bath towel." ”
You just quietly opened the bathroom door just a crack, clutched your chest, quickly grabbed the towel, and then slammed the bathroom door shut. Through the door, I could still hear your voice: "Thank you, thank you so much......"
…… Tenna didn't want to hear things like that. He didn't want you to thank him; he just wanted you to take all of this for granted, including his existence. However...... The moment the bathroom door opened, he still saw something he shouldn't have, like your exposed, fair skin...... Anyway, he walked back hand in hand and foot to sit on the sofa, just covering his screen with his hand.
You just used a towel to dry your hair, then wrapped the towel around your lower body. Then you wrapped yourself in the towel and walked out of the bathroom. Tenna glanced at you but immediately looked away, turning away from you. You didn't even look at Tenna now, just walked back to your room and put on your clothes, with your damp hair still scattered behind you. You rummaged through the nightstand and pulled out the hairdryer, feeling that blow-drying was too much trouble to blow-dry your hair. So you went to the living room, handed it to Tenna, and said matter-of-factly, "Help me dry my hair, Tenna." "After all, he told you to do it, just give him orders...... Hmm, something like that, right?
Tenna finally turned his head. His screen lit up, but his expression was still unhappy. You're used to seeing him like that every day, just moving a little toward Tenna so he could get your hair.
…… Tenna had never done anything like this before. He stiffly picked up the hair dryer, turned on the switch, and started blow-drying directly on your hair. Your messy, wet hair was covered in the rush of his hair, making you twitch at the corner of your mouth. You simply tied it up and handed it to him, shouting, "If you want to do this, hold it and blow-dry, or you'll blow it all over my head!" ”
He obediently followed your instructions and started blowing, holding each strand like combing his hair, but you still cried out in pain and started slapping Tenna's thigh: "That's not it, you're holding it so hard! Take it gently!" ”
…… In short, this chaotic hair-drying process finally ended amid your fuss...... Maybe it ended perfectly. Tenna didn't even need you to say anything; she picked up a comb and started combing your hair. He was indeed strong, holding your hair to help you smooth out the bumps and knots caused by his wild blowing. You squinted slightly, enjoying his care. Only when he finally finished combing and tied your hair did you stretch lazily and lie back down on the sofa, looking at Tenna expectantly, waiting for him to prepare lunch.
Tenna also, as you wished, went to prepare lunch. Today’s lunch was relatively simple: two bacon and cabbage sandwiches and two glasses of watermelon juice… besides that, tenna also brought a plate of bacon-wrapped fried enoki mushrooms for you. Steaming hot, you hurriedly devoured the meal, enjoying the delicacies until you were full, then collapsed in your seat. tenna instinctively took the finished bowls and plates to wash them.
You sat in your seat, feeling drowsy and a bit drowsy. Then you heard Tenna's cold voice exploding in your ear: "If you want to sleep, go sleep in bed. Staying here is a nuisance." When you wake up, you see Tenna tidying up the dining table.
Actually, lying down and falling asleep outside like this can easily catch a chill, but Tenna wouldn't remind you of that. He just looked at you expressionlessly. You scratched the back of your head, chuckled twice, stood up, and then walked back to your own room, yawning: "Then I'll go back and rest first!" "I won't bother you anymore." ”
Tenna listened as you slammed your door shut, but expressionlessly wiped the table even harder. He wanted to sleep with you too, but you didn't agree to it yesterday...... Even though he said he could shrink or something, I doubt you would agree to it today.
He simply wiped the dining table clean viciously, making it look shiny and brand new. Then Tenna returned to his room, wrapped himself tightly in the blanket, imagining you lying here last night, imagining you lying here now, lying in his arms...... Unconsciously, it seemed his imagination had come true in the dream.
He woke up a bit earlier than you, sitting in the living room, flipping through the books you bought today. I don't know what he was trying to study, but naturally, for the rest of the day...... You only picked a book and asked Tenna to read it to you. This one was quite interesting, and you listened intently to the love story between the heroine and the android. When the time came, Tenna put down the book and made dinner for you. You enjoyed it happily, let Tenna read to you for a while, and before going to sleep, you pressed Tenna down to give him the same antenna massage as the previous two days. After saying goodnight, you yawned and went back to your own room to sleep.
But you hadn't fully fallen asleep yet. Half-awake, you heard a knock at the door. You rubbed your eyes, turned on the light, and sat up: "What's wrong, tenna...... Didn't you go to sleep? ”
Tenna opened the door, standing outside with the screen pitch black. Just looking at it like this was pretty scary—at least you were startled by his wide eyes. Tonight, the thunderstorm had just started, and a bolt of lightning flashed by, lighting up his screen. Are you sure if the lights were off...... Tenna's appearance is definitely perfect for a horror movie.
TBC.

title: Gambler 8 (dntx you)
content:
He didn't say anything, just stood there with the screen pitch black—hmm, the antenna didn't droop, and he seemed to be in good condition. You quickly assessed it and couldn't help but ask again, "So, did something happen, Tenna?" ”
Tenna just shook her head, and then you heard that voice that sounded like it was pretending to be hoarse, tinged with stiffness and anxiety, making you feel like he was probably just lying......
“…… The thunder outside is too loud, I'm a bit scared. Can I sleep here with you for a night? I'll shrink it down and won't disturb you." His voice was still stiff. He tried hard to keep his screen pitch black so his expression wouldn't slip through, since he was lying to you.
You hesitate for a moment, listening to thunder outside. At the same time, lightning flashes again, illuminating his screen. Tenna visibly trembles twice—the movement is too obvious, and it actually feels a bit pretentious. You scratch your head, look at Tenna, and mutter quietly, "But the soundproofing in the two rooms isn't much different......
Of course, Tenna heard your voice clearly. His body only stiffened further, and you confirmed with Tenna again: "Are you going to sleep here with me?" ”
You looked at that dark TV and nodded.
You hesitated for a moment, but honestly, it didn't matter where you slept...... So you stood up, gave up the bed, and walked toward the door: "Then you sleep in my room. I'll sleep in your room." You don't need to bring anything else; after all, you just put on your pajamas and head out. As you passed the doorway and next to Tenna, Tenna suddenly grabbed your wrist tightly and firmly. You couldn't help but frown, because it hurt so much that moment. But the next second, Tenna let go of her hand as if nothing had happened just now.
You turned your head in confusion, looked up at Tenna, but you couldn't see his TV screen. He tilted his head to the side again, his voice cold and hard. He tried to keep his voice from stammering: "I...... "I mean, I want to sleep with you." After saying this, he subtly swallowed.
You blinked, slowed for two seconds, and finally understood what Tenna meant: because it was a thunderstorm, he wanted to sleep with you...... Because he was a bit afraid of thunder? This is something you wouldn't have imagined; after all, he looked like he wasn't afraid of anything.
You turned around and walked back to your own bed, sat down, and patted the empty seat next to you: "Alright, then sleep on it...... But remember to shrink down, or you'll push me out." You complained softly and moved aside, and Tenna sat down next to you. He shrank a little but didn't look very small—just about your size by comparison.
You carefully reached out to pat his head, massaged his antenna, and then softly said, "I'll turn off the lights and go to sleep." ”
Tenna nodded, and his antenna drooped obediently. You couldn't help but reach out and pat his head again, gently rubbing his antenna. It seemed he was relaxed enough, so you turned off the light and lay back down.
You were already very sleepy, yawned, and in the thunderstorm, you sank into the warm bed, soon drifting into a half-awake state. In a daze, you felt something snuggling into your arms, radiating a bit of warmth. Unable to resist, you hugged him tightly and gently patted Tenna's back. At first, Tenna was a bit panicked—after all, it would be hard if you noticed. But clearly, you hadn't noticed, so Tenna curled up in your warm embrace, greedily enjoying your embrace and the faint fragrance on you, reluctantly drifting off to sleep.
When you woke up again, you only felt a bit uncomfortable in front of you. Once fully awake, you realized that at some point, you had been held in an embrace by a tenna that was the same size as usual, or perhaps even bigger. No wonder you felt a bit of metallic discomfort. There was no longer any thunder outside the window. You imagined that he might have returned to his previous size in the middle of the night without realizing it. You carefully tried to move outside, but his arm was lying across your back, holding you tightly, making it impossible for you to break free. Helpless, you had to gently tap his screen, your face flushing—you never expected such close contact.
You whispered to him, poking him with your finger: "Tenna, tenna? Wake up......"
But his screen was still pitch black, showing no signs of waking up, and it even seemed like he was holding you tighter.
In fact, Tenna had already regained consciousness, but he had turned off his screen, doing his best to keep his body stretched out as if still lost in a dream. His mechanical heart was pounding nervously, honestly...... He didn't know if you would notice, but he just wanted to pretend to sleep and enjoy a little more tender moments. He lay here, holding you, as if he truly possessed you. After all, you were so small to him, after all, you were weak to him...... He wanted to have you, possess you, protect you, so that all the hurt would be enduring for him.
You didn't notice Tenna was pretending to sleep, just raised the volume a bit in frustration and gently tugged at his antenna: "Tenna? Time to wake up. You still have to make me breakfast, I'm starving......" You complained softly. Indeed, you were very hungry, but Tenna still showed no signs of waking up. You had to tentactively tug at his mechanical arm, trying to break free from his embrace. If it really didn't work, you could just bake a couple of slices of bread for breakfast. That's how you used to get through it.
Tenna instinctively wanted to tighten his arms and grab you, but then he snapped out of it, quickly let go, and sat up straight. The screen showed an apologetic expression: "Sorry, I don't know how I did that." ”
You only thought his transformation was an accident, so you waved your hand and smiled lightly, "It's okay, just be more careful next time...... Let's make breakfast first, I'm starving." Your voice, with a soft scent from just getting up, sounded more like you were being spoiled. Tenna swallowed nervously, and at the same time, he felt a bit unwilling—he couldn't accept that you didn't take it seriously, he couldn't accept that you were just reacting like this. He wanted to hold more weight in your heart, but why exactly? He didn't know; that was all he was thinking.
Tenna went to the kitchen and quickly prepared breakfast for you. You poked at the jam and finished the bread, along with the breakfast bacon and ham. You wiped your mouth, your eyes darting around, then suggested, "Let's play checkers today!" ”
This is one of the games you're quite good at, since the rules of checkers are simple. You take out the checkers board and start seriously playing checkers with Tenna...... Naturally, you win this time. Even if Tenna didn't hold back, he had to admit that he really couldn't beat you in checkers.
And you just clapped your hands happily: "Yay, I won again today! Just so you know, you're still in charge of lunch and dinner today." Tenna nodded without objection, then automatically walked behind you to help you fix your hair and re-braid it. Of course, you didn't think anything was wrong; you just thought for a moment about where else you should go today...... Yesterday you went to the supermarket, and when you came back, you noticed there was no change of clothes for Tenna at this place, even though he was just a guest to your house...... Well, but since you picked it up, you have to take responsibility, so of course you had to buy Tenna some clothes.
So you put your palms together again, looking at Tenna, who had returned to sitting across from you, and said, "Come with me out shopping for clothes today!" ”
Any order was fine. Of course, Tenna had no objections. He just nodded in agreement with your idea, so you happily walked out the door, while Tenna followed behind, but...... You first walked into a men's clothing store. Tenna looked at you in confusion. A question mark appeared on his screen, and you just gave him a push—uh, not at all. Still, you pointed to the clothes in the men's store and said, "My clothes are pretty much enough. Go pick out some clothes you want to wear." ”
There were no tailors here who could make clothes for Tenna, but...... The sizes of the clothes here were suitable for ordinary Dark Dwellers, but they weren't really for him. In fact, he could only look at the cuts and such. He picked out a few clothes, all either blue-purple or blue-black suits, which looked almost the same. The store manager nodded and bowed, promising to start the production process as soon as possible and try to provide you with the finished product as soon as possible. You looked at his only clothes in these colors and felt a bit uncomfortable, muttering, "Why are there only these colors...... Why don't you try on other colors? Other styles are fine too. ”
As you spoke, you held up a white sweatshirt and gestured it over Tenna. He shrank down a bit at just the right moment, and it turned out to be pretty good. So you happily called out to the manager, "Prepare this outfit for him too!" ”
The manager responded, then picked up another set of pure black shirts nearby. The cut looked nice and suited Tenna, so you tossed the shirt to the manager as well.
Tenna, on the other hand, stood stiffly here as your model. Although he didn't need to change clothes, saving a lot of trouble, he had to stand there the whole time as a hanger—so he had to let you gesture on him. You brought over a red blazer, gestured for it, but it really didn't suit him, so you regretfully tossed it aside.
Then purple, brown, blue—yukata, haori jackets, and ordinary outdoor jackets. You tried them out, and it turned out that a white shirt paired with a black haori looked quite nice, or a white yukata would work too. Finally, you tried on a hat, but unfortunately, there was an antenna on his head, so a regular hat didn't look like it would fit, so you had to regretfully give up on the hat.
The suits and similar items at this shop were custom-made, and as for yukata and haori that were naturally loose styles, they fit him perfectly without any sense of incongruity.
You brought him a set of light blue pajamas, packed them up to take with you, then walked a couple of steps back and looked at Tenna's current outfit, finally nodding in satisfaction—although the yukata and haori pairing sounds a bit odd, you have to admit, it actually looks pretty good. You know you have good taste!
You casually tossed the clothes you bought to Tenna, but he refused to let you pay no matter what. You had no idea where he got the dark coins from, but he paid smoothly and then followed you out of the store with bags of various items.
You looked him up and down, and Tenna was wondering why you were looking at him, when she heard you lean in and quietly ask, "Um, that...... Do you still need to buy some underwear or something...... "A few days ago you forgot about this, but now that you've remembered, you can't let him sleep in a free shift...... Uh, speaking of which, did he wear underwear last night......
Tenna was stunned for a moment. You saw his screen light up, the corners of his mouth curved downward, and there was an indescribable blush on the screen. He looked a bit embarrassed and angry. You chuckled awkwardly twice, hurriedly stepped back two paces, deciding not to discuss the matter further, but Tenna grabbed the back of his neck. His tone sounded unusually sinister: "Of course I need to buy some underwear. Do you want to come with me?" He even spoke each word through gritted teeth.
Your eyes darted around twice, and you awkwardly chuckled, "You can go buy this yourself. I won't go with you......"
After saying this, you tugged at his hand holding your clothes, trying to make him let go, but he held on so tightly you couldn't pull it off. You got a bit anxious and said in a commanding tone, "Let me tell you, let go of my collar!" ”
Tenna let go as you said, but you were still struggling. When he let go, you stumbled twice and nearly fell. It was Tenna who grabbed you again and helped you steady yourself. You looked up to thank him, but you noticed he turned his head, as if he didn't want to listen to you.
Your eyes darted around, and now you quietly reached out and grabbed Tenna's sleeve: "Um, let me take you to the lingerie store. You probably don't know where it is, do you?" "Just ...... Just consider it a thank-you gesture, that's it!
TBC.

title: Gambler 9 (dntx you)
content:
"Oh." Tenna's voice was cold. He still didn't look down at you, or you'd see the blush on his screen—he definitely didn't want that.
You didn't care; after all, he agreed and agreed. You happily grabbed his sleeve and dragged Tenna toward the lingerie store. Tenna didn't use any force, so you easily pulled him along—or rather, he followed you.
In short, you've arrived at your final destination—a lingerie store—which sells both men's and women's lingerie. The reason for coming here is because you thought you should buy a few pieces too, since the old ones are a bit old. You nudge Tenna toward the men's lingerie and go off to check your size.
Meanwhile, Tenna silently held several pairs of the largest panties in the largest sizes. To be honest, he didn't even need to go to the fitting room; just by comparing his clothes, he knew these were the only ones that suited him. He quickly packed up and walked to the cashier. Then the clerk told Tenna that the lady who came with Tenna—that is, you—hadn't come out yet. So Tenna sat down at the seat in front of the register and started waiting. The clerk, seeing you all come to such a private place like the lingerie store, thought you were a couple or something, and quietly started chatting with Tenna. The content was basically about the size and style of the lingerie you were trying out. He even recommended a few sexy lingerie styles to Tenna, though almost all of them were women's, though men's styles were rare.
Tenna looked at the lingerie in front of her, swallowed hard, and instinctively stared at the screen going dark—he started imagining what you'd look like wearing these clothes. At this moment, he didn't want to show his blushing, shy screen to others, so he simply asked for a black plastic bag and bought all the clothes. The clerk looked at Tenna with a mysterious smile.
You changed into your underwear. Since there was no life-size mirror in the fitting room, you didn't know how it would work, so you carefully opened the door, wanting to see how the bra looked on the top in front of the mirror. But as soon as you stepped out, you widened your eyes and saw Tenna sitting there, completely silent with a pitch-black screen, staring at you. Startled, you quickly closed the door and shrank back. Oh my god, you never expected Tenna to be so fast! And...... And why aren't the men's and women's sections completely separated? Although it's not a big deal, since the key areas aren't exposed...... But if he sees you dressed like this, you still feel embarrassed. You can't help but pat your cheek, honestly...... You really couldn't get used to it, so you blushed and hurriedly tried on the remaining clothes. Thinking about how underwear wasn't meant for show—as long as it was comfortable, that was enough. You took a deep breath, tried to stay calm, and then took those few clothes you had changed into to the register to pay.
You don't know why the cashier's gaze toward you is somewhat ambiguous, and it seems that this ambiguous gaze occasionally swept over you and Tenna...... In short, you just walked out of the store with Tenna, then took a deep breath: "Finally, we're done. Let's head back." ”
At this moment, Tenna, who hadn't spoken much before, spoke up: "Don't you need to buy some more clothes?" The reason was simple: he wanted to get back at him. You changed his clothes for so long before, making him a hanger, and he wanted you to experience that feeling too—even though today he was a servant, it seemed like what he should do.
You paused, then looked up at Tenna. His screen was lit, and for some reason, he was smiling, showing a few sharp teeth, making you uneasy for no reason. You always felt like he probably wasn't up to any good intentions...... So just in case, you cautiously asked, "...... Tenna, what do you think of your taste?" "You don't think his taste is very good...... Usually, when men choose women's clothes, they don't seem to have any aesthetic taste.
You haven't had any other men pick out clothes for you; you just have that kind of stereotype.
Tenna tilted his head, his voice growing deeper, the corners of his mouth cracking. He didn't look very happy, and you only felt that that smile carried a threatening tone: "Me?" Of course I have great taste. I used to organize beauty pageants—and even beauty shows, which were game segments. "He was a bit annoyed, always feeling like you were underestimating him.
"Do you really think I'd deliberately pick out ugly clothes for you? Then don't worry, of course I'll pick clothes that I don't think are great." He snorted coldly as he spoke. Of course, he wasn't trying to pick out ugly clothes for you—after all, standing in front of him dressed beautifully, he was in a good mood too.
But you just breathed a sigh of relief, patted your chest, and gave a genuine smile: "That's good, that's good. Then come with me, I just happen to want to change some clothes too." ”
But for some reason, even though Tenna was still smiling, you couldn't help but feel he seemed even more annoyed, or maybe maybe a bit dissatisfied...... You felt like you hadn't really offended him anywhere. Anyway, no matter how hard you thought about it, you didn't know why, so you just took Tenna to the women's clothing store.
Then you waved your hand and pretentiously said, "Go ahead, my servant, bring your master some pretty clothes." ”
“…… Oh. His voice was dry as he walked toward the clothes rack nearby, while you sat in your seat, casually swinging your legs, staring blankly at Tenna while waiting for him to pick out a few outfits for you.
But before you could fully regain your composure, Tenna came over carrying several sets of clothes and threw them over your head, completely covering you.
You were stunned for a moment, and now it was your turn to be furious: "What are you doing, tenna! Today I'm your master—how dare you treat me like this?" ”
As you spoke, you anxiously tried to take off the clothes on top of your head, but Tenna's voice was just lazy, with a hint of a smile on his face. But...... Many flowers instinctively popped out of his nose, and Tenna frowned to cover them, turning the screen black again: "Well, sorry, my master." ”
You angrily took the clothes down, glanced at the labels, and found that they all fit your size perfectly. Plus, these clothes looked pretty good, so in the end, you didn't get angry with Tenna. Instead, you glared at him fiercely. Tenna's screen lit up, and he still gave you that arrogant grin. You couldn't help but feel annoyed, pouted, and walked toward the fitting room.
You start trying on your first outfit. For some reason, it seems to be Gothic: a leather jacket on top, a dress with lace embellishments on the bottom, and a small jacket on top. You put on this outfit and look down at yourself, feeling pretty good. There's still no life-length mirror in the fitting room, so you have to step outside and take a look at it. At the same time, show Tenna that you're quite satisfied with the clothes he picked—at least not just bright red with bright green. Bright yellow paired with bright purple—that deadly combination. So you excitedly say to Tenna, "You have great taste! I really like this outfit!" ”
Tenna's screen instinctively wanted to light up again, clusters of flowers popping up from his nose, but he held back and didn't do so. In his eyes, his screen inexplicably closed again, and then you heard his cold, cold voice: "Average, I don't think it's that great." ”
But then he turned to the cashier and said, "How many Dark Coins is this outfit?" I'll pay for it. ”
The cashier quoted the price, and Tenna directly took out a dark coin and handed it to the cashier. You paused for a moment, raised your eyebrows at him, and said in a slightly mischievous voice, "Didn't you say you thought it wasn't great? Why did you buy it again? Are you planning to wear it?" ”
Of course, Tenna wouldn't tell you. He genuinely thought this outfit looked great on you. Your skin was fair, and paired with the black outfit, it actually made you stand out even more. His voice was just stiff: "Didn't you think it was nice? I'll buy it for you. After all, today I'm your servant." His voice also carried a hint of stiffness.
You glanced at him hesitantly, then simply went back into the fitting room. You picked up a nearby blue-and-white dress and started trying it on. It was a slip dress with a small shawl on top, probably because you were afraid of catching a chill. In any case, you put on the dress, but the zipper was a bit tight for you, and no matter how hard you tried, you wouldn't pull it off. In the end, you had to open a small gap in the fitting room, looked at Tenna, and whispered, "My servant, it's your turn to do your thing. Come help me zip up." ”
Tenna did as instructed and went over to zip your back. He was a bit annoyed, so he grabbed the shawl nearby and covered your shoulders tightly. Actually, these two pieces weren't a set; they were just similar in color. He brought them just to drape them over your shoulders, not wanting anyone else to see such a beautiful scene.
His voice was also very low: "How long are you going to keep playing this chuunibyou game?" "Yesterday he watched and saw you studying some kind of chuunibyou book. Today, your tone will be like this."
You chuckled twice: "Don't you think this is fun?" Then Tenna just stared at you with the screen pitch black, probably really not finding it fun...... You could only purse your lips.
"Alright, I'm not playing anymore, okay? So, what do you think of this outfit?" As you spoke, you spun around in front of the life-sized mirror twice. You really liked this light-colored outfit, much more than the one you just wore before.
Tenna just turned on the screen, the corners of his mouth flat. He glanced at you, then said in a flat tone, "This one is just average. I don't think there's anything particularly eye-catching, but it's fine on you." ”
You pouted, walked over and tugged at Tenna's antenna. For some reason, he naturally lowered his head and pulled it for you: "Can't you praise me a bit?" I think this outfit looks really nice. ”
It was beautiful, Tenna thought to herself. He didn't want you to go out and let others see it, of course...... He couldn't say such thoughts out loud, because he knew you probably wouldn't agree either. Why would he say it out loud? He could only let that jealousy, that somewhat despicable emotion fill his chest.
"Hmm, barely enough. I think it's okay." He just added this sentence, then turned to ask the cashier how much it was, and took out the dark coins to pay.
You blink, feeling a bit strange—didn't he say he didn't like it? Judging by how eagerly he was to settle the bill for you, it actually seemed like he really liked it.
Next, you tried on a few more dresses he picked, repeating the same process. You started to get a bit tired of listening, so you waved your hand to interrupt Tenna, who was about to speak: "Alright, I know you're going to say this outfit is just average. You better stop commenting...... Do you know that makes me sad to say that?" "I do feel a bit disappointed, but not to the point of being especially sad. You're just a little unhappy, a little bit of ...... That's all, and you're not really sure."
Tenna stopped talking, and his screen went dark again. Your words echoed in his mind, and he began to reflect...... Isn't this a bit too much for you? He clearly wants you to be a little happier these days, so that when he turns the tables and becomes your master in the upcoming bet, you won't feel so sad. He really is seriously reflecting on himself. Then, when you put on your old clothes and walk out of the fitting room, you see Tenna tilting her head, seemingly a bit awkward, and say to you, "Just now...... Just think I was just saying something offhand. Actually, when you put on those clothes, you look really beautiful. ”
He liked it very much, but...... Tenna wasn't used to directly expressing these few words of affection; it was probably a habit he had left over from before. He didn't know what to do, so he could only act cruel, even more cruelly...... At least that way, no one would disobey his orders. He didn't seem used to getting along with others as equals.
You paused, watching Tenna lower her head after saying that, looking quite embarrassed...... Or maybe he just didn't want you to see his expression. At that moment, the expression on his screen was unpredictable, and at this moment...... He didn't know what expression to use toward him.
And you just smiled, stood on tiptoe, and patted the TV's head: "Alright, I know you didn't mean to...... After all, you just paid to buy those clothes for me. But I still hope that in the future, you can be honest with me, okay? Otherwise, I'll really feel sad. I'm not used to guessing what others mean by it. ”
TBC.

title: Gambler 10 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna didn't answer you. You saw him just staring at the screen and turning the head of the TV away. You didn't know what he meant—was he unhappy or something...... But he was still holding a few pieces of clothing in his arms, picked out by him for you to try on. Your eyes darted around, and you took the clothes from his hands first: "Alright, I'll go try on these outfits first." With that, you closed the fitting room door and walked back in. After you entered, Tenna turned the screen back, lit up, and stared expressionlessly at the fitting room. Clusters of fresh flowers started popping up from his nose again. Tenna frowned and snuffed out all the flowers.
He really wasn't used to being honest, or maybe ...... Honestly, he actually lost some of his intimidating power. And he felt that his honesty probably wasn't very pleasant to hear. But since you want to hear it...... Tenna decided to give it a short try, just during this short period inside the ready-made clothing store.
You changed into another outfit and came out. This one had a long trailing tail, which was really inconvenient. I don't know how Tenna chose it. The outfit had a bit of a Baroque style. You put on a hat on your head and put on a shawl. This was a long skirt with a blue base accented with pink and white. Fortunately, at least you didn't have to ask Tenna to zip it up.
You hesitated for a moment before finally pushing open the fitting room door and stepping out, one hand still holding a long trailing tail. You glanced at it in front of the full-length mirror and seemed quite satisfied. Then you turned around and saw Tenna standing there, arms crossed, waiting for you. His screen was lit, and the corners of his mouth were flat. You blinked, spun around the tail in front of him, and asked, "How about this outfit?" "If you ask me, how did you end up choosing this outfit? It's not convenient at all......" You couldn't help but complain again.
Tenna frowned and admired your spinning movements. It was indeed beautiful, but also quite inconvenient. He nodded, his voice still stiff, this time tinged with a bit of stiffness. He realized he still didn't like to speak directly, so when he spoke, he instinctively took a beat: "Indeed, this outfit looks barely manageable, and it's really inconvenient—too much trouble." ”
…… He actually meant that you could just wear it for him to see, so you wouldn't have to go out anyway, so it didn't matter what happened. But when the words came out, the tone changed: "This outfit is just for wearing when you're not going out." ”
After saying this, he fell silent, just turned his head away to stop looking at you. He really hadn't paid for the outfit. You pursed your lips. Although you were used to it now, you still felt sad when you heard that...... You deliberately sighed loudly, as if talking to yourself, but Tenna heard it clearly: "Alright, I knew this outfit was inconvenient and not good...... I'll just change into another outfit." After saying that, you glanced at Tenna out of the corner of your eye, but he still didn't react. You didn't expect any reaction from him now, just sighed as he walked into the fitting room.
Once you walked in, Tenna stiffly turned her head and told the cashier she had paid for the same set she had just made. The cashier glanced at Tenna speechlessly: "Aren't you going to comfort your girlfriend?" She looked very upset. ”
For some reason, whenever Tenna heard the word 'girlfriend,' he couldn't help but feel his heart racing...... That mechanical heart seemed to be beating rapidly again. Even though nothing particularly excited him, Tenna couldn't figure it out. He just let out a muffled 'oh', and the cashier couldn't figure out what he meant. In the end, he just glanced at him speechlessly and continued calculating the ledger.
And you stayed in the fitting room without coming out for a while. Tenna's antenna involuntarily drooped, and he was indeed a bit nervous—could it be that you were hiding inside and secretly crying? But he couldn't hear anything, only the rustling sound of changing clothes. Or were you angry? So he didn't want to come out for a while—did you hate him? Would you drive him away? In the end, this thought took over his mind. He really didn't want you to drive him away—not just because once he left, he would have nowhere to go, nor just because he wanted to be your master. What else? What other reason? He racked his brains for a while, but in the end, he came up with one answer: in short, he wants to stay by your side, and he hopes you will stay by his side. As for why...... It seems unreasonable; he can't figure it out.
Maybe it's because your smile is so charming, because you're so resilient, and that spirit moves him. He unconsciously wants to accompany you to the end, maybe it's because your gaze is gentle, as if you can embrace everything, or maybe it's because your words are soft and pleasant, making him want to hear a few more words—it's fine to hear you say it for a lifetime. Maybe...... Tenna made up a thousand reasons for himself, probably just to find one reason that would give him more courage to knock on the fitting room door and talk to you. His hand rested on the fitting room door. He hesitated for a moment, then put his hand down and then picked it up again. He hesitated for a long time without knocking on the door, but the fitting room opened its door from inside. Tenna was stunned for a moment, hurriedly withdrew his hand, and looked at you, still stammering, his mouth opening and closing for a long time without making a sound. He had to admit he really liked this outfit...... And he had a little idea in mind, choosing colors and patterns similar to his outfit.
This time, you also changed into a yukata and haori jacket. This somewhat unusual outfit was prepared by Tenna. You had just been fiddling with the fitting room for a long time, hoping this outfit would look better...... Well, but you didn't come out earlier because you were trying out clothes inside. Most of the clothes were sports tops and wide-leg pants, which made it easier for you to move. In any case, you didn't have to worry about how good they looked, so you didn't wear them for Tenna and just changed into the next outfit on your own.
At that moment, you saw Tenna standing right at the doorway of the fitting room, almost right up to you...... You struggled to lift your head and look at him. Honestly, from this angle, you could only see his chin, so you quietly asked, "Tenna, what's wrong?" "By the way, you picked out this outfit too, right? Does it look good?" As you spoke, you slightly pulled your shoulders together. You couldn't shake the feeling that Tenna seemed a bit uneasy, to the point that you felt a bit uneasy.
Tenna instinctively closed his screen. He didn't want you to notice his emotions, so he just anxiously lowered his head to look at you. He could feel that he was in high spirit at that moment, and if he ignored it, his nose would bloom with flowers again. He didn't want you to see this scene, so after quickly sizing you up a couple of times, he tilted his head and stammered, "This outfit...... This one looks great." He really liked it...... But at this moment, he was actually too embarrassed to say something like that, or rather...... He felt that this sentence shouldn't be said out loud, at least for now.
You paused for a moment, clearly not expecting Tenna's words to be so blunt this time. So you squinted and smiled excitedly and sincerely, "Right? I knew this outfit looked great, and I really like it!" Then you turned to the cashier and asked if she could wear the outfit with her. The cashier said of course you can.
"Then I'll wear this outfit and it's comfortable...... It suits me well." So you turned your head, muttering to yourself, and instinctively grabbed Tenna's sleeve—at that moment, he was wearing that strange yukata and haori together.
Tenna cleared her throat twice, carrying the large bags the cashier had packed with clothes. He didn't turn to look at you, just walked out on his own. You and the cashier settled the clothes you picked out and put them in bags, then you caught up with Tenna and stuffed the bag into his hands. You were a bit puzzled. You looked up at Tenna, but all you could see was the TV's chin and the pitch-black screen. You couldn't help but ask him, "You haven't looked at me since just now. What's wrong with you?" ”
His voice was just dry: "It's nothing." "It seemed like he really didn't want to respond to you...... But in fact, he just didn't know how to respond. He didn't dare look at you, afraid that if he looked at you, the screen would light up and his nose would start to fall like flowers. However, when he saw your smile just now, he also felt genuine joy, and all the tangled emotions and sadness he had before vanished completely. Suddenly, Tenna understood something; he seemed to ...... wanted you to feel happiness.
But he wasn't sure what to do, so he could only stay like this now, saying nothing. After all, you used to ...... He didn't seem to like the way he spoke.
You heard that, looked at his reaction, and pouted. It seemed Tenna didn't really want to hear you either...... So you didn't have to ask for trouble, so you closed your mouth and walked home with Tenna. He deliberately slowed his pace a bit, so keeping up with him wasn't a problem at all.
And this awkward silence floated between the two of you, and for a moment, neither of you had any intention of breaking it.
Even though Tenna's screen was dark, he couldn't help but bend his antenna, glancing at you with his refracting peripheral eye. He saw the corners of his mouth curve downward, clearly not very happy...... He racked his brains about what to say to break the deadlock, and finally remembered what the cashier had just said. Even though you weren't boyfriend or girlfriend—he thought, he really did want to apologize to you. After all, those were probably the things that made you unhappy.
So after a while, it was Tenna who took the initiative to break the deadlock. His voice still carried a hint of shyness, and the volume wasn't very loud. He stammered and awkwardly said, "Um...... Earlier, I'm sorry." It was as if saying that sentence had drained all his strength.
You looked up at him in surprise, but all you could see was the pitch-black screen. For some reason, the antenna that had been standing upright just moments ago drooped, and he didn't seem to be in a good mood.
You just shook your head: "I'm not angry. Are you talking about what happened in the fitting room earlier?" ”
