His voice was still a bit stammering, not loud: "I don't see you as something I can take whatever I want...... You, you are very important to me." He seemed too shy to speak, hesitating for a while before quietly finishing his words. If it weren't so quiet here, you might have missed what he was saying.
“…… Yeah, I know, but you idiot, do you know the summer festival has to come back tonight?" You stood on tiptoe and tapped the now pitch-black TV screen again. You don't need to look at his expression anymore. Anyway, you know it's going to be another mess, and you know he probably feels too shy to show you a screen full of flowers.
His body stiffened for a moment, and only then did Tenna realize. Although he had arranged everything necessary for the summer festival...... He seemed to have gotten the timing wrong. He was so happy this morning that after winning the bet, he took you out.
“…… I understand." He seemed a bit gritted and a bit gloomy, probably because this wasn't a complete surprise—he still failed. Tenna was a bit dissatisfied.
But you just tugged at his hand: "It's okay, then we can spend the whole day playing here...... Don't just stand here, come with me." ”
He turned around, this time you walked ahead, while he followed behind, holding your hand. His screen lit up, and as he watched your back, the corners of his mouth lifted slightly, but in the end, he pulled it away—after all, it was a smile that looked silly to him.
You looked at the steaming snack stall and picked up a box of mung bean cakes and soybean cakes. You knew Tenna had prepared them all just for you, so it was fine. You picked up a fork and took a bite. It wasn't too sweet or cloying, nor too sticky...... You didn't know how this texture was made—this mung bean cake was cool and refreshing, and that piece still carried warmth...... In short, you really liked it. You switched to a fork, picked up a piece of mung bean cake, and tilted your head up to hand it to Tenna: "Do you want to try some?" But since you set this up here, you must have tasted it before, right......" You muttered to yourself, while Tenna just lowered her head. Although his face was still cold, he bit down on the small piece of mung bean cake. He swallowed the small piece of mung bean cake in no time after chewing it.
But he just mumbled in a muffled voice, "This is different." "After all, you handed him this mung bean cake...... Of course, the meaning behind eating it was different from what he ate himself.
You paused for a moment, but honestly...... You still felt a bit unaccustomed, but hurriedly chuckled twice: "Why are you eating it with me?" You can take it yourself. "With that, you hurriedly grabbed another piece of sticky candy and tossed it into your mouth.
Tenna was momentarily stunned. The once light heart finally settled back down. He just gave a soft "mm," his voice a bit muffled. You simply walked toward the stall ahead, pulled Tenna along, and said enthusiastically, "Ah, steaming hot takoyaki—it should taste pretty good, right?" You excitedly picked up a box of takoyaki, then also handed it to Tenna. You naturally let go, squinting slightly as you tasted the takoyaki. Tenna held the small box of takoyaki, his fingers twitching. He felt a bit disappointed that you let go, but...... He didn't dare to grab it again, because you were busy eating takoyaki.
Walking further ahead, you actually see a shadow puppet show—even though no one is behind it, the shadows on this small stage are still dancing. You stop while eating takoyaki, watching the play with great interest—yes, this is a classic Momiji Hunt performance. You remember most kabuki performances are there, but you didn't expect there to be shadow puppetry.
"This is so ingenious—how did you do it?" After finishing your takoyaki, you tossed the empty box into the nearby trash bin, then tugged at Tenna's sleeve.
"This ...... It's a timed mechanism, but I'm not sure about its exact operating principle. "Tenna shook her head. After all, he always delegated the specific mechanisms to his subordinates, and they seemed quite happy anyway.
He hadn't eaten many takoyaki; he had already tasted it, had already eaten it. He just reached out again to gently hold your hand, and you didn't let go, just walked forward on your own.
You saw the stall selling pindou...... You saw you and Tenna on the display stand. You paused, your eyes lowered, your heart racing and a bit restless. You roughly understood what Tenna meant.
…… But you won't forgive him so easily. After all, you've truly been hurt.
You are just ...... It's just that, after seeing all this, you can't control your emotions and have confirmed some things. Maybe you just want to be sure that he truly cares about you.
You found a chair in front of the bean pinning stall and sat down, casually asking tenna, "Can I play with whatever things at the stall?" "Even so, you didn't hold back and directly picked up the bean mixing materials you needed."
Tenna softly responded with a soft 'mm,' watching your movements, and simply thrust a piece of takoyaki to your lips. You paused for a moment, knowing it was Tenna. You looked up at him: "Why are you eating by yourself? Why feed me......"
But Tenna just silently held up the takoyaki. From his pitch-black screen, you couldn't see any expression—just his drooping antenna, looking a bit pitiful. After a moment of silence, you bit into the takoyaki, hurriedly turned his slightly flushed cheeks, and said nothing.
Tenna quietly breathed a sigh of relief in her heart. Since you were willing to accept it, it meant he had taken it further. He just kept trying, handing you another pill to your lips. You didn't look up at him again, nor said anything more. You just ate the takoyaki he fed you, continuing to make the bean platter. When you were done and finished eating the takoyaki, he threw away the empty box, only to see you holding something to show him.
This is the bean pine you just finished—you modeled it after Tenna's image today, and the way you remember his nose with a flower, you sculpted a tiny pixel bean shape for him.
"Why do you like this look that looks so silly?" Tenna's screen lit up again, and he spoke bluntly.
You just shook your head: "Not at all, it's obviously cute." "As you spoke, you burst out laughing again."
Tenna really wanted to argue with you, but you just laughed happily. He felt seeing your smile was more important, so in the end, he didn't say much.
If you're a little dumb, then be a little silly...... As long as you're happy, that's all that matters. He watched as you carefully tied the freshly finished bean-piecing hole onto the strap, then grabbed a goldfish pouch from next door and tied it around your waist.
Then you curiously look at the various masks on the stall. You pick up a bird-beak mask, stand on tiptoe, and gesture in front of the pitch-black screen. Unfortunately, given his head size, it definitely can't fit, but that doesn't stop you from gritting and holding the tiger mask and fox mask in front of his screen.
Tenna was a bit at her limit, but seeing you smile, he just stared at the screen in the darkest and said nothing.
Until you finally pick up a Samoyed mask, hold it up, and hang it crookedly on his antenna. You take two steps back to admire it, applauding and nodding in satisfaction.
Tenna also saw through the nearby mirror that this Samoyed was grinning foolishly—truly foolish. He couldn't help but retort, "Why did you choose this mask for me?" This one is just too dumb, ugly too. ”
"So cute, just the opposite color to yours...... Hmm, this one looks great, I want to wear this. "You said this was just talking to yourself, wearing a fox mask crookedly.
“…… Why not choose the wolf's mask over there? "Tenna pointed and felt that mask was fierce and scary enough, suitable for him.
You tugged at the fox's mask and put it on the head, gestured in front of the mirror to see it look better. Then you looked at the Samoyed mask hanging from the antenna, smiling foolishly, and Tenna, who was scowling at you, burst out laughing: "But it suits you perfectly! Who told you to barely smile...... "It's a little prank to get back at him!"
TBC.

title: Gambler 17 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna was silent for a while, but in the end didn't take any other masks. He just straightened his face coldly and adjusted the angle of the silly, silly, grinning Samoyed mask in front of the mirror. He thought this thing was just too silly—he didn't like it at all. But looking at the curve of your smile, Tenna felt his mechanical heart was growing faster as your smile deepened. So, he simply kept it that way, and he felt that this was actually pretty acceptable.
Anyway, you don't care what Tenna is thinking...... You only care about your own mood. His mood is of no concern to you today, since he needs to apologize to you for what he did wrong, so doing anything is never too much. You just pulled Tenna forward and walked on. You arrived at a goldfish fishing stall and saw little goldfish swimming around, red, black, and white. Eaggerant, you grabbed a paper net—you had never tried catching a goldfish before, so you excitedly went down to the net. Unfortunately, the net was thin and the area where you fell was a bit deep. Although you caught a goldfish, it quickly broke, and the fish fell through the cracks.
You looked gloomily at the paper net, then at the small pool, and you couldn't help but feel...... This activity is just too difficult. Before, Tenna had been standing beside you, watching. Now he swallowed hard and quietly stood behind you. His figure enveloped you, and his right hand grabbed yours. You heard his deep, somewhat hoarse voice above your head: "Let me teach you." ”
He only said this short sentence, and you swallowed nervously, feeling a bit nervous. Besides, being so close always makes you a little embarrassed. Luckily, Tenna was standing behind you, so he couldn't see the blush on your face.
You also relaxed your right hand, ready to see what Tenna was doing. He grabbed a paper net and quickly skimmed through the shallow water. The net was wet but not broken, while the red and black goldfish swimming on the surface were jumping violently inside the CNKI.
You widened your eyes, and just as Tenna was about to pull her hand back, you grabbed his sleeve: "So, Tenna, do you know how to fish out those deeper goldfish?" "You eagerly planned to try it yourself, since it wasn't really the goldfish you just caught."
Tenna was silent for a moment. Although he had practiced catching goldfish for a long time, he never tried to catch those at the lower bottom. After all, paper nets break easily, and he thought that as long as he could show off his skills and catch goldfish, he would be satisfied...... But he would never admit it to you. He wouldn't say he couldn't. Tenna silently picked up another paper net. This time, he stopped moving, then stared at the pool for a moment, and finally quickly caught a white goldfish from the bottom. He silently breathed a sigh of relief, thinking to himself that he had done it; otherwise, he would have had to figure out how to explain it.
You naturally clapped your hands too: "That's amazing, tenna! I want to try it too." Hearing your words, Tenna couldn't help but lift her head. Although his face was still expressionless, the pile of flowers popping out of his nose revealed his mood. He had wanted to turn off the screen, but remembering what you said, his body remained stiff and he didn't move again. You looked at the reflection on the water, seeing Tenna, though his face was cold and he was crossing his arms, flowers still appeared at the tip of his nose, petals kept falling down, some even landing on the water, stirring faint ripples. You couldn't help but smile faintly, and suddenly you found him quite amusing like this...... No, actually, Tenna herself was quite amusing.
Although you might be a bit foolish—it doesn't matter. You know he cares about you, and just knowing that is enough. You pick up another paper net, imitating Tenna's movements, holding your breath and focusing intently as you wait for the goldfish above the water to settle down a bit. Then you drop the paper net—this time you successfully catch a black goldfish. Happily, you put that goldfish together with the ones Tenna had just caught in a plastic bag, then switch to another paper net, focus intently on the water surface, and drop the net again—unfortunately, this time you didn't catch any goldfish in the depths, and the net broke.
You feel a bit discouraged and sigh, saying, "Still not successful...... Tenna, can you demonstrate again? "Of course, saying things like that doesn't mean anything else at all.
Tenna was silent for a moment, then nodded to himself. You saw his agreement through the reflection on the water's surface, then you automatically stepped aside. Tenna picked up another paper net, closed the screen, and stared at the ripples on the water's surface before being caught again—this time his paper net was also torn, completely empty. You heard his stiff voice: "It was an accident. I'll try again." ”
As he spoke, he picked up another paper net, but this time his movements were a bit impatient. He just dropped straight in and tried to retrieve the goldfish from the bottom. This time, the net broke halfway through the surface, and the goldfish scattered in all directions. Tenna's movements grew even more anxious. He kept picking up the paper nets to try them one after another, but the result was the same—not a single goldfish was caught. He wanted to pick up the paper net again, but this time you gently held his hand: "Alright, looking at it this way, there's nothing fun about this project...... Well, let's go to the front. I think that shooting game looks pretty interesting." Although you really wanted to laugh, you held back your laughter, though a hint of amusement still unconsciously appeared in your eyes. Of course, Tenna saw it too, and couldn't help but feel even more annoyed—he knew you probably thought it was funny how funny he had tried so many times and still failed, but he didn't know what to do; he had never practiced this before.
He just walked behind you with the screen pitch black. You walked forward on your own, picked up the toy gun and thought about it, then looked at the countless water balloons hanging on the wall. You'd never played this kind of game before, just squinted and started aiming—well, you have to see how many you can actually hit!
The toy gun fires ten rounds per round, but unfortunately, you can't handle it because you don't know how this toy gun was modified...... You think the recoil is so strong that in the end you only hit three water balls.
“…… Looks like this is the only way. Tenna, do you want to give it a try?" "It's a bit of a shame you put down this toy gun." Tenna said nothing, just handed you a piece of paper. You glanced at it—it was the prize rules for this stall.
Hit a water balloon and receive a TV character character as a bonus.
Hit two water balloons to receive a TV character charm.
Hit three water balloons and receive a photo personally signed by Tenna.
Hit four water balloons to receive a scaled-down Tenna standee.
Hit five water balloons to receive a Tenna-themed phone lanyard + charm.
Hit six water balls to receive a large version of the Tenna standee.
Hit seven water balloons and receive a square pillow printed with Tenna's image as a gift.
Hit eight water balloons to receive a miniature Tenna doll.
Hit nine water balls to receive a life-size Tenna standee.
Hit ten water balloons to receive a life-size Tenna doll.
You silently look at the prize list. At first, the two were just pretending, but later they stopped pretending. Anyway, it's just something with Tenna's character. No wonder he doesn't plan to reject it...... Anyway, it's an event he planned, and the prizes he designed. These are the prizes and stuff...... Hmm, but he probably really wants you to hit ten of them, right?
While you were thinking, tenna handed you a photo. You glanced at it and indeed, it was tenna’s signature, Mr.Anton Tenna, with some ink still not dried. Moreover, it’s unknown when the photo was taken; anyway, he was still wearing that dark blue outfit and had the appearance of being very serious and solemn. You put the photo away, looked at the blacked-out screen of tenna, and deliberately said, “Ah… it seems there’s nothing much fun left, let’s head back first. I originally thought we could have played all day…” Your tone carried a bit of regret. Then you turned and walked back the way you came, wanting to see how tenna would react. As expected, he grabbed your wrist. You turned around to look at him in puzzlement; his antenna drooped and then straightened again, but the screen was still completely black.
You tilt your head in confusion and ask, "What's wrong, tenna? It's just about to be lunchtime...... Let's go home first. ”
Tenna paused, his screen lit up again, the corners of his mouth still downward: "Oh, there's a cooking stall over here. I'll take you there." He said stiffly, then without giving you a chance to explain, grabbed your hand and led you in a certain direction. You didn't say going home anymore, because you were indeed a bit curious about what the stall Tenna was talking about.
This was the only stall that looked a bit deserted...... After all, the stall was filled with noodles, probably not cooked yet. You found a chair and sat down, curiously watching Tenna expressionlessly crawl to the back of the stall, then skillfully grabbed a handful of noodles and put them in the pot. I didn't know what he had added, but you sniffed and found it smelly. Before long, a miso ramen dish was ready, covered with a thin layer of beef. You took a bite and closed your eyes in enjoyment. Honestly, the taste of this ramen was just amazing...... It's not hard to bite but not too mushy either. Although you usually don't like noodles, you still think this bowl tastes amazing, so you can't help but take a few more bites. Before you know it, you've finished the whole night's ramen, and you can't help but burp with satisfaction.
Tenna crossed his arms and looked at you. He simply cooked himself a bowl of udon noodles and ate it. Watching you eat ramen with full concentration, he felt incredibly happy at that moment—if only time could have stayed here and now, at least...... At least he wouldn't have to worry about making mistakes in the future, or about the future—he just needed to enjoy the moment.
Unfortunately, ramen always comes to an end, and these brief yet happy moments also have their end. Tenna watched you squinting slightly in your chair enjoying yourself, and Chao Jue casually asked, "I think your pistol skills still need improvement. How about I take you to play again?" He never mentioned that he wanted you to break more water balloons, so he could just hand you all the prizes he had prepared.
You blinked. You guessed Tenna wanted you to win more prizes, but since he didn't say anything, you wouldn't go out of your way to remind him. You just nodded thoughtfully, frowning slightly: "Isn't this too much trouble for you?" ”
Tenna just kept a cold face as he walked out of the stall, grabbed your hand, and led you toward the other side of the water polo. You couldn't see his expression clearly, only his icy voice: "No, and you know how to use a toy gun. In the future, you'll be able to protect yourself with real ammunition." ”
You don't know why he's crying. Suddenly thinking of this, you can't really answer him, just quietly say thank you behind him.
Thank you, Tenna, for caring about you, for being willing to spend time with you, for being willing to play with you, thank you...... Thank you, for hoping you can protect yourself, even though you don't think he needs to worry so much.
Tenna just pretended not to hear, and luckily you couldn't see his reddened screen at that moment. He led you back to the front of the stall, then circled behind you, grabbed your hand, picked up the toy gun, and aimed it at the water ball not far away.
Then he pulled the trigger and started shooting. Most of the recoil was borne by Tenna, while you simply followed along and pulled the trigger. In no time, all ten bullets were fired, neatly breaking ten water balls. Then Tenna let go of your hand and cleared his throat twice: "Mm, done." ”
You look at your own hand, then at that toy gun, and still find it hard to believe—it actually broke ten water balls. It seems Tenna's former identity was probably quite ordinary...... But that thought only flashed through your mind for a second before being erased. After all, what was he like in the past and what did it have to do with you? You only cared about what he was like now.
So you turn around, open your hands to Tenna, and ask him for a gift: "Alright, now that I've broken ten water balls, what about my reward?" "Although those were all broken by Tenna grabbing your hand—that doesn't stop you from asking him for gifts, since the list of prizes is clearly written. I guess Tenna also hopes you can win these."
TBC.

title: Gambler 18 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna's screen lit up again. He lowered his head to look at you, his lips flat, face expressionless. You found it a bit odd and couldn't help but wave your hand at him again: "So where's my reward?" Where is it? ”
Then Tenna pointed at herself and asked in a low voice, "Isn't having me enough?" ”
You paused, watched him react for a moment, then soothing you, your face turned completely red, and your voice became stammered: "What do you mean? Are you trying to deny the other rewards and not give them to me?" "Although those rewards just look like all sorts of Tenna merchandise...... Compared to Tenna himself, it seems like he himself is a bit more important.
"But the reward for breaking ten water balls in a row says the Tenna doll is me." He said dryly, as if reciting some lines. To be honest, this project wasn't something he had prepared; it was his pippins who told him to do this kind of romantic thing—although he didn't fully believe it, he had indeed followed these subordinates' tricks at the goldfish fishing spot before, getting closer to you by following his superiors' tricks, so now he still planned to give it a try.
After saying that, he turned off the screen and tilted his head back. He didn't want you to see his expression. You were momentarily stunned but didn't force him to turn on the screen. You just stood on tiptoe and tugged at the mask on top of his head, blocking his face. That made it look much better. The final prize was actually his own or something...... Think about it, this was probably his little surprise. Although you don't know how he came up with such a cheesy idea now, which was completely different from his usual style. You looked at him suspiciously, but in the end didn't ask much, just stood on tiptoe slightly and carefully hugged him. Your voice was muffled. You didn't want Tenna to find out that you cried again: "Alright, I understand...... Having you is enough." "Your voice is also very low.
Tenna's body stiffened when he realized your movement, then a burst of joy burst with joy. He realized you were embracing him, feeling the softness and warmth of your body, and his mechanical heart beat faster once more. His body stiffened slightly, then he also reached out and carefully hugged you.
"Me too...... Same thing." His voice was very soft. If it weren't for the silence at this moment, you wouldn't have heard him at all. You just let go of his embrace and gently pushed his arm away. Your face flushed a little, and you just turned your head and hurriedly pulled him forward.
"Alright, let's go play at the next stall. Feels like there's nothing fun here either." Your voice sounded a bit hurried, and Tenna, behind you, was also blushing with the screen. He felt the screen was getting hot, secretly cursing himself for being a bit foolish, but...... But his heart was still pounding violently. Undeniably, he genuinely felt happy about it, genuinely glad by your closeness, and he also genuinely felt a sense of happiness—just, just...... He never showed these feelings; it had been his long-held habit, and he shouldn't easily expose his emotions to others. So he simply turned off the screen and followed behind you, saying nothing.
You walk to the next booth, which is the ring toss area. The general rule is that whatever you put on your jacket wins that prize. You glance at what is on the ground, then fall silent. The front row is Tenna puzzle pendants in various poses, the second row is Tenna figurines with different expressions and movements, and the third row ...... is Tenna's pillows with different images, and the fourth row is Tenna dolls of different sizes.
You picked up the ring toss, hesitating about where to throw it, when you saw Tenna walk into the stall and stand in the only open space...... Well, you were still wondering what that piece should be, but now the answer is revealed: Tenna.
You look at him helplessly, while Tenna unexpectedly tilts her head up, opens the screen, and flashes that fierce, grinning grin. Your body trembles involuntarily as you look at the prizes. Honestly, you don't want anything, but in the end, you hesitantly toss a ring toss...... You hit Tenna's figurine.
You look at it and throw another ring toss, hitting the pendant in the first row. You don't even want to touch the items in the third and fourth rows—or rather, you did it on purpose. You simply just throw the ring toss and continue on the figurine in the second row, so you won't get any other items. You watch Tenna's face grow darker and darker. The screen that was lit up slowly dims. He must be gritting his teeth as he looks at you, while you deliberately turn your head away from looking at Tenna, just tossing the toss rings toward the first and second rows. When you only have one ring toss left, Tenna's screen goes completely black.
Seeing Tenna like this, you felt a bit guilty. Only then did you realize you had probably gone a bit too far, almost forgetting that today was actually Tenna's decision. But he didn't order you. You cleared your throat twice and casually tossed the ring toss forward. It didn't matter what it hit, and you didn't plan to look. You just heard footsteps, turned to look, and saw Tenna leaning over. The ring toss was a bit big, just bypassing his TV and landing on Tenna's shoulder. He just leaned down to meet your gaze, his tone calm: "Now I'm your prize." ”
You looked at him, pursed your lips, a bit flustered—to be honest, you never expected him to do this at first! You just hurriedly led him out from behind the stall and took the ring toss off his head. You didn't dare look back at him again, just let go and hurried forward, saying, "Alright, I get it. You're my prize." As you said this, you felt even more embarrassed and couldn't help but pat your burning face with your hand. You really started to wonder where Tenna had learned all this...... Or maybe he tried flirting with other Dark People? Thinking of this, the heat in your heart feels like it has been washed away by cold water. Once it cools down, you immediately calm down. You can't help but avoid thinking about it, but you also know now is not the time to ask about it.
You walked forward in silence, your figure no longer lively as before. Tenna didn't know what was wrong with you. He stepped forward, wanting to hold your hand, but you only slightly moved aside, avoiding his hand. Tenna instinctively felt a sense of loss—everything had been fine before, so why had you become like this now? He didn't understand.
Did you not like the earlier event? But you clearly had a great time, and you looked happy after it ended. You couldn't possibly be unhappy because you came here...... You had happily spent the whole morning here with him. He didn't know exactly why you were unhappy; after thinking it over, it could only be because of himself.
Could it be that ...... Don't you actually dislike what he does? Do you actually dislike him a lot, but just fail to show your pride and show it? At that moment, Tenna felt flustered. He urgently wanted to ask you, wanted to ask why you were upset. But before he could speak, he remembered what Mike had said to him. He told himself that if he noticed Y/N was unhappy, he should apologize first and reflect on himself, which was more effective than asking why she was unhappy. Because apologizing first puts you in the weaker position, and no matter what, the other side will feel much better. The latter ...... feels a bit of a lofty and confrontational question. Besides, Tenna won the bet today, so if he asks, you'll definitely speak...... However, your mood might get worse too. Maybe all his efforts will be wasted.
He carefully grabbed your sleeve, but you didn't let go, just tilted your head and sulkingly didn't look at him again. You knew it might just be your wild thoughts, but you couldn't stop your thoughts.
Tenna hesitated for a moment, then lowered her head and said dryly, "...... I'm sorry. ”
You were a bit surprised, not knowing why he suddenly acted like this. You just replied in a gloomy tone, "Ah, what's wrong? Why are you suddenly apologizing?" I never said you did anything wrong. ”
Tenna carefully reached his hand forward again. This time, he grabbed your hand, but you didn't break free. He let out a gentle sigh of relief, wrapping his big hand around your small hand and softly said, "Because...... Because you looked unhappy, I thought you'd like the prizes at those two stalls just now...... That's a routine my subordinate promised me girls would definitely like, but you don't seem to like it much, so I have to apologize to you." His voice was a bit stammered and stammered. It was the first time he had ever said such a long sentence, and also the first time he racked his brains trying to figure out how to apologize to someone else.
In the past, he would never have apologized—after all, he was the big boss of those people, so it didn't matter. Anger, rage, and irritability were his normal state. Even though he occasionally realized he was mistaken afterward, at most he'd just stiffly say sorry, and most of the time, he wouldn't even apologize.
But Tenna knew...... What he wanted was not for you to become his subordinate; he seemed to want you to be equal to him, to be happy, to be happy, to be able to laugh, to always be with you, to watch over your future, and for you to see his ...... The past no longer mattered; after all, he was no longer the lord of the TV world.
So his attitude toward you shouldn't be the same as his subordinates; he needs to be more careful and cautious. But perhaps it's precisely because he has feelings for you that he becomes so sensitive and suspicious, revealing a tone and expression he has never shown before. The moment Tenna spoke, she felt a sense of unfamiliarity; he kept feeling it wasn't like himself.
You paused, your wild thoughts stopping. You realized that Tenna was actually explaining what had happened before...... You originally thought he wouldn't say anything, and he probably wouldn't notice anything was wrong with your mood. You just need to finish this summer festival well today; nothing else is that important.
You sniffled, feeling like crying again, but you held it back and held it back, your voice muffled: "...... I didn't dislike the prizes from those earlier events, but no matter what, thank you. ”
Thank you for noticing your disappointment, thank you for being willing to explain for you, but...... It sounded like it was the first time he had apologized so solemnly.
Tenna was taken aback for a moment, then followed behind, adding another sentence. Her tone was stiff and a bit awkward, and she said very quickly, "Don't misunderstand, it's just that this summer festival is what you're looking forward to, so I asked those guys what girls like more." ”
He doesn't want you to discover his selfish intentions yet...... Well, it's okay if he finds out, but he will never admit it no matter what.
You nod gently: "Mm, I understand." ”
No matter what, all this just shows that he cares about you a lot. You know, so you sincerely feel a sense of happiness again.
The remaining stalls weren’t much different from the previous ones. You pulled tenna along to play for a while and got three or four prizes named tenna—well, the actual prizes of Mr.Anton Tenna himself. By the end, you began to wonder if there were any other prizes in these games, since even inside the claw machines, it was filled with all kinds of tenna dolls, and nothing else.
When you get tired from shopping, you grab Tenna and bring him to the same stall at noon to make you another bowl of ramen. Then you pull him down to sit at the end of the street, at the end of a cliff, chatting casually.
"I'm so happy today...... I really like this summer festival, tenna. "You really like this summer festival that belongs only to you, but you can't tell him. You also feel a flutter in his heart. You really like him.
