Looking at the omurice in front of you, even though Tenna said nothing, it seemed like he had said everything. You just smiled, stood up, picked up the ketchup, and drew a heart on his omurice.
Then you all sat down, almost as if in tacit agreement, not looking at each other anymore. You probably knew that when facing each other, you only had rosy cheeks, and you knew that when you looked at each other, you could only see rosy faces.
You enjoy your own heartfelt omurice. You don't even know when Tenna has become so familiar with your taste. This omurice is neither too salty nor too bland, and according to your taste, it's made with vegetable curry. There's not much spiciness, just a light flavor. On the side are slices of broccoli and potatoes, along with a piece of chicken cutlet, fried to a crisp and just the right amount of flavor.
You finished your dinner contentedly. Tenna carried the plates to the kitchen as usual to clean up, then took off the childish apron with a heart. He pulled you back to sit on the sofa. You still held hands and wouldn't let go. Your mind went blank, since you didn't know what to do next. You just sat on the sofa, lost in thought, and Tenna didn't know what to do either. He just held your hand tightly, refusing to let go, as if once he let go, everything that happened today was just a dream for him.
His thoughts were racing, never stopping for a moment. His mechanical heart was pounding, roughly ...... He was savoring what had happened that morning, enjoying your hand holding his, enjoying this unknowingly unknown love. But he knew that at least—even just a little—you cared about him. And precisely because of this, his heart was beating greedily, telling him he wanted more, needed more, more emotions to satisfy his desires and fill his heart. So Tenna couldn't help but turn back and sneak a glance at you. You seemed unaware of his gaze, just lost in thought. Tenna felt a bit delighted that you hadn't noticed, but then he felt a bit dissatisfied—he hoped you would notice him, that you could always see him.
Then he started to feel a bit down, his antenna drooping, and he began to suspect that you didn't love him as much as you claimed. After all, what you said yourself was unclear. He started to suspect that maybe you didn't care about him that much, just because he seemed to care, and you seemed to care in response to him too. He started to worry...... Maybe you say you love him, but your mind is unclear. Maybe you're thinking about someone else—he can't guarantee you're thinking only of him. But Tenna has to admit, no matter what, he always subconsciously thinks of you—every frown and smile, your red eyes and cold tears when you cry, your vivid words, your calls, your fair skin, the fireworks explosion of excitement and heartbeat when he hears you say 'love', and your sincere smile.
He couldn't help but squeeze your hand a little tighter. You frowned, instinctively a bit dissatisfied. He gripped a bit tightly, making your wrist hurt a little. But looking at his pitch-black screen and his drooping antenna, you didn't know why he was upset—you, well, actually worried Tenna might not care about you that much, but that thought quickly dispelled by yourself. After all, nothing can be fake on the day of the summer festival. He definitely cares about you, but you have no idea how much he cares.
You just ...... gently lifted up, leaned in to kiss his screen, and his screen became wet. You just lowered your head, a bit nervous, and said, "Um...... I, I ordered you to go to my room, lie down on my bed, and then ...... and sleep with me. ”
Tenna was stunned for a moment, then his screen lit up again. You seemed to see the corners of his mouth curl up in a quick smile. He seemed to smile, but soon after, his expression cooled again. He simply nodded calmly and then quickly walked toward your room.
After you washed up, you lay down on the bed. Of course, when you finished tidying up, you would find Tenna already lying there, arms crossed, his mouth curved downward, still wearing a sour expression. But flowers were blooming from the tip of his nose, drifting down one by one, leaving the bed covered with petals he had fallen.
You couldn't help but smile, climbed onto the bed, looked down at him, and tapped his nose: "Now the bed is covered in petals, how am I supposed to sleep?" ”
Tenna just let out a muffled 'oh', got up, and swept the petals that had fallen from the bed onto the floor. Then, his screen closed again, leaving only a pitch-black patch.
You lay helplessly beside him and whispered, "Turn on the screen. I actually quite like how you look—you're really cute." ”
You don't hear Tenna's answer, just ...... You see him turn the screen back on, his nose still blooming with large clusters of flowers, yet he remains expressionless.
You just grabbed his arm, gently nudged him into his embrace, and buried your head in his chest. You felt his body stiffen for a moment, then slowly relaxed, turned sideways, and hugged you tightly, pulling you into his embrace.
…… You're dreaming again, but this time, you didn't wake up scared. After all, in the dream, Tenna with all kinds of expressions surrounded you, saying they liked you as if hoping for your answer. But in the dream, you couldn't say a word.
Until you wake up from a deep sleep.
TBC.

title: Gambler 25 (dntx you)
content:
When you woke up, you were still in Tenna's arms. You were a bit dazed and instinctively rubbed your head against his chest. Before you could say anything, Tenna spoke first, his voice tinged with embarrassment: "I-I'll go make breakfast for you first." Then he pulled away from your side and walked straight out of your bedroom. You rubbed your eyes, finally fully awake. You got dressed, freshened up quickly, and sat down in the living room. You watched Tenna busy in the kitchen, and you could indeed smell the aroma of breakfast.
Hmm...... However, Tenna was still wearing that somewhat funny pink heart-shaped apron. Looking at that outfit, you couldn't help but chuckle twice, though Tenna probably didn't notice.
You gently close your eyes and breathe in the air—the toasted aroma of bread, the sweetness of scones, the mellow and bitter flavors of black tea and coffee, the oily saltiness of sausage and bacon...... Until a crisp sound of bowls and dishes hitting the table can be heard, and at the same time, you hear Tenna's voice—a hint of coldness mixed with a hint of caution: "Breakfast is ready. Shall you inspect it?" ”
So you open your eyes and see Tenna, with her lips curved just like usual, crossing her arms and looking at you, looking at you with a rather expressionless expression. Looking at the breakfast on the table, you pick up bread, sandwich some cheese, spread blueberry sauce on it, take a bite, squint slightly, give Tenna a thumbs up, and mumble, "Mm, it's delicious." ”
You see Tenna barely noticeable a smile at you, but then he just restrained his smile, leaving only clusters of flowers sticking out from his nose, petals falling onto the table.
Breakfast ended quickly. Tenna washed the dishes and tied up your hair. Today, he styled your hair into a relatively low twin ponytail, making you look more obedient. Tenna just sat across from you and proposed a new challenge. Today's wager was the Snake Snake, to see who could score the highest score inside.
Naturally, Tenna won—he's still very good at these little games, and you didn't say anything unconvincing, just waited for him to make a request. Tenna cleared his throat and first said, "Then I'll order you, say I love you, say I will love you forever." His voice carried a hint of anticipation, but his screen was off, and all you could see was his antenna shaking.
“…… I love you, I will love you forever," you blinked and repeated his words, then paused before adding, "I will love all of you." "You don't even know if this is sincere or just a lie; you just ...... You only know that Tenna likes hearing it, so you said it out loud.
Sure enough, he was very happy. You saw his screen light up again, and you saw flowers blooming from the tip of his nose, but the corners of his mouth remained—though they were upturned, he only showed an especially arrogant smile, exactly like those dolls in your room.
He came over and gently hugged you, burying his head in your shoulder. You always felt his screen seemed a bit damp, since your shoulder had become damp too. However, Tenna quickly let go, coughed dryly, and continued in a commanding tone: "Then come out shopping with me." ”
You nodded. Just then, you changed into your clothes for going out, so you got up and walked toward the door. But Tenna carefully reached out and held yours. You could feel his hand still a bit stiff, or rather, his body—after all, he looked so light, even a bit like his hands and feet. You glanced at him with concern, though your body was instinctively a bit stiff too, and you weren't used to these things. However, Tenna just gently squeezed your hand and whispered, "I'm afraid you'll get lost. After all, I'm more familiar with the Dark World." As he said this, his hand still tightly held you.
Honestly, he is indeed a bit nervous because he doesn't want you to let go of his hand. Even though you confess your love to each other, he still worries about it. Even though you express your feelings to each other...... He also doubts how important he is to your heart.
So you walked out the door in a somewhat stiff state, while Tenna couldn't help but turn his head to quietly look at you. You could feel his gaze—a bit hot, but hard to describe...... There seemed to be a hint of dampness, just staring straight at you. Maybe because you hadn't said anything, his actions were just more open, blatantly staring at you, as if he hadn't seen you at a moment, you'd disappear. And you couldn't help but turn your head and sneak a glance at Tenna as well. You met the screen he had turned to. You couldn't see his eyes, but you could feel his gaze fazed. He just quickly turned his head and said, "I'm afraid you'll get lost." ”
You couldn't help but smile, but you didn't say much, just softly responded with a hum.
You quickly arrived at a small commodity street, or rather, it looked kind of like a wholesale market...... Anyway, this was your first time seeing a place like this in the Dark World, and you couldn't help but take a few more looks. Hmm...... Tenna spontaneously introduced it to you: "Most of the market here sells daily necessities. Further inside, it's basically snacks, and further inside are the usual fresh produce." ”
You get it—actually, this market is a bit like a vegetable market. You have absolutely no experience when it comes to picking fresh vegetables, so you can only leave that to Tenna. But you still dove curiously into those daily necessities shops and stores. Tenna grabs your hand, afraid you'll get lost, or maybe he's just afraid you'll disappear from his sight.
…… He was just afraid of losing you—even if just briefly, losing your figure in sight was enough to make him hesitate and feel melancholy for a long time. You didn't let go of Tenna's hand, just let him hold your hand. Then you slipped into a shop selling all kinds of small accessories—mostly necklaces and bracelets, as well as all kinds of pendants and ornaments. Many of the ornaments were cute—like ceramic birds, bamboo groves, butterflies, and little hamsters. There was also a separate shelf with all kinds of music boxes, some shaped like gramophones, some piano-shaped, and some like dancers dancing to the music box's music...... There's also the old-fashioned TV style: flip the music box and adjust the buttons on the small TV, and it can switch between comic strips.
You have a great time, but when you see the price is completely unaffordable, you can only put your hand down regretfully and turn to those less expensive necklaces and bracelets.
Curious, you pick up a bracelet. It's blue-purple, probably imitating the color of the starry sky, with a tiny moon hanging underneath—it looks pretty nice, but then your attention is drawn to a string of rose-pink and reddish beads nearby. You place these two bracelets on your hand and gesture, but you can't get a definite answer. So you look at Tenna and look at him longingly: "Tenna, which one do you think looks better?" As you spoke, you held up the two bracelets in front of Tenna. Without hesitation, he chose the blue-purple one, since its color was closer to his.
So you happily settled the bill, put the bracelet on your wrist, and then showed off to Tenna a gesture, who just nodded expressionlessly.
You pulled Tenna around the tiny yet dazzling little shop, and finally you reached the sign with all kinds of letters. After hesitating for a moment, you picked up a pendant engraved with a 'T', then another with your initials, and handed it to Tenna, continuing to look at him eagerly. Tenna didn't say much, just pulled you to the counter to pay, then hung the pendant engraved with your initials next to the TV logo on your chest. You paused for a moment, watching Tenna's movements, and in the end, you just placed the small pendant together with the Tenna bean pine pendant you had made earlier.
Of course, you naturally have no idea. Tenna quietly checks out all those music boxes you made while you're not paying attention, then demands they be sent directly to your doorstep.
You just pulled Tenna forward, your hand naturally holding his, and Tenna just stared at your back. He said nothing, just quietly gazed at you, chewing over and over your name in his mind. He kept recalling your figure and your smile over and over. Just then, you turned back and smiled at him: "Um, I think this shop is pretty interesting. Want to go check it out together?" As you spoke, you pointed to the shop next to you.
Tenna also glanced in the direction you pointed. He noticed that this shop sold models of various weapons. He was momentarily stunned, but still nodded and walked into the shop with you.
You happily picked up a naginata nearby—when you watched movies and TV before, you thought these big, sweeping weapons looked really cool. Even though it's just a model, you can't resist trying to show off with it, and swinging it looks quite proper.
Tenna saw you enjoying it, so he didn't say much, just glanced casually, then picked up a realistic Magnum pistol. I have to admit, the simulation was quite accurate—at least it had the feel he should have. When you got bored, you put down the pistol and curiously moved over to Tenna, picking up a 38mm automatic revolver. Although this pistol has recoil, it's automatic automatic burst fire, so it's fairly convenient to use. After fiddling with it for a while, you find it okay, then excitedly suggest to Tenna, "There's nothing fun about models either...... There should be shooting ranges or something like that in the Dark World, right? Can you take me to try it out?" ”
Tenna nodded. He didn't object to your request, after all...... As long as you don't leave him, as long as you'll always be in his eyes, he feels everything is fine. But he said, "There's not enough time today. I'll take you next time." ”
He planned to find an organization nearby with other entertainment facilities, and in a few days take you out for a good visit...... Well, he just wanted to spend a little more time with you, not for any other reason.
You just nodded happily and led him forward. You passed a shop selling ready-made clothes and various fabrics. Of course, many fabrics were made into sachets, handkerchiefs, and the like—everything you could want. Curious, you leaned in to take a look and found that the handkerchiefs and sachets were embroidered with all kinds of patterns, including the clothes. Some were loose, some tight-fitting. In any case, these were styles you had never seen before. The store manager explained that these were qipaos or something. You picked a light-colored one, embroidered with elegant purple and indigo patterns, then excitedly walked into the fitting room to change into the new outfit. These clothes didn't need zippers...... After all, once you put them on, you had to button the front buttons. You've pretty much finished putting on the dress. It really is tight, but the fabric is very smooth—at least the kind of fabric you really like. There was only a half-length mirror in the fitting room, so you could only barely look at yourself in the mirror. In the end, you pushed open the fitting room door and walked out. You cautiously took a spin—Tenna was right outside, so you could see everything clearly. Then you quietly asked, "What do you think of this outfit?" ”
Tenna looked at the qipao that hugged the curve of her body, at your soft chest and graceful waist perfectly outlined by curves, and at the gently fluttering hem and the smooth thighs you revealed as you turned—he always felt his nose was warm, and he just thought it was just a flower blooming as usual. He turned off the screen and said coldly, "It looks great, but I don't recommend wearing it out, or rather, absolutely not." Saying this, he ended up paying the bill with the store manager.
“…… Then why buy it?" "You were a bit dazed, and at that moment Tenna took off his suit jacket and covered you. Your vision darkened, and when you looked up again, all you could see was the shirt he was wearing underneath.
"Put it on for me to see." He spoke concisely, coughing lightly twice, only tilting his head. You belatedly felt a flushed face on your face, hurriedly wanting to open the fitting room again.
"Then I'll change my clothes back......"
But Tenna just held your hand and forcefully walked out. You couldn't see the expression on his face, only his dry, cold voice: "No need, that's enough." ”
…… Being covered by the scent is like being completely enveloped by him, and Tenna especially enjoys this feeling.
TBC.

title: Gambler 26 (dntx you)
content:
You paused for a moment, but still kept up with Tenna's pace. His pace wasn't very fast, just as you could catch up. The suit was a bit too loose for you, even covering your calves, draped loosely over your shoulders. Tenna simply turned around and buttoned the first button for you, then continued pulling you forward until you left the daily necessities area and arrived at the front selling lots of snacks and snacks.
You gently tugged Tenna's hand, and he stopped. It was only then that he realized just how out of control he had just done—but he instinctively grabbed your hand tightly, tilted his head to look at you, probably waiting for your reaction to see if you would dislike this behavior. Tenna was a bit nervous, but you just smiled and tugged his arm again: "I'm hungry. Let's just buy something to eat, how about it?" ”
Tenna nodded shyly, and you, having gotten what you wanted, pulled her to a nearby stall lined with all kinds of dried fruits: dried mangoes, dried yellow peaches, dried strawberries, dried cranberries, dried blueberries...... You only took some of each kind, then handed it to the manager for a quote. Before you could take out your wallet, Tenna had already taken it out to pay you, then spontaneously picked up the dried fruits you wanted and held them to your mouth.
You instinctively chewed and swallowed. The fruit was crisp, with a hint of sweetness, but not overly sweet. Before you could savor it carefully, Tenna handed him another piece of dried mango. You instinctively chewed and swallowed it once more. Then you coughed twice, and you picked up a piece of dried yellow peach to feed him. His screen turned on again, and you noticed he seemed stunned before eating, while flowers appeared on his nose once again. You got used to him acting like this, just picked up a few pieces of dried blueberries and stuffed them into his mouth, then pulled him to keep walking.
This was a snack stall, apparently a stall for couple's lung slices, with lots of cold dishes to choose from. You stopped walking here, after all, you really were hungry. Mi rubbed his belly and cautiously glanced at Tenna with a pitiful look. Tenna just expressionlessly took out some dark coins and bought a serving of couple's lung slices, while you happily started picking out: shredded pork tripe, duck feet, kelp strips, beef slices, vermicelli, bean sprouts...... All kinds of dishes, filling a full bowl. The owner brought the couple's lung slices to the table next to the shop. Tenna frowned slightly, barely liking the environment. You didn't mind, just enthusiastically picking out dishes to go with the meal—the owner specially prepared two bowls of white rice for you.
But after just two bites, you couldn't help but start shoveling rice, your eyes turning red, and your cheeks flushed red. Tenna silently looked at you. He could eat a little of these things, but he wasn't very used to dishes that were somewhat biased.
And you just grabbed another glass of water with the owner, gulped it down, and then whispered, "So spicy...... I wonder what kind of flavor it is, but it's so spicy......
Tenna glanced over, picked up the teapot on the table and poured you another cup of water, while you just continued eating cautiously. Tenna awkwardly picked up his chopsticks and tasted the same thing, then closed the screen and hurriedly picked up your cup and took a sip. It really was too spicy, but he couldn't handle it anyway.
Looking at his pitch-black screen, and the faint red that still appeared even when the screen was off, you couldn't help but point at him and burst out laughing: "I knew it...... Ouch, cough cough cough...... "But because you laughed so loudly, you choked and hurriedly grabbed the cup and took another sip.
And so, you kept going through a cycle of spiciness—drinking water—eating—one more bite—spicy—drinking water. Finally, the lunch was over. When you stood up again, you were still a bit dizzy and weak in the legs from the constant spiciness. Panting, you hugged Tenna's arm: "Phew...... Next time, let's not eat something this spicy...... Although it was indeed quite intoxicating, it was also quite painful. In any case, Tenna just nodded in agreement.
Further ahead, there were quite a few snack shops selling mung bean cakes, red bean cakes, soybean cakes, as well as red date cakes and maltose...... Of course, there were quite a few nearby shops selling all kinds of beef jerky. You might not be very interested in sweets for now, but you still bought some red date cake...... Well, you really like this flavor and have eaten quite a few times at Guangshi World.
Then you picked out some various flavors of beef jerky, which Tenna still held. Tenna paid the bill, and since you weren't hungry for now, you naturally didn't have any snacks or anything like that.
You keep walking forward and find a stall selling fruit wines—plum wine, cider, wine. You can't see the alcohol content, but you think the alcohol content isn't very high...... It probably isn't too low, so to taste it, you took a bottle of each and let Tenna carry it as usual.
Hmm...... The rest were mostly snack stalls, or all kinds of dried fruit or pork jerky. You casually picked up a skewer of candied hawthorn, ate two but didn't like them, and just handed them to Tenna to finish them all. The rest probably didn't have much to look like, and you were reluctantly pulled back home by Tenna.
He placed all the dried fruits and the like on the dining table, but put those bottles of fruit wine into the fridge and frozen. Then he went into your room. You have no idea what happened, but you heard some crackling sounds—you wanted to go in and take a look, but Tenna specifically warned you not to go in, so you had to sit on the sofa, anxiously waiting. In the end, you chose to start gnawing on dried fruit.
And Tenna...... Actually, he was just throwing the merchandise from your room into the water. After all, isn't having him enough for you? He was even jealous of the merchandise made to look like him, so he threw it down the window. Of course, he called the former staff to take the items away; otherwise, it wouldn't be good to just throw them away.
Only when he tidied up your room and confirmed you could only see him did he nod in satisfaction and leave your bedroom again. Of course, he still looked at you and ordered, "Don't enter the room before going to sleep." ”
You tilt your head in confusion, not quite understanding what Tenna means...... Anyway, you nod and just sit obediently on the sofa. Tenna seems to really like you like this. He stares at you with a sharp glance, and once again you feel his burning gaze, so you can't help but look back. The moment you look, he just coughs and says, "I'm just thinking about what you'd like to eat for dinner." "It seems like a completely unrelated question, probably just changing the subject, but you still answer his question honestly.
"I want to eat grilled lamb chops, sprinkle a little fennel and cumin, that's enough." You definitely don't want to eat spicy food anymore.
Tenna nodded and sat down on the sofa too. He cautiously reached out his hand tentatively, finally holding yours tightly. You felt his hand still a bit stiff—maybe it was just your imagination...... But overall, his palm was a bit damp. You hesitated for a moment, then held his hand back, while Tenna let out a gentle sigh of relief, but...... You could feel that burning yet slightly damp gaze converging on you. Tenna was still staring at you with a hint of clarity, as if missing you at first glance would mean losing something.
You still can't help but turn your head to look at him, while Tenna just maintains that pose. His screen is off, and at this moment, you can't catch his expression. He just clears his throat twice and says, "I'm wondering, what kind of movie do you want to watch? Is it a suspense? An adventure genre? Or a horror movie?" ”
You were drawn in and indeed started thinking seriously about the question, then nodded: "Hmm...... Suspense and horror, right? I saw a synopsis of a movie yesterday, and I think it looks pretty good. ”
Tenna turned on the projector, and you enthusiastically started picking out movies, finally choosing a film called "Haunted House."
The movie begins. Tenna turns off the lights, and the room is filled only with the faint glow of the screen. You watch the movie with curiosity. It roughly tells the story of a team of archaeologists who accidentally discover a intact, undecayed house in an underground tomb. After discussion, they decide to send some researchers to investigate inside the mansion. The protagonist is a member of this research team. Because of her innate yin-yang eye, she discovers souls drifting inside the mansion and, as the team leader, redeploys their research plan. However, in the end, the researchers still die one by one inside the haunted house, because not only the ghosts inside the mansion but also countless mechanisms within the buildings, and even zombies hidden within the buildings. In the end, the female lead personally intervenes, interfering with the ghost's actions while dodging all traps and attacks, narrowly completing the scientific mission.
You watch the film with great interest. Honestly, the mysterious things inside don't really scare you...... But you can still feel Tenna's gaze, that slightly hot and moist gaze, and sense that he is frequently looking at you. You guess he probably wants you to be scared by the things in the film and hide in his arms, but unfortunately, none of these things scare you at all.
Tenna felt a bit unwilling. He was unwilling to just hold your hand. He wanted to get closer to you, even if it was just being held by you, it would be much better than now—he really couldn't accept it. And of course, he didn't really pay close attention to the movie. Most of the time, he was distracted and watching you. Of course, the scenes in the movie didn't scare him; he just thought you'd at least feel a bit flustered, or move closer to him—but you just stared at the screen with great interest.
He was unwilling to give up. He gripped your hand tightly, gritted his teeth, and simply shrank it down a bit—to about the size of a pet—then slowly moved closer to you: "Um...... Y/N, I'm a little scared." Even so, his voice was still dry and hard, not sounding particularly scared...... After all, you barely heard any pitch fluctuations.
But you couldn't ignore that burning gaze. In the end, you still picked him up, held him in your arms, and softly said, "Does this feel good?" ”
You only hear Tenna's small, somewhat faint voice: "Mm, this feels much better." And Tenna just naturally leans back like this, feeling perfectly justified, then nestles into your arms.
He really enjoys your embrace—warm and soft. And comfortable. Tenna certainly never cared about the plot on the projector, since no movie can compare to a TV show. He's just accompanying you, then enjoying your company. He craves your gaze, and now, he's content—because he can feel you looking at him again and again.
It wasn't until the movie ended, when you turned on the light, that Tenna reluctantly came out of your arms, regaining her size and expressionless appearance. In short, you suspected he wasn't truly afraid...... But it didn't matter, you were just...... Well, just treat some things as secret secrets you know.
After all, you also enjoy the feeling of being with him.
After watching the movie and having dinner, as usual, Tenna read you some books, applied medicine, gave her an antenna massage, and finally planned to go back to your room to sleep.
You quickly finished washing up, then followed by Tenna and walked into the bedroom together—after all, he wanted to sleep with you. You turned on the bedroom light and found it spotless and tidy, with only the music box you used to watch on the small commodity street that morning on the bedside.
You hesitantly looked at Tenna, but Tenna just turned her head. He crossed his arms tightly again and said coldly, "It's nothing. I just thought your room needed to be a bit cleaner, so I cleaned you up again." ”
You blinked at him, and he just lay down on the bed by himself, leaving you a spot. His voice was dry, and the screen closed: "Besides, I'm in your room. Don't you think that's enough?" "For some reason, you always feel that his words sound a bit sinister."
So you quickly nodded, "That's enough, of course it's enough." Then you lay down on the bed, nestled in his arms, curled up, and gently rubbed against him.
A night without dreams.
TBC.

title: Gambler 27 (dntx you) (end)
content:
You were woken up by being called out to her in a daze. It was Tenna's voice, still dry: "Alright, Y/N, you should get up and eat." But his voice carried a hint of anticipation, probably hoping you'd give him some feedback. You were a bit reluctant to get out of bed...... You even yawned, rubbed your sleepy eyes, and finally got dressed and got out of bed.
Breakfast during this period is usually the same: bread baked to your taste, jam prepared, plus freshly baked sausages, bacon, and soft-boiled eggs. You spread jam as usual and start tasting the bread, giving Tenna a thumbs up, and you see flowers bloom on his nose again. After breakfast, clear the plates, and Tenna brushes your hair. Today, he only tied your hair into a braid, letting it fall over your chest, looking gentle and gentle. You hadn't tried this hairstyle before and stared curiously in the mirror for a long time before putting it down.
Today's bet is up to you. After thinking for a while, you finally decide what the bet will be—well, let's play I WANNA in a match, whoever clears it first wins.
You really enjoy playing this game when you have free time. Although your skills aren't great, you've gotten used to it and become proficient, so it doesn't take long to complete it. Looking at Tenna, as a Dark Folk playing this game for the first time—or rather, a Dark Folk new to computer games—he was very reluctant, since he wasn't interested in computer games...... So in the end, he stumbled through this level, though it took him nearly three times as long as you did. So naturally, you won. You happily squinted your eyes. Aunt Zaang, Tenna didn't look very happy but didn't say much, just stiffly asked, "So, do you have any orders today?" ”
Tenna said, lifting her head as if looking at you, but all you could see was the pitch-black screen and feel his burning gaze. Ever since you woke up, that gaze had been fixed on you, with a damp, sticky feeling, as if she didn't want to leave you. You felt a bit helpless, but had no choice but to follow him.
"Mm...... Then say 'I love you' first and let me hear it. "You're a bit excited, you admit it, you do want to hear that—but to some extent, it's not wrong to reciprocate what happened yesterday."
"I...... I love you, I've always ...... I've loved you...... Tenna's voice was stammering and a bit hesitant, and by the end his voice grew quieter and quieter. Even though you heard him clearly, you still had the intention to tease him on purpose, just putting your hand to his ear and pretending not to hear clearly.
Then you pretended to be serious and said, "Hmm? What are you talking about? I can't hear clearly—" You dragged out your voice at the end, smiling at Tenna, waiting for his answer. To be honest...... You were really looking forward to him saying these things out loud.
Tenna took a deep breath and slightly raised her voice. He was no longer as flustered as before, but he was still reluctant to say such words, so he just whispered, "...... I love you." Although the volume was a bit higher than before, you still had to listen carefully to make it clear. So you pretended to be doing something, pretending to be looking at your phone messages, and after a moment, you looked up in surprise at Tenna, whose screen was dark and the antenna drooping.
"Hmm?" "What are you talking about? I still didn't catch ......" As you spoke, your voice carried a hint of apology. You looked at Tenna with a hint of apology, then you heard Tenna take a deep breath. Then he snatched the phone from your hand. His screen was still pitch black, as if flipping through something. He turned his phone screen toward you, pointed at someone in the contact list, and asked, "Who is this person?" ”
You glanced at it and waved your hand indifferently: "Ah, my brother who always asks me to help out. If it weren't for my parents' request, I wouldn't have added his contact info. It's kind of unlucky...... Delete it, delete it." "Then you tapped your phone screen twice and deleted that contact information."
Tenna was finally satisfied, though he was still scrolling through your phone. You didn't mind if he looked at your phone—after all, there was nothing shady inside.
Then he held up his phone in front of you, this time pointing to another contact number—after all, just like before, the name looked like a man's. He just asked, "What about this one? And who is this person?" ”
You sighed, deleted this person's contact information, and explained, "This is my college counselor...... We haven't been in touch for a long time; it's just that calling him during college sometimes makes it easier to solve problems. ”
Tenna happily puts the phone back. After all the hassle, you finally have no choice but to delete all your contacts directory, leaving only Tenna's contact info. You even open other social apps to show him so Tenna can be sure that his only contacts are left, or in other words—your whole world is just him.
"Satisfied now, right? You know perfectly well that those people are all people of light, and I can't possibly be able to contact their ......" You muttered to yourself, while Tenna's antenna stood up again. He still stared at the screen, just nodding. But in the end, he couldn't help but turn it on. This time, not only did flowers pop up from his nose, even the corners of his mouth couldn't help but lift, clearly showing he was extremely happy. You couldn't help but glance at him with disdain, but Tenna suddenly stepped forward and hugged you tightly. You could feel his TV head buried in the side of your neck.
And he just whispered softly in your ear, breathing warm breath: "I love you." Like this...... Did you hear me clearly? "His voice was low and hoarse. You felt your ears grow hot, and couldn't help but gently push him, murmuring, "I heard you clearly, I heard you clearly...... Don't get so close to me......"
You felt a bit embarrassed and gently shoved Tenna, who did let go of you with your strength. You cleared your throat twice: "Um, I'm going out alone, don't follow me." Saying that, you hurried out of the room. After running a few hundred meters, you patted your slightly flushed cheek, your eyes darting around. After a moment of wild thought, you still walked into a jewelry store. You happened to discover this when you and Tenna went out shopping for clothes before...... You thought you'd never set foot in a jewelry store in your lifetime, but today you still walked in.
Of course, not long after you left the house, you felt that burning gaze again. You sneaked a glance out of the corner of your eye, and sure enough, Tenna had followed, though his hiding skills weren't very good...... In any case, you just sighed silently in your heart and ignored him, just staring at the rings displayed on the counter and began to wonder what style you should choose.
Maybe because you had been inside the jewelry store for quite a while, and you chatted with the clerk a bit, you only felt that burning, sticky gaze growing even more damp, or rather, it seemed to carry a hint of darkness. You sighed helplessly, greeted the clerk, then crossed your arms and walked out of the store, speaking leisurely, "Alright, Tenna, come out. I know you're nearby." ”
But after you said this, there was no reaction from those around you; even that burning gaze vanished for a moment before returning to you.
You sighed softly in your heart, then deliberately raised your voice: "Oh no, it looks like my boyfriend got lost...... Where did he go? I can't go without my boyfriend. Maybe I should just find someone else, like the ...... in the store." As you spoke, you looked toward the jewelry store, about to walk inside, when you felt your arm being grabbed tightly—it was Tenna. Once again, he showed that gritted teeth expression. You instinctively shivered, for some reason feeling that his expression really carried a hint of horror and bloodiness.
“…… I'm your boyfriend. Who else do you want to find?" After saying this, he turned off the screen and turned his head away. He didn't look very happy, or rather, a bit embarrassed, but at least his voice was extremely rapid.
You blink at him, tilting your head slightly: "I'm not looking for anyone else, I'm just looking for you......" You want to add one more sentence, but Tenna suddenly steps forward and hugs you. You pause, only hearing his low, cold voice, sounding a bit listless: "Don't say things like that again next time." Also...... "Don't leave me alone and leave ......"
His voice grew quieter and softer, sounding stammering, and you could only helplessly hug him back, then cupped his head and gently kissed him on the screen.
"Alright, next time we go out, I'll call you to join me...... Actually, I just wanted to prepare a surprise for you. "You feel a bit helpless, but Tenna still holds you tightly and refuses to let go.
You have no choice but to soften your tone and lower your voice: "Do you want to see what surprise it is?" ”
Tenna didn't answer you; all you could see was him nod. You took a small box out of your pocket, opened it, and inside were two rings, each engraved with your name. The conversation you had just had with the jewelry store staff was about choosing a ring that fit Tenna's size.
"Ta-da...... Hmm, cough cough...... If you don't like it, I'll put it away...... Seeing Tenna showing no reaction, you rubbed the tip of your nose and felt a bit guilty, wondering if you were a bit too impatient...... You know that even though Tenna got the answer from you, he still wasn't very calm. Otherwise, why would he keep asking you to repeat that sentence?
Tenna was stunned for a moment, shook his head, and simply reached out his hand toward you. You took out a larger ring engraved with your name and slipped it onto his ring finger, and Tenna eagerly slipped the ring with his name onto your left ring finger.
You saw his screen light up again, and this time the antenna just drooped, gently shaking. You sighed, grabbed Tenna's hand, and softly said, "Alright, satisfied now, right? Let's go home." ”
Tenna just muttered, and once again, fresh flowers sprouted from his nose, some drifting and falling to the ground, while the corners of his lips couldn't help but curl up, revealing a smile that could be described as silly. He just whispered softly, as if his lips were off the mark: "Mm, Y/N, I love you." Then he returned and held your hand tightly. You were a bit troubled by his movement, but you still let him hold your hand, just responding casually.
"Yeah, I love you too...... Alright, alright, let's go home...... Actually, from the very beginning, the warmth on your face hasn't faded. If you didn't think love means you should give the other person something better, you wouldn't have done this. You don't know what love really looks like, you haven't experienced it, but maybe this sweet feeling now is love...... Maybe that's all there is to it.
You don't even know what love should do, it's just ...... Since Tenna wants you to be with him forever, then just stay with him forever; since Tenna wants you to love him, and you say you love him, then just say it out loud...... Maybe all these things are because you love him.
You don't know, you just know that at times like this, you yourself are happy...... That's all, because you also long for his company, for his love. Although perhaps neither of you truly knows what love should look like, just as it is now, it's good.
So you naturally reminded him, "Mm...... Then come with me to the shooting range this afternoon, and watch a movie with me tonight. What do you want to see?" You gave up on the order, but...... When you call out 'tenna' like this, you're still a bit unaccustomed. After all, you've used to calling him to keep you company with orders.
"Well, then...... Watch "Heartbeat." "Tenna said, you know, this is a famous romance film.
And you just smiled and nodded: "Alright, let's watch this tonight...... Oh, and um, you want to sleep with me." You said this, shyly pinching your fingers. Tenna just nodded gently, his dark screen turned on, and he smiled at you.
Tenna was sitting on the sofa at that moment, and you sat down and gently intertwined your fingers with Tenna. Tenna just casually said, "What else do you want to do?" ”
"I'm going to the bookstore! There was a book last time I had been eyeing for a long time, but it was on the shelf, and I couldn't reach it at all...... Tenna, go and help me get it. ”
"Alright."
You squinted and smiled, then moved a little closer, then leaned against Tenna's shoulder.
In this gamble, no one is a complete winner, nor is there a complete loser, after all...... This is just the story of two gamblers who bet on themselves and ultimately win against each other.
END.

title: Gambler [Merge]
content:
Heaven have a mercy—you were just wandering out for a walk after settling in the Dark World. How could you see a TV person lying on the edge of a cliff, looking like he's lost his legs?
Moreover...... It looked like he was left here and no one was going to care about him anymore. Although you don't like meddling, you can still be considered kind-hearted. After thinking it over, you went home and brought out a cart to move him onto it, then struggled to pull it carefully. After all, you saw this was a TV person, who knows there might be many intricate parts on his body. You wouldn't dare to bump him around.
After finally carrying him home, you look at the large TV he's unconscious and the two broken legs you brought back, feeling a bit worried. Fortunately, your parents forced you to study science, so you know how to repair computer circuits, so naturally you can repair TVs too. So you dig through the CRT user manual you've collected out of boredom, connect the wiring on his broken leg, finally put on the insulation tape, and then clapp, lie back on the bed, hum in satisfaction, and you're done! Reward yourself with a nap!
Half-awake, you frowned because you heard a sobbing sound like crying—not loud, but definitely enough to keep you awake. You angrily opened your eyes to see what was disturbing your peaceful sleep, but you realized the sound was coming from your side. Turning to look, you realized...... It was the TV person you brought back, now shrunk into a tiny ball, big enough to hold in your arms, and still whimpering continuously.
You gently moved a couple of times closer. He was probably still lost in his own emotions, still sobbing and sobbing, curling up into a small ball. The pitch-black screen was wet, with tears still dripping down.
You're a bit worried. You know about the existence of the People of Darkness, but no one tells you what to do if someone else cries. You know, your parents will just slap you, complaining that your crying is too loud, that you've cried too much and that your family's good fortune is gone. But you won't do that, because hearing those words won't make you happy, so you won't do that.
You racked your brains for a long time, but in the end, you gently placed your hand on his shoulder and tentatively asked in a low voice, "Hello?" ”
The TV seemed to pause for a moment, but it was still sobbing, its voice broken and intermittent: "I...... I can't give you anything, why, should ...... Save me? ”
You look at him in distress, so you reach out and pat his head again. You think, when you cry, getting a pat on the head would make you happy—maybe he would do the same.
"Hmm...... I don't want anything, I just don't want to see a perfectly fine person die there...... Ah, for the Dark People, it's damage, right? "You nodded, your voice very soft. You really didn't think about anything when you brought him back.
"But if you say that, does that mean there's nowhere to go...... Then you can stay here for now, pay me the rent first, and pay me later, that's fine......" You kept nagging, thinking about how you'd always behaved, probably because you had no way out, and you would rack your brains trying to figure out what to do next. But you saw that he didn't make a sound, just curled up and sobbing, while his screen was flooded with even bigger tears.
You scratched your head, so you took a piece of candy from the bedside table, spread it to his lips, and whispered softly, "Don't cry, eat something sweet. You have to be happy." ”
He didn't answer your question, just silently swallowed the candy. You don't even know where his screen opened to swallow the candy, but you saw him stop whimpering, though the screen was still a bit damp, and you finally breathed a sigh of relief.
You see this little TV person sit up from his soaking wet bed, the dark screen staring at you, showing no other reaction. You simply sit cross-legged on the floor too, because squatting all the time would be exhausting.
You waved a finger in front of him: "Alright, you should be more alert, right? Now I'm going to start questioning." ”
You see the little TV guy nodding.
You hugged your knees and asked first, "So who exactly are you, and how should I address you?" ”
“…… Anton Tenna, you can call me whatever you like. You...... Where did you find me? "His voice trembled slightly.
You shrugged: "Ah, on a cliff. You should be able to tell I'm a citizen of light, or a human, right?" ”
Tenna nodded lightly, but then asked, "Then...... Why does that Light Tribe choose the Dark World? His voice was muffled, the antenna dropped, and his body seemed to tremble slightly. You don't understand why he reacted this way. Is it strange for the Light Tribe to appear in the Dark World?
But you just smiled indifferently and shrugged: "Ah, how did it turn into you asking me a question?" Alright, I have to tell you, I ...... It was because I didn't want to have any more contact with my parents that I went to the underworld. ”
Your words were relaxed, but when you said it, you couldn't help but zone out a little. You remembered that day—the day you completely decided to move to the Dark World. After all...... You're not short of money. You can go wherever you want; you belong to yourself.
"But what exactly happened to cause you to be so seriously injured?" You looked at Tenna's legs with a curious look. Clearly, they were now able to move freely.
“…… I struck a deal with the Howling Knights, the deal fell through, and that's it. "His emotions seemed to have stabilized somewhat. In any case, the screen was still pitch black, but he wasn't crying anymore.
You sized him up, then nodded thoughtfully: "...... Who is this? Never heard of him, but he probably wouldn't chase you to kill you, right? ”
Tenna shook her head, but then asked urgently, "Have you heard of TV WORLD?" ”
You frowned and thought for a moment, then shook your head as well: "I haven't heard of it. All I know is that the place where we live now is called Castle Town. Is that a place very important to you? If so, I'll help you find out later." ”
Tenna nodded but shook her head again, her tone gloomy: "...... That world has probably already been sealed. ”
You didn't quite understand the word, but seeing his downcast expression, you didn't press further. Instead, you opened a nearby drawer and took out two more candies—one opened and put in your mouth, and the other was opened and fed to Tenna. This time, he ate them without hesitation.
You smiled helplessly: "Alright...... Although I still don't know exactly what the situation is, I think you need to stay here for a while. Wait until you find your next place before leaving. ”
As you spoke, your mouth was mumbling a bit hard to hear because you had that candy in your mouth. You felt Tenna's body tremble, then he nodded stiffly.
You stood up and gently picked him up. Well, he really does feel light in your arms. The apartment you rented happens to have a guest room, and you moved in a couple of days ago just finished tidying up. I didn't expect you'd need it today. Tenna seemed even stiffer in your arms. You didn't pay him any mind, just put him on the bed and softly said, "Alright, I think you need to rest for a while. I'll be leaving now." Then you gently closed the door.
You don't know what Tenna made again, but you happened to be a bit thirsty, so you made yourself some floral tea. After a few sips, you put the teapot and teacup on the table, walked to the guest room door, and shouted loudly, "If you're thirsty, there's something on the table to drink!" ”
You heard Tenna respond from inside the room, then ignored him and went back to your room to lie back on the bed and go back to sleep. When you woke up again, you rubbed your eyes and glanced over. You realized it was almost dinner time, so you quickly opened the door and went out to make a simple dinner. Although you couldn't cook, you could at least heat up the semi-prepared dishes.
But as soon as you reached the living room, you heard the sounds of stoves and smoke coming from the kitchen, along with a faint smell of cooking oil. You hurried to the kitchen—what if this guest temporarily staying at your house blew up your kitchen?
But your worries seemed unnecessary, because as soon as you walked into the kitchen, you saw Tenna, now about the same size as before, wearing an apron and heat-resistant gloves, carrying a plate of roasted lamb leg.
You stopped in your tracks, stared at him wide-eyed, and said, "Huh?" You instinctively let out a soft "ah."
Tenna bypassed you and placed the grilled lamb chops on the table. You instinctively turned to stare at him, and Tenna looked back at you. His screen lit up, though his expression seemed a bit cold, and for some reason, his voice sounded a bit tough but weak inside: "What, can't I go into your kitchen?" ”
You shake your head: "That's not ......." But as you say this, all you see is Tenna's back. He walks into the kitchen again, while you sit at the dining table, a bit confused, feeling that something is off.
Next, Tenna placed several plates on the table and brought over the knife and fork. He sat across from you. Neither of you made the first move, but instead fell into an eerie silence.
While you were still struggling with what to say, you heard Tenna's voice: "This is ...... To repay you for saving me today and making you dinner, don't count on me anymore. ”
You sighed, thinking to yourself that you never intended to have him make dinner, and you didn't expect any payment, but on the surface, you just nodded: "Alright, alright." ”
You hesitated for a moment, but finally decided to cut a piece of roasted lamb leg and eat it. You bought this and kept it in the fridge, worrying about what to do. Today, Tenna finished making it, and of course you gladly accepted it.
“…… Also, for the next while, I probably really will be staying here. "Tenna hesitated for a moment, or perhaps hesitated, but his voice still sounded cold.
You just nodded again: "Alright, alright, I know. I'll pay rent for now......." But before you could finish, Tenna interrupted you.
"No, I think...... Although you saved me, I shouldn't repay you like a beast of burden. You're the one who should be a beast of burden. "He said seriously, his face grave.
You whisper, "I didn't make you work like a beast to repay me...... but you felt like Tenna had just glared at you.
So you changed your tune: "Alright, alright, then either I'll be like a beast of burden, or you'll be a horse, right? Let's play a game." As you spoke, you put down your knife and fork, clapped your hands excitedly, and said, "Heavens have had it—after all these years, you've never played a proper game with anyone."
"What game?" He asked briefly. He considered himself a game show host, skilled at any game.
You waved your finger as if teasing her, feeling like Tenna glared at you again, then cleared her throat and said, "It's simple. It's just a bet every day. Whatever you want, the winner can order the loser to do anything, and within that day—sounds fair, right?" ”
"What if the loser refuses to comply?" Tenna crossed his arms, probably thinking the proposal was feasible, but he needed to clarify everything.
"That's simple. If the loser refuses to comply, then the winner will have to work like a beast of burden for the rest of their life." You clapped your hands and announced. Honestly, you never came up with such a shameless idea before. But Tenna insisted on saying something like that. How could you not play a game with him?
Tenna seemed to hesitate for a moment, then gritted his teeth and nodded at you: "Alright." ”
You tilt your head: "Then this game officially starts tomorrow. As for today—well, I saved you, so I asked you to help wash the dishes and such. Isn't that too much?" ”
Tenna gritted her teeth, looking a bit furious: "...... Not too much. ”
"It's settled then. I swear—swear it's a suction swearing, and you won't change for ten thousand years!" As you spoke, you extended your pinky to Tenna. Tenna hesitated for a moment, then extended her pinky too. Compared to him, his body was really big—even his hands were several times bigger than yours. You just smiled and pinky promised him, then began enjoying the dinner.
After eating, Tenna would clean up after all—so you just messed up mutton fat and similar items on the table, watching Tenna grit her teeth as she tidied up, while you just leisurely drank a cup of floral tea, tidied yourself up a bit, and after passing the night, you went back to your room.
You're still smiling when you sleep, after all—you've already started looking forward to what tomorrow will be like.
TBC.
You wake up in the morning, your eyes loosening as you scratch your messy hair, grab a casual piece of clothing, open the door, and head out, planning to grab some kind of breakfast—until you realize there's a TV sitting at your own dining table that you snap out of it. This isn't just your own home. You shiver, smooth your hair, and seeing Tenna still eating breakfast, you can't help but swallow at the aroma. You simply sit across from him, weakly waving your hand and saying, "Let's make a bet now, bet on rock-paper-scissors, best of three." ”
Tenna put down her knife and fork on the screen, hesitated for a moment, then placed her hand on the table. His voice was still very low, maybe just imagining it, but it seemed a bit hoarse.
"So...... The daily betting should be decided by someone else, otherwise it's not fair enough. "Tenna said, obediently following your countdown to rock-paper-scissors. As expected, you won. Tenna watched the screen go dark. If the screen were still lit, his expression would probably have cracked."
You wave your hand and lie face down on the table: "Alright...... I'm now ordering you to prepare breakfast for me and serve it first...... Then you close your eyes and enter standby mode.
Tenna gritted her teeth, still made breakfast for you, then slammed it heavily on the table. The sound was loud and startled you. You suddenly sat up, groggily staring at Tenna, mumbling, "What's wrong? What's wrong?" ”
"It's nothing, it's just that the breakfast you wanted is ready." Tenna said through gritted teeth.
You scratch your head and finally wake up a bit, then a delicious aroma wafts into your nostrils. You giggle twice and nod to Tenna: "Ah, thank you for making breakfast for me!" "And you ignore Tenna's murderous gaze as she stares at you, eat breakfast like a storm, then burp. You wave your hand, signaling Tenna to clear the dining table."
Naturally, he gritted his teeth and went to clean up everything, and after breakfast, you finally felt refreshed, planning which novel to read first today.
But before you could decide, Tenna sat down opposite you again. His screen lit up, and he looked a bit bitter and deeply resentful. He cautiously asked, "So what am I supposed to do next?" ”
You yawned, not quite understanding why he acted like this, but if you wanted to tell him something...... There wasn't much to tell him about, right? After thinking for a moment, you jumped up and rummaged through the nearby drawer for a comb, then handed it to Tenna: "Then help me comb my hair...... My hair is too long, combing it is such a hassle." You complained, and your long hair was always tangled, and you didn't have the strength to hold onto it, so every time you combed it, it hurt. Over time, you got used to your hair running all over and about. After all, you lived alone, and no one would criticize you.
Maybe it's just your imagination, but you keep feeling as if you hear Tenna breathe a sigh of relief. You don't care about it anymore, just take out another hair tie and hand it to Tenna: "Just help me tie it up, whatever you want to do anyway......" You watch Tenna silently stand up holding the comb, then you feel your hair being lifted. He probably used the comb to pull it down to the knot, and your scalp is being pulled. Flustered, you reach out to hold his hand, tears almost welling up in your eyes.
"Ouch, ouch, ouch, ouch...... That's not it. If you find a knot or a hard comb, grab the hair on top and slowly comb it through. That's how ...... "You scoop up a handful of hair with a pitiful look, then shape your fingers into a comb and comb it down.
"And you're way too strong...... you muttered, mourning your still-aching scalp.
Tenna said nothing, just followed your instructions, picked up a lock of hair, and slowly combed it down. He was indeed quite strong, holding the lock and smoothing it out for you, without even causing your scalp to ache at all. You sighed in relief, feeling your hair tied back up, and the back of your neck felt refreshing—it was truly comfortable.
"Yeah, that's right—thank you, it's been a long time since I've felt this refreshing." As you spoke, you cheerfully flicked your ponytail and then slapped Tenna hard.
Your body stiffened, then mechanically turned around, looking at the expressionless Tenna and chuckled twice: "Um...... Sorry, I didn't mean to. ”
Tenna just looked down at you expressionlessly, then said gruffly, "It's okay, I won't feel pain anyway. Maybe I do...... You will also think it doesn't matter." ”
You quickly waved your hand: "How could that mean you don't care...... You still owe me rent! Of course I wouldn't just abandon you." As you spoke, you stroked your high ponytail, then lay back comfortably and sprawled out on the sofa.
"What else do you want me to do?" His voice sounded stiff, reluctant, and lacking any emotion. You were worried about what to do next, but seeing Tenna, you couldn't help but stroke your chin: "Well...... Hmm, first of all, lunch and dinner are all in your hands! "You don't know how to cook, so having someone who can cook now is perfect."
Tenna nodded. His pitch-black screen was still staring at you, looking rather scary—at least you shivered.
"Then...... Go to the bookshelf next door. Yes, this one. Just pick up any book and read it to me. "You gesture at the nearby bookshelf and instruct Tenna to bring down a book for you.
Tenna glanced at it; the title of the book was ...... "The Proud Empress and Her 108 Male Favorites in Her Harem."
He silently sits next to you holding the book and mechanically starts reading. You listen while pointing and saying, "Don't sound like a mechanical voice...... Read with more emotion! Yes, the queen's lines should be a bit more domineering. The number one male favorite has a 'green tea' type, his lines can be read in a way that makes me feel a bit pitiful, and the second male favorite is the tsundere type...... Hmm, the flavor is just right. Just read it like this...... As you say that, you yawn again, lean back on the sofa with your eyes closed, listening to Tenna read aloud beside you. His voice becomes a bit more emotional, and the deliberately rough tone is gone. It actually sounds quite kind...... You thought about it casually. Except for lunch and dinner when he was away for a while, Tenna read this book to you the rest of the time. You even made a pot of floral tea to soothe his throat. Before you knew it, the day had just passed like this.
Tenna was still a bit incredulous...... He thought he would really work like a beast of burden for you, but you only asked for some conditions that he didn't even consider. He gave you a complicated look and urged you that it was time and time to sleep.
“…… There's still a little left to finish. Why don't you read it to the end, or let me read it myself too...... You immediately opened your eyes, wanting to reach for the book Tenna was holding, but unfortunately he lifted the book up, and he was so tall that even if you jumped onto the sofa and stood on tiptoe, you couldn't reach it. All you could do was look at Tenna with a puff of anger.
Although his screen was lit, the corners of his mouth always curved downward, and his voice remained cold: "No, I'm going to sleep." He knew from the family TV that he couldn't play any more programs for kids at the time, and now of course he understood.
"I...... I'm the winner today, so you have to listen to me and give me back that book! ”
You were so angry you nearly jumped off the sofa, but Tenna reached out to support you before you sat back down.
And Tenna did hand you the book as you requested. Excited, you took it and saw that it was a math book Tenna had pulled out from somewhere. You immediately deflated: "How could this be...... I'm talking about the book you're reading today! ”
His lips straightened, and for some reason, you could see a hint of innocence: "But I've already given you the book you wanted." ”
After saying that, he added, "You need to rest early, or what if you don't have the energy to read the follow-up tomorrow?" His voice softened a bit, though it still sounded a bit stiff and stiff.
You pouted, unhappily tossing the book onto the sofa and heading toward the bedroom: "Alright...... I'm going to bed. "You look listless, but you really are tired. Otherwise, you'd be arguing with Tenna for eight hundred rounds!"
But it was a dreamless night. You walked out of the bedroom yawning with messy hair, your nose wafting again. When you reached the dining table, you realized that besides Tenna's breakfast, you also had yours. You pulled out a chair and sat down in surprise, clapping: "Wow, you actually made breakfast for me. Thank you, tenna—" You squeezed your throat, your voice turning sweet and sweet.
Tenna ignored him and kept cutting the fried egg, her voice still icy: "It's nothing, I just helped you toast a bit." There were plenty of empty spots in the bread machine. ”
You blinked, looking at the fried egg sandwiched between the two slices of bread, and the sausage, bacon, and scones on another plate. You thought to yourself, this was no easy task, but you didn't say much. Instead, you picked up the two slices of bread and stuffed your mouth until it was full, your cheeks puffed up, and you stammered, "It's your turn to decide today. What kind of bet are we going to play?" ”
Tenna put down her knife and fork. He had already finished his meal, just stared at your movements, and casually said, "Gomoku." ”
You bite into the bread, blinking your eyes. Gomoku...... Your skills are pretty poor, after all, you can't even beat the machines. Although you feel a bit weak, you still nod vigorously: "Alright, Gomoku is Gomoku!" ”

Aunt Zaang, Tenna didn't look very happy but didn't say much, just stiffly asked, "So, do you have any orders today?" ”
Tenna said, lifting her head as if looking at you, but all you could see was the pitch-black screen and feel his burning gaze. Ever since you woke up, that gaze had been fixed on you, with a damp, sticky feeling, as if she didn't want to leave you. You felt a bit helpless, but had no choice but to follow him.
"Mm...... Then say 'I love you' first and let me hear it. "You're a bit excited, you admit it, you do want to hear that—but to some extent, it's not wrong to reciprocate what happened yesterday."
"I...... I love you, I've always ...... I've loved you...... Tenna's voice was stammering and a bit hesitant, and by the end his voice grew quieter and quieter. Even though you heard him clearly, you still had the intention to tease him on purpose, just putting your hand to his ear and pretending not to hear clearly.
Then you pretended to be serious and said, "Hmm? What are you talking about? I can't hear clearly—" You dragged out your voice at the end, smiling at Tenna, waiting for his answer. To be honest...... You were really looking forward to him saying these things out loud.
Tenna took a deep breath and slightly raised her voice. He was no longer as flustered as before, but he was still reluctant to say such words, so he just whispered, "...... I love you." Although the volume was a bit higher than before, you still had to listen carefully to make it clear. So you pretended to be doing something, pretending to be looking at your phone messages, and after a moment, you looked up in surprise at Tenna, whose screen was dark and the antenna drooping.
"Hmm?" "What are you talking about? I still didn't catch ......" As you spoke, your voice carried a hint of apology. You looked at Tenna with a hint of apology, then you heard Tenna take a deep breath. Then he snatched the phone from your hand. His screen was still pitch black, as if flipping through something. He turned his phone screen toward you, pointed at someone in the contact list, and asked, "Who is this person?" ”
You glanced at it and waved your hand indifferently: "Ah, my brother who always asks me to help out. If it weren't for my parents' request, I wouldn't have added his contact info. It's kind of unlucky...... Delete it, delete it." "Then you tapped your phone screen twice and deleted that contact information."
Tenna was finally satisfied, though he was still scrolling through your phone. You didn't mind if he looked at your phone—after all, there was nothing shady inside.
Then he held up his phone in front of you, this time pointing to another contact number—after all, just like before, the name looked like a man's. He just asked, "What about this one? And who is this person?" ”
You sighed, deleted this person's contact information, and explained, "This is my college counselor...... We haven't been in touch for a long time; it's just that calling him during college sometimes makes it easier to solve problems. ”
Tenna happily puts the phone back. After all the hassle, you finally have no choice but to delete all your contacts directory, leaving only Tenna's contact info. You even open other social apps to show him so Tenna can be sure that his only contacts are left, or in other words—your whole world is just him.
"Satisfied now, right? You know perfectly well that those people are all people of light, and I can't possibly be able to contact their ......" You muttered to yourself, while Tenna's antenna stood up again. He still stared at the screen, just nodding. But in the end, he couldn't help but turn it on. This time, not only did flowers pop up from his nose, even the corners of his mouth couldn't help but lift, clearly showing he was extremely happy. You couldn't help but glance at him with disdain, but Tenna suddenly stepped forward and hugged you tightly. You could feel his TV head buried in the side of your neck.
And he just whispered softly in your ear, breathing warm breath: "I love you." Like this...... Did you hear me clearly? "His voice was low and hoarse. You felt your ears grow hot, and couldn't help but gently push him, murmuring, "I heard you clearly, I heard you clearly...... Don't get so close to me......"
You felt a bit embarrassed and gently shoved Tenna, who did let go of you with your strength. You cleared your throat twice: "Um, I'm going out alone, don't follow me." Saying that, you hurried out of the room. After running a few hundred meters, you patted your slightly flushed cheek, your eyes darting around. After a moment of wild thought, you still walked into a jewelry store. You happened to discover this when you and Tenna went out shopping for clothes before...... You thought you'd never set foot in a jewelry store in your lifetime, but today you still walked in.
Of course, not long after you left the house, you felt that burning gaze again. You sneaked a glance out of the corner of your eye, and sure enough, Tenna had followed, though his hiding skills weren't very good...... In any case, you just sighed silently in your heart and ignored him, just staring at the rings displayed on the counter and began to wonder what style you should choose.
Maybe because you had been inside the jewelry store for quite a while, and you chatted with the clerk a bit, you only felt that burning, sticky gaze growing even more damp, or rather, it seemed to carry a hint of darkness. You sighed helplessly, greeted the clerk, then crossed your arms and walked out of the store, speaking leisurely, "Alright, Tenna, come out. I know you're nearby." ”
But after you said this, there was no reaction from those around you; even that burning gaze vanished for a moment before returning to you.
You sighed softly in your heart, then deliberately raised your voice: "Oh no, it looks like my boyfriend got lost...... Where did he go? I can't go without my boyfriend. Maybe I should just find someone else, like the ...... in the store." As you spoke, you looked toward the jewelry store, about to walk inside, when you felt your arm being grabbed tightly—it was Tenna. Once again, he showed that gritted teeth expression. You instinctively shivered, for some reason feeling that his expression really carried a hint of horror and bloodiness.
“…… I'm your boyfriend. Who else do you want to find?" After saying this, he turned off the screen and turned his head away. He didn't look very happy, or rather, a bit embarrassed, but at least his voice was extremely rapid.
You blink at him, tilting your head slightly: "I'm not looking for anyone else, I'm just looking for you......" You want to add one more sentence, but Tenna suddenly steps forward and hugs you. You pause, only hearing his low, cold voice, sounding a bit listless: "Don't say things like that again next time." Also...... "Don't leave me alone and leave ......"
His voice grew quieter and softer, sounding stammering, and you could only helplessly hug him back, then cupped his head and gently kissed him on the screen.
"Alright, next time we go out, I'll call you to join me...... Actually, I just wanted to prepare a surprise for you. "You feel a bit helpless, but Tenna still holds you tightly and refuses to let go.
You have no choice but to soften your tone and lower your voice: "Do you want to see what surprise it is?" ”
Tenna didn't answer you; all you could see was him nod. You took a small box out of your pocket, opened it, and inside were two rings, each engraved with your name. The conversation you had just had with the jewelry store staff was about choosing a ring that fit Tenna's size.
"Ta-da...... Hmm, cough cough...... If you don't like it, I'll put it away...... Seeing Tenna showing no reaction, you rubbed the tip of your nose and felt a bit guilty, wondering if you were a bit too impatient...... You know that even though Tenna got the answer from you, he still wasn't very calm. Otherwise, why would he keep asking you to repeat that sentence?
Tenna was stunned for a moment, shook his head, and simply reached out his hand toward you. You took out a larger ring engraved with your name and slipped it onto his ring finger, and Tenna eagerly slipped the ring with his name onto your left ring finger.
You saw his screen light up again, and this time the antenna just drooped, gently shaking. You sighed, grabbed Tenna's hand, and softly said, "Alright, satisfied now, right? Let's go home." ”
Tenna just muttered, and once again, fresh flowers sprouted from his nose, some drifting and falling to the ground, while the corners of his lips couldn't help but curl up, revealing a smile that could be described as silly. He just whispered softly, as if his lips were off the mark: "Mm, Y/N, I love you." Then he returned and held your hand tightly. You were a bit troubled by his movement, but you still let him hold your hand, just responding casually.
"Yeah, I love you too...... Alright, alright, let's go home...... Actually, from the very beginning, the warmth on your face hasn't faded. If you didn't think love means you should give the other person something better, you wouldn't have done this. You don't know what love really looks like, you haven't experienced it, but maybe this sweet feeling now is love...... Maybe that's all there is to it.
You don't even know what love should do, it's just ...... Since Tenna wants you to be with him forever, then just stay with him forever; since Tenna wants you to love him, and you say you love him, then just say it out loud...... Maybe all these things are because you love him.
You don't know, you just know that at times like this, you yourself are happy...... That's all, because you also long for his company, for his love. Although perhaps neither of you truly knows what love should look like, just as it is now, it's good.
So you naturally reminded him, "Mm...... Then come with me to the shooting range this afternoon, and watch a movie with me tonight. What do you want to see?" You gave up on the order, but...... When you call out 'tenna' like this, you're still a bit unaccustomed. After all, you've used to calling him to keep you company with orders.
"Well, then...... Watch "Heartbeat." "Tenna said, you know, this is a famous romance film.
And you just smiled and nodded: "Alright, let's watch this tonight...... Oh, and um, you want to sleep with me." You said this, shyly pinching your fingers. Tenna just nodded gently, his dark screen turned on, and he smiled at you.
Tenna was sitting on the sofa at that moment, and you sat down and gently intertwined your fingers with Tenna. Tenna just casually said, "What else do you want to do?" ”
"I'm going to the bookstore! There was a book last time I had been eyeing for a long time, but it was on the shelf, and I couldn't reach it at all...... Tenna, go and help me get it. ”
"Alright."
You squinted and smiled, then moved a little closer, then leaned against Tenna's shoulder.
In this gamble, no one is a complete winner, nor is there a complete loser, after all...... This is just the story of two gamblers who bet on themselves and ultimately win against each other.
END.

title: Important Thing 1 (dntx you)
content:
You leave the world of light because...... You feel you can no longer stay in that world, or rather, there is no longer any need; the things that exist there are completely unnecessary. So you come to the dark world...... You beg the Happy Gang to find you a place to stay in Castle Town, so you settle down there. This is just right—you don't want to go out, don't want to eat, don't want to see the sun, don't want to talk to anyone, don't want to ...... to live.
You just sit dumbly in your room, hugging your knees with both hands, dumbfounded, showing no reaction or wanting to have any reaction. The dark world lords who were also left by the Happy Gang to live in Castle Town also saw you, a little citizen of light...... Of course, only Tenna still remembers you. He remembers seeing you before. Before that, he was your family's TV, and of course, it was only when you were very young...... He doesn't know how you became like this now. Although it was just something you said casually as a child, Tenna remembered it. He still remembered what you said: grow up well and stay with him forever—of course, you might not remember, but he remembers the promise you once made. Although he never mentioned you again, in fact, it was ...... He always remembered you.
He doesn't understand what exactly is going on with you. Of course, after all these years, he's no longer the same as before, and it's only natural that you will change. But in the end, he just ...... Silently knocking on your door.
You heard a noise coming from your door, your eyelids twitched, but you showed no intention of getting up to respond, and you didn't say a word. Tenna knew you were in the room, but you didn't respond. His brows furrowed, but he forced himself to suppress his irritation and knocked on your door again, showing some patience. But...... It was very quiet inside, and there was still no response.
He took a deep breath, suppressing the urge to smash the door open, and patiently asked, "Is Y/N inside?" ”
…… How would he know your name? You're a bit curious, but you really don't have the strength to respond...... If only no one would disturb you, how wonderful that would be, but...... But that's probably impossible. You stared blankly at the door, completely in a dimly lit room, then lowered your head, pretending not to hear.
Tenna knew you were inside the room, after all, you hadn't gone out at all these days—but it was still very quiet, as if no one was there; all he felt was emptiness. Tenna's expression turned cold; his patience was running low...... Even if he broke down a door, the Happy Gang wouldn't dare say much, let alone anyone else. So he clenched his fist and smashed it against your door—the door shattered with a crack, and you were startled, your body instinctively shrinking back. You curled up and looked toward the doorway...... It was a tall TV figure standing against the light at your door.
