Although the dark world had no sunlight, your room was so dark that when you looked at that TV person, your pupils involuntarily contracted slightly.
You're pretty sure you don't know this guy...... But Tenna just fumbled around, found the ceiling light switch in your room, and then walked straight up to you, looking down at you. You closed your eyes uncomfortably because the light was suddenly on, oh my god...... You really can't get used to this kind of light; you feel like you haven't seen a light in a long time.
And this TV person stood right in front of you, his tone cold and a bit commanding: "Come out, you can't stay here forever." ”
…… You don't want to talk, but you still have some strength, so you shake your head.
Tenna clicked his tongue irritably, torn between leaving you behind or continuing to care for him...... Hmm, the latter option was very appealing, but he wouldn't be willing to accept it. He definitely didn't want the person he once fantasized about spending the rest of his life with to end up like this. He crouched down to look at you. Now he finally looked you in eye contact, and your vacant eyes stared at him. Tenna gave another order: "Then come out and eat something. Don't die here. This place is near my room. If I die, those Lightfolk will come after me again." ”
But you just shake your head again; you don't feel any hunger; sadness has taken over most of your senses...... Other than that, you really have no other feelings.
He irritably grabbed your wrist. He didn't understand how you had become so hard to communicate with—completely different from the little girl he remembered who dared to scribble on his screen. He looked at you, and you just stared blankly at his screen. In your pupils, your TV head was also reflected. Tenna clicked his tongue, grabbed your head with both hands, and you didn't resist at all. Only a hint of confusion flickered in your eyes. You were indeed a bit curious about what Tenna was planning.
But he simply said coldly, "Now, look at me." ”
You looked at him as he said, and then you saw, a black-and-white whirlpool appeared on his screen. You saw...... You saw that faintly glowing, spinning thing, making your consciousness dizzy, even completely disappearing. You looked dazed at Tenna. Even though you had been hypnotized, you looked no different from one who hadn't.
Tenna looked at you like this, unsure if he had succeeded or not...... But this was the best solution he could come up with. He still held your head and looked you straight in the eye, though his voice softened a bit: "Alright, now, call me Tenna. You know me, don't you?" ”
“tenna…… I, should I know you?" You just answered his question blankly, following his words in a daze, even though you ...... probably really don't remember.
"You've seen it, the TV that used to be in your house," Tenna didn't want to say much about it, just glossed over it with a single sentence. Then, he began giving new instructions, "You have to eat properly, get out more and move around, and live seriously." He didn't know if this would work for you, so he could only try it for now. And sure enough, you just shook your head, tears streaming freely from your eyes.
“…… No, I, I can't ...... I, why do I want to live? "Your voice is soft, you say this, your hands involuntarily hugging your own head, you, oh my god...... Your head is just a mess, but that sadness still weighs heavily on your heart, making it impossible to relax even a little.
“…… Is there no point in living for you? Nothing matters to you, so there's no need for you to keep living. Is that what you think?" Tenna still remembered some of the psychological counseling shows she had watched before. Although his voice was now cold and stiff—he was forcing himself to say each word—while he stared at you intently, watching to see how you would react.
You shook your head and nodded: "...... I don't matter to anyone. Everyone will hate me, they'll despise me, so no one matters to me...... Anyway, in the end, I won't ...... either." You whispered honestly...... Even though you said these things, so coldly, you were still crying, your body trembling. Maybe those words truly came from your heart, but do you really want that?
Tenna was silent for a moment, his hand stiffly wiping the tears from your cheeks...... To be honest, when you cry, he felt like he understood why you were crying, but he didn't fully understand either...... Maybe it was because their situation was similar, but now he was also a TV discarded by others who were considered unimportant, so any Light Citizen was simply unimportant to him. But, but—you are different, you are different, at least that's what Tenna believes.
He hesitated for a moment, but finally cupped your head with his hands, his tone commanding: "Look at me." ”
And you really did look up blankly at Tenna.
“…… You might not matter to anyone; after all, you're just a bunch of useless people of light. He clicked his tongue lightly as he said this, and as he looked at you, his tears began to fall like they were free.
He roughly wiped the tears from your cheeks, making your cheeks a little red from his actions, while Tenna just said sternly, "No crying. Anyway, those are all useless humans, but you have to understand, you are very important to things." "For example...... He—of course, he wouldn't reveal this to you, and you sniffled, still sobbing, though not completely stopping your crying...... You just looked at Tenna with your eyes blurred.
"So, you'll think I'm important, got it?" As he spoke, he finally let go. At least that way, you'd probably pay attention to him instead of just staying in this room waiting to die.
You obediently nodded: "...... Yes, Tenna is a ...... very important TV to me. "Although you can't remember most of it clearly, you still remember some things, like that old TV.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 2 (dntx you)
content:
And you just stared blankly at Tenna, because that's all you remembered. All you knew was that you could say that, even if his presence was completely gone in your consciousness, even if all your memories of the past had vanished, it seemed that because of Tenna's words, you remembered a little again. At least, in your subconscious, there really was such a TV station.
So now you can only stare at him blankly. Even though your eyes were lifeless, now you just look even more ...... more dazed. Tenna looks into your eyes, seeing that you're still in a well-behaved state, still maintaining eye contact with you. He just cups your cheeks and looks at you, or rather, gazes at you.
"Now, I'm calling you to eat. You have to eat properly, okay?" His voice still carried a commanding tone. He just couldn't change that, and Tenna also thought there was no need to change it. No matter how he talked to you, it was the same, especially since you wouldn't remember anything right now.
“…… But I don't want to eat, Tenna." You just shook your head, probably because Tenna's current status was unusual for you, and your words and actions seemed even more obedient. At this moment, you just stared at him blankly. And your face still showed a somewhat sad emotion.
“…… You have to eat. I don't want to watch you die in front of me, you know?" Tenna said this, unusually patient, or else he might have just dragged you out and stuffed something into your mouth.
"Mm, don't worry, I won't die in front of you." Your voice was light and floaty, and for some reason, there was a hint of disappointment in it. Tenna looked at you, feeling as if she had forgotten something...... But in the end, he just patted your shoulder firmly with his hand.
"As long as you don't die, that's good. Then let's go eat now. It's already time. If you don't eat, do you expect me to feed you?" Saying that, Tenna stood up. Now he looked down at you, but you didn't move and just shook your head again. Tenna felt the current in his wires rushing wildly, making the whole TV feel a bit hot—probably overheated. Of course, seeing your reaction, he thought a warm red was normal, and now he was just taking a deep breath. Even though a TV probably doesn't have any breathing at all, he just grabbed your wrist forcefully.
"Come on, come out with me." This time, he simply said that sentence, and you stumbled as he dragged you out of the room. You hadn't stepped out of your room in a long time...... So for you, this was a bit uncomfortable, and immediately after, you were dragged into Tenna's room, which was generally very dark, the whole room blue. It was made of purple and black, with only a few scattered traces of white. Tenna stared at the screen, just pulling you to sit at the table. Then he brought out a simple steak and tomato-flavored pasta and placed it on the table, speaking very succinctly: "Eat." ”
You just shook your head: "...... I'm not hungry, tenna, I really don't want to eat." You said this, shaking your head again. You always felt like your mind was a bit foggy.
And you finally wake up from that hypnotic dream...... Your vision is no longer a chaotic darkness; instead, you can clearly see what is in front of you. You immediately realize that this is not your own room, but an outsider's room. At the same moment, you clearly see that the person sitting opposite you on TV is the big guy who had just barged into your room. You look at him warily because you don't know this guy...... But you feel he is somewhat familiar, as if somewhat close, and you always feel...... He seems very important to you, yet why is it that you have no memory of this at all, and you don't recognize this guy at all?
"I'm Tenna. You just promised me you'd come here for dinner. It's that simple." Tenna naturally noticed you had come to your senses. Although your eyes were still lifeless, you instinctively shrank back and felt nervous...... A hint of panic also appeared in your eyes.
After hearing Tenna's words, you blink and look at the table in front of you. There really is steak and pasta on it—it's lunch. Even though you have no interest in eating, you still believe Tenna's words, because lately you've been like this all along—sometimes your memories from the past suddenly disappear. So, Tenna's words sound perfectly fine to you. Although you're also puzzled about why you made such a request, you feel this guy is very approachable...... So, it's probably because of your own feelings. That's what you thought.
But after looking at the dishes on the table, you still decide to argue your case: "But, tenna, I really don't want to eat at all. Can I skip this?" ”
"No." He simply replied to you like that, looking down at you from above. You pouted, still a bit unhappy, but...... Unexpectedly, you didn't want to disobey this TV person's request—was it because he was probably very important to you? You think it might be like that, especially ...... It seemed like a voice in his mind was reminding him to eat well, live well, and not die in front of Tenna. It must be the memory content from that lost period...... That's your guess, even though you don't really know. You just quietly lower your head. Even though looking at these things makes you nauseous, in the end, you pick up your knife and fork, start cutting the steak, and then take small bites of it.
Your stomach, which hadn't touched food in a long time, twitched at that moment, a spasm-like pain, though you couldn't tell if it was pathological or psychological...... You couldn't figure it out. You were just suppressing that urge in your body, letting your stomach ache, letting the urge to vomit arise inside you. But you simply suppressed that desire, and your chest naturally ached from your actions. Your face turned a bit paler, and your movements paused slightly. Then, your fork grabbed the next steak and put it in your mouth.
Tenna frowned. Looking at your expression, he felt something was off, but he couldn't quite put his finger on it. After all, he had never interacted with you, didn't know you well, and certainly wouldn't know how you reacted or felt in certain states. You mechanically maintained the same movement, slowly bringing the steak into your mouth, trying to suppress the sensation you had just experienced. Your face only grew paler, or rather, deathly pale. If I had to describe it, your movements only slowed down. Seeing you like this, Tenna found it even stranger. In the end, he couldn't help but grab your hand. His voice was still cold, but there was still a hint of urgency and worry about you, making his words sound a bit strange now.
"Stop eating. What's wrong with you?" He wanted to show some concern for you, but even when it came to his lips, he only managed to say those words. At least it showed he cared for you, right? That's what he was thinking, and you looked pale, only smiling. You wanted to open your mouth and say something...... But you couldn't speak. The nausea and pain building up inside you were suddenly at odds. In the end, you couldn't help but lean on the table, tilt your head to the side, and with a loud "wah," you spit it out.
You kept vomiting, feeling a burning sensation in your throat and mouth, probably a bit of acid reflux...... Immediately after, all you felt was an indescribable bitterness in your mouth, and only after you poured everything out of your stomach did you feel much better. Then you sat up straight again, pale-faced, your body swaying, while Tenna just looked at you with a strange expression, because his screen was pitch black now, and you couldn't tell what he was feeling. In the end, you could only force yourself to say, "Sorry...... I—I'm sorry, I just threw up everything and dirtied your floor. I'm really sorry, but I can help clean it......" As you spoke, you grabbed the tissues on the table, wanting to squat down to deal with the vomit, but Tenna just took a deep breath and grabbed your wrist again: "It's fine, is the steak just not to your taste? You threw up everything." His voice was still fairly calm, though he felt like his body was overheating again—he was just constantly warning himself not to argue with you, that there was no need to argue with someone who was sick, and that's what he told himself.
“…… It's not like that, I just don't want to eat." You slowly shook your head, trying to organize your sentence, and in the end just told Tenna about it. In fact...... You know that when you're feeling really bad, you throw up all the food you eat, but you think your current emotional state should be pretty good. You don't even know why you've become like this, so you feel ashamed.
"I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...... I ruined the lunch you prepared......
TBC.

title: Important Thing 3 (dntx you)
content:
He only felt his antenna jumping, as if electric currents were running wildly throughout his body. He only knew he was overheating—in fact, Tenna just felt his body was probably a bit too hot. Of course, there was a reason for being too hot. Hearing what you said made him even angrier, a feeling he couldn't describe. He didn't know what had happened to you all these years, why you ended up like this. He also wanted to know what had happened to you over the years, even though those things didn't matter to him.
But he cares about you, so those things are exactly what he needs to know. And now, he's just holding your hand, holding you down as you squat down to wipe the floor. His tone is harsh, his face unpleasant, his screen dark, not letting you see his screen, and his tone is only a bit eerie: "I didn't let you do this kind of work. It's not like I'm short on people here. If you want to work that much, why not serve me?" Of course, his tone carried a hint of sarcasm, and you stared blankly at Tenna and asked blankly, "Is that really okay?" How am I supposed to serve you? "This is probably your habit over the years. You subconsciously think that if someone treats you a little better, you should repay them double...... Even if you don't want to do that, everyone tells you it's the right thing to do. Your parents tell you you should repay their kindness in raising you, your teachers tell you to be grateful, your friends tell you to repay the kindness they have given you.
“…… Eat me well. That counts as taking good care of me." Tenna snorted coldly. He hadn't expected you to actually respond, and his tone grew even more fierce, because his mood was clearly worse now. He really couldn't imagine that such a confident girl from before had become like this. He was clearly just saying things out of anger, but you didn't understand, which made Tenna even angrier.
You stammered, not daring to look up at him, just repeating, "Sorry, I really can't eat, so I wasted your good intentions......
Tenna took another deep breath, trying to calm herself down a bit. He looked at the plate of pasta left on the table, frowned, and finally used a fork to roll up a few pieces and brought them to your mouth, his tone cold and stiff: "Eat." ”
You shivered, but still followed Tenna's instructions, carefully swallowing the pasta. You chewed, then swallowed. Then your face turned pale again, because you almost wanted to spit it out again...... But seeing Tenna sitting opposite you with a dark, gloomy screen made you feel a bit uneasy. You didn't dare spit out what was in your mouth, even though what you had just swallowed was now mixed with the sour liquid in your stomach and returned to your mouth. So you just sat there. Tenna brought the fork back to your mouth, but you just shook your head and gave Tenna a pale smile, as if telling you you'd be fine in a while.
“…… Spit out what's in your mouth." Tenna was truly speechless. He didn't even know why you endured such things, endured things that would make you feel painful. Even if it seemed you couldn't endure even a bit longer, you would still endure it.
You didn't dare disobey his orders, so you leaned against the table and tilted your head to the side, vomiting out everything in your mouth. No one had come to deal with the vomit on the floor, so you felt a bit uneasy. Tenna looked at you like this and felt a headache coming on. Obviously, whenever you're in a bad mood, you can't eat anything, and even if you do, you'll vomit it out...... No matter how you feel, even if he hypnotizes you, it won't make your mood better. So thinking about this, he actually feels a bit irritated again. He put down his fork again. He wasn't sure if his words would make you feel better, but he could only do that. He remembered those employees really liked hearing him speak, so maybe it was useful.
“…… Hey, I really don't understand why you're in such a bad mood. How about this: let me help you relax, how about that?" He hesitated for a moment before saying this. You looked up at him in confusion, and Tenna gave that standard smile of eight teeth, pulling out a kitchen knife stained with blood—was it freshly coagulated blood, or bright red with the taste of rust.
"Let's play a game. I'll be chasing after you, and your mission is to run forward. How about that?" Maybe letting the sadness in your heart be replaced by other emotions might help—at least that's what Tenna thought. Whether it actually works or not, he wasn't really sure. Anyway, when he appeared in front of the employees like this, he just felt that those people were much more efficient, and he was quite satisfied.
But you just stared blankly at Tenna, then closed your eyes. You exposed your snow-white neck to him, your voice soft and crisp: "No need, I already know my fate. Tenna, just put the knife down and snap it, and it's over." You even felt a bit of longing, you longed for the end of death—but at this moment, you forgot something: Tenna's face darkened, his smile fading away, and he also put away the knife. His hand gently gripped your neck. If he wanted, he could snap your neck in the next second. Of course, he wouldn't do that. His tone only grew more sinister at this moment: "I told you, don't die in front of me." ”
You nervously opened your eyes again, then nodded. Tenna also turned on the screen, sizing you up, and finally just snorted coldly: "Anyway, no matter what, you have to finish this meal today. I don't want you to starve in front of me. Besides, you're dirty too—how many days have you been without a shower? I'm afraid your little arms and legs will break at the slightest movement. Eat something, or you won't be able to run back." As he spoke, he again showed a blank expression and pulled out that knife. You instinctively wanted to say he could do anything, but before the words could come out, you remembered, he said you shouldn't die in front of him, so...... So you really need to eat something to be able to run, right?
You didn't say anything, just propped yourself up on the chair, staring blankly at the plate of pasta on the table. Tenna just rolled up a spoonful of pasta with her fork and brought it to your mouth. Your mood was still bad, but at least you remembered—you couldn't die in front of him...... If you didn't eat, you know, your body was weak right now. He wouldn't even need to chase after you. If he just threw that knife in front of you, you'd faint immediately.
So in the end, you opened your mouth and ate that mouthful of pasta. Maybe it was because your emotions had at least calmed down a bit. Although your body still felt a bit uncomfortable, your stomach still ached, and you didn't feel much nausea. You just took one bite and then stopped wanting to eat—that kind of calm, almost like you were full...... Even though you knew you weren't really full, and your face was still a bit pale, you didn't spit it out. Tenna looked at you and looked at you, seemingly finally able to eat. He snorted coldly. Now he was a bit more satisfied, but seeing you like this, if he didn't watch, you probably wouldn't eat anything. So from now on, he could only stay by your side. Logically, he should have felt unhappy, but in reality...... He actually felt quite satisfied with the result, at least which meant he was indeed important to you, and that he was still a useful TV. Although he didn't need others to accept this, it was undeniable and somewhat sad that at this moment, he did have this thought.
In the end, he just rolled up another fork of pasta and held it to your mouth. He said nothing, and you obediently opened your mouth and ate the pasta. As you chewed, your stomach, which had been hungry for so long, started working again. The dizziness caused by low blood sugar in your mind vanished, and at least you felt a bit better—probably because of eating, and your mood improved a bit. Tenna looked at you now, barely satisfied. He just snorted coldly, then shoved the fork into your hand. His tone remained icy, but now you were somewhat used to him speaking like this: "Alright, you eat by yourself from now on." ”
You silently twirled the pasta on your fork and brought it to your mouth in small bites, while tenna sat across from you, arms crossed, watching you, probably thinking about something, though he didn’t say a word. He just stared at your movements, and you had no idea how much time had passed. In any case, you ate very slowly, and finally managed to finish the entire plate of pasta. Only then did Tenna lift his TV-like head, and then casually summoned a pippins to clean up the vomit left on the floor. He glanced at the time, then gave you an order: 'It’s already past three in the afternoon. You should go out for a walk.' His tone carried an air of authority that left no room for doubt. You hesitated for a moment, and finally just shook your head softly and said, 'I don’t want to go anywhere... tenna, can’t I just stay here in your room?'
You're really, really tired of a monotonous life.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 4 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna paused. To be honest, he was very moved when he heard you say that—but, but, but, if he lets you stay here, if he doesn't order you, he'll just watch you wither or even die right before his eyes—that's not what he wants to see, that's not what he wants to happen. So at this moment, he stands up, looks down at you from above, and repeats it as if commanding: "No, you must leave. My room can't stay here forever. This is my room—how can you possibly take it for yourself?" As he finished speaking, his tone rose two more notches, but it still sounded icy. Actually, his voice didn't rise or fall much.
You stared at him blankly, saying nothing for a while. Maybe you just didn't know what to say...... Tenna looked at you, and he frowned again. Clearly, he wasn't happy, and he didn't know what else to say to you. It seemed you probably wouldn't agree to go out no matter what—he walked back to you, half-crouched, and looked straight at you. You looked at him with a puzzled expression, and Tenna just said coldly, "Look at me." "You don't even know what he's trying to do. You just follow his instructions and look at his screen. At first, his screen goes pitch black, then immediately after, black-and-white circles appear on his screen again. You always feel those circles look familiar, but then the vortex starts spinning, and for a moment, you can't think of anything else. You just stare blankly at the vortex until you completely lose consciousness, until you look even more dazed in Tenna's eyes."
You just stared at him like that, then blankly asked, "Tenna, is there something you need?" ”
Tenna looked at you. It was obvious that the hypnosis was already working, so he continued to order you: "Now, get up and take a stroll outside." ”
And you just shook your head: "...... But I don't want to go out, Tenna." In that instant, that melancholy and a hint of timidity appeared on your face again. Tenna suddenly realized that things might not be so simple. Maybe you have your reasons for not wanting to go out...... Even though he didn't know what the reason was.
"Why?" But after thinking it over, he finally just asked about the three words 'you'—pure, just a bit curious—of course, more than that, he was concerned about you, and of course, he just wanted to know why you wouldn't go out.
"Get out...... Yes. There will be people, a joke...... My, and I, I, going out is very dangerous...... You stammered, your brows furrowing. Obviously, you didn't want to say it out loud, but...... You still, under the influence of hypnosis, voiced what was on your mind.
“…… You always have to tell me the truth, do you understand, Y/N, you can't lie to me? So, do you really think that? "Tenna held your shoulder, and you frantically gestured and waved your hands wildly, your cheeks flushed a little, as if trying to make Tenna believe your words were true.
"Of course, of course it's true! Tenna means a lot to me, so I won't lie to her...... "You just shake your head, your face full of seriousness, and you just want Tenna to believe what you say. Tenna looks at your expression seriously, confirming you're not lying, and you truly believe it. He takes a deep breath, feeling that talking to you seems troublesome—he seems to have accidentally gotten into a mess, but well, he's willing. He doesn't want to just watch you die."
"Hmm, how could anyone laugh at you? No one would ever notice you, right? You're not some important person." Tenna said casually, but for some reason, your eyes actually grew redder. You just lowered your head in disappointment and shook it.
"There will be, I'm very conspicuous right now...... I... I'm really ugly, right? I'm ...... It's been a long time since I took good care of myself, so I must be ugly now. Once I go out, everyone will notice me. Besides, I wasn't good to begin with, so people would dislike me even more. Even if I don't say it on the surface, once they see me, they'll probably talk about me in private. I... I don't know. Maybe everyone will dislike me if they see me. Do you hate me? You definitely hate me too...... After all, I'm so annoying...... As you spoke, your head kept lowering, and your mood gradually sank. You really didn't dare to look up, not wanting to hear the answer you didn't even need to hear.
Tenna looked at you irritably. To be honest, he really didn't understand why you thought that way. Of course, he didn't dislike you at all, even though you were like this now—he was also irritated. He didn't know what to say for you to believe him. Of course, maybe he needed to say something more, but...... He didn't want to say that sentence. He didn't want to say it, even though no one would hear it. But what if, what if you remembered?
Tenna looked at you, irritably, tugged at his antenna, and finally grabbed your face with both hands. He was really a bit too strong, and you were a bit dazed, just staring blankly at Tenna. His hand grabbed the soft flesh on your cheek, making your cheeks a bit distorted. He looked at you, finally clicked his tongue lightly, and eased his grip, just cupping your face. He looked at you coldly: "I'm very important to you, right? So I absolutely won't hate you." ”
“…… No matter what happens, no matter how much time passes? You, are you sure it will definitely be like this...... As you spoke, your voice trembled a little, light and light, as if you couldn't believe it.
"Yes, I'm sure I will. I won't dislike you. Is that enough?" Although he always felt that speaking like that was a bit strange, Tenna didn't comment further. He simply let go of your hand from your face and instead grabbed it, looking at you calmly. You stared up at him in a daze, and only then did Tenna realize that you had started crying loudly without her noticing, and your eyes were red...... Obviously, although no sound came out, you had just cried your heart out. Tenna really didn't understand why you were crying so hard, nor why no sound came out when you were. Normally, anyone would cry loudly, but you didn't make a single sound.
And now, you only show a smile, even though your cheeks are still covered in tears, even though ...... Even though you are still crying, at this moment, that smile reveals a kind of pure beauty. You hug Tenna, bury your head in his shoulder, your tears soaking the clothes on his shoulder. Tenna's body stiffens for a moment, but in the end, he doesn't push you away. He just slowly places his hand on you. Only then does he hear your extremely faint crying. But at this moment, you weren't crying out of sadness; instead, you seemed to be a little joyful. Tenna listened to you and softly said, "Thank you, I knew it...... You really mean a lot to me." ”
…… He wants to argue that you're not like that, but it's just a hint he planted in you, just to make things easier for him, to control you, to keep you from dying...... But in the end, he didn't bother to explain much. If you think so, then so be it—it won't do him any harm anyway.
He just changed the subject and asked you another question: "So, why do you think going out alone is dangerous? Are you even afraid to go out alone? Then how dare you come to me?" Although he was the one who forcibly dragged you over...... But that didn't stop him from righteously confronting you about this matter.
"Because...... Tenna is very important to me, and Tenna doesn't dislike me, so I feel that getting close to you won't be dangerous. Outside...... There are too many messy people outside, and someone might be following me. I find it scary. There used to be people who always followed me around...... As you spoke, you started trembling again, your body starting to shake. Although there was no danger now, you instinctively recalled it, and your face turned pale, as if you had fallen into the crisis of that time again......
Tenna had to grab your shoulder. A vortex-like pattern once again appeared on his screen, and he said coldly, "Look at me. You have to understand, with me by your side, you'll be safe, with no danger at all. You have to trust me. You'll feel, believing in Tenna is a wonderful thing, understand?" By the end, his tone slowly softened again. Looking at your blank expression, he just hoped you would remember these things.
“…… "Well, I believe you, Tenna." You nodded blankly and smiled at Tenna.
"Alright, since it's not dangerous, just come out with me," even though that's the case, maybe from now on you'll have to go out with him—but he was still satisfied with the outcome, so he continued, "If you find yourself annoying, I'll help you tidy it up. I think it's beautiful, and no one dares to object. Is that okay?" ”
TBC.

title: Important Thing 5 (dntx you)
content:
Your body shrank slightly. Perhaps you weren't prepared either, and at this moment, you just looked at Tenna timidly and anxiously, quietly asking, "Really...... Is that okay? ”
Tenna irritably scratched the antenna again, clicking his tongue: "There aren't that many questions. If I say it's okay, then it's fine. Alright, now I'll help you clean up yourself." As he said this, he snapped his fingers to wake you up from this hypnotic state. You reacted dizzily for a while, but finally you were awake. Your earlier memories seemed to have gone blank again, but seeing Tenna showing no other reaction, you thought, maybe nothing major has happened. So you felt relieved, just looking at Tenna obediently with a hint of confusion.
And he just gave you the order: "Alright, come out with me later. For now, I'll help you get yourself in order." He said this, looking down at you from above, and you just nodded blankly. For some reason, you always felt like going out with him would be safe, and ...... Probably no one would laugh at you anymore—at least that's what you think, so...... So you just nodded in agreement, then quietly looked up at Tenna, probably waiting for his next move. Tenna coughed twice, and seeing you like this, he still felt a bit embarrassed...... Well, okay, maybe it's just that I feel a bit embarrassed thinking about what might happen next.
At that moment, he waved his hand, pointing toward the bathroom, and gave you another command: "Alright, go now, take a good shower. I think you still know how to shower, right? You don't need me to help you, do you?" His tone ended with a hint of mockery. He crossed his arms and looked at you. Although it wasn't impossible, there were still some gender distinctions, so he wouldn't just take you to help you bathe.
“…… Can I skip the shower?" You just whispered that, but in fact, you have no motivation to do anything, so what Tenna said now meant to you...... It couldn't spark even a hint of interest in you, you ...... You just felt that it was too tiring. No matter what you did, you felt too tired. If it weren't for Tenna's request, if you didn't think going out with him would be safe, you wouldn't even want to go out. In fact, you simply don't have the strength to muster the energy to walk even a single step.
"Why?" Don't you want to go out with me? Tenna stood with her hands on her hips, looking at you. Of course, he saw the conflict on your face, but because of that, he couldn't quite understand what you were thinking.
“…… I—I don't want to move, I feel tired. I'm sorry, Tenna, maybe I've made you expect you for nothing." You whispered, truly...... Honestly, you don't want to move at all, that's all. You sit there dejected, thinking, Tenna must be disappointed in you, after all, you're just such a useless person...... You don't even know why you care about Tenna's opinion, but it seems you do care a lot, probably because Tenna is very important to you, so...... You actually worry that he might leave a slightly negative impression of you.
Tenna smacked her lips irritably, then looked at your body and trembled, probably thinking Tenna was angry. In fact, although he felt irritated, he hadn't thought about ignoring her—even though he really felt the urge to act recklessly, but...... He didn't think ignoring you was a good choice; he couldn't just stand by and watch you die.
“…… Do you really not want to move yourself?" But just in case, he asked again, because he had already thought of a solution, but felt you probably wouldn't accept it, so he decided to ask for your opinion once more.
"Mm, I don't want to move at all." You murmured, your voice very soft. If it weren't for the quiet room, Tenna really wouldn't have heard you. He looked you up and down again, smacking his lips irritably. Then he stepped forward, straddled your legs, and hugged you, then pulled you into his arms. You were a bit confused, but instinctively, to prevent yourself from falling, you still hugged Tenna's neck tightly. Your pupils instinctively dilated, and you stammered, "Tenna, what are you doing?" ”
He simply answered your question succinctly: "I'll take you to take a shower." With that, he carried you toward the bathroom. He led you into the bathroom, then placed you on a seat nearby. Immediately, he turned on the bathtub faucet, and soon the tub was filled with water. You cautiously looked up at Tenna, not knowing what he was up to. Then Tenna grabbed you and threw you into the tub. A large amount of water gushed out, soaking his clothes as well. Tenna irritably took off his suit jacket. Fortunately, his clothes weren't soaked, while you sat dazed in the tub. Your clothes were soaked and clinging to you, with a translucent, faint feeling. Tenna slightly looked away, stiffly grabbed the shower gel from the shelf nearby, and tossed it to you.
"Take off your clothes yourself, then apply the shower gel." He ordered you like this, but for a while, he didn't hear any sound. Tenna had to turn to check on you, and then he found you still sitting motionless in the bathtub.
Tenna felt the wires all over his body buzzing and rushing through the currents again, and his body felt overheated again—oh my god, why is it so hard for you to do something?! He was completely confused about you, only able to give you a sinister smile and lower his voice: "Do you want me to help you take off your clothes?" ”
You just shook your head. You really didn't think that way...... But you've been wearing this outfit for a long time, haven't taken it off for a long time, so at this moment, your brain seems to be short-circuiting, and you can't even figure out how to take off your clothes!
So in the end, you just stammered, "...... I—I didn't think that way, but I forgot, forgot how to take off this dress. I'm sorry......" As you spoke, your head kept sinking lower. You always felt this was something very sorry, even though ...... Even though it seemed like it wasn't something to feel very sorry for, you still instinctively apologized.
Tenna clicked his tongue irritably. He hadn't expected you to forget something like this—it was truly unbelievable—so unbelievable that he couldn't help but sneer a few times.
"What, have you really forgotten everything? Are you trying to make me strip off your clothes?" He no longer cared about how you looked now, nor about your half-covered state. After all, all he had left was anger.
“…… It's not like that, but I really can't remember, and besides, I don't want to take off this outfit." You hesitated, just lowered your head and hugged your knees. In fact, you do feel that wearing clothes is the only way to feel safe...... Even if you were alone, you wouldn't want to take off your clothes, because ...... Because that's how you feel safe, that way you can protect yourself. It's as if something is always watching you.
"I think you should go check your brain," Tenna sneered, tapping her own head with her finger. "Let's see which part of your brain made a mistake." ”
But you nodded seriously: "Yes, right, I know...... I must have something wrong with my brain. After all, I've already become like this now." As you spoke, your voice grew quieter and lower. It's something you don't want to admit but have to admit.
"......" Tenna completely didn't want to talk to you anymore. He really didn't understand what you were thinking, so he just kept a cold face—or rather, he kept the corners of his mouth curved downward. Then he stepped forward, bent down, roughly yanked off your clothes, and tore your wet clothes apart. You instinctively widened your eyes and hugged yourself, because you felt very unsafe now, and your body was trembling. Of course, Tenna wasn't in the mood to admire your body. He just picked up the bottle of shower gel that had fallen into the tub nearby and poured it directly onto you. You looked at Tenna in confusion. He simply turned off his screen and smeared all the body wash on your body. His movements weren't gentle, and probably to avoid suspicion, he didn't look carefully. He just carelessly smeared the shower gel on your body, even a bit roughly. At least you saw your skin turning red.
All you can do is blink and watch Tenna's actions. He randomly smears the shower gel onto your body, rubs it open, and soon the bathtub is covered in white foam, covering your body. Only then does Tenna grab your hair, wet it with water, then pull up a chair and sit at the back of the tub—he's already given up on letting you shower yourself, or maybe he'll help you out. So now he's ready to apply shampoo to your hair. You obediently lean against the edge of the tub, waiting for Tenna's next move.
"Alright, I'll help you wash up. From now on, you can't say you'll be annoying when you go out. Let's see who dares say something like that." Tenna just snorted coldly.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 6 (dntx you)
content:
You just responded awkwardly, since you didn't know what you were supposed to say right now. So you just lowered your head, hugged your knees, and quietly sank into the bathtub, leaving only your head exposed. Tenna snorted coldly and poured a lot of shampoo on your hair—he bought it on the spot when he saw you today, and the shower gel too. After all, at first glance, you looked sloppy and didn't look like a proper person at all. So he had already decided to make sure you take good care of yourself. Considering you probably wouldn't prepare any of these things yourself, he prepared them for you as well.
But he had never washed his hair, and certainly never washed someone's hair. He just poured shampoo on it and rubbed it hard a few times. Before long, his hair was covered in foam. He rubbed vigorously, since what he wanted now was to make you cleaner. Your body trembled involuntarily, and he seemed to hear your suppressed muffled groan. Tenna stopped what he was doing. He didn't quite understand what was wrong with you, so he simply asked directly, "What's wrong with you?" ”
“…… It hurts, tenna, my scalp hurts...... Tenna, can you be gentle...... "Your voice is very faint. If it weren't for the quiet room and Tenna listening carefully to what you said, he would have almost lost his understanding of what you were saying."
But now he heard clearly. He was silent for a moment, then snorted coldly: "If it hurts, why didn't you tell me earlier? Why don't you tell me now?" It's already too late. "Even as he said this, his hand movements were still a bit gentler. At this moment, he was just gently rubbing your hair, and soon, he no longer heard your sounds. The whole bathroom was filled only with the faint sound of foam rubbing between your hair." Only now did Tenna nod in satisfaction; it seemed she was basically ready...... He refilled the hot water, soaked your hair in a small basin, carefully rinsed off the foam on top, then poured out the water and refilled it, carefully washing your hair thoroughly. At least he could confirm that all he saw now was shiny, smooth black hair. Only then did he finally pour out the water and let your hair fall on you, while you remained motionless during the process...... Tenna casually grabbed a towel from the side and tossed it to you, saying succinctly, "You wash yourself." ”
However, you didn't take the towel, nor did you make any moves. You just quietly sat in the bathtub with your legs hugged. Tenna raised an eyebrow. He now felt his body was a bit overheated again—hmm, it seemed that keeping you by his side all the time was actually quite useful, at least it kept him running and didn't age. Tenna thought coldly, although he thought it might not be appropriate, and there were still some gender differences among them—though the Dark People generally don't distinguish between genders, at least he was Mr. Tenna! But now, he had no other choice, after all...... After all, where could he find a girl to bathe you at this time? The few people from the Happy Gang usually don't come to Castle Town.
So in the end, he just kept a cold face and picked up the towel again. He shifted his position and sat down on the side of the bathtub, then grabbed your hand. After all, he wanted to test it again: "Use your hand, grab this towel, and then wipe it on your body. You'll probably do that kind of thing, right?" He thought he was quite patient when talking to you, though his tone still carried a hint of impatience. And you really did shrank back, your face unconsciously showing a look of fear and anxiety. Tenna couldn't wait any longer, just clicked his tongue lightly, then picked up the towel. At least for now, he was still turning off his screen. He was just randomly wiping your skin with the towel. He couldn't see clearly, but the sensation in his hand was still clear. Fortunately, at least there was still a towel through the air...... His movements were a bit rough, but at least he hurt you. At first, you didn't dare to speak, but then you thought...... What Tenna just said to you, you suddenly felt like it wouldn't matter if you complained to him a little. So in the end, after quite a while, you finally mustered up the courage. You thought you had finally mustered the greatest courage of your life so far—you said, "Tenna, tenna, your movement hurts, can you be a little gentler......"
"Yeah, remember to say it earlier next time. This is almost over." Tenna said casually, not daring to wipe your sensitive parts, so in the end, he just washed a couple of times and was done. Of course, his movements softened considerably because of your words. You blinked. At first, you thought that if you said something, if you went against his opinion, he would probably be very angry...... But it seemed there wasn't really much? Maybe, maybe...... What could I have told him more? Maybe nothing terrible would happen. Thinking about it, those terrible guesses probably never came true in the end. That way, you could finally relax. Probably...... It's not completely reassuring; at least you can relax a little more.
Tenna drained the water from the tub, refilled it with clean water, and washed off all the remaining shower gel on you. Finally, he pulled you out of the tub, grabbed a large towel from the shelf nearby, and tossed it to you: "Dry yourself. You do things like this someday, right?" His tone was light as he spoke, crossing his arms and looking at you. You stood there blankly, clutching the big towel with both hands, but still didn't do anything. Yes, it seems you don't have the energy to do anything else now...... Just after that meal, it felt like you had exhausted all your strength for the day, so you only whispered softly, lowering your voice: "Tenna, tenna, I...... I'm exhausted...... Even holding onto this towel took a lot of your strength, or rather, willpower, to keep yourself from throwing it on the floor right now. Tenna turned the screen back on and looked at you. He just felt irritable—he didn't understand why you couldn't even do this little thing now. But he could only endure the overheating sensation, wrapped the towel around your body, tied a knot, then picked up another towel nearby and began carefully drying your hair. Of course, he softened his movements a bit so it wouldn't hurt you. Then he pinned your hair up, since your hair was just too long. He glanced at you, then simply picked you up again. You curled up in his arms, probably still a bit foggy, and then Tenna put you back on the bed. He opened the wardrobe and took a look. It was full of his clothes, but nothing suitable for you—well, after all, he hadn't bought you any clothes in particular. He casually pulled out a shirt from it, probably wearing it at some point, then draped it over you, covering your body, and finally untied the towel and tossed it aside. The shirt was too big, covering you completely, and you were still a bit dazed, just pulling it down a little. Immediately after, you heard Tenna's slightly mocking voice.
"Oh, you still know how to move? I almost thought you were dead." As he said this, he buttoned up your shirt. Although it was on you now, the shirt looked almost like a cape, in the end, Tenna just carried you out of the bedroom and laid you on the sofa. He took out the hair dryer he had bought when buying shampoo, then grabbed your hair and, rather unskillfully, started drying it for you. He wasn't used to this, so at first he blew all his hair over your face, and you silently sat on the sofa wearing that oversized shirt. Tenna grabbed your hair, trying to use a bit of force to avoid you crying out in pain later. He kept blowing along your hair, the hair dryer running on hot air, pressed tightly against your scalp, while Tenna continued blowing on your hair in this direction.
You had no choice but to speak up: "Tenna, tenna, can you move the hairdryer a bit farther away...... It's so hot." The sound of the hairdryer was too loud. Although he realized you were talking, he couldn't really grasp what you were saying, so in the end he turned off the exhaust fan, his voice still stiff: "What are you talking about?" ”
Your body instinctively shrank back, but you still repeated what you just said, though your voice was much quieter now.
“…… "Oh," Tenna responded. In his senses, the temperature wasn't too hot—it was even a bit lower than his usual body. But since you said that, he had no choice but to hold the hairdryer a bit farther away. Accompanied by the wind whistling through the hairdryer, his remaining half of his mumbling words were swept into the wind, "So delicate." ”
You sat quietly there. Even though you didn't hear clearly, you felt it probably wasn't a good thing. But since you didn't hear clearly, you might as well pretend you didn't hear it...... After all, after all, more important than words, his actions are more important, after all...... Yes, that's exactly what you think.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 7 (dntx you)
content:
You sat dazed on the sofa, just gently tugging at your clothes. Honestly, honestly...... You really don't like this kind of thing. Being in someone else's home, having someone take care of you, no matter what, makes you feel awkward and embarrassed. But, but...... Staying here, by Tenna's side, you only feel very safe. Maybe it's because he really is very important to you. That's what you think.
…… So, so, right now, at this very moment, you sit here, slowly close your eyes, thinking, maybe...... Maybe, even if you fall asleep right now, it wouldn't matter.
But now Tenna's movements had stopped. He let go, and the sound of the hairdryer stopped, replaced by his impatient voice: "Alright, go change your clothes now, then come out with me. You can't expect me to help you change clothes, can you?" ”
You didn't make a sound, you didn't answer him, just gently hugged your knees and sat there, then shook your head...... Oh my god, you really are still so sad, so anxious that you simply have no strength left to do anything.
Tenna stood behind you. Although he couldn't see exactly what your expression was, he could see your head shaking. He irritably tugged at his antenna and finally walked out of the room, slamming the door shut with him. You stared blankly at the door that had just made a loud noise, then lowered your head bitterly. Just as I thought...... He will eventually dislike you, right? Thinking about it this way, you realize that to anyone, you are insignificant, irreplaceable, and you feel a bit gloomy, but your mood grows even more bitter, tinged with a bitterness, as if your heart is being gripped. You, you—maybe, maybe...... But, frustrating, you must be feeling frustrated. Even though you comfort yourself like this, you just lower your head, burying your head between your legs, hugging yourself tightly, letting tears slide down your cheeks.
Immediately after, you hear another loud bang at the door. You look up and see Tenna walk in holding a dress—in fact, Tenna had just gone out to get clothes...... He casually took one out of your wardrobe and looked at it. Fortunately, although those clothes smelled a bit from being stored for too long, they didn't smell particularly bad or moldy. At that moment, Tenna strode up to you. Of course, he saw the sliding marks on your face. He clicked his tongue lightly, not understanding why you were crying again. He just half-squatted down and casually wiped the tears from your cheeks with his hand. You heard his tone a bit stiff, or maybe he didn't seem in a great mood, but overall, he seemed a bit patient: "Why are you crying again? I really don't understand you...... Forget it, if you want to cry, then cry." Tenna said, handing you the outfit she was holding: "Here, can you change yourself?" Anyway, at least put on your underwear. "He just spent ages searching for you to get all the clothes, and naturally, during this process, he overheated himself—he hadn't expected that he, once a dignified lord of the Dark World, would now do something like this.
You took the clothes from his hands. Although you really didn't have much strength left, forcing yourself to put on two sets of underwear wasn't difficult. So you started changing clothes right in front of Tenna—Tenna suddenly shut down her screen and then turned around, her voice tinged with frustration: "Who gave you permission to do this? At least say it first?! Didn't I ever tell you you could change clothes freely in front of me?! ”
“…… I'm sorry, Tenna." You reacted half a step too slowly, a bit sluggish to give him that reply. Tenna took a few deep breaths to calm herself, thinking, maybe you really aren't paying much attention to this matter either, and right now, you probably don't have the energy to pay attention to it either, so he'll reluctantly forgive you this once.
"I didn't ask you to apologize. Alright, I'll put on the rest of the clothes for you." After calming himself, he turned to look at you again, hmm...... Of course, he saw that you were wearing nothing but those two underwears, your fair skin, which looked unusual from long exposure to sunlight, exposed right in front of him. Tenna felt like her body was overheating again, and you were just like that...... She looked at him with innocent, innocent eyes. To be honest, Tenna hadn't expected you to be so clueless. Helpless, he put the pure white dress he had just taken out from the wardrobe onto you, then obediently lowered your head and let Tenna tidy your clothes. He zipped up the back of you and picked you up so the dress would fit you perfectly. Now, you were dressed properly. He just sat there motionless. Tenna glanced at you twice, then finally took out a silver brooch from the nearby drawer, which was a bit larger than the TV's, and pinned it to your chest.
"Now everyone will know you're mine, so no one dares to say anything to you, understand?" As he spoke, he patted your shoulder, and you tilted your head obediently in return.
"So, now, get up, go outside, and take a walk around, okay?" Although he still spoke in a commanding tone, Tenna still slightly awkwardly softened his tone. He knew you probably weren't used to the way he spoke, even though he thought it didn't matter, as long as you could listen—but maybe he had to admit, when he looked at you, he couldn't say such harsh words, even though he didn't think his words sounded particularly bad, but...... However, he noticed you trembling occasionally, so for your sake, he softened his voice a little. He really didn't want to see you so afraid of him.
"I don't want to go out, I...... If you leave Tenna, it will definitely be dangerous outside, right?" You murmured like this, your body instinctively curling back up. You curled up again into a curled up on the sofa. Tenna clicked his tongue lightly, roughly grabbed your wrist, and led you away from the sofa. Then you stumbled to your feet, only to fall forward into Tenna's embrace. Tenna placed both hands on your shoulders to help you stand steadily, though for a moment he missed the soft feeling of you just throwing yourself into his embrace...... But what mattered more now was to let you live just like a normal person.
"Then I'll go out with you. How about that? You can walk, right?" Tenna said, grabbing your wrist and looking down at you from above. You just shook your head, as if denying Tenna's words. You just, just...... Your legs felt weak, so you fell back into Tenna's arms once again.
"I, I think I'm ...... Sorry, Tenna, I caused you trouble...... You just instinctively started apologizing with a heavy sense of apology. Tenna irritably grabbed the antenna and tugged at it, feeling a bit annoyed to hear that word from you, because in his dictionary, those three words never exist.
"It's okay, don't apologize. What I need isn't your apology. Alright, I'll just carry you out of my arms." After saying that, Tenna immediately wrapped her arms around your waist, letting you sit on his arm. You instinctively cried out, your hands tightly wrapped around Tenna's neck, while your body was pressed against Tenna's chest. You turned your head and saw Tenna's screen—it was pitch black, very obvious...... He still seemed to be in a bad mood, and all you heard was that low, somewhat cold voice: "Say more thanks, say less sorry. What I need is not your apology." "He actually didn't like this very much...... But now, he had no other choice.
You can't see how his face looks now, because he's turned off the screen, so you can only lower your voice and whisper: "...... Alright, thank you, Tenna, really, thank you very much. ”
"If you're truly grateful to me, then do something to repay me. I don't want a casual word." Actually, Tenna had just thought that if she could boost her spirits a bit, if she could eat properly, go out properly, interact with people, and live well, that would be enough. But she didn't expect that after a while, you hesitated and kissed Tenna on the screen—in fact, you had just been thinking that from what you had learned before, guys seemed to like intimacy with girls, and you couldn't offer Tenna anything else, so just one kiss was probably appropriate.
Tenna was stunned. He felt his body overheating again. Oh my god, oh my god—he didn't mean you to do that? Although he did think about some dirty things, it was obvious, you—oh my god, oh my god...... Tenna was still dark on the screen, because now he knew his screen was definitely hot and red, and he didn't intend for you to see it. He just asked gruffly, "What are you doing? Who told you to do this?" ”
You were startled. It was the first time you'd heard Tenna speak like that, so instinctively you shrank your neck and hid in Tenna's arms. You stammered, "I—I thought you'd like ...... like this."
TBC.

title: Important Thing 8 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna was stunned. He really didn't know how you understood this, and he also felt a sense of crisis. If you treated others the same way, if others said they liked it—then you'd be far too defenseless. Luckily, the person was him, because he definitely wouldn't harm you. To be honest, he really hoped you could act this way, and he did like you a little.
“…… "Besides me, you're not allowed to do this to anyone else, understand?" In the end, Tenna didn't comment on your behavior. He just said this with a somewhat warning tone. You looked a bit confused but nodded, and you think about it, besides him, you probably wouldn't know anyone else...... But you were still a bit unhappy because of his intense reaction just now, so in the end, you just curled up in his arms without making any other sound and stopped moving. Tenna glanced down at you again. What you should say but not say was what he originally ...... Forget it, at this point he didn't know what to say. He couldn't possibly say things he liked to say, but he did hope you could do it again. But now, who are you two now? You two clearly have no relationship. In the end, Tenna buried these messy thoughts in his heart again. He simply led you out of the room.
At this point, there were hardly any Dark People outside. Although strictly speaking, the Dark People probably didn't need to rest, most still followed the habits of the Light Clan and chose to settle down for now. So there weren't many people on the road at this moment. Tenna was holding you as you strode outside. You had only dared to curl up in Tenna's arms, because in your expectations, maybe many people outside would notice you. But then...... Now, there was hardly anyone around, and it was very quiet. So you dared to lift yourself slightly from his arms and look outside, even though those shops didn't really look much different to you.
Tenna held you and casually glanced around. Of course, he noticed you were a bit more relaxed at this moment, so he spoke up: "Where do you want to go and see?" ”
You couldn't help but shrink back a little. Tenna's sudden response startled you, but thinking about what had happened before, this time you still mustered up the courage and carefully whispered your opinion: "I, I...... "I was scared by you, and you suddenly spoke ......" As you spoke, you kept whispering, afraid Tenna would hear clearly. Tenna took a deep breath, telling himself many times not to lose his temper with you, because it wasn't worth it, because...... Because that would have wasted all his efforts, so in the end, he just said irritably, "Alright, I get it." His tone was also stiff, because he was never used to others bossing him around. You were the first.
“…… Thank you, Tenna," you originally wanted to say sorry, because you noticed his tone wasn't very nice, maybe a bit upset. But when the words were about to reach your lips, you changed your tune, because you remember he told you not to keep saying sorry, "Sorry for the trouble, I don't have much I want to go......" You said that, and indeed, you weren't interested in going anywhere. Tenna listened to you and turned and headed straight for the dessert shop next door. He ordered a big fruit cake, a piece of pudding, and a plate of macarons, then placed you down at the table opposite him. Soon, the desserts he ordered were brought to the table.
"Then just eat something. You've basically thrown up dinner." He said straightforwardly and matter-of-factly, digging up the plate of pudding himself, while you stared blankly at the stuff in front of you, finally just shaking your head: "I'm not hungry, but you still have to go to waste, tenna......"
"—It didn't cost much, just eat properly, don't talk." His knuckles tapped the table, you flinched for a moment, but in the end, you shut up, but looking at the things on the table, you still had no appetite; you didn't feel like eating...... You weren't hungry; the pasta you had for dinner was already enough for you. So you sat there without moving.
"What, do you want me to feed you?" Tenna raised an eyebrow, speaking with a hint of mockery. Who would have thought you actually lifted your head slightly to look at him, showing that "Is that okay?" expression, making Tenna choke up, as if his body had overheated again—oh my god, oh my god, he really had no idea what was going on with you now. He snorted heavily in annoyance, picked up a macaron, and held it to your mouth.
"Alright, eat up. It's already right at your mouth." As she spoke, Tenna lifted her chin slightly. You hesitated, but still bit down on the macaron, but only a small piece came down. Tenna thought you had bitten it, and then his hand just let go—of course. Then he watched as the large remaining macaron fell onto the table, while you just watched helplessly.
Tenna just felt like his body was getting hotter. He really couldn't figure out why he was acting like this, and he just snorted coldly, picked up the macaron, and simply ate it himself. Hmm...... For some reason, it was even sweeter, much sweeter than what he usually ate. It was just a flavor he liked more. Tenna picked up another piece from the plate, but it tasted just like usual...... Could it be because you bit into that piece just now? He was momentarily distracted, not knowing if your lips were sweet when biting down. No, now wasn't the time to think about that. He just stood up, scooped you up from the seat opposite, then you sat on top of him. Tenna held you and sat on his lap. He picked up another macaron and held it to your lips, saying succinctly, "Eat." And you obediently bit off a small bite of that macaron—just a tiny bite...... Because the macaron looked as if it hadn't been bitten before, Tenna just frowned. He held you and waited patiently, while you chewed for a while, eventually leaning in and taking another bite. Now...... It seemed like he had eaten a bit more—at least half of the macaron was already down. Tenna lost all patience and directly finished the remaining half. And as it turned out, you did take a long time to bite and then quietly say, "Tenna, this is so sweet. I feel like I'm already full...... He ordered too much. No matter what, you don't think you'll finish it yourself. Tenna glanced at the cake and the remaining macarons on the table, not realizing you had eaten so little...... Well, in the end, Tenna finished all the desserts left on the table, which were nothing to him.
"You finally got full, and with so little to eat, no wonder you're so thin." Tenna clicked his tongue, his hand circling your waist, and his fingers couldn't pinch the extra fat on your belly. That was enough to prove just how thin you really are. Healthy people have some of it. You pursed your lips and didn't say anything. Think about it, Tenna was right, and you really ...... You really are very thin, and he wasn't wrong. So in the end, you just lowered your head and didn't react much. Tenna looked at you like this, and he didn't know why you suddenly became so downcast. Even though he hadn't said anything—but, well, in the end, he just gently patted your head: "Okay, eat more from now on, got it?" ”
…… Otherwise, if you do something like that, you might not be able to handle it. Your small body definitely can't handle it. No, what exactly is he thinking? Tenna shook the TV head to dispel that thought.
"But, but I really can't eat ......" Your voice was very weak, tinged with a hint of plaintive sobbing, almost like you were laughing and sobbing. Of course, Tenna knew you weren't like that right now; you were just stating the facts. He sneered and simply picked you up.
"Alright, eat as much as you can. If you can't, just let me eat. I'm heading back." Saying that, he carried you back toward your residence. When you reached the door, he put you down and placed you at the entrance of your house.
"Go back and sleep." After saying that, Tenna turned and walked toward her own house, but you grabbed his clothes, grabbed the tail of his suit. Your voice was timid and carried a hint of unease: "But, but I can't sleep......"
"Are you a kid, afraid of the dark and afraid to sleep? Or what? You can't possibly be afraid of your bed, can you?" Tenna turned to look at you. He had never heard of anyone having trouble sleeping.
And you just shook your head and nodded, and no one knew what you meant. Tenna looked at you irritably, and you finally bit your lip and whispered, "No, that's not it, I just...... Can't sleep. ”
You will think about too many things—whether it's darkness, tomorrow, yourself, or others. These things are all within your scope of thought. So no matter what, you can't shake off the thoughts in your mind. No matter what, you have to force yourself to fall asleep at dawn, no matter what...... Your body will also be exhausted because of this, but there's nothing you can do.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 9 (dntx you)
content:
You tugged at Tenna's clothes, just lowered your head slightly, and stopped looking at him. Tenna looked at you and indeed fell silent for a moment. He ...... To be honest, he thought things were over by now, but he didn't know you would actually muster the courage to say something like that. Tenna lowered his head to look at you, unable to see the expression on your face, and could only ask coldly, "So, what do you want to do?" ”
“…… I feel very comfortable staying with Tenna, so could you let me sleep in your place...... Your voice was very low, after all, you knew this was a bit of an excessive request. You knew very well that Tenna might refuse you, and you had already prepared for that.
And sure enough, you hear Tenna's firm voice: "No." ”
…… You knew it would turn out like this, so in the end you just lowered your head and said nothing. Seeing you so pitiful, Tenna couldn't help but feel a bit irritated. He couldn't help but grab his antenna, tugged twice, and finally said gruffly, "There's only one bed in my house. If you let me sleep on it, I won't have anywhere to sleep." ”
"I can sleep on the sofa, or sleep on the floor, anything is fine. I just think it'll be easier to fall asleep that way......" You quickly added, gesturing desperately with your hands to show what you were really thinking. You don't ask for much; you just want to be under the same roof as someone you think is important. Tenna turned off the screen and looked down at you. Finally, he turned and walked toward his own home, pulling your hand away. You hung your head in disappointment, thinking this was impossible, but then you only heard Tenna's dry voice: "Do as you please." ”
You looked up, and your eyes lit up. This might be the most radiant moment in your eyes these days, and you followed Tenna's lead, but...... But after you stepped into his house, you sat straight down on the sofa. Although Tenna was in a bad mood, he really didn't want to treat you unfairly. After all, he had told himself from the start that he just didn't want to watch you die, but ...... The matter was just that simple. He didn't want to see you freezing in this weather, so he went back to his room and threw a blanket at you. His voice was still stiff, more like a command than a command, just commanding you: "Alright, go get some good sleep." ”
Then Tenna turned to leave. But you tightly grabbed the hem of Tenna's clothes, gently swaying her twice, and your voice sounded a bit pitiful: "Um, I... I can't sleep...... Tenna, can you tell me a bedtime story? ”
Seriously, are you still a kid? Do you still need to be put to sleep? Tenna really wanted to mock you like that. He remembered that when you were little, you always had to switch to the story channel and listen to stories on TV just to fall asleep. After all these years, has your habit really not changed at all? Tenna wasn't sure either, but after a moment of silence, he pulled up a chair and sat down beside the sofa. He wasn't holding any storybook in his hand; he just looked down at you, just like that. His screen turned off again. He tried to organize his words but failed, and in the end, he could only ask in that cold, hard voice: "Alright, then what story do you want to hear?" "Rarely, although it was stiff, his tone was still gentle. In fact, you were a bit surprised and prepared yourself for him to reject you."
And after thinking it over carefully, you realized you really didn't have any particular stories you wanted to hear, so you grabbed the blanket and pulled it up to your chin, revealing only those blinking, blinking eyes. You gently shook your head and said, "I—I don't really want to hear anything, so...... Just say something casually, tenna." "That said, you still look forward to the stories Tenna will tell you."
Tenna thought for a moment, then turned the screen back on, expressionlessly saying, "Once upon a time, there was a man named Alibaba who made a living by collecting fish by the sea. Although life was tough, at least the fruits of labor and labor made him happy. Until one day, a storm swept across the sea, and the waves swept Alibaba away. From then on, there was no one named Alibaba in this world again. That's the story." He casually mixed together fairy tales you had read on those TV shows before, and you blinked in disbelief.
"Is that the end of it?"
"That's it. Alright, get some good sleep." Tenna said this and got up once more to leave. He really had no talent for making up stories, and watching his back, you finally had no choice but to turn over and continue lying on the sofa. In fact, you weren't sleepy at all—in fact, you really didn't feel sleepy at all. And with Tenna gone, the room became quiet again. You lay restlessly on the sofa, feeling no sleepiness at all. You just felt more awake, and your mood involuntarily sank. You know, you're an unlikable kid, you know, you're a disgusting kid, you know, maybe Tenna will find you annoying one day...... And whenever you think about this, your heart can't help but ache. You probably don't want Tenna to dislike you, after all...... He is now the most important presence to you. After all, what you still remember is the TV that once appeared in your home.
You tossed and turned, opening your eyes in this dim room. You only became more awake, without a trace of sleepiness. Whenever you thought about the possibilities of the future, you felt very uneasy. Of course, you knew Tenna had gone into his own room to rest...... But you, and you, you never had a moment to relax, not even a moment to relax, except when you were with Tenna. You thought of Tenna again...... At this moment, you could barely see clearly in the darkness. You lifted the covers, stood up from the sofa, and decided to find Tenna. You stumbled toward Tenna's room, and then you saw someone lying on the bed, much taller than you. With the screen off, it was probably the TV viewer resting. You hesitated and eased your grip, trying not to make a sound. You climbed onto his bed. His arms felt heavy to you, but you still pulled his arm onto you, nestled into his warm embrace. At that moment, you felt at ease—yes, yes, this was very safe. At least tonight, you wouldn't have to worry anymore. Just crawl out when Tenna wakes up tomorrow morning...... You dazedly thought this, but you had already fallen asleep. Unfortunately, you didn't have time to think more. Of course, your body was just too exhausted. At this moment, you completely relaxed, so...... So, the next morning, you slept soundly and didn't wake up as you planned in time. Tenna, on the other hand, turned on the screen and woke up. Of course, he noticed something seemed to be in his arms, and when he looked down, he saw you had squeezed tightly into his embrace, and you were just curled up into a ball. Or perhaps, you hadn't ...... You didn't do anything else, just curled up and fell asleep. He even heard your shallow breathing. Tenna's brow twitched. He really didn't understand why you had come here again, but seeing how deeply you slept, he guessed he hadn't rested well recently, so in the end, he just snorted coldly and didn't plan to bother with you anymore.
But you still heard that cold snort and then woke up from that quiet sleep. You found Tenna had already woken up, and you were just curling up tightly and hugging yourself. Your voice was soft and faint, and you instinctively apologized again: "Sorry, Tenna, I just, just couldn't sleep...... Sorry for disturbing you so rashly......"
"I didn't ask you to apologize. Alright, you really can't fall asleep after hearing that story?" Tenna said casually as she put her clothes on, and you obediently shook your head. You chose to be honest: "Mm." Actually, after hearing that story, I was even more clear-headed, but...... But I felt embarrassed to keep you here and tell me other stories...... As you spoke, your voice grew quieter again.
"No need to be shy. Just tell me whatever you want." Tenna said casually, and for a moment he was starting to doubt himself—was his story really that bad? But at least, you just don't like it...... It seems his storytelling skills really need improvement.
At that moment, Tenna also heard your voice: "Then, then can I sleep with Tenna every night...... Otherwise, I don't think I can sleep......
Tenna's brow twitched, feeling his body was overheating again. Oh my god, it seemed like you had no idea what your words meant. Actually, this is basically because it's an intimate relationship, but he's not that close to you. At most, he just can't stand how you look now, so he reached out to control you.
He sneered, "No, do you want to date me?" He just asked you back, and you tilted your head looking puzzled: "Dating ...... What does it feel like? I've heard that word, but I'm not sure what it really is......
Tenna was instantly speechless by you.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 10 (dntx you)
content:
What, do you not even have basic common sense? Tenna was very curious about what kind of life you've been living all these years, but for now, he managed to explain things to you with some patience.
"It's like being with someone you care about, talking about romance every day, something like that." Although his explanation was vague, since he didn't know what it was best to say.
"Is that so...... Then Tenna and I fit that description too, right? Why can't we date? "You tilted your head and blinked at Tenna. You were indeed curious about this. Logically, you should be able to date Tenna too, right?
Tenna was at a loss for words. He wanted to say that things between you and him aren't like that, and that your feelings were also hypnotized by him...... He couldn't be sure if you really felt that way. Although the suggestion made him a bit tempted, reason still stopped him, so in the end he just shook his head, resolute, and his tone was icy: "No, no, it's not allowed." Alright, you're not allowed to bring up this topic again. ”
After being rejected by Tenna, you might feel a bit down, but then you pull yourself together and tug at Tenna's clothes: "So, what does it really feel like to be in love?" Isn't it...... Hmm, it feels really comfortable? "You're really curious about that, because you've heard before that dating seems to be a wonderful thing.
"Of course not. Dating is painful. You'll keep thinking about the other person, and seeing some of their actions makes you sad and upset, even leading to arguments. Dating isn't a good thing." Tenna grinned. Even though he wasn't trying to threaten you, seeing his expression still made you instinctively scared, and you shrank your shoulders. You're deflating again...... So dating is such a scary thing. Then don't date. Of course, that's just what you're thinking. On the surface, you just look at Tenna and tilt your head slightly: "Then...... So what exactly is my relationship with Tenna? So, what kind of relationship can I stay here and sleep? ”
“…… Family, right? We should be family. Do you really want to sleep with me? Tenna had already changed her clothes. At this moment, he was crouching slightly by the bed, looking straight at you. You nodded in response. You nervously pulled the blanket over the lower half of your face, revealing those restless, darting eyes.
"Well, if you're alone...... I—I can't sleep, I want to be with Tenna. "You said honestly." Tenna irritably grabbed the antenna; he didn't know why you acted like this—but after all, he had hinted to you before, so it's normal for you to want to stay by his side.
Tenna clicked her tongue lightly, and in the end, just held your hand. His screen was lit, but he remained expressionless: "Alright, you said it yourself, so you can stay."
