"Maybe he had a bit of a romantic thought, maybe something like that...... He actually does want to date you, but he rejected you, he ...... After all, he doesn't know if you truly feel that way. What he wants is your genuine feelings. If he can only have a fake relationship, then it's better never to have had it at all.
He just stood up again, looking down at you from above: "Alright, get dressed and come out for breakfast. Don't stay in bed all the time." After saying that, he turned and walked out. You struggled to put on your clothes. When you got out of bed, your legs were still shaking a bit—after all, your body was still a bit weak. But in the end, you still held onto the wall and walked out the door, then sat down at the dining table. Soon, Tenna, wearing an apron and still stained with the red blood stained on the screen, walked out of the kitchen. He was carrying two plates: one for regular bread and fried eggs, and the other for bacon. Seeing Tenna's expressionless face, you felt a bit uneasy, instinctively shrinking back. Your hand obediently rested on your knee, and you watched as Tenna sat down across from you, hesitating for a moment. Finally, you mustered the courage to ask, "Tenna, why is there blood on your screen......
“…… Ah, it splashed on the ingredients while handling them. What, is it really an eyesore?" Tenna replied casually, cutting open a piece of bacon with a knife, then popped it into his mouth without even looking up at you.
You hurriedly shake your head, and then, perhaps realizing Tenna couldn't see this, you finally lowered your voice and whispered, "It's nothing, I'm just a little scared...... It's okay, this is fine too." Saying these words, you felt as if you were comforting yourself. Even though...... Your mood didn't relax much.
Tenna looked up at you again, then frowned and wiped the blood off the screen. Seeing you trembling there, he couldn't understand what there was to be afraid of, but he still wiped the blood clean and said gruffly, "Alright, it's all left. Just eat properly." After saying that, he lowered his head and went back to eat his breakfast. After hesitating for a moment, you still ate the fried egg and bacon first. But after eating them, you felt full. You stuck your fork in the bread, but after a long time it still wouldn't get to your mouth, just boredly spinning it around the plate. When Tenna looked up again, he saw this scene. His brows furrowed again, and this time he felt his body was starting to heat up.
His voice was still cold, but it was clear he had lost some patience: "What, is it so bad? Is it worth spending your time here?" ”
“…… No, it's pretty good. It's just that I really can't eat anymore. Thank you for the breakfast Tenna prepared! But I really can't eat anymore...... You hesitate, instinctively wanting to apologize again. After all, this was indeed a waste of food. But as the words reached your lips, you remembered Tenna's words of reprimand, so in the end, you just said thank you and then lowered your head again.
Tenna frowned and sized you up. With thin arms and legs, you held lightly and lightly, barely touching any flesh. I really don't understand how you managed to get so thin...... But it seems you really don't want to eat anymore, really can't eat. I guess your appetite is really small right now.
Helpless, he could only soften his tone a bit, though it still sounded so cold: "Alright, if you can't finish it, that's fine, but at least eat a few more bites, okay? I don't want to see you starve to death." "Although what he said was still very awful."
Your body trembled again. You knew Tenna actually meant no harm toward you, but hearing those words made you feel a bit wronged...... You pouted, shook your head, and pushed away all the thoughts in your mind. You just looked at the remaining bread on your plate with some hesitation. In truth, you really didn't want to keep eating, but in the end, you gritted your teeth and cut off a small piece and put it in your mouth.
…… It's sweet, and you really like the taste. Plus, the bread is very soft and melts easily in your mouth. You were momentarily stunned, and Tenna frowned as she saw you just shake your head. She wondered what you were doing suddenly now.
“…… I'm really full, Tenna." As you spoke, you burped satisfactorily, as if to prove that your appetite really was just that small. Tenna frowned as she took the plate in front of her, muttering softly so your voice could hear: "That's all you eat. If you faint outside, I won't take you to the hospital. You'll know once you fall yourself." ”
“…… I, I'll do my best, Tenna." You instinctively lowered your head and stammered. Tenna irritably tugged at the antenna and snorted coldly, "Alright, I get it. Try to eat more next time." ”
Otherwise, with you like this, Tenna wouldn't dare use too much force to grab you. What if you fall apart the next second?
He just stuffed the remaining bread from your plate into his mouth, chewed briefly twice, and swallowed it. Then, he brought a bottle of hot milk from the kitchen and placed it in front of you, speaking succinctly: "Drink this milk." ”
You frowned just by looking at the milk. Actually, you never liked milk much as a kid, and Tenna clearly knew that was the ...... After all, he was the one who watched your TV when you were little.
You wore a bitter face, deciding to put on a pitiful expression and try to act cute, but this didn't work on your parents...... Because no matter what, you were definitely wrong. No matter what, your brother would never be wrong. And now you were a bit anxious. You didn't know what Tenna's attitude would be toward your coquettishness. You just whispered, half complaining, half murmuring: "I... I don't want to drink milk......"
"No, drink the milk. You don't want to really faint when you go out, do you?" Tenna tapped her knuckles twice on the table, staring at you. Of course, he did soften a little because of your coquettishness, but business is one thing—you still have to drink this milk.
In the end, he slowed his tone and barely comforted you: "This milk is sweet. Drink it, I think you'll like it." "Although he wasn't really sure either, after all these years without seeing it, he had long forgotten what your preferences were...... It's also possible that everything is still the same as before.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 11 (dntx you)
content:
You stopped talking about it, and of course, you still didn't want to drink milk...... But, but, hearing Tenna say that, maybe it wouldn't taste bad...... You hesitated for a moment, then looked up at Tenna. Naturally, you couldn't see his expression, only his cold face, maybe a little guilty...... You still picked up the milk cup, closed your eyes, took a deep breath, and tried hard to remind yourself not to spit it out after just one sip. Then, trembling, you picked up the cup and finally mustered the courage to drink it—oh my, the taste really wasn't bad, no fishy smell, just the sweet, milky taste. You're a bit surprised—after finishing the glass of milk, you put down the empty cup and instinctively stick out your tongue to lick the circle of milk marks stuck to your lips. Your tongue is small, very pink, and Tenna stares at your tongue and can't help but swallow hard. Then he turns his head to the TV...... Oh my god, just now he wanted to hold you down for a moment, then kiss your lips, trying to lick the lingering sweetness in your mouth. Of course, then he reminded himself that at least now, at least for now, he couldn't think about doing that. Despite ...... Even though that desire was burning in his soul.
You looked up at Tenna in confusion, and for some reason, his head suddenly turned away...... Well, you think you don't understand, and you don't really want to. You just obediently put down your empty cup, let out a quiet burp, and then, a bit timidly, whispered, "I...... I, I'm done, Tenna. ”
“…… Mm. He just replied gloomily, didn't look at you again, just picked up the blanket and headed toward the kitchen. Then he came out again and looked down at you, "Alright, are you going out for a walk today?" "Although it was a question, his words were certain—no matter what, he would take you away from here."
“…… Uh, I don't really want to. Can't I just stay here forever?" You whispered, "Indeed, right now you just want to sit here quietly, and then you can zone out...... No matter what, you don't need to think too much about things. You're still wearing the same dress as yesterday. Tenna clicked his tongue, walked over, and grabbed your wrist directly. His force wasn't heavy, but definitely not light. Anyway, you instinctively frowned and muttered, "You're hurting me......"
"Spoiled girl." He said lazily, but still relaxed his grip, gently wrapping his arm around your wrist. You obediently followed behind him, lowering your head, a trace of loneliness flashing across your face for a moment.
"Alright, is there anywhere you want to go?" He didn't look at you either, so naturally he didn't know that your mood was actually a bit down at this moment. He was just casually asking for your opinion.
"No, Tenna goes, I'll go wherever she goes...... I don't care, it's okay." You mumbled, your voice a bit muffled. Only then did Tenna realize something was off. He turned to look at you, pinched your chin, forcing you to look up at him. Your brows furrowed in discomfort—clearly, Tenna hurt you. So you still used that mumbled, mumbled voice: "Tenna, Tenna, you hurt me......"
Tenna also frowned, roughly wiping away the tears that had somehow trickled down your cheeks. His tone was also unpleasant, tinged with impatience: "Why are you crying? Are you really that fragile?" ”
“…… Yes. I'm just such a fragile and delicate person. You hate me, right? I know, many people dislike me, and many who know me will eventually dislike me." Tears fell from your eyes again. You lowered your head, holding back the tears, puffing out your cheeks. You thought you spoke that way because you were a bit sulky...... Maybe that's true, but your tears still couldn't stop sliding down, dropping one by one onto the floor. For a moment, it was very silent. You only heard the sound of tears sliding down. The long silence, even that uneasy feeling spread through the space, through the cracks in the windows, through the cracks in the doors. You couldn't bear it anymore, and you didn't want to hear the answer...... Anyway, it was absolutely obvious. You must hate such words, so you turned your head, trying to break free from your wrist and run toward your home.
But Tenna just grabbed your wrist. He opened his mouth but closed it again, wanting to tell you he didn't regret hating you. He wanted to say...... Those words didn't mean anything else; he actually didn't expect your fragile heart to be so easily hurt. You struggled a couple of times but found you couldn't get out, and in the end just turned to glare at Tenna—even though your gaze had no intimidation at all. You looked at Tenna, knowing your voice was unpleasant at that moment, because it was choked and choked with tears: "Alright, let go, why are you still holding me!" "Anyway, if you want me not to die in front of you, then I'll just go somewhere else, so it won't bother your eyes!" "As you spoke, you used your other hand to pull Tenna's hand tightly around your wrist, then dashed off, stumbling away. Tenna…… Tenna clearly wanted to say more, but he ...... He wanted to tell you he didn't mean it that way, but he couldn't bring himself to say it. Besides, why did he have to explain everything to you? This is just too funny.
He turned off his screen, it was pitch black, and any Dark Folk could see his low mood, and he just sneered and returned to his room. He was busy with his usual affairs, preparing lunch as usual, but...... But he always felt a bit uneasy, and he couldn't help but feel a bit irritable. He ...... He wanted to see the same smile you always show, because your smile belonged only to him, even though you rarely smiled. He also wanted to see your wet eyes...... He still wanted to hold onto your warm body. Moreover, since he had decided from the start to get you out of that situation, he couldn't just leave you alone now.
Tenna grabbed his antenna and muttered under his breath, "What a hassle." But he still grabbed the suit draped over the chair and strode out of the room. First, he went to your home. Of course, you wouldn't be staying there...... He thought for a moment, then went to the rooms of the other Happy Gang guys, but found nothing. The dessert shop and coffee shop—you weren't there either. Well, you probably just wanted to find a place where no one was around, so he finally climbed the city wall and spotted you crouching in a corner, hugging your knees...... Tears still streaked on your face. Even from a distance, he could hear your sobs and sobs. Tenna was silent for a moment, then finally walked up to you and crouched down. Even as he squatted, he still looked down at you.
You also noticed the shadow in front of you. You looked up and saw Tenna, then turned your head and gently pushed him with your hand. Even though it didn't help, Tenna's body didn't move at all. Your voice was muffled, choked with tears, tinged with a hint of resentment: "What are you doing here? Aren't you saying I won't die in front of you?" ”
Tenna sighed, turned your face away, and made you look straight at him. Then his screen changed, returning to that black-and-white circle pattern. The vortex kept spinning, and as you looked at his screen, your eyes moved with the vortex. Then, immediately after, you lost consciousness, just staring blankly at Tenna.
…… At least you should calm down for now.
"Listen, without my permission, you can't leave my side. Did you hear me?" Tenna's screen was facing you, his voice carrying a hint of command and temptation, and you just nodded blankly: "Got it, I won't leave Tenna." ”
"And ......" Tenna hesitated at this point. There were some things he didn't want to say out loud. He always felt very embarrassed, and it didn't fit his identity at all. But now, you won't have any memories...... But after the hypnosis, you won't remember anything. Yet he still didn't want to say it out loud, and in the end, he only mumbled, "You hate me?" ”
"No, I don't hate Tenna...... I really like being with Tenna, but, but, tenna, do you really hate me? I'm so troublesome...... Just like you said, I'm fragile, very delicate, I'm just that kind of unbearable guy, someone who makes others really dislike me. I'm terrible...... It's normal to dislike me, but I feel so sad, so sad. When Tenna said that to me, I felt...... It's just too sad...... You sobbed and sobbed as you said these things. Tenna looked at your cheeks, and finally reached out to gently wipe away the tears that had slipped from your eyes. But your tears only grew heavier, soaking his gloves. Tenna was silent for a moment. He looked at you, clearly just perfectly normal...... Actually, you were a bit gentler than when talking to others. He hadn't expected you to be unable to accept this.
In the end, he could only dry and say, "Alright, I won't say that again......"
After a moment of silence, seeing that you still showed no sign of stopping crying, he sighed helplessly: "...... Don't cry." His voice was still stiff and dry.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 12 (dntx you)
content:
“…… I can't stop. "Your voice sounded a bit aggrieved. Of course, you were just telling the truth. You sobbed and sniffed. Although no more tears fell, you still stammered, still sobbing. Looking at Tenna squatting in front of you, whose face wasn't very pleasant, you couldn't help but shrink back. You still remembered that when you were little, whenever you cried, you would always get slapped. Maybe because your voice was so unpleasant, you just suppressed your voice, even though tears still slid down your cheeks.
“…… If you want to cry, then cry." Tenna clicked his tongue lightly. Seeing you like this, he couldn't say anything harsh anymore. He just bent down and picked you up. You lay on his chest, still a bit dazed, tears dripping down your cheeks and naturally soaking Tenna's clothes. He looked down at you expressionlessly, and in the end, he just carried NIIT down from the city wall.
After a while, you finally wake up from this hypnosis. When you wake up in confusion, you find yourself lying in Tenna's arms—you should be sulking, you should have left here, even though you can't remember what happened before. But staying here really makes you feel so safe. You really don't want to leave, so you just dejectedly lowered your head and pretended nothing had happened, curling up in Tenna's arms.
But you hear a cold snort from above. Tenna's voice is icy and tinged with a hint of teasing, which makes you feel a bit embarrassed.
"Alright, you're finally awake. Are you still planning to stay here and not leave?" He said, his voice drawn out, sounding a bit lazy. You moved your lips and finally got out of his arms. You don't know exactly what happened earlier, but since he doesn't dislike you...... You can stay here, stay by his side, and that's something you secretly feel a little happy about. You just grabbed the hem of Tenna's clothes, quietly, in a timid voice—if it weren't for the quiet surroundings at this moment, he probably wouldn't have heard a word—you said, "Thank you, tenna...... Thank you for bringing me back." ”
"Hmm, so where are you planning to go?" He crossed his arms and asked, his tone still lazy and a bit careless. Tenna looked at you without saying much, just waiting for your decision, nothing more.
“…… It doesn't matter where you go, as long as you're with Tenna. "You were a bit dazed, just subconsciously giving that answer." Tenna took a deep breath. He felt like his body was overheating again. Well, a feeling that's hard to describe—after all, he hadn't expected you to give a serious answer, but he still instinctively corrected himself.
“…… You want to go out alone, do you understand? You can't always let me stay with you, can you? You're so precious, right?" As he spoke, he glanced you up and down again, and you lowered your head in embarrassment. Oh my god...... Honestly, what he said really hit a chord with you, but you still felt a bit unconvinced, trying to defend yourself.
"But, but, it's dangerous outside. Only Tenna is safe, that's what I think...... So, Tenna, are you really not allowed to be with me? "As you spoke, you sounded a bit lonely. You just lowered your head and carefully tugged at Tenna's sleeve. Of course, you didn't know that Tenna unconsciously lifted the corner of her mouth a little. Anyway, the hint was definitely successful. You would want to stay by his side, no matter where you went—but in the end, he just roughly grabbed your wrist and took you forward with long strides. You had to jog to keep up with him, and his tone was impatient: "You're so annoying. You can't survive without me, do you?" ”
You thought carefully for a moment, then nodded seriously, even though Tenna probably couldn't see it: "Yeah, that's right...... Without Tenna, I probably wouldn't have survived. It's all Tenna's fault, I clearly don't want to go on living anymore." As you spoke, your voice gradually faded. Clearly, you seemed a bit guilty when you said that. Tenna, on the other hand, was so annoyed by your words that she laughed: "You blame me for this?" What, I'm wrong just standing here? ”
“…… Hmm, if it weren't for Tenna, I wouldn't want to go on living. Surviving is really exhausting...... Your voice was still very soft, like mumbling to yourself. You kept jogging, following Tenna's footsteps. Soon, after not exercising for so long, you started panting heavily. Tenna glanced back at you, but in the end, she slowed her pace.
"If you can't keep up, just say so. I'm not deaf, I can't hear you. Even though you keep mumbling, I even suspect you're just saying those things for yourself. Even if you're tired, you still have to stand here." His words were a bit incoherent, just a cold snort waiting for you to follow in his footsteps. Since he had decided from the start to find a way to pull you back from the edge of the crumbling cliff, of course he couldn't give up now—a decision he had made from the start. Yes, it was just a decision he made from the very beginning.
"Thank you, tenna. I didn't ...... in time," you muttered under your breath, but still ran up and walked side by side with Tenna. You looked up at Tenna. From this angle, you could only see the chin of the tall TV head, but not his expression, and Tenna just snorted coldly and said nothing. Of course, he noticed your burning gaze—well, of course, you should look at him like that, after all, that's what Tenna thinks. He tugged at your wrist, relaxing a bit so you wouldn't cry out in pain again. He pulled you to a rather secluded spot, a park where the Dark People lived. Of course, there weren't many of them at this moment, but Addison had set up a few stalls nearby, happily selling their goods. You glanced at them curiously; most of them were snacks and drinks...... Tenna originally planned to pull you to find a seat nearby, but you tugged at Tenna's sleeve and pointed at the stall over there. Clearly, you were a bit excited: "Tenna, Tenna, I want to check out that stall...... It actually seems pretty interesting." ”
"Now you're a bit interested again? Go watch it yourself, I think it's pretty boring." "Those Dark folk living in castle town have already seen it many times, so of course they find it boring. Only you, a little girl who hasn't been in the dark world long and doesn't go out, would find these things interesting."
"But...... But I want Tenna to go with me. "Your voice also lowered, tinged with a hint of shyness. You just nervously tugged at Tenna's clothes, hoping to go with him, because...... Only when he's by your side will you feel safe and at ease, and you don't want to leave him.
Tenna smacked her lips irritably, but in the end still grabbed your hand and walked toward the stalls over there: "Alright, got it." Even though he said that, all he felt was a bit of surprise inside. He ...... He really liked being with you. Of course, since it seemed you liked it too, that would be wonderful. If ...... It would be great if things could go on like this, but in the end, this feeling was just something he gained through hypnosis. He didn't know if you'd always remember all this, nor did he want to know. He just pulled you to stand in front of the stall.
Curious, you pick up a powder-blue marshmallow from the stall. Tenna casually tosses the dark coin down, then takes a bite—oh my, it's a completely different feeling from the world of light, fluffy like a cloud. After biting into a piece, the rest of the body stays just as fluffy, unlike the light world, which is made with saccharin. So after biting, the remaining part shrinks, making it completely uninteresting. You take another bite, and the soft texture isn't particularly sweet. Just right for your taste. Tenna's hand slipped down unintentionally and then tightly held yours. He turned his head to look at you, and you didn't notice anything off. After tasting it, you excitedly handed Tenna the skewer from your hand, biting it right by his mouth. Although you stood on tiptoe to hand over the marshmallow, his height was insufficient, so Tenna casually picked you up so you could bring the marshmallow to his lips.
He looked at you silently, then at the string of marshmallows: "Kids love to eat this, why are you giving it to me?" He doesn't like that kind of thing—it's not very sweet, and it's a dessert with little weight. It's more like a little to pass the kids by.
"Try it, this marshmallow is different from the light world. I thought it would shrink with just one bite, but this texture really feels like you're eating clouds......" You danced excitedly, your hands and feet waving wildly. Clearly, you were very excited.
Tenna bluntly pointed out your thoughts: "You're overthinking it. The method is exactly the same as in the world of light, except the dark world has cast magic on top, so you end up with this texture. The rest of the rest will be fixed in shape and won't easily change." Pudding is still tastier than marshmallows. ”
Hearing his explanation, you pause for a moment, then quickly feel down again.
TBC.

title: Important Thing 13 (dntx you)
content:
"Alright, I thought the food in the Dark World would be different...... "No food anywhere really gets you interested, but you do want to try something new. Tenna looked down at your lonely state, and for once, she felt helpless. He hadn't expected your mood to change so quickly...... Oh my god, he didn't mean to do this, and right now, he couldn't think of any way to fix it. He just carried you home, whispering, "I'll cook for you today." Although his voice sounded cold, stiff, and a bit impatient, you didn't know why he was acting that way. He just stared blankly and said "Oh," which counted as an answer.
Life really is like a stagnant pool, with no other changes. Sitting at the table, holding your head in a daze, you can't help but wonder what Tenna will bring out for you...... Uh, try to make sure you don't spit it out this time, hopefully. You cheer yourself on inwardly, then you watch Tenna come out holding a plate of fried hamburger meat, along with a plate of vegetable salad. Hmm...... There's also a serving of stewed noodles, and the rest is a plate of pudding. Obviously, Tenna probably isn't very good at this, or maybe he just doesn't cook much. After all, part of the burger was burnt and some parts were not even cooked...... You carefully picked up your knife and fork and started eating. You tried to pick up a piece of hamburger meat you thought was at least cooked. It was cooked, but you weren't used to the taste—you covered your mouth and retched twice, but in the end, you tilted your head and vomited. Tenna took a bite too. It wasn't very good, but not bad either. He glanced at you. Although you couldn't see his gaze, you could feel his gaze was cold and scrutinizing: "What's wrong? Is it not tasty?" ”
You hurriedly shake your head: "No, actually, the taste is pretty good." But, but...... It's been too long since I ate meat, I'm not used to it...... Your voice was a bit weak, and you didn't dare look up at Tenna. Oh my god, you really didn't know how Tenna would react. But right after, you also thought of a solution, so you quickly suggested it to Tenna.
"Well, anyway, it's just to fill my stomach, so I'll just eat some snacks...... Just a couple of bites and I'll be full, so it's not easy to throw up!" As you spoke, you shook your head excitedly, but Tenna looked even worse. He moved the plate of pudding on the table toward himself; it was just his dessert after the meal.
"No, just eat properly. Or do you want to play an exciting chase game?" As she spoke, Tenna pulled out another kitchen knife and gave you a sinister smile. Your body trembled. Honestly, you ...... Although you're a little scared, you know Tenna isn't really going to do anything like that, so you've grown a bit braver, even though your voice still sounds weak.
"I...... I—but I just don't want to eat meat...... Although your voice grew quieter and lower. Your fork was messily probing the plate, and in front of you was the stewed noodles Tenna had served you. Even though, you really didn't want to eat this stewed noodles at all...... You didn't really feel like eating.
Tenna took a deep breath, feeling that his mobile suit seemed to be overheating again. Hmm, that feeling wasn't just an illusion at all. He briefly turned off the screen, and when he turned it back on, it was once again a whirlpool of black and white, spinning like a circle. His voice softened a little, though still that annoying tone.
"Alright, now, look up and look at me." You looked up at Tenna in confusion. You saw those black-and-white circles, and your mind went blank for a moment. Then, your gaze only grew even more vacant, staring blankly at Tenna.
"Tell me, why don't you want to eat?" Tenna casually tapped the table with her knuckles, looking at you, and you just shook your head blankly, muttering, "I just don't want to eat...... I can't eat it......
“…… Why can't you eat it?" Although Tenna thought there probably wasn't much reason for this, he still went along with the question. He was very curious about what you were thinking.
You were quiet for a moment, then softly said, "It's just that I'm not used to it." ”
“…… It's just eating meat, why are you unused to it? You bastard, just a little bit, with no flesh on you. If you don't eat more, what if you end up falling right in front of me like that?" Tenna really doesn't understand how you take care of yourself. You looked fine as a kid, but now every time you pick it up and touch it, it's all your hard bones, with no flesh left. It's unbearably unbearable.
"It's just that it's been too long since I last ate it...... I'm not used to it." "You stammered to explain to yourself, honestly, you really ...... You can't eat anymore, Tenna thought about it and realized it was true. After all, you don't even eat, so your stomach probably can't handle it too. But you just can't go without meat either. He softened his tone and said, "Then...... You should at least eat a little at every meal. You have to get used to it. You have to grow up well, understand? If you keep looking like this, people will still think I'm abusing you. ”
You quickly shake your head: "No, no, Tenna is very good to me......"
"Then just eat well, got it?" He said bluntly, nodding at you, so Tenna added, "At least you need to be able to eat what I make, got it?" ”
“…… Okay, got it. "Seeing you nod obediently, Tenna snapped her fingers to wake you up. After you shook your head and snapped out of your groggy state, you looked at the things on the table in front of you, and before you knew it, you felt your appetite had improved a bit...... Although it still wasn't great, for Tenna's sake, you would still eat these things.
So you still put two pieces of hamburger meat in your mouth, chewed carefully, then looked up pitifully at Tenna: "Tenna, tenna, I... I can't eat anymore...... Your stomach is just a tiny bit bigger now. Tenna glanced at you but didn't say much. She simply moved the plate of hamburger meat in front of herself, then tapped the plate with the stewed noodles in front of you.
"Alright, let's finish the remaining stewed noodles. Is that okay?"
And you look at that plate of obviously unfinished stewed noodles, just shake your head again, your voice growing softer: "I... I can't finish it...... Tenna, thank you for preparing so much for me......
Tenna took a deep breath, struggling to suppress his inner turmoil. He simply scooped out half of the stew noodles from his plate and put it on his own plate. To Tenna, the remaining part of the plate was like a pocket meal.
Looking at the plate of stewed noodles in front of you, you wanted to shake your head, but you weren't sure...... But you felt Tenna seemed to be in a bad mood, and in the end you nodded: "I, I'll try, I think, I think, that's okay...... "You're really not sure."
Although Tenna was a bit irritable, his tone softened as much as possible when facing you, though still a bit anxious and impatient: "Alright, if you can't finish it, just say so." Don't force it in. "As he spoke, he started eating too. Even though he was a bit distracted, he couldn't help but glance in your direction, while you were serious, though not very skilled, slowly picking up Li Min's noodles from the plate with a fork and stuffing them into your mouth. Tenna had already taken care of his own part. He just crossed his arms and watched you finish the last bite of your plate, chew, and then swallow it. Then, as if you'd completed some major task, you lifted your head, and for once, your eyes sparkled as you looked at Tenna—at that moment, Tenna felt a bit dazed, and for a moment, he almost wanted to kiss your eyes. Wait, what was he thinking...... He put that thought aside and just listened carefully to what you were saying.
"Tenna, I've finished all the stewed noodles!" You said that, even though you didn't say much...... But your sparkling eyes still revealed that you probably wanted some kind of reward. Tenna clicked her tongue lightly: "A kid, huh? So childish." Hearing this, your eyes turned a little lonely, just staring blankly down at your plate.
Tenna clicked her tongue again when she looked at you, took a knife, cut open the pudding, and placed half on a clean empty plate...... Although he was a bit reluctant—no, very reluctant—he didn't mind sharing it with you...... He also wanted to see you looking at him with those sparkling eyes—so cute, he ...... He liked it very much, even though he wouldn't say it out loud.
He just pushes the half piece of pudding from the plate in front of you, his voice still cold, as if he doesn't care at all, even though he's doing the exact opposite.
"Here, reward. Eat. You probably like it quite a bit, right?" As you said this casually, you blinked, lifted your head again, and looked at Tenna with those sparkling eyes. Although you weren't very good at smiling—and you hadn't tried it in a long time—you still gave Tenna a smile you thought was radiant—even though Tenna thought it looked a bit unpleasant.
"Yay, thank you, tenna!"
TBC.

title: Important Thing 14 (dntx you)
content:
Tenna just snorted coldly and lowered her head to eat her portion. You happily shook your legs and ate the half portion of pudding. Although you didn't exactly like it, this sweet taste truly soothed your soul and lifted your mood. So a smile spread across your face. Tenna was clearly enjoying his portion, but now he was a bit distracted. He couldn't help but look up at you, naturally seeing the smile on your cheek. Tenna wanted to say something, but in the end, he just let out a soft laugh. The corners of his lips couldn't help but lift slightly; he always felt that what he ate today should be a bit sweeter...... Maybe it was just his imagination, or maybe not. Tenna didn't know why she felt this way. After finishing the meal and clearing the plates, he looked at you and asked casually.
"Can you go shower by yourself today?" Although it was a question, it was actually a command, and in reality, it didn't give you any options or plans to refuse. You paused, honestly...... You felt like this was unnecessary.
So you muttered quietly, "But, I, I don't want to take a shower...... The weather isn't very hot...... "Although it's not exactly hot, this weather does make you sweat. It's just a bit of a bit dry. Of course, taking a shower is definitely the best choice, even though you probably wouldn't want to.
"I think you need to take a shower. What are you doing? Are you planning to shower with me?" He said with a hint of mockery, making your body shrink back a little. Honestly, you never thought about it, even though if Tenna wanted to, you ...... You wouldn't refuse him, because Tenna has done a lot for you, but you have nothing to repay him...... So, offering your body seems to be the only option, even though you don't know if Tenna will agree to it.
“…… I don't want to go, Tenna, I don't want to do anything else, is that okay?" In the end, you just whispered like this, as if pleading softly...... Oh my god, oh my god, if I could, the time saved would only make you just sit blankly on the sofa. Tenna clicked his tongue at you, then finally picked you up and walked toward the bathroom. He turned on the faucet, filled the tub with hot water, and then put you in. Of course, this time his movements were gentler, no longer tossing you in like last time. But since you were wearing white clothes today, it was only natural that once your clothes got wet, they would stick to you. Tenna cleared her throat, turned her head away, and didn't look at you anymore. He just said impatiently, "Alright, it's just a simple soak and a quick soak before coming out. You can dry it yourself." As he spoke, he tore off the white towel from the shelf and tossed it to you. You sat dazed in the middle of the bathtub, telling the truth. You hadn't really reacted at all, just picked up the towel and draped it over the edge of the tub to avoid getting wet.
And since there was no sound at all, Tenna couldn't help but turn his head to take a look. He clicked his tongue, a bit impatient, and turned off his screen to avoid seeing it burning...... Hmph, at least his body was overheated right now. He just randomly lifted the TV's head, roughly tore off your clothes, and then pushed you into the bathtub. Although you don't know why—maybe Tenna is important to you, or maybe there's something else—you don't really care.
“…… Do you really enjoy going out with me? "Tenna just asked, not answering your question, but instead started another topic.
You just smiled brightly at Tenna as usual: "Of course I like it, because being by Tenna's side is safe, and I'm happy too!" "The answer doesn't seem much different from what you gave when you were hypnotized; in the end, it's all because Tenna is very important to you—and he knows it's all just the result of hypnosis. He clearly didn't deepen this hint, yet you still have that thought.
“…… You have to learn to be alone, right? I can't stay here forever." His voice sounded very blunt, though much gentler than usual, and you just tilted your head in confusion at Tenna: "...... But, but, I...... Tenna, why can't we always be together? "Your thinking is simple: as long as you two stay together, that's enough...... You don't really care about what kind of relationship you two have. Anyway, as long as you stay together, that's all that matters.

He didn't look at you. Tenna knew exactly what he was doing—maybe as long as you got to know someone else, as long as you distanced yourself from him, he wouldn't hold onto those feelings that shouldn't have arisen and keep guessing your thoughts, and you would gradually forget him as you broke free from hypnosis—you'd end up with someone else. Although now, just thinking about this made him furious, almost furious, he felt that as time passed, everything would get better. After all...... How could the feelings gained from hypnosis ever be real? Even he couldn't believe that. He didn't know why he had become weak. At first, what he wanted to abandon was this cowardly self, but at some point, that same feeling returned to him. It's you who brings this cowardice back onto him—he thinks, he wants to abandon this feeling, and also abandon you, because—because he's certain he doesn't care about you that much. As long as you let go, everything will get better.
"No, don't get so close to me. You're almost healed now, right? You don't need me anymore, do you? Then get lost. Don't be so deadbeat around me. Go find someone else to play your pretend game." His voice was icy cold. You had been about to reach out and tug at his sleeve again, but you blinked in disbelief upon hearing that...... You, my god, how could he say something like that...... The heart that had been beating suddenly stopped in that moment, as if frozen in place, but at this very moment, in your heart...... You can't quite describe how you feel—it's just loneliness, pain, a sense of sorrow. Your eyes are red, and your tears are coming back again...... You almost burst out, but you sniff. Even though tears drip from your face, you don't make any extra sounds—just muffled, a bit hoarse: "...... I—I understand. I'm sorry, Mr. Tenna, I've disturbed you lately. ”
After saying this, you wiped the tears from your eyes with your finger. You took nothing with you, just rushed toward the door in a panic. You opened the door, then gently closed it, and left just like that. Hearing your words, Tenna turned his head. He wanted to tell you things weren't like that—he wasn't asking you to apologize, but you had already left. Tenna quieted down. Usually, you sat on the sofa with Tenna, and he couldn't just stay free. But now, he simply lay back on the sofa, legs spread wide. He took out a cigar that hadn't been touched for a long time because you were here, and put it in his mouth. He snorted coldly, thinking, anyway...... Anyway, as long as he stayed here freely, everything was still the same as before—what's wrong with that?
However, while cooking, he instinctively made an extra serving of food, then called out, "Y/N, come eat." But in the empty room, no one responded to his words. Tenna was stunned for a moment, then snorted coldly and simply sat down to finish the food for two people.

His expression shifted as he just stared at the air beside him. In the end, he threw down what he was holding and walked into the bathroom himself. Soon he came out and went back into his own room.
He lay on the bed and turned off the light...... In the darkness, he turned over, his hands instinctively trying to grab something, but there was nothing. He restlessly rolled back and forth on the bed. Naturally, he hadn't rested well that night. You, who usually lay beside him, were not here tonight. It didn't matter, after all, in a few days everything would be fine. That's what he told himself.
This time, Tenna remembered to prepare only one serving for the meal, even though he wasn't used to it at all. Because just as he was about to leave, he instinctively reached out and tugged at your wrist. He usually grabs your wrist, but today, he grabbed nothing—there was only cold air beside him. Tenna was stunned for a moment, then snorted coldly, and simply opened the door and walked out alone.
It didn't matter, it would be fine in a few days, he was just telling himself this.
But...... Not good at all. He instinctively wanted to call your name in front of the stall, to ask what flavor you prefer, but in that instant, he realized...... You are no longer by his side, and you won't be there anymore, so...... He has to leave everything with you behind. But that's not good at all. Tenna walked down the street and saw your figure...... Standing next to you was a pippin. That kind of guy—how could you be hanging out with such a despicable guy and laughing happily? He saw it clearly—that pippins had just used two clumsy little tricks he could tell at a glance, and they had won your smile—you were chatting and chatting with him about something.

He hated the heart-wrenching feeling when he saw you with someone else. But now, his steps were fixed here, and he couldn't step forward, step forward...... Say something to you. "Oh...... First, you need to bring a basket. Darling, what do you think of this? "Tenna said as she excitedly picked up a basket. You glanced at it quickly—it was probably something everyone else would use for picnics. So you nodded and responded with a hum.
He enthusiastically went to pick out the rest again.
"How about that...... Dear, do you prefer red tablecloths, yellow or blue? "He put down the basket, picked up a few tablecloths, and showed them to you. You glanced at them and thought the color didn't really matter, but today's weather was pretty nice, right?
So you think for a moment and say, "Then, the blue one." ”
He muttered as he opened the fridge again, folded the blue tablecloth, and put it in the basket: "Oh...... First, the red bean paste bread and daifuku I bought yesterday, plus some bread and snacks from the bakery...... Put on a few plates, and prepare hot water and tea set...... Just like yesterday, he naturally picked you up, the antenna still hanging in front of the screen. His other hand was holding the picnic basket, but his movements were slow. After a long while, he still hadn't left the house, as if waiting for you to regret it.

Tenna, on the other hand, became at a loss. He carefully held you, bent down as he walked out the door, then gently closed the door as if afraid of waking you, and walked out onto the street.

You tilted your head slightly and glanced at him, then at the snacks on the tablecloth. At that moment, a pleasant idea popped into your head. You winked at Tenna and said, "Mm...... I want to have some sandwiches now. ”

He carefully arranged the two slices of bacon, sandwiched salad in the middle, and stuffed some sausage slices. And Tenna, who got your thumbs, was happily shaking the antenna.
Of course, you wouldn't be stingy with praise, but since you're not good with words and don't say much, that was all you could say. But Tenna was very happy; he knew this was your approval of what he had done—before, it seemed he had never lived like this. He only remembered the expectant glances he gave you time and again, while you remained indifferent, while Tenna...... could only feel disappointed, but despite his disappointment, he could only revolve around you—or rather, he was willing.

Tenna propped her chin up, just sitting on the tablecloth, smiling, a little flower popping up from her nose, just staring at you the whole time. Of course, you could sense his gaze, but you didn't care. You simply picked up another red bean bun from the plate, slowly stuffed it into your mouth, didn't look up at Tenna, just took another sip of tea.
Tenna, however, was already satisfied. His antenna flickered, and he just stared at you in a daze. The place was quiet, but occasionally people would pass by. When they saw you and Tenna sitting close together, they all smiled knowingly, and Tenna felt happy. All he had to do was look down at you, and he could already see all his own happiness. You couldn't control all his emotions, which made you feel a bit irritated—though maybe your lover is just such a troublesome creature.

You tilted your head, a bit puzzled, but in the end, you still fed him a large fortune, and he obediently ate it. You simply said coldly, "That's your future, it has nothing to do with me." ”

But you just leaned in, gently kissed his screen, and spoke softly, almost as if inviting: "You promised you wouldn't throw away the collar, and you wouldn't let me lose yours." So, what do you think your future will be like? ”
His screen was still damp, only his body had grown a bit larger, and his voice sounded a bit muffled and damp: "...... I will always be by your side." Tenna said. Although he still felt a bit dissatisfied and anxious, more than anything, it was a sense of joy...... Or perhaps a feeling as if dust had settled. You reached out with satisfaction, patted Tenna's TV, then pressed your cheek against his wet screen and whispered softly, probably not hoping he could hear clearly: "Mm, as long as you don't throw away the collar." ”

Or maybe he only realized after countless experiences that these words were truly rare for you, so his antenna stopped drooping, and the screen grew slightly warm—at least when you leaned on it, it felt warm.
