"Oh...... First, you need to bring a basket. Darling, what do you think of this? "Tenna said as she excitedly picked up a basket. You glanced at it quickly—it was probably something everyone else would use for a picnic. So you nodded and responded with a hum.
He enthusiastically went to pick out the rest again.
"How about that...... Dear, do you prefer red tablecloths, yellow or blue? "He put down the basket, picked up a few tablecloths, and showed them to you. You glanced at them and thought the color didn't really matter, but today's weather was pretty nice, right?
So you think for a moment and say, "Then, the blue one." ”
He muttered as he opened the fridge again, folded the blue tablecloth, and put it in the basket: "Oh...... First, the red bean paste bread and daifuku I bought yesterday, plus some bread and snacks from the bakery...... Put on a few plates, and prepare hot water and tea set...... He was busy tidying up all sorts of things, and you just rested your chin on your hand, yawned, and watched him busy.
Hearing your yawn, Tenna's body stiffened. He turned to look at you, his voice a bit stammered: "Dear...... Darling, do you want to rest for a while? Can't we go together...... "Well, it's okay......" As he said this, his head lowered, the flower on his nose withered and fell, the screen went pitch black, the antenna drooped, and his whole body shrank a little.
You sighed softly and rubbed your temples: "I'm fine. You've been waiting for a long time, haven't you? Let's set off." ”
Tenna just let out a muffled 'oh'. His body had grown a bit larger, but the screen still didn't light up. Just like yesterday, he naturally picked you up, the antenna still hanging in front of the screen. His other hand was holding the picnic basket, but his movements were slow. After a long while, he still hadn't left the house, as if waiting for you to regret it.
You yawned again, kissed his antenna, then pressed your head against his still cold screen and closed your eyes. Soon, your breathing became even, almost like you had fallen asleep.
Tenna, on the other hand, became at a loss. He carefully held you, bent down as he walked out of the house, then gently closed the door as if afraid of waking you, and walked out onto the street.
His screen lit up again, becoming somewhat warmer. You muttered and rubbed against his screen. Tenna's body only stiffened further. Then, his heart burst with joy, feeling that light happiness again. He was certain he was very happy now, and Duan Duan could never be happier. He just gently rubbed your cheek with the screen.
Then, cautiously, a smiling face appeared on the screen, a flower blooming at the tip of his nose, leading you forward at a pace that wasn't exactly fast. Of course, there would be passing Dark Commoners, some even knowing Tenna. After all, it's not just about making money—they also have to go out to prepare meals for you. Those Dark Folk wanted to greet Tenna, but Tenna always gestured to silence with her index finger in front of her mouth, then pointed at you sleeping soundly in his arms and shook her head. Of course, his face was still full of happiness, especially about your slight dependence on him...... He just felt a bit flattered.
The Dark People understood, also nodding at Tenna with a smile, watching her figure as she led you away.
Tenna always thought that if only this time could be a little longer, if the road could go farther and have no end, how wonderful that would be...... From time to time, he would lower his head to look at you, as if if you could disappear from his arms for even a second.
But the road does have an end. Tenna saw the park too. His antenna drooped slightly, and he slowly carried you inside, then found a patch of fresh grass—not far from people, but definitely not disturbed—and put down the picnic basket.
Then he gently poked your cheek with his finger and softly called out, as if he couldn't bear to wake you up: "Wake up, Y/N, we've arrived." ”
Actually, you haven't been sound asleep at all—just a light sleep. You can't just let yourself sleep outside without rest. Even though you're in Tenna's arms, you can feel his carefulness. You know how gentle his breathing is. Only then do you rub your eyes, pretend you've just woken up, look around, and see Tenna patiently waiting for you. Then you tap Tenna's screen: "Put me down." ”
Tenna obediently put you down. He carefully laid out the tablecloth—or rather, your picnic cloth—then laid out the tableware, arranged the bread and snacks he had brought from home, and finally set up the tea set. He brewed a pot of hot tea with hot water, poured a cup, and eagerly offered it to you.
You took a gentle sip of the hot tea. The temperature was just right, and you sat down in the empty spot on the picnic cloth, right next to Tenna. You slightly lifted your head and saw Tenna looking at you with concern. The antenna hung down, and you gently stroked it and asked, "What's wrong?" ”
He nervously tugged at his clothes, seemingly adjusting his tie again, probably to look a bit better, and softly asked, "Sorry...... I just want to know, darling, what would you like to eat first? ”
You tilted your head slightly and glanced at him, then at the pastries on the tablecloth. At that moment, a good idea popped into your head. You winked at Tenna and said, "Mm...... I want to have some sandwiches now. ”
Tenna seemed stunned for a moment, then hurriedly picked up two slices of bread. For some reason, his picnic basket actually contained some sausages, bacon, lettuce, and a jar of salad. He carefully arranged the two slices of bacon, sandwiched salad in the middle, and stuffed some sausage slices. Finally, somehow he got the knife and cut the sandwich in half, cutting it diagonally, turning it into a simple sandwich.
You took a bite and gave Tenna a thumbs up. No matter how many times you try, you have to say Tenna's cooking is really impressive. The sausage and bacon were probably homemade by him to suit your taste; they weren't too salty, and the salad dressing helped balance the flavor. Overall, you enjoyed eating them with great enjoyment.
And Tenna, who got your thumb, was happily shaking the antenna.
TBC.
This story features a more S personality and a more M tenna. Some chapters also contain R18 content.
——
Of course, you wouldn't be stingy with praise, but since you're not good with words and don't say much, that's all you can say. Yet Tenna was very happy; he knew this was your approval of what he had done—before, it seemed he had never lived like this. He only remembered the expectant glances he cast at you again and again, but you remained indifferent, while Tenna...... could only feel disappointed, but despite his disappointment, he could only revolve around you—or rather, he was willing.
…… After all, just calling his name is enough to make him happy for a long time, let alone watching him all the time. Tenna propped her chin up, just sitting on the tablecloth, beaming with a smile, a little flower blooming from her nose, just staring at you the whole time. Of course, you could sense his gaze, but you didn't care. You simply picked up another red bean bun from the plate, slowly stuffed it into your mouth, didn't look up at Tenna, and just took another sip of tea.
Tenna, however, was already satisfied. His antenna flickered, and he just stared at you. This place was quiet, but occasionally people would pass by. When they saw you and Tenna sitting close together, they all smiled knowingly, and Tenna felt happy. He only needed to look down at you and already saw all his own happiness. He knew...... No matter what, in the eyes of outsiders, you were probably a perfect couple. He desperately longed for you to admit something, but as long as you tacitly accepted...... That would be enough.
Lost in these wild thoughts, Tenna didn't react for a moment when you handed him a large fortune cake. Until he heard your leisurely voice: "Alright, have something to eat too. Weren't you the one who called me here for a picnic?" "Even though you know very well that he probably doesn't really want a picnic, he just wants to spend a little more time with you. You don't quite understand why he stays by your side all the time, but maybe...... That's fine too.
After all, you really do need someone who is wholeheartedly yours.
But in any case, no matter what, you still have a bit of tolerance toward your lover. Seeing his smile, probably lost in thought, with a hint of teasing, you watch Tenna hurriedly bite down on the daifuku, then leisurely take another sip of hot tea and softly ask, "What are you thinking about?" ”
But just those few words startled Tenna like a sudden thunderclap. His antenna instinctively trembled a few times, the screen flickered on and off, and finally his antenna drooped gently, looking a bit aggrieved. You couldn't understand what he was really upset about, even though you had already fulfilled the request he made.
As for Tenna...... He really feels awkward asking you, asking if he will be part of your life journey, asking you...... Are you really a real couple? If so, why have you made no commitments until now? He is clearly your lover and has done all those things with you, but in the end, what does he mean to you?
He hugged his knees tightly, and the head of the TV hung down. You looked at him, waiting for him to speak. He would always say something, so you heard him speak cautiously, almost trembling: "I...... I'm wondering, what will my dear Y/N become in the future? Will ...... What will you do in the future? "Will he be there in your future?"
You tilted your head, not realizing he was thinking about this question, so you thought carefully before answering, "Hmm...... My future? I hadn't thought about that before; after all, the most important thing is the present. "You said slowly, and it was rare for you to say something this long.
"However...... If you truly want an answer. I will do my job well, use my savings to buy a new home, and the clothes and furniture I wear. Maybe, maybe I will still have the free time and energy to travel again. "You spoke calmly about your original plan. You are very confident you can achieve this goal, and by then, you will be free.
But as Tenna listened, his figure suddenly shrank even smaller, and the antenna completely drooped. When you turned your head to look, you saw his screen was wet again, and big tears began to fall again.
You sighed silently, picked up a large fortune cake, and brought it close to his screen. He opened his mouth and ate it, while your voice remained calm: "What's wrong with you? If you hadn't told me, I would never have known." Your lover always seemed to like to wash his face in tears. You didn't know why he was like this, but you knew he was sad. You couldn't control all his emotions, which made you feel a bit irritated—though maybe your lover is just such a troublesome creature.
So you just watched his screen glow slightly, probably chewing on that daifuku, while you gently wiped his screen with your hand, then leaned in and softly kissed the TV casing. You felt the screen seem a little warm, at least not as cold as before, and you just quietly watched him, listening to his sobs. He whimpered a few times before finally speaking.
"Then...... What about me? "He doesn't dare ask why he's not in your future, nor does he dare ask...... Will you even consider him in your own future? He really wants to question you: what does he really mean to you? Is he just a trivial plaything? Or an insignificant object? But he doesn't dare to ask you. If, to you...... He really isn't important, then he hopes that at least, at this very moment, Tenna is an important presence to you, not something to be ignored.
You tilted your head, a bit puzzled, but in the end, you still fed him a large fortune, and he obediently ate it. You simply said coldly, "That's your future, it has nothing to do with me." ”
After a pause, you hear your lover's sobs grow louder. If no one else were around, you'd be afraid you'd be met with a bunch of condemning looks. He wailed loudly, like the sound of a kettle boiling......
You had no choice but to add, "But since you said you'll never take off the collar...... Then now, take me home and hold me." As you spoke, you reached out your hand to him. Tenna's crying gradually faded, but the screen was still damp. He obediently began to tidy up the napkin, finally picked up the basket again, and looked at you. You walked toward him, naturally reaching out both hands. Tenna held the basket with one hand, while the other picked you up and slowly walked forward. His posture remained unchanged; your toes almost touched the ground.
But you just leaned in, gently kissed his screen, and spoke softly, almost as if inviting: "You promised you wouldn't throw away the collar, and you wouldn't let me lose yours." So, what do you think your future will be like? ”
His screen was still wet, but his figure had grown a bit larger, and his voice sounded a bit muffled and damp: "...... I'll always be by your side." Tenna said. Although he still felt a bit dissatisfied and anxious, more than anything, it was a sense of joy...... Or perhaps a feeling as if dust had settled. At least, Tenna knew that to you, he wasn't insignificant.
You reached out satisfied, patted Tenna's TV, then pressed your cheek against his wet screen and whispered softly, probably not hoping he could hear clearly: "Mm, as long as you don't throw away the collar." ”
And then you stopped talking. Although you didn’t manage to give him a completely satisfying answer, Tenna also understood… or perhaps, he only realized after experiencing countless times that these words from you were already very rare, so his antenna no longer drooped, and the screen became slightly warm, at least when you leaned against him, it just felt cozy. You closed your eyes and started dozing against Tenna, your breathing becoming steady, and Tenna thought you were asleep, lowering his footsteps and not daring to make a sound.
But you remembered how far his steps would reach, and you quietly counted them. Only when you were almost home did you rub your eyes and, pretending to just wake up, lightly straighten in Tenna’s arms, then pointed to the shop on the street corner: 'Tenna, stop there for a moment.'
Tenna held you as she said and stopped in front of the pastry shop, then bent down slightly so you could talk to the old lady inside.
The old lady just smiled and said, "Oh my, the young couple is here again." ”
You just smiled and said, 'Mm. Five cream puffs, five matcha daifuku, all to go.' Then you took out your wallet and paid. The old lady packed the pastries in paper bags and handed them to you.
Tenna carried you back toward home. You also took out a cream puff and stuffed it into his mouth, then leaned in and kissed the corner of his mouth.
It wasn’t until you reached your front door that all the pastries were finished, and Tenna’s screen lit up again. He happily set you down, took out the key, and opened the door.
After dinner, you pulled him along to play video games to pass the time, then after washing up, you lay down normally on the bed and closed your eyes.
Tenna carefully pulled the blanket back and lay down next to you, snuggling up close. It seemed that even just sleeping next to you would make him happy for a long time. You gently rubbed in his direction, then tilted your head and rested your head on his chest. Tenna's body instantly stiffened, but hearing your steady breathing, he thought you were probably sound asleep. So he carefully placed his arm on top of you, maintaining a half-hugging posture, awkwardly falling asleep.
TBC.

title: [Merge] Collar Two (1)
content:
A night without dreams.
When you come to your senses, you find yourself still curled up in Tenna's arms, just a little looser, carefully and carefully, while his head still rests against your neck, making you feel a bit uncomfortable.
You sighed, gently pulled his arm up, and stood up—it was time to get up and prepare breakfast for work—even though your body was still a bit sore.
But as soon as you sat up, Tenna grabbed your wrist. When you looked back, you noticed his screen had lit up at some point. It seemed he had been startled awake by you, his voice still tinged with drowsiness and caution, and even the grip on your wrist grew lighter.
He just asked softly, "Today...... You don't have to work, right? Can you stay with me a little longer? "You paused for a moment. You remembered today was Saturday, so you really didn't need to go to the office, but you're a bit hungry now, so you can't just lie here like this.
So you just patted Tenna's head and softly said, "Mm, but it's time to get up for breakfast. I'm hungry." With that, you grabbed the clothes you had taken off yesterday and put them on yourself, then got ready to get out of bed. In short, you could eat anything you wanted, and you only planned to bake some toast.
Then you hear rustling sounds, and then you feel yourself being embraced in a warm embrace. But his arm doesn't touch you, just gently wraps around you, while his head rests on top of yours. Tenna's voice sounded a bit muffled: "...... I—I'll help you prepare breakfast. Can you ...... Stay a little longer? "What he actually wanted to ask was if you could spend a little more time with him, but he didn't dare ask, so he had no choice but to ask.
You gently scratched his TV's head: "Alright, I'll wait for you." "After all, it's only for a short while, and since there's nothing to do today, you're willing to spend a little more time with him." After all...... You were thinking that you should give him something he was hoping for. It's just a pity you can't give him much.
So you sit at the dining table, watch Tenna happily wear an apron, then walk into the kitchen to get busy. You smell the toasted aroma of bread, the sweetness of jam, the crackling of fried eggs in the pan, and the unique scent of morning.
And you just sit at the table, waiting for Tenna to bring the food. Breakfast is simple: just a few slices of freshly baked, slightly crispy bread, paired with blueberry jam set aside and two golden fried eggs on the plate. Besides that, there are a few slices of freshly fried bacon and two steaming hot sausages on the plate.
You spread jam on the bread, took a bite, then squinted happily. Sure enough, having something steaming hot for breakfast is truly comforting.
Tenna nervously wiped her still oily hand over the apron, a bit timid but full of anticipation, and asked, "What do you think...... How does this smell like? ”
Since he'd asked so much, you stopped and said directly: "I...... I don't like bread that's slightly burnt. Next time, don't set it to level 2—just use level 1. "Although slightly burnt bread tastes great, you told him before that speed 2 is enough...... But it really does depend on luck.
Tenna hurriedly wiped her hands with her apron: "Alright, I remember what you said...... It's just, just ......"
You glanced up at him, tilting your head slightly: "Just what?" ”
He finally took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and told you honestly, "I just opened the fridge and found there wasn't much left in stock...... Could you—can you go with me to the bakery?" "He wants to buy you some bread. Of course, he has his own reasons—he wants you to spend a little more time with him, and occasionally, he hopes you can go with him for a dessert meal, whatever it is."
You pulled out a napkin to wipe your mouth, thought for a moment, then nodded gently: "Alright, I'll go with you. But I'm a bit tired......" Before you could finish, Tenna couldn't wait to interrupt you.
"Darling, what do you want? I can do anything." "He's willing to do anything for you. Even if ...... is impossible, as long as it's your command, he'll be willing.
You propped your chin with your hand and thought carefully. You felt this proposal was a bit bold, but you did want to experience it. After all, he was so tall, so you suggested, "I wonder, could you carry me over there?" ”
Tenna's antenna suddenly stood upright, shaking excitedly. He propped his chin, and even the mouth on the lit screen curved into a smile: "Darling, of course I'm willing! You can tell me as much as you want, I'm only afraid of you...... Maybe you don't want to ......" Because he could tell you were a question, maybe you still didn't trust him that much, maybe...... Maybe you didn't love him as much as he loved you, but he was always comforting himself that loving you was enough...... But he still wanted more. From that moment that belonged only to him yesterday, he seemed even greedier. He hoped for more moments when you could belong completely to him, just...... That seems completely impossible.
You slowly swallowed the egg—it was soft-boiled egg. Tenna really remembered your preferences, at least this breakfast was very satisfying. Hearing this, you were momentarily stunned: "No, I'm not unwilling. Then just carry me over there." You said this in a flat tone, as if giving an order, and Tenna was clearly very pleased with it. After all, you could see the two antennas above his head swaying happily again.
As she spoke, breakfast was finished. Tenna put all the plates in the kitchen and brought you a glass of honey water. This is your morning habit—adding two drops of honey to a glass of water will make the water taste better. You just took a gentle sip of the perfectly warmed honey water, squinting slightly, listening to the splashing water in the kitchen—probably Tenna cleaning those plates.
After you finished the honey water, Tenna came out. He took the cup away and rubbed his hands together at you. You looked at his screen, cold sweat seeming to drip down, probably...... Is he nervous? That's your guess, and as you expected, he said, "Darling...... I've packed up. Shall we set off? ”
You softly hummed in response, and he bent down slightly. You looked up at him and saw the ruby pendant gently swaying around his neck. You remembered the photo of you two hidden inside the pendant, but in the end said nothing, just gently grabbed the pendant with your hand and then grabbed the collar. You felt Tenna's body stiffen for a moment, but he still managed to force out a few laughs: "Haha, darling, get ready, we're heading out!" As he spoke, he reached out to support your hips and easily picked you up, even bouncing it in his hand.
You frowned slightly, but in the end, you reached out and wrapped your arms around Tenna's neck to hug him. Your cheek was pressed against Tenna's screen, and his body stiffened again, then his heart burst with joy from these subtle touches. He likes it when you approach him proactively, and he likes to approach you proactively. Every time he turns his head to see your face, he feels immense joy, and his heart in his chest is pounding violently. Fortunately, you can't hear the sound of his heart right now. He feels satisfied just watching you stay by his side, but he also feels anxious, because after all, what is close to him is your body, not your heart...... If, if ...... One day, you can wholeheartedly tell him that you love him. But Tenna always felt that such a day would never come.
So he carefully cherished this small moment, cherished the present moment, and didn't want to be able to have it even now.
You leaned against Tenna's slightly hot screen and glanced at him with some puzzlement. For some reason, Tenna walked with a bit of a hand and foot, and seemed a bit light and light. If you hadn't subtly pushed him, you felt like he would have crashed straight into the utility pole ahead.
"If you feel uncomfortable, then put me down." You said.
But when Tenna heard this, she suddenly hugged you tightly, shaking her head: "No...... No, I won't let you go...... No, I'm not feeling uncomfortable, darling, you know, I'm just too happy...... "Oh my god, what on earth is he rambling about?" He doesn't even know. But when he says this to you, he seems a bit pitiful, a bit cautious, and the screen goes dark, as if the next second the screen will be wet again, with big droplets rolling down.
You were silent for a moment, feeling that he was holding you too tightly, but you didn't say anything. You just reached out to touch the head of the big TV, then wrapped your arm around him and gently pressed it against his screen. But his screen seemed to be getting hotter and hotter.
Tenna holds you, walking down the street with enthusiasm, or perhaps almost like a drifting haze. He lifts his head toward the TV, as if wanting everyone to know that his lover is always clinging to him at this moment, holding his lover—if only it had lasted a little longer, he just wanted to hold you forever, always be with you.
He carried you slowly and cautiously down the street. You wondered if he was walking too slowly and couldn't help but look at him, only to see a rare big flower pop out of his nose, and even the corner of his mouth was upturned. You were silent for a moment, then noticed that the Dark People passing by the street saw you and whispered at you both, lost in thought. Tenna probably noticed and raised his head even higher.
You don't really know what he's really happy about, but for once, you don't want to disturb him for the moment, so you just reach out and gently tap his screen and whisper, "That grandma's shop at the corner...... Stop for a moment, I want to buy some daifuku and other snacks." ”
Tenna did as told, but he just shook you again, forcing you to hold him tightly so you wouldn't fall. You felt the TV screen pressed against your cheek change direction, and it seemed to have quietly kissed your cheek, wet. You stunnedly touched your cheek, and at that moment, Tenna also walked over to the corner shop. He bent down slightly and squatted down so you could see the counter and the wooden shelves clearly, but he refused to let you go. You could only feel the hot screen pressed against your cheek. You felt uncomfortable, moved a little away, but then felt the screen press close again. In the end, you let him be, not fussing over these little things.
You just patted the TV case with your hand again: "Aren't you going to put me down?" Don't you feel tired? "You originally wanted to shout for him to put you down, but all you could feel was his hand at your waist tightly gripping you. Hearing that, he suddenly shook his head.
"Not tired, I'm not tired at all, it's so easy! After all, holding my beloved feels light too." That's what he said. You looked down and saw his hand trembling slightly as he held you. Your gaze shifted and you looked back at the counter. The elderly lady was smiling at you: "Wow, you two are really close......"
Tenna seemed even happier hearing this. He looked down at you again. You didn't deny it, so more and more flowers bloomed in his heart. He felt sweet and delightful, constantly repeating and savoring the word 'husband and wife' in his heart. You ...... It really is the relationship you acknowledge. He hid that hint of blossoming in his heart, not daring to show it to you.
So naturally, you just don't know anything. You just tucked the stray hair that had fallen from your ear behind your ear, then looked at the items on the wooden shelf and started ordering: "Auntie, get me five strawberry daifuku and five matcha-flavored ones." Mm...... Then take five cream puffs and that piece of red bean pastry bread. ”
The old lady smiled and picked up the snacks for you, wrapped them, handed them to you. You also took out your wallet to pay, then poked Tenna's screen to signal that he could get up.
When he picked you up, his figure inevitably swayed, taking several moments to steady himself. You saw it all and quietly said, "Let's hurry up on the rest of the journey." "After all, there's no point in wasting time any longer."
Tenna's screen went black again, and ...... It seemed like some droplets of water were rolling down again. Whether it was just my imagination or not, his figure seemed to shrink a bit—probably not just an illusion, since now your feet were touching the ground and standing on the ground, while he silently wrapped his arms around your waist, the heavy TV head resting on your shoulder. You sighed, forced to ask, "What happened to you again?" ”
But he just whispered, "You...... Are you looking down on me? You...... Do you think I'm ...... I'm useless now? "Your voice trembles with sobbing. You turn your head slightly, and his tears have already soaked your shoulders. You don't know why your lover is so sensitive, so you can only reach into an oil-paper bag and take out a cream puff, speaking softly.
"Tenna, open your mouth." As you spoke, you gently tugged at his collar, signaling him to obey. But before you could react, the screen had already lit up. Although tears were still rolling, and you could feel his body trembling, he still opened his mouth.
You gently put the cream puff into his mouth and said, "Go ahead. I don't mind you...... I just told the truth." You looked a bit confused, watching Tenna close her mouth, then after a while opened it again, and simply tossed another cream puff in.
He still held you, the head of the TV resting on your shoulder, sobbing: "...... So, so I ...... you Is it useless to you? ”
Tenna felt that everything seemed sour and astringent, but that cream puff, after biting through the shell, filled his mouth with sweetness, making him feel that everything between him and you was just like this—sweet and sour, as if he had to ...... He had to say something to taste a bit of sweetness. And he enjoyed it willingly.
You touched his screen, frowned slightly, feeling a bit awkward, so you took a bite of the strawberry daifuku yourself, then held the daifuku in your mouth, turned around, and hugged Tenna too. His screen instinctively lit up again, and you precisely found his mouth, gently bit it, kissed it, and fed the strawberry daifuku into his mouth as well.
Then you whispered, "...... You're not useless to me. You...... Well, very important to me. "You don't know what to say either, but it's clear that the sobs have faded, yet he still holds you, even tightening his grip when you pull him close.
You had no choice but to kiss his screen again, then take out a matcha daifuku from the bag and stuff it into his mouth.
"After all...... You know, I still care about you a lot," you struggled to find your words, trying hard to figure out what to say to him. In the end, you picked up the ruby pendant, opened it, and showed him the photo of them together. "At least for now...... At least, tomorrow and the day after, I'll like you. At least, I love you very much...... "No matter what else he wants, you don't know what else he wants, you don't know what else you can give, and maybe you know too...... You just can't give it.
Tenna finally stopped crying, her hand holding you loosened a little. He sniffled and asked, "So...... At most?" His voice still trembled a little.
You didn't say anything, just lowered your head slightly, picked up a cream puff, and stuffed it into your mouth. After chewing for a while, Tenna swallowed. In that moment of silence, Tenna even began to regret the question she had just asked...... He knew perfectly well what the answer would be.
But you lift your head and slowly say, "I will love you forever." ”
Tenna was stunned for a moment, his screen lit up again, and a flower appeared on his nose. He was truly surprised—after all, he never thought he'd hear that from your mouth. He could only imagine, and always only imagine. He always thought you would one day promise him, always thinking about the day he would ...... He could truly have you......
But he hadn't been happy for a few seconds before his heart, as fragile as glass fell to the ground, dirty and completely shattered. The flower at the tip of his nose also withered and slowly withered.
Because he heard your voice—your cold yet almost ruthless voice: "Is this what you want to hear? You clearly know...... It's just a lie. ”
Tenna fell silent again. He just grabbed your shoulder, that pitch-black screen staring at you, as if the next second the screen would change into something else. You just stood on tiptoe again and kissed him on the screen.
In the end, you still compromised. If your partner wants to do that, then so be it: "If you want to walk slowly with me...... Then just walk slowly, no rush." You just can't figure it out...... Why is he so obsessed with promises you can't make?
But he just lit up the screen, slowly grew a bit bigger, and then, just like before, picked you up again. You noticed his hand was still trembling a little, but...... Maybe he didn't want you to notice—it wasn't very obvious.
Your cheek pressed against his screen, and he was still crying. The screen was pitch black and cold. He just held you and slowly walked forward. You could only gently kiss his screen, softly licking the tears rolling down the screen. His screen was bright, and flowers kept sprouting from the tip of his nose, as if his whole body were floating among petals. Yet he was just holding the collar happily, dancing along the street, casually making a circle. The passersby all looked at Tenna with strange expressions, but he didn't care at all. He just joyfully hugged the collar and murmured to himself, “So Y/N cares about me this much... So she has always been watching me, and... she has always known where I am, which means I have always been by her side...” Tenna felt his whole body becoming light and floaty. He remembered that there was a bug in the collar and couldn't help bringing it closer to his mouth, then continued repeating himself.
"I like you... I like you so much, oh Y/N... You have no idea how much I love you. I was thinking, it would be great if you just kept looking at me... My wish has actually always come true. I originally thought it was impossible... Darling, I really like you so much, love you so much..." He was somewhat incoherent, while on the other end, holding the phone and listening through the eavesdropping device, you remained silent.
Tenna's screen became wet again, with tears continuously streaming down, but this time his screen wasn't dark; on the contrary, it was lit up. Tenna was anticipating, or perhaps entirely delighted, he was looking forward to all the goodness in the future. He thought he knew everything, knew just how much you cared for him, so... so why didn't you tell him before? Tenna's mind raced with thoughts as he quickened his pace toward the home you shared.
…He noticed it. At first, you were a little nervous, but then you became slightly calm. After all, if he couldn't accept it, he could leave, but he seemed to be able to accept all of this.
You stayed at home, slowly closing your eyes to rest, until a loud crash sounded, and your door was pushed open. Then Tenna carefully closed the door again. He leaned over to your side and lay on your lap. You felt those tears wetting your lap once more, and when you opened your eyes, you saw his screen glowing, and the flowers emerging from his nose were falling on you one by one.
He spoke incoherently: 'Y/N, dear, so it was you who put the tracker and the bug inside the collar, so you only had me in your contact list, so you only cared about me… Why didn't you tell me sooner? I've been constantly worrying. If you had told me earlier… how happy I would have been, and dear would be happy too, right? Oh really, finding out that dear cares about me so much, I'm just so happy, I like you so much…'
You interrupted him: 'So how do you know that you are the only one in my contact list?'
Tenna stiffened, and his originally upright antenna drooped at this moment. He said softly, 'I... uh, peeked at your phone during the Christmas period...'
However, he became self-righteous again: 'But you’ve also been keeping track of my movements all along, so in this way, we’re even!'
You silently watched Tenna without speaking, and Tenna also quietly turned off the screen. In the long silence, he felt a bit uneasy.
And you are thinking that perhaps checking and interfering with someone else's privacy is inherently an unacceptable behavior. You don't think there's anything wrong with him checking your phone, but... but since he equates this matter with monitoring his whereabouts, perhaps he assumes that he wouldn't like it if someone checked his phone, meaning he wouldn't like it either... but you don't know, you only know that Tenna seems very happy.
So you just asked softly, 'Are you really feeling happy?'
Tenna just rested her head on your lap, staring at you with the dark screen, her voice also trembling a little: 'You... what do you mean?'
You just shook your head: 'I don't know... do you really like it, or rather, do you really like me?'
No sooner had the words fallen than Tenna eagerly interrupted: 'Of course I like you, I like you very, very, super much!'
"...Fine, but you have to understand, I can never give you the same level of feelings in return. After all, what is most important to me is myself, and only then comes you. And if you want to become my possession... locators, bugging devices, cameras... all of this and the like will be surrounding you. So... if you can't be sure that you can accept this collar, I can leave your side." You lowered your head to look at him, then tilted your head away and stopped looking at him, just lightly clenching your fists. You thought, this is the last chance for Tenna—if he leaves this time and never comes back, you will find the next more obedient dog, a dog easier to control, and if Tenna chooses to stay by your side—he will have no more chances.
Tenna also lowered his head, his antenna drooping down and landing on your legs. He felt a little heartbroken, with a heavy feeling in his chest, as if falling into an ice pit.
His voice trembled as he slowly asked you, 'So… so you mean to drive me away?' Tenna couldn't be sure that he could accept this kind of love, because in his heart, the most important was you, and only then himself. He… he even began to doubt this kind of love of his.
But you didn't answer him; you just turned your head, closed your eyes, and didn't let Tenna see the struggle in your gaze.
Tenna lifted his head, then lowered it again, slowly picking up the shattered mood all over the floor. With heavy steps, he opened the door and gently closed it; he left your home.
TBC.

title: [Merge] Collar Five
content:
This story features a more S personality and a more M tenna. Some chapters also contain R18 content.
——
The next morning, you smell the aroma of breakfast—it's the one Tenna prepared for you. You get up, get dressed, and sit at the dining table, waiting for Tenna to bring the breakfast. He brings the prepared breakfast to the table, still wearing an apron, then leans on the TV, his nose still blooming, sitting across from you, looking at you with anticipation.
As you ate bread spread with blueberry jam, you said slowly, "After breakfast today, take me to the company with you." "As you spoke, you picked up another piece of bacon and put it in your mouth."
Tenna seemed even more excited. He leaned his head forward a bit and asked mournfully, "How is it...... How do we get there? ”
You glanced at him, not understanding why he could ask such a silly question, but you still kindly answered: "How you usually take me away, today you just take me there. Just carry me and leave." ”
Tenna quickly nodded. I wasn't sure if it was just your imagination, but you always felt like his screen suddenly seemed to brighten.
After you finished breakfast, Tenna waited at the door, half-squatting down, arms resting there, waiting for you to sit in his arms. You didn't hold back, straddled his arm, wrapped your arms around his neck, and sat on his arm. Then you watched Tenna lift his head to the TV, happily leading you out, your nose brimming with flowers. He wished everyone could see you two in the same state right now. And you just closed your eyes slightly, leaned against his screen, counting his steps, and only opened them when he was almost at the company entrance.
At that moment, Tenna was holding you hesitantly. You were at a corner, and the company's Dark People couldn't see you. Tenna quietly asked, "I...... Should I put you down here?" Although he asked that, he was still a bit reluctant. He didn't want to put you down, but wanted to show everyone that this was their relationship. He wanted everyone to know that you were a perfect couple.
You tapped his screen and said casually, "Just take me over directly." After all, the receptionist knows you're my husband. "So, it's okay to do this. You just hid a possibility and didn't tell Tenna—those Dark People all know Tenna is now your husband, and Tenna was their former boss. It's inevitable that once they learn Tenna got a job, they won't squeeze him out, thinking he's only staying here because of connections. However...... You also hope he can handle these troubles himself.
Either he stays by your side, just being a loyal dog. Although a bit mean and a bit foolish, this is a well-behaved and well-suited dog, or ...... Tenna is either able to accomplish something on his own and do something, proving that he is valuable. That way, even if he feels unwilling, he will still let the dog go out. However, if he likes the life he once had...... Then he will come back. If he doesn't like it and just walks away, then you'd rather get a new dog.
Even if you thought that way, you didn't tell Tenna a word, just waited for him to carry you to the company entrance. All the Dark People in the lobby looked at you with strange yet somewhat admiring eyes. Tenna carried you up the elevator, lifting his head proudly, because now the Dark People at your company probably knew the news, knew the sovereignty he had declared, and also understood the relationship between them.
Tenna walked into your office, put you down, and turned to leave. You flipped through the documents on your desk, then called out to Tenna: "Wait." ”
Tenna happily turned her head again, her nose blooming with flowers. He thought you had some sweet words to talk to him.
And you only handed Tenna a document: "This is a proposal. Your job is to revise and polish it, and to develop a plan to promote our company's new programs and productions." You said calmly. You watched as Tenna's screen went dark. He timidly took the proposal, then left your office and closed the door.
You calmly started handling the documents handed over by other employees, since you can't do nothing—you're very busy. You nod as Zapper revised the submitted proposal again. You agreed the script should have broadcast value, but still needed to be handed over to the project team evaluating the TV drama for re-review. So you put the file on the pending side. You looked at the document Pippins submitted. They proposed opening a casino in a rented shop near the company. You thought it was probably for their own use, and since casinos are a gray industry and not good for the company's future, you directly vetoed the proposal. Finally, there's the document Shadow Guy handed you over. This document mainly concerns the new show's plan, attaching a temporary stage venue ticketing map, a layout map, and a corresponding emergency response plan. You nodded and thought the plan was feasible, so you approved it. Finally, you took the proposal Zapper presented to you, made some suggestions and annotations regarding the broadcast of the TV drama, and finally called Battat. Your voice was calm: "Ah, there's a TV drama planning proposal here that needs your review. Come to my office and take this proposal now." ”
Soon, your door was knocked. You called out and invited in, watching as Battat, wearing a microphone helmet and carefully entering your office, bowed in greeting and then took away the proposal.
You look at Battat and sigh softly: "I've said it many times, I know you guys, you don't have to dress like this." ”
Battat hesitantly replied yes, then closed the door and walked out. You glanced at the time—it was time for the morning meeting. So you turned on your computer and started a video conference. Except for Tenna, who just took office today, everyone else participated.
You cleared your throat twice and started by explaining something: "Today, Mr. Tenna officially joined our company and will take on the role of content planner." You announced this calmly, and as you looked at the countless faces in the video conference, they were indeed starting to get anxious.
One of the zappes saluted you: "Boss, Mr. Tenna does mean something different to us. After all, it's because of him that we can survive in this dark world. But I don't think what Mr. Tenna is good at is suitable for our company......
An pippins also started to interrupt: 'Yeah, boss, could it be that guy only got in because of your connections? Can he really achieve anything?'
Shadow guy couldn't speak, just played a little tune on the saxophone, agreeing with Zapper and Pippins.
You cleared your throat: "First of all, I did hire Tenna partly because he was once the lord of this dark world, and because of his potential abilities. Second, his joining this company has nothing to do with me. I assigned him a project, and as long as he can actually do it well, it proves he has the strength to stay here. So...... There's no need for you to rush to mock him. "You said softly.
You know what these employees will probably do, so you hold a meeting at this time to remind them not to say anything randomly. Some employees probably understand, while others seem half-aware. You can only say this much; the rest depends on their choice and Tenna's choice. You simply announce the meeting is over, then close the video call.
The morning's work was almost done. You glanced at the time, used your personal phone to call Tenna, and called him up. Tenna came to the ground in high spirits. He thought you were going to give him something, but you just handed him a contract, your voice cold and indifferent: "This is the contract I drafted this morning. Take a look and see if there's anything wrong. I'm hiring you. You're working part-time, just come to the company for 24 hours a week, and the pay is clearly stated, along with vacation benefits and so on. I hope you'll accept it." "You rarely spoke so long to Tenna. Tenna stayed silent, took your contract, and started flipping through it. He had to say the benefits listed in the contract were very good, much better than the ones he had previously hired. In the end, he nodded and signed his name on the contract.
So you signed your name on it too. The contract took effect, and you put it away in a drawer. Then, resting your chin on your hand, you looked at Tenna, who was standing in front of you, a bit timid, and softly asked, "So...... Do you have any thoughts on the planning proposal I gave you this morning? ”
Mentioning this made Tenna excited, having something to say: "Ah, I've reviewed the polishing of that proposal. I think we need to reconsider the broadcast time slot—this time slot isn't very suitable for this show. Also, I want to share opinions about staff selection. I think using pippins on stage would be more suitable for this show......" He beamed with excitement, returning to his old profession similar to his previous job, looking energetic again.
You still propped your chin up, only nodding gently when you heard his words. Indeed, according to your idea, this proposal was revised the same way—this job was just a test you assigned to Tenna. So you nodded and generously praised, "You did a great job. That's exactly where the proposal needs revision. Next, I'll leave the revisions, implementation, and coordination of this proposal to you. I believe you won't let me down." After saying that, you took another sip of water to soothe your throat.
TBC.
You looked at him, seemingly overjoyed by your praise, Tenna was overjoyed, her nose blooming again. You just calmly asked, "So, regarding the proposal I proposed to have you write from scratch, what do you think about it?" ”
When this question was mentioned, Tenna stammered again; his screen went dark again, his hands behind his back, and you just quietly looked at him.
After a while, after a moment of silence, Tenna finally spoke. His voice became less confident again, perhaps realizing that no matter how hard he tried, the plan he came up with was still a bit old-fashioned: "I...... Um, the plan I have is to take promotional photos for them, and then promote them during the TV show......
You nodded. This was a standard plan, not too bad. You tapped your knuckles on the table and added, "You're right. Overall, your idea can be implemented, but you also need to understand the current situation. The promotion of the new play can't be limited to TV shows; it needs to be promoted across major media platforms, and we need to filter which media outlets are more suitable for our promotion, and which might not be very effective even if they do it. I've also assigned you to work on this planning proposal. I believe you'll do it well." As you spoke, you gently nodded at him. The office door was knocked, and you saw a zapper walk in. So you asked him to wait outside the door for a moment.
Finally, you look at Tenna again and nod at him: "I believe you'll do well with the proposal I hand over to you later. I hope you can create even better results for my company—hmm, so if you have anything else, you can leave now." As you said this, you still wore a smile, while Tenna, somewhat unskillfully, glanced at the time on her phone and finally tentatively asked, "It's almost noon. Can I invite my wife to lunch?" As he spoke, he took out another lunchbox and placed it in front of you, eagerly scooping it over the edge of the table, just raising the screen to look at you.
You hesitate for a moment, then see Tenna take out another lunchbox and place it beside you, then nod to him: "Alright, come sit here." ”
At the same time, you shout toward the door: "Sorry, it's lunch break. Come over when you start work in the afternoon!" The zapper outside responded, and you heard his hopping footsteps away.
Tenna was a bit unhappy and muttered, "Why don't you just have him wait outside the whole time...... "The last time he came, he could only sit on the sofa watching Zapper report the mission to you."
But you just shook your head and said softly, "I can't let my employees feel disheartened." ”
Tenna fell silent. He wanted to question you, but could that really make him feel disheartened? But...... But he also knew that whatever he made could already be fulfilled, he seemed a bit greedy. But even then, he would never be satisfied, never satisfied, even though he didn't even know if he could reach eternal length with you.
So he quietly opened the two lunchboxes, eagerly handed you the utensils, and you ate the takoyaki and pork rice balls prepared in today's lunchbox, then leaned in to kiss Tenna's screen.
"Today's food is really good, I really like it." You said lightly, and Tenna just felt her body become lighter. He chuckled foolishly as you calmly continued eating the rice ball. By the time you finished, Tenna hadn't even eaten a few bites.
So you thought for a moment and reminded, "Then sit on the sofa next to you and continue eating." Tenna didn't understand but still sat down next to her as you instructed. Then you dialed the phone and called the Zapper, who you had just called down, to come back and report.
Zapper bounced open the door to your office, glanced discreetly at Tenna, who was still sitting on the sofa eating lunch, then placed the documents on your desk and began to report to you.
"Boss, regarding the tour you mentioned to our project team before, our team has already discussed it again. This production was a huge success at first, so we're preparing to start a tour. However, the actors will probably need to be replaced, and there are also stage design plans and stage prop selection plans...... Take a look." He mumbled as he finished speaking, handing you the documents, anxiously waiting for your answer.
You took the plan and glanced over it. There were no major issues. Just as you were about to take a closer look, you noticed a resentful, burning gaze. You looked up and saw Tenna hadn't continued eating, just staring at you with her antenna hanging down. You sighed softly, really not understanding why Tenna was acting like this again.
So you could only skim through the proposal again, quickly nod, and give a conclusion: "The plan is well done, generally fine. Just continue with this plan. If there are any minor issues, contact me or ask other colleagues—some of them are more experienced in this area." After saying that, you handed the file back to Zapper. He nodded and happily jumped out of your office again. You glanced at Tenna, who still exuded a gloomy aura and a pitch-black screen. You reluctantly sat down beside him and gently stroked his screen.
You asked, "What's wrong with you now?" ”
Tenna just shrank a bit, gradually becoming about your height. He tilted his head, staring at you through the pitch-black screen. It looked quite frightening at first glance, and you calmly looked back at him. In the end, he seemed deflated, the screen wet as it rested on your shoulder, soaking your shirt: "I...... Why do you still call someone in during your lunch break...... I just want to spend a little more time with you......" As he spoke, his heavy, huge TV screen rubbed against your shoulder.
You sighed and gently patted his head: "Because he came to see me earlier, and it wasn't lunch break yet. I finished lunch with you, so of course I had to finish the work I had delayed earlier." He explained patiently, reaching out to gently wipe the tear stains from his screen.
Tenna sniffled, her sobs growing quieter, and his voice was also very soft. He just asked in a low voice, "During lunch break...... Can't it be just the two of us together? "Can't ...... Can't it always be just him and you? Can't it just be like this? It felt like some monster was baring its fangs in his heart, but he could only force that monster to retreat.
You took out your phone to check the time and calculated: "You just called me to dinner twenty minutes early, but I only took ten minutes to settle this work matter." "In other words, you even made an extra ten minutes to spend with him."
"Lunch break is a time to rest." You added, telling Tenna that he could come anytime during lunch break whenever he wanted.
But he seemed to misunderstand and sniffled again: "So...... Except for work, I don't come to see you during my breaks. ”
You sighed and poked his screen: "During break, you can come see me whenever you want." ”
You don't know why Tenna sometimes acts a bit silly, but that's okay—you're patient. Tenna's screen lit up again, and a flower appeared on his nose again. He picked the flower and placed it on your head. That way, anyone who comes in will see the flower and know you belong to Tenna.
You let him lean on your shoulder and let him do as he pleased, just leaning on the sofa, resting your head against his, taking a nap during the lunch break. Then, as the break was about to end, the alarm rang, you woke up, and gently nudged Tenna: "Alright, it's getting late. You should go back to your post." ”
Tenna stood up, his antenna still drooping, looking a bit gloomy. But when he saw the flower on your head, his mood improved a lot, and he happily strode out of the office.
You sighed, still slightly pulling open your collar, revealing the bite marks he left on your neck yesterday. You don't want to cause any trouble, but...... A little showing off can satisfy the anxious guy, right?
So this afternoon, everyone who came to report saw the flower on your head that clearly belonged to Tenna and the bite marks on your neck. They hesitated, and after finishing their report, hurried out. You sighed silently in your heart, hoping Tenna could face the trouble ahead.
As for Tenna...... He returned to his small studio to start handling the plan. You turned on the pinhole camera's monitor and absentmindedly watched Tenna's actions. Then you saw Tenna push open the door and walk out. You switched to the regular camera in the hallway and continued watching Tenna's actions. Shortly after he left, you saw him run into Pippins, who was bouncing and talking about something. The monitor didn't have recording function, so you could only see Tenna's screen turning red. He seemed to be arguing with Pippins.
You look at the screen, black-and-white and red-blue lights shining on your face, flickering on and off.
Tenna felt wronged, because Pippins probably came because he used to look down on them—he still looks down on them now, but clearly, Pippins probably also looks down on Tenna.
The pippins bounced and said sarcastically, "Are you really not the employee the boss squeezed in?" "I think you're close to the boss, and you even left her with a kiss mark." ”
TBC.
Tenna still blushed, trying to argue his case: "But if it weren't for my ability, why did she hire me and put me in charge of content planning?" As he spoke, he pointed to the name on the sign above his office.
Pippins was still bouncing around: "Hmm...... I don't believe you can trust this job. "After all, Tenna used to be an employee, and they knew all too well what Tenna was capable of.
“…… Even if you don't believe me, you have to trust Y/N's judgment." Tenna's screen was pitch black, just a bit red for some reason. Pippins saw it, but he didn't care; he was just a bit surprised that Tenna would actually defend you. Before...... Aside from those people from the Dream Chaser family, he had never seen Tenna defend anyone else.
"Yeah, but maybe the boss is just blinded by lard—" pippins said casually. You didn't have any rule forbidding them from cursing the boss, so he just said whatever came to mind. But before he could finish, Tenna interrupted him.
He said anxiously, "You say I can do it, but please don't talk about her...... I won't allow anyone to speak ill of her. ”
Pippins fell silent, looking at Tenna with a curious gaze. He hadn't expected Tenna to openly defend you like this, probably...... Maybe she really does have some feelings for you? Pippins didn't mind that either. He just shrugged: "Alright, let's see in a few days and see if your abilities really match the position—hmm, I still genuinely doubt the boss's judgment." After saying this, he mumbled another sentence.
"If only the boss liked me too—I'd be perfect as a lover......"
Tenna heard this too, and he hurriedly interrupted the pippins again: "No, you're not suitable. Do you know what Y/N usually does? Do you know what she likes to eat? Do you know what she prefers to hear? Do you know what positions she likes? Do you know what kind of person she likes to see? Do you know what kind of person Y/N actually is? You know nothing, how dare you say things like that......" As he spoke, the screen flickered, then brightened for a moment but then went dark. He was actually a bit nervous, because he knew that even after spending so much time with you, he still didn't fully understand you. He still didn't know what kind of person you really was—he could only say he had a superficial understanding.
Pippins was stunned by Tenna's question. His gaze toward Tenna changed again, and finally, he stood properly on the ground: "So I really don't know much about you...... Now I know why the boss chose you, and why he trusted you." He said this without a trace, but walked straight away. Tenna watched his back, snorted coldly, and went to your office with the proposal documents. Only then did he realize that although the TV shouldn't have felt anything, he felt sweat all over his back, and even the TV screen was soaking wet, leaving only cold sweat.
He exhaled twice and walked toward the elevator. The elevator carried him to the floor where your office is located. Tenna knocked on your office door, and you only responded with a cold invitation. When someone opened the door and walked in, you realized it was Tenna.
Your tone was calm: "Is the proposal ready?" ”
His screen was pitch black, but he couldn't see how wet he was. The cold sweat that had just broken out had already been secretly wiped away. He nodded, placed the proposal on the table, and then nervously waited with his hands behind his back, waiting for what you'd say next.
You picked up those documents and flipped through them. Overall, they were pretty good. Tenna rearranged the timing and lineup of the promotional and planning staff, and also suggested the general approach for the event.
So you nodded: "Hmm, this document is pretty well done, but you should also remember to check out the current electronic products and media programs. You need to see what's trending right now, then complete the next proposal. As for this proposal, I'll find someone to carry it out. Tenna, you can leave now." ”
You put down the document and typed on your computer, planning to notify the Dark People from other departments to take the proposal home. But you didn't hear any footsteps. When you looked up, Tenna was still standing at your desk with her hands behind her back. His screen seemed to be dripping with cold sweat again. You didn't know why he was so nervous, so you just tilted his head and asked, "Hmm?" Is there anything else you want to tell me, or is there any work to report to me? ”
Tenna's fingers twisted and twisted behind her for a while, and finally he timidly spoke. His voice was very soft. He didn't know how you'd react, but he had a kind of hope—a strange anticipation—that he would punish those pippins who badmouthed you. He already knew those pippins weren't any good: "Exactly, when I first left the office, I had an argument with one pippin—that pippin actually dared to doubt your judgment and even secretly cursed you. If you ask me, none of these pippins were any good from the start. You can't just let them go on like this, or you'll just be sidelined at the company." If you ask me, you should threaten them and use some punishment so they won't dare to act recklessly...... He mutters to you, quietly sharing the methods he's used before. He's full of hope that maybe you'll punish these guys severely, just as he expected. Tenna is also looking forward to it, maybe you'll say something to comfort him—after all, he's the one hurt by these words. At this moment, he's standing in front of you, his antenna hanging low, head hanging down, looking dejected.
And you just glanced at him quietly, then asked lightly, "That's all you say. Is that all?" ”
Tenna was taken aback. He hadn't expected you to react like this, but he still nodded: "Yes, that's all. But if you ask me, just this is already serious. You can't just let it go, or who knows what your company will end up like......" He kept rambling, cautiously looking up to observe you, but you still wore that same expression.
You sighed, resting your elbow on the table. You tilted your head and looked at him, gently tapping the table with the knuckles of your other hand: "I understand, but I never set any rules about what they can or can't say. Here, as long as you work hard and show me your performance, that's enough." I don't have such high demands, nor do I need to be so rude. If they really say something to me, then either their nature is bad and they won't do their work well. Of course, I can fire them. But if they say something else, maybe my decision was truly wrong, and I will reflect on myself and try to correct myself. "You rarely spoke to Tenna for a long time. Tenna listened in a daze, her figure shrinking until you couldn't see him anymore.
You sighed, stood up, walked to the table, picked him up, and placed him on the sofa, softly saying, "But thank you for standing up for me, and thank you for being willing to say something to me. That's enough." You saw his drooping antenna shake slightly, clearly hearing what you said, but you still picked him up, kissed his wet screen twice, and whispered.
"Tenna has done great, you know. I really like you, so...... Get well soon, I still need you. "Your voice was soft, and after saying that, you put him down and just sat quietly beside him. Sure enough, he grew bigger again, and you could hear his faint sobbing.
He was just crying: "So...... I just said so much to you, was it useless, I...... am I an unqualified lord......? Tenna began to doubt himself. He admitted he couldn't be as generous as you. If he knew an employee was badmouthing him, he would definitely fly into a rage, punish that employee, and dock his salary. The reason he wasn't fired was because in his world, there were only so many employees.
You remain silent, then gently tap the case of his TV: "No, of course you are a qualified Lord of the Dark World, because you have given the people of darkness hope and regained light and the joy of life." ”
"I...... I'm just an ordinary boss who took over your work and works here, so my approach is naturally different from yours. If they all resign because I'm too strict, they'll find other jobs, and my company is no longer dominated by the people of darkness. I'm not like you. Of course, you can punish them as you please, because you're the sole master of the world. But I can't, because I've only replaced some of the people whose functions govern here. I hope you can understand that." "You still have some patience to explain to tenna. You really aren't the master of this world; it's just that the people under your command trust you. You, a citizen of light, have gained the ability to control this world that lies between the realms of light and darkness."
Tenna finally stopped crying. His antenna still hung down, and he just quietly listened to you telling the story. His antenna twitched, as if he understood something.
"So...... Well, you've already done very well, Tenna. "You don't know how much more to praise him, so in the end you just patted his shoulder and said as if nothing had happened." Tenna's antenna stood upright again, his antenna trembled twice, then he suddenly turned around and hugged you, his voice still trembling.

He had you completely, possessed you, so he cherished this time, rhythmically moving shallowly and deeply, feeling the tight, soft flesh of the passage wrapping around his thick member. Until, after an unknown amount of time, you buried your head and continued rubbing against his chest. His body shuddered, trembling for a moment. His member buried inside you, he whimpered and hugged you tightly as well, feeling his member twitch in waves, spraying wave after wave of cool fluid, as if he wanted to hand over all the long-accumulated desires inside to you, shooting inside you.
Tenna held you tightly, then carefully pulled out that member, holding you in her arms, and went to the bathroom to help clean up, while you let Tenna play with your sore, exhausted body. He carefully applied some medicine to the slightly swollen flower after intense sex. You sat in his lap, closed your eyes, quietly listening to the hair dryer click, while Tenna picked up strands of your hair and gently dried it. He looked at your body, at the faint hickeys and pinching marks left on it, swallowed hard, and couldn't help but feel desire again, but he held back—because at this moment, he already felt incredibly happy.
So he gently held the sleepy you and lay down on the bed, carefully setting you aside, while he simply turned to gaze at you for a long time.
You muttered something twice, but Tenna couldn't hear clearly. He just watched you turn over under the covers, then roll into his arms, nuzzling his chest with your head. You were almost dozing off, not thinking much about it, just knowing that in front of this guy, you could relax a bit and you were probably safe. So you followed that slight warmth and rubbed against his warm chest, then curled up in his arms.
Tenna's screen couldn't help but light up. A blooming flower appeared again at the tip of his nose, but Tenna simply plucked the flower from his nose and carefully tucked it between your hair. He looked at you, gently lowered his head, kissed the top of your head, then carefully embraced you, closed the screen, gently tugged at the blanket, and hugged you, who was already making even breathing sounds and probably already asleep, curled up in the blanket as he fell asleep.
Tenna thought, if only every day could be like this, if only every day ...... He could look at you, kiss you, and then hold you to sleep. He doesn't know if you'll agree to this small request, so he can only cherish this seemingly long yet incredibly brief time and hold you to sleep. Maybe in his dreams, he'll hear you promising him forever again and again, and loving him again and again.
He only smiled at the corner of his mouth and peacefully drifted off to sleep, even though he had no dreams all night.

title: Collar 11 (tennax you)
content:
This story features a more S personality and a more M tenna. Some chapters also contain R18 content.
——
You woke up groggily, still exhausted and sore, and you weren't exactly very clear-headed. But...... The light was on, and you smelled the aroma of toasted bread—probably Tenna got up first to prepare breakfast. You sat up, holding your forehead, changed your clothes, and tried hard to prove you could still get out of bed. Then you got up and slowly walked toward the dining table, sitting down in your usual spot.
Tenna placed the baked bread and jam on the table, along with freshly fried eggs still sizzling and two slices of bacon smoking. She placed the knife, fork, and plate in front of you, then sat down opposite you. You saw his screen lit up, and the antenna was upright—probably hoping you'd give him a compliment.
You leisurely spread jam and put bread in your mouth, the heat just right. It seems he listened to what you said yesterday and calculated the events you'd likely wake up for—after all, your wake-up time is quite fixed.
You put down the bread in your hand, nodded for once, and gave Tenna a gentle smile: "Yeah, well done. The taste is exactly what I like." Then you saw Tenna's antenna wobbling unobtrusively, her nose sticking out, and a little flower sprouting from her nose tip. You actually smiled inwardly, but you didn't show it on your face, just slowly eating breakfast.
Your movements were elegant yet quick. Soon, you finished breakfast. Tenna took the dishes, knives, and forks to wash them. Of course, he had already had breakfast. You squinted at the table and rested for a moment. Hearing his cautious footsteps, you opened your eyes and looked at Tenna, who was cautiously approaching you. He smiled awkwardly at you: "I...... I thought you were asleep. I was even thinking of carrying you to bed to sleep. ”
But you just shook your head softly, "I still remember, today I have to go out with you." ”
Tenna immediately straightened up. Whether it was just my imagination or not, you always felt his screen was a little brighter. Of course, soon it was about the same brightness as usual. His voice was a bit excited but also a bit cautious: "Then...... Then, this time, can we go to the park together...... Shall we have a picnic? "He wants to spend more time with you, and he wants to ...... He wants others to see that he is loved by you, at least ...... He wants others to think he is.
You looked up at him. Tenna's screen had gone dark, and the antenna was drooping. Probably because he hadn't received your reply, he felt you didn't agree, so he hurriedly said, "Alright, actually I just wanted you to stay with me a bit longer—"
But before he could finish, you interrupted him. You just nodded and said softly, "Sure." ”
Tenna's voice stopped. He probably hadn't expected to hear the answer, so his screen slowly lit up, the antenna stood upright, and you see another little flower sprouting from his nose, while he was just busy with excitement.
"Oh...... First, you need to bring a basket. Darling, what do you think of this? "Tenna said as she excitedly picked up a basket. You glanced at it quickly—it was probably something everyone else would use for a picnic. So you nodded and responded with a hum.
He enthusiastically went to pick out the rest again.
"How about that...... Dear, do you prefer red tablecloths, yellow or blue? "He put down the basket, picked up a few tablecloths, and showed them to you. You glanced at them and thought the color didn't really matter, but today's weather was pretty nice, right?
So you think for a moment and say, "Then, the blue one." ”
He muttered as he opened the fridge again, folded the blue tablecloth, and put it in the basket: "Oh...... First, the red bean paste bread and daifuku I bought yesterday, plus some bread and snacks from the bakery...... Put on a few plates, and prepare hot water and tea set...... He was busy tidying up all sorts of things, and you just rested your chin on your hand, yawned, and watched him busy.
Hearing your yawn, Tenna's body stiffened. He turned to look at you, his voice a bit stammered: "Dear...... Darling, do you want to rest for a while? Can't we go together...... "Well, it's okay......" As he said this, his head lowered, the flower on his nose withered and fell, the screen went pitch black, the antenna drooped, and his whole body shrank a little.
You sighed softly and rubbed your temples: "I'm fine. You've been waiting for a long time, haven't you? Let's set off." ”
Tenna just let out a muffled 'oh'. His body had grown a bit larger, but the screen still didn't light up. Just like yesterday, he naturally picked you up, the antenna still hanging in front of the screen. His other hand was holding the picnic basket, but his movements were slow. After a long while, he still hadn't left the house, as if waiting for you to regret it.
You yawned again, kissed his antenna, then pressed your head against his still cold screen and closed your eyes. Soon, your breathing became even, almost like you had fallen asleep.
Tenna, on the other hand, became at a loss. He carefully held you, bent down as he walked out of the house, then gently closed the door as if afraid of waking you, and walked out onto the street.
His screen lit up again, becoming somewhat warmer. You muttered and rubbed against his screen. Tenna's body only stiffened further. Then, his heart burst with joy, feeling that light happiness again. He was certain he was very happy now, and Duan Duan could never be happier. He just gently rubbed your cheek with the screen.
Then, cautiously, a smiling face appeared on the screen, a flower blooming at the tip of his nose, leading you forward at a pace that wasn't exactly fast. Of course, there would be passing Dark Commoners, some even knowing Tenna. After all, it's not just about making money—they also have to go out to prepare meals for you. Those Dark Folk wanted to greet Tenna, but Tenna always gestured to silence with her index finger in front of her mouth, then pointed at you sleeping soundly in his arms and shook her head. Of course, his face was still full of happiness, especially about your slight dependence on him...... He just felt a bit flattered.
The Dark People understood, also nodding at Tenna with a smile, watching her figure as she led you away.
Tenna always thought that if only this time could be a little longer, if the road could go farther and have no end, how wonderful that would be...... From time to time, he would lower his head to look at you, as if if you could disappear from his arms for even a second.
But the road does have an end. Tenna saw the park too. His antenna drooped slightly, and he slowly carried you inside, then found a patch of fresh grass—not far from people, but definitely not disturbed—and put down the picnic basket.
Then he gently poked your cheek with his finger and softly called out, as if he couldn't bear to wake you up: "Wake up, Y/N, we've arrived." ”
Actually, you haven't been sound asleep at all—just a light sleep. You can't just let yourself sleep outside without rest. Even though you're in Tenna's arms, you can feel his carefulness. You know how gentle his breathing is. Only then do you rub your eyes, pretend you've just woken up, look around, and see Tenna patiently waiting for you. Then you tap Tenna's screen: "Put me down." ”
Tenna obediently put you down. He carefully laid out the tablecloth—or rather, your picnic cloth—then laid out the tableware, arranged the bread and snacks he had brought from home, and finally set up the tea set. He brewed a pot of hot tea with hot water, poured a cup, and eagerly offered it to you.
You took a gentle sip of the hot tea. The temperature was just right, and you sat down in the empty spot on the picnic cloth, right next to Tenna. You slightly lifted your head and saw Tenna looking at you with concern. The antenna hung down, and you gently stroked it and asked, "What's wrong?" ”
He nervously tugged at his clothes, seemingly adjusting his tie again, probably to look a bit better, and softly asked, "Sorry...... I just want to know, darling, what would you like to eat first? ”
You tilted your head slightly and glanced at him, then at the pastries on the tablecloth. At that moment, a good idea popped into your head. You winked at Tenna and said, "Mm...... I want to have some sandwiches now. ”
Tenna seemed stunned for a moment, then hurriedly picked up two slices of bread. For some reason, his picnic basket actually contained some sausages, bacon, lettuce, and a jar of salad. He carefully arranged the two slices of bacon, sandwiched salad in the middle, and stuffed some sausage slices. Finally, somehow he got the knife and cut the sandwich in half, cutting it diagonally, turning it into a simple sandwich.
You took a bite and gave Tenna a thumbs up. No matter how many times you try, you have to say Tenna's cooking is really impressive. The sausage and bacon were probably homemade by him to suit your taste; they weren't too salty, and the salad dressing helped balance the flavor. Overall, you enjoyed eating them with great enjoyment.
And Tenna, who got your thumb, was happily shaking the antenna.
