title: Collar 12 (tennax you)
content:
This story features a more S personality and a more M tenna. Some chapters also contain R18 content.
——
Of course, you wouldn't be stingy with praise, but since you're not good with words and don't say much, that's all you can say. Yet Tenna was very happy; he knew this was your approval of what he had done—before, it seemed he had never lived like this. He only remembered the expectant glances he cast at you again and again, but you remained indifferent, while Tenna...... could only feel disappointed, but despite his disappointment, he could only revolve around you—or rather, he was willing.
…… After all, just calling his name is enough to make him happy for a long time, let alone watching him all the time. Tenna propped her chin up, just sitting on the tablecloth, beaming with a smile, a little flower blooming from her nose, just staring at you the whole time. Of course, you could sense his gaze, but you didn't care. You simply picked up another red bean bun from the plate, slowly stuffed it into your mouth, didn't look up at Tenna, and just took another sip of tea.
Tenna, however, was already satisfied. His antenna flickered, and he just stared at you. This place was quiet, but occasionally people would pass by. When they saw you and Tenna sitting close together, they all smiled knowingly, and Tenna felt happy. He only needed to look down at you and already saw all his own happiness. He knew...... No matter what, in the eyes of outsiders, you were probably a perfect couple. He desperately longed for you to admit something, but as long as you tacitly accepted...... That would be enough.
Lost in these wild thoughts, Tenna didn't react for a moment when you handed him a large fortune cake. Until he heard your leisurely voice: "Alright, have something to eat too. Weren't you the one who called me here for a picnic?" "Even though you know very well that he probably doesn't really want a picnic, he just wants to spend a little more time with you. You don't quite understand why he stays by your side all the time, but maybe...... That's fine too.
After all, you really do need someone who is wholeheartedly yours.
But in any case, no matter what, you still have a bit of tolerance toward your lover. Seeing his smile, probably lost in thought, with a hint of teasing, you watch Tenna hurriedly bite down on the daifuku, then leisurely take another sip of hot tea and softly ask, "What are you thinking about?" ”
But just those few words startled Tenna like a sudden thunderclap. His antenna instinctively trembled a few times, the screen flickered on and off, and finally his antenna drooped gently, looking a bit aggrieved. You couldn't understand what he was really upset about, even though you had already fulfilled the request he made.
As for Tenna...... He really feels awkward asking you, asking if he will be part of your life journey, asking you...... Are you really a real couple? If so, why have you made no commitments until now? He is clearly your lover and has done all those things with you, but in the end, what does he mean to you?
He hugged his knees tightly, and the head of the TV hung down. You looked at him, waiting for him to speak. He would always say something, so you heard him speak cautiously, almost trembling: "I...... I'm wondering, what will my dear Y/N become in the future? Will ...... What will you do in the future? "Will he be there in your future?"
You tilted your head, not realizing he was thinking about this question, so you thought carefully before answering, "Hmm...... My future? I hadn't thought about that before; after all, the most important thing is the present. "You said slowly, and it was rare for you to say something this long.
"However...... If you truly want an answer. I will do my job well, use my savings to buy a new home, and the clothes and furniture I wear. Maybe, maybe I will still have the free time and energy to travel again. "You spoke calmly about your original plan. You are very confident you can achieve this goal, and by then, you will be free.
But as Tenna listened, his figure suddenly shrank even smaller, and the antenna completely drooped. When you turned your head to look, you saw his screen was wet again, and big tears began to fall again.
You sighed silently, picked up a large fortune cake, and brought it close to his screen. He opened his mouth and ate it, while your voice remained calm: "What's wrong with you? If you hadn't told me, I would never have known." Your lover always seemed to like to wash his face in tears. You didn't know why he was like this, but you knew he was sad. You couldn't control all his emotions, which made you feel a bit irritated—though maybe your lover is just such a troublesome creature.
So you just watched his screen glow slightly, probably chewing on that daifuku, while you gently wiped his screen with your hand, then leaned in and softly kissed the TV casing. You felt the screen seem a little warm, at least not as cold as before, and you just quietly watched him, listening to his sobs. He whimpered a few times before finally speaking.
"Then...... What about me? "He doesn't dare ask why he's not in your future, nor does he dare ask...... Will you even consider him in your own future? He really wants to question you: what does he really mean to you? Is he just a trivial plaything? Or an insignificant object? But he doesn't dare to ask you. If, to you...... He really isn't important, then he hopes that at least, at this very moment, Tenna is an important presence to you, not something to be ignored.
You tilted your head, a bit puzzled, but in the end, you still fed him a large fortune, and he obediently ate it. You simply said coldly, "That's your future, it has nothing to do with me." ”
After a pause, you hear your lover's sobs grow louder. If no one else were around, you'd be afraid you'd be met with a bunch of condemning looks. He wailed loudly, like the sound of a kettle boiling......
You had no choice but to add, "But since you said you'll never take off the collar...... Then now, take me home and hold me." As you spoke, you reached out your hand to him. Tenna's crying gradually faded, but the screen was still damp. He obediently began to tidy up the napkin, finally picked up the basket again, and looked at you. You walked toward him, naturally reaching out both hands. Tenna held the basket with one hand, while the other picked you up and slowly walked forward. His posture remained unchanged; your toes almost touched the ground.
But you just leaned in, gently kissed his screen, and spoke softly, almost as if inviting: "You promised you wouldn't throw away the collar, and you wouldn't let me lose yours." So, what do you think your future will be like? ”
His screen was still wet, but his figure had grown a bit larger, and his voice sounded a bit muffled and damp: "...... I'll always be by your side." Tenna said. Although he still felt a bit dissatisfied and anxious, more than anything, it was a sense of joy...... Or perhaps a feeling as if dust had settled. At least, Tenna knew that to you, he wasn't insignificant.
You reached out satisfied, patted Tenna's TV, then pressed your cheek against his wet screen and whispered softly, probably not hoping he could hear clearly: "Mm, as long as you don't throw away the collar." ”
And then you stopped talking. Although you didn’t manage to give him a completely satisfying answer, Tenna also understood… or perhaps, he only realized after experiencing countless times that these words from you were already very rare, so his antenna no longer drooped, and the screen became slightly warm, at least when you leaned against him, it just felt cozy. You closed your eyes and started dozing against Tenna, your breathing becoming steady, and Tenna thought you were asleep, lowering his footsteps and not daring to make a sound.
But you remembered how far his steps would reach, and you quietly counted them. Only when you were almost home did you rub your eyes and, pretending to just wake up, lightly straighten in Tenna’s arms, then pointed to the shop on the street corner: 'Tenna, stop there for a moment.'
Tenna held you as she said and stopped in front of the pastry shop, then bent down slightly so you could talk to the old lady inside.
The old lady just smiled and said, "Oh my, the young couple is here again." ”
You just smiled and said, 'Mm. Five cream puffs, five matcha daifuku, all to go.' Then you took out your wallet and paid. The old lady packed the pastries in paper bags and handed them to you.
Tenna carried you back toward home. You also took out a cream puff and stuffed it into his mouth, then leaned in and kissed the corner of his mouth.
It wasn’t until you reached your front door that all the pastries were finished, and Tenna’s screen lit up again. He happily set you down, took out the key, and opened the door.
After dinner, you pulled him along to play video games to pass the time, then after washing up, you lay down normally on the bed and closed your eyes.
Tenna carefully pulled the blanket back and lay down next to you, snuggling up close. It seemed that even just sleeping next to you would make him happy for a long time. You gently rubbed in his direction, then tilted your head and rested your head on his chest. Tenna's body instantly stiffened, but hearing your steady breathing, he thought you were probably sound asleep. So he carefully placed his arm on top of you, maintaining a half-hugging posture, awkwardly falling asleep.

title: Collar 13 (tennax you)
content:
This story features a more S personality and a more M tenna. Some chapters also contain R18 content.
——
It's a new week. After finishing the breakfast Tenna carefully prepared, you didn't comment, just hurriedly grabbed your briefcase and headed out. After all, you have to go to work.
As for Tenna—he was curled up at home, sitting on the sofa, dark on the screen, and then a cooking show started playing automatically on his screen, already thinking about what kind of meal to prepare for you.
And you...... Sitting at your own desk, watching reports submitted by others. The company you currently work for—or rather, the company you run is a media company—and you are reviewing the promotional and performance planning proposals submitted by your subordinates.
You tapped the paper and said emotionlessly, "The overall number of people planning was wrong. In my opinion, this performance should be reduced by one thousand people—just report it to three thousand when reporting. Also, the safety planning plan isn't detailed enough, so keep revising it." After saying that, you handed the reports back to Zapper, who was bending down to show you. He bowed toward you and then hopped away, while you just pressed your brow with a slight headache, closed your eyes and pretended to nap, since you're waiting for the next report to be presented.
However...... Probably they're still revising the plan, so at least you haven't seen it before noon.
Tenna carefully plated the lunchbox, placing two small strawberry sandwiches in the lunchbox, then several sausages shaped like little octopuses—and a few cherry tomatoes piled together. After closing the lunchbox, he carefully carried it and walked toward your company.
Tenna walked into your company, and the front desk pippins asked who he was looking for—Tenna's feelings were complicated, since these Dark People were originally employees of his world, but you saved him and took over the position of lord of this world, and he had no complaints.
His antenna bent, trembled twice, the screen lit up, and a little flower appeared at the tip of his nose: "I—I'm Y/N's husband! I'm here to deliver lunch to my dear wife!" He shouted this loudly and proudly, and the front desk pippins gave him a rather flirtatious glance, then finally let Tenna take the elevator upstairs.
Holding the lunchbox, wondering what to say to you, Tenna's mind was always active. He was hoping you'd praise him, or perhaps the smile you'd show after tasting the lunchbox, or maybe you'd give him a kiss—or a hug, even if just a word? He imagined what you'd say when you saw him. As he thought, another flower popped up at his nose. He carefully picked one and stuck it on his strawberry sandwich, hoping you'd see his joy and embrace his heavy feelings.
Thinking this, he stepped out of the elevator, lightly and swiftly heading toward your office. Finally, he stopped in front of a room, which was also his former room—thinking of this, Tenna couldn't help but feel a bit bitter, but he quickly composed himself. He knew that being saved by you and receiving your love — even if only for this very moment, it was already very happy. He didn't ask for more. Because...... He knew very well that maybe the people of light would still look at him seriously, only you, and only you.
Tenna took a deep breath and gently knocked on the door. Then he heard your voice, indifferent, saying, "Please come in."
He pushed open the door, holding the lunchbox in his hands, standing tall and shouting loudly, "Darling—"
But before he could finish his sentence, he died because he discovered there was someone else in your office—a Shadow Guy, the same person he had been hiring as a fan before. His screen went black, his hand lowered, and of course, you noticed Tenna's voice, tapping his knuckles on the desk: "Okay, put it on the desk first." "You need to finish your current tasks first."
Tenna silently shrank a little, walked over, placed the lunchbox on your desk, then sat down on the sofa nearby, the screen dark, antenna hanging down. He waited for you to finish talking, and also for you to notice him. He hoped you—even just glancing at him would be nice. But you didn't look at Tenna. You just looked at the proposal Shadow Guy presented, flipped through it, and then commented, "Hmm, this proposal is pretty good, but you need to make sure you can find an agent who can provide it, or at least hire one." Also, since the plan is finalized, you should discuss what kind of script you want to produce these next few days and give me a rough look. After you finished speaking, you handed the proposal to Shadow Guy, who gave you a slight bow before happily leaving your office.
Tenna hadn't expected you to be completely unaware of him, and only after the door closed did you have the energy to deal with lunch and Tenna's matters. You glanced in his direction and saw his screen was covered in tears, wet, even the sofa was a bit wet. His body had become very small, probably about the size of a pet dog. He hung his head, looking as if he had no other reaction.
Tenna wondered, when will you finally look at him seriously? He felt a bit wronged. You and those employees have plenty to say, so why are you so reserved with words when facing him, saying just a few words? Tenna doesn't understand why you're like this, nor does he understand how you treat him, and he doesn't dare disturb you. So he can only quietly cry here, and he can only feel sad about it all, but no matter what, it's hard to let go.
You sighed, not knowing what was really going on with your lover. There was always a first-come, first-served order. You must have handled other people's matters before taking care of your own lunch. But you still sat down beside him holding the lunchbox, then sat on your lap holding him. You opened the lunchbox and began to enjoy today's lunch.
You first take a bite of the sandwich, then say seriously, "Hmm, the sandwich tastes great. Tenna put a lot of thought into making it, right?" Thank you. "But you know that saying these things probably works, since you see the hanging antenna slightly upright, and you don't see his tears dripping down soaking your clothes anymore."
Then you used your fork to pick up a small sausage and chewed on it, softly saying, "The shape of the sausage is quite interesting. Tenna probably decided after watching a lot of cooking shows, right?" As you spoke, you gently touched his screen again. It was still icy cold, but it didn't feel damp anymore.
In the end, you ate the cherry tomatoes again and softly said, "That's great. Eating fruit after meals is a good habit. Thank you, tenna, for reminding me." As you spoke, you gently patted Tenna's head, and then you watched as his TV screen lit up again, but...... Probably because he was still in your arms, he hadn't grown bigger.
You heard his voice sound a bit muffled and a bit cautious: "So...... So do you like this lunchbox? "You like it too...... Is he the one who went to great lengths to prepare your lunchbox? But Tenna didn't dare ask that question; he just leaned closer into your arms, the head of the TV resting against your chest.
You gently stroked his cheek again and said casually, "Mm, I really like it. Tenna's bento tastes really good." Then you held him and spun him around. You could feel the screen suddenly getting hot, and Tenna seemed to be getting bigger. But since he was still in your arms, Tenna held back the urge.
You gently hugged him again, then placed him on the sofa beside you, returned the lunchbox to him, and smiled slightly: "Tenna can take this empty box home now. I'm very satisfied." "As for exactly what you're satisfied with—of course you wouldn't tell him."
Then, you see Tenna suddenly grow bigger, and then he hugs you tightly, kissing your face wildly, or rather, an overwhelming wave of kisses falls like that. As he kisses, he licks and entwines yours, making you a little dizzy, tears welling up at the corners of your eyes, while your gaze remains clear.
Tenna finally let go of you. His hands carefully wrapped around you. You sighed softly and stuck the little flower from the lunchbox into your head, as if announcing Tenna's possession. You felt Tenna's screen brighten even more—probably a surprise. Anyway, he stammered, "Darling...... I love you the most. I will always love you the most......
You gently reached out to tap his screen, didn't say much, and didn't respond. You just nodded, responded with a hum, then tilted your head to look at him and kissed his screen. You felt his screen getting even hotter.
"Go back, lunch break is almost over." You said, which meant work would start soon, and others would walk into the office. Only then did Tenna reluctantly get up, glancing back at you every few steps, while you simply sat back down at your desk, starting to clear the morning piles of work and messy documents, without looking up at him.
But as soon as Tenna saw that flower still hanging on your head, she was overjoyed. He knew that all his longtime employees in this company were his longtime employees, so—all the Dark People would know that the flower belonged to Tenna, and that you belonged to him. With this indescribable yet elusive secret thought, he happily went down from the elevator.

title: Collar 14 (tennax you)
content:
In this story, the Yn personality is more S, and the Tenna is more M. Some chapters also contain R18 content. This chapter mainly focuses on Tenna's psychological portrayal.
——
As he passed by, those Dark People would look at him with a look that he couldn't quite understand, just a slightly ambiguous gaze, as if he were acting like something truly disgraceful. Tenna just straightened his antenna, glared fiercely at the pitch-black screen—well, even though he had no eyes at all, he felt that gesture sounded more like a glare. In short, after he looked over, no other inexplicable gazes came his way.
Tenna only remembered after stepping out of the company gate—he seemed to have planned to wait here and pick you up after work, but hadn't told you about it beforehand. You didn't know Tenna's plan. Tenna hesitated whether to go upstairs and tell you again, or just wait outside the company—he knew exactly when you got home each day, because everything was fixed except for overtime. But he didn't know how long he'd be waiting here, or rather—Tenna didn't know if he had the right to wait for you and then walk back with you. But...... Since you let him have that kind of relationship, that means he had the right to do it.
Tenna walked back and forth outside the door holding the empty lunchbox. He knew that quite a few Dark Citizens passing by and those in the company lobby were looking at him with strange expressions. He also knew that for you...... Maybe whether he was waiting for you or not wasn't that important. His antenna couldn't help but hang down again, and in the end, he hesitantly walked into the company building, went to the front desk, and asked the pippins, "Your boss...... I mean Y/N. What time does he usually get off work? ”
Pippins looked at Tenna with a very strange expression. After all, this was the first time he'd seen his former boss so humble, and he was just flipping through the booklet, pretending not to hear Tenna's question: "Oh, sorry, what are you talking about, sir? Could you please say it again?" ”
Tenna couldn't help but bare his sharp teeth, but he just gritted his teeth in anger. He knew exactly what these guys were doing—to get back at how he treated them before! Your voice was somewhat cold, and Tenna's body stiffened. He probably didn't know you would give that answer, nor did he know you would say that. Seeing tears about to roll down his screen again, you sighed, held the head of the TV, and looked at him, repeating yourself once more.

He had seen it countless times before, but ...... He never opened it, because he knew you wouldn't like him interfering in your affairs.
But tonight, whether he's lost in thought or for some reason, Tenna sneaks a glance at the bathroom. He estimates you'll be out in ten or twenty minutes, so he picks up your phone and sneaks a look. He tells himself that just one glance is enough.
The unlock password for the phone was theirs...... On the day they met, Tenna didn't expect that you would always remember. The lock screen was open, and he couldn't quite understand the other apps. He just clicked on the exact same Contacts app as on his phone, and then he discovered—or perhaps as if ecstatic—that in your contacts list, there was no one else except him, and everything else was blank.
Tenna thought, maybe...... Maybe the wish he once made in his heart, a wish he thought was impossible to fulfill, was so easily fulfilled. Tenna just acted guilty and put her phone back on the coffee table, comparing it to try to keep it in its original spot. Then Tenna sat upright on the sofa, wanting to stop the endless blooming of his nose, but the flowers kept popping up. Helpless, Tenna could only cover his nose and try to keep his screen pitch black. He nervously glanced at the bathroom—you were still inside. Tenna made up his mind, went into the kitchen, grabbed a piece of cake, and then entered their shared room and closed the door.
He hesitated for a moment, then his nose started to bloom again, and he slowly typed a text message for you: [Dear, please come to your room with your eyes covered, then take it off. I've prepared a surprise for you!] ]
He touched his chest, which was pounding violently. Tenna took a deep breath, then spread the cakes on himself, then stuck the fruit from the top of the cake onto the cream on his body. Just as you were thinking this, you heard a knock on the office door. You shouted loudly to come in, then saw Tenna push your door open and walk in. You signaled with your eyes what else he wanted, and Tenna swallowed twice and whispered, "...... You said that if you complete the task well, you can freely claim a reward. ”

But now he knew that he was the only contact on your phone, and you only had him, and probably only him in your whole world. So Tenna was already very satisfied.

You raised your eyebrows and waved, "Of course. You just need to go to the train station here and catch a train there. It's pretty fast." ”
Tenna quickly nodded and thanked you. He hadn't brought anything except a bit of Dark Coin, and was just set off enthusiastically. But when he arrived at the train station security checkpoint, he dazedly heard the alarm at the gate. Tenna knew that since he was a mechanical creature from head to toe, passing through security wouldn't be easy. But the security checks in the Dark World were carefully designed—unless there was something he couldn't bring and everything was made of metal, since the Dark People working at the station could see it.

Tenna took off the collar in confusion and handed it to another staff member. He opened the pendant to check it and told Tenna, "There are trackers and bugging devices inside. These can't be brought on trains." ”

He just glanced at the collar again, then at the two small items in the staff member's hands. The screen suddenly lit up: "Oh—then could you please help me put these two things back?" I've been anxious all along. If you had told me earlier...... How happy would I be? Darling, you would be happy too, right? Oh really, I'm so happy to see you care so much, darling. I like you so much......"
You interrupted him: 'So how do you know that you are the only one in my contact list?'
Tenna stiffened for a moment, and his previously upright antenna now drooped. He whispered, "I...... Um, I secretly checked your phone during Christmas......
However, he became self-righteous again: 'But you’ve also been keeping track of my movements all along, so in this way, we’re even!'

But since he equates this with checking and monitoring his whereabouts, maybe he thinks he doesn't like checking his phone, which means he wouldn't like it either...... But you don't know, you only know Tenna looks happy.
So you just asked softly, 'Are you really feeling happy?'
Tenna just rested her head on your lap, staring at you with the dark screen, her voice also trembling a little: 'You... what do you mean?'
You just shook your head: 'I don't know... do you really like it, or rather, do you really like me?'
As soon as she finished speaking, Tenna interrupted her anxiously: "Of course I like you, I really, really, super like you!" ”
“…… Okay, but you have to understand, I can never give you equal feelings, because in my heart, the most important thing is myself, and you comes second. And if you want to become my possession...... Trackers, bugs, cameras...... Everything like that will surround you. So...... If you're not sure you can accept this collar, I can leave my side. You think, this is Tenna's last chance—if he leaves this time and never comes back, you'll find the next more obedient dog, a better one to control. But if Tenna chooses to stay by your side—he won't have another chance.
Tenna also lowered his head, his antenna drooping down and landing on your legs. He felt a little heartbroken, with a heavy feeling in his chest, as if falling into an ice pit.

But you didn't answer him, just turned your head away, closed your eyes, and didn't let Tenna see the struggle in your gaze.
Tenna lifted his head, then lowered it again, slowly picking up the shattered mood all over the floor. With heavy steps, he opened the door and gently closed it; he left your home.

Although he felt an inexplicable pleasure when he saw you raise his coffee cup and pour it over the man across from him, the splattered coffee soaked the document he was holding up. He had already seen this document, but because you were here, he was distracted and embarrassed to put it down—what if you saw it?
Although he had already looked at this document several times earlier—it wasn't really important, and most of it was just nonsense—it was still the document he wanted Tenna to see—ah, damn boss, and he was just an unlucky employee, Battat thought through gritted teeth. And he was innocently caught up in this kind of scene. Thinking about it this way, he was even more unlucky. When would his luck finally turn around?!
But when he quietly lifted his head from behind the file, he realized that at some point, you had been staring at him, or rather, looking at the document in front of him. Battat didn't know why, but he was so nervous that cold sweat broke out. Oh my god, he really didn't want to see you in a place like this. It would be best if you just walked away!
Unfortunately, his hopes were dashed. You already knew that the one hiding behind the documents was battat, and you saw the coffee marks on the document that had been inexplicably affected. Of course you should go to him for compensation. Of course, you might think, maybe battat now would rather you walk away—but you refuse!
Yes, that's right. When you couldn't see him again, you regretted it for quite a while. You really enjoy the feeling of talking to him—it's really clear and very clear, much better than some useless employees under you! Now that I see him again, of course I want to have a proper conversation.
It's not that you never thought about looking for him, but unfortunately, in the TV world, it seems like he's just avoiding you. In any case, every time you go there, you never see him, so you leave regretfully.
Over time, only his shadow and faint words occasionally surface in your mind.
After thinking for a moment, you walked up and knocked on his desk, looking down at him from a high vantage point—from this angle, you could even clearly see that the person hiding behind him was battat. You almost wanted to laugh, but held it in.
"Ahem, I'm sorry, the coffee I just smashed soaked part of your documents. How do you need me to compensate you?" You cleared your throat as if to put on airs.
Battat looks up, and now your smiling gaze meets yours. He won't recognize you until you recognize him, and he can't pretend not to know you.
He sighed and put down the self-deceptive document: "Hey...... No need for compensation! At worst, I'll go back and make a new copy! ”
You glanced at the document out of the corner of your eye: "But it seems this document might actually be quite important?" ”
"Yeah! If I hand over this document with coffee marks, I can't even imagine how Mr. Tenna will scold me! Alright, so I'll remake it...... Sigh, next time I'll have to sit farther away from others. ”
You blinked, pulled out the chair opposite him, and sat down. Battat was startled and instinctively sat up straight, his voice becoming a bit dry.
"W-why are you staying here? Didn't we agree that you wouldn't need to pay any compensation?" He stammered as he spoke.
And you merely glance at the documents, which even exceed the height of your upper body after sitting down, and shake your head in disappointment: "So you have to handle so many documents every day?" ”
Battat was stunned and hurriedly waved his hand: "Of course not! Most of these documents aren't urgent; I only need to glance at them. The rest are urgent—of course, that's not part of my daily workload. I just happened to have some documents piled up a few days ago, so I sent them all to myself. ”
You quietly look at battat: "Even if those documents aren't urgent, you should at least read them all and then summarize what exactly they are, right?" This is also a waste of your time and energy. "You don't think he's suited for these tasks.
So you rested your chin on your hand and looked at him: "If you ask me, you just need to handle those urgent documents. As for everything else, why not give it to other employees?" Paying those guys isn't for free. ”
"Uh... well, just having a job is good enough, after all, I'm just an pippins." He lowered his head, suddenly a bit hesitant, probably feeling a little embarrassed.
"So what if it's just pippins? As long as your abilities are here, who cares what your status is?" You pursed your lips, then thought for a moment and suddenly spoke.
"Forget it, it's rare to meet someone, and it feels like a special kind of fate—so, maybe we should just get a marriage certificate? And you should quit your job and switch jobs while you're at it, and come work at my company." "You're seriously giving your proposal."
"W-what, are you serious?" Battat didn't know where to start complaining for a moment, since every sentence had a lot to criticize.
And you nodded seriously: "Of course it's true. I'm just frustrated with not finding someone to marry, and even after marriage, I rarely see anyone staying overnight at the company—so as long as you come work at my company, that's enough! And I guarantee the benefits will be much better than those at Tenna. I'll give you plenty of vacation, enough overtime pay, a reasonable salary, and all sorts of other random funds and insurance...... you start calculating on your fingers.
"After all, I would never mistreat my husband." You said so righteously and with righteousness.
Battat was stunned by your words, but in the end, he nodded, then suddenly stood up, swept all the documents to the ground, and ran out: "You're right, I'm going to resign right now and start working at your company tomorrow!" ”
End.

——
Battat held the half-written proposal in his hand, hesitating as he glanced at the buildings on both sides. To be honest, he had his reasons for not daring to stay in the room he had been in before—how could he possibly hope others would discover that Mike was now wearing a disguised copy?
In short, besides, this proposal could only be left to him to write...... The other two guys were unreliable. He tapped his head and decided to find a place with few people to complete the proposal. Plus, he had stayed up late last night and had gotten up early again today to finish it, so he might need a cup of coffee......
In short, he walked into a quiet, seemingly deserted café ahead.
There weren't many people inside the café, and the seats were all empty, even giving off a fresh feel. Even the owner was dozing off at the counter.
But you still caught the sound of the glass door opening and footsteps. After all, you hung a wind chime on the door to keep yourself from noticing a guest had arrived. Now the bell was ringing, so you immediately woke up and forced a perfect business smile, pretending you hadn't fallen asleep at all.
"Welcome, sir. What would you like to use? The menu is clearly marked, and of course, you can also order at the counter." You said with a smile, placing the coffee cup you had washed that morning on the counter—uh, of course, you've actually washed it many times.
"By the way, we can freely choose our coffee cups...... Well, since you're the first customer in our shop, the cup you pick will become your exclusive cup, okay?" You blinked, somehow feeling like you're trying hard to promote the coffee business. Even though no one came to drink coffee, you were happy to have some peace and quiet, saving time and effort dealing with customers and brewing coffee.
After all, you're not short of money; opening a coffee shop is just for sentiment and personal interests. You still want to attract a group of regular customers with affordable coffee and simple yet delicious flavors, so they can rest briefly and enjoy comfort.
"Ah...... Is that so? "Battat was startled. Actually, when you were dozing off, he didn't think about waking you. He just forced himself to finish the proposal, and he didn't expect you to wake up.
Still, he cleared his throat and stepped forward, looking at the various coffee cups displayed on the counter. Some cups were simple, decorated with diamond-shaped or striped patterns, others had creative designs, shaped like peacocks or other species, and others used abstract colors and brushstrokes to depict abstract artworks.
There was a cup that looked quite odd, with only a name signed on it with a dark green pen. Battat couldn't recognize the name, at least he didn't think it was a celebrity's name. It looked like it was written casually, since some of the strokes had been washed away and some were slightly blurry.
He double-checked, "Can I pick any cup?" "After all, that cup looked like your own name, and Battat felt a bit embarrassed to pick one, but he couldn't help but look at the cup."
Following his gaze, you were startled and muttered, "Why did you take out this cup too...... I was planning to keep it for myself......
Then you closed your eyes for a moment and said with righteous determination, "Guest, pick whatever you like! Anything is fine—and I believe in your taste, I'm sure you'll have a good time here." ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, but finally reached out and poked the cup with only bare green handwriting: "Then this one, clean, and I like the color of the handwriting." ”
You opened your eyes, and good, you really picked out the cup you had forgotten at first, so you took it out together—you mourned in your heart, the one you wrote your name on for fun, and the cup that had gone out of glory after just two days, then continued to smile: "Okay, the color of this handwriting looks just like yours...... Hmm, what would you like to drink? I'll make you coffee right away. ”
"Huh...... Anything goes? I just want to stay alert. "As he spoke, battat shook the document in his hand. It was a proposal he had been halfway through last night, and now his mind was spinning, really not knowing what else to write.
You stroked your chin and thought for a moment: "Alright, I understand. I'll deliver your coffee to you later. Please wait a moment, sir!" ”
Battat let out a gentle breath and couldn't help but add, "Don't always use such respectful words to address me. I always feel a bit embarrassed...... Besides, my name is Battat, and I think I'll come to this place in the future too." He let out a breath. After all, it was really quiet here, with hardly anyone around, which was perfect for his work, and he didn't have to worry about whether anyone would notice him.
You blink and nod: "Alright! Well then, Mr. Battat, please find any seat to sit down. The coffee will be ready later!" ”
As you spoke, you picked up a bag of coffee beans, ready to grind them into coffee before brewing—since this process was quick. You decided to brew a cold brew coffee, which was refreshing, not acidic, and also had a refreshing effect. Since it was Battat's first time and the first customer, you decided to use only classic coffee beans.
So you can take out the Tampika—or call it Blue Mountain coffee beans? This is considered the oldest variety, a classic coffee flavor, very clean in texture, with floral notes, fruit acidity, and a refreshing sweetness.
The coffee machine rumbles. Once the coffee grounds are ready, you steep them in cold water and wait for a cold brew to finish. This process is a bit long—at least you yawn again. But the cold brew is still brewed. You see brown swirls gently spinning, and you think this cup must have a fresher taste, rich aroma, and sweetness.
Pour the coffee into that cup, carry the porcelain plate out, and immediately spot Battat sitting by the window, his head slowly moving as if he's about to fall asleep.
You walked briskly, deliberately softening your footsteps as you approached him, set down the cup of coffee, and then looked at Battat's head bit by bit, feeling a bit troubled. You saw the pen in his hand irregularly tapping the paper below, even with some scribble-like symbols in front—it was clear he was not fully conscious, but he came here to finish his work and even needed coffee, which probably meant he was urgently needed a document.
Anyway, you hesitate for a moment, but still nudge his shoulder and softly call out, "Battat, battat, wake up. The coffee is ready, and your work isn't done yet." ”
In any case, he suddenly woke up, his face still a bit startled. He didn't know what words had scared him out, but when he opened his eyes, he found you were looking at him innocently.
Seeing that he still looked a bit dazed after waking up, you pushed the cup of coffee toward him: "Alright, have this. The coffee is ready. I think it'll help refresh you." ”
Battat looked at it and still picked up the cold brew. To be honest, he didn't really care what kind of coffee it was—even if it was just a quickly brewed espresso, it didn't matter—but this cold brew still lifted his spirits. Of course, there was still a bitter taste at the mouth, but the acidity that should have come with the bitterness was almost gone, replaced by a soft, floral aroma and a subtle sweetness that seemed to envelop body and mind. Combined with the relatively cool temperature, it cleared his entire dice awake.
At least he couldn't say the coffee wasn't good; rather, it was rather novel. He hadn't expected such an unknown shop to have such outstanding craftsmanship.
"Hmm...... Thank you for this cup of coffee. I'm fully awake now. "Battat rubbed his head. Now he was looking at the proposal in his hand with some worry. He hadn't figured out what to write next, and now it was even better—he even wrote some scribbles on it. This paper was basically useless, and he would have to redo everything later.
"Although the coffee is delicious, I still hope all the guests who come here can relax. However...... Is this job really urgent?" As you spoke, you glanced at the document again.
"Yeah, I have to submit it tomorrow. If I don't write well enough, the boss might scold me. I'm still worrying about how to write next......
"Then, let me take a look. Maybe from a third-party perspective, I can offer better suggestions." You suggested.
Battat was stunned and stammered, "That's not really right...... This is my job, and you have your own job......
You just shrugged: "Oh, it's fine, no one else comes here anyway. Besides, I just hope you can relax a bit more here, so—let me take a look! Don't worry, I won't mess it up!" You even stuck out your tongue as you spoke.
Battat hesitated for a moment, then handed you the document that was definitely going to be discarded, then took out a blank one and began writing.
You took the document, sat across from Battat, and started reading, nodding from time to time. To be honest, what you wrote earlier seemed fine, or rather, it was good—well, although TV program planning proposals should be handed over to dedicated planning personnel, right? No matter how you look at it, they shouldn't be suitable for this, right?
But you do have some experience in organizing and planning—after all, your family has a company.
So you cleared your throat and started to look serious: "Ahem, I think what you wrote is fine, but I think before officially implementing this plan, we first need to identify each character's role, determine what they can do, and make sure they do what suits the job...... And for the upcoming project, why not include an audience participation segment? "You asked this question with some curiosity.
Battat hesitated for a moment, then looked up at you and whispered, "Because lately, the audience in the audience has been getting fewer and fewer." ”
You tapped your knuckles on the table: "Then there should be a segment like this—you have to attract some stable viewers to stay as a steady traffic. Of course, if you don't consider the audience, then your proposal should be a recommendation ...... for movies and TV dramas? So, you can compare and analyze similar films and provide in-depth explanations, such as studying some more specialized points. The mainstream tends to be watched by the general public, while those niche groups will naturally have more professional viewers or simply curiosity. ”
Alright, Battat thought your suggestion did use some wording, but he hesitated for a moment: "Is this really useful?" ”
And you nod firmly: "Of course it works! At least I really like this kind of more professional explanation...... Hehe. "As you spoke, you awkwardly touched your nose.
Battat nodded and began writing furiously. However, while writing, he could always sense a sharp gaze—not sharp, but feeling uncomfortable when someone was watching made him uncomfortable. After all, he came to this café hoping no one could see him......
So he still looked up a little awkwardly, looking at you, and found you resting your chin on your hand, watching him with great interest. When he stopped writing, he tilted his head in confusion: "Hmm?" What's wrong? ”
Battat cleared his throat twice: "Could you stop looking at me?" I feel a bit uncomfortable with this...... I can't keep writing. ”
You blinked, then simply closed your eyes, then leaned over the desk and muttered a couple of words: "Alright! Now I won't look at you, you can keep writing...... Just enough for me to sleep for a while......
As you talked, your voice quieted down, and soon you fell silent. It was obvious you were asleep, since Battat could hear the soft, even breathing.
He looked at you hesitantly, but in the end, he buried his head and started writing furiously. Whether it was the effect of that cold brew coffee, or the slight relaxation of his nerves during our conversation, or the suggestion you made that seemed a bit off-topic but actually useful, Battat felt his mind sharpened a lot at this moment, and he quickly finished writing the proposal. All that was left was to rub his aching hands, drink coffee, and stare blankly at your sleeping profile.
Coffee was just too useful. At least now, Battat didn't feel sleepy at all, and even miserably thought maybe he could write three more proposals.
When you wake up, the dice in front of you have long since left, leaving only an empty coffee cup and coins pressed underneath. You can count it—it's a bit more expensive than a cold brew coffee.
Besides that, there was a note under the coffee cup, probably written hastily by battat: Thank you.
You chuckled, put away the note, and picked up your coffee cup.

Alright—since you're here, let's see what we have for today. It's on me! "You wave your hand generously, showing your generosity.
Battat was momentarily stunned, then quickly waved his hand: "Ah, no need, it's just a cup of coffee. I'll just pay for it myself—"
"It's okay, as long as I'm happy, so what do you want to drink?" "I'll give you a free meal today." You raised an eyebrow and picked up a packet of coffee beans placed nearby.

“…… Uh, heart-shaped? "He looked around nervously, clearly not having any good choices, so he could only grumble and follow your choice. After all, Battat can see the latte art shape on your coffee cup.

You threw the coffee beans in, waiting for them to grind into powder and hand it to you. You hummed a tune, prepared hot water, put the coffee grounds into a cup, then poured in milk and hot water to brew. After a while, the coffee gradually turned light brown, and finally, you added a heart-shaped cream latte art on top.

Then you carried the tray toward battat, and you could immediately see him sitting at the same spot as yesterday, staring out the window in a daze, his fingers seemingly unconsciously tracing something on the table.

You smile and say, "Well, so it probably tastes better with coffee, right?" If you eat it plain, it definitely tastes sweet. "But you didn't tell Battat about this earlier, after all...... Getting overwhelmed by sweetness and stuff is kind of amusing to look at his expression.
He hesitated for a moment, but finally chose to believe your words, so he picked up his coffee and took a sip. To be honest, today's coffee did taste a bit sweeter. Maybe it was because of the latte art on the top floor, but the whole cup had a soft, sweet sensation that actually washed away the coffee's original bitterness.
But even so, a bitter taste still lingered. Seeing your expectant gaze, he couldn't resist and still picked up a macaron and popped it into his mouth—seriously! You had just promised in your heart never to touch this again? But seeing you look at him so pitifully, Battat couldn't help but try again.
…… But the taste is still acceptable? At least this time it's not as sweet. The lingering bitterness in the mouth washes away some of the macaron's sweetness, while the excess sweetness takes away the original coffee-like bitterness. In fact, starting with a bitter bite and then tasting the sweet one is a good choice—at least now Battat doesn't mind this flavor.
But he put down his coffee cup for a while. He thought for a moment, then couldn't help but ask with a question: "So, there are clearly no other customers, right? Why are you still opening a café here?" ”
You blink and sit up straight: "Is this a Q&A session?" Then let's ask one question after another—I'll answer you first! Well, honestly, I don't care if anyone comes. Of course—I also hope everyone can relax here. ”
"But my cooking skills aren't that great, and this café just opened. It's normal that no one comes—after all, there are already several famous cafés now." You shrugged as you spoke.
Battat nodded thoughtfully, then asked, "So...... Aren't you bored? ”

"It's nothing really, I'm just working on the TV world side... it's just that the workload is a bit heavy. Anyway, I'm just a pippins..." battat smiled awkwardly, and under your gaze, his voice suddenly lowered, since he felt a bit embarrassed about this topic.

But after that, you didn't listen. Forgive me, even though you inherited the company, you have absolutely no interest in running it.
"Really? But the boss probably thinks the pippins are just gambling and not doing their jobs...... Anyway, it doesn't really matter, anyway, they don't notice me. "Battat scratched his head in frustration, his clothes getting a little wrinkled."
You blinked: "Hmm, alright...... Let me answer your question first. Actually, it's not boring at all. Even though there are no customers, I'm happy to have some free time. I just need to sit there reading and don't have to socialize with anyone. It's just too convenient! But having guests come is a good thing, at least I can chat with you here." "Ah, actually, it doesn't really matter. I can just leave me here alone......" he stammered again.

"Alright, maybe you just want to find someone to chat with?" Battat sighed and decided not to pursue the previous topic further.
"Hmm, I'll answer that later. Let me ask you first. I want to know why, since you're so tired, you haven't switched jobs yet. You seem to be working very hard, so other places shouldn't be rejecting you, right?" ”
As you spoke, you took a sip of macchiato, put a piece of macaron into your mouth, chewed on it, and asked unclearly.
"Honestly, I've tried before, but other places wouldn't hire me once they saw I was a pippins, they didn't even bother to look further—" At this point, battat seemed a bit indignant. He had been holding a coffee cup, planning to take another sip, but now he angrily put the cup down on the table, making a loud clinking sound, which even spilled some coffee foam onto the table.
You have to admit, you were startled by his actions, but you quickly recovered. You just picked up a macaron and held it to his lips, your eyes slightly curved: "Alright, don't be mad. Have something sweet, okay?" If other places don't hire you, it's their loss—if you want, you can apply at my company. I'll definitely read your resume carefully! ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, then took a sip of coffee, waiting for the bitterness to wash over his mouth before taking the macaron and putting it in his mouth. Carefully and shyly, he thanked him: "Thank you." ”
"It's fine. But well, I'm not the type to chat with people, and I'm not the type to chat just because someone comes. Most of the time, it's better to be quiet. It's just ...... I found it interesting to chat with you, so I wanted to talk with you." You thought for a moment, touched your chin, and said solemnly.
"Maybe I'm just a bit curious about you. After all, it's not easy to find this café so precisely—so, would you like to apply for a job at my company?"
Battat hesitated for a moment, then slowly shook his head, his voice a bit hoarse: "In that case, probably not." ”
"Hey—why!" You dragged out your words, a bit incredulous.

You rubbed your chin to recall for a moment, then nodded firmly: "Ah, you can read, right? Usually, after the coffee shop closes, I go home. I always put out a disc with music playing, brew myself a cup of coffee, and sit on the sofa listening to music while reading. Oh, and I still have a gramophone at home now. I usually use that one to play music!" As you spoke, you gestured with your hand again, excitedly introducing the story.
"Anyway, and since my house is pretty big, sometimes when I get in the mood, I even dance along with the music on the gramophone...... But I don't look very good at dancing. I think I'm probably the kind of person who steps hard when dancing with others." You scratched your head awkwardly and stuck out your tongue.
Battat nodded thoughtfully: "Wow...... What a charming life." Saying this, his mood inexplicably sank, because he definitely couldn't live like this himself—every day was just too exhausting. At this moment, he seriously thought about whether their personal habits might not be quite right......
But before he could think further, you continued: "It's not exactly that stylish, I just have nothing to do. After waking up in the morning, I make myself a cup of coffee so I can happily go to work. And the house is too big...... I really don't like tidying up, so I just leave things around casually and I can see them. Just keeping the room tidy and tidy is exhausting. ”
“…… But I do prefer to use my free time to do something else and don't want to tidy things up. Mainly, being the only one busy is dull and boring, and no one else is watching. That doesn't feel accomplished, so it's better to be a bit more artistic in arranging things. At least I feel more at ease while watching. ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, then asked, "...... For example? ”
"For example, stacking a stack of books—like a triangle, stacked like a tower—I can even play a game of pulling out books and see when they'll collapse!" But the weight of books is different. Maybe playing cards would be better...... You excitedly gestured with your hands.
The conversation lasted for a while, the rain outside the window eased, and you said goodbye to Battat reluctantly, then you both headed off in different directions. Of course, you were planning to return home, and it was almost evening.
You walk toward home with new understanding and affection.
