"Then let's go to the KTV. If you're tired, you can rest for a bit...... Ah, but if you fall asleep, KTV charges by the hour, so it should be expensive......" Battat lowered his voice and began muttering halfway through.
You tilted your head, thought about the question, then cheerfully suggested, "It's fine, at worst case, I'll just pay!" ”
"How could that be! If it's a date, I should be the one paying!" You heard battat's retort, then you covered his mouth.
"Yeah, if it's over budget, I'll pay for it. No arguing, okay? I know it's not easy if you want to save money. You can't be the only one paying, can you!" After saying this, you finally let go of Battat's lips.
He muttered softly, "But you were the one who paid before...... This time, I have to pay, right......
You pretend you didn't hear and just whistle and turn your head.
Soon, you arrived at the KTV and got a private room to sit in. The room was dimly lit. You glanced at the song station and enthusiastically asked Battat what song he wanted to pick.
Battat cleared his throat twice: "Mm...... I'll just type it myself, no need to trouble you." "After all, the songs he wants to sing, he doesn't feel comfortable telling you directly. Even though it's just the two of you now, at least those are songs about work and bosses! Some are filled with curses, and he just feels embarrassed to tell you......
You blink at battat and wave your hand: "No trouble, I happen to want to request a song too, and maybe I can pick two songs we'll sing together." ”
"Mainly, I'm a bit embarrassed about the song titles, so I'll let myself handle them!" He closed his eyes for a moment and said as if he had given up on something.
You seem to understand, looking at Battat's face as if facing death with fear, you let out a meaningful "Oh—" and then casually pick a few songs you like. Honestly, there are all kinds of languages, and your preferences are quite broad.
Then you sit back down on the sofa and signal Battat to go pick a song: "Go ahead, I've already chosen. I'll ask if I remember later." ”
Battat nodded and went to the song selection station to pick a few songs. Of course, his movements were still a bit sneaky when searching, probably because he didn't really want you to see him. You shifted your gaze slightly; no matter how much you hide it, you'll still be able to see it on the TV screen later.
Sure enough, after you casually sing a few songs you picked, you see the songs Battat chose appear on the screen. The moment you see the title, you can't help but feel sympathy for Battat, who always has to work. But since you're ultimately wealthy, this empathy might just be a vague pity. Still, you do think the company treatment at Battat is really bad! Even though you've only heard part of it.
Because now the screen shows ...... Uh, the title of that song is "fuck the job."
In short, all you can do is mourn for Battat. But honestly, his voice seems quite suitable for singing? No, maybe it's even better for reading bedtime stories...... Although this song sounds explosive, you only hear a hint of fatigue and weariness in Battat's voice, and his voice is a bit hoarse, more like the soft rustling of pages scraping a book. You think absentmindedly, resting your chin on your hand as you listen to Battat's singing. After singing this song, the next few are also about scolding the boss or the job. You can't help but cough twice, go to the song selection station, and pick out a few songs that can be sung as duets or duets.
…… Isn't it just for this little thing that comes to KTV on a date! If I asked you, you'd definitely shout like that.
This isn't really some kind of trick. Basically, after battat gets tired singing, you pick up the microphone, and the next song starts with the woman's segment. When it's the man's turn, battat hesitates before raising the microphone, his movements a bit chaotic.
You were very close. Although you didn't look at each other while singing, it felt as if you could feel each other's feelings, as if our hearts were drawing close at that moment, as if your feelings at that moment were the same as those lyrics on the screen.
When a few choral songs ended, the private room time you reserved arrived. Reluctantly, you put down the microphone and left the KTV with Battat.
For the rest of the day, you wandered around the commercial street. Although you didn't like shopping, strolling around with Battat was a different feeling. You enjoyed that feeling until sunset, when the sun set, you reluctantly said goodbye to Battat and then went home.
Once again, you feel that kind of gaze, but this time you don't care.
But for several days in a row, you feel like someone is following you, but when you look back, you can't find the target.
End.
To be honest, if it's just once or twice, maybe you're just overthinking it, but after a few times, you start to wonder what exactly is going on—whether someone is really following you—so you're considering hiring a thug.
But before that, you decide to call Battat to accompany you. After all, two are safer than one, and if Battat notices, it will confirm, that someone is indeed following you.
Now Battat visits the coffee shop almost every day, only occasionally when he needs to work overtime. So you reach his desk and whisper, "When I get off work, come with me home." ”
Battat was stunned for a moment, his face instinctively flushed. Could it be that you two are actually progressing this fast? He still hasn't figured it out......
But before he could keep his wild thoughts, seeing his sudden blushing, you waved your hand and waved it in front of his eyes: "That's not what I meant. I didn't mean you should come home with me or anything. I just suspect someone has been following me lately, so I hope you'll come along. After all, having you with me makes me feel more at ease." You lowered your voice to explain why you were doing this, and after hearing this, Battat gradually toned down his previously shy expression and became serious.
"I understand. But regarding this matter, haven't you considered calling the police or something?" he asked.
You shrugged: "Hmm...... I did think about it, but right now I'm just suspicious. Calling the police directly might not be the right idea. I still want to at least make sure this is done before reporting it. ”
“…… Alright, I'll go back with you." So you heard battat reply, lowering his voice. To be honest, he sincerely hoped all of this was just your imagination; battat didn't want you to actually run into danger. Things like stalkers are still a bit too scary.
Sigh, when will it finally be completely peaceful? Battat couldn't help but wonder.
You nod in satisfaction and return to the counter to continue making coffee and serving customers. Although there weren't many customers left, today was very leisurely. After finishing these tasks, you sat behind the counter dozing off until Battat walked up and gently tapped the counter, finally fully awakening.
Only then did you realize it was already this hour, and everyone else in the store had left. You shyly smiled at battat: "Ah...... Sorry, I just fell asleep. ”
Battat shook his head: "It's fine, but if you fall asleep here, you might catch a cold. Let's rest after we get home." ”
You nodded vigorously, quickly packed your things, walked to the shop entrance, changed 'open' to 'close', then grabbed Battat's hand and raised it high, saying excitedly, "Yay! Let's go home together!" ”
Battat felt inexplicably embarrassed watching your actions, but when he heard the word 'together,' he felt as if his soul had fallen into a warm spring, soaking in the warm and sweet flow. For a moment, he just wanted to miss that feeling. But whenever he thought about maybe going home together in the future—words you often say and might say—he couldn't help but feel a sense of fulfillment.
"Come to think of it, this feels like it's the first time I've gone home with Battat. Want to talk about something?" You put one hand behind your back, while the other tightly held Battat's hand, gazing thoughtfully at the swaying sunset on the horizon.
Battat pondered for a moment: "That's fine, but lately it's been work-related matters, so I don't think there's much to say...... Anyway, he's been constantly dragged into overtime lately, so he's only had a bit of free time these past couple of days. He also wants to see you every day, as if all his fatigue melts away in that moment, but...... He usually doesn't get that chance. Usually, after overtime, he has to go back to his own place and feels embarrassed to ask for your photos or something.
So often, I can only think of that vague image in my heart, but the more I miss you, the more I want to see the real you, to see every frown and smile of you, to see you laughing for him, to hear your voice, to feel your gentle warmth.
"That's fine, right...... Anyway, I've only been working lately, nothing else to do. Ah, speaking of which, that fiancé hasn't come to bother me for days, which is actually a great thing! Pfft, just mentioning that guy makes me feel unlucky...... Let's talk about something interesting! By the way, I've occasionally run into a guest lately, and it's pretty fun......
He listened to you rambling, watched you sway his hand as you pulled him, and couldn't help but speak up, even if it was just a babble in a very quiet voice: "I do...... Is it more fun than me?" And he stammered and stammered.
You got cold, glanced to the side, and saw that Battat's face had turned bright red at some point. He didn't dare look at you anymore, but turned his head away, just saying these things.
So you couldn't help but laugh out loud, reaching out and poking his face: "Of course I like you the most. You're the funniest, but honestly, I can't say that...... Anyway, I like you the most! Hmm, maybe I just think you're cute enough? But you're reliable too, and you really are fun. "Although always saying that kind of thing does sound a bit like bullying honest people, you still think you're just telling the truth!"
Battat scratched his cheek, turned to look at you, and muttered quietly, "What's the word for 'cute'......"
"I mean to praise you?" Anyway, I really like it. "You smiled and pinched his cheek. Honestly, it felt a bit hard to the touch, but it didn't really matter. The touch was actually quite smooth, very comfortable, so you couldn't help but kiss his cheek before letting go.
Battat was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly turned his face away, just covering his cheek with his other hand, feeling a bit embarrassed. Besides, just touching his cheek made him feel the warmth. In any case, he might as well not turn back to look at you.
You looked at Battat's reaction and snorted twice, secretly laughing to yourself: "Ah, my little boyfriend gets shy so easily. What do we do next...... After all, if you're dating or getting married, these things aren't uncommon, and there might be even more restrictive things...... You start to think about this.
Battat suddenly stopped in his tracks, making you stumble a bit. You turned to look at Battat, just about to complain, but then you realized his face was already bright red.
After hesitating for a moment, you didn't complain anymore. Instead, you walked back and gently grabbed his hand: "Alright, those are all unrelated matters. Let's go home first!" ”
Battat stammered, "Yes, yes, let's go home first......" He had just thought about what might happen in the future, so he couldn't help but feel embarrassed because of it. How strange. He should have thought about these things long ago. Battat couldn't help but feel a bit annoyed, or maybe he simply thought that maintaining the current state would be fine.
As long as they belong to each other, what kind of relationship doesn't seem very important. Battat couldn't help but think this way. But since such a relationship has developed, to this extent, he can't help but want to take things further, can't help but wish everything could be more perfect—that's what he strives for.
…… Well, probably, at least he'll be working toward that.
But once they set off again, after a moment of silence between you, Battat also sensed the faint sound of footsteps and their gazes—a lingering gaze that seemed to be being followed by someone.
So Battat lowered his voice: "It seems like someone is following us. Should you call the police first?" ”
You thought for a moment, gently shook your head at him, and said, "No need, I've thought of a good idea!" As you spoke, you flashed a sly smile.
“…… It's good that you have a solution. "Battat breathed a slight sigh of relief, but he still heightened his vigilance. If someone following behind tried to do something, something injure, it would be a serious problem.
You climbed the stairs of your apartment, and to let the person following you get out, you deliberately skipped the elevator today. Then, the footsteps of the followers became even more obvious. After all, your stairs are made of iron, and no matter how hard you try to hide them, it's hard to hide your footsteps on stairs like this.
At the corner, just enough to block the other person's view, you stop silently, listening to the other person's footsteps growing more urgent. Then, pulling Battat and turning around to look down, you see that fiancé is climbing the stairs.
You pouted, a bit annoyed: "Tsk, he really is a persistent ghost. Why is he so annoying?" ”
Battat also frowned and lowered his voice: "Maybe we should just call the police and have this guy arrested." ”
You waved your hand: "At least his family has some money, so it's not a serious crime. As long as you pay a little, he can be bailed out. That's not very good." "But seeing his clothes getting even tattered, I'm afraid the family is on the verge of complete bankruptcy, with the whole family going to beg for debts not far off."
…… That's why you're so anxious, you thought absentmindedly, opening the voice recorder you had tucked in your pocket, taking two steps outside, standing there looking down at your fiancé with your arms in your hands, your voice lazy.
"What brings you here? Don't tell me you live here. The owners here can be found through the first-floor owners' register. I'm pretty sure your name isn't on the list. And don't say you're here to see some familiar person...... I know almost all those people. I don't recall anyone cooperating with your family's company; those who did stopped long ago. ”
My fiancé also stopped and stood on the stairs, revealing a look that was almost twisted, or rather, rather humble, and in short, even a bit frantic: "No, I'm here to find you." Then he suddenly sped up and charged at you. Fortunately, he didn't seem to be carrying any weapons, so you instinctively took two steps back. But the next second, you saw Battat suddenly appear from the side, blocking your way and grabbing the hand your fiancé was about to grab at you.
“…… What do you want from me? I've already told you, it's absolutely impossible." You poked your head out from behind the battat and looked at your fiancé.
"Haha...... As long as you're not married, I've always had a chance, right? Besides, being with someone like that isn't right for you at all. Marrying me is the right choice...... He looked crazed, as if he believed this reasoning was correct.
You can't help but wonder if you can send this guy to a psychiatric hospital.
"Forget it. We've been planning to get married for a long time. You have no chance at all, and if you keep pestering us, I'm planning to call the police. This time, I also recorded it with a voice recorder, including the previous harassment incidents. It looks like your family is about to go bankrupt too, right? If I just have my family put a bit more pressure on you, your company will go bankrupt completely, and you'll probably end up in debt. Maybe this evidence isn't much now, but by then it could be enough for you to never see the light of day...... So are you sure you want to keep this tangled up? As long as you leave now, I won't hold it against you anymore. "As you spoke, you took out the recorder and shook it, adjusting your hands and playing the recordings from the previous sessions.
Battat was stunned for a moment, instinctively turning to look at you, and you gave him a wink.
That fiancé's face turned deathly pale. He gave you one last resentful glare before hurriedly going down the stairwell.
You let out a breath. In fact, you weren't so sure. If your fiancé had gone crazy at that moment, there would have been nothing you could do. After all, you're just a wealthy young lady raised with no strength!
"Phew...... It looks like he won't come looking for him again, but tomorrow I'll talk to the people at my company and ask them to help speed up his company's bankruptcy. "You wiped the cold sweat from your forehead and murmured, while Battat just looked at you.
You turned to look at him too, noticing that under your gaze, Battat's face was gradually turning red, and he muttered, "Just now...... So handsome." Although if you didn't listen carefully, you might not even hear that mumbling sound.
So you can't help but laugh out loud, and then a thought flashes through your mind, suddenly suggesting, "How about we go get our marriage certificate tomorrow?" ”
Battat hadn't fully recovered before your words snapped him out of his daze. Although he was still a bit confused, he pointed at himself and said, "Wait, what? Didn't you say there was going to be a formal proposal ceremony first?" ”
You nod matter-of-factly: "Yeah, but those can be made up for later, whatever you want. As for now, anyway, I plan to completely give up on that beast's hopes......
Tbc.
Battat hesitated twice. Looking at your expression of such a matter of course, he suddenly felt a bit timid and confused, but didn't know if he should speak up at this moment. He was led by the hand as you walked up the stairs, and before he could ask the question he wanted to ask, his face flushed red: "Wait, are you really going to take me back to your place?" ”
Only then did you stop in your tracks. Luckily, Battat didn't bump into you directly. He looked at your back in confusion, but saw you turn around thoughtfully and stare at him for a few moments, making Battat feel inexplicably flustered.
Then you nod knowingly: "Ah, you can stay at my place tonight. I thought about it, and tomorrow happens to be the weekend, so we can get up early together to get the marriage certificate...... Hmm, speaking of which, I heard getting a marriage certificate is pretty cheap now? Let me treat you. ”
Battat couldn't help but chuckle: "What are you talking about? A marriage certificate isn't about whether you invite or not...... And it should be me who should be inviting you, right? No, I'm not asking you that question...... Seeing you about to hold his hand and walk up again, he hurriedly added.
So you stop again, tilt your head and look at Battat: "Hmm, then what do you want to ask?" ”
Actually, when you asked this, you were a bit nervous, because you really couldn't figure out what Battat was going to ask. After thinking it over, you felt your earlier actions were perfectly normal, nothing suspicious. That proposal about marriage was, of course, serious and perfectly normal.
"Um...... "Exactly, are you serious about your marriage proposal? Going to get the marriage certificate tomorrow morning, you shouldn't be in such a hurry, right? And you're just going to accept me like that......" He stammered, his voice growing quieter and quieter, and under your gaze, he looked even more uneasy.
You stroked your chin, then walked down the steps and cupped Battat's face, looking him straight in the eye and said very seriously, "Of course, of course I'm serious, and I really do believe in you. Although our time together was probably brief, we still have a long time to get to know each other, so we can use that time to slowly get to know each other. That freshness of discovering each other's likes and preferences for the first time is something worth experiencing...... Ah, that's probably not the point. "You laughed as you spoke, then leaned in to kiss his lips before letting go.
"It's fine to make up for the wedding after the wedding. I know you probably don't have much time, so just take your time getting ready! As for going to get the marriage certificate tomorrow, it's not entirely to discourage that person's thoughts. Just think of it as me being too impatient!" "I really, really want to see you every day." You said with a smile. Night had fallen unnoticed. In the corner, you were blocked by a brick wall, with little light, but you could still see Battat's face visibly flushed in the dim light.
So you can't help but laugh: "I think it's because I love you that I want to do this. It's not just about liking, but because I'm willing to give a little more for you. So I think maybe at this moment, it's okay for me to take a step forward." Hmm...... So, do you love me? "When you say this, you can't help but get nervous. Even though you know the answer is probably yes, you still look at Battat nervously, staring intently."
Battat took a deep breath, cupped your face, and then kissed your lips. He was so close that you could see his trembling pupils still fixed on you, feeling the warmth on his cheek.
"D-Of course, I love you too, but I should be the one to say things like this, right? Why are you the one saying it......" He stammered, a bit embarrassed, and you could see his neck and cheeks were flushed red.
"Ah, then you're an idiot. You can't even see through something so simple. I'm the one who spoke first." You said matter-of-factly.
"How can you say that? It's normal to feel nervous because you can't be sure of your feelings......," he whispered, trying to retort.
But maybe once you fall in love, it's easy to become a fool. You think about it, because you used to be like that too.
"No matter what, aren't we already sure what we're going to do from now on? So as long as we keep moving forward, that's enough! I could say 'I love you' to you many times—today and again, so let's go home first!" You said that, turned around, and took Battat's hand as they walked upstairs.
Battat once again murmured the word 'go home' in his heart. From then on, it would be your shared home. He couldn't help but smile, his heart began to dance lightly, as if his soul was elevating. He began to look forward to tomorrow immensely, eagerly looking forward to what came next. He vaguely understood that from now on, every day, similar scenes would play out between you and him.
But when we arrived at your place, Battat started stammering again: "Uh, do you have a guest room at home? How about I go sleep in the guest room for the night?" ”
Your home is very spacious, and the items aren't exactly tidy, but the messy arrangement adds a special artistic beauty. After all, there aren't many things, probably because the house is just too big.
You glanced at battat curiously: "Why do you want to stay in the guest room? You can just share a bed with me. It's not like my bed isn't big enough!" Besides, we're already a couple, and we're getting married tomorrow. Don't be embarrassed. "As you spoke, you grabbed Battat's hand and led him into the room. Then Battat saw the pillow on the bed that looked just like his. He couldn't help but lose his voice and instinctively turned to look at you.
You coughed twice, still feeling unjustified, but still resolute: "Ahem, ahem, that's not ...... I originally thought couples should live together once they confirmed their relationship, but I was too embarrassed to bring it up. I saw you didn't intend to bring it up, so I could only buy a pillow matching yours and sleep with it every day. That's not a problem! ”
Although you can't hold a real battat, hugging a pillow can still fulfill your wishes!
Battat glanced at you, a bit speechless, then at the pillow on the bed, and finally stammered, "Th-then I'm standing here now...... He stammered again, not knowing what to say next. To be honest, he didn't think you had to throw the pillow down; it just looked awkward.
You scratch your head, watching him get a little more interested in teasing him: "Hmm, then what should I do...... If I throw the pillow down, can I hold you while I sleep? ”
Well, but you know Battat probably won't agree, right? I really don't understand why he's still so shy now, but seeing him shy is actually quite amusing—at least you like it.
Just say battat is cute.
"Ah...... Ah, that's fine! "He closed his eyes, no longer caring what he was saying. Maybe in that moment, he was a little jealous of the pillow you could hold every day. He admitted it, but honestly, he didn't have any other thoughts.
He just feels that, at this moment, it should be just you and him.
So you took the pillow and placed it on the sofa outside, then went back to sit on the bed and took off your outer clothes. Battat instinctively covered his eyes because you had taken off your underwear right in front of him and changed into pajamas.
Seeing Battat like this, you couldn't help but laugh: "Ah...... You'll see it in the future, right? Maybe you have to do even more. If it's like this now, what should we do next? ”
Battat just thought that if he didn't cover his eyes, he'd probably get a nosebleed. Now he realized he really needed to train his tolerance. Otherwise, it would be too embarrassing to have to drip nosebleed onto you in the future...... He absolutely couldn't accept this kind of situation!
"Uh...... "I-I'll try hard......" he stammered, letting go of his hand covering his eyes. He could see two faint spots peeking out beneath your pure white nightgown, rising and falling with your movements. He scratched his head. Although his cheeks were flushed, at least he didn't react much.
Then you pat the bed: "Alright, come up and sleep!" ”
Battat climbed onto the bed in sync with his hands and feet. Although he didn't have a nosebleed, he looked like he was out of the loop. His reaction was a bit dazed, and he was a bit nervous. But tonight, you didn't sleep holding Battat.
Maybe because we're getting married tomorrow, today we just have to lie on the same bed and sleep. You lie on either side of the bed. Battat listens to your breathing, feeling a bit distracted, and in the end, he doesn't even know how he fell asleep. When you pull him up the next day, he's still a bit dazed and staring blankly.
…… Then you quickly changed clothes and went to get your marriage certificate. When you got the notebook and looked at the photos of you two on it, Battat wasn't fully awake until you waved your hand in front of him, and he suddenly snapped back to reality, stammering again.
"Ah...... Ah! That's how it ends...... "For some reason, he felt a sense of loss. Maybe he didn't have a perfect wedding ceremony, even if it wasn't perfect, or maybe because he hadn't suggested it, and even the ring was given to him after you bought it. With mixed feelings, he put the ring on his left ring finger.
But looking at that ring, his mood visibly improved. From today on, he officially shared the same home with you.
You nodded: "Mm, that's it...... Alright, let's go home! Let's go back together. For the rest of today, we can still stay together. ”
Well, let's go home together.
The rest of the time, you didn't go out or do much. Battat was just handling the documents he brought from the staff dormitory. He didn't have much, so you spent the rest of your morning moving in and organizing them. You quietly read a book beside Battat. To be honest, Battat still didn't feel the reality of being married, but looking at the ring, he suddenly realized that you two were indeed married.
Homework, then resting, lying on the bed and falling into a deep sleep. Today, you actually rolled over and hugged Battat, but not so tightly, so Battat could still sleep that he hadn't touched the softness of your chest. In any case, in the end, he still drifted off to sleep.
But the next morning, when he woke up to the alarm, he found you weren't by his side, and he smelled the aroma of coffee wafting from the living room.
Battat changed clothes and walked out of the bedroom, watching as you placed the two coffee cups with your name and Battat's name on the table, poured steaming coffee, then placed the cup with Battat's name in front of you, while the cup with your name was placed opposite.
When you see Battat wake up, you happily wave at him: "You're awake, let's have a cup of coffee first." ”
Battat cleared his throat twice, sat down across from you, picked up the cup of coffee, and took a gentle sip. Then he realized it was a cappuccino, probably made from different coffee beans, so this time it had a hint of floral and botanical freshness, along with a rich, smooth milky taste.
So he put down his coffee cup: "Ah, is this a cappuccino?" ”
You snapped your fingers: "Bingo." That's right, then I'll reward you with a good morning kiss—" As you spoke, you suddenly stood up, leaned over, bent over, and kissed him.
Battat was a bit stunned, his cheeks flushed as he looked at you.
So you can't help but smile with a smile: "Oh, hurry up and eat breakfast, or you'll be late for work soon, right?" ”
Only then did Battat respond twice, hurriedly finish off the breakfast, and hurriedly arrive at TV WORLD with the documents he had handled yesterday.
Although probably no one would notice, he couldn't help but deliberately show off the ring on his hand when colleagues passed by. Today, Pluey and Jongler's gazes didn't quite match, but he proudly showed off the ring on his hand.
But it might not be appropriate to impersonate Mike, and showing the same ring could easily give away...... Battat hesitated for a moment, but still took off the ring and hung it on the necklace, putting it on his neck.
In short, he felt floating and floating that day, not even feeling that work was painful anymore. In fact, his enthusiasm for work was higher than before. It was only when he realized that he started to blame himself for not being so motivated, or else the work he would get would just keep piling up.
Anyway, the day work ended, and he went home. Whenever he thought of the word 'home,' he thought of you at home, and couldn't help but smile.
Pushing open the door, in the mist, Battat sees you sitting at one end of the table, waiting for him to come home. When you see Battat, you push your coffee cup over.
"Welcome home."
End.
Oh oh, that's all for the main story...... But there are also post-marriage extras afterward, I don't know how many more to write ()

title: Coffee Cups 1-9
content:
Battat held the half-written proposal in his hand, hesitating as he glanced at the buildings on both sides. To be honest, he had his reasons for not daring to stay in the room he had been in before—how could he possibly hope others would discover that Mike was now wearing a disguised copy?
In short, besides, this proposal could only be left to him to write...... The other two guys were unreliable. He tapped his head and decided to find a place with few people to complete the proposal. Plus, he had stayed up late last night and had gotten up early again today to finish it, so he might need a cup of coffee......
In short, he walked into a quiet, seemingly deserted café ahead.
There weren't many people inside the café, and the seats were all empty, even giving off a fresh feel. Even the owner was dozing off at the counter.
But you still caught the sound of the glass door opening and footsteps. After all, you hung a wind chime on the door to keep yourself from noticing a guest had arrived. Now the bell was ringing, so you immediately woke up and forced a perfect business smile, pretending you hadn't fallen asleep at all.
"Welcome, sir. What would you like to use? The menu is clearly marked, and of course, you can also order at the counter." You said with a smile, placing the coffee cup you had washed that morning on the counter—uh, of course, you've actually washed it many times.
"By the way, we can freely choose our coffee cups...... Well, since you're the first customer in our shop, the cup you pick will become your exclusive cup, okay?" You blinked, somehow feeling like you're trying hard to promote the coffee business. Even though no one came to drink coffee, you were happy to have some peace and quiet, saving time and effort dealing with customers and brewing coffee.
After all, you're not short of money; opening a coffee shop is just for sentiment and personal interests. You still want to attract a group of regular customers with affordable coffee and simple yet delicious flavors, so they can rest briefly and enjoy comfort.

You put down your spoon, leaving only an empty plate in front of you. Then you looked at battat, who was sitting across from you. He seemed to be hesitating about what to say. After all, you saw his mouth opening and closing for a long time, and his face alternating between pale and red, making you curious about what he was planning to say.
So you sat up a bit straighter, resting your hand on the table with your chin on your hand, staring at Battat. Probably because you were staring at him intently, Battat's face blushed even more and he stammered, not knowing what to say.
In fact, he was indeed hesitating. He didn't know why he was considering so much now. He hadn't thought so much when he first made the suggestion, but now he had so many more concerns. Maybe he suddenly realized that he had always cared about your feelings? That's why he considered whether the plan was good or bad—after all, he was afraid you might not like it.
Although maybe you'll still agree with his proposal with a smile and approval, the more you do it, the more nervous he becomes, and the more he'll think about what you'd like more. That's when Battat realizes he doesn't really know your preferences that well, but he doesn't want to directly ask what you'd like. Maybe...... Should I hint a little?
Actually, he felt it was fine to keep sitting here daydreaming. Even though the environment was so noisy and irritating, in the moment you watched him, in the moment he saw you, he felt quiet and couldn't hear anything else. So quiet that all he could hear was his heartbeat.
But Battat still felt maybe he should go out for a walk and explore other places. After all, sitting here all the time might not seem a big deal, but it didn't quite match the original purpose of relaxing.
But when you watched him, all those thoughts melted away, leaving him unable to keep up and not even knowing what he was thinking. Battat was now so focused on his mind as if his mind was short-circuiting, avoiding your gaze—no, maybe nowhere to hide, since he was sitting right across from you.
And that was all he had been thinking about earlier. After struggling for a long time, he still couldn't come up with a conclusion; both answers and reasons were locked in his mind.
And finally, you couldn't help but speak. When you stared at battat for who knows how many seconds—maybe it was the ninety-second longing? You didn't really care about the passage of time. After all, you were willing to waste this time just sitting here with battat, even if it was just sitting there, even though you usually cared a lot about time and task planning.
“…… So, what exactly do you want to say to me? "You gently tapped the table with your knuckles and asked.
"Ah...... Ah, it's nothing, I just think we should go for a walk together, or maybe somewhere else too? Or maybe you want to keep sitting here? I just don't know where you'd prefer to go. "Battat stammered out this sentence, turning his face slightly. He knew the heat on his face hadn't died down yet, and you must have seen it clearly. But now, he was a bit ready to give up—if you saw him, so be it." He just scratched his head, pretending to be busy.
You tilt your head slightly, and you notice his face is redder, so you turn your face slightly and scratch your ear, knowing your ear is a bit hot now.
You just don't answer and ask back: "Then...... Do you want to go for a walk more? ”
Battat quickly waved his hand: "No, no, no, I'm fine. It depends on your mood. Anywhere is fine, as long as you like it." But at this moment, he didn't dare look up at you again, and naturally missed the red on your earlobe.
“…… Hmm, then let's go for a walk. We can chat a bit and such, which is better than going somewhere else. Right now, I just want to casually talk about painting and be with you. Ah, if you don't like chatting, then just quietly take a walk. "So you smiled and said, watching battat lower his head, feeling a bit itchy to get your hands moving, but in the end didn't dare to reach out. He just pulled his outstretched hand back, pretending he had something to do, then touched his nose.
"Ah, no, if it's just to chat, it's fine. I'm willing to chat with you...... No, that's not what I mean. Actually, I'm willing to chat with you no matter when. "Battat quickly waved his hand again, still not daring to look up at you. He didn't want you to see the expression on his face. After all, oh my god, he had no idea what the situation would be like. He just felt his face burning hot, and he didn't know what he was saying—maybe it was the truth, or maybe it was just nonsense.
And indeed, even if he might be tired and doesn't want to reply to anyone, he'll still be willing to chat with you. Perhaps through this conversation, he regains his energy and feels happiness and happiness.
…… Not at that coffee shop, just by your side, he feels relaxed.
You blink, looking at his still bowed head, then touch your nose, shift your gaze slightly, and cough twice: "Ah, then let's go for a walk. Say something casually, or if you don't want to say anything, just walk quietly." After saying this, you quickly got up.
Battat quickly got up too. At least his face wasn't so hot now, and he finally wanted to look up at you, catch your back, and follow behind you as you walked out.
You walked down the street, and after thinking for a moment, you suggested, "There's a garden nearby...... How about we take a walk over there? Anyway, that park has always been open to the public for free, and if you walk a bit further, you can even see the sea." "Honestly, you rarely go to see the sea. After all, where you live and the café are both quite far from the ocean. It's just that today you have some free time, and your mood is relaxed. Maybe going to see the sea is a good choice."
And you have a bit of selfishness—your mood is excited but also a bit nervous. You know Battat will probably agree, but what if? What if he refuses? Although you can still force a smile and make other suggestions, the disappointment at that moment will probably linger for a long time. In short, well, you want to go see the sea with Battat, or just take a walk in a quiet spot, just the two of you, and then you can ask whatever questions you want, because you want to get to know Battat better.
…… You also want to know his life, his habits, his hobbies—more and more, just out of curiosity or some special feeling. You can't say for sure, you just desperately hope for it.
Battat nodded matter-of-factly: "Ah, of course. If you want to go, let's go together. Anywhere is fine, and if you want to visit several places, that's fine too." He had no objections to this, and even hoped that this kind of time could last longer, or that time would pass a little more slowly. He hoped to watch over you longer, or maybe not at all, just knowing you were still by his side.
You relaxed and, with your obvious answer, headed to the park with Battat. There really was plenty of shaded space. Although it was loose, it was still a nice sight. The buildings on both sides were all vintage-style. If you wanted to take some photos here as souvenirs, it would be a nice atmosphere. Unfortunately, you're not someone who likes taking photos, and there was no one else in the garden at the moment. You didn't bring any professional camera equipment; the bag you took out only had an emergency water bottle, an umbrella, and a phone.
Unfortunately, you can't find anyone else to take photos of you both, so these tempting thoughts can only be put to rest.
Battat seemed to be lost in thought. You glanced at him quietly, waved your hand in front of him, and only then did he snap back to reality, rubbing his brow: "Ah...... I was distracted! Did you just say something? ”
You shook your head: "No, actually, I was just about to say something. I just saw you lost in thought, so I wondered if I could call your lost god back." As you spoke, you secretly chuckled a couple of times.
Battat felt a bit embarrassed and scratched his head: "Ah...... Ah! Go ahead, I'm listening! I'll definitely listen to you seriously. "He assured him, but also felt a bit guilty. Maybe it was because he was walking beside you that he couldn't help but zone out, because at this moment he didn't need to care so much, so it was fine to just think about something, because he knew you were right beside him. It was a kind of trust that was indescribable and even he couldn't understand.
"Ahem, then I'll say it. Actually, I wanted to ask you a few questions...... I want to know, besides work, what do you usually do after work?" You cleared your throat and asked solemnly.
Who would have thought battat's expression would go blank at that moment? You can't help but turn your head to glance at him a couple more times.
“…… It's nothing special, right? Usually, it's just work. Sometimes, after work, there might be some work to handle, so I have to work overtime. The little time left is mostly for rest, and nothing else to do. I'll just be spending some time at the coffee shop you run recently. "As he spoke, he couldn't help but cough lightly twice, and his voice grew quieter by the end. If you hadn't listened carefully to his answer, you might have missed that sentence.
You tilted your head slightly, knowing your cheeks were a bit hot at that moment. Then you scratched your cheek, coughed lightly, and couldn't help but ask, "It sounds tough usually...... Is it that your relationship with colleagues isn't great?" ”
Battat waved his hand: "I get along pretty well with my colleagues! Besides, there are other colleagues who occasionally help me share some of my workload, but...... After all, sometimes work just can't be finished. There's nothing I can do. ”
You nodded knowingly, and after a moment of silence between us, you spoke in a hesitant, surprised voice: "So, do you mean you can't do anything else besides that?" You must have some kind of hobby...... you muttered.
“…… Isn't there really not much time? The remaining occasional free time is also used to sort out problems...... "Battat continued to answer quietly.
You didn't ask what exactly he was sorting out, since his expression looked troubled and probably didn't like others asking him, so you just quietly waited for him to nag.
"However...... As for other things, I do collect some things occasionally, even if I might not need them. Besides that, I organize the items in the room, since things get messy every so often. I feel uncomfortable just looking at those messy facilities...... Battat said this while frowning, probably trying hard to recall something, so much so that his tone became unclear. It was obvious he thought for a while before giving a broken answer. Maybe it was simply because he had never paid attention to these things and didn't care much about his own life, so he didn't remember it either.
After all, caring about his own life was useless, and no one would pay attention to this matter. He just hadn't expected you to ask about it.
"Ah...... Do you have a collecting habit? If that's the case, do you need to buy a lot of storage equipment or something? "You asked casually. The shaded area was gradually left behind, and not far ahead was the ocean you mentioned. Above the ocean, on the ground you were stepping on, a path stretched out, crooked and crooked. In short, there was still some distance from the sea surface, so it was impossible to get close to the ocean.
"Not really, I just collect some small items occasionally? It seems like I only did this a long time ago. Now, because I'm too busy, I actually don't have much time." Battat sighed as he spoke.
"Oh...... Speaking of which, you don't really like sweet food? What about spicy food? Do you know how to eat it? Because I'm thinking about whether to go out for extra spicy ramen tonight, I wanted to ask for your opinion. "You clasp your hands behind your back, as if you're just asking casually, but in fact, your hands behind your back are tangled and picking at your fingers, sweating from nervousness."
“…… I can't handle spicy food; I can eat a little bit of other flavors, but it seems like I can't eat anything spicy, including drinks and such. I always get my face off with just one bite." Battat didn't hesitate much and quickly answered. Of course, he didn't think too much about what you meant based on your words.
You nod gently, just about to say something more when suddenly raindrops hit your face. When you look up, you realize the sky had turned gloomy at some point. At first, just a few wet raindrops hit the ground, wetting a patch of it. Then, the raindrops started to fall with a splash, growing louder, about to soak you both.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 1-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
The middle planning proposal is just my nonsense, since I don't study this.
——
Battat held the half-written proposal in his hand, hesitating as he glanced at the buildings on both sides. To be honest, he had his reasons for not daring to stay in the room he had been in before—how could he possibly hope others would discover that Mike was now wearing a disguised copy?
In short, besides, this proposal could only be left to him to write...... The other two guys were unreliable. He tapped his head and decided to find a place with few people to complete the proposal. Plus, he had stayed up late last night and had gotten up early again today to finish it, so he might need a cup of coffee......
In short, he walked into a quiet, seemingly deserted café ahead.
There weren't many people inside the café, and the seats were all empty, even giving off a fresh feel. Even the owner was dozing off at the counter.
But you still caught the sound of the glass door opening and footsteps. After all, you hung a wind chime on the door to keep yourself from noticing a guest had arrived. Now the bell was ringing, so you immediately woke up and forced a perfect business smile, pretending you hadn't fallen asleep at all.
"Welcome, sir. What would you like to use? The menu is clearly marked, and of course, you can also order at the counter." You said with a smile, placing the coffee cup you had washed that morning on the counter—uh, of course, you've actually washed it many times.
"By the way, we can freely choose our coffee cups...... Well, since you're the first customer in our shop, the cup you pick will become your exclusive cup, okay?" You blinked, somehow feeling like you're trying hard to promote the coffee business. Even though no one came to drink coffee, you were happy to have some peace and quiet, saving time and effort dealing with customers and brewing coffee.
After all, you're not short of money; opening a coffee shop is just for sentiment and personal interests. You still want to attract a group of regular customers with affordable coffee and simple yet delicious flavors, so they can rest briefly and enjoy comfort.
"Ah...... Is that so? "Battat was startled. Actually, when you were dozing off, he didn't think about waking you. He just forced himself to finish the proposal, and he didn't expect you to wake up.
Still, he cleared his throat and stepped forward, looking at the various coffee cups displayed on the counter. Some cups were simple, decorated with diamond-shaped or striped patterns, others had creative designs, shaped like peacocks or other species, and others used abstract colors and brushstrokes to depict abstract artworks.
There was a cup that looked quite odd, with only a name signed on it with a dark green pen. Battat couldn't recognize the name, at least he didn't think it was a celebrity's name. It looked like it was written casually, since some of the strokes had been washed away and some were slightly blurry.
He double-checked, "Can I pick any cup?" "After all, that cup looked like your own name, and Battat felt a bit embarrassed to pick one, but he couldn't help but look at the cup."
Following his gaze, you were startled and muttered, "Why did you take out this cup too...... I was planning to keep it for myself......
Then you closed your eyes for a moment and said with righteous determination, "Guest, pick whatever you like! Anything is fine—and I believe in your taste, I'm sure you'll have a good time here." ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, but finally reached out and poked the cup with only bare green handwriting: "Then this one, clean, and I like the color of the handwriting." ”
You opened your eyes, and good, you really picked out the cup you had forgotten at first, so you took it out together—you mourned in your heart, the one you wrote your name on for fun, and the cup that had gone out of glory after just two days, then continued to smile: "Okay, the color of this handwriting looks just like yours...... Hmm, what would you like to drink? I'll make you coffee right away. ”
"Huh...... Anything goes? I just want to stay alert. "As he spoke, battat shook the document in his hand. It was a proposal he had been halfway through last night, and now his mind was spinning, really not knowing what else to write.
You stroked your chin and thought for a moment: "Alright, I understand. I'll deliver your coffee to you later. Please wait a moment, sir!" ”
Battat let out a gentle breath and couldn't help but add, "Don't always use such respectful words to address me. I always feel a bit embarrassed...... Besides, my name is Battat, and I think I'll come to this place in the future too." He let out a breath. After all, it was really quiet here, with hardly anyone around, which was perfect for his work, and he didn't have to worry about whether anyone would notice him.
You blink and nod: "Alright! Well then, Mr. Battat, please find any seat to sit down. The coffee will be ready later!" ”
As you spoke, you picked up a bag of coffee beans, ready to grind them into coffee before brewing—since this process was quick. You decided to brew a cold brew coffee, which was refreshing, not acidic, and also had a refreshing effect. Since it was Battat's first time and the first customer, you decided to use only classic coffee beans.
So you can take out the Tampika—or call it Blue Mountain coffee beans? This is considered the oldest variety, a classic coffee flavor, very clean in texture, with floral notes, fruit acidity, and a refreshing sweetness.
The coffee machine rumbles. Once the coffee grounds are ready, you steep them in cold water and wait for a cold brew to finish. This process is a bit long—at least you yawn again. But the cold brew is still brewed. You see brown swirls gently spinning, and you think this cup must have a fresher taste, rich aroma, and sweetness.
Pour the coffee into that cup, carry the porcelain plate out, and immediately spot Battat sitting by the window, his head slowly moving as if he's about to fall asleep.
You walked briskly, deliberately softening your footsteps as you approached him, set down the cup of coffee, and then looked at Battat's head bit by bit, feeling a bit troubled. You saw the pen in his hand irregularly tapping the paper below, even with some scribble-like symbols in front—it was clear he was not fully conscious, but he came here to finish his work and even needed coffee, which probably meant he was urgently needed a document.
Anyway, you hesitate for a moment, but still nudge his shoulder and softly call out, "Battat, battat, wake up. The coffee is ready, and your work isn't done yet." ”
In any case, he suddenly woke up, his face still a bit startled. He didn't know what words had scared him out, but when he opened his eyes, he found you were looking at him innocently.
Seeing that he still looked a bit dazed after waking up, you pushed the cup of coffee toward him: "Alright, have this. The coffee is ready. I think it'll help refresh you." ”
Battat looked at it and still picked up the cold brew. To be honest, he didn't really care what kind of coffee it was—even if it was just a quickly brewed espresso, it didn't matter—but this cold brew still lifted his spirits. Of course, there was still a bitter taste at the mouth, but the acidity that should have come with the bitterness was almost gone, replaced by a soft, floral aroma and a subtle sweetness that seemed to envelop body and mind. Combined with the relatively cool temperature, it cleared his entire dice awake.
At least he couldn't say the coffee wasn't good; rather, it was rather novel. He hadn't expected such an unknown shop to have such outstanding craftsmanship.
"Hmm...... Thank you for this cup of coffee. I'm fully awake now. "Battat rubbed his head. Now he was looking at the proposal in his hand with some worry. He hadn't figured out what to write next, and now it was even better—he even wrote some scribbles on it. This paper was basically useless, and he would have to redo everything later.
"Although the coffee is delicious, I still hope all the guests who come here can relax. However...... Is this job really urgent?" As you spoke, you glanced at the document again.
"Yeah, I have to submit it tomorrow. If I don't write well enough, the boss might scold me. I'm still worrying about how to write next......
"Then, let me take a look. Maybe from a third-party perspective, I can offer better suggestions." You suggested.
Battat was stunned and stammered, "That's not really right...... This is my job, and you have your own job......
You just shrugged: "Oh, it's fine, no one else comes here anyway. Besides, I just hope you can relax a bit more here, so—let me take a look! Don't worry, I won't mess it up!" You even stuck out your tongue as you spoke.
Battat hesitated for a moment, then handed you the document that was definitely going to be discarded, then took out a blank one and began writing.
You took the document, sat across from Battat, and started reading, nodding from time to time. To be honest, what you wrote earlier seemed fine, or rather, it was good—well, although TV program planning proposals should be handed over to dedicated planning personnel, right? No matter how you look at it, they shouldn't be suitable for this, right?
But you do have some experience in organizing and planning—after all, your family has a company.
So you cleared your throat and started to look serious: "Ahem, I think what you wrote is fine, but I think before officially implementing this plan, we first need to identify each character's role, determine what they can do, and make sure they do what suits the job...... And for the upcoming project, why not include an audience participation segment? "You asked this question with some curiosity.
Battat hesitated for a moment, then looked up at you and whispered, "Because lately, the audience in the audience has been getting fewer and fewer." ”
You tapped your knuckles on the table: "Then there should be a segment like this—you have to attract some stable viewers to stay as a steady traffic. Of course, if you don't consider the audience, then your proposal should be a recommendation ...... for movies and TV dramas? So, you can compare and analyze similar films and provide in-depth explanations, such as studying some more specialized points. The mainstream tends to be watched by the general public, while those niche groups will naturally have more professional viewers or simply curiosity. ”
Alright, Battat thought your suggestion did use some wording, but he hesitated for a moment: "Is this really useful?" ”
And you nod firmly: "Of course it works! At least I really like this kind of more professional explanation...... Hehe. "As you spoke, you awkwardly touched your nose.
Battat nodded and began writing furiously. However, while writing, he could always sense a sharp gaze—not sharp, but feeling uncomfortable when someone was watching made him uncomfortable. After all, he came to this café hoping no one could see him......
So he still looked up a little awkwardly, looking at you, and found you resting your chin on your hand, watching him with great interest. When he stopped writing, he tilted his head in confusion: "Hmm?" What's wrong? ”
Battat cleared his throat twice: "Could you stop looking at me?" I feel a bit uncomfortable with this...... I can't keep writing. ”
You blinked, then simply closed your eyes, then leaned over the desk and muttered a couple of words: "Alright! Now I won't look at you, you can keep writing...... Just enough for me to sleep for a while......
As you talked, your voice quieted down, and soon you fell silent. It was obvious you were asleep, since Battat could hear the soft, even breathing.
He looked at you hesitantly, but in the end, he buried his head and started writing furiously. Whether it was the effect of that cold brew coffee, or the slight relaxation of his nerves during our conversation, or the suggestion you made that seemed a bit off-topic but actually useful, Battat felt his mind sharpened a lot at this moment, and he quickly finished writing the proposal. All that was left was to rub his aching hands, drink coffee, and stare blankly at your sleeping profile.
Coffee was just too useful. At least now, Battat didn't feel sleepy at all, and even miserably thought maybe he could write three more proposals.
When you wake up, the dice in front of you have long since left, leaving only an empty coffee cup and coins pressed underneath. You can count it—it's a bit more expensive than a cold brew coffee.
Besides that, there was a note under the coffee cup, probably written hastily by battat: Thank you.
You chuckled, put away the note, and picked up your coffee cup.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 2-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts as mine
Some things are just me making things up, and I don't know if they're true. Anyway, this is a refreshing chronological account (I guess). There's no plot, maybe it's just a romantic exchange (hmm).
——
You absentmindedly wiped the cup in your hand, a bit distracted. Well, ever since Battat left, no other customers have come to this café, so—since he still said he'd come again, I was actually a bit curious about when he'd finally arrive.
Glancing at the cup with your name on it, now belonging to battat, you feel a bit troubled—this means you need to replace it—alright, you take a white coffee cup out of the cabinet, but it's completely empty and spotless, so you don't plan to write anything on it for now.
You just nod in satisfaction, pour yourself a macchiato, and add a beautiful latte art. Since you don't know which shape is best, you just draw a heart on it. The characteristic of this coffee is that it's relatively sweeter, with less bitterness and more milky smoothness and sweetness. Of course, the whipped milk foam itself is one of the sources of sweetness.
Just as you were about to take a sip of the steaming macchiato, the sound of wind chimes rang out again. Following the sound, you looked toward the door and saw Battat walk in. He had indeed visited the shop as promised. Today, he hadn't taken anything, and his spirit was a bit better than yesterday. He wasn't glowing, but at least he wasn't so haggard.
You put down the coffee you'd just taken a sip of, stood up straight, leaned against the counter, and looked at battat: "You really came. So, what do you think? The proposals I gave you yesterday were pretty good, right?" As you spoke, you lifted your head smugly.
Battat hesitated for a moment, then nodded: "Indeed, when I submitted it, it was the first time I'd seen the boss so friendly......" After all, this proposal was submitted under the identity of Pippins, not Mike. As for why? Of course, everyone had to submit a proposal. As for Mike? Haha, he didn't have to do that job.
Thinking of this, Battat was about to grit his teeth again, but you glanced at him. Of course, you were beaming with joy, a bit delighted: "See, I told you I wouldn't give you any bad advice!" Alright—since you're here, let's see what we have for today. It's on me! "You wave your hand generously, showing your generosity.
Battat was momentarily stunned, then quickly waved his hand: "Ah, no need, it's just a cup of coffee. I'll just pay for it myself—"
"It's okay, as long as I'm happy, so what do you want to drink?" "I'll give you a free meal today." You raised an eyebrow and picked up a packet of coffee beans placed nearby.
"Uh...... Then, macchiato? "Battat glanced twice, probably seeing the coffee you hadn't touched yet, and hesitantly placed the order.
"Hmm, then what about latte art? What do you need?" You softly hummed an off-key tune, then thought about bringing out some darkly roasted coffee beans this time. These beans had a rich taste, with a hint of chocolate or toasted bread, no acidity, and probably just right.
“…… Uh, heart-shaped? "He looked around nervously, clearly not having any good choices, so he could only grumble and follow your choice. After all, Battat can see the latte art shape on your coffee cup.
You nodded, "Alright!" Then find a seat, I'll bring it to you later. As you spoke, the coffee machine started to sound. You threw the coffee beans in, waiting for them to grind into powder and hand it to you. You hummed a tune, prepared hot water, put the coffee grounds into a cup, then poured in milk and hot water to brew. After a while, the coffee gradually turned light brown, and finally, you added a heart-shaped cream latte art on top.
You thought for a moment, then took out a tray and put on the coffee you had just taken a sip of and the coffee you had just made for him, along with a plate of macarons just taken from the fridge.
Then you carried the tray toward battat, and you could immediately see him sitting at the same spot as yesterday, staring out the window in a daze, his fingers seemingly unconsciously tracing something on the table.
You gently placed the tray in front of him, finally bringing Battat back to attention. He hesitated for a moment as he looked at the two cups of coffee on the tray: "What are you...... want to drink with me?" He raised his voice, probably a bit incredulous, or perhaps a bit embarrassed.
You nodded matter-of-factly: "Yeah, anyway, no one else is coming. I just want to find a seat for a while. Sitting here is just fine, and I can even watch you." Otherwise, just staring at the door out of boredom would be just too boring.
He seemed to have stammered for a moment, probably not expecting you to say that. Finally, he cleared his throat and said, "Ah, alright, is it okay if you sit here?" He wasn't sure when he said the last sentence, since it probably wasn't something he could decide.
"Hmm...... This shop is mine, so I can sit wherever I want. "You shrugged, placed the cup of coffee in front of him, the macaron on the table, your own coffee across from you, then returned the tray to the counter before coming back to sit down.
You nudged the plate of macarons toward the battat: "Dessert included—give it a try?" You blinked, tilted your head to look at him, propping up your cheek.
Battat picked up a macaron and put it in his mouth, then his face scrunched up—although the dice's face was a bit amusing, probably because he thought the expression wasn't very good, he quickly switched to a count emoji and put it on.
"This is way too sweet, isn't it?!" Although he disliked the sweetness, he still obediently ate the macaron. However, when he switched back to his expression, his expression wasn't very pleasant, the corners of his mouth curled upward, looking like he didn't dare to try it again.
You smile and say, "Well, so it probably tastes better with coffee, right?" If you eat it plain, it definitely tastes sweet. "But you didn't tell Battat about this earlier, after all...... Getting overwhelmed by sweetness and stuff is kind of amusing to look at his expression.
He hesitated for a moment, but finally chose to believe your words, so he picked up his coffee and took a sip. To be honest, today's coffee did taste a bit sweeter. Maybe it was because of the latte art on the top floor, but the whole cup had a soft, sweet sensation that actually washed away the coffee's original bitterness.
But even so, a bitter taste still lingered. Seeing your expectant gaze, he couldn't resist and still picked up a macaron and popped it into his mouth—seriously! You had just promised in your heart never to touch this again? But seeing you look at him so pitifully, Battat couldn't help but try again.
…… But the taste is still acceptable? At least this time it's not as sweet. The lingering bitterness in the mouth washes away some of the macaron's sweetness, while the excess sweetness takes away the original coffee-like bitterness. In fact, starting with a bitter bite and then tasting the sweet one is a good choice—at least now Battat doesn't mind this flavor.
But he put down his coffee cup for a while. After all, he wasn't that hungry and didn't really want to eat, so he just looked at you, suddenly feeling a bit curious about you—after all, you seem carefree, as if nothing matters at all. It's not like him, but while this kind of idleness is enviable, over time it just gets boring, right? Otherwise, why would you show such an excited expression right in front of him?
He thought for a moment, then couldn't help but ask with a question: "So, there are clearly no other customers, right? Why are you still opening a café here?" ”
You blink and sit up straight: "Is this a Q&A session?" Then let's ask one question after another—I'll answer you first! Well, honestly, I don't care if anyone comes. After all, I inherit the family business I left behind, but I also want to open a café like my parents. It's small, doesn't need many people, just purely handmade coffee, accommodating some regular customers, and as long as it can earn praise for the skills, that's enough. Of course—I also hope everyone can relax here. ”
"But my cooking skills aren't that great, and this café just opened. It's normal that no one comes—after all, there are already several famous cafés now." You shrugged as you spoke.
Battat nodded thoughtfully, then asked, "So...... Aren't you bored? ”
And you just smiled and waved your fingers: "That's the next question. Let me ask you first—well, I'm curious, what kind of work are you actually doing? Why do you look so haggard?" ”
"It's nothing really, I'm just working on the TV world side... it's just that the workload is a bit heavy. Anyway, I'm just a pippins..." battat smiled awkwardly, and under your gaze, his voice suddenly lowered, since he felt a bit embarrassed about this topic.
"So what if it's pippins? Pippins should have dice rights too. Whether it's using dice or anything else, everyone should follow the rules and regulations. If it's labor, there should be relevant regulations too, right...... You purse your lips, a bit dissatisfied. Actually, you've heard about the owner there before, but it doesn't really concern you, so of course you didn't care. It's just that during a meeting with the company's shareholders, there was discussion about whether to cooperate with the other party. However, one shareholder objected, saying the other party was already on the decline and that cooperating again at this point wasn't worth it.
But after that, you didn't listen. Forgive me, even though you inherited the company, you have absolutely no interest in running it.
"Really? But the boss probably thinks the pippins are just gambling and not doing their jobs...... Anyway, it doesn't really matter, anyway, they don't notice me. "Battat scratched his head in frustration, his clothes getting a little wrinkled."
You blinked: "Hmm, alright...... Let me answer your question first. Actually, it's not boring at all. Even though there are no customers, I'm happy to have some free time. I just need to sit there reading and don't have to socialize with anyone. It's just too convenient! But having guests come is a good thing, at least I can chat with you here." You blinked as you spoke, showing a playful expression.
"Ah, actually, it doesn't really matter. I can just leave me here alone......" he stammered again.
But you just shook your head in disapproval: "How can that be! I pride myself on making sure every guest feels relaxed and comfortable here, so of course I want you to experience it too!" As you spoke, you rolled up your sleeves, looking like you were following through on your word, feeling like you were burning with energy.
"Alright, maybe you just want to find someone to chat with?" Battat sighed and decided not to pursue the previous topic further.
"Hmm, I'll answer that later. Let me ask you first. I want to know why, since you're so tired, you haven't switched jobs yet. You seem to be working very hard, so other places shouldn't be rejecting you, right?" ”
As you spoke, you took a sip of macchiato, put a piece of macaron into your mouth, chewed on it, and asked unclearly.
"Honestly, I've tried before, but other places wouldn't hire me once they saw I was a pippins, they didn't even bother to look further—" At this point, battat seemed a bit indignant. He had been holding a coffee cup, planning to take another sip, but now he angrily put the cup down on the table, making a loud clinking sound, which even spilled some coffee foam onto the table.
You have to admit, you were startled by his actions, but you quickly recovered. You just picked up a macaron and held it to his lips, your eyes slightly curved: "Alright, don't be mad. Have something sweet, okay?" If other places don't hire you, it's their loss—if you want, you can apply at my company. I'll definitely read your resume carefully! ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, then took a sip of coffee, waiting for the bitterness to wash over his mouth before taking the macaron and putting it in his mouth. Carefully and shyly, he thanked him: "Thank you." ”
"It's fine. But well, I'm not the type to chat with people, and I'm not the type to chat just because someone comes. Most of the time, it's better to be quiet. It's just ...... I found it interesting to chat with you, so I wanted to talk with you." You thought for a moment, touched your chin, and said solemnly.
"Maybe I'm just a bit curious about you. After all, it's not easy to find this café so precisely—so, would you like to apply for a job at my company?"
Battat hesitated for a moment, then slowly shook his head, his voice a bit hoarse: "In that case, probably not." ”
"Hey—why!" You dragged out your words, a bit incredulous.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 3-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
This episode is a detective scene (? ) Writing deductions is so satisfying, I love deduction.
——
Battat gave a couple of awkward laughs, scratched his head, and quietly turned his face away. After all, he knew that if they faced each other directly, he might notice something was off on his expression.
"Actually, there's no particular reason for that. If you don't want to quit, then don't quit. I ...... really like this job." This sentence was quite difficult, because Battat immediately knew he was lying. Alright, right now I just don't want you to see the forced smile on his face.
You narrowed your eyes, took another sip of coffee, and then suddenly said, "How about this, have you heard of turtle soup?" "It's the one I asked but you can only answer yes or no." ”
Battat turned his face again, a bit puzzled: "Yes, I've heard of it." But...... Suddenly want to play with turtle soup? What is soup noodles? ”
You just smugly shook your finger: "Oh, of course I'm asking you, just in the form of turtle soup. I can get very few answers from you. If I can guess, I'll win. How about it?" Hmm, of course, the premise is that you don't lie. "You muttered a couple more times.
He shook his head: "Uh, I'm still not very willing to lie. If that's the case...... Then you go ahead and ask." In the end, he stammered again, probably full of guilt.
You stroked your chin and suddenly spoke: "Ah, then do you like your current job?" ”
Battat hesitated for a moment. Honestly, he didn't want to answer after just the first question—oh my god, how could he possibly like his current job?! Two jobs combined are just too busy and exhausting, and besides that, there's no one else to share the burden!
But he couldn't lie about it. First, he couldn't betray his conscience; his true feelings were as they were. Second, if he really lied, he felt a bit embarrassed, always feeling guilty and guilty.
So in the end, he shook his head: "No." ”
And you nod in satisfaction: "Wow, you really didn't lie...... So the next question: do all your employees have to work on that proposal? ”
This time, Battat thought about this question. Honestly, if he weren't Mike, he'd definitely say yes. But when he was Mike, he really never got the job. The difference was obvious—at most, he had submitted proposals and then adapted them into practical shows.
…… Of course, most of the proposals I submitted were written by myself.
So he still shook his head, his voice a bit muffled: "No." ”
Your knuckles tapped the table, paused for a moment, and looked at his expression. Honestly, it's pretty hard for you to analyze other people's expressions—after all, you're not specifically studying this, just curious and digging into some things. For example, right now, you can only tell from his eyes that he is indeed recalling rather than fabricating facts. Of course, that's enough.
So you cheerfully keep asking: "Well, then—does that mean ordinary employees have to do this work?" ”
This time, Battat didn't hesitate; instead, he was straightforward and eagerly nodded: "Yes." ”
You whistled inwardly. If ordinary employees have to do this job, it means they came yesterday with those documents. But they also know not everyone will do this job—well, more precisely, it's the top-level senior staff?
Since that's the case, you spoke again: "Hmm, then do you know any senior employees?" ”
Battat instinctively swallowed twice. For some reason, he felt like you might have guessed the truth. Before he could finish his sentence, he already wanted to lie. But lying only increased his psychological pressure. In short, he didn't really want to lie, nor did he really want to deceive you.
So in the end, he just shook his head with difficulty: "I don't know him." ”
…… In fact, the entire TV world is just an ordinary employee aside from his direct boss. As for Mike's true identity, oh my, even he can't figure it out.
You let out a soft "uh," just in case, you asked one more question: "So, do you have any senior employees there?" ”
At this moment, Battat pondered for two seconds, then spoke with a hint of doubt: "No...... No, it should be? "He wasn't quite sure either.
You still kindly explained, "This is called 'yes and no.'" ”
"Alright, yes and no." He sighed, his shoulders slumping. But he still instinctively picked up a macaron and stuffed it into his mouth, only to be scrunched up all over in the next second.
You covered your mouth and chuckled softly, then spoke seriously: "So you're actually being that senior employee too?" ”
Battat was raising his coffee cup, intending to take a sip first. Hearing your sudden words, he instinctively tried to spit out his coffee. Luckily, he didn't spit it out right away—he just got interrupted and coughed several times.
You immediately fell silent, looking at Battat with some concern: "Is it important? If I'd known, I should've waited until you finished this sip of coffee before asking......" As you spoke, you pulled your chair over and sat down, gently patting Battat's back to help him catch his breath.
Oh my god, you don't want to see a murder report on the newspaper headlines the next day, and Battat's finger pointing to the coffee cup indicates that coffee is the real murderer. Of course, you don't want to lose this customer, since chatting with him is quite enjoyable. Maybe you already consider him a friend—even though he still knows nothing. If he never comes back to the café after that, you'd actually feel a huge pity.
He coughed several times before waving at you: "Cough...... It's fine, you're right. The answer to this question is yes. ”
You see he stopped coughing and instead raised his coffee cup again, looking somewhat lost in thought, as if trying to calm his nerves with a sip of coffee. Of course, he was also lost in mind eating the macaron, this time not even caring about the sweetness.
Anyway, you waited for him for a while, and only after he came to his senses did you speak: "Hmm, so apart from that, no one knows you're still a senior employee?" ”
Battat hesitated for a moment but still shook his head: "No." ”
You rub your chin, then somehow pull out a pair of sunglasses and start pretending to be serious as you lift your glasses like a detective: "Alright! Now the truth is clear! You take turns being that ...... senior employee? Anyway, and your boss doesn't know about this yet, so you don't want to quit. Otherwise, no one will share the senior employee's workload...... Hmm, but actually, you can quit too, right? ”
You take off your glasses in confusion and look at Battat, whose face is exhausted.
He waved his hand: "Alright, you really are sharp...... Let's just take it as you say. But maybe not wanting to quit is a kind of responsibility, right?" "Actually, Battat doesn't know what mindset kept him stuck with this job and the disguise."
You nod, then tilted your head: "I see...... But since you're here, let's relax for a while! Besides, I guess this is your secret—it's not that you shared it yourself, so don't feel guilty. And having someone help you share the secret must feel pretty good, right? "After saying that, you let out a couple of smug laughs and started humming.
"Yeah, it does feel much easier. It's rare that nothing happened, but it makes you want to get a good night's sleep." Battat realized he was genuinely smiling. Although he was momentarily panicked when the secret was asked, what followed was a sense of relief and comfort. For some reason, he instinctively felt like you were probably keeping a tight lip.
You rubbed your nose and said, "Aha, so if you're feeling troubled, come here to relax and treat me like a tree hollow. Anyway, I absolutely won't tell anyone." ”
“…… That wouldn't be a good idea. I can't just dump all my negative emotions on you, but......" he dragged out his words.
You were about to retort to him, but seeing that he was about to say something more, you also remained silent.
Then you see battat suddenly point at you with a very serious expression. For some reason, you feel that his expression has a bit of a gamble or a desperate gamble? You don't even know if you should describe it that way.
In short, you just stared blankly at his hand.
"So, now it's my turn to ask questions. You said before that the questions are one-for-one, but since you just asked so much, now it's my turn to ask." Battat said this while laughing, though he knew his smile was actually a bit forced.
You stared at him in surprise, and after hesitating for a moment, you nodded: "Alright, then is it still the same rules as the turtle soup we just did?" Of course, I wouldn't lie either. ”
Battat nodded, then pondered for a moment before asking, "So, don't you really find it boring?" ”
