You shake your head matter-of-factly: "Of course not." ”
“…… So, do you hope more customers will come by?" He continued, and of course, you couldn't tell anything from his expression—just a subtle sensation, and you were a bit nervous.
So you swallow hard: "Yes and no." ”
This time, it was Battat who lightly tapped the table. He looked at your innocent expression and pondered for a moment. Honestly, he's not really good at this kind of thing, so he just made a rough guess and analysis based on your answer: "Hmm...... So, do you want more regulars? Is it better to have fewer people than to be regular? ”
This time you nod happily: "Of course, the answer to both questions is yes." ”
"Hmm, and your family probably doesn't support that?" This is just speculation; in fact, Battat has no information about your family's company or anyone else.
"Of course not. So, no." This time you shook your head. Rather, these questions were somewhat superficial, so you answered quickly.
"So...... Do you have ambition? "He asked.
This time, you hesitated for a moment before shaking your head. In fact, you were wondering whether you should be considered ambitious—probably not. If you were, you'd already be the boss of the group by now, and wouldn't be running a café here.
"No. Uh, how should I put it? Anyway, I don't have ambition. "You actually wanted to explain more, but thinking about how wrong it would be to say more, in the end you just kept quiet.
"So, does your family group have any other coffee-related businesses?" Battat seemed to want to write something down, but in the end, he held back, his hand moving slightly on the table.
You think for a moment: "Yes." ”
If it's coffee-related businesses, then there are indeed several in the family, and they're chain chains. You might be a bit distracted.
"Uh...... Maybe it's related to instant coffee? "Battat hesitated for a moment before deciding to ask the question. To be honest, it was just a bold guess; he wasn't even sure if it was right.
You only glanced at battat in surprise, since you never expected his associative ability to be so formidable: "Uh, yes." ”
Well, now you feel like your secret is about to be guessed, and you've given up struggling.
Battat picked up the sunglasses you had just placed on the table and put them on, also pushing up his glasses to pose like a famous detective: "Alright, then I get it—you don't have ambition, so you don't want to manage the family business. But you want to prove that handmade coffee is much better than instant coffee. You want to attract a group of regular customers through handmade coffee, you want your family to stop opposing your approach and instead agree with your opinions? Or—you want others to value your views?" ”
He confidently shared the series of reasoning he had just made, and you just shrugged, then your shoulders slumped: "Alright, you're right—anyway, it's because my family doesn't agree with my viewpoint. I wanted to prove my point of view out of spite, so I came to open the café." ”
You added, "But I really want every customer here to feel relaxed. I sincerely hope every guest can enjoy a time that belongs to them all here." ”
Battat snorted lightly at this moment. He had to admit, he was actually feeling a bit more confident in his reasoning skills now, much better than when he was troubled by who Mike really was before.
…… Inside this café, there is indeed a lot to relax and enjoy—this is something Battat has to admit.
Of course, now he enjoys the feeling of coming here, and he'll come again next time. Maybe he'll look forward to chatting with you again.
Anyway, now he proudly turns his face to the side, and you can see his nose is sticking up. Somehow, it's a bit funny, but you still give him a serious applause: "Wow, Detective battat!" ”
He cleared his throat twice: "Mm, uh, you're a famous detective too. As for me, I really don't dare to deserve that." ”
You shake your head, ready to argue, and glance out the window, only to realize it's almost nighttime.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 4-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC belongs to me
…… What's going on? Why does my mouth speaks so long? This was clearly only half the content I imagined this chapter should have (despair).
——
So you shake your finger and wink: "Of course you're a famous detective. After all, look, you already saw through my secret. You know, I never intended to tell you at first." ”
Battat glanced at you. Actually, he thought what he figured out wasn't important; to you, it was probably just part of the reason. And...... He had reason to suspect you were just deceiving him by saying that.
But since you said so, he might as well be proud at the right moment. So he raised his nose again, but still shyly touched it, probably afraid it would grow longer: "Uh, alright, then I'm a detective too!" He tried hard to put on a happy face, even though his raised pitch only made him seem a bit funny and also meant failure.
Moreover, the nose hasn't grown longer either; it stays perfectly there and remains the same length.
"Yes, yes, you are the detective." You even applauded him enthusiastically, watching Battat finally lift his head with a smile, and you were very happy.
"By the way, it's already dinner time before you know it. Let me treat you to dinner!" You suddenly said this.
Battat had just raised his cup to take another sip—even though it was already a bit cold, the cold coffee had its own unique flavor. Now, hearing you say that, he almost spat it out again, but his good personal manners made him drink it down, and what took his place was once again choking.
This time, you patted his back with practiced familiarity and said with a hint of concern, "Are you okay?" Don't keep daydreaming. If you're going to drink coffee, you should drink it properly. Look, you're choking again. ”
Although it was probably your fault—you turned your head a little guilty—you still said this with confidence.
Battat wiped his mouth: "It's all because of what you said—coffee and dessert are already enough, right? What's the point of treating him to dinner?" By the end, he was almost muttering, but his words were just right for you to hear.
You turn your head innocently to look at him: "To celebrate—and partly to thank you. You're my first guest, a repeat customer, and it's rare. You don't have work today, so you should just relax a bit!" ”
This time, Battat just gave you a strange look: "...... Do you treat all the returning customers to meals? ”
You pinched your chin and thought carefully, then shook your head: "Hmm...... No. I just... maybe it's because you're special! In short, I invited you because I wanted to invite you to dinner! "You said cheerfully, since you can't figure things out, just don't think about them for now. That's your way of survival."
He rubbed his head, seeming a bit troubled: "Alright...... What do you want to eat? Next time, I'll treat you back...... "Battat muttered under his breath, sounding a bit pained, probably thinking about money that wasn't even in his hands yet.
"Wait a moment, I saw a shop when I passed by nearby before. It seems pretty interesting...... Anyway, since no one else is coming, the café is officially closed today! "You cheered, ran to the café's entrance, changed the direction of the open sign to close, then turned your hands behind your back and looked at battat: "Alright, let's go!" ”
He stood up, hesitated for a moment, but still put the two coffee cups along with the empty tray onto the counter. Of course, the coffee had already been finished. It had to be said, the caramel macchiato really had a charm that made people enjoy coffee. At this moment, your cup was stacked with his. Battat stared blankly at the empty cup for two seconds until he heard your urge again: "Alright, I'll tidy up the cups and all that later. Let's go out to eat first!" ”
Only then did he snap back to reality, cleared his throat, and said, "Sorry, I'll come right away." Only then did he look away and quicken his pace toward you.
But the moment his gaze fell on you, he couldn't help but ask, "Aren't you going to write something on that cup?" ”
You hesitate for a second, then realize he was talking about your coffee cup. So you just happily shake your head: "I'm not planning to write anything for now. If I write my name again, it might easily confuse it with your cup...... That's not good, so let's keep it pure white for now. I'll wait until I get inspired someday. Maybe I'll get inspired and write a poem on it someday!" ”
Of course, you walk very fast, and Battat has to quicken his pace to keep up with you. Of course, for some reason, at times like this, he doesn't dare to look at you, so he just stares at the hanging sun hanging from the horizon...... The so-called sun.
And the orange and purple colors blending from the sky hanging on the horizon. Only then did he softly say, "Ah, then wait until you have inspiration before writing." ”
…… Although he just wanted to say that it was fine if you wrote your name again and then mixed things up, he didn't mind at all. But maybe you would, so Battat hesitated for a moment and ultimately didn't speak.
"Mm-hmm, of course no problem. Speaking of which, I'm planning to invite you to this place for dinner!" As you spoke, you excitedly pointed to the shop next to it with a French title. It was clearly a French restaurant, though probably not that upscale. But it still had the vibe of a grand Western restaurant.
Battat hesitated and asked, "Are you sure you want to go here?" ”
You nodded, "Mm-hmm, I'm sure." I've always been curious about how French cuisine tastes, and since we're treating you this time, I'll give it a try!" Saying that, you tried to pull Battat's arm into the restaurant.
Of course, he didn't have time to scold you for suddenly grabbing his arm. Battat could only frown and refute your point: "First of all, French food probably doesn't taste great, and second...... This kind of restaurant must be expensive! It looks so upscale. If you want to eat French food, we can go to another place, because this one might not taste great either, and they even brazenly advertise it so openly that people won't know what it's selling......
You hesitate for two seconds, then stop: "Uh, hey, but aren't Western restaurants always expensive?" I remember correctly. ”
“…… Not all restaurants are expensive, right? There are plenty of affordable ones, right? How about we change direction?" Battat rubbed his brow again, then grabbed your arm, trying to get you to change direction so you could leave in front of the restaurant.
You think about it carefully and think that makes sense, but you still want to go to this restaurant, so you just put on a serious face: "Alright, you make sense, but I think I'll stick with this place. After all, expensive has its advantages, at least the service won't be bad!" So today I'm treating you here! "Saying that, you grabbed Battat's arm and rushed inside. This time, Battat couldn't resist you and was pulled inside by you as well."
He felt his vision go black. Now he felt more money flying farther away from him, but ...... Forget it! He gritted his teeth; after all, he had to keep his word!
You pulled Battat down at a table, and the waiter quickly brought you the menu. Battat seemed a bit lost in thought—maybe he was just daydreaming? You waved your hand in front of him, but he still ignored you.
“Battat？ Battat？ So I've ordered my food, okay?" Just in case, you still asked again and called out to him. Of course, he still didn't respond, so in the end, you could only glance at Battat with a hint of concern, then happily hold the menu and start ordering.
Soon, you handed the menu back to the waiter, then rested your chin on your hand and watched the still-recovered battat, waiting for the waiter to bring the food. Soon, a double serving of creamy mushroom soup was served, along with a small serving of wine to accompany the meal.
Seeing battat like this, you thoughtfully pushed the creamy mushroom soup in front of him and said very thoughtfully, "battat, it's ready, wake up!" ”
Only then did he snap back to reality, slap his head with a smack, and look at you awkwardly and laugh twice: "Ahaha...... Sorry, I've been distracted for a while. Is the dish serving? "Absent-minded, he said as he picked up the spoon and took a sip of creamy mushroom soup. Then he burned himself and put the spoon down again.
Now he was fully awake, put down his spoon seriously, and pretended that the soup wasn't just like him, just placing his hand on the table properly.
You blinked innocently, still not telling him that you had just felt like he had left your body. You just gently blew on the soup on the spoon, then slowly put it in your mouth, squinting slightly. The salty, fresh cream flavor mixed with freshly stir-fried mushrooms, and the steaming soup had a hint of sweetness. It really was perfect as an appetizer, at least you were looking forward to what else they would serve next.
"You get what you pay for. Their taste is pretty good. Want to try some?" So you said.
Battat hesitates at you, then looks at the creamy mushroom soup with bitter eyes. To be honest, because he'd just been burned, he didn't dare to try it for now. And just thinking about how expensive the creamy mushroom soup might make his vision go black. Drinking it was like gold, so he didn't dare to take a bite.
Anyway, under your expectant gaze, Battat had no choice but to pick up the spoon and take a sip of soup. His eyes finally lit up slightly, finally freed from that lifeless state. After all, it really tasted good, and it was worth comforting himself after several days of hard work to finally get some rest. So he didn't mind that you spent a lot of money on the treat—forget it, how could he not mind?!
Wait until you come back with a proper treat. At worst, you'll just treat a few more times. I can't just let you spend money for nothing...... Battat felt a bit pained, but still made this decision. Of course, you across from you knew nothing, just swung your legs and finished your creamy mushroom soup, waiting for the main dish to be served.
Soon, a pan-seared squab along with seafood baked rice was brought to you. It was clearly freshly baked, still sizzling with hot oil. Of course, another portion was placed in front of the battat. The seafood baked rice was sprinkled with fresh shrimp and small fish, mixed with some chopped scallions and squid bits, and the aroma of the rice irresistibly filled your nose.
You nod in satisfaction, first tear off the pigeon's wings, then take a couple of bites. The skin is still crispy, and the taste is really good. And the meat is also tender and fragrant, showing that this restaurant has a keen eye for ingredients and is spicy...... Well, that's not the point—since you've already spent money yourself, of course they have to serve well! That's exactly what you think of as a matter of course.
Battat hesitated for two seconds, then used the provided spoon to scoop a spoonful of baked seafood rice and put it in his mouth. Well, it really was delicious. Now he was completely convinced.
Before long, you've finished the main course. Wait for the waiter to bring the plates down and bring out dessert and salad to pair with the wine. The meal is about to end.
The dessert was a freshly baked, delicately plated apple pie, fragrant, and steaming hot. The salad was rather ordinary, just a bowl of vegetables and fruits topped with salad dressing.
You use a fork to pick up some vegetable leaves and put them in your mouth. When the apple pie seems to cool down a bit, you put it in your mouth. The crispy crust and the fragrant apple flavor blend together...... It's truly sweet and delicious, at least you're willing to have another piece. Before you know it, everything on the plate has been gone.
Of course, at this moment the plates in front of you are all empty, which means you've finally finished eating. For some reason, Battat looks at the fact that no new plates are served, but instead lets out a sigh. You glance at him in confusion, unable to figure out what he's thinking.
You were the one paying the bill too. Battat propped his head up and glanced at the bill from the side. Even though you kept insisting Battat didn't need to pay, he still shook his head firmly.
"Anyway, when I get there, I'll definitely find another place to treat and invite him back." He still clenched his fist and said this, looking like he was burning with some fighting spirit.
Food...... You didn't mind, so you reluctantly nodded and agreed to battat. In fact, you were looking forward to what kind of shop he would take you to.
But after saying goodbye today, you haven't seen him for several days in a row, which makes you feel a bit melancholy and lonely, and also a bit uneasy. After all, you don't have his contact information. Although you took him as a friend without permission, in reality, you were just strangers who met by chance. At this point, you actually regret not leaving a single contact information.
However, the wind chimes occasionally ring, which means your shop door has been pushed open. At that moment, you look up in surprise, only to find it is a strange face, and then lower your head in disappointment.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 5-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC belongs to me
…… Customer: Am I part of your play?
——
Even so, when you see a new customer arrive, you instinctively smile, pick up another coffee cup, and place it on the counter to make a gesture of invitation to that customer.
"Hello, you can freely choose the coffee on the menu, and of course, you can also pick some desserts to accompany you and enjoy this leisurely time together. Additionally, you can select your own exclusive coffee cup for your own use." You introduced it enthusiastically, and of course, you placed the battat cup on the table below.
However, the customer glanced around and frowned, probably not liking these colorful things. In the end, he pointed to the one on the table: "Is this okay?" I prefer a cleaner cup. ”
You paused for a moment. He pointed in the direction exactly the cup you had just been about to put away, so you could only smile and continue explaining, "Uh...... Sorry, someone has already chosen this cup, but if the guest wishes, we also have pure white cups to choose from. "As you spoke, you took another pure white cup from the cabinet. As for your own cup, it was still next to the coffee machine, since you wanted to make yourself a cup of coffee today.
The guest nodded, clearly very satisfied: "Then let's have this cup. Also, a latte and a ham sandwich." ”
You nod: "Okay, sir." After saying this, you take the cup and start brewing coffee. The coffee beans are still Blue Mountain Railcard, the most classic and convenient. For a latte, you need to add a bit of milk to the coffee...... After all, this is chosen because you like rich milk flavors and a mild taste. Of course, some might think the latte is too bland, but you just pour a large amount of steamed milk into the coffee, then whip some milk foam on top, and the whole cup shows a faint brown hue, carrying the sweet aroma of milk before serving it to the guest. Of course, it also comes with a fresh sandwich.
The customer nodded and accepted it, and you returned to the counter. This time, you looked a bit troubled by your blank coffee cup. Honestly, if you didn't write anything, you might get confused with the customer's cup, but if you wrote something, it might be mistaken for Battat's cup. Using other colored pens was one option, but unfortunately, there were no other colored pens in the shop. You should know, you usually only prepare one or two pens for emergencies; you're not the type to hoard colored pens.
Just as you were at a loss, you heard the wind chime ring again. Instinctively, you looked up—in fact, you hadn't expected much, since you'd been disappointed so many times over the past couple of days. But when you looked up, you couldn't help but be startled. It was none other than battat. Although his face was covered by a large number of documents, you could still tell by his figure and clothes.
Even walking was a bit unsteady, and the documents were swaying as well, looking like they might fall at any moment. I had no idea how he managed to open the café's glass door—maybe by pushing it open with his elbow? Anyway, you hurried out of the counter and went over to help him pick up some of the documents. At least now you could see the top of his head, though only a little bit of the top was visible. You hesitated, but still helped him carry the documents. This time, you got used to where he usually sits, so you walked straight to the window and put the files down.
Battat followed behind you. Because you helped him carry some of the documents, his steps were noticeably lighter than before. You could tell how hard he had been holding them all the way—after all, his legs no longer trembled, and his body no longer wobbled. He placed all the documents on the table before wiping the sweat from his forehead, looking at you with a hint of apology: "Phew...... Thank you. ”
But you just waved your hand indifferently, placing your other hand on your hip: "It's nothing, it's just a small favor. We're friends, after all." ”
Battat seemed his brain hadn't fully activated yet, or maybe he was just a bit out of the loop, just repeating instinctively, with a slightly rising tone at the end, probably puzzled: "Friend, ......?" ”
You immediately put on that somewhat hurt expression and looked at him: "What's wrong? We're not friends after all? I thought we were friends for a long time, but it turns out all of this was just my arrogance, just my one-sided wishful thinking. "As you spoke, you clutched your chest, pretending to be heartbroken and about to faint.
Battat waved his hand, trying hard to force a smile, but his expression was still very forced. It was better not to smile, since his smile was too stiff and almost intimidating, baring his teeth. Of course, you know he wanted to show a smile to comfort you, so you wouldn't feel scared.
…… All you can do is find it a bit funny that he struggles to show a desperate smile and still tries to cheer you up.
Of course, you have basic manners; you definitely won't laugh out loud at a time like this! So you just look at him seriously, waiting to see what else he can say.
"Of course that's not what I meant...... I just didn't react to it. Of course we're friends...... Battat waved his hand. Somehow, you could hear a hint of weakness in his voice. Of course, his expression was also haggard. The last time you saw him, you were fine, but this time he already had heavy dark circles under his eyes.
So you just blink and stop dwelling on the previous question. After all, you just suddenly wanted to say something weird hoping Battat would be a bit happier. If only it could help him break free from this dead-like state. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be going well now—he probably took what he just said seriously. Hmm, maybe all serious people do this? You don't know, because it's the first time you've encountered someone like Battat.
So you just cleared your throat and patted battat on the shoulder: "Alright, I knew you definitely thought we were friends!" But I think compared to drinking coffee, what you need now is a good night's sleep and a good rest, not to waste your body on coffee to extend work hours and keep wasting your life on work. "You looked at battat seriously, trying to persuade him.
But battat just glanced at you and turned away: "Ah, but all these paperwork are to be finished today...... That's why I planned to have a cup of coffee and then quietly finish these tasks. ”
You pouted your cheeks, a bit unhappy. Even though you knew he was here to handle these tasks and definitely wouldn't listen to you to rest, you couldn't help but complain, "What kind of boss is this? He actually assigns so much work!" If an employee died in front of him, would he compensate him? This counts as a work injury...... If you ask me, you might as well quit your job and quit. What is there to hide about that senior employee......
Battat cleared his throat twice, then gestured for the height of the documents: "These are the tasks I was supposed to handle." ”
Then he gestured to the height of another stack of documents: "These are the tasks that the senior employee must handle." ”
Of course, he lowered his voice when he said these things, since he had seen other customers inside the café. Although he probably didn't know him, it was better to be safe.
You glance at the height of his gesture, then open your mouth wide. Four-fifths of the work at his gesture is for regular employees, leaving only one-fifth......
So you can't help but mutter, "Uh, so the lives of ordinary employees aren't really their lives?" Are senior employees the truly valuable employees? ”
“…… Not really, the remaining one-fifth of the work is actually more complicated than four-fifths. "Battat rubbed his brow again, because the remaining medicine was for stage planning, writing preparatory scripts, planning the broadcast times for each scene on stage, as well as lighting and sound effects—all sorts of messy things had to be considered.
You closed your mouth and looked at him worriedly, paused, then lowered your voice and asked, "How about I help you handle part of it?" Since you said that four-fifths isn't important, does that mean it's okay to just do a little? ”
At this moment, Battat glanced at you with a hint of alarm and hurriedly shook his head: "No...... These are all my jobs. I really feel sorry for your help, and I'm afraid you won't fully understand what you're supposed to do......
You just raised your eyebrows: "Hmm, so you actually think I can get it done?" "It's fine, at worst case, just tell me exactly what you're going to do. I think it's fine. Anyway, besides sitting at the counter daydreaming, there's nothing else I can do." ”
Battat carefully examined your expression. Well, he could confirm that you were indeed saying such things, so it was unlikely he would change your decision, though it was fine.
But actually, Battat was just afraid you'd discover these two stacks of documents were exactly the same—he personally felt there was nothing to deal with, so he might as well just throw them away. But Tenna still had to check them, or else he wouldn't get paid. He was counting on saving up these salaries to treat you to a meal. As for why the documents were identical, it was because he bribed another pippins, agreeing to help him finish the work, and that Battat needed to hand over this month's salary—after all, pippins had other ways to make money, so Battat went into the deal with it without a clear conscience. As for whether Pippins would eventually hand over his salary, he wasn't sure.
So in the end, he sighed: "Alright, I understand. I'll pick out some for you later...... Alright, now, give me a cappuccino first. ”
You nodded, jumped to the other end of the counter, and started brewing a cappuccino with battat's coffee cup. This time, you added less steamed milk to balance the coffee and milk flavors, creating a smooth texture with the bitterness characteristic of coffee. You whipped some milk foam on top, then handed the cup of coffee to battat, and of course, placed a piece of tiramisu in front of him.
You said, "Hmm...... Tiramisu is the kind that mixes bitterness with sweetness, with a balanced flavor and not too sweet. I think you'll like this flavor? Anyway, I've prepared it for you. Actually, I just want to tell you that tasting sweets will lift your mood a bit. "As you spoke, you smiled and sat across from you with another cappuccino. But it was still a pure white cup before. To pour coffee and avoid confusion, you had to use the only dark green pen left in the shop to write a name on it—you even felt quite proud, thinking you were really smart.
Because you wrote the name 'battat' on the cup, so you wouldn't get confused, and you happily picked up your coffee cup and took a sip.
As for Battat across from you, he was startled when he saw the name on your coffee cup, instinctively about to spit out the coffee he'd just drunk, but even after the depreciation once, he barely swallowed the pickup before coughing.
You dragged a chair over and patted him on the back, saying as you played, "What's wrong? Why did you choke again? Next time you drink coffee, don't zone out." ”
He just coughed for a while before calming down, wiped his mouth, and said, "No...... It's nothing, just a bit surprised to see my name written on your cup......
You raise your eyebrows proudly: "Well, I wrote this on the spot to avoid confusion, because the new guest asked for a pure white cup today. Anyway, if I write it this way, I definitely won't get it wrong. So, am I smart?" ”
Battat could only nod: "Yes, that's right, very smart." He looked at your proud head and couldn't help but reach out to touch it, but only after touching did he realize what he had done, so he stared blankly at his own hand.
After a while, he finally stammered, "Sorry...... Just now, I was rude. ”
You blinked and patted your own head. Hmm, it was very smooth and felt great to the touch, so you just shook your head: "It's okay, I know it feels great, so if you want to touch it, go ahead. Maybe it can even relieve stress!" You smiled brightly.
"If you ask me, you're just under too much pressure. It's not even your business, but you still have to carry so many burdens...... Is it because your sense of responsibility is too strong? In short, don't work too hard. Staying in such a high-pressure and high-intensity work environment all the time can easily make you anxious and easily self-destructive," you thought for a moment, then nodded firmly. Now you took Battat's hand and placed it on your head. "Hmm, so this should be more stress-relieving and help you relax a bit. Let's try again?" ”
Your eyes sparkled as you looked at him with anticipation.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 6-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
…… It seems like a mere ledger......
——
Battat couldn't help but turn his head away looking at your expectant gaze. He didn't dare to look at you any longer, so he coughed awkwardly twice, struggling internally. To be honest, he was a bit hesitant about whether to touch it again...... Hmm, his hand was a bit restless, and he could feel the softness and fluffiness on top of his head now.
He hesitated for a moment, then squeezed his glasses shut tightly and steeled himself: "Alright!" He said this as if he had surrendered heroically, then lowered his hand and touched the top of your head, as if facing death fearlessly, and his movements were very stiff.
Blinking, you naturally notice his unnatural movement, so you kindly remind him, "That way, the pressure will only increase...... Relax a bit?" "This was obviously just a suggestion, but Battat immediately pulled his hand back, as if burned, clearing his throat to hide his embarrassment.
"Alright, let's leave it at that...... Let's finish the work first, work comes first! "Actually, it's fine to hurry up and finish it later, but now, whenever Battat thinks about the work left unfinished, that anxiety wells up in his heart.
You nodded knowingly, "Alright, then let me help you finish part of it. By the way, what kind of handwriting do you have? Maybe I can imitate it...... You hesitated as you glanced at the stack of documents. Clearly, they were all blank.
Battat hesitated for a moment, then pulled out a piece of paper and handed it to you, then divided part of the file out: "This one, right? I just happened to write part of it after I got these jobs yesterday, so you can just write it in this format...... Hmm, and then this part, not very important." He nodded.
He gave you his part, and whether it was out of trust or selfishness, since you wanted to imitate the handwriting, he showed it to you. As for the documents he traded with other pippins, he handled it himself.
Although he actually thought it didn't matter how you wrote it—after all, Tenna didn't seem like someone who would check these documents. To be honest, he hadn't even seen the boss name any employee's proposal adopted! But seeing how motivated you were, of course he wouldn't discourage you. He just thought for a moment and added, "Uh...... Actually, you can just write whatever you want? ”
You shook your head sharply: "That won't do!" Battat clearly looks like he's seriously completing these tasks. Of course I won't hold you back—I have to work hard too! "You seem to be burning with burning energy too."
Of course, for you, battat's handwriting isn't very hard to imitate. After all, it's probably to make it clear that it's not written in a complicated or hard way to read, just a bit of a hook at the end of the letter, probably a personal habit.
You carefully reviewed the documents Battat had written. There was nothing special about it, just drafting a speech that the boss might need. By the way, the speech was well written. If you could join your company just doing paperwork, that would be fine...... You were tempted again, but in the end, you regretfully gave up on it. You felt you couldn't persuade Battat right away.
You don't actually dislike his persistence; in fact, you quite appreciate it. In a way, he probably quite enjoys the job he has now? You don't really know either. Anyway, after reading this speech, you can guess you can put it down and start checking the requirements for other documents, oh...... There are also several dialogue proposals and program planning references, probably referring to the specific segments that need to be arranged in the program.
You see that the title is a detective show, think deeply, and then confidently write down some segments. Of course, first, you need someone to explore the scene for clues, then deduce based on the clues found and the intelligence provided by the NPC. Naturally, when questioning the NPC, you need some script; if the script completely fails, you get no answers......
You finished writing the document in a long way, glanced at your own words proudly, then compared it to Battat's speech. Hmm, you couldn't tell it was written by a second person—how nice.
But while you were studying this document, Battat had already completed three documents in wild cursive form. After all, he hadn't taken pippins' work too seriously, and wild cursive and similar styles suited their personalities better, right? In short, he wrote quickly, even after just a brief mental concept. Besides, Tenna probably wouldn't even look at pippins' files, which made Battat feel more at ease.
Seeing Battat finish a document so quickly, you can't help but feel a bit anxious and speed up your writing—haha, you just said anxiety is bad, but now you're actively anxious. But as long as it solves problems, sometimes being anxious is actually a good thing......
As you pondered, you couldn't help but take a sip of coffee, finally snapping out of the chaotic emotions. You diligently finished the documents again. Whether it was your imagination or not, battat's movements seemed to be just passing the job. You wanted to ask what the documents were, but seeing him start working on another pile and looking much more serious, his writing much slower, you couldn't bear to disturb him. So in the end, you remained silent, focusing on the document in front of you.
When you're finally done, you stretch lazily, watching Battat prop his head up writing the last document, quietly take a bite of the tiramisu that was brought out and hasn't been touched at all. Chewing on it, you ask unclearly, "Hmm, by the way, is this job for a senior employee really tough?" ”
As soon as he finished speaking, you saw Battat finally let out a long breath, slapped the last file on the pile beside him, and for once, revealed a look that could only be described as arrogant...... Sneering? Anyway, maybe he's just too happy about finishing his work, that's what you're guessing.
"Hard to do?" Of course it's hard. After all, although the boss has assigned almost the same content, each time he only carefully reviews the part the senior employee does and then takes their suggestions, praising them for a long time. But the ordinary employees have worked so hard to do all this, and who knows where he has thrown it away! "At this point, Battat was a bit frustrated. He reached out and gestured hard, not sure what he wanted to say.
In short, you just watch him vent his emotions, then take a deep breath, pick up a spoon, and scoop a mouthful of tiramisu. Of course, since you had already dug a piece, he avoided that side and only dug down a portion from the other end.
"So that's how it is...... I thought you should just quit your job already. Why bother working in a company like this? The treatment is just too bad! "You started defending battat.
Battat took a deep breath, pulled his chair closer to you, looked around, then lowered his voice: "Right...... If I were just an ordinary employee, I might have been fired. Although I don't know what other company would accept pippins, it's still better than being exploited. If I hadn't disguised myself as that senior employee, I definitely would have left......
He muttered, "You don't know if Battat is just looking for an excuse not to leave that company."
In short, you spoke up again, of course lowering your voice and with some concern for battat: "...Are you really not being PUA by the company you're currently at? Also, your sense of worth seems quite low? I think it has nothing to do with status or anything. As long as you have the ability, what company wouldn't hire you? If a company rejects you just based on status, I think such a company really has no vision and surely won't last long."
“…… But if you truly like your current job, I wouldn't insist you quit. I just think you really need to relax a little longer from time to time." You said with a cheerful smile.
Battat hesitated for a moment, pondering his true position, and finally hesitantly replied, "I don't know either...... But I guess I still like this job, right?" As he finished speaking, his voice rose upward, clearly showing that even he wasn't quite sure about it.
You just smiled and patted his shoulder: "Well, if you're tired, why not come here and rest?" You can talk to me for a bit. Of course, if you don't want to say anything, it's quiet enough here. You just need to come here and sit for a while. At least it should help you relax a bit, right? Besides, I said you can treat me like a tree hollow, so just say whatever you want! "As you spoke, you proudly patted your chest.
"Indeed...... It's relaxing here, but now that I'm relaxing, it feels like I'm just taking a nap. "In the end, he couldn't help but laugh and just took a gentle sip of coffee. The coffee had cooled a bit, but the rich milk and coffee flavors blended together still created a unique taste.
“…… Then sleep? "You asked, not quite sure.
"I just finished my coffee and still can't sleep." He answered matter-of-factly.
"Then just chat casually? Speaking of which, isn't there anyone holding this senior position? Why do you need to pretend......
Battat put down his coffee cup, resting his chin on his hand, putting on a deep expression in thought for a moment, then finally spoke softly: "Mm...... Actually, that senior employee also has a name—his name is Mike. But even though his room is there, it's empty. The key is, the boss always calls out Mike's name, and whenever Mike is gone, he gets really angry! Uh, part of the purpose is to keep him from taking it out on the employees below, but anyway, after we think about it, only the other two of us will take on the role of Mike. Of course, it's just a disguise......"
Your gaze shifted slightly, landing on the tall pile of documents: "Uh, so there are still so many documents to handle? So does that mean you're the one handling all the paperwork for Mike?" ”
Battat let out a quiet breath, leaned over the table, and stretched out his hands. It was clear he was truly tired.
"Yeah...... To be honest, at first the three of us shared the work, but it turned out the handwriting was different and the quality was different, so we decided to split up and finish it separately. Maybe this time it was my turn, and next time it was another. But this time, all the work piled up fell on me......
He seemed to be muttering to himself, but his volume was just right for you to hear. You nodded thoughtfully, scooped up another spoonful of tiramisu, and then, like Battat, lay down on the table and let out a quiet sigh.
"Alright, I understand. Although they don't let me do these tasks anymore, I've handled it myself, so I know this situation very well......" At this point, you start to feel a bit melancholy recalling the past.
Battat turned his head to look at you: "What is it...... Is there something you need? ”
"Well, it's not really that important, right? It's just that I'm of age and should inherit the company, so I've been involved in some matters. But my father happened to die in an accident, and the power has fallen to another elder on the board. I don't know what his attitude is, but I just didn't want to deal with those matters anymore, so I used the excuse of opening a coffee shop and left."
“…… Anyway, they won't be short of my supplies." You said this as if it were only natural.
"It doesn't sound like a great situation, but if that's the case, you could definitely try to reclaim your power, right?" Battat thought for a moment and said this, then sat up straight and scooped up a spoonful of tiramisu to eat. He was probably just daydreaming, so he didn't realize he had taken the wrong spoon, since when he put down two spoons on the same side earlier.
"But I still prefer my current life—it's easygoing, doesn't require me to think too much, and I can chat with guests I'm interested in...... Oh right, it seems you're holding my spoon." You scratched your cheek, still leaning on the table, just slightly looking up at battat.
His movements froze. He had already put the spoon in his mouth, but now he was unsure whether to take it out or not. Although it was strange to see the dice mysteriously turn red from bottom to top, you still sat up and said understandingly, "It's okay, I'll get another handful. It's also my fault for not paying attention and putting the spoon together......" You muttered to yourself, stood up, and walked over to the counter to pick up another spoon.
Of course, you glanced at the spot where the previous guest was, but you don't know exactly when he left. Anyway, he left a few coins under the coffee cup, probably as a tip? You guess.
Battat took out a spoon and stared blankly at it several times. Of course, he still felt a bit dizzy at this moment, and when you came back with a new spoon, you'd see him still like this. Of course, you took a different one—this time, you brought a small ceramic spoon.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 7-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC belongs to me
…… Sorry for making me sound like I rambled so much. If I write it like this, Forget it, I like it, so whatever! By the way, the plot seems a bit cheesy (look), but as long as it's useful, that's enough!!
——
He coughed dryly twice, not knowing where to put his hands, his gaze wandering, so he could only scratch his head haphazardly. After all, things get busy when things are inexplicable, and there are always a bunch of little tricks and tricks.
You just sat down with a hint of confusion and looked at him, scooped a piece of tiramisu with your newly picked spoon, and stammered, "What's wrong with you?" ”
Battat cleared his throat twice more: "Ahem, it's nothing, I just suddenly remembered I still have some things to deal with, so I'll leave first." "Of course, he's definitely not running away! Well, maybe he really does need some time to think things through...... Now you're still sitting next to him, and he honestly doesn't know what to think. After all, his mind is full of you right now, and he can't think of anything else.
After saying this, he stood up holding the documents, and you nodded blankly: "Oh, then that's settled. See you next time!" ”
Battat seemed to nod behind that stack of documents, then pushed open the café door with his arm and hurried off. You even peeked at his back and couldn't help but marvel—wow, his footsteps are so steady, not a single document fell off. Of course, maybe it's because Battat is quite familiar with this kind of thing.
Fortunately, Tenna hadn't checked the documents and couldn't have noticed anything unusual. After arguing his case, Battat still got his salary. He counted the points he had and exchanged them for Dark Coins. Thinking he could finally treat him back, Battat visited the café again. As he approached, his mood soared, and he felt a bit nervous.
But when he reached the entrance, his heart sank again, because the coffee shop was pitch dark and there was a 'close' sign hanging there, clearly a closed place. He had deliberately chosen a time to come at the same time as his usual visits, so logically, he should be open. But today might just be your day off, since running a café is tough. Battat comforted himself like this and then left the entrance, though as he left, he couldn't help but instinctively glance back a couple more times.
However, on the second and third days, when he arrived at the coffee shop entrance, he still saw it pitch black and the door tightly locked. Battat couldn't help but feel anxious—although he thought he wouldn't let him get into trouble, he suddenly realized that apart from the coffee shop, he had no contact with you. You two were like strangers, only knowing each other's names and appearances, knowing nothing else, no contact information, let alone a deeper connection.
…… If he'd known, he would have asked for your contact info when they parted last time. Battat felt a bit regretful. Now, he could only wander off and keep visiting the café, only to be turned away.
Of course, this kind of absent-minded state didn't show while working. He was still seriously completing the work belonging to mike, but it was still noticed by pluey and jongler. However, it seemed battat didn't want to say anything; they just shook their heads, pretending not to notice, while actively helping him share some of the workload.
…… Of course, whether it was done well was another matter.
On the anxious fifth day, Battat finally saw the café open. He breathed a sigh of relief, pushed open the glass door, and walked in, nervously gathering his emotions and thinking about how to start the conversation.
When you first heard the sound of wind chimes, your body involuntarily trembled. Only when you saw Battat coming in did you breathe a sigh of relief, a smile forming on your face as you asked, "Ah, it's Battat. What would you like to drink today?" ”
Battat walked up to the counter, looking at your seemingly flawless but actually forced smile. After hesitating for a moment, he gritted his teeth and asked, "I...... You haven't seen the coffee shop open these past few days. Has something happened? Ah, I think I can ask. After all, since you're willing to listen to my troubles, I should be listening to your worries too." Battat said, patting his chest and putting on a serious and earnest look.
“…… After all, we're friends, aren't we? "When he said this, his tone rose slightly, with a hint of confusion and a hint of pleading.
You blinked at Battat, who suddenly took a serious pose, and put away the forced smile on your face: "Alright...... I'll tell you after I finish making coffee. I think my thoughts are still a bit chaotic right now. ”
Battat nodded, even feeling overjoyed and at a loss, since he didn't know he'd convinced you so easily. You have to understand, he probably wouldn't have shared his troubles before. Pretending to be Mike or something like that was better buried deep in his heart. But since you figured it out, he had no reason to hide it any longer, so he couldn't help but reveal more in your sincere eyes.
…… So, maybe you're the same—because of your seriousness and enthusiasm, you're willing to talk about locking your troubles. If no one asks, you'll pretend nothing happened and start thinking of solutions yourself, even if it's difficult. But once someone asks, you can't help but want to share your worries and confusion.
Actually, most customers who never come to me don't ask; they simply close the shop out of necessity, and only Battat asks.
You still made two caramel macchiatos and brought them over, because you wanted a sweet sip of coffee—that was just your personal desire. Of course, you also paid attention to the coffee cup with your name on it for Battat, and the cup with Battat's name on it was for you. This time, you wouldn't get confused, thinking excitedly. Besides that, you also brought a plate of macarons.
Battat is still sitting by the window, while you sit opposite him, put down your plate, and exhale.
"Alright...... Anyway, let's have a sip of coffee first. Let's both feel a bit better." You've finally combed yourself together a bit, and once again put on a faint smile on your face. It's just your habit. After all, your elders always teach you that smiling makes people feel better, and of course, that also means you're in a pretty good mood yourself.
But Battat just frowned and looked at you. To be honest, he always felt something was off about your smile, and couldn't help but say, "...... If you don't want to laugh, then you better not laugh." ”
Your smile immediately faded, and you just lowered your head, feeling helpless, holding the coffee cup with both hands, rubbing it. After a moment, you hesitantly asked, "So, are you really willing to listen to me?" ”
Battat nodded firmly: "Yes, so are you willing to tell me exactly why?" ”
You take a deep breath and then lift your head, probably to prevent tears from suddenly falling into the coffee cup. But you only keep your strength and won't do that.
"Well, actually, it wasn't that bad at first. I just planned to close the shop for a whole morning. After all, I told you before that the company executives suddenly called me over, saying it would be better if I kept the engagement we had already made. I really can't see what he meant, but I didn't want to fulfill that engagement, so I still proposed annulling it. After all, that engagement was a verbal agreement made while my father was alive, so of course it could be annulled, so the company executive did agree. But that fiancé didn't agree and insisted on continuing the engagement......" you rambled on.
“…… I guess it's because his family is on the verge of bankruptcy lately. After all, I heard their business line is on the verge of crisis. They've probably lost a lot of money on investment, so they can't wait to hold this wedding banquet. After all, if the engagement is finalized, they could get a huge sum of money. ”
Battat listened while frowning, his brows never lowered. In fact, his mood was fluctuating too—in short, it was unsettled—actually, when he first heard you had a marriage proposal, his mood suddenly sank, then when he heard you didn't want it, he suddenly felt joy, and later, when he heard your fiancé was still going to get married, he was furious. The origin of this feeling was elusive and unclear. Battat actually had a vague guess, but he also found it absurd—you had only met a few times, only for a short time, and didn't even leave your contact information. Why did this vague feeling arise?
He looks at your face seriously again, his thoughts drifting for a moment, pondering such a question. He doesn't know the answer either, but since that's the case, so be it. Maybe he doesn't even need an answer, since so-called answers are just to convince himself, and all he needs to know is the fact.
By the time I came to my senses, your rambling was nearing its end: "...... Then that fiancé, in short, was not very satisfied. I don't know how he found out where my coffee shop is. These past few mornings, he's been coming to pester me, demanding I go back and fulfill this engagement with him. It's just too annoying. To avoid his harassment, I simply closed the shop in the afternoon...... Luckily, he hasn't come over today. "As you say this, you let out a breath.
"Actually, if he were harassing me, it would be fine. But I'm worried he'll keep pestering other customers, making it so bad that no one else dares to come. If he wants to smash the shop or something, that would be even worse......" You pressed your brow to your forehead, and after saying the last sentence, you took another big sip of coffee before slamming the cup down on the table. Then, with a hint of nervousness, you looked at Battat.
"Come to think of it, I realize I've said so much. You don't find it annoying, do you? I just really want to talk about all these things......" you said, a little embarrassed, and pressed your fingers together.
Battat shook his head: "Of course it's fine, you ...... Uh, you can treat me like a tree hollow? Anyway, just say whatever you want to say." He said uncertainly, patting his chest again, as if to say he could definitely rely on him.
You chuckled, slumped over the table, turned to look out the window, and muttered to yourself, "Hey...... Saying it does feel much better, but I don't know what I'd do if that guy comes looking for me again......
Battat hesitated for a moment, then gritted his teeth and said, "How about we exchange contact info? If he shows up again, just call me directly. I think ...... If I can't help one of them, at least I can call others along. We can't just let this continue. Besides, it's not convenient to call the police for just harassment, so it's best if you have someone to protect you. Uh, I'm not recommending me. If you have a better candidate, you don't need to consider me......" By the end, he started stammering again, feeling his head burning—maybe his heart was burning too. Fortunately, he turned his face to look out the window, so he didn't see anything. Battat quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
You thought carefully for a moment, then turned and took out your phone: "Then let's add your contact info. Actually, we're all so familiar with each other, yet we've never added a contact info or anything...... Huh, why are you blushing? ”
You sit up. Honestly, you haven't really seen that expression on his face before. It was quite novel, so you couldn't help but take a second look at him.
Battat hadn't expected you to suddenly turn your head; he had just breathed a sigh of relief thinking you wouldn't see him! Anyway, now he could only lightly cough twice: "Ahem, it's nothing, let's add your contact info first." He also took out his own phone.
Then you swapped numbers. He saw you pin his number to the top and marked it with an asterisk. Somehow, he felt his chest throb twice more violently. He just hurriedly lowered his head, a bit shy, avoiding your gaze, and set your number to the pin. After hesitating for a moment, he added a heart to the end.
You let out a long breath: "Phew...... Next time he comes, I'll call you first! I think if he saw other men beside me, he wouldn't be so arrogant. But I can't really say what that kind of person might be thinking......
Battat glanced at the sky. He had come to the café early this morning, so it was still quite early. He looked at you, who was still muttering, hesitated for a moment, and offered a suggestion: "But that guy will probably find him later, right?" Why not close the café and go out first? The main thing is to clear his mind. Otherwise, being pestered by him every day would be uncomfortable. ”
You rub your chin, clearly convinced, and take a bite of macarons. Muttering as you nod, you say, "Alright, then let's go out and relax!" Good food lifts your spirits. I hope I can forget the unhappiness of the past few days! ”
You wave your hand to encourage yourself, and seeing you pull yourself together, Battat quietly breathes a sigh of relief.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 8-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
…… Feels like I could write a lot about this post, and I also tried to write about the feeling of a secret crush in this chapter (what does that mean?)
——
However...... Hearing you mention gourmet food, Battat decided to double-check, so he asked, "Hmm, are you planning to go eat something to relax first?" ”
You nodded vigorously: "Yes! I want mango brûlée, caramel pudding, chocolate brownie, chiffon cake, matcha mille crepe ......" You wanted to continue, but when you mentioned these foods, your mouth was watering. Luckily, you held it back—at least it preserved some of your image.
Battat could only helplessly press his brow: "If you order so much, you probably won't finish it." He was simply pointing out that fact. Although you probably don't want to hear this at this moment, since it sounds a bit disappointing at first.
You just stuck out your tongue. Although your mood was interrupted for a moment, you didn't seem too troubled. You just cleared your throat twice: "Oh dear...... If you can't finish it, just pack it up and put it in the fridge and continue eating tomorrow, or if you're hungry or craving, you can eat it. Besides, the snacks are stored in another stomach! Hmm, besides, you're here. If I can't finish it, I'll leave it to you! "As you spoke, you righteously patted battat on the shoulder, as if reluctantly letting it go, and even pretended to wipe away your tears.
“…… But eating dessert every meal isn't healthy. "Battat held back a bit and couldn't help but say this. Of course, he was seriously suggesting it, not deliberately disturbing your mood, just that he felt he should at least stop it at this moment to avoid binge eating.
"If it really doesn't work, you can try one this time and another ......next time," Battat couldn't help but ramble on with some suggestions. Only then did he realize you'd quieted down at some point, quickly turned to glance at your expression, and quietly breathed a sigh of relief. Luckily, you didn't look angry.
"Alright, you make a good point, so I'll reluctantly listen to that. But I'll still order two types. If I can't finish them, I'll leave them to you." You smugly waved your fingers, paused, and added another sentence.
"Yeah, but actually, it's because it keeps in the fridge and doesn't taste good......" you muttered quietly.
Battat scratched his head, a bit hesitant to ask: if you couldn't finish it for him, would you split it into two clean desserts first, or would you get stained on it...... Uh, fine, he didn't dare think any further, so he just cleared his throat and turned his head: "Alright, shall we head out now?" "I happen to have nothing else to do today." "He's been coming to see you these past few days after finishing his business. After all, he's already decided to treat you to a good meal, maybe there are other things to do too. In any case, it's best to finish things early and free up a whole period."
You thought about the question and hesitantly nodded, "Alright, let's head out now!" Hmm, but I'll treat you anyway. After all, I just want to eat, and I might have to trouble you to eat the ...... I left." You gave a couple of awkward laughs as you spoke.
After saying that, you got up to change the sign to 'close' first. Battat's eyes widened, a bit flustered. He had actually already planned to treat him, but hadn't known what reason to use before. But now, he had a ready-made one—
So he suddenly stood up and stepped in front of you. You looked at him in confusion: "Hmm, is there something else?" ”
"Uh, um, I think so. After all, I suggested it to relax and to lift your spirits, so this time I'll treat you." Otherwise, every time it's you're the one treating, he'll feel extremely embarrassed and always thinking about when he'll repay you.
You blink and shake your head sharply: "No, let me treat you. How can I let you spend money? After all, the dessert shop I'm going to is probably quite expensive." ”
Well, you really are thinking of him, and battat knows that. But he still took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and insisted, "No, I absolutely have to treat this time. I can't just let you spend money, can I?" "He had saved up money specifically to get him back. If he couldn't repay this time and had to wait until next time, wouldn't that be a long-lasting entanglement?"
…… While maintaining this connection is fine, Battat always feels a faint sense of guilt and guilt because of it.
You muttered, "It's not like I'm the only one paying. Anyway, whatever, this time I'll pay. Let's just say it like this!" After saying that, you didn't care what Battat wanted to say and walked straight past him toward the shop entrance. Battat watched you walk away, but just as he reached out to grab your arm, he hesitated for a moment and let go, just following your footsteps.
You closed the café, wiped the nonexistent sweat from your forehead, then turned to battat: "Alright, let's go to the dessert shop. I've been eyeing their desserts for a long time, but I was busy opening the café back then and didn't even have time to try them. This time, I finally got the chance!" "As you spoke, you clapped your hands happily and started leading the way ahead of your own pace."
This was the last time battat had sighed since meeting you. Yet, for some reason, the corners of his mouth lifted slightly. When he belatedly realized this, he hurriedly reached out to try to pull the smile down, secretly relieved that you hadn't noticed anything. After all, since you were walking ahead, you naturally couldn't see what was happening to him.
Before long, you arrived at the dessert shop you mentioned. The decor itself exudes a warm and sweet feeling. After all, not every dessert shop cleverly writes its name in creamy font, decorates the interior with various creams and carvings, and even the top of the fork is shaped like a small candy.
You walked up to the counter and happily ordered two desserts. In the end, you chose the caramel pudding and chocolate brownie, since to you, it wasn't too sweet. You were still thinking about the battat—though for you, it wasn't too sweet, and you weren't sure how it would be for the battat.
This shop uses a prepayment system, so after ordering dessert, you have to take out dark coins to pay. Battat was still daydreaming, but when he saw you take out dark coins, he shuddered and quickly took out his dark coins, almost simultaneously handing them to the waiter.
"Sorry...... Uh, anyway, please accept the price for these two desserts. "Battat said dryly.
You widened your eyes, glared blatantly at battat, then looked at the waiter and handed your own dark coin forward: "Please accept mine! Don't mind the ...... that guy handed you over."
Battat looked away, pretending not to notice your gaze, but insisted on pushing the dark coin forward: "Please accept mine." ”
The waiter glanced at the two of you. To be honest, she felt a bit troubled, unsure which one to accept, though whichever one you took would only lead to an argument after you went down...... Since you took out the dark coins first, she hesitated for a moment and still accepted them.
You raised your eyebrows and made a 'yay' in your mind, then looked at battat and whispered a complaint, "Why are you fighting over paying? Didn't you say I'd pay for this meal?" ”
Battat actually felt a bit regretful. He put away the money, his gaze wandering, not daring to look at you, and simply said softly, "I just think...... Since I want you to feel better, it's necessary to pay for you. After all, I want you to relax, and it's my responsibility to make you happy." "It's not just because he wants to repay the money you paid before, nor because of the guilt and guilt—he sincerely hopes you'll be happy."
…… I hope you can truly smile from the heart.
You were stunned for a moment, then instinctively scratched your cheek, gave a couple of awkward laughs, and for some reason your face flushed a little, feeling as if the temperature on your face was on fire...... Ah, I just feel something isn't right! You know this is a reaction called shyness, and for some reason, your heart skipped a beat just now, as if it was beating for the battat in front of you. Immediately after, it was a pounding sound like a drumbeat, which probably won't stop for a while.
In short, you hope Battat didn't see you blushing, and luckily he turned his head at that moment.
After a moment of silence between you two, you quietly said, "...... It's nothing, but maybe next time you'll treat us even better. ”
You also want to be willful once, without worrying about anything or overthinking, just entrust your heart to the other person, trust that they can protect it, and you can simply enjoy happiness and let your emotions flow freely. But now, probably still can't do that, right? In short, you have just quietly buried this fluttering feeling deep inside.
"It's settled then. I'll treat you to dinner. Anyway, don't overthink things today—just relax." Battat said this quickly, as if afraid you'd change your mind. You couldn't help but chuckle, feeling relieved that this ease had actually faded the flush from your cheeks. After all, just then, Battat turned to look at you.
"Alright, no problem! Let's find a place to sit first. We can't just stand here like a block of wood forever." ”
You sat down by the window, and soon two desserts were brought over on plates. The chocolate brownies were topped with what looked like freshly made chocolate liquid, slightly cooled and solidified, yet still soft and liquid. The caramel pudding swayed with the shaking of the plate.
You handed a fork to Battat, hesitated for a moment, put your hands together and announced, "I want to eat pudding first!" ”
Battat nodded. He actually had no objections to your choice, but he still sat still, just watching you enjoy the dessert, since we had agreed to eat it first.
Instead, after a few bites, you looked up at battat in confusion: "What's wrong? Why are you so still? It's actually pretty awkward that I'm the only one eating......
He cleared his throat twice: "I'm waiting for you to finish eating......
He wanted to say more, but you just waved your hand nonchalantly to interrupt him: "It's okay, let's eat together. I don't mind. Anyway, two servings will definitely fill me up, and who knows if I won't finish it all, especially since I had macarons and stuff before...... Anyway, let's finish this pudding first!" ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, swallowed hard, and honestly felt a bit nervous, so it wouldn't matter if he dropped the word...... After all, if he dropped his spoon, it might end up where you ate. Is it really okay for two people to share the same pastry together? Only then did he belatedly recall the tiramisu from last time, but that time it was spaced apart because of the size of the cake, and the tiramisu wasn't finished in the end.
But seeing your completely unconcerned expression, he just feels a bit empty inside, or maybe a bittersweet feeling? Maybe he's just overthinking it, but maybe you simply don't care about it at all. Maybe today you're willing to share the same cake with him, and tomorrow you'd rather share the same dish with someone else. No, it's better not to torment your heart with these wild thoughts. He lets go of those thoughts and tries to focus his attention on the pudding in front of him, trying to focus only on this particular dish.
He raised his spoon, and to be honest, he ate the pudding without knowing how to taste it. But there was still a faint sweet and greasy taste lingering in his mouth, accompanied by a bit of caramel's unique burning pain and sweet flavor. You glanced worriedly at Battat, not sure why he was distracted again. But right now, your main focus was on other questions, so you asked, "Hmm...... How does it taste? I mean, it doesn't taste too sweet, right? ”
Only then did Battat snap back to reality, nodding nervously and shaking his head: "Ah, I can accept it. I mean, it's not too sweet. Anyway, it's still delicious......" As he said this, he picked up a spoon and scooped a bite. For some reason, that cloying sweetness stirred ripples in his heart every time he saw you. But within that sweet taste, there was a hint of sourness. Pudding shouldn't have this flavor, so why could he sense it?
In the end, you finished the pudding, and Battat gave up struggling, though he still felt a faint sense of anticipation and a hint of happiness inside...... When you shared the pudding, it was as if your souls merged at that moment, swapping your understanding—after all, when you were eating, you were already in the same state.
But you still seem unfazed, so Battat can only finish the remaining chocolate brownie with you, both hopeful and disappointed.
