title: Coffee cup 9-Battatx you
content:
Battatx, you ooc belong to me, some of which are just my imagination and fabrication because I don't know either......
…… Then I immersed myself in the art of self, so compared to Russian? Well, there are just a lot of psychological descriptions......
——
After finishing the brownie, you leaned back and sat down in your chair. You didn't rush to get up, just squinted slightly, as if you were satisfied. You put down your spoon, leaving only an empty plate in front of you. Then you looked at battat, who was sitting across from you. He seemed to be hesitating about what to say. After all, you saw his mouth opening and closing for a long time, and his face alternating between pale and red, making you curious about what he was planning to say.
So you sat up a bit straighter, resting your hand on the table with your chin on your hand, staring at Battat. Probably because you were staring at him intently, Battat's face blushed even more and he stammered, not knowing what to say.
In fact, he was indeed hesitating. He didn't know why he was considering so much now. He hadn't thought so much when he first made the suggestion, but now he had so many more concerns. Maybe he suddenly realized that he had always cared about your feelings? That's why he considered whether the plan was good or bad—after all, he was afraid you might not like it.
Although maybe you'll still agree with his proposal with a smile and approval, the more you do it, the more nervous he becomes, and the more he'll think about what you'd like more. That's when Battat realizes he doesn't really know your preferences that well, but he doesn't want to directly ask what you'd like. Maybe...... Should I hint a little?
Actually, he felt it was fine to keep sitting here daydreaming. Even though the environment was so noisy and irritating, in the moment you watched him, in the moment he saw you, he felt quiet and couldn't hear anything else. So quiet that all he could hear was his heartbeat.
But Battat still felt maybe he should go out for a walk and explore other places. After all, sitting here all the time might not seem a big deal, but it didn't quite match the original purpose of relaxing.
But when you watched him, all those thoughts melted away, leaving him unable to keep up and not even knowing what he was thinking. Battat was now so focused on his mind as if his mind was short-circuiting, avoiding your gaze—no, maybe nowhere to hide, since he was sitting right across from you.
And that was all he had been thinking about earlier. After struggling for a long time, he still couldn't come up with a conclusion; both answers and reasons were locked in his mind.
And finally, you couldn't help but speak. When you stared at battat for who knows how many seconds—maybe it was the ninety-second longing? You didn't really care about the passage of time. After all, you were willing to waste this time just sitting here with battat, even if it was just sitting there, even though you usually cared a lot about time and task planning.
“…… So, what exactly do you want to say to me? "You gently tapped the table with your knuckles and asked.
"Ah...... Ah, it's nothing, I just think we should go for a walk together, or maybe somewhere else too? Or maybe you want to keep sitting here? I just don't know where you'd prefer to go. "Battat stammered out this sentence, turning his face slightly. He knew the heat on his face hadn't died down yet, and you must have seen it clearly. But now, he was a bit ready to give up—if you saw him, so be it." He just scratched his head, pretending to be busy.
You tilt your head slightly, and you notice his face is redder, so you turn your face slightly and scratch your ear, knowing your ear is a bit hot now.
You just don't answer and ask back: "Then...... Do you want to go for a walk more? ”
Battat quickly waved his hand: "No, no, no, I'm fine. It depends on your mood. Anywhere is fine, as long as you like it." But at this moment, he didn't dare look up at you again, and naturally missed the red on your earlobe.
“…… Hmm, then let's go for a walk. We can chat a bit and such, which is better than going somewhere else. Right now, I just want to casually talk about painting and be with you. Ah, if you don't like chatting, then just quietly take a walk. "So you smiled and said, watching battat lower his head, feeling a bit itchy to get your hands moving, but in the end didn't dare to reach out. He just pulled his outstretched hand back, pretending he had something to do, then touched his nose.
"Ah, no, if it's just to chat, it's fine. I'm willing to chat with you...... No, that's not what I mean. Actually, I'm willing to chat with you no matter when. "Battat quickly waved his hand again, still not daring to look up at you. He didn't want you to see the expression on his face. After all, oh my god, he had no idea what the situation would be like. He just felt his face burning hot, and he didn't know what he was saying—maybe it was the truth, or maybe it was just nonsense.
And indeed, even if he might be tired and doesn't want to reply to anyone, he'll still be willing to chat with you. Perhaps through this conversation, he regains his energy and feels happiness and happiness.
…… Not at that coffee shop, just by your side, he feels relaxed.
You blink, looking at his still bowed head, then touch your nose, shift your gaze slightly, and cough twice: "Ah, then let's go for a walk. Say something casually, or if you don't want to say anything, just walk quietly." After saying this, you quickly got up.
Battat quickly got up too. At least his face wasn't so hot now, and he finally wanted to look up at you, catch your back, and follow behind you as you walked out.
You walked down the street, and after thinking for a moment, you suggested, "There's a garden nearby...... How about we take a walk over there? Anyway, that park has always been open to the public for free, and if you walk a bit further, you can even see the sea." "Honestly, you rarely go to see the sea. After all, where you live and the café are both quite far from the ocean. It's just that today you have some free time, and your mood is relaxed. Maybe going to see the sea is a good choice."
And you have a bit of selfishness—your mood is excited but also a bit nervous. You know Battat will probably agree, but what if? What if he refuses? Although you can still force a smile and make other suggestions, the disappointment at that moment will probably linger for a long time. In short, well, you want to go see the sea with Battat, or just take a walk in a quiet spot, just the two of you, and then you can ask whatever questions you want, because you want to get to know Battat better.
…… You also want to know his life, his habits, his hobbies—more and more, just out of curiosity or some special feeling. You can't say for sure, you just desperately hope for it.
Battat nodded matter-of-factly: "Ah, of course. If you want to go, let's go together. Anywhere is fine, and if you want to visit several places, that's fine too." He had no objections to this, and even hoped that this kind of time could last longer, or that time would pass a little more slowly. He hoped to watch over you longer, or maybe not at all, just knowing you were still by his side.
You relaxed and, with your obvious answer, headed to the park with Battat. There really was plenty of shaded space. Although it was loose, it was still a nice sight. The buildings on both sides were all vintage-style. If you wanted to take some photos here as souvenirs, it would be a nice atmosphere. Unfortunately, you're not someone who likes taking photos, and there was no one else in the garden at the moment. You didn't bring any professional camera equipment; the bag you took out only had an emergency water bottle, an umbrella, and a phone.
Unfortunately, you can't find anyone else to take photos of you both, so these tempting thoughts can only be put to rest.
Battat seemed to be lost in thought. You glanced at him quietly, waved your hand in front of him, and only then did he snap back to reality, rubbing his brow: "Ah...... I was distracted! Did you just say something? ”
You shook your head: "No, actually, I was just about to say something. I just saw you lost in thought, so I wondered if I could call your lost god back." As you spoke, you secretly chuckled a couple of times.
Battat felt a bit embarrassed and scratched his head: "Ah...... Ah! Go ahead, I'm listening! I'll definitely listen to you seriously. "He assured him, but also felt a bit guilty. Maybe it was because he was walking beside you that he couldn't help but zone out, because at this moment he didn't need to care so much, so it was fine to just think about something, because he knew you were right beside him. It was a kind of trust that was indescribable and even he couldn't understand.
"Ahem, then I'll say it. Actually, I wanted to ask you a few questions...... I want to know, besides work, what do you usually do after work?" You cleared your throat and asked solemnly.
Who would have thought battat's expression would go blank at that moment? You can't help but turn your head to glance at him a couple more times.
“…… It's nothing special, right? Usually, it's just work. Sometimes, after work, there might be some work to handle, so I have to work overtime. The little time left is mostly for rest, and nothing else to do. I'll just be spending some time at the coffee shop you run recently. "As he spoke, he couldn't help but cough lightly twice, and his voice grew quieter by the end. If you hadn't listened carefully to his answer, you might have missed that sentence.
You tilted your head slightly, knowing your cheeks were a bit hot at that moment. Then you scratched your cheek, coughed lightly, and couldn't help but ask, "It sounds tough usually...... Is it that your relationship with colleagues isn't great?" ”
Battat waved his hand: "I get along pretty well with my colleagues! Besides, there are other colleagues who occasionally help me share some of my workload, but...... After all, sometimes work just can't be finished. There's nothing I can do. ”
You nodded knowingly, and after a moment of silence between us, you spoke in a hesitant, surprised voice: "So, do you mean you can't do anything else besides that?" You must have some kind of hobby...... you muttered.
“…… Isn't there really not much time? The remaining occasional free time is also used to sort out problems...... "Battat continued to answer quietly.
You didn't ask what exactly he was sorting out, since his expression looked troubled and probably didn't like others asking him, so you just quietly waited for him to nag.
"However...... As for other things, I do collect some things occasionally, even if I might not need them. Besides that, I organize the items in the room, since things get messy every so often. I feel uncomfortable just looking at those messy facilities...... Battat said this while frowning, probably trying hard to recall something, so much so that his tone became unclear. It was obvious he thought for a while before giving a broken answer. Maybe it was simply because he had never paid attention to these things and didn't care much about his own life, so he didn't remember it either.
After all, caring about his own life was useless, and no one would pay attention to this matter. He just hadn't expected you to ask about it.
"Ah...... Do you have a collecting habit? If that's the case, do you need to buy a lot of storage equipment or something? "You asked casually. The shaded area was gradually left behind, and not far ahead was the ocean you mentioned. Above the ocean, on the ground you were stepping on, a path stretched out, crooked and crooked. In short, there was still some distance from the sea surface, so it was impossible to get close to the ocean.
"Not really, I just collect some small items occasionally? It seems like I only did this a long time ago. Now, because I'm too busy, I actually don't have much time." Battat sighed as he spoke.
"Oh...... Speaking of which, you don't really like sweet food? What about spicy food? Do you know how to eat it? Because I'm thinking about whether to go out for extra spicy ramen tonight, I wanted to ask for your opinion. "You clasp your hands behind your back, as if you're just asking casually, but in fact, your hands behind your back are tangled and picking at your fingers, sweating from nervousness."
“…… I can't handle spicy food; I can eat a little bit of other flavors, but it seems like I can't eat anything spicy, including drinks and such. I always get my face off with just one bite." Battat didn't hesitate much and quickly answered. Of course, he didn't think too much about what you meant based on your words.
You nod gently, just about to say something more when suddenly raindrops hit your face. When you look up, you realize the sky had turned gloomy at some point. At first, just a few wet raindrops hit the ground, wetting a patch of it. Then, the raindrops started to fall with a splash, growing louder, about to soak you both.
Tbc.

Alright, I want to write about the Xianghe San...... Alright, the first part is finished!! Yay (what does that mean)
——
You flusteredly took out the emergency umbrella from your bag, but luckily you brought one just in case. After all, there happened to be no buildings nearby to block the rain, and naturally, there were no eaves or anything like that. You pulled Battat, who was a bit dazed from the sudden rain, and huddled under the umbrella, your tone a bit anxious.
“…… I don't know why it suddenly started raining, and it's probably going to get heavier. We should hurry up and leave!" "And since this umbrella is originally meant for one person, standing together now would actually feel a bit crowded, so you naturally put your arm around Battat's shoulder, and now you two are pressed tightly together.
Battat was actually thinking about what to do. If it really didn't work, he could use a jacket to cover himself, and then you two would run together to the nearby street, or the nearest building to take shelter from the rain. Of course, both of them had to wear their jackets, but he was caught off guard by the fact that you actually brought an umbrella. His previously wandering heart suddenly calmed down, but at the same time, he felt a bit embarrassed.
…… So close! And your hand was still holding his shoulder. He could feel the warmth in your palm and your body leaning in close, as if so close. He could hear your warm breathing, which gradually grew rapid, because the rain was getting heavier and your steps quickened. Battat could even feel your breath gently brushing his face; he knew all of this was forced to do now...... But his face still couldn't help but burn hot.
And having you grab his shoulder or something like that made him feel a bit embarrassed. He knew it was just to get closer, otherwise the umbrella wouldn't hold two people. Even now, only the part tightly pressed together was still warm and dry. The part near the edge of the umbrella was damp from the rain, and the rain came in suddenly and heavy, not letting up quickly. The wind picked up, soaking his clothes roughly.
So he just listens nervously to the gradually accelerating heartbeat—he even worries if you can hear it, but at this moment, battat doesn't care about that; he simply reaches out and puts his arm around your shoulder as well.
You take a deep breath. Maybe your current state is just a bit of a romantic awkwardness, or maybe being so close fulfills a certain inner hope. In any case, despite the heavy rain and the pattering on the umbrella surface, your mood is actually quite good, even a bit excited. Maybe it's okay if this kind of time lasts a little longer, of course, as long as the rain isn't so heavy. You still don't want to endure your wet clothes sticking to you.
So when Battat placed his hand on it, you actually zoned out for a second—ah, you never expected you two to be holding that position. But maybe it's not so bad? At least the warmth of relying on each other brings you joy. At least it's like two souls coming close, and you hope Battat won't hear your heartbeat, because it's been trembling for a long time and you can't make out the exact frequency.
Quickening your pace, holding the small umbrella to shield yourself from the downpour, you huddled together, almost running away. Finally, you spotted a street not far away. We ran to the nearest building and found a seat to sit in. The shop was still warm, and at least the shivering from the rain suddenly eased—after all, it was already early autumn, not particularly cold, but once it rained, you had to change clothes, or else you'd just shiver.
You put down the umbrella, shivered, rubbed your hands, and the brightness inside made the rain and darkness outside seem even smaller, as if the earlier storm had been nothing but a nightmare. But your wet clothes remind you that none of this is a dream.
Luckily, only part of it was wet, and even so, you still complained: "...... So annoying, suddenly it rains or something. ”
"At least for now, we can sit down for now. Maybe we'll be better when the rain stops...... Or maybe we can take a taxi home? " Battat suggested.
You nodded in agreement: "That's all we can do. By the way, this is a ramen shop! Have a bowl of ramen to warm up!" ”
As you spoke, you shouted, "Boss, give me a bowl of spicy noodles!" From afar, you heard a "Okay!" Then you looked back at Battat.
"What do you want to eat? Maybe pork bone ramen...... This soup tastes a bit better. Anyway, it's just right to warm up with some soup." "Although the rain just soaked my mood, it doesn't stop you from feeling happy again. After all, just looking at Battat's face makes you feel happy, to the point that you hum a tune in your heart."
"Ah, then let's go with tonkotsu ramen. But we agreed that tonight's dinner would be my treat." "Battat didn't care what exactly to eat; as long as you feel happy, that's all that matters." He just hurriedly double-checked the treat. And you nodded indifferently.
"Yes, I know! Don't worry, this time I won't rush to pay. I'm giving you a chance to show off." "After saying that, you winked slightly.
Battat was a bit helpless, muttering quietly, "What's the show? Two bowls of ramen won't cost much......" He had originally thought about treating you to a French meal too, but the heavy rain dampened his hopes. For now, you can only stay in this small ramen shop.
However, the small ramen shop was warm enough—at least that's how Battat felt—so he thought it was all bearable. No, rather than enduring it, it was more like enjoying it...... Maybe the time we spent squeezing under the umbrella was just too unforgettable, though it was only for a short while.
So you raised your voice and reminded, "Boss, one more order of tonkotsu ramen!" ”
Before long, two servings of ramen were served, steaming clouds drifting around, temporarily blocking your view from overlapping together, so you could only clearly see the food in front of you.
You broke open your chopsticks and took a bite of the extra spicy ramen, then slapped your cheek and started sticking out your tongue: "Wow, so spicy!" ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, but still righteously pushed his tonkotsu ramen out: "Or, shall we swap the ramen? I'll eat the extra spicy one." Although he said this while feeling uncertain himself, knowing he couldn't handle spicy food and probably wouldn't get a few bites even if he got it,
You still stuck out your tongue, just shaking your head: "No. Aren't you totally uncomfortable with spicy food? I'm eating extra spicy ramen just to relieve the irritability of the past few days—anyway, just having a few drinks and alcohol will help you recover." ”
Just then, the owner brought over orange juice, cold and cold. You took several sips of food and set it down, then took a deep breath: "Phew, you're alive." Then you leaned back and leaned back in the chair.
Battat looked at your flushed face and hesitated: "Or should we order another order?" Can you really finish it? ”
You waved your hand: "Of course I can finish it!" Eating extra spicy ramen is all about challenge—it's just a bit spicy, and it's not enough to kill anyone! And the spiciness really warms up your body, right? Look, my face is warm right now. If you don't believe me, you can even touch it. "As you spoke, you pointed to your own face.
Battat cleared his throat twice: "Well, that's not necessary...... You can tell just by looking." At the same time, he complained quietly in his heart, How can you be so defenseless? Is your face something you can just touch like that? He had to pat his head before...... He really didn't know what kind of feelings you had when you said things like that.
But the good times didn't last. Battat had only taken two bites of ramen before he saw you coughing from the spiciness, and even after several sips of orange juice, it didn't work.
He started worrying again, stood up and came over to your side, gently patting your back: "...... Otherwise, maybe you shouldn't eat extra spicy ramen! What if eating it will only make you feel worse! ”
Battat genuinely worried about this matter.
You calmed down a bit before waving your hand: "It's okay, it's okay, it's okay. This is something that happens all the time when you eat spicy food...... I'll be fine in a moment!" You said this so confidently, and Battat could only glance at you helplessly and sit back down across from you.
He had already finished that bowl of tonkotsu ramen, drunk part of the soup, and it tasted really good. At this moment, he could only prop his face up with his hands and watch you still struggle with that extra spicy ramen. You've only eaten half of it now, your face flushed red, and some physiological tears welling up in your eyes—probably from the spiciness. But you're trying hard not to let those tears fall into the bowl. If they contaminate the ramen underneath, that would be bad!
He rests his chin on his hand, staring at your movements, while you show no sign of embarrassment, still battling with the spicy ramen. Battat looks at you, not knowing what you're thinking, or maybe not thinking at all—he's just lost in thought, staring at you like that, or maybe he's just daydreaming. At this moment, he can only feel his own heartbeat steadily, or rather, he can hear the sound of his heart beating for you.
Finally, after staring at you blankly for a while, you finished off the extra spicy ramen and leaned back happily, planning to rest for a while. After all, the heavy rain outside the window was still ongoing, and it looked like it would last a while before it would stop. The warmth and brightness inside the shop seemed to be from two different worlds compared to the damp, icy cold outside.
"Looks like I'd better sit a bit longer before I leave. My clothes are almost dry by now, and I don't want to get soaked again when I go out now......" you muttered, and Battat nodded in agreement.
Then, his heart raced. After hesitating for a moment, he asked nervously, "Then...... Can we just chat casually? I have some questions I want to ask you too. ”
You looked at battat with a hint of surprise, then nodded cheerfully: "Of course you can! I was thinking we might as well chat a bit, but before we could finish, a sudden downpour interrupted us...... So if you want to say something, just say it. ”
Battat took a deep breath, his hands clasped together on the table. He hesitated, secretly fiddling with his palm, lowering his head under your curious gaze. In the silence surrounding each other, he waited for quite a while before finally speaking: "Then...... Actually, I wanted to ask you, what do you do when a coffee shop closes? ”
You rubbed your chin to recall for a moment, then nodded firmly: "Ah, you can read, right? Usually, after the coffee shop closes, I go home. I always put out a disc with music playing, brew myself a cup of coffee, and sit on the sofa listening to music while reading. Oh, and I still have a gramophone at home now. I usually use that one to play music!" As you spoke, you gestured with your hand again, excitedly introducing the story.
"Anyway, and since my house is pretty big, sometimes when I get in the mood, I even dance along with the music on the gramophone...... But I don't look very good at dancing. I think I'm probably the kind of person who steps hard when dancing with others." You scratched your head awkwardly and stuck out your tongue.
Battat nodded thoughtfully: "Wow...... What a charming life." Saying this, his mood inexplicably sank, because he definitely couldn't live like this himself—every day was just too exhausting. At this moment, he seriously thought about whether their personal habits might not be quite right......
But before he could think further, you continued: "It's not exactly that stylish, I just have nothing to do. After waking up in the morning, I make myself a cup of coffee so I can happily go to work. And the house is too big...... I really don't like tidying up, so I just leave things around casually and I can see them. Just keeping the room tidy and tidy is exhausting. ”
“…… But I do prefer to use my free time to do something else and don't want to tidy things up. Mainly, being the only one busy is dull and boring, and no one else is watching. That doesn't feel accomplished, so it's better to be a bit more artistic in arranging things. At least I feel more at ease while watching. ”
Battat hesitated for a moment, then asked, "...... For example? ”
"For example, stacking a stack of books—like a triangle, stacked like a tower—I can even play a game of pulling out books and see when they'll collapse!" But the weight of books is different. Maybe playing cards would be better...... You excitedly gestured with your hands.
The conversation lasted for a while, the rain outside the window eased, and you said goodbye to Battat reluctantly, then you both headed off in different directions. Of course, you were planning to return home, and it was almost evening.
You walk toward home with new understanding and affection.
Part One· End.

title: Coffee cup 11-Battatx you
content:
Battat you, OOC counts me as me
There are fiancés with unknown meanings and names, purely fictional. In the end, I guess I'm a bit illiterate. I don't know how to organize the language......
In short, nod to 'there for you'!
——
After that, you continued running the café as usual. To be honest, although you were still a bit worried and unsettled, your mood improved a lot because of that afternoon's relaxation. Maybe it was just because Battat was by your side. Of course, when you saw Battat's number pinned at the top of your phone, you hummed softly, feeling very happy.
Well, if you have any problems, just call this number. You believe the all-powerful battat can definitely help you solve it! Or maybe he's not actually omnipotent, just that you just have wishful thinking about it...... No matter what it is, he's all-powerful to you! As long as he's around, you'll feel like many problems can be solved easily!
So you hummed a tune and planned to make yourself a cup of coffee, today...... Maybe make an espresso. Sometimes you need this bitter taste to refresh yourself, and the sour bitterness to clear your mind. Just as you take out the T-pica coffee beans and are about to pour them into the coffee machine, you hear the sound of wind chimes at the door and the glass door pushes open.
Just as you look up to greet the guest with a smile, you see the fiancé toss his hair and, thinking he's eye-catching, walks in arrogantly. You instantly lose your smile and take a deep breath to calm yourself.
Honestly, seeing this fiancé makes you feel annoyed. If what happened a few days ago hadn't happened, you could have a polite conversation with him. But he keeps coming to harass you and wants you to close the café. After marriage, just stay at home, and he keeps asking when you'll fulfill the engagement. You never want to talk to him calmly anymore, and you even instinctively want to avoid it.
Taking a deep breath, you glanced at your phone. The screen was still on the contacts, so you decided to call battat—after a prior agreement, at least you should notify someone when trouble arises. Besides, you don't actually have many close friends. Some friends can be awkward to contact for help over time, but battat happens to be someone you just met recently and know well. You can confidently tell him about these things, especially if you might encounter trouble.
…… Well, of course, there's a bit of selfishness in this. It's more like you expect Battat to willingly help you solve your problems. It's not that you want him to repay what you've done before, nor that you just want to use him as a shield. You just feel that if you owe each other, you'll always remember each other, and your connection will only grow closer.
Although this might make these little schemes seem a bit dark...... But what does it matter? If it's useful, then it's useful! Before your fiancé approached, you first dialed your number, then put it on silent. You looked at him with a smile—of course, a fake smile, with a twitch at the corner of your mouth. You really had to suppress your anger to force out that smile.
"Ah, it's you, my fiancé. What do you want?" You even deliberately spoke in that affected voice.
Battat originally saw your call coming through and hurriedly ran to a quiet place before answering, but his expression changed as soon as the call connected. He had planned to say something and had organized his words, but after hearing your words, he didn't care about that and hurriedly left TV WORLD.
Pippins looked at the green dice that had suddenly run out with strange expressions, but they didn't care about it and continued their small business on their own.
Battat was just running outside, panting heavily, without even asking for leave! But he thought these things could wait until he got back...... Well, your own business is more important. Actually, there are other ways to solve this problem. He could suggest you hire someone else to help you, and the reason he's willing to take on all this trouble to help you is probably just selfishness.
Because he wants to take the opportunity to get to know you better? Because he's willing to help you solve anything? These are just the reasons. These thoughts raced through his mind but didn't stop, because he couldn't stop his pace either.
Battat was just running toward the café while his phone was ringing. He put it on speakerphone—no matter what, he had to hear what was happening on your end. At the same time, he was pondering what he should do...... Should he step forward as a protector? Maybe that would be dangerous, but should we use reason?
At the same time, he could hear your somewhat distorted voice on the other end of the line, and the fiancé's voice, which had become faint but still clear and arrogant because of the distance.
"Me?" "I'm fine, I just came to check on your business, dear...... There aren't many people in the shop, why don't you just close it altogether?" His voice was also very affected and forced.
You suppress your nausea and the urge to twitch your brow, still forcing a smile: "...... Don't call me dear, we're not that close yet, right? Even if there aren't many customers, I can still keep this café running—after all, I've already bought the land. Besides, it's the off-season, so it's normal not to have many customers. ”
"No, we're already about to get married. I think we should get to know each other a bit more...... That's a very fitting way to address each other. ”
You wave your hand: "We've made it very clear before, haven't we? My father has died, and the verbal engagement can be voided. Why don't you agree? Clearly, annulling the engagement would be a good thing for you, and there was no proof to begin with. ”
"No, I think our engagement should definitely continue, because I ......"
You feel annoyed. This is almost the kind of thing he's been repeating every time you see him these past few days. Honestly, you're tired of hearing it. You can almost imagine what he'll say next—just saying 'I love you,' then showing loyalty, as if he truly loves you. Yet you only find it ridiculous and absurd. He's using what he thinks to be love to bind you, forcing you to marry, and you don't even think such a marriage should exist. You just feel disgusted.
So you just endure the nausea and start spacing out, waiting for his long speech to end, but his words are interrupted by the sudden sound of wind chimes ringing at the door.
Following the voice, you see the panting Battat holding the glass door, pushing it open. He is still gasping for breath, and you see the call on the phone screen has been disconnected.
He let out a long breath, and somehow, seeing the battat lifted his mood. After pushing open the glass door, he strode toward the front desk, slapped both hands on the counter, and even casually pushed his fiancé aside, forcing him to secretly despise some low-class person and take two steps to the side—even though there was plenty of room on the other side of the battat.
You cleared your throat twice, this time putting on a genuine smile: "Ah, it's battat, would you like something to drink?" ”
“…… A cappuccino, please." His eyes darted around as he belatedly realized that although he had rushed over anxiously, his mind went completely blank after arriving here, and he had no idea what he was supposed to do next.
"Alright, I'll bring your cappuccino over later." You nodded happily. You knew it was probably because you suddenly felt happy. Your voice was much softer than the dry taste from when you talked to your fiancé earlier. You were startled when you spoke—how could you actually say such a gentle voice?
At that moment, the fiancé suddenly spoke up discontentedly: "...... Why have you never used that tone on me? I'm your fiancé." ”
You and Battat looked at him as if you had just remembered him. You almost wanted to roll your eyes at him. He was just too annoying—couldn't you even notice something so obvious? You really have no sense of tact.
But you still replied politely, "Because I don't think I need to talk to you like that." After saying this, you should still feel touched by yourself for a moment. You're really conscientious and too easy to talk to, as soft and soft as cotton candy.
Battat is secretly watching you, but he's hesitant, always wanting to say something, but doesn't know what to say at this moment. After all, he doesn't have any formal, impressive status to speak up for you—just that he doesn't like him and acts righteously? That reason might work?
In any case, he let out a breath and stepped forward before the fiancé was about to say something: "...... Sir, you should leave. I think your behavior toward this young lady already constitutes harassment, doesn't it? Can't you tell she doesn't want to chat with you? ”
A few scattered customers in the café chimed in with this, and some even said, "Exactly, and this gentleman has been bothering the owner for several days straight! The coffee shop is closed, and I want to find a place to have a good sip of coffee and rest for a while—there's nowhere to go!" ”
As soon as he said this, the other guests chimed in with him.
You exhale and look gratefully at Battat. He scratches his head and instinctively avoids your gaze, though of course, you don't care about that.
Your fiancé's face turned the color of pig liver with anger. He pointed at you and your 'battat' for a long time but still couldn't say a word. You secretly whispered to him, secretly complaining that he broke down so easily. You were still worrying about how to get him to leave.
At this moment, he glared fiercely at you and stormed off, but before leaving, he said something as if declaring war: "Just wait and see, it's just a coffee shop. Even if there's nothing, it's fine. I'll make sure you see clearly—you can only choose me." ”
Then he forcefully pushed open the glass door and walked out. You exhaled and lay face down on the table. The earlier irritation finally dissipated quite a bit with your fiancé's departure, and there was even a battat.
You turned your face, lifted your head a little to look at Battat, and muttered, "Thank you so much today, otherwise that thing would have been chattering for ages before leaving satisfied...... To be honest, no one said a word when you came a few days ago. I didn't expect that after you did, those guests would start talking too. Anyway, thank you so much. Today it's my treat! ”
Battat cleared his throat and grew quieter: "I didn't do much, I just said a few words. It's because you usually do well that customers are willing to speak up for you." Maybe it's because there are so few people and they don't have much courage...... They were just waiting for someone to speak. But it's okay, I'll speak up for you. "After saying this, he felt embarrassed for a moment, turned his face and scratched his head in panic, his face turning red again.
"Ah, if it's a distress no one else can see, can you tell?" You looked at battat's expression and suddenly laughed, wanting to say something casually.
"Ahem, I...... I probably can't tell? But I'll do my best. If you keep bottling up your worries, you'll only get more troubled. "He said this very seriously.
Battat is indeed very serious; he wants to help you, to listen to your troubles, and to solve the problems you encounter. He also knows you will listen to his troubles and do the same things...... Ah, but Battat is still a bit hesitant, because these are also things close friends would do.
"Hmm...... It's okay, actually, as long as you ask, I'll tell you! And I want to hear your troubles, and I want to help you when you need help...... Anyway, I hope you can tell me when I ask you. "You shook your finger.
Battat was stunned, his thoughts still a bit chaotic, or rather, a bit lost. He kept feeling that this was actually the kind of relationship you two had before. In other words, without realizing it, you had already entered each other's hearts, understood each other, and at least at some point became friends. Or maybe just friends? Thinking of this, his mood involuntarily sank, but he quickly adjusted his emotions.
So he just cleared his throat twice and added, "Mm...... But if it's like today's situation, and others can't see your troubles, then let me handle it—at least let others understand the truth. No matter what happens, you can come to me. I will always be with you. ”
You paused for a moment, scratched your face, and thankfully your hair was loose to hide your slightly reddened ears, and you cleared your throat twice: "Cough...... Yeah, I'm the same way. I'll always be with you! "As you spoke, you clenched your fist and raised it as if encouraging yourself, looking like your mood had lifted again.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 12-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
…… Ah, so sweet (savoring)
——
Battat couldn't help but smile softly, but as soon as he started laughing, he felt something was off. He quickly cleared his throat twice, covering his chin to hide the blush on his neck: "Mm...... Anyway, I'll be leaving now. I just came here at work on the spot, and now I have to go back and explain...... "It was as if reality had returned—cold and dark. He let out a long sigh and started to look listless.
You blinked, waving your fists to encourage him: "It's fine, then hurry back to work! Otherwise, if you get caught sneaking out early, it would be a problem...... Well, as for treating someone, just hold it for now—I'll make up for it next time!" Saying that, you smiled and gave him a wink.
Battat breathed a sigh of relief and hurried back again. Fortunately, at least the boss didn't notice his early departure, and those pippins found out...... It wasn't a big deal; Tenna wouldn't believe them anyway. Battat was now holding a somewhat self-destructive attitude.
Work was busy that day, and by the time he finished, it was already evening. There was really no time. He thought the coffee shop was probably closed by now, so he went home with a hint of melancholy, just staring blankly at the pinned contact number as he walked. In the following days, he didn't have time to go to the café either. Tenna suddenly assigned a lot of tasks, leaving him overwhelmed and secretly cursing the boss in his heart. Besides that, he would glance at his phone screen whenever he had time. He was actually hoping to see your messages suddenly appear on the screen, so whatever he sent was fine...... Unfortunately, you didn't send anything.
He could only keep up with a mix of anticipation and anxiety until the weekend came, and with no work left that day, he visited the café again.
Pushing open the glass door, the familiar sound of wind chimes rang out. Just hearing that sound made Battat feel all his restlessness and confusion leave him. When he saw your face looking toward him, his heart was pounding, but he barely showed any other reaction. Instead, he cleared his throat twice and walked to the counter.
"Mm...... Let's just go with the cappuccino. And pair it with a sandwich. ”
You nodded cheerfully: "Alright, let's go with this combination! I haven't seen you for days, and I was still worried about you......" You complained again.
After all, you do have some worries. Every time you look at the pinned contact info, you zone out, tapping away to send something, but in the end, you give up. What if Battat doesn't like messaging at all? You might as well wait for the other person to message you first. And so you waited until the weekend.
Battat was taken aback, scratched his head, and turned away: "Just ...... Actually, you could message me...... I don't mind. It's not that busy, at least I can still reply to your messages......
You blink and nod firmly: "Alright!" But I tend to talk a lot...... Maybe you can say a bit about everything? ”
"It's okay, I'll reply to anything." He nodded firmly. Actually, what Battat didn't say was that no matter what you posted, he would happily read it and reply with joy. Unless at that moment, he was completely unable to muster the energy to reply......
This kind of situation is probably going to happen.
"Alright, that's the usual seat. Go sit down, I'll bring you a coffee sandwich later." As you spoke, you turned around and picked up a bag of coffee beans to start brewing.
Grind into coffee powder, then pour in milk and hot water to brew together, whipping it up...... With the rich flavor of milk and the unique bitterness of coffee, make a cup of cappuccino. The milk flavor isn't too strong, so you can really enjoy it for a while.
You hold your coffee, sip a sandwich, hum a tune happily, and walk toward where the battat is. Just as you put down the tray, you hear the doorbell ring again. You turn around and instinctively put on a smile, wanting to welcome the new guest, but as soon as you turn away, your smile freezes on your face because you realize your fiancé has come over again.
Fortunately, at least he hadn't brought anyone else along yet. Somehow, you finally breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, at least the coffee shop wouldn't have any problems, though you don't know why you were actually feeling relieved about something like this.
“…… My fiancée is still serving these country bumpkins. You should leave this place with me. We should only enjoy refined treatment and service." He spoke again in a pretentious tone, and your face turned completely dead.
"No need. Serving others is my business. Seeing my guests happy makes me happy too. You don't need to get involved." You really wanted to roll your eyes, but it felt very impolite, so after hesitating for a moment, you decided not to. You knew very well that this was a half-to-the-scenes relationship. After all, it was like that last time, and yet this fiancé was still persistently coming over. It was clear he really wanted the money you had.
“…… Why are you so disobedient? Come with me, come with me, I'm going to show you properly!" He raised his voice, then strode forward, suddenly grabbing your arm, trying to drag you outside.
You widen your eyes, completely unable to react, and are pulled and staggered. The next second, you start thinking about what you should do. Before you can come up with a solution, you feel yourself falling into an embrace, and you see Battat's hand grab your fiancé's arm, not letting him move forward.
Battat had actually been on guard since that person walked in. He thought it might just be a verbal dispute today, but unexpectedly, he was about to get physical. The incident happened so suddenly; Battat was purely reacting instinctively, and only felt embarrassed when he came to his senses. After all, seeing you almost fall in front of him, how could he just turn a blind eye? Besides, he couldn't just stand by and watch you be taken away by someone else.
…… So it ended up in this position. He felt his neck and face burning up, wondering how to explain himself later. Was this hug just an accident in a moment of urgency?
In any case, he took a deep breath and raised his voice: "...... Are you going to forcibly kidnap someone in broad daylight? ”
My fiancé waved his other hand in disdain. He tried to break free, but Battat was using so much force that he couldn't break free for a moment. His expression gradually darkened, but he still stubbornly said, "What does this have to do with you between us as fiancées?" "We just have some unexplained conflict." ”
Battat was at a loss for words. To be honest, he didn't know what to say. If you want to talk about relationships, it really doesn't matter. You can't just say that because she's someone I like, I want to protect her, right? What would you think if you heard that?
Just as he was at a loss, you suddenly spoke up. You tried to break free from your fiancé's hand. After all, just grabbing your wrist and using a bit of skill and technique could help you break free. Then you patted Battat's arm, and Battat instinctively took you two steps back.
"Mm...... Because he's my boyfriend, of course he has to protect me. Of course, we have to deal with this so-called engagement together. And it has nothing to do with you. What I like is him, not you. I will never acknowledge this engagement. "As you spoke, you raised your eyebrows smugly and looked at your fiancé, satisfied as his face turned a pig liver color once again.
Battat's body stiffened. To be honest, he had just been pondering what he should say, but he hadn't expected you to say something like that. To be honest, at first he was overjoyed, even feeling a bit dizzy and overjoyed, since he didn't even know you would say that. But what followed was fear and a sense of unease that wasn't real enough. What if you were just saying these things to appease your fiancé?
…… If you tell him afterward that it was all false, Battat can only force a smile and accept everything you say. He doesn't even dare imagine such a scene, maybe he will leave once it's all over?
That way, he won't have to hear your perhaps apologetic words. At least that joy and happiness can last a little longer. To be honest, he never even considered the possibility that you would like him...... He doesn't really think there's anything about him worth liking.
That fiancé pointed at you and kept saying 'you, you, you' for a long time, then finally shouted angrily, "If that's true, then prove it to me!" I remember, this is just your guest, right? What reason do you have to say that? What if you're just looking for someone to deal with me? I don't believe you have no love for me at all. ”
In fact, the fiancé quickly realized what was going on. As for those words, they were probably just putting on a show of weakness—they were all made up and probably just trying to show off. Battat could tell at a glance. Of course, he also knew that if he didn't say something, his fiancé definitely wouldn't believe him and would keep pestering the topic.
…… Is there anything that can directly prove this? Maybe a direct kiss is the fastest, right? To be honest, it was only because you just said he was your boyfriend that he dared to do that; otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to think about such things before...... Only then did he realize that he had always longed to kiss you, but that thought had been suppressed by him all along.
You take a deep breath, intending to say something more, when suddenly, you feel your face being turned, then you widen your eyes as you watch Battat's face get closer and closer.
…… They say kissing means closing your eyes, right? But when you opened your eyes and saw sweat dripping from Battat's forehead, probably a sign of nervousness, you looked at his tightly shut eyes and belatedly realized your lips were gently bitten. It was a very gentle touch, carrying a soft, slightly cool scent of moisture, a gentle, slightly warm embrace. Only then did you realize you were being kissed, and Battat's hand was still gripping your chin. You could feel his hand trembling slightly, probably from nervousness and anxiety.
Blink sluggishly, and when battat lets go of you, even as if afraid to see you, and turns you directly to face you, your mind finally snaps back to reality, and you instinctively want to laugh.
This smile isn't because of something funny, but a smile of happiness and joy. When you say those words, you truly mean it. After all, this kind of affection isn't fake. You like being with battat, enjoying chatting with him, even if you say nothing and just sit quietly, feeling like he's right beside you. Whether it's just ordinary friendship or elevated love, it doesn't matter to you, as long as you can always be together—after all, you like him the most.
But if you want to take things further, you're still a bit nervous, because you're not sure what he's really thinking. Saying that would sound like he's going all out.
…… Then you can be sure that Battat is pretty much the same idea.
Your fiancé now looked at you with a bit of frustration and rage, and finally roared: "...... Wait, next time I'll definitely bring someone else with me! This time I messed up! No matter what, you'll definitely come with me! "Saying this, he stormed outside, knocking over an empty table he passed by. The vase on the table fell to the floor, shattering into pieces with a crisp crashing sound.
You rubbed your brow with a headache. You weren't too worried about the money of a vase...... But next time, he might really bring people to cause trouble.
So you muttered to yourself, "He's super male, right...... Now this is a big problem. If he really brings people next time, it'll be hard to deal with. ”
Then you hear Battat behind you hesitate for quite a while before finally speaking: "Mm...... Um, was everything you just said true? "He still sounded uncertain and anxious, still trying to confirm something."
So you laughed. You turned around, cupped his face, and looked into his eyes. Seeing Battat, her face flushed again from eye contact: "Everything I just said was true, I super—like you!" And since you've kissed him, does that mean you don't admit it? Boyfriend? ”
You even deliberately dragged out the last words, making them sound intonated and rhythmic.
Battat coughed several times, but he couldn't avoid your hand, or maybe he didn't want to: "Mm...... Ahem, I like you the most. "By the end, his voice was so quiet it was almost like a mosquito's buzz, but you still heard it clearly."
You wanted to tease him, but now you spoke seriously: "But it sounds like he's planning to bring people to smash my shop...... Hey, I'll hire people......" You rubbed your eyebrows in frustration.
Unexpectedly, battat interrupted you with a serious expression. His face was still a bit flushed, and his voice stammered: "I...... I'll figure something out! After all, I'm your boyfriend, so leave this to me! " He said, patting his chest.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 13-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
…… It felt like a random conversation started, and it ended with a hilarious ending.
——
You rubbed your chin, your tone a bit hesitant: "Really? Isn't this a bit too much trouble for you......? In the end, this kind of thing is still my problem. I'll handle it myself! I'm already very grateful that you helped me out these two times......
Before you could finish, Battat interrupted him. His brows furrowed tightly, and his voice grew urgent: "How can you say that? I don't think these are troubles at all, I...... Ahem, no matter what trouble it is, I'll find a way to help you solve it." By the end, probably a bit embarrassed, his voice gradually quieted down again.
You blinked, not sure if it was curiosity that got a good idea. Or maybe you just wanted to tease him. You pulled him to sit by the window, then propped your chin up and smiled at him: "Hey, why? I feel like these troublesome things shouldn't be left to you alone......"
He cleared his throat twice, still speaking softly, his voice almost murmuring: "Ah, because I really like you." ”
You curved your eyes slightly, tilted your head, and deliberately dragged out your voice: "What? I can't hear you. Say it again?" ”
Just as you finished saying this, you noticed Battat looked up at you intently, and for some reason, you seemed a bit guilty. Well, you did do it on purpose. After all, the shop was so quiet, you naturally could hear what he was saying. You just wanted him to repeat it a few more times, or rather, you just wanted to hear it a few more times. Every time you heard it, you felt overjoyed, and for a moment, nothing else was on your mind.
If only time could only stop at this moment, how wonderful that would be. Then you wouldn't have to worry about troubles or worries anymore; you just needed to enjoy the sweetness of the present.
Battat actually knew you were doing it on purpose. After all, your smiling face was full of ill intent. He was sure that even if your voice was soft, you could hear it. But he didn't mind repeating it a few more times. If it weren't for someone else present, he would feel embarrassed and want to say it out loud, repeating it over and over until your face turned red, until your lips touched again, and those warm, soft sensations came back to you.
Of course, that was just a fantasy. Right now, Battat didn't know why he had been so bold just now, and now he felt a bit embarrassed thinking about it. And seeing you propping up your head, leisurely waiting for his answer, somehow he suddenly had a flash of inspiration—maybe he had a bit of a mischievous sense of humor. Maybe he had never had such thoughts before, but maybe it was only after meeting you that Battat started having similar thoughts.
…… It was your presence that allowed him to see more colors in life.
So he coughed lightly twice, suddenly stood up slightly, and leaned close to your ear. Actually, at that moment, Battat blushed too. Luckily, from this angle, you couldn't see it, and he whispered in your ear: "Because I like you the most." ”
You paused, feeling a slightly cool yet slightly gentle breath brushing your ear. You heard the sentence clearly, so you couldn't help but blush. Your ears felt hot, so you covered your ears with your hands, but your heartbeat quickened. You could even hear the sounds in your chest. Fortunately, the battat sitting across from you couldn't hear a thing.
You watched him sit back across from him with a smile, his face a bit flushed, and couldn't help but glare at him. Although you knew your glance wasn't very harmful, you then coughed dryly and stammered, "Alright...... Alright! I understand, I like you the most! But if you have any trouble, you should tell me. If there's any difficulty, we should solve it together...... I can't just dump all the trouble on you. Anyway, I'll figure something out this time. I've decided to hire some thugs. Anyway, I don't need that money, but it might affect customer traffic......
You muttered to yourself, after all, you know those fierce, intimidating thugs might scare off a lot of people, but there's nothing you can do—for the peace of the future, you have to do it.
The other customers sitting inside the café were probably intimidated by the sticky atmosphere between the two of you. In any case, they tossed down their tips, pressed them under their coffee cups, and hurried away. You didn't really mind.
"Mm...... I'll still bring people over. If that's the case, let them be your guests then—they'll be the right way to hold the stage. "Battat suggested.
You glanced at him curiously: "Who are you trying to get here?" ”
“…… My colleagues. As for who they are, you'll know when the time comes." He just spoke vaguely, and you nodded knowingly, not asking further. Anyway, you'll find out when the time comes.
"But the timing is probably a bit tight, right? After all, I don't know when he'll bring people over. I plan to start hiring thugs tomorrow...... "You're still a bit worried. Maybe you're just being overly guarded. That so-called fiancé keeps coming to harass you and doesn't seem to care about anything else. You might think it's fine if he does something illegal, and might even be very arrogant."
"I think it will probably take three to five days. After all, he can't possibly find someone to come over that quickly, and after today's setback, it probably will take some time before he can muster the courage...... But hiring a thug first is a good idea. You have to protect yourself, and if that person suddenly goes mad or something...... Battat spoke very seriously about this matter, and even gave you a thorough reminder.
You look at your new boyfriend just nodding with a smile. You don't mind if it sounds a bit like lecturing. Instead, after Battat finishes, he feels a bit embarrassed and scratches his head: "Ah, sorry, I'm not trying to interfere with your decision, nor do I mean to make choices for you. As long as you feel comfortable, that's enough......"
"It's okay. I know you're saying all this because you're worried about me, and you really consider my feelings, so I don't feel uncomfortable at all. You're really nice, but you're right. I have to protect myself, and you have to protect yourself too. Otherwise, I'll hire some thugs for you too. What if he goes crazy and tries to attack you...... "You're seriously thinking about this issue, and you even carry a hint of worry."
Battat cleared his throat a few times: "I'll be careful these days, and I usually stay at the company, so it's not a big problem, right...... Sometimes I even have to work overtime because of another identity, and I think he probably won't find me either." As he spoke, he turned into mumbling.
To be honest, he was a bit annoyed at his current job, because work was holding him back. He couldn't see you all the time, but he felt a bit grateful for his job, because no matter what, the colleagues he knew now were doing things that helped him to some extent. Although exactly that kind of help was another matter, because whenever he talked about working overtime, he felt his life was tough.
“…… Uh, what you said does make some sense. "You cleared your throat twice and slightly looked away.
Alright, hearing him casually talk about working overtime and such, you even start to feel a bit sorry for him. It seems you won't have many chances to meet...... Wait, why are you starting to think about this? You shouldn't be thinking about this now, so you shake your head and throw your thoughts away.
Then you seriously suggested, "Hmm, maybe you should leave with your colleagues after work lately? Wouldn't that be safer...... I have no other choice but to hire a thug." "You said this with a hint of regret."
"You're way too nervous. Why are we making contingency plans for such possibilities...... battat muttered quietly, but he didn't think your explanation was completely impossible, so his expression grew more serious. "Alright, I'll be careful. We'll take precautions." ”
Then you exchanged glances and suddenly burst out laughing. You pointed at battat, panting and said, "Look at you, you're still too nervous." ”
Battat felt a bit embarrassed but retorted, "What's the big deal? Just in case, and you were the one who brought up this possibility first." ”
"Whatever, and you were the one who nervously warned me first. I just think if there's any danger, both of us probably need to be cautious."
“…… Ahem, it's just some emergency plans......
"Looks like work really is too busy. Even for something like this, you need to prepare contingency plans or something. Do you need to prepare several more plans just in case?"
You see Battat fall silent, looking conflicted, even a bit tempted, and you can't help but raise your eyebrows in disbelief: "No way, you really want to do this?" ”
He awkwardly cleared his throat: "I'm just thinking about it. I think maybe sometimes it can be used as a reference......"
“…… Thinking so much is exhausting. Sometimes you just need to relax and go with the flow. Constantly overthinking makes you anxious. "As you spoke, you lifted your body slightly, pressed down on battat's furrowed brows, and gently smoothed them out.
"Hmm...... Makes sense, but I often can't do that......"
"Then let's stop here. As long as you tell me everything, you'll be able to relax a little!" Oh, and after chatting for so long, my mouth was dry—I almost forgot to make you coffee...... You ran toward the counter, picked up two coffee cups, started pouring hot water and milk as usual, whipped the milk foam, made latte art, made two cappuccinos, and drew two heart-shaped latte art, each with your names written on it.
You handed the cup with your name on it to battat, the cup in your hand had his name on it, and then you sat across from him holding the coffee.
Drinking coffee is like quenching thirst. You seem to have endless things to say, but probably no clear focus. You just say whatever comes to mind, just say whatever comes to mind, then laugh together until both cups are finished, leaving the cup empty, and you finally say goodbye, still wanting more.
After Battat went home for the weekend, he went back to work. He had already decided to convert all the dark coins into points. Anyway, those pippins would definitely pass by when they heard about points being handed out...... He just gritted his teeth and used up the dark coins he hadn't used before and the points he had painstakingly accumulated. Now his expression was somewhat worn, because he was a complete pauper.
But it's okay, it's just spending a little money for you. If you lose it, you can save it again. He definitely doesn't want anything bad for you.
Naturally, since he used points, and hearing there was free coffee, those pippins were all very happy—uh, maybe because of the points. In any case, they had agreed to support Battat at the café, and if any annoying guy showed up, they'd definitely be the first to rush in!
Pippins just laughed and said in a slightly cynical tone, "Boss, we'll always follow you!" ”
Battat awkwardly tugged at the corner of his mouth: "Uh, I don't need you to follow me forever, and I'm not going to keep handing out points to you! My points are also given by Tenna! And don't call me boss. If you call me the coffee shop owner boss later, I'd be really happy......" He awkwardly covered his mouth, hiding his face that had suddenly turned red for some reason.
Those pippins seemed to suddenly understand something and excitedly said in unison, "Oh, I get it! That's the boss's wife!" ”
“…… No!! That's not it! "He waved his hands and began to explain weakly, but no pippins listened to him or cared about his explanation; they all laughed and scattered. Only Battat was still helplessly reaching out his hand, and then he could only sigh and let go.
…… Forget it, at worst I'll explain later, he thought with such a weathered mind.
Probably seeing the excitement, some Zapper and Shadow Guy wanted to join in, thinking they were there to hold the show anyway, so calling more people didn't matter, so Battat agreed. Pluey and Jongler didn't know if they wanted to watch the spectacle or really want to help, but they were eager to join in.
…… Anyway, the more people, the better! Battat simply agreed to everything, but all these just for fun, for free, Battat wouldn't give them any points...... He would just send those pippins over and use up all his existing points.
But to join the fun, they were even willing to skip work, probably because work was so boring that they had to go on strike every few days to show the boss a lesson!
In short, for several days after Tenna came, all she saw was the empty TV world, with only a few employees left, and Mike was gone.
…… The law doesn't punish the masses, that's probably how it is. At least they weren't punished afterwards, and even got more points.
But now, Battat was sitting in the café with a bunch of pippins, looking awkwardly at the packed café and you, who were suddenly so busy you barely had time to rest.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 14-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
——
You wiped the sweat from your forehead and glanced at Battat through the pile of pippins. Honestly, you didn't expect him to bring so many...... Uh, probably a guest, come over. And Battat even told himself with a guilty look that he had told those pippins there was free coffee here.
You want to laugh, but also a little happy—this means you have lots of customers, and now you can make coffee to your heart's content. After all, it's just brewing, and it will be ready soon. Besides, most of Battat's colleagues have probably seen you before...... Well, you're not really sure, and this is just some secret secret. You wouldn't be embarrassed to tell Battat out loud.
"Alright, guests, your coffee is here!" You walked over with a tray and placed the cups of coffee in front of the pippins, who started cheering: "Thank you, boss's wife!" ”
The smile on your face froze, then you slowly, mechanically turned your head to look at Battat. You saw his expression stiffen too, still desperately waving his hands, as if trying to deny it, but those pippins seemed to ignore it completely.
Because after a while, while you were behind the counter wiping a glass, an pippins came over.
"Can I order? I'd like an extra sandwich." he said.
You're a bit surprised, but still nod: "Of course. I'll bring the sandwich over in a bit. Which seat are you in?" ”
He pointed to the seat by the door, then happily jumped up on the spot: "Thank you, boss's wife!" ”
Your expression stiffened again. Good thing you didn't drink coffee right now, or you'd be squirting about it. Actually, you probably felt a bit embarrassed. After all, you never expected things between you two to progress so quickly. The current situation is already pretty good—do you want a couple to fast-forward to getting married...... Uh, but if the relationship isn't confirmed, maybe you really might just drag Battat straight to get the marriage certificate, so your fiancé won't bother you again.
Thinking this, you can't help but zone out, your hands slowing down until someone knocks on the counter and you snap out of it. You look—it's battat. He's scratching his head, tilting his head, probably embarrassed, since his face is flushed again, and his eyes are evasive, not daring to look at you.
So you stop what you're doing, look at him, and gesture for him to speak.
“…… Ahem, well, I didn't want them to shout like that. They acted on their own and wouldn't listen to my explanation, so please be understanding......" He spoke quieter and quieter, still not daring to meet your eyes, and now he didn't dare to look at your expression.
Well, he had actually thought that since it was a romantic relationship now, he would definitely get married in the future—unless the relationship ended in regret and only had to break up. Thinking about this made him anxious. Battat couldn't even imagine such a scenario. If possible, he could just keep this relationship alive and stay sweet.
He sincerely wished for this.
Of course, calling him 'wife' right away was way too fast! It almost made it sound like he had ulterior motives or ulterior motives. He never thought that way—he just wanted a relationship that would come naturally!
You propped your chin up, watching battat lower his head and not dare look at your face, deliberately switching to a slightly aggrieved tone and pursing his lips: "Wow, aren't you planning to marry me?" I thought...... We'll definitely be married someday." After saying this, you rested your chin on both hands, blinking your eyes, watching battat's face grow redder and redder. Of course you said that on purpose. You could tell it was probably just those pippins making decisions on their own. Of course, after getting used to it for a while, you actually quite like that kind of nickname, and might even smile and nod in agreement when pippins call you that. Well, even if it's not right now, it will happen sooner or later, so it won't matter if it's a moment.
But after hearing this, Battat coughed several times and finally managed to lift his head, though his gaze still darted around, refusing to keep looking into your eyes. He was afraid that once their eyes met, he'd be so stammered he wouldn't be able to say a word clearly, so for convenience, he simply kissed you on the lips.
This was something he wasn't very willing to do.
"Ahem...... No, it's not like that! If possible, of course I want to, I ...... I also hope our relationship and identity are more formal, but if I call you like this now, I'm afraid you'll ......" He still stammered his words because Battat saw you gently press your hand on his.
You smiled and said, "It's okay, whether earlier or later, it doesn't matter—and there's nothing to be embarrassed about. You should be happy, right?" Now everyone probably knows about our relationship...... You mumbled and mumbled, and now you really are feeling a bit happy. At least his company knows that Battat is about to get married.
"Uh...... Hmm, that really makes sense. "He cleared his throat twice and decided to change the subject. Otherwise, if we kept dragging on this topic, Battat really couldn't take it anymore.
"Why don't you give me a latte, and pair it with a tiramisu?" Changing the subject but not knowing what to say, Battat ultimately chose to order.
"Okay, is it still the window seat?" You took out a coffee cup with your name on it, nodded, and picked up a bag of coffee beans, deciding to brew them.
Battat hesitated for a moment and looked at the seat he usually sat, then noticed Pluey and Jongler sitting there. He took a deep breath and nodded, "Let's take those seats. By the way, those two are the ...... who usually pretend to be that senior employee with me." His voice was lowered.
Your hand paused while making the coffee, your gaze instantly sharpened. You looked in that direction and lowered your voice as well. For some reason, he seemed to hear a hint of killing intent in your voice: "...... It's just that those two made you do so much work and still don't share the burden a little? ”
Battat started coughing violently. He felt like if he kept coughing like this, his throat wouldn't be his. Didn't he realize he'd been coughing way too many times these past two days?
He just hurriedly said, "No, we just agreed to complete the work in turns, but the workload that time was really heavy. This is probably the boss's problem......
You curved your eyebrows slightly: "So, who is your boss?" Tonight, I'll hire someone to take him down. ”
Battat was stunned, unable to find his voice for a long time. After a long moment, he stammered, "Th-are you serious?" Although I always think this boss is bad and always curse him behind his back...... But I don't feel the need to, uh, to the point of taking him down? ”
Seeing the confused and anxious expression on his face, you chuckled: "Ah, of course I'm joking, don't take it seriously...... Hmm, but it's kind of funny seeing you take a joke seriously." After you finished, you cleared your throat twice, your expression turning serious.
"Hmm, to make you less nervous, I've decided to say fewer jokes like this. It's not good...... "You muttered to yourself. Of course, deciding to say less doesn't mean you won't say anything. If you want to tease Battat, you'll say it anyway!"
Battat waved his hand: "I don't think so...... If you want to say it, just say it. I don't think you need to change your preferences for me. There's no need; we just need to maintain each other's preferences. ”
"Hmm...... You're right. Just stay true to yourself. Dating doesn't mean you have to change yourself completely for the other person. But some habits are better to accommodate the other person...... You muttered, and Battat didn't catch clearly. Just as he was about to ask what you had just said, he heard the doorbell.
You and Battat look toward the door and immediately see your fiancé arrogantly leading a group of people inside—clearly here to cause trouble.
Take a deep breath. To be honest, you do feel a bit resentful inside. Your fiancé suddenly came over and disrupted your plans. You originally wanted to casually say a few more words to Battat. But if this time you can resolve the matter completely, that might be good enough.
Honestly, you didn't expect that Battat had just brought his colleagues over, and his fiancé would come with his hired thugs to cause trouble.
And he didn't say a word. As soon as he arrived, he ordered the thugs to throw tables and smash them against the wall, looking like he was trying to completely ruin your shop. Some thugs even dragged tables toward the counter, startling you. You instinctively hugged your own cup and Battat's cup, which had just been poured with coffee grounds and hadn't been brewed yet, while Battat pulled you toward the counter. Fortunately, no attacks fell on you anymore because those thugs were stopped.
Holding two cups, you curl up in battat's arms. Though a bit cold and not exactly warm, you carry a special sincere warmth, as if it comes from your heart, making it easy for you to draw close to that sincere heart.
It took you a while to open your eyes and look, since your part-time job didn't dare imagine how your shop would be destroyed. But when you opened your eyes, you were stunned because you saw the pippins army making their move, even sneaking in some Shadow Guy and Zapper to join the fun. You listened to those pippins shouting not to lay hands on the boss's wife or her shop, then grabbed the legs of the gangsters, hanging them one by one, which actually stopped them from moving forward.
Shadow guy also pulled out a saxophone. Honestly, you have no idea what this is for—is it some kind of background music atmosphere...... But maybe because of the music, those pippins are pushing even harder. No one knows why.
Battat had a guess—probably because he was fighting so hard for points, and it was rare for something this interesting...... Before coming to the café, he saw these pippins opening on TV World, wondering who would be the ultimate winner and who contributed the most. Of course, the winner got the lowest spots, which was probably why they worked so hard. As for battat...... Well, he knew pippins would do this, so he initially announced that each participating pippin would receive points.
Then those pippins kept shouting, 'We'll always follow the boss and his wife,' and even pinned the thug to the ground. Now Zapper jumped up and jumped onto the thug, hopping and bouncing.
The scene was chaotic for a while. At least you stared wide-eyed at the scene. The fiancé cursed and fled the café because the pippins were still chasing him and wanted to beat him up, shouting things like 'No coveting the boss's wife' before rushing in, causing the fiancé to leave the shop in a sorry state. After finally escaping the pippins, the thugs also fled in panic, and the victorious pippins began to jump joyfully.
You blinked, suddenly bursting into laughter, "Really...... I didn't expect to see such a satisfying scene. He deserved it! But now he probably won't dare come bothering me again......
"Yes, he deserved it. Hmm...... I hope he won't come back, that's for the best. "Battat nodded as well, fully agreeing. Only after the chaos stopped did he reluctantly let go. To be honest, he still wanted to hold you a little longer. He just wanted to get closer to you a little longer.
"Luckily, the counter wasn't much damaged. I'll make you some coffee first and bring it over later!" You didn't notice anything, just cheerfully saying things like that.
Battat nodded, "Yeah, that's the spot. I'll wait for you to come over." Then he walked toward the window seat. Pluey and Jongler were still sitting there, and as soon as Battat sat down, they stared at Battat with those winking expressions—well, it's hard to say if they actually have such organs, but Battat could tell from their expressions.
Battat cleared his throat twice, feeling a bit light, probably feeling a bit guilty and showing off when facing his colleagues. In any case, he just slightly lifted his head, raised his nose, and put on a proud expression.
…… He felt the two guys opposite him simultaneously utter disdainful sounds, but it probably wasn't just his imagination.
The chaos inside the café was quickly brought clean. The pippins actively helped clean up the mess, making Battat feel bad for his wallet for no reason. He hadn't said he'd get points for cleaning afterward, so when he got back, he'd probably have to count that part too......
But before he could decide how many points to award, the coffee was already served. A cup with your name on it was pushed in front of you, with a heart drawn with latte art. Battat was stunned for a moment and instinctively held the cup. A serving of tiramisu was placed on the table.
...Immediately after, he felt a kiss on his face, and watching your figure walking away, battat's face suddenly blushed.

title: Coffee cup 15-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
…… You guys talk so much!
——
Battat instinctively pressed his face down, opened his mouth to look at your back, unsure what to say. Of course, you didn't give him the chance to speak, so he could only look at the two guys in front of him, who were probably laughing at him with a hint of grievance and annoyance, and lowered his voice slightly: "Stop laughing!" ”
But they were still laughing, and even more happily. Of course, they didn't forget to ask Battat when he planned to get married—after all, it looked like they were still just dating. Just now, while Battat was at the counter, Pluey and Jongler had been eavesdropping on their conversation. Even though their voices weren't loud, they still caught a bit.
Battat paused when he heard the question, scratched his head, and turned his face away: "Well...... It's not about my opinion, but about hers. She says when, but I don't know......" He lowered his voice as he spoke, as if afraid you might overhear. Of course, overhearing it probably wouldn't be a big deal. Battat was just unsure what you were thinking, which is why he stammered like that.
You don't know what Battat was talking about, but while clearing the remaining cups and the counter, you couldn't help but glance at his seat. Seeing how happy he seemed to be chatting with his colleagues, you couldn't help but purse your lips, feeling a bit unconvinced that Battat was happy when chatting with you...... So he probably likes chatting with you more, probably. Although you don't know why he still feels dissatisfied at a time like this, it's probably just a subtle little thought.
