But your eyes darted around. Although you were nervous and uneasy for a while, hesitating in your heart, you finally decided to take the initiative. If you just keep watching here and only secretly muttering behind your back, that's not your style. In fact, doing so might even make you feel unfamiliar—hmm, maybe love really can change a person, since you're really feeling timid, wanting to hide in some dark corner and wait for everyone else to leave before coming closer. You don't really understand what you're afraid of. You can't be like you're afraid of seeing your own family...... It just feels off.
You pour yourself a caramel macchiato, decide to drink something sweet to lift your mood, then walk over to Battat's seat with the coffee, pull over a chair, and sit next to him.
His voice faltered. Battat instinctively glanced at you, then quickly looked away. Pluey and Jongler gave Battat a meaningful look, then stared several times at the cups each had each other's names on them, before taking their leave.
You blink, watching those two walk away together, then glance at Battat, who is avoiding eye contact with you, probably not wanting to meet your gaze. After a pause, you can't help but say, "They've already left...... You don't have to be so embarrassed, okay? No one else is watching us anyway. ”
You spoke lightly, and Battat quietly complained in his heart, but in the end, this had nothing to do with you. He just felt a bit embarrassed, so much so that he didn't dare look at you anymore.
But he did lift his head and take a deep breath. Although it was rare and his voice was a bit stammered, he still managed to finish the sentence: "Ahem...... Um, I want to ask...... "It's just ......" Although he didn't have the courage to finish for a moment.
You patiently waited for Battat to finish, just resting your chin on your hands and looking at him. In your view, Battat's face grew redder and his voice stammered, until finally he took a deep breath and spoke a few words smoothly and completely.
“…… When are you getting married?" The voice of this sentence faded again. If you hadn't been trying hard to listen, you probably wouldn't have heard at all. And when you heard that, you were a little stunned. Honestly, you hadn't even thought about this before...... Well, or maybe you never intended to do it in the first place.
But maybe your words speak faster than your mind, so you ask directly: "So is this a proposal?" ”
The warmth on Battat's face finally faded: "If this is a proposal, it's not formal enough...... At the very least, you should prepare a lot. I...... I just want to know what you're planning...... "He seemed to be muttering softly, and you rested your chin on your hand as you looked at Battat, and at some point, the corners of your mouth lifted.
So you cleared your throat and answered seriously, "Mm...... To be honest, I actually didn't plan to get married...... Before you could finish, you saw Battat's face turn gloomy and desolate, startling you into quickly grabbing his hand, pulling the chair closer to him, and now you two were basically sitting right next to each other.
"Ahem, let me finish what I have to say. Although I hadn't planned on that before, after meeting you, I feel it's time to consider these things...... Uh, so I want your opinion? If you want, we can even go get the marriage certificate tomorrow. "You said casually, then looked at Battat, who wanted to drink a sip of coffee to calm his nerves. Hearing the last sentence, he almost spat out the coffee again, and now he was coughing nonstop. At this moment, you skillfully patted his back.
Then you rubbed your chin thoughtfully and said, "But isn't this progress a bit too fast?" Or maybe we should wait a bit longer...... Hmm, too fast probably isn't a good thing. Anyway, I respect your choice. Whatever you say goes, then it's when! ”
Battat coughed for a while before he recovered. He wiped his mouth and just held your hand in return: "...... No need, going to get the marriage certificate tomorrow is a bit too rushed! Besides, isn't there supposed to be a formal proposal ceremony for weddings and such? At least give me a chance to prepare all this...... he muttered a complaint.
You didn't mind, just shrugged: "That's fine, you can make up for it later! Honestly, you really don't want to go tomorrow—" You were still a bit excited at this point, but before you could finish, Battat interrupted you.
"No need, really no need!" This time, both hands waved vigorously, showing resistance, so you had no choice but to regretfully smack your lips and withdraw the offer.
Actually, you think this opinion is pretty good...... But it seems Battat probably isn't used to it, so there's nothing you can do. But seeing him like this now is actually quite amusing, ahem, doesn't that mean you always like seeing your boyfriend blush when he says something so arrogant?
"Alright! Then let's discuss this matter. Anyway, you know my opinion, so my answer is anytime, don't worry too much." As you spoke, you patted Battat's hand.
"Mm...... Mm. "He steadied himself and replied softly, but instinctively gripped his coffee cup tighter.
"Then what's the next topic...... Hmm, what should I say? Ah, speaking of which, I think that fiancé probably won't come back. Today, I really gave him a good time. "As you spoke, you started gesturing excitedly again.
"Hmm...... Not sure, right? Maybe you should try to gather information from your company? "Battat hesitated a little.
You just curled your lip: "No need to ask, I know a little. That guy is very proud. After eating turtle here so many times, he definitely won't come to the coffee shop again. Besides, I heard their company's stock has dropped again recently, so he definitely won't have time to come back." ”
Battat nodded, accepting the explanation: "That's good...... But you probably still need to be careful." He was still somewhat worried.
You waved your hand, clearly looking somewhat indifferent: "I'll be careful, and that guy can't do anything to me...... Let's not mention that troublesome person! If you keep talking, it's really unlucky. Ptooey, ptooey, ptooey. "As you spoke, you spat a few times. Battat quietly turned his head and chuckled quietly.
"Hey, I heard you giggling!" You started tugging at Battat's shoulder, a bit annoyed.
"Mm...... Sorry, I won't let you hear next time. "You heard Battat say that with his back to you.
So you pretend to be even more dissatisfied: "What? So there will be a next time, right?" ”
"I can't just laugh out loud in front of you...... It just feels a bit impolite." Battat whispered. Honestly, this would be mocking you, and he wouldn't dare show it in front of you.
“…… Well, if you laugh in front of me, then laugh. I don't think it's a big deal, and I wouldn't treat it as mockery. In fact, I'm happy that you can laugh." You mumbled. It's not that you say things like this to make Battat happy, but you know it's funnier to do so...... Sometimes it's not funny, but as long as you can ease the tense atmosphere, you'll feel happy.
…… And you really love seeing his smile, and you feel happy just because you see Battat's smile—that's true.
Battat was taken aback. To be honest, he hadn't expected you to make such a suggestion. He even found it a bit unbelievable and couldn't help but ask, "Do you really not care at all?" ”
You nod seriously: "Yes, I don't care about that. After all, seeing the person you like happy makes you happy too—isn't that perfectly normal!" ”
Your words sounded perfectly natural, and then you successfully saw Battat's face blush again. This time, you wiped your nose, whistled inwardly, and looked away a bit guiltily.
Think about it, you didn't mean to, you're just telling the honest truth.
"Ahem...... Alright then, I want to be happy if you're happy too, even if I might get hurt because of it...... he murmured.
“…… I don't need you to get hurt for me. If I can't protect my lover, that's a complete failure. So don't say that, and don't make hurt a premise. We all need to be fine. ”
As you say this, you can't help but chuckle softly.
Battat couldn't help but nod, scratching his face, still a bit embarrassed. After a while, he quietly asked, "Alright, let's move on to the next topic...... Well, since we're lovers, shouldn't we go on a date? We haven't officially dated yet......
But becoming lovers was only a few days ago...... Not going on a date or anything like that was perfectly normal. At this point, Battat actually felt a sense of unreality. He never dared to imagine that he had become your lover just like that. He thought he could only secretly hide this relationship, just stay by your side and see your smile, even if it would always be just friends. He just wanted to focus on watching your every smile and hear your voice.
And now, he wants to kiss you.
So after saying that, Battat paused, looking at you intently. You seemed to be lost in thought, likely pondering the question Battat had just asked. Then he lowered his head and gently kissed your lips—though only briefly and briefly, like a brief touch. In short, you only felt a brief softness brush against your lips.
You paused, then instinctively looked at Battat, noticing he had already turned his head away out of embarrassment. So you started tugging at his shoulder and shaking his body: "Why did you suddenly kiss me?" ”
"Ahem...... Maybe it's just what I think? Or maybe I just feel I should do it, just in that moment...... I want to do it." His voice grew quieter as he spoke, his tone a bit flustered. Maybe Battat didn't even know why he had that thought just now, and now, he belatedly felt embarrassed.
You tilted your head slightly to look at Battat, then, as if remembering something, suddenly grabbed his head and kissed him when he was caught off guard. The last page Battat saw your seemingly triumphant smile. Before he could say anything else, he could only feel your lips pressing against yours.
…… Then, he feels your tongue effortlessly entering his mouth, which initially gives Battat a natural sense of terror...... But seeing you so close to him, he closes his eyes and begins to enjoy it all.
end.

title: Coffee cup 16-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
…… Such a complicated romance(? ) There really are a lot of talkative words
——
After the kiss ended, you finally sat back down, still wanting more. You wiped your mouth while you were at it, feeling as satisfied as if you'd had a hearty meal. But you didn't think that was enough—it was just a small appetizer...... Wait, we're not married yet, so don't think about these things. You thought it over carefully, then firmly crossed out that option.
Anyway, clear your throat and see Battat's dazed expression, cough twice: "Ahem...... It's just a matter of reciprocity! B-anyway, let's not worry about that guy from now on. What are we going to do together? ”
After a long roundabout time, you finally remembered this, so naturally, you're seriously proposing it now.
"Ah...... Uh, what do you want to do? I can do anything...... Battat stammered, almost unable to get out of his sentence. To be honest, after everything just ended, he was still blushing and his heart racing, and when he saw your smile, the sound of his heartbeat became even more obvious. But Battat just wanted to keep looking at your brows and eyes, your smile, and your smiling eyes—the longer the better, the longer he could keep it that way. He almost forgot what you were saying, until you waved your hand in front of him and asked worriedly.
"You seem to be daydreaming all along, my boyfriend. Did you even hear what I was saying?" You were also talking excitedly for a while before realizing that Battat was staring at you, distracted, and his face was getting redder the more you looked. You didn't really mind repeating what you just said. Even now, seeing him blushing at you, you didn't even want to interrupt him. Maybe maintaining the status quo was a good choice......?
But in the end, you still chose to speak up. If you let today pass leisurely without saying anything, what will you use to strengthen your connection afterward?
It was only after hearing you said that Battat snapped back to reality. He was a bit flustered, just scratched his head instinctively, and forced a laugh: "Ah...... Ah! I—I really didn't hear you just now. I want to apologize to you, I didn't hear anything...... Although he was a bit flustered and guilty, he was indeed apologizing solemnly.
You prop your head up and tilt your head to look at him: "No need to apologize, I'll say it again! Don't worry, after all, I'm very patient with my boyfriend." You laughed as you spoke.
"Then...... Thank you for being willing to repeat it again, thank you, girlfriend." As he spoke, Battat covered his face with his hand. He knew that no matter the color, his face was burning hot, and maybe whatever it was—he was just a little embarrassed. And you just smiled and grabbed his hand, easily pulling it down without any resistance, and gently kissed his cheek.
At the end, you added, "Actually, blushing is cute too, and kissing it gives a warm and intimate feeling. I know why you have to cover it." You pouted as you spoke.
“…… "I'm just embarrassed, that's all." He murmured.
"Alright...... Alright! Let's leave it at that. By the way, what I actually wanted to say is that I recently bought a two-player puzzle game. The puzzles look really fun. Do you want to play together? "You were still a bit nervous when you sent out the invitation again, and couldn't help but twitch your fingers.
Battat scratched his cheek, feeling the warmth on his face fade a little, and stammered, "D-Of course you can, when!" Speaking of which, our company's lounge still has a TV and a game console. Maybe I can just slack off and play games......" he said hesitantly.
“…… Wow, are you even willing to give up your job for me? "Your mouth is wide open.
Battat hurriedly waved his hand because he had something to do, his face flushed red: "That's not what I meant! I-I'll only come over after finishing work...... Well, if I have some free time, I'll tell you. Actually, we can do whatever we want......
You rubbed your chin, nodded thoughtfully, and then suggested, "How about we try calling together to watch a movie next time? If we don't have time to go to the cinema, we can watch some old films, and then we can chat casually!" "The more you talk, the happier you get.
"I guess, but isn't it a bit inappropriate to call during work hours...... Battat started thinking about this again.
"Hmm, it's fine. Just think of it as a work-related contact. Besides, your colleagues are all here. I remember today is a workday, right? That means actually, it's not ...... Doesn't matter?" "By the end, you started to feel a bit uncertain again."
Battat thought for a moment and realized it was true. Tenna wouldn't care about playing games or chatting freely in the lounge, so he probably wouldn't care about these things either. So he nodded firmly.
"Alright, it's settled then." Battat promised solemnly.
But obviously, this promise would take a bit longer to be fulfilled. After all, those colleagues would still be visiting the café for the next few days. Maybe they felt it was a waste to come just for one day, or maybe they just didn't want to go back to work. At least when they left, you could sense a hint of reluctance. Of course, Battat came over too, but he still felt a bit of urgency about work. Even when he came, he brought documents and other tasks, and sometimes he would walk over holding a pile of documents, staggering over. You couldn't see his head anymore, so you had no choice but to help him carry some documents to his designated spot, then serve him an espresso.
It wasn't until the week passed that those colleagues reluctantly left, and the coffee shop flourished. The week was once again quiet. At first, you might even find it hard to get used to the quiet, so you could only sit behind the counter out of boredom, fiddling with the remaining cups. Until you saw your phone screen lit up—it was a message from battat. You instantly perked up and sat up straight.
Battat's message said he had finished his work and was always on call if you needed company.
You poked at your phone screen, curious, and quickly typed to ask, "Could it be that Batt was just going through the motions and just wanted to come play games with you quickly?"
Even through the screen, you can imagine Battat's somewhat embarrassed and annoyed expression, because you see him sending you multiple exclamation marks, telling you he really did his job seriously before coming to you, but he was always thinking about you while finishing work.
With a dry cough, you take out your computer and open the game. Fortunately, the game is online and doesn't need to be downloaded separately, so you just make a call to battat.
Battat had been holding his phone with both hands, waiting for your reply, but suddenly you called. He didn't put it on silent, and when the phone rang, he almost threw it away. Luckily, after a moment of panic, he held his phone steadily, swallowed hard, and answered your call.
Although your voice has been slightly distorted by mobile phone transmission, he can still clearly hear your voice and the smile in your words.
"Ah, battat, I'll send you the link!" As soon as he answered, he heard your cheerful voice.
Battat responded with a soft sound, and then he saw you send him a new link because his phone vibrated twice. Without hesitation, Battat just studied for a moment, connected the TV to his phone, opened the link, and then you invited him to join the same game.
Although it's just a two-player puzzle game, it still includes character modeling. After all, you need to search for clues within the environment before proceeding with puzzles. In fact, you value two-player cooperation more than puzzles.
Battat looked at the character you controlled. Even though he knew it wasn't you and couldn't see you now, he couldn't help but blush. It felt as if you were sitting right next to him, so much so that he couldn't help but sit up straight, trying to face everything in the best possible way.
…… Well, although he knows very well that you can't see it, maybe this is just psychological comfort. He is well aware of this, but he can't help but strike his best pose in front of you, so now battat can't help but start circling around your game character. He can't control this character to do more movements, so he has no choice but to circle around it.
Watching his actions, you couldn't help but laugh: "Ahaha...... Battat, what are you doing? Let's go find something. We can't keep circling around me all the time! ”
Battat stammered for a moment before finally saying, "Just ...... Um, is this just a way to show affection? Seeing you standing here makes me unable to resist, even though I know that's not really you......"
You pause for a moment, then scratch your cheek awkwardly. Well, you know the temperature on your cheek is rising, and you start to feel relieved that Battat can't see it.
"Ahem...... Alright, I'll join too! "So you don't keep blushing. Since you're showing affection, you might as well start circling around Battat's character too. And in a perfectly balanced puzzle game, you two keep spinning around, looking like you've rear-ended someone."
Battat couldn't help but laugh too. To be honest, after handling so much work, he finally felt truly happy at this moment, as if he could throw away all his previous anxiety. He had ignored the gossiping looks from passing colleagues, and the look of wanting to say something but holding back from Tenna's look. Or maybe at this moment, if he mentioned it to him, he would just shrug to show he didn't care at all, and in a good mood, boldly say, "No matter what they do, if they don't like me, don't look at me."
…… But he usually wouldn't dare do that.
"Ahem, better not spin around. Weren't you supposed to play games? Let's find nearby items first......" battat coughed twice and stopped first, and the game character you controlled suddenly crashed into his character.
You pouted and started complaining to him: "Then don't stop all of a sudden. Look at you, I even bumped into you!" But this was just a meaningless accusation. After all, the damage caused was zero, just a game character, so of course it didn't hurt much. But in reality...... Wow, you two probably wouldn't be this foolish.
“…… So, sorry? "Battat hesitated for a moment before answering tentatively.
"It's fine, I'm not really blaming you. Alright, let's go!" You still said enthusiastically, controlling your game character to run out. Soon, you had run quite far, but after a while, you were stopped because you didn't have a way to open the door forward, so you had to return to Battat's side in frustration.
"Mm...... Ah, thank you for understanding? But for this door, maybe this item might be useful? "As he spoke, Battat showed the item he had just gotten—a handle. Then he placed the handle in an empty spot next to the main door. You glanced at it—sure enough, a string of codes appeared on the wall, but only half of it was left, and the other half had been quickly erased, as if it had been eaten.
"Looks like there's something else to it...... Speaking of which, the character you control seems to have a keen eye. "You've circled around Battat's character several times again.
"Yes, I can control a eyepiece, but I still can't figure out what it actually serves......" Battat interrupted before he could finish.
You excitedly said, "Very useful. For example, I couldn't see that prop earlier, but battat did. I have no idea how the game is set up...... Speaking of which, the character I control seems to have a magic orb, which seems to be able to change time or something. ”
As you spoke, you began spinning the magic orb, turning it in one direction. Then you saw the scene twist and spin, the once icy and snowy scene transformed into spring blossoms, the old but hard door transformed into a luxurious and exquisite door, and the code engraved on the wall became clear, no longer looking like it had been eaten.
So you can't help but open your mouth wide and let out a wow: "Looks amazing...... But no wonder it takes two people. If it were just one, it probably wouldn't be enough to do so much......
"Hmm...... Not sure, but this should open the door. Let's go in first! "This time, Battat pulled himself together and shouted, though after a while, he immediately became dejected, as if just saying that one sentence had used up half his strength.
Keep moving forward. To be honest, your cooperation is quite tacit. Some levels require colleagues to solve puzzles based on past and future time; missing them means failure. You and Battat only succeeded after two attempts, and the game was successfully cleared, leaving you wanting more. Actually, you didn't really want to hang up right now.
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 17-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
It's just casual talk, just casual talk! But in love, having a lot of casual talk seems normal (what does that mean?
By the way, the cowboys' little high heels are really cool. I really threw the dice too.
——
So you decide to suggest: "The game is over, but there's still a little time left. How about we pick a movie to watch?" ”
Battat hesitated for a moment but nodded, then realized you couldn't see his movements, so he cleared his throat twice: "Ahem, hmm, I think it's fine. What do you prefer to watch?" ”
You rub your chin and ask, "Battat can also pick movies he likes. I don't really care what to watch, actually...... Besides, I picked the games and you played with me, so now I think you should pick one." ”
And although you know some things, you don't really know all these big and small preferences—maybe even Battat himself doesn't know this. You decide to ask at this point, just in case he didn't notice this or something. After all, sometimes you don't pay much attention to these usual details, but in certain matters, you still have preferences.
Battat hesitated for a moment. He hadn't really watched many movies and wasn't sure what to watch with you, so he just stammered, "Uh, honestly, I don't really have anything I particularly like, so you can pick whatever you like." ”
You find it a bit incredulous: "Wow, do you really have no preferences at all?" "At least you have some videos you like, but you've saved the other ones too."
"Hmm...... Either way, you can pick anything? "You hear battat stammering on the other end of the line.
So you decide to change your approach: "What about youth coming-of-age films, romance films, crime investigation films, suspense and mystery films, thrillers and horror films, adventure war films, biopics...... There are quite a few genres, but I'm only talking about a part. Can you pick one?" After saying that, you waited for Battat's answer, but for a moment he fell silent. The phone didn't come through again, and you patiently waited.
"So there are so many film genres...... you hear Battat muttering.
In fact, he found it unbelievable, but he hadn't really watched many movies before. He just thought that if he were with you at this moment, he should choose romance films. After all, given your current relationship...... But he can't be sure you always like romance movies. What if they're the ones you're least interested in, and he insists on watching them together? What if it actually kills your interest? It's better to choose movies you'll definitely be interested in.
If you could hear his inner thoughts, you'd probably say Battat is just overthinking and being too cautious. Rather, he always puts himself in a low position, always thinking about himself in everything.
After hesitating for a moment, he finally said, "I think it's fine. I don't have a preference for that, so I just need to choose according to your preferences." ”
You find it hard to believe, so you tap the receiver with your finger. On the other end, Battat hears a crisp tapping.
“…… Then I'm curious, what were you trying to choose before? After all, I heard you were probably agonizing for quite a while. "I think you can still ask about this question.
"Ah...... It's just that, I think romance films might suit us, but I don't know if you'll like them, so it's up to you to make the choice...... You hear his stammering voice, and right now you want to rush up and poke his forehead to see what he's thinking. But right now, he's not in front of you, so you have no choice but to give up.
"What do you mean? If I'm with you, I can see anything. I just feel happy having you by my side. I want to chat with you more, so it doesn't matter what I look at." You couldn't help but laugh as you spoke.
Battat's face flushed again. He scratched his cheek, relieved that you couldn't see his expression: "Then...... Ahem, anyway, you can choose. You can watch whatever you want. Honestly, just hearing your voice makes me happy, so I don't care about what I watch—just follow your preferences...... His voice is very soft. If you hadn't turned up the phone volume, you wouldn't have heard him at all.
"Mm...... Let me think, how about you turn your head, roll a dice, and pick randomly? I think opening blind boxes is pretty fun too. "You suggested, this was just a sudden idea. After all, you've thought about your own favorite films before, but now, maybe being a bit more random would be more fun!"
"Is that so? Then I'll give it a try......" Battat muttered. In fact, the choice was still in his hands. If he didn't roll the dice and just randomly called out a type, you'd still believe it. But he was quite honest, so he turned his head to see what time it was.
It's 6 o'clock, so...... The randomness is indeed quite strong, battat muttered to himself, and still told you on the other end of the phone: "I threw it out, it's an adventure war movie...... Hmm, in that case, what should we watch? ”
You're stuck. In fact, you know battat is asking sincerely, but it seems you merged adventure and war genres for convenience, leaving you at a loss for words.
In the end, you find your voice: "Alright, then Battat prefers adventure films or war films. Actually, these are two completely different genres...... Although you prefer the former, since you can't immediately come up with a specific title for the latter.
"Let's watch adventure movies first? If that's the case, we can save war movies for next time." Battat thought for a moment and said.
So you open your movie resource library, hesitate for a moment, and ask, "Alright, do you have Red Dead Redemption DVD on your end?" ”
Upon hearing this, Battat got up and rummaged through the TV. Indeed, there was a stack of films stacked together. He easily found the disc of the disc you mentioned, then inserted it into the TV.
"Yes, I have it on my end. It's already inserted." He reported to you.
"Alright, let's count down to three, two, one, and then start playing together. That way, the timing should be about right!" On the other end of the line, it was your cheerful voice.
Battat instinctively focused his attention, paying attention to your voice. When you said it would start, he immediately pressed play. In the not-so-dark lounge, Battat started playing a movie, ignoring the gossipy looks on Pluey and Jongler's faces as they passed by. Anyway, it probably had nothing to do with him, probably. Actually, their gazes were intense and hard to ignore, but Battat just pretended not to notice.
He simply curled up quietly on the sofa in the lounge, watching the film start playing, while you sat in your seat, waiting for the film to gradually reach its climax.
This is a classic Western cowboy film—but perhaps even more iconic, arguably the origin of Westerns, is probably the train heist. But it's not that important; you just happen to remember this, you casually think about it, waiting for the movie you've seen before to finish playing. You have indeed seen this before, and you can even know what the plot will be next. Just to watch it with Battat, you still chose this classic film.
But the surprise of watching for the first time and the familiarity of watching it a second time are two different feelings. At least at this moment, you can chat with battat: "Honestly, the makeup here looks pretty fake...... They clearly want to create a bloodstain effect, but it just looks like ketchup or something. ”
"Hmm, after all, it's impossible to really bleed, and if animal blood is used to create this effect, wouldn't that almost be ......?" Battat began to ponder.
"If it's animal blood, the effect would be even better. Besides, it's obvious it's the props team's problem. But considering the era this film was made, it's understandable." You said casually.
"Indeed, prop presentation and such are quite important for people to be immersed in the film." Battat agreed with this, but the two of you seem to have some topics that don't quite match. He was clearly still lost in the previous sentence, probably lost in thought.
"Oh...... I won't disturb you while watching the movie. Let's chat later!" You shrugged and quieted down.
But after a while, you couldn't help but speak up again: "...... This place is just too funny. The male lead is crawling under the wooden planks below the steps outside the door. Didn't the people up there notice this? ”
"Maybe it's just ...... Hmm, using their reactions to highlight the protagonist's mechanics? "Saying this, Battat wasn't entirely sure; he was just making a guess on the spot.
"Hmm, that might make sense, but this way of expressing it is still a bit too funny...... But considering the filming time, I'll forgive you!" "Your voice sounds a bit more angry."
Battat couldn't help but want to laugh, but he held it back. He just nodded on the other end of the line where you couldn't see and said, "Well, then forgive me!" Anyway, isn't that kind of thing fun? ”
You drag your chin at the screen, pursing your lips: "Hmm, this is really fun...... But if I were writing the script, I definitely wouldn't design a scene like this! ”
He followed your lead and asked, "So how would you design it?" ”
You excitedly gestured at the screen, since no one would see anyway, so you casually gestured: "This part is the protagonist trying to evade the cowboys chasing and blocking the whole town, since they're all big villains—so, uh, maybe the protagonist disguises himself and then blends into the cowboys' internal group, attacking from within and directly breaking ......."
"Maybe this idea isn't bad...... But will this male lead disguise himself? "Battat quietly listened to your thoughts and asked casually.
You were stumped by the question, stammered for a moment, then said in a pretentious tone, "Just add some small details at the beginning to show the male lead knows how to do makeup!" This kind of thing is simple. Just add these little details when he first arrives in town......
“…… Then where did his makeup tools come from? "Battat began to sigh.
"Uh...... I don't know, maybe I picked it up somewhere...... You started to stammer, your voice quieting, and only then did you realize a bit guilty. Well, you know your idea is unlikely. Although it makes the male lead look handsome, the chances of it happening are still too low.
So you cleared your throat twice: "Alright, let's not talk about this. The chances of it happening are way too low!" Speaking of which, I really like these denim boots—they have little high heels, and there are gears behind the heels and stuff. "You chose to change the subject directly. Although it sounds a bit stiff, you don't have many options.
"Hmm...... I heard those gears are spurs? Are they meant to motivate the horse to run faster while riding? Probably so? Right? "battat flipped through his knowledge base, hesitating as he spoke.
"I know, but that doesn't stop me from liking these kinds of boots—they look so cool." You exclaimed.
"If you want, maybe I can try making a pair?" Battat hesitated and suggested. He had seen it, and it wasn't too difficult for him.
You opened your mouth wide and exclaimed, "Wow, battat, you, are you my mom?" ”
On the other end of the line, Battat's voice sounded a bit embarrassed and angry: "Of course not! I just think you might need this ......."
"Hmm...... I do want to do have some, but aren't you busy? I won't trouble you for now! "You skipped over the topic lightly.
"Of course I know you're not, battat. You're my boyfriend, hehe." As you spoke, you couldn't help but grin foolishly, and blushing on the other end of the line, blushing as well. He shyly cleared his throat and, after a moment, hesitantly spoke.
"Um...... Want to go out together this weekend? I, uh, I'm free on the weekend anyway, so we can have a good time together......
"Alright, let's go together this weekend. Where to go is up to you." You made this decision happily.
Before you know it, the movie on the screen has finished playing, and the end credits are playing. But you really did finish playing it all at once, since when you were talking about the Spurs earlier, it was already the end of the film.
It's almost time to get off work. Reluctantly, you hang up the phone, change the sign at the café entrance from 'open' to 'close', and happily head home with your phone. You look forward to Battat sending you some new message, glancing at the screen from time to time, still looking forward to your weekend date.
…… It's just that you always feel like someone is quietly following you, but when you turn around, you see nothing—only an empty street. Is it just your imagination, or are you scaring yourself?
Tbc.

title: Coffee cup 18-Battatx you
content:
Battatx you, OOC counts me as me
What to sing at KTV, the inspiration comes from casual chats with rice cakes (? ）
——
Well, in the end, you didn't see anything, maybe it was just an illusion. Anyway, you were looking forward to spending the weekend out with Battat. Amid anticipation, time seemed to slow down, but the weekend still arrived.
That day, you made a point of getting yourself ready in advance, making sure your clothes and everything else were neat and looked very attractive. Then you took a deep breath, opened the door, and went to ask where Battat was meeting. You were unusually nervous, since this was your first time dating someone...... It didn't seem like you could say it like that, but it was indeed your first time dating, and if nothing went wrong, maybe you'd even get married in the end? You couldn't help but start imagining the future, looking at the location Battat sent on your phone, humming an off-key tune as you walked over.
You guess the battat might have arrived long ago, since the time we agreed on wasn't this time...... Pouting your lips, you decide to wait until you arrive to have a proper talk.
Battat really arrived early to wait at that location because he was very nervous. Honestly, this was his first time asking you out, so he was very nervous and even checked his outfit. He was also very nervous and excited at night, so he didn't sleep well. He woke up early in the morning, carrying that nervous mood, unable to fall asleep anymore. He simply got up to tidy himself up and arrived at the destination early. While waiting while sending you the location for you, he kept adjusting his collar and clearing his throat, afraid that if he misbehaved later, it might make you unhappy.
When you arrived, you saw Battat still tidying up his clothes with a nervous expression. You blinked, waved at him, and ran toward him, unable to help but complain, "Phew...... How long have you been here...... "You were still out of breath as you spoke. You came running here, and now you're about half an hour ahead of the agreed time.
Battat scratched his head, feeling uncertain too, so he hesitantly said, "Uh...... Probably, I was only half an hour ahead of you, right? "Actually, it was even earlier. After checking the current time, he realized he'd been standing here for over an hour. He didn't know what was going on, and even after standing for so long, he didn't feel tired—instead, he was getting even more nervous." In short, the heat in his body hadn't faded. But the moment he saw you, his heart seemed to settle down, and the nervousness that had been bouncing around instantly eased.
You sized up battat several times, making him feel a bit guilty. You began to wonder if there was anything wrong with what you said, or if you had noticed something wrong. Then you pouted and poked battat's forehead: "What an idiot—you must have come earlier, didn't you? I told you not to be so nervous!" "We're just hanging out to have fun...... You muttered to yourself, belatedly realizing you were nervous too, so your voice quieted down.
Battat pressed his forehead. Actually, you didn't poke hard, and it didn't hurt at all, but at this moment, he still pretended to be hurt by you and quietly said, "I'm not that nervous now. Mainly, I hope you won't feel upset about it...... So I can't help but feel nervous, and I want to do it as perfectly as possible......
For some reason, you actually saw a hint of pitiful grievance in Battat's eyes. Thinking about it, you softened first: "Ah...... Then you definitely didn't sleep well last night, right? ”
His gaze shifted slightly, feeling a bit guilty: "That's true, mainly because I was a bit nervous, so I didn't rest as well." ”
“…… How about we find a place to sleep and catch up on some sleep first?" You suggested.
"No way, you came out just to have fun, and you seem to have prepared a lot for it...... He quickly waved his hand, trying to find some reason to persuade you. But Battat had to admit, he was indeed a bit tempted by your words. Although he hadn't felt sleepy at all during the waiting because he was so nervous, now he was belatedly feeling exhausted.
Well, if he hadn't come out today specifically for a date, Battat probably would have just spent the whole day lying in bed. After all, working for a week is exhausting—not only does he have to do two jobs, but sometimes he even has to work overtime.
"Going out on a date isn't just about having fun. Do whatever you want. For example, right now, I'm tired, so I want to sit down with you to rest for a while, or maybe we can just lean on each other and sleep together!" You waved your fingers and, without giving you a chance to respond, grabbed Batt's hand and ran toward a nearby chair. This was a commercial street, so of course there were benches too. Maybe because it was so early and there weren't many people on the street, there was no one on the benches.
You pulled Battat to sit down, stretched, and yawned: "Phew...... I'm a bit sleepy too. How about we rest here for a while? ”
"Mm...... But wouldn't sitting here feel cold? "Battat still hesitated a little.
"No way, and besides, my body is very strong. I shouldn't catch a cold just because of a little wind......" You thought for a moment and muttered, and before you could react, you felt something warm clothing draped over you. Looking down, it was battat's jacket.
Looking at the battat again, you'll see he's already turned his head, just using the back of his head to point at you, probably ...... You guess he's blushing again.
"Give me your coat. Aren't you cold?" As you spoke, you tugged at the jacket in your hand. Luckily, it was a trench coat, big enough, and when you pulled it open, it could cover both of you. So you happily spread the coat over both of you.
"I'm not cold. I'm wearing plenty of clothes, and I can't let you catch a chill......" Battat was still mumbling when he noticed your trench coat was half-spread and fell onto him, and his voice abruptly stopped.
"Hmph, that's good. We'll split it half, just right!" You smiled and waved your fingers, looking quite proud.
So Battat couldn't help but smile: "Hmm, that's amazing!" He even gave you a big round of applause.
You kept smiling, yawned again, then leaned on battat's shoulder and closed your eyes. Soon, all you could hear was your gentle breathing. Battat glanced at you cautiously, making sure you were really asleep. He didn't dare make any more noise, just tugged the trench coat that had fallen off from your movements again, gently closed his eyes, and fell asleep leaning against you.
I don't know how much time passed before Battat slowly woke up. He instinctively glanced at you first and realized you had woken up at some point. Moreover, he was sleeping with his shoulder on your shoulder, and you were watching him the whole time.
So Battat quickly sat up straight, unable to help but whisper complaint, "Why didn't you just wake me up earlier......"
"Because seeing you sleeping soundly, I couldn't bear to wake you up, and seeing your sleeping face made me quite satisfied...... Ah, wait, I can't say it like that, but being with you is really relaxing. "You scratched your cheek and couldn't help but blush."
"Oh, oh...... Anyway, I've slept enough, and we should leave now. A good date can't just keep sleeping, right? "Battat felt a bit embarrassed and guilty. If he had slept well last night, he wouldn't have needed to catch up on sleep today.
"It's okay to keep sleeping, as long as we stay together. Why isn't it a date?" You have your own twisted logic, and battat can't convince you, so he just goes with you.
"Alright, if you think it's fine, then fine." Battat nodded, hesitating a bit and his words became hesitant, and you noticed this, looking at him expectantly.
"Okay, battat, tell me, where are we going?" You actually don't have any good opinions, since you don't really like shopping, so if you come to the commercial street, there's not much to do. You can't just go to a livehouse and listen to music together......
…… Although this seems fine, your mind can't help but start wandering.
"Then let's go to the KTV. If you're tired, you can rest for a bit...... Ah, but if you fall asleep, KTV charges by the hour, so it should be expensive......" Battat lowered his voice and began muttering halfway through.
You tilted your head, thought about the question, then cheerfully suggested, "It's fine, at worst case, I'll just pay!" ”
"How could that be! If it's a date, I should be the one paying!" You heard battat's retort, then you covered his mouth.
"Yeah, if it's over budget, I'll pay for it. No arguing, okay? I know it's not easy if you want to save money. You can't be the only one paying, can you!" After saying this, you finally let go of Battat's lips.
He muttered softly, "But you were the one who paid before...... This time, I have to pay, right......
You pretend you didn't hear and just whistle and turn your head.
Soon, you arrived at the KTV and got a private room to sit in. The room was dimly lit. You glanced at the song station and enthusiastically asked Battat what song he wanted to pick.
Battat cleared his throat twice: "Mm...... I'll just type it myself, no need to trouble you." "After all, the songs he wants to sing, he doesn't feel comfortable telling you directly. Even though it's just the two of you now, at least those are songs about work and bosses! Some are filled with curses, and he just feels embarrassed to tell you......
You blink at battat and wave your hand: "No trouble, I happen to want to request a song too, and maybe I can pick two songs we'll sing together." ”
"Mainly, I'm a bit embarrassed about the song titles, so I'll let myself handle them!" He closed his eyes for a moment and said as if he had given up on something.
You seem to understand, looking at Battat's face as if facing death with fear, you let out a meaningful "Oh—" and then casually pick a few songs you like. Honestly, there are all kinds of languages, and your preferences are quite broad.
Then you sit back down on the sofa and signal Battat to go pick a song: "Go ahead, I've already chosen. I'll ask if I remember later." ”
Battat nodded and went to the song selection station to pick a few songs. Of course, his movements were still a bit sneaky when searching, probably because he didn't really want you to see him. You shifted your gaze slightly; no matter how much you hide it, you'll still be able to see it on the TV screen later.
Sure enough, after you casually sing a few songs you picked, you see the songs Battat chose appear on the screen. The moment you see the title, you can't help but feel sympathy for Battat, who always has to work. But since you're ultimately wealthy, this empathy might just be a vague pity. Still, you do think the company treatment at Battat is really bad! Even though you've only heard part of it.
Because now the screen shows ...... Uh, the title of that song is "fuck the job."
In short, all you can do is mourn for Battat. But honestly, his voice seems quite suitable for singing? No, maybe it's even better for reading bedtime stories...... Although this song sounds explosive, you only hear a hint of fatigue and weariness in Battat's voice, and his voice is a bit hoarse, more like the soft rustling of pages scraping a book. You think absentmindedly, resting your chin on your hand as you listen to Battat's singing. After singing this song, the next few are also about scolding the boss or the job. You can't help but cough twice, go to the song selection station, and pick out a few songs that can be sung as duets or duets.
…… Isn't it just for this little thing that comes to KTV on a date! If I asked you, you'd definitely shout like that.
This isn't really some kind of trick. Basically, after battat gets tired singing, you pick up the microphone, and the next song starts with the woman's segment. When it's the man's turn, battat hesitates before raising the microphone, his movements a bit chaotic.
You were very close. Although you didn't look at each other while singing, it felt as if you could feel each other's feelings, as if our hearts were drawing close at that moment, as if your feelings at that moment were the same as those lyrics on the screen.
When a few choral songs ended, the private room time you reserved arrived. Reluctantly, you put down the microphone and left the KTV with Battat.
For the rest of the day, you wandered around the commercial street. Although you didn't like shopping, strolling around with Battat was a different feeling. You enjoyed that feeling until sunset, when the sun set, you reluctantly said goodbye to Battat and then went home.
Once again, you feel that kind of gaze, but this time you don't care.
But for several days in a row, you feel like someone is following you, but when you look back, you can't find the target.
End.

title: Coffee cup 19-Battatx you
content:
To be honest, if it's just once or twice, maybe you're just overthinking it, but after a few times, you start to wonder what exactly is going on—whether someone is really following you—so you're considering hiring a thug.
But before that, you decide to call Battat to accompany you. After all, two are safer than one, and if Battat notices, it will confirm, that someone is indeed following you.
Now Battat visits the coffee shop almost every day, only occasionally when he needs to work overtime. So you reach his desk and whisper, "When I get off work, come with me home." ”
Battat was stunned for a moment, his face instinctively flushed. Could it be that you two are actually progressing this fast? He still hasn't figured it out......
But before he could keep his wild thoughts, seeing his sudden blushing, you waved your hand and waved it in front of his eyes: "That's not what I meant. I didn't mean you should come home with me or anything. I just suspect someone has been following me lately, so I hope you'll come along. After all, having you with me makes me feel more at ease." You lowered your voice to explain why you were doing this, and after hearing this, Battat gradually toned down his previously shy expression and became serious.
"I understand. But regarding this matter, haven't you considered calling the police or something?" he asked.
You shrugged: "Hmm...... I did think about it, but right now I'm just suspicious. Calling the police directly might not be the right idea. I still want to at least make sure this is done before reporting it. ”
“…… Alright, I'll go back with you." So you heard battat reply, lowering his voice. To be honest, he sincerely hoped all of this was just your imagination; battat didn't want you to actually run into danger. Things like stalkers are still a bit too scary.
Sigh, when will it finally be completely peaceful? Battat couldn't help but wonder.
You nod in satisfaction and return to the counter to continue making coffee and serving customers. Although there weren't many customers left, today was very leisurely. After finishing these tasks, you sat behind the counter dozing off until Battat walked up and gently tapped the counter, finally fully awakening.
Only then did you realize it was already this hour, and everyone else in the store had left. You shyly smiled at battat: "Ah...... Sorry, I just fell asleep. ”
Battat shook his head: "It's fine, but if you fall asleep here, you might catch a cold. Let's rest after we get home." ”
You nodded vigorously, quickly packed your things, walked to the shop entrance, changed 'open' to 'close', then grabbed Battat's hand and raised it high, saying excitedly, "Yay! Let's go home together!" ”
Battat felt inexplicably embarrassed watching your actions, but when he heard the word 'together,' he felt as if his soul had fallen into a warm spring, soaking in the warm and sweet flow. For a moment, he just wanted to miss that feeling. But whenever he thought about maybe going home together in the future—words you often say and might say—he couldn't help but feel a sense of fulfillment.
"Come to think of it, this feels like it's the first time I've gone home with Battat. Want to talk about something?" You put one hand behind your back, while the other tightly held Battat's hand, gazing thoughtfully at the swaying sunset on the horizon.
Battat pondered for a moment: "That's fine, but lately it's been work-related matters, so I don't think there's much to say...... Anyway, he's been constantly dragged into overtime lately, so he's only had a bit of free time these past couple of days. He also wants to see you every day, as if all his fatigue melts away in that moment, but...... He usually doesn't get that chance. Usually, after overtime, he has to go back to his own place and feels embarrassed to ask for your photos or something.
So often, I can only think of that vague image in my heart, but the more I miss you, the more I want to see the real you, to see every frown and smile of you, to see you laughing for him, to hear your voice, to feel your gentle warmth.
"That's fine, right...... Anyway, I've only been working lately, nothing else to do. Ah, speaking of which, that fiancé hasn't come to bother me for days, which is actually a great thing! Pfft, just mentioning that guy makes me feel unlucky...... Let's talk about something interesting! By the way, I've occasionally run into a guest lately, and it's pretty fun......
He listened to you rambling, watched you sway his hand as you pulled him, and couldn't help but speak up, even if it was just a babble in a very quiet voice: "I do...... Is it more fun than me?" And he stammered and stammered.
You got cold, glanced to the side, and saw that Battat's face had turned bright red at some point. He didn't dare look at you anymore, but turned his head away, just saying these things.
So you couldn't help but laugh out loud, reaching out and poking his face: "Of course I like you the most. You're the funniest, but honestly, I can't say that...... Anyway, I like you the most! Hmm, maybe I just think you're cute enough? But you're reliable too, and you really are fun. "Although always saying that kind of thing does sound a bit like bullying honest people, you still think you're just telling the truth!"
Battat scratched his cheek, turned to look at you, and muttered quietly, "What's the word for 'cute'......"
"I mean to praise you?" Anyway, I really like it. "You smiled and pinched his cheek. Honestly, it felt a bit hard to the touch, but it didn't really matter. The touch was actually quite smooth, very comfortable, so you couldn't help but kiss his cheek before letting go.
Battat was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly turned his face away, just covering his cheek with his other hand, feeling a bit embarrassed. Besides, just touching his cheek made him feel the warmth. In any case, he might as well not turn back to look at you.
You looked at Battat's reaction and snorted twice, secretly laughing to yourself: "Ah, my little boyfriend gets shy so easily. What do we do next...... After all, if you're dating or getting married, these things aren't uncommon, and there might be even more restrictive things...... You start to think about this.
Battat suddenly stopped in his tracks, making you stumble a bit. You turned to look at Battat, just about to complain, but then you realized his face was already bright red.
After hesitating for a moment, you didn't complain anymore. Instead, you walked back and gently grabbed his hand: "Alright, those are all unrelated matters. Let's go home first!" ”
Battat stammered, "Yes, yes, let's go home first......" He had just thought about what might happen in the future, so he couldn't help but feel embarrassed because of it. How strange. He should have thought about these things long ago. Battat couldn't help but feel a bit annoyed, or maybe he simply thought that maintaining the current state would be fine.
As long as they belong to each other, what kind of relationship doesn't seem very important. Battat couldn't help but think this way. But since such a relationship has developed, to this extent, he can't help but want to take things further, can't help but wish everything could be more perfect—that's what he strives for.
…… Well, probably, at least he'll be working toward that.
But once they set off again, after a moment of silence between you, Battat also sensed the faint sound of footsteps and their gazes—a lingering gaze that seemed to be being followed by someone.
So Battat lowered his voice: "It seems like someone is following us. Should you call the police first?" ”
You thought for a moment, gently shook your head at him, and said, "No need, I've thought of a good idea!" As you spoke, you flashed a sly smile.
“…… It's good that you have a solution. "Battat breathed a slight sigh of relief, but he still heightened his vigilance. If someone following behind tried to do something, something injure, it would be a serious problem.
You climbed the stairs of your apartment, and to let the person following you get out, you deliberately skipped the elevator today. Then, the footsteps of the followers became even more obvious. After all, your stairs are made of iron, and no matter how hard you try to hide them, it's hard to hide your footsteps on stairs like this.
At the corner, just enough to block the other person's view, you stop silently, listening to the other person's footsteps growing more urgent. Then, pulling Battat and turning around to look down, you see that fiancé is climbing the stairs.
You pouted, a bit annoyed: "Tsk, he really is a persistent ghost. Why is he so annoying?" ”
Battat also frowned and lowered his voice: "Maybe we should just call the police and have this guy arrested." ”
You waved your hand: "At least his family has some money, so it's not a serious crime. As long as you pay a little, he can be bailed out. That's not very good." "But seeing his clothes getting even tattered, I'm afraid the family is on the verge of complete bankruptcy, with the whole family going to beg for debts not far off."
…… That's why you're so anxious, you thought absentmindedly, opening the voice recorder you had tucked in your pocket, taking two steps outside, standing there looking down at your fiancé with your arms in your hands, your voice lazy.
"What brings you here? Don't tell me you live here. The owners here can be found through the first-floor owners' register. I'm pretty sure your name isn't on the list. And don't say you're here to see some familiar person...... I know almost all those people. I don't recall anyone cooperating with your family's company; those who did stopped long ago. ”
My fiancé also stopped and stood on the stairs, revealing a look that was almost twisted, or rather, rather humble, and in short, even a bit frantic: "No, I'm here to find you." Then he suddenly sped up and charged at you. Fortunately, he didn't seem to be carrying any weapons, so you instinctively took two steps back. But the next second, you saw Battat suddenly appear from the side, blocking your way and grabbing the hand your fiancé was about to grab at you.
“…… What do you want from me? I've already told you, it's absolutely impossible." You poked your head out from behind the battat and looked at your fiancé.
"Haha...... As long as you're not married, I've always had a chance, right? Besides, being with someone like that isn't right for you at all. Marrying me is the right choice...... He looked crazed, as if he believed this reasoning was correct.
You can't help but wonder if you can send this guy to a psychiatric hospital.
"Forget it. We've been planning to get married for a long time. You have no chance at all, and if you keep pestering us, I'm planning to call the police. This time, I also recorded it with a voice recorder, including the previous harassment incidents. It looks like your family is about to go bankrupt too, right? If I just have my family put a bit more pressure on you, your company will go bankrupt completely, and you'll probably end up in debt. Maybe this evidence isn't much now, but by then it could be enough for you to never see the light of day...... So are you sure you want to keep this tangled up? As long as you leave now, I won't hold it against you anymore. "As you spoke, you took out the recorder and shook it, adjusting your hands and playing the recordings from the previous sessions.
Battat was stunned for a moment, instinctively turning to look at you, and you gave him a wink.
That fiancé's face turned deathly pale. He gave you one last resentful glare before hurriedly going down the stairwell.
You let out a breath. In fact, you weren't so sure. If your fiancé had gone crazy at that moment, there would have been nothing you could do. After all, you're just a wealthy young lady raised with no strength!
"Phew...... It looks like he won't come looking for him again, but tomorrow I'll talk to the people at my company and ask them to help speed up his company's bankruptcy. "You wiped the cold sweat from your forehead and murmured, while Battat just looked at you.
You turned to look at him too, noticing that under your gaze, Battat's face was gradually turning red, and he muttered, "Just now...... So handsome." Although if you didn't listen carefully, you might not even hear that mumbling sound.
So you can't help but laugh out loud, and then a thought flashes through your mind, suddenly suggesting, "How about we go get our marriage certificate tomorrow?" ”
Battat hadn't fully recovered before your words snapped him out of his daze. Although he was still a bit confused, he pointed at himself and said, "Wait, what? Didn't you say there was going to be a formal proposal ceremony first?" ”
You nod matter-of-factly: "Yeah, but those can be made up for later, whatever you want. As for now, anyway, I plan to completely give up on that beast's hopes......
Tbc.

title: Coffee Cup 20 (End of text) - Battatx You
content:
Battat hesitated twice. Looking at your expression of such a matter of course, he suddenly felt a bit timid and confused, but didn't know if he should speak up at this moment. He was led by the hand as you walked up the stairs, and before he could ask the question he wanted to ask, his face flushed red: "Wait, are you really going to take me back to your place?" ”
Only then did you stop in your tracks. Luckily, Battat didn't bump into you directly. He looked at your back in confusion, but saw you turn around thoughtfully and stare at him for a few moments, making Battat feel inexplicably flustered.
Then you nod knowingly: "Ah, you can stay at my place tonight. I thought about it, and tomorrow happens to be the weekend, so we can get up early together to get the marriage certificate...... Hmm, speaking of which, I heard getting a marriage certificate is pretty cheap now? Let me treat you. ”
Battat couldn't help but chuckle: "What are you talking about? A marriage certificate isn't about whether you invite or not...... And it should be me who should be inviting you, right? No, I'm not asking you that question...... Seeing you about to hold his hand and walk up again, he hurriedly added.
So you stop again, tilt your head and look at Battat: "Hmm, then what do you want to ask?" ”
Actually, when you asked this, you were a bit nervous, because you really couldn't figure out what Battat was going to ask. After thinking it over, you felt your earlier actions were perfectly normal, nothing suspicious. That proposal about marriage was, of course, serious and perfectly normal.
"Um...... "Exactly, are you serious about your marriage proposal? Going to get the marriage certificate tomorrow morning, you shouldn't be in such a hurry, right? And you're just going to accept me like that......" He stammered, his voice growing quieter and quieter, and under your gaze, he looked even more uneasy.
You stroked your chin, then walked down the steps and cupped Battat's face, looking him straight in the eye and said very seriously, "Of course, of course I'm serious, and I really do believe in you. Although our time together was probably brief, we still have a long time to get to know each other, so we can use that time to slowly get to know each other. That freshness of discovering each other's likes and preferences for the first time is something worth experiencing...... Ah, that's probably not the point. "You laughed as you spoke, then leaned in to kiss his lips before letting go.
"It's fine to make up for the wedding after the wedding. I know you probably don't have much time, so just take your time getting ready! As for going to get the marriage certificate tomorrow, it's not entirely to discourage that person's thoughts. Just think of it as me being too impatient!" "I really, really want to see you every day." You said with a smile. Night had fallen unnoticed. In the corner, you were blocked by a brick wall, with little light, but you could still see Battat's face visibly flushed in the dim light.
So you can't help but laugh: "I think it's because I love you that I want to do this. It's not just about liking, but because I'm willing to give a little more for you. So I think maybe at this moment, it's okay for me to take a step forward." Hmm...... So, do you love me? "When you say this, you can't help but get nervous. Even though you know the answer is probably yes, you still look at Battat nervously, staring intently."
Battat took a deep breath, cupped your face, and then kissed your lips. He was so close that you could see his trembling pupils still fixed on you, feeling the warmth on his cheek.
"D-Of course, I love you too, but I should be the one to say things like this, right? Why are you the one saying it......" He stammered, a bit embarrassed, and you could see his neck and cheeks were flushed red.
"Ah, then you're an idiot. You can't even see through something so simple. I'm the one who spoke first." You said matter-of-factly.
"How can you say that? It's normal to feel nervous because you can't be sure of your feelings......," he whispered, trying to retort.
But maybe once you fall in love, it's easy to become a fool. You think about it, because you used to be like that too.
"No matter what, aren't we already sure what we're going to do from now on? So as long as we keep moving forward, that's enough! I could say 'I love you' to you many times—today and again, so let's go home first!" You said that, turned around, and took Battat's hand as they walked upstairs.
Battat once again murmured the word 'go home' in his heart. From then on, it would be your shared home. He couldn't help but smile, his heart began to dance lightly, as if his soul was elevating. He began to look forward to tomorrow immensely, eagerly looking forward to what came next. He vaguely understood that from now on, every day, similar scenes would play out between you and him.
But when we arrived at your place, Battat started stammering again: "Uh, do you have a guest room at home? How about I go sleep in the guest room for the night?" ”
Your home is very spacious, and the items aren't exactly tidy, but the messy arrangement adds a special artistic beauty. After all, there aren't many things, probably because the house is just too big.
You glanced at battat curiously: "Why do you want to stay in the guest room? You can just share a bed with me. It's not like my bed isn't big enough!" Besides, we're already a couple, and we're getting married tomorrow. Don't be embarrassed. "As you spoke, you grabbed Battat's hand and led him into the room. Then Battat saw the pillow on the bed that looked just like his. He couldn't help but lose his voice and instinctively turned to look at you.
You coughed twice, still feeling unjustified, but still resolute: "Ahem, ahem, that's not ...... I originally thought couples should live together once they confirmed their relationship, but I was too embarrassed to bring it up. I saw you didn't intend to bring it up, so I could only buy a pillow matching yours and sleep with it every day. That's not a problem! ”
Although you can't hold a real battat, hugging a pillow can still fulfill your wishes!
Battat glanced at you, a bit speechless, then at the pillow on the bed, and finally stammered, "Th-then I'm standing here now...... He stammered again, not knowing what to say next. To be honest, he didn't think you had to throw the pillow down; it just looked awkward.
You scratch your head, watching him get a little more interested in teasing him: "Hmm, then what should I do...... If I throw the pillow down, can I hold you while I sleep? ”
Well, but you know Battat probably won't agree, right? I really don't understand why he's still so shy now, but seeing him shy is actually quite amusing—at least you like it.
Just say battat is cute.
"Ah...... Ah, that's fine! "He closed his eyes, no longer caring what he was saying. Maybe in that moment, he was a little jealous of the pillow you could hold every day. He admitted it, but honestly, he didn't have any other thoughts.
He just feels that, at this moment, it should be just you and him.
So you took the pillow and placed it on the sofa outside, then went back to sit on the bed and took off your outer clothes. Battat instinctively covered his eyes because you had taken off your underwear right in front of him and changed into pajamas.
Seeing Battat like this, you couldn't help but laugh: "Ah...... You'll see it in the future, right? Maybe you have to do even more. If it's like this now, what should we do next? ”
Battat just thought that if he didn't cover his eyes, he'd probably get a nosebleed. Now he realized he really needed to train his tolerance. Otherwise, it would be too embarrassing to have to drip nosebleed onto you in the future...... He absolutely couldn't accept this kind of situation!
"Uh...... "I-I'll try hard......" he stammered, letting go of his hand covering his eyes. He could see two faint spots peeking out beneath your pure white nightgown, rising and falling with your movements. He scratched his head. Although his cheeks were flushed, at least he didn't react much.
Then you pat the bed: "Alright, come up and sleep!" ”
Battat climbed onto the bed in sync with his hands and feet. Although he didn't have a nosebleed, he looked like he was out of the loop. His reaction was a bit dazed, and he was a bit nervous. But tonight, you didn't sleep holding Battat.
Maybe because we're getting married tomorrow, today we just have to lie on the same bed and sleep. You lie on either side of the bed. Battat listens to your breathing, feeling a bit distracted, and in the end, he doesn't even know how he fell asleep. When you pull him up the next day, he's still a bit dazed and staring blankly.
…… Then you quickly changed clothes and went to get your marriage certificate. When you got the notebook and looked at the photos of you two on it, Battat wasn't fully awake until you waved your hand in front of him, and he suddenly snapped back to reality, stammering again.
"Ah...... Ah! That's how it ends...... "For some reason, he felt a sense of loss. Maybe he didn't have a perfect wedding ceremony, even if it wasn't perfect, or maybe because he hadn't suggested it, and even the ring was given to him after you bought it. With mixed feelings, he put the ring on his left ring finger.
But looking at that ring, his mood visibly improved. From today on, he officially shared the same home with you.
You nodded: "Mm, that's it...... Alright, let's go home! Let's go back together. For the rest of today, we can still stay together. ”
Well, let's go home together.
The rest of the time, you didn't go out or do much. Battat was just handling the documents he brought from the staff dormitory. He didn't have much, so you spent the rest of your morning moving in and organizing them. You quietly read a book beside Battat. To be honest, Battat still didn't feel the reality of being married, but looking at the ring, he suddenly realized that you two were indeed married.
Homework, then resting, lying on the bed and falling into a deep sleep. Today, you actually rolled over and hugged Battat, but not so tightly, so Battat could still sleep that he hadn't touched the softness of your chest. In any case, in the end, he still drifted off to sleep.
But the next morning, when he woke up to the alarm, he found you weren't by his side, and he smelled the aroma of coffee wafting from the living room.
Battat changed clothes and walked out of the bedroom, watching as you placed the two coffee cups with your name and Battat's name on the table, poured steaming coffee, then placed the cup with Battat's name in front of you, while the cup with your name was placed opposite.
When you see Battat wake up, you happily wave at him: "You're awake, let's have a cup of coffee first." ”
Battat cleared his throat twice, sat down across from you, picked up the cup of coffee, and took a gentle sip. Then he realized it was a cappuccino, probably made from different coffee beans, so this time it had a hint of floral and botanical freshness, along with a rich, smooth milky taste.
So he put down his coffee cup: "Ah, is this a cappuccino?" ”
You snapped your fingers: "Bingo." That's right, then I'll reward you with a good morning kiss—" As you spoke, you suddenly stood up, leaned over, bent over, and kissed him.
Battat was a bit stunned, his cheeks flushed as he looked at you.
So you can't help but smile with a smile: "Oh, hurry up and eat breakfast, or you'll be late for work soon, right?" ”
Only then did Battat respond twice, hurriedly finish off the breakfast, and hurriedly arrive at TV WORLD with the documents he had handled yesterday.
Although probably no one would notice, he couldn't help but deliberately show off the ring on his hand when colleagues passed by. Today, Pluey and Jongler's gazes didn't quite match, but he proudly showed off the ring on his hand.
But it might not be appropriate to impersonate Mike, and showing the same ring could easily give away...... Battat hesitated for a moment, but still took off the ring and hung it on the necklace, putting it on his neck.
In short, he felt floating and floating that day, not even feeling that work was painful anymore. In fact, his enthusiasm for work was higher than before. It was only when he realized that he started to blame himself for not being so motivated, or else the work he would get would just keep piling up.
Anyway, the day work ended, and he went home. Whenever he thought of the word 'home,' he thought of you at home, and couldn't help but smile.
Pushing open the door, in the mist, Battat sees you sitting at one end of the table, waiting for him to come home. When you see Battat, you push your coffee cup over.
"Welcome home."
End.
Oh oh, that's all for the main story...... But there are also post-marriage extras afterward, I don't know how many more to write ()

title: Coffee Cup 21 (Extra 1) - Battatx You (1)
content:
Speaking of when they first got married, Battat was a bit uncomfortable. Every day after work, he instinctively wanted to walk toward the staff dormitory. After thinking for a moment, he stopped in his tracks and remembered he should be heading in another direction—he should be going home, the home you share with him.
And every time he thinks of this concept, Battat can't help but smile.
Everyone at TV World also noticed that battat no longer lived in the staff dormitory. After all, every day after work, he was the only one who was completely different from the others! It wasn't exactly envy or jealousy, since he had gotten to know a bit before, so he just chatted a bit privately. For example, battat was beaming again today, casually showing off the ring he wore before coming over. Also, battat left a bit earlier than usual, probably to get home quickly or something.
Even though they chatted a bit privately, they were still good colleagues. Life was so boring that they had to find any topic to talk about, so the Battat incident had now become a new topic.
But Battat didn't know any of this. Even if he did, he probably wouldn't care much. He would only become more proudly showing off the ring on his hand. After all, he also wanted others to know about his situation, to know what kind of person you were to him, and how important you were to him.
On this day, Battat rarely worked overtime. He usually didn't like working overtime, since he wanted to see you early and spend more time with you. It wasn't because time spent made you more important. To him, you were his most precious treasure. He simply liked and loved the feeling of being with you, which completely relaxed his nerves and made him feel comfortable.
However, there was just too much work to handle that day. It wasn't just that he suddenly had a huge pile of work to handle; Mike's place also suddenly had a pile of urgent tasks, and they were urgent and time-limited. He couldn't even get them straight out of work to finish them and had to rush to the TV world.
By the time he tiredly walked home with his belongings, it was already late at night. Battat was unusually a bit guilty. He glanced at his phone—it was already past ten at night. He had already sent you a message when he was supposed to get off work, saying he had to work overtime today and couldn't be home on time. You replied with an OK.
And then there was nothing more, so Battat didn't know what he'd face when he got back. Would you be upset about this, would you throw a tantrum? Does he still have the energy to deal with these things? Battat was really thinking about these issues. Even though he was exhausted and wished he could collapse quickly and get a good night's sleep, he also hoped to handle the relationship well and not let you feel the slightest dissatisfaction. He hoped you could always be happy.
Until he opened the door with a nervous heart, what greeted him was not the pitch-black he had imagined. Only the moonlight outside the window was not the kind of reproachful or resentful look he might see. Instead, it was just steaming food, seemingly a bit cold on the table, not very lavish. There were two coffee cups on the table, but instead of coffee, they held milk, also steaming with steaming mist. You were lying at the other end of the table, looking like you had fallen asleep.
But when you heard the door open, you rubbed your eyes and climbed up from the table, smiling toward Battat, who had just entered but still felt a bit out of place with the warm atmosphere of the house, still carrying the humidity and coolness of the outside air: "Welcome home!" ”
Actually, when you saw him message saying he was working overtime, you guessed he probably wouldn't be eating properly anymore. You once specifically asked Battat how he handled lunch and dinner, but he stammered and said he mostly only ate a sandwich. You immediately realized how casual he was about to eat. But luckily, he still knew to eat on time and wouldn't get sick because of it...... In short, although your cooking skills aren't great and you don't like cooking, you still decided to prepare a meal for him.
So for lunch, you usually prepare it in a lunchbox: put cooked pasta, fried eggs and steak, a few cherry tomatoes on top, a slice of mint, and finally a sandwich on the other side. Occasionally, you stir-fry some seafood baked rice and add it, topped with shrimp and diced ham sausage. Or sometimes you make heart-shaped omurice, drawing a heart on top with ketchup. But you never use any spell to make it taste better. Does love really make food taste better? Actually, you're curious about this too.
As for dinner and such...... Actually, you were lazy. You just carefully prepared that meal for Battat, and your own lunch was just a casual leftover from the morning's meal. Anyway, it wasn't impossible. And dinner was always takeout you ordered. Although you bought it from outside, you still studied the plating carefully, not wanting your plating to be imperfect. This led to Battat seeing a beautifully plated dinner every day when he came home, and he seemed never to suspect anything.
