Well, if you say he's skeptical, he still has a bit. Battat was just thinking, how could you have the leisure to fuss with these platings and such?
Today, you also prepared dinner for him, which might count as a late-night snack. Since tomorrow is a holiday, you can rest a bit later and get a good night's sleep tomorrow. To wait for Battat, you sat at the table the whole time, only reheating the food when it got cold, and flipping through a book in boredom. You said you were reading, but you were a bit distracted. Although Battat said you didn't need to wait for him, you had nothing else to do after working at the coffee shop, so you simply waited for him.
But you can't get through the book or think about anything else. All you have left in your mind is 'battat,' so you put down your book and lay down on the desk to fall asleep out of boredom, until you hear the door open, open your eyes, and see 'battat' coming home.
You're sure his first glance was at you, so you smiled and said welcome home, then stood up, pulled Battat down into the seat, and said, "Alright. You've worked hard all day. I guess you didn't have a proper dinner. Have something to eat, treat it as a late-night snack!" ”
Battat awkwardly scratched his head and chuckled twice. He really hadn't had a proper dinner, just a few simple bites of sandwiches to get by and then got back to work. You knew this all too well. Only now did he realize he was really starving. Although the food on the table wasn't very abundant and looked weak and not very tasty after being reheated many times, to him it was still a hearty late-night snack.
He picked up his knife and fork, ready to cut a piece of steak and put it in his mouth, but before he could do it, he couldn't help but ask, "Preparing such a lavish dinner and still waiting for me—you must be exhausted, right?" ”
You propped your chin up and watched Battat's movements. Since you had already finished eating, you couldn't help but glance at Battat in surprise: "Of course, that's because these aren't my job of making things. I'm just responsible for the plating...... You didn't even notice anything at all?" "Those were all takeout orders you ordered, but that also shows your taste in choosing restaurants is pretty good. Battat didn't even notice anything off."
Battat felt a bit embarrassed when he heard this. He scratched his cheek and thought carefully. He really didn't notice anything unusual—probably because every day was exhausting. Dinner and such, he could just take care of it casually. In fact, Battat was quite happy that you booked his lunch and dinner, since he really didn't have the energy to prepare any of this. He hadn't expected you to prepare something special for him.
Now that he heard you were only responsible for the plating, he actually wanted to say, 'You really put a lot of effort.' After a pause, he finally felt embarrassed.
So he cleared his throat twice: "Alright, I really didn't taste it. Maybe the taste doesn't really matter to me......
That's true—even though the food you prepare isn't very good, Battat still finishes it with gratitude. He's grateful for you for preparing lunch for him, and he loves you for making plans for him. Maybe love is like this—it requires both sides to give their all.
And he's not picky eater, and besides, the lunch you prepare is much more lavish than what he usually lazily eats with sandwiches.
"I knew taste wasn't that important to you. Actually, it's not that important to me either. Maybe my appetite isn't that strong......" You think for a moment and casually say, "Well, but it's actually convenient too, and takeout isn't a problem." ”
"The taste really doesn't matter, right? I'm actually curious about what kind of work you did to arrange the plates." Battat thought for a moment and decided to ask the question.
You thought carefully for a moment, then tapped your chin: "Mm...... For example, the steak you're eating now was taken out of the takeout box and placed on a plate, with my sliced cherry tomatoes and a slice of mint on it. The pasta roll next to the steak was also rolled out from another takeout box and placed beside it. ”
As you spoke, you pointed to the plate.
"Plating sounds like a very knowledgeable matter, but you really worked hard......" Battat couldn't help but sigh.
"Mm...... It doesn't matter. After all, since I'm back, I've been idle. To me, these things actually feel like cultivating my character—quite artistic. "You thought for a moment and nodded.
You really do quite enjoy this kind of time, and for you, what’s rare about this period is how very quiet it is. You don’t need to think too much; you only need to consider battat’s preferences and your own, only need to worry about how to arrange things so they look better, only need to ponder the texture of today’s food—just like tending to delicate flowers and plants. You are willing to set aside some time to think about these matters.
And now, by caring for Battat like tending to delicate plants—oh, these are living dice, not some kind of plants, and they'll probably be easy to care for, but you still hope they can live better, so you're doing these things voluntarily.
Battat hesitated for a moment, but in the end didn't dwell on the issue any further, and simply asked, "Then...... I wonder, since I came back so late today and made you wait so long, would you blame me? ”
At this point, he couldn't help but add, "Besides, I told you, you don't have to wait so long, don't wait for me. If you're tired, just rest first......"
You looked at battat in surprise and shook your head: "No, I was just waiting for you. I didn't do anything else. In fact, looking forward to your coming home is a unique experience, because I know I'll always wait for you to open the door and cross the threshold, so I'm willing to wait a little longer." ”
But as you spoke, you couldn't help but laugh again: "Besides...... How could I blame you? I won't blame you. You didn't do this willingly; you were forced to work overtime, and you're a victim. If anyone should blame you, it should be the one who made you work overtime. I wouldn't blame you over such a small matter. I considered this possibility from the very beginning when I chose you. ”
After a pause, you added, "Besides, you're tired too. If you don't want to talk, don't speak. Just finish your meal and go rest...... Oh, and you can't eat too much. What if you wake up hungry in the middle of the night?" You muttered to yourself.
Battat stared blankly at you, swallowing the rest of his words, then lowered his head to speed up his eating, swallowing the tears that were about to fall. He thought, unless it's necessary, it's better not to cry in front of you.
Although he was a bit moved by what you said, if he cried at a time like this, wouldn't that just ruin the mood......
You sat across from him, picked up a glass of milk, took a sip, and after a moment of slow thought, added, "Ah, remember to drink milk. I remember it's good for sleep, so I hope you sleep better...... Look at you, you've got dark circles under your eyes these past few days. When are you planning to change jobs?" You couldn't help but complain, but you still respect Battat's choice. If he doesn't want to switch jobs, then forget it.
Battat didn't say anything, just picked up the glass of milk and took a big gulp. After finishing this late-night snack, you quickly tidied up the dishes and planned to clean them up the next day. Then, after washing up, you changed into your pajamas and collapsed onto the bed with Battat.
Tbc.
That day, he went to work as usual and went home after work. Even though he hadn't done much, Battat still felt exhausted. Maybe he sped up to finish those tasks so he wouldn't have to work overtime. It turned out he could leave work early and received envious, jealous looks from his colleagues, but...... He was exhausted too, feeling like he'd fall asleep on the floor in the next second, dragging his feet out in a daze. As for how his colleagues would see him, he didn't really care; he just couldn't wait to get home and see you, nothing more.
Just thinking of your smile made his tired steps, which had slowed down a bit, suddenly quicken at this moment. He was truly impatient. He wanted to go back and see you, to see your every smile, to hear your voice. Well, for Battat, this was just a brief break after a tiring day.
He pushed open the door, and you were still sitting on the sofa reading. Hearing the door open, you were startled and looked up at battat. After all, he did leave work early sometimes, but never as early as this day. Could it be because of working overtime recently? You couldn't help but start speculating, but you put down your book, quickly got up, walked over, took his briefcase, and set it aside, tilting your head to look at him: "Welcome home." ”
Battat finally felt a sense of relief when he saw you. He exhaled and smiled, nodding: "Mm, I'm back." ”
But he looked like he was just overworked...... After thinking it over, you took his hand and sat down on the sofa, complaining, "Oh no, you came back way too early today...... I haven't even prepared dinner yet, or maybe you can just skip the plate and eat takeout directly." You couldn't help but laugh again. You know, recently you'd deliberately prepared dinner just when Battat was about to go home. After all, you didn't want to be caught just ordering takeout. It wasn't awkward, but it still felt a bit embarrassing.
"But since it's rare to be back early today, let's sit on the sofa for a while before going for dinner...... You look exhausted from the whole day, so take a break. I didn't have many customers today, so I closed early and went home. Speaking of which, the coffee shop has had a few more regulars recently, which is great. Looks like more and more customers will get to know my coffee shop......" you muttered to yourself, pulling Battat to sit on the sofa and couldn't help but start sharing your day's trivial matters. In short, you can say anything—from simply clicking into a funny page full of ads when your phone malfunctions, or developing a new coffee product to give Battat a try, to saying you heard your fiancé's company recently went bankrupt and your fiancé was sent to a mental hospital. It feels like he might not be able to get out for a long time, maybe forever.
Battat just quietly gazes at your face. Honestly, he's exhausted—so tired that he doesn't want to speak at all, and so tired that he doesn't want to hear others' voices. But when he sees your mouth opening and closing, hearing your clear voice, he doesn't want you to stop. His soul only feels calm in that moment, or maybe...... Even if it's just trivial matters that probably no one wants to know, he wants to know and listen to you. Of course, he won't tire of you.
He just stared at your face, then suddenly said, "I like you." "Battat didn't understand this either; it was just an impulse in his heart, just a sudden suddenness. He wanted to tell you everything he was feeling, but all those surging emotions eventually boiled down to just four simple words—just four words that could sum up all his feelings."
So Battat just said, I like you.
You were stunned for a moment, and halfway through your sentence, you instinctively froze. You scratched your face, unable to hide the flushed blush spreading across your face. Your eyes darted around nervously, not knowing where to look. In short, you didn't dare look at Battat: "Why are you suddenly saying things like that...... Ah, I like you too! I really like you! ”
You said that last sentence out loud, even though you can't figure out why you did it—probably just suddenly feeling shy.
"I like you too, I like you the most." Battat quickly added, probably feeling that wasn't enough, and even added a 'most' comment. After saying this, he lowered his head and didn't dare look at you anymore, even feeling embarrassed for himself. Oh my god, why did he blurt out that sentence just now? Has it turned into some kind of mutual confession now? It's not that he doesn't like hearing that, he just thinks...... He just thought, oh my god, do you really need to do this?
You blinked, lowered your head, and didn't dare look at his face anymore. Maybe it was just to hide the blush on your face, or maybe you were afraid that if you saw Battat again, you wouldn't be able to say a word. You don't even know why you're doing this event now.
Anyway, you take a deep breath and add, "I only like you, you the most." Mm...... You could say I only love you, but that sounds a bit strange, as if I once loved someone else......" At this point, you couldn't help but laugh.
You don't forget to add, "Ah, anyway, I've never liked anyone else. I just gave my love to you." You didn't feel guilty about saying this, since you really did do it.
Battat's eyes darted away, but in the end, he slowly raised his head to look at you, meeting your sparkling, smiling eyes. Though his cheeks were shy, you couldn't help but feel a light sense of joy, as if your whole soul was delighted, and his heart was racing at that moment. In short, you couldn't wait to hear Battat say more...... Or perhaps, you just couldn't wait to do something else?
You don't know either, but at least for now, you still wish you could hear something more, even though before you hear it, your ears are burning hot and red.
Battat swallowed hard, but finally looked away, not daring to meet your gaze. He really was about to hesitate, not knowing what he was saying: "Mm...... I only love you. I've devoted my whole life to you. I will always love you......
Hearing this, you couldn't help but pat your face. Well, the heat on your cheeks just wouldn't go down...... Your heart was pounding and wouldn't stop, so you could only look at Battat with a hint of complaint, even though after that was filled with joy, and you thought Battat probably couldn't see your eyes.
So in the end, you just cleared your throat: "Alright. So I love you." After saying that, you probably couldn't hold back, or maybe you just didn't want to hear what he said next. You just felt this was enough, so you should just shut his mouth. So after saying that, you kissed him.
Just then, Battat looked up too. He was too shy and didn't want to hear any more. After all, his heart was beating too fast, and he couldn't control it. He was afraid it would break from beating so fast, so he thought, maybe a kiss could shut your mouth, so he looked up too.
So your lips met, and you widened your eyes slightly as you looked at Battat's tightly shut eyes and his hand holding your head nervously and awkwardly, and in the end, you closed your eyes.
So in that moment, you were simply immersed in the soft yet somewhat cool sensation, like a quiet and desolate lake. But when you reached deep into the water, you could feel an inner raging whirlwind. At least, that's what you thought before being kissed until you were dizzy. You were even a bit surprised, not knowing how Battat suddenly learned so much......
But there are times when you let go, so after this kiss, both Battat and you blushed and turned their heads away, not daring to look at each other for a moment. You just hurriedly spoke, pretending to be busy, and stood up: "Ah...... Ah, the takeout should be arriving. I'll go get ready first! ”
"Alright, thank you for your hard work." Battat replied stiffly. Out of the corner of his eye, he watched you walk away, then pressed his hands to his face and quietly buried his head in his knees. It would probably take him a while to fully wake up.
For dinner, you poured milk into two coffee cups as usual. This time, you didn't bother to plate it and simply served it in a takeout box, then you invited Battat over to eat. He finally calmed down and finished the dinner face to face with you, without mentioning what had just happened.
As for the taste of dinner, Battat didn't really care about that. After all, if you were willing to prepare dinner for him, it was already good enough, maybe even pleasantly surprised. In short, having takeout was better than eating fast food every day.
And he probably knows that preparing a lavish dinner is exhausting for you, or rather, tiring for everyone, and Battat doesn't want you to be so exhausted. If you have extra time, it's better to do more of your own things, even though you probably don't mind that.
After all, you'll definitely say that what battat does is exactly what you want to do...... Well, then you mutter to yourself that this sentence is probably not quite right, and tell battats not to cause any ambiguity. Of course, he knows exactly what you mean, and precisely because he knows, he never brings it up.
But after dinner, Battat sat back down on the sofa, as if he had exhausted all his strength, looking like he didn't want to do anything. You looked at him worriedly and said, "If you really feel tired, Battat, should you go back to sleep first?" ”
And he just waves his hand, leans back on the sofa, and tells you not to need it.
You hesitate for a moment, then sit on the sofa, reading the book you hadn't finished before, while Battat sits right next to you, his head pressed against yours, probably reading as well.
But after an unknown amount of time, you felt a heaviness on your shoulder. When you turned your head, you realized it was Battat who had somehow fallen asleep leaning on your shoulder.
You hesitated for a moment. Fortunately, the weather wasn't too cold, and the house was warm and windless, so you wouldn't catch a chill if you fell asleep here. But you gently laid him down, leaning him on your lap, letting him continue sleeping. Battat was clearly very tired and hadn't woken up, while you just gently lowered your head, kissed his forehead, and went back to reading your book.
But after reading for about an hour, you yawned, feeling a bit sleepy, and your mind was a bit unsettled while reading. Maybe putting down the book and resting for a while was the best choice. Then you lowered your head hesitantly to glance at the still-sleeping battat, then at the clock hanging on the wall. It was still before nine o'clock at night!
So you put down your book with peace of mind, reminding yourself to take a nap for a while, then lean back on the sofa and close your eyes, and soon fall asleep too.
When Battat woke up rubbing his eyes, it took him two or three seconds to realize he was resting on your lap. Instinctively, his face flushed, and he hurriedly got up, only to find you were already asleep. He glanced at the clock hanging on the wall—it was about a little past ten, not very early. Battat couldn't just let you keep sleeping here.
He hesitated for a moment, but finally bent down slightly, one arm wrapped around your leg and the other around your neck, carefully lifting you up, hoping not to disturb your sleep. Of course, you slept well, showing no sign of waking up. Battat took a deep breath, his steps light and light, trying not to make a sound, then walked to your bedroom and laid you on the bed.
Around ten o'clock, it was almost time to sleep, so after putting you on the bed, he gently crawled down beside you and lay down.
But you were a bit awake when you were put on the bed, or maybe you were just about to fall asleep again. You glanced at battat lying beside you, rolled over in a daze, hugged him, and muttered, "I love you, battat. Good night." ”
He's now with his back to you, so you can't see his sudden blushing face; you can only hear his stammering voice: "I love you too...... Good night. ”
You closed your eyes again with peace of mind, soon fell back asleep, and had a pleasant dream.
In your dream, you wander in that clear lake, cool and moist, yet not damp—just refreshing. Then, holding the crescent moon reflected in the lake, embracing the stars and raindrops flowing down, you fall into deep darkness once again.
The moonlight is truly beautiful.
Tbc.
Time passed quickly. At least while you were still missing the leisure time, Battat had a fairly long vacation, so he spent most of his time cooped up at home. It's not that you don't want him to take holidays or want him to keep working and relax; you just like the moments when no one cares about you and you can just throw things around. So now, for once, you nervously placed the book you had just finished reading and wanted to throw on the sofa on the nearby bookshelf.
Battat was leisurely sipping a cup of coffee at the dining table. Seeing this, he couldn't help but laugh: "Ah...... Maybe you don't need to be so formal. You can just tidy up the things left here later. There's no rush. But looking at it this way, the house really does seem a bit messy......" he said, glancing around involuntarily.
You scratched your head and smiled awkwardly: "Well...... It's just that some things weren't put away properly before. If you want, I can put them away right now...... You probably still remember exactly where you put your things, so it's not too difficult to tidy up right now.
Battat glanced at you hesitantly: "...... Are you sure? Otherwise, let's pack up together later. We just haven't decided what to do today...... Besides, running the coffee shop every day is actually very tough, so of course it can't be compared to my work. ”
You waved your hand: "Sure, definitely! I'll get ready soon. As for you, since it's a rare holiday, just rest well. I won't trouble you!" You declared solemnly, hands on hips.
Battat couldn't help but laugh: "Ah...... Actually, it doesn't really matter. Organizing things together may be a pretty tedious thing, but as long as I'm with you, it becomes even more interesting. Plus, just organizing things may be monotonous, but it can calm my mind. ”
"That actually makes sense. It's just that doing these things alone is too boring, so I don't want to do them. But since you're here now, I guess my motivation has gotten a bit higher...... You muttered, picking up the books from the TV counter, then putting them back on the shelf, picking up the boxes you'd thrown on the coffee table one by one, stacking them together, and putting them back on the TV counter. Then you gathered the sanitary pads you had casually tossed on the coffee table and put them into a small box to place on the table...... Besides the colleagues from battat, quite a few people from your company also came. Although you no longer manage the company, you hold the largest shares, so they should show you some respect. Besides, you're the heiress of this company.
They sit on the bench on the other side, applauding you.
The priest, acting as the master of ceremonies, began to preside over the wedding, and looked at Battat first.
"Are you willing to marry her as your wife? She will be your lifelong friend, partner, and my only true love. On this special day, before God, you will promise that in good times or bad, rich or poor, healthy or sick, happy or sorrowful, you will always be by her side as her husband. Love her wholeheartedly, be proud of her, respect her, do all you can to meet her needs, protect her in times of trouble, comfort her in sorrow, be faithful to her forever, cherish her forever. ”
"I'm willing." You heard him say that.
Then, the priest repeats the same sentence to you, and you happily say yes. Then, under the priest's watchful eye, you exchange rings.
You saw Battat start laughing, so you couldn't help but go over and hug him. Then, amid the cheers from the audience, you picked up an apple from the stage, took a bite, and placed it near Battat's mouth.
Although Battat's face was still flushed, he instinctively hugged you, caught you as you pounced on him, and then leaned in to bite the apple in your hand. He also knew what this apple meant today...... Or rather, what it meant, of course, the simplest meaning was peace and smoothness.
But before he could think further, he felt a warm, soft touch on his lips. Now it was Battat's wide-eyed expression, almost unable to react, watching your closed eyes, and in the end, he closed his eyes.
Then, amid the increasingly enthusiastic jeers from the audience, he carefully exchanges this kiss with you. In a mix of stickiness and sweetness, this pure white vow ends.
End.

title: Coffee Cup 21 (Extra 1) - Battatx You
content:
Speaking of when they first got married, Battat was a bit uncomfortable. Every day after work, he instinctively wanted to walk toward the staff dormitory. After thinking for a moment, he stopped in his tracks and remembered he should be heading in another direction—he should be going home, the home you share with him.
And every time he thinks of this concept, Battat can't help but smile.
Everyone at TV World also noticed that battat no longer lived in the staff dormitory. After all, every day after work, he was the only one who was completely different from the others! It wasn't exactly envy or jealousy, since he had gotten to know a bit before, so he just chatted a bit privately. For example, battat was beaming again today, casually showing off the ring he wore before coming over. Also, battat left a bit earlier than usual, probably to get home quickly or something.
Even though they chatted a bit privately, they were still good colleagues. Life was so boring that they had to find any topic to talk about, so the Battat incident had now become a new topic.
But Battat didn't know any of this. Even if he did, he probably wouldn't care much. He would only become more proudly showing off the ring on his hand. After all, he also wanted others to know about his situation, to know what kind of person you were to him, and how important you were to him.
On this day, Battat rarely worked overtime. He usually didn't like working overtime, since he wanted to see you early and spend more time with you. It wasn't because time spent made you more important. To him, you were his most precious treasure. He simply liked and loved the feeling of being with you, which completely relaxed his nerves and made him feel comfortable.
However, there was just too much work to handle that day. It wasn't just that he suddenly had a huge pile of work to handle; Mike's place also suddenly had a pile of urgent tasks, and they were urgent and time-limited. He couldn't even get them straight out of work to finish them and had to rush to the TV world.
By the time he tiredly walked home with his belongings, it was already late at night. Battat was unusually a bit guilty. He glanced at his phone—it was already past ten at night. He had already sent you a message when he was supposed to get off work, saying he had to work overtime today and couldn't be home on time. You replied with an OK.
And then there was nothing more, so Battat didn't know what he'd face when he got back. Would you be upset about this, would you throw a tantrum? Does he still have the energy to deal with these things? Battat was really thinking about these issues. Even though he was exhausted and wished he could collapse quickly and get a good night's sleep, he also hoped to handle the relationship well and not let you feel the slightest dissatisfaction. He hoped you could always be happy.
Until he opened the door with a nervous heart, what greeted him was not the pitch-black he had imagined. Only the moonlight outside the window was not the kind of reproachful or resentful look he might see. Instead, it was just steaming food, seemingly a bit cold on the table, not very lavish. There were two coffee cups on the table, but instead of coffee, they held milk, also steaming with steaming mist. You were lying at the other end of the table, looking like you had fallen asleep.
But when you heard the door open, you rubbed your eyes and climbed up from the table, smiling toward Battat, who had just entered but still felt a bit out of place with the warm atmosphere of the house, still carrying the humidity and coolness of the outside air: "Welcome home!" ”
Actually, when you saw him message saying he was working overtime, you guessed he probably wouldn't be eating properly anymore. You once specifically asked Battat how he handled lunch and dinner, but he stammered and said he mostly only ate a sandwich. You immediately realized how casual he was about to eat. But luckily, he still knew to eat on time and wouldn't get sick because of it...... In short, although your cooking skills aren't great and you don't like cooking, you still decided to prepare a meal for him.
So for lunch, you usually prepare it in a lunchbox: put cooked pasta, fried eggs and steak, a few cherry tomatoes on top, a slice of mint, and finally a sandwich on the other side. Occasionally, you stir-fry some seafood baked rice and add it, topped with shrimp and diced ham sausage. Or sometimes you make heart-shaped omurice, drawing a heart on top with ketchup. But you never use any spell to make it taste better. Does love really make food taste better? Actually, you're curious about this too.
As for dinner and such...... Actually, you were lazy. You just carefully prepared that meal for Battat, and your own lunch was just a casual leftover from the morning's meal. Anyway, it wasn't impossible. And dinner was always takeout you ordered. Although you bought it from outside, you still studied the plating carefully, not wanting your plating to be imperfect. This led to Battat seeing a beautifully plated dinner every day when he came home, and he seemed never to suspect anything.
Well, if you say he's skeptical, he still has a bit. Battat was just thinking, how could you have the leisure to fuss with these platings and such?
Today, you also prepared dinner for him, which might count as a late-night snack. Since tomorrow is a holiday, you can rest a bit later and get a good night's sleep tomorrow. To wait for Battat, you sat at the table the whole time, only reheating the food when it got cold, and flipping through a book in boredom. You said you were reading, but you were a bit distracted. Although Battat said you didn't need to wait for him, you had nothing else to do after working at the coffee shop, so you simply waited for him.
But you can't get through the book or think about anything else. All you have left in your mind is 'battat,' so you put down your book and lay down on the desk to fall asleep out of boredom, until you hear the door open, open your eyes, and see 'battat' coming home.
You're sure his first glance was at you, so you smiled and said welcome home, then stood up, pulled Battat down into the seat, and said, "Alright. You've worked hard all day. I guess you didn't have a proper dinner. Have something to eat, treat it as a late-night snack!" ”
Battat awkwardly scratched his head and chuckled twice. He really hadn't had a proper dinner, just a few simple bites of sandwiches to get by and then got back to work. You knew this all too well. Only now did he realize he was really starving. Although the food on the table wasn't very abundant and looked weak and not very tasty after being reheated many times, to him it was still a hearty late-night snack.
He picked up his knife and fork, ready to cut a piece of steak and put it in his mouth, but before he could do it, he couldn't help but ask, "Preparing such a lavish dinner and still waiting for me—you must be exhausted, right?" ”
You propped your chin up and watched Battat's movements. Since you had already finished eating, you couldn't help but glance at Battat in surprise: "Of course, that's because these aren't my job of making things. I'm just responsible for the plating...... You didn't even notice anything at all?" "Those were all takeout orders you ordered, but that also shows your taste in choosing restaurants is pretty good. Battat didn't even notice anything off."
Battat felt a bit embarrassed when he heard this. He scratched his cheek and thought carefully. He really didn't notice anything unusual—probably because every day was exhausting. Dinner and such, he could just take care of it casually. In fact, Battat was quite happy that you booked his lunch and dinner, since he really didn't have the energy to prepare any of this. He hadn't expected you to prepare something special for him.
Now that he heard you were only responsible for the plating, he actually wanted to say, 'You really put a lot of effort.' After a pause, he finally felt embarrassed.
So he cleared his throat twice: "Alright, I really didn't taste it. Maybe the taste doesn't really matter to me......
That's true—even though the food you prepare isn't very good, Battat still finishes it with gratitude. He's grateful for you for preparing lunch for him, and he loves you for making plans for him. Maybe love is like this—it requires both sides to give their all.
And he's not picky eater, and besides, the lunch you prepare is much more lavish than what he usually lazily eats with sandwiches.
"I knew taste wasn't that important to you. Actually, it's not that important to me either. Maybe my appetite isn't that strong......" You think for a moment and casually say, "Well, but it's actually convenient too, and takeout isn't a problem." ”
"The taste really doesn't matter, right? I'm actually curious about what kind of work you did to arrange the plates." Battat thought for a moment and decided to ask the question.
You thought carefully for a moment, then tapped your chin: "Mm...... For example, the steak you're eating now was taken out of the takeout box and placed on a plate, with my sliced cherry tomatoes and a slice of mint on it. The pasta roll next to the steak was also rolled out from another takeout box and placed beside it. ”
As you spoke, you pointed to the plate.
"Plating sounds like a very knowledgeable matter, but you really worked hard......" Battat couldn't help but sigh.
"Mm...... It doesn't matter. After all, since I'm back, I've been idle. To me, these things actually feel like cultivating my character—quite artistic. "You thought for a moment and nodded.
You really do quite enjoy this kind of time, and for you, what’s rare about this period is how very quiet it is. You don’t need to think too much; you only need to consider battat’s preferences and your own, only need to worry about how to arrange things so they look better, only need to ponder the texture of today’s food—just like tending to delicate flowers and plants. You are willing to set aside some time to think about these matters.
And now, by caring for Battat like tending to delicate plants—oh, these are living dice, not some kind of plants, and they'll probably be easy to care for, but you still hope they can live better, so you're doing these things voluntarily.
Battat hesitated for a moment, but in the end didn't dwell on the issue any further, and simply asked, "Then...... I wonder, since I came back so late today and made you wait so long, would you blame me? ”
At this point, he couldn't help but add, "Besides, I told you, you don't have to wait so long, don't wait for me. If you're tired, just rest first......"
You looked at battat in surprise and shook your head: "No, I was just waiting for you. I didn't do anything else. In fact, looking forward to your coming home is a unique experience, because I know I'll always wait for you to open the door and cross the threshold, so I'm willing to wait a little longer." ”
But as you spoke, you couldn't help but laugh again: "Besides...... How could I blame you? I won't blame you. You didn't do this willingly; you were forced to work overtime, and you're a victim. If anyone should blame you, it should be the one who made you work overtime. I wouldn't blame you over such a small matter. I considered this possibility from the very beginning when I chose you. ”
After a pause, you added, "Besides, you're tired too. If you don't want to talk, don't speak. Just finish your meal and go rest...... Oh, and you can't eat too much. What if you wake up hungry in the middle of the night?" You muttered to yourself.
Battat stared blankly at you, swallowing the rest of his words, then lowered his head to speed up his eating, swallowing the tears that were about to fall. He thought, unless it's necessary, it's better not to cry in front of you.
Although he was a bit moved by what you said, if he cried at a time like this, wouldn't that just ruin the mood......
You sat across from him, picked up a glass of milk, took a sip, and after a moment of slow thought, added, "Ah, remember to drink milk. I remember it's good for sleep, so I hope you sleep better...... Look at you, you've got dark circles under your eyes these past few days. When are you planning to change jobs?" You couldn't help but complain, but you still respect Battat's choice. If he doesn't want to switch jobs, then forget it.
Battat didn't say anything, just picked up the glass of milk and took a big gulp. After finishing this late-night snack, you quickly tidied up the dishes and planned to clean them up the next day. Then, after washing up, you changed into your pajamas and collapsed onto the bed with Battat.
Tbc.

title: Coffee Cup 22 (Extra 2) - Battatx You
content:
That day, he went to work as usual and went home after work. Even though he hadn't done much, Battat still felt exhausted. Maybe he sped up to finish those tasks so he wouldn't have to work overtime. It turned out he could leave work early and received envious, jealous looks from his colleagues, but...... He was exhausted too, feeling like he'd fall asleep on the floor in the next second, dragging his feet out in a daze. As for how his colleagues would see him, he didn't really care; he just couldn't wait to get home and see you, nothing more.
Just thinking of your smile made his tired steps, which had slowed down a bit, suddenly quicken at this moment. He was truly impatient. He wanted to go back and see you, to see your every smile, to hear your voice. Well, for Battat, this was just a brief break after a tiring day.
He pushed open the door, and you were still sitting on the sofa reading. Hearing the door open, you were startled and looked up at battat. After all, he did leave work early sometimes, but never as early as this day. Could it be because of working overtime recently? You couldn't help but start speculating, but you put down your book, quickly got up, walked over, took his briefcase, and set it aside, tilting your head to look at him: "Welcome home." ”
Battat finally felt a sense of relief when he saw you. He exhaled and smiled, nodding: "Mm, I'm back." ”
But he looked like he was just overworked...... After thinking it over, you took his hand and sat down on the sofa, complaining, "Oh no, you came back way too early today...... I haven't even prepared dinner yet, or maybe you can just skip the plate and eat takeout directly." You couldn't help but laugh again. You know, recently you'd deliberately prepared dinner just when Battat was about to go home. After all, you didn't want to be caught just ordering takeout. It wasn't awkward, but it still felt a bit embarrassing.
"But since it's rare to be back early today, let's sit on the sofa for a while before going for dinner...... You look exhausted from the whole day, so take a break. I didn't have many customers today, so I closed early and went home. Speaking of which, the coffee shop has had a few more regulars recently, which is great. Looks like more and more customers will get to know my coffee shop......" you muttered to yourself, pulling Battat to sit on the sofa and couldn't help but start sharing your day's trivial matters. In short, you can say anything—from simply clicking into a funny page full of ads when your phone malfunctions, or developing a new coffee product to give Battat a try, to saying you heard your fiancé's company recently went bankrupt and your fiancé was sent to a mental hospital. It feels like he might not be able to get out for a long time, maybe forever.
Battat just quietly gazes at your face. Honestly, he's exhausted—so tired that he doesn't want to speak at all, and so tired that he doesn't want to hear others' voices. But when he sees your mouth opening and closing, hearing your clear voice, he doesn't want you to stop. His soul only feels calm in that moment, or maybe...... Even if it's just trivial matters that probably no one wants to know, he wants to know and listen to you. Of course, he won't tire of you.
He just stared at your face, then suddenly said, "I like you." "Battat didn't understand this either; it was just an impulse in his heart, just a sudden suddenness. He wanted to tell you everything he was feeling, but all those surging emotions eventually boiled down to just four simple words—just four words that could sum up all his feelings."
So Battat just said, I like you.
You were stunned for a moment, and halfway through your sentence, you instinctively froze. You scratched your face, unable to hide the flushed blush spreading across your face. Your eyes darted around nervously, not knowing where to look. In short, you didn't dare look at Battat: "Why are you suddenly saying things like that...... Ah, I like you too! I really like you! ”
You said that last sentence out loud, even though you can't figure out why you did it—probably just suddenly feeling shy.
"I like you too, I like you the most." Battat quickly added, probably feeling that wasn't enough, and even added a 'most' comment. After saying this, he lowered his head and didn't dare look at you anymore, even feeling embarrassed for himself. Oh my god, why did he blurt out that sentence just now? Has it turned into some kind of mutual confession now? It's not that he doesn't like hearing that, he just thinks...... He just thought, oh my god, do you really need to do this?
You blinked, lowered your head, and didn't dare look at his face anymore. Maybe it was just to hide the blush on your face, or maybe you were afraid that if you saw Battat again, you wouldn't be able to say a word. You don't even know why you're doing this event now.
Anyway, you take a deep breath and add, "I only like you, you the most." Mm...... You could say I only love you, but that sounds a bit strange, as if I once loved someone else......" At this point, you couldn't help but laugh.
You don't forget to add, "Ah, anyway, I've never liked anyone else. I just gave my love to you." You didn't feel guilty about saying this, since you really did do it.
Battat's eyes darted away, but in the end, he slowly raised his head to look at you, meeting your sparkling, smiling eyes. Though his cheeks were shy, you couldn't help but feel a light sense of joy, as if your whole soul was delighted, and his heart was racing at that moment. In short, you couldn't wait to hear Battat say more...... Or perhaps, you just couldn't wait to do something else?
You don't know either, but at least for now, you still wish you could hear something more, even though before you hear it, your ears are burning hot and red.
Battat swallowed hard, but finally looked away, not daring to meet your gaze. He really was about to hesitate, not knowing what he was saying: "Mm...... I only love you. I've devoted my whole life to you. I will always love you......
Hearing this, you couldn't help but pat your face. Well, the heat on your cheeks just wouldn't go down...... Your heart was pounding and wouldn't stop, so you could only look at Battat with a hint of complaint, even though after that was filled with joy, and you thought Battat probably couldn't see your eyes.
So in the end, you just cleared your throat: "Alright. So I love you." After saying that, you probably couldn't hold back, or maybe you just didn't want to hear what he said next. You just felt this was enough, so you should just shut his mouth. So after saying that, you kissed him.
Just then, Battat looked up too. He was too shy and didn't want to hear any more. After all, his heart was beating too fast, and he couldn't control it. He was afraid it would break from beating so fast, so he thought, maybe a kiss could shut your mouth, so he looked up too.
So your lips met, and you widened your eyes slightly as you looked at Battat's tightly shut eyes and his hand holding your head nervously and awkwardly, and in the end, you closed your eyes.
So in that moment, you were simply immersed in the soft yet somewhat cool sensation, like a quiet and desolate lake. But when you reached deep into the water, you could feel an inner raging whirlwind. At least, that's what you thought before being kissed until you were dizzy. You were even a bit surprised, not knowing how Battat suddenly learned so much......
But there are times when you let go, so after this kiss, both Battat and you blushed and turned their heads away, not daring to look at each other for a moment. You just hurriedly spoke, pretending to be busy, and stood up: "Ah...... Ah, the takeout should be arriving. I'll go get ready first! ”
"Alright, thank you for your hard work." Battat replied stiffly. Out of the corner of his eye, he watched you walk away, then pressed his hands to his face and quietly buried his head in his knees. It would probably take him a while to fully wake up.
For dinner, you poured milk into two coffee cups as usual. This time, you didn't bother to plate it and simply served it in a takeout box, then you invited Battat over to eat. He finally calmed down and finished the dinner face to face with you, without mentioning what had just happened.
As for the taste of dinner, Battat didn't really care about that. After all, if you were willing to prepare dinner for him, it was already good enough, maybe even pleasantly surprised. In short, having takeout was better than eating fast food every day.
And he probably knows that preparing a lavish dinner is exhausting for you, or rather, tiring for everyone, and Battat doesn't want you to be so exhausted. If you have extra time, it's better to do more of your own things, even though you probably don't mind that.
After all, you'll definitely say that what battat does is exactly what you want to do...... Well, then you mutter to yourself that this sentence is probably not quite right, and tell battats not to cause any ambiguity. Of course, he knows exactly what you mean, and precisely because he knows, he never brings it up.
But after dinner, Battat sat back down on the sofa, as if he had exhausted all his strength, looking like he didn't want to do anything. You looked at him worriedly and said, "If you really feel tired, Battat, should you go back to sleep first?" ”
And he just waves his hand, leans back on the sofa, and tells you not to need it.
You hesitate for a moment, then sit on the sofa, reading the book you hadn't finished before, while Battat sits right next to you, his head pressed against yours, probably reading as well.
But after an unknown amount of time, you felt a heaviness on your shoulder. When you turned your head, you realized it was Battat who had somehow fallen asleep leaning on your shoulder.
You hesitated for a moment. Fortunately, the weather wasn't too cold, and the house was warm and windless, so you wouldn't catch a chill if you fell asleep here. But you gently laid him down, leaning him on your lap, letting him continue sleeping. Battat was clearly very tired and hadn't woken up, while you just gently lowered your head, kissed his forehead, and went back to reading your book.
But after reading for about an hour, you yawned, feeling a bit sleepy, and your mind was a bit unsettled while reading. Maybe putting down the book and resting for a while was the best choice. Then you lowered your head hesitantly to glance at the still-sleeping battat, then at the clock hanging on the wall. It was still before nine o'clock at night!
So you put down your book with peace of mind, reminding yourself to take a nap for a while, then lean back on the sofa and close your eyes, and soon fall asleep too.
When Battat woke up rubbing his eyes, it took him two or three seconds to realize he was resting on your lap. Instinctively, his face flushed, and he hurriedly got up, only to find you were already asleep. He glanced at the clock hanging on the wall—it was about a little past ten, not very early. Battat couldn't just let you keep sleeping here.
He hesitated for a moment, but finally bent down slightly, one arm wrapped around your leg and the other around your neck, carefully lifting you up, hoping not to disturb your sleep. Of course, you slept well, showing no sign of waking up. Battat took a deep breath, his steps light and light, trying not to make a sound, then walked to your bedroom and laid you on the bed.
Around ten o'clock, it was almost time to sleep, so after putting you on the bed, he gently crawled down beside you and lay down.
But you were a bit awake when you were put on the bed, or maybe you were just about to fall asleep again. You glanced at battat lying beside you, rolled over in a daze, hugged him, and muttered, "I love you, battat. Good night." ”
He's now with his back to you, so you can't see his sudden blushing face; you can only hear his stammering voice: "I love you too...... Good night. ”
You closed your eyes again with peace of mind, soon fell back asleep, and had a pleasant dream.
In your dream, you wander in that clear lake, cool and moist, yet not damp—just refreshing. Then, holding the crescent moon reflected in the lake, embracing the stars and raindrops flowing down, you fall into deep darkness once again.
The moonlight is truly beautiful.
