title: Coffee Cup 23 (Extra 3) - Battatx You
content:
Time passed quickly. At least while you were still missing the leisure time, Battat had a fairly long vacation, so he spent most of his time cooped up at home. It's not that you don't want him to take holidays or want him to keep working and relax; you just like the moments when no one cares about you and you can just throw things around. So now, for once, you nervously placed the book you had just finished reading and wanted to throw on the sofa on the nearby bookshelf.
Battat was leisurely sipping a cup of coffee at the dining table. Seeing this, he couldn't help but laugh: "Ah...... Maybe you don't need to be so formal. You can just tidy up the things left here later. There's no rush. But looking at it this way, the house really does seem a bit messy......" he said, glancing around involuntarily.
You scratched your head and smiled awkwardly: "Well...... It's just that some things weren't put away properly before. If you want, I can put them away right now...... You probably still remember exactly where you put your things, so it's not too difficult to tidy up right now.
Battat glanced at you hesitantly: "...... Are you sure? Otherwise, let's pack up together later. We just haven't decided what to do today...... Besides, running the coffee shop every day is actually very tough, so of course it can't be compared to my work. ”
You waved your hand: "Sure, definitely! I'll get ready soon. As for you, since it's a rare holiday, just rest well. I won't trouble you!" You declared solemnly, hands on hips.
Battat couldn't help but laugh: "Ah...... Actually, it doesn't really matter. Organizing things together may be a pretty tedious thing, but as long as I'm with you, it becomes even more interesting. Plus, just organizing things may be monotonous, but it can calm my mind. ”
"That actually makes sense. It's just that doing these things alone is too boring, so I don't want to do them. But since you're here now, I guess my motivation has gotten a bit higher...... You muttered, picking up the books from the TV counter, then putting them back on the shelf, picking up the boxes you'd thrown on the coffee table one by one, stacking them together, and putting them back on the TV counter. Then you gathered the sanitary pads you had casually tossed on the coffee table and put them into a small box to place on the table...... You cleared your throat twice, and after only doing a little something, you started putting your hands on your hips and thinking you were impressive. Unable to resist, you turned around and sat down on the sofa again, slumping against the backrest.
You let out a long sigh and dragged out your words: "Ah—so tired—working is so exhausting—"
"Are you tired just like this...... How about we go together later? I'm almost finished drinking anyway. "Battat said, then simply finished the last sip of coffee, then put down his cup and walked over to the sofa, sitting down beside you. His hands rested obediently on the sofa, tilting his head to look at you. For some reason, you found him just incredibly cute like this. So you couldn't help but laugh, finally sitting up straight, and then leaned in to kiss Battat on the cheek.
"Why did you suddenly kiss me...... Battat didn't react either. Instinctively, he covered his face and turned his head a bit, blushing as he asked softly.
You just tilted your head: "Yeah, because I suddenly thought you were cute and liked you, I couldn't help but kiss you!" As you spoke, you waved your finger in a gesture. Clearly, you felt there was nothing wrong with you.
Battat couldn't help but sigh, "Ah...... I like you too. No, isn't this just like that day! Don't keep talking!" As he spoke, he suddenly turned his head. Seeing you still about to speak, he steeled himself and kissed her decisively. Well, he knew exactly what you were about to say next; he just didn't want to hear......
After all, if you keep listening, the result will still be the same. It's better to let everything end before it happens, so he chose to silence you first, and that would be fine. Uh, but maybe it's just that he just wants to kiss.
You blinked, but luckily this kiss was just a superficial touch, like a dragonfly skimming the water, and didn't continue. So you just tilted your head and looked at battat: "Alright, I won't continue...... Uh, then in that case, shall we tidy up the living room first? "Actually, your face is flushed now, and your speech is a bit stammering. You might as well pat your cheeks and feel the warmth on your face finally fade away."
Even though you did these things under Battat's gaze...... But he's the real culprit! So it's understandable that you did all this! Thinking of this, you felt justified again, even though you only gave Battat a guilty glare.
Battat bit his lip, glanced around the living room, took a deep breath, and finally nodded: "Alright, let's tidy up the living room first...... But at first glance, it doesn't seem like much to tidy up, but our habits are still a bit different, so there are some things I need to change. "You two stand up together. You watch as Battat walks over to the bookshelf first, then puts the book on the shelf—hmm, probably just stuffed it in after you finished. He arranges the books in order of height and size, top and bottom, placing books from one country on one shelf, and if it's just a few rare ones, he puts them on the other side. Just looking at them like this is instantly lifting.
So you seem to understand, rubbing your chin thoughtfully: "Could it be...... Do you actually have OCD? Then it's hard for you to stay in such a messy environment before......" At this point, you couldn't help but laugh awkwardly.
"No obsessive-compulsive disorder...... I just think this looks a bit better. I think maybe the way you act like that is just your habit, maybe also a kind of artistic beauty. It's just that we might recognize different kinds of art. "Battat explained seriously to you.
"Hmm, that's true. Actually, I think it's pretty nice that way sometimes...... Uh, not that I just leave a book on the coffee table after reading." You scratched your head awkwardly, and Battat couldn't help but laugh.
"Actually, just putting it around casually isn't a big deal. As long as you remember to tidy up later, it's fine, or you're willing to spend extra time tidying up...... "Battat was still very serious, sounding like he was making up for you."
You just shook your head: "You don't need to make up for me. It's fine to just toss things around occasionally, but the real worry is that I might just throw them away and never put them back later. But if it's placed in a fixed place, even if it's not where it should be, it's actually quite convenient to pick it up." As you spoke, you couldn't help but pick up the floral tea bag that had just been on the coffee table and tidied up, preparing to take it to the kitchen.
"Hmm...... Convenience and tidiness are indeed a question worth exploring. Maybe it's better for you to access conveniently, but in this case, just being tidy but not convenient at all could actually cause trouble...... Maybe we can change the layout? "Battat pondered for a moment, then suggested.
You were actually startled by him. Watching him tidy up the medicine boxes, putting the same color together and stacking different colors by height, he answered your question as he sorted it out, as if lost in thought.
So you can't help but start thinking about this question: "Ah...... Change the layout? Wouldn't this be a hassle? Honestly, it's not good if two people have different habits, right? And you have to figure out how to accommodate the other's habits—that's such a hassle...... You mutter, feeling that living together isn't so bad.
While you were still deep in thought, you felt a pair of hands cupping your cheeks, and following the force, you lifted your head. What you saw was battat's serious expression, and you couldn't help but pause for a moment.
"What...... What's wrong? "You couldn't help but feel a bit guilty when you asked that.
"It's only been a while of living together, and you're already complaining about it? I've specifically looked into it. Getting married or living together is a process of adapting to each other's habits...... You can't just enjoy the sweetness of love and ignore life......" His voice sounded a bit helpless, and so did his expression, but you could still see a sense of seriousness and seriousness in it.
So you instinctively retort, "I didn't ...... I'm paying attention to life too...... Although you feel increasingly guilty as you talk. You're the type who really dislikes wasting time, so you're willing to spend more time organizing things for a battat. But if both of you suddenly have to change your habits or something, you feel uncomfortable and feel like it's a hassle.
"Is marriage something that requires changes from both sides?" So you can't help but ask, and then fall into deep thought. After all, the idea of marriage before was just an uncontrollable feeling; you haven't even looked into what to do after marriage.
Battat couldn't help but rub your face: "Of course. Only then can we live together like family. If we don't change because of this, once that love fades a bit, all that's left is habitual quarrels." Although being able to accept and adapt to each other's habits is probably part of marriage......
You're starting to speak a bit unclearly: "Alright." But I think love won't fade anytime soon, right? Why are you always worried about these things...... And since accepting your partner's habits is also a formality, I don't think we need to change them! ”
“…… You really are, forget it. Aren't you willing to spend a little time on me?" Battat couldn't help but chuckle. He couldn't quite put his mind into what he was feeling at that moment, but looking into your sparkling eyes staring at him, he couldn't help but lower his head and kiss your forehead.
You couldn't help but let out a long "Hey," then eagerly replied, "Of course I'm willing to spend time on you, as long as it takes. I don't care about that!" "If you really care, you wouldn't spend time just to arrange the plates; you'd just let Battat go home for takeout." Of course, although I've already explained the answer to this question last time, you'll still spend time and effort designing the plating afterwards, which is probably very interesting to you as well.
"Hmm...... Let me think, it's actually not that troublesome, just changing part of the layout. For example, the flower tea you just brought in—if it's convenient and you want to drink it every day, then placing it on the living room coffee table makes sense too, because it's very convenient. "Battat said as he pulled you back onto the sofa.
You rubbed your chin, then suddenly understood: "Oh oh oh...... So, you don't really need to change anything, it's just that there are some things I need to discuss with you? "You feel like you roughly understand what battat means. You thought you actually needed to create another common habit, which made you worry for a long time.
"Of course, it's just some shared rules. There's no need to change our habits or anything. As long as we both feel comfortable, that's enough. As for everything else, there's no need to worry too much. Anyway, no outsiders visit our home, and even if they do, they won't comment much. If they really say something, I'd think those people are just talking." Battat said, shaking his head helplessly.
"That's actually true...... I get it, so some books should still be placed on the TV counter. After all, if they were all on the bookshelf, I'm afraid I'd forget. "You nodded thoughtfully, said this, then got up and walked over to the bookshelf to start picking up books.
You pull out books you were interested in but hadn't had time to read, resulting in several empty spaces on the bookshelf—damaged ones, with books beside them toppled and tilted, creating another messy yet orderly scene.
Just like when you enter Battat's life now, although it catches him off guard, he is happy to break some ingrained habits for you.
Then you stack the books you pulled out and place them on the TV counter according to their height. You also learn exactly how battats are made, and honestly, this does make it much more comfortable.
So you put your hands on your hips, happily admiring your achievement, then turn around and give battat a thumbs-up: "Ah...... It's really great, now both of us can feel comfortable! But you are precious to me in itself, so the time I spend only makes you more precious to me. "You can't help but laugh as you say this.
Battat couldn't help but laugh too, nodding gently: "Yes, you're precious to me too." ”
End.

title: Coffee Cup 24 (Extra 4) - Battatx You
content:
After some time, you finally decided to get married—though that might not be quite right, since you were just planning to hold a wedding ceremony on top of that. If you don't hold it, it will seem too shabby, and no one around will know, losing any sense of ceremony.
So you still plan to hold a wedding ceremony on Halloween. But before that, you first need to prepare wedding dresses and such...... Getting a whole set is quite troublesome. Of course, the wedding will definitely be held inside a church, not somewhere else.
So you finally have some free time on weekends to pick out wedding dresses, and also plan to take wedding photos or something. Think about printing out the photos and hanging them on the wall...... Hmm, you even think your idea is really great!
So you and Battat picked out ready-made dresses at the bridal shop, because if it were custom-made, you wouldn't have any inspiration at all. In the end, you picked a dress with flowers at the waist, strings of pearls hanging from the hem, and a wedding dress with stars and flowers hanging from it. As for the wedding suits...... Actually, there wasn't much difference; you just picked a white set for Battat and enthusiastically pushed him to change.
You happily said, "I think this set will look great. Go try it on!" "That suit also has a little flower on the pin on the chest!" You think these two outfits are just perfect.
Battat was helpless and went to the dressing room to change, and you enthusiastically put on that wedding dress—hmm, perfect! You even spun around in front of the mirror several times, happily admiring the outfit, feeling it suited you perfectly. In short, you thought the outfit looked amazing.
When Battat came out, you couldn't wait to step forward and grab his hand, excitedly asking, "What do you think of my outfit?" "Saying that, you spun around in front of Battat again.
Battat's face instinctively flushed red. He coughed twice and turned away, his voice stammering: "Ah...... Ah, very beautiful!" Saying this, he still didn't turn to look at you.
"If you think I'm good-looking, why don't you turn your head to look at me? That means you don't actually like me that much." You pouted and said that on purpose, but you know battat was just shy—you saw him blushing. Even though we're already married, he's so shy now. You always think teasing him is a fun thing.
"Of course I like it...... It's more like I like it so much that I want to save it for the wedding day to slowly appreciate it. If I finish by now, won't there be nothing left to see? I have to keep some beauty and suspense." "Battat coughed twice but still didn't turn to look at you, but he was seriously explaining to you."
You paused for a moment, but your face couldn't help but turn red. Battat's face wasn't blushing anymore, but now it was yours who blushed, so you could only stammer, "Ah...... Well, this...... Actually, it's okay to look more at it now. Maybe you'll think I'm better looking later, or maybe the experience feels different for two times. "As you spoke, you patted your face again, cleared your throat twice, and decided not to dwell on this issue any further.
"Alright, in that case, let's go take wedding photos!" You suggested excitedly.
Battat had no objections. In fact, he really wanted to take photos with you, and now he couldn't help but watch your back. His gaze followed your shadow, he was watching you, and you were completely unaware, just pulling him along to pick out the wedding pose together.
But looking at those photos, he barely managed to laugh out loud. After all, he still has good manners and wouldn't laugh out loud easily. You don't have so many concerns and burst out laughing at those photos.
"Hey...... Oh my god, what kind of amazing pose are these? I know what they're trying to show, but this photo is just too funny...... You laugh as you say this, almost breathless, pointing at a sample photo above.
I don't even know how that example photo was taken, but the woman sat quietly in the man's hand. Maybe the photoshopping wasn't very good, but it actually made the picture look quite funny. Although you know it's probably meant that the woman is the man's treasured person...... Well, you can't help but laugh.
Battat lowered his gaze to look at another photo. Hmm, it was somewhat normal, but probably not quite that normal—why did they have to shoot it like a beauty and a beast? And they actually made the man look like a beast, making the woman stay next to the beast, and the beast was still wearing a suit......
You saw that photo too and laughed so hard you could barely straighten up. Battat could only helplessly pat your back: "Alright, I know those photos are really funny...... Why don't we just take a photo in the simplest pose......" He couldn't help but laugh as he spoke, though not as hard as you are.
But before he could finish, you interrupted him. You just waved your hand to signal him not to continue, and then you straightened up and stopped laughing so exaggeratedly, even though you were still covering your mouth to laugh.
Then you pointed to the photo you just saw, and said resolutely and firmly, "No, I want this pose. Don't you think it's actually fun?" I think we should give it a try...... Ah, although taking photos like this in wedding photos might be funny, it's fine, as long as I can't see it. And if one day I'm in a bad mood, just looking at this photo will lift my spirits...... You can't help but laugh even louder.
Battat was helpless and ultimately let your thoughts go. He didn't care what kind of photo he took anyway...... Well, as long as you don't laugh so loudly when you see the finished photo. But actually, he laughed loudly when he saw that photo too.
So he thought that maybe one day when he was in a bad mood, looking at this photo would lift his mood as well.
Hmm...... Probably, in fact, feeling better might simply be because I saw you.
After that, you both ordered wedding dresses, booked a church, and had to find ways to send invitations to your colleagues at battat. Compared to that, you didn't have much to invite, since you'd already notified your company. Come if you want.
"By the way, I'm planning to personally hand out those invitations at your company." You said enthusiastically. You even specially designed invitations for this, but didn't write your names because you didn't know the names of those colleagues. You just planned to hand them out yourself.
Battat actually looked a bit troubled by this: "Isn't that a bit inappropriate...... Besides, you don't even know my colleagues. I'll just hand them out...... He didn't really want those pippins to see you and then loudly call you the boss's wife or something. That would be a social death! Although this statement is indeed true now, social death is social death; it's impossible to change the nature of this kind of thing so easily......
You shook your head disapprovingly: "No, I think it's more polite and respectful for us to do this together. Besides, you're busy with work, so I'll just go over and send invitations myself, and get to know your colleagues and stuff. After all, last time I saw those little guys, it was pretty fun." You couldn't help but laugh as you spoke. Battat thought your last sentence was the real point, so he could only look at you helplessly.
"You mean those red pippins...... There's nothing wrong with them—they just love gambling, scam more money, and talk nonsense...... "Battat knew exactly what bad things were about those pippins, since when he was playing Mike, he could often hear Tenna complaining.
"Hmm...... That's not so bad, right? Much better than some of our company's employees. I think as long as you don't skip work and can complete your assigned tasks on time, you're considered a good employee. "You said this casually.
"Saying they don't skip work isn't quite right...... Wait, how did this suddenly come up? Weren't we just talking about the invitation a moment ago? Anyway, I think I just need to send out invitations...... "Battat said, covering his forehead because he felt a bit of a headache.
You looked at him disapprovingly: "Alright, I said I'll go, so I'll go. And I figured it out—if you go, you definitely won't invite a single person! So I'll go anyway—I'm going to invite all your other colleagues! Of course, except for your boss." You couldn't help but laugh as you spoke.
"Ah, alright then...... Then let's go. I don't think our boss has a rule that forbids employees' family members from coming to the company." So battat couldn't help but laugh too.
You got battat's permission, so you couldn't help but start humming. The next morning, as usual, the coffee was ready. But this time, after finishing the coffee, you didn't part ways and headed in either direction, but both headed to TV World, where battat was located. Honestly, you even closed the café just so you could invite all the employees to the wedding for battat's company today.
So you eagerly followed Battat to TV World. To be honest, this was your first time visiting Battat's company, so you inevitably slowed your pace. You must be a bit curious...... You also want to know what kind of work he usually does.
So Battat went to his desk first. Before leaving, he turned his head uneasy to glance in your direction, then found you happily chatting with other pippins, which left Battat speechless.
…… He shouldn't have worried about you. He clearly knows that with your personality, you can do well anywhere. Thinking this, Battat started to spit on himself. On one hand, he couldn't help but feel a bit bitter because of your actions, even though he knew you probably hadn't done anything—just handing someone an invitation.
However...... Still, it's normal to feel a bit jealous because of this. Even though it was his first time experiencing it, Battat was surprised to know what it was—he just felt jealous when he saw your behavior, and you were so absorbed in sending invitations that you didn't even have time to notice him.
So Battat had no choice but to walk to his workstation, feeling disappointed but pretending to be strong, and start his work for the day.
And you really do have a great time chatting with those pippins, but don't have time to pay attention to the battat. When you remember your husband and instinctively look up, all you can see is his back sitting at his desk.
So you pause for two seconds, decide not to interfere with the battat's work, and lower your head to continue the conversation with those pippins.
"Speaking of which, we're planning to get married on Halloween—here's our wedding invitation, for you guys. I don't know exactly how many pippins there are. If there are many, I'll send out more invitations......" You said this as you sent dozens of invitations to the pippins gathered around you.
And they jumped up and down happily: "The boss's wife is so wonderful! That's enough. If we didn't have an invitation, we'd definitely go mooch a meal and drink!" Those pippins said this in unison, and you couldn't help but laugh.
"Ah, that's fine too. Anyway, we're having the whole place to ourselves that day, so we can order whatever we want to eat or drink!" You announce this, and the pippins start cheering, dragging their invitations and leaving.
Then you send the invitation to those shadow guys who are holding saxophones and playing some unknown tune. They shake hands with you one by one, and although they can't speak, they look exceptionally happy. After shaking hands, they happily take the invitations and run off one by one.
You sent the invitations to Zapper again. You remembered these guys too, came to the café with Battat that day, hopping around on the thugs your fiancé hired. You vowed to send all the invitations to them, even to the weather couple you'd never met—though you don't know why they suddenly hugged and cried, muttering something you couldn't quite understand.
But you didn't really mind. You just counted the two invitations left, thinking about who you hadn't sent yet. Then you saw Battat suddenly poke his head out from his desk and whispered to you, "Come with me to a place." He waved his hand at you.
A bit confused, but you still follow Battat over. He leads you around a few times, left and right, and finally stops at an office door. When you open the office, there's a Zapper and a Shadow guy sitting on the sofa, looking like they're eating chips. Hearing the door open, you instinctively hide the chips.
You suddenly realize that the remaining two invitations are meant for this place. Just say you asked Battat in advance how many colleagues he had, and the quantity would definitely be reliable! So you stepped forward first and handed those two invitations to Zapper and Shadow Guy.
They accepted the invitation, excited, and started winking at Battat. Battat sighed, shook his head, and deliberately ignored that they were just eating chips. Then he cleared his throat and spoke seriously: "Alright, hurry up and change your clothes. The show is about to start, and if Tenna can't find Mike, she'll get mad at us again." He said this with a full stream of resentment.
They gave Battat a crooked salute and left. Then Battat took out a set of clothes from a nearby cabinet. You might think that was probably Mike's, so you couldn't help but ask, "So Mike has three people?" ”
“…… Yes, the three of us played together, but we wouldn't appear at the same time. After all, we didn't know what Mike looked like, so we had to design it this way. "Battat explained as he pulled his clothes on, his voice a bit heels from the headpiece. You can notice, to avoid revealing the ring, he just took it off and hung it around his neck—of course, inside that leather suit.
You scratched your chin. Since you'd already sent out invitations and had nothing else to do, you simply followed battat: "In that case, you can just ignore it and switch jobs...... I've said before, anyone who discriminates against you just because of your status isn't a good company." You said seriously.
Battat's voice was helpless even through the hood: "I want to too, but the two guys I dragged along to be Mike are still here. What will they do if I leave......" He sounded a bit irritable.
So you let out a long 'oh': "Ah...... I see, you're actually just worried about others. If you ask me, you're just overthinking things. You should always think about yourself first...... You muttered to yourself. You muttered to yourself. Now you were backstage, and you noticed his collar was a bit crooked—probably because he was in a hurry when getting dressed, so you couldn't help tidying it up.
Then you smiled: "But if you think that's good, then maybe it's pretty good too!" Ahem, anyway, if you like it, that's the best...... Hmm, don't worry about my opinion! It's almost time for the performance, so I won't stay the day after tomorrow and will head back to the lounge first...... "You wave goodbye to battat, and battat waves back with the microphone to say goodbye to you."
Then you head toward the lounge.
Tenna happened to witness this scene, and couldn't help but fall into deep thought. In fact...... TV World really didn't stop family members from coming and going. Even though you're not an employee here, Tenna just saw you on the other end of the lounge. You're sending invitations to pippins, and those pippins still call you boss's wife. Now he saw you tidying Mike's clothes again. Tenna hesitated, but he didn't know who the pippins were talking about as boss.
So he just walked over and said, "Congratulations on getting married." He stood in front of Battat.
Battat was startled, but finally snapped out of it and hurriedly said, "Ah, thank you for the congratulations! But there's no time to lose—let's get ready to start airing the show right away!" ”
“…… Aren't you going to invite me to see the venue?" Tenna walked out, took a few steps, then turned back to look at Battat.
…… Sigh, I shouldn't have let you follow me backstage. No, in the end, all of this really is Tenna's fault. Battat simply vented his frustration on Tenna.
"Ah...... Um, our invitations have just been sent out! Without invitations, you can't get into our wedding venue, and we're about to get married. There's no time to reprint them, since those invitations are all gilded...... battat spoke rapidly, wanting to quickly dismiss Tenna's idea. Please...... He definitely didn't want the boss to go to the wedding, and if he did, his identity would be exposed!
And he wasn't lying. Those invitations were indeed gilded, and you prepared them for a long time before printing them—probably a little over a week.
"Oh...... Alright then, I can only offer you my congratulations. I'll give you a day off today. Go home and rest well—after all, you're getting married. "Tenna said.
Battat could hardly believe it—could a boss really be this easy to talk to? He walked out with his hands and feet back to Mike's office. You'd already been back in the lounge to rest, so Battat took off his clothes, feeling the joy and joy of having a holiday at least for today, and returned to the lounge. When he got back, he spotted you at a glance—you were sitting on the lounge sofa, bored, playing games.
When you see Battat arrive, you happily wave your hand: "I'm here!" ”
After saying that, you were a bit puzzled again: "Hey...... Why are you back so soon? Did the show end quickly? "If you remember, a show should last at least one or two hours, but it's only a little over ten minutes. You're already prepared to wait here for two hours for your gaming buddy."
"The boss thought Mike was getting married, so he took a day off...... So I came back. He probably saw the wedding invitation you just sent and how you were helping me get dressed backstage. But it's not bad, at least it's a day off...... "Battat sits next to you, leaning against you, whispering these things to you."
You listen, nodding, but couldn't help but shake your head: "That's not right...... It's just one day off?! Don't think it's nothing just because of this one day off...... you muttered.
"It doesn't really matter. The boss actually asked me for wedding invitations just now. That scared me. Luckily, I said I already sent them out and didn't have time......" he let out a breath.
“…… If he asks you, just tell him I'm unhappy about seeing the boss at the wedding—he doesn't even know me anyway." You frowned, not very happy. In the end, you picked up the other game console and handed it to battat.
"Perfect, I was just worried about having no one to play duo mode with me. Now come on, come on." You said happily, taking the opportunity to check to make sure no one was outside the lounge, then you leaned in and gave Battat a kiss.
Battat covered his face and whispered, "What are you doing now? Doing these things outside isn't really appropriate...... But he only complained a little, then turned on the game console.
You cleared the game smoothly—actually, you had a great time in sync and had a great time. So after the game ended, you put down your console and couldn't help but lean in and kiss your battat again: "This was so much fun...... Hehe, I like you playing games with me, not that I don't like you at other times. I just want to say I like you. ”
"Alright...... Why is this happening again? I like you too......" battat whispered, still covering his cheek, feeling really embarrassed, then quickly leaned in and kissed you on the cheek.
At this point, you all forgot to check outside to see if anyone was watching, so just as the show ended, Tenna, passing by, saw the scene through the lounge door and hesitated.
And there was still some time before he was completely off work and heading home. After saying goodbye, Battat returned to Mike's office to change clothes. After all, although the boss said it was a holiday, he was still quite dutiful and remembered that he had scheduled electric shock therapy for Tenna at that time!
So after he changed his clothes, he hurried over, and then battat noticed that tenna was about to speak but hesitated in his direction, and finally spoke: "You... your fiancé seems to have cheated before marriage? I just saw her in the lounge kissing another green pippins."
Battat almost lost his breath and started coughing. Oh my god, Tenna saw it again. How could such a coincidence happen? Well, maybe they just didn't pay much attention at the time. After all, they were having their fill and probably didn't think about it that much.
So he just cleared his throat twice: "This is a private matter between us as a couple, ah. Boss, you don't need to worry about it, I'll handle it properly." ”
He didn't ask any more questions. Only then did Battat quietly breathe a sigh of relief. Ah, luckily he didn't keep asking; if he meddled so much, he'd get tired of it too. Fortunately, time passed quickly, and it was time to get off work. Today, Battat went home with you. It was rare for you to walk back hand in hand, facing the sunset, stepping on each other's shadows, and nibbling on the same bunch of apple candies.
For the next period, work hasn't had any unexpected events, and for some reason, Battat always feels that work is much more relaxed than before, with fewer tasks to complete—especially with Mike's, since it's ...... Probably worried that his subordinate is getting married, Tenna feels embarrassed to assign so much work. In this regard, Battat is actually somewhat grateful that Tenna knows Mike is getting married. If he finds out it's just the green pippins under his command, he probably won't care about anything.
In short, time flies. The calendar book is torn open and flipped. Battat looks at the brand-new calendar, listens to your sudden mysterious voice, and realizes today is Halloween.
Normally, you should pick up the bride and then go to the church for the wedding, with a whole bunch of wedding cars. But since you two are living together, today is just a wedding ceremony, so there's no need for the wedding car. You just rode in the same car to the church. The church was already prepared, with all kinds of decorative decorations hanging on the walls, and even white doves fluttering. The light was just right, casting colorful shadows through the stained windows. Stepping on those colorful shadows, you walked hand in hand toward the high platform, where the priest was holding a cross in both hands, waiting for you to pass.
The pristine white seats on either side were now empty, except for some reason, some white rose petals had fallen on them. Faintly, you could hear the song "The Maiden's Prayer" playing, while you and Battat just exchanged a smile. He took your hand and walked to the stage, looking at each other. Yet, for once, you felt a bit shy about it.
The wedding venue began to open up, and it was time for the appointed time. So Nasi pippins, Zapper, and others squeezed in with invitations, happily claiming seats in the church. Seeing you and Battat standing on the high platform, they started to cheer around.
Battat couldn't help but feel even more embarrassed: "I told you, actually, it's just the two of us who can do it......"
You shook your head in disagreement: "I knew it, if you were to post invitations yourself, you definitely wouldn't invite a single person!" And it's all a make-up wedding ceremony...... Everyone should be watching, it's nice to be a little livelier. "At this point, you can't help but laugh.
So Battat couldn't help but laugh when he looked at you. He didn't know why he was laughing; maybe it was just because seeing you made that piece of his heart warm and sweet.
Besides the colleagues from battat, quite a few people from your company also came. Although you no longer manage the company, you hold the largest shares, so they should show you some respect. Besides, you're the heiress of this company.
They sit on the bench on the other side, applauding you.
The priest, acting as the master of ceremonies, began to preside over the wedding, and looked at Battat first.
"Are you willing to marry her as your wife? She will be your lifelong friend, partner, and my only true love. On this special day, before God, you will promise that in good times or bad, rich or poor, healthy or sick, happy or sorrowful, you will always be by her side as her husband. Love her wholeheartedly, be proud of her, respect her, do all you can to meet her needs, protect her in times of trouble, comfort her in sorrow, be faithful to her forever, cherish her forever. ”
"I'm willing." You heard him say that.
Then, the priest repeats the same sentence to you, and you happily say yes. Then, under the priest's watchful eye, you exchange rings.
You saw Battat start laughing, so you couldn't help but go over and hug him. Then, amid the cheers from the audience, you picked up an apple from the stage, took a bite, and placed it near Battat's mouth.
Although Battat's face was still flushed, he instinctively hugged you, caught you as you pounced on him, and then leaned in to bite the apple in your hand. He also knew what this apple meant today...... Or rather, what it meant, of course, the simplest meaning was peace and smoothness.
But before he could think further, he felt a warm, soft touch on his lips. Now it was Battat's wide-eyed expression, almost unable to react, watching your closed eyes, and in the end, he closed his eyes.
Then, amid the increasingly enthusiastic jeers from the audience, he carefully exchanges this kiss with you. In a mix of stickiness and sweetness, this pure white vow ends.
End.

title: Coffee Cup 25 (R18 Extra) - Battatx You
content:
That day, Battat still left work on time and went home. After arriving, he looked at the exquisitely plated pre-made dishes on your table—well, and two steaming cups of coffee.
Battat was somewhat curious. He sat down across from you, glanced down at the coffee cup, and casually asked, "Hmm...... What kind of coffee is this? It smells quite good. "After all, it really smells nice, with a fresh scent of flowers, fruits, and plants. There's hardly any bitterness, but rather a refreshing sweetness."

So you eagerly followed Battat to TV World. To be honest, this was your first time visiting Battat's company, so you inevitably slowed your pace a bit. You must be a bit curious...... You also wanted to know what kind of work he usually does.
So Battat went to his desk first. Before leaving, he uneasily turned his head to glance in your direction, then found you chatting happily with other Pippins, leaving Battat speechless.
…… He shouldn't have worried about you. He clearly knows that with your personality, you can do well anywhere. Battat thought this way and began to spit on himself. On one hand, he couldn't help but feel a bit bitter because of your behavior, even though he knew you probably hadn't done anything and were just handing someone an invitation.
However...... Still, feeling a bit bittersweet about it is somewhat normal. Even though it was his first time experiencing this, Battat was surprised to know what it was—he was just jealous when he saw your behavior, and you were so absorbed in sending invitations that you didn't even have time to notice him.
So Battat had no choice but to walk to his workstation, feeling disappointed but pretending to be strong, and began his work for the day.
And you do have a great time chatting with those Pippins, but you don't have time to pay attention to Battat. When you remember your husband and instinctively look up, all you see is his back sitting at his desk.
So you pause for two seconds and decide not to interfere with Battat's work, lowering your head to continue talking with those Pippins.
"Speaking of which, we're planning to get married on Halloween—here's our wedding invitation for you. I don't even know how many Pippins there are. If there are many, I'll send out more invitations......" You said this as you sent dozens of invitations to the Pippins gathered around you.
And they jumped up and down with joy: "The boss's wife is so wonderful! That's enough. If we didn't have an invitation, we'd definitely go mooch a meal and drink!" The Pippins said this in unison, and you couldn't help but laugh.
"Ah, that's fine too. Anyway, we're having the whole place to ourselves that day, so we can order whatever we want to eat or drink!" You announce this, and the Pippins start cheering, dragging their invitations and leaving.
Then you sent the invitations to those Shadow Guys who were holding saxophones and playing some unknown music. They shook hands with you one by one, and although they couldn't speak, they looked exceptionally happy. After shaking hands, they happily ran off with the invitations.
You sent the invitation to Zapper again. You remember these guys too, and that day you came to the café with Battat, hopping along with the thugs your fiancé hired. You were determined to send all the invitations to them, even to a weather couple you'd never met—though you don't know why they suddenly hugged and cried, muttering something you couldn't quite understand.
But you didn't really mind. You just counted the two invitations left, thinking about who you hadn't sent yet, and then you saw Battat suddenly poke his head out from his desk and whisper, "Come with me to a place." He waved at you.
A bit confused, but you still followed Battat over. He led you around a few times, left and right, and finally stopped at an office door. When you opened the office, Zapper and Shadow Guy were sitting on the sofa, seemingly eating chips. Hearing the door open, you instinctively hid the chips.
You suddenly realize that the remaining two invitations should be used here. Just say you asked Battat in advance how many colleagues he had, and the number of invitations would definitely be a safe one! So you stepped forward first and handed those two invitations to Zapper and Shadow Guy.
They accepted the invitation, excited, and started winking at Battat. Battat sighed, shook his head, and deliberately ignored that they were just eating chips. Then he cleared his throat and spoke seriously: "Alright, hurry up and change your clothes. The show is about to start, and if Tenna can't find Mike, she'll get angry with us again." As he said this, he was filled with resentment.
They gave Battat a crooked salute and left. Then Battat took out a set of clothes from a nearby cabinet. You might think that was probably Mike's, so you couldn't help but ask, "So Mike has three people?" ”
“…… Yes, the three of us played together, but we wouldn't appear together. After all, we didn't really know what Mike looked like, so we had to design it this way. "Battat explained as he put the clothes on himself. His voice became a bit muffled from the headpiece. You can notice, to avoid revealing the ring, he just took it off and hung it around his neck—of course, inside that leather suit.
You scratched your chin. Since you'd already sent out invitations and had nothing else to do, you simply followed Battat: "In that case, you can just ignore it and switch jobs...... I've said before, those who discriminate against you because of your status aren't really good companies." You said seriously.
Battat's voice was helpless even through the hood: "I want to do it too, but the two guys I dragged along to be Mike are still here. What will they do if I leave......" He even sounded a bit irritable.
So you let out a long 'oh': "Ah...... I see, you're actually just worried about others. If you ask me, you're just overthinking things. You should always think about yourself first...... You muttered to yourself. You muttered to yourself. Now you were backstage, and you noticed his collar was a bit crooked—probably because he was in a hurry when getting dressed, so you couldn't help tidying it up.
Then you smiled: "But if you think that's good, then maybe it's pretty good too!" Ahem, anyway, as long as you like it, that's the best...... Hmm, don't worry about my opinion! It's almost time for the performance, so I won't stay the day after tomorrow and will head back to the lounge first...... You wave goodbye to Battat, who waves his hand at the microphone and says goodbye to you.
Then you head toward the lounge.
This scene happened to be witnessed by Tenna, and he couldn't help but fall into deep thought. In fact...... TV World really didn't stop family members from coming and going. Even though you're not an employee here, Tenna just saw you on the other end of the lounge. You're sending invitations to Pippins, and those Pippins are still calling you 'boss's wife.' Now he's seeing you tidying Mike's clothes again. Tenna hesitates, but he doesn't know who the boss those Pippins are talking about is.
So he just walked over and said, "Congratulations on getting married." He stood in front of Battat.
Battat was startled, but finally snapped out of it and hurriedly said, "Ah, thank you for the congratulations! But there's no time to lose—let's get ready to start airing the show right away!" ”
“…… Aren't you going to invite me to see the scene?" Tenna walked out, took a few steps, then turned back to look at Battat.
…… Sigh, I shouldn't have let you follow me backstage. No, in the end, all of this really is Tenna's fault. Battat simply vented his frustration on Tenna.
"Ah...... Um, our invitations have just been sent out! Without invitations, you can't enter our wedding venue, and we're about to get married soon. There's no time to reprint them, since those invitations are all stamped with gold......" Battat spoke rapidly, wanting to quickly dismiss Tenna's idea. Please...... He definitely didn't want the boss to go to the wedding, and if he did, his identity would be exposed!
And he wasn't lying. Those invitations were indeed gilded, and you prepared them for a long time before printing them—probably a little over a week.
"Oh...... Alright then, I can only offer my congratulations to you. I'll give you a day off today. Go home and rest well—after all, you're getting married. "Tenna said.
Battat could hardly believe it—could a boss really be this easy to talk to? He walked out hand and foot in hand and back to Mike's office. You had already gone back to the lounge to rest, so Battat took off his clothes, feeling the joy and joy of having a sense of being on holiday for at least today, and returned to the lounge. When he got back, he immediately saw you—you were sitting on the lounge sofa, bored and playing games.
When you saw Battat arrive, you happily waved your hand: "I'm here!" ”
After saying that, you were a bit puzzled again: "Hey...... Why are you back so soon? Did the show end quickly? "If you remember, a show should last at least one or two hours, but it's only a little over ten minutes. You're already prepared to wait here for two hours for your gaming buddy."
"The boss thought Mike was getting married, so he took a day off...... So I came back. He probably saw the wedding invitation you just sent and how you were backstage helping me get dressed. But it's pretty good, at least it's a day off...... Battat sat next to you, whispering to you about these things.
You listen, nodding, but couldn't help but shake your head: "That's not right...... It's just one day off?! Don't think it's nothing just because of this one day off...... you muttered.
"It doesn't really matter. The boss actually asked me for wedding invitations just now. That scared me. Luckily, I said I already sent them out and didn't have time......" he let out a breath.
“…… If he asked, just tell him he wasn't happy to see the boss at the wedding, since he didn't even know me anyway. "You frowned, not very happy. In the end, you still picked up another game console and handed it to Battat.
"Perfect, I was just worried about having no one to play duo mode with me. Now come on, you come in." You said happily, checking to make sure no one was outside the lounge, then you leaned in and kissed Battat.
Battat covered his face and whispered, "What are you doing now? Doing these things outside isn't really appropriate...... But he only complained a little, then turned on the game console.
You cleared the game smoothly—actually, you had a great time in sync and had a great time. So after the game ended, you dropped the console and couldn't help but lean in and kiss Battat: "This was so much fun...... Hehe, I like you playing games with me, not that I don't like you at other times. I just want to say I like you. ”
"Alright...... Why are you like this again? I like you too......" Battat whispered, still covering his cheek, feeling really embarrassed, then quickly leaned in and kissed you on the cheek.
At this point, you all forgot to check outside to see if anyone was watching, so just as the show ended, Tenna, passing by, saw the scene through the lounge door and hesitated.
And there was still some time before completely getting off work and going home. After saying goodbye to you, Battat returned to Mike's office to change clothes. After all, even though the boss said it was a holiday, he was still fairly conscientious and remembered to schedule electric shock therapy for Tenna at this time!
So after changing, he hurried over. Then Battat noticed Tenna looking like she wanted to say something but kept hesitating before finally speaking: "Y-your fiancé seems to have cheated before marriage? I just saw her kissing another green Pippins in the lounge."
Battat almost lost it and started coughing. Good heavens, Tenna saw it too? What a coincidence! Well, perhaps they just didn’t pay much attention back then, since they were having fun and wouldn’t think too much about it.
So he just cleared his throat twice: "This is a private matter between us as a couple, ah. Boss, you don't need to worry about it, I'll handle it properly." ”
He didn’t ask any further. Battat quietly breathed a sigh of relief. Thankfully, he didn’t continue questioning; otherwise, he would have felt annoyed as well. Fortunately, time passed quickly, and it was finally time to get off work. Today, Battat was going home with you—a rare occasion. You held hands and walked back together, facing the sunset, stepping on each other’s shadows, sharing the same candy apple.
Work in the following period was without any unexpected issues, and for some reason, Battat felt that work was much lighter than before, with fewer tasks to complete, especially from Mike. After all… perhaps it was because he considered that his subordinate was getting married, and Tenna felt awkward assigning so much work. In this regard, Battat was somewhat grateful that Tenna knew that Mike was getting married. If he had only known that it was the green Pippins under him who was getting married, he probably wouldn’t have cared about anything.
In short, time flew by. The calendar flipped a page, and Battat looked at the new page, hearing your mysteriously playful voice and realizing that today was Halloween.
Normally, you should pick up the bride and then go to the church for the wedding, with a whole bunch of wedding cars. But since you two are living together, today is just a wedding ceremony, so there's no need for the wedding car. You just rode in the same car to the church. The church was already prepared, with all kinds of decorative decorations hanging on the walls, and even white doves fluttering. The light was just right, casting colorful shadows through the stained windows. Stepping on those colorful shadows, you walked hand in hand toward the high platform, where the priest was holding a cross in both hands, waiting for you to pass.
The pure white seats on either side were empty, but for some reason, some white rose petals had fallen onto them. Faintly, the tune of "A Maiden’s Prayer" could be heard playing. You and Battat exchanged smiles; he took your hand and walked onto the stage. Looking at each other, you both felt rare shyness.
The wedding venue started allowing people in as the scheduled time had arrived. Nashi Pippins and Zapper, among others, pushed in with invitations, joyfully occupying the church seats. Seeing you and Battat standing on the stage, they began to cheer.
Battat couldn't help but feel even more embarrassed: "I told you, actually, it's just the two of us who can do it......"
You shook your head in disagreement: "I knew it, if you were to post invitations yourself, you definitely wouldn't invite a single person!" And it's all a make-up wedding ceremony...... Everyone should be watching, it's nice to be a little livelier. "At this point, you can't help but laugh.
Battat couldn’t help but laugh as he looked at you. He didn’t know why he laughed—probably just because seeing you made his heart feel warm and sweet.
Besides Battat’s colleagues, many people from your company also came. Although you no longer managed the company, you held the largest share, so they had to show you some respect, and besides, you were the heiress of the company.
They sit on the bench on the other side, applauding you.
The priest acted as the officiant and began the ceremony, first looking at Battat.
"Are you willing to marry her as your wife? She will be your lifelong friend, partner, and my only true love. On this special day, before God, you will promise that in good times or bad, rich or poor, healthy or sick, happy or sorrowful, you will always be by her side as her husband. Love her wholeheartedly, be proud of her, respect her, do all you can to meet her needs, protect her in times of trouble, comfort her in sorrow, be faithful to her forever, cherish her forever. ”
"I'm willing." You heard him say that.
Then, the priest repeats the same sentence to you, and you happily say yes. Then, under the priest's watchful eye, you exchange rings.
You looked at Battat and began to smile, so you couldn’t help but step forward to hug him. Then, amidst the cheers from below, you picked up an apple from the stage, took a bite, and placed it near Battat’s mouth.
Although Battat's face was still flushed, he instinctively hugged you, caught you as you pounced on him, and then leaned in to bite the apple in your hand. He also knew what this apple meant today...... Or rather, what it meant, of course, the simplest meaning was peace and smoothness.
Before he could think further, he felt a warm, soft touch on his lips. This time, Battat’s eyes went wide; he was nearly unable to react, watching you close your eyes, and finally, he closed his own eyes as well.
Then, amid the increasingly enthusiastic jeers from the audience, he carefully exchanges this kiss with you. In a mix of stickiness and sweetness, this pure white vow ends.

You are a scavenger.
…… Although this name doesn't sound particularly grand, it still sounds a bit better than being called a scavenger or scavenger scavengers. You don't think being a scavenger is a bad thing. After all, many unemployed people who can't find a job survive by relying on treasures dug out of trash bins.
But you're different. If you work harder, set aside those little schemes, and work seriously and steadily, you can accumulate a fortune, but the price is probably endless toil day and night, premature illness, and a body that is already exhausted. And for you, most professional skills are actually easy to learn, which is rather boring, lacking challenge and fun. So, for the sake of getting something without effort, you decide to become a scavenger instead!
Well, after all, you really love money, and you genuinely enjoy the feeling of getting something for nothing. You don't feel ashamed of it; on the contrary, you take pride in it. After all, as long as you have money, you can easily get most of what you want. As long as you have money, you can even gain a fairly reputable status, but you just can't gain inner cultivation.
So today, you also squatted in some unknown, remote alley, rummaging around to see if you might suddenly discover something valuable, and then you pulled out a puppet.
You thought for a moment, looking at this dirty puppet...... And you're wearing glasses, huh? Although the clothes are dirty and messy, they actually look like a suit? You muttered to yourself, "Alright, this should be worth some money. Let's take it back first......"
Holding the puppet and tossing it to the ground, you carefully looked over the other items in the trash bin, making sure there was nothing else worth taking with you. Only then did you leave regretfully, pretending to be sad and wiping away tears that didn't exist.
"Hey...... Everyone is too cautious. Why can't they just accidentally drop some valuables...... "For example, a wallet filled with lots of money, or a small gold statue, or even a jade bracelet."
Unfortunately, today's dream of gaining something without effort still hasn't come true. Of course, you're not a thief—you still have some moral integrity and won't directly touch someone else's wallet.
Thinking this, you watched the puppet compose herself a bit. At least today you had gained a little! You hummed an off-key tune and carried the puppet home. Of course, you didn't notice the puppet's limbs twitching a few times, as if struggling.
Back home, the room was filled with your half-finished paintings hanging on the wall out of boredom, an electric guitar that had gathered dust in the corner for a long time, unfinished sheet music scattered on the coffee table, and a few pieces of clothing you had piled up on the bed that planned to be pieced together for further design.
You simply stepped over the oil paintbrushes and paint tubes rolling on the floor, looked at the dirty puppet and pondered for a moment, thinking that if you wanted to fetch a higher price, you had to dress it up properly...... Well, let's wash it clean first. You pick up a brush, turn on the faucet, planning to rinse it first and then use it to brush off all the dirt and mud. You even roll up your sleeves and put on rubber gloves.
Then you see the puppet you lifted to put into the sink start struggling violently, shaking its arms and legs, mixed with all sorts of chaotic noises. At least you find that sound quite harsh. "[Pause]—I mean, I don't [believe] a [living being] should be treated this way—"

"—I'm not [Wood]!" You feel like you heard a scream, and since your ears hurt right now, you can't help but scratch your ear with your free hand.

You spoke in a tone tinged with heaviness and mourning: "Ah, for my happiness, I'll make you make some sacrifices—I'm truly sorry!" ”
"[Action delay]! I think there might be other [commercial channels]! Definitely more expensive than ordinary [firewood]! ”
So your movements paused again, but you still held the axe, looking down at him from above, speaking with a hint of doubt: "Uh...... So, you mean I'll package you up and sell you for a higher price? ”
Thinking about it carefully, it's not impossible, but you don't want to accept the fact that all your excitement along the way was wasted. But maybe that's actually quite interesting?
The other person nodded eagerly. So you finally put down your axe and regained some composure: "Alright, but I think you need to at least clean it thoroughly so I can wrap it up. The puppet's body trembled: "[No need], I can [complete] the [cleaning work] myself." ”
You nod indifferently, just grab a piece of paper and start writing something. Maybe selling it with carved images—or maybe as a gimmick for a living puppet?

Anyway, when you see him come out, you casually wave your hand: "Hmm, I've thought of another way now. Since you've proposed other business methods, maybe you know a bit too?" Forget it, it's not important. "You just waved your hand indifferently.
"No objections, right? If you have any objections, I can sell you as ordinary firewood. Anyway, wood like yours should be quite valuable, probably worth a lot of money. Here, the axe is still there." You pursed your lips and pointed at the axe placed next to the dining table.
His body trembled again, sounding somewhat like he was enduring humiliation: "...... I have no [opinion]. ”
"Mm. No objections, that's good." "You clapped your hands and pretended not to hear his humiliating tone."
"Anyway, what I'm thinking of now is selling a single collectible using precious wood and carved puppets as a gimmick...... This process might require you to keep disguising yourself as an immobile puppet, and then maybe you can sneak out of those wealthy merchants' homes and then we sell them again? "As you say this, you start to laugh inwardly, already fantasizing about becoming a top-tier rich man.
“…… Before that, I need to [inform] that I am one of a kind, one of a kind. "You hear him say.
So you nod knowingly: "Ah, I understand. These will also be included in the promotional materials at the time. Also, the money I want to get is split fifty-fifty?" "Well, of course, you can live here however you like. You can use whatever you want or eat whatever you want. If you split it fifty-fifty, part of it will be considered rent." "You shamelessly said that.
"...... [can]." You felt yourself hearing his humiliating voice again, but of course, you pretended not to hear.
You just snorted twice, then bent down and reached out your hand to him, saying, "Then...... The deal is done. Happy cooperation? I think I should ask your name. ”
“SPAMTON G. SPAMTON.” he said.

Right now, you have to handle both the pre-production and mid-stage marketing presentations. Hopefully, Spamton will be able to do well in the later stages, since yesterday you thoroughly discussed how to proceed with this plan.
You sit down on the sofa opposite the rich man, then place the box containing Spamton on the table, and of course, he obediently performs a pure, lifeless puppet.

“…… Indeed, it is exquisite and peerless art, but why does it look like this? In my opinion, it is even somewhat ...... ugly. ”
You hinted with Spamton out of the corner of your eye to hold on a bit longer, at least waiting until you successfully got the money and left the manor before he could break the rules. But you still wore that perfunctory smile and continued to persuade him: "Ah, don't you think ugliness is also a special form of artistic expression? You left the estate contentedly, then exchanged your check for cash, packed it in a suitcase, and returned home.
—Then, at night, you see Spamton climb through the window and return to your home.
You snorted twice, as expected. Well, you hadn't been confident before, but even if he hadn't come back, if you had pocketed all this money, it would have been enough for you to live freely for a long time.
And now, you pick up a suitcase with half the cash and place it on the table: "Here, this is the half money we agreed on before." ”

You raised your eyebrows and asked, "So, will we continue tomorrow?" ”

Now you have tasted a bit of unearned gain; at least you are considered very wealthy, though not top-tier yet.

Moreover, since the fingerprints and other clues left behind could not be fully investigated, this suddenly became an unsolved case.
At this moment, you know things are about settled, so you prepare two fake IDs and passports, and even slip one to Spamton, asking, "Alright, are we going to the next place?" ”
Spamton seemed stunned by the question; he instinctively reached out and pointed at you.
"With [you]?" His voice rose, clearly filled with disbelief.
And you just nod indifferently: "Of course, I don't think I'd just use it and throw it away. After all, you're my partner." ”
You held Spamton, even wrapped him up a bit, and boarded the ship heading overseas.
