"You shamelessly said that.
"...... [can]." You felt yourself hearing his humiliating voice again, but of course, you pretended not to hear.
You just snorted twice, then bent down and reached out your hand to him, saying, "Then...... The deal is done. Happy cooperation? I think I should ask your name. ”
“Spamton.G.Spamton.” he said.
You nod and roll up your sleeves: "Alright, then get a good rest tonight! The plan starts tomorrow!" ”
——
You really did wrap the Spamton in a box, like a delicate puppet doll, and at first glance, it looked beautiful and luxurious—after all, you invested some money in the box.
Then you rang the doorbell and gently tugged at the tie you had just taken out of the wardrobe that morning. There was a voice changer hanging from it, and you started wearing that usual smile meant to brush people off—well, after all, you were wearing a mask for disguise, which made your face look even more fake.
You will meet the master of this place under the servant's welcome.
After all, you made a fake certificate at the last minute, then used some hacker tricks to portray you as an executive at a company. And you even investigated wealthy merchants who might buy puppets or timber. To avoid fingerprints, you even wore gloves and moved with greater caution. Of course, to outsiders, this was probably just a sign of distant respect.
Of course, the names on the documents are fake, and the executives' names are fake too. You don't know if all this work for selling a puppet is really worth it, but since it's done, let's see it through to the end. Besides, if it's a 50-50 split, you have to do something. Right now, you have to handle both the pre-production preparation and the mid-stage sales pitch. Hopefully, Spamton will do a good job in the later stages, since yesterday you all thoroughly discussed how to carry out this plan.
You sit down on the sofa opposite the rich man, then place the box with the spamton on the table. Of course, he obediently performs a pure, lifeless puppet—there.
But you simply spread your arms and raise your voice: "We've conducted some user group surveys, and I suspect you might be interested in this collectible...... You know, our company mainly targets high-end trendy antiques, and since you like collecting antiques and exquisite items, I think you'll definitely be interested. ”
As you spoke, you opened the box and nudged the puppet toward the old man: "Here, this is truly one of a kind, probably unique in the world—it's a special kind of wood, and our company only obtained it by chance. It's hard to find a way to sell it. I believe you will take good care of this collectible, since it's so special, even carved into the shape of a puppet." ”
“…… Indeed, it is exquisite and peerless art, but why does it look like this? In my opinion, it is even somewhat ...... ugly. ”
You hinted with Spamton out of the corner of your eye to hold on a bit longer, at least waiting until you successfully got the money and left the manor before he could break the rules. But you still wore that perfunctory smile and continued to persuade him: "Ah, don't you think ugliness is also a special form of artistic expression?" In some cases, ugliness is also a kind of beauty, and isn't there a recent trend of judging ugliness? I think this collectible is definitely very suitable. ”
The old man probably took your explanation to heart. At least he was convinced by you. You discussed the price, and he wrote you a check.
You left the estate contentedly, then exchanged your check for cash, packed it in a suitcase, and returned home.
—Then, at night, you see Spamton climb through the window and return to your home.
You snorted twice, as expected. Well, you hadn't been confident before, but even if he hadn't come back, if you had pocketed all this money, it would have been enough for you to live freely for a long time.
And now, you pick up a suitcase with half the cash and place it on the table: "Here, this is the half money we agreed on before." ”
Spamton was silent for a moment, then climbed onto the chair opposite: "You, take care of it first." ”
You raised your eyebrows and asked, "So, will we continue tomorrow?" ”
"[Yes]."
You smiled with satisfaction. In the following period, you continued to forge various fake certificates and company identities, wearing different masks and voices. You entered every wealthy merchant you had specially investigated interested in wooden products, and received no fewer than ten checks from them. Now you have tasted a bit of unearned gain; at least you are considered very wealthy, though not top-tier yet.
However, the matter was eventually discovered at the home of a wealthy merchant who had lost a puppet, followed by a police call. The wealthy became more alert and belatedly realized they had been deceived. They checked and found that the names and faces of the people they saw were all different, and even their voices were different. Some said they saw polite men, while others said they saw women with rough movements.
Moreover, since the fingerprints and other clues left behind could not be fully investigated, this suddenly became an unsolved case.
At this moment, you know things are almost done, so you prepare two fake IDs and passports, and stuff one into Spamton's hand, asking, "Alright, are we going to the next place?" ”
Spamton seemed stunned by the question; he instinctively reached out and pointed at you.
"With [you]?" His voice rose, clearly filled with disbelief.
And you just nod indifferently: "Of course, I don't think I'd just use it and throw it away. After all, you're my partner." ”
You held the Spamton, even wrapped it up a bit, and boarded the ship heading overseas.
End.
A unique art form. That's exactly it.

title: Otherworld Fantasy Drift [Part 1] (sptx You) (1)
content:
Uh, there's a P5 fusion, if you don't understand, private Marseille ......
——
You're so enthusiastic for no other reason: you actually know the recently popular leader of the Phantom Thieves Gang—and you naturally know about other worlds and changing your mind. Today, you accidentally discovered that your phone also had a navigation app for another world. You even asked around, and found out they use the same app...... Although you're just an international student studying in the United States.
And last night, in my dream, I even found myself in a room that was all blue, with a long-nosed old man saying his name was Igor, saying he was some kind of unruly person and was about to embark on his own journey of rebirth...... I don't understand, TD!
You don't know why your otherworldly navigation app actually has a location for your address, but you just mark three questions. Anyway, you still open the navigation and arrive at your destination. Then, after a flash of red-black light before your eyes, you arrive at a completely different ...... It looks like a cyber-style city.
Not only that, your clothes have changed. You touch your face—it's a mask with half a butterfly wing that somehow appeared. Your clothes have changed to cyberpunk-like mechanical outfits. You close your eyes and think, then try to summon your own persona just like those senior members of the Phantom Thieves taught you.
So you shouted, "Sodium aluminate!" ”
…… Nearby passersby—perhaps called Shadow or the People of Darkness—saw the Light Folk in bizarre costumes shouting and shouting for no reason, and everyone was so frightened they fled.
And you...... standing here with both hands raised, apart from a gust of wind blowing a flyer that blocked your face, there was no other sound.
You cleared your throat and took the flyer down to see what it was. The flyer was wrinkled, probably folded and thrown away, then blown here by the wind. You carefully examined the blurry handwriting—it probably read SPAMTON G. SPAMTON, apparently some kind of promotion, half-price deal...... Well, you remember that palaces usually have a small ecosystem, and the palace content is generated based on the owner's subconscious. So this Spamton guy must be the target you're looking for this time—in other words, someone who has changed their mind!
No, no, no...... It shouldn't be called a candidate for a change of heart; rather, it's someone who must change his heart!
You carefully folded the flyer in half, tucked it away on your persona, and then walked forward with great enthusiasm. You hadn't summoned a persona, so you had to use the weapons that automatically appeared in the other world—a spear and a revolver. Just as the seniors said, any model can be brought to another world, and those shadows take it seriously—it can be reset and used every time!
You enthusiastically swing your revolver and take out one monster after another. If you really can't take them out, you stun them with your spear first, then poke a few more times. Honestly, you don't even know how these monsters attack you right away; some even rush toward you even after seeing you from afar...... But gradually, monsters stop rushing at you on their own; they even sweat vividly when they see you and then run off into the distance.
You actually just wanted to stop a monster and ask for directions...... At that moment, you frustrated and touched your mask, wondering if you were really that scary. Not a single monster was in sight, and for some reason, the streets were empty. It seemed that snowflakes were drifting down without you noticing.
You took a deep breath. Since it looked like there was only a straight road for now, you quickly followed the road forward and finally reached the entrance of a castle. After entering, you almost tripped over those blue eggs.
No one knows how ...... The ground is covered with these things! As long as you bump into them, you'll enter battle. All you can do is curse and smash the eggs with your gun as you move forward. Finally, you reach the finish line, and your eyes light up. This place is so deep and remote—it must be the place the seniors called the treasure! Once you take the treasure, you'll change your mind smoothly, and from then on, there will be one less evil adult in this world!
—Yeah, you're an adult now, after all, you're an adult.
You rushed toward the finish line with great enthusiasm, but when you pushed open the tightly closed door, all you saw was darkness. Besides that, there seemed to be a creature with a pile of green threads hanging from it. It looked furry but also a bit cold—probably some kind of robot.
To be honest, you're a bit disappointed. After all, you haven't seen the Palace Master on this trip. But if you can get the treasure directly, that would be a great thing—so you just wanted to grab the guy hanging up and steal it. After all, the treasure you're stealing will soon be yours! Heh heh heh!
But you couldn't pull it. Not only could you not pull it, you also heard a crackling sound with electricity, a voice that was a bit hard to hear but tinged with anger: "This [bold and reckless] [People of Light], are you [reckless]?" ”
You didn't quite understand what he was saying, so you paused for a moment. Your hand didn't let go, just blankly asked, "Are you alive?" ”
You've never heard of a secret treasure having living creatures. Did you come across something so rare in a hundred years? You couldn't help but feel overjoyed. Once this otherworldly journey succeeds, you'll have to show off a bit!
"[Pretending to know]. I'm SPAMTON G. SPAMTON! The most popular [1997 salesman]! An [outstanding Dark Citizen]! "He shouted loudly, his voice piercing, but you got it—he was the true master of this palace, the most formidable shadow!
Your expression grew serious, and Spamton raised his hand. The light cannon gradually began to gather energy, aiming at the top of your head, looking like it would leap onto your head at any second. You rolled on the ground, raised your revolver to aim at him, and loudly announced, "In that case...... Ahem, I hereby announce here: SPAMTON G. SPAMTON, who has committed the sin of greed, your crimes are unforgivable. Let me steal that heart of desire and change your soul! ”
Well, actually, you were just making things up on a whim. You don't even know what you're actually saying, and only after saying it do you realize that maybe, probably, maybe...... You should have sent a notice letter to the Palace Master first, and then come to attack him—the order was completely reversed. But that's totally fine!
For some reason, this strange guy's pale face turned bright red, as if it had warmed up. His legs swung with the string as he shouted, "I don't have a [heart-shaped object]! And your [criminal charges] can't be established! ”
You were stunned for a moment. If he had no heart, how could you change his mind? You couldn't just move him out completely...... Could a part of desire really be a living incarnation? So this really is a secret treasure.
Not meeting the palace master is a good thing. But...... It looks like they're about to start fighting the secret treasures, so troublesome......
You pouted, feeling a bit guilty after his rebuttal, but you still waved your revolver and started shooting: "Cut the nonsense! The otherworldly navigation already brought me here, and you even have a palace, so you're the unforgivable sinner!" ”
You pull the trigger, and the big flying bird—or rather, the big bird suspended by a string—shields its wings in front of you, blocking the bullet attack. With a clang, the bullet flew out, but it didn't seem to cause much damage.
You're a little frustrated—this palace master's defense is way too high, isn't it? Wait, wait, it's a secret treasure.
“…… But I don't have a [heart-shaped object], so your [brilliant idea] can't be realized! "His voice seemed a bit calmer, probably wanting to have a good talk with you.
"Why do you always speak with some unknown recording...... Forget it, even if you have no heart in this place, you still show your intentions. Because you are just a shadow formed by your inner subconscious! Even death would only be a shadow that disappeared from the shadow. "You put your hands on your hips and announced. In fact, you didn't know why you were talking with the palace master again. Feeling uneasy, you raised your spear again and thrust it at the wings blocking his way.
“…… I'm not the 'Shadow Creature' you mentioned, I'm the 'People of Darkness'! Spamton shouted wildly.
The good news is, the spear's tip did pierce into those two wings. The bad news is, you tried to pull the spear out, but no matter how hard you tried, you couldn't pull it out.
Could it be...... Losing a weapon like this, and giving up like that? But this is your first visit to the palace, and you always feel you have to achieve something. All you have left is a revolver, you can't draw that long spear, and relying only on mouth and revolver, you know you definitely won't be able to defeat the enemy before you.
You take a deep breath...... You know that if you can't succeed this time, you'll always be the child adults see as accomplished, dependent only on them. You'll always have to ask adults for help, only to receive their disappointed or understanding looks. You don't want to go on like this. You don't want to let yourself fall into this situation. You want to refute those adults who are always stubborn, unwilling to discern or accept change. You—you want to be yourself.
A sharp pain shot through your head, and the revolver was thrown to the ground. You clutched your head with both hands, kneeling on the ground, your face pale. For some reason, another voice popped into your mind. The mask that had been hanging on your face now seemed to stick tightly to yours. Spamton across from you was startled—to be honest, he didn't know how you suddenly ended up like this, but maybe he could have snagged your soul.
He hesitated, swinging the puppet and moving slightly closer to you, but an invisible aura rising from around you forced him to stay at a distance of about a meter and watch you.
You endured the voices in your mind, and then—the mask was torn off, and with it flowed blood that looked like a torn skin, and the wound healed quickly. You gasped for breath, got up from the ground, and called out to the Persona that had just answered your call.
“…… Kukukaner! ”
A huge shadow appeared behind you, her golden hair flowing, but her face was terrifyingly empty. Behind her were emerald-green wings, and she was holding a bundle of golden wheat. At your call, a bolt of lightning struck the ground. If Spamton hadn't flashed so quickly, the lightning might have struck him instead.
He looked at you with a complicated expression, because he saw the yellow heart shining in your chest. The spear finally fell to the ground, and you stopped picking it up. You just clumsily controlled the Persona, first casting a witch's curse—yes, it lowers the opponent's defense, so you won't be unable to hit it again later.
But since this is a turn-based battle, after you act, it's his turn to act. I just don't know why it's a bullet hell attack—the senior never said it would happen!
But it didn't matter. You're from Gotham, and you're used to it. At this moment, you were just easily dodging and neutralizing his attacks. After all, you're a Gotham native, and you're very skilled at dodging others' attacks.
So you just dodge left and right, use the gaps in his attacks to dodge, and do a backflip to dodge his sudden laser cannon, while secretly complaining that this guy can use so many attack moves in one round.
Just as you were about to give yourself another buff that boosts attack and defense, he hurriedly spoke up: "[Go Easy]! I'm not the owner of the [Palace Mansion]! ”
You're a bit surprised, but you still don't forget to give yourself a buff first. You just widen your eyes and look at him: "Aren't you the master of the palace?" Then who exactly are you? ”
You looked him over carefully a few more times. Hmm, according to what the senior said, his body seems to be red, red, black, black, purple, and purple...... This guy seems to barely fit the description, correct. There will be a sound like chains, basically as if something is binding it. This guy has countless green ropes on his body, and when he just moved, he did hear a bit of metal clashing himself. Correct. Then...... After hunting several shadows, because the event lingers too long, it will appear to hunt the Persona Messenger.
So you realize, your left hand clenched into a fist and you pat your right palm: "Oh oh oh, I get it, you're a hunter!" ”
So of course you won't let him off! After all, you've heard that killing a hunter can earn you a lot of experience points, and you can just kill those weak shadows directly! It's not that you find it troublesome, but you just want to save time, so of course you'll take this hunter in front of you seriously!
TBC.
Spamton was stunned for a moment. To be honest, he had no idea what a hunter was, but seeing you eager to attack and ready to attack, he knew it wasn't a good word, and just from the literal meaning, he could tell what it was!
In short...... Even if he were him, he had to say no. After all, he didn't want to fight you for no reason, especially since he wasn't even that person! He had lived in the Dark World for so long and had never heard of that name!
He's just an ordinary Dark Commoner—to be honest, when facing you, Spamton suddenly realized he was actually quite ordinary.
"[People of Light], stop [Combat Mode], I'm not the [Hunter] you mentioned!" He could only try hard to control this unruly body to dodge your attacks, shouting loudly, afraid you wouldn't hear clearly. Of course, his voice was anxious—he wanted to end the fight as soon as possible.
"You say it's not true, so it's not? A mentally ill person would still say he's not mentally ill! Since you denied it, then you must be the hunter!" "You shouted loudly and easily handed down the verdict. Although you know your words sound a bit unreasonable, it doesn't matter—victory in this battle is more important than that! Anyway, as long as you defeat him, no one will remember your conversation anymore!
Spamton gritted his teeth. He really didn't know how to answer you. Saying he wasn't a hunter would make you swear he was a hunter, but he couldn't admit he was!
However...... His gaze wandered as he saw the yellow heart, or rather, the soul, flickering and beating in your chest. He wanted to obtain it, so he could truly become a big shot—if it was to hunt souls, then he could indeed accept the title of Hunter.
“…… Yes, I am a [Hunter], and I am also an ordinary [Dark Folk]. So, [Light Folk]—please hand over your [Heart-shaped Object]." He said this, swinging his arms and legs as he approached you, raising his arm again. The laser cannon gathered light again. You weren't afraid of this at all; you simply used Kukukan to stack a defensive enhancement effect again, then raised your arm, a bright yellow light gathered, and then struck down heavily—a massive tear-point attribute damage. Spamton's movement speed was just too slow now, unable to dodge the attack. Moreover, metal conducts electricity, so the lightning kept circulating around him. His entire ...... The Dark Folks twitched in midair. You let go of your hand, looking a bit helpless at the figure before you.
You automatically understood what he said—he said he was just an ordinary shadow—how could a hunter be ordinary at all! In short, you attacked him with all your might. Now it seems the effect was too good. Although you couldn't see his health bar, you could tell it was probably decreasing. After all, he was still trembling, white and yellow glows bursting from his body, and the whole big bird was bristling with feathers.
You frowned and looked carefully for a while. You remember the seniors always say hunters are very hard to beat...... Why does this look so easy? He looks like he's about to be killed by you.
Unfortunately, this was a turn-based battle, and Spamton's barrage of bullets flew toward you again, surrounding you. The white and blue barrage attacks were about to land, but with the Persona Mask, you were confident and opened a rain shield, absorbing the damage from this time.
But...... Spamton once again moved away from you, then folded his wings to block in front of you. You tentatively used the same attack. The massive lightning striked, but seemed to cause no damage at all. He looked perfectly fine, except for a triumphant laugh.
"[Hahahaha] [Laughing Mode], I've activated [Omni-Defensive Function], so you can't make a [perfect attack]." He said this, and the laser cannon started charging again. This time, the laser hit where you had been standing, and you jumped a few steps to the side.
Indeed, just like he said, you can only glare at him with hatred, wondering if this damn defense is maxed out—how come it didn't deal any damage at all?
“…… At worst, just stack a few more buffs. I don't believe it's impossible!" You figured you had to succeed today, so you started frantically stacking witch curses on Spamton, then had lightning strike down, trying to achieve a nuclear explosion. Unfortunately, you didn't succeed. Even if you struck precisely, it didn't seem to hurt him at all, making you almost lose heart—maybe you wanted to die, since you were really tired. I don't know why Spamton still looked so radiant.
You took two breaths, wiped the sweat from your forehead, and said, "...... Is your defense mode really unsolvable?" You asked sincerely, sincerely questioning, since you two were at a stalemate now, and chatting idly wouldn't be enough.
"Of course, this is [Universal Defense], [Super High School Level.] "Somehow, you can hear a hint of pride in his words. Well, you don't really know what he's so proud of—maybe he's so proud that you can't beat him no matter what, while he's slowly wearing down your fighting spirit.
"I don't believe it. There must be a breakthrough. Isn't so-and-so supposed to be invincible? But his ankle is his weakness...... You must have a weakness too!" You wiped your sweat again, stopped attacking, and instead stood where you were to observe Spamton. Anyway, you're in turn-based now; if you don't move, he can't move.
When fighting Spamton, you find he always tries to get close to you, and his gaze is always intentionally or unintentionally directed at your chest, but you see nothing but a flat stretch. You suspect he might be concerned about something you can't even see, since your heart is still in his chest. But no matter what, you can't figure out what he's looking at—what's inside...... Surely he can't just make his inner will manifest, right? That makes you find it a bit funny.
If you carefully observe the structure of the Spamton Neo, his body is covered in armor. It seems this metal armor gives him extremely high defense. In other words, if he could be removed from the armor, it would probably be easy to win—but this seems a bit difficult. For now, his head is firmly attached to this armor, as if he was born naturally. Unless his head is cut off—that should be even harder, right?
Those wings are also used to boost defense; if you take out the wings first, it should also reduce his defense...... But the lightning he just struck down was useless. But you still plan to give it a try and attack in chunks.
So you raise your hand again, lightning gathers in the air, but this time you don't strike the Spamton directly, but rather the individual wing that strikes.
The rumbling thunder flashed by, and your eyes lit up. It really worked. Although the damage was still halved, you saw the wing's health bar—it had just been destroyed by one-fifth!
Spamton was stunned. He didn't know you could switch to such an attack style, so he quickly used his other wing to block it, trying to weaken the attack, shouting loudly, "You...... There's no [attack operation manual]! You shouldn't be able to perform a solo attack! ”
"So what? As long as it works, it's a good solution. Are you jealous of me? Because you can't do it?" You raised your eyebrows smugly, dodging the barrage of barrage of comments scattered at you like dollar signs.
Spamton was about to be driven mad by you: "I don't have the [Envy Program]!" ”
You don't care about that. Since he blocked with his other wing, you might as well choose the other wing as your target, also losing about one-fifth of his health.
You decided to keep pushing forward, but...... You heard footsteps behind you. You instinctively became nervous; after all, you didn't want to be surrounded from front and rear, nor did you want others to snatch the hunter you had painstakingly fought halfway through. So you hurriedly turned around and glanced at what seemed to be a human like you rushing over. You couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief—at least you wouldn't be caught in a pincer attack.
Then you use Kukukan to refresh Spamton's two Archangel's Calls, and his health bar instantly fills up again. You'd rather start over later than let someone else steal your kill!
Then you strolled away, quietly heading to another place, because you wanted to see ...... What other way could you deal with this troublesome guy?
Hmm, you see that blue little guy holding a sword standing in front of Spamton. Spamton was a bit surprised—you gave him two healing skills and then ran away, but he couldn't care about that now. After all, Kris was the real prey he'd set his sights on from the start. He was confident he could snatch the heart-shaped item from him. After all, without Kris's help, he wouldn't have gotten this NEO set now.
So, the dull and tedious battle began once again. Kris silently attacked Spamton, and after losing half his health, Spamton reactivated his defensive mode. No matter how he attacked, he couldn't break through or harm him.
For some reason, you feel uneasy, after all—you hear that little one calling someone's name, but no one has come. But you keep feeling that, in the end, what he calls over might be a powerful weapon.
As you just saw, it was because of those green threads that the armor could be manipulated according to Spamton's will. It looked ...... Actually, even after he got that armor, he was still being controlled. If he cut off those strings, it would be easy for him to separate that super-defensive armor from Spamton's main body, defeat Spamton, and gain a lot of experience!
You made those judgments and picked up your spear again. Anyway, you're ...... You've long since recuperated, now just staring intently at the strings above him. During Kris's turn, Spamton didn't move—exactly what you wanted! You rushed forward, jumped up, hooked the spear tip, and the sharp metal sliced through all the green ropes. Then you landed a cool backflip—then you stared blankly at Spamton Neo, whose threads had been cut by you, falling to the ground. The pink and yellow glasses on his face flew toward you, merging into your body—it seemed like just a phantom, his glasses still hanging on his face.
Then you see the little boy pointing a sword at you, expressionless. You might be a bit angry, since this counts as stealing someone's head. But you feel that what just merged into your body is a Persona Mask, meaning you can probably carry multiple Personas at the same time—this must be what that old man named Igor means.
You coughed twice, raised both hands in a surrender gesture: "I have no intention of fighting you. If you have anything to do, just leave quickly." ”
The boy left as instructed, and he seemed to be heading toward the white fountain ahead. You didn't concern yourself too much; since this palace hadn't disappeared yet, you decided to try out the personality mask you had just obtained.
You retracted Kukulkan and then shouted, “Sodium aluminate!”
Spamton Neo reappeared behind you, except this time—he no longer had the green strings attached.
He apparently knew about his connection to you now, and he said in a flustered and frustrated tone, “Why are you [ACTION MODE?!?] trying to [SAFELY RELEASE!!!] me?” He didn’t want to be restrained. Previously it was the strings, now it was you, and he clearly knew he would probably have to follow your orders.
You scratched your head and let out an off-key whistle: “Uh, if I were to safely release you… then you would completely disappear, which is basically the same as not existing.” Although the personality masks you obtained should all be recorded in some kind of Personality Mask Compendium… you weren’t sure if the one you have now was the same as the one extracted from the compendium.
Spamton was quite annoyed, but now he could at least see the yellow soul inside your chest. However, no matter what, he couldn’t reach out to grab it—probably flagged as harmful. He became a little impotently furious again.
“Alright, but apart from [super high-level defense abilities], I don’t have any other powers.” Although he probably did… he just wasn’t sure what he counted as right now.
“Hmm, it’s okay… anyway, over here it seems I’m the only personality mask user. Going out alone to try and change people’s hearts sounds simple and challenging but also really boring. It’s just right to have someone accompany me to listen to my rambling… wow, why is this place starting to collapse!?” You started chattering on and on. Spamton couldn’t get a word in, and he had to admit that you indeed talked a lot. Then you scrambled noisily toward the entrance.
Spamton was forced to follow behind you. He wanted to roll his eyes but ended up sarcastically saying, “Looks like you still [lack athletic skills].”
In short… your haul this time was pretty good. This unnamed palace had completely disappeared from the navigation system, and you gained a personality mask to keep you company in conversation—a big success!
And your adventure had only just begun.
END.

You carefully examined the blurry handwriting—it probably read SPAMTON G. SPAMTON, apparently some kind of promotion, half-price deal...... Well, you remember that palaces usually have a small ecosystem, and the palace content is generated based on the owner's subconscious. So this Spamton guy must be the target you're looking for this time—in other words, someone who has changed their mind!
No, no, no...... It shouldn't be called a candidate for a change of heart; rather, it's someone who must change his heart!
You carefully folded the flyer in half, tucked it away on your persona, and then walked forward with great enthusiasm. You hadn't summoned a persona, so you had to use the weapons that automatically appeared in the other world—a spear and a revolver. Just as the seniors said, any model can be brought to another world, and those shadows take it seriously—it can be reset and used every time!
You enthusiastically swing your revolver and take out one monster after another. If you really can't take them out, you stun them with your spear first, then poke a few more times. Honestly, you don't even know how these monsters attack you right away; some even rush toward you even after seeing you from afar...... But gradually, monsters stop rushing at you on their own; they even sweat vividly when they see you and then run off into the distance.
You actually just wanted to stop a monster and ask for directions...... At that moment, you frustrated and touched your mask, wondering if you were really that scary. Not a single monster was in sight, and for some reason, the streets were empty. It seemed that snowflakes were drifting down without you noticing.
You took a deep breath. Since it looked like there was only a straight road for now, you quickly followed the road forward and finally reached the entrance of a castle. After entering, you almost tripped over those blue eggs.
No one knows how ...... The ground is covered with these things! As long as you bump into them, you'll enter battle. All you can do is curse and smash the eggs with your gun as you move forward. Finally, you reach the finish line, and your eyes light up. This place is so deep and remote—it must be the place the seniors called the treasure! Once you take the treasure, you'll change your mind smoothly, and from then on, there will be one less evil adult in this world!
—Yeah, you're an adult now, after all, you're an adult.
You rushed toward the finish line with great enthusiasm, but when you pushed open the tightly closed door, all you saw was darkness. Besides that, there seemed to be a creature with a pile of green threads hanging from it. It looked furry but also a bit cold—probably some kind of robot.
To be honest, you're a bit disappointed. After all, you haven't seen the Palace Master on this trip. But if you can get the treasure directly, that would be a great thing—so you just wanted to grab the guy hanging up and steal it. After all, the treasure you're stealing will soon be yours! Heh heh heh!
But you couldn't pull it. Not only could you not pull it, you also heard a crackling sound with electricity, a voice that was a bit hard to hear but tinged with anger: "This [bold and reckless] [People of Light], are you [reckless]?" ”
You didn't quite understand what he was saying, so you paused for a moment. Your hand didn't let go, just blankly asked, "Are you alive?" ”
You've never heard of a secret treasure having living creatures. Did you come across something so rare in a hundred years? You couldn't help but feel overjoyed. Once this otherworldly journey succeeds, you'll have to show off a bit!
"[Pretending to know]. I'm SPAMTON G. SPAMTON! The most popular [1997 salesman]! An [outstanding Dark Citizen]! "He shouted loudly, his voice piercing, but you got it—he was the true master of this palace, the most formidable shadow!
Your expression grew serious, and Spamton raised his hand. The light cannon gradually began to gather energy, aiming at the top of your head, looking like it would leap onto your head at any second. You rolled on the ground, raised your revolver to aim at him, and loudly announced, "In that case...... Ahem, I hereby announce here: SPAMTON G. SPAMTON, who has committed the sin of greed, your crimes are unforgivable. Let me steal that heart of desire and change your soul! ”
Well, actually, you were just making things up on a whim. You don't even know what you're actually saying, and only after saying it do you realize that maybe, probably, maybe...... You should have sent a notice letter to the Palace Master first, and then come to attack him—the order was completely reversed. But that's totally fine!
For some reason, this strange guy's pale face turned bright red, as if it had warmed up. His legs swung with the string as he shouted, "I don't have a [heart-shaped object]! And your [criminal charges] can't be established! ”
You were stunned for a moment. If he had no heart, how could you change his mind? You couldn't just move him out completely...... Could a part of desire really be a living incarnation? So this really is a secret treasure.
Not meeting the palace master is a good thing. But...... It looks like they're about to start fighting the secret treasures, so troublesome......
You pouted, feeling a bit guilty after his rebuttal, but you still waved your revolver and started shooting: "Cut the nonsense! The otherworldly navigation already brought me here, and you even have a palace, so you're the unforgivable sinner!" ”
You pull the trigger, and the big flying bird—or rather, the big bird suspended by a string—shields its wings in front of you, blocking the bullet attack. With a clang, the bullet flew out, but it didn't seem to cause much damage.
You're a little frustrated—this palace master's defense is way too high, isn't it? Wait, wait, it's a secret treasure.
“…… But I don't have a [heart-shaped object], so your [brilliant idea] can't be realized! "His voice seemed a bit calmer, probably wanting to have a good talk with you.
"Why do you always speak with some unknown recording...... Forget it, even if you have no heart in this place, you still show your intentions. Because you are just a shadow formed by your inner subconscious! Even death would only be a shadow that disappeared from the shadow. "You put your hands on your hips and announced. In fact, you didn't know why you were talking with the palace master again. Feeling uneasy, you raised your spear again and thrust it at the wings blocking his way.
“…… I'm not the 'Shadow Creature' you mentioned, I'm the 'People of Darkness'! Spamton shouted wildly.
The good news is, the spear's tip did pierce into those two wings. The bad news is, you tried to pull the spear out, but no matter how hard you tried, you couldn't pull it out.
Could it be...... Losing a weapon like this, and giving up like that? But this is your first visit to the palace, and you always feel you have to achieve something. All you have left is a revolver, you can't draw that long spear, and relying only on mouth and revolver, you know you definitely won't be able to defeat the enemy before you.
You take a deep breath...... You know that if you can't succeed this time, you'll always be the child adults see as accomplished, dependent only on them. You'll always have to ask adults for help, only to receive their disappointed or understanding looks. You don't want to go on like this. You don't want to let yourself fall into this situation. You want to refute those adults who are always stubborn, unwilling to discern or accept change. You—you want to be yourself.
A sharp pain shot through your head, and the revolver was thrown to the ground. You clutched your head with both hands, kneeling on the ground, your face pale. For some reason, another voice popped into your mind. The mask that had been hanging on your face now seemed to stick tightly to yours. Spamton across from you was startled—to be honest, he didn't know how you suddenly ended up like this, but maybe he could have snagged your soul.
He hesitated, swinging the puppet and moving slightly closer to you, but an invisible aura rising from around you forced him to stay at a distance of about a meter and watch you.
You endured the voices in your mind, and then—the mask was torn off, and with it flowed blood that looked like a torn skin, and the wound healed quickly. You gasped for breath, got up from the ground, and called out to the Persona that had just answered your call.
“…… Kukukaner! ”
A huge shadow appeared behind you, her golden hair flowing, but her face was terrifyingly empty. Behind her were emerald-green wings, and she was holding a bundle of golden wheat. At your call, a bolt of lightning struck the ground. If Spamton hadn't flashed so quickly, the lightning might have struck him instead.
He looked at you with a complicated expression, because he saw the yellow heart shining in your chest. The spear finally fell to the ground, and you stopped picking it up. You just clumsily controlled the Persona, first casting a witch's curse—yes, it lowers the opponent's defense, so you won't be unable to hit it again later.
But since this is a turn-based battle, after you act, it's his turn to act. I just don't know why it's a bullet hell attack—the senior never said it would happen!
But it didn't matter. You're from Gotham, and you're used to it. At this moment, you were just easily dodging and neutralizing his attacks. After all, you're a Gotham native, and you're very skilled at dodging others' attacks.
So you just dodge left and right, use the gaps in his attacks to dodge, and do a backflip to dodge his sudden laser cannon, while secretly complaining that this guy can use so many attack moves in one round.
Just as you were about to give yourself another buff that boosts attack and defense, he hurriedly spoke up: "[Go Easy]! I'm not the owner of the [Palace Mansion]! ”
You're a bit surprised, but you still don't forget to give yourself a buff first. You just widen your eyes and look at him: "Aren't you the master of the palace?" Then who exactly are you? ”
You looked him over carefully a few more times. Hmm, according to what the senior said, his body seems to be red, red, black, black, purple, and purple...... This guy seems to barely fit the description, correct. There will be a sound like chains, basically as if something is binding it. This guy has countless green ropes on his body, and when he just moved, he did hear a bit of metal clashing himself. Correct. Then...... After hunting several shadows, because the event lingers too long, it will appear to hunt the Persona Messenger.
So you realize, your left hand clenched into a fist and you pat your right palm: "Oh oh oh, I get it, you're a hunter!" ”
So of course you won't let him off! After all, you've heard that killing a hunter can earn you a lot of experience points, and you can just kill those weak shadows directly! It's not that you find it troublesome, but you just want to save time, so of course you'll take this hunter in front of you seriously!
TBC.

title: Otherworld Fantasy Drifting [Part 2] (sptx you)
content:
Spamton was stunned for a moment. To be honest, he had no idea what a hunter was, but seeing you eager to attack and ready to attack, he knew it wasn't a good word, and just from the literal meaning, he could tell what it was!
In short...... Even if he were him, he had to say no. After all, he didn't want to fight you for no reason, especially since he wasn't even that person! He had lived in the Dark World for so long and had never heard of that name!
He's just an ordinary Dark Commoner—to be honest, when facing you, Spamton suddenly realized he was actually quite ordinary.
"[People of Light], stop [Combat Mode], I'm not the [Hunter] you mentioned!" He could only try hard to control this unruly body to dodge your attacks, shouting loudly, afraid you wouldn't hear clearly. Of course, his voice was anxious—he wanted to end the fight as soon as possible.
"You say it's not true, so it's not? A mentally ill person would still say he's not mentally ill! Since you denied it, then you must be the hunter!" "You shouted loudly and easily handed down the verdict. Although you know your words sound a bit unreasonable, it doesn't matter—victory in this battle is more important than that! Anyway, as long as you defeat him, no one will remember your conversation anymore!
Spamton gritted his teeth. He really didn't know how to answer you. Saying he wasn't a hunter would make you swear he was a hunter, but he couldn't admit he was!
However...... His gaze wandered as he saw the yellow heart, or rather, the soul, flickering and beating in your chest. He wanted to obtain it, so he could truly become a big shot—if it was to hunt souls, then he could indeed accept the title of Hunter.
“…… Yes, I am a [Hunter], and I am also an ordinary [Dark Folk]. So, [Light Folk]—please hand over your [Heart-shaped Object]." He said this, swinging his arms and legs as he approached you, raising his arm again. The laser cannon gathered light again. You weren't afraid of this at all; you simply used Kukukan to stack a defensive enhancement effect again, then raised your arm, a bright yellow light gathered, and then struck down heavily—a massive tear-point attribute damage. Spamton's movement speed was just too slow now, unable to dodge the attack. Moreover, metal conducts electricity, so the lightning kept circulating around him. His entire ...... The Dark Folks twitched in midair. You let go of your hand, looking a bit helpless at the figure before you.
You automatically understood what he said—he said he was just an ordinary shadow—how could a hunter be ordinary at all! In short, you attacked him with all your might. Now it seems the effect was too good. Although you couldn't see his health bar, you could tell it was probably decreasing. After all, he was still trembling, white and yellow glows bursting from his body, and the whole big bird was bristling with feathers.
You frowned and looked carefully for a while. You remember the seniors always say hunters are very hard to beat...... Why does this look so easy? He looks like he's about to be killed by you.
Unfortunately, this was a turn-based battle, and Spamton's barrage of bullets flew toward you again, surrounding you. The white and blue barrage attacks were about to land, but with the Persona Mask, you were confident and opened a rain shield, absorbing the damage from this time.
But...... Spamton once again moved away from you, then folded his wings to block in front of you. You tentatively used the same attack. The massive lightning striked, but seemed to cause no damage at all. He looked perfectly fine, except for a triumphant laugh.
"[Hahahaha] [Laughing Mode], I've activated [Omni-Defensive Function], so you can't make a [perfect attack]." He said this, and the laser cannon started charging again. This time, the laser hit where you had been standing, and you jumped a few steps to the side.
Indeed, just like he said, you can only glare at him with hatred, wondering if this damn defense is maxed out—how come it didn't deal any damage at all?
“…… At worst, just stack a few more buffs. I don't believe it's impossible!" You figured you had to succeed today, so you started frantically stacking witch curses on Spamton, then had lightning strike down, trying to achieve a nuclear explosion. Unfortunately, you didn't succeed. Even if you struck precisely, it didn't seem to hurt him at all, making you almost lose heart—maybe you wanted to die, since you were really tired. I don't know why Spamton still looked so radiant.
You took two breaths, wiped the sweat from your forehead, and said, "...... Is your defense mode really unsolvable?" You asked sincerely, sincerely questioning, since you two were at a stalemate now, and chatting idly wouldn't be enough.
"Of course, this is [Universal Defense], [Super High School Level.] "Somehow, you can hear a hint of pride in his words. Well, you don't really know what he's so proud of—maybe he's so proud that you can't beat him no matter what, while he's slowly wearing down your fighting spirit.
"I don't believe it. There must be a breakthrough. Isn't so-and-so supposed to be invincible? But his ankle is his weakness...... You must have a weakness too!" You wiped your sweat again, stopped attacking, and instead stood where you were to observe Spamton. Anyway, you're in turn-based now; if you don't move, he can't move.
When fighting Spamton, you find he always tries to get close to you, and his gaze is always intentionally or unintentionally directed at your chest, but you see nothing but a flat stretch. You suspect he might be concerned about something you can't even see, since your heart is still in his chest. But no matter what, you can't figure out what he's looking at—what's inside...... Surely he can't just make his inner will manifest, right? That makes you find it a bit funny.
If you carefully observe the structure of the Spamton Neo, his body is covered in armor. It seems this metal armor gives him extremely high defense. In other words, if he could be removed from the armor, it would probably be easy to win—but this seems a bit difficult. For now, his head is firmly attached to this armor, as if he was born naturally. Unless his head is cut off—that should be even harder, right?
Those wings are also used to boost defense; if you take out the wings first, it should also reduce his defense...... But the lightning he just struck down was useless. But you still plan to give it a try and attack in chunks.
So you raise your hand again, lightning gathers in the air, but this time you don't strike the Spamton directly, but rather the individual wing that strikes.
The rumbling thunder flashed by, and your eyes lit up. It really worked. Although the damage was still halved, you saw the wing's health bar—it had just been destroyed by one-fifth!
Spamton was stunned. He didn't know you could switch to such an attack style, so he quickly used his other wing to block it, trying to weaken the attack, shouting loudly, "You...... There's no [attack operation manual]! You shouldn't be able to perform a solo attack! ”
"So what? As long as it works, it's a good solution. Are you jealous of me? Because you can't do it?" You raised your eyebrows smugly, dodging the barrage of barrage of comments scattered at you like dollar signs.
Spamton was about to be driven mad by you: "I don't have the [Envy Program]!" ”
You don't care about that. Since he blocked with his other wing, you might as well choose the other wing as your target, also losing about one-fifth of his health.
You decided to keep pushing forward, but...... You heard footsteps behind you. You instinctively became nervous; after all, you didn't want to be surrounded from front and rear, nor did you want others to snatch the hunter you had painstakingly fought halfway through. So you hurriedly turned around and glanced at what seemed to be a human like you rushing over. You couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief—at least you wouldn't be caught in a pincer attack.
Then you use Kukukan to refresh Spamton's two Archangel's Calls, and his health bar instantly fills up again. You'd rather start over later than let someone else steal your kill!
Then you strolled away, quietly heading to another place, because you wanted to see ...... What other way could you deal with this troublesome guy?
Hmm, you see that blue little guy holding a sword standing in front of Spamton. Spamton was a bit surprised—you gave him two healing skills and then ran away, but he couldn't care about that now. After all, Kris was the real prey he'd set his sights on from the start. He was confident he could snatch the heart-shaped item from him. After all, without Kris's help, he wouldn't have gotten this NEO set now.
So, the dull and tedious battle began once again. Kris silently attacked Spamton, and after losing half his health, Spamton reactivated his defensive mode. No matter how he attacked, he couldn't break through or harm him.
For some reason, you feel uneasy, after all—you hear that little one calling someone's name, but no one has come. But you keep feeling that, in the end, what he calls over might be a powerful weapon.
As you just saw, it was because of those green threads that the armor could be manipulated according to Spamton's will. It looked ...... Actually, even after he got that armor, he was still being controlled. If he cut off those strings, it would be easy for him to separate that super-defensive armor from Spamton's main body, defeat Spamton, and gain a lot of experience!
You made those judgments and picked up your spear again. Anyway, you're ...... You've long since recuperated, now just staring intently at the strings above him. During Kris's turn, Spamton didn't move—exactly what you wanted! You rushed forward, jumped up, hooked the spear tip, and the sharp metal sliced through all the green ropes. Then you landed a cool backflip—then you stared blankly at Spamton Neo, whose threads had been cut by you, falling to the ground. The pink and yellow glasses on his face flew toward you, merging into your body—it seemed like just a phantom, his glasses still hanging on his face.
Then you see the little boy pointing a sword at you, expressionless. You might be a bit angry, since this counts as stealing someone's head. But you feel that what just merged into your body is a Persona Mask, meaning you can probably carry multiple Personas at the same time—this must be what that old man named Igor means.
You coughed twice, raised both hands in a surrender gesture: "I have no intention of fighting you. If you have anything to do, just leave quickly." ”
The boy left as instructed, and he seemed to be heading toward the white fountain ahead. You didn't concern yourself too much; since this palace hadn't disappeared yet, you decided to try out the personality mask you had just obtained.
You retracted Kukulkan and then shouted, “Sodium aluminate!”
Spamton Neo reappeared behind you, except this time—he no longer had the green strings attached.
He apparently knew about his connection to you now, and he said in a flustered and frustrated tone, “Why are you [ACTION MODE?!?] trying to [SAFELY RELEASE!!!] me?” He didn’t want to be restrained. Previously it was the strings, now it was you, and he clearly knew he would probably have to follow your orders.
You scratched your head and let out an off-key whistle: “Uh, if I were to safely release you… then you would completely disappear, which is basically the same as not existing.” Although the personality masks you obtained should all be recorded in some kind of Personality Mask Compendium… you weren’t sure if the one you have now was the same as the one extracted from the compendium.
Spamton was quite annoyed, but now he could at least see the yellow soul inside your chest. However, no matter what, he couldn’t reach out to grab it—probably flagged as harmful. He became a little impotently furious again.
“Alright, but apart from [super high-level defense abilities], I don’t have any other powers.” Although he probably did… he just wasn’t sure what he counted as right now.
“Hmm, it’s okay… anyway, over here it seems I’m the only personality mask user. Going out alone to try and change people’s hearts sounds simple and challenging but also really boring. It’s just right to have someone accompany me to listen to my rambling… wow, why is this place starting to collapse!?” You started chattering on and on. Spamton couldn’t get a word in, and he had to admit that you indeed talked a lot. Then you scrambled noisily toward the entrance.
Spamton was forced to follow behind you. He wanted to roll his eyes but ended up sarcastically saying, “Looks like you still [lack athletic skills].”
In short… your haul this time was pretty good. This unnamed palace had completely disappeared from the navigation system, and you gained a personality mask to keep you company in conversation—a big success!
And your adventure had only just begun.
END.

title: Computer rogue software 1-Sptx you(1)
content:
Sptx, you, OOC belongs to me
Actually, yes, I want to write about a madman yn. I love writing about madmen (? ) but it still doesn't seem crazy enough...... (Memor)
In short, this article shouldn't be very long
——
You yawn, leaning back in your computer chair, casually playing some electronic rock music on the computer, but you have no interest at all, nor do you feel any excitement again. So your hands are just fiddling with the hanging rope, absentmindedly thinking about which method would be better. Honestly, you don't want to suffer too much.
But then, you suddenly hear the music stop abruptly, stopping at a high note. The food in your hand has a slightly teasing flavor. You think the music player has suddenly stopped, so you look up at the computer, then freeze for a moment.
The music player was indeed paused, but it was more accurate to say the software had already disappeared, and for some reason, an icon had appeared on the computer desktop...... Uh, it looked a bit like the head of the guy called Spamton from Chapter Two of Triangular Rune.
You raised your eyebrows slightly, showing a bit of interest, so you put down the rope in your hand and operated the mouse to click on the icon that suddenly appeared.
…… It won't open. Well, that's not surprising. You shrug, drag the app icon to the trash bin, and then plan to delete it.
The trash bin did show a 'filled' icon, but after a while, the same icon appeared again on the previously clean desktop.
You hesitate for a moment, open the trash can to confirm, confirm that the big head Spamton is still there, and then confirm that the desktop has the same big head. This time, you drag the icon over again, confirming that there are indeed two identical icons in the trash can, then breathe a sigh of relief. But before you can fully relax, you notice another identical icon pops up on the desktop.
This time, you completely felt a heart attack, rarely feeling a bit annoyed, and of course, a strange curiosity and excitement followed. After all, this was indeed an unexpected event, and you really wanted to know what was going on.
So you thought for two seconds, considering what exactly to do—after all, the extra spamton icon on the computer was obviously some kind of rogue software! You couldn't delete it, you couldn't open it, which was the most annoying part, so you decided to just open the Deltarune yourself to see if anything had changed.
No sooner said than done, you still opened the Deltarune, found Chapter Two, and clicked in to see if anything would change—hmm, although you had already cleared it, thanks to unlocking an extra save file earlier to unlock hidden items, you easily arrived at the trash can in the game, which should be the first time you met.
But when you control Kris to walk over, the computer screen goes black. You blink and think the computer has crashed, but if you move the mouse, it can still move normally.
So you slumped into your computer chair, leisurely waiting for the now-black computer to surprise you.
I don't know how much time passed, but at least your physical sensation was only a few minutes. You were starting to get a bit impatient, and only then did you see a line of text flash across the pitch-black screen.
…… I just [knew]. [You] will definitely make this [choice].
You stroke your chin and instead ask, "So can you hear what I'm saying?" ”
[Of course]! [Of course you can]!
You nodded, dragged out your voice, and said, "So you hacked my computer's camera permissions." ”
The other side seemed to freeze instantly. At least when you looked at the screen, it returned to pitch black, and for quite a while, the next sentence didn't pop up.
You lost interest too. After waiting a little longer, the screen still showed no words, so you got up and planned to leave first.
After all, you have other things to do, and you need to check the effectiveness of several medications to see which ones cause the least pain. You're very busy.
But the moment you stand up, you see another sentence flashing on the screen.
[Wait]! I hope you can [stay]; I have a [deal] here that will absolutely satisfy you.
So you sit back down, still curious about what he can say. Although to you now, he's just a computer rogue software.
"Alright, then what do you think we should do? Do you need money, my soul, or my life?" You raised your eyebrows, crossed your arms, and asked.
No, nothing [needs] you to give in [effort].
You slowly shake your head. Anyway, you know he must be able to see it: "I know, you must need something, otherwise you wouldn't be doing the deal with me." Of course, I don't care about that, because I don't care about what I say. If you want it, you can take it freely. I'm actually curious about what terms you can offer that interests me. "As you spoke, you shrugged, showing you didn't care at all."
Spamton seemed to choke up again. In any case, the message on the screen still didn't pop up for quite a while. After a while, the sentence from earlier finally changed.
No, it only requires you to give a small part of your soul.
You stroked your chin again: "Is that so...... A deal with a demon? Interesting, so what are your terms? I want to hear your chips. ”
So, do you want to hold your head high, to become a big shot?
You just shook your head and decisively refused: "No, I don't want to. After becoming famous, I have to deal with so many sycophants who only know how to flatter and flatter. They won't even tell you what went wrong, only praise you to the brim. When you lose power and then chase after someone else, I don't want that kind of fame." ”
…… So, perhaps you want a steady stream of inspiration?
This time, you frowned and pondered for a moment, then shook your head: "No need. I have inspiration myself, so of course I don't need you to provide it. Besides, since you're saying that, what can you offer me?" Honestly, I can't trust you this time. ”
Spamton was stuck again, but this time you were just waiting leisurely to see what terms he would offer. You weren't in a hurry to leave.
So, perhaps a healthy and graceful body?
You still shake your head: "I don't need it. My body is enough now. Although I have illness and pain, I'm not completely healthy, but as long as I can ignore the pain, I don't mind. Actually, I've long gotten used to it; it's just that I haven't fully overcome the pain yet." ”
So, what is the genuine love from those around you?
This time you sneered with a hint of mockery: "Love?" What is that? Can it be eaten as food? I don't understand what it really is, I don't need it, I have no friends, and my parents don't care about me. That's fine. I like this feeling of being unnoticed because then no one cares about my death. And no one pays attention to my death. ”
So, tell me your true needs.
It feels like Spamton is completely powerless, but you still stroke your chin with interest before speaking.
"I see...... First of all, I hope I can live well for tomorrow, so I can die without regrets. Of course, I can die without regrets now. If I weren't still a bit curious about this rogue software that suddenly appeared on my computer, maybe I'd already be lying downstairs by now. "You spoke your thoughts somewhat indifferently.
"So—my only regret is that I have not yet experienced anything that excites me, gives me passion, or makes me happy, burns my reason in it, and lets me experience the rare freedom to forget everything and let go of everything, something fresh enough. After that, I hope to have a grand death. ”
"This is the condition I want." You shrugged, waiting leisurely for Spamton's reaction, eagerly waiting to see if he would agree to your terms.
This time, Spamton was silent for a while longer before struggling to get some words out of the screen. You can imagine he was probably still thinking.
[Okay], [Agreement established], I will [agree] to these [requests]. Or rather, you can feel these without needing any other [conditions]. So, [you] really don't need any other [conditions]?
You think seriously for a moment, then decisively shake your head: "No need, I'm even willing to give my whole soul for this—I just want to see something truly magnificent that excites me, or something that can rekindle my desire to live in that moment. Maybe I just need a mystery?" ”
You chatter endlessly and naturally press the confirm button in a pop-up on your computer screen. Honestly, you don't even care why you can access it without using a mouse—after all, this isn't a touchscreen computer.
Then, you suddenly feel an emptiness in your body, as if at the heart of your heart, endless desire begins to burn. But inside, it is so empty that that desire cannot overcome your desire to die.
Touching your chest, you pondered for a moment, then you heard some noises behind you, along with some tangled threads? Instinctively, you turned around, and then you saw spamtonNEO standing there, looking like a program failure, at least the numbers 1001 were tangled and unstable.

"I think maybe you should quit the game." What you heard was that slightly hoarse, electric crackling sound—in short, not very pleasant.
You know it's Spamton's voice, and you accept it quickly. You don't really care what he did—maybe he really did something to your soul—so you just raise your eyebrows: "What, do you find the repetitive plot boring?" ”
Although you're curious why this save file hasn't been damaged yet and can still move freely, is missing an NPC really that important? At this point, you actually have a new question.

After all, it truly brought changes to your life, so you feel okay and accept it all in a good mood.

After all, in his view, he believed you didn't really have any ideals or desires—so he was curious, curious about what your future would be like.
"Then, [you] have given the [correct answer]." In the end, he simply said this.

But at least, perhaps even with just this result, Spamton is satisfied enough.

Does this mean you're actually just a string of error codes? ”
Spamton didn't answer your question; it just forked your game window and opened a nearby video app.
You pouted, "Tch," and actually avoided answering. But you have your own answer to this question; it's definitely a string of error codes.
Looking at the movie posters displayed on the first page of the video app, you barely got in the mood and gave an introduction: "You want to watch a movie?" Hmm...... Actually, I haven't seen many movies and can't really recommend them, so let's see which movie you prefer. "You said this, sounding uninterested.
You might find watching movies boring; often, as soon as you see the beginning, you start guessing how the ending will be, so it's like being exposed to the content early on, which makes you even less interested.
You just sit in your computer chair with your arms crossed, hesitate for a moment while staring at the mouse, click on a movie poster, and then start playing the movie.
You yawned.
"I think this [movie] might have [viewing value]." You hear a voice deep in your mind say, and you just casually respond with a couple of hums.
This film is called "The Butterfly Effect." Just from the beginning, when you see the story of the little boy and girl, you can guess what the adult boy does to change the girl's past and future—well, after all, the best ending is to meet but never meet again.
So you find it boring and boring, and you don't really want to keep watching. But you guess Spamton probably didn't get into any entertainment when he was trapped in the game, so now he's actually enjoying it.
At least you can hear his comments on the plot, which shows he is indeed watching carefully.
And the novelty finally wears off, so you simply stand up and decide to study humanoid computers again—after all, you've just been possessed by Spamton, who knows what changes might happen?
Just as you got up and walked over, you heard Spamton's slightly surprised voice: "[Question: Direction of Progress]?" ”
You glanced at the lab not far away. Yes, you couldn't be bothered to do research outside, so you just set up a lab at home—just casually replying, "Doing research." Doing research is a bit more fun than watching movies. ”
At this moment, he realized he'd made a wrong choice—maybe he should have opened other software, since he could already control your computer himself—
However, Spamton subconsciously explained, "Maybe you should [enjoy] the process." ”
You lowered your gaze slightly, picked up the scattered carrier from the ground, and planned to carry it back to the lab.
"No, I'm a result enthusiast." As you spoke, your voice paused, then rose upward.
"So—actually, I can do anything. You need my soul, my life, my vitality or emotional dedication, and even other things. But on the other hand, I hope you can help me rediscover the fun of this world, or maybe just the amusement of your existence, even just a little curiosity of mine, which might guarantee my passion for you for a while—give it a try, let me fall asleep thinking of you, how about that?" "You're quite interested. After all...... Often, when you're thinking about nothing, you end up sleepless, just lying in bed for an hour or two full of excitement.
So, maybe things will change now? You're looking forward to it.
Tbc.
…… He didn't answer you, and you just shrugged. You couldn't really say how disappointed—maybe you really did feel a bit disappointed. But you just walked into the lab by yourself, manually ignoring any sounds that might pop into your mind.
But what followed was indeed very quiet, probably because Spamton couldn't understand your research process; it was simply that when he saw it, he subconsciously felt a sense of foreboding...... Because right now you were still experimenting with lab mice, but you were muttering something about it. If you want to develop humanoid computers, maybe human volunteers will be needed to conduct experiments or something similar......
He suddenly doesn't really want to appear before you again; maybe the next second, you'll drag him into the lab. But that wasn't his original intention.
But you didn't care about that, just immersed yourself in studying the model. You were rarely inspired—the previous experiment had stalled for a long time and didn't continue. Now, you've decided to add richer tactile and emotional modules to your semi-finished humanoid computer.
So, even after dinner time passed for an hour or two, you were still stuck in the lab, completely forgetting about having dinner.
Until Spamton, unable to hold back any longer, finally spoke: "[Reminder:] has already passed [Dinner time]." ”
At this moment, you could hear everything clearly, and when the voice in your mind sounded, you belatedly realized you'd been hungry for too long, and your stomach was aching a little. To be honest...... Because you often forget to eat during experiments, it's normal for your digestive system to be weak.
You coughed twice and finally stopped what you were doing. The research was about to wrap up, so it wouldn't be a big deal to stay here. Then you carefully closed the door, disinfected yourself, and then headed to the kitchen.
"Oh, thanks for the reminder, otherwise I really would have forgotten to eat." You still don't forget to thank him. Although even if he doesn't remind you, he'll realize sooner or later...... Probably. Maybe it'll be another hour or two.
Thinking this, you still asked, "By the way, you can see the time on my computer, right?" So...... Can you give me an accurate time? Just to remind me, otherwise I might not realize it's time for dinner until it's time to sleep. ”
That statement sounds quite natural. After all...... Indeed, you can't bring an alarm clock into the lab, so it's actually quite convenient to see Spamton, who can communicate with you in your brain.
"...... [can], but [reward]?" Actually, he could do these things for you for free, but he always felt that if he didn't ask for any payment, it would seem like he was losing out.
You thought for a moment, rubbed your chin, and casually made yourself instant noodles first. Eating is a waste of time for you, so it's better to eat instant noodles, though after eating instant noodles, you might get a stomachache at night...... Well, you can just bear with it.
"Payment...... "Well, the reward is that I won't use you for experiments in the future, right?" You said this with regret and reluctance. You have to understand, a good experimental subject is really hard to find—but Spamton's successful possession of that semi-finished product is also a precious sample, so you can still reluctantly give up some ideas.
"[Deal]." He agreed to this condition without much hesitation. Spamton didn't want to be dragged onto the lab table the very next second after he appeared, but he couldn't show up steadily right now.
"Alright, let's close it...... Ah, it's about time to sleep. "You leisurely finished your instant noodles. Glancing at the time, it was already ten o'clock at night. You should hurry up and take a shower and rest."
So you quickly washed the dishes and went to the bathroom, then took off your clothes directly. But just as you finished undressing and before you could turn on the faucet, you heard Spamton's frantic voice.
"[Stop]! [You] did not send a [notification]! "His voice sounded somewhat flustered.

Uh, but this is just a normal human structure, nothing special, right? Besides that, there are thousands of people like this—what's so special about it? ”
Anyway, you just treat your body as your body, so you just quickly shower and change clothes, check the time, and regretfully realize that it's probably better to just rest directly.
"...... [nothing special]." You heard him wait a long while before answering dryly, so you nodded as if it were only natural.
"It's just nothing special. Forget it, I have to rest anyway. Let's talk about these things tomorrow."

"[What's your condition]?" After hesitating for a moment, he decided to take the initiative to ask about your condition.
