Eating instant noodles late at night is a bit too greasy, so my stomach feels uncomfortable and a bit painful...... Sigh, it'll be fine in a while." "You know your body well, just going through a storm for a while now. After a while, you'll be fine. Or maybe you lie down and fall asleep too early; in the past, you had to lie down for an hour before falling asleep......
By then, you would have already endured the pain with a blank expression.
Spamton was silent for a moment, then suddenly switched to a more solemn tone and said, "[Starting tomorrow], I will be responsible for [prompting time]." ”
And you just wave it off indifferently: "Then I'll trouble you to remind me...... In fact, you know very well that, according to habit, he will probably give up after a few days. After all, this is no ordinary thing at all. After saying this, your pain finally eased, and before you knew it, you fell back asleep.
But unexpectedly, he actually stuck with it, so for the next three months, you had to stop your half-finished research during the reminder time to eat properly—well, you ate either fast food or instant noodles. In short, you wouldn't cook for yourself, which would be a waste of time.
Although most of the time is spent in the lab, occasionally you sit in front of the computer under Spamton's strict demands, watching the mouse move itself to open a new movie.
…… They even pause for about an hour to let you drink water.
You find it quite novel. Even if you don't listen to his request, it won't matter, but this novelty still makes you sit in front of the computer.
Until once again, drinking water and watching the video on the screen, you yawned out of boredom: "...... But just sitting like this is so boring. ”
Although it's a bit fun, it's only in the first few times—the novelty wears off, and once the novelty wears off, you feel bored again. Honestly...... For you, it's just a lack of fun. If it weren't for Spamton still looking engrossed in the movie, you'd have wanted to leave just now.
At that moment, you suddenly feel a weight on your shoulders. Looking down—you won't mistake it, Spamton's hands are wrapped around you, or maybe it's that Neo too. You can't help but turn your head, tilt your head up slightly, and find Spamton holding you, looking down at you. Noticing your gaze, you say, "Then, maybe [you] can [accompany] me while watching [the film]?" ”
You glanced at him twice, blinking your eyes, seeing that he still seemed somewhat ethereal, still showing the 0110 code body, but it was obviously much more substantial—after all, developing that humanoid computer now follows Spamton's appearance, so naturally there aren't as many obstacles.
Silent, you don't know what kind of emotions you're in right now, or even a strange calm—you don't know how to continue in a moment lacking passion, but in the end, you let out a light laugh: "Alright, let's finish reading then." ”
Is it the only bit of fun in the boring moments? Or is it simply accepting this boring time? You probably think it's the former. In fact, as long as it brings you a little freshness, you won't lose interest in Spamton.
So, of course, you were happy to do more for him. You eventually developed the first humanoid computer. This time, you didn't ask Spamton's opinion, but directly connected the humanoid computer's wires to the computer and then transmitted its consciousness code data over there. You propped your chin up, watching the humanoid computer you placed unconscious on the bed, and then it slowly woke up.
Looking into the eyes—it's Spamton, so you smile with satisfaction, then belatedly get excited: "Wow, I did it. I did it! That's great...... With this technology, I'll never be bored again. ”
If you feel bored, just create a new humanoid computer personality to accompany you, but before that, you still need to study Spamton's code. After all, you're just typing it in directly.
"Maybe ...... [I] won't let you feel the emotion of 'boredom.'" You heard Spamton's voice. Honestly, it sounded a bit nicer. After all, you made special adjustments when designing the humanoid computer. Otherwise, you wouldn't be able to stand the unpleasant mechanical sounds all the time. Even though you don't know why there are so many things in his words that seem to be clipped from some recording, or even hyperlinks.
So you looked down at him: "Hmm...... But honestly, I did agree on the deal, right? After all, what you wanted was dimensional upgrades, and now I've helped you achieve that. So even if the deal is finalized and then voided? ”
But Spamton just suddenly stood up and stood in front of you—you also removed the handwire from the humanoid computer while developing it, which didn't do much good, since it wasn't a puppet you wanted to control. And seeing him stand up now, you couldn't help but take two steps back—the sense of pressure was still a bit too strong.
"Then, I want to make a new [Trade]."
You swallow hard, but your voice remains calm and unruffled: "Content?" ”
You hear him chuckle a few times as if strange: "I will let you experience a daily life that is always [interesting], let you have the ideal [life], let [you] feel [happiness], and never be [boring]...... But in contrast, the content of the [transaction] is a [marriage request]. ”
You look up at him strangely, but you have to admit you're a bit tempted...... But he's sure he still has many requests he hasn't made, and you don't really care about them.
So you just shrugged: "Like this?" That's fine too. But you have to wait until I develop the other humanoid computers first, otherwise you won't have a legal status and won't get married, right?" You seriously considered this issue and then headed back to the lab.
But before that, Spamton grabbed your collar and lifted you up, and you looked at him helplessly.
"First of all, it's lunchtime now." he said.
“…… Alright, alright. "You covered your head.

However, he also knew that although he had appeared here now, his time wouldn't be long. After all, he could see that his body was now covered with various binary characters of 0110, and as time passed, the illusory parts had become more and more numerous.

"To be honest, discovering something like this made you feel quite sad for a moment—or rather, a sense of loss. After all, you still have the chance to do a proper research, and I didn't expect it would only be so short."
So you cross your arms and watch Spamton disappear before you, leaving behind the same vessel you had previously created in a boring way—he only left behind a phrase before disappearing: "We will meet again." ”
Hmm...... Since you say so, you might as well believe it. After all, you're indeed somewhat interested in the deal he mentioned. As for this device, it was developed when he wanted to research humanoid computers before, and he didn't pay much attention to its appearance. However, when Spamton appeared earlier, he simply adopted his own image.
…… So, by entering his code, can this carrier come back to life? You used to struggle with what kind of code could activate a humanoid computer, but now you have some ideas.
But before that, you decide to go back to your computer and see what the game that just had a black screen looks like now.
After sitting back in your computer chair, you see your character still standing there, facing the night and the deep blue walls, but the front is empty. Speaking of which, this game is exactly what you downloaded when you were bored.
Just as you're about to move your game character to another location, you hear a voice in your brain—honestly, you find it quite novel, it seems surreal, and just moments ago it could be explained as code transfer, but now—you're a living person, not a machine.
"I think maybe you should quit the game." What you heard was that slightly hoarse, electric crackling sound—in short, not very pleasant.
You know it's Spamton's voice, and you accept it quickly. You don't really care what he did—maybe he really did something to your soul—so you just raise your eyebrows: "What, do you find the repetitive plot boring?" ”
Although you're curious why this save file hasn't been damaged yet and can still move freely, is missing an NPC really that important? At this point, you actually have a new question.
"Given that, you should be able to see my computer screen, and maybe see me through the computer webcam—but that's not really important. What I want to know is, are you a character who belongs only to this archive, or are you a collective? Is it a single string of code operating independently, or is it all the code of the consortium?" You said lightly, and you really were just curious about it. You always felt that after learning Spamton could break free from it, your curiosity increased, and naturally, you had other questions, countless beyond measure.
As for this question, before he could answer, you quickly came up with an answer yourself: "Oh, it's a collection. After all, the save file isn't corrupted, which means you've completely detached—you want to upgrade dimensionally, no longer just a string of code." You finished your conclusion like pouring beans.
Then his tone turned a bit cold: "Maybe you already took over the computer's access and learned through the camera what I'm developing. You saw an opportunity—so you proposed a deal to me. What you want isn't as simple as you say, but more conditions." ”
After saying this, you instead collapsed backward into your computer chair, stretching out your voice and speaking in a relaxed tone: "Ah...... But I don't really mind, so I can do whatever I want! ”
After all, it truly brought changes to your life, so you feel okay and accept it all in a good mood.
Spamton was momentarily speechless. He knew that what you said was basically right. He couldn't refute it, except for one sentence that was wrong—although he thought there was an opportunity, he chose you to complete the deal for another reason: he wanted to get to know you up close to satisfy his growing curiosity about you. After all, in his view, he believed you didn't really have any ideals or desires—so he was curious, curious about what your future would be like.
"Then, [you] have given the [correct answer]." In the end, he simply said this.
But you raised your eyebrows proudly: "I knew it—it had to be like that! Well, even if I said something wrong, it doesn't matter. I just want to get a general idea of the reasons behind your behavior. After all, there must be a set of logic that drives you to do this." You say you don't care, since a string of code definitely has running logic—so he must have it too.
Yes, you don't see the other person as an equal. If you can possess the humanoid computer you built, how could it still be human?
"Naturally, there is [logic], and [you] are very [smart]." He just followed your lead.
And you just wave your hand indifferently: "Of course I know—alright, do you want me to transfer your code completely into that humanoid computer?" Although it might be a bit troublesome, it's a very simple thing. ”
"No, I don't need to. I'll enter at the [necessary] moment." Spamton said.
…… In fact, he was now somewhat confused. Although he had indeed successfully ascended to some extent, he could only possess that kind of body. For him, was this his true purpose?
But at least, perhaps even with just this result, Spamton is satisfied enough.
You shrugged. Actually, this was the first time you had encountered game code coming to life, gaining your own thinking ability, or perhaps your own emotional ......? So you raised your eyebrows with interest: "Ah, speaking of which, you've developed your own self-awareness, or rather, your own emotions and values...... Does this mean you're actually just a string of error codes? ”
Spamton didn't answer your question; it just forked your game window and opened a nearby video app.
You pouted, "Tch," and actually avoided answering. But you have your own answer to this question; it's definitely a string of error codes.
Looking at the movie posters displayed on the first page of the video app, you barely got in the mood and gave an introduction: "You want to watch a movie?" Hmm...... Actually, I haven't seen many movies and can't really recommend them, so let's see which movie you prefer. "You said this, sounding uninterested.
You might find watching movies boring; often, as soon as you see the beginning, you start guessing how the ending will be, so it's like being exposed to the content early on, which makes you even less interested.
You just sit in your computer chair with your arms crossed, hesitate for a moment while staring at the mouse, click on a movie poster, and then start playing the movie.
You yawned.
"I think this [movie] might have [viewing value]." You hear a voice deep in your mind say, and you just casually respond with a couple of hums.
This film is called "The Butterfly Effect." Just from the beginning, when you see the story of the little boy and girl, you can guess what the adult boy does to change the girl's past and future—well, after all, the best ending is to meet but never meet again.
So you find it boring and boring, and you don't really want to keep watching. But you guess Spamton probably didn't get into any entertainment when he was trapped in the game, so now he's actually enjoying it.
At least you can hear his comments on the plot, which shows he is indeed watching carefully.
And the novelty finally wears off, so you simply stand up and decide to study humanoid computers again—after all, you've just been possessed by Spamton, who knows what changes might happen?
Just as you got up and walked over, you heard Spamton's slightly surprised voice: "[Question: Direction of Progress]?" ”
You glanced at the lab not far away. Yes, you couldn't be bothered to do research outside, so you just set up a lab at home—just casually replying, "Doing research." Doing research is a bit more fun than watching movies. ”
At this moment, he realized he'd made a wrong choice—maybe he should have opened other software, since he could already control your computer himself—
However, Spamton subconsciously explained, "Maybe you should [enjoy] the process." ”
You lowered your gaze slightly, picked up the scattered carrier from the ground, and planned to carry it back to the lab.
"No, I'm a result enthusiast." As you spoke, your voice paused, then rose upward.
"So—actually, I can do anything. You need my soul, my life, my vitality or emotional dedication, and even other things. But on the other hand, I hope you can help me rediscover the fun of this world, or maybe just the amusement of your existence, even just a little curiosity of mine, which might guarantee my passion for you for a while—give it a try, let me fall asleep thinking of you, how about that?" "You're quite interested. After all...... Often, when you're thinking about nothing, you end up sleepless, just lying in bed for an hour or two full of excitement.
So, maybe things will change now? You're looking forward to it.
Tbc.

title: Computer Rogue Software 3 (end) - Sptx You
content:
…… He didn't answer you, and you just shrugged. You couldn't really say how disappointed—maybe you really did feel a bit disappointed. But you just walked into the lab by yourself, manually ignoring any sounds that might pop into your mind.
But what followed was indeed very quiet, probably because Spamton couldn't understand your research process; it was simply that when he saw it, he subconsciously felt a sense of foreboding...... Because right now you were still experimenting with lab mice, but you were muttering something about it. If you want to develop humanoid computers, maybe human volunteers will be needed to conduct experiments or something similar......
He suddenly doesn't really want to appear before you again; maybe the next second, you'll drag him into the lab. But that wasn't his original intention.
But you didn't care about that, just immersed yourself in studying the model. You were rarely inspired—the previous experiment had stalled for a long time and didn't continue. Now, you've decided to add richer tactile and emotional modules to your semi-finished humanoid computer.
So, even after dinner time passed for an hour or two, you were still stuck in the lab, completely forgetting about having dinner.
Until Spamton, unable to hold back any longer, finally spoke: "[Reminder:] has already passed [Dinner time]." ”
At this moment, you could hear everything clearly, and when the voice in your mind sounded, you belatedly realized you'd been hungry for too long, and your stomach was aching a little. To be honest...... Because you often forget to eat during experiments, it's normal for your digestive system to be weak.
You coughed twice and finally stopped what you were doing. The research was about to wrap up, so it wouldn't be a big deal to stay here. Then you carefully closed the door, disinfected yourself, and then headed to the kitchen.
"Oh, thanks for the reminder, otherwise I really would have forgotten to eat." You still don't forget to thank him. Although even if he doesn't remind you, he'll realize sooner or later...... Probably. Maybe it'll be another hour or two.
Thinking this, you still asked, "By the way, you can see the time on my computer, right?" So...... Can you give me an accurate time? Just to remind me, otherwise I might not realize it's time for dinner until it's time to sleep. ”
That statement sounds quite natural. After all...... Indeed, you can't bring an alarm clock into the lab, so it's actually quite convenient to see Spamton, who can communicate with you in your brain.
"...... [can], but [reward]?" Actually, he could do these things for you for free, but he always felt that if he didn't ask for any payment, it would seem like he was losing out.
You thought for a moment, rubbed your chin, and casually made yourself instant noodles first. Eating is a waste of time for you, so it's better to eat instant noodles, though after eating instant noodles, you might get a stomachache at night...... Well, you can just bear with it.
"Payment...... "Well, the reward is that I won't use you for experiments in the future, right?" You said this with regret and reluctance. You have to understand, a good experimental subject is really hard to find—but Spamton's successful possession of that semi-finished product is also a precious sample, so you can still reluctantly give up some ideas.
"[Deal]." He agreed to this condition without much hesitation. Spamton didn't want to be dragged onto the lab table the very next second after he appeared, but he couldn't show up steadily right now.
"Alright, let's close it...... Ah, it's about time to sleep. "You leisurely finished your instant noodles. Glancing at the time, it was already ten o'clock at night. You should hurry up and take a shower and rest."
So you quickly washed the dishes and went to the bathroom, then took off your clothes directly. You were pretty fast—after all, if you washed up quickly, you might even be able to finish the remaining experiment. But just as you finished undressing and before you could turn on the faucet, you heard Spamton's frantic voice.
"[Stop]! [You] did not send a [notification]! "His voice sounded somewhat flustered.
You turn on the faucet in confusion: "Stop what, stop, notify what notification? Is it because I didn't notify NIIT that I need to take a shower...... Uh, but this is just a normal human structure, nothing special, right? Besides that, there are thousands of people like this—what's so special about it? ”
Anyway, you just treat your body as your body, so you just quickly shower and change clothes, check the time, and regretfully realize that it's probably better to just rest directly.
"...... [nothing special]." You heard him wait a long while before answering dryly, so you nodded as if it were only natural.
"It's just nothing special. Forget it, I have to rest anyway. Let's talk about these things tomorrow."
Saying that, you walked out and lay down on the bed, then closed your eyes. Your mind was still active, but probably because of the surprise Spamton brought you this morning, you no longer thought about the next step of the experiment or what theoretical results should be achieved. Instead, you began to wonder: how exactly did Spamton successfully appear and possess you? What exactly is it trying to achieve for him? Is it really the same as the things you casually speculated before? Thinking about these questions, you can't help but start to feel sleepy. So you open your eyes, yawn, and whisper, "Good night." ”
Spamton knew she was speaking to him, so he replied, "Good night." ”
Of course, he didn't say much; he just stared absentmindedly at your face after you fell asleep. In fact, in his current state, he didn't need sleep at all. So he just operated your computer to open a webpage, clicked on the page, hesitated for a moment, and finally opened the pages about proper nutrition in three meals a day and how to eat for health.
But before he could watch for long, after browsing a few web pages, he heard you turning over. He noticed you had actually woken up again, his eyes wide open. Looking at the time, Spamton realized it had only been an hour.
"[What's your condition]?" After hesitating for a moment, he decided to take the initiative to ask about your condition.
You just pretended to be indifferent and waved your hand. Even though cold sweat was pouring down your forehead, you forced a smile: "Ah, old problem. Eating instant noodles late at night is a bit too greasy, so my stomach feels uncomfortable and a bit painful...... Sigh, it'll be fine in a while." "You know your body well, just going through a storm for a while now. After a while, you'll be fine. Or maybe you lie down and fall asleep too early; in the past, you had to lie down for an hour before falling asleep......
By then, you would have already endured the pain with a blank expression.
Spamton was silent for a moment, then suddenly switched to a more solemn tone and said, "[Starting tomorrow], I will be responsible for [prompting time]." ”
And you just wave it off indifferently: "Then I'll trouble you to remind me...... In fact, you know very well that, according to habit, he will probably give up after a few days. After all, this is no ordinary thing at all. After saying this, your pain finally eased, and before you knew it, you fell back asleep.
But unexpectedly, he actually stuck with it, so for the next three months, you had to stop your half-finished research during the reminder time to eat properly—well, you ate either fast food or instant noodles. In short, you wouldn't cook for yourself, which would be a waste of time.
Although most of the time is spent in the lab, occasionally you sit in front of the computer under Spamton's strict demands, watching the mouse move itself to open a new movie.
…… They even pause for about an hour to let you drink water.
You find it quite novel. Even if you don't listen to his request, it won't matter, but this novelty still makes you sit in front of the computer.
Until once again, drinking water and watching the video on the screen, you yawned out of boredom: "...... But just sitting like this is so boring. ”
Although it's a bit fun, it's only in the first few times—the novelty wears off, and once the novelty wears off, you feel bored again. Honestly...... For you, it's just a lack of fun. If it weren't for Spamton still looking engrossed in the movie, you'd have wanted to leave just now.
At that moment, you suddenly feel a weight on your shoulders. Looking down—you won't mistake it, Spamton's hands are wrapped around you, or maybe it's that Neo too. You can't help but turn your head, tilt your head up slightly, and find Spamton holding you, looking down at you. Noticing your gaze, you say, "Then, maybe [you] can [accompany] me while watching [the film]?" ”
You glanced at him twice, blinking your eyes, seeing that he still seemed somewhat ethereal, still showing the 0110 code body, but it was obviously much more substantial—after all, developing that humanoid computer now follows Spamton's appearance, so naturally there aren't as many obstacles.
Silent, you don't know what kind of emotions you're in right now, or even a strange calm—you don't know how to continue in a moment lacking passion, but in the end, you let out a light laugh: "Alright, let's finish reading then." ”
Is it the only bit of fun in the boring moments? Or is it simply accepting this boring time? You probably think it's the former. In fact, as long as it brings you a little freshness, you won't lose interest in Spamton.
So, of course, you were happy to do more for him. You eventually developed the first humanoid computer. This time, you didn't ask Spamton's opinion, but directly connected the humanoid computer's wires to the computer and then transmitted its consciousness code data over there. You propped your chin up, watching the humanoid computer you placed unconscious on the bed, and then it slowly woke up.
Looking into the eyes—it's Spamton, so you smile with satisfaction, then belatedly get excited: "Wow, I did it. I did it! That's great...... With this technology, I'll never be bored again. ”
If you feel bored, just create a new humanoid computer personality to accompany you, but before that, you still need to study Spamton's code. After all, you're just typing it in directly.
"Maybe ...... [I] won't let you feel the emotion of 'boredom.'" You heard Spamton's voice. Honestly, it sounded a bit nicer. After all, you made special adjustments when designing the humanoid computer. Otherwise, you wouldn't be able to stand the unpleasant mechanical sounds all the time. Even though you don't know why there are so many things in his words that seem to be clipped from some recording, or even hyperlinks.
So you looked down at him: "Hmm...... But honestly, I did agree on the deal, right? After all, what you wanted was dimensional upgrades, and now I've helped you achieve that. So even if the deal is finalized and then voided? ”
But Spamton just suddenly stood up and stood in front of you—you also removed the handwire from the humanoid computer while developing it, which didn't do much good, since it wasn't a puppet you wanted to control. And seeing him stand up now, you couldn't help but take two steps back—the sense of pressure was still a bit too strong.
"Then, I want to make a new [Trade]."
You swallow hard, but your voice remains calm and unruffled: "Content?" ”
You hear him chuckle a few times as if strange: "I will let you experience a daily life that is always [interesting], let you have the ideal [life], let [you] feel [happiness], and never be [boring]...... But in contrast, the content of the [transaction] is a [marriage request]. ”
You look up at him strangely, but you have to admit you're a bit tempted...... But he's sure he still has many requests he hasn't made, and you don't really care about them.
So you just shrugged: "Like this?" That's fine too. But you have to wait until I develop the other humanoid computers first, otherwise you won't have a legal status and won't get married, right?" You seriously considered this issue and then headed back to the lab.
But before that, Spamton grabbed your collar and lifted you up, and you looked at him helplessly.
"First of all, it's lunchtime now." he said.
“…… Alright, alright. "You covered your head.

title: Gold Medal Pet 1-sptx You(1)
content:

——
You yawn, rub your eyes, and straighten yourself in front of the mirror—well, it seems no cosmetics can hide the dark circles under your eyelids anymore.
You haven't had a good night's sleep for two or three months in a row. Maybe it's because your anxiety is too severe. When you went to the sleep disorder department for a checkup, the doctor gently suggested you look for emotional support and build connections with others, whether animals or people—whether they're people of light or darkness. Overall, you're deficient in a series of factors, with endorphins being the most severe.
After hesitating for a moment, you decide to accept the doctor's suggestion. Indeed, you are solitary and haven't had any contact with the outside world for a long time. Yet you hate people, hate talking to people, whether the People of Light or the People of Darkness—it's pretty much the same concept to you: people.
But the Dark People are always a bit better, since to some extent, they're more like objects in disguise. So you decide to stay in the Dark World for a while, buy a property on the edge of Cyber City, and then go to the pet store to get a bunch of cats and dogs, along with a few birds—cuckoos, parrots, and even a few hamsters—and a squid mice. For some reason, as soon as those little animals see you, they come over and refuse to leave. But when you see those soft, smooth fur, your heart softens. You don't want any of the animals to be sad, so in the end, you grit your teeth and buy them all.
Fortunately, you still have some savings and used all the universal currency to exchange a large pile of dark coins before coming here.
You hold a cat in your arms, a hamster cage in the other, and a bunch of cats and dogs running around your feet, along with a few chipmare mice—birds flying in the sky following you. You sigh and pass through the alley you must pass home. You hear something from the trash can, but you don't have time to look, because you still have to groom the cats and dogs in your arms and feet. Listening to their soothing purring, your mood gradually relaxes.
Back home, you put the cage on the floor. The once quiet house was now filled with the chatter of animals, but you didn't find it noisy. Instead, you half-knelt and gently groomed the kitten at your feet, your fingers running through the smooth fur. Parrots and similar creatures flew over, stopped, perched on your shoulder, and refused to leave.
You prepare to count how many small animals you bought today, taking a deep breath as you gently hum a song to them. The melodious tune makes the previously noisy animals all quiet down. You stroke the cats and dogs beside you, silently counting in your mind until your hand unconsciously touches the greasy, seemingly bristly brittle fur—not only that, you also touch down to something that seems smooth, even somewhat cold...... Skin?
You glanced down, your pupils dilating sharply, and for a moment, you panicked. The reason was simple: the animal in your hand didn't seem like a small animal you bought—it was a puppet that had come from somewhere.
It's your fault—the size difference between the other animals is so big, and you didn't notice...... He looked roughly about one meter tall. The other little animals were a bit displeased at this, snoring angrily and suppressedly. Even the parrots perched on his shoulder began flapping their wings, and a few tried to peck him. You quickly reached out to stop them, gently stroked their fur, and then they quieted down again, perching on a nearby rack, though still staring at him like tigers.
The cats and dogs kept clasping their hands, telling you to stop petting them and instead pet yourself. You suddenly snapped back to reality, withdrew your hand, and stroked a ragdoll cat that had rubbed against your feet. Its eyes widened in fright, and you instinctively curled up to look at it: "You...... Are you the pet I bought too?" "You say that, but you don't believe it at all. Besides, if you ask about it, you'll regret it—you know you've asked the wrong question yourself.
But he nodded as if it were only natural, even introducing himself to you, proudly puffing out his chest: "Yes, I am [you] [the Gold Medal Salesman] Spamton G. Spamton, who is determined to pay in full!" ”
You stroked the goosebumps rising on your arm. To be honest...... You didn't even expect his voice to be like this. It's not that it was terrible to accept; you just felt that this kind of sound, mixed with electric currents and recorded audio, was the first time you'd heard it. The little animals around you were growing even louder, snoring in dissatisfaction and anger the day before yesterday, so you could only stroke their soft fur to comfort them.
"Well...... But what I need to buy is a pet, not a salesperson. "In the end, you decided to explain quietly." For some reason, the smile on his face seemed stiff, but then it curved even further.
"No, I am exactly the perfect pet model you need. If missed, there will be no more." His words left you stunned, making you take a while to understand.
You and it stared silently for a while, and the parrot on its shoulder began repeating your words, as if mocking Spamton: "What you need to buy is a pet!" "Not a salesperson!"
Spamton, however, reached out, then placed your hand on his head, pressed your hand and stroked your hair, smiling: "I believe [you] will give a [100% positive review]." ”
…… In fact, he only changed his tune after hearing your request. At first, he didn't know why you brought so many small animals back, but he felt he couldn't miss this chance to meet the People of Light, so he came along with them. And now, he knew this was probably his only chance to interact with the People of Light—he couldn't give up. After living in the trash for so long, he desperately hoped everything could change, desperately wished he could return to how things were before.
That's why he made up his mind to put your hand on his head. Even though this wasn't something he wanted to do. But soon, he changed his mind, realizing that being touched by you was actually a very pleasant thing.
After hesitating for a moment, you still leaned in, gently stroked his hair, scratched his face, and finally scratched his chin. Although you were a bit unfamiliar with this human-like form...... It wasn't much like petting a cat or something, so you scratched his chin again, while Spamton tilted his head back, squinting slightly, even making a faint purr.
He was even a bit shocked—it was purely a subconscious reaction, but he really did like your touch. This was unimaginable for Spamton.
Listening to his purring, your eyes curved into a smile, and you couldn't help but laugh. This really is no different from other pets...... Moreover, this pet can talk, making it seem more convenient than others to hear requests.
"Alright then...... Maybe you really are the pet I need. But before that, shouldn't you take a bath first? "You stroked his chin again and asked softly. The other little animals were all very clean, clearly having been thoroughly cleaned by the pet shop. But Spamton's body was dirty—or rather, he was no different from someone who had just crawled out of a pile of trash—and maybe that was true.
Spamton was stunned, instinctively shrinking back. He didn't want to take a hot bath—that would always bring back some unpleasant memories for him. But after sizing him up for a while, you finally handed him something like a towel you had just bought. Of course, he seemed to need a change of clothes, but you definitely didn't—you just glanced at it and didn't dare look again. His lower half wasn't even wearing pants, which means...... He was openly exposing his genitals, and in that sense, he seemed no different from other pets. So you think, maybe your previous clothes would have been suitable for him too, and in the end, you took out a white cotton nightdress.
When you look up again, he's about to sneak out to your doorstep. You tilt your head, puzzled: "Isn't it my top pet?" Why is it ...... Trying to sneak away? "Though you wouldn't be that angry, since you know most small animals are afraid of water, or rather, afraid of bathing. You could understand Spamton's fear, but still walked over, grabbed him by the back of the neck, and pulled him back into the living room.
Spamton continued to argue: "A Gold Pet doesn't necessarily need a Bathing job." ”
And you replied seriously, "But all my pets need to be cleaned thoroughly...... After all, I don't want to sleep with a dirty pet tonight." You complained, but didn't hear the puppet's response. You turned to look at him and saw that the puppet's face had inexplicably turned bright red, with wisps of white smoke...... Or rather, steam was rising from the top of his head.
You find it a bit funny, but indeed, because of sleep disorders, you've already planned to have these little animals sleep with you. After all, having them by your side visibly calms your anxiety.
You push Spamton, then bring the change of towels and clothes into the bathroom, and finally close the door. You turn on the faucet, and hot water starts spraying from it, while Spamton is sitting in the bathtub. He looks at you in surprise: "[You] want to participate in [bathing]?" ”
“…… Isn't it normal to help your pet bathe?" You tilted your head too, and while you were at it, you tidied up your shampoo, body wash, and pet bath oils. Hot water quickly filled half the tub. Spamton instinctively wanted to jump out, but you scratched his chin, stuffed it back in, and even pulled off his coat.
For some reason, his face seemed even hotter—at least the temperature you accidentally touched while scratching your chin told you.
And you just blinked innocently at him, splashing hot water on him, then squeezing out pet bath oil and applying it to his hair and upper body...... Just as you were about to reach out again, Spamton hurriedly held your hand down. For some reason, his voice seemed a bit stuttered.
"I...... I can switch the operating mode myself! "As he spoke, he hurriedly squeezed out some shower gel and applied it to his body, while you focused on ruffling his hair. After confirming that the grease was almost completely washed off, you finally drenched it little by little with hot water to wash off the foam.
Spamton's body seemed to relax too, or maybe your movements made him feel comfortable. He started snoring again, then suddenly stopped.
Although there was a little incident, the bathing process was still over. In the end, you put that white nightgown on him and pushed him out of the bathroom.
TBC.
*Endorphins, also known as endorphins or endorphins. Endorphins are neuromodulatory chemicals secreted by the pituitary gland. They are spontaneously produced by the body after persistence in doing something for a long time, making people feel euphoric, satisfied, and calm. Endorphins play an important role in regulating emotional behaviors (including anxiety, fear, tension, and pleasure) and in pain control. They are closely related to drug addiction, post-exercise excitement, appetite control, sexual response, as well as mental illnesses such as depression and schizophrenia.
Endorphins are a class of endogenous opioid peptides that specifically bind to morphine receptors in the brain, acting similarly to morphine, hence the name "endogenous morphin-like peptide." Besides analgesic functions, these peptides also have many other physiological functions, such as regulating body temperature, cardiovascular health, and respiratory function.
Endorphins are a general term for neuropeptides with morphine-like activity.

You were still slightly damp, and your face was tinged with a blush from the warm bathroom earlier. But as soon as you stepped out, the small animals around you, who were still sliding open the door, immediately gathered around your legs, gently rubbing their fur against you, and snoring at Spamton with hostility.
You scratched your head and looked up at Spamton, who had just showered and was still wearing your white nightdress. Even though that cotton nightgown couldn't fully cover it...... So it was as if his entire body was half-covered.
You coughed lightly twice, quietly turned your head away, hiding the burning marks on your face, and simply asked, "...... What would you like to eat?" ”
Spamton was taken aback and instinctively pressed his stomach. He probably hadn't expected you to ask such a question. He had thought you'd let him dine with those other animals.
You adjusted your mood, turned back to look at him, and just slightly raised your chin: "I think you probably want to sit down and eat even more." ”
Spamton just nodded silently. Of course he hoped, after all, he wasn't really a pet—just a way to respond in a moment of crisis.
You glanced at him and nodded in satisfaction. As expected, your pet was still very well-behaved—you first put food on the other little animals just for pets, then walked to the kitchen, picked up your apron, opened the fridge, and looked at the steak with only two servings left. You were a bit silent, but finally poured butter into the pan and cracked two eggs at the same time. That's how you get by for dinner.
You brought two steaming hot plates to the table, but at first glance you didn't see Spamton. You glanced again and saw him also squatting beside the food bowl, fighting a cat for food. The cat's fur was bristling up, struggling to chew and swallowing as if hoping to eat faster. Spamton, however, reached straight out and scooped a handful of food from the bowl, tossed it into his mouth, making a crunching sound. It seemed the cat food must be very hard.
You sighed, put the plate on the table, then walked over, grabbed Spamton's scruff, and pulled him to stand. You put the cat food back in the food bowl, and only then did the kitten quiet down again. The little cat had been meowing a lot around your legs as if it were tattling.
You picked up the Spamton and had him sit on a chair across the table. After thinking for a moment, you said, "Are you starving?" Anyway, this is your cat food. "Then you sat down on a chair, picked up your knife and fork, and started cutting the steak in front of you.
The air was silent for a moment, and for a moment, only the sounds of small animals gnawing on food could be heard. Then you heard the same sound of a knife cutting across the plate from across the table. The dinner passed silently. Those little animals ate even faster; some started calling around you again after eating. The parrots carefully retracted their paws and rested on your shoulder, while a few cats and dogs crawled straight onto your bed to sleep, curling up into a ball. Their fur was shiny and smooth, clearly well cared for at the pet store, completely different from the one in front of you.
You hesitated for a moment, then got up to clear the dishes and put them in the dishwasher. Then you rummaged through the cabinet and took out a bottle of hair oil, walked over, and gently applied it to Spamton's dry, frizzy hair after washing.
You hear Spamton's seemingly energetic voice: "Thank you for your generous contribution!" But there was always a hint of unease in his voice. He instinctively dodged for a moment, but forced himself to stay in his seat, compelling himself to accept your kindness.
You looked at his slightly trembling body, hesitated for a moment, and finally finished applying the hair oil. After all, this is your pet, so you have to take good care of it. Thinking this, you just said that, as if it were only natural: "...... Of course, you're my pet, so of course I won't hesitate to show my kindness." ”
He seemed choked up, but when he opened his mouth, only a sound of breath came out. You could imagine what he wanted to say, but after hesitating for a moment, he still said nothing. You had something to do, grabbed a pet comb, and started combing his hair. You didn't know why, despite his short hair, the ends still got tangled. You just gently picked up strands of hair and combed them until that once fuzzy hair finally settled down.
You took two satisfied steps back, looking at your masterpiece. Of course, while combing your hair, he made that comforting purring sound, but soon stopped again. You didn't mind that much, just subconsciously touched his hair again.
"Well, that's what counts as qualified...... Alright, you can go rest. "You waved your hand and covered your mouth and yawned, only then realizing just how long it took to apply essential oils and carefully comb your hair...... It's about time to wash up and rest.
Spamton glanced at the empty space between the nearly crowded furry beds, probably voluntarily moving away from a place for you to rest. He just smiled and said, "But [you] need [premium companionship services]?" ”
You paused, glanced at Spamton, then at your bed, your eye twitching. Almost all the creatures squeezed onto it, and you actually didn't have a place for Spamton to sleep...... Squeezing onto the sofa felt a bit like pet abuse. Anyway, you hesitated for a moment and said, "Ah, well, actually, it's yours to spamton." After all, no matter what he says, he's a creature that can talk, move, and chooses for itself. Even though you call him a cat, you don't mean to see him as one. But you do treat him as your own pet.
After saying that, you went to wash up. Of course, you didn't know that after that, Spamton brazenly climbed onto the bed, taking up some space and leaving you a spot next to him. The other cats and dogs barked at him in dissatisfaction, but Spamton didn't care; he just pretended not to hear and lay there.
When you finished washing up and were about to rest, this was the scene you saw. You blinked, just lay down on the bed, then rubbed spamton's hair with your smooth hair. You think you were a bit drunk and half-awake...... Anyway, right now you really wanted to lean against Mao Furnerong.
And the hair you had just carefully washed and cared for also rubbed against yours, then your cheeks, and finally your chest. He rubbed his cheek against your face again. The feeling of being so furry and cuddly was great. You couldn't help but moan, but it still felt a bit strange...... But you felt unusually drowsy, about to fall asleep, and didn't have time to think about it. So you just nudged your head a little, finally burying it in his abdomen, and instinctively rubbed it twice, but unfortunately, it was only slightly soft. Or rather, the cool skin, your head rubbing against the cotton nightdress felt a bit strange. You felt Spamton's body stiffen for a moment before relaxing, and you instinctively curled up into a ball, absorbing the only comfort beside you, wrapped your arms around his waist, and then fell into a deep sleep.
This night, you slept soundly for once, sometimes only waking up just before the alarm clock went off. Having slept well, your mood improved considerably. Rubbing your eyes, you were about to get up, but then your body stiffened. You noticed that in front of you, your sexual organ was erect, and the tip seemed to be leaking out.
You took a deep breath and hurriedly sat up, feeling a bit chaotic inside. At this moment, you had to admit one fact—the guy in front of you, or rather, the male, wasn't your pet, but just an ordinary and genuine Dark Dweller. You cleared your throat, wanting to change clothes and leave quickly, but then you felt a pair of hands rest on your waist, and your body stiffened again. You glanced to the side and saw Spamton still hadn't woken up—maybe it had been too long since he'd slept so comfortably in such a comfortable environment. After all, you remembered that yesterday he smelled like a pile of garbage, probably coming out of the trash.
It looked like an instinctive gesture...... You didn't know why he did this. At that moment, a cat jumped onto the bed, came over to nuzzle you, and was probably about to eat breakfast. You patted the cat's head; it put its cheek into your palm and softly purred. You rubbed Spamton's head and scratched his hair, and his head instinctively rubbed against your waist, making you instinctively dodge.
You take a deep breath, but in the end, you shake Spamton to wake him up quickly: "...... Get up, time for breakfast! ”
The first thing Spamton heard when he woke up was this. When he opened his eyes, the first thing he saw was the white, soft flesh on your waist, and he immediately realized what position he was in right now, so he hurriedly got up. He ...... Did he subconsciously get close to you in his sleep? In other words, maybe his subconscious felt that the safest place around you was?
He didn't know what to say, so he instinctively said, "...... sorry, I didn't provide the full service." ”
You shake your head: "It's okay...... It doesn't matter, I just think you're pretty cute like this." Although I was a bit embarrassed when I first noticed—after all, it was like sharing a bed with a stranger—then you realized that was actually just your pet.
So you instinctively grabbed him by the back of the neck and had him sit on the other side of the table, while you went to the kitchen to simply toast a few slices of bread, fried some eggs and some bacon, and grabbed two boxes of jam before coming out. You placed one plate in front of Spamton, another in front of yourself, and began to enjoy breakfast with great enjoyment. Before that, you had first placed food for the other little animals, but now the room was quiet again, with only the sound of chewing.
Looking at Spamton's expression, he seemed hesitant, wanting to ask something but unable to bring himself to say it. You simply spoke first: "Spamton, what's wrong?" ”
TBC.
He just shook his head and repeated, "[Sorry], I didn't provide [perfect service]." ”
After saying that, he continued eating breakfast. You glanced at him tentatively, but still couldn't get an answer, so in the end you had to give up. He won't tell you now, but someday he'll will...... Probably?
But over time, you gradually forget about it. You just still treat him as a slightly different pet—he's just a bit bigger and speaks things you can understand. Other than that, he doesn't seem much different from other pets.
After all, when you occasionally subconsciously pat his head, he squints and lifts his head high, looking proud, since the little animals surrounding you are all purring in dissatisfaction.
Sometimes, when you reach out to touch his head, Spamton will actively lean in, rubbing his cheek against your palm a few times, making you blush with emotion. In the end, you can only stumble your head away, not daring to look into his innocent yet indescribable eyes.
Every morning, you still maintain that state. Sometimes, even if you instinctively curl up and bury your head in his belly to fall asleep at night, the next morning you find Spamton's head buried inside your belly, and you end up in that strange posture, sharing the bed for who knows how long.
In short, you feel refreshed and your mental state gradually improves. You no longer have to toss and turn at night unable to sleep; you just need to lie down for a while and fall asleep, and you won't wake up suddenly in the middle of the night. You really enjoy this feeling.
Spamton, on the other hand, felt he couldn't go on like this. He admitted he really liked the environment at your home, and admitted that being in such a warm setting made him not even want to leave. He even felt a bit guilty, since bringing him back wouldn't do you any good—on the contrary, you spent a lot on him.
So during meals, he always looks at you with a complicated expression, and you glance at Spamton somewhat puzzled: "Why do you keep staring at me?" "Do you think he wants to say something...... Probably.
"Thank you for the angel's generosity." He just shook his head and said this.
You stared at him for a few seconds, not knowing if what you meant matched what he meant, so you just shook your head: "It's nothing...... After all, raising one pet is still a raise, and raising a bunch is still raising. ”
Your words were understated, but Spamton lowered his head. He knew he couldn't go on like this. You have your own goals, and he has his own ambitions and ideals—and he knows very well that he is not content to remain just a pet forever. Even though you may not be able to tell them apart.
But since he's still considered a pet to you—then you should agree to any excessive requests, right? Anyway, Spamton decided to use you, and of course, that was the first and last time.
He unconsciously stirs the bacon twice with his fork, and while you're dipping your bread in jam, you suddenly hear Spamton talking again.
"The Queen's Mansion is the Underground Abyss...... There is a [Fit Body], and I wish to have the right to use it. "This time, he lifts his head, gazing at you with intense intent."
You hesitated for a moment...... Honestly, other pets still have to guess their thoughts. His thoughts are just for him to say, which is really convenient. But for the queen's mansion, or the basement, it really is a bit difficult for you.
But if the pet wants it and the pet gets it, you'll still try. So you nodded: "Alright." "You didn't ask further. You didn't want to go and get this body—what exactly does it want—well, maybe you're still curious, but for you, knowing the answer doesn't mean much."
Spamton was a bit surprised. He had been nervous just now, after all, he didn't know if you'd agree, or if you'd ask anything more. But now...... He actually felt a sense of emptiness, since you hadn't asked anything.
So he hands you something like a USB and adds a sentence: "In front of the [Underground Abyss], you can use the [Obstacle Blockade] to solve the problem with the key cracker." ”
You accepted the USB, glanced at Spamton again, and patiently asked, "Besides that, you probably have other requests, right?" ”
“…… Hand me the [Hard Drive Eject] inside the [Bodybuilding Body]. "He hesitated for a moment, but still answered your question.
You nodded, got up, put the finished dishes into the dishwasher, checked the eating habits of the other animals, then waved to Spamton and left. Spamton also waved absentmindedly at you.
You didn't expect that when you went over today, there were no guards inside the Queen's mansion. The slot card butlers you found when you passed by before were nowhere to be found, so you entered the mansion very smoothly. But when you were searching for the basement, you had some trouble, since it was a bit hard to find.
But after a long search, you finally found a hidden room, went to the basement, and tried to avoid those inexplicably complex mechanisms. Finally, you obtained the hard drive inside that so-called well-built body.
…… Well, the so-called well-built body was just a piece of armor hanging on the wall, covered in dust and even covered in moss. I don't know why it's so heavily guarded.
You returned home and handed the hard drive to Spamton, speaking succinctly: "The hard drive you want." ”
Spamton didn't know you could be this fast...... He was already prepared—maybe you wouldn't be coming back today, maybe he'd wait for you to come back and apologize to him for the moment you do. You really couldn't fulfill his request, couldn't go to the basement, and couldn't get this hard drive.
Or rather, precisely because of this, he didn't have high expectations at first, which is why he was now somewhat overjoyed.
He took the disk, and this time looked at you with great seriousness—even his voice grew serious, making you look at him intently as well.
“…… Next, I will make a [deal] with you. ”
"What?" Clearly, you didn't understand what he was saying, but since the pet was so serious, you decided to answer him seriously.
"Become a [big shot]. The condition is [hard drive inserted]. "He just said.
…… You don't want to become a so-called big shot. Honestly, it's better to let your mental health issues go early. Thinking this, you can't help but complain, "Of course I'll put the hard drive back as you ask...... But I don't want to be a big shot. I wish you could solve my mental health problems. ”
Spamton was silent for a moment, then couldn't help but stare at you again. He realized that every time he spent time with you, he always made some new discoveries.
"Then I'll find a way to [become your professional psychologist], with the condition of [inserting a hard drive]."
"No deal, I'll do as you requested." You just said that, watching Spamton disappear on the spot, while the hard drive in your hand twisted a few times. It looked like Spamton had stored the data inside. You found it a bit novel, not sure how he managed to do it.
Though curious, you still chose to go and put the hard drive back first. With the experience from last time, you easily arrived at your destination this time. You put the hard drive where Spamton was located back in, but there was no extra reaction. You tilted your head and decided to head back first.
Then, on the way back, a body suddenly appeared before you. You were startled, and when you saw it was Spamton wearing that set of armor, you curiously touched the feathers on the armor before burying your face in it. You never expected that the armor that had just been hanging on the wall that looked like a cold, mechanical piece of armor was now covered in fluffy feathers.
And when your face touches it, it not only feels soft but also carries a warmth that doesn't belong to mechanics. Maybe Spamton is moving at that moment, and the feathers covering it have become warm.
This made Spamton's body stiffen for a moment. He probably hadn't expected that asking him to help solve your psychological problems would be so simple. But his body still had a string hanging from his body, and he was still not free—even though he was rightfully entitled to be called a big shot, what he truly wanted still hadn't been found.
You didn't care much, just hugged Spamton Neo's waist, then buried your face in his body and rubbed back and forth. His tone was a bit muffled, and when it reached his ears, it was still a bit vague, but he still heard your words clearly. After all, in the quiet basement now, there were only the two of you.
"Ah...... So it's Mao Furong. Then I guess you don't need to work hard to become a professional psychologist. You are now. "You seem a bit intoxicated, rubbing your head against it as you speak."
Spamton neo hesitated for a moment as he looked at you, who now seemed insignificant to him, or could be easily restrained by hand. Naturally, a verbal agreement doesn't have to count—after all, it's not some written contract. Moreover...... He not only wants to break the agreement, he also wants something else from you.
Because he knows you are a citizen of light, and he also knows that you probably definitely have a heart-shaped object, or rather, a soul.
So you heard a voice coming from above, belonging to Spamton: "I will become your [Gold Pet Psychological Mentor], on the condition that you have a [heart-shaped object]." His voice even carried a hint of coaxing; he knew how important souls were to you people of light. But maybe having a soul would allow him to achieve his desired goals; perhaps having a soul would mean he would no longer be bound by these strings and manipulated by these strings. Maybe......
But before he could think further, he heard your answer first. You lifted your head and looked up at Spamton Neo, your tone a bit light: "Sure." ”
He was stunned, unable to react for a moment. But for you, this really wasn't much—just handing over control of your life and part of your body to a Dark Commoner. Compared to the dull, day-to-day life and incurable psychological problems, this was nothing.
But you just smiled, your voice a bit soft: "Sure...... As long as you're still my pet, that's enough." You emphasized this, since if he broke the contract again, you wouldn't have much to do.
For a moment, silence fell again. You felt those furry wings encircle you, and your field of vision was pitch black, with only the heart still radiating light—the soul.
Right after, you lose consciousness. You don't know what happened afterward, only that when you wake up groggily, you feel yourself lying on furry wings, and when you slightly lift your head, you see the ceiling of your home and the Spamton Neo sleeping across from you.
Even though your chest seemed a bit empty—you were especially content, simply lying back down and falling asleep again in the furry yet warm embrace.
End

content:
The name could also be endorphins. 3k+, estimated to finish in three or four chapters, not long. sptx you, OOC apologies
——
You yawn, rub your eyes, and straighten yourself in front of the mirror—well, it seems no cosmetics can hide the dark circles under your eyelids anymore.
You haven't had a good night's sleep for two or three months in a row. Maybe it's because your anxiety is too severe. When you went to the sleep disorder department for a checkup, the doctor gently suggested you look for emotional support and build connections with others, whether animals or people—whether they're people of light or darkness. Overall, you're deficient in a series of factors, with endorphins being the most severe.
After hesitating for a moment, you decide to accept the doctor's suggestion. Indeed, you are solitary and haven't had any contact with the outside world for a long time. Yet you hate people, hate talking to people, whether the People of Light or the People of Darkness—it's pretty much the same concept to you: people.
But the Dark People are always a bit better, since to some extent, they're more like objects in disguise. So you decide to stay in the Dark World for a while, buy a property on the edge of Cyber City, and then go to the pet store to get a bunch of cats and dogs, along with a few birds—cuckoos, parrots, and even a few hamsters—and a squid mice. For some reason, as soon as those little animals see you, they come over and refuse to leave. But when you see those soft, smooth fur, your heart softens. You don't want any of the animals to be sad, so in the end, you grit your teeth and buy them all.
Fortunately, you still have some savings and used all the universal currency to exchange a large pile of dark coins before coming here.
You hold a cat in your arms, a hamster cage in the other, and a bunch of cats and dogs running around your feet, along with a few chipmare mice—birds flying in the sky following you. You sigh and pass through the alley you must pass home. You hear something from the trash can, but you don't have time to look, because you still have to groom the cats and dogs in your arms and feet. Listening to their soothing purring, your mood gradually relaxes.
Back home, you put the cage on the floor. The once quiet house was now filled with the chatter of animals, but you didn't find it noisy. Instead, you half-knelt and gently groomed the kitten at your feet, your fingers running through the smooth fur. Parrots and similar creatures flew over, stopped, perched on your shoulder, and refused to leave.
You prepare to count how many small animals you bought today, taking a deep breath as you gently hum a song to them. The melodious tune makes the previously noisy animals all quiet down. You stroke the cats and dogs beside you, silently counting in your mind until your hand unconsciously touches the greasy, seemingly bristly brittle fur—not only that, you also touch down to something that seems smooth, even somewhat cold...... Skin?
You glanced down, your pupils dilating sharply, and for a moment, you panicked. The reason was simple: the animal in your hand didn't seem like a small animal you bought—it was a puppet that had come from somewhere.
It's your fault—the size difference between the other animals is so big, and you didn't notice...... He looked roughly about one meter tall. The other little animals were a bit displeased at this, snoring angrily and suppressedly. Even the parrots perched on his shoulder began flapping their wings, and a few tried to peck him. You quickly reached out to stop them, gently stroked their fur, and then they quieted down again, perching on a nearby rack, though still staring at him like tigers.
The cats and dogs kept clasping their hands, telling you to stop petting them and instead pet yourself. You suddenly snapped back to reality, withdrew your hand, and stroked a ragdoll cat that had rubbed against your feet. Its eyes widened in fright, and you instinctively curled up to look at it: "You...... Are you the pet I bought too?" "You say that, but you don't believe it at all. Besides, if you ask about it, you'll regret it—you know you've asked the wrong question yourself.
But he nodded as if it were only natural, even introducing himself to you, proudly puffing out his chest: "Yes, I am [you] [the Gold Medal Salesman] Spamton G. Spamton, who is determined to pay in full!" ”
You stroked the goosebumps rising on your arm. To be honest...... You didn't even expect his voice to be like this. It's not that it was terrible to accept; you just felt that this kind of sound, mixed with electric currents and recorded audio, was the first time you'd heard it. The little animals around you were growing even louder, snoring in dissatisfaction and anger the day before yesterday, so you could only stroke their soft fur to comfort them.
"Well...... But what I need to buy is a pet, not a salesperson. "In the end, you decided to explain quietly." For some reason, the smile on his face seemed stiff, but then it curved even further.
"No, I am exactly the perfect pet model you need. If missed, there will be no more." His words left you stunned, making you take a while to understand.
You and it stared silently for a while, and the parrot on its shoulder began repeating your words, as if mocking Spamton: "What you need to buy is a pet!" "Not a salesperson!"
Spamton, however, reached out, then placed your hand on his head, pressed your hand and stroked your hair, smiling: "I believe [you] will give a [100% positive review]." ”
…… In fact, he only changed his tune after hearing your request. At first, he didn't know why you brought so many small animals back, but he felt he couldn't miss this chance to meet the People of Light, so he came along with them. And now, he knew this was probably his only chance to interact with the People of Light—he couldn't give up. After living in the trash for so long, he desperately hoped everything could change, desperately wished he could return to how things were before.
That's why he made up his mind to put your hand on his head. Even though this wasn't something he wanted to do. But soon, he changed his mind, realizing that being touched by you was actually a very pleasant thing.
After hesitating for a moment, you still leaned in, gently stroked his hair, scratched his face, and finally scratched his chin. Although you were a bit unfamiliar with this human-like form...... It wasn't much like petting a cat or something, so you scratched his chin again, while Spamton tilted his head back, squinting slightly, even making a faint purr.
He was even a bit shocked—it was purely a subconscious reaction, but he really did like your touch. This was unimaginable for Spamton.
Listening to his purring, your eyes curved into a smile, and you couldn't help but laugh. This really is no different from other pets...... Moreover, this pet can talk, making it seem more convenient than others to hear requests.
"Alright then...... Maybe you really are the pet I need. But before that, shouldn't you take a bath first? "You stroked his chin again and asked softly. The other little animals were all very clean, clearly having been thoroughly cleaned by the pet shop. But Spamton's body was dirty—or rather, he was no different from someone who had just crawled out of a pile of trash—and maybe that was true.
Spamton was stunned, instinctively shrinking back. He didn't want to take a hot bath—that would always bring back some unpleasant memories for him. But after sizing him up for a while, you finally handed him something like a towel you had just bought. Of course, he seemed to need a change of clothes, but you definitely didn't—you just glanced at it and didn't dare look again. His lower half wasn't even wearing pants, which means...... He was openly exposing his genitals, and in that sense, he seemed no different from other pets. So you think, maybe your previous clothes would have been suitable for him too, and in the end, you took out a white cotton nightdress.
When you look up again, he's about to sneak out to your doorstep. You tilt your head, puzzled: "Isn't it my top pet?" Why is it ...... Trying to sneak away? "Though you wouldn't be that angry, since you know most small animals are afraid of water, or rather, afraid of bathing. You could understand Spamton's fear, but still walked over, grabbed him by the back of the neck, and pulled him back into the living room.
Spamton continued to argue: "A Gold Pet doesn't necessarily need a Bathing job." ”
And you replied seriously, "But all my pets need to be cleaned thoroughly...... After all, I don't want to sleep with a dirty pet tonight." You complained, but didn't hear the puppet's response. You turned to look at him and saw that the puppet's face had inexplicably turned bright red, with wisps of white smoke...... Or rather, steam was rising from the top of his head.
You find it a bit funny, but indeed, because of sleep disorders, you've already planned to have these little animals sleep with you. After all, having them by your side visibly calms your anxiety.
You push Spamton, then bring the change of towels and clothes into the bathroom, and finally close the door. You turn on the faucet, and hot water starts spraying from it, while Spamton is sitting in the bathtub. He looks at you in surprise: "[You] want to participate in [bathing]?" ”
“…… Isn't it normal to help your pet bathe?" You tilted your head too, and while you were at it, you tidied up your shampoo, body wash, and pet bath oils. Hot water quickly filled half the tub. Spamton instinctively wanted to jump out, but you scratched his chin, stuffed it back in, and even pulled off his coat.
For some reason, his face seemed even hotter—at least the temperature you accidentally touched while scratching your chin told you.
And you just blinked innocently at him, splashing hot water on him, then squeezing out pet bath oil and applying it to his hair and upper body...... Just as you were about to reach out again, Spamton hurriedly held your hand down. For some reason, his voice seemed a bit stuttered.
"I...... I can switch the operating mode myself! "As he spoke, he hurriedly squeezed out some shower gel and applied it to his body, while you focused on ruffling his hair. After confirming that the grease was almost completely washed off, you finally drenched it little by little with hot water to wash off the foam.
Spamton's body seemed to relax too, or maybe your movements made him feel comfortable. He started snoring again, then suddenly stopped.
Although there was a little incident, the bathing process was still over. In the end, you put that white nightgown on him and pushed him out of the bathroom.
TBC.
*Endorphins, also known as endorphins or endorphins. Endorphins are neuromodulatory chemicals secreted by the pituitary gland. They are spontaneously produced by the body after persistence in doing something for a long time, making people feel euphoric, satisfied, and calm. Endorphins play an important role in regulating emotional behaviors (including anxiety, fear, tension, and pleasure) and in pain control. They are closely related to drug addiction, post-exercise excitement, appetite control, sexual response, as well as mental illnesses such as depression and schizophrenia.
Endorphins are a class of endogenous opioid peptides that specifically bind to morphine receptors in the brain, acting similarly to morphine, hence the name "endogenous morphin-like peptide." Besides analgesic functions, these peptides also have many other physiological functions, such as regulating body temperature, cardiovascular health, and respiratory function.
Endorphins are a general term for neuropeptides with morphine-like activity.

Spamton was taken aback and instinctively pressed his stomach. He probably hadn't expected you to ask such a question. He had thought you'd let him dine with those other animals.
You adjusted your mood, turned back to look at him, and just slightly raised your chin: "I think you probably want to sit down and eat even more." ”
Spamton just nodded silently. Of course he hoped, after all, he wasn't really a pet—just a way to respond in a moment of crisis.
You glanced at him and nodded in satisfaction. As expected, your pet was still very well-behaved—you first put food on the other little animals just for pets, then walked to the kitchen, picked up your apron, opened the fridge, and looked at the steak with only two servings left. You were a bit silent, but finally poured butter into the pan and cracked two eggs at the same time. That's how you get by for dinner.
You brought two steaming hot plates to the table, but at first glance you didn't see Spamton. You glanced again and saw him also squatting beside the food bowl, fighting a cat for food. The cat's fur was bristling up, struggling to chew and swallowing as if hoping to eat faster. Spamton, however, reached straight out and scooped a handful of food from the bowl, tossed it into his mouth, making a crunching sound. It seemed the cat food must be very hard.
You sighed, put the plate on the table, then walked over, grabbed Spamton's scruff, and pulled him to stand. You put the cat food back in the food bowl, and only then did the kitten quiet down again. The little cat had been meowing a lot around your legs as if it were tattling.
You picked up the Spamton and had him sit on a chair across the table. After thinking for a moment, you said, "Are you starving?" Anyway, this is your cat food. "Then you sat down on a chair, picked up your knife and fork, and started cutting the steak in front of you.
The air was silent for a moment, and for a moment, only the sounds of small animals gnawing on food could be heard. Then you heard the same sound of a knife cutting across the plate from across the table. The dinner passed silently. Those little animals ate even faster; some started calling around you again after eating. The parrots carefully retracted their paws and rested on your shoulder, while a few cats and dogs crawled straight onto your bed to sleep, curling up into a ball. Their fur was shiny and smooth, clearly well cared for at the pet store, completely different from the one in front of you.
You hesitated for a moment, then got up to clear the dishes and put them in the dishwasher. Then you rummaged through the cabinet and took out a bottle of hair oil, walked over, and gently applied it to Spamton's dry, frizzy hair after washing.
You hear Spamton's seemingly energetic voice: "Thank you for your generous contribution!" But there was always a hint of unease in his voice. He instinctively dodged for a moment, but forced himself to stay in his seat, compelling himself to accept your kindness.
You looked at his slightly trembling body, hesitated for a moment, and finally finished applying the hair oil. After all, this is your pet, so you have to take good care of it. Thinking this, you just said that, as if it were only natural: "...... Of course, you're my pet, so of course I won't hesitate to show my kindness." ”
He seemed choked up, but when he opened his mouth, only a sound of breath came out. You could imagine what he wanted to say, but after hesitating for a moment, he still said nothing. You had something to do, grabbed a pet comb, and started combing his hair. You didn't know why, despite his short hair, the ends still got tangled. You just gently picked up strands of hair and combed them until that once fuzzy hair finally settled down.
You took two satisfied steps back, looking at your masterpiece. Of course, while combing your hair, he made that comforting purring sound, but soon stopped again. You didn't mind that much, just subconsciously touched his hair again.
"Well, that's what counts as qualified...... Alright, you can go rest. "You waved your hand and covered your mouth and yawned, only then realizing just how long it took to apply essential oils and carefully comb your hair...... It's about time to wash up and rest.
Spamton glanced at the empty space between the nearly crowded furry beds, probably voluntarily moving away from a place for you to rest. He just smiled and said, "But [you] need [premium companionship services]?" ”
You paused, glanced at Spamton, then at your bed, your eye twitching. Almost all the creatures squeezed onto it, and you actually didn't have a place for Spamton to sleep...... Squeezing onto the sofa felt a bit like pet abuse. Anyway, you hesitated for a moment and said, "Ah, well, actually, it's yours to spamton." After all, no matter what he says, he's a creature that can talk, move, and chooses for itself. Even though you call him a cat, you don't mean to see him as one. But you do treat him as your own pet.
After saying that, you went to wash up. Of course, you didn't know that after that, Spamton brazenly climbed onto the bed, taking up some space and leaving you a spot next to him. The other cats and dogs barked at him in dissatisfaction, but Spamton didn't care; he just pretended not to hear and lay there.
When you finished washing up and were about to rest, this was the scene you saw. You blinked, just lay down on the bed, then rubbed spamton's hair with your smooth hair. You think you were a bit drunk and half-awake...... Anyway, right now you really wanted to lean against Mao Furnerong.
And the hair you had just carefully washed and cared for also rubbed against yours, then your cheeks, and finally your chest. He rubbed his cheek against your face again. The feeling of being so furry and cuddly was great. You couldn't help but moan, but it still felt a bit strange...... But you felt unusually drowsy, about to fall asleep, and didn't have time to think about it. So you just nudged your head a little, finally burying it in his abdomen, and instinctively rubbed it twice, but unfortunately, it was only slightly soft. Or rather, the cool skin, your head rubbing against the cotton nightdress felt a bit strange. You felt Spamton's body stiffen for a moment before relaxing, and you instinctively curled up into a ball, absorbing the only comfort beside you, wrapped your arms around his waist, and then fell into a deep sleep.
This night, you slept soundly for once, sometimes only waking up just before the alarm clock went off. Having slept well, your mood improved considerably. Rubbing your eyes, you were about to get up, but then your body stiffened. You noticed that in front of you, your sexual organ was erect, and the tip seemed to be leaking out.
You took a deep breath and hurriedly sat up, feeling a bit chaotic inside. At this moment, you had to admit one fact—the guy in front of you, or rather, the male, wasn't your pet, but just an ordinary and genuine Dark Dweller. You cleared your throat, wanting to change clothes and leave quickly, but then you felt a pair of hands rest on your waist, and your body stiffened again. You glanced to the side and saw Spamton still hadn't woken up—maybe it had been too long since he'd slept so comfortably in such a comfortable environment. After all, you remembered that yesterday he smelled like a pile of garbage, probably coming out of the trash.
It looked like an instinctive gesture...... You didn't know why he did this. At that moment, a cat jumped onto the bed, came over to nuzzle you, and was probably about to eat breakfast. You patted the cat's head; it put its cheek into your palm and softly purred. You rubbed Spamton's head and scratched his hair, and his head instinctively rubbed against your waist, making you instinctively dodge.
You take a deep breath, but in the end, you shake Spamton to wake him up quickly: "...... Get up, time for breakfast! ”
The first thing Spamton heard when he woke up was this.
