When he opened his eyes, the first thing he saw was the white, soft flesh on your waist, and he immediately realized what position he was in right now, so he hurriedly got up. He ...... Did he subconsciously get close to you in his sleep? In other words, maybe his subconscious felt that the safest place around you was?
He didn't know what to say, so he instinctively said, "...... sorry, I didn't provide the full service." ”
You shake your head: "It's okay...... It doesn't matter, I just think you're pretty cute like this." Although I was a bit embarrassed when I first noticed—after all, it was like sharing a bed with a stranger—then you realized that was actually just your pet.
So you instinctively grabbed him by the back of the neck and had him sit on the other side of the table, while you went to the kitchen to simply toast a few slices of bread, fried some eggs and some bacon, and grabbed two boxes of jam before coming out. You placed one plate in front of Spamton, another in front of yourself, and began to enjoy breakfast with great enjoyment. Before that, you had first placed food for the other little animals, but now the room was quiet again, with only the sound of chewing.
Looking at Spamton's expression, he seemed hesitant, wanting to ask something but unable to bring himself to say it. You simply spoke first: "Spamton, what's wrong?" ”
TBC.

title: Gold Medal Pet 3 (end) - sptx you
content:
He just shook his head and repeated, "[Sorry], I didn't provide [perfect service]." ”
After saying that, he continued eating breakfast. You glanced at him tentatively, but still couldn't get an answer, so in the end you had to give up. He won't tell you now, but someday he'll will...... Probably?
But over time, you gradually forget about it. You just still treat him as a slightly different pet—he's just a bit bigger and speaks things you can understand. Other than that, he doesn't seem much different from other pets.
After all, when you occasionally subconsciously pat his head, he squints and lifts his head high, looking proud, since the little animals surrounding you are all purring in dissatisfaction.
Sometimes, when you reach out to touch his head, Spamton will actively lean in, rubbing his cheek against your palm a few times, making you blush with emotion. In the end, you can only stumble your head away, not daring to look into his innocent yet indescribable eyes.
Every morning, you still maintain that state. Sometimes, even if you instinctively curl up and bury your head in his belly to fall asleep at night, the next morning you find Spamton's head buried inside your belly, and you end up in that strange posture, sharing the bed for who knows how long.
In short, you feel refreshed and your mental state gradually improves. You no longer have to toss and turn at night unable to sleep; you just need to lie down for a while and fall asleep, and you won't wake up suddenly in the middle of the night. You really enjoy this feeling.
Spamton, on the other hand, felt he couldn't go on like this. He admitted he really liked the environment at your home, and admitted that being in such a warm setting made him not even want to leave. He even felt a bit guilty, since bringing him back wouldn't do you any good—on the contrary, you spent a lot on him.
So during meals, he always looks at you with a complicated expression, and you glance at Spamton somewhat puzzled: "Why do you keep staring at me?" "Do you think he wants to say something...... Probably.
"Thank you for the angel's generosity." He just shook his head and said this.
You stared at him for a few seconds, not knowing if what you meant matched what he meant, so you just shook your head: "It's nothing...... After all, raising one pet is still a raise, and raising a bunch is still raising. ”
Your words were understated, but Spamton lowered his head. He knew he couldn't go on like this. You have your own goals, and he has his own ambitions and ideals—and he knows very well that he is not content to remain just a pet forever. Even though you may not be able to tell them apart.
But since he's still considered a pet to you—then you should agree to any excessive requests, right? Anyway, Spamton decided to use you, and of course, that was the first and last time.
He unconsciously stirs the bacon twice with his fork, and while you're dipping your bread in jam, you suddenly hear Spamton talking again.
"The Queen's Mansion is the Underground Abyss...... There is a [Fit Body], and I wish to have the right to use it. "This time, he lifts his head, gazing at you with intense intent."
You hesitated for a moment...... Honestly, other pets still have to guess their thoughts. His thoughts are just for him to say, which is really convenient. But for the queen's mansion, or the basement, it really is a bit difficult for you.
But if the pet wants it and the pet gets it, you'll still try. So you nodded: "Alright." "You didn't ask further. You didn't want to go and get this body—what exactly does it want—well, maybe you're still curious, but for you, knowing the answer doesn't mean much."
Spamton was a bit surprised. He had been nervous just now, after all, he didn't know if you'd agree, or if you'd ask anything more. But now...... He actually felt a sense of emptiness, since you hadn't asked anything.
So he hands you something like a USB and adds a sentence: "In front of the [Underground Abyss], you can use the [Obstacle Blockade] to solve the problem with the key cracker." ”
You accepted the USB, glanced at Spamton again, and patiently asked, "Besides that, you probably have other requests, right?" ”
“…… Hand me the [Hard Drive Eject] inside the [Bodybuilding Body]. "He hesitated for a moment, but still answered your question.
You nodded, got up, put the finished dishes into the dishwasher, checked the eating habits of the other animals, then waved to Spamton and left. Spamton also waved absentmindedly at you.
You didn't expect that when you went over today, there were no guards inside the Queen's mansion. The slot card butlers you found when you passed by before were nowhere to be found, so you entered the mansion very smoothly. But when you were searching for the basement, you had some trouble, since it was a bit hard to find.
But after a long search, you finally found a hidden room, went to the basement, and tried to avoid those inexplicably complex mechanisms. Finally, you obtained the hard drive inside that so-called well-built body.
…… Well, the so-called well-built body was just a piece of armor hanging on the wall, covered in dust and even covered in moss. I don't know why it's so heavily guarded.
You returned home and handed the hard drive to Spamton, speaking succinctly: "The hard drive you want." ”
Spamton didn't know you could be this fast...... He was already prepared—maybe you wouldn't be coming back today, maybe he'd wait for you to come back and apologize to him for the moment you do. You really couldn't fulfill his request, couldn't go to the basement, and couldn't get this hard drive.
Or rather, precisely because of this, he didn't have high expectations at first, which is why he was now somewhat overjoyed.
He took the disk, and this time looked at you with great seriousness—even his voice grew serious, making you look at him intently as well.
“…… Next, I will make a [deal] with you. ”
"What?" Clearly, you didn't understand what he was saying, but since the pet was so serious, you decided to answer him seriously.
"Become a [big shot]. The condition is [hard drive inserted]. "He just said.
…… You don't want to become a so-called big shot. Honestly, it's better to let your mental health issues go early. Thinking this, you can't help but complain, "Of course I'll put the hard drive back as you ask...... But I don't want to be a big shot. I wish you could solve my mental health problems. ”
Spamton was silent for a moment, then couldn't help but stare at you again. He realized that every time he spent time with you, he always made some new discoveries.
"Then I'll find a way to [become your professional psychologist], with the condition of [inserting a hard drive]."
"No deal, I'll do as you requested." You just said that, watching Spamton disappear on the spot, while the hard drive in your hand twisted a few times. It looked like Spamton had stored the data inside. You found it a bit novel, not sure how he managed to do it.
Though curious, you still chose to go and put the hard drive back first. With the experience from last time, you easily arrived at your destination this time. You put the hard drive where Spamton was located back in, but there was no extra reaction. You tilted your head and decided to head back first.
Then, on the way back, a body suddenly appeared before you. You were startled, and when you saw it was Spamton wearing that set of armor, you curiously touched the feathers on the armor before burying your face in it. You never expected that the armor that had just been hanging on the wall that looked like a cold, mechanical piece of armor was now covered in fluffy feathers.
And when your face touches it, it not only feels soft but also carries a warmth that doesn't belong to mechanics. Maybe Spamton is moving at that moment, and the feathers covering it have become warm.
This made Spamton's body stiffen for a moment. He probably hadn't expected that asking him to help solve your psychological problems would be so simple. But his body still had a string hanging from his body, and he was still not free—even though he was rightfully entitled to be called a big shot, what he truly wanted still hadn't been found.
You didn't care much, just hugged Spamton Neo's waist, then buried your face in his body and rubbed back and forth. His tone was a bit muffled, and when it reached his ears, it was still a bit vague, but he still heard your words clearly. After all, in the quiet basement now, there were only the two of you.
"Ah...... So it's Mao Furong. Then I guess you don't need to work hard to become a professional psychologist. You are now. "You seem a bit intoxicated, rubbing your head against it as you speak."
Spamton neo hesitated for a moment as he looked at you, who now seemed insignificant to him, or could be easily restrained by hand. Naturally, a verbal agreement doesn't have to count—after all, it's not some written contract. Moreover...... He not only wants to break the agreement, he also wants something else from you.
Because he knows you are a citizen of light, and he also knows that you probably definitely have a heart-shaped object, or rather, a soul.
So you heard a voice coming from above, belonging to Spamton: "I will become your [Gold Pet Psychological Mentor], on the condition that you have a [heart-shaped object]." His voice even carried a hint of coaxing; he knew how important souls were to you people of light. But maybe having a soul would allow him to achieve his desired goals; perhaps having a soul would mean he would no longer be bound by these strings and manipulated by these strings. Maybe......
But before he could think further, he heard your answer first. You lifted your head and looked up at Spamton Neo, your tone a bit light: "Sure." ”
He was stunned, unable to react for a moment. But for you, this really wasn't much—just handing over control of your life and part of your body to a Dark Commoner. Compared to the dull, day-to-day life and incurable psychological problems, this was nothing.
But you just smiled, your voice a bit soft: "Sure...... As long as you're still my pet, that's enough." You emphasized this, since if he broke the contract again, you wouldn't have much to do.
For a moment, silence fell again. You felt those furry wings encircle you, and your field of vision was pitch black, with only the heart still radiating light—the soul.
Right after, you lose consciousness. You don't know what happened afterward, only that when you wake up groggily, you feel yourself lying on furry wings, and when you slightly lift your head, you see the ceiling of your home and the Spamton Neo sleeping across from you.
Even though your chest seemed a bit empty—you were especially content, simply lying back down and falling asleep again in the furry yet warm embrace.
End

title: spamton.zip (1)
content:
Yawning, thinking about the homework the teacher assigned, you reluctantly search online for pirated software—the genuine version costs you about a hundred or two hundred silver dollars, and you wouldn't be happy about it! And the teacher said you should go online and search for it yourselves, just find a pirated copy to use. Unfortunately, the teacher didn't give you an installation package for the pirated software, so you could helplessly search online with your limited computer skills.
After skipping several pages that looked like paid ads, you finally found a page that looked ad-free and, surprisingly, even quite clean. Of course, you also cautiously avoided the security installation requirement to download some software manager, choosing a normal installation.
The mouse clicked, and you finally downloaded the installation package—though for some reason, what was the name of the package? spamton.zip you had a bad feeling about it. Why did the name look like it...... What kind of spam did it look like? Did you download it by mistake?
Haha, you can't just put a virus on your own computer after all this fuss. You gave a couple of awkward laughs, but still tried it out and extracted the installation package. Next, in the folder that opened automatically, you saw four exe files filled with garbled text and a bunch of json files. Besides that, the file your teacher requested indeed popped up.
At the same time, your computer flashes a virus warning, warning that those garbled files are all infected and may harm your computer. You click the mouse, block those files, frown and drag them to the trash to delete them, but for some reason...... Once those files are deleted, the JSON files in the folder and the pirated software you want will disappear together.
You frantically struggled for a long time and even downloaded powerful uninstall software, but it still didn't work.
With no other choice, you click on the pirated software, hoping it will work.
But no matter how much you tapped, nothing happened—just as you were feeling discouraged, you saw another prompt pop up in the center of your computer, saying the software was trying to launch other apps at the same time, and the system had blocked them from running.
You searched for ages and finally found this pirated software! With no other options, you have to go into Windows Security System and pull out those four garbled software programs, setting them to run safely.
This time, the pirated software finally got running. However...... The four garbled files also started running. This time, the filenames were no longer garbled; as the pirated software unfolded, the four garbled files also gained their own names.
It seems to be arranged from old to new, according to the change time: the first file is white, the second is called big shot, and for some reason, the third and fourth files look very similar—one is Spamton, the other is Spamton Neo. Meanwhile, several little figures who look completely different but have similar hairstyles appear on the screen. They call them people...... They don't really look alike, since people aren't this color scheme and don't have long noses.
You tried to turn off the four gadgets that appeared, but even if you opened Task Manager and forcibly shut it down, it would restart the next second and appear on your screen, looking like it had been infected with a virus. You pinched your nose and had no choice but to hurry and finish the homework left by the teacher first. After all, you didn't have the money to buy another computer, nor did you have time to reinstall it.
I don't know what crazy the teacher is, but lately I've been assigning homework related to this software, leaving you no time to think about the little gadgets on the computer screen.
However, aside from staying on your computer screen to block your view a bit and occasionally moving around, they don't do anything particularly distracting you, so you temporarily forget about it.
…… Besides when you're scrolling through short videos on your computer and that big shot suddenly raises the webpage pop-up and throws it out of the screen, making it impossible to find it. Besides that white, who especially likes to run ad pop-ups on your computer screen, as long as you're not doing anything serious, it will pop up ads to block your view or even block the videos you're scrolling through. Besides Spamton, which suddenly throws out some blue egg-like things that make you unable to open game software, forcing you to click on the blue egg and then the computer is forced to open a large, explicit photo that looks like Spamton is showing off itself. Except for Spamton Neo, which occasionally wraps a green cable around your shutdown button, forcing you to keep your computer open every day, everything else is fine, right?
Well, if it weren't for the occasional time when you can't finish your homework, Big Shot controlling your mouse to finish the design drawings assigned by the teacher, White proactively popping up ads for hacking software when you need to download software, Spamton organizing the document formats for assignments, and Spamton Neo proactively throwing the priority project software pop-up at the very front, you would definitely have reinstalled your computer long ago!!
However...... You're still used to having these four little things at the top of your screen. You know now: the one in a red suit is Big Shot, the one with pure white hair and body is White, the tiny one is Spamton, and the big one with wings flying around your screen every day is Spamton Neo.
You feel like they must be the same person from different periods...... But after all, they're just virtual personas—what does it have to do with you? Thinking this, you can't help but feel a bit disappointed. You laugh at yourself, thinking it's not just because real life is too lonely, that you imagine these are real beings that can accompany you, right?
That's just wishful thinking...... But sometimes you just stare blankly at the screen, watching Spamton hang up your father's video call, then Spamton neo typed and fired, saying a series of sarcastic but polite remarks that knocked your father back.
You might also think, if only they really existed...... That way, you would never have to fear going home again.
You blinked, trying hard to keep the tears from flowing, just controlling the mouse arrow to pat Spamton's head and tapping Spamton Neo's wings.
They seemed very happy. You saw the four little ones on the screen huddled together, saying something unknown, then White jumped up and waved to greet you, and you had no choice but to pat his head.
White seemed satisfied and dragged out your parents' chat boxes, while Big Shot opened the software you were about to use and started drawing the work diagrams for your homework.
You couldn't help but move the mouse back and forth, patting White's head and poking Big Shot's head again, while White ...... You don't know why, but you could see the blush in that little white shadow. As for Big Shot, his movements seemed to pause for a moment, then he worked even harder and faster to draw your work.
You lowered your eyes, leaning in front of the computer, looking at the four little things on the screen. Big Shot was still controlling your mouse to help you finish your homework, and your eyes reddened, but you couldn't help but say, "If only ...... If you really existed, how wonderful it would be to always be with me...... I really like you all. ”
You were just mumbling this sentence to yourself, but for some reason, those four little things on the screen seemed to have heard you. white jumped up, probably blushing, to greet you once again, while spamton danced joyfully in place, its little short legs moving up and down. As for spamton and neo… a small, connected, five-featured blue heart flew out from the chest, only to be stuffed back in by him.
Big Shot just finished drawing the work-to-finish drawing quickly, and countless ad pop-ups flooded your computer screen. All the pop-up messages were 'I love you,' and all the options below were 'yes.'
You were startled, clicking your mouse on the screen. At the same time, a pop-up was thrown by white, and your mouse happened to land on yes. Immediately after, all the pop-ups on the computer disappeared, as if it had just been your imagination.
Staring blankly at the computer screen, you shake your head and decide to ignore everything that just happened—after all, it was probably just your imagination. After all, these are just programs running on your computer, and for some reason, these four little ones are so vivid. Other than that, how could they possibly be real? Besides that...... There could be no more unexpected things happening.
You think, you're just too lonely, so you place your feelings on it. You're just too lonely, so you fantasize that they are real. You just ...... Too much, too much desire, loved by someone, even if you don't even understand what love feels like, and what it's like to be loved.
Yet, you still sincerely hope someone can give you that feeling.
You still live as usual, spending three years of university with these four little ones on the computer screen. Until your senior year, you all need internships. The teacher also proposed an exchange student project, sending a few students from your world—the Light World—to study in the Dark World. Correspondingly, this is also a practical project. Exchange students need to observe the ecological environment of the Dark World and collect relevant information about the cultural industries of the Dark World.
It was only then that you realized...... Besides this world, there is another world that exists. And since your grades have always been the top in your major since university, you naturally have an exchange student spot.
For some reason, when you were muttering that you were going to the Dark World as an exchange student, the four little ones on the screen were all very happy.
And you pack your bags, take a deep breath at the agreed time, and muster the courage to step into the whirlpool at the boundary of light and darkness, into that unknown dark world.
TBC.

title: spamton.zip (2)
content:
First comes a dazzling white light, then a wave of dizziness—you close your eyes, endure that dizzy feeling, and then open them.
To your surprise, you thought the Dark World would be as dark as its name suggests, but that's not the case. Although there was no white light, neon lights flickered, and the entire city was radiating a dazzling halo. This was almost indistinguishable from the place you came from, except this was another city you knew completely unfamiliar with.
You tentatively took two steps forward, and then something that looked completely different from a human suddenly appeared. Startled, you took two steps back. He claimed to be a Dark Folk and a serocard butler responsible for guiding the way.
You cautiously ask if he has a certificate, and he does pull out a black-and-white piece of paper with a stamp and signature, clearly a letter of authorization.
Only then did you relax and follow him forward. But for some reason, the road felt especially long, and you didn't know where the destination was. But when you saw a shopping street, you couldn't help but stop—because you saw that white Addison that used to bounce on your computer.
You can't believe it and can't help but close your eyes again, wiping them carefully before opening them. Standing there is still a white Addison frantically advertising in front of an unnoticed shop.
You suddenly recall the advice your teacher gave you before coming to the Dark World. He said that the People of Darkness are all made up of objects from the Light World, generated by the objects of the Light World and the emotions of their users. Every Dark World is related to the People of Light who created this Dark World.
But...... You're certain you have nothing to do with the creation of this dark world—or rather, you have nothing to do with any dark world...... So, why is he here?
After hesitating for a moment, you still say to the squalacher butler, "Sorry...... I might be delayed for a few minutes; I want to go check out the shopping street. ”
The Color Card Butler nodded very kindly: "It's fine. Miss, please visit this dark world. It doesn't matter how long it takes." ”
So you head toward the shopping street. For some reason, you feel a bit timid and nervous. What if this Addison looks extremely similar and has nothing to do with the one on your computer? What if you just mistaken it in a moment of urgency? What if......
You don't even know what you're thinking, and you're just walking heavily, stopping in front of Addison's store.
White was dozing off when he suddenly realized someone was approaching. He quickly snapped back to reality, and when he saw it was you, his eyes instantly sparkled: "Ah, it's Y/N! You're here!" ”
You hesitate for a moment. Since he acts like he knows you, he must be the one on your computer. But...... Why?
"Mm. I'm here...... Why are you here? After much thought, you still asked the question, nervously looking at the Addison in front of you.
"Because of [Love Permission]?" We fall under the category of "spam," so [please click the hyperlink]. "White explained rapidly, leaving you a bit stunned. Not only did you not understand what he said, but even if you did, you still couldn't analyze the underlying meaning.
Although you roughly understand why it appears on your computer, ......
"What kind of love permit?" How could it suddenly be connected to love?
White widened his eyes and looked at you, and only then did you realize he still had heterochromatic pupils: "But...... You have autism and have applied for a permanent companionship? I think you think we're cute. ”
Here, 'cute' probably means 'lovable'...... You are speculating based on the context of the upper and lower levels.
But you still seemed a bit troubled: "But that's not what I actually meant. I just hope someone can be with me and stop being alone......"
He patted his chest: "[Wholeheartedly at Your Service], and here is our [Love Application Certificate]. ”
As he spoke, he pulled out a red notebook—it was a marriage certificate. Your eyes widened as you flipped through it for a long time, but no matter what, you couldn't believe the marriage certificate looked fake, to the point that your voice was trembling.
"When did I marry you?" How come you didn't know about this? No one told you?
White thought for a moment, then gave you an answer: "Five days ago, a [please click the hyperlink] [marriage application]." ”
After thinking hard for a while, you finally remembered: indeed, five days ago, this white Addison was holding an ad pop-up hanging on your computer screen. Party leader, you didn't need to download anything, but you still patted Addison's head with your mouse, then clicked into that hyperlink. Unfortunately, you couldn't open that link, and when you clicked in, it was completely blank.
Now you realize it was a marriage application, but you never imagined it would end like this.
You choked up for a moment, and after a long pause, you finally spoke: "...... But when I clicked into that page, it was blank. I thought it was just a link that wouldn't open, and you never told me what that link was for......
White lowered his head. You couldn't see his expression, but you could only know he spoke a bit pitifully: "So...... Y/N doesn't recognize this [marriage application] and wants to [legally dissolve the marriage] and [regret: Baidu Encyclopedia]? ”
You nod awkwardly, remembering he couldn't see, and added, "I don't think I agreed to letting us be together......
Although you don't dislike them, and even like them a little. But suddenly saying they're marrying you, you still can't accept it. How did you suddenly have a marriage certificate with the Dark People?
"Then...... Do you really dislike me? His voice trembled and even sounded a bit weak, sounding very soft.
You quickly waved your hand: "No, actually, I actually quite like you two." As you spoke, you scratched your head awkwardly.
White looks up stubbornly at you: "Then why do you have to [regret: Baidu Baike]?" I'll [shoot a perfect script] [prove the basics] for you to see, I'll make you [fall into the whirlpool of love] for me. ”
You opened your mouth, a bit speechless. Honestly, if you were to talk about marriage, you wouldn't be very resistant.
“…… Alright, oh right, I still have to register at the school here, so I'll be leaving first. "You said this hurriedly, without turning to look at his expression, and left the shopping street in a panic.
The Color Card butler was still standing there waiting for you. You exhaled, tidied your messy hair from running so fast, and forced a stiff smile: "Alright, let's keep going." ”
The Color Card butler nodded and continued leading the way. Soon, you noticed the wall ahead was covered with advertisements, all drawn of someone you knew very well—the man in a red suit, that big shot.
You were silent for a while, thinking that since Addison had appeared in this world, it would be normal for other little things on your computer screen to appear, but at the same time, you might as well avoid encountering them for now, since ...... White said he married you, who knows what the others might say.
Unfortunately, even though you desperately hoped not to run into these guys, you still ran into Big Shot at the school gate.
The Color Card Butler introduced that this was the Dark People who were coming to this school today to participate in a performing arts event.
Big shot glanced at you, his eyes curved with a smile: "Y/N, [My Lover]...... You finally [arrived at the scene]. ”
After the color card butler took you to the place, he left, and your pupils trembled as you looked at Big Shot: "When did I become your lover?" "I didn't even tell you that?"
Big Shot's lips curled into a smile: "...... Last weekend, I passionately created a poster effect image for you, marked with engagement details, and you [chose to agree]. ”
You barely recall: last weekend the teacher did assign an assignment for designing a wedding poster. You hadn't even started it yet, but Big Shot was already using your mouse to help you complete the assignment, and you just clicked save. So how did you choose to agree?
"I'm just saving my homework as usual, so why did I choose to agree?" No matter how hard you rack your brain, you still can't figure it out.
The corners of his mouth still curved down: "I sincerely believe, you chose to agree to marriage services." You even clicked the [hyperlink] and gifted me a [gemstone ring]. ”
As he spoke, he showed you the ring finger wearing the ring. The ring looked familiar, and you finally remembered—this was your homework from your jewelry design class. You designed this ring, but Big Shot pushed away the pop-up where you had just saved your assignment. You casually said that if he wanted it, you could give it to him. Now, the ring has become a physical item, worn on Big Shot's hand.
You were at a loss for words and didn't know what to say. You just glanced at him in panic, lost in thought—maybe your mind was out of your mind. You asked, "Even if you gave me a ring, what about the ring you gave me?" ”
Big Shot leisurely took out a red velvet box, then knelt on one knee. He opened the box to show you. Inside was a ring similar in style to the gemstone ring you designed, looking like a couple's piece.
He solemnly said, "Miss Y/N, I hereby [solemnly swear] to submit a [marriage application]. Please click the [Hyperlink] to make a [Marriage Request]. I am willing to [honor my vow], [wholeheartedly] [care for] you, never [betray the vow], never [give up pure love].' ”
You covered your face, and for a moment, you really didn't know what to say.
TBC.

title: spamton.zip (3)
content:
So you just waved your hand in a panic: "...... Propose? Then I still need to think it over. It's so rushed like this......
But Big Shot simply shoved the ring box into your hand, lowering his brows and saying, "No matter what, this is a [precious token of affection]. I hope you can [accept it all]." ”
Once you say that, you're not too embarrassed to refuse—but treating an engagement ring as a gift? That's quite extravagant.
You hesitate for a moment, while Big Shot just lifts his head and looks at you with a sincere gaze. You sigh and finally choose to compromise.
"Alright, I'll accept it for now...... But regarding the marriage proposal, I really need to think it over carefully. "You emphasized it.
Actually, if you say you don't care at all, that's just a lie...... You do feel a bit tempted, because you know that after marriage, someone will be there who will stay by your side and never leave you, even if you agree to everything. But you're not sure if you can give them the love they hope for. Can you ...... Be responsible?
So in the end, you just chose to avoid it, and you just pretended none of it happened, smiling: "And my reporting time is up, so I'll head to the office first." ”
After saying that, you put the ring box onto your body and walked toward the school, while Big Shot just stared blankly at your back, heading toward the school as well, just in completely different directions.
You went to the office, negotiated with the other Dark Citizens to complete the paperwork, then finally exhaled and walked out of the office. The matter was ...... Finally, it was almost done.
But before you can check your schedule and see where you're teaching, you suddenly hear a whooshing wind—like a slicing sound. Then, a bunch of fluffy wings envelop you. You glance at them—pink and yellow wings, and even the part of your body that rests instinctively is fluffy.
You feel as if he's resting his head on top of you...... Then you hear him speak, and through his wings you guess it's Spamton Neo, but you never imagined his words would be so moving.
He said, "Y/N—my dear darling, you've finally arrived at the designated location." "Spamton Neo's voice still sounded a bit sweet and sticky. In short, you feel it doesn't seem like his original voice."
You don't reject this hug; in fact, you subconsciously feel a bit of enjoyment and comfort—it makes you wonder if you've truly reached the Dark World, but you have no impression. But...... You do know this feeling, maybe just like he once rattled away on your computer, helping you turn down difficult parents and incomprehensible classmates.
So unusually, you softened your voice a bit and asked, "I don't remember...... Did I have some relationship with you before? ”
However, his words still carried a hint of unfamiliarity.
You see the wings wrapping you stiffen for a moment, as if you've hurt you, to the point that you feel a bit apologetic. But Spamton Neo just spoke up a bit aggrieved, "Just last Monday, you clearly gave me [gifts], [fresh flowers], and [gifts] and [confession quotes]. Are you really [flatly denying]?" ”
You stroked his wings and paused for a moment, recalling last Monday when you gave each little thing a virtual flower as a gift to show your gratitude. But just to thank Spamton Neo for standing up for you, you sent him a separate message, which might have caused a misunderstanding...... You just wanted to express your gratitude, but he took it as a confession.
So you shake your head and nod again: "Ah...... Yes, I did send you flowers, but that passage isn't really a confession......
However, afterwards, spamton neo's enthusiasm did seem to increase significantly, to the point that it would even proactively click on your chat contacts to help you reply. It also knows which contacts' messages you absolutely do not want to see, so it would deliberately use green strings to entangle the bubbles, preventing you from seeing content that would make you feel sad.
"So Y/N...... Are you trying to [abandon your family] now? "Spamton Neo's voice trembled slightly, and you could hear a hint of pity in it.
Your voice also became stammered: "I...... I didn't mean that, and where did the ...... come from?"
Before the Spamton neo could answer, you felt something grabbing your pants. When you looked down, you saw a little Spamton clinging to your leg, refusing to let go, holding a blue egg in the other hand, even tied with a pale pink bow.
Spamton also looked aggrieved: "This is our 'fruit of love,' it's called pipis. This is the child I [lost everything] to give you 'pregnancy,' but you chose to [break your vow] [betray the marriage agreement]. ”
Your pupils contracted slightly, and your fingers trembled as you pointed at that pipis: "This egg...... You... were you the one who gave birth to it? ”
Spamton nodded: "When you press the [Confirm Security Agreement], you agree to the [marriage application]. We were originally a [harmonious and beautiful family], but you chose to [sign the contract] [someone else's marriage application], so our [marriage agreement] was declared void." ”
As he spoke, he lowered his head, looking sad. And you listened in surprise—turns out that pressing 'yes' right from the start was already an unfair clause—no wonder, Spamton was especially attentive to you during that period, even opening the corresponding app pop-up before you acted. But it seems that after White mentioned that moment, Spamton's actions became much less frequent.
…… You've seen him holding a blue egg with a mysterious smile and blushing—turns out this is the fruit of love he spoke of.
In any case, the current situation is hard for you to accept. In other words, you unknowingly accepted the love of these four Dark People whose real name is Spamton G. Spamton...... But do you really need their love? You're not sure, you're a bit lost. Maybe you do long for someone to love you, but at least, it shouldn't be so many Dark Folk around, right?!
So you take a deep breath, pick up the Spamton, and stare at each other with you: "...... So what is your request? ”
"[Sign the marriage contract to restore the marriage]." His answer was also very quick.
And you decisively shook your head: "No...... I don't want to remarry, and in fact, I never agreed to the engagement......
Before he could finish, Spamton raised the blue pipis, and you got stuck. You couldn't continue—you still thought you had some conscience...... You couldn't just abandon the guy who had the child because of you.
At the same time, Spamton Neo spoke up: "I have also [conceived] a [child] for you." ”
As he spoke, he also took out a pipis and handed it to you.
Your eye twitches, and you sense that Spamton Neo's voice still has a hint of self-righteousness...... Well, now you're not quite sure if Pipis is actually related to you—maybe it's just a copy of the spam!
So you just sigh heavily: "...... Spamton neo, let's break up. ”
At the very least, you have to resolve a love debt. The others all claim to have had engaged relationships with you, but this one is just a romantic relationship, so it's probably easiest to settle. By the way, you just took some time to check your class schedule—there just happens to be no classes today, so you have plenty of time to waste time with them and talk things out clearly.
You feel those wings flapping a few times—a gust of wind, and Spamton Neo just says, "[Hands together], [Hands together]." ”
You are a bit confused and repeat: "I mean...... break up. ”
"No, just [join hands]." he said.
Spamton, who was held in your arms, also said, "I don't want a [divorce], I only want to remarry." ”
You felt a bit troubled, but you couldn't find any more excuses to run away. In the end, you just sighed: "...... Alright, then you all follow me first. Hmm, next I'm going to the lobby to watch the show. Are you going to go? ”
This is a program specially prepared for you exchange students. Besides you, there are several other people of Light, and they probably left early.
You do feel a bit of a headache, but you have to admit...... When you're being held, and holding Spamton, you only feel at ease—surprisingly, not a trace of irritability. In the past, when someone else kept pestering you to confess, you would only feel extremely annoyed, but at this moment, you only feel at ease, as if you're satisfied...... Pleasure?
You don't know why, nor do you know if this counts as love, but what you do know is that you don't dislike them—maybe you even like them a little.
After all, liking and loving are different, and you know that very well...... Probably.
"[Of course]." The two voices rang out almost simultaneously. Their voices were so similar that you could barely tell them apart. However, after getting their permission, you still held one in your arms and wore a large pendant as you walked toward the chapel. Other Dark People students passing by all saluted you, probably feeling quite shocked. You felt a bit embarrassed and annoyed by the gaze, and couldn't help tugging at the spamton neo on you: "You don't have to keep hanging on me...... It's not like you can't walk on your own. ”
As for the Spamton in your arms, since he's a little thing, you don't care.
Spamton neo obediently responded with an 'oh' and swayed out with the string hanging from it. You don't know how he did it, but on his way back, he handed you a candied hawthorn stick and held a box of takoyaki in the other.
"[Worth Tasting], I remember your [Preferences]." As he spoke, he handed you the candied hawthorn, and you instinctively took it, ate one, and squinted your eyes in satisfaction.
TBC.

title: spamton.zip (4)
content:
He finally stopped carrying you while walking, and you breathed a sigh of relief, feeling much more at ease. After finishing the candied hawthorn, spamton neo thoughtfully brought a skewer of takoyaki to your mouth. You ate one, chewed, and it tasted pretty good, with the perfect temperature—neither too hot nor slightly cold. You didn't know how he managed it.
Watching you chew, Spamton Neo took back the stick, poked one himself, and put it in his mouth. At that moment, Spamton poked you, and you instinctively looked down at him, seeing him looking pitifully at you, with tears at the corners of his eyes. You hurriedly poked a takoyaki and brought it to Spamton's mouth.
So Spamton was satisfied, while Spamton Neo, who watched this scene unfold, began to complain: "...... Y/N, [dear], this is a [delicacy] I use for [you and me to share], not for [third parties]. "He said this as he looked at Spamton with a slightly hostile gaze.
And you just looked at spamton neo quite innocently, chewed on it, and swallowed the meatball in your mouth: "Hmm...... You bought this for me, right? In other words, I actually have the right to dispose of it. ”
Spamton neo was speechless; he didn't want to refute you...... After all, your words were too important to them. And thinking about it carefully, it wasn't impossible to accept—after all, this was just the old self, rounded up to still be himself.
So spamton neo eventually lifted it high and gently put it down, saying, "Yes, [reasonable], you have [full authority]." After all, compared to quarreling and making you feel embarrassed, or saying something that might hurt you, he preferred to keep you quietly without making a fuss.
You curved your brows and smiled heartily, while Spamton Neo grinned at you with a big tooth. To be honest, his smile wasn't very good, but you just slightly restrained your expression and then took his hand. Compared to yours, his palm naturally had a ring of strokes, but you just slipped your hand in.
Spamton neo was a bit surprised; he hadn't expected you to accept it so quickly—he had thought he was going to pester you relentlessly, so he just tightly but cautiously wrapped his hand around you, afraid of any harm.
But you don't think that much; you just know...... Spamton neo has helped you scold your parents and shielded you from hurt from outsiders, so you know you have to thank him, and ...... Although you don't know what love really is or what dating is, you know that what he does is definitely because he cares about you, at least...... Probably because he cares about you, and at that moment, a strange warmth always wells up in his heart. Even though you may not need to respond, you still have to do it because you feel he's worth it.
So you walk toward the chapel holding Spamton in one arm and holding Spamton Neo with the other.
As for spamton...... You always feel a sense of familiarity, probably because he seems too attentive on your computer screen. So at this moment, you don't feel particularly unfamiliar—just a sense of familiarity.
And at this moment, they quieted down for once.
Until you walk into the chapel and see Big Shot hosting the show on stage, and he even throws you a wink and greets you. Your body stiffens, and then you feel both the Spamton in your arms and the Spamton Neo holding the sword beside you tense up, radiating hostility.
You quickly pulled Spamton Neo to sit down in any spot. Luckily, there weren't many students from the People of Light, so you could find a row of empty seats. Now you don't have to worry about others giving you strange looks.
Spamton spoke softly, his glasses now blurred into a mosaic: "I know...... You once had the [Entity] of the [Proposal Ceremony]. "You gave a dry laugh. So they all knew...... Forget it, things have come to this. It doesn't matter anymore to pursue the truth or the truth. Even if you flatly deny it, you can't deny their past actions, can't deny that love.
So you can't deny it. Moreover...... You've figured it out, and you probably don't really want to deny it. Being loved by many, many people, cared for by many, many people is probably the hope deep in your heart.
But now, the situation only makes you happy. Such chaotic and complicated matters stir ripples in your life, like stagnant water, so you don't dislike it.
“…… I didn't know that was considered a proposal back then, so please forgive me." You muttered.
"In our eyes, that is the [wedding proposal ceremony]. If your [affection level is zero], then you can let him [hold a farewell ceremony]." spamton neo sneered and said beside you.
You rub your temples and feel a bit of a headache. To be honest, you don't want to accept marriage abruptly, but you don't have to cut off contact either—you're just ...... In short, the level of affection isn't zero.
So you just softly said, "...... Well, I'm not trying to propose, nor have I agreed to it, so I'll talk about Qin Chu's matter. But...... It's definitely not that I don't have feelings for him, so I won't ask him to quit. ”
At this moment, you think absurdly—after all, these guys seem to be the same being, in a sense. After all, this is the Dark World, not the Light World, so there aren't so many demands. Besides, no one has ever said no, so why can't all four of them accompany you at the same time?
But you know that this idea is truly absurd...... So it's just a fleeting thought.
At that moment, you feel another person sitting down beside you. You glance to the side, then your pupils narrow—you realize it's actually white.
He quietly watches you, a little sad. You glance at the Spamton in your arms and the Spamton Neo you are holding in your hand, cough awkwardly twice, first withdraw the hand holding Spamton Neo, then fumble around your body. When you finally find a ring box, you don't care much and simply open the ring box and hand it to White.
"I...... Hmm, although I can't quite accept suddenly having a marriage, I feel I should show some gratitude, so this is a gift from me. "You stammered a bit, and you only realized that this ring was the one Big Shot gave you earlier, and you accepted it."
White just looked at you sadly: "I understand the actual situation. This ring is a big shot's [proposal gift], and I find it hard for me to accept." ”
At that moment, Spamton Neo suddenly hugged you from behind, his chin resting on your shoulder and gently rubbing twice, tickling a little. He just slightly lifted his chin and looked at White with a somewhat provocative look: "But now I'm the legal lover recognized by Y/N, you should be [eliminated from the game]." ”
“…… I didn't mean that, I just grabbed a ...... in a moment of urgency." You gasped, closed your eyes for a moment, then opened them again, and said solemnly, "But at the time, I had no intention of proposing...... Nor did I intend to spend my life together, but......" As you said this, you looked at White and lowered your head in grievance. You quickly added, "But we can start over, starting as lovers." ”
Spamton tugged at your sleeve: "So, am I still Y/N's [legal husband]?" ”
Spamton neo hugged you slightly: "I'm your [legal lover], I haven't gone through a [Recognition Agreement]." ”
You opened your mouth, saw White trying to get up and leave, and quickly grabbed his hand, pulling him back to sit beside you.
“…… There was no rule that a person could only have one lover, right? "You smiled awkwardly.
You spent quite a while tugging around here, not even noticing that the show had ended. The other Light Folk had left, and Big Shot was quietly standing behind you, watching you.
Suddenly, he spoke up, startling you: "...... Y/N, what about me? How do you [judge the ownership of my existence]? ”
His voice sounded a bit pitiful, and you were startled by his sudden reaction. Spamton Neo just held you and gently patted your head to comfort you.
You swallowed hard and looked behind you. Spamton Neo didn't stop you, so you only saw Big Shot standing in the darkness, looking dejected.
“…… Ah, I won't say yes to your proposal. I didn't mean to propose to you back then, you know, it was just homework," you explained seriously, while Big Shot's head just drooped lower, "Even though I won't accept the proposal...... But you can do it too, starting as lovers." At this point, Big Shot lifted his head again, looking proudly at White, who still looked aggrieved, Spamton, and the somewhat angry Spamton Neo.
"If we can't have a 'remarriage ceremony,' then at the very least, can I establish a 'lover' relationship with you?" Spamton tugged at your sleeve again, shaking it twice. Seeing his eyes reddened and tears uncontrollably falling, you could only reach out and pat his head, your voice softening as well.
“…… Alright, alright, I promise you." "Anyway, agreeing to one is accepting, promising four is acceptance. You're already a bit reckless. Leave the rest to your future self. As for now?" First, settle down these four guys first.
Spamton neo was a bit angry and a bit unwilling: "But Y/N, [Lovers] [Exclusive]." ”
White suddenly raised his voice: "But I [obey all will] Y/N, so I agree to the [romantic relationship]. If you dislike [multiple sharing], you can [exit the program]." ”
TBC.

title: spamton.zip (5)
content:
In short, you don't know exactly how long the big shot stood in the back watching, and you also somewhat dare not look at spamton neo—the relationship involving multiple people is indeed difficult for the initial lover to accept, but you also know clearly that you do not regret this decision.
White simply shoved the ring back into your hand and said resolutely, "I'm willing to [share lovers], [I like you], no—it's that [we] like you, so...... I'm willing to [accept the rules]. "The more he spoke, the quieter his voice became. If it weren't for the strange silence of you five now, you probably wouldn't have heard what he was saying."
At that moment, Spamton, in your arms, grabbed your cheek, forcing you to lower your head to look at him. His face was serious, but he only spoke softly: "...... If Y/N is willing to consider a [request for remarriage], I'm willing to [share a lover]. ”
Big shot glanced at White standing behind, then at Spamton and you, and chuckled. You couldn't tell what kind of mood he was feeling, just couldn't help but shiver and stared at him wide-eyed.
"Then, if Y/N agrees to my [marriage request], I'm also willing to share a lover."
…… In other words, if you agree to marry Spamton and Big Shot, they're willing to accept the existence of other Dark Clans.
You opened your mouth, but before you could speak, Spamton Neo beat you to it. He said flusteredly, "This is my [legal], [unique], [lover's relationship]!" As he spoke, Spamton Neo hugged you tightly and threw the Spamton in his arms down. The little thing clattered to the ground, but no one picked him up. You instinctively wanted to reach out, but Spamton Neo restrained your movements, and you couldn't reach him.
You can feel his chin resting on your head. You want to cover his mouth to stop his output, but unfortunately, he lifts his head again, and you can't reach him.
He was still saying, "I am the only lover!" But for some reason, you inexplicably sensed a trace of panic and fear from his repeated emphasis on this sentence. Otherwise, why would he keep shaking your hand while holding you? He probably ...... Very uneasy.
You patted his hand resting on your waist, finally breaking him off and whispering, "...... No need to be so nervous, I won't agree to get married." ”
As soon as he said this, Spamton, who had just gotten up, fell again. Big Shot took the ring box you returned to him and lowered his head in disappointment. White, who had just wanted to demand a title, awkwardly shut his mouth, leaving only Spamton NEO holding his head high and looking at them.
But your next sentence shattered him too: "...... But I never confessed to you, nor did I agree to your confession. You all know this was a choice I made without knowing it, so we can only break up. Sorry." As you spoke, you tried to open Spamton Neo's hand and walk out on your own, but no matter how hard you tried, it was useless.
You patted the hand of the Feared Spamton Neo again, and only then did he reluctantly withdraw his hand. After all, he still doesn't want you to get hurt.
You cleared your throat and tried hard to stand among these four Dark People, trying to be impartial. Wang Dao Pingping. "Ahem...... In other words, I actually have nothing to do with you guys, but I don't mind having multiple lovers, nor do I mind you competing fairly. "As you spoke, you tilted your head slightly and made a wink gesture toward them.
The four Dark People exchanged glances.
White nodded obediently: "I understand the [Precautions]." ”
Big Shot just smiled and said, "I sign the [Notes]." ”
Spamton just walked over cautiously, gently tugging at your pant leg, but with little force: "...... I repeat the [Notes Treaty]. ”
Spamton neo was still somewhat dissatisfied, trying to scare off the others with his height, but unfortunately, success was unlikely, since they were all Spamton G. Spamton.
So in the end, he could only speak somewhat reluctantly: "I agree to the [Precautions]." ”
You nodded, finally feeling relieved. You glanced at the little guy at your feet carefully tugging at your pant legs, wondering if you felt a bit sorry for him or just held him in your arms.
Spamton flashed a provocative smile at the other three out of your sight, and you didn't know, just said, "I'm heading to the dorm first." ”
The color card manager will help you bring your luggage and such, but you still need to take it out and pack it properly.
White immediately eagerly followed: "So, Y/N, do you need [help]?" ”
You smacked your lips, about to refuse: "No need, I can handle it alone...... You're used to doing everything alone. Although some things are troublesome if you do it alone, you're used to it.
But immediately after, Spamton Neo caught up, clearly still unconvinced: "No, I think you [need high-altitude assistance]." ”
You opened your mouth, about to say no need, but Spamton in your arms spoke up: "I can help you handle [low-end things]." ”
Then Big Shot spoke up: "Then...... Maybe Y/N still needs [Physical Assistance]? ”
The four Dark People followed you toward the dormitory. The journey was much more conspicuous than before. You had to cover your cheek with your free hand, trying to avoid embarrassment, but in the end, you accepted them...... Follow them to your dorm. After all, you couldn't think of any reason to politely decline all of this.
Once at the dormitory, Spamton Neo let you sit on the chair he pulled out to rest. Immediately, the four Dark People got busy and bustling about. You had nothing else to do; you just needed to speak up when they were completely unsure. Most of the time, they knew exactly where things should be placed, as if they knew exactly what you were thinking. You didn't know why they understood this way, but at this moment, you just felt very comfortable.
Spamton neo helped you hang the curtains, Big Shot moved out a heavy case and placed it under your desk. White put the computer on it, attaching the case and keyboard and mouse. Spamton held a rag, cleaning up the probably nonexistent dust on the dorm floor. Then, Big Shot and White helped you make the sheets and put on a duvet cover—since their heights were the most suitable. Spamton neo arranged the books layer by layer on the bookshelf—those you rarely use were placed on top, and frequently used items at the bottom. Spamton put the miscellaneous toys you brought along and miscellaneous items like scissors into the cabinet under the desk, of course...... And your sanitary pads. Your face flushed a little, and you couldn't help but scratch your cheek awkwardly. White noticed this, walked over, and worriedly cupped your face: "Y/N, [Accident and Major Accident]?" ”
The other three Dark People also looked at you. Although slightly different, you could feel the same concern in their eyes.
You quickly shook your head. After all, you couldn't say it was because Spamton saw your sanitary pads and put them away, which made you feel a bit awkward...... But thinking about it, you usually use your computer to shop for these private hygiene products online, so it's true—there's nothing to be embarrassed about.
So you just coughed dryly twice: "No...... It's nothing, I just feel a bit embarrassed." As you spoke, your voice gradually softened.
Spamton put down the sanitary pad in his hand: "If it's [awkward: from Baidu Baike], then leave these to Y/N [organizing responsibility]." ”
You coughed twice again; they really were considerate...... You could always feel a strange warmth spreading in your heart: "No need, no need. After all, I'd rather sit here and slack off. Just help me tidy up." ”
You feel a bit at ease. After all, they can see your needs and preferences without even saying a word, which makes you feel so comfortable. However...... After all, they've helped you so much, and you really should give them some reward or reward. You're still embarrassed to let them help, even though they're probably trying to show off in front of you, even though ...... They might not need anything, but if you do nothing, you'll feel a bit guilty.
So after they packed your luggage and tidied up your dorm—of course, the ones provided for the Lightfolk were single dorms, so it was fine for them to stand here together. You applauded them and thanked them with sparkling eyes.
At this moment, Big Shot bent down slightly, squinting and smiling at you: "Y/N is very satisfied with the [thoughtful service]...... So, is there an extra reward? "As he spoke, he clicked his lips suggestively.
You paused. You really hadn't figured out what the reward would be, but would kissing be a bit much...... Before you could answer, you heard Spamton speak up somewhat reluctantly: "I think this is a 'necessary service.'" He seemed quite proud, probably because serving you was indeed his goal...... One of them? After all, on your computer screen, he seemed so attentive.
But for some reason, his eyes filled with tears again. There was nothing you could do—you picked him up and wiped his tears, then gently kissed his forehead and stammered, "This ...... This is the reward. ”
You still can't bear to see others cry, and you steeled yourself to think that just kissing your forehead wouldn't be hard to accept...... But maybe the big shot you suggested at the start wasn't very satisfactory?
As you spoke, your face grew hot. You patted your cheeks—since you couldn't favor one over the other—and kissed each of the four Dark People on the forehead. Each Dark Citizen looked very satisfied, smiling, while Big Shot still felt it was a pleasant surprise—when he first brought it up, he didn't expect you to agree, just hoped you'd think it over. He thought he wouldn't get a kiss today, but he still got a wet, soft kiss.
They finally left satisfied, and the last one to leave, white, gently helped you close the room door. After they left, you finally returned to your desk and began checking your class schedule.
TBC.

title: spamton.zip (6)
content:
The Dark World School's class schedule...... The schedule is pretty relaxed. You double-checked and found that there were basically only one or two classes a day, or sometimes none. You weren't sure if this was a special treatment for the People of Light, and the course content was quite relaxed. The Light People you exchanged for were in a separate class.
But every time you walk into the classroom, you can immediately see those four Spamton G. Spamton guys sitting in the same row, even elbowing and joking at each other—probably to save your seats? But when you look at the empty classroom, it's obvious they don't need to take seats. But their bickering is so obvious that the other Light People all look at them, even the newly arrived Dark People teacher has pupils in shock, pointing at them in silence.
You feel a bit embarrassed, although you only need to pretend not to know them — but as soon as you walk into the classroom, those people of darkness spot you, and immediately spamton neo start calling out loudly to you: 'Y/N, my [beloved]——'
It's so awkward, you almost don't want to bother with them, but then Big Shot smiles and says, "Y/N, there are [reserved seats] here. You can come and enjoy the [Privilege Aura]." ”
You felt even more embarrassed—because now the rats and classmates' gazes were fixed on you again, forcing you to grit your teeth and walk toward those four Dark Citizens. The other three wore smug expressions, but White was a bit uneasy. As you approached, she whispered, "Y/N...... Are we the [Troublemakers]? ”
You looked at him, sighed, and just rubbed your forehead: "...... No, don't overthink it. "Thinking about it, you agreed to it yourself, so there's nothing to regret. So you just walked over, pushed them aside, and sat down in the very center, trying to be perfectly balanced.
"Also, you don't have to reserve a seat for me...... Didn't you see that not many people came to class? "You took a deep breath.
"But I want to meet Y/N at the first sight...... I want to meet my wife at the very first sight. "Spamton whispered.
You can't do anything about them. In short, the class doesn't forbid others from coming to audit, so the four of them openly sit beside you, occasionally switching seats, because Spamton and White, who sit on the outside, will protest. You won't just see the poor little one being bullied like that.
The classroom atmosphere was also very relaxed; the teacher basically didn't bother with you. Fortunately, the exchange students who could come were all good students, and the class continued like this.
However...... Sometimes you do get drowsy because the teacher's lectures are very boring, and you don't take notes carefully. But when class finally wakes up, a notebook is pushed over—sometimes big-shot, sometimes white—depending on who sits next to you, and all the notes you haven't recorded in class.
Every time, you opened your mouth as if wanting to say something but held back, so you had to lean in and kiss the person taking notes on the forehead. This caused Spamton and Spamton Neo to compete to take notes for you, and in the end, because the handwriting wasn't nice enough, you sent them back.
Since you are the only one in the dormitory, you don’t really mind them coming in and out of your room. Occasionally, when your homework is really overwhelming, big shot will directly grab your computer to help you with your homework, and spamton neo will forcibly push you onto the bed to make you rest, because they say that people of darkness don’t need to rest, it doesn’t matter to them, but people of light must rest.
White carefully covers you with a blanket and puts you in an eye mask. As for Spamton...... It serves as a pillow in your arms.
They all envy Spamton for receiving such treatment, while Spamton, on the other hand, always fears that this privilege might disappear at any moment. All they can do is open your eyes after you fall asleep, repeatedly sketching and tracing your brows in your mind, recording your quiet posture in your sleep, carefully smoothing your forehead when you seem to have a nightmare and furrowing your brow, and remembering your smile during sweet dreams.
So, when you wake up, he will smile but reveal a subtle cautiousness and say, "Y/N, are you satisfied with the [companionship service]?" ”
You yawn, still a bit half-asleep: "Of course I'm satisfied...... It's nice to have someone to hold you. "You mutter, to be honest, you usually have some anxiety, but when you hold Spamton, that feeling disappears, and you get a good night's sleep.
Only then did Spamton let out a barely noticeable sigh of relief, but at the same time, the others seemed dissatisfied. Spamton neo came over, lowering his head to look at you. The slight pressure made you instinctively widen your eyes and shrink back. Perhaps noticing your movement, spamton neo slightly raised his body again: "...... [no intention to intimidate], but I can also [provide services] [companionship services]." His voice was sincere, tinged with a hint of urgency.
You paused for a moment, then Big Shot and White, who had just been helping you tidy up the room, also came over and said in unison, "I can also provide [companionship services]." ”
Spamton glared angrily at them, and you glared at them, hesitated for a moment, and looked at them. Seeing Big Shot's deliberately put on smiles and the inexplicably lively face, you couldn't help but get distracted and cough twice.
"Then...... Then let's take turns and try with someone else. Let's start with Big Shot. "As you spoke, you were still staring blankly at Big Shot's face.
Big Shot's smile grew even brighter, leaning in even closer to you, while you stared at him blankly.
He softly asked, "Do you really like looking at my [face]?" As he spoke, he deliberately leaned close to your ear, his voice mixed with warm breath reaching your ear. You felt your ears a bit damp and a little hot—no, it seemed like your whole face was a bit hot, so much so that you couldn't help but cover your face, leaving only your eyes visible as you looked at them.
The other three Dark People glared angrily at Big Shot, who was smugly apparent, while you just mumbled and replied, "It's a turn...... Take turns, anyone can ......" Your voice grew quieter and quieter.
Luckily, the Dark World School has prepared single dorms for you, and no one is coming for rounds. The beds are relatively large, so you and another Dark Citizen can fit in.
They behaved quietly, just resting with you in their arms. To your surprise, when they held you, your inner irritation seemed to calm down. So every morning when you woke up, you would snuggle tightly into their arms, then blush, push them away.
For some reason, it seemed they weren't arguing much anymore, as if they had tacitly agreed to the same goal.
Before class every day, Spamton Neo will hand you a cup of milk tea, all with your favorite flavors. Spamton will place your desk in advance with the books and notebooks you'll use in the class, Big Shot will find the relevant content for your review, and White will help you tidy up your clothes for the day. If the temperature suddenly drops or rises, he will remind you to change—you feel like you've been turned into a loser by these four Dark Citizens, and every morning when you wake up, you see them greeting you together.
Maybe after some time, you've gotten used to enjoying it all, and getting used to kissing them—at first just the forehead, then the cheek, and finally the ...... the corner of the mouth, and finally the lips.
You usually get pulled hard until your lips are bitten until they're swollen and red, and then you let go. This always makes you feel embarrassed, but...... You have to admit, that unfamiliar warmth and sense of comfort wraps around you, making you feel like crying and becoming increasingly reluctant to part with them.
You usually don't check the phone brought from the world of light, because most of it doesn't have content you're interested in, and it even has contact information for people you dislike but have to interact with—your parents.
To prevent them from causing trouble with the school, you actually charged your phone and didn't set it to silent.
But when your phone rings, your body instinctively stiffens, your face turns pale, your hands tremble, and you don't know what to do for a moment.
At this point, Spamton Neo rushes over to answer your phone. You don't know who is on the other end or what is being said. He doesn't turn on speaker and covers his phone a bit, not wanting you to hear.
And all you can hear is Spamton Neo's voice: "I'm Y/N's [legal lover]. She's been [in good shape] lately and doesn't need [extra attention]. ”
Then he hung up the phone and looked at you as if asking for a reward.
You paused for a moment, then slightly curved your eyebrows, leaned in and tiptoed to kiss the corner of his mouth, then hurried off to the classroom for the next class, leaving spamton neo standing there grinning foolishly and touching the corner of his mouth.
But a year is neither too long nor too short. Soon, it's time for your exchange student life to end, and you should return to the World of Light.
The other classmates left early. Some were eager to see their parents, some wanted to rush to see their loved ones, and some were just there to watch game updates. In the end, only you remained, holding your suitcase and standing before the beam of white light, hesitating.
Those four Dark People stand behind you, watching your back, anxiously waiting for your decision.
After hesitating for a moment, you finally put down your luggage, wiped away the tears streaming from the corner of your eyes, and then turned to walk toward them.
“…… I'm not leaving." You opened your phone, and for the first time mustered the courage to type for your parents, saying: You don't love me, I don't love you. I won't go back again.
Afterwards, he blocked all their contact information.
White once again opened an ad pop-up that read: "We love you."
Big Shot somehow pulled out 99 roses and scattered them at your feet.
Spamton cautiously leaned over and grabbed your pant leg: "Can you apply for remarriage? Let's start with a [lover's relationship]?" ”
Spamton's neo just rushed over and hugged you, shouting with excitement, "Y/N, I'm your 'forever lover'!" ”
You didn't push away Spamton Neo's hand, but instead hugged the other three Dark People who had come closer: "Mm...... I love you too. As for remarriage and all that...... Let's think about it again! ”
Actually, you still don't quite understand what love really is, but you want to dedicate all the experiences you have to them...... This is probably love, right? But it's okay, you still have a lot of time to think about this question, and you think they will always be with you.
END.

title: spamtonzip (1)
content:
Yawning, thinking about the homework the teacher assigned, you reluctantly search online for pirated software—the genuine version costs you about a hundred or two hundred silver dollars, and you wouldn't be happy about it! And the teacher said you should go online and search for it yourselves, just find a pirated copy to use. Unfortunately, the teacher didn't give you an installation package for the pirated software, so you could helplessly search online with your limited computer skills.
After skipping several pages that looked like paid ads, you finally found a page that looked ad-free and, surprisingly, even quite clean. Of course, you also cautiously avoided the security installation requirement to download some software manager, choosing a normal installation.
The mouse clicked, and you finally downloaded the installation package—though for some reason, what was the name of the package? spamton.zip you had a bad feeling about it. Why did the name look like it...... What kind of spam did it look like? Did you download it by mistake?
Haha, you can't just put a virus on your own computer after all this fuss. You gave a couple of awkward laughs, but still tried it out and extracted the installation package. Next, in the folder that opened automatically, you saw four exe files filled with garbled text and a bunch of json files. Besides that, the file your teacher requested indeed popped up.
At the same time, your computer flashes a virus warning, warning that those garbled files are all infected and may harm your computer. You click the mouse, block those files, frown and drag them to the trash to delete them, but for some reason...... Once those files are deleted, the JSON files in the folder and the pirated software you want will disappear together.
You frantically struggled for a long time and even downloaded powerful uninstall software, but it still didn't work.
With no other choice, you click on the pirated software, hoping it will work.
But no matter how much you tapped, nothing happened—just as you were feeling discouraged, you saw another prompt pop up in the center of your computer, saying the software was trying to launch other apps at the same time, and the system had blocked them from running.
You searched for ages and finally found this pirated software! With no other options, you have to go into Windows Security System and pull out those four garbled software programs, setting them to run safely.
This time, the pirated software finally got running. However...... The four garbled files also started running. This time, the filenames were no longer garbled; as the pirated software unfolded, the four garbled files also gained their own names.
It seems to be arranged from old to new, according to the change time: the first file is white, the second is called big shot, and for some reason, the third and fourth files look very similar—one is Spamton, the other is Spamton Neo. Meanwhile, several little figures who look completely different but have similar hairstyles appear on the screen. They call them people...... They don't really look alike, since people aren't this color scheme and don't have long noses.
You tried to turn off the four gadgets that appeared, but even if you opened Task Manager and forcibly shut it down, it would restart the next second and appear on your screen, looking like it had been infected with a virus. You pinched your nose and had no choice but to hurry and finish the homework left by the teacher first. After all, you didn't have the money to buy another computer, nor did you have time to reinstall it.
I don't know what crazy the teacher is, but lately I've been assigning homework related to this software, leaving you no time to think about the little gadgets on the computer screen.
However, aside from staying on your computer screen to block your view a bit and occasionally moving around, they don't do anything particularly distracting you, so you temporarily forget about it.
…… Besides when you're scrolling through short videos on your computer and that big shot suddenly raises the webpage pop-up and throws it out of the screen, making it impossible to find it. Besides that white, who especially likes to run ad pop-ups on your computer screen, as long as you're not doing anything serious, it will pop up ads to block your view or even block the videos you're scrolling through. Besides Spamton, which suddenly throws out some blue egg-like things that make you unable to open game software, forcing you to click on the blue egg and then the computer is forced to open a large, explicit photo that looks like Spamton is showing off itself. Except for Spamton Neo, which occasionally wraps a green cable around your shutdown button, forcing you to keep your computer open every day, everything else is fine, right?
Well, if it weren't for the occasional time when you can't finish your homework, Big Shot controlling your mouse to finish the design drawings assigned by the teacher, White proactively popping up ads for hacking software when you need to download software, Spamton organizing the document formats for assignments, and Spamton Neo proactively throwing the priority project software pop-up at the very front, you would definitely have reinstalled your computer long ago!!
However...... You're still used to having these four little things at the top of your screen. You know now: the one in a red suit is Big Shot, the one with pure white hair and body is White, the tiny one is Spamton, and the big one with wings flying around your screen every day is Spamton Neo.
You feel like they must be the same person from different periods...... But after all, they're just virtual personas—what does it have to do with you? Thinking this, you can't help but feel a bit disappointed. You laugh at yourself, thinking it's not just because real life is too lonely, that you imagine these are real beings that can accompany you, right?
That's just wishful thinking...... But sometimes you just stare blankly at the screen, watching Spamton hang up your father's video call, then Spamton neo typed and fired, saying a series of sarcastic but polite remarks that knocked your father back.
You might also think, if only they really existed...... That way, you would never have to fear going home again.
You blinked, trying hard to keep the tears from flowing, just controlling the mouse arrow to pat Spamton's head and tapping Spamton Neo's wings.
They seemed very happy. You saw the four little ones on the screen huddled together, saying something unknown, then White jumped up and waved to greet you, and you had no choice but to pat his head.
White seemed satisfied and dragged out your parents' chat boxes, while Big Shot opened the software you were about to use and started drawing the work diagrams for your homework.
You couldn't help but move the mouse back and forth, patting White's head and poking Big Shot's head again, while White ...... You don't know why, but you could see the blush in that little white shadow. As for Big Shot, his movements seemed to pause for a moment, then he worked even harder and faster to draw your work.
You lowered your eyes, leaning in front of the computer, looking at the four little things on the screen. Big Shot was still controlling your mouse to help you finish your homework, and your eyes reddened, but you couldn't help but say, "If only ...... If you really existed, how wonderful it would be to always be with me...... I really like you all. ”
You were just mumbling this sentence to yourself, but for some reason, those four little things on the screen seemed to have heard you. white jumped up, probably blushing, to greet you once again, while spamton danced joyfully in place, its little short legs moving up and down. As for spamton and neo… a small, connected, five-featured blue heart flew out from the chest, only to be stuffed back in by him.
