Big Shot just finished drawing the work-to-finish drawing quickly, and countless ad pop-ups flooded your computer screen. All the pop-up messages were 'I love you,' and all the options below were 'yes.'
You were startled, clicking your mouse on the screen. At the same time, a pop-up was thrown by white, and your mouse happened to land on yes. Immediately after, all the pop-ups on the computer disappeared, as if it had just been your imagination.
Staring blankly at the computer screen, you shake your head and decide to ignore everything that just happened—after all, it was probably just your imagination. After all, these are just programs running on your computer, and for some reason, these four little ones are so vivid. Other than that, how could they possibly be real? Besides that...... There could be no more unexpected things happening.
You think, you're just too lonely, so you place your feelings on it. You're just too lonely, so you fantasize that they are real. You just ...... Too much, too much desire, loved by someone, even if you don't even understand what love feels like, and what it's like to be loved.
Yet, you still sincerely hope someone can give you that feeling.
You still live as usual, spending three years of university with these four little ones on the computer screen. Until your senior year, you all need internships. The teacher also proposed an exchange student project, sending a few students from your world—the Light World—to study in the Dark World. Correspondingly, this is also a practical project. Exchange students need to observe the ecological environment of the Dark World and collect relevant information about the cultural industries of the Dark World.
It was only then that you realized...... Besides this world, there is another world that exists. And since your grades have always been the top in your major since university, you naturally have an exchange student spot.
For some reason, when you were muttering that you were going to the Dark World as an exchange student, the four little ones on the screen were all very happy.
And you pack your bags, take a deep breath at the agreed time, and muster the courage to step into the whirlpool at the boundary of light and darkness, into that unknown dark world.
TBC.
First comes a dazzling white light, then a wave of dizziness—you close your eyes, endure that dizzy feeling, and then open them.
To your surprise, you thought the Dark World would be as dark as its name suggests, but that's not the case. Although there was no white light, neon lights flickered, and the entire city was radiating a dazzling halo. This was almost indistinguishable from the place you came from, except this was another city you knew completely unfamiliar with.
You tentatively took two steps forward, and then something that looked completely different from a human suddenly appeared. Startled, you took two steps back. He claimed to be a Dark Folk and a serocard butler responsible for guiding the way.
You cautiously ask if he has a certificate, and he does pull out a black-and-white piece of paper with a stamp and signature, clearly a letter of authorization.
Only then did you relax and follow him forward. But for some reason, the road felt especially long, and you didn't know where the destination was. But when you saw a shopping street, you couldn't help but stop—because you saw that white Addison that used to bounce on your computer.
You can't believe it and can't help but close your eyes again, wiping them carefully before opening them. Standing there is still a white Addison frantically advertising in front of an unnoticed shop.
You suddenly recall the advice your teacher gave you before coming to the Dark World. He said that the People of Darkness are all made up of objects from the Light World, generated by the objects of the Light World and the emotions of their users. Every Dark World is related to the People of Light who created this Dark World.
But...... You're certain you have nothing to do with the creation of this dark world—or rather, you have nothing to do with any dark world...... So, why is he here?
After hesitating for a moment, you still say to the squalacher butler, "Sorry...... I might be delayed for a few minutes; I want to go check out the shopping street. ”
The Color Card Butler nodded very kindly: "It's fine. Miss, please visit this dark world. It doesn't matter how long it takes." ”
So you head toward the shopping street. For some reason, you feel a bit timid and nervous. What if this Addison looks extremely similar and has nothing to do with the one on your computer? What if you just mistaken it in a moment of urgency? What if......
You don't even know what you're thinking, and you're just walking heavily, stopping in front of Addison's store.
White was dozing off when he suddenly realized someone was approaching. He quickly snapped back to reality, and when he saw it was you, his eyes instantly sparkled: "Ah, it's Y/N! You're here!" ”
You hesitate for a moment. Since he acts like he knows you, he must be the one on your computer. But...... Why?
"Mm. I'm here...... Why are you here? After much thought, you still asked the question, nervously looking at the Addison in front of you.
"Because of [Love Permission]?" We fall under the category of "spam," so [please click the hyperlink]. "White explained rapidly, leaving you a bit stunned. Not only did you not understand what he said, but even if you did, you still couldn't analyze the underlying meaning.
Although you roughly understand why it appears on your computer, ......
"What kind of love permit?" How could it suddenly be connected to love?
White widened his eyes and looked at you, and only then did you realize he still had heterochromatic pupils: "But...... You have autism and have applied for a permanent companionship? I think you think we're cute. ”
Here, 'cute' probably means 'lovable'...... You are speculating based on the context of the upper and lower levels.
But you still seemed a bit troubled: "But that's not what I actually meant. I just hope someone can be with me and stop being alone......"
He patted his chest: "[Wholeheartedly at Your Service], and here is our [Love Application Certificate]. ”
As he spoke, he pulled out a red notebook—it was a marriage certificate. Your eyes widened as you flipped through it for a long time, but no matter what, you couldn't believe the marriage certificate looked fake, to the point that your voice was trembling.
"When did I marry you?" How come you didn't know about this? No one told you?
White thought for a moment, then gave you an answer: "Five days ago, a [please click the hyperlink] [marriage application]." ”
After thinking hard for a while, you finally remembered: indeed, five days ago, this white Addison was holding an ad pop-up hanging on your computer screen. Party leader, you didn't need to download anything, but you still patted Addison's head with your mouse, then clicked into that hyperlink. Unfortunately, you couldn't open that link, and when you clicked in, it was completely blank.
Now you realize it was a marriage application, but you never imagined it would end like this.
You choked up for a moment, and after a long pause, you finally spoke: "...... But when I clicked into that page, it was blank. I thought it was just a link that wouldn't open, and you never told me what that link was for......
White lowered his head. You couldn't see his expression, but you could only know he spoke a bit pitifully: "So...... Y/N doesn't recognize this [marriage application] and wants to [legally dissolve the marriage] and [regret: Baidu Encyclopedia]? ”
You nod awkwardly, remembering he couldn't see, and added, "I don't think I agreed to letting us be together......
Although you don't dislike them, and even like them a little. But suddenly saying they're marrying you, you still can't accept it. How did you suddenly have a marriage certificate with the Dark People?
"Then...... Do you really dislike me? His voice trembled and even sounded a bit weak, sounding very soft.
You quickly waved your hand: "No, actually, I actually quite like you two." As you spoke, you scratched your head awkwardly.
White looks up stubbornly at you: "Then why do you have to [regret: Baidu Baike]?" I'll [shoot a perfect script] [prove the basics] for you to see, I'll make you [fall into the whirlpool of love] for me. ”
You opened your mouth, a bit speechless. Honestly, if you were to talk about marriage, you wouldn't be very resistant.
“…… Alright, oh right, I still have to register at the school here, so I'll be leaving first. "You said this hurriedly, without turning to look at his expression, and left the shopping street in a panic.
The Color Card butler was still standing there waiting for you. You exhaled, tidied your messy hair from running so fast, and forced a stiff smile: "Alright, let's keep going." ”
The Color Card butler nodded and continued leading the way. Soon, you noticed the wall ahead was covered with advertisements, all drawn of someone you knew very well—the man in a red suit, that big shot.
You were silent for a while, thinking that since Addison had appeared in this world, it would be normal for other little things on your computer screen to appear, but at the same time, you might as well avoid encountering them for now, since ...... White said he married you, who knows what the others might say.
Unfortunately, even though you desperately hoped not to run into these guys, you still ran into Big Shot at the school gate.
The Color Card Butler introduced that this was the Dark People who were coming to this school today to participate in a performing arts event.
Big shot glanced at you, his eyes curved with a smile: "Y/N, [My Lover]...... You finally [arrived at the scene]. ”
After the color card butler took you to the place, he left, and your pupils trembled as you looked at Big Shot: "When did I become your lover?" "I didn't even tell you that?"
Big Shot's lips curled into a smile: "...... Last weekend, I passionately created a poster effect image for you, marked with engagement details, and you [chose to agree]. ”
You barely recall: last weekend the teacher did assign an assignment for designing a wedding poster. You hadn't even started it yet, but Big Shot was already using your mouse to help you complete the assignment, and you just clicked save. So how did you choose to agree?
"I'm just saving my homework as usual, so why did I choose to agree?" No matter how hard you rack your brain, you still can't figure it out.
The corners of his mouth still curved down: "I sincerely believe, you chose to agree to marriage services." You even clicked the [hyperlink] and gifted me a [gemstone ring]. ”
As he spoke, he showed you the ring finger wearing the ring. The ring looked familiar, and you finally remembered—this was your homework from your jewelry design class. You designed this ring, but Big Shot pushed away the pop-up where you had just saved your assignment. You casually said that if he wanted it, you could give it to him. Now, the ring has become a physical item, worn on Big Shot's hand.
You were at a loss for words and didn't know what to say. You just glanced at him in panic, lost in thought—maybe your mind was out of your mind. You asked, "Even if you gave me a ring, what about the ring you gave me?" ”
Big Shot leisurely took out a red velvet box, then knelt on one knee. He opened the box to show you. Inside was a ring similar in style to the gemstone ring you designed, looking like a couple's piece.
He solemnly said, "Miss Y/N, I hereby [solemnly swear] to submit a [marriage application]. Please click the [Hyperlink] to make a [Marriage Request]. I am willing to [honor my vow], [wholeheartedly] [care for] you, never [betray the vow], never [give up pure love].' ”
You covered your face, and for a moment, you really didn't know what to say.
TBC.
So you just waved your hand in a panic: "...... Propose? Then I still need to think it over. It's so rushed like this......
But Big Shot simply shoved the ring box into your hand, lowering his brows and saying, "No matter what, this is a [precious token of affection]. I hope you can [accept it all]." ”
Once you say that, you're not too embarrassed to refuse—but treating an engagement ring as a gift? That's quite extravagant.
You hesitate for a moment, while Big Shot just lifts his head and looks at you with a sincere gaze. You sigh and finally choose to compromise.
"Alright, I'll accept it for now...... But regarding the marriage proposal, I really need to think it over carefully. "You emphasized it.
Actually, if you say you don't care at all, that's just a lie...... You do feel a bit tempted, because you know that after marriage, someone will be there who will stay by your side and never leave you, even if you agree to everything. But you're not sure if you can give them the love they hope for. Can you ...... Be responsible?
So in the end, you just chose to avoid it, and you just pretended none of it happened, smiling: "And my reporting time is up, so I'll head to the office first." ”

"Then...... Then let's take turns and try with someone else. Let's start with Big Shot. "As you spoke, you were still staring blankly at Big Shot's face.
Big Shot's smile grew even brighter, leaning in even closer to you, while you stared at him blankly.
He softly asked, "Do you really like looking at my [face]?" As he spoke, he deliberately leaned close to your ear, his voice mixed with warm breath reaching your ear. You felt your ears a bit damp and a little hot—no, it seemed like your whole face was a bit hot, so much so that you couldn't help but cover your face, leaving only your eyes visible as you looked at them.
The other three Dark People glared angrily at Big Shot, who was smugly apparent, while you just mumbled and replied, "It's a turn...... Take turns, anyone can ......" Your voice grew quieter and quieter.
Luckily, the Dark World School has prepared single dorms for you, and no one is coming for rounds. The beds are relatively large, so you and another Dark Citizen can fit in.
They behaved quietly, just resting with you in their arms. To your surprise, when they held you, your inner irritation seemed to calm down. So every morning when you woke up, you would snuggle tightly into their arms, then blush, push them away.
For some reason, it seemed they weren't arguing much anymore, as if they had tacitly agreed to the same goal.
Before class every day, Spamton Neo will hand you a cup of milk tea, all with your favorite flavors. Spamton will place your desk in advance with the books and notebooks you'll use in the class, Big Shot will find the relevant content for your review, and White will help you tidy up your clothes for the day. If the temperature suddenly drops or rises, he will remind you to change—you feel like you've been turned into a loser by these four Dark Citizens, and every morning when you wake up, you see them greeting you together.
Maybe after some time, you've gotten used to enjoying it all, and getting used to kissing them—at first just the forehead, then the cheek, and finally the ...... the corner of the mouth, and finally the lips.
You usually get pulled hard until your lips are bitten until they're swollen and red, and then you let go. This always makes you feel embarrassed, but...... You have to admit, that unfamiliar warmth and sense of comfort wraps around you, making you feel like crying and becoming increasingly reluctant to part with them.
You usually don't check the phone brought from the world of light, because most of it doesn't have content you're interested in, and it even has contact information for people you dislike but have to interact with—your parents.
To prevent them from causing trouble with the school, you actually charged your phone and didn't set it to silent.
But when your phone rings, your body instinctively stiffens, your face turns pale, your hands tremble, and you don't know what to do for a moment.
At this point, Spamton Neo rushes over to answer your phone. You don't know who is on the other end or what is being said. He doesn't turn on speaker and covers his phone a bit, not wanting you to hear.
And all you can hear is Spamton Neo's voice: "I'm Y/N's [legal lover]. She's been [in good shape] lately and doesn't need [extra attention]. ”
Then he hung up the phone and looked at you as if asking for a reward.
You paused for a moment, then slightly curved your eyebrows, leaned in and tiptoed to kiss the corner of his mouth, then hurried off to the classroom for the next class, leaving spamton neo standing there grinning foolishly and touching the corner of his mouth.
But a year is neither too long nor too short. Soon, it's time for your exchange student life to end, and you should return to the World of Light.
The other classmates left early. Some were eager to see their parents, some wanted to rush to see their loved ones, and some were just there to watch game updates. In the end, only you remained, holding your suitcase and standing before the beam of white light, hesitating.
Those four Dark People stand behind you, watching your back, anxiously waiting for your decision.
After hesitating for a moment, you finally put down your luggage, wiped away the tears streaming from the corner of your eyes, and then turned to walk toward them.
“…… I'm not leaving." You opened your phone, and for the first time mustered the courage to type for your parents, saying: You don't love me, I don't love you. I won't go back again.
Afterwards, he blocked all their contact information.
White once again opened an ad pop-up that read: "We love you."
Big Shot somehow pulled out 99 roses and scattered them at your feet.
Spamton cautiously leaned over and grabbed your pant leg: "Can you apply for remarriage? Let's start with a [lover's relationship]?" ”
Spamton's neo just rushed over and hugged you, shouting with excitement, "Y/N, I'm your 'forever lover'!" ”
You didn't push away Spamton Neo's hand, but instead hugged the other three Dark People who had come closer: "Mm...... I love you too. As for remarriage and all that...... Let's think about it again! ”
Actually, you still don't quite understand what love really is, but you want to dedicate all the experiences you have to them...... This is probably love, right? But it's okay, you still have a lot of time to think about this question, and you think they will always be with you.
END.

title: vagrant1 (dnsx you)
content:
…… Extremely unlucky. Think about it, holding that hospital X-ray report and thinking, you really are unlucky. The doctor tells you to prepare for a maximum of five years to live, but you still have to come back for a follow-up after six months...... Because you don't know if your condition will change.
Really...... So unlucky. You let out a sigh of relief, packed up your money, ignored the messages your parents sent you, and with a mix of bitterness and indifference, thought: I hadn't cared about you for years, so what's the point of rushing to care about you now? My illness had long been delayed, and the money I'd saved over the years seemed useless. The rest of the time I could just live as I pleased.
If ...... You just want to go somewhere where these people won't disturb you. You turn off your phone, stare blankly at the money you've gathered, and finally decide to exchange it for Dark Coin and spend your last years in the Dark World. Think about it, no one in the Dark World knows you...... Well, but a few years ago you seem to have accidentally entered the Dark World. You can't remember exactly what happened, but you probably just casually used the last dollar you had left to buy something from Addison.
Hopefully, you won't see him again. Thinking this, you step into the dark world and use your dark coins to buy a small house by the street. The environment here is pretty good, and it's close to convenience stores and such. After tidying up your room a bit, you plan to go to a nearby cinema to watch and casually watch a movie to pass the time. After all, it doesn't matter what you do anymore.
Spamton also saw you when passing by the cinema entrance. Of course he recognized you—he recognized you as the Lightfolk who bought his first thing that year. But—he's changed a lot, so you probably don't recognize him anymore. But it's okay, you can meet again, you can meet again. He once longed countless times about whether he could see you again. That wish seems to have become an obsession, which is why he has now become a hot shot. He ...... He wants to see you, and he wants you to see him. He is almost driven mad by the thought of this. Spamton swallows nervously, greedily staring at you. Today, you're just wearing an ordinary white long dress with your hair down. You don't have much time left to live, so of course you don't care about your own appearance.
You were a bit distracted, and as you walked toward the cinema, a figure about the same height as you stood in front of you. You looked up at him in confusion—it was a well-dressed male Dark Citizen...... He wore a dark red suit with stripes, his skin was snow-white, his nose long, and he was smiling at you.
You stopped in your tracks, tilting your head in confusion as you looked at him, while Spamton just smiled and said, "Miss [Beautiful Lady], you are a [Citizen of Light]. The arrival of the [Citizen of Light] has brought brilliance to the entire [Dark World]. I would like to know [Your Name]?" I am SPAMTON G. SPAMTON, [Glad to serve you]. ”
You looked at him in confusion, feeling like some clichéd way to pick up a conversation. Honestly...... And his voice was crackling with electric currents and a random clip of a recording playing. Could it be that all the Dark People talk like this? You don't know. But it doesn't matter if you try to strike up a conversation. It's already the last few years, and you can live as you please, without caring at all about the consequences or consequences—as long as you're not with your parents.
So you said, "I'm Y/N, Mr. Spamton, hello, I'm going to see a movie...... Do you want to join me too?" You said casually, not really caring what his answer would be, but it was still somewhat unexpected. He actually nodded, "Then—[My Honor], do you prefer watching [genre films]?" "He asked about your preferences. Although your way of speaking was a bit odd, you still understood."
You nod gently: "Then can you recommend something to me?" I like watching some suspense and mystery genres...... Don't want horror movies, or it would scare me. By the way, how many movies has Mr. Spamton seen? ”
"[Countless]—but among the recently released films, I would recommend [buy the film], this one. I hope you can be [joyful]." Spamton said as he pointed to a movie poster. You glanced at it—the movie was called 'September 1st,' and it seemed to tell the story of a teacher and several other students.
You thought for a moment and nodded in agreement, then turned to look at Spamton and winked at him: "So, Mr. Spamton, would you like to come with me to see it?" ”
"Of course, this is my honor." Spamton said this while bowing seriously, giving you a hand-kiss through his hand, then naturally took your hand and led you inside. We bought two movie tickets, and you both walked into the theater and sat side by side in the center.
This film tells the story of a teacher who is pushed down the building by a student on September 1st, the day school begins. Later, on September 1st, the teacher is reborn, and she begins to avoid the ongoing cases that could lead to death, carefully unraveling the mystery behind the scenes to deduce the culprit. The film ends. Although there are only two people in the theater, you remain quiet until the very end, applauding and smiling at Spamton: "Hmm, the film Mr. Spamton recommended is quite good." ”
Spamton looked at your smiling face and swallowed gently. At that moment, he had a desire to kiss your lips, to lick your cheek over and over, to see your smile again and again, to hear you call his name.
So naturally, he asked, "I'm glad you can be 'joyful.' I want to invite you to spend [feasting time] and 'romantic years' together?" "To be honest, he was indeed a bit nervous, after all...... At this moment, he was indeed asking you for a one-night stand.
You were stunned for a moment, not knowing why you still understood a little, but...... Even though you're so young, you still want to experience these things. Precisely because you're so young and have never had these experiences before, you are indeed somewhat tempted.
However...... The doctor has already forbidden you from drinking. You think maybe having sex again might be a bit dangerous...... So you just smiled and shook your head, somewhat regretfully refusing him: "Ah...... Sorry, but it's getting late, I have to go back. See you next time, Mr. Spamton. ”
Even after being rejected, he still smiled warmly, as if he didn't feel embarrassed at all. He just felt a bit regretful—it seemed that making this request from the start was a bit reckless.
"Alright then, [Honored Miss], I would like to keep your [contact information], and save it for [next meeting]." As he spoke, he took out his phone again.
After hesitating for a moment, you took out your phone and glanced at it. Good, nothing in the light world could bother you anymore. It showed no signal, but now you had signal from the dark world. So you added Spamton's contact information, then walked out of the cinema to say goodbye to him, planning to buy something to eat at the convenience store.
Spamton held the phone number you just gave him, his body trembling instinctively. He was a bit excited, so he eagerly opened the other phone he was carrying. This phone was used only to contact the other side—the person who had made the deal. Naturally, it was highly confidential. Even if he traced the source of the signal, he couldn't trace it back to Spamton, only to the Wilderness.
He opened that phone, entered your phone number, and sent the first text message rapidly.
[Honey, the clothes you wore today are just so beautiful...... I really like them. I wonder what other clothes the baby looks like? I'm really looking forward to it. ]
[Speaking of which, darling actually talked to another man today, and even went to the movies together...... I'm so jealous. When will I be able to go to the movies with my dear? ]
[Dear, is dinner just bread? It feels so heartbreaking...... Next time, I'm going to prepare dinner for you, darling. I hope you can finish it all by then, so don't waste my kindness. ]
He sent you three messages with a rapid sound. Seeing that all three messages showed as read, his breathing grew rapid. Spamton knew you saw it—definitely did. He waited for your reaction and quietly walked away.
Meanwhile, you were gnawing on bread bought at the convenience store, your phone vibrating one after another. You opened it and saw it was a spam text message from an unknown number.
…… Unlucky, really unlucky. You came to the Dark World just for some peace, and now you've run into a pervert. You instinctively look around but don't see any strange figures. But you think about it...... You're about to die anyway, so it's fine to play along with this pervert.
But you still bit into your bread and sent a string of texts with a crackling sound: [? You pervert, what exactly makes you want to follow me? ] After saying that, you blocked that number.
Spamton tapped his hand and realized you had blocked this number. He just smiled and registered another account on his phone to send you another message. Honestly, he was just glad you replied to him...... Even if you scolded him, he didn't mind.
[Oh my, the baby actually replied to my message, I'm so surprised! ]
[But dear, why are you calling me a pervert...... I just like you so much, that's why I keep looking at you. ]
[And you even blocked me...... Darling, treating me like this makes me so sad TAT]
You were silent for a while, then looked at another harassing text message, thinking this voyeur was ...... In short, he was a pervert, but he did have some real skills, so you seriously replied to his messages and teased him a bit—after all, you can do whatever you want.
[Hmm, then tell me, I only wore a white dress, what exactly looks good about me? ]
TBC.

title: vagrant2 (dnsx you)
content:
He hesitated for a moment, then secretly peeked at you again—just looking at you like this made him genuinely happy. He watched you innocently nibble on that piece of bread, frown slightly at the messages on your phone. He watched your black hair floating with the wind, messy, and you casually brushed the hair that floated in front of your face back behind your head. Spamton felt that all of this was beautiful, extremely beautiful, making him involuntarily hold his breath, gazing at you intently, also watching your skirt fluttering in the wind.
And you seemed to notice something; you felt as if some gaze was fixed on you, so you couldn't help but lift your head and look in that direction. But Spamton just withdrew his gaze, hiding behind the wall, and continued typing and sending messages to you with some excitement and slight trembling in his hands: [Very beautiful, extremely beautiful... Baby, you are like a sprite standing in the wind, as if you could ride the wind away from all of this... Yes, dear, you don't seem to belong to this world, and you can no longer eat bread... I will prepare for you what you deserve.]
[Yes, and your hair is dark and shiny, and the way it flows together with the hem of your dress is very beautiful… Darling, I wish I could look at you a little longer, but you don't seem to like it much, so I can't look at you anymore;;]
You looked at these two messages and raised your eyebrows. Honestly, this stalker seems kind of interesting... Hmm, it would be better if he didn't harass you, but you still replied to a message as if you were deliberately teasing him.
Hmm, but in a couple of days I'm going to get a haircut, so you won't be able to see my black hair flowing in the wind.
After sending this message, you put down your phone, looked around the room, sighed, and honestly... although some areas are still messy, given your current physical condition, you simply don't have the strength to organize everything. You start thinking about whether you can hire someone to help tidy up the room—after all, you don't mind spending a bit more money now, and those things, for you, really aren't a big deal.
You slumped on the sofa, still pondering your thoughts, when you heard your phone constantly vibrating. It seemed like that guy had sent you a lot of messages again. With nothing else to do, you simply picked up your phone to see what the messages were about.
[Baby actually replied to me again... Does this mean baby cares about me? ///^^///]
[But dear, it would be such a pity if you cut off that long hair... Are you really going to do it TAT]
[Or baby, after cutting it, leave your hair for me! I will definitely treasure it——///<_>/// Baby, don't waste your hair, I really like it…]
[Everything dear should belong to me... Don't cut your hair casually...]
[I'm begging you TAT]
[Baby, why aren't you replying to me? Do you really want to cut it off right now TAT]
[Then I will squat outside the baby's room, ready to pick up the hair you throw away ^^]
You twitched the corner of your mouth as you watched the messages being sent endlessly in the chat box as if his life depended on it. You didn’t understand how he could type so fast, and yet talk about so much on his own. But looking at him like this was kind of funny, or rather… a little cute?
So you casually sent him a few messages.
[Replied to you]
[Not cut off]
[I won't give you the chance to pick it up either]
This time the message from the other side also came very quickly.
[Baby has come back to me again awa]
[This time it's actually three messages! Dear... dear, are you willing to chat with me?]
You raised your eyebrows and tapped the screen with your finger: [What if I don't want to chat with you?]
[Darling, please don't abandon me TAT……]
[Could it be that my dear doesn't like me sending so many messages? TAT]
[If you really don't like it... OTTO]
"If you don't like it, will you just keep crying?" You admit that chatting with this guy is quite interesting, but... you can't go on like this for much longer. It's fine to tease him online, but you certainly don't want to suffer in real life.
[I will hide in a place where my darling can't see me and keep crying until my darling is willing to pay attention to me ><]
After seeing this sentence, you turned off your phone. You plan to ignore him for a while, believing that he won't be able to resist bothering you again after some time.
Meanwhile, Spamton communicated a bit, and then moved into the house next to yours. To be honest, this entire street was originally an asset that the partners intended to give him—so naturally he also got the keys to your house. However, he just quietly tidied up the house and then prepared to give you a surprise when he meets you tomorrow. Maybe you'll be very happy—maybe you'll just think it's a coincidence. Spamton, fantasizing about your reaction when you see him tomorrow, couldn't help humming a couple of notes. He was in a really good mood, or rather, a bit too good of a mood.
As for you... you lay on the sofa resting for a while before realizing that your phone hadn't rung all afternoon. You picked it up and looked, only to find that the last message was still the one he sent. Rarely, you moved your fingers and tapped a reply: [Really crying?]
[Really cried TTTTTT]
Spamton is sitting on the sofa in the house next to yours, smiling, wiping the tears that flow from his swollen eyes, pretending. He doesn't know if this trick will work on you, but this is all he can do.
You pressed your lips together, and for some reason felt a bit guilty: [Alright, go ahead and send it, I'm fine]
After all, you also feel indifferent; if he wants to post, then let him post.
Great——then I will send lots of messages to my baby every day! It doesn't matter if my baby replies or not, as long as my baby sees them~
You clicked your mouth once, and couldn't help but send him another message: [Are you a pervert, acting like this?]
[///^^///Yes, I am the pervert belonging to the baby alone///^^///]
…To be honest, you were a little disgusted, so you simply put down your phone, walked into your bedroom, tidied up the books you had brought from the world of light, hesitated for a moment, and then casually picked up a book to start flipping through it. You were only trying to pass the time; you didn't know what you should do. Maybe you should find something to do in the dark world?
You were daydreaming about these things while looking at the book. To be honest, you didn't actually absorb much, since you had been distracted the whole time. When you came back to your senses, the book was already flipped to the last page. You sighed, put the book back on the shelf, and then picked up your phone again, only to realize that he had sent you a lot of messages again.
[Awa, I knew the baby's heart is very soft... but it's fine as long as you're soft-hearted only towards me! Baby must not be this soft-hearted towards other men... I would be very unhappy TAT]
[But I'm not happy, and the baby probably wouldn't feel anything either... TAT, can you care about me a little more, dear?]
[Darling, look at me, look at me... I know you haven't seen any of this news, when will I get the baby's favor?]
[The movie that baby watched with someone else today should be really good, right? I'm so jealous of the person who watched the movie with you... I also want to watch a movie with baby.]
[Dear, look at me, look at me, look at me...]
You unlocked your phone and swiped the screen, and all these messages were marked as read, but the next second, his message popped up again.
[Dear, you finally saw my message ///><///]
You let out a sigh and yawned, looking at the time—it’s actually only about half past nine, but you really do need to get a good rest.
So you quickly sent him a message: [Alright, little pervert, I'm going to sleep, good night]
[Awa, my dear gave me a nickname… I like it so much, good night my dear! I hope I'm in your dreams, baby! ///><///]
You stared at the message in silence for a moment, rubbed your forehead, and then turned off your phone, also setting it to silent so that if he sent messages in the middle of the night, it wouldn't wake you. Then you curled up, hugging yourself, and fell asleep in the blanket. To be honest, you arrived in a strange world today, and there was one more person bothering you. You slept somewhat unsteadily, often half-asleep and half-awake during the night. When you sat up in the morning, facing the dim light of this world, you were still a bit bewildered. Then you remembered, you are in another world, and you have welcomed the morning of the second day.
You stared blankly outside, then reopened your phone — only to find that the little pervert hadn't sent you any new messages. Instead, you felt a bit inexplicably disappointed, so after hesitating for a moment, you tapped on the keyboard and sent him a message: [Good morning]
[Good morning, my dear—I waited for you for so long, and you finally woke up awa.] The person on the other side almost replied to you instantly. You suspect that they might have been staring at the phone screen all the time, or maybe they even set a special notification tone for you, otherwise how could they respond so quickly?
What does baby plan to eat for breakfast? Do you need me to prepare it for you! I want to know what baby likes to eat more~
You scratched your somewhat messy hair. Because you were going out, you changed your clothes and tied up your hair. You planned to go find something to do; always staying at home alone, waiting for death... that feeling wasn't pleasant either. So you put on a blue and white dress with lace and tied your hair into a high ponytail.
You typed on your phone keyboard: [Haven’t decided yet. Probably I'll go to the convenience store to buy a sandwich to eat.]
[Only eating convenience store food is unhealthy TAT, baby look at me, I will prepare breakfast for you every morning from now on!]
You raised your eyebrows and walked to the door. To be honest, you didn't know where he would put the breakfast, but when you opened the door, you saw a plate at the doorway, with steaming sandwiches on it, along with a steaming sausage and a fried egg.
You subconsciously widened your eyes and looked around, but there wasn't a single figure in sight, and this sudden breakfast was exactly as written in the message earlier—it would be prepared for you every morning.
You hesitated for a moment, carried this breakfast back to the living room, closed the bedroom door, and started eating. Honestly, this breakfast really tastes good.
TBC.

title: vagrant3 (dnsx you)
content:
After breakfast, you look at the plate—it's even single-use. You just need to throw it away. So you throw the tray into the trash, brew yourself a pot of floral tea, take a sip, look at your phone in silence for a moment, and finally send a message: [Thank you for breakfast]
The other side still replied instantly: [No need to thank me, it's my duty to prepare breakfast for my dear>><<]
You chuckled, suddenly feeling a bit better than before, your previously confused, even somewhat lonely mood, at least...... At least you still have someone to talk to, at least someone in this world still notices you. You are not alone or alone. Maybe that's not so bad.
[Alright, little pervert, I'll look forward to the meals you prepare for me.] You rarely type this seriously. You think, although it probably shouldn't be right, for someone who has mastered your movements and probably keeps watching you, you should ...... feel afraid. But now, all you have is the sadness of finally being valued, a strange sense of satisfaction. You put down your phone, close your eyes, and think about it, and indeed...... Indeed, this kind of thinking is probably wrong, but...... But besides that, who else can give you that feeling?
You calm yourself down and type again: [Mm, it tastes great, thank you for your breakfast, I really like it]
[Dear, just like the taste of breakfast!! I'll definitely make something that makes you taste even better ///^^///]
You chuckled softly and typed another line: [Are you crazy...... Why do you have to watch me every day, and control my every move? ]
[Then I'm my dear little lunatic...... Because I like babies, I love babies so much, that's why I keep watching you, awa]
You were silent for a while, chewing over the word 'like' in your mouth. You couldn't tell what liking was, what love was; your parents and teachers never taught you these things, so...... Is this what liking is? You don't know; you only feel that you truly are cared for, and beyond that, you know nothing else.
[Do you like it...... I don't understand. But if you like it, then do it. I won't stop you. ] Finally, you lowered your eyes and typed this line.
You don't understand, you don't understand, you can't understand any of this. But you don't mind, just turn off your phone, open the door, and head out.
Spamton, on the other hand, gazed at the message you sent with longing. He chuckled foolishly, saying, "Since you didn't stop him, it proved he could do it, to prove ...... It proved that you still cared about him, that you were still watching him." Spamton once thought that after becoming a hot shot, he was left with only loneliness and a fate of madness. He let himself sink into madness, because his greed was boundless, and because he had always ...... He always wanted to become a bigger figure. He wanted to go to the world of light, he wanted to see you again. He once thought that living in the Queen's mansion would change his fate, but the truth proved he could only sink into this lonely madness.
Until he sees you again, standing before him when he was once infinitely lonely, keeping him away from the ridicule of other Addisons, saying you will become his friend, he thinks maybe that god he never believed in heard his wish and brought you to his side.
He placed the phone in his own house, and when he heard you open the door again, he hurried to open it too. You looked at the neighbor who opened the door almost simultaneously in surprise—he was Spamton, whom you had met once yesterday.
He smiled warmly at you, first bowed slightly, and gave you a kiss: "[Honored Miss], it's an honor to meet you again." ”
You stared at him blankly, blinked twice, and asked blankly, "Hey, so you live here too?" When I saw you yesterday...... You don't live here, do you...... You think for a moment, then hesitate.
Spamton's smile only deepened: "Hmm, yesterday it was [temporary housing], and today I'm [officially moving] here. It's really a [coincidence]—it's actually right next to the lady." As he spoke, he gave you a gentle bow again.
You scratched your head and awkwardly laughed twice: "You don't have to ...... No need to treat me so seriously. Since we exchanged contact information yesterday, let's call it a friend, right? Friends don't need to be so formal. ”
…… Friend. Spamton looked up at your smile. In a daze, he felt your smile was just as radiant as countless years ago, as if it could dispel the loneliness in his heart, still so dazzling that he felt a bit ashamed, and could only ...... Keep smiling, but a trace of dark desire surged in his eyes as he gazed at you.
"Of course, this is my [honor]." He smiled warmly and gently shook your hand.
“…… Hmm, so could you introduce this dark world? I just moved here and plan to stay here for a few years. I want to buy some things...... But I don't know what to choose...... You lowered your head a bit embarrassedly, your toes restlessly spinning on the ground. You thought maybe asking such a question was really ...... Isn't that a bit much? You don't know, that's just how you feel.
But Spamton just chuckled lightly: "Of course, no problem. I happen to need to [purchase and install supplies] too. So, [Miss, please come with me.'" As he spoke, he gently took your hand. You hesitated and glanced at him. Honestly, you were a bit lacking in confidence. You even mustered the courage to say that sentence just now, because you've only known him for a day...... What if he thinks you're just casual and familiar?
But Spamton knew that you had known each other for a long time. Maybe that didn't mean much to you, since he saw it. You would also help other Dark People who had been bullied. That warmth wasn't his only thing. He just carefully held your warm hand now.
…… You followed behind him in silence, wanting to say something but not knowing what to say. In the end, you just followed him to the commercial street.
You might feel this street looks familiar, as if you've been here before...... But maybe your memory is too vague, you can't recall anything, just follow Spamton into one of the stores.
This store sells bedding. Yesterday, you just made a bed and slept in. Indeed, buying some things is quite necessary, so you went over and picked out a set in sky blue.
But when you look back, you find Spamton just smiling at your back, seemingly not intending to pick anything.
You can't help but ask him with some confusion, "Don't you need to buy anything?" ”
He just slowly shook his head: "[No need]. I used to have [home decoration supplies], but it only required [moving time], and I only bought [daily necessities]. ”
You nodded half-understandingly, trying to carry the set of items to pay. As you walked out, Spamton took the item from your hand: "This is pretty heavy. I think I need [help]." You were a bit dazed, thinking you could do it yourself, but your own words...... And it was indeed exhausting, so in the end you didn't say much.
Then came some daily necessities. Spamton stored this bag of bedding and started taking you to the supermarket—desk lamp, tissues, toothpaste, toothbrush, cups, and the like...... These are all daily necessities you need. You picked according to your own needs, while Spamton quietly noted down the patterns you picked, then quietly picked couple styles out of sight. If there were no couple pieces, they would use the same pattern as you. Spamton sincerely looked at them and felt quietly happy. Maybe this means you and he have taken things further.
In the end, you were a bit troubled carrying big and small bags, but Spamton still took the initiative to carry the bag and led you home.
You feel a bit embarrassed, since Spamton did a lot of physical work for you...... And you'll probably need his help later, so you start thinking about how to repay him.
Finally, when you reach the door, Spamton puts your things down and prepares to open his door and walk in. You eagerly tug at the hem of Spamton's suit. He turns to look at you in confusion, while you just stammer, "Mr. Spamton...... Could you help me out a little? As payment...... "Let me treat you to lunch......" As you spoke, your voice grew quieter and quieter, after all...... You're really sorry.
But Spamton just smiled at you. Maybe it was just your imagination, but you felt his voice had softened: "Y/N, no need to be so formal, just say [my name]. We're [friend added]." ”
You nodded half-understandingly, but carefully tugged at his clothes: "Okay...... Spamton, could you help me tidy up my house a bit? I don't have the energy to finish tidying up those rooms...... "Actually, yesterday you only made sure your house was roughly visible, so you got some sleep."
Spamton nodded, "Of course, [I'm glad to be able to serve you.] ”
He thought, now he could walk into your room openly—he could install pinhole cameras openly in your room. Just thinking about this made him extremely excited, eager to get inside your house as soon as possible. So he opened the door and put the things he had bought inside, then picked up yours and smiled, "Alright, let me [help] then." ”
TBC.

title: vagrant4 (dnsx you)
content:
You nodded and let Spamton walk into your house carrying the things, while you just sat on the sofa watching him busy everywhere. Honestly, you couldn't really help much—you just felt a bit embarrassed and a bit guilty. Looking at Spamton busy in your living room, you softly said, "Mm...... Thank you for your help. I plan to treat you to a meal after you're done. What do you think?" ”
Spamton looked at you and just smiled, "No need, it's not necessary. It's my honor to help you." As he spoke, he picked up a wall painting and helped you hang it on the wall. He said he wanted to help you clean up the house while you were at it, so he was still helping you wipe the wall. You fiddled with your fingers and looked at him, feeling a bit embarrassed. You don't like owing others favors. Although you're not good at socializing, after hesitating for a moment, you mustered the courage to speak again.
"But I'm just asking you to help...... If I do nothing, I'll feel really embarrassed......" You whisper, looking up at Spamton, who was still focused on cleaning your walls. Of course, you wouldn't know he had taken the opportunity to place a pinhole camera in your corner.
"It's okay...... Maybe, as long as you're willing to accept my [romantic invitation]. None of it matters. "He said with a smile, his voice tinged with amusement. It took you a moment to react and realize he probably wanted to invite you on a date...... In other words, he was just helping a girl he liked a little. For some reason, thinking about this made you feel a bit relieved, so after hesitating for a moment, you agreed to it.
"How about this...... Are you asking me to go on a date with you? I think...... Yes, I can accept your invitation. "As soon as you finished speaking, you suddenly felt a spasm or spasm all over your body. That sensation made you lose consciousness for a moment. Fortunately, you were sitting on the sofa, so this episode didn't affect you much. Spamton probably didn't notice either. You glanced up quietly and saw he was indeed busy and serious. So you let out a small breath to relax a bit, secretly took out a bottle of painkillers, poured one pill, and popped it into your mouth, then took a sip of water.
"Oh—then I'll notify you of the exact time and place via my phone. I hope you'll have the honor." He has his back to you. You can't see his expression, only a hint of teasing in his voice. You don't know if it's just your imagination, but you just repeated it once more.
"Yeah, it's okay, I will definitely go...... I'm very grateful to you, so I will definitely go. "You say that." Hearing your words, Spamton suddenly felt an impulse. He suddenly wanted to ask you: Did you agree to the date because you were grateful, because you owe him a favor, or because you agreed to accompany him on the date? He wanted to ask you, but was afraid the answer he got wouldn't be satisfactory...... He didn't know if you really liked him a little, and genuinely wanted to go on a date. But Spamton knew very well that if he didn't ask, he might have to hold that question for the rest of his life.
He comes down from your ladder, planning to continue the bedroom renovation, while casually asking, "So...... Are you genuinely willing to accompany me on a [romantic invitation]? His words are casual as if it were just a casual question. But you are stunned by his question, reacting for a moment. To be honest, you haven't really thought about what you really think.
—Maybe it's just that it doesn't matter. You don't know what liking is, you don't know what love is, and of course, you don't know what the real purpose of dating is. You don't care about any of that. If it weren't for physical reasons, you would have really agreed to Spamton's invitation yesterday, drank with him, and then slept together.
…… So agreeing to a date isn't much to you, so you just reply with a bit of confusion: "Probably?" I don't know...... I don't know what the point of a date really is. "You do know what a date is for—it's basically two people meeting up together to build feelings. But you feel none of that has anything to do with you."
You hear Spamton's voice turn a bit disappointed: "Ah...... I thought the [Honorable Miss] must have [voluntarily going]. ”
"But is it voluntary...... It doesn't have much impact, right? I'm willing to go on a date with you, so that should be enough, right? "You tilted your head in confusion, only to see Spamton turn around and wave gently at you.
"Not so easily...... At the very least, I hope you have a bit of affection for me. A romantic invitation requires both sides to feel the romance." As he spoke, he quietly installed another pinhole camera on the wall of your bedroom. Of course, he would avoid those awkward moments—but aside from that, he'd keep an eye on you.
You were silent for a while, thought carefully in your mind for a while, and finally said, "But I'm sure I am...... voluntarily." You said this with certainty, absolute certainty, knowing what you were thinking...... Although you don't know exactly what this feeling is, or why you relax a little with spamton, you are certain that it was absolutely voluntary.
But Spamton just went down the ladder, helped you make the bed, and softly said to you, "But...... I think you need to know that the premise of this "romantic invitation" is "I like you." I hope you agree to go to the "romantic invitation" because you share my feelings." "He didn't look at you. In fact, Spamton was a bit timid. He didn't dare look at your face or your expression; he wasn't ready to accept all of this outcome yet."
You paused for a moment, but in fact, you did think about it a little...... For you, can you accept this affection? Can you reciprocate Spamton with the same feelings? For some reason, you think of an anonymous little pervert on your phone, saying he really likes you, so he keeps chasing after you. You can't help but look at Spamton, saying that the only one who likes you right now is the little pervert on your phone and Spamton—could it actually be the same person? Then you find yourself too funny, just shake your head, thinking, how is this possible? How could such a gentle and elegant person and the guy constantly going crazy on your phone chat interface be the same person?
Thinking this, you finally shake your head and softly reply to spamton: "...... I'm sorry." "I'm sorry you can't fully understand what he really means by 'liking' in his words. I'm sorry you can't reciprocate him with equal emotion. I'm sorry if that's the case...... You can't agree to his date, can't go with him.
Spamton just lifts his head and smiles at you. For some reason, you feel it's a smile even uglier than crying, but his voice still carries a smile, making it hard to tell apart: "Ah...... Then I hope you'll wait until you have the same feelings for me before agreeing to my romantic invitation. I just hope you can feel the same kind of love...... At the very least, only agree to him when you've experienced it. Spamton knew that words like this were probably a bit of moral coercion, and he was also well aware that you clearly didn't need to share the same feelings as him...... He knew very well that even if he was hysterically and resolutely loving you, if you didn't care, it wouldn't matter at all.
You thought for a moment, then spoke with uncertainty and hesitation: "Mm...... I can't be sure I'll like you to the same degree, nor what I'll be like next, so...... Only after I understand your feelings will I agree to go on a date, is that okay? "Honestly, you don't even know how to accept someone's love...... There is a moment when you feel nervous, wondering if you're overthinking it.
Spamton looked up at you, nodding in surprise: "Of course you can! This is my honor." "As he spoke, he bowed to you in a proper way. You couldn't help but burst out laughing, his eyes curved into a smile.
"Then it's settled. If that day ever comes...... I'll tell you. "You said to him solemnly.
Spamton nodded, and finally he started tidying up the bathroom. You followed and arranged everything one by one—a cute little rabbit tooth cup and a toothbrush rack shaped like a little rabbit hanging for the brush. Spamton also helped you clean the bathroom—well, he didn't install cameras in the bathroom, so he had some conscience. And you felt a bit embarrassed...... You originally thought cleaning the bathroom yourself would be enough, but Spamton just pushed you onto the living room sofa and sat down. When he wiped the sweat from his forehead and came out, Spamton told you everything was tidied up.
You hurriedly got up and opened the door for him. Although he lived next door to you, you felt some manners were still necessary. You smiled and said goodbye to Spamton, then watched him open the door and walk inside before closing your own door. Looking at the tidy and tidy home, you smiled, thinking you'd have to come by and bring something to your neighbor—he couldn't help for nothing.
Meanwhile, after Spamton closed the door, he excitedly took out items that matched or matched yours and placed them on the shelf. He fantasized about being a couple with you and couldn't wait to turn on the camera to check—but no rush. If you found out he was the same person who sent the anonymous message, maybe everything would be ruined. Although he was impatient, he was still somewhat patient.
TBC.

title: vagrant5 (dnsx you)
content:
You were sitting on your own sofa, and before long you heard your phone vibrating. You helplessly picked up your phone and glanced at it, thinking to yourself that it was probably that little pervert sending you a new message again.
[Baby, you actually let another man into your home... TAT Other men can be very dangerous! Unlike me, who only cares for my dear ///^^///]
Spamton is very aware... it's all just the same person, but that doesn't stop him from putting himself down a bit while messaging you. After all, he doesn't want to see you smile at anyone other than him, because that would make him insanely jealous; he would want to gouge out the other person's eyes... Your smile should belong only to him. Yet despite such crazy thoughts, he doesn't act on them; he just pitifully taps out another message and sends it again.
[He can even go shopping with his beloved... I wish I were standing next to my beloved, I would definitely make my beloved happier than he is now awa]
[But I saw what my dear chose, hehe… Baby and I are using the couple version, I specially picked it //^^//]
After sending the message, Spamton looked at the couple's cup on the table and held it up to drink a sip of water with great care—ah, if he could use the same cup as yours, then he could drink the water you left behind, and in that way, he could taste your saliva, which rounded up, would be like kissing—but for now, just having the couple's cup is also good, and that doesn't stop him from fantasizing, imagining what it would be like if you were sitting right next to him, smiling at him.
So he couldn't help sending you another message: [awa, the water the baby drank must be very sweet... Unfortunately, I can only use the couple's cups, imagining my dear right next to me OTTO]
You watched these messages, your mouth twitching slightly a few times, not knowing how this little pervert could so tirelessly keep sending you messages. In the end, you still moved your finger and tapped the screen: [Aren't you... tired?]
The other person also replied to your message instantly. Spamton restlessly twisted his hands and kept tapping his feet. He was waiting for you to reply with a new message: [awa dear, you replied to me~ Of course I'm not tired, even if I have to chat with my dear all day long, I would never feel tired! After all, I love my dear the mostest! \><//]
You let out a snicker, unable to resist, and teased him again with a sentence: [Alright then, just tell me, how much do you really like me?]
[Hmm... it's like chocolate must be made from cocoa beans, coffee certainly contains coffee beans, and without you, my dear, I wouldn't be myself. It's your existence that makes me who I am. That's probably the level of affection we're talking about~\><//]
You looked at this sentence in silence. Suddenly, you wondered if the 'like' that Spamton mentioned could also be of this degree. You weren't sure, but regarding what you tracked today... you did want to ask Spamton about it.
So you exited this chat box, opened Spamton's chat box, and asked: [Mr. Spamton... today, when we were shopping at the mall, did you notice anyone following us?]
Spamton's other phone rang, and seeing that it was a message from you, he quickly sat up straight and replied seriously: ['Unknown', 'As far as I know'] I haven't felt anyone else's gaze. But in fact, besides him, no one else was staring at you, and besides him, no one else could openly be by your side, so naturally, he was very proud.
You were silent for a moment, looking at the message from Spamton, once again shattering your doubts. The habit of sending messages is completely different—how could it be the same person? You must have been overthinking it, and if it really were him, who would get jealous of themselves?
So in the end, you still typed two words and sent them to him: [Got it, thank you. Mr. Spamton.]
Then you switched back to that chat box, your vocabulary for cursing is very limited, but you still couldn't help wanting to scold him: [Are you crazy? You keep bothering me, want to control who I date, and still want to use couple items with me??]
[QAQ Because this way I can be a little closer to my dear...] Spamton picked up another phone and replied to you in a sticky, gooey tone with practiced ease. He stared at the messages on the screen, and when he saw you calling him crazy, his mouth actually curled up into a smile, very delighted. Does this prove—at least a little—that you care about him? At the very least, you would feel anger about it. He craves all of your emotions, whether happy or sad, joyful or angry. As long as your gaze is cast upon him, as long as your emotions arise because of him—he is satisfied with it all. He desires you so much that he even wants to devour your anger entirely.
Spamton swallowed a mouthful of saliva, knowing that his lower body had become somewhat swollen and hot again, and he couldn't help but send you another message, while also reaching down to start fondling that area: [Darling, even your insults sound so nice~~^^~~ Scold me a bit more, hehe~~] His expression became a little flushed, and of course, his tone also became somewhat flushed.
You looked at the message displayed on your phone screen and couldn't help but frown and gag a few times. To be honest, you never expected him to react like this... It was really a miscalculation!!
You frowned as you furiously tapped on the screen: [Pervert, lunatic, a criminal! I hate you so much… I’m going to replace all my cups and stuff, there’s no way you and I can use matching couple things!] You angrily tapped on the screen, only realizing after finishing that why would you even tell him about this… You could have just secretly replaced them yourself, anyway, he probably wouldn’t have known.
But it was too late for you to retract the message, because he saw it. Spamton's mood sank; he was a bit hurt, just gloomily tapping on the screen: [Don't... TT, my dear, don't hate me... I know I'm perverted, but I'm a pervert belonging only to you, baby. I'm sick, suffering from an illness called 'you'... In short, my dear, please don't hate me TTTTTT]
[Darling, don't change the cup or anything... TTTT, anyway, the baby won't see mine. It's no big deal for the baby and me to use couple items. Anyway, I really like it. It's as if darling is right here beside me~~><~~]
You furrowed your brows, not knowing what to reply at the moment. In fact, it doesn't matter whether you change or not. If you do change, you'll have to worry about spending an extra amount of money... Although you originally planned to just find some casual work here in the Dark World.
But when you see him using a couple's cup like yours and saying things so casually, it always feels a bit awkward, so you quickly type out a string of characters: [Oh, didn't you say you liked me? Then why don't you comfort me... maybe I'll let you keep using it.] You consider this giving both him and yourself a way out. After typing this string, you feel your face seems to be slightly flushed. You can't help but touch your own cheek, not knowing why your heart seems to be beating a little faster... Maybe it's just your imagination, you think, after all, your heart isn't in the best condition, so occasional spikes in heart rate are understandable.
Spamton sat in the house next to yours and thought for a moment—hmm, this was his first time doing something like this, and he wasn't very good at it, but no matter what, he wanted to keep the right to use couple mugs with you. So he started typing again rapidly: [awa, darling, you're so cute... The mug you chose and everything else is so cute, I really like it, and I really like you too... I wish everything darling belonged to me, but sorry darling, I shouldn't have said using couple mugs with you might startle you~ There's a very famous bubble tea shop here in the Dark World, and I ordered a cold drink to be delivered to your door, so please don't be mad, darling~~^^~~ Although you're cute even when you're mad, next time if you do get mad, you have to tell me~~ I will properly apologize to you! Sorry, baby... I also shouldn't have called your angry look cute, but I just like you too much \><//]
You looked at this little essay, full of mixed emoticons and messy symbols, and sighed. To be honest, you weren’t really that angry… rather, the fact that there is someone who genuinely cares about you, truly cares about everything concerning you, actually makes you feel a little… somewhat happy. This is the first time you’ve felt this way—someone saying they like you, saying they love you, caring about you wholeheartedly. You don’t know if this is right; perhaps it isn’t… but what does that matter to you? Anyway… it won’t last long, and you don’t know how long this affection will continue—maybe until your death. If that’s the case, it would be good; that way… you, like the vast majority of the people of light, would go to your death wrapped in love.
Thinking like this, you cleared your throat twice and pretended to be very angry as you sent a message: [Alright! I know, I will accept the sincerity of your apology, I won’t change the cup, it’s enough that you know you were wrong]
After you sent this message, a while later, the door was knocked. You walked over and opened the door, and saw a cup of milk tea properly packaged on the floor, with a small note attached that read QAQ. You smiled, took out the milk tea inside, and began to drink it. Hmm, the taste was not bad, just a little sweet. Then you opened your phone and saw a message he had sent.
[Awa, the milk tea has arrived, right! QAQ I truly feel sorry for my dear... I hope my dear can accept my gift \><//]
You took another sip of the milk tea, let out a light laugh, and also sent a message: [Hmm, very tasty, thank you, little pervert, but this cup of milk tea is a bit sweet, I like it with 30% sugar or no sugar.]
[Got it!~~\^^//~~] You received his reply very quickly.
TBC.

title: vagrant6 (dnsx you)
content:
He looks like he is happy... You slowly sip this cup of milk tea, switch pages on your phone, and feel a bit worried about what you should do next. Although the illness has been confirmed... you can still handle some small daily tasks, and you are thinking about whether you should go out to work.
But just as you listened, the phone vibrated again, and that little pervert's message popped up.
[Dear, do you want to go to work? >X<, I think dear doesn't need to go to the office awa, I can support the baby! Believe me! WWW] You don't really know how he came to this conclusion, but based on your recent activities, it's indeed possible to infer this news.
But you still sent him a message asking back: [How did you know I was looking for a job?] You didn't tell anyone about this, and you don't know where he got the information from.
On the other end of the phone, Spamton, who received the message, had just switched back to the monitoring interface. He watched you frown slightly as you began examining your phone. He couldn't help but cup his face in both hands, muttering to himself, 'Ah... my dear, you look so good even with a frown... I wish I could lean in and give you a kiss...' Knowing that you frowned because of the text he sent, he couldn't help feeling even happier. He liked seeing your emotions change because of his words.
Spamton laughed hee-hee, without revealing anything about the surveillance, otherwise it would be easy to associate it with him. He just expertly typed a line of text for you: [awwww because I pay close attention to everything my dear! I noticed this morning when baby was paying at the mall, baby was a bit reluctant to spend money... is it because savings aren't enough awa, if baby needs it, just say the word and I will send the dark coins my dear needs right to your door T^T]
You looked a bit silent at this message, and I have to say, his observation is remarkable—well, you did hesitate for a moment when you were paying, because buying this house had already spent most of your savings. The remainder is enough to support you comfortably for the next few years, as long as you don't overspend. But you want the remaining time to be a bit happier.
But you were still a bit curious, so you sent him another message: [Hmm, your observation skills are quite good. Then why don’t you tell me, what was my expression like back then?] You thought maybe you should just tease him a bit, after all, you have nothing to do while sitting here now.
[//^^// Baby praised me awa! I'm so happy——but dear, weren't you also giving me a cold look at that time? If I were standing next to you, I definitely wouldn't let you keep that expression! OO(>x<)oo]
You stared at this message in silence for a while. Indeed, your expression really wasn't very good when watching the cashier check the prices... Where exactly was he looking at you from? Or did he just hack into the supermarket's surveillance system? Otherwise, how could he see it so clearly?
You felt that you couldn't come up with an answer to this question for the time being, so you simply opened the door and walked out. You planned to casually look for a job, after all, it was only the afternoon, so there was still a bit of time — as for lunch, you just ate some bread casually to get by.
You had no idea that, not long after you walked out, Spamton quietly opened the door to take a look at your back, and then used a spare key to open your room door, closing it tightly behind him. He eagerly lay down on the sofa, rolled around, closed his eyes, as if this could allow him to enjoy your scent, as if your scent could completely envelop him—of course, he also had some selfishness; he hoped that the lingering scent that belonged to him could also completely envelop you.
Then he finally got up from the sofa, picked up the milk tea bottle you haven’t thrown away yet, and then absently licked the straw, with a lingering sweet taste, as if he was savoring the sweet flavor in your mouth, as if... he were kissing you.
Spamton took a deep breath and reluctantly put down the cup. He glanced at the cleaning tools left in your house, and although it wasn't necessary, he still helped tidy up a bit. He also took a look at your fridge, and then stuffed into it what he thought should be in it. He checked the time, took out some ingredients, and helped prepare dinner for you. After everything was cleaned up, he placed the dinner on the dining table and even put on a food cover. Then, Spamton quietly left your house and returned to his own. He opened his phone and, trying to contain his excitement, started messaging you again.
[Dear, why don't you ever clean up the trash T^T, it's so messy... I helped the baby clean up and throw away the trash, praise me quickly~~(-V-)~~]
[The milk tea the baby drank is also so sweet~~ I nibbled on the straw my dear used, it's sweet, I really like it, this is the baby's flavor~~(-V-)~~]
By the way, dear, have you gone out… I prepared dinner for you, so you don't have to tire yourself out awa. I hope you like the taste of the dinner!
Spamton was still excited to send you something else, but a phone call came through on his mobile. Although he maintained a smiling expression, the aura around him cooled down. He certainly didn't want the call to disturb his sweet time with you—of course, this was only his one-sided sweetness.
Spamton picked up the phone, and it seemed that the person on the other end said something, while the smile on Spamton's face widened: 'Of course, let's complete this 【deal】! 【Fair for all】, you 【deserve it】!' This was an item that had been on display for a long time without selling, and now it finally had an audience—well, and you could get a lot of Dark Coins. If you agree, he would give you all the Dark Coins.
It seemed that the other side said something again, and Spamton just chuckled lightly: 'Well then, [Deal's a go].'
The call was disconnected, and he stared blankly at the dark screen, thinking about his current situation and then recalling the past.
At that time, he was just an ordinary Addison staying on the commercial street—a white one, looking thinner and weaker than the other Addisons, and unable to complete any deal. He originally thought that everything would just continue like this, but he could not bear the bullying from the other Addisons, could not endure their insults... until that moment, you appeared in front of him.
You are a being of light, and at that moment, Spamton admitted that he, too, seemed to have captured the only light from this dim and lifeless existence. You simply stood in front of him, frowning as you scolded the other Addisons, and then awkwardly bought goods from his stall with the currency of the world of light. That was the first item sold at his stall—and it was precisely because of your visit as a being of light that other beings of darkness also flocked to his stall, until he received that phone call—until he completely fell under the queen's authority. When moving into her villa, Spamton also knew that he was getting closer and closer to you.
He once did not dare to hope that you could stay by his side... but now he can finally watch you day and night, every moment, he can finally... finally let you see him again.
Of course, you also noticed those few text messages and couldn't help frowning. You didn't expect that he would actually take the opportunity to sneak into your home when you weren't there. But after thinking about it, there really isn't much in the house anyway, so if he wants to go, let him go.
And it just happened that you didn't have the energy to tidy up, he was willing to help you clean the room and even made dinner for you... you were quite surprised.
So you casually sent him messages: [Ah, thank you, I'll try the taste of the dinner you made]
After sending this message, you originally intended to put your phone away, but then the phone vibrated several more times, and you saw several more messages flash on the screen.
[If the baby likes it, I will make dinner for the baby every day awa]
[By the way, dear, you won't be mad at me for sneaking into your room, right… I just missed you so much, so I lay on your bed for a while \>X<//]
[If my dear doesn't like it, I'll try not to do it next time awa... Don't worry, my dear, your bed is absolutely clean! All the dust has already been swept away by me~~-V-~~]
You watched these few messages and the corner of your mouth twitched, then you couldn't help but laugh a little, and typed a reply to him quickly: [You are really a pervert, a lunatic, wicked to death, sneaking into my room and even sucking my straw, sleeping in my bed, and yet you are so self-righteous?]
[awa Baby scold me a few more times~~] As a result, the person on the other side replied instantly, but it just looked like they sent you this message in a very playful way. The corner of your mouth twitched, and you decided to ignore them for the time being. You happened to walk into a flower shop; the dark world doesn't have many types of flowers that bloom—but the owner of this shop, upon hearing that you are a being of light, welcomed you warmly and also said that most of the time you wouldn't need to work, as long as you sat here and attracted customers. It seems that the business of this flower shop isn't very good either.
But you happened to be studying design — you casually picked a few flowers and performed a bit of the art of flower arranging for the shop owner, which happened to match your field of expertise. The shop owner nearly begged you on your knees to stay. Your mouth twitched; anyway, you were planning to stay at this shop. After all… the work was easy, and although the salary wasn’t much, it was enough for you to do things at your leisure.
On the other side, after receiving the text you sent him insulting him, Spamton simply held his face with both hands, his expression swirling, and his cheeks were a bit red. He held his phone, waiting for your reply, but... it was as if you didn't see the message; the message still showed as unread. So his originally turbulent emotions came to a stop. He turned on your home camera to check and confirmed that you hadn't come home yet—he was anxiously waiting.
