title: vagrant7 (dnsx you)
content:
You have no idea what Spamton is really thinking; you just looked at the flowers in the shop and discussed with the owner. You wanted to take a bouquet back to give to your neighbor, and of course the owner waved his hand and agreed.
You made some selections and used white lilies, some red carnations, and black roses to create a simple bouquet. You wrapped it with wrapping paper, planning to give it to your neighbor when you get back. Although he said it wasn’t necessary, you still felt you should give a gift to your neighbor.
So on the way back, you bought two small cakes according to your own taste — tiramisu and matcha mille-feuille. You didn't know if the neighbor would like them, but you liked them yourself. If he didn't eat them, you would eat them yourself. That's how you planned it.
When you slowly wandered back and hesitated for a moment before knocking on the neighbor's door, Spamton practically jumped up from the sofa in a flash to open the door for you. He opened the door with a beaming smile, and the first thing that hit your nose was a faint floral fragrance. Then... he saw you, he saw you looking a bit nervous, holding this bouquet of flowers and carrying two small cakes.
Spamton was almost clutching his chest and about to faint—he felt light-headed, and he hadn't expected you to give him a gift or anything, so now he's just looking at you with a slightly surprised expression on his face.
You cleared your throat twice, feeling a bit embarrassed under his gaze, and your voice became much softer: 'Um... I hope Mr. Spamton can accept the gift. I can't agree to your request for a date for the time being, but I really want to thank you for the help you provided this morning, so I hope you can accept these.' Saying that, you lowered your head and handed the items forward.
Spamton accepted the bouquet of flowers, and to be honest, he was indeed very excited. He looked at you with a smile and said, 'Ah... this is [my honor], I really don't need [excessive thanks], after all, the [people of darkness] are very happy to [provide help] to the [people of light]. I think you should [taste] those two cakes, I prefer ones [full of sweetness].'
You hesitated for a moment, then just said thank you again and closed his room door. Since he doesn’t like to eat it, these two cakes will be your dessert after the meal! You opened the door, changed into slippers, and indeed, you immediately saw the thermal cover on the dining table... Inside, it was quite simple: steak and a fried egg, along with some spaghetti sprinkled with ketchup. Besides that, there was also a small bowl of vegetables, which seemed to be some broccoli.
You sprinkled black pepper sauce on it, tasting a piece of steak along with the fried egg beside it, squinting your eyes slightly. Although it had cooled a bit... the taste was still very good. You finished the broccoli and finally started on the pasta. You picked up your phone and realized he still had a message you hadn't seen. Although the corner of your mouth twitched and you weren't really inclined to deal with this weirdo, you still replied to him.
[Thank you, although it's a bit cold, the steak tastes very good, and I also like the soft-boiled egg.] After sending this message, you also finished the last bite of pasta and opened the small cake you bought to start eating.
Spamton originally put the flowers you sent into a vase and was holding his face, admiring them. He knew what black roses represented—perhaps you weren't very familiar with the language of flowers and just thought they looked nice together, but he knew that black roses meant you were saying he was a demon belonging only to you—well, he liked this idea. After all, in his eyes, you were an angel; in his eyes, you were his salvation—so nothing could be more fitting than this.
At the same time, his phone vibrated. He unlocked it and glanced at it, discovering that it was a message sent by you, and his smile grew even brighter.
His fingers twitched as he replied to your message: [awa dear, as long as you like it! I've remembered baby's taste—next time I'll do the same, hope dear will still like it! //^^//]
[Oh right, dear, you can put the used bowls and chopsticks there... I'll help you clean up, dear! \>X<//]
[In short, dear, don't overwork yourself, just rest well~~ I like you the most~~ V+~~]
You looked at the message and sighed. He said that, and you couldn't just ignore all this anyway. In any case, you still tidied up these things, briefly soaked them in water, and put them in the sink.
[My dear actually took the initiative to do something——I already told you, my dear, you don't need to wear yourself out! But I like you like this, my dear, it's precisely because of this that I like you even more~~OO>X<OO~~]
You stared at the text message and blinked, instinctively switching to the phone camera to take a look. You began to check the room's layout—sure enough, you found a small red dot in the corner of the wall. It was a pinhole camera. This pervert could sneak into your home quietly, and of course, could also secretly set up a camera.
You couldn't help but curse again: [You pervert, did you secretly install a camera for me?] But that being said... could it be possible that Spamton, who came to your house in the morning to help you tidy up, also installed a camera? Could these two guys be the same person? You can't be sure, or rather, you also find this suspicion somewhat ridiculous, after all, these two guys are completely different in their behavior.
But you really don't have much in the way of insulting words; over and over, it's just these phrases you can repeat, and the pervert on the other side has probably already gotten used to it.
[~~^_^~~ Baby, scold me a little more... just this level isn't enough~~] Spamton licked the corners of his lips, crossing his legs to hide the heat of his lower body. His gaze was unpredictable. To be honest... he really wanted to get closer to you, even closer. No matter what kind of emotion it was, he would accept it all.
You took a deep breath, feeling like you couldn't even scold this pervert. Your face turned red, you were a bit angry, probably out of shame and rage, and you simply decided to add this number to the blacklist as well.
Spamton still wanted to send you some information, but when he saw that what he sent was a big exclamation mark, he had no choice but to create a new phone number to continue harassing you.
[TTTTT baby, why did you block me again! Fortunately, I still have a new phone number, so I can see my dear every day. I am simply so happy~]
[Baby, are you angry? If it's because of me, then vent all your anger on me! I can handle it! I hope baby can look at me a few more times awa]
[Dear, even if you block me, it’s useless. I will keep bothering you, forever~~^^~~]
You looked at the message he sent, feeling a bit helpless, and also an unexplained anger you didn't know how to vent, so you could only take a fierce bite of the matcha cake: [You also know that I really can't do anything to you!!]
[I am very angry, I don't want anyone to pry into my privacy! I don't want a pervert to keep bothering me! I hate you, I hate you, I hate you! You are so annoying, do you know that? I really don't want to deal with you!!]
[I really hate you...] You typed these words, slumping on the sofa, and tears flowed uncontrollably. You awkwardly reached out to wipe your tears, sobbing. To be honest... you really didn’t care, but this pervert wanted to pry more and more... The emotions piled up in your heart also needed an outlet. Was it panic? Was it fear? You didn’t know... However, maybe there was some, after all... After all, you were just a girl who had just graduated from college, and after learning about your illness, you had already been living in despair and fear, not to mention there was a pervert constantly following you.
You threw your phone onto the sofa, wiped your eyes by yourself, sobbing, and Spamton, looking at the camera, also became a bit flustered — he didn't expect you to react this way. He did want you to vent your anger at him, but he didn't know that you would actually start crying as you spoke.
He hurriedly took the phone and started sending you messages: [TAT baby I... I didn't mean to, I just like you too much... I don't want to lose you, that's why I did this, after all, only this way can baby see me T^T.] He doesn't want to lose your sight, doesn't want to lose your attention... he wants your gaze to always stay on him.
[If TAT is sad, then scold me, don't ignore me... pay attention to me, pay attention to me, pay attention to me...]
[It's okay if you dislike me, baby can do whatever you like, just don't ignore me… T_T]
[Pay attention to me, pay attention to me… Does baby like eating small cakes? Should I buy some small cakes for baby? TTT]
[Dear, I'm sorry... I'm sorry, I'm sorry... It's okay if you don't forgive me, I know someone like me might be scary to you... OTTO, but this is the only way I can get close to you... Whatever you like, I'll buy it for you, please pay attention to me QAQ]
Spamton instinctively bit his fingernails; he felt flustered and didn't know what else to say to you, but at this moment, he saw your message again.
You sniffed, finally willing to unlock your phone. To be honest... although you feel a bit wronged and a bit scared, you don't really dislike this person. It's probably just a little awkward. You... you don't know, you think being watched isn't necessarily bad, but you don't want to be watched all the time... after all, you still belong to yourself.
You thought for a moment, recognized your own feelings, and confirmed again that you didn't really dislike this guy. You looked at the message on your phone, pouted slightly, feeling a bit wronged but also a little like you were acting coy, and quickly typed out a line to him: [Pervert, big bad guy!! Then I want to eat red velvet cake]
You sniffed, curled up, and hugged your knees tightly. You realized... to some extent, you even seemed to be a little dependent on this unknown pervert.

title: vagrant8 (dnsx you)
content:

He lowered his head to look at his phone, seeing the message showed read, anxiously waiting for your message. Then it showed the other party was typing. He held his finger, anxiously watching, and then saw the message from you.
You sniffled and sat on the sofa, thinking maybe you were a bit desperate...... Or perhaps, you just had a slight tendency toward self-torture and recalled your condition. This was why you didn't care about the anonymous pervert's message at first—after all, you didn't care. But now, you seemed indifferent to those surveillance cameras. You just felt it didn't matter anymore, but no matter what, you felt you were just telling the truth.
[Whatever! The surveillance doesn't matter...... Anyway, if you really see me dead on the surveillance, you can call someone to collect my body. ] You typed this angrily, and just then, your door rang. You walked over and opened it, only to find a red velvet cake on the floor. You carried the cake back to the coffee table, ignoring the vibration of your phone, and just leisurely ate the cake.
Meanwhile, Spamton on the other end gets anxious when he sees your message—he doesn't know why you're saying that, even though everything seems fine, everything seems to be going smoothly. He can't help but message you: [Darling, why say that? OTTO, darling, how could you die? Dear, you should die with me TTTT]
[Dear, pay attention to me, why do you say these things, did I break the baby’s heart T^T I apologize to the baby, don’t say such things that make one want to die TTT]

[I just look at my dear one eating a small cake without looking at my phone...... TT If my darling feels hurt, scold me, whatever it is, just don't ignore me OTTO]
[Dear, do you like red velvet cake? If you like the flavor, I’ll buy some for you next time OVO]
[Dear, pay attention to me, pay attention to me......]
Spamton anxiously kept sending you messages, occasionally switching back to the surveillance screen to check your state. Seeing you still sitting on the sofa happily eating a red velvet cake, he couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief, but you still hadn't replied to anyone's messages...... But he started to feel a bit anxious again. Countless terrifying thoughts swirled in his mind, but he was doing his best to tell himself not to think any further. He stared at the screen, stared at you, stopped texting, just waiting for the moment you replied.
And you finally finished eating the red velvet cake, your mood calmed down a lot. At least your tears stopped flowing, and you finally opened your phone to check the messages he left behind. Hmm...... Ah, are you saying you won't die? But telling you you to die was the doctor's judgment, not his responsibility.
You lowered your eyes, staring blankly at the message, then took out a paper report from the small bundle you had brought from the Light World. It was the original impact report. You held the report up to the surveillance camera, letting him see it clearly. Choking up, you said—you know the other end of the surveillance probably heard it too: "Did you see it clearly?" This is a proper report. I only have about five years left to live. If you find it boring, just find someone else to bother with and stop bothering me. ”
After saying that, you sat back down on the sofa, ignoring the vibrating phone and ignoring his answer. You just curled up, hugged your legs tightly, and closed your eyes. You had no idea why you were so unlucky—diagnosed with an illness, only to be haunted by a stalker......
You hugged yourself, curled up restlessly on the sofa and fell asleep, and of course Spamton saw your report and heard your slightly choked voice. His hand trembled, and to be honest—he was indeed a bit angry, because he had only just learned about it. But did he want him to give up on you? That was absolutely impossible, whether it was life or death...... He would always haunt you. Spamton stared intently at the surveillance footage, looking at you, and began to worry—if you couldn't even survive five years, what if you couldn't wake up at all? He didn't know what to do either; he just stared at the screen in confusion.
Spamton was thinking, maybe he should have known earlier, like this...... At least he could help control your condition. He just checked, and your report shows stage III. It seems it doesn't matter whether you treat it or not, just to ease the pain a little.
His heart seemed heavy too...... Even though he didn't know if he truly had feelings, he simply opened his phone and typed in messages for you again.
[Darling, you won't die so easily...... There are medications to suppress the disease, right? As long as you take your medicine, you'll be fine...... At worst, I'll die with you^^, because if you don't exist, then living in this world has no meaning. ] Part of it is probably to stand out, to look down on those who bullied me before, but...... But more importantly, he just thinks maybe standing high up will be able to see you. He did it, he saw you, he truly saw you—but Spamton doesn't know why he is still so sad. Why does he still feel so lonely? Just like always...... He is just a wanderer filled with loneliness.
After sending this message, he put down the phone and instead sent you a message from another phone—the Spamton account.
[Do you have any free time tomorrow? I hope to invite you to go out together.] He thought, if he could keep an eye on you all the time...... Then there would be no problem.
You had no idea Spamton had been watching surveillance surveillance all night, living in fear all night. You just opened your eyes and instinctively opened the door. It was a breakfast pretty much the same as yesterday, except today the bread was replaced with a sandwich. You started eating while opening your phone to check messages. You stared at the anonymous pervert's message and was silent for a while, not answering him, only pulling out two or three bottles of medicine. You hadn't planned to take the medicine before...... After all, the death date was set, but you knew if you didn't take it, he'd bombard you, so in the end, you obediently poured out the pills one by one, mixing them with water and swallowing them.
Then you exit the chat box and see Spamton's message. You hesitate for a moment, then realize today is Sunday and you really don't have much else to do...... Agreeing to go out for a while probably isn't a big deal, but you know your body is well aware of your condition, because your condition is always a bit unsteady and your balance isn't great. Hopefully, nothing will go wrong when the time comes.
So you quickly typed back to Spamton.
[Hmm...... There's nothing else to do today, I'm quite free. Mr. Spamton, where do you want to take me? ]
Spamton stared at the screen, watching you check the message, swallowed the pill, and only then did he breathe a slight sigh of relief. Immediately after, he received your message. Spamton hesitated for a moment, but still typed for you.
[I hope you [invite] Miss to purchase [the corresponding clothes]...... After all, your clothes don't look like they match the [Dark World]. ] He said cautiously, nervously waiting for your reply to his message.
You pause for a moment when you look at this message, then think about your wardrobe...... Well, you're not someone who really likes buying clothes, so all you brought from the world of light were just a few pieces. They're enough for everyday wear, but probably not for going out, especially since you've found a job...... You probably need to dress up a bit better.
So after hesitating for a moment, you agreed to spamton: [Alright, then Mr. Spamton...... Yes, I agree. I'll let you know before I leave later. Thank you, Mr. Spamton, and I hope you can give me some advice. ]
The other side replied very quickly. If your neighbor weren't so polite, you'd probably start doubting that little pervert just because of that speed.
[Of course, no problem, this is my honor.] After seeing this message, you turned off your phone and continued eating breakfast, then threw away the disposable utensils. You carefully walked into your bedroom to think about what to wear before going out, and finally changed into a pair you thought was acceptable—a plain blue shirt on top and white jeans on the bottom. Only then did you get ready to go out.
Spamton, while watching you change clothes on the surveillance screen, swallowed a few times—you didn't take it all off, but seeing your fair skin, he couldn't help but close his eyes and cover his burning cheeks. Only when he heard the door open next door did he hurriedly open the door and smile at you.

How he wanted to bite directly, how much he wanted to leave a mark on your body—but Spamton also knew it wasn't the right time, so he simply reached out, carefully avoiding your skin, pulling the zipper of your skirt, then softly said, "[Perfectly Complete]." ”
You touch your back—you're sure you're dressed. Then you turn around and smile sincerely at Spamton: "Ah, thank you, Spamton. If it were just me, I really wouldn't know what to do." ”
After saying that, you spun your skirt around and sized yourself up, then looked at yourself in the mirror in the dressing room. You noticed Spamton standing behind you, smiling at you. He happened to be wearing a white suit today...... But before you could think further, Spamton praised, "She's truly [exceptionally beautiful], like an angel." ”

He admits he's dark, admits he's just wishful thinking, admits he's a coward, and doesn't even dare to pour out all his dark, damp emotions to you. But Spamton also enjoys this dark scrutiny, enjoying the attention you would have on him at that moment.
You had no idea what Spamton was thinking. You just held up her skirt and looked at herself in the mirror, her bright smile spreading: "Yeah, I really like this outfit too, except it's a bit inconvenient to wear...... Maybe it's not very convenient for everyday work." You muttered as you spoke, while Spamton wore exactly the same smile. Whether it was your imagination or not, you felt that smile had become a bit more genuine. Spamton simply took out another set of clothes—a white skirt on top and black on the bottom, probably more suitable for going out. You took the outfit and held it up to show it up—maybe it was just your imagination, but you felt that all the clothes in this store were about your size.

You quietly called his name: "Spamton...... Um, can you help me check if this outfit looks good? "Your voice was very soft, a bit nervous but also a little expectant.

He just smiled gently, his eyes curved in a smile. You couldn't see his eyes, only heard him smiling as he said, "Then I'll use the 'Princess Carry Ceremony' to take you away from the 'Anomalous Place.'" ”
You blinked at him, but couldn't see any panic on his face. For some reason, your face just grew hotter as you patted your face and stammered away from him, "Th-I'll go change my clothes first!" And ...... And how dare you hug and hug in public! ”
With that, you closed the locker room door, and Spamton just raised his voice to say, "Mm...... After all, we're [friends]? And I'm [pursuing] you, so I think that's [reasonable]. ”
You muttered quietly in the locker room, "What is reasonable...... But you still couldn't zip the zipper behind you, so you finally opened the locker room door and whispered to Spamton, "Help me zip it up...... Just like before. ”
Spamton smiled and avoided your skin, gently zipping up your belt. Then he bent down slightly and made a gesture of invitation: "Well then, [Honored Miss], please [accompany me]." ”
You hesitated for a moment, grabbed his outstretched hand, and then walked out of the shop with Spamton. You both returned to the commercial street. To be honest...... You really hadn't been shopping properly since coming to the Dark World, so when Spamton gently held your hand as they walked down the shopping street, you found it strangely new and couldn't help but look around wanderingly.
However...... Not far ahead was a long puddle, which looked like it had been left from a rainy day two days ago. You stood there silently, but Spamton suddenly stretched his hand across your legs and wrapped his arms around Spamton's waist, lifting you up. Your eyes widened as you couldn't help but hug Spamton's neck tightly—you didn't want to fall suddenly. Looking at Spamton's face so close, you blushed a little and couldn't help but lower your face. You heard the Dark People around you probably muttering something. You didn't really know what they were talking about, but Spamton was clear that it was just jealousy that he had found a companion for the Light Folk, or—well, just consider them praising you. Spamton slightly raised his head, glanced at the Dark Kin, then lowered his head to look at you.
You feel a bit embarrassed being stared at by Spamton, and just as you were about to say something, you heard him speak.
He gently asks you, "Is the strength just right?" ”
You nodded anxiously, unable to look up at him anymore. You felt his burning gaze fixed on you, and you sensed the whispers of the other Dark People. You felt as if your heart was sick, beating so wildly and chaotically. You stammered and asked, "Now...... Can you put me down now? "You crossed that ditch long ago, but Spamton kept holding you tightly and refused to let go.
Hearing this, Spamton felt a bit disappointed. After all, he really wanted to hold you all the time—he wanted to be by your side all the time, to watch over you all the time. But he still followed your instructions and put you down, just hanging his head in a slightly aggrieved way: "[Sorry], I thought you'd like [close contact]." ”
Your eyes shifted when you heard this, but it wasn't exactly disliking him...... After all, when Spamton held you, you felt a bit cold on him. For you, this temperature was just right and quite comfortable, but staying in his arms all the time made you feel a bit embarrassed.
Spamton was overjoyed—he was still savoring the soft touch when he held you earlier, the warmth of your body, and your slightly flustered breath. He was even a little jealous of himself—after all, this kind of person could hold you and earn your trust, while the other side of him only received your sadness and tears, only fear and sorrow...... Though they were the same people, they received completely different treatment. He lowered his eyes and gazed darkly at your shadow, thinking that when he got back, he would send you lots of messages to harass you...... As long as you were willing to look at him a few more times, that would be enough.
You just waved your hand flusteredly: "Sorry...... I just thought you might be tired this way. "You looked at the street vendors, and there were quite a few stalls along the commercial street, so you bought a skewer of candied hawthorn and stuffed it for Spamton, and took one yourself.
You look at him cautiously: "So be happy, it's not that I hate you...... And I don't really dislike your interactions...... Your voice grew quieter as you watched Spamton still lower his head, looking a bit aggrieved. Then you cautiously moved closer to him and asked, "Um...... Um, I don't mean to hate you. ”
Spamton took the skewer of candied hawthorn, and out of sight, he smiled warmly. He knew you'd definitely soften—hmm, so he looked up and returned to his previous expression, but to you, for some reason, that voice carried a hint of mischief: "So, ......【Do you like me】? ”
You were stunned for a moment, thought for a moment, and finally shook your head, muttering, "...... Sorry." "Although you're happy, you still don't understand what liking really is. Can this really be called liking? What do you think liking is...... It's not something that can be explained so easily.
Spamton received the same answer as before. He wasn't upset, just held your hand and whispered, "Shall we go sit at the [Café] over there for a while?" ”
TBC.

title: vagrant11 (dnsx you)
content:
You hesitated for a moment. To be honest, after wandering around for a while, you did get a bit tired. There still seemed to be seats on the other end of the café, so you agreed to spamton's request. But after just a few steps, you stumbled and felt a bit dizzy. Spamton caught you, but you fell in the opposite direction of him. So although he held you, you fell into his arms.
You feel like your nose has bumped into his chest...... It seems a bit painful, but his chest feels a bit soft. He wrapped his arms around you and didn't say much, just asked with concern, "[Honored Miss], are you alright?" ”
Your face flushed bright red. You just pushed his chest, and Spamton let go of your gentle arm. You straightened up again, panicked, and thanked him: "I'm fine. Thank you, Mr. Spamton, for catching me just now, or I would have fallen to the ground...... You said that, not daring to look up at him anymore.
Spamton just chuckled lightly: "Y/N, just call me [my name], no need for honorifics." ”
You hesitated for a moment, then nodded and bowed again: "Anyway, thank you, spamton...... Also, I'm sorry you have to consider someone like me...... "You know this is unnecessary, so your voice gradually quieted.
Spamton simply said softly, "[It's okay], but Y/N...... Is there a health problem?" You heard the concern in his words. You didn't want someone you'd only known a few days to worry about your illness, nor did you want too many people to know about it, so you just lifted your head and gave a bright smile.
"It's nothing, I just tend to zone out, so sometimes I just step on something and fall...... Thank you for your concern, let's hurry to the café!" With that, you took Spamton's hand and led him toward the café.
Spamton just quietly watched your back, silently mouthing to your back: Liar.
Your body clearly has problems, but you refuse to tell him—he feels a bit sad, maybe you still don't fully trust him, but...... Maybe that's only natural, it shows you have a strong defensive mindset, but Spamton is still a little sad, just a little. Another identity knows and understands this, while the one who seems to get along better with you knows nothing.
…… Spamton thought, better watch the surveillance footage later and prepare some medicine for you, how about that...... At least that way, when you suddenly collapse from illness, he won't be at a loss. This time or two is fine; you just almost fell, and he can support you. But what if next time, the time after that, if you faint right in the middle of the road? He can't just watch you flustered and not know what to do. Spamton knows, of course he knows, and he needs to be fully prepared.
At the café, you order two cappuccinos, then several small cakes. You still prefer tiramisu and matcha cake, while Spamton ordered mango mille crepe and chocolate cookie cake, both of which looked very sweet.
After you finished the cake, it was rare that you didn't say much during the process. Lunch was also over, and you had to go to the flower shop in the afternoon to take care of something. So Spamton took you home, tidied yourself up, took off the dress and hung it on the rack, changed into another outfit, and headed out. Spamton, in the other house, watched you leave, instinctively bit his thumbnail. You couldn't be seen on the surveillance camera, so you left. After thinking for a moment, he took another phone and followed you out.
Soon, you felt a gaze sizing you up from behind. Instinctively, you turned your head to look, but you saw nothing. There was no Dark Civilian behind you, only a cold, empty wind blowing by. You shivered, hugged your clothes tightly, and walked back toward the flower shop.
After a while, you noticed that sticky, slightly burning gaze again. You knew it was that little pervert, but when you turned around again, that line of sight had vanished again. In the direction you looked, there were Dark People without any organs, only a few who looked rather elderly, walking slowly.
Meanwhile, Spamton clutched his pounding heart, took a deep breath, then exhaled two deep breaths, but a kind of indescribable, or perhaps somewhat sickly flush, appeared on his face.
He smiled foolishly, marveling at your beauty on one hand, and on the other...... But at the same time, he was intoxicated by your sudden counter-reconnaissance move. Spamton knew you were bound to discover something, which matched his initial guess, so he just felt...... You had become even more charming.
This time, you didn't notice the person following you, and after several more looks, still couldn't find it...... You hesitated for a moment, but eventually gave up on finding the guy, feeling a bit tired. In the end, you just went to the flower shop, greeted the owner, and started getting used to how to handle the flowers.
Spamton sat in the café across from the flower shop. He picked up a newspaper for himself, but of course he didn't read it—he just secretly watched your movements inside the shop out of the corner of his eye. Once he was sure there was probably nothing wrong, he quickly walked back, re-entered your house, gave you a quick cleaning, prepared dinner for you, and finally put on a warming hood. After finishing all that, he went back again. He didn't want to see you collapse suddenly—he was just too afraid of it.
Covering it with that newspaper, Spamton sent you a message on that phone: [Baby, your outfit looks great today~~
(^^o^^)~~]
Your phone vibrated, and you picked it up and naturally saw the message. You hesitantly glanced around. There were still many dark people blocking the Spamton, but you didn't see him. You just angrily tapped on the screen: [Where are you?] Why are you bothering me every day, and disturbing my work? Alright, that's what she's saying. Actually, you don't really have any work right now. You just haven't done anything, just here studying flowers and replying to this little pervert's message.
[I came to bother you because I saw my dear you have no job~~><~~]
[Honey, please don't find me so annoying...... Your outfit really looks great—a sky-blue puff-sleeve shirt and white shorts paired with these flowers are a perfect match! ~~^^~~]
[Anyway, I really like this outfit...... But dear, the clothes you change into when you go out this morning look even better TAT]
[Darling, don't wear such pretty clothes when you go out and meet people...... I'm so jealous, I want to kill everyone who sees you! ]
[And darling, she even changed into the white outfit! Baby, you have no idea how much that outfit looks like a wedding dress when paired with someone else's outfit OTTO]
Messages kept popping up, and you thought about the outfit you wore that morning, then about Spamton's white suit, and instinctively blushed. Only then did you realize how much those two outfits looked just like a wedding.
You pat your cheek to calm yourself down. The temperature finally subsides, and Spamton looks at you through the newspaper. He looks at your flushed cheeks with some joy, happy that you finally remembered the outfit from that morning, but he also feels a bit jealous—why must you use another account to say you can truly understand? When will you truly understand his feelings? Spamton doesn't know either.
And after you calmed down, you kept pressing your screen and sending him messages: [So what? Even if I married him, I would never marry a pervert like you! ]
[QAQ Baby's words make me so sad...... Darling, don't you care about me at all? Darling, don't you think of me at all? ] He keeps pressing his screen to send you messages, while the corners of his mouth behind the newspaper are curling up wildly. He's in a good mood, or rather, his heart is overjoyed, thinking you'll marry him. To be honest, after all that long sentence, he only noticed all that...... Well, he finished reading the whole message. After sending that message, he turned off his phone and stopped texting, just holding a glass of iced Americano to refresh himself.
You hesitated for a moment when you looked at his message, turned off your phone screen, and felt your thoughts were a bit chaotic and complicated. But you couldn't help but open it to see if that little pervert had sent you any new messages. In that moment, you have to admit, you'...... You do care a bit about him—maybe not just a little. At least, he does hold a place in your heart. You may find him noisy and hate that he's invading your life, but over the past few days, you've unconsciously gotten used to his presence.
Probably because ...... He knows about your illness but still sticks by your side. After learning about your condition, the friends who once cared for you have all disappeared, and family members didn't pay much attention. Now, the belated affection only feels fake to you, which is quite funny.
Only him...... Well, he constantly harasses you, he's a pervert. You find it ridiculous and ridiculous, and in the end, a pervert cares more about you than the person you've ever truly cared for.
You stayed silent, turned off your phone screen, and finally opened the chat window. After hesitating for a moment, you sent him a message: [I've thought about it, I do care a little, just a little.] ]You...... You still don't want to let down the person who has given you feelings, so you're a bit conflicted.
TBC.

title: vagrant12 (dnsx you)
content:
You just didn't expect the reply from the other side to be so shameless—well, he was a pervert to begin with, so the reply couldn't be too good. You still have a bit of self-awareness.
Just looking at the message displayed on the phone screen, you couldn't help but twitch the corners of your mouth.
[Awa, the baby actually cares about me a little… That proves the baby actually cares about me very much, right! The baby really can't do without me~~^^~~]
[I also care about you so much, my dear. I like you the most, love you the most, the most, the most ><///]
I wish my dear liked me too… Since my dear cares about me, it must mean my dear actually likes me a lot, right awa, I'm so happy //><//
You coughed dryly twice, touched your slightly flushed face, and muttered softly to yourself, reminding yourself that this was just some pervert whose identity you didn’t even know, so why feel embarrassed because of his words... it’s not worth it. Thinking this, you turned off your phone screen and slipped it back into your pocket without looking at it again. Your phone vibrated several more times before going completely silent. On the other side of the café, Spamton used a newspaper to shield himself, cautiously peeking out to make sure you were no longer paying attention. Only then did he put his phone away, no longer sending you messages, but behind the newspaper, he gazed at you faintly and somewhat obsessively. He knew that his feelings might be a bit despicable, even he thought it seemed a little shameless, yet he still lost himself in watching your figure. Only when he kept looking at you did he feel satisfied.
You seemed to have noticed this thick and somewhat intense gaze as well, but when you lifted your head, you couldn't catch that glance anymore. In the end, you had no choice but to lower your head and focus on your own work. You still cherished this hard-earned job very much, after all, you also really liked flowers.
Unconsciously, it was already time to get off work. You quickly tidied up a bit and headed home. Just like when you came, Spamton was quietly following you again, but no matter how many times you turned around, you couldn't catch a glimpse of anyone. You glanced at your phone and realized that it vibrated because that little pervert had sent you a message again.
[Baby cares about me awa... rounded up, it means baby likes me too; rounded up, it means my dear married me!] You don’t even know how he came up with that rounding... You obviously told him that it was impossible to marry him, right? You don't understand, and at that time, Spamton was only holding onto a mix of bitterness and a little joy, thinking about the outfit he wore in the morning that looked like a couple's costume, thinking about you... He has always loved you wholeheartedly, so at this very moment, his whole focus is only on you, and nothing can distract him.
And you just feel a bit troubled, so you simply keep reading. The following messages are still from the little pervert, and you always feel that he seems a bit too happy.
[\^^// I made dinner for my wife and even helped tidy up the house for her! Baby, hurry and praise me awaaa]
[I don't know if my wife will like the taste of dinner... In any case, I think my wife should like this flavor!]
[I also prepared a small cake for my wife and put it in the fridge. It's tiramisu; my wife should prefer this flavor... Hmm, if she doesn't like it, she can tell me too TWT]
You couldn't help but frown at these messages, and at the same time you felt a sticky gaze, so you couldn't help but turn your head, but unfortunately there was no one on the street, only meaningless posters that had been rolled up.
You pulled your gaze back, just tapped on the screen, and replied to him with a sentence: '[...Don't call me wife, I never agreed to marry you.]' After sending this message, you couldn't help but chuckle. Did you really consider marrying that pervert? Well... actually, you don't know either, maybe you did have such a thought. After all, you still hope that in the end there will be someone to hold your funeral, someone to cry for you, anyone would be fine.
…What are you thinking about? That’s impossible too, right? You smiled bitterly at yourself, lowered your head, and noticed a dark creature shaped like a cat in the corner of the wall. It looked already very weak… It just opened its eyes feebly and let out a soft meow at you. You were momentarily stunned, but still crouched down carefully and picked it up. Then you realized that this little cat’s… leg was broken; it only had three legs. Once in your arms, it instinctively bristled, baring its teeth and looking very defensive. You thought for a moment, then took a stick of ham sausage from your bag, parted its outer fur, and brought it to its mouth. It seemed to hesitate for a while before relaxing and started eating in small bites.
You looked at the little kitten in your arms and gently reached out to stroke its rough fur. You whispered, 'You don’t have a home either, do you... You probably don’t have much time left either... Come home with me.' Spend the last bit of time with me... that’s what you were thinking. This frail little kitten doesn’t seem like it has many years left, so this way, whether it leaves this world or you leave this world, it won’t be too heartbreaking.
And Spamton, quietly following behind you, gritted his teeth, feeling jealous—just jealous, after all, why should that cat be able to curl up in your arms? Why should that cat be able to enjoy your gentle strokes and warm voice? Why, why, why... He took out that phone and sent you a few more messages. You felt the phone vibrate a few times, but you didn’t pay it any mind. You knew it was probably that little pervert sending you something again anyway; no rush, you could check it later.
Spamton thought, just thought... he thought bitterly, he cannot go to death with you, but must he wait until he sees your death with his own eyes before following you to death? He doesn't know either.
He is jealous of this cat, that it might have the possibility to die with you, he is jealous of all of this... How much he wants to rush over and hold you right now.
Of course, you have no idea what he is really thinking. You just walked a bit further and then suddenly felt a little dizzy. Fortunately, there was a utility pole nearby. You leaned on the utility pole for a while, and after no longer feeling dizzy, you continued walking toward home.
You reached your front door, took out your keys, and opened it. You put the three-legged kitten on the floor, took a metal basin, filled it with some milk, and placed it on the floor for it to drink. Then, you immediately noticed the thermal cover on the table. You walked over and opened the cover, and a delicious aroma wafted out. You sat down and enjoyed dinner alone, while Spamton, who entered the room a little later, watched the monitor, satisfied to see you enjoying the meal. He knew this dinner probably suited your taste perfectly—sure enough, the next second he received a text message.
You tasted the flavors of these dishes, which seemed a little bland, but overall they were very much to your liking... Hmm, you didn't really know what this little pervert usually paid attention to, but you still took out your phone to send him a message. It was only at this moment that you noticed a few messages he had sent you.
[Does OTTO baby not like this nickname... I clearly like it very much.]
[Alright, dear, stop calling me that, I won’t say it that way anymore... Dear, do you like the way I call you now better? I will improve.]
[Baby, pay attention to me... I'm so lonely by myself TWT]
This was sent to you after you said not to shout like that at yourself; you can tell his typing speed is very fast.
And probably after some time has passed, you saw a few new pieces of information again.
[Baby, don't hold that cat QWQ, that cat is dirty, what's good about it? Baby, look at me, I'm strong and healthy, surely perfect for you!!]
[I'm so jealous of that cat that has taken over your arms... I wonder if I could secretly kill it when my dear isn't paying attention...]
[But I really still like my baby so much! My baby is beautiful and kind-hearted, I really like them too much ////]
You looked at these few messages and sighed slightly, but still replied with a few messages: [What's lonely about being alone? Anyway, you can also send messages to bother me.]
You can call it whatever you want, but I already said it, I won't marry you, stop daydreaming.
[And... that little kitten, I only brought it back because it looked pitiful. You absolutely cannot kill it. This little kitten has already suffered enough, and I don’t want it to fall into your hands as well.]
[Finally, dinner was delicious, thank you... though it was a bit bland, and thank you for preparing the little cake.] After sending this message, you opened the fridge, took out that small tiramisu, and started enjoying it. You squinted your eyes slightly, feeling incredibly happy... hmm, this little cake, bitter yet sweet, was just too delicious.
You glanced at your vibrating phone, not knowing that Spamton on the other end was happily looking at the heap of messages you had sent him. He even went so far as to count exactly how many words you had sent this time... Spamton just felt that he was incredibly happy to have received so many messages, so he typed back at you with a long-lasting smile on his face.
[Am I dreaming!! Baby actually sent me so many messages awa]
I know, next time I will pay more attention to the ingredients~~^^~~
[Since the baby has already said it, I won't take action... but I still think that little kitten is so annoying QWQQQ]
You looked at his message and sighed, and unknowingly a smile appeared on your face: [I’m not dreaming.]
[Then... unless you can also turn into a little kitten, you can only watch.] After sending these two messages, you hummed happily twice and put your phone away.

title: vagrant13 (dnsx you)
content:
You ignored the vibration of your phone, simply let out a long sigh, and then lay down on the sofa to let yourself relax for a while. The day had indeed been quite fulfilling, but what followed was the physical fatigue. As your condition progressed, you constantly felt that your body seemed to get tired more easily—this probably wasn't just your imagination.
In short, you lay on the sofa, staring blankly at the ceiling, and then you heard a faint meow... You slightly tilted your head to look and found it was that still somewhat sluggish little kitten, though it seemed a bit more energetic after drinking the milk. You gently curled your finger toward it, and perhaps because it was full and felt this warm place was relatively safe, the kitten approached the sofa. You picked it up and placed it on yourself, and then the little kitten walked around on you, finally curling up on your chest.
On the other side, Spamton watching the surveillance couldn't help but feel a bit gloomy… and there was also a kind of sour feeling. He looked at the little cat lying on you and bit his teeth viciously. He wasn't even sure if he would strangle the little cat when you weren't at home… Maybe he would actually do it, Spamton wasn't sure either.
He just reluctantly picked up that phone again and sent you a bunch of messages in a flurry, and meanwhile switched to another phone to send you a casual greeting... hmm, now spamton is a bit nervous and eagerly waiting for your reply.
Although you heard the vibration of your phone, because you were temporarily feeling tired and didn’t want to get up, you just closed your eyes and lightly napped without any intention of responding. You didn’t know how much time had passed; in any case, maybe an hour, maybe two hours. And Spamton was just on the other end, staring intently at the screen, looking at you, then at the little cat on you. He sincerely wished he could become that little cat right now, so he could be close to you—that way, he could also snuggle on you and not get off.
However... seeing you lazily pick up your phone, Spamton just felt his heart race. He couldn't wait to grab his own phone and wait for you to reply to his message.
You saw your contact list and frowned slightly; that anonymous little pervert and Spamton had both sent messages... You thought about it for a moment, and decided to open the little pervert's chat first, after all, reading his messages doesn't require you to organize your words, and you can reply if you feel like it.
[TTT I also want to become that little kitten… snuggling in the baby's arms, just looking at my dear, I feel so happy awa]
[Also, if dear needs it, I can prepare something for that little kitten... but I really don't want to do that >X<]
[But if my dear likes that little cat, I can't do anything about it... In any case, my dear can do whatever they want, it's all my dear's free choice... ORZ]]
[But dear, taking care of a kitten by yourself in that situation would be troublesome, right? Otherwise, you could find someone else to help take care of it—for example, me awa]
After a while, he sent some messy information again.
[That cat! How can it rub all over the baby so freely! I don't even get such a chance TTTTTTTT><TTTTTTT]
[I don't care, baby, you must throw that little perverted cat off of you... it, it touched you in that kind of place... How could this happen!!]
[And dear, why aren't you replying to me again? Respond to me, respond to me/////]
[In short, that cat is so annoying! It's still bothering darling. Darling, why don't you throw him out? Anyway, just looking at him, he's in that state, sitting there, and surely nobody wants him... Darling, it's already pretty good if you give him some food... TT><TT]
You frowned, because lying on the sofa holding your phone was a bit tiring. You simply turned over to look at the phone screen, yawned, and slowly typed to him: [Mm hmm, then you should try your best to become a cat. Why would I throw that cat away? Since I picked it up, I’ll take good care of it… Besides, it doesn’t look like it has much longer to live.]
[Just because no one wants it doesn't mean it's a bad cat... Besides, it's just kneading, it's okay.] After typing, you yawned again. You looked at the little grayish, dirty white kitten that had rolled over and carefully curled up beside you... Somehow, it reminded you of a long, long time ago, probably when your memory wasn't very clear. At that time, it seemed you accidentally entered this world, but you were still the same as now—or rather, from beginning to end, you never changed. You stood in front of that small, white, slightly grayish Addison, blocking the other dark-cloaked people from bullying him. Then, with only one dollar you had on you, you bought something from his stall... If you remember correctly, it should have been a small towel? You carefully wiped the dirty marks off him with that towel, then reached out your hand to tell him that, at least in this world, you were willing to be his friend—he was not worthless, not unloved.
I just don't know what happened to that white Addison later... You never saw him again. Lost in thought, you casually stroked the fur of this little cat and sent a message to that little pervert: [Oh right, I feel like drinking blueberry juice. Can you buy some 100% blueberry drink and put it in my fridge tomorrow? Thanks in advance.]
[I promise to help my dear complete the task! TTT, my dear really is still such a kind-hearted being of light...] The reply from the other side came quickly as well, and as you looked at this reply, you couldn't help but frown. You recalled the things from just now... At the same time, a guess arose in your mind: could this little pervert on the other side be the same white Addison from back then? Otherwise... otherwise, why would he say 'really still'?
You were thinking, but you didn't ask this question first; you just switched to the chat box next door and stared blankly at the messages Spamton sent you.
[Successfully arrived], I wonder if the [honorable young lady] is [especially delighted] about today's [outing plans]?] You looked at this message, thought about what happened in the morning, and couldn't help but smile again.
And Spamton... he looked at the surveillance screen, somewhat envious of the person who could receive your smile, only to realize the next second that the person who actually received the smile was himself.
[Thank you, spamton, I really enjoyed this morning's activity... um, I sincerely look forward to the next time I go out with you.]
[But shopping really is a bit tiring after all. If you ask me, watching a movie is still a little better… Speaking of which, the dessert I had at the café today was also pretty good.]
[Although I am back home, I still have to go work in the afternoon... very tired, but fortunately the boss is easy to get along with, and I haven't done a lot of work either.]
By the way, to thank Mr. Spamton, I prepared a flower arrangement for you... I should give it to you tomorrow. When are you available to receive it?
Spamton listened to the vibration of his phone and looked at the messages from you flashing on the screen, feeling a bit bittersweet—he stared at the messages you sent, as usual counting every word one by one to see exactly how many words you had sent him, then he pressed down a smile at the corner of his mouth and replied to your messages with poise.
[As long as you like it, it's 'my honor.' I'm also looking forward to going on a trip with you... if you're willing, maybe tomorrow?]
[I will choose according to [the young lady's preferences], so... the next activity will be [watching a movie].]
Tomorrow morning or evening, I am available [to receive gifts].
Although you looked at his messages a little slowly, he still sent them to you one by one. You compared the speed at which the messages were sent and let out a sigh of relief. You then said… your neighbor is so polite, how could he possibly be the same person as that anonymous little pervert on your phone? You dismissed your doubts once again.
[Thank you for your invitation... but I have to work, so I'm only available on the weekend! Got it, I will deliver the prepared bouquet tomorrow!]
Speaking of which, I actually found a little kitten on my way home today... it only has three legs, really pitiful.
I took it home, fed it a little and gave it some milk or something, and it became very close to me! Just now it was even stepping on me.
[So strangely cute... and also strangely heartbreaking. I don't know who would abandon such an adorably cute kitten, and it looks like its leg might have been broken from being abused...]
By the way, does Mr. Spamton know anything about the nearby hospitals? I'm planning to take this child to see one in a few days.
Spamton looked at the messages you sent, his expression becoming even more plaintive. He monitored you, followed you, observed your daily life... and you just easily spoke about these daily things to another person, and it just so happened that this person was also him.
However... in other words, doesn't this also prove that you do care about him a little, care about this neighbor who is courting you? Thinking about this, he felt his chest pounding violently, and he couldn't hide the smile on his face as he replied to your messages.
[So about the 【weekend invitation】, the cat you mentioned feels really 【pitifully cute】... As for the nearby 【pet hospital】, 【go straight and then turn right】 【to reach it】.] However, Spamton remained very reserved; he only replied to you with one message, simply covering all the answers in it.
You received a reply and happily responded to him with a thank you. Then, you opened that little pervert's chat box again and began to think about your wording.
You hesitated, tapping and pressing on the screen and then deleting, and in the end... you still only sent one message: [Are you one of those dark people called addisons?]

title: vagrant14 (dnsx you)
content:
Spamton still smiled when he saw your message, but it was obvious his expression wasn't very good. He knew—you must be suspicious, but he was afraid you might associate the once humiliated white Addison with the current Spamton. He didn't want you to think that way.
…… If only you knew that the real identity of that pervert was just Spamton. Thinking back to the past, he only tormented you and him at the same time. Unexpectedly, he didn't want you to realize he was the same Addison back then. He ...... After all, he hopes the memories that once stayed deep in your heart will still be beautiful.
So he just smiled and quickly tapped on the screen, replying to your message: [Baby, why would you think that? I'm just a simple Dark Folk OWO]
You don't believe what he said...... Maybe he's lying like that. You muttered, stood up, put away your phone, and planned to wash up and sleep. But for some reason, you had another episode today—it never happened this often before. Dizzy and dizzy, you knelt on the floor, ignoring the pain from the sudden fall. With trembling hands, you pulled out a small medicine bottle from your pocket, poured out three pills, and swallowed them. Spamton, who was on the other end of the surveillance camera, stood up immediately. If he weren't worried about exposing anything, he would have rushed straight to your house—luckily, he saw you get up again, so he sat down again, still shaken.
He anxiously sends you a message: [Honey, why did you fall again? It must hurt a lot, right? TATTT]
[I think my dear needs someone to take care of you, otherwise it's too dangerous for you to live alone. ]
You catch your breath and get up to see these two messages. Although you're not in a great mood right now, you still raise your eyebrows—maybe you think talking to him can lift your spirits, and you know what he means, but you can't help teasing: [Then who is the person you're talking about?] ]
[Of course it's me! \\><// Darling, rest assured, I will take good care of you. You absolutely cannot invite that annoying neighbor of yours|| ^^|| I really hate him, he can actually make my beloved smile and talk......]
You can't help but laugh out loud when you look at his message. You know what answer he'll give you, and you know your emotions are twisted at this moment—probably a bit of joy from being cared for. Even though you don't know where that feeling comes from, still...... But I have to say, being cared for and watched, you suddenly start laughing, even though tears still stream from the corners of your eyes.
…… So even if you're about to die, someone will care. Is someone truly caring about you? So that's how it is? You don't know, nor do you know that Spamton on the surveillance screen was flustered when he saw your tears. You just think...... If someone is willing to pay attention to you, it's probably to repay the kindness they once did. In the light world, you did so much, but in the end, those people just felt it was just what they should do. But in the dark world...... The only kindness you ever gave was that once. You didn't believe anyone would pay attention to you for no reason, so you tapped the screen with certainty: [I get it, you're that white Addison, right? No need to argue anymore, I know it's you. ]
If ...... If you really guessed wrong, then you were wrong; after all, it's just a trivial matter...... Your own death is also a minor matter, and being noticed because of these things is obviously just a minor matter. Although you smile, tears are still on your face as you lie on the bed. You know that perhaps the other person doesn't think these are trivial matters...... But you already feel it doesn't matter; your phone is still vibrating, and you are just lying on the bed asleep.
Spamton stared at his phone, then at your sleeping face on the surveillance camera, feeling a rare sense of helplessness—no matter what he said, it probably wouldn't help, and you had already accepted it. He had to admit that if it weren't for that incident, he wouldn't be here now, nor would he be here staring at you on camera. He had already noted down the medications you used, and after preparing them, he bought them with him. That way, if you get sick again, no matter what, he has a way to save you. He can't just stand by and watch you get hurt in front of him.
Spamton stared at the unread messages still displayed on his phone screen, his expression darkening and looking even paler under the screen's light.
[How could the baby think like that? I just really like the baby OTTO]
[But if the baby insists on saying that, I have to admit it...... I am the Addison from back then. I really like you. Darling, your movements are so gentle, your smile is so warm...... I originally thought I was going to die under those guys' bullying, but the baby saved me, awa. At that moment, my darling looked so beautiful...... I always remembered you until I saw you again. Your appearance was a surprise to me! I ...... I never thought I would see you again......] He looked at the two messages, hesitated for a moment, then wanted to withdraw them, but the retraction event had already passed; no matter what, you would see them. Spamton had no choice but to put away his phone, gave a wry smile, and tossed and turned, finally falling asleep.
The next morning, as usual, you open the door and see the breakfast prepared. While savoring the meal, you open your phone and find that the account you marked as 'Little Pervert' had sent you two unread messages. You open it and take a look—sure enough, the little pervert admitted it. He was the Dark People from back then.
You hesitated for a moment, but still sent him a message: [Because I don't believe anyone would follow me for no reason......]
[The only thing I can remember was that white Addison that I was somewhat involved with. So as expected, it was you. ]
As soon as you sent your message, you got a reply from him: [TAT baby is such a good citizen of light—it's normal for others to follow you for no reason, like your neighbor......]
[I won't allow the baby to belittle themselves like this! And the flower shop owner treats you very well...... The convenience store waiter is the same, everyone clearly likes you OWO]
…… What exactly is liking? What is love? Can just a little attention and kindness count as liking? You don't know, you put down your phone and nervously eat breakfast. You didn't reply to his messages, but tears welled up uncontrollably, dripping onto your phone screen and the dining table. You didn't know why you were crying—maybe, maybe you just suddenly understood something, maybe...... Maybe this kind of affection isn't something you need to reciprocate either. You suddenly realize that you seem ...... It seems like you can give Spamton an answer, but you're not sure.
You tidy yourself up, throw away the plates, take a deep breath, and walk out the door. You knock on the door next door first, deciding to ask him for a favor first. If love isn't something you need to fully reciprocate, then you probably feel more at ease.
Spamton, hearing your knock, rushed over and opened the door. As usual, he smiled broadly and asked, "[Honored Miss], do you need [special services]?" ”
You nodded: "Well, lately I feel like someone is following me...... So, I was thinking it might be safer to have a Dark Folk accompany me. With that in mind, I asked Mr. Spamton. ”
He excitedly gestured behind his back. You don't know, your neighbor is that perverted stalker, and you don't know that doing so actually gets his wish and allows him to stay by your side all the time.
Spamton simply nodded modestly: "Of course, it's my honor." With that, he turned around and closed the door, gently holding your hand as you walked forward.
After walking a distance, you finally didn't feel that stalking gaze anymore. You couldn't help but exhale softly, but you didn't know that Spamton had been secretly watching you all along. He looked at your pale skin exposed on the outside, at your cheeks tinged with a hint of redness...... How he wished he could kiss and bite him right now, but he knew he couldn't do that; no matter what, he had to endure. So he just swallowed hard and turned his head away.
And you didn't notice his gaze. You just stared at the same spot in the corner as yesterday, nervously and excitedly tugging spamton: "Look, this is where I found that little cat yesterday!" Speaking of which, this street does look a bit desolate. It doesn't seem to have any Dark Folks ......."
Spamton just smiled and replied to you, "It's too early, many of the [Dark People] haven't appeared yet." "But he secretly thought to himself that once he takes you to your destination, he'll be entering your house. He's determined to make sure that kitten doesn't climb onto you again."
You just nodded half-understandingly, tugged at his sleeve, and pointed to a nearby shop: "Ah...... It looks like a dessert shop! I wonder how it tastes. How about trying it next time? ”
Spamton glanced at the shop; he still had some impression of it, and the food was pretty good.
He said, "I'm pretty impressed. The desserts here taste pretty good." If you like them, next time we'll try a try or two." He was a bit nervous because he had classified you as "we," and he didn't know if you'd agree.
And you just nodded, your tone very cheerful: "Hmm, then let's try it next time!" I wonder if this place has any special features...... you mutter.
And Spamton just felt overjoyed—you accepted that title and naturally adopted it, doesn't that mean...... Does that mean you've accepted him?

title: vagrant15 (dnsx you)
content:
But Spamton could only suppress his excitement. He tried hard to look straight ahead to avoid noticing his burning gaze, and you naturally continued without realizing it: "Hmm...... Um, speaking of which, the café across from the flower shop always seems super popular. I wonder how the food over there tastes......
Of course Spamton knows the café you mentioned. That was the café he sat at yesterday and secretly watched you for a long time. The café is indeed doing well, but Spamton feels embarrassed to tell you that so many of the customers are actually hired by him...... The goal is to hide his presence.
He just smiled and replied, "Ah, [Extremely popular]?" Maybe it's just a personal preference...... I don't like the [special texture]. "He was just telling the truth.
You just nod thoughtfully: "Hmm...... Is that so? But next time I'll give it a try. What if I happen to like the food at this café? ”
"Of course, I'm willing to accompany you, miss." Spamton said with a cheerful smile. You chatted casually like this, and only when you finally reached the flower shop entrance, you really didn't notice that gaze anymore. You breathed a sigh of relief, then ran into the flower shop, took out a handful of bird of paradise, and handed it to Spamton as you went out.
"Mm...... Thank you, Mr. Spamton. Also, please take me home when I get off work. It's just a small gift, and I hope you like it." As you spoke, you bowed to him firmly.
Spamton really likes this kind of flower. He looked at your lowered head, swallowed hard, and didn't go straight up to touch it. After all, your head looks fluffy, and it probably feels very comfortable to touch—soft and fluffy.
He simply took the bouquet and chuckled, "Alright, I'll head home now. If you need a [farewell service], just send a [text notification.] With that, Spamton carefully carried the bouquet toward home. You smiled as you watched his figure leave, then returned to the flower shop to continue your work for the day.
Spamton took the bouquet home and carefully placed the flower arrangement into a vase, placing it together with the flowers you had given him earlier. He admired it for a while before reopening your house's surveillance cameras. He watched as your cat boldly climbed onto the dining table after you left. Spamton snorted coldly, went out to buy some things—besides the blueberry juice you ordered yesterday, there was some cat food, canned cat food, and cat toys. Then he swaggered into your house, carefully putting the blueberry juice into your fridge, then placing the cat food and canned cat food on the counter, and setting the cat toys aside. The kitten was quickly attracted to the toys, rummaging around on them and occasionally rolling down the steps. Spamton looked at the kitten and lowered his voice fiercely: "Everything has been given to you for purchase. You need to remember that your toys and other items were purchased by me. You can't climb onto the lady of this house anymore, and you can't keep harassing my wife." The kitten didn't know if it understood, but it just meowed happily.
Only then was Spamton satisfied. He sneaked back across from your flower shop, sizing you up through the newspaper. He secretly envied those Dark People who could talk to you and get your smile, so he couldn't help but take out his phone and send you another message.
[Baby, why are you smiling at that Dark Folk again...... Darling, can't you smile at me more? If you keep this up, I'll gouge out the eyes of everyone who sees your smile!! OTTTO]
[Darling, you came here with someone else this morning, right...... Or your annoying neighbor, seriously...... It's so bad I can't even look at you openly anymore, darling. ]
[But now there's no one else around, so I can look at them for as long as I want. The baby is just so beautiful, no matter what, she always catches my eye at first sight~~^^~~]
You looked at his message, hesitated for a moment, then sighed and replied when there were no customers: [Is it only natural for me to smile at customers? You Addison are in business too, you can't help but understand this......]
[Also, I just find it annoying to keep turning around to see if anyone is following me, so I call someone to accompany me, once and for all...... Forget it, if you want to watch, go ahead. I can't stop you. ]
After sending those two messages, you stopped paying attention to the vibrations on your phone. Spamton enthusiastically sent you two messages: [Mm-hmm...... Next time, I'll try not to let the baby notice and follow you, so you won't find me annoying~~^^~~~]
[Darling, you actually let me look at it casually...... Then I have to stare at it even more openly! The baby is just too beautiful. I really like you, I love you the most, most of all, awa......]
You didn't pay attention to any of the noise, just continued to greet guests with a smile. Spamton, staring at the smile you gave others, found it especially glaring. He didn't want to keep watching, so since it was about time, he simply went back to your house to prepare dinner for you, then returned to the café to watch you.
You were completely unaware, just sending Spamton a message just before getting off work: [I'm off work, Mr. Spamton, please come pick me up.] ]
The other side only replied with a few words: [Received, [Brave the Storm]. ]
Spamton quietly slipped away from the café, then to the next street corner, making sure you couldn't see him, he openly walked toward you to pick you up and take you home. When you saw Spamton, your eyes lit up and you waved at him.
On the way back, you walked side by side, your shoulders occasionally bumping. You kept muttering as if you had in the morning, "There were quite a few guests today, I laughed so hard my face almost stiffened......" You complained, and Spamton just nodded gently. Unconsciously, you maintained this state. You returned home, waved goodbye to him, and then opened the door.
To your surprise, besides the dinner and thermos on the table today, you also see the kitten playing with a huge cat toy...... Or playing inside the cat house, and then you find cat food and canned cat food on the counter. Open the fridge and you'll find blueberry juice just as you wished.
You sit at the dining table, open your phone again, and see that little pervert's unread messages, with new ones popping up one after another.
You glance at it—hmm, the first two messages were sent by you at the flower shop this afternoon, the rest were just sent earlier.
[Darling, you saw that, awa. I bought blueberry juice for you and put it in the fridge. You can drink it whenever you want~~^^~~]
[Darling, if you have anything you'd like to ask me about, that's okay. I promise to prepare everything for you///^^///]
[Also...... I've prepared everything the cat will need. TAT baby, don't let too much attention focus on him, even though just looking at me is enough......]
[And I've also prepared dinner for you, darling. You can try it, I guarantee today's flavor will be yours! \\><//]
[But if you still don't like me, be sure to tell me TAT. I will definitely change, don't dislike me...... Ah, darling, you must have seen my message, right? How about that? Praise me ///^^///]
You hesitated for a moment as you stared at the message popping up on your phone screen, sighed, and finally opened your thermos to take a bite. Spamton, on the other end, was excitedly checking the surveillance footage, his legs trembling uncontrollably to ease his nervousness. Watching you eat, his emotions reached their peak, and he couldn't wait to see what kind of feedback you would have.
And as you chew and taste it, you have to admit, you can't really find fault with it...... Honestly, the taste is really good—at least you like it, and you can't go against your conscience and say you dislike it.
So you sent a message to that little pervert: [I really like it today, thank you, blueberry juice in the fridge...... Thank you too, I didn't have time to take care of the kitten, you bought it a lot, thank you. ]
[Then...... Hmm, let me compliment you, I really like you, you did a great job. ]You dryly message, always feeling like your words of praise were really bad.
But Spamton was already very happy. He happily praised him: [awa baby praised me~~ After saying so many thanks, does baby even like me at all? QWQ]
You silently stared at the message, your face flushed, and after hesitating for a long time, you deleted and trimmed it before sending a message: [Just a little, just a little. ]
While you were typing, the little cat was tugging at you, and you casually picked it up, and the kitten nestled up on top of you. Spamton on the other end of the surveillance camera pouted, thinking that this heartless little guy had actually climbed onto you again—how outrageous!
[Oh, by the way, I want to eat grilled fish tomorrow. ]
The other side replied instantly: [Got it!! Promise dear love to eat!! I really, really love baby's awa, so can you ...... Take that cat stuck to you down TAT]
You chuckled softly: [No]
[TTTTT]
The next few days...... It's pretty much the same as today. You'll call Spamton to go to and from work with you, and you can't help but talk to him a lot. Think about it, you've probably gotten used to Spamton's presence and his declarations of affection. And as usual, every day when you come home, you'll find a little extra stuff at home—either cat toys or small gifts for you. Come to think of it, Valentine's Day is really coming soon, right? Hmm...... About half a month left. In short, you're used to having a spotless house, and sometimes there's even extra dinner. Sometimes you order food, and the next day it's served to you exactly to your liking.
Until the weekend, you hesitate in front of the mirror for a moment, then finally change into the white dress you wore from the day you first met. You plan to go to the date, you want to give Spamton an answer—you already have the answer to this question.
