title: vagrant16 (dnsx you)
content:
You knocked on your neighbor's door, and almost the next second, he came to open it. Spamton had always been looking forward to this day, longing to go out alone with you, so when he heard your knocking, his pupils instinctively dilated—even though the next second he returned to a calm smile.
"Esteemed Miss, would you like to join us for an invitation?" He asked with a cheerful smile.
Looking at him, your face involuntarily flushed a little, so you lowered your head slightly, reached out to play with your hair, and whispered, "Mm, Mr. Spamton, let's go watch a movie together...... Also, about your previous confession to me, I've figured out how to ...... how to answer you. "Your words were a bit stammering.
"So...... Is it the [Romantic Choice of Consent]? "He asked, quietly lowering his head to look at you, gazing at your fair neck exposed because of the bow, and even his breathing grew rapid. He thought, he really ...... He liked you so much that just looking at you like this made him excited and unable to contain himself.
"Hmm...... Probably, right? I think I roughly understand what your likes really mean...... So, I, I want to give it a try...... As you spoke, your voice grew quieter and quieter, and Spamton just chuckled softly and reached out to hold your hand.
On one hand, he was ecstatic—because this way, he could approach you as an ordinary couple, even enter your household. But on the other hand, he felt a bit jealous and dissatisfied, because he knew this wasn't how he truly looked when facing you, but just a disguise to win your favor.
True affection...... True love may not be like this, because for a long time, he only has obsession with you. He can't notice those dark people who only look kinder to him after his career starts to improve a little. All his obsession, all his madness, all his love has gathered around you. Spamton just wants to watch you always, always because he has always loved you, always, always...... All his obsession and madness are invested in you; he just cares about you deeply.
But now, he still hides all this darkness and dampness behind that mask of smile. He holds your hand, feeling the beating in your chest seem to quicken, and he pulls you toward the nearby cinema.
You study movie posters, look up synopsis, and then excitedly point to one of the movies and say, "I want to see this movie." ”
Spamton took a look; the movie was called "Sick Night," just a very simple title...... Well, it seems to combine elements of suspense, horror, and romance. Spamton nodded, bought two movie tickets, then bought you a bucket of popcorn, then took your hand and walked into the theater.
At this hour, the cinema was empty. You sat down with Spamton, a bit nervous and excited. Then Spamton took out a popcorn and held it to your mouth. You swallowed it instinctively, remembering what you had just done, and your face involuntarily turned even redder.
Spamton, on the other hand, just smiles and continues to feed you popcorn. As the theater darkens, you start to focus on the movie screen.
There's nothing particularly special about this film...... The protagonist falls in love with the female lead at first sight, feeling he has a fever called 'female lead,' and begins to pursue her relentlessly. At the same time, the male lead is also a pathological criminal. He commits crimes and waits for the female lead to solve them, but the final answer is nothing but an absurd and ridiculous confession. The female lead keeps solving these cases until the last one, and the answer is the deranged male lead, so she arrests him.
You watched with great interest, since the cases in this film were all quite interesting. It wasn't until the movie ended, when the lights were turned back on in the theater and the few Dark People gradually left, and you were still savoring the movie with great interest.
Spamton gently takes your hand: "[Let's go]?" Continue with [romantic invitation]? ”
Only then did you snap back to reality, smacking your lips and excitedly suggesting, "I want to go to that dessert shop I told you about last time! I remember you said it tasted great—so, I wanted to give it a try." ”
Spamton smiled and nodded, "Of course, no problem." He pulled you outside the cinema. Curious, you glanced at the poster outside the theater, still feeling a bit nervous, since you planned to formally accept his confession at the dessert shop.
And you just excitedly chat casually with Spamton: "I think the cases in that movie just now were really interesting!" The male lead actually disguised himself as a stalker, and when the female lead finally uncovered the truth, she only left her with a ridiculous confession—honestly, this kind of male lead is still annoying, either he doesn't like him or just tells her directly. What kind of thing is that? "As you say this, you purse your lips again, not very happy.
Spamton lowered his gaze, thought for a moment, and gave a completely different answer: "Hmm...... I actually think it's not quite so. Maybe the male lead was just afraid of a failed confession, so he adopted an extreme strategy. ”
You pouted your cheeks: "That's way too extreme...... Or maybe I think it's a bit crazy. Anyway, I don't like it, but the female lead looks so cool when solving cases! I really like her...... Yeah, the male lead is a guy too, right? "As you talk, you get a bit frustrated and can't help but start waving Spamton's hand, swinging it back and forth.
"I also like that female lead too, because for the male lead, she's probably the only place for storing his obsession." Spamton said this but didn't look at you. He was a little scared. If you disliked that male lead like this—would you hate him too? But it didn't matter, as long as you kept your identity hidden, Spamton still knew his limits.
As he thinks this, he just squeezes your hand slightly. You don't notice, just resting your chin with your other hand and pondering for two seconds: "Hmm...... You mean the film's final flashback, where the female lead helped the male lead when his entire family died, he was bullied, and even subjected to cold violence and beatings? "At the end of the film, before the male lead was caught by the female lead, he had some reminiscence, and at the same time...... He also joked that he couldn't go back to the past long ago, because he had already punished those who had bullied him long ago.
You turn to look at Spamton, see him nod gently, and you smile too: "Oh my...... Does she seem very affectionate? But for the female lead, that's just a casual display of kindness. After watching the movie, I think she's always been wonderful. If she meets innocent people at a crime scene, she'll comfort them kindly, and if she finds small animals on the street, she'll help them. Actually...... I think this kind of female lead actually has the qualities of a 'white moonlight.' You said this, casually kicking stones on the road.
Spamton, on the other hand, was momentarily stunned, then smiled softly in his heart. He felt that using the word 'white moonlight' to describe you was very fitting......
Moreover, he had long since gone mad. To stand in this position, he had done everything, and he could no longer go back. He still looked at you, still quietly gazed at you, still longing for you.
No matter how many times it happens, no matter how long it takes, his gaze will always fall on you.
Unaware, you happily pulled Spamton into the dessert shop. Inside, there was milk tea, coffee, and all kinds of snacks and desserts. You flipped through the menu, hesitated for a long time, but finally ordered a Jasmine Milk Green Tea, then a matcha cake and a sandwich, and finally handed the menu to Spamton.
"Hmm...... Is this really enough? Spamton smiled, flipping through the menu.
You nodded, seriously: "I can't eat too much either...... Just order whatever you want! After all, you just treated me to a movie, so I should return the favor. ”
Spamton just shook his head: "Hmm...... No, it's my [romantic pursuit], so I should [pay for everything]. "As he spoke, he ordered a cappuccino, two tiramisu, a strawberry mille crepe, and a Napoleon cake.
You paused. Of course you understood what Spamton meant. He said that since he was pursuing you, it was only right for him to spend money...... But you always felt like you owe him a favor, and besides, you were ready to agree.
So in the end, you hesitated for a moment, but under Spamton's puzzled gaze, you finally spoke: "You can't say that...... I've already, I'm ready to accept your confession, so this counts as our joint date, and it's only right for me to pay." "You're holding on like this."
Spamton just smiled and continued to look at you, softly asking, "So, ...... do you like me?" ”
You shook your head and nodded again, showing a smile: "I...... I'm not sure, but if liking is just about caring and being good to you, then I'm sure I like you. "You've thought it over over the past few working days. You care about your neighbor, and you're willing to give everything you have to be good to him. So, this is probably what liking you is."
Then Spamton smiled and pointed to his own lips: "In that case...... a [kiss request]?" ”
You were stunned for a moment, your face flushed instantly, but you still closed your eyes, stood up, and leaned in to gently kiss Spamton's lips. His lips were icy cold, and you intended to part with a touch, but Spamton suddenly hugged your head, gently tracing your lips with his tongue. When you sat back down, you felt a bit dizzy from the kiss, your cheeks flushed, and you looked at Spamton, wanting to bite him again. He subtly licked his lips with his tongue, as if reminiscing about the taste from earlier. At the same time, the desserts and drinks you ordered were brought to the table.

title: vagrant17 (dnsx you)
content:
Spamton pushed those two small plates of tiramisu toward you. You paused for a moment, then smiled and accepted them. You chatted casually while eating cake, and you cheerfully started talking about what happened at work a couple of days ago.
"I feel like a lot of roses have been sold lately. Maybe Valentine's Day is coming soon...... I wonder if there are any other Valentine's Day customs here in the Dark World?" As you spoke, you looked at Spamton curiously, but Spamton just shook her head
"No, only by giving each other chocolate is to show your love or care." He said, and you nodded as you listened, which sounded pretty much like the habits of the Light World...... Then you should prepare some chocolate for Spamton as well! Although you're not very good at making chocolate, you can still melt the original and reshape it according to the mold.
You happily dig up tiramisu and eat it, shaking your legs: "That doesn't sound much different from the Light World...... Well, then on Valentine's Day, I'll give you my gift." "Anyway, melting chocolate and then making a box for him isn't too difficult."
Spamton nodded and smiled gently: "Yes, recently, the purchase volume of [romantic gifts] has also surged. There are probably many [Dark People] preparing Valentine's Day gifts. ”
"Oh...... Wow, it sounds like everyone values this festival. Is Valentine's Day important in the Dark World too? "You can't help but be curious. You know that the Dark People are, to some extent, just creatures made up of objects. Do these creatures have emotions too?
"Perhaps the [Dark People] also possess a [Burning Heart]." he said.
You also remembered that little pervert who harassed you every day on your phone. No comment or denial, but he didn't message you today. That's really rare—hmm, maybe he went out too? But then again, today is the weekend, and every time he sends messages, he sits at a different time from his neighbor...... Thinking this, you look at Spamton, then you deny yourself, or maybe you just don't dare to think further. After all, Spamton is so polite—how could he possibly be the same person as that little pervert?
Absolutely no chance.
But as you think about it, you suddenly remember a question: poking at the matcha cake with your fork, and you look at Spamton: "Hmm...... But you must be a salesman or something, right? So Addison? ”
Spamton was momentarily stunned, but still nodded. He was a bit nervous; he didn't want you to link the two identities, and he didn't want you to discover that he had become like this now—but it didn't matter, as long as he could have you.
You get a definite answer and press on, asking, "In that case, have you ever seen a pure white Addison?" As you spoke, you sized up Spamton. He had well-groomed black hair and was wearing clothes with red stripes today. To be honest, the image of Addison in your memory has long since faded...... You don't even know what he's changed now.
Spamton propped his hands under his chin, just tilted his head slightly, then gently shook it: "No, I haven't seen Addison like that with my own eyes." "He lied. He had seen himself countless times in the mirror—that desperate shadow that swore one day to trample people underfoot. But now, when he looked in the mirror again, he felt a bit dazed, because...... In the mirror, he seemed unable to capture the white Addison he once was. But what did it matter? He wished he could sever ties with his former self—but no, he still needed you.
So he was always hesitating and struggling.
And you hesitate for a moment, stare at Spamton for a while, and in the end you deny yourself. You don't think that white Addison from back then would look like this now.
You shake your head, denying yourself, feeling it's a bit ridiculous...... Maybe it's really ridiculous.
Although you were a bit curious about where that white Addison had gone, now that you had finished the dessert, you took the initiative to pull Spamton up: "Mm...... Alright, but we're done eating, let's go! "Saying that, you rushed to the counter to pay, then you grabbed Spamton's arm and walked out, even leaning in to kiss him on the lips. His mouth was still a bit sweet, while Spamton tasted a bit bitter and sweet in yours, just like his mood.
…… Just like the sweetness he felt at this moment because he couldn't let you accept all his bitterness, and the sweetness that came from you agreeing to his confession. Spamton held your hand as you walked out, while you bounced around, occasionally glancing back at Spamton. To be honest, you were still a bit nervous and uneasy, since this was your first time in love—and with a Dark Folk at that. Of course, you also felt joy, as if just being with him made you very happy.
However...... However, you took a few more steps forward, then suddenly stopped. You were a bit unsteady, but you still wanted to straighten up. But all you saw before your eyes were black-and-white noise. Then, suddenly, it was as if all the strength in your body—or rather, all your perception in that instant was completely drained. Your mind was filled with pain, scattering spasms, and dizziness. Instinctively, you leaned forward, wanting to fall forward.
Your eyes were half-open, half-closed, and at that moment you lost consciousness. Although you recovered the next, you still couldn't move freely. And you saw—you saw Spamton panic-stricken and hug you, then took out a red medicine bottle from his pocket and poured out three pills to feed you.
You were briefly confused, then you realized that Spamton was the little pervert who kept texting you to harass you—he was actually the white Addison.
At first, you just felt confused, a bit heavy in your heart, and for a moment, you didn't realize what was happening now. Then...... Then, the blurry figure of the white Addison in your memory matched the figure of Spamton in front of you. At that moment, you suddenly felt a sense of grief. You didn't know why he had become like this, why he kept harassing you, or why he deceived you.
In the end, you only feel your heart feels heavy and heavy, as if you are soaking in seawater. You understand all this, and you can't blame him...... He comes to confess to you, no wonder when Spamton walks beside you, you don't feel like you're being followed, no wonder they always appear at different times. Is that feeling really liking, is it love? You don't know, you only know he truly cares about you, even to the point of doing such a perverse thing. And just now, you accepted his confession without knowing anything and were still planning to prepare gifts for him.
…… Your romance ended just because it was fake. You were deceived by him, you should have been very angry, you should have been very angry—after all, he really has caused a lot of trouble in your life. But is it really troublesome? He cleans your room, tidies your clothes, prepares dinner, takes care of your cat, and even ...... He even cares about your condition.
So after feeling the sadness and anger of the deception in that moment, all you have left is helplessness. You look at this Addison, who somehow has become what he is now, at the rare guy whose face no longer has a smile. Finally, when all consciousness returns, you stand up, head bowed as you look at Spamton, who was still half-crouched on the ground. Your voice is muffled, tinged with bitterness and sadness: "...... I hate you." ”
You left these words behind, turned around, and hurried toward home. You were afraid, afraid that if you saw him again, you would lose control of your emotions. You were also afraid, afraid that his smile would make you feel pity and sympathy, and instinctively soften. Your mind was a mess of thoughts, and you were just ...... Just hurrying along, desperately hoping to get home and sort out all these thoughts.
But as you hurried forward, you heard the sound of running behind you. Then, you felt someone grab your sleeve. You knew it must be Spamton. Turning around, you saw him lowering his head and whispering to you: "[Sorry]." ”
…… What you need isn't just this one 'sorry', or rather, you don't even know what you really need. But when he finished speaking, the tears you had managed to hold back finally fell. Trembling, you used your other hand to pry open the fingers tightly gripping your sleeve one by one. You sobbed, your voice inevitably growing louder, emotional, and with a trembling voice of sobs: "Liar...... Liar! Stay away from me, stay away from me...... I hate you, I hate you...... Hate you......" You murmured this sentence, and the next second, Spamton just reached out and grabbed your other sleeve.
He knows everything has been exposed, and at this moment, you probably know everything clearly—but, but he can't just watch you collapse in front of him, can't watch you endure such pain, can't watch you limp away.
He just whispered, "Don't [abandon] me, just [mind me], [mind me]." He quietly repeated this sentence.
You sniffed, your emotions calming down a bit, then pried his fingers apart and continued walking toward your own house: "You liar, pervert, lunatic...... I hate you, ......" As you spoke, you wiped your cheek with your finger and fiercely dodged Spamton's hand.
Spamton is still following behind you. You can hear his footsteps, but he just carefully tugs at your sleeve. You have no strength to break free from him, your body trembling from crying, powerless, and you can only let him move.

title: vagrant18 (dnsx you)
content:
You didn't want to pay attention to him anymore. After all, you were crying too weakly now. You stiffly walked toward home, while Spamton carefully tugged at your sleeve behind you, following closely behind. He was still murmuring the same words, sounding a bit humble and a bit sentimental, but all you felt inside was the helplessness that burned with anger.
Spamton kept repeating the same phrase: "[Mind Me]...... "You [Mind Me]......"
But you just walk to the door, then tremble as you take out your keys, open the door, and walk in.

Tears rolled down from your eyes again. You raised your voice a little, but by now you were already exhausted, so your voice sounded hoarse—just a bit louder than usual.
You looked at him, tried to shake his hand off but couldn't. With red eyes, you looked at Spamton and choked out, "...... I hate you, stay away from me." At this moment, your mood was still fairly calm, and you tried to stay calm.
Spamton just shook his head: "No, I can't [distance myself] from you. I'm afraid of your sudden [death warning], and I'm afraid I can't ...... "I can actually see you." "His words were a bit difficult when he spoke. He lowered his head, not daring to meet your gaze. He felt a bit guilty, but more important than all that was you—that you could survive."
You take a deep breath and do your best to keep your peace. Looking at him, you still can't help but sob and say, "So why did you do this? Why did you lie to me?" "You want to close this door, want to cut Spamton off your life for good, but you know he has the key to your room, he installed cameras in your room, and his rescue invades your life like it's everywhere."
You're tired, your body is growing more and more exhausted, you don't have the energy to move anymore, and you don't want to spend any more energy fiddling with door locks and cameras. In other words...... Do you really hate this little pervert's behavior? Maybe not, at least...... You do have a feeling that you realize there are people who don't care about anything, don't care about what happens to you, only care about you, but in any case, you are angry about this deception, and you should be angry at their actions.
…… Yes, at least you can feel anger, at least you should feel angry because of him.
So you just look at him, look at Spamton, and wait for his answer, even though you might never be satisfied with whatever he answers.
He finally lifted his head and looked at you again. He seemed to hesitate for a moment, then whispered, "Because I am truly loyal to you, because I'm afraid you won't be able to accept the whole me, because I hope you can ...... be happy." "Of course, he also hopes you can belong completely to him, but now it seems he ...... Hmm, it seems like he messed up. But it's okay, at least you still have time.
You sniffed, finally unable to hold back. Tears streamed down your eyes, dripping and soaking the road in front of your door. You just stubbornly looked at him and raised your voice a bit more. This time, it sounded like an emotional outburst from the peak of a breakdown, because your body began to tremble uncontrollably. Spamton wanted to reach out to support you, but hesitated and didn't dare to act.
"You...... You liar, you know, do you know this hurts me? I, I'm telling you...... Ugh, I'm not happy at all, I hate you, I hate you...... Even though you don't know what love is, you still feel like it's not really love.
Spamton gestured, trying to explain to you: "I think after learning the truth, you'll [completely loath] me. I want to keep the 'good memories' from back then, I hope...... I hope you can feel more of 'kindness.' "No matter what identity you are, in the end, you radiate kindness. He knows, and you know that even though he constantly invades your private sphere, in reality, everything he does ultimately aligns with your wishes. In fact...... You can't completely dislike him.
But at this very moment, you still need to vent your emotions. Your sobbing grows louder, your body heavs and trembles, and that uncontrollable sense of helplessness gradually envelops you: "Wu...... Now you're satisfied. I hate you, I hate you...... I hate you!! I never want to see you again...... Let me go, let me die alone...... "You cried and cried, but your body was eventually wrapped in helplessness. For a moment, you couldn't move any more and could only choke up as you spoke. Spamton held you tightly, about to collapse from the last moment. He gently closed your door, then laid you down on the sofa. He crouched halfway to look at you, lowered his eyelids, and finally whispered again.
"...... [Sorry]."
You lie on the sofa, sobbing and feeling the tingling from your body twitch a little more, you watch as Spamton skillfully opens the fridge, takes out some ingredients, and walks into the kitchen. Then comes the sound of cooking smoke—he's preparing dinner for you.
He placed a steak and pasta on the table, along with fried bacon enoki mushrooms and a fried egg, then covered it with a thermos. Then he picked up the kitten that wanted to snuggle up to you and gently coaxed, "She's not feeling well...... Don't go bother her." Then he poured in cat food and canned cat food, and the kitten came over to eat.
Finally, Spamton knelt in front of you again and whispered, "If you want to [beat] or [insult] me, I'm free...... Just [mind me], that's enough. "He said humbly.
You look down at him from above, and the tears you barely managed to hold back almost welled up again. You want to scold him, but all you do is respond with a few words. You've never tried hitting anyone...... But now, you do want to vent your emotions on him.
You dislike this a little, but you have no choice but to accept it, because you've long been used to this perverted care. Without him...... Maybe you'll get bumps and bumps on your body, and the last days won't be exactly happy.
You don't know what feelings you feel right now. You don't seem to dislike him enough, but the feelings of affection and joy that just rose shattered with the fact that he gave you medicine—that identical red medicine bottle, three pills...... You never told anyone; only the anonymous pervert who had been monitoring you all along knew.
You sniffled, feeling the grievances and anger in your heart that needed to be vented: "Pervert, liar, you lunatic, I really hate you...... Are you crazy? You still want to get close to me, I hate you, you're really too twisted...... But over and over, it's just these few sentences.
"Well, I'm a [pervert], a liar, a lunatic, but...... But don't keep [hating me]." His voice was still soft, but listening to his words made you cry even harder.
"What, I have to hate you...... I hate you......" You repeat this sentence, as if you can truly hate him completely, but you know you probably never truly hate him; you even somewhat depend on this pervert...... You keep feeling like you're starting to hate yourself a little.
You sobbed, leaned over to look at him, and raised your hand—even though your hand was still a bit numb and weak, you still reached out and used all your strength to slap Spamton's face. A red mark immediately appeared on his pale face. Spamton knew you were angry...... He sensed your anger too, and his face obediently slapped askew from you. But then he lifted the other side of his face toward you and softly said, "Darling...... If you want to [vent your anger], hit here again—[Symmetry and Unity]. ”
You think, 'Where is it that just delivered to someone's door?' But you pouted and still slapped him across the face. Unexpectedly, he grabbed your hand and gently licked it in your palm, his voice a bit muffled: "Baby's hand hurts a lot, right? Does this make it a little better?" ”
You pulled your hand back, and this time it was easy. He didn't stop your movement. You turned your head away and didn't look at him: "...... You pervert, are you crazy? You still want to lick my hand...... you mutter.
He just continued humbly, "Mm, I'm a pervert, dear...... Let's have dinner first. ”
You were indeed a bit hungry. You hadn't eaten enough at lunch, and crying for so long had taken a lot of energy. You stood up and instinctively swayed a little. Spamton quickly caught you, shook off his hand, and staggered over to the dining table, sat down, and opened the warming hood. No matter what...... The food was just right for your taste. No matter what, you were used to it—to the dinner prepared every day, to the texts every day, to the daily commute schedule. Biting your lip, tears welled up in your eyes. You glanced over and saw Spamton still half-crouching beside you. So you pointed at the door, sniffed, and said resolutely, "Get out, get out right now. I don't want to see you right now." ”
Spamton got up as instructed. He walked to your door, still turned to look at you, then reluctantly closed the door. You sat there for a while before finally burying your head in tears.

Spamton returned home, turned on the surveillance camera, and watched you. Listening to your faint sobbing, he tensed up again. He felt as if his chest ached. He didn't want to see you cry; he hoped you could always smile brightly—preferably because of him.

[Baby...... Today, I'm sorry, but I can't just stand by and watch you suffer ......>X<]

But his original intention was just to get a little closer to you, just to see you smile at him, just to look at you...... He just wanted to look at you, that's all.

[Baby is right, it's useless...... But the baby is still willing to talk to me, the baby is really kind, I really like her ^^]
This time, you looked at Spamton's message, just pursed your lips and replied with a simple 'mm.' Then you ignored your phone, went to the bathroom to tidy yourself up, and threw yourself onto the bed. You were so exhausted that you fell asleep in no time.

But you found breakfast still in front of the door—bread, a sandwich, a fried egg, and a glass of milk, with a note stuck beside it. You glanced at Spamton, who was also smiling at you. You didn't really want to talk to him, but still whispered, "...... Thank you." ”
Spamton's eyes curved with a smile: "This is all what I should do." He was a bit pleased. You were still willing to talk to him, and you accepted his breakfast in the morning, which proved you weren't completely or completely ignoring him. That was fine.

You quietly moved a little to the side, avoiding him, while Spamton only moved a little closer, and your shoulders rubbed against each other from time to time.

His burning gaze fixed on your face, then on your neck. Spamton couldn't help but swallow softly, always thinking...... What would it feel like if you bit it? Even if it was just a gentle lick?
You really couldn't hold back anymore. You tilted your head and glared at him, whispering, "Watch the road, why are you always looking at me?" ”
"Because [I like you], I want to watch you [every moment]." His voice was soft, and you could still feel his gaze falling on you, just not as intense as before.
Silent all the way, you walk into the flower shop and instinctively smile at the owner, announcing you're on duty.
Spamton's eyes showed a hint of grievance. He wanted your smile too, and he didn't want to have only this moment—even though, even though you still cared about him a little, even though he was satisfied, everyone was greedy, especially him, he hoped...... Wishing you could smile at him more often, or just smile at him—how wonderful that would be.

Your phone vibrated twice. You opened the screen, saw his message, and inevitably rolled your eyes.
[Oh, then I'll quit. ]
Spamton looked down pitifully at the message, not very happy, but after a while, he saw you come out again holding flowers, so he cheered up again because he could sit here and watch you.

After all, you wanted this guy to get some retribution. As long as he wasn't happy, you'd be happy.

Spamton watched this scene, his chest souring with bubble after bubble. He wasn't very happy, but could only stare at the scene, staring at the scene he found especially glaring, continuing to send you messages: [Baby, don't smile at those customers, they're not worth it at all!] ]
You just replied coldly with a [Oh. ]
Then you smile even brighter at the next customer.

You have to smile and greet him well. If we close his orders, we'll have even bigger deals later!" He excitedly rubbed his hands together.
You forced a stiff face and gave Spamton a smile, your voice stammering and a bit stiff: "Hello, sir, what would you like to do?" ”
Spamton looked at your fake, fake smile, feeling a bit bitter inside. He simply asked in a low voice, "I...... If you want to [apologize], which flower is more suitable? ”
Looking at him, you know he's apologizing. You don't really want to accept it, but you still ask him to wait a moment, then prepare a bouquet of flowers—probably made of yellow roses, lilies, and lavender, with some baby's breath as decoration.
You handed the bouquet to Spamton, your tone still dry: "Sir, the flowers you want are 10,000 Dark Coins." "You did it on purpose, quoted such a high price. The store manager's eyes widened. Actually, the bouquet was only 100 Dark Coins. Just as he was about to say something, he saw Spamton pull out a check, write 10,000 Dark Coins, and hand it to you, then take the bouquet."

You couldn't help but ask, your tone a bit choked: "What are you doing here?" ”
“…… I'll prepare a delicious dinner for you." He said this without telling you that this was actually part of his apology, and ...... You've probably long since gotten used to the dinner he makes, so it's probably impossible to get rid of him so easily now.
You remained silent, and you had indeed gotten used to this dinner. So in the end, you sat on the sofa, looked at the bouquet, and finally placed it on the table, and then...... You opened your phone and casually scrolled through it, letting the sound of cooking smoke fill the kitchen.

content:

You still care about him, you still ...... Or rather, you subconsciously notice him.
Is this love? You don't know; you only know that if you are sure it is love, you will hate the self that still loves you, if that is not love...... You will hate the self who still cares about him, your soul, your heart, and your own pain and love despite being hurt, hating that you still cannot let go of that hurt and this love—or what is called love.
Because, you know, in this world...... Probably only this one person will say he loves you from beginning to end, and you cannot let go of this feeling, nor the comfort and warmth you feel from it.

You don't answer him, but you finish your plate, put the rest on the table, and walk off to the bathroom on your own. You don't really know what your current relationship is, but maybe, you ...... You really don't dislike him.
Otherwise, why would you pretend to be cold and say at this moment, "Oh, by the way, you haven't washed the clothes I changed out of yesterday yet. Remember to wash them thoroughly." ”
Spamton just smiled and responded, his back looking quite cheerful. Of course, at least you're willing to talk to him, at least you can talk to him, no matter how cold or heartless you are—after all, he only needs you.
After tidying up, you lay down on the bed to rest. After finishing washing your things, Spamton quietly glanced at you at your bedroom door, whispered goodnight, and then left your home. You had been lying with your back to the bedroom door, but when you heard that gentle sound, tears welled up in your eyes. You didn't know what that was...... You didn't know, but you were still hoping he would say goodnight to you again tomorrow. You knew you shouldn't be like this.
But in the end, you just curl up into a ball, slowly falling asleep in curled up and crying.
…… No difference. The next few days are no different. Spamton still openly follows you to and from work, and every day when the store closes, he buys a bouquet to represent an apology. But your offer keeps dropping—from 10,000 to 8,000, then 5,000, and finally to 1,000. In the morning, you still eat the breakfast he brings you; at night, he still brazenly walks into your door, prepares dinner for you, washes your clothes, then says goodbye and says goodnight.
…… Think about it, you've probably gotten used to the 'good night' he says every night. Somehow, you always feel like there's a 'I love you' afterward, or maybe ...... That 'good night' was actually born from the words 'I love you' swallowed whole.
You don't realize that you just quietly and silently spent the week until you finished the breakfast he prepared on a weekend morning, heard your phone vibrate twice, and when you opened it, you found a message from Spamton's account.
[Today there's a [newly released] suspense movie. Maybe you'd like to [enjoy it]? ]
You didn't want to pay attention to him, but he would pay for the movie tickets. When you watch a movie, it's basically a private show, let alone a suspense movie...... This is so tempting that you hesitate for a moment, but in the end, you type and reply to him.
[What movie. ]
[It's called 'The Guest,' a film about a visitor [visiting] the host but unexpectedly [exposing the conspiracy]. ] Spamton saw your answer, though it was just a few words, though very cold, even though you still disliked him very much—but that didn't stop Spamton from feeling happy because of your brief answer.
He ...... Well, he just wants to pursue you again. If everything that was before doesn't count, then does everything that starts now count?
In short, Spamton sent you another message, replied instantly, and typed very fast. Once fully exposed, he gave up on the disguise.
[I think you'll [like this film], so I [boldly] invite you to [join the invitation]. ] If you hadn't been typing, you probably would have sent several more messages.
Unfortunately, you don't buy into it, but when you look at these two messages, you can't help but smile. You are indeed a bit curious about what this film actually is.
[How dare you? Anyway, you're really bold. ] You couldn't help but stab him first, since he had been pretending to deceive you for a long time.
But in the next sentence, you still answered seriously: [But I'm very interested in this movie. I'm going to do it.] ]
After sending this message, you put down your phone and went to change into a white and purple dress with lace and lace, adorned with a bow on the chest as decoration. Then you changed clothes and heard a knock on your door.
Spamton looked at the surveillance that hadn't been removed by you; he knocked just in time because you were ready. He knew you were ready.
And you did open the door, snorted coldly at Spamton, and then walked off toward the cinema on your own. Spamton followed, his shoulders rubbing against yours. He cautiously turned his head to glance at you, then smiled, casually shifted his hand toward yours, and gently took yours.
You knew his hand was holding yours, but you pressed your lips together, feeling a bit awkward. In the end, you just turned away and snorted coldly, pretending not to notice. You didn't know what to do anymore. You knew you should reject him, but you didn't really want to say no.
So...... So let's just do it this way. He holds your hand, gently swaying it, his lips curling up unconsciously. Spamton knows he's gotten another chance to slowly get closer to you. He—of course he'll cherish this opportunity, after all, he wants you to be filled with only him.
You walked to the cinema, where he bought two movie tickets, held your hand, and led you to sit down in the theater. You didn't turn to look at him, but you could feel his gaze still burning and wrapping around you. So you couldn't help but shake his hand and whisper, "Why do you always look at me when you look at the movie screen?" "Coincidentally, the movie was also playing at that very moment."
Spamton, on the other hand, just smiled. He wasn't there to watch a movie anyway; he was just looking for a chance to see you. So he simply picked up a popcorn and brought it to your mouth. You watched the movie lost in thought and instinctively ate the popcorn in his hand. Then you paused, annoyed by your own habit—but when Spamton handed over the next popcorn, you couldn't help but eat it.
The movie ends while your mind is still unsettled. You think you might not even have finished watching it, so you can't help but glare at Spamton with a hint of complaint, only to see him still smiling at you. You happen to bump into his pupils. Although he usually keeps his eyes closed, now he opens them and gazes at you with longing. You look at the reflection in his pupils and instinctively turn your head, your face flushing slightly. You hear him seem to chuckle, which makes you even more annoyed. But you say nothing, just nibble hard with your nails on the back of his hand, while your hands remain clasped together until you get home.
You instinctively tried to close the door, but Spamton squeezed in through the crack. You instinctively tried to push him, but your body shuddered and you instinctively fell to the side. Spamton caught you and then laid you down on the sofa. He was still half-kneeling in front of you, looking up at you and whispering, "[Sorry], I know you're still [very angry]...... I don't know how else I can 【make amends】 to you, so whether it's 【punishment】 or 【hitting and scolding】, 【whatever you want】." He knew that although your attitude had loosened a bit, you were still angry. Your eyes told him you were still filled with sadness and anger, and at that moment he saw it. Spamton doesn't know how to ease your emotions either; he's not good at that. He just half-kneels in front of you, tilting his head up to look at you, as if he wants whatever he wants.
You looked down at him, tears silently streaming down your cheeks. For some reason, you couldn't hold back your own crying again. You sniffled, having told yourself long ago to be strong...... But at this moment, you still lifted your foot. Today you were wearing low heels, and because you almost fell earlier, you didn't take them off. You hesitated for a moment, but in the end, you just stepped on his chest, staining his clothes. Then, with all your might, in what you call the fiercest tone, you said, "I hate you, I hate you. If only you could stay a little farther away from me......" As you spoke, you stomped his chest, pressing it down.
Spamton let out a muffled groan, feeling a bit hot and erect below. He simply lowered his head, sincerely cupped your foot, gently kissed the top of it, and whispered, "...... Mm, [I love you]. ”

title: vagrant21 (dnsx you)

Seeing him like this actually made her a bit uncomfortable. She just awkwardly tilted her head aside and said softly, '...Wait.'
Spamton indeed stopped in his tracks, smiling as he looked in your direction—he knew you probably wouldn’t really be cruel enough to let him leave, and of course, even if he left, he couldn’t get very far from you. It’s just that compared to the current distance, he would be a bit farther away, probably… probably just a little beyond you, falling behind you and watching you like this.
"Baby...... Is there any other 【special request】? His words sounded somewhat ambiguous, and the nickname he said carried a more erotic tone. His gaze was dark and unreadable, waiting for your answer. He looked at your fair neck, at your defenseless demeanor, wanting so much...... How he wished to have you completely at this moment, every moment, but he gently licked his teeth, knowing there was no rush about it.
…because he genuinely wants your true heart, wants your care, and longs for your smile.
And you slightly raised your voice, your fingers anxiously gripping the sofa. While saying this sentence, you were also a bit nervous, your heart pounding like a drum. You knew that perhaps once this sentence was spoken, some things could never return to the way they were.
But in the end, you still closed your eyes and said, 'You haven't prepared dinner for me yet.'
So Spamton changed direction and walked towards the kitchen. He asked absentmindedly, 'Want to [use the recipe]?'
You puckered your lips and turned your head back to look at Spamton busy over by the fridge, whimsically instructing, 'I want to eat fruit pizza, but not too sweet. You know my taste.'
You stared at him, watching as he took out flour and fruit. Soon, the sound of water running in the kitchen and the rotation of the oven could be heard. You silently sat down at the dining table, and after a while, Spamton brought over a steaming hot pizza for you, topped with mango and some melon-like fruits. You picked up a piece, and the pizza had a sticky, cheesy texture. You took a bite, and the slightly sweet flavor mixed with a hint of salt filled your mouth. However, the saltiness wasn't strong; it just balanced the overly sweet taste of the fruit, making the pizza not too sweet, perfectly suiting your taste.
You lightly bit your lip, saying nothing, and just picked up another slice of pizza. And Spamton only softly asked, 'Do you like [flavor]?'
……Actually, you really like this taste, but in the end, you just muttered in a muffled voice: 'It's okay.' Your voice was brief, and you quickly lowered your head. Your tears were welling up in your eyes, about to fall, but you didn't want Spamton to see them. You didn't want him to know… that you were actually, to some extent, moved by him. No matter what, in the corners of your mind that you can't admit to and don't want to touch, you do care about him a little.
Spamton lifted the corners of his mouth. Although you only said it like that, he took it as a compliment, so he couldn't help but lean slightly closer to you, and then cautiously asked in a soft voice, 'So... could you give me [a hug]?'
You didn't respond to him; you were afraid that tears would well up when you spoke, so you just pulled your chair forward a little, as a way of refusing. But Spamton seemed completely unaware, as if he couldn't tell, just smiling as he leaned in. From behind you, he gently circled you around the chair, resting his head lightly on your shoulder. You could feel a bit of warm breath from his mouth blowing on your ear. For some reason, you just felt a little flushed, as if your ears had become hot.
He was just holding you, his eyes slightly lowered, softly repeating in your ear: '...I love you, [I really love you], darling, I really [can't lose you]... I just want to [keep holding you like this], I just want to [look at you]...' He murmured quietly, but every word was saying he loved you. You bit your lip, blinked, and finally couldn't hold back the tears in your eyes, letting them fall onto his arms gently wrapped around you. Spamton was slightly stunned, then he tilted his head, wanting to nuzzle and gently lick the tears falling down your cheeks. You awkwardly turned your head to avoid his lips, and Spamton didn't try again. He simply rested his chin on your shoulder, his cheek gently rubbing against yours. You didn't make a sound; at first, your body was a bit stiff, but it gradually softened. Unconsciously, your back seemed to break out in a cold sweat, and you just lightly wiped the tears from your face with your hand, then gently pushed Spamton's hand away, and he obediently pulled back. You didn't know how much time had passed; you just softly said to him, 'Alright, you can go now.'
After saying that, you hung your head and sat quietly in the chair. Spamton washed the bowls and plates, then stood at the doorway, looking at you still sitting in the chair without raising your head, and just softly said good night to you before closing the door and leaving.
You wiped your tears two more times before lifting your head, expressionless, carrying your change of clothes into the bathroom. You felt a bit vengeful again—perhaps taking revenge for his silent hug just now, perhaps for his attempt at an overstepping kiss, or maybe you were just taking revenge on yourself. You quickly finished washing up, turned on the heater in the room, and then walked out wearing only your underwear.
You lifted your gaze and looked at the tiny camera, which still faintly glowed red, and lightly moved your lips: Seeing this scene, are you satisfied? This is what you wanted to see, right?
Then you lay on the sofa by yourself. The little cat had become sleek and shiny during this time, and now it jumped onto the sofa and nestled on your lower abdomen. You lay there, tears rolling in your eyes.
…You know, Spamton is just a hopeless, lousy, perverted guy, and you… you’ve already become hopeless too.
Meanwhile, Spamton, watching the surveillance in the neighboring house, instinctively covered his nose. He tilted his head, his gaze wandering everywhere, just not daring to look at the screen again. He could only hurriedly grab another phone—the one he usually used to send annoying messages to you—and quickly typed a message.
Baby TAT, hurry up and put on your clothes, you'll catch a cold like this, it's not good for your health.
You casually looked at the message, feeling a bit tired from typing while lying down, so you turned over before replying to him. Your legs were crossed casually, and Spamton happened to glance at the screen. His face turned red again, and his nosebleed wouldn't stop flowing. He hurriedly grabbed two pieces of tissue to stop the nosebleed and stared at the screen intently, waiting for your reply.
"It doesn't matter, the heater is on, it's comfortable this way." You type casually and lazily, and it takes a while before he receives your reply.
Spamton swallowed softly; of course… of course he wanted to completely possess you, wanted to see you clearly in every way, but at this very moment, you seemed to be doing it on purpose. He felt a bit delighted, yet also a bit bitter. He knew that perhaps you were not entirely sincere.
But no matter what, he still took a deep breath, calming the intense beating in his chest. He looked at you almost greedily, tracing your figure through the surveillance. He wanted to watch you every moment; if he couldn’t see you—he might as well kill himself. He thought, this must be love, this surely is love.
He was just quickly typing on his phone: [The heating isn’t enough either, OTTO, it’s really cold in this weather... Baby, you must take care of your health TTTT]
[And haven't you taken your medicine today yet? Hurry up and take your medicine, dear, I will watch you take it >X<]
[And then there's that cat... How many times have I told that cat to go away QWQ, does baby like the cat more?]
You looked at these few text messages with hatred. Honestly, even with the heater on, after the temperature from the bathroom dissipated, you still felt a bit cold, so you took the coat next to you and put it on yourself. Spamton couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Then, pouting in dissatisfaction, you took a small red bottle of medicine from the drawer, poured out three pills, and swallowed them. He had always reminded you to take your medicine, and after your identity was exposed, he became even more insistent on you remembering to take it. You had been thinking of giving up anyway, because whether you took the medicine or not, it would only extend your time by a little, but you still took the medicine under his reminders.
In the end, you replied to his message: [You saw it, took the medicine, I won't let myself get cold.]
[I don't like cats more, but I hate you.]
Spamton stared at the text message, watching your movements on the surveillance, and only then let out a slight breath. He didn't want to see you faint in front of him again, so he kept urging you to take your medicine. He tapped and knocked, ignoring your indifference, feeling happy—after all, it seemed that you wrote more words today than yesterday, and he had always remembered that.
[Mm-hmm, baby is great! \><//Praise the baby, I like my dear the most]
[So dear... do you like me just a tiny little bit, just a tiny bit~~^^~~]
You sneered, curling up on the sofa, letting your coat wrap around you, giving you a bit of warmth, the minimal warmth that ensures you won't get into trouble. You are too lazy to bother; you have no intention of troubling yourself... You won't be able to enjoy it for long.
You looked at the text he sent and couldn't help but lift the corners of your mouth, then lowered them again. You kept a cold expression while sending him messages.
[What an idiotic question, you obviously know that I really dislike you.]
[...But maybe just a little, only a tiny bit.] You hesitated for a moment, but still had to admit this point.
Even if everything in the past was a deceit, a lie... you still care about all of it.

But you look at your phone screen, frowning as you tap on it, half-complaining: "You're so naggy, you get involved in this matter." ]

Spamton is still following behind you, no longer walking side by side with you, probably because of what you said over the weekend. And when you hear Spamton's steady, unhurried footsteps behind you, you feel a bit annoyed, or maybe just a little annoyed. You can't help but quicken your pace and walk ahead. You glance back quietly, and he's still following at the same speed, which makes you even more annoyed. But no matter how fast you pace, you can hear the same footsteps—unhurried, like a demon clinging to you.

On the other hand, you seem ...... not really want to do that.
You probably really are used to his presence, so you just stared blankly at your phone, letting him walk around your home, letting him appear before you. You no longer deliberately raised the price, just still sold him one thousand dark coins.
But on the other hand...... That powerless feeling has been accumulating in your heart, ready to burst out at any moment. As the checkup approaches, you inevitably become irritable, anxious, or even nervous. You know the last time the doctor said you'd live no more than five years, but you don't know what kind of judgment they'll make this time. You took a deep breath, inevitably tears welling up in your eyes, and your voice trembled: "...... Then what is the love you talk about? It's just looking at me like this, clinging to me like this. Is this your love?" "Actually, you don't really know what true love looks like. You're just deliberately making things difficult for him...... You don't know what that really is, but you do know it was the only comfort in the final loneliness of your life. You were probably just afraid, afraid that in the end, the only person who cared about you would leave.
But Spamton simply grabbed your hand and kissed gently, his voice murmuring with a hint of ambiguity: "Yes, [I love you], I [long to gaze] at you, I [always care about being with you], I [hope you belong to me], I [hope you'll think I belong to you]." As he spoke, just about to kiss your wrist, you just pulled your hand back. Your hand trembled, so the force wasn't very strong. You just slapped him, and his face obediently tilted to your movement, leaving a faint red mark.
Then you pulled your hand back and grabbed the sofa, closed your eyes, and shouted at him almost hysterically, "You know very well, I told you I'm about to die, I won't belong to you at all! I don't think you're anything to me...... Please stop clinging to me, okay...... I have no choice...... I really have no choice, I truly hate you. "By the end, your voice gradually faded, choking with tears, and in the end, tears couldn't help but flow down your cheeks.
He invades your life, and whenever you think of anything, you always think of him. You ...... You seem to have lost the courage to leave him on your own, and you don't even know what you're venting for—you're just ...... Can't help it, even if someone knows what you're thinking and understands what you're afraid of. Yes, you're scared and panicking. If this guy doesn't know...... Then he's really failing.
But he just held your hand, gently pressed it against his other face, and softly said, "Mm, if the baby wants to [vent], just hit me. That feels a bit better." ”
You paused for a moment, then gently patted his face. Now there were faint red marks on both sides of his cheeks, and he just held your waist, gently resting his chin on your legs, and said, "I know you're afraid of panic, but I love you. If you [will eventually leave or die], then I...... can only [follow] you. Without you, I have nothing [I care about]—my [love] [nowhere to anchor], my [desires] [nowhere to store]...... No matter what I want to say, want to [scold], [confide], I will always be by your side, because [no matter what] I [care]. "As he spoke, this sentence sounded like a gentle vow...... But you know, he said, if you're gone, he'll die too.
You lowered your head, tears still streaming down your cheeks, and Spamton caught them in his palm. Then he stood up and embraced you, kneeling on the sofa, enveloping you.
You didn't stop him, and Spamton pushed further, starting kissing your chin and licking your tears. Your body trembled slightly, because you were too emotionally charged and you had little strength left. Your hands weakly rested on the sofa, your voice trembling and a little low: "You're really annoying...... Absolutely annoying...... "Why does he even care about your death...... Has even death become something you no longer feel free about? But you don't care...... If you're no longer free, then so be it. Admit you've become hopeless, if...... If he can survive, then you can live on too. It's fine to just live like that.
What exactly are romance, love, and feelings of affection? Those things no longer matter...... In short, you're not living for those things; you just care a little, just a little.
In the end, you hugged him back with your hands that had regained some strength. You buried your head in the hollow of his shoulder, tears soaking his clothes, while you choked back tears and said, "...... I hate you." "You hate him, you hate that he deceived you and always clings to you.
He just softly responded with a hum.
“…… Hate you. "You hate him, hate him, hate him, making you so used to him this way, this way of caring for him, this ...... The way you can't stay away from him. You hate him, hating him makes you feel like you can only rely on him, and everything can only be confided to him.
"Mm."
“…… I like you." Finally, you whispered. You don't know what it is; you only know that you truly care about him...... Whenever you subconsciously zone out, you always think of him. No matter what, he is always in your life. No matter what, you can't leave him.
"I love you." He simply said softly.

Near the end of work that day, Spamton visited the flower shop again, this time with a different request: "Please give me a bouquet of [Black Roses]." ”

He held your hand as usual, but just leaned in and kissed the corner of your mouth. You didn't avoid it anymore. He just glared at him fiercely.

title: vagrant24 (dnsx you)
content:
…… But before that, you find Spamton mysterious and don't know what to do. If you ask him, he's reluctant to tell you, so you have to give up.
On this day after work, he didn't buy a bouquet of apology flowers as usual, but unusually asked for another: "Please give me a bouquet of [Red Roses]." The manager looked at you again with that expression you couldn't understand. You didn't want to understand either, just wrapped a bouquet of red roses and handed it to Spamton, accepting only one hundred dark coins as usual.
On the way home from work, Spamton, as usual, pressed close to you, your shoulders gently brushing against yours. You tilted your head slightly, and Spamton happened to lean in and kissed you on the lips. You were momentarily stunned, then quickly turned away, not wanting him to see the blush on your cheeks, but when Spamton chuckled, he couldn't help but turn back and glare at him.
He just chuckled and said, "Darling, do you know the exact date today?" "You don't know why he asked you about the date. You can see these things on your phone too."
You only replied impatiently, "I know, today is Friday, today is February 14th—" But at this point, you pause, finally realizing something. You can't help but turn your head, widening your eyes at Spamton, who just smiles at you, the bright roses blooming in his arms.
Yes, today is Valentine's Day, so it's no wonder...... Spamton has been a bit mysterious these past few days, probably planning some surprise for you. You can't help but feel a bit excited.
But in the end, you just awkwardly turned your head away, refusing to look at him: "Oh, today is Valentine's Day, I got it...... But I didn't prepare a gift for you." You really forgot the date, didn't even remember it was Valentine's Day—of course, even if you did, you wouldn't have prepared a gift for Spamton. Although it seems like you've already accepted it now, you haven't officially admitted it yet.
Spamton was smiling too. You turned your head away and couldn't see him, but you can imagine that the smile on his face just involuntarily widened, making you feel a bit embarrassed and annoyed. Honestly—you never intended for this guy to prepare a gift for you.
He simply said softly, "It's okay, I've prepared a [surprise gift] for you. I hope you like it." "Calling it a surprise—there's really nothing too amazing, just this bouquet of roses, the chocolates he made himself, and a cake he gave you for Valentine's Day. He's specially formulated ingredients to suit your taste, guaranteeing you'll love it."
You pursed your lips but didn't say much, just let Spamton hold your hand and lean even closer, as if to pull you into his arms. You only tacitly accepted his actions, until you opened the door and was greeted by darkness.
You paused, about to say something and question Spamton, but he just took your hand and took a step forward. Then, as if a switch was pressed, you saw colorful lights flickering throughout the room, creating a ...... atmosphere. It was a romantic Valentine's Day atmosphere. After all, most of the lights were pink, and in the center of your field of vision, on the wall directly opposite, there were also colored lights. Using these lights, you wrote a message: Happy Valentine's Day.
You paused. The door closed behind you, and then Spamton's arms wrapped around you. He hugged you from behind and handed you the bouquet of roses. His voice was soft, but it was so clear to your ears.
He said softly, "Happy Valentine's Day, please accept my [Surprise Gift]." As he spoke, he took out another box of chocolates and handed them to you. It was heart-shaped packaging, with a red bag tied on top. You carefully opened it, and inside it was all heart-shaped white chocolates. Think about it, you probably never told Spamton you liked white chocolate. You don't know how he knew, but each white chocolate was outlined with dark chocolate and the word 'love' written on it. You paused, then took out a chocolate and popped it into your mouth. The sweet and slightly bitter flavors burst in your mouth—although the chocolate was a bit overly sweet, you really liked the taste, and you really liked the cool, slightly bitter and sweet texture.
You put the box of chocolates on the cabinet beside it, the roses inserted into the vase, then you turned around, burying your head in his chest and hugging him in return. Your voice was still trembling, half excited and moved—after all, a few years ago, you stopped hoping to receive gifts. Your family didn't even celebrate your birthday anymore, since your mother thought your birthday was her day of suffering, and you were already eighteen—no point in throwing you a birthday anymore. Not only that, she also ordered others not to celebrate your birthday, so you never received gifts again.
You sobbed softly, your tears soaking the clothes around Spamton's chest. He felt a little damp, but he just gently stroked your smooth hair with his hand. He opened his eyes slightly, his sticky gaze fixed on you, unwilling to leave for a long time. After all, he just wanted to watch you forever, always, for a long, long time.
His voice was also light and airy, as if it hadn't hit the ground: "Ah...... I know you haven't prepared a [surprise gift], but it's okay. As long as you accept my [surprise gift], I'll be satisfied. But on March 14th...... You need to perform the [Return Gift Work]. As he spoke, his eyes curved slightly, like a cunning fox smiling. But since you didn't see his expression, you naturally didn't notice anything.
And you just sniffed, your voice a bit muffled: "Mm, got it...... I'll return the favor." "It's probably bouquets and chocolates or something like that, but you don't know how to make chocolates. At most, you'd just buy a few brands of chocolate, melt them together, and then reshape them with molds. But you think Spamton would like it even then."
Spamton softly hummed, still holding you, and softly said, "Also...... There's also a [surprise gift]." As he spoke, he finally let go of the embrace, then took your hand and led you to the dining table. He lifted the cover on the table, revealing the blue-purple blueberry cream cake underneath. You widened your eyes slightly; you never expected he had prepared a small cake for you—well, you really love this, since you like blueberry flavor, so you couldn't wait to sit down, cut a piece of cake to taste yourself, and then happily closed your eyes. Wow, this flavor really suits your taste—not overly sweet, but just right for you. Maybe someone who loves sweets finds it a bit bland, but you really love it.
Alright, now there's another question...... You also have to think about whether to prepare a small cake or something like that as a return gift.
You squinted slightly in enjoyment, and Spamton sat across the table, cupping his chin with both hands, smiling warmly at your expression. You put down your fork, pursed your lips, and solemnly said to Spamton, "I...... I really like the dishes you prepared, thank you, hmm...... Anyway, I really like your gift, and then...... And after all, it's Valentine's Day, I—I have to tell you I like you...... Well, just a little bit of liking you, just a little. "You emphasized it this way.
Spamton just nodded, casually responding with a hum, then said lightly, "Mm, I love you, I love you very, very much, I will always love you." ”
You pouted and tilted your head, knowing your cheeks were flushing again. At the same time, you finally prepared yourself to tell him the words you'd been planning to say but couldn't say these past few days.
"I know...... Alright, I have to tell you, I need to go back to the Light World for a check-up in a couple of days. I should be back in a day or two, so don't rush." "You waved your finger. This counts as a promise, and it's also a vow. If you didn't care about Spamton at all, you wouldn't have told him about this."
Spamton just smiled. He knew about your condition, but he couldn't go to the Light World with you or accompany you for a check-up. That was what he felt especially regretful. He could only nod, looking at you with longing. How he wished you could stay in the Dark World forever, but unfortunately...... Your illness is something only the People of Light possess, so you can only go to the Light World for treatment.
You originally thought it would be as agreed, but this follow-up wasn't a big deal—just checking if the tumor inside the brain had expanded.
It's just ...... You just broke your promise and couldn't return to see Spamton at the agreed time. While waiting for a follow-up at the hospital, you suddenly lost consciousness and fell backward to the ground. When you woke up again, you were lying weakly on the hospital bed. The doctor told you that you had suddenly lost consciousness that day. After examining your condition, they couldn't delay any longer and performed surgery. The bad news was that you probably wouldn't be able to move normally for a long time after the surgery, but the good news was...... Previously, the hospital misjudged your condition, but your post-surgery condition is still relatively good. If nothing unexpected happens, you should be able to live for a long time.
