"Of course not, but you just admitted to being a nanny." You cheerfully felt his tail restlessly wrapping around your arm again, snapping your fingers casually.
"But...... I really like how you take care of me. "You said softly.
Spamton stopped making a sound, just circled around to the front and buried himself in your arms. You seemed to see him even glare at the kitten, then deliberately pushed the kitten aside. You sighed, but still hugged Spamton, then pressed the switch, letting the wheelchair run forward automatically.
"I love you." He just repeated the words again, his voice muffled. You casually responded with a hum, but didn't respond. After circling outside twice, you prepared to leave. But...... On the way back, you heard other Dark People discussing. It seemed some Light Folk had entered the Dark World, as if they had just finished dealing with the nearby Dark World. You didn't react to the news; instead, Spamton nervously wrapped his tail even tighter. You didn't know exactly what he was so nervous about, but in the end, you all made it home.
You call out to Spamton to help you out: "It's not convenient for me to be alone, can you help me? I want to take a bath." The kitten, missing one leg, was on the floor, happily hopping around despite only having three legs, while you simply wheeled your wheelchair to the bathroom door, then slowly stood up, holding onto the doorframe. Spamton hurried over to support you, circling you twice, his voice a bit stammering: "I should...... How to [help]? ”
"Hmm, I just have to hold onto the handle...... Help me wash up, like this. "You said, trying hard for a while but still couldn't take off your clothes, and it was Spamton who flew around helping you take them off."
"Is this so, is this ...... [Beyond Logic]?" He was still stammering. You felt like his nose was about to flow again, and you just shrugged, your voice turning a bit pitiful.
"We're a couple, aren't we? And...... Do you want to see me fall in the bathroom? "You said this, blinking at him. Spamton coughed twice; turning into this little thing, he felt a bit embarrassed to help you again...... If things were still like before, he definitely wouldn't be this nervous. If he could go back to the past—he remembered those Lightfolk who had probably come to this world today and heard what he heard today.
But no matter what, he still busied himself, holding soap and towels to help you wash up—it was only then that you truly took off your wig. Spamton saw the scars left on your head, and just a few new strands of hair, gently pressing against you with some tender concern. He didn't know if he could truly feel it with you...... But at that moment, he truly felt pain because of it.
After Spamton cleaned up for you, you changed into your pajamas, lay back down on the bed, and hugged Spamton to sleep again.
The next period was like this, about half a month later. You thought it would always be like this...... In the morning, Spamton prepares breakfast for you. After eating, he pushes your wheelchair, and you go for a walk together. Sometimes you stand up and walk around with your wheelchair for a while. On Sundays, Spamton goes shopping for some things, and you have plenty of money—but that morning, you won't go out, just stay home playing on your phone and wait for Spamton to come back. Normally, he comes back around ten or eleven in the morning, but today...... You wait until noon, but still no sign of him.
You feel a bit uneasy and drive your wheelchair out of the house. First, you ask the other neighbors nearby: "Hello, did you see the Dark People who used to come out with me this morning?" ”
They had been whispering among themselves, whispering and whispering something, but upon hearing this, the Dark People began to talk at once.
"Today, other Lightfolk have come to Cyber City."
"I saw your little guy talking to those People of Light."
"Then those people of light seem to have gone to the Queen's villa......
"As for where that Dark Citizen went, we haven't seen it." As they spoke, they all shook their heads.
You forced down your unease and steered your wheelchair toward the Queen's villa. Somehow, you kept feeling that Spamton...... Maybe it was in that place. Unexpectedly, there were no other Darkfolk guards at the villa's entrance, and the road was clear and unobstructed. Along the way, you saw some signs of smashing and smashing. Following these marks, you finally arrived at the basement door.
…… Then you look at the path to the basement with only stairs and fall silent. Luckily, you brought a cane for convenience, so you get up, grit your teeth, and shakily walk downstairs. After you finally manage to walk up the two steps on your own, when you reach the basement, you hear the howling wind...... There are also the sounds of battle coming and going. You look up at the basement and see a tall—so tall you don't know how to describe it—but countless threads are tied around him, but these threads ...... Most seem broken, but they still wrap around him, with only one strand trembling from the ceiling.
Is that spamton? You don't know, you only know it suddenly became huge, huge. You take a deep breath, steady your breath, and shout at maximum volume: "Spamton!" ”
Immediately after, the monster hanging in the air, which had been laughing wildly, suddenly retracted its expression, staring at you in panic.
TBC.
Ever since he heard that the People of Light might come to Cyber City, Spamton has been a bit dazed. Even though you say it's okay, and you like him even like this, Spamton knows well—many things can never be the same as before, he can't hold you completely anymore, and he can't help you with many things. He ...... He's become a tiny one, always afraid you'll leave him one day, and he's unwilling to accept it, after all...... He used to stand by your side and hold your hand, but now, he can only fly beside you, held in your arms.
That sense of unwillingness and pain grows day by day, and you probably haven't noticed anything. Spamton probably hopes you'll discover something, but he's afraid you'll notice even a little. If only you could know his pain—but he doesn't want you to suffer the same either.
Spamton found those Lightborn, made a deal, and helped remove the patrolling guards on the Queen's Manor Road, while they helped get the Neo armor from the basement. At that moment, his whole body was torn apart—a kind of pain, and a growing obsession took over his soul. No matter what—no matter what, he wanted to grow even bigger, to have what he once had, to be able to embrace you completely again. This mad obsession took over his mind, and he launched an attack on those Lightborn. As long as he obtained the same soul—he could go to the world of light, and he could always be by your side.
This mad obsession drove him. Even though the threads tied tightly to his body hurt unbearably, and every break made him feel on the verge of collapse, he still persisted, continuing to block the path of those of the Light's people with sorrow and obsession, until he heard your voice.
—Until he heard your voice clearly.
He stiffly lowered his head to look at you. The first thing he noticed was that you weren't in a wheelchair, just leaning on a cane, panting heavily. Instinctively, he reached out to hug you, but then Spamton's movements stiffened for a moment, because he noticed that his body was almost covered in spikes...... It really wasn't suitable to hug you.
Kris stopped attacking because of your sudden appearance. He watched you warily, and together with the other two, you glanced at them wearily, then leaned on your cane and walked step by step toward Spamton. This should have been Spamton's attack turn, but he stopped moving because of you, so the Lightfolk couldn't move.
You walk up to him, hesitate for a moment, and finally grab one of his outstretched hands—you really can't hold him anymore, so you just ask in a low voice, "...... Shall we go home?" At this moment, you don't think about anything else, just want to take him home. The rest can be discussed later.
"...... [Unable to set off and return], my [Program] needs a [heart-shaped object]." He said in a low voice.
You looked up at him, then at the few Lightfolk across from you, finally pressed your temple, pulled out dozens of dark coins, and tossed them to them, whispering, "This is an apology...... I'm sorry, this guy won't attack you anymore, but I hope you can leave here for now, okay? ”
The three guys stayed silent, and in the end, didn't accept the dark coin you threw out. They just walked up the path in the basement.
And you watch them finally leave, then you breathe a sigh of relief and look up at this especially big spamton...... Hmm, in the end, you still hold him carefully and whisper, "Mm...... Is this your real hope, or is it false...... Um, what's the programming? ”
Sometimes, you feel as if you've never truly met this guy before, maybe because he has too many traits...... But no matter what, once you've made up your mind, you won't let go. You just look up at him, waiting for his answer.
Spamton seemed to make a slight gumble. He reached out and picked you up. Although the area in front of him was a bit hard, he held you carefully, and you actually felt a faint warmth from the cold metal...... It seemed this body still had some softness; his voice was even deeper, the crackling of electric currents almost piercing human ears: "I hope...... I can have a [heart-shaped object], and then travel with you to the [World of Light]. "His voice was very low, but he was speaking right next to your ear, so of course you heard it clearly.
You pouted and poked his head with your finger. Although your finger hurt a bit because you were somewhat metallic now, "Are you an idiot?" "When did I say I was going to the Light World?" "If nothing unexpected happens, you should be staying in the Dark World forever. After all, your lover is here, and you have no lingering attachments to anyone or things in the Light World."
But Spamton just whispered, "...... However, your [Re-examination Results] require you to travel to the [Light World]. "He still didn't say what happened to you during your absence, but you suddenly understood...... He seemed to have endured pain beyond ordinary people's imagination during that time.
You pressed your forehead against his. Now that he was holding you, you looked like a tiny one, but you just gently wrapped your arms around his neck and softly said, comforting him: "After that, everything will be fine. I just need to go to the Light World for a check-up. I'll really be back in two days, hmm?" ”
But Spamton just stares at you, looking into his eyes now, and you feel inexplicably a little scared—though you're used to the changes your lover has experienced lately.
"[I don't trust], I wish I could go to the [Light World] with you. I want to [embrace] you again, [hug like this]." As he spoke, it was as if all his unwillingness and confusion had drifted out of his voice. You were stunned for a moment. You understood—he wanted to be with you all the time—hmm, this was probably a simple wish, and now he was looking at you, as if asking you to help him fulfill this small wish.
You gently pressed against him, resting your head on his shoulder, carefully avoiding the spikes. You softly asked, "Then...... Do you want my soul?" "For you, the soul isn't that important to begin with, after all...... Although you can rely on this soul to accomplish many things...... But you have no desire for anything in the world of light. If he wanted to go to the world of light, you think you would go with him.
Spamton seemed stunned for a moment. He hugged you tightly, his voice a bit dry: "If I seize your [heart-shaped object], what will you ...... [what should you do]?" ”
"It's okay...... Although I've never done anything like this, I should be able to split half with you." You muttered, honestly, if it weren't for what happened today reminding you, you would have almost forgotten you still have a soul.
You look at this big Spamton, annoyed again, and poke his forehead: "You really are an idiot...... Why didn't you tell me about this? I'm really sad, you know, because you kept this from me...... You kept it from me, but Spamton suddenly interrupted you.
He murmured softly, "[Sorry]." ”
You stopped mid-sentence, and in the end just glared at him fiercely. Then you closed your eyes and let the soul inside you—the heart-shaped object—fly out. The only difference was that it was a blue heart. You didn't say much, just tried to separate the heart, and then the other half returned to your body. You did feel a bit weak, and indeed a bit empty—probably because you instinctively wanted your partner to fill your empty chest. You just looked at the small heart that had become new and handed it to spamton: "You...... Take it." ”
Spamton was stunned for a moment, but still took the half soul. Then that tiny heart burrowed into his chest, and he placed you back on the ground. The threads scattered across the floor, and he simply transformed back into that small, demon-like thing that flew to your side.
You look at him, embrace him, that soul—or rather, heart—resonating in sync within both of you. In that moment, you feel completeness again, and Spamton also feels contentment. He vaguely realizes through the presence of this heart what he can do now.
You head toward the basement stairs, ready to complete the difficult task—climbing back up—when Spamton suddenly grows larger. He transforms back into his former form, the same as before he voluntarily jumped into the acid pool. He just wraps his arms around your waist and lets you sit on top of him. You stare blankly holding your cane, tilting your head to look at him, while Spamton just leans in, smiles, and kisses your forehead again. Then, he slowly carries you upward, smoothly leaving the Queen's villa, putting you back in his wheelchair, and pushing you outside.
You bit your lip, but you didn't look back at him, just nervously asked, "You...... Do you want to return to the Light World with me?" As soon as you said that, you laughed at yourself. That was clearly a definite answer. What exactly were you worried about?
Spamton was taken aback, a smile playing at the corner of his mouth: "Of course, I am very willing. This is my honor. Do you need me to push you to the Light World?" ”
So you smiled too: "Alright, let's go home." You all headed toward the boundary between the worlds of light and darkness.
TBC.
There were no other obstacles; the road was almost unobstructed. Spamton pushed your wheelchair into the world of light. It was his first time seeing the scenery of the world of light. Watching the bustling traffic, as if no one had noticed you, he couldn't help but chuckle softly. To be honest—he didn't feel much at this moment, but the soul that existed in his chest told him that everything was certain, real, and reliable.
So he softly asked, "What about the next [target location]?" ”
"I told you, we're going home...... But I haven't really tidied up my house in the Light World, so I originally thought I wouldn't go back. "You complained, pointing Spamton in the right direction. He pushed you that way. There are many monsters and humans in this world, and that's why no one paid much attention to your strange pair. When Spamton pushed you into the elevator, he still ...... a bit lacking in reality.
But now, he watched you open the door with the keys, then you took two steps back and instructed Spamton, "Go tidy up quickly. I haven't been here in a long time, and the house must be pretty dirty by now." ”
Spamton walked into your house, and indeed...... It looked like it hadn't been lived in for a long time, covered in a thin layer of dust. He used cleaning tools to tidy up the whole room until it was spotless before pushing you back in. You looked at the shiny house with satisfaction, couldn't help but stand up to spin a few times, but your steps were unsteady and you fell. Spamton caught you, and you looked at each other, unable to help but giggle foolishly.
"Oh...... Alright, from now on, this place is our home. Do you like this place?" "You smiled cheerfully." Squinting her eyes as she asked him, her hand instinctively wrapping around his neck.
"I [especially like it]." Spamton responded with a cheerful smile. Although the house was a bit small, with only one bedroom, the bed was big enough for you to sleep on it—just thinking about being able to hold you to sleep at night made his heart race.
So he couldn't help but add, "I also [especially like you]." ”
Your face flushed a little, and you couldn't help but turn your head slightly, muttering softly, "Mm...... Yeah, I like you too, but it's just a little bit, just a little bit. "You emphasized that no matter how many times you keep stressing this matter."
Spamton just put his arm around you, gently reached out to pat your head, and softly asked, "Mm...... So, what about the [Lunch Requirement]? "After his reminder, you remembered that after all this time, you still hadn't thought about lunch. You're not even that hungry now."
You thought for a moment, your eyes darted around, then you tugged at Spamton's hand: "Mm, let's have a good lunch today! There's nothing at home...... So, let's go out and eat! ”
You held his hand and walked out, still a bit wobbly. Spamton grabbed your hand tightly, hugging your shoulder just as you were about to fall. You leaned into his embrace and laughed at him in unison.
You arrived at a nearby hotpot restaurant, and with a big wave, you said, "I'm treating you today!" "You can eat whatever you like!" You ordered a mandarin duck pot, then picked dishes according to your own preferences, and passed the menu to Spamton, who also ordered some dishes—to be honest, back in the Dark World, he had never tried hotpot before, so he couldn't help but be curious about what this thing called hotpot tasted like.
When the food was served, you raised your chopsticks to try something, but your right hand trembled uncontrollably. Spamton stopped your hand, imitating your movements, and somewhat unskillfully put all the dishes you wanted into the hot pot. Then he looked at you and asked, "Do you need anything extra?" ”
You shake your head, indicating you have nothing left. When the soup starts boiling, you tell Spamton you can retrieve the items. He frantically handles the things—some are on your plate, and some can't fit them on, so he puts them on his plate.
You looked at Spamton and gave a slightly mischievous smile: "Want to try it too?" It's really tasty. Just rinse the scooped vegetables in sesame oil for a bit. "As you spoke, you demonstrated by dipping the lamb rolls into the sesame oil for a bit, then putting them in your mouth, showing a look of enjoyment.
Spamton, half skeptical, followed the instructions and ate a slice. Then, his face, which had been smiling, started to lose his composure. He quickly picked up the cold boiled water beside him and took several sips. His pale cheeks began to flush, and he even coughed several times while holding his cup, clearly from the spiciness.
You couldn't help but smile with your eyes curved into several loud laughs. Only when you got his clearly reluctant smile, which was a bit plaintive, did you finally stop laughing, just holding back your laughter and saying, "Looks like you probably can't handle spicy food...... Hmm, whatever you want to eat, just put it in this white soup pot. As for what you put on your plate, if you still want to eat it, just rinse it with cold water before eating. ”
Spamton glanced at you but said nothing. He just got up and went to the condiment station to get some dipping sauce. You ignored him and continued eating your own food. Then Spamton put the oil-stained dishes from his plate into yours as well. You didn't think about it, just rinsed the sesame oil as usual and put it in your mouth. Then your cheeks flushed, and you couldn't help but take the glass of cold boiled water and drink several sips.
The reason was simple—you realized Spamton had taken another plate full of chili sauce. He had deliberately soaked the food in the chili before handing it to you. Now you were spicy, sticking out your tongue to fan the air, glaring fiercely at Spamton. Although that glare only made you look coquettish with your cheeks flushed. Spamton, looking at you, just kept smiling. But he didn't dare put the red soup pot in again. He just asked what dish you wanted, put it in the pot, and picked it up on your plate to save you from suddenly shaking your hand again. If he burned you, he'd be heartbroken.
And he himself only made a pot of plain soup. Overall, you all enjoyed your lunch quite well, and when it came time to pay, you used the currency of the whole world to settle the bill...... This made Spamton look a bit like a pretty boy.
Because of this, the waiter quietly shot him a look.
Spamton simply ignored you, took your hand, and led you out: "Next [destination]?" ”
You thought for a moment: "Let's go to the supermarket...... I need to buy something. Hmm, you hold it for me." As you spoke, you pointed toward the supermarket, and Spamton led you over, then ...... You directed him to take the bedding set and various daily necessities. This time, Spamton didn't sneak in secretly, but openly took some couple-style cups and plates in front of you. You shot him a sneaky glare and let him go.
But you were giving instructions again: "I want to eat crayfish tonight!" The crayfish here looks pretty good, buy some to take home...... Hmm, and some fruit...... I want to buy some blueberries to take home! "As you spoke, you started picking and picking, but unfortunately, your taste is pretty limited. Anyway, Spamton came over and took most of what you had screened, picking out something else. You muttered a bit unhappy, but Spamton was the one who cooked, so you chose to follow his advice.
In the end, you brought a big pile of things to pay the bill. Spamton held you by one hand and carried the things home with the other. He placed you on the sofa in the room and started tidying up the things by himself. You felt a bit embarrassed and wanted to help, but in the end, Spamton sent you back to sit on the sofa, just propping up your chin and watching Spamton busy.
After you finished packing your daily necessities, you went out to buy some clothes. Spamton kept holding your hand, and the clerks assumed you were a couple. They kept promoting couple clothing. Some of the clothes were pretty good, but some were just plain in shape. Spamton originally wanted to buy them all with a wave of his hand and send them out, but you grabbed his hand and forcibly pulled him out of the store, whispering, "We're not in the Dark World anymore. We're not that wealthy, so don't spend money recklessly." ”
…… That's what you said, but in the end, you still spent all sorts of money on something delicate but impractical, purely for looks. Spamton looked at you quietly, and you just gave a dry laugh, guiltily looking away.
Every day when you're at home or when you go out, you think about someone else waiting for you at home, always thinking about ...... Going home early so you can see the other person. When you think this way, either he or you look forward to the moment of coming home even more. Of course, most of the time, Spamton stays by your side, as if if if you disappear the next second if he doesn't look at you.
Even for hospital check-ups, Spamton accompanied you. You needed to get an MRI enhancement, and Spamton squeezed over to sign the enhancement notification—after all, he was your family member.
Of course, the follow-up results were good, so there was nothing to worry about. Spamton just held hands as usual, you wobbled as you walked, and Spamton looked at you with a smile until you accidentally fell into his arms again. He hugged you tightly and then gently kissed your forehead.
You blinked, hugged him tightly, leaned in and kissed his lips, then you looked at each other and laughed silently.
…… Tomorrow will probably be another day of gentle breezes and bright sunshine, and you will always maintain this daily routine. After all, at this very moment, life and death are intertwined—that soul represents you, and naturally, it represents your life and death.
But as long as ...... As long as we can always see each other, that's enough.
END.

title: [Merge] vagrant
content:
Page 1
Page 2
Blank page 1
Blank page 2
…… Extremely unlucky. Think about it, holding that hospital X-ray report and thinking, you really are unlucky. The doctor tells you to prepare for a maximum of five years to live, but you still have to come back for a follow-up after six months...... Because you don't know if your condition will change.
Really...... So unlucky. You let out a sigh of relief, packed up your money, ignored the messages your parents sent you, and with a mix of bitterness and indifference, thought: I hadn't cared about you for years, so what's the point of rushing to care about you now? My illness had long been delayed, and the money I'd saved over the years seemed useless. The rest of the time I could just live as I pleased.
If ...... You just want to go somewhere where these people won't disturb you. You turn off your phone, stare blankly at the money you've gathered, and finally decide to exchange it for Dark Coin and spend the last few years of your life in the Dark World. Think about it, no one in the Dark World knows you...... Well, but a few years ago you seem to have accidentally entered the Dark World. You can't remember exactly what happened, but you probably just casually used the last dollar you had left to buy something for Addison.
Hopefully, you won't see him again. Thinking this, you step into the dark world and use your dark coins to buy a small house by the street. The environment here is pretty good, and it's close to convenience stores and such. After tidying up your room a bit, you plan to go to a nearby cinema to watch and casually watch a movie to pass the time. After all, it doesn't matter what you do anymore.
Spamton also saw you when passing by the cinema entrance. Of course he recognized you—he recognized you as the Lightfolk who bought his first thing that year. But—he's changed a lot, so you probably don't recognize him anymore. But it's okay, you can meet again, you can meet again. He once longed countless times—whether he could see you again—this wish seems to have turned into an obsession, which is why he's now turned into a hot shot. He...... He wants to look at you, and he wants you to see him. He almost goes crazy thinking about it. Spamton swallows nervously, staring greedily at you. Today, you're just wearing an ordinary white long dress with your hair down. You probably don't have much time left to live, so of course you don't care about your own appearance.
You were a bit distracted, and as you walked toward the cinema, a figure about the same height as you stood in front of you. You looked up at him in confusion—it was a well-dressed male Dark Citizen...... He wore a dark red suit with stripes, his skin was snow-white, his nose long, and he was smiling at you.
You stopped, tilting your head in confusion to look at him, while Spamton just smiled and said, "Miss [Beautiful Lady], you are a [Citizen of Light]. The arrival of the [Citizen of Light] has brought brilliance to the entire [Dark World]. I want to know [Your Name]?" I am Spamton G. Spamton, [pleased to serve you]. ”
You looked at him in confusion, feeling like some clichéd way to pick up a conversation. Honestly...... And his voice was crackling with electric currents and a random clip of a recording playing. Could it be that all the Dark People talk like this? You don't know. But it doesn't matter if you try to strike up a conversation. It's already the last few years, and you can live as you please, without caring at all about the consequences or consequences—as long as you're not with your parents.
So you say, "I'm Y/N, hello, Mr. Spamton, I'm going to see a movie...... Do you want to come with me too?" You said casually, not really caring about what his answer would be, but it was still a bit unexpected for you—he actually nodded: "So—my honor, do you prefer watching genre movies?" "He asked about your preferences. Although your way of speaking was a bit odd, you still understood.
You nod gently: "Then can you recommend something to me?" I like watching some suspense and mystery genres...... I don't want horror movies; watching that would scare me. Speaking of which, how many movies has Mr. Spamton seen? ”
"[Countless]—but among the recently released films, I would recommend [buy the film], this one. I hope you can [rejoice.] Spamton said as he pointed to a movie poster. You glanced at it—it was called 'September 1st,' and it seemed to tell the story of a teacher and several other students.
You thought for a moment and nodded in agreement, then turned to look at Spamton and winked at him: "So, Mr. Spamton, would you like to come with me to see it?" ”
"Of course, this is my honor." Spamton said this while bowing seriously, giving you a hand-kiss through his hand. Then, naturally, he took your hand and led you inside, bought two movie tickets, and you both entered the theater and sat side by side in the center.
This film tells the story of a teacher who is pushed and falls to her death by a student on September 1st, the day school begins. Later, on September 1st, she is reborn, begins to avoid the ongoing deadly cases that could have happened to her, and carefully unravels the mystery of the culprit. The film ends. Even though there are only two people in the theater, you remain quiet until the very end, applauding and smiling at Spamton: "Hmm, Mr. Spamton's recommendation of this film is pretty good." ”
Spamton looked at your smiling face and swallowed gently. At that moment, he had a desire to kiss your lips, to lick your cheek over and over, to see your smile again and again, to hear you call his name.
So naturally, he asked, "I'm glad you can be 'joyful.' I want to invite you to spend [feasting time] and 'romantic years' together?" "To be honest, he was indeed a bit nervous, after all...... At this moment, he was indeed asking you for a one-night stand.
You were stunned for a moment, not knowing why you still understood a little, but...... Even though you're so young, you still want to experience these things. Precisely because you're so young and have never had these experiences before, you are indeed somewhat tempted.
However...... The doctor has already forbidden you from drinking. Think about it, maybe having sex again would be a bit dangerous...... So you just smiled and shook your head, somewhat regretfully refusing him: "Ah...... Sorry, but it's getting late, I have to go back. See you next time, Mr. Spamton. ”
Even after being rejected, he still smiled warmly, as if he didn't feel embarrassed at all. He just felt a bit regretful—it seemed that making this request from the start was a bit reckless.
"Alright then, [Honored Miss], I would like to keep your [contact information], and save it for [next meeting]." As he spoke, he took out his phone again.
After hesitating for a moment, you took out your phone. You opened it and glanced at it. Good, nothing in the light world could bother you anymore. It showed no signal, but now you had signal from the dark world. So you added Spamton's contact information, then walked out of the cinema to say goodbye to him, planning to buy some snacks at the convenience store.
Spamton held the number you just gave him, his body trembling instinctively. He was a bit excited, so he eagerly opened the other phone he was carrying. This phone was used only to contact the person who had made the deal with that side, so naturally, it was highly confidential. Even if he traced the source of the signal, he couldn't trace it back to Spamton, only to the Wilderness.
Then he opened that phone, entered your number, and sent the first text message: [Honey, the clothes you wore today are just too beautiful...... I really like them. I wonder what other clothes the baby looks like? I'm really looking forward to it. ]
[Speaking of which, darling actually talked to another man today, and even went to the movies together...... I'm so jealous. When will I be able to go to the movies with my dear? ]

Spamton just put his arm around you, gently reached out to pat your head, and softly asked, "Mm...... So, what about the [Lunch Requirement]? "After his reminder, you remembered that after all this time, you still hadn't thought about lunch. You're not even that hungry now."
You thought for a moment, your eyes darted around, then you tugged at Spamton's hand: "Mm, let's have a good lunch today! There's nothing at home...... So, let's go out and eat! ”
You held his hand and walked out, still a bit wobbly. Spamton grabbed your hand tightly, hugging your shoulder just as you were about to fall. You leaned into his embrace and laughed at him in unison.
You arrived at a nearby hotpot restaurant, and with a big wave, you said, "I'm treating you today!" "You can eat whatever you like!" You ordered a mandarin duck pot, then picked dishes according to your own preferences, and passed the menu to Spamton, who also ordered some dishes—to be honest, back in the Dark World, he had never tried hotpot before, so he couldn't help but be curious about what this thing called hotpot tasted like.
When the food was served, you raised your chopsticks to try something, but your right hand trembled uncontrollably. Spamton stopped your hand, imitating your movements, and somewhat unskillfully put all the dishes you wanted into the hot pot. Then he looked at you and asked, "Do you need anything extra?" ”
You shake your head, indicating you have nothing left. When the soup starts boiling, you tell Spamton you can retrieve the items. He frantically handles the things—some are on your plate, and some can't fit them on, so he puts them on his plate.
You looked at Spamton and gave a slightly mischievous smile: "Want to try it too?" It's really tasty. Just rinse the scooped vegetables in sesame oil for a bit. "As you spoke, you demonstrated by dipping the lamb rolls into the sesame oil for a bit, then putting them in your mouth, showing a look of enjoyment.
Spamton, half skeptical, followed the instructions and ate a slice. Then, his face, which had been smiling, started to lose his composure. He quickly picked up the cold boiled water beside him and took several sips. His pale cheeks began to flush, and he even coughed several times while holding his cup, clearly from the spiciness.
You couldn't help but smile with your eyes curved into several loud laughs. Only when you got his clearly reluctant smile, which was a bit plaintive, did you finally stop laughing, just holding back your laughter and saying, "Looks like you probably can't handle spicy food...... Hmm, whatever you want to eat, just put it in this white soup pot. As for what you put on your plate, if you still want to eat it, just rinse it with cold water before eating. ”
Spamton glanced at you but said nothing. He just got up and went to the condiment station to get some dipping sauce. You ignored him and continued eating your own food. Then Spamton put the oil-stained dishes from his plate into yours as well. You didn't think about it, just rinsed the sesame oil as usual and put it in your mouth. Then your cheeks flushed, and you couldn't help but take the glass of cold boiled water and drink several sips.
The reason was simple—you realized Spamton had taken another plate full of chili sauce. He had deliberately soaked the food in the chili before handing it to you. Now you were spicy, sticking out your tongue to fan the air, glaring fiercely at Spamton. Although that glare only made you look coquettish with your cheeks flushed. Spamton, looking at you, just kept smiling. But he didn't dare put the red soup pot in again. He just asked what dish you wanted, put it in the pot, and picked it up on your plate to save you from suddenly shaking your hand again. If he burned you, he'd be heartbroken.
And he himself only made a pot of plain soup. Overall, you all enjoyed your lunch quite well, and when it came time to pay, you used the currency of the whole world to settle the bill...... This made Spamton look a bit like a pretty boy.
Because of this, the waiter quietly shot him a look.
Spamton simply ignored you, took your hand, and led you out: "Next [destination]?" ”
You thought for a moment: "Let's go to the supermarket...... I need to buy something. Hmm, you hold it for me." As you spoke, you pointed toward the supermarket, and Spamton led you over, then ...... You directed him to take the bedding set and various daily necessities. This time, Spamton didn't sneak in secretly, but openly took some couple-style cups and plates in front of you. You shot him a sneaky glare and let him go.
But you were giving instructions again: "I want to eat crayfish tonight!" The crayfish here looks pretty good, buy some to take home...... Hmm, and some fruit...... I want to buy some blueberries to take home! "As you spoke, you started picking and picking, but unfortunately, your taste is pretty limited. Anyway, Spamton came over and took most of what you had screened, picking out something else. You muttered a bit unhappy, but Spamton was the one who cooked, so you chose to follow his advice.
In the end, you brought a big pile of things to pay the bill. Spamton held you by one hand and carried the things home with the other. He placed you on the sofa in the room and started tidying up the things by himself. You felt a bit embarrassed and wanted to help, but in the end, Spamton sent you back to sit on the sofa, just propping up your chin and watching Spamton busy.
After you finished packing your daily necessities, you went out to buy some clothes. Spamton kept holding your hand, and the clerks assumed you were a couple. They kept promoting couple clothing. Some of the clothes were pretty good, but some were just plain in shape. Spamton originally wanted to buy them all with a wave of his hand and send them out, but you grabbed his hand and forcibly pulled him out of the store, whispering, "We're not in the Dark World anymore. We're not that wealthy, so don't spend money recklessly." ”
…… That's what you said, but in the end, you still spent all sorts of money on something delicate but impractical, purely for looks. Spamton looked at you quietly, and you just gave a dry laugh, guiltily looking away.
Every day when you're at home or when you go out, you think about someone else waiting for you at home, always thinking about ...... Going home early so you can see the other person. When you think this way, either he or you look forward to the moment of coming home even more. Of course, most of the time, Spamton stays by your side, as if if if you disappear the next second if he doesn't look at you.
Even for hospital check-ups, Spamton accompanied you. You needed to get an MRI enhancement, and Spamton squeezed over to sign the enhancement notification—after all, he was your family member.
Of course, the follow-up results were good, so there was nothing to worry about. Spamton just held hands as usual, you wobbled as you walked, and Spamton looked at you with a smile until you accidentally fell into his arms again. He hugged you tightly and then gently kissed your forehead.
You blinked, hugged him tightly, leaned in and kissed his lips, then you looked at each other and laughed silently.
…… Tomorrow will probably be another day of gentle breezes and bright sunshine, and you will always maintain this daily routine. After all, at this very moment, life and death are intertwined—that soul represents you, and naturally, it represents your life and death.
But as long as ...... As long as we can always see each other, that's enough.
END.

title: up
content:
…… Extremely unlucky. Think about it, holding that hospital X-ray report and thinking, you really are unlucky. The doctor tells you to prepare for a maximum of five years to live, but you still have to come back for a follow-up after six months...... Because you don't know if your condition will change.
Really...... So unlucky. You let out a sigh of relief, packed up your money, ignored the messages your parents sent you, and with a mix of bitterness and indifference, thought: I hadn't cared about you for years, so what's the point of rushing to care about you now? My illness had long been delayed, and the money I'd saved over the years seemed useless. The rest of the time I could just live as I pleased.
If ...... You just want to go somewhere where these people won't disturb you. You turn off your phone, stare blankly at the money you've gathered, and finally decide to exchange it for Dark Coin and spend your last years in the Dark World. Think about it, no one in the Dark World knows you...... Well, but a few years ago you seem to have accidentally entered the Dark World. You can't remember exactly what happened, but you probably just casually used the last dollar you had left to buy something from Addison.
Hopefully, you won't see him again. Thinking this, you step into the dark world and use your dark coins to buy a small house by the street. The environment here is pretty good, and it's close to convenience stores and such. After tidying up your room a bit, you plan to go to a nearby cinema to watch and casually watch a movie to pass the time. After all, it doesn't matter what you do anymore.
Spamton also saw you when passing by the cinema entrance. Of course he recognized you—he recognized you as the Lightfolk who bought his first thing that year. But—he's changed a lot, so you probably don't recognize him anymore. But it's okay, you can meet again, you can meet again. He once longed countless times about whether he could see you again. That wish seems to have become an obsession, which is why he has now become a hot shot. He ...... He wants to see you, and he wants you to see him. He is almost driven mad by the thought of this. Spamton swallows nervously, greedily staring at you. Today, you're just wearing an ordinary white long dress with your hair down. You don't have much time left to live, so of course you don't care about your own appearance.
You were a bit distracted, and as you walked toward the cinema, a figure about the same height as you stood in front of you. You looked up at him in confusion—it was a well-dressed male Dark Citizen...... He wore a dark red suit with stripes, his skin was snow-white, his nose long, and he was smiling at you.
You stopped in your tracks, tilting your head in confusion as you looked at him, while Spamton just smiled and said, "Miss [Beautiful Lady], you are a [Citizen of Light]. The arrival of the [Citizen of Light] has brought brilliance to the entire [Dark World]. I would like to know [Your Name]?" I am SPAMTON G. SPAMTON, [Glad to serve you]. ”
You looked at him in confusion, feeling like some clichéd way to pick up a conversation. Honestly...... And his voice was crackling with electric currents and a random clip of a recording playing. Could it be that all the Dark People talk like this? You don't know. But it doesn't matter if you try to strike up a conversation. It's already the last few years, and you can live as you please, without caring at all about the consequences or consequences—as long as you're not with your parents.
So you said, "I'm Y/N, Mr. Spamton, hello, I'm going to see a movie...... Do you want to join me too?" You said casually, not really caring what his answer would be, but it was still somewhat unexpected. He actually nodded, "Then—[My Honor], do you prefer watching [genre films]?" "He asked about your preferences. Although your way of speaking was a bit odd, you still understood."
You nod gently: "Then can you recommend something to me?" I like watching some suspense and mystery genres...... Don't want horror movies, or it would scare me. By the way, how many movies has Mr. Spamton seen? ”
"[Countless]—but among the recently released films, I would recommend [buy the film], this one. I hope you can be [joyful]." Spamton said as he pointed to a movie poster. You glanced at it—the movie was called 'September 1st,' and it seemed to tell the story of a teacher and several other students.
You thought for a moment and nodded in agreement, then turned to look at Spamton and winked at him: "So, Mr. Spamton, would you like to come with me to see it?" ”
"Of course, this is my honor." Spamton said this while bowing seriously, giving you a hand-kiss through his hand, then naturally took your hand and led you inside. We bought two movie tickets, and you both walked into the theater and sat side by side in the center.
This film tells the story of a teacher who is pushed down the building by a student on September 1st, the day school begins. Later, on September 1st, the teacher is reborn, and she begins to avoid the ongoing cases that could lead to death, carefully unraveling the mystery behind the scenes to deduce the culprit. The film ends. Although there are only two people in the theater, you remain quiet until the very end, applauding and smiling at Spamton: "Hmm, the film Mr. Spamton recommended is quite good." ”
Spamton looked at your smiling face and swallowed gently. At that moment, he had a desire to kiss your lips, to lick your cheek over and over, to see your smile again and again, to hear you call his name.
So naturally, he asked, "I'm glad you can be 'joyful.' I want to invite you to spend [feasting time] and 'romantic years' together?" "To be honest, he was indeed a bit nervous, after all...... At this moment, he was indeed asking you for a one-night stand.
You were stunned for a moment, not knowing why you still understood a little, but...... Even though you're so young, you still want to experience these things. Precisely because you're so young and have never had these experiences before, you are indeed somewhat tempted.
However...... The doctor has already forbidden you from drinking. You think maybe having sex again might be a bit dangerous...... So you just smiled and shook your head, somewhat regretfully refusing him: "Ah...... Sorry, but it's getting late, I have to go back. See you next time, Mr. Spamton. ”
Even after being rejected, he still smiled warmly, as if he didn't feel embarrassed at all. He just felt a bit regretful—it seemed that making this request from the start was a bit reckless.
"Alright then, [Honored Miss], I would like to keep your [contact information], and save it for [next meeting]." As he spoke, he took out his phone again.
After hesitating for a moment, you took out your phone and glanced at it. Good, nothing in the light world could bother you anymore. It showed no signal, but now you had signal from the dark world. So you added Spamton's contact information, then walked out of the cinema to say goodbye to him, planning to buy something to eat at the convenience store.
Spamton held the phone number you just gave him, his body trembling instinctively. He was a bit excited, so he eagerly opened the other phone he was carrying. This phone was used only to contact the other side—the person who had made the deal. Naturally, it was highly confidential. Even if he traced the source of the signal, he couldn't trace it back to Spamton, only to the Wilderness.
He opened that phone, entered your phone number, and sent the first text message rapidly.
[Honey, the clothes you wore today are just so beautiful...... I really like them. I wonder what other clothes the baby looks like? I'm really looking forward to it. ]
[Speaking of which, darling actually talked to another man today, and even went to the movies together...... I'm so jealous. When will I be able to go to the movies with my dear? ]
[Dear, is dinner just bread? It feels so heartbreaking...... Next time, I'm going to prepare dinner for you, darling. I hope you can finish it all by then, so don't waste my kindness. ]
He sent you three messages with a rapid sound. Seeing that all three messages showed as read, his breathing grew rapid. Spamton knew you saw it—definitely did. He waited for your reaction and quietly walked away.
Meanwhile, you were gnawing on bread bought at the convenience store, your phone vibrating one after another. You opened it and saw it was a spam text message from an unknown number.
…… Unlucky, really unlucky. You came to the Dark World just for some peace, and now you've run into a pervert. You instinctively look around but don't see any strange figures. But you think about it...... You're about to die anyway, so it's fine to play along with this pervert.
But you still bit into your bread and sent a string of texts with a crackling sound: [? You pervert, what exactly makes you want to follow me? ] After saying that, you blocked that number.
Spamton tapped his hand and realized you had blocked this number. He just smiled and registered another account on his phone to send you another message. Honestly, he was just glad you replied to him...... Even if you scolded him, he didn't mind.
[Oh my, the baby actually replied to my message, I'm so surprised! ]
[But dear, why are you calling me a pervert...... I just like you so much, that's why I keep looking at you. ]
[And you even blocked me...... Darling, treating me like this makes me so sad TAT]
You were silent for a while, then looked at another harassing text message, thinking this voyeur was ...... In short, he was a pervert, but he did have some real skills, so you seriously replied to his messages and teased him a bit—after all, you can do whatever you want.
[Hmm, then tell me, I only wore a white dress, what exactly looks good about me? ]
TBC.
He hesitated for a moment, then secretly peeked at you again—just looking at you like this made him genuinely happy. He watched you innocently nibble on that piece of bread, frown slightly at the messages on your phone. He watched your black hair floating with the wind, messy, and you casually brushed the hair that floated in front of your face back behind your head. Spamton felt that all of this was beautiful, extremely beautiful, making him involuntarily hold his breath, gazing at you intently, also watching your skirt fluttering in the wind.
And you seemed to notice something; you felt as if some gaze was fixed on you, so you couldn't help but lift your head and look in that direction. But Spamton just withdrew his gaze, hiding behind the wall, and continued typing and sending messages to you with some excitement and slight trembling in his hands: [Very beautiful, extremely beautiful... Baby, you are like a sprite standing in the wind, as if you could ride the wind away from all of this... Yes, dear, you don't seem to belong to this world, and you can no longer eat bread... I will prepare for you what you deserve.]
[Yes, and your hair is dark and shiny, and the way it flows together with the hem of your dress is very beautiful… Darling, I wish I could look at you a little longer, but you don't seem to like it much, so I can't look at you anymore;;]
You looked at these two messages and raised your eyebrows. Honestly, this stalker seems kind of interesting... Hmm, it would be better if he didn't harass you, but you still replied to a message as if you were deliberately teasing him.
Hmm, but in a couple of days I'm going to get a haircut, so you won't be able to see my black hair flowing in the wind.
After sending this message, you put down your phone, looked around the room, sighed, and honestly... although some areas are still messy, given your current physical condition, you simply don't have the strength to organize everything. You start thinking about whether you can hire someone to help tidy up the room—after all, you don't mind spending a bit more money now, and those things, for you, really aren't a big deal.
You slumped on the sofa, still pondering your thoughts, when you heard your phone constantly vibrating. It seemed like that guy had sent you a lot of messages again. With nothing else to do, you simply picked up your phone to see what the messages were about.
[Baby actually replied to me again... Does this mean baby cares about me? ///^^///]
[But dear, it would be such a pity if you cut off that long hair... Are you really going to do it TAT]
[Or baby, after cutting it, leave your hair for me! I will definitely treasure it——///<_>/// Baby, don't waste your hair, I really like it…]
[Everything dear should belong to me... Don't cut your hair casually...]
[I'm begging you TAT]
[Baby, why aren't you replying to me? Do you really want to cut it off right now TAT]
[Then I will squat outside the baby's room, ready to pick up the hair you throw away ^^]
You twitched the corner of your mouth as you watched the messages being sent endlessly in the chat box as if his life depended on it. You didn’t understand how he could type so fast, and yet talk about so much on his own. But looking at him like this was kind of funny, or rather… a little cute?
So you casually sent him a few messages.
[Replied to you]
[Not cut off]
[I won't give you the chance to pick it up either]
This time the message from the other side also came very quickly.
[Baby has come back to me again awa]
[This time it's actually three messages! Dear... dear, are you willing to chat with me?]
You raised your eyebrows and tapped the screen with your finger: [What if I don't want to chat with you?]
[Darling, please don't abandon me TAT……]
[Could it be that my dear doesn't like me sending so many messages? TAT]
[If you really don't like it... OTTO]
"If you don't like it, will you just keep crying?" You admit that chatting with this guy is quite interesting, but... you can't go on like this for much longer. It's fine to tease him online, but you certainly don't want to suffer in real life.
[I will hide in a place where my darling can't see me and keep crying until my darling is willing to pay attention to me ><]
After seeing this sentence, you turned off your phone. You plan to ignore him for a while, believing that he won't be able to resist bothering you again after some time.
Meanwhile, Spamton communicated a bit, and then moved into the house next to yours. To be honest, this entire street was originally an asset that the partners intended to give him—so naturally he also got the keys to your house. However, he just quietly tidied up the house and then prepared to give you a surprise when he meets you tomorrow. Maybe you'll be very happy—maybe you'll just think it's a coincidence. Spamton, fantasizing about your reaction when you see him tomorrow, couldn't help humming a couple of notes. He was in a really good mood, or rather, a bit too good of a mood.
As for you... you lay on the sofa resting for a while before realizing that your phone hadn't rung all afternoon. You picked it up and looked, only to find that the last message was still the one he sent. Rarely, you moved your fingers and tapped a reply: [Really crying?]
[Really cried TTTTTT]
Spamton is sitting on the sofa in the house next to yours, smiling, wiping the tears that flow from his swollen eyes, pretending. He doesn't know if this trick will work on you, but this is all he can do.
You pressed your lips together, and for some reason felt a bit guilty: [Alright, go ahead and send it, I'm fine]
After all, you also feel indifferent; if he wants to post, then let him post.
Great——then I will send lots of messages to my baby every day! It doesn't matter if my baby replies or not, as long as my baby sees them~
You clicked your mouth once, and couldn't help but send him another message: [Are you a pervert, acting like this?]
[///^^///Yes, I am the pervert belonging to the baby alone///^^///]
…To be honest, you were a little disgusted, so you simply put down your phone, walked into your bedroom, tidied up the books you had brought from the world of light, hesitated for a moment, and then casually picked up a book to start flipping through it. You were only trying to pass the time; you didn't know what you should do. Maybe you should find something to do in the dark world?
You were daydreaming about these things while looking at the book. To be honest, you didn't actually absorb much, since you had been distracted the whole time. When you came back to your senses, the book was already flipped to the last page. You sighed, put the book back on the shelf, and then picked up your phone again, only to realize that he had sent you a lot of messages again.
[Awa, I knew the baby's heart is very soft... but it's fine as long as you're soft-hearted only towards me! Baby must not be this soft-hearted towards other men... I would be very unhappy TAT]
[But I'm not happy, and the baby probably wouldn't feel anything either... TAT, can you care about me a little more, dear?]
[Darling, look at me, look at me... I know you haven't seen any of this news, when will I get the baby's favor?]
[The movie that baby watched with someone else today should be really good, right? I'm so jealous of the person who watched the movie with you... I also want to watch a movie with baby.]
[Dear, look at me, look at me, look at me...]
You unlocked your phone and swiped the screen, and all these messages were marked as read, but the next second, his message popped up again.
[Dear, you finally saw my message ///><///]
You let out a sigh and yawned, looking at the time—it’s actually only about half past nine, but you really do need to get a good rest.
So you quickly sent him a message: [Alright, little pervert, I'm going to sleep, good night]
[Awa, my dear gave me a nickname… I like it so much, good night my dear! I hope I'm in your dreams, baby! ///><///]
You stared at the message in silence for a moment, rubbed your forehead, and then turned off your phone, also setting it to silent so that if he sent messages in the middle of the night, it wouldn't wake you. Then you curled up, hugging yourself, and fell asleep in the blanket. To be honest, you arrived in a strange world today, and there was one more person bothering you. You slept somewhat unsteadily, often half-asleep and half-awake during the night. When you sat up in the morning, facing the dim light of this world, you were still a bit bewildered. Then you remembered, you are in another world, and you have welcomed the morning of the second day.
You stared blankly outside, then reopened your phone — only to find that the little pervert hadn't sent you any new messages. Instead, you felt a bit inexplicably disappointed, so after hesitating for a moment, you tapped on the keyboard and sent him a message: [Good morning]
[Good morning, my dear—I waited for you for so long, and you finally woke up awa.] The person on the other side almost replied to you instantly. You suspect that they might have been staring at the phone screen all the time, or maybe they even set a special notification tone for you, otherwise how could they respond so quickly?
What does baby plan to eat for breakfast? Do you need me to prepare it for you! I want to know what baby likes to eat more~
You scratched your somewhat messy hair. Because you were going out, you changed your clothes and tied up your hair. You planned to go find something to do; always staying at home alone, waiting for death... that feeling wasn't pleasant either. So you put on a blue and white dress with lace and tied your hair into a high ponytail.
You typed on your phone keyboard: [Haven’t decided yet. Probably I'll go to the convenience store to buy a sandwich to eat.]
[Only eating convenience store food is unhealthy TAT, baby look at me, I will prepare breakfast for you every morning from now on!]
You raised your eyebrows and walked to the door. To be honest, you didn't know where he would put the breakfast, but when you opened the door, you saw a plate at the doorway, with steaming sandwiches on it, along with a steaming sausage and a fried egg.
You subconsciously widened your eyes and looked around, but there wasn't a single figure in sight, and this sudden breakfast was exactly as written in the message earlier—it would be prepared for you every morning.
You hesitated for a moment, carried this breakfast back to the living room, closed the bedroom door, and started eating. Honestly, this breakfast really tastes good.
TBC.
After breakfast, you look at the plate—it's even single-use. You just need to throw it away. So you throw the tray into the trash, brew yourself a pot of floral tea, take a sip, look at your phone in silence for a moment, and finally send a message: [Thank you for breakfast]
The other side still replied instantly: [No need to thank me, it's my duty to prepare breakfast for my dear>><<]
You chuckled, suddenly feeling a bit better than before, your previously confused, even somewhat lonely mood, at least...... At least you still have someone to talk to, at least someone in this world still notices you. You are not alone or alone. Maybe that's not so bad.
[Alright, little pervert, I'll look forward to the meals you prepare for me.] You rarely type this seriously. You think, although it probably shouldn't be right, for someone who has mastered your movements and probably keeps watching you, you should ...... feel afraid. But now, all you have is the sadness of finally being valued, a strange sense of satisfaction. You put down your phone, close your eyes, and think about it, and indeed...... Indeed, this kind of thinking is probably wrong, but...... But besides that, who else can give you that feeling?
You calm yourself down and type again: [Mm, it tastes great, thank you for your breakfast, I really like it]
[Dear, just like the taste of breakfast!! I'll definitely make something that makes you taste even better ///^^///]
You chuckled softly and typed another line: [Are you crazy...... Why do you have to watch me every day, and control my every move? ]
[Then I'm my dear little lunatic...... Because I like babies, I love babies so much, that's why I keep watching you, awa]
You were silent for a while, chewing over the word 'like' in your mouth. You couldn't tell what liking was, what love was; your parents and teachers never taught you these things, so...... Is this what liking is? You don't know; you only feel that you truly are cared for, and beyond that, you know nothing else.
[Do you like it...... I don't understand. But if you like it, then do it. I won't stop you. ] Finally, you lowered your eyes and typed this line.
You don't understand, you don't understand, you can't understand any of this. But you don't mind, just turn off your phone, open the door, and head out.
Spamton, on the other hand, gazed at the message you sent with longing. He chuckled foolishly, saying, "Since you didn't stop him, it proved he could do it, to prove ...... It proved that you still cared about him, that you were still watching him." Spamton once thought that after becoming a hot shot, he was left with only loneliness and a fate of madness. He let himself sink into madness, because his greed was boundless, and because he had always ...... He always wanted to become a bigger figure. He wanted to go to the world of light, he wanted to see you again. He once thought that living in the Queen's mansion would change his fate, but the truth proved he could only sink into this lonely madness.
Until he sees you again, standing before him when he was once infinitely lonely, keeping him away from the ridicule of other Addisons, saying you will become his friend, he thinks maybe that god he never believed in heard his wish and brought you to his side.
He placed the phone in his own house, and when he heard you open the door again, he hurried to open it too. You looked at the neighbor who opened the door almost simultaneously in surprise—he was Spamton, whom you had met once yesterday.
He smiled warmly at you, first bowed slightly, and gave you a kiss: "[Honored Miss], it's an honor to meet you again." ”
You stared at him blankly, blinked twice, and asked blankly, "Hey, so you live here too?" When I saw you yesterday...... You don't live here, do you...... You think for a moment, then hesitate.
Spamton's smile only deepened: "Hmm, yesterday it was [temporary housing], and today I'm [officially moving] here. It's really a [coincidence]—it's actually right next to the lady." As he spoke, he gave you a gentle bow again.
You scratched your head and awkwardly laughed twice: "You don't have to ...... No need to treat me so seriously. Since we exchanged contact information yesterday, let's call it a friend, right? Friends don't need to be so formal. ”
…… Friend. Spamton looked up at your smile. In a daze, he felt your smile was just as radiant as countless years ago, as if it could dispel the loneliness in his heart, still so dazzling that he felt a bit ashamed, and could only ......
