[I will choose according to [the young lady's preferences], so... the next activity will be [watching a movie].]
Tomorrow morning or evening, I am available [to receive gifts].
Although you looked at his messages a little slowly, he still sent them to you one by one. You compared the speed at which the messages were sent and let out a sigh of relief. You then said… your neighbor is so polite, how could he possibly be the same person as that anonymous little pervert on your phone? You dismissed your doubts once again.
[Thank you for your invitation... but I have to work, so I'm only available on the weekend! Got it, I will deliver the prepared bouquet tomorrow!]
Speaking of which, I actually found a little kitten on my way home today... it only has three legs, really pitiful.
I took it home, fed it a little and gave it some milk or something, and it became very close to me! Just now it was even stepping on me.
[So strangely cute... and also strangely heartbreaking. I don't know who would abandon such an adorably cute kitten, and it looks like its leg might have been broken from being abused...]
By the way, does Mr. Spamton know anything about the nearby hospitals? I'm planning to take this child to see one in a few days.
Spamton looked at the messages you sent, his expression becoming even more plaintive. He monitored you, followed you, observed your daily life... and you just easily spoke about these daily things to another person, and it just so happened that this person was also him.
However... in other words, doesn't this also prove that you do care about him a little, care about this neighbor who is courting you? Thinking about this, he felt his chest pounding violently, and he couldn't hide the smile on his face as he replied to your messages.
[So about the 【weekend invitation】, the cat you mentioned feels really 【pitifully cute】... As for the nearby 【pet hospital】, 【go straight and then turn right】 【to reach it】.] However, Spamton remained very reserved; he only replied to you with one message, simply covering all the answers in it.
You received a reply and happily responded to him with a thank you. Then, you opened that little pervert's chat box again and began to think about your wording.
You hesitated, tapping and pressing on the screen and then deleting, and in the end... you still only sent one message: [Are you one of those dark people called addisons?]
TBC.
Spamton still smiled when he saw your message, but it was obvious his expression wasn't very good. He knew—you must be suspicious, but he was afraid you might associate the once humiliated white Addison with the current Spamton. He didn't want you to think that way.
…… If only you knew that the real identity of that pervert was just Spamton. Thinking back to the past, he only tormented you and him at the same time. Unexpectedly, he didn't want you to realize he was the same Addison back then. He ...... After all, he hopes the memories that once stayed deep in your heart will still be beautiful.
So he just smiled and quickly tapped on the screen, replying to your message: [Baby, why would you think that? I'm just a simple Dark Folk OWO]
You don't believe what he said...... Maybe he's lying like that. You muttered, stood up, put away your phone, and planned to wash up and sleep. But for some reason, you had another episode today—it never happened this often before. Dizzy and dizzy, you knelt on the floor, ignoring the pain from the sudden fall. With trembling hands, you pulled out a small medicine bottle from your pocket, poured out three pills, and swallowed them. Spamton, who was on the other end of the surveillance camera, stood up immediately. If he weren't worried about exposing anything, he would have rushed straight to your house—luckily, he saw you get up again, so he sat down again, still shaken.
He anxiously sends you a message: [Honey, why did you fall again? It must hurt a lot, right? TATTT]
[I think my dear needs someone to take care of you, otherwise it's too dangerous for you to live alone. ]
You catch your breath and get up to see these two messages. Although you're not in a great mood right now, you still raise your eyebrows—maybe you think talking to him can lift your spirits, and you know what he means, but you can't help teasing: [Then who is the person you're talking about?] ]
[Of course it's me! \\><// Darling, rest assured, I will take good care of you. You absolutely cannot invite that annoying neighbor of yours|| ^^|| I really hate him, he can actually make my beloved smile and talk......]
You can't help but laugh out loud when you look at his message. You know what answer he'll give you, and you know your emotions are twisted at this moment—probably a bit of joy from being cared for. Even though you don't know where that feeling comes from, still...... But I have to say, being cared for and watched, you suddenly start laughing, even though tears still stream from the corners of your eyes.
…… So even if you're about to die, someone will care. Is someone truly caring about you? So that's how it is? You don't know, nor do you know that Spamton on the surveillance screen was flustered when he saw your tears. You just think...... If someone is willing to pay attention to you, it's probably to repay the kindness they once did. In the light world, you did so much, but in the end, those people just felt it was just what they should do. But in the dark world...... The only kindness you ever gave was that once. You didn't believe anyone would pay attention to you for no reason, so you tapped the screen with certainty: [I get it, you're that white Addison, right? No need to argue anymore, I know it's you. ]
If ...... If you really guessed wrong, then you were wrong; after all, it's just a trivial matter...... Your own death is also a minor matter, and being noticed because of these things is obviously just a minor matter. Although you smile, tears are still on your face as you lie on the bed. You know that perhaps the other person doesn't think these are trivial matters...... But you already feel it doesn't matter; your phone is still vibrating, and you are just lying on the bed asleep.
Spamton stared at his phone, then at your sleeping face on the surveillance camera, feeling a rare sense of helplessness—no matter what he said, it probably wouldn't help, and you had already accepted it. He had to admit that if it weren't for that incident, he wouldn't be here now, nor would he be here staring at you on camera. He had already noted down the medications you used, and after preparing them, he bought them with him. That way, if you get sick again, no matter what, he has a way to save you. He can't just stand by and watch you get hurt in front of him.
Spamton stared at the unread messages still displayed on his phone screen, his expression darkening and looking even paler under the screen's light.
[How could the baby think like that? I just really like the baby OTTO]
[But if the baby insists on saying that, I have to admit it...... I am the Addison from back then. I really like you. Darling, your movements are so gentle, your smile is so warm...... I originally thought I was going to die under those guys' bullying, but the baby saved me, awa. At that moment, my darling looked so beautiful...... I always remembered you until I saw you again. Your appearance was a surprise to me! I ...... I never thought I would see you again......] He looked at the two messages, hesitated for a moment, then wanted to withdraw them, but the retraction event had already passed; no matter what, you would see them. Spamton had no choice but to put away his phone, gave a wry smile, and tossed and turned, finally falling asleep.
The next morning, as usual, you open the door and see the breakfast prepared. While savoring the meal, you open your phone and find that the account you marked as 'Little Pervert' had sent you two unread messages. You open it and take a look—sure enough, the little pervert admitted it. He was the Dark People from back then.
You hesitated for a moment, but still sent him a message: [Because I don't believe anyone would follow me for no reason......]
[The only thing I can remember was that white Addison that I was somewhat involved with. So as expected, it was you. ]
As soon as you sent your message, you got a reply from him: [TAT baby is such a good citizen of light—it's normal for others to follow you for no reason, like your neighbor......]
[I won't allow the baby to belittle themselves like this! And the flower shop owner treats you very well...... The convenience store waiter is the same, everyone clearly likes you OWO]
…… What exactly is liking? What is love? Can just a little attention and kindness count as liking? You don't know, you put down your phone and nervously eat breakfast. You didn't reply to his messages, but tears welled up uncontrollably, dripping onto your phone screen and the dining table. You didn't know why you were crying—maybe, maybe you just suddenly understood something, maybe...... Maybe this kind of affection isn't something you need to reciprocate either. You suddenly realize that you seem ...... It seems like you can give Spamton an answer, but you're not sure.
You tidy yourself up, throw away the plates, take a deep breath, and walk out the door. You knock on the door next door first, deciding to ask him for a favor first. If love isn't something you need to fully reciprocate, then you probably feel more at ease.
Spamton, hearing your knock, rushed over and opened the door. As usual, he smiled broadly and asked, "[Honored Miss], do you need [special services]?" ”
You nodded: "Well, lately I feel like someone is following me...... So, I was thinking it might be safer to have a Dark Folk accompany me. With that in mind, I asked Mr. Spamton. ”
He excitedly gestured behind his back. You don't know, your neighbor is that perverted stalker, and you don't know that doing so actually gets his wish and allows him to stay by your side all the time.
Spamton simply nodded modestly: "Of course, it's my honor." With that, he turned around and closed the door, gently holding your hand as you walked forward.
After walking a distance, you finally didn't feel that stalking gaze anymore. You couldn't help but exhale softly, but you didn't know that Spamton had been secretly watching you all along. He looked at your pale skin exposed on the outside, at your cheeks tinged with a hint of redness...... How he wished he could kiss and bite him right now, but he knew he couldn't do that; no matter what, he had to endure. So he just swallowed hard and turned his head away.
And you didn't notice his gaze. You just stared at the same spot in the corner as yesterday, nervously and excitedly tugging spamton: "Look, this is where I found that little cat yesterday!" Speaking of which, this street does look a bit desolate. It doesn't seem to have any Dark Folks ......."
Spamton just smiled and replied to you, "It's too early, many of the [Dark People] haven't appeared yet." "But he secretly thought to himself that once he takes you to your destination, he'll be entering your house. He's determined to make sure that kitten doesn't climb onto you again."
You just nodded half-understandingly, tugged at his sleeve, and pointed to a nearby shop: "Ah...... It looks like a dessert shop! I wonder how it tastes. How about trying it next time? ”
Spamton glanced at the shop; he still had some impression of it, and the food was pretty good.
He said, "I'm pretty impressed. The desserts here taste pretty good." If you like them, next time we'll try a try or two." He was a bit nervous because he had classified you as "we," and he didn't know if you'd agree.
And you just nodded, your tone very cheerful: "Hmm, then let's try it next time!" I wonder if this place has any special features...... you mutter.
And Spamton just felt overjoyed—you accepted that title and naturally adopted it, doesn't that mean...... Does that mean you've accepted him?
TBC.
But Spamton could only suppress his excitement. He tried hard to look straight ahead to avoid noticing his burning gaze, and you naturally continued without realizing it: "Hmm...... Um, speaking of which, the café across from the flower shop always seems super popular. I wonder how the food over there tastes......
Of course Spamton knows the café you mentioned. That was the café he sat at yesterday and secretly watched you for a long time. The café is indeed doing well, but Spamton feels embarrassed to tell you that so many of the customers are actually hired by him...... The goal is to hide his presence.
He just smiled and replied, "Ah, [Extremely popular]?" Maybe it's just a personal preference...... I don't like the [special texture]. "He was just telling the truth.
You just nod thoughtfully: "Hmm...... Is that so? But next time I'll give it a try. What if I happen to like the food at this café? ”
"Of course, I'm willing to accompany you, miss." Spamton said with a cheerful smile. You chatted casually like this, and only when you finally reached the flower shop entrance, you really didn't notice that gaze anymore. You breathed a sigh of relief, then ran into the flower shop, took out a handful of bird of paradise, and handed it to Spamton as you went out.
"Mm...... Thank you, Mr. Spamton. Also, please take me home when I get off work. It's just a small gift, and I hope you like it." As you spoke, you bowed to him firmly.
Spamton really likes this kind of flower. He looked at your lowered head, swallowed hard, and didn't go straight up to touch it. After all, your head looks fluffy, and it probably feels very comfortable to touch—soft and fluffy.
He simply took the bouquet and chuckled, "Alright, I'll head home now. If you need a [farewell service], just send a [text notification.] With that, Spamton carefully carried the bouquet toward home. You smiled as you watched his figure leave, then returned to the flower shop to continue your work for the day.
Spamton took the bouquet home and carefully placed the flower arrangement into a vase, placing it together with the flowers you had given him earlier. He admired it for a while before reopening your house's surveillance cameras. He watched as your cat boldly climbed onto the dining table after you left. Spamton snorted coldly, went out to buy some things—besides the blueberry juice you ordered yesterday, there was some cat food, canned cat food, and cat toys. Then he swaggered into your house, carefully putting the blueberry juice into your fridge, then placing the cat food and canned cat food on the counter, and setting the cat toys aside. The kitten was quickly attracted to the toys, rummaging around on them and occasionally rolling down the steps. Spamton looked at the kitten and lowered his voice fiercely: "Everything has been given to you for purchase. You need to remember that your toys and other items were purchased by me. You can't climb onto the lady of this house anymore, and you can't keep harassing my wife." The kitten didn't know if it understood, but it just meowed happily.
Only then was Spamton satisfied. He sneaked back across from your flower shop, sizing you up through the newspaper. He secretly envied those Dark People who could talk to you and get your smile, so he couldn't help but take out his phone and send you another message.
[Baby, why are you smiling at that Dark Folk again...... Darling, can't you smile at me more? If you keep this up, I'll gouge out the eyes of everyone who sees your smile!! OTTTO]
[Darling, you came here with someone else this morning, right...... Or your annoying neighbor, seriously...... It's so bad I can't even look at you openly anymore, darling. ]
[But now there's no one else around, so I can look at them for as long as I want. The baby is just so beautiful, no matter what, she always catches my eye at first sight~~^^~~]
You looked at his message, hesitated for a moment, then sighed and replied when there were no customers: [Is it only natural for me to smile at customers? You Addison are in business too, you can't help but understand this......]
[Also, I just find it annoying to keep turning around to see if anyone is following me, so I call someone to accompany me, once and for all...... Forget it, if you want to watch, go ahead. I can't stop you. ]
After sending those two messages, you stopped paying attention to the vibrations on your phone. Spamton enthusiastically sent you two messages: [Mm-hmm...... Next time, I'll try not to let the baby notice and follow you, so you won't find me annoying~~^^~~~]
[Darling, you actually let me look at it casually...... Then I have to stare at it even more openly! The baby is just too beautiful. I really like you, I love you the most, most of all, awa......]
You didn't pay attention to any of the noise, just continued to greet guests with a smile. Spamton, staring at the smile you gave others, found it especially glaring. He didn't want to keep watching, so since it was about time, he simply went back to your house to prepare dinner for you, then returned to the café to watch you.
You were completely unaware, just sending Spamton a message just before getting off work: [I'm off work, Mr. Spamton, please come pick me up.] ]
The other side only replied with a few words: [Received, [Brave the Storm]. ]
Spamton quietly slipped away from the café, then to the next street corner, making sure you couldn't see him, he openly walked toward you to pick you up and take you home. When you saw Spamton, your eyes lit up and you waved at him.
On the way back, you walked side by side, your shoulders occasionally bumping. You kept muttering as if you had in the morning, "There were quite a few guests today, I laughed so hard my face almost stiffened......" You complained, and Spamton just nodded gently. Unconsciously, you maintained this state. You returned home, waved goodbye to him, and then opened the door.
To your surprise, besides the dinner and thermos on the table today, you also see the kitten playing with a huge cat toy...... Or playing inside the cat house, and then you find cat food and canned cat food on the counter. Open the fridge and you'll find blueberry juice just as you wished.
You sit at the dining table, open your phone again, and see that little pervert's unread messages, with new ones popping up one after another.
You glance at it—hmm, the first two messages were sent by you at the flower shop this afternoon, the rest were just sent earlier.
[Darling, you saw that, awa. I bought blueberry juice for you and put it in the fridge. You can drink it whenever you want~~^^~~]
[Darling, if you have anything you'd like to ask me about, that's okay. I promise to prepare everything for you///^^///]
[Also...... I've prepared everything the cat will need. TAT baby, don't let too much attention focus on him, even though just looking at me is enough......]
[And I've also prepared dinner for you, darling. You can try it, I guarantee today's flavor will be yours! \\><//]
[But if you still don't like me, be sure to tell me TAT. I will definitely change, don't dislike me...... Ah, darling, you must have seen my message, right? How about that? Praise me ///^^///]
You hesitated for a moment as you stared at the message popping up on your phone screen, sighed, and finally opened your thermos to take a bite. Spamton, on the other end, was excitedly checking the surveillance footage, his legs trembling uncontrollably to ease his nervousness. Watching you eat, his emotions reached their peak, and he couldn't wait to see what kind of feedback you would have.
And as you chew and taste it, you have to admit, you can't really find fault with it...... Honestly, the taste is really good—at least you like it, and you can't go against your conscience and say you dislike it.
So you sent a message to that little pervert: [I really like it today, thank you, blueberry juice in the fridge...... Thank you too, I didn't have time to take care of the kitten, you bought it a lot, thank you. ]
[Then...... Hmm, let me compliment you, I really like you, you did a great job. ]You dryly message, always feeling like your words of praise were really bad.
But Spamton was already very happy. He happily praised him: [awa baby praised me~~ After saying so many thanks, does baby even like me at all? QWQ]
You silently stared at the message, your face flushed, and after hesitating for a long time, you deleted and trimmed it before sending a message: [Just a little, just a little. ]
While you were typing, the little cat was tugging at you, and you casually picked it up, and the kitten nestled up on top of you. Spamton on the other end of the surveillance camera pouted, thinking that this heartless little guy had actually climbed onto you again—how outrageous!
[Oh, by the way, I want to eat grilled fish tomorrow. ]
The other side replied instantly: [Got it!! Promise dear love to eat!! I really, really love baby's awa, so can you ...... Take that cat stuck to you down TAT]
You chuckled softly: [No]
[TTTTT]
The next few days...... It's pretty much the same as today. You'll call Spamton to go to and from work with you, and you can't help but talk to him a lot. Think about it, you've probably gotten used to Spamton's presence and his declarations of affection. And as usual, every day when you come home, you'll find a little extra stuff at home—either cat toys or small gifts for you. Come to think of it, Valentine's Day is really coming soon, right? Hmm...... About half a month left. In short, you're used to having a spotless house, and sometimes there's even extra dinner. Sometimes you order food, and the next day it's served to you exactly to your liking.
Until the weekend, you hesitate in front of the mirror for a moment, then finally change into the white dress you wore from the day you first met. You plan to go to the date, you want to give Spamton an answer—you already have the answer to this question.
TBC.

title: down
content:
You knocked on your neighbor's door, and almost the next second, he came to open it. Spamton had always been looking forward to this day, longing to go out alone with you, so when he heard your knocking, his pupils instinctively dilated—even though the next second he returned to a calm smile.
"Esteemed Miss, would you like to join us for an invitation?" He asked with a cheerful smile.
Looking at him, your face involuntarily flushed a little, so you lowered your head slightly, reached out to play with your hair, and whispered, "Mm, Mr. Spamton, let's go watch a movie together...... Also, about your previous confession to me, I've figured out how to ...... how to answer you. "Your words were a bit stammering.
"So...... Is it the [Romantic Choice of Consent]? "He asked, quietly lowering his head to look at you, gazing at your fair neck exposed because of the bow, and even his breathing grew rapid. He thought, he really ...... He liked you so much that just looking at you like this made him excited and unable to contain himself.
"Hmm...... Probably, right? I think I roughly understand what your likes really mean...... So, I, I want to give it a try...... As you spoke, your voice grew quieter and quieter, and Spamton just chuckled softly and reached out to hold your hand.
On one hand, he was ecstatic—because this way, he could approach you as an ordinary couple, even enter your household. But on the other hand, he felt a bit jealous and dissatisfied, because he knew this wasn't how he truly looked when facing you, but just a disguise to win your favor.
True affection...... True love may not be like this, because for a long time, he only has obsession with you. He can't notice those dark people who only look kinder to him after his career starts to improve a little. All his obsession, all his madness, all his love has gathered around you. Spamton just wants to watch you always, always because he has always loved you, always, always...... All his obsession and madness are invested in you; he just cares about you deeply.
But now, he still hides all this darkness and dampness behind that mask of smile. He holds your hand, feeling the beating in your chest seem to quicken, and he pulls you toward the nearby cinema.
You study movie posters, look up synopsis, and then excitedly point to one of the movies and say, "I want to see this movie." ”
Spamton took a look; the movie was called "Sick Night," just a very simple title...... Well, it seems to combine elements of suspense, horror, and romance. Spamton nodded, bought two movie tickets, then bought you a bucket of popcorn, then took your hand and walked into the theater.
At this hour, the cinema was empty. You sat down with Spamton, a bit nervous and excited. Then Spamton took out a popcorn and held it to your mouth. You swallowed it instinctively, remembering what you had just done, and your face involuntarily turned even redder.
Spamton, on the other hand, just smiles and continues to feed you popcorn. As the theater darkens, you start to focus on the movie screen.
There's nothing particularly special about this film...... The protagonist falls in love with the female lead at first sight, feeling he has a fever called 'female lead,' and begins to pursue her relentlessly. At the same time, the male lead is also a pathological criminal. He commits crimes and waits for the female lead to solve them, but the final answer is nothing but an absurd and ridiculous confession. The female lead keeps solving these cases until the last one, and the answer is the deranged male lead, so she arrests him.
You watched with great interest, since the cases in this film were all quite interesting. It wasn't until the movie ended, when the lights were turned back on in the theater and the few Dark People gradually left, and you were still savoring the movie with great interest.
Spamton gently takes your hand: "[Let's go]?" Continue with [romantic invitation]? ”
Only then did you snap back to reality, smacking your lips and excitedly suggesting, "I want to go to that dessert shop I told you about last time! I remember you said it tasted great—so, I wanted to give it a try." ”
Spamton smiled and nodded, "Of course, no problem." He pulled you outside the cinema. Curious, you glanced at the poster outside the theater, still feeling a bit nervous, since you planned to formally accept his confession at the dessert shop.
And you just excitedly chat casually with Spamton: "I think the cases in that movie just now were really interesting!" The male lead actually disguised himself as a stalker, and when the female lead finally uncovered the truth, she only left her with a ridiculous confession—honestly, this kind of male lead is still annoying, either he doesn't like him or just tells her directly. What kind of thing is that? "As you say this, you purse your lips again, not very happy.
Spamton lowered his gaze, thought for a moment, and gave a completely different answer: "Hmm...... I actually think it's not quite so. Maybe the male lead was just afraid of a failed confession, so he adopted an extreme strategy. ”
You pouted your cheeks: "That's way too extreme...... Or maybe I think it's a bit crazy. Anyway, I don't like it, but the female lead looks so cool when solving cases! I really like her...... Yeah, the male lead is a guy too, right? "As you talk, you get a bit frustrated and can't help but start waving Spamton's hand, swinging it back and forth.
"I also like that female lead too, because for the male lead, she's probably the only place for storing his obsession." Spamton said this but didn't look at you. He was a little scared. If you disliked that male lead like this—would you hate him too? But it didn't matter, as long as you kept your identity hidden, Spamton still knew his limits.
As he thinks this, he just squeezes your hand slightly. You don't notice, just resting your chin with your other hand and pondering for two seconds: "Hmm...... You mean the film's final flashback, where the female lead helped the male lead when his entire family died, he was bullied, and even subjected to cold violence and beatings? "At the end of the film, before the male lead was caught by the female lead, he had some reminiscence, and at the same time...... He also joked that he couldn't go back to the past long ago, because he had already punished those who had bullied him long ago.
You turn to look at Spamton, see him nod gently, and you smile too: "Oh my...... Does she seem very affectionate? But for the female lead, that's just a casual display of kindness. After watching the movie, I think she's always been wonderful. If she meets innocent people at a crime scene, she'll comfort them kindly, and if she finds small animals on the street, she'll help them. Actually...... I think this kind of female lead actually has the qualities of a 'white moonlight.' You said this, casually kicking stones on the road.
Spamton, on the other hand, was momentarily stunned, then smiled softly in his heart. He felt that using the word 'white moonlight' to describe you was very fitting......
Moreover, he had long since gone mad. To stand in this position, he had done everything, and he could no longer go back. He still looked at you, still quietly gazed at you, still longing for you.
No matter how many times it happens, no matter how long it takes, his gaze will always fall on you.
Unaware, you happily pulled Spamton into the dessert shop. Inside, there was milk tea, coffee, and all kinds of snacks and desserts. You flipped through the menu, hesitated for a long time, but finally ordered a Jasmine Milk Green Tea, then a matcha cake and a sandwich, and finally handed the menu to Spamton.
"Hmm...... Is this really enough? Spamton smiled, flipping through the menu.
You nodded, seriously: "I can't eat too much either...... Just order whatever you want! After all, you just treated me to a movie, so I should return the favor. ”
Spamton just shook his head: "Hmm...... No, it's my [romantic pursuit], so I should [pay for everything]. "As he spoke, he ordered a cappuccino, two tiramisu, a strawberry mille crepe, and a Napoleon cake.
You paused. Of course you understood what Spamton meant. He said that since he was pursuing you, it was only right for him to spend money...... But you always felt like you owe him a favor, and besides, you were ready to agree.
So in the end, you hesitated for a moment, but under Spamton's puzzled gaze, you finally spoke: "You can't say that...... I've already, I'm ready to accept your confession, so this counts as our joint date, and it's only right for me to pay." "You're holding on like this."
Spamton just smiled and continued to look at you, softly asking, "So, ...... do you like me?" ”
You shook your head and nodded again, showing a smile: "I...... I'm not sure, but if liking is just about caring and being good to you, then I'm sure I like you. "You've thought it over over the past few working days. You care about your neighbor, and you're willing to give everything you have to be good to him. So, this is probably what liking you is."
Then Spamton smiled and pointed to his own lips: "In that case...... a [kiss request]?" ”
You were stunned for a moment, your face flushed instantly, but you still closed your eyes, stood up, and leaned in to gently kiss Spamton's lips. His lips were icy cold, and you intended to part with a touch, but Spamton suddenly hugged your head, gently tracing your lips with his tongue. When you sat back down, you felt a bit dizzy from the kiss, your cheeks flushed, and you looked at Spamton, wanting to bite him again. He subtly licked his lips with his tongue, as if reminiscing about the taste from earlier. At the same time, the desserts and drinks you ordered were brought to the table.
TBC.
Spamton pushed those two small plates of tiramisu toward you. You paused for a moment, then smiled and accepted them. You chatted casually while eating cake, and you cheerfully started talking about what happened at work a couple of days ago.
"I feel like a lot of roses have been sold lately. Maybe Valentine's Day is coming soon...... I wonder if there are any other Valentine's Day customs here in the Dark World?" As you spoke, you looked at Spamton curiously, but Spamton just shook her head
"No, only by giving each other chocolate is to show your love or care." He said, and you nodded as you listened, which sounded pretty much like the habits of the Light World...... On the way back, you heard other Dark People discussing. It seemed some Light Folk had entered the Dark World, as if they had just finished dealing with the nearby Dark World. You didn't react to the news; instead, Spamton nervously wrapped his tail even tighter. You didn't know exactly what he was so nervous about, but in the end, you all made it home.
You call out to Spamton to help you out: "It's not convenient for me to be alone, can you help me? I want to take a bath." The kitten, missing one leg, was on the floor, happily hopping around despite only having three legs, while you simply wheeled your wheelchair to the bathroom door, then slowly stood up, holding onto the doorframe. Spamton hurried over to support you, circling you twice, his voice a bit stammering: "I should...... How to [help]? ”
"Hmm, I just have to hold onto the handle...... Help me wash up, like this. "You said, trying hard for a while but still couldn't take off your clothes, and it was Spamton who flew around helping you take them off."
"Is this so, is this ...... [Beyond Logic]?" He was still stammering. You felt like his nose was about to flow again, and you just shrugged, your voice turning a bit pitiful.
"We're a couple, aren't we? And...... Do you want to see me fall in the bathroom? "You said this, blinking at him. Spamton coughed twice; turning into this little thing, he felt a bit embarrassed to help you again...... If things were still like before, he definitely wouldn't be this nervous. If he could go back to the past—he remembered those Lightfolk who had probably come to this world today and heard what he heard today.
But no matter what, he still busied himself, holding soap and towels to help you wash up—it was only then that you truly took off your wig. Spamton saw the scars left on your head, and just a few new strands of hair, gently pressing against you with some tender concern. He didn't know if he could truly feel it with you...... But at that moment, he truly felt pain because of it.
After Spamton cleaned up for you, you changed into your pajamas, lay back down on the bed, and hugged Spamton to sleep again.
The next period was like this, about half a month later. You thought it would always be like this...... In the morning, Spamton prepares breakfast for you. After eating, he pushes your wheelchair, and you go for a walk together. Sometimes you stand up and walk around with your wheelchair for a while. On Sundays, Spamton goes shopping for some things, and you have plenty of money—but that morning, you won't go out, just stay home playing on your phone and wait for Spamton to come back. Normally, he comes back around ten or eleven in the morning, but today...... You wait until noon, but still no sign of him.
You feel a bit uneasy and drive your wheelchair out of the house. First, you ask the other neighbors nearby: "Hello, did you see the Dark People who used to come out with me this morning?" ”
They had been whispering among themselves, whispering and whispering something, but upon hearing this, the Dark People began to talk at once.
"Today, other Lightfolk have come to Cyber City."
"I saw your little guy talking to those People of Light."
"Then those people of light seem to have gone to the Queen's villa......
"As for where that Dark Citizen went, we haven't seen it." As they spoke, they all shook their heads.
You forced down your unease and steered your wheelchair toward the Queen's villa. Somehow, you kept feeling that Spamton...... Maybe it was in that place. Unexpectedly, there were no other Darkfolk guards at the villa's entrance, and the road was clear and unobstructed. Along the way, you saw some signs of smashing and smashing. Following these marks, you finally arrived at the basement door.
…… Then you look at the path to the basement with only stairs and fall silent. Luckily, you brought a cane for convenience, so you get up, grit your teeth, and shakily walk downstairs. After you finally manage to walk up the two steps on your own, when you reach the basement, you hear the howling wind...... There are also the sounds of battle coming and going. You look up at the basement and see a tall—so tall you don't know how to describe it—but countless threads are tied around him, but these threads ...... Most seem broken, but they still wrap around him, with only one strand trembling from the ceiling.
Is that spamton? You don't know, you only know it suddenly became huge, huge. You take a deep breath, steady your breath, and shout at maximum volume: "Spamton!" ”
Immediately after, the monster hanging in the air, which had been laughing wildly, suddenly retracted its expression, staring at you in panic.
TBC.
Ever since he heard that the People of Light might come to Cyber City, Spamton has been a bit dazed. Even though you say it's okay, and you like him even like this, Spamton knows well—many things can never be the same as before, he can't hold you completely anymore, and he can't help you with many things. He ...... He's become a tiny one, always afraid you'll leave him one day, and he's unwilling to accept it, after all...... He used to stand by your side and hold your hand, but now, he can only fly beside you, held in your arms.
That sense of unwillingness and pain grows day by day, and you probably haven't noticed anything. Spamton probably hopes you'll discover something, but he's afraid you'll notice even a little. If only you could know his pain—but he doesn't want you to suffer the same either.
Spamton found those Lightborn, made a deal, and helped remove the patrolling guards on the Queen's Manor Road, while they helped get the Neo armor from the basement. At that moment, his whole body was torn apart—a kind of pain, and a growing obsession took over his soul. No matter what—no matter what, he wanted to grow even bigger, to have what he once had, to be able to embrace you completely again. This mad obsession took over his mind, and he launched an attack on those Lightborn. As long as he obtained the same soul—he could go to the world of light, and he could always be by your side.
This mad obsession drove him. Even though the threads tied tightly to his body hurt unbearably, and every break made him feel on the verge of collapse, he still persisted, continuing to block the path of those of the Light's people with sorrow and obsession, until he heard your voice.
—Until he heard your voice clearly.
He stiffly lowered his head to look at you. The first thing he noticed was that you weren't in a wheelchair, just leaning on a cane, panting heavily. Instinctively, he reached out to hug you, but then Spamton's movements stiffened for a moment, because he noticed that his body was almost covered in spikes...... It really wasn't suitable to hug you.
Kris stopped attacking because of your sudden appearance. He watched you warily, and together with the other two, you glanced at them wearily, then leaned on your cane and walked step by step toward Spamton. This should have been Spamton's attack turn, but he stopped moving because of you, so the Lightfolk couldn't move.
You walk up to him, hesitate for a moment, and finally grab one of his outstretched hands—you really can't hold him anymore, so you just ask in a low voice, "...... Shall we go home?" At this moment, you don't think about anything else, just want to take him home. The rest can be discussed later.
"...... [Unable to set off and return], my [Program] needs a [heart-shaped object]." He said in a low voice.
You looked up at him, then at the few Lightfolk across from you, finally pressed your temple, pulled out dozens of dark coins, and tossed them to them, whispering, "This is an apology...... I'm sorry, this guy won't attack you anymore, but I hope you can leave here for now, okay? ”
The three guys stayed silent, and in the end, didn't accept the dark coin you threw out. They just walked up the path in the basement.
And you watch them finally leave, then you breathe a sigh of relief and look up at this especially big spamton...... Hmm, in the end, you still hold him carefully and whisper, "Mm...... Is this your real hope, or is it false...... Um, what's the programming? ”
Sometimes, you feel as if you've never truly met this guy before, maybe because he has too many traits...... But no matter what, once you've made up your mind, you won't let go. You just look up at him, waiting for his answer.
Spamton seemed to make a slight gumble. He reached out and picked you up. Although the area in front of him was a bit hard, he held you carefully, and you actually felt a faint warmth from the cold metal...... It seemed this body still had some softness; his voice was even deeper, the crackling of electric currents almost piercing human ears: "I hope...... I can have a [heart-shaped object], and then travel with you to the [World of Light]. "His voice was very low, but he was speaking right next to your ear, so of course you heard it clearly.
You pouted and poked his head with your finger. Although your finger hurt a bit because you were somewhat metallic now, "Are you an idiot?" "When did I say I was going to the Light World?" "If nothing unexpected happens, you should be staying in the Dark World forever. After all, your lover is here, and you have no lingering attachments to anyone or things in the Light World."
But Spamton just whispered, "...... However, your [Re-examination Results] require you to travel to the [Light World]. "He still didn't say what happened to you during your absence, but you suddenly understood...... He seemed to have endured pain beyond ordinary people's imagination during that time.
You pressed your forehead against his. Now that he was holding you, you looked like a tiny one, but you just gently wrapped your arms around his neck and softly said, comforting him: "After that, everything will be fine. I just need to go to the Light World for a check-up. I'll really be back in two days, hmm?" ”
But Spamton just stares at you, looking into his eyes now, and you feel inexplicably a little scared—though you're used to the changes your lover has experienced lately.
"[I don't trust], I wish I could go to the [Light World] with you. I want to [embrace] you again, [hug like this]." As he spoke, it was as if all his unwillingness and confusion had drifted out of his voice. You were stunned for a moment. You understood—he wanted to be with you all the time—hmm, this was probably a simple wish, and now he was looking at you, as if asking you to help him fulfill this small wish.
You gently pressed against him, resting your head on his shoulder, carefully avoiding the spikes. You softly asked, "Then...... Do you want my soul?" "For you, the soul isn't that important to begin with, after all...... Although you can rely on this soul to accomplish many things...... But you have no desire for anything in the world of light. If he wanted to go to the world of light, you think you would go with him.
Spamton seemed stunned for a moment. He hugged you tightly, his voice a bit dry: "If I seize your [heart-shaped object], what will you ...... [what should you do]?" ”
"It's okay...... Although I've never done anything like this, I should be able to split half with you." You muttered, honestly, if it weren't for what happened today reminding you, you would have almost forgotten you still have a soul.
You look at this big Spamton, annoyed again, and poke his forehead: "You really are an idiot...... Why didn't you tell me about this? I'm really sad, you know, because you kept this from me...... You kept it from me, but Spamton suddenly interrupted you.
He murmured softly, "[Sorry]." ”
You stopped mid-sentence, and in the end just glared at him fiercely. Then you closed your eyes and let the soul inside you—the heart-shaped object—fly out. The only difference was that it was a blue heart. You didn't say much, just tried to separate the heart, and then the other half returned to your body. You did feel a bit weak, and indeed a bit empty—probably because you instinctively wanted your partner to fill your empty chest. You just looked at the small heart that had become new and handed it to spamton: "You...... Take it." ”
Spamton was stunned for a moment, but still took the half soul. Then that tiny heart burrowed into his chest, and he placed you back on the ground. The threads scattered across the floor, and he simply transformed back into that small, demon-like thing that flew to your side.
You look at him, embrace him, that soul—or rather, heart—resonating in sync within both of you. In that moment, you feel completeness again, and Spamton also feels contentment. He vaguely realizes through the presence of this heart what he can do now.
You head toward the basement stairs, ready to complete the difficult task—climbing back up—when Spamton suddenly grows larger. He transforms back into his former form, the same as before he voluntarily jumped into the acid pool. He just wraps his arms around your waist and lets you sit on top of him. You stare blankly holding your cane, tilting your head to look at him, while Spamton just leans in, smiles, and kisses your forehead again. Then, he slowly carries you upward, smoothly leaving the Queen's villa, putting you back in his wheelchair, and pushing you outside.
You bit your lip, but you didn't look back at him, just nervously asked, "You...... Do you want to return to the Light World with me?" As soon as you said that, you laughed at yourself. That was clearly a definite answer. What exactly were you worried about?
Spamton was taken aback, a smile playing at the corner of his mouth: "Of course, I am very willing. This is my honor. Do you need me to push you to the Light World?" ”
So you smiled too: "Alright, let's go home." You all headed toward the boundary between the worlds of light and darkness.
TBC.
There were no other obstacles; the road was almost unobstructed. Spamton pushed your wheelchair into the world of light. It was his first time seeing the scenery of the world of light. Watching the bustling traffic, as if no one had noticed you, he couldn't help but chuckle softly. To be honest—he didn't feel much at this moment, but the soul that existed in his chest told him that everything was certain, real, and reliable.
So he softly asked, "What about the next [target location]?" ”
"I told you, we're going home...... But I haven't really tidied up my house in the Light World, so I originally thought I wouldn't go back. "You complained, pointing Spamton in the right direction. He pushed you that way. There are many monsters and humans in this world, and that's why no one paid much attention to your strange pair. When Spamton pushed you into the elevator, he still ...... a bit lacking in reality.
But now, he watched you open the door with the keys, then you took two steps back and instructed Spamton, "Go tidy up quickly. I haven't been here in a long time, and the house must be pretty dirty by now." ”
Spamton walked into your house, and indeed...... It looked like it hadn't been lived in for a long time, covered in a thin layer of dust. He used cleaning tools to tidy up the whole room until it was spotless before pushing you back in. You looked at the shiny house with satisfaction, couldn't help but stand up to spin a few times, but your steps were unsteady and you fell. Spamton caught you, and you looked at each other, unable to help but giggle foolishly.
"Oh...... Alright, from now on, this place is our home. Do you like this place?" "You smiled cheerfully." Squinting her eyes as she asked him, her hand instinctively wrapping around his neck.
"I [especially like it]." Spamton responded with a cheerful smile. Although the house was a bit small, with only one bedroom, the bed was big enough for you to sleep on it—just thinking about being able to hold you to sleep at night made his heart race.
So he couldn't help but add, "I also [especially like you]." ”
Your face flushed a little, and you couldn't help but turn your head slightly, muttering softly, "Mm...... Yeah, I like you too, but it's just a little bit, just a little bit. "You emphasized that no matter how many times you keep stressing this matter."
Spamton just put his arm around you, gently reached out to pat your head, and softly asked, "Mm...... So, what about the [Lunch Requirement]? "After his reminder, you remembered that after all this time, you still hadn't thought about lunch. You're not even that hungry now."
You thought for a moment, your eyes darted around, then you tugged at Spamton's hand: "Mm, let's have a good lunch today! There's nothing at home...... So, let's go out and eat! ”
You held his hand and walked out, still a bit wobbly. Spamton grabbed your hand tightly, hugging your shoulder just as you were about to fall. You leaned into his embrace and laughed at him in unison.
You arrived at a nearby hotpot restaurant, and with a big wave, you said, "I'm treating you today!" "You can eat whatever you like!" You ordered a mandarin duck pot, then picked dishes according to your own preferences, and passed the menu to Spamton, who also ordered some dishes—to be honest, back in the Dark World, he had never tried hotpot before, so he couldn't help but be curious about what this thing called hotpot tasted like.
When the food was served, you raised your chopsticks to try something, but your right hand trembled uncontrollably. Spamton stopped your hand, imitating your movements, and somewhat unskillfully put all the dishes you wanted into the hot pot. Then he looked at you and asked, "Do you need anything extra?" ”
You shake your head, indicating you have nothing left. When the soup starts boiling, you tell Spamton you can retrieve the items. He frantically handles the things—some are on your plate, and some can't fit them on, so he puts them on his plate.
You looked at Spamton and gave a slightly mischievous smile: "Want to try it too?" It's really tasty. Just rinse the scooped vegetables in sesame oil for a bit. "As you spoke, you demonstrated by dipping the lamb rolls into the sesame oil for a bit, then putting them in your mouth, showing a look of enjoyment.
Spamton, half skeptical, followed the instructions and ate a slice. Then, his face, which had been smiling, started to lose his composure. He quickly picked up the cold boiled water beside him and took several sips. His pale cheeks began to flush, and he even coughed several times while holding his cup, clearly from the spiciness.
You couldn't help but smile with your eyes curved into several loud laughs. Only when you got his clearly reluctant smile, which was a bit plaintive, did you finally stop laughing, just holding back your laughter and saying, "Looks like you probably can't handle spicy food...... Hmm, whatever you want to eat, just put it in this white soup pot. As for what you put on your plate, if you still want to eat it, just rinse it with cold water before eating. ”
Spamton glanced at you but said nothing. He just got up and went to the condiment station to get some dipping sauce. You ignored him and continued eating your own food. Then Spamton put the oil-stained dishes from his plate into yours as well. You didn't think about it, just rinsed the sesame oil as usual and put it in your mouth. Then your cheeks flushed, and you couldn't help but take the glass of cold boiled water and drink several sips.
The reason was simple—you realized Spamton had taken another plate full of chili sauce. He had deliberately soaked the food in the chili before handing it to you. Now you were spicy, sticking out your tongue to fan the air, glaring fiercely at Spamton. Although that glare only made you look coquettish with your cheeks flushed. Spamton, looking at you, just kept smiling. But he didn't dare put the red soup pot in again. He just asked what dish you wanted, put it in the pot, and picked it up on your plate to save you from suddenly shaking your hand again. If he burned you, he'd be heartbroken.
And he himself only made a pot of plain soup. Overall, you all enjoyed your lunch quite well, and when it came time to pay, you used the currency of the whole world to settle the bill...... This made Spamton look a bit like a pretty boy.
Because of this, the waiter quietly shot him a look.
Spamton simply ignored you, took your hand, and led you out: "Next [destination]?" ”
You thought for a moment: "Let's go to the supermarket...... I need to buy something. Hmm, you hold it for me." As you spoke, you pointed toward the supermarket, and Spamton led you over, then ...... You directed him to take the bedding set and various daily necessities. This time, Spamton didn't sneak in secretly, but openly took some couple-style cups and plates in front of you. You shot him a sneaky glare and let him go.
But you were giving instructions again: "I want to eat crayfish tonight!" The crayfish here looks pretty good, buy some to take home...... Hmm, and some fruit...... I want to buy some blueberries to take home! "As you spoke, you started picking and picking, but unfortunately, your taste is pretty limited. Anyway, Spamton came over and took most of what you had screened, picking out something else. You muttered a bit unhappy, but Spamton was the one who cooked, so you chose to follow his advice.
In the end, you brought a big pile of things to pay the bill. Spamton held you by one hand and carried the things home with the other. He placed you on the sofa in the room and started tidying up the things by himself. You felt a bit embarrassed and wanted to help, but in the end, Spamton sent you back to sit on the sofa, just propping up your chin and watching Spamton busy.
After you finished packing your daily necessities, you went out to buy some clothes. Spamton kept holding your hand, and the clerks assumed you were a couple. They kept promoting couple clothing. Some of the clothes were pretty good, but some were just plain in shape. Spamton originally wanted to buy them all with a wave of his hand and send them out, but you grabbed his hand and forcibly pulled him out of the store, whispering, "We're not in the Dark World anymore. We're not that wealthy, so don't spend money recklessly." ”
…… That's what you said, but in the end, you still spent all sorts of money on something delicate but impractical, purely for looks. Spamton looked at you quietly, and you just gave a dry laugh, guiltily looking away.
Every day when you're at home or when you go out, you think about someone else waiting for you at home, always thinking about ...... Going home early so you can see the other person. When you think this way, either he or you look forward to the moment of coming home even more. Of course, most of the time, Spamton stays by your side, as if if if you disappear the next second if he doesn't look at you.
Even for hospital check-ups, Spamton accompanied you. You needed to get an MRI enhancement, and Spamton squeezed over to sign the enhancement notification—after all, he was your family member.
Of course, the follow-up results were good, so there was nothing to worry about. Spamton just held hands as usual, you wobbled as you walked, and Spamton looked at you with a smile until you accidentally fell into his arms again. He hugged you tightly and then gently kissed your forehead.
You blinked, hugged him tightly, leaned in and kissed his lips, then you looked at each other and laughed silently.
…… Tomorrow will probably be another day of gentle breezes and bright sunshine, and you will always maintain this daily routine. After all, at this very moment, life and death are intertwined—that soul represents you, and naturally, it represents your life and death.
But as long as ...... As long as we can always see each other, that's enough.
END.

title: what is love (White Pan R18)
content:
After a few drinks, you should have felt a bit sad, but now all you feel is empty loneliness, and in the refreshing night breeze, you feel even more sober. You still don't understand why, when your ex breaks up with you, he angrily says you're someone who can't even touch the edge of love. But you really don't feel sorry for him.
You just felt a bit lonely. So, riding the wave of alcohol, probably dizzy or mustering courage, you slipped into the dark world as usual. In this world, no one knew you, and no one questioned you anymore. You walked along the neon-lit street, looking at the glowing skyscrapers around you, feeling the wind, but not feeling even more alert. Instead, feeling dizzy, you crossed the street and reached a commercial street ahead.
From afar, you see a white figure. His shop is deserted and deserted, with no one asking about it, but it seems he sees you and actually walks toward you. You have some impression of this figure, but you can't quite recall it, only that he is also a member of Addison.
But he remembers you. He knows you're a citizen of light, and that's only natural, but what impresses him most is ...... Probably a few times before, when he was being bullied by other Addisons, you stood in front of him and bought an item from his shop without even looking.
After that, his shop's business did pick up, but no one knew what those Addisons were talking about again. Gradually, no one came to visit.
At this moment, Spamton summoned his courage again. He picked out products from his shop but couldn't find anything good-looking—something you'd definitely like at a glance. After hesitating, he hurriedly picked up a pen. At least the appearance was polished and attractive enough.
You blinked, dullly looking at the hesitant white Addison standing before you.
"Hello, is there something I need?" After hesitating for a moment, you still chose to speak first.
At the same time, he spoke up: "[Limited Time Special Price $4.99!] ][Half Price Offer Today Only]! As he spoke, Spamton tried to take out the pen, but in his panic, he didn't know where it had gone.
You glanced at him twice, remembered that this was the little salesman you had bought to help him out before. Whether it was drunkenness or genuine sorrow for his fate, you gently wrapped your arm around his wrist, grabbed his hand, and then slipped a $100 bill into his collar.
“…… Can I buy you for just $4.99? I probably paid twenty times that amount. Then, consider me the one who bought you." You don't even know what you're talking about, just silently turn around, grab his hand, and walk toward a nearby hotel.
Spamton, for once, widened his eyes. He wasn't here to sell himself to you—though if you truly wanted to take a few more glances, he would feel genuine excitement and joy.
He hadn't expected that the first item he promoted was bought by you, and the second time was the same. But this time, by a twist of fate, the one he promoted ended up being himself—even sold at a low price. But if you asked him if he was willing to do such a business? Spamton would say again, he was naturally willing.
He didn't struggle at all, just followed your footsteps, and for some reason, he even felt a bit timid and excited—a bit elated. Is he really going to be with you? Is he going to be with you, the noble citizen of light? He still found it hard to believe. Although Spamton could tell you were drunk and that these decisions were probably not sober, he knew he had to seize this opportunity—or rather, hold on tight.
After walking down the street for a while and feeling a bit chilly, you finally sobered up, feeling a bit embarrassed and regretful. Oh my god, what exactly did you just do! But at this moment, you've already checked into a room with Spamton, and even walked into the guest room under the mischievous gaze of the front desk.
You walk into the room, turn around, and take out the bill you've been tucking into Spamton's collar just now. Feeling a bit too scared to look at him, you just lower your head and say, "...... I was just rambling earlier. This deal probably wasn't what I imagined. You can leave now." ”
But Spamton only took two steps closer to you. You instinctively stepped back, then sat down on the bed, while he half-knelt on the floor, resting his head on your legs. He looked up, and for some reason, his expression seemed a bit pitiful: "But [you] have already [gained lifelong rights], [you] want to throw me into the [trash bin]?" "He seems to be accusing you."
Actually, Spamton just thought that at this moment, he should take advantage of this chance of misidentification to get involved with you, or rather—take it further. But he wasn't sure whether the surge in his chest was really some affection and affection for you. But maybe it was the warmth of the room, or maybe the faint scent on your body that made him yearn for you. At that moment, he swallowed hard for no reason, feeling as if he was a bit thirsty.
You're starting to panic. I didn't expect Spamton to take that deal seriously. Maybe...... You really do need the nourishment of your next relationship. Maybe a romance with the Dark People can change anything? But no love really starts like that. At least, reason tells you it's not, but it's still a kind of venting. In the end, you just nod and shake your head.
"If you agree...... Of course I don't mean to abandon you! It's just that I'm worried you might be reluctant, you—" Before you finished speaking, your eyes widened because your skirt was lifted by the white addiso, and your underwear was pushed aside, making you look rather pitiful, revealing thick black pubic hair and two pink petals hidden within.
You've never done anything like this before. At this moment, I couldn't help but stutter, not knowing what to say.
"You...... Are you going to do this right now? "At this moment, you actually feel flustered and at a loss.
He simply reached out a hand and gently stroked the petals: "[You] already [have lifelong usage rights], and of course, [you] can [do as you wish]." ”
You widened your eyes, unsure how to react for a moment. His hand played with the two petals, and at that moment, the previously dry petals began to ooze a bit of honey, wetting his fingers. The two petals involuntarily shrank back, but Spamton didn't stop his actions. His fingers only slightly moved upward, caressing and pressing among the dense flowers, as if searching for something. Your body trembled involuntarily, and the moans from your throat grew louder, and your breathing grew more rapid. All of this was extremely unfamiliar to you, and your body went limp, unsure of what to do next. You looked at Spamton, and he just smiled and grabbed your clitoris, which had just become slightly erect and was suddenly tingling with each press.
Then, his fingertips lightly traced it twice. Your body trembled, as if even more warm water was spurting out from your flower. He looked at those two pink petals opening and closing, licked his lips, and for some reason, felt even more hungry and thirsty.
Spamton was actually doing these things for the first time. His movements were a bit bluish, but he still pressed the clip ad he somehow saw, gently pressing his clitoris, rubbing and rubbing his fingers back and forth, then lightly flicking with his fingertips. Waves of tingling itch and pleasure surged back in your heart once again. You moaned in excess, feeling your body grow soft, but you were so embarrassed that you didn't want to lie on your back right now. Even though the waves of pleasure grew more intense, his fingers lightly slid into the wet flower, gently stretching the wet yet warm passage, then rubbing and spinning the tender flesh walls with his knuckles.
That wave of pleasure seemed to weaken again, at least giving you a moment to catch your breath. So you took a few deep breaths, instinctively grabbing the sheets with both hands, but your toes curled up involuntarily. For a moment, the room was quiet, but the faint sounds of water and heavy breathing still mingled together, blending together, while that lewd scent gradually swept through the room.
Spamton didn't look up at you, just listened to your breathing. He knew he was right, so his finger smoothed out the folds on the wall of the passage, letting the honey drip down the opening and closing petals onto the floor, making a soft, fragmented sound.
His fingers kept pushing deeper, gently stroking the inside of the passage with his fingertips, pressing with varying degrees until your body trembled violently. Then Spamton knew he had found the right spot. His fingertips circled that sensitive spot, then pressed down hard. At the same time, his thumb, which had been rubbing back and forth on your clitoris, pressed down hard at that moment. Instinctively, you tilted your neck back, feeling as if you had reached the edge of some uncontrollable emotion. [A long, long time ago, a young girl woke up. She didn't know where she was, nor who she really was, where she came from, or where she was going. She didn't know why she existed here; it seemed as if the whole world was left with only her—no, perhaps even the concept of a person suddenly appeared in her mind, and she began to wonder: What is a person?
The girl left this small yet incredibly clear world, or rather, this home. Her name was given by her parents, so she understood who she was, or rather, who she was by others' definitions. She was born from her mother's womb, given life by her parents; her first cry in the world was her cry, her parents raised her, and her parents taught her to leave this family. So she knew where she came from; she was born from her parents' expectations and carried them away.
So the girl grew up carrying her parents' expectations, experiencing tears, joy, falling and getting back up again, experiencing disappointment and the joy of success, admiration and undeniable jealousy, and the inevitable sense of superiority from looking down on others. She grew up, under the guidance of her parents and the guidance of elders, becoming an upright, free, and brave person.
She knows where she wants to go, she wants to pursue her ideals. She knows what she should do, she wants to work hard for her ideals and even dreams, to shatter the injustices in the world, to protect justice, to speak up for the weak, to make choices freely, even if the road ahead is muddy and full of thorns, even if it is hard to break free from fate's shackles, even if it feels like heavy shackles and shackles making it hard to move forward, even if she occasionally feels as if a god is guiding her actions to make choices against her own wishes—she must resolutely move toward an unknown future.
Now, the girl has answered those three questions, but she still doesn't know—what exactly is a person?
She continued on the path she had set, wielding the invisible sword in her hand without hesitation, cutting through the thorns ahead. She would bravely and resolutely cross all the lows and mud, crossing mountains, rivers, and seas, but the further she went, the heavier her steps became.
Because along the way, besides the beautiful scenery and smiling people, she also saw many other things. She saw people struggling to survive at sewer mouths piled with mud and dirty water dripping all day, their cheeks emaciated only to bones, their teeth lost all — perhaps sold for money, their hair sparse and messy, some stained with oil, and some without proper clothing; She also saw people in high positions, with debauchery and indulgence, flushed faces but still raising their glasses and shouting, stepping on unappetizing fresh meat, dressed in gold and silver; She saw beggars wandering the streets, shouting for someone to show mercy and give him some money. She saw life and death. On her journey, the girl witnessed all kinds of human life. She felt anger and humiliation, and sometimes joy and emotion. She couldn't help but ask herself: So, why should people be human?

So the girl felt guilty. She did everything she could to help these people, teaching homeless children how to make a living, guiding her to find families in need of adoptive children, persuading the wealthy to give leftover meals to the poor left at the sewer entrance, stopping her numb-faced wife from cutting off her hand, leading her to report to the police and lawsuits, leaving evidence to ensure her husband was punished......

So the girl woke from the dream; the invisible blade in her hand became a pen this time, the path beneath her feet became countless sheets of paper, she faithfully recorded every word and action she saw on the paper beneath her feet, and she traced her thoughts and thoughts with the pen in her hand. She also hopes that by constantly moving forward, she can find answers to her current ideals: What is a person? Why must people become human? What is the meaning of existence? She has been searching for answers to these questions, from life to death. Perhaps she cannot find the right answers or answer her own questions, but she stubbornly and resolutely walks her own path, without hesitation.
The story ends here. So, what do you think is the meaning of existence? ]
After telling the story, you didn't ask him what he thought, just stuffed the leftover sandwich into his hand, saying you couldn't eat much. Then you noticed the dirt on his hand and stuffed it directly into his mouth.
At first, he just chews mechanically, then quickly gulps down his food. You silently watch him with those lifeless eyes, close the book in your hand, slowly walk to the shelf, place this book on it, and take down another.
This time, it's a book called "Diconca's Night Talks from the Countryside."
After he finished eating, you knelt down, propped your head up, and looked at him, slowly asking: "What do you think is the meaning of existence?" "There's no point in asking this question in itself; you just want to know the answer."
He stared at you steadily, hesitated for a moment, and said, "...... 'big', become 'bigger', 'very big', 'big' to surpass [the sky], 'big' to be completely 'free', 'big' enough to let go of restraints...... Maybe [you] want to become [big shot] too? ”
You gazed at him, only gently nodded, nodded your chin, and understood his answer: "...... I understand, but if you allow me to politely decline, I don't want to ...... become some big shot. Actually, I just want to quietly read here for a while, and then...... Maybe find someone to listen to my story...... That's why I kept you here. ”
You lowered your gaze to look at the book in your hand, then at him, taking a deep breath and trying hard to look up at your inner tension and unease: "But this is ...... Maybe you can be my ghost typist and agent?" "Your words were very difficult, almost word by word and deliberate."
"That is, you help me record what I say, use a typewriter or other means, and then submit it on my behalf...... That's probably the kind of work it is. I don't want to stand in front of people...... In fact, why should I tell you all this? Just pretend you didn't hear it...... "By the end, your voice was very soft, almost murmuring, and you didn't even know where you got the courage to say these things to a stranger, so you instinctively hugged your knees and shrank back.
But you hear his resolute, or rather, impatient voice: "[No], of course I [will], but why do [you] need a [Ghost Typist]?" ”
You look up at him, then reach out and grab the book. Your hand trembles visibly, and the book falls to the floor. You say emotionlessly, "As you can see, I can't write, can't record, so I need someone else to help me write it...... Maybe you can?" At this point, you hesitate again.
Then you look at him and nod without hesitation, but you have no idea what he really thinks. But based on his words, you guess he might need greater fame, become more powerful and influential, and then be able to look down on everything ......? Maybe that's not the freedom he needs, but you dared to make this suggestion, and he accepted it.
So you continued, "Mm...... Alright. In exchange, you can live here, you can dine here, and I'll prepare new clothes for you. The house next to this small library is mine too, you can live there. "Sometimes when you read late, you don't return to the world of light but stay here.
“…… Besides that, you can also get half the pay you get from publishing books. I don't know how to split it evenly......" you hesitate as you speak.
Spamton looked at you again, surprised that you would offer such a large share of the profits, but he didn't need that share, so he just shook his head: "[No], I don't need [profit sharing]. ”
Your words were interrupted, just blinking slowly, reacting for a moment, then asking, "...... Then what do you need? ”
His gaze fell on your chest—no, or even deeper—and you dullly glanced at your own chest.
He said, "I need your heart-shaped object." ”
You blinked slowly. You know that without a soul, you always lack something, or rather, it's like the death of self-awareness, or perhaps, you simply don't exist as a person, but you don't care.
You just nodded: "Alright. But there's a premise: if my gray soul can turn red, I'll give it to you." ”
A beat too late, you remembered and added, "Hmm...... So, is that it, the deal is done? Ah, I haven't even asked your name yet. ”
“…… Spamton G. Spamton。 His voice sounded somewhat stifled.
And you just bent down slightly, grabbed his hand, and shook it, not caring that the puppet's little hand looked dirty now: "Well then, Mr. Spamton, the recording work will start tomorrow. I'll provide you with the equipment." ”

title: One Thousand and One Nights 2-sptx you
path: articles/en/spt/一千零一夜/一千零一夜2-sptx你.html
content:
"So...... "Hmm, I'll provide the equipment. Tonight, Mr. Spamton, will you stay in the next room for now?" I'm afraid you don't have a fixed residence or a steady source of income, do you? "You stared at him steadily, tilting your head slightly.
Spamton seemed a bit hesitant, or rather, rather reluctant: "Thank you, thank you for your kindness...... But maybe I shouldn't accept free support......
You tilted your head, frowning in confusion, and the corners of your mouth curved slightly: "Hey, but didn't you already agree? I thought we had already settled the deal......" Your words carried a hint of regret.
"I believe the [heart-shaped object] has already surpassed all this [reward], so I shouldn't agree to the former." He explained this.
You stroked your chin, thoughtful, then lowered your eyebrows and looked at him gently: "But the heart-shaped object you mentioned isn't that important to me...... If you need it, I can give it to you too. And if I have someone I hire live outside, I'd feel embarrassed, so just agree to my request...... No, or rather, it's a request. ”
"Ah, or are you just sneaking away like the rats in the sewer, and then sneaking back the next day?"
“…… Alright, I [agree]. "You can't see his expression; it's just that after the silent silence, he finally agreed to your request.
"Also, your attitude doesn't need to be so lowly, compared to ......" He tried to say something more, but you just bent down, expressionless, and reached out to cover his mouth. You know your approach is actually quite ruthless—whether it's forcing him to stay to listen to stories, making him your ghost typist, or even providing him with a place to stay now. But maybe you're just too lonely, too isolated, that's why you do this. You don't know why he chose to stay at first, and you don't really mind.
Maybe Spamton just thinks that since you're a citizen of light, there's always an opportunity, and it's for this seemingly undetectable chance that he stays.
He stopped speaking, and you stared at him, slightly pulling the corner of your mouth: "Alright, I'm asking you because I know it's all just my demand, and you don't have to agree to it." ”
“…… Now that things have been settled and the story is finished, let's go back and rest." As you spoke, you grabbed the little puppet by the collar and put the book—which had only turned two pages—back onto the shelf, then headed toward the neighboring room.
Though small, the house is fully equipped. Although small, this house has a one-bedroom living room and a kitchen, which is naturally enough for someone like you who only stays occasionally in the Dark World. Today...... After telling the story, you feel a bit tired and don't plan to go back.
You carried Spamton into the house, then put him on the floor, took out some clothes from the room, went to the bathroom to take off his clothes, and planned to change and wash up. You didn't know when Spamton had gone far, but you didn't pay much attention. You just washed up simply, dried with a towel, tied up your hair, wrapped it in a towel, and left the bathroom.
You see Spamton pacing anxiously on the carpet, seemingly afraid of dirtying the clean and tidy house you brought in, so you slow down a beat and say, "Ah, it's fine, just come in directly. I clean the house every day. But I think you should take a hot shower first." ”
After that, you just ignored him. After all, no matter what, you definitely have the ability to take care of yourself. Soon, you heard sounds coming from the bathroom. You lay on the bed, put on your underwear, covered yourself with a blanket, and casually opened a book placed by the bedside to start reading...... It was a copy called "Six Records of a Floating Life."
When he walked back in, you looked up at him and realized he hadn't prepared any clothes, so he was still wearing a towel...... Although that was enough. You pressed your temples and grunted, "I'll find a piece of clothing for you to put on...... I have a dryer at home. Your clothes can be changed tomorrow after washing." Saying that, you casually grabbed a leftover white shirt from the wardrobe and handed it to him. In the Dark World, you still have some clothes to change into.
He took the white shirt but didn't put it on. After a moment of silence, he asked you a question: "...... My [Resting Place]?" ”
You let out an 'ah' and turned to look at him again: "Right here." Because there's only one bed, you should sleep on this bed too. But I don't live here often, so you don't need to worry. ”
You see the puppet's face seems to be flushed, smoke appears to be rising from its head, and you tilt your head in confusion, not quite understanding.
“…… Didn't you understand? "You asked, while getting back on the bed and tucking the blanket over you, patting the other half of the bed.
"No...... no, of course I understand, but is this really unreasonable......" he stammered as he finished speaking.
Of course you know what he means, you know what he's saying, but you just lower your gaze and look at him emotionlessly: "I know...... But I don't care about that kind of thing. If you want, you can change clothes here. I don't mind, but to me, that means nothing." The words were a bit harsh but real, because that's your true inner thought. In other words, you don't even care what exactly is happening to you. That's why you easily let him in and put him to bed.
…… Anyway, what does it matter? You will eventually die, your soul will never belong to you, so before that, it doesn't matter if you give your soul to Him.
His movements paused, but the stiffness he had earlier faded. He just looked up and gave you a look you couldn't understand. You don't know if that was out of shock, or if ...... Was it just a form of pity?
