content:
…… Well, actually, adding it again is just to avoid forgetting yourself. If you don't remind yourself, you would easily believe Spamton's recommendations. After all, you remember the good but not the bad. Although you might get angry when you first remember, you will forget it later. You only remember the person who took all your money back then, and now he has returned all that money to you! True, anyway, in the underworld, this cash is useless.
You happily followed behind Spamton, walking slowly as you counted the cash. Good, no problem, still the amount you lost that day. But this little money doesn't seem to be enough to do much, hmm, maybe you can consider it yourself......
Before you could finish your thoughts, you almost kicked Spamton again. You couldn't guarantee how much your toes would hurt if you hit the puppet, so you quickly stopped, then looked up and saw rows of houses. Then you knew you'd reached your destination.
It looked like there were some residents, but not many...... You looked around thoughtfully, nodded, and walked toward one of the houses that looked nice. The landlord was still standing there, and it looked like all these were bulk rental properties. Compared to those with agents, these houses were a bit cheaper than those with agents, but their safety and legality weren't guaranteed......
Just as you were thinking this, you noticed Spamton was still following you, because he had just bumped your leg. You lowered your head and looked at him in surprise: "...... Why are you still following me? You've already taken me to our destination. I'm grateful to you, but that's all. ”
"I think maybe your silver dollars aren't enough." But that's all he said.
You pouted, reluctantly accepting his explanation. But to be honest—you don't think five thousand Dark Coins isn't enough!
As it turns out, he was right, and you were overthinking it. The house here also requires a month's deposit and three months' rent, and every month it's exactly 1,500 Dark Coins, meaning it will be used up just right.
After looking around, most of them were two-bedroom apartments, and there were some one-bedroom apartments, but they were really cramped and simple. You might as well go back and renew that room—after all, you're used to living there and getting used to it.
You put your hands on your hips, thought for a moment, then looked at Spamton, making eye contact with him. Spamton was looking at you innocently. In the end, you gritted your teeth: "Alright then...... Then, let's split the rent and take you with us! So you have to pay half the cost, which means splitting the bill evenly! ”
Now you remember you actually wanted to check out the prices here, but you had forgotten about it earlier...... But it's still not too late to check it out later.
Spamton nodded, then took out three thousand Dark Coins and handed them to you. You sighed, walked up to one of the landlords, and handed him the six thousand Dark Coins along with them. Then you picked up Spamton and asked him to add contact information with the landlord—after all, you don't have a phone from the Dark World.
Now, everything is over. You walk in with your bag and casually toss it aside. Honestly, you really don't have much luggage, so you only need to buy some daily necessities and food. After sliding the clothes from your bag onto the bookshelf, you grab your Spamton and walk out.
"Come with me to buy something." You said angrily, but fortunately, there were still grocery stores and convenience stores in the Dark World, unlike his shop, which looked rundown.
"I think that [shop] might be more suitable." Spamton pointed to a shop not far away. You looked toward that direction and found it was also a small, old shop. Then you looked at the convenience store in front of you, which was simple yet clean and hygienic, and fell silent.
You squinted and noticed something interesting: "What, you don't want me to go in?" Could it be that the prices of these two items are different? ”
Spamton quickly shook his head. You couldn't read his expression, and in any case, you couldn't see any signs of lying. You walked into the convenience store in front of you, half-believing—you definitely wouldn't go to that obviously suspicious shop!
…… As it turned out, the prices here seemed quite cheap. Of course, you didn't really understand it. You just knew that when you bought a bunch of things and paid the bill, you only spent a few dozen Dark Coins.
So when you came out carrying a pile of pots and pans, you started staring at Spamton: "...... Be honest, where exactly did you take me just now? Why was it so expensive!" You gritted your teeth, feeling like he had scammed you again. Maybe on purpose, to ride on the house you rented or something. Honestly, can't he just rent a place himself?!
Spamton shook his head and once again avoided answering: "Perhaps [you] need [transportation]?" ”
"I don't need that. If I were to move these things back, it would be easy. I'm very strong—no, don't change the subject, you have to pay me up!" If it weren't for being so unavailable, you would have grabbed his collar and shook it hard.
"Then, maybe [you] misunderstood." The amount of these [houses] is 1,500 [silver dollars] for twelve [months], which means renting [for the whole year]. "When you hear his voice, there is no trace of guilt.
You grit your teeth in frustration: "I don't need to rent for that long...... Ask the landlord if that's the case. If so, then ask if you can cancel early! ”
You feel like you've been inexplicably tricked, and you have to bring this guy along—well, now it's something annoying. You think it's your own fault, forgetting what you said just a few minutes ago, forgetting to remind yourself to check elsewhere, and instead believing Spamton's words.
…… Sigh, you know you're a bit slow to react and easily trust others. This has always been your problem. But you think that after suffering this loss, you'll definitely remember it next time.
Holding a box of things, you watch Spamton open his phone, its glow flickering. Of course, your eyesight is sharp, so you can clearly see what he's chatting—ah, yes, it was a conversation with the landlord, indeed asking how long 1,500 Dark Coins lasted, and you could rent for a year and then return it—it seemed you were used to the price of the Light World, so you didn't ask too much.
You grit your teeth and hear Spamton's casual remark: "[Sure]." ”
Of course you know, but for some reason, you're still holding back a lot of anger—uh, well, maybe you'll forget about it again soon. You're always like this, but this time you swear in your heart, you must remember this!
Anyway, you quicken your pace and return to the place you just rented—ah, now it should be called your home. Uh, or rather, your home...... No, just roommates, you see Spamton climbing up to the sofa and sitting there, which always feels a bit awkward.
Tsk, forget it, better not see him for now, or you'll get mad again. You quietly turned your head and started packing up with a breath of anger.
After cleaning up and placing pots, pans, and the like in various spots, you went out and bought a few more quilts and covers to lay them back on the bed. The originally empty wooden bed instantly became full, and now it was even cozier. You stood with your hands on your hips, looking at your results, and nodded in satisfaction.
Then you look toward another room and fall silent. To be honest, you don't really want to make a bed for Spamton...... Judging by how he looks, it's definitely not okay, and besides, that bed is too big, not suitable, right?
The more work you do, the more work you get, and the more diligent you are, the more you'll take on the work for yourself. You agree with that. Anyway, you can handle it now, so you just collapse onto your own bed.
You heard Spamton's voice: "My [residence]?" ”
You turned over and said indifferently, "Ahh...... No, if you want to sleep, go make your own bed. I bought it for you, and I paid for it myself! ......! But you have to live here too, so you can do some chores yourself! ”
You definitely don't want to take on the work for yourself! And in the end, no one pays you, so why do all this? You muttered to yourself like this.
Then you feel the soft bed sink. You tilt your head to look and see that Spamton has climbed up the bed and is lying down beside you.
You were speechless for a second, but the bed was indeed huge, right? Still, you couldn't help but ask: "So your solution is to share a bed with me?" Then I'd rather have a one-bedroom apartment...... No, if I move to a new place to rent now, I could kick you out......
You muttered, though you had no intention of getting up. Because you were afraid of trouble, so if you wanted to keep things as they were, so be it. You just couldn't be bothered to move.
"[Solution]. One person's [half cost], so it's a [reasonable action]. " he said.
You actually know what he means—because he really did give half the money, so you can't kick him out. But if you see him now, you'll be furious, since he tricked you into handing over all that money, so you can only split it half.
So you turned around, choosing not to see his face again, but your voice was muffled: "Alright, this bed is big, so we can split it half and half...... If you lie there and don't bother me, it's fine......" You muttered to yourself, then felt your face gently poked. You looked up and saw Spamton had somehow crawled over to your side and even poked your cheek.
Raising your eyebrows, you simply turn around, twist his cheeks, and pull him to the sides: "What are you doing—didn't they say not to bother me?" What are you doing—"
Well, the puppet's face isn't very interesting to pull at either. Honestly, you even find it a bit hard to pull, so in the end you let go and just silently stared at Spamton.
Very good, now you're in that strange state of rage, but still very calm—so you just quietly look at Spamton.
"Very [sorry][disturbing behavior]. I think this can [get your attention]; I have some [questions] that need [consult] [you]. "He said, you tilted your head, and you can see Spamton lying right next to you.
You took a deep breath. Honestly, you were suppressing your anger. And why did I have to bother you just to ask you questions! That's what you thought, and of course you asked: "If it's just a question, you can ask like that too. As long as I can answer, I'll say it. So do you think that face-to-face things will make me seem more sincere? No matter what, I won't lie, right...... As you speak, your voice quiets. You look at Spamton, and as he meets your gaze, you find it hard to believe.
Because you feel, yes, that's right, that's exactly what he thinks.
…… Alright then. You take another deep breath: "Uh...... Alright. Alright! Just say what you want to ask, I won't ask so much...... "It feels like asking more won't help, and if you turn around again, Spamton will definitely find a way to make you turn back, so in the end, you just keep your head down and look at him."
Of course, now that you're lying in bed, all of this seems even more unbelievable.
"I want to [know] that [you] don't have a [direct answer] answer to a [question] in the [game]."
You thought about what the problem he meant was...... To be honest, your memory isn't very good, so the room fell into an eerie silence. You really did think hard for a while and finally remembered what the problem was.
So you cough twice: "Ah, I remember now, that question......" Then you fall silent again.
Actually, you're not very opposed to answering that question, because you stopped caring. But for you, answering that question doesn't help much. Still, it's definitely easier to ask a familiar stranger. Maybe...... Actually, you do care a little, but after forgetting it, you think everything is fine.
You rarely remember those things, so now that you're asked to recall them, you actually feel a bit down.
You cleared your throat, lifted your head to look at the ceiling, stared blankly, and fell into your memories: “Ah, actually it's nothing really, it's just that I’ve always been slow to react since I was little, and I’m not very smart, so I’ve always done a little worse than others in school because I usually hand in my paper as soon as I figure out the solution, and it’s the same during exams. Plus, because my family was very poor and had many children, I wasn’t the most important one; I’m the eldest daughter, and I was responsible for taking care of everyone. Maybe it’s because I spent too much time taking care of others. Anyway, my grades were always poor. After I didn’t get into university, my parents scolded me as trash—well, it wasn’t a big deal, they’ve said things like that to me more than once anyway.”
You finished this passage in one breath; you didn’t really need a response, or rather, you just needed someone to hear it, even though you weren’t particularly sad. Then you tilted your head and looked at Spamton, who didn’t seem to react at all, before intending to continue speaking.
Tbc.

title: Horror Game Port 8 - Interlude - Monday 3 - sptx You

content:
With your hands behind your head, you rest your head on it, staring at the ceiling for a few seconds, pondering your words for a moment before softly speaking: "Mm...... And then, anyway, I didn't get into college, and at my age, I left home. But my parents still call me every month asking for money, meaning I have to support my younger siblings, and since they worked so hard to raise me, I have to give them money too. ”
“…… I don't have much money either, I only have a high school diploma, what can I possibly do? Although I barely found a job...... But right now, I'm just doing some odd jobs, helping move bodies in the hospital morgue......
You pause for a moment, then give a self-deprecating smile: "Forget it, there's really nothing more to say. That odd job is gone now. Even though I'm strong, the boss hired a male helper and fired me. Why is it that girls can't do this kind of work......
“…… In short, that's exactly what happened. I chose to rent in the Dark World because I didn't want them to call me again—by the way, you probably can't get their calls from the Dark World," you remember the first time you came to the Dark World and then left, when you left, you found several missed calls on your phone, so you probably couldn't get through. "So it's best if they don't bother me. I'm really annoyed with them." Hmm...... And I don't plan to do any more odd jobs; I want to do something else. ”
Even if you didn't get into college, you've always wanted to complete the adult self-study exam. You know, even though you're learning slowly, and it might take twice as long as others, it doesn't mean you can't learn. You just didn't have that opportunity before. And now, you think...... Maybe next time, the money from completing the side tasks will be enough to sign up for exams and buy textbooks and study questions. There will probably be some surplus leftover.
After saying that, you didn't care about his reaction, just turned over and yawned: "Hey...... Actually, I didn't do much today, right? I don't know why I'm so tired...... "Actually, it's only close to noon."
But maybe it's to avoid seeing the expression he might show, which is why you choose to turn things around. You don't want others looking at you with a look of maybe pity. You don't need pity, because you know you'll keep moving forward strongly. You always want to prove that you can still do something, achieve certain goals, and that you're not destined to achieve nothing, as your parents say.
Just as you were lost in thought, you heard Spamton's voice behind you: "Maybe [you] could choose another [path]?" Also, maybe [you] need [Sweet Supplement]. ”
You know, this is hoping you'll feel a bit better—after all, there's a saying that eating sweets can make you feel better. Although you think the truth of this saying is still to be verified, since you haven't really eaten sweets.
You're glad you turned away, and he can't see your expression, so now you can still pretend to be relaxed and say, "Ah, no need, just eat something random—I don't mind, I'm used to it!" When I was busy doing odd jobs before, I often had nonstop meals, just having a bite to eat was enough...... You kept rambling, not even knowing what you were talking about.
But actually, the salary they pay you can barely get by, but...... Your parents always ask you for money, and if you don't give enough, they'll call you like crazy. Even if you change your phone number and your account on other apps hasn't changed, they'll still message and call you. With no other choice, you can only keep yourself a small portion of money. So of course, that money isn't enough for your food and drink.
—But just barely managing to survive is already pretty good. You're already amazing! You always comfort yourself like this. Even though you've deeply remembered your parents' story.
Actually, it wasn't like that at first. You still cherish your parents' kindness, so you selectively forget their harsh words and willingly give money. But later, when you get fired, they still chase you for money, the same amount as before. If it's not enough, they'll urge you to ask, and you gradually get tired of it, and that filter slowly breaks down.
"[You] should [take care of] your own [health]." Spamton said this.
…… Although he was only saying this, after all, he probably wasn't particularly protective of his own health. Even if he ended up like this, it wasn't the outcome he had imagined. However...... Perhaps it was also the result of his own actions.
You turn your back to Spamton, just shrugging: "Mm...... Doesn't matter, who cares about these things? I'm the only one who cares......
Before he could finish, Spamton interrupted him, and you heard him speak: "I [care]." ”
You pause, your mind rarely pauses for a moment, or rather, it crashes. You still need to think about what he really means. Of course, you know it's probably not because your relationship is particularly close, since you two are currently related by interests, so there might be many other reasons......
Before you could figure out a solution, listen to him continue: "After all, [we] need to [join] [enter the game] now. I don't want [you] to be in a bad state." ”
Oh, oh...... That's the reason...... You nodded quietly to yourself and casually replied, "Don't worry, my body is strong. Carrying you to complete the task is easy...... But you make a good point—let's go out for lunch!" ”
You were still very proactive; you acted without hesitation. You immediately sat up in bed, grabbed Spamton's scruff, and scrambled out the door.
"[Stop], [Place] me on [the ground]! I can [move free]!" "You feel him struggle twice in your hand.
You casually made a couple of 'ohs', put him down on the ground, and still complained, "Hmm, but you're walking too slowly. Maybe I'd rather just carry you faster...... Uh, or maybe you sit on my shoulder and I'll walk with you? That's way faster than this, right?" "Although that would make your shoulders a bit sore, it's still much better than taking it slow." You may be patient, but you're an impatient person, so this isn't something you have to wait for.
He suddenly stopped walking. You almost kicked Spamton, but this time you didn't complain again, so he wouldn't interrupt you before he could finish his complaints. You just crossed your arms and watched what he was planning. Unexpectedly, Spamton turned around and reached out his hand to you.
You looked at his movements in surprise and met his gaze—uh, well, you still couldn't tell what his mood was. So you just pointed at Spamton, then at your own shoulder: "Uh...... So, you're going to sit on it? ”
Spamton nodded: "Yes, this is your [proposal]. ”
You muttered, "It's not like you have to carry it out just because you made a proposal...... I was just saying it casually...... Even though you complained, you still bent down, took his hand, and then simply picked him up through his arm and sat him on your shoulder. Hmm, your shoulders really do hurt...... But it's more comfortable than holding him, and doing so makes you much faster.
So you walked out like a gust of wind, walking quickly. But after just a short while, you slowed your pace a bit, because you felt a bit lost. You weren't familiar with the layout of the dark world and didn't know where to go right now. So you stood there looking around for a long time, looking at the distant streets on either side, trying hard to recall where the restaurant was located.
At that moment, Spamton pointed to the left and poked your cheek—uh, otherwise you definitely wouldn't be able to see it. Although you think he could just say it directly! But that was indeed very convenient and efficient, so you couldn't be bothered to say anything.
"This [direction] has [dessert shop], [ramen shop], and [barbecue shop]." You follow the direction he pointed, nodding thoughtfully, naturally curious.
"So you actually want dessert more?" Although I don't think eating snacks at noon is bad, wouldn't it be a bit tiring...... "At least you think most desserts are both sweet and greasy, so you tend to keep your distance."
"I think maybe [you] need [sweets]. Also, [sweets] have a rather [light, bitter taste]. ”
"Maybe that's true, but honestly, I don't need sweets! I don't think it matters, it's long gone, though it's still going on...... But I haven't cared for a long time!" You said this in a relaxed tone, still smiling. Of course, you know that smile is fake, maybe even a bit exaggerated...... After all, it's just a disguise.
Spamton turned his head and saw your slightly upturned lips. He didn't say much—after all, you two weren't close enough to take things further. Maintaining the status quo was fine—if you took a step further, maybe anyone would find it hard to endure.
"Alright, that's just because I need [sweets]. After all, I don't have enough [money]." So he said this.
You rub your chin and click, "Alright, if you have money and want to spend some money, I get it, I get it—then I'll take you to the dessert shop!" If it's just dessert, this money is definitely more than enough! ”
As it turns out, although desserts are a bit more expensive than buying daily necessities, they're still within your means. So you wave your hand and order three or five servings of cake. Anyway, you can definitely finish it. If he can't finish it...... Then pack it up and put it in the fridge. Remember, you still have one at home.
So you picked and picked, ordering a tiramisu, a chocolate brownie, a red velvet cake, and a matcha Black Forest cake, and finally after hesitating for a moment, you ordered a honey cake—well, you were just curious about the taste.
The dessert was served to you quickly. You put the Spamton next to you, then noticed he couldn't reach the table—his head was just a little above it. You were silent for a moment, then picked him up and sat him on your lap.
"Uh...... Forget it, you should eat first. "Now he can reach the food on the table, but you always feel this posture is awkward, so you choose to stare blankly at the dessert.
"No, maybe [you] can [eat at the same time]." he said.
You pouted, not daring to agree with the suggestion, but still reluctantly took the fork, brought over the plate of honey cake, and took a bite—you stuck out your tongue and put it down.
It's too sweet. It's not that you can't eat it, but the cloying sweetness isn't for you. You think you should just go back and have some dark chocolate. Just as you're lost in thought, you notice Spamton actually pulls over the plate of honey cake you've just taken one bite and pushed aside, and you can't help but widen your eyes.
"Wait, don't you think it's sweet and sweet...... You raise your eyebrows, their brows twisted into a strange shape.
"[No]." Actually, Spamton hadn't told you either. Now, tasting these foods and savoring these flavors felt like a thin membrane, not fully appreciated. So the sweetness now was also elusive—what he could sense was just the lingering aftertaste of extreme sweetness. So this flavor was just right for him.
You stroked your chin in confusion and muttered to yourself, "So you're a sweet person, the kind who likes very sweet things......"
…… He won't be able to explain this to you. To explain this, he has to talk about how he became what he is now, what he went through—memories he doesn't want to touch right now. Even though all of that has truly happened, and he's still striving to change his current situation and destiny.
So Spamton just tacitly assumes your opinion.
In the end, you actually nodded and said, 'Alright, I understand. But I feel like just eating this piece of cake is enough for you, so the rest is all mine!' So you happily picked up a plate of tiramisu and started eating. Although your current posture was indeed a bit strange, after a whole morning of fussing and then a period of rest, you were genuinely hungry, so you needed to eat now!
'...【Okay】. Then I will only pay for this 【cake】.'
You casually replied twice, 'I know. After all, for fairness's sake, this time I won't ask for it to be split evenly. You eat as much as you pay.' You weren't being unreasonable to demand he pay half in this situation.
By the time he was almost done, you had already finished two portions of cake and were about to eat a third. You looked down at his situation and couldn't help but sigh, '...You're so slow.'
'【Food】 should be 【savored slowly】.' Though in reality, it was just an excuse. Even if it had some flavor, in a state of nearly lost taste, he still felt that eating like this made him miserable.
Tbc.

title: Horror Game Port 9 - Interlude - Monday 4 (end) - sptx you
path: articles/en/spt/恐怖片大逃杀 end/恐怖游戏端口9-间章-月曜日4（end）-sptx你.html
content:
After lunch, you spent the whole afternoon fiddling around and spending time tidying up the room. Everything now looked so cozy and livable—at least that's how you felt. So you looked at the furnishings in the room, nodded in satisfaction, and clapped your hands. After a simple dinner, you lay on the bed for a while, daydreaming, staring at the ceiling. At this moment, you completely blocked out any outside noise, including the spamton's sound. After all, you wouldn't respond to anyone who spoke; you were too tired.
It kept dragging things out until you felt it was almost time to sleep—after all, you had already started yawning and getting sleepy. Only then did you slowly get out of bed, finish a simple wash, and then collapse back on, instinctively about to undress and turn off the light.
But before starting this task, you barely remembered Spamton's presence, so you quickly stopped and looked down at him: "Wait, do you still want to sleep here?" "You asked hesitantly, finally putting down the clothes you had half-undressed."
"...... naturally, my room doesn't have suitable furnishings." he said.
You stroked your chin and thought for a moment. Indeed, his room was basically unfurnished. After all, you wouldn't care about any of that! What does his stuff have to do with you—just thinking about the hassle, some things couldn't be stacked, so he simply put them on his bed, like leftover bedding for changing and washing. Thinking about it made you feel guilty again.
Alright, you didn't give anyone a place either. After all, a small puppet doesn't take up much space, so you cleared your throat twice and suggested, "Alright, then you can ...... sleep on the floor?" "Although you were just saying it casually, you never expected him to listen." Sure enough, of course he didn't go down; he just kept lying there, looking at you with a faint, distant gaze.
"Alright, I know this isn't very practical. Maybe you can stay here any longer...... But don't just look at me! Go wash up! I need to change clothes! "You said this as you walked over, grabbed him by the back of the neck, and put him on the ground. After all, you bought him some clothes, of course, he paid for it. So now you're feeling quite justified.
Although Spamton struggled in your hand for a moment, it didn't last long, because you grabbed him by the neck and then threw him to the ground. Then you lay comfortably on the bed, resting your hands on your head, watching his back. For him, all of this might be difficult, but you believe he can handle it on his own!
At this point, you recall what happened that morning. You really ignored the dirty feeling when you first took him out of the trash bin, since in the world of light you saw many beggars living under bridges, begging everywhere, and rummaging through trash bins. Of course, rather than relying on fate in vain, you still trust your own hands and the wealth you create yourself.
…… So, you won't do the same thing as those people, because you believe you always have some ability to change yourself.
After thinking for a moment, you finally remembered what you were supposed to do—you almost forgot! Hurriedly, you changed your clothes, pulled up the blanket, and curled up comfortably. You were almost asleep, after all, you were exhausted all day. The bright lights were so bright and blinding that you wanted to turn them off, but you were still thinking about Spamton, who hadn't slept yet, so you didn't move. Oh my god, you almost feel moved for yourself. After all, you're such a good person, willing to hold on a little longer for this.
Yawning again, you finally saw him come out. After all, you could hear him climbing onto the bed with your eyes closed, and of course, you also felt the bed sink in a lump together. Although it was slow, probably because he spent some time getting into bed. You still didn't open your eyes, just clumsily getting up and feeling for the switch on the wall, then turned off the light. Your vision turned dark again, so you happily and comfortably lay back down.
But after just a short while, you felt the blanket being pulled. You were slow for a moment before realizing something: Oh, you only prepared a quilt, not something for Spamton to cover up. So you awkwardly coughed twice in your heart, then turned over and chose to throw the blanket in that direction. In the darkness, even though you opened your eyes, you still couldn't see anything, so you were just following your instincts. Fortunately, you probably caught it, since you now felt a bit of wind leaking there.
You were a bit speechless, choosing to close your eyes and press against your blanket—well, it didn't help anyway. You simply reached forward and felt around, then pulled the Spamton a little toward you. Good, now there won't be any draft, but you think if you turn around, you'll press on him.
After a moment of silence, you choose to ignore it, just close your eyes and sleep!
You slept deeply and comfortably, a peaceful night without any dreams, sleeping soundly until dawn. You groggily opened your eyes, reacted dully for a moment, and realized Spamton was now in your arms...... Uh, but this was actually warm, and the blanket didn't let air out. But how did things end up like this? You couldn't help but start thinking about it.
After thinking for a long time, you still can't come up with an answer, so you can only guess it might be a subconscious behavior while sleeping. After all, you still like to wrap yourself tightly in a blanket like a zongzi, and you're used to sleeping alone. So it's probably normal that you didn't recognize Spamton as a person while you were asleep.
So you let go of the spamton, scratched your head, and didn't forget to apologize to him: "Uh, sorry, I didn't notice last night...... So I still think if you go to the floor, you'll sleep more freely...... "Of course you wouldn't make another quilt for him, because you're lazy. So thinking about the current situation, it's actually acceptable again.
"...... It's okay. In the game, you're in the same state." "He looks like he's already awake, maybe he didn't sleep well at all. You won't care about that. Since he hasn't complained much, just pretend nothing happened.
So you just coughed dryly: "Haha...... Really? That's really embarrassing. "Of course, you didn't look that embarrassed, just gave a couple of awkward laughs. Indeed, you remembered, it was the same before. You were hugging Spamton, fast asleep, since you had to rest up and recover before that killer returned.
Spamton didn't answer your question, just jumped to the next topic: "Maybe you could [consider] [breakfast time]." He really did wake up long ago. After all, being held by you isn't very comfortable. It's not unacceptable, but he always finds it a bit strange. Ultimately, maybe it's because your relationship isn't that close. So all of this feels a bit strange.
As for the specific strangeness—probably, everything seems indifferent in the game, but once you leave the game world, it feels like you have to look at it separately. You know this, and of course, he understands it too.
But whether you actually do it depends on your feelings. So now everything seems strange, since none of this is separated, yet the same pattern continues.
However, perhaps because they understood the situation, no one mentioned this abnormal condition, only maintaining it.
You let out a couple of 'oh ohs', yawned, and recalled slowly: "By the way, I forgot to buy breakfast...... There's absolutely nothing left at home, so let's go out for breakfast!" "Because it's still a bit cold outside, you don't want to crawl out of bed to change clothes. The blanket is so warm—if you weren't hungry, you'd even want to lie under the covers a little longer."
Now, you chose to change clothes under the covers. Spamton quietly turned around, probably out of self-awareness. Of course, he could still hear the sounds behind him clearly. After a rustling sound, it finally quieted down, and your voice came again.
"Alright, I'm done changing...... Hurry up and finish changing your own clothes. It's not like I didn't buy you new ones, so don't wear the old one anyway...... You muttered, then took out another set of clothes and tossed them next to Spamton, then you went over to wash up first.
Spamton was silent for a moment, then finally got out of bed.
Anyway, after all this was over, you skillfully lifted him onto your shoulder, patted your cheek to sober yourself up, and then walked out the door to look for food. There were quite a few breakfast shops on the neighboring street. At least you happily bought bread and sandwiches, dipped them in jam, and poked Spamton to signal him to pay for you. He split the price evenly with you, you accepted it happily, then stuffed a sandwich into his mouth.
He probably never expected you to do this, and in a flustered panic, he started eating the sandwich with both hands.
Soon, the breakfast was over. Eating bread sandwiches alone was quite choking, so you bought two steaming cups of orange juice. Even if you treated Spamton, you didn't ask him for money. You just thoughtfully handed him a straw when he finally let go of his sandwich halfway through eating. Of course, the force might be a bit strong. If he chokes, it doesn't really concern you. You just happily think you're so thoughtful, and you also drink the orange juice yourself.
After drinking the sweet and sour orange juice, you finally feel alive, your body warm, and you've eaten. So you pat your belly, yawn, and feel a bit sleepy—you pat your cheeks to try to wake up. At that moment, you feel Spamton poking your cheek, and instinctively raise the glass of orange juice, since he hasn't finished it yet.
But when you turn your head, you realize he actually handed you the Dark Coins. You glanced at them—it was exactly the price of two glasses of orange juice. You were a bit speechless and couldn't help but mutter, "I was already planning to treat you, so how did it end up being you inviting me......" Even though you said that, you still accepted the Dark Coins without hesitation and then shoved the orange juice into his hand.
"I want to express my sincere gratitude to you." He held the glass of orange juice in both hands, but didn't drink it. Instead, his tone was filled with seriousness as he spoke.
You waved your hand: "If you were truly thanking me, you wouldn't just treat me to a meal of orange juice, right? At least treat me to a big meal...... You complained, feeling Spamton stiffen on your shoulder. You were heading home, but walking very slowly. Now your hand was about to touch the doorknob, so you couldn't help but turn back to glance at Spamton.
“…… What, are you really going to treat me? Then I'm going to a fancy restaurant, I want to eat roast squab, roast lamb, and fried steak...... What else is there...... "You casually mentioned a few dish names, then couldn't continue. Forgive me, you've never been to a fancy restaurant, so of course you don't recognize those names. You only recognized some dishes when you happened to pass by before.
"No, it's just about [thinking] about [ways of expressing gratitude]." he said.
You shrugged: "Ah, if it were the simplest way...... You just need to help me finish the side quests properly. After all, I can't be bothered to think about the answers to those questions. If it were me, at most I could seriously complete the main quests...... "Just being able to complete the main quests seriously is already impressive!" You're too tired and really don't want to think about the problems anymore.
"I promise, I will complete the side quests seriously." Spamton said. Of course, his willingness to help you complete the side quests wasn't to express gratitude. What he said was just a token gesture...... He thought, he didn't necessarily have to do it all at once. As for completing side quests, half was waiting for you to take him along to complete the main quests, and the other half was that he also needed the reward amounts for side quests. Moreover, he had a feeling that these quests might not appear for nothing.
"Mm hm hm, that's good." Only then did you nod in satisfaction. After all… you didn’t really care whether he was expressing gratitude; you just needed a companion.
Anyway, you were only in a cooperative relationship, nothing more. Back at home, you picked up Spamton and put him on the floor. At least for now, the tasks you needed to do were basically finished. You couldn’t think of anything else, so you simply sat on the sofa and started scrolling through the phone you had just bought in the Dark World yesterday.
Spamton also climbed onto the sofa and sat next to you. You could still hear the sound of his straw, but you didn’t bother with it. You just kept scrolling through the news and updates from the Dark World, and nothing seemed particularly noteworthy.
The one-week free time given by the game system expired after your brief week residing in the Dark World. On this day, you sat on the sofa as usual, but your vision went blank for a moment. After a strong sense of dizziness, you arrived at another place. Of course, Spamton was right there on the floor beside you.
Monday·END

title: Horror Game Port 10 - Add Fuel to the Fire 1 - sptx You
path: articles/en/spt/恐怖片大逃杀 end/恐怖游戏端口10-火上浇油1-sptx你.html
content:
[Main Quest: Explore the Building, Head to the Top Floor] Reward: One Month of Rest and Security Protection.
[Side Quest: Explore the Building and Learn the Cause of Its Current State] Reward: 100,000 currency + 100,000 Dark Coins
The light screen appeared before you, and seeing the reward this time, you let out a sigh of relief—if the rewards aren't split yet, you'll really have to settle in the Dark World, but at least for now, you don't have that plan.
You looked around—thick fog, thick fog, endless fog, surrounding and obscuring everything else. Maybe the sunlight was just right, since the sky was clear, with only endless splashes of blue paint and no accidental graffiti of white clouds. Maybe it would be strange if there was fog right now—but you knew, it was just a forbidden place to explore. Only the building before you stood tall, as if it could pierce straight into the clouds. Through the building, you could even see the reflected sunlight, so dazzling that you couldn't help but close your eyes when you looked up—but you still noticed that through the window, you couldn't see inside the building. Of course, perhaps because the sunlight was just right, you shouldn't have seen it anyway.
But—you look at the glass door before you, unable to see what is inside, only through the glass you see pitch black. This is probably the strangest place, since there are glass windows all around. Even if there is darkness without light, it shouldn't be pitch black, but should be filled with bright light, or rather, a bright scene in between.
However, you took a deep breath and swallowed hard. No matter how strange it was, it didn't matter—it just looked strange on the outside. It didn't mean you would encounter anything strange inside, nor did it add any pressure to be paranoid. Persuading yourself like this, you lowered your head, looked at Spamton, then skillfully lifted him up and sat him on your shoulder, saying casually, "Alright, the side quest is still up to you to complete. Reaching the top of the building is still a breeze, isn't it?" ”
Although you say this, you know the building looks neglected for years. Even the lock on the glass door is rusted, forming iron-red rust swirling over the lock. Of course, it probably won't damage it if you touch it—it's just that you always have to be suspicious. And that means the elevator in this building must be broken, meaning you probably have to walk up the stairs. This is probably a test of physical strength and endurance. However, you naturally aren't afraid of this kind of test; in fact, you're eager to try.
"Naturally, this is a cooperation treaty." he said.
You nodded casually and stepped forward to tentatively push open the glass door. You thought that if the main character of the game was to explore the building, they probably wouldn't block you at the door; otherwise, there would be nowhere else to look for the key. Sure enough—you only gently pushed the door, but at first it was unmoving and clumsy, stuck by the lock, so you could still see only complete darkness. But when you instinctively touched the lock and instinctively grabbed the rust, it broke apart, making a crisp clanging sound as it fell to the ground.

Your work is too hard and exhausting, and you've never had time to settle down and study. At the same time, you don't have enough money to support yourself with exam registration and study.
So now, timidly, you sat down, filled out the registration form, paid the tuition, and prepared to wait for the exam after some time—you eagerly looked forward to that day. After leaving the registration point, you first went to the bank to exchange the check. Because the amount was large, the bank clerk gave you a strange look but said nothing. It was just extra. You opened a bank card to deposit the remaining money, keeping some as cash.
Afterwards, you also go to a nearby bookstore to buy lots of study materials and exercises, planning to pick up the knowledge you've lost, and you think you should go further.
Maybe part of what you're thinking is actually going against your parents, wanting to prove yourself to them, to show them you're not useless, and to prove that you can do the same. And you clearly know what you can do.
After buying all these materials, it was almost noon. You deliberately picked a restaurant that looked pretty good, had a hearty meal, and then left slowly with those books in your arms. Your phone was vibrating again, but you didn't pay any attention, just hummed an off-key tune as you walked toward the entrance to the dark world.
You know...... Now it's time for you to go home. Oh, or as Spamton puts it, a return voyage is fine too. Actually, you don't care how you describe it; it's just that when you mention the word 'home,' you can't help but feel a warmth in your heart. Because you know, at least, that's probably how it is—someone else is waiting for you to go back—that kind of place should be called home.
So you are willing to call this brief residence home, even though it wasn't something you wanted at first, despite the deception and exchange of possibilities, even though you are merely partners living under the same roof, you clearly understand that he must be waiting for you no matter what.
So, belatedly, you start to look forward to the scene of going back. Your mood is no longer as irritable as when you first received so many calls, but instead a hint of joy, your steps become lighter, and you quicken your pace.
Think about it, maybe you see him as a trustworthy partner under the same roof.
So you hold the pile of study materials and stand at the doorway again. You take a deep breath and push the door open.
Turning your head to avoid the tall study materials, you see Spamton climbing onto the sofa waiting for you without you noticing.
——
Actually, after you left in the morning, Spamton was unusually a bit lost. Sure, the fridge at home still had sandwiches and other things, so just a simple breakfast was fine. But your sudden departure left him a bit confused. Of course, he quickly settled on his goal.
So after finishing breakfast, he went out and took a detour to his little shop. It wasn't very far; he had paid special attention to this when choosing a location. But it seemed like he didn't care much, and in fact, he paid the rent somewhat foolishly, which was both amusing and exasperating.
He sat in his small shop. Now he didn't need to rummage through the trash bins, so apart from sitting here, he actually had nothing to do. Besides, hardly anyone came to the dump, or rather, no one. In fact, you were his first customer here—though you weren't here to buy anything, you were here to ask him for money.
But Spamton didn't sit here just for money; he wanted more, something more noble. Perhaps he was still nostalgic for his former status and wealth, but nostalgic memories of the past were not wrong.
In short, no customers came. But Spamton, on the other hand, was still worried about what you mentioned about coming back in the afternoon, so in the end, he just closed the shop at noon and then returned home.
To be honest, he actually doesn't think there's any reason to wait for you. After all, you two are just business partners who met in the gaming world. In real life, aside from sharing a shared apartment, there's no other social interaction. But for some unknown reason, he still sits on the sofa waiting for you to return, just like when he tricked you into renting the apartment with him earlier.
That kind of unknown plot...... Maybe it's just because, in some way, you really do count as the number one customer of that shop in the junkyard.
Moreover, he always believed that with you, he could uncover more secrets, and that he could go to the world of light, or even go a step further.
Become a bigger, big-minded figure who can oversee everything.
So now, hearing the sound of the door opening, Spamton instinctively looked up and saw you—no, or rather, your figure hidden by those materials.
You chuckled awkwardly: "Ah...... I seem to have bought too many materials. I'll pile them all in your room later. You probably don't mind, since you're still lying on my bed sleeping...... Ah, I don't need your help, I can move there by myself! That's still a breeze. "As you spoke, you carried the pile of books toward the room that originally belonged to Spamton, muttering a few words to him. Anyway, even if you accept that this place is a fleeting home, you won't forget the fact that he has taken up a part of your bed!
As for the last sentence, you hurriedly said it when you saw the little puppet suddenly jump off the sofa and walk toward you. You don't want these materials to crush him instantly.
…… Although that scene would probably be quite interesting, you even imagined it for a moment, and couldn't help but blurt out, "Honestly, I feel like just holding a few books for you would be going to collapse...... You can't really help me with that, can you?" "Besides, you wouldn't feel tired even if you put another Spamton on your shoulder. Of course, you still didn't say that out loud."
You just walk over, put the study materials on the empty wooden bed, and stretch lazily.
You hear Spamton's voice coming from behind: "I don't think a few [books] could cause my [collapse]." You turned around, lowered your head to meet Spamton's gaze, then raised your eyebrows, showing some interest in his words.
So you picked out three or five heavier books, crouched down, and handed them to Spamton: "Then why don't you try?" If you can carry these books, then I've lost. ”
"[The Price of Victory or Defeat]?" Spamton was also somewhat interested in your proposal, so he asked.
You gasped, suddenly not knowing what to say. Honestly, a spur-of-the-moment gamble was just a passing whim; of course, you hadn't decided what to wager with.
So you and Spamton stared at each other for a while, then sighed softly: "I don't know...... I never really thought about what the bet should be. I was going to say, if you lost, you could just make a request, but I just felt like you would use the bet to trick me...... "Spamton doesn't have much reputation with you—it's more like it's a negative reputation."
Uh, even though you still trust him in some things, you inexplicably become cautious about this one, because you always have a bad feeling.
"As long as [you] think [it's inappropriate], you can end the [fulfillment] of the [bet]." he said.
In fact, Spamton wasn't sure what he would do if he got a blank bet; he just felt he urgently needed that bet—or a leverage, or maybe he needed you to feel indebted to him in some way. That way, you wouldn't forget this little salesman who was once glorious in the underworld but is now down and out.
You were silent for a moment, making sure Spamton was serious, then reluctantly nodded: "Alright, it's settled then. If I lose, you can make any demand...... Of course, whether it will follow your instructions is up to me. ”
Even though you guess he'll definitely win the bet when he emphasizes the price, and even feel a bit regretful, since he's already said it, you're curious about what he'll actually ask—your damn curiosity.
So in the end, you agreed to his request.
"Alright, then let's give it a try." You shrugged and placed the book on his open hand—though he staggered a little, he didn't fall, just hugged the stack of books and shook for a while before steadying himself. You couldn't see his expression, but you knew it would probably sound like he had succeeded—though you had just guessed he would win.
So now, your mood actually started to flare up a bit. You grabbed those books, a bit angry, and said with a frustration and dissatisfaction you didn't even know what it was: "Alright, alright. I know you won." ”
But this anger came quickly and faded quickly. You calmed it down quickly, and at that moment, you even felt a bit embarrassed about your earlier outburst. After putting the book back, you turned around and squatted down to sincerely apologize to Spamton.
"Uh...... Sorry, I suddenly felt like losing my temper just now, and my tone probably wasn't very pleasant. "You scratched your head, gave an awkward laugh twice, and finally tilted your head.
Spamton glanced at you in surprise. In fact, he didn't think anything about this at all...... Or rather. He didn't think you did anything wrong. He'd heard plenty of words with disgust or resentment lately, and all he could do was grit his teeth, thinking that one day everyone would apologize to him, and that one day he'd have to trample those who mocked him underfoot—though he didn't think what those words just said meant anything, he hadn't expected to receive his first sincere apology since becoming like this.
So he looked up and met your gaze: "I [don't need] a sincere apology in return." More than that, I'm somewhat curious about the [reason for the apology]. "So now, Spamton was curious why you apologized at this moment.
You let out a long breath: "Mm...... It seems you don't mind at all...... Of course, this sentence also sounds like you're talking to yourself based on your own speculation, but personally, you think it's not a big deal.
So after a pause, you hesitated and managed to speak: "Hmm, even though you might not mind, I still want to apologize. After all, we're now business partners...... In a way, you're friends too? A trustworthy friend—ah, I'm not saying I trust everything you say." As you spoke, you didn't forget to patch yourself up.
"Although maybe reconciling after a conflict will take things further...... But hurt is hurt, and I don't want to hurt what really happened. So when I realized I might have hurt you, I apologized. Ah, maybe saying that might be overreacting...... "As you spoke, you felt awkward again, cleared your throat twice, stood up, and pretended to be busy to tidy up the books on the bed. Although there wasn't much to tidy up—you already categorized them when you bought them, so now it's just futile to sort them again.
Spamton didn't think you were doing it for that reason. Maybe, maybe, he said maybe. You really do take him seriously as a partner, even a friend...... Of course, he is the same.
Yes, he told himself, and so did he.
You were quiet for a moment, no longer dwelling on the previous topic. After haphazardly tidying up your books for a while, you suddenly remembered there was one more thing, so you turned to look at Spamton: "Hmm...... Come to think of it, I never asked what you want to make if you won. Of course, if it's too complicated, I definitely won't help make it happen. ”
You even cautiously ask this question, and after saying it, you keep staring at Spamton—afraid he might bring up something you might find very difficult to do, but it is indeed possible.
But what you didn't expect was that Spamton simply said: "[Discount Promise] [Future Fulfillment], I Haven't Thought of Suitable [Discount Content]." ”
You stared at each other for a while, and all you could catch was the innocence in his gaze. Although those dark pupils carried an inexplicable chill after staring for a long time, in the end you just looked away and cleared your throat.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll start reading first...... Don't disturb me!" As you spoke, you pulled out a book and walked toward the desk in your bedroom. Of course, to study well, you didn't forget to buy a new pen or something. You're ready now.
You hesitate for a moment, then turn on the desk lamp, really planning to start studying hard. But after just two pages, you start zoning out, unable to recall any of the content, and it's hard to reconnect now, causing you to search your mind for memories, wishing you had studied these things before. Otherwise, if you were asked to read them again...... You definitely wouldn't understand.
Just as you stared at your textbook, feeling deeply resentful, you felt your hem being tugged. Actually, even ordinary force wouldn't awaken you from deep thoughts, it's just ...... The force was a bit too strong, maybe because you used a lot of force, causing you to lower your head and look at Spamton, who was tugging at your clothes.
“…… What else do you want? Didn't you say not to bother me? "The memory fragments you just retrieved are all messed up too. You're not very happy, puffing out your cheeks as you look at him."
"I think maybe we can [learn together]." He gave this kind of answer.
Your mouth twitched: "What ...... Why study together? Do you really need to take exams or something? I need exams, but you don't......
You have no idea what he's really thinking about making this request, but, well, since he made it...... It's not a big deal for you, and maybe having someone with you will make your learning even more efficient. Thinking this, you bent down and picked him up over his arm, then placed him on your lap, your chin naturally resting on his head. To be honest, it was a bit rough and not very soft, and that hair was a bit annoying...... You should take good care of your hair later, you muttered to yourself, but didn't do much but instead looked back at your textbook.
Fortunately, you found part of your memory, so you just hurriedly finished that part of the problem and then flipped back, memorizing knowledge points you weren't familiar with.
You're hesitating and want to directly check your answers to see if there's anything wrong with your answer...... Well, this might sound like cheating, but you're really not confident enough in your answer. You still want to refer to the standard answer to see where you're really lacking.
But at that moment, you heard Spamton's voice again: "...... Can you [explain] this [question] [pay for me]?" As he spoke, he reached out his puppet's small hand and tapped the page of the book. When you looked, it was exactly the same question you had just wanted to flip through directly...... Uh, anyway, you don't think flipping through the answer directly would make you wrong! So you just cleared your throat twice: "I'm not really sure about this question either...... Can we just go check the answer directly? ”
After saying this, you pondered for a moment and felt something was off, so you hurriedly said, "No—you really are seriously studying the question, but why do I have to explain it to you?" Since you can't see his eyes right now and can only stare at the back of his head, you silently ground your teeth but felt too embarrassed to slap the back of his head. Instead, you put down your pen and pinched his face, pulling the cheeks to the sides. Although you don't know why the puppet can be pinched like a normal face, with a gentle and soft feeling, you used this movement to vent the inexplicable anger rising in your heart and completely relaxed.
…… It seems that the sudden tension just now also relaxes at this moment, and you realize it belatedly.
But you didn't let go, so Spamton's tone changed a bit: "I [believe] I also have the right to learn, and you need [special benefits] [help]. ”
…… You don't know what exactly is going on between these two sentences, but you do let go and mutter, "Could you really guide me through other problems...... I never thought I'd need your help, would I......"
You really haven't thought about this. At this very moment, you remember you've never asked him about his educational level...... Uh, can you really describe the Dark People like that? Maybe for all the Dark Ones, there's really no educational level, because as far as you know, they're just incarnations of objects corresponding to the real world.
So you wisely choose to skip the question and instead ask, "Then tell me, what are you good at?" ”
Spamton fell silent, so long that you thought he hadn't heard your question clearly, and you even considered whether to repeat it—well, but just a second before you were about to repeat, you heard his answer.
"Maybe it's [the script] and the clever design of language?" He sounded uncertain either.
But you stroked your chin and nodded thoughtfully: "Oh, oh...... You mean reading comprehension questions? Uh...... And essays, I hate essays...... You mutter, your voice gradually fading.
Then you raised your voice again: "If that's the case, why should I explain this problem to you? You could have done it better yourself, right?" "You don't think he needs your help to solve this problem."
No, seriously, why is he really studying with you? You seriously suspect he was bored and came to bother you.
So you puffed up your words in anger—of course, you weren't that angry, just a bit of amusement and resentment: "Aren't you just bothering me? Maybe I should just throw you down?" "You think it's better to just quiet down and read alone. Although that might sometimes make you zone out and your study progress won't be fast, it's still better than spending time chatting like this and making no progress at all."
"No, it's not about [disrupting progress]. I think I can [help] [you] [understand the problem]."
You were stunned by his words, but when you snapped back to reality, you grabbed his face and snarled, "So you mean I still need you to explain the problem to me?" What exactly are you thinking! Do I really need it! "Although you still feel a bit guilty saying this, after all, you still have some clue about the question you just mentioned, and you have no idea how to answer the next one.
"I think [you] need [special services]." His voice was muffled, but you could still hear it clearly. You puffed out your cheeks, even though you knew in some ways he was indeed true.
"Alright, then you try it." In the end, you still said this reluctantly.
It turns out that the understanding and answers he gives in this area are almost exactly the same as the reference answers...... You have to admit that maybe you really need his help, but you still feel a strange sense of frustration. Of course, you quickly feel proud, since you've switched to textbooks for other subjects quickly. Spamton quiets down and says nothing more.
So you figured it out—he just couldn't figure it out...... Hmm, maybe he knows some basics. You really don't know what kind of academic level the People of Darkness really are.
So next, you happily continue your learning process in a quiet environment, hmm...... Holding something in your arms does make you feel better, and you know you're not the only one suffering—that's enough.
It wasn't until you felt hungry that you instinctively glanced at your phone and saw it was almost six o'clock. You hurriedly put down your pen, stretched, and casually asked, "What would you like for dinner?" "Anyway, you have money now. After leaving the game world, you can split the rest of the money as well. After all, you live in the dark world now, so there's no way you won't need any dark coins...... Uh, of course, he probably won't need the currency of the light world.
Just give him half of the bills he's in that box later! If he doesn't need you, he'll force you to buy and sell them! Although at this moment, you never imagined that he would use these bills to buy other things from you later.
"Let [your] opinion be yours." Spamton simply said. He didn't have many demands for food.
You thought for a moment, and since you've been craving it lately, you clench one hand and clap your other hand in applause: "Alright, let's go have hotpot!" You happily finalize your next schedule.
As for why hotpot...... Actually, you just feel craving it. When you go to sign up in the morning, you pass by a hotpot restaurant, and the aroma makes you want to have a meal yourself.
So you picked up the Spamton, slung it over your shoulder, and walked out. You glanced at yourself and sure you had locked the door, then happily walked out.
…… But you're not very familiar with the terrain of the Dark World, so after a few steps outside, you get stuck. You look down at Spamton on your shoulder: "Uh...... As for the Dark World, where is the hotpot restaurant?" "You asked sincerely, and your earlier arrogance quickly turned to lethargy.
Spamton silently watched you for a moment, then identified the direction, then pointed you along the way: "[Direction Requirements], [Navigation] Go from here to obtain [Hot Pot Buffet Access]." In fact, in his memory, he had never been to a hotpot restaurant; in fact, there were hardly any hotpot restaurants in Cyber City...... After all, most Dark People couldn't get used to that taste. Compared to the tingling sensation of chili dancing on the tip of the tongue, it was more likely just a simple pain.
Of course, spiciness is always like that.
You didn't think much of it, just reached out and pressed it on Spamton's head: "Oh, thank you." Then you happily walked in the direction he pointed out.
Soon, you arrive at the hotpot restaurant and glance at the nameplate. Good, it reads...... Uh, probably Chinese characters? They're all about to be wild, but you can barely make out what they are. But the English labels below make you realize this really is a hotpot restaurant, since the English letters are just plain printed type.
It was clear that there really weren't many hotpot restaurants in the Dark World, although in the Light World, there weren't many hotpot restaurants in his own area either...... You swallowed hard, as if that aroma was lingering in your nose again, so you eagerly walked in.
The waitress was also a member of the Dark Folk herself. In any case, you couldn't tell what she really belonged to, but under her guidance, she found a seat and sat down, casually placing the Spamton across from her.
Then you look at his head, which is just a little above the table, and fall silent. Honestly...... When eating hotpot, holding him is inconvenient, since hotpot easily spills soup and broth.
You ordered a mandarin duck pot, and the base came out quickly. You picked out your favorite dishes, then handed the menu to Spamton for him to order.
You drag your chin, hesitantly looking at him and then at the table. You even suspect that even if you hold him, he won't be able to reach that pot. Only then do you feel a bit regretful—although you could help him get food or something, wouldn't that be too much trouble?! And why should you help him with such things! Thinking about this, you might be a bit annoyed, but these thoughts were just fleeting in your mind and never showed them.
On the surface, you just looked at him calmly, pondering which chip would be best. In the end, you just took a deep breath: "...... Can you cook?" "Completely unrelated, but you still asked the question."
Spamton seemed stunned for a moment, hesitated for a moment, then hesitated before nodding.
The corners of your mouth lifted slightly, clearly satisfied, of course...... Uh, it's not that you don't know how, you just really don't have the energy. Besides, at this rate, you can't offset the dissatisfaction in your heart now—at most, it will only erase part of it.
But those things can be thought about later! For now, you just made the decision and said, "Alright—let's do it then! I'll serve you some food later, since I feel like you can't reach it anyway...... Don't look at me like that. If you don't believe me, try it yourself." ”
Spamton did try it himself. His poor puppet hand couldn't even touch the edge of the soup pot, and you just shrugged and kept muttering. Anyway, Spamton just happened to hear his voice: "Hmm...... And I think you might not be able to reach either. I'll hold you and eat later, it's such a hassle...... "You don't really like this kind of form."
After all, you're used to being alone.
Spamton silently glanced at you: "...... thank you for your generosity." He originally wanted to refuse, but was truly helpless, so he had no choice but to agree. However, he himself had no reason to refuse this deal.
Then you added, "Alright, I'll help you eat...... Uh, this sounds so strange, but as long as you understand, that's enough! Also, as a condition, you have to cook at home from now on. "As you spoke, you nodded, thinking your suggestion was really clever.
Spamton had no objections...... However, when he heard the word 'home,' the puppet's body still trembled slightly, and you didn't notice.
Soon, the pot boils and all the ingredients are served. You happily get ready to put it in and glance at the spamton...... Then you notice your glasses are now shrouded in mist, and you can't see anything clearly.
You couldn't help but cover your mouth and try hard to hold back your laughter, but you couldn't help but laugh twice. After coughing a few times, you finally said, "Sorry...... I didn't mean to laugh out loud, I just ...... Pfft...... "You usually wear those glasses properly, but occasionally you can see them change into other colors as if they reflect emotions, but you don't really care about what kind of emotions those look like, nor have you ever asked. It seems like it's just a special ability of the dark world.
But now, just like ordinary glasses, there's fog on them, which makes you laugh involuntarily. You thought the Dark People's glasses wouldn't fog up.
You hear Spamton's voice, of course, with a hint of frustration: "[It's okay.] ”
…… You don't think he's completely fine; it's just that you put away your smile, bring over his plate, and then pick up the cooked slices of meat and similar items to portion...... It was only then that you remembered that because you had been laughing all along, you had put the wrong pot. What should have been half white broth and half red broth was now all made red broth by you.
So you cough twice, scratch your hair, and meet Spamton's gaze—for some reason, the fog on his glasses has cleared.
"Uh, I made the wrong choice...... So can you eat it spicy? "You carefully confirm.
Spamton nodded; there was nothing he couldn't do...... After all, he had eaten a bit of everything.
So you nod as well, then get up and pick him up, sit him on your lap, and say boldly, "Alright! Then you eat first!" ”
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then picked up his chopsticks somewhat unskillfully...... He was simply imitating your movements, but he had already done it well, then picked up a piece of meat and put it in his mouth.
…… Burning hot, painful, just like before, he couldn't taste anything else. So, with unskillful movements, he put down his chopsticks but didn't move again.
You glanced down at Spamton, unable to see his expression, so you couldn't help but ruffle his hair: "Alright, it looks like you can't eat it. I'll make you some plain soup—" As you spoke, you prepared to pick up another dish, each serving half.
But your movement was stopped by Spamton's voice.
"[No need], I can endure [scorching heat], [pain], and [spicy meal]." Even so, he still added many adjectives...... Even though his original intention was indeed to use pain to remind himself of something.
You twitched the corner of your mouth and poked Spamton's cheek: "At this point, you might as well stop eating it. You'd better treat yourself better. There's no need to hurt yourself...... Although you don't really know why he suddenly acted so strangely, and you never asked him.
…… You don't have a hobby of poking other people's wounds.
So you insisted on adding half white and half red broth, then smiled and asked, "But do you need any special service?" Like feeding you or something...... After all, you seem very unskilled with chopsticks. "You didn't even consider this when you spontaneously decided to eat hotpot."
Then you looked at the little puppet and shook your head, so you just shrugged and didn't ask further.
Unexpectedly, Spamton's next move was almost flawless. You belatedly thought, this guy's learning ability is really strong...... You can't help but feel a bit envious, since learning is painful for you, and absorbing and digesting knowledge takes a long time.
So you just prop your chin up and pick up food, watching the little puppet eat, and take a few bites yourself. For a moment, it was very quiet, with no other sounds.
You thought it would all quietly pass like this, but unexpectedly, Spamton suddenly spoke up: "I [think] maybe [you] will be curious about that [burning memory]. ”
You slowed your movements in surprise: "Ah, it's fine. After all, if you didn't want to take the initiative to ask, I wouldn't ask anyway. Your past should still be considered your privacy...... I don't really want to pry into it." "But Spamton has already taken the initiative to ask about your past. If you ask him, it might be a kind of courtesy, right?" That's what would be fair, right?
So you think for a moment, then cautiously ask: "Well, if you're willing to talk, what exactly is your past?" "Even though you're not particularly curious.
…… But the fact that the Dark People can shrink is definitely intriguing. After all, the salesperson you met before was about your height, unlike now, who is only half your height.
You see him stop what he's doing, probably not very willing to speak. Then you wait a moment before hearing his voice break the silence.
His voice was very calm, though you could still hear a slight trembling in it. It was clear he wasn't, or rather, was very unwilling to recall that past, but he still told you. Think about it, this really is a case of reciprocity...... Well, actually, when you talk about your own past, it's not that you don't care at all; it's just that there are more things you should care about. You just shouldn't keep getting caught up in those feelings, so you end up letting the feelings that once erupt be pushed away.
And you hear Spamton briefly recount his past. Once a member of Addison, he never sold anything, until one day he received a phone call that changed his fate, even moving into the Queen's mansion...... Until one day, the magic that changed his fate failed, he was no longer a big shot, kicked out, and even thrown into a pool of acid.
You thought of it at an inopportune moment, and it was like some magic that fails at midnight, except the cost was heavy. When he finished speaking, you just patted his head, pondered for a moment, and said, ‘Alright… It seems that fate really is fickle, and you could even say it's unfair. But everything has passed, and there are still many things we can do, aren't there? Perhaps we can always change fate.’ You thought that at this moment, he might not need too much comfort; maybe when he speaks it out, he only needs someone to listen.
In fact, maybe no one had heard this story before… Hmm, so you said half-jokingly, ‘Anyway, if you encounter something upsetting, share it with me. Maybe I can help somehow… Uh, after all, we are still partners, so I suppose we can count as friends, right…?’ You weren’t quite sure.
And you didn’t hear Spamton’s reply, just saw him nod. You scratched your head, feeling a little guilty, since you didn’t even know if your words were appropriate. This was the first time you tried to say something comforting. Cut me some slack, you scarcely have any friends.
When the hotpot was finished, you yawned and got ready to get up and pay, only then did you hear Spamton speak. Relatively speaking, you even felt that his voice was solemn, although still mixed with unpleasant static and strangely fluctuating sharp recorded sounds: ‘【Thank】【you】 for your 【effort】. Presenting you with 【super deals】. Perhaps you also need my 【help】.’
You glanced at Spamton, just held him up while mumbling, ‘Ah… I understand, but most of my emotions I can digest myself…’ You felt saying it might seem like causing trouble for others.
‘It’s not 【trouble】.’ It was only when you heard his reply that you realized you had unconsciously said that last sentence as well.
You cleared your throat twice, scratched your ears, which were curiously warm, quickly paid the bill, and took Spamton home. The following days were not much different from before, doing exercises, facing exams without too much tension—until the day of the exam.
And when the results were released, you were happy to see that you had been admitted to the adult university, and most of the questions were very simple.
Next, a month-long deadline arrived, and you also prepared to enter the next game.
Interlude: Tuesday · END

[Side Quest: Find the Truth About the Zombie Appearance and Solutions] Reward: 100,000 Gold + 100,000 Dark Coins
