content:
Even after returning to the dark world and leaving the game world, you still held Spamton. When you came to your senses, you exhaled and quickly let go of it.
Ultimately, you're a bit frustrated and a bit dazed. You feel like you haven't contributed much to the main quest, which frustrates you—who always prides yourself on not being able to clear Spamton without you—and you haven't completed all the side quests, which makes you feel a bit guilty.
…… If possible, try to complete all the side quests in the future, you thought to yourself.
However, after quieting down for a while and calming down after leaving the game world, you didn't expect a check with a denomination of 50,000 still appearing in your hand—exactly half the reward for side quests. It seems that side quest rewards are actually settled based on task progress, but realizing this only makes you more frustrated.
Meanwhile, Spamton nearby was drowned out by the swirling dark coins. Of course, after a short while, those dark coins disappeared, disappearing into some unknown account. Seeing this, you couldn't help but laugh, feeling a bit better. Spamton glared at you, probably because you were still happy, and didn't say much.
After receiving these rewards, you glanced at the time—it was 3 a.m. So you quickly lay down, threw yourself heavily onto the bed, took a deep breath, closed your eyes, and fumbled to pull Spamton, who was sitting beside you, to lie down next to you.
“…… Alright, it's only three in the morning. If you have something to say, let's talk about it tomorrow. Get some good rest first." After saying that, you yawned. Spamton didn't say anything more, but when you turned over, you felt the little puppet press a little closer to your chest, its head seemingly resting against your chest, which made your expression a bit strange.
Thinking about it, it seems like this was always the way you held him before...... But you never cared before, after all, he was just your business partner; it didn't matter if he was male or female. Honestly, you never even really cared about Spamton's gender; maybe he was just a biological male or female...... Alright, you were joking. It's just that you never cared before, but now you're fussing about it, which feels a bit strange and a bit awkward.
But if you try to ignore that awkward feeling and try to fall asleep, you actually start to feel a bit sleepy. But deep down, you're still mindful of that bit of frustration, and that mood is getting worse. So, although your body feels sleepy, your mind is still excited—or rather, that sense of frustration is building up, making it hard for you to move on for a while.
So when you open your eyes, look down at Spamton, who is probably really asleep with your eyes closed, you start shaking his shoulders without caring and say, "Forget it, you probably haven't fallen asleep yet. Come chat with me!" ”
Spamton was woken up by your shake, glaring at you angrily, while you glared back with righteous confidence. He thought, maybe he understood what you were thinking right now, so even though he was a bit angry when you woke him up, he still dutifully comforted you, the Citizen of Light: "I think you've already worked very hard. No matter how the game ends, you can't be absent." ”
He thought, maybe normally he'd just ignore everything, and he doesn't know how to give you that damn free psychological counseling at this point. Good baby, free psychological counseling is free, so be it. Spamton knows you need companionship and understanding, after all, he knows that no matter what, you're essentially lonely. And no matter what, he actually needs to thank you.
Hmm...... Maybe it's for some other reason, but who knows?
You sighed and started rubbing his head hard again. To be honest, his hair wasn't very smooth, and it wasn't very comfortable to the touch, but you found it stress-relieving. Maybe watching Spamton frown and endure your pressure while swaying along with your hand was very relaxing.
"I know...... Actually, I know I've done a lot, but without you, maybe the main quest wouldn't have been so easy to complete. If it weren't for you, maybe I wouldn't have been able to complete the side quests either. So, you actually have to do it. "Oh my god, you don't even know what you're talking about. Maybe it's just nonsense. But as you spoke, you couldn't help but laugh. Alright, you have to admit, without this partner, there are many things you wouldn't have accomplished.
Spamton just looked at you, then the puppet's small hand poked your cheek: "Your [existence] is also necessary. Without [you], I can't clear [any game]. ”
You quietly listened to him say this and couldn't help but nod: "Actually, I know this, but I...... Even knowing this, you still can't help but feel frustrated, can't help blaming yourself, still can't help but think, if it were someone else, would it be better, or if I were a bit smarter...... "Before you can finish, Spamton interrupts you, covering your mouth with both hands."
"No, [you] is [you], and my [collaborative partner] only needs [you]. Because it's [you], we can smoothly reach the [game ending]." "For some reason, although the puppet's voice still mixed with strange electric currents and messy clips that seemed to be taken from the radio, you felt that at this moment his words were very serious, and probably meant sincerely.
So you couldn't help but nod; in the end, you agreed with what he said. Well, you are you, and it can only be you. Since he agreed, it was better to maintain the status quo!
So you reached out and grabbed Spamton's face, then tugged at him. You smiled and winked at him twice, signaling that you knew about this and that he didn't need to say anything more.
So he released the hand covering your mouth, but just before you could speak, the puppet's hand covered your eyes again. You blinked in surprise, and Spamton could feel your eyelashes brushing against his palm. Honestly, it tickled a little, and for some reason, it tickled his heart too. But before that, he spoke seriously: "Then, now [you] should [get good sleep]." ”
You pouted, wanting to say something more, but since he was woken up by you and didn't scold you, you forgave him! So you pulled his hand away, just closed your eyes, and muttered, "Alright, alright, I get it. I'm going to sleep now...... Oh, you should sleep too......" As you spoke, you randomly patted his head and then stroked his hair.
Although you were still lost in these thoughts, maybe Spamton's words put you at ease, or maybe you were still a bit sleepy. In any case, before you knew it, you had fallen asleep.
Early the next morning, you sat up proudly, and at the same time picked up the still-sleeping Spamton, tossed her off the bed: "Alright, I need to change my clothes. You step aside for a bit!" ”
Fortunately, the moment you picked him up, Spamton was already awake, though his gaze still carried a hint of grievance. He took his clothes and headed to the bathroom first, and soon came out. You had also changed your clothes, so now it was your turn to wash up.
After washing up, tidying up your clothes, you head out. You sit on Spamton's shoulder with you, and before opening the door, Spamton takes the key hanging on the wall. You're used to this—since you don't usually remember to bring your key, you leave it all to Spamton.
Then, breakfast was probably still sandwiches...... But you planned to change it today, so after walking a bit and then turning a corner, Spamton was a bit puzzled. He poked your cheek, and you poked his cheek, saying, "Eating sandwiches all the time feels a bit boring. I'm planning to change today!" ”
…… So your breakfast today turned into a proper Western restaurant, with bacon, freshly fried sausages, fried eggs, two croissants, a small box of jam, and a small plate of soybeans. Even though you didn't quite understand what that combined, you still finished your breakfast. Wiping your mouth, you waited for Spamton, who was swinging his legs because he couldn't get a seat, to finish breakfast—honestly, you were the one who put him up there. After all, he couldn't reach it himself.
For some reason, his pace had slowed down. You remember a month ago when he ate ravenously, it felt like he hadn't eaten in ages. But now, perhaps he had adapted to and enjoyed this comfortable life, so he began to savor it slowly.
…… Actually, you don't think it's a big deal. Honestly, you don't have much of a demand for food—after all, you're not interested in these foods, or rather, you don't care much about meals. But watching others eat seems pretty fun, so you prop up your chin and tilt your head, casually watching Spamton.
Of course, he can also notice the gaze on his body and your gaze. So Spamton, munching on bread, looks up and gives you a puzzled look, asking why you are looking at him that way. You just wave your hand to show you have nothing special.
But you really didn't know how to talk and said, "I feel like you actually enjoy eating pretty well...... Uh, it's not that I look like you're enjoying it, I mean you actually enjoy your meal. ”
Spamton didn't answer your question, just glanced at you again. You couldn't shake the feeling that his expression was as if this was only natural. Well, that was indeed quite reasonable.
After breakfast and paying the dark coins, you buy two bottles of milk and give one to Spamton, while you bite the straw and drink slowly. Even after finishing, you still can't help but bite the straw. You're already somewhat familiar with the road, so this time you don't need Spamton to guide you. You can still find the location of the dump, and of course, the location of his little shop.
But when you reached the door, you were startled. You thought the shop was basically deserted, so you took Spamton and enjoyed breakfast slowly, and he ate very slowly himself! Now you have to think about whether he did it on purpose. After all, it seems like there's a long line in front of the shop, with all kinds of Dark People gathered at the entrance, noisy and noisy. In any case, you didn't hear clearly, and with so many people, you inexplicably felt intimidated. You definitely didn't want to go in.
So you quietly walk a little outside, then poke the spamton on your shoulder: "Can you come over today?" I'm a bit afraid to go. "But your textbooks and such are still in Spamton's shop. If that's really the case, you'd have to ask Spamton to bring out your textbooks." Thinking of this, you start to worry again.
Spamton looked at the Dark People, his eyes darting around, lost in thought. Anyway, you shivered inexplicably, feeling like he wasn't thinking anything good. Still, he nodded: "Alright, today I'll do [marketing]. However, [you] need to do [ground placement]. ”
Hearing this, you quickly put him down and put him on the floor, then quietly moved a couple of steps to the side, crouched down and said to him, "Uh, but my homework book is still in your shop. Can you help me get it later?" You saw it too—there are so many people of darkness, I feel like I can't squeeze in. "You're actually someone who knows how to yield to others, so you're embarrassed to cut in line. Even if, in some ways, you seem to be one of the shop owners too?"
No, you're just a clerk.
Spamton glanced at you silently. For some reason, you noticed his lenses had turned into that garbled mosaic again, as if he wanted to say something more. But in the end, he just nodded at you: "Alright. But I suggest you perform [Azimuthal Shift]; [You] cannot [Freeze in Coordinate Stop]. ”
You nodded, knowing what he meant—basically, you can't stay here. So you rubbed your knees, stood up, and walked around a pile of garbage ahead to the back. At this moment, you're actually relieved that the trash here is almost piled up like a small mountain, which makes it easier for you to hide.
So you hide behind a pile of garbage, peeking out sneakily. Honestly, you're a bit curious about what happens to those Dark People afterwards. After all, aside from the staff and Spamtons you interact with while eating, you haven't interacted with any other Dark Folk before. You don't know why those clerks always show that excited expression every time they see you, almost fainting. You can't possibly be a celebrity in the Dark World, right?
Then, as you saw many of the Dark People leave, still looking very dejected, you can't help but stroke your chin.
Although you don't really know what happened...... But it seems there are still a few Dark People gathered outside Spamton's store, sounding like they're angrily making a fuss about something. No one knows exactly what Spamton said, but in the end, those Dark People left angrily. The entrance returned to quiet, but when they left, it seemed they bought something to take with them and left some Dark Coins on the counter. Since the distance was a bit far, you couldn't hear clearly. You just stroked your chin and wondered to yourself, surely Spamton's business suddenly improved...... It's not impossible, but maybe he did something else without you noticing.
In any case, after all the Dark People piled up at the shop entrance had left, you sneaked out cautiously and glanced around to see if any other Dark People had noticed you—though you didn't know why you were acting like a thief at this moment, in the end, you quickened your pace and entered the cramped shop, sat skillfully on the small stool you usually sitted on, and then took the textbook and homework book that Spamton handed you.
To ease the awkward and quiet atmosphere that somehow seemed a bit awkward, you pretended to laugh cheerfully: "Seems like business has improved, hmm?" ”
…… But for some reason, after saying that, Spamton didn't respond. Instead, he lowered his head, and the atmosphere became even more awkward. You realized belatedly, you should have said the wrong thing...... Did you say something wrong? Even though you couldn't figure it out, what exactly did you say wrong?
But that doesn't stop you from apologizing first. After all, sometimes you really don't know how to read the atmosphere and always say something wrong for no reason: "Uh, sorry, I think I said something wrong just now?" But honestly, I don't really understand why those people gathered at your door...... Could it be that they're just here to see something new? "You're starting to guess casually.
…… After all, you really don't know the real reason, so you just make things up, and Spamton doesn't seem like he's trying to tell you the real reason.
Only then did Spamton look up at you. Of course he knew why—because you were a rare Light Clan in the Dark World, and those Clan of Darkness had never met you before. No matter the reason, they would come to see you—maybe out of pure curiosity, maybe some good intention, or maybe just a stunt for the Clan of Light.
He deliberately kept you in his shop, partly because he genuinely hopes you can learn something...... Probably, but chances like that might not be frequent, and a large part of the reason is that he hopes to use your identity as a citizen of light to achieve some goals, even though he isn't sure if that will happen.
So, how could he possibly tell you the truth? Even though he knows the real reason, he absolutely cannot say it, so he just brushes you off, half-truthfully: "Maybe, he really is here to [see something new]." Spamton is neither lying nor telling the absolute truth, and such words are the easiest to gain people's trust.
And sure enough, you believed it, nodding thoughtfully: "Alright...... I don't even know what's so interesting about it, so let's just leave them alone." As you spoke, you shrugged and immersed yourself again, burying your head in your textbook.
Watching the novelty...... Of course, it's about you, the New Light Citizen to them, Spamton thought, but just turned away, sitting at the counter in a daze. He believed that more people would come later, because what he told those Dark People was that those who came to buy goods had a chance to receive a reward from the Light Citizens.
As for what the reward was...... It was just that you were sent to sell things to the Dark People. Plus, you could find some work too—a win-win situation.
In the following days, the customer flow did seem to increase a bit, and for some reason, Spamton went out more often. But when he came back, he always brought something with him. You felt like he was restocking, and it was normal for him to leave for a while—but whenever he left, it seemed that some Dark People would come to buy things, so you had to take Spamton's place to host and help sell things. Honestly, at first you didn't get used to wearing a smiling face, but over time you got used to it. You just honestly sold what they needed.
…… After all, Spamton always seems to be slick with his tongue selling other things, so the Dark Commoners who come to buy things leave with two or three items they didn't actually want—probably some kind of discount or promotional tactic. In short, you're amazed. You're still too honest and straightforward; you definitely won't learn these things. Occasionally tricking people is enough to make you feel guilty for quite a while.
However, those Dark People always seem very excited when they receive the goods you hand over, which you don't quite understand...... This is just like the behavior of those shop assistants before, which you can't understand. It's just that those clerks seem used to it now, while the Dark People remain just as excited. Could it be because you are a Light Citizen?
And with more and more customers lately, you really feel like you really need to find out what's going on...... Just because you're not good at socializing doesn't mean you can't.
Anyway, when another Dark Citizen came to the window to buy medicine, you handed him a reagent vial while pretending to be casual—well, it looks like your disguise failed, but it doesn't matter: "Speaking of which, these potions are pretty ordinary and can be bought elsewhere, right? Why come all the way to the junkyard?" "And don't think you don't care about prices at all. You've noticed these items are actually a bit more expensive than other shops, at least a few dozen Dark Coins."
…… This doesn't seem like a trivial matter anymore.
So the Dark People accepted the medicine bottle and handed over the Dark Coins, but gave you a rather strange look: "Because the shop owner said that as long as you come here to shop, there's a chance you'll encounter a shop assistant who is a Light Citizen...... So when they hear this news, almost all the Dark People come to take a look. You're the shop assistant, don't you know? ”
You were a bit stunned. You really didn't know this, and Spamton had never told you before. This time, you finally felt as if a bucket of ice water had been poured over your head. Your lips trembled twice. Although you instinctively wanted to shake your head, you knew you couldn't, so you just smiled: "Ah...... I know, I feel like I've heard of it, but I just couldn't remember right away. Sorry to bother you. ”
Lies—you've never even heard of them, and this is the first time you've heard them.
That Dark Citizen nodded, happily took the vial and left, while you stood dumbfounded behind the counter, tugging at the corner of your mouth, feeling angry at being tricked, but even more so a sense of helplessness.
…… You even think that being able to tell a lie so smoothly just now is a huge joke. Oh my, you're not exactly a completely honest and upright person anymore. True, how could a truly honest person dream of windfall from the sky?
You've already experienced being deceived by Spamton once, but you still chose to trust him. Honestly, this isn't a big deal, nothing major. You know, it's probably some kind of marketing strategy he needs, and it really works. But for some reason, there's a deep sense of helplessness and indescribable resentment, and you feel like you shouldn't have stopped.
Actually, if he had told you from the start that he had come to the store for this purpose, you probably wouldn't have thought much of it, so you might just be angry that he deceived you...... Moreover, to be honest, there is a kind of anger at being looked down upon.
Although you know he does mean well, you also know that at least for now, what kind of job suits you better is not standing behind the counter as a salesperson.
But...... Well, you can't keep your imagination, because you hear the shop door being pushed open, you see Spamton returning.
He was just as usual, just thanking you and saying, "Thank you, Miss Y/N, for taking care of me during my [outings]." "As he spoke, Spamton raised his hand, probably wanting to shake your hand, just like always."
But you just quietly watch him, then exhaustedly slump your shoulders. You don't know what kind of look you have now—maybe it's disappointment. You try to stay calm, since you don't want to argue. Arguments often hurt both sides because emotions are out of control at that time.
So you just quietly ask, "I...... In your shop, is it just a mascot role? "You know, you probably just got it serious, you're certainly not just a mascot sitting here for people to admire.
Spamton looked up at you, probably realizing you had noticed something. He just stood on tiptoe, grabbed your hand, and shook it twice as if it were a handshake. For some reason, you found this behavior a bit amusing.
"Of course not. I'm very grateful to you for your exclusive support." He only said this, without fully confirming some things.
But you also understood what he meant. You just reacted slowly, not completely lacking thinking ability. Ultimately, you were just a person whose thinking ability was about the same as ordinary people.
“…… Alright, I understand, so you didn't truly want me to work and help at your shop; you had your own purpose mixed in." You concluded, at least that's the conclusion you can reach now. Honestly, did you feel disappointed? Maybe a little...... Although at first, it didn't seem like you should have had high expectations.
At least you understand what his purpose was before that he hadn't told you. If only he had told you everything completely at the time, but unfortunately, there are no ifs.
But he just looked at you, and you two stared at each other, staring at each other for a moment. After a moment of silence, it seemed he thought it might be better to just say it outright. Spamton nodded decisively: "Yes, this is my true intention." However, the right [interest entanglement] is much stronger. ”
Hmm...... In other words, he thinks that sincerity mixed with interests might be more sincere. You don't agree or deny it, after all, you actually have no idea what sincerity really is. In other words, you have no idea what those things about love and love really mean, nor do you know what they feel. However...... Maybe what he said really is true.
Your conversation was calm, and there was no argument. But for some reason, after saying this, he lowered his head, seemingly afraid to look at you again. You couldn't be bothered to ask unnecessary questions, since you already knew the general answer.
You just stood up and said decisively, "Alright...... I know you don't see me as a mascot entirely; you have good intentions, but I don't want to accept it. Also, I don't want to be a mascot to some extent, although it's convenient and I know it. But taking shortcuts...... There's no joy more than steadily gaining something, at least that's how I feel. So, I think I'm more willing to do work that suits me honestly, and I want to prove my own strength. At the very least, I have to tell myself that I can do it. ”
You announced this, then prepared to walk out of the shop. Although you said this, you still felt a bit lost, since you didn't know what other work you had to do...... Your previous job was helping move corpses in the hospital morgue. You can't go to the hospital to carry bricks or anything like that now, which doesn't seem very suitable for you......
Just as you were lost in thought, Spamton spoke up, sounding like he wanted to persuade you to stay: "I understand, [you] don't want to accept [discounts]. [You] want to make a [full purchase], but I also want [you] to know that [you] can always come to my [Store: Location] to enjoy [free coupons]." However, I don't agree with [you]'s view. Whether it's [Portable Road] or [Rough Road], as long as you can become [Big Shot], I think it's worth [trying]. ”
This seems like the first time you've had such a long and serious conversation...... In the past, there were occasional moments like this, and you or him would always brush it off. Sometimes, you weren't really sure what he was thinking.
You turn around and look at him seriously, only to find that Spamton does have a serious expression, and it seems he is serious.
You sigh, then take a deep breath. You know what he means is that his shop will always welcome you, that this position has always existed, or rather, it was originally created especially for you.
But after thinking it over, you actually reached out and hooked your finger, signaling Spamton to give you the money: "By the way. Last month's salary, and this half month's salary, you can give me first." ”
So you and Spamton stared at each other for a long time. After all, he probably hadn't expected you to make such a request—honestly, your money really isn't easy to split. You hooked your fingers again, stood on your hips with your hands on your hips, and looked at Spamton. After a moment of silence, he finally counted out 1,500 Dark Coins and handed them over to you—just a month's and a half months' salary.
After you get the money, you count it and confirm the amount is indeed 1,500, then accept it satisfactorily. Then you look at him and think for a moment. To be honest, you hesitate for a moment, since dissecting someone's inner feelings might sound awkward, and the other person might not even listen...... But it's just a sentence.
Yes, just one sentence, so you cleared your throat: "Alright, actually, I don't particularly dislike your behavior. I just feel that at least you don't need to hide it from me...... In other words, I thought we could already be considered good friends and could say a few honest words, but you still chose to deceive me, which makes me a little sad." After saying that, for some reason, you felt much lighter. Indeed, having words bottled up in your heart might make it even more painful.
It's better to just say it out loud now, but you don't know if Spamton is willing to say it. You feel like he's always unwilling, and even if you try to probe his thoughts, he'll block them off, always hiding as if it's some shameful secret.
Spamton looks back at you, and once again his glasses have turned completely pixelated, making it impossible to see what his true thoughts are. After all, you can't even see his eyes anymore, and now you can't even see his expression, as he lowers his head, lost in thought.
"...... sorry, I thought this would be better for you." He just said that, without explaining anything else, but for some reason, it only made you angrier.
Yet you still took a deep breath and kept your composure: "Alright, it turns out this isn't good for me. It only shows you treat me badly, doesn't it?" You shrugged as you spoke, feeling like you were about to laugh in anger.
At this moment, Spamton finally lifted his head. He looked a bit flustered, and you were sure he was indeed nervous at that moment...... Well, you don't really know what you mean to Spamton—probably just a business partner. You've realized this, so your anger eventually turns into a faint exhaustion and disappointment.
But he said, "No, Miss Y/N, I want you to have the [best experience], that you and I are [friend added], I just ...... maybe that's just one of my [habits]. "Oh my god, he doesn't even know what he's saying, why things have come to this. As if everything is about to fall apart any second? Spamton can only admit that maybe he hasn't really considered what you'd think. He's just afraid you'll reject him.
…… Still, why was he afraid? He didn't know either.
You lift your head again and look him straight in the eye: "Alright, maybe you really do think about what's best for me...... Well, anyway, I've already told you, so please don't be so good in the future, okay? Although this time I was hurt, as long as I explain it clearly, I can quickly put this matter behind me. I just hope this kind of thing never happens again. ”
You see Spamton reluctantly nod: "...... I guarantee it." ”
You don't know how effective his promise is, but hearing that makes you satisfied. After all, if he's truly a master of deception, it doesn't matter if he deceives you from the start to the end—you'd rather know nothing. It's better than being like this now.
So you relaxed and reached out a hand to him: "Alright, then let's get to know each other again. Want to be friends?" My name is Y/N. ”
He looked at you with a complicated expression, but finally reached out and held your hand: "Hello, Miss Y/N, nice to meet you." ”
You shook hands, and you finally walked out of the shop, happily holding the 1,500 Dark Coins you had just received. But just before you left, you suddenly remembered something and turned back to Spamton, shouting, "Ah, I'll be home tonight! Remember to bring my textbooks and stuff back!" ”
Out of the corner of your eye, you catch a glimpse of Spamton nodding helplessly, so you happily walk away.
Even so, you still haven't figured out what exactly you want to do...... But since you've already made it clear, you can actually do whatever you want, even if it's just a manual laborer carrying bricks at the dock. Of course, if that's what you think, you wouldn't actually do it.
…… Or maybe work as a cashier at a grocery store or something, but isn't that pretty much the same as working at a spamton store? Looking at it this way, it's better to be a manual laborer...... Speaking of which, the Dark World should have hospitals too, right? After all, the Light World has them, so why wouldn't the Dark World have one?
Sure enough, you did find a hospital inside Cyber City. To be honest, it seems the Dark People inside don't really need your help, since some of them already have syringes with them. It feels like the Dark Folk entering the hospital will be discharged soon. Your feelings are a bit complicated.
Still, you managed to find a job here, and although I probably handed it over to you right away for the sake of your Lightfolk, it leaves you feeling a bit complicated. To be honest, you don't like this at all, but there's nothing you can do. After all, you don't fit in with the Dark People—no matter how you look at it, you're just a Lightfolk.
And you came to the hospital because you secretly learned a bit of nursing work while at the hospital. You think those nursing skills should be enough, since you were a bit nervous when you first arrived. Who knew the work here would be so simple? Maybe it's because you're a citizen of light, so these jobs are so simple.
Anyway, you easily finished your day's work and happily left work and headed out. You bought a sandwich to stave off your hunger. After all, even though you're going home that evening, you don't know if Spamton will be waiting for you to eat together—what if? Thinking of this, you took out your Dark World phone and sent him a message, but he didn't reply. After hesitating for a moment, you didn't call, but casually bought a bouquet of blue irises while passing by a flower shop.
After all, the fresh taste lifts your spirits, and the flowers just look good. Just then, after finishing that sandwich, you take out your phone and check again, only to find Spamton replied to your message, telling you he didn't have dinner.
Very good...... If he doesn't reply, you have to call him. After all, you were just too shy to call because you had stuffed your mouth with a sandwich, so you happily replied with a message asking if he had a dinner spot he wanted to visit.
Spamton said no, so after thinking for a moment, you suggested we go eat sukiyaki today.
He said yes. Maybe he doesn't mind exactly what location you mentioned.
In short, you're just happily heading home. On the way, you remember there's no vase at home, so you buy another vase. At least it looks beautiful enough—but actually, after buying it, you realize you've only bought some useless things, and your salary just went through it. Even though it's only a little, you still stick out your tongue in embarrassment.
But keeping a good mood is also very important! So you still brought the vase and the bouquet back home, happily pushed open the door, and shouted, "I'm back!" "Anyway, you know he's definitely home, otherwise he wouldn't have come back so quickly."
You naturally heard Spamton's voice: "[Welcome home]." ”
And you, happily humming an off-key tune, place the vase on the coffee table, unfold the bouquet and put it inside, pour in some water, and make sure these beautiful flowers can live a few more days.
Think about it, you really do treat this place as your home. After all, this is the place you've been hoping to return to, and where people are waiting and waiting for you to come back. It's where you can truly feel at ease. Although there were a few minor conflicts earlier, you have to admit that maybe this will bring your relationship even closer.
At least, that's what you think.
Spamton naturally noticed your movements too, and naturally, he asked, "[Question: Motive]?" "You saw him sitting on the sofa, his feet not touching the floor, still slightly swinging his legs.
And you just stand on your hips, looking somewhat satisfied at your masterpiece—even though you've just placed a vase and water and casually inserted the flowers: "Ah, the house should have some decorations, right? That way, it feels more like home, and seeing it will lift your mood." ”
“…… Indeed. Then I'll also do the [Regular Quest: Change the Bouquet]. He was silent for a moment, then answered you like this. Spamton had to admit that your choice was the right one. Of course, he actually liked this place quite a lot, because he felt at ease in this residence. As for whether it was because you were there...... Well, Spamton thought, and at this point, he had to admit that it was precisely because of you that he liked this place.
Maybe, he thinks, he really wants to trust you more, and he really can't deceive you anymore.
…… After all, compared to other things, he probably fears seeing your disappointed expression. When we talked to you earlier today, he almost thought you would abandon him after that. But it seems that perhaps you and he share the same or similar thoughts.
You didn’t overthink it; you simply walked over familiarly, then picked up Spamton and held him in your arms: 'Mm-hmm… alright, let’s have dinner first! No need, just remember to replace the flowers when you see the ones originally placed have withered, because I sometimes forget to bring new flowers myself. Actually, my memory isn’t particularly good.' Saying this, you stuck out your tongue.
You took Spamton to the sukiyaki restaurant, which you happened to see on your way home from work, so you easily—or rather confidently—found the way there, and at the end, you didn’t forget to say to Spamton: 'See, I can find the way without navigation!' You didn’t really know what you were doing; in short, what you wanted to express was that even without his help, you could live just fine on your own, as that’s how you had always gotten by before.
Spamton didn’t respond, but you felt the puppet in your arms touch your arm, which could be considered a kind of response, although you didn’t really know what he meant by it.
Sukiyaki is actually somewhat similar to hotpot, except that the main thing cooked is wagyu beef slices, and it’s served with a soft-boiled egg. You broke the soft-boiled egg into your small bowl, then casually also broke an egg for Spamton. After all, after you placed him in his seat, his head barely reached above the table.
The pot quickly came to a boil. You dropped in thin slices of wagyu beef, then lifted them out again and put them in your bowl, and didn’t forget to give Spamton two slices as well, since he certainly couldn’t reach them himself—and who knows, the puppet’s arm might even get burned if it touched the boiling pot.
Although your actions were voluntary, you couldn’t help but complain a little: 'Ah, look how nice I am, even serving you food.' Well, it was more like seeking praise than complaining.
Spamton silently glanced at you and nodded: 'Miss Y/N [Wise and Mighty], [Unmatched].'
'…What are you praising this time?' you couldn’t help but comment, but your mood brightened. You knew what he was referring to—your achievements in the game world. Well, you admitted you had indeed contributed a lot! In short, you enjoyed the meal, not forgetting to split everything evenly, half for you, half for him.
After the meal, you continued to the Light World to attend adult university classes—or rather, you hurried there, as it was already a bit late after sukiyaki, and you almost arrived late. You didn’t know what Spamton had done at home, probably helping with cleaning; in any case, when you returned, the room was clean and tidy.
You washed up, then lay down on the bed with Spamton and fell into a deep sleep, enjoying a long period of rest, and in the morning hastily went to the hospital to start work. For the next half month, you almost repeated this schedule.
Until one day, a month’s time was up, and as usual, you fell asleep, but upon waking, you found yourself in another place.

content:
Apologies if there are any OOCs. This chapter may contain disturbing bloody violence, as well as references to profanity. Please read with caution.
——
[Main Quest: Survive Safely and Escape the Hotel] Rewards one month of rest and safety protection.
[Side Quest: Successfully find evidence, report it, and bring the criminal to justice] Reward: 100,000 gold and 100,000 Dark Coins.
You hugged the Spamton, looking seriously at the screen in front of you, then rubbed your chin. You turned off the screen and first surveyed the surroundings—hmm, it looked like it was a guest room inside a hotel. To be honest, although the room was a bit cramped, it was comfortable enough. The warm yellow light illuminated the entire room. Besides that, the room by the window was the bed you were sitting on, and on the other side by the wall was a small table and chair. Besides that, there were simple amenities like a kettle. On the opposite wall was a projection screen similar to a TV, and the cabinet below was a flower arrangement. The hallway next door led out to a simple small wardrobe and a bathroom.
Just looking at these things probably isn't a problem; the only problem is probably—
Your expression was grave, so you wouldn't seem so overwhelmed as you asked, "Why are we in the same room?" "And this room only has a queen bed, which means you two still have to squeeze in and sleep together. But since Spamton is so small, you can roll around freely on the big bed."
But for some well-known reasons—anyway, you looked seriously at the condoms on the counter, feeling inexplicably a bit uncomfortable staying in this room any longer.
Spamton was a bit speechless at your question, but following your gaze, he probably understood what you were thinking, so he fell silent for a moment.
The room fell into an indescribable silence at that moment. After a while, he finally spoke: "...... Perhaps to implement the [Room Change Measure]?" ”
Of course, you think the same way. Although it's fine to sleep together, aren't those previous worlds all spent this way...... It's just that the king bed room simply makes you a bit uncomfortable.
"Go ahead and give it a try, but maybe you can't change rooms yet." You took a deep breath, hugged the spamton, and walked out with the room card. You looked for the elevator or stairs and found that this small hotel only had stairs, but the floors weren't very high—about three floors in total, unless there was a basement or something—you had just climbed up out of curiosity to take a look.
The second and third floors are all residents' rooms, so there are quite a few rooms. The first floor has a kitchen, dining room, and library, and even the lobby has a comfortable, soft sofa. The warm yellow lighting makes this place seem a bit like it's for high-end residents—in other words, a place for the wealthy. You suddenly feel uncertain about changing rooms, since you're not sure if you can afford it—maybe you can't afford it at all.
I have no idea how this game system arranged for you to live in a place like this.
Anyway, you should walk to the counter, clear your throat, and the receptionist at the front desk looks up to ask if there's something wrong.
"Uh...... Can I change rooms? I want to swap out the king room I'm currently staying in for a standard double suite. "As you spoke, you showed your room card.
Come to think of it, it seems she's deliberately ignoring the Spamton in your hand. You don't even know why he's so unnoticed, but the receptionist just said she'd help you check it for a moment and then looked down at the computer.
And you quietly hold the Spamton, waiting.
After a while, she looked up again: "I'm sorry, miss, but the hotel doesn't have any spare rooms left. The king room you booked is the last one and can't be changed." ”
To be fair, this was actually what you expected, so you just shrugged in thanks and hugged the Spamton, ready to leave. Although you wanted to survive safely, you hadn't yet seen anything dangerous.
But just as you were about to climb the stairs, you heard a "clatter" from the kitchen nearby, as if the blade was pressing closely against the cutting board. The receptionist seemed unfazed and continued with her own tasks. You would have been careless at first, if only you hadn't smelled a bit of strange blood.
Anyway, you stopped and looked back. Your pause didn't catch the receptionist's attention, so you darted around and simply walked back with your spamton. You sat down on the sofa in the lobby, and for easier observation, you chose a spot almost directly opposite the kitchen. Even in this spot, you could still smell blood.
The clanging sound continued. You saw the man wearing a chef's hat raise his kitchen knife high and slash fiercely, shattering the bones stained with blood-red flesh in front of him. The blood had not been properly treated and was slowly flowing down along with the chopping motion. Faintly, you could almost hear the ticking sound—the sound of blood flowing, and as a result, you smelled an even stronger smell of blood. You didn't know why the chef didn't handle the blood, which made the meat look extremely fishy.
So you decided to ask the lady at the front desk. You walked over again, knocked twice on the counter, but couldn't think of anything else to say, so you straightforwardly asked, "Who is that person in the kitchen?" I noticed he hadn't even cleaned the blood on the raw meat, and I'm worried the food he made wouldn't taste good enough. What if he couldn't provide satisfactory service? ”
The receptionist answered your question without even looking up: "The person in the kitchen is also one of our guests, not a real chef. The meals we serve are all carefully prepared." This guest said he brings his own ingredients but enjoys working in the kitchen. He also enjoys serving his special dishes to other guests. Of course, we respect our guests and do not force others. ”
You nodded, roughly understanding what was going on, but this cold yet cozy inn inexplicably made you feel fearful. Survive safely and escape from the hotel...... Then you can just leave right now, right? You looked toward the main entrance. Although it was tightly shut, it was not impossible to open. You walked over and opened the door, only to be forced by the howling cold wind to close it again, causing you to shiver involuntarily. To be honest, it was indeed cold outside—far too cold, but inside the inn, it was surprisingly warm. And you just noticed—outside is a world of ice and snow, and the bridge in front of the inn is broken and impassable. In other words, at least for now, you can't leave. Of course, if you want to risk crossing the natural barrier, that's not impossible.
…… So, maybe we have to wait until the bridge is repaired, or at least until the temporary passage is completed. At this moment, you turn to look at the hall again, and hearing the sounds coming from the kitchen, you suddenly feel a chill down your spine and shiver.
At that moment, Spamton raised his hand and poked your cheek, so you looked at the little puppet in your arms with a curious expression.
He lowers his voice and says to you, "Now, we should go to the kitchen [visit and search]." ”
Indeed, what he said made sense—whether it's a main or side quest, you should go to the kitchen to investigate. No matter what, that person's behavior is a bit strange...... Of course, this isn't a reason you can subconsciously treat the other person as a bad person.
But you shouldn't harbor ill intentions, but you must always be wary of them. You still have to go and see for yourself. You steadied yourself and still carried the little puppet toward that direction. The closer you walked into the kitchen, the louder the noise became. You saw the bloodstains stained on the chef's robe, the white apron, and the red blood—everything was so obvious. You also saw the chef's face. To be honest, his appearance was ordinary, but at that moment he seemed a bit manic, even tinged with a subtle reddish heat, as if he had suddenly caught a fever. The closer you got, the more pronounced the smell of blood became, mixed with the smell of rust. No matter what, it was unbearable, and you involuntarily frowned and covered your nose. To be honest, you don't like this smell at all, nor do you like this behavior. And looking at his expression, you think this person is really strange.
It's just that for some reason, Spamton doesn't seem affected at all. Maybe from this perspective, you can't see his expression clearly, but in any case, when you look down at him in a panic, you don't notice any change in his expression. So maybe he actually can't smell ......? Or maybe he can smell it but only faintly? For some reason, you keep feeling like you've caught some kind of inspiration, or maybe it's just your imagination. After all, how could something like that really happen, let alone happen with Spamton? Only then do you suddenly realize that you subconsciously believe Spamton can solve most things perfectly, and you don't know why you think that way.
In short, you just couldn't stand the smell, so you took a deep breath. When another sound rang out, your body instinctively trembled. You looked at the bones and meat he was chopping. He didn't seem to know how to cut meat, probably not a professional chef, and didn't follow the grain of the meat but freely cut into the shapes he wanted. This was also why his voice was loud—the sounds of chopping and chopping meat were so hard to ignore. You imagine if you were on the second floor, you would vaguely hear them.
And those white, blood-stained bone fragments fell to the ground. Along with the occasional bits of flesh, you might even wonder if he was really just enjoying the process.
Anyway, you swallowed hard, stood in front of the kitchen, and decided to step inside. The so-called chef was still lost in his own world and didn't notice your arrival at all. You stood at the kitchen doorway and quickly glanced around. There was nothing strange—pots and pans, since you had to prepare meals for several people, there were many stoves, and even a large pot. The only odd thing was that there were actually two refrigerators here, which was definitely something to pay attention to.
You steadied yourself and watched as the chef wiped the sweat from his forehead. Finally, you stopped what you were doing and dared to ask, "Chef, I heard you're a guest here. So, we should be free to tour the kitchen here?" ”
The chef glanced at you and nodded cheerfully: "Of course! I'm also welcome you to ask me questions!" As he spoke, he grinned. Honestly, that smile was so exaggerated that it almost stretched all the way to your ears, making you shiver uncontrollably. To be honest, you don't even know what to ask.
At this moment, Spamton spoke up: "In that case, I'd like to ask about your [Ingredients: Source]. ”
Well, at this moment, Spamton treats your mouth as pretty good, and you suddenly feel especially at ease. Oh my god, you don't want to ask these questions at all. Just the strong smell of blood in the kitchen makes you want to frown and pinch your nose. But you have to suppress the impulse; you wouldn't dare do it until you're sure the other person is friend or foe.
You see the chef's eyebrows raised, as if puzzled that you asked a completely simple and easy question, one that was not even difficult for him: "Where do you get the ingredients?" Of course, this inn provides them. ”
…… But the receptionist just now said that the chef brought the ingredients himself. So where did these self-prepared ingredients come from?
Just in case, you might want to ask another question: "Can I ask which refrigerator the hotel uses?" ”
The chef pointed to a fridge located on the inner side. So you walked over and opened it, and it was packed full—white meat, red meat, and various vegetables. You could have refilled it after he took out the food, but ...... Even so, you didn't see any meat similar to the one the chef had prepared.
That chef went back to work. Once again, you heard the pounding of chopping meat, but instinctively shivered. This time, you closed the fridge and walked over to another fridge, leaning against the outside of the kitchen, also directly behind the chef. You carefully opened the fridge door to look. Fresh blood was still flowing down, but it was cold blood slowly dripping downward. Some hung on the freezer doors, while others dripped onto the floor.
And you see: white bones, deep black marrow, and the neatly patterned red flesh still bleeding from it. On top is a layer of yellow, greasy, and physiologically uncomfortable fat, and the top layer—obviously—is human skin. After all, where else can you find an animal with pale yellow skin and black fur?
Ah, but humans are also animals.
This ingredient—or rather, human flesh—was clearly fresh and looked like it had died not long ago. But the receptionist just now said the hotel was full, so did they even know those guests were dead? You didn't know; all you knew was your hair standing on end, your body instinctively on guard. If the chef behind you tried to make a move on you, you would be almost completely unprepared. Either way, you first took out your camera and quietly filmed the scene inside the fridge, then turned your back to film his back, and then you exhaled.
Fortunately, he probably had no intention of making a move.
You gently closed the fridge door, tiptoed around cautiously holding the Spamton, and turned around, trying not to make a sound. Even though the receptionist was still in the lobby and unlikely to make a move, those staff were probably just accomplices. In short, not being discovered is best. The receptionist noticed your actions but didn't say anything, just lowered her head and continued with her own affairs, which made you breathe a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, he didn't notice the sounds behind him. After all, the sound of the knife chopping bones was so loud it drowned out all the sounds behind him, giving you a chance to skip the fridge and walk back to the kitchen door. Now you know the bloody pieces he was cutting were probably human flesh, and you know his expression was so wild because he was dealing with human flesh...... Either way, this realization made you feel sick, but you resisted the urge to gag. At least for now, you couldn't let him notice anything.
You just stood at the kitchen door, trying to keep a smile and say, "Thank you. We've finished touring the kitchen and are planning to leave now." The chef just responded with a cold "hmm," not even looking up to look at you. Mi couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief, hurriedly hugging the Spamton, quickly walking next door to the library, then leaning against the wall and retching twice. Of course, aside from the stomach acid burning his throat, there was actually nothing in his stomach. Only then did you realize that you hadn't eaten anything yet, just been so focused on the tour. No wonder you felt so nauseous.
At that moment, Spamton poked your cheek again, drawing your attention to the desserts on the coffee table in the middle of the hall: "Maybe you can [temporarily solve your hunger]?" "Although he hadn't actually eaten much, he was already used to this feeling of hunger, so not eating didn't matter to him.
Probably.
You steady yourself and look over. There are indeed several kinds of desserts on the coffee table, delicate and small, probably prepared for guests resting in the lobby, since this is considered a high-end restaurant. It looks like red velvet cake, tiramisu, Black Forest cake, honey cake, and so on...... Ah, and matcha cookies.
Once the dry heaving and nausea had eased, you sat down on the sofa in the living room, picked up the teacup on the coffee table and started drinking slowly, trying to calm the burning sensation in your throat. Once you felt better, you picked up a matcha cookie and put it in your mouth, then brought over the honey cake, then placed the Spamton on the other side of the sofa and placed the honey cake in front of him. You remember he hadn't eaten anything either, and the honey cake was ...... Uh, probably to his taste.
You searched around again and handed him a plastic spoon. Spamton silently glanced up at you, then nodded at you, probably expressing his gratitude, before lowering his head to start eating the honey cake. Although it was a bit too sweet, his sense of taste wasn't sharp now, so the sweetness was just right for him.
You don't like things that are too sweet; you prefer a mild, bitter taste. So you eat a few more matcha cookies before bringing over the tiramisu to eat.
After eating, you finally felt a bit full and regained strength. But for some reason, you felt drowsy and couldn't resist your sleepiness, as if some sleeping pill had been put on you. At this moment, all you wanted was a good sleep. You forced yourself to stand up and grab the spamton back to your room, but after just a couple of steps and a few steps, your legs gave out and you collapsed to the floor, making a dull thud.
You fell asleep.
Spamton was startled by you. He had suspected that these exquisite desserts on the coffee table might be problematic, but the receptionist didn't say anything, and after a quick try, at least the honey cake was fine...... So he wasn't sure which cake had been drugged.
If he'd known earlier, he wouldn't have suggested you come to eat these cakes. No...... He couldn't say whether his actions were intentional retaliation. In fact, he had long warned himself not to mind the previous discussion at the shop, which wasn't really a quarrel, but he still couldn't help but worry about that incident.
He feels like he's getting farther and further away from his goal. Although this so-called game system says you can make wishes as long as you complete all the game tasks, who knows if that's true or not?
He has to do something at this moment. At least, yes, Spamton thought, of course, you still need to understand that you really can't do without him. So at this moment, he didn't remind you.
…… Of course, without you, he probably can't either, but now Spamton doesn't want to admit it.
In short, he was now considering whether he could drag you back, but after some experiments, he could only pull you a little; beyond that, he couldn't do much more. The difference in size was too great, and of course, there was also a difference in strength.
The next moment, he saw a man slowly coming down the stairs. Spamton hid behind the sofa, out of a corner of his vision, sensing that the man was probably coming downstairs to see his prey.
Seeing the cake eaten on the table and you collapsed on the floor, that man happily pulled you along and led you up the stairs, ignoring your back and head banging against the steps countless times. The receptionist lowered her head even more, pretending not to see all this, perhaps already used to it.
Having witnessed all this, Spamton now felt genuine regret, and of course, an indescribable anger. He really shouldn't have let that sudden desire for revenge and expectations bring you into such a situation. Besides, he just wanted you to learn a lesson a little, not to truly hurt you.
In any case, he quietly followed along. Spamton guessed what the man was probably planning to do—to knock people out, like prey to be slaughtered, and it wouldn't matter what he did then.
He followed the man outside his room, and slipped in just as he opened it. Fortunately, because of his size, the man didn't notice Spamton's movement. He simply placed you in a chair, tied your hands and feet, and even tied a rope around your neck, probably to prevent your escape. Then he was counting his instruments. If he wasn't mistaken, it was probably some kind of torture device...... In short, there were those torture devices for pulling fingernails and teeth...... And the pear-shaped pincers that forcibly held an adult's mouth—doing so would leave a lifetime of ugly scars around his mouth. For now, the man intends to wait until you wake up to do these things. As for the final task...... Maybe hanging him, but how should the body be handled? Naturally, it was handed over to the chef downstairs, which is why the chef said the hotel was the source of the raw materials.
To be honest, Spamton couldn't do much more, and he couldn't just wait here in a hurry. 'He is regarded as the deity who controls sleep and dreams, belonging to the ranks of the Old Gods. He often dwells at the boundary of reality and dreams, observing those who dream.
Dreams are his domain. It is said that if you are targeted by him in a dream, you will be transformed into a form He finds interesting. Your human instincts will be cut off and separated, and you will never escape from the dream world.
If trapped in dreams, life will be spent as His toy or pastime... If this "life" truly has an end." 】
You shivered again, feeling like you'd seen something you shouldn't have, giving you goosebumps all over.
Spamton, on the other hand, appeared perfectly fine and energetic. He simply read the passage by the glow of the oil lamp, then concluded, "It seems those [prisoners] are also suffering in the [Dream World]. ”
He also helped you stroke your goosebumps. Although the puppet's little hand was a bit cold, you felt much better.
You couldn't help but nod: "Yes, I wonder how the people who experimented on them managed to do it...... Well, to be honest, after reading these experiment records, I realized that the ones who used them for experiments were actually the ones who deserved to be arrested." Your expression turned serious.
Spamton nodded as well: "However, when it comes to the 'mastermind's true culprit,' we have absolutely no clue." ”
You flipped through the experiment records again. Indeed, the experimenter was very cautious, leaving almost nothing related to themselves behind. But since this book is frequently flipped through, you guess that the experimenter might actually be nearby. So—just have someone take out this place in one go. But you think that experimenter will definitely leave you a way out.
You closed the book, stuffed it back onto the shelf, and picked up another book that looked dustless, with many signs of flipping through. You casually said, "Hmm, but these people can't escape death too. The experimenter seems to have some conscience—in fact, he was actually using death row prisoners for experiments." "But whether it improved or worsened, you can't tell just from the experimental records. You're confused, and there are so many symbols on it that you can't understand at all."
Another book seems to say that the bridge before the cliff appears when encountering demons, because that bridge exists at the boundary between yin and yang. It is neither real nor illusory, but has survived here through certain means.
You don't really know how you did it, but after flipping through it, the last page contains records related to the time of encountering demons.
['The 'Hour of Encountering Demons' is a mysterious period in Eastern legend.
Generally, it refers to the one hour before and after dusk, when yin and yang alternate, the boundary between the two realms becomes blurred, and demons and ghosts are more likely to appear. Ancient people believed that dim lighting made it easier to encounter evil spirits, hence the term 'encountering demons,' meaning encountering demons. In folk customs, going out at this time is taboo to avoid encountering 'hidden spirits' or encountering the true form of monsters.'
'If we explain it from a scientific perspective, we can understand the reason: changes in light at dusk cause the cone cells and rod cells in the eye to switch between them. When people cannot adapt to changes in light, they may develop illusions due to fear of the unknown, mistaking others for something else.' 】
…… Although you are a materialist atheist, it seems you can only believe these strange and mysterious things now; otherwise, you might never be able to leave this place, because this inn is already a dead island. That said, maybe that bridge is actually a monster, which is why it appears when encountering demons. In any case, there is indeed a way to leave. You put the book back on the shelf, just as you were about to turn and leave, you found the door behind you gone, and the inside of the library had turned pitch black. You raised the oil lamp in your hand, your face turning pale. You seemed to hear some sounds behind you. No matter what, the surroundings seemed to become infinitely spacious, and the dusty and rustic bookshelves that had just gathered dust had now vanished at this moment.
You turn around and look toward the source of the sound. You hold Spamton tightly in your arms—or rather, a bit too tight. Spamton frowns, but he says nothing more, just lets you do as you please.
After all, he knows your nerves are tense right now, and he can't provoke your emotions any further.
You look pale-faced, only to find that in the very center of this darkness, for some reason, there is an altar—for some reason, everything around it appears so clear, with no light at all, and a mirror in the center is shining, silvery white, as if reflecting moonlight that doesn't exist.
Around it, something black worm-like creatures kept wriggling, looking like lumps rising and falling, with a faint smell of blood and rust. You guessed that the black marks were actually stained with dark red blood. No matter what, this suspicion made you nauseous.
No, wait, if you look closely, those lumps don't seem to rise and fall—maybe they're just stationary. After all, if you get closer, you'll realize that what you initially thought were black lumps are actually people wrapped in black robes.
They were kneeling on the ground, chanting incantations as they crowded around the altar, so excited that their robes trembled all over.
You quieted down, just holding the oil lamp. Spamton actually couldn't see anything; all he could see were shelves of bookshelf, and you walked through them without any obstacles, carrying him along. He also smelled a whiff of rust. No matter what, he felt it probably wasn't a good thing, but when he pinched your cheek, you showed no reaction. At this moment, he couldn't care about your possible vulnerability. He tried to shake your arm to wake you, but you didn't react at all. Or rather, you didn't even notice Spamton in your arms, just listened blankly.
"Ah! Ah! Shabu. Nicholas! The Black Goat of the Forest, which has nurtured millions of offspring! ”
Strange syllables are pieced together into words.
"Let all things be united as one! We call for your arrival! Supreme Mother Goddess! Goddess of Dark Abundance! O Black Goat of the Forest, who bears millions of offspring! Ah! Shabu Nicholas! ”
"Please follow the thousands of children and fill us with your seeds! Let more people come to your temple to worship!" ”
"Come on, come on! Goat! Black Goat of the Forest! Collect our offering! ”
They were speaking a language you couldn't understand at all, yet for some reason, you could hear it clearly. You shivered instinctively, and the puppet's small hand touched your arm again. Only then did you realize Spamton was still in your arms. You glanced down at him, then looked up. Everything before you vanished like smoke like a phantom, and before you was a brand-new bookshelf in front of you. All the books were brand new, with no sign of being opened.
“…… Did you see the illusion from earlier? "You asked after a moment of silence. You hadn't even realized Spamton's existence earlier, which left you feeling uneasy.
Spamton just shook his head: "Apart from the [smell of rust] and countless [bookshelf], [empty]." ”
You pause for a moment, then deflat: "Alright, then I don't even know how I ended up seeing those hallucinations...... First, hurry up and see if there's anything else worth reading in the library, then leave here." "You definitely don't want to be chased by a mad killer who might have escaped and called in a killer."
But it's fine that only you see those hallucinations, and at least you don't have to worry about covering Spamton's eyes or anything...... Alright, you're just daydreaming and talking nonsense again. Actually, none of this is really important. Maybe it's because your inspiration is a bit strong?
In short, you look up at the bookshelf in front of you. It's brand new, and for now, it's hard to tell what is special about it...... After all, all the spines are written in English, Greek, French, and German—words you can't understand at all, though these are basically Latin...... Oh, and Spanish and Russian. You don't understand anything at all, just that you know these are probably some kind of magic books. Thinking about this makes you shiver involuntarily.
You simply grab a copy and flip through it to see what is written on it. You see some messy text. Although it's in English, when put together, it gives you a feeling you can't understand.
The runes written on them seemed to be for some kind of summoning.
[Summoning Baeki's Rune]
[Rune to Summon Hasta]
[Rune to Summon Igronak]
[Rune to Summon Lilith]
[Rune to Summon Nyaratotip]
[Rune to Summon Shabu Nicholas]
[Method for Refining Shogges]
[How to Make the Crucible of the Ancient]
…… After casually flipping through the table of contents, you found almost everything was of this kind. You believe Spamton must have seen everything clearly. In any case, you couldn't help but shiver, then you looked up, planning to put the book you couldn't understand or use back onto the shelf. Then you saw an eye staring intently at you in that gap. Earlier, when you were reading, it was inconvenient to put Spamton back on your shoulder to help him read. Now you shivered, shook the book, and threw it to the floor.
You were so frightened that you took two steps back, instinctively pulled out a steel pipe and grabbed it. You had no idea what was going on. You raised the oil lamp and saw that the person had taken two steps back. It was a woman, wearing a necklace with an inverted cross on her chest, grinning mischievously. She looked rather thin and weak, lacking any intimidating presence, but you still didn't dare let your guard down.
The woman, on the other hand, was still grinning, probably looking very happy: "Ah, so you're also a follower of the Black Holy Mother, huh? I saw you take this book, and I've always wanted to witness the miracle the Black Holy Mother has descended...... But I've never succeeded once, so this time I want to summon her and give it a try. Why don't you try it too?" ”
…… It looks like he's just a cultist, and you breathe a little easier. But when you glance at Spamton, he nods gently, signaling that he's already turned on the recorder, or at least he's turned it on when you first met this woman.
You're not sure if killing these people directly counts as bringing them to justice. If it were really that simple, you might actually be tempted...... But it's better to just go through some trouble.
So you just shake your head: "Sorry, but I don't intend to ......"
But before he could finish, Spamton interrupted him. He covered your mouth and simply asked, "[Black Saint]?" ”
"Oh, that's the one, the Black Goat Mother! Look, I still have a mark." As she spoke, she proudly showed off the mark on her hand.
You squinted and took a look. The mark and palm print had almost perfectly blended together, resembling an eye but also like a mouth. Overall, it was quite strange. Although the fusion was quite good, seeing her proudly begging for praise left you speechless for a moment.
The shape and location of this imprint remind you of a female demon and a god in Greek mythology...... Lamia and the god Pan. In some legends, Lamia was cursed to devour her child, and her eyes grew in her hands. In some myths, the story of Pan having eyes in the palm and devouring a child is performed by Pan. Since Pan also has attributes of a herdsman, some scholars believe this is a variant of the ancient myth of the agricultural god eating her child.
…… After all, you've read some Greek mythology, and you remember that the god Pan was actually a variant of Shab Nicholas.
So your expression twisted for a moment.
She was still lost in her own pleasure, talking to herself: "Oh my...... It's just a pity that the other travelers don't believe in shabu, calling them atheists. It's still that the life in their own hands makes them feel even more intoxicated. What do you mean? It's just a simple punishment that makes a person suffer, to die, and then chops up their flesh and bones for cooking. How can that be called art? Oh, wait, I'm a follower of the Black Holy Mother, not the King of Yellow." As she spoke, she hurriedly covered her mouth again.
And you feel like laughing, your mood relaxing for once. To be honest, although this girl hasn't done much, she can still be considered an accomplice to those people...... Precisely because she is also a bystander, precisely because she hasn't actually done anything.
And you probably understand what Spamton means: it's basically to stabilize this girl first, then you can escape. Summoning isn't something that can be done overnight.
Although you didn't know if this was a good idea, for now, it was the only option, so you took Spamton's hand away...... In short, you nudged him twice with the hand holding the lamp, and slipped the lamp into his hand, putting the steel pipe away. Then you held him in your arms. After all, you were frightened, so you should calm yourself down properly.
You shook your head and nodded: "Mm...... Although I'm actually an atheist myself, I think I can go with you and give it a try—maybe it works?" "To be honest, you don't really think there's a chance of success."
She looked at you seriously twice, first a bit disappointed, then burst out laughing: "What...... You're also an atheist, really boring. But looking at it this way, You're actually the kind of person who is half believed, half skeptical. Such people can't be complete atheists, but they won't be theists either, because they always doubt the existence of gods. ”
You are speechless.
To be honest, before that, you always thought you were a complete materialist atheist...... But today, you suddenly became uncertain. She was right—you really are the kind of person who is half skeptical, someone who says you don't believe in God while still wanting to test yourself.
And she merely began to chant a phrase, seriously and head-shaking: "Since you are like warm water, neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out." ”
…… You know this is a phrase from the Bible. What does she mean by saying it now? Anyway, you felt as if you had fallen into an ice cave, just staring at her in silence, unable to speak.
She didn't explain this sentence, just waved her hand impatiently: "Anyway, only devout believers can participate in the summoning ceremony. Go away, go away, you completely unfaithful." What a pity...... If they were complete atheists, if they could find a few words to convince them, they might come to believe in people. People like you are the hardest to deal with. ”
After saying this, she skipped away, feeling like a bone stuck in your throat. You silently shoved the book back on the shelf, unsure what else to do.
So you have Spamton carry the lamp, while you just stand there in a daze.
It wasn't until Spamton poked your cheek that you finally snapped out of it, lowered your head to look at him, and said, "...... What's wrong? ”
…… You don't even know what happened to you. Well, maybe everything is a mess, and now, or rather, from now on, even the once firm heart is shaken at this moment.
But Spamton just looked up at you. He lifted the lamp, illuminating your face. For a moment, the light seemed a bit glaring, and you couldn't help but squint.
“…… Nothing, but Miss Y/N, you must believe in yourself." That's all he said.
You quietly lowered your head to look at him. Spamton was silent for a moment because of your gaze before continuing, "I don't think [you] have any fault. [Half-doubt] is the best [situation] in most cases. ”
You stared at him and suddenly couldn't help but laugh out loud. Your mood really improved a lot, to the point that you could even joke with him: "So, I guess I have a half-doubting attitude toward you too, right?" "If he had said something like that before, you would definitely have done it. After all, he's not someone you can trust forever, especially since he said it himself!"
But now, even if he says that, you still believe what he says. Although you were hurt by him not long ago, it was just a small matter; once it passes, it doesn't become a lasting wound for you. So you still choose to trust him, because now he is your business partner, or your friend, and ......
What else is there? You can't think of anything right away, so wait until you remember later.
Spamton was silent for a while, then nodded and shook his head: "Yes, I think [you] should [must] do this, but I don't [have hope] [you] and don't [trust]. "He felt conflicted and conflicted, and in the end just said this. He didn't know if this was good or bad. Maybe maintaining the status quo is also good.
…… But perhaps taking a step forward is just as good, even though the road ahead is unknown.
"Mm...... So what should we do...... You pretended to be troubled, stroked your chin, and then, just as you wished, saw Spamton's tight lips turning a bit nervous, and all his glasses were pixelated. "Alright, even though you said that, I'll still trust you, because we're very, very good friends...... Uh, probably best friends?" "You think about it and feel a bit uncertain.
Then you added, a bit fiercely: "I trust you so much, you can't stab me in the back, or I'll definitely hunt you down. I mean what I say!" "Although it's hard to say if you'll be able to do that by then, it doesn't stop you from making threats first."
Spamton's glasses returned to their original pinkish color. He just nodded silently, and you nodded in satisfaction. That girl had long since left, and for a while, only you two remained in the library. It looked rather eerie. You shivered and hurried back to the entrance. Now you could see that bright and warm hall again. You hung the lamp back on before walking back into the hall. There was a clock hanging above the front desk. You glanced at it—it was almost dusk.
…… If it's time for Fengmo, going out now should be pretty much the same. You hugged Spamton, pushed open the door with one hand, and walked straight out. After all, you'd probably gathered enough evidence. Luckily, you had muted your camera beforehand, so they didn't notice your little moves. You checked the camera and confirmed that you had recorded all three ruthless men upstairs, then satisfied and turned off the camera.
Then you look up. The sun is shining brightly today. At dusk, the shadow of the inn casts its shadow, enveloping you, stretching and extending until it covers the cliff and reaches the other end. Then you widen your eyes—you see, as the shadow casts, between the cliff and the other end, a black bridge actually appears. Although it sways and has an illusion, it probably exists. In any case, you carefully walked over, squatted down, and touched it with your finger to confirm that the bridge was real.
But Spamton just shook his head at you, indicating he couldn't see the bridge. Perhaps, it was someone as skeptical as you who, at this moment, believed in the existence of Fengmo Shi and saw it.
Anyway, you take a deep breath. To prevent the bridge from suddenly disappearing, you speed up desperately to the other side. Then you bend over to catch your breath, then look back at the hotel one last time. The screen flashes to remind you that the main quest is complete and you will leave the world in 24 hours.
At this point, you don't have time to fuss over anything else—luckily, you're probably in the same era, or even the same world. In any case, you don't dare to think too much about it. You just go to the nearest internet café, log into your account, have Spamton edit a stunning copy for you, and upload the evidence of your filming and recording. Click send.
If calling the police directly doesn't help, then they use public opinion. Under pressure, the police will always find a way to give the public the truth. Although you may feel a bit nervous, you're not sure if this will really work.
…… But it seems that because you sent bloody and violent content, you're now being chased by the police. Luckily, you only have 24 hours—oh, now it's 20 hours.
You and Spamton dodged, and for once, rummaged through the trash cans for some food. After all, you were basically penniless now, and you were anxiously waiting for the side quest to be completed. Although you wanted to complain about the current situation, time was tight, and you had no mood to say anything more. Spamton clearly knew this and didn't say much.
…… Finally, just one second before leaving the world, you see the progress bar for the side quest hit 100%. After that, you and Spamton lose consciousness.
