content:
You suddenly sat up from the bed, looking at the familiar desk shrouded in darkness before you, the faint light outside the window, and the tall building, and then you dumbly realized you had returned...... It was truly thrilling—in the last second of the countdown, the mission progress reached 100%. Anyway, you held the check for one hundred thousand and cheered, almost kissing you.
And Spamton, sitting next to you, silently lifts her head to look at you.
You were excited for a while before finally remembering the little puppet who played the game with you. So you looked down at him, and saw that he was sitting obediently on the bed, looking very pure and innocent. Only you knew he was not innocent at all.
In short, you just snorted coldly, then lifted him up over your arm. To you, Spamton's struggles seemed like just scratching an itch, and you tilted your head slightly, looking at him in confusion: "...... Why is it that when I encounter the demon, I can see that bridge, but you can't?" "You don't think Spamton seems like someone who doesn't believe in God at all. Otherwise, you wouldn't have been called an angel before. It's not just when you lie to gain trust during religious trials."
You noticed Spamton's eyes shifted slightly. Even though you were staring at him and couldn't see his eyes clearly through his glasses, he actually didn't want to see you. After all, you could see his pupils moving and refusing to meet your gaze...... From this perspective, he seemed a bit guilty.
"Alright, it seems you don't want to answer me...... How about we play turtle soup? I'll have a guess for you to answer." You waved your finger and said seriously.
Now Spamton's eyes turned back to look at you. You always felt he seemed a bit speechless, but in the end, he nodded and agreed to your request.
"Ahem, alright, then I'll ask first: are you an atheist?" You cleared your throat and looked carefully into Spamton's eyes, trying not to lie. Well, he really didn't show any signs of lying. After all, his eyes were staring straight at you, which made you feel a bit awkward and embarrassed, even though you didn't know why you were feeling embarrassed at this moment.
And Spamton just shook his head silently. He certainly wasn't an atheist.
You rub your chin. If he's also the kind of person who is half-doubtful, there's no way he wouldn't be able to see that bridge...... But it's possible. After all, at that time I somewhat believed what Fengmo said. Maybe Spamton didn't believe it either. Speaking of which, I really hadn't carefully observed the twilight footage; maybe Spamton happened to have seen it.
So you continue to ask: "So, are you actually the kind of person who only believes and doubts?" But you don't believe what Fengmo said? ”
Spamton stared at you blankly, and you just stared at him like that. After a while, this silent silence didn't make you feel awkward anymore—in any case, he finally spoke: "Although [you] raised [double the doubt], my [answer] is [YES]." ”
You responded with a couple of 'ohs' and instinctively apologized, then you snapped back to reality and slapped your head, regretting what you were supposed to apologize for. At the same time, you put the Spamton down and placed it back on the bed.
You weren't too sleepy anymore. Even though it was only three in the morning, you were still pretty alert, so you just looked at Spamton with curiosity: "It's nothing serious, and it's normal not to believe it, but why don't you believe that rumor is true?" ”
Honestly, you're just curious—no other reason or reason, just curiosity.
“…… This is not part of the 'choose one game' category. " he emphasized.
And you nod decisively: "Yes, I know, that's just my question...... Uh, well, actually, it seems you don't have to answer so well? Actually, it's fine not to answer those previous questions...... Uh, I'm just a bit curious about you?" "Why is it getting more and more off? You wanted to add a couple more words to steer the conversation back, but at that moment, Spamton interrupted you."
"No, we are close friends. Of course I can answer your questions." He said.
You bend down slightly, blink twice, and look at him: "Then...... Is it even a secret? ”
"...... [Confidential Incident] is not included in the scope of the answer." His voice became dry again, mixed with the crackling of electricity. To be honest, it wasn't very pleasant to hear.
But you've gotten used to this sound, and after hearing it so often, you now find it has a strange beauty.
You just shrugged: "Uh...... Alright! If it's really your personal secret, it's fine not to say it—everyone has secrets, and so do I. I just don't want you to hide things from me about things related to me. After all, we're friends, there's no need to hide anything from each other." Your voice softened. Despite ...... Alright! You think your request seems a bit much, but even though we're friends, hiding some things from each other seems normal, right? Or are you asking too much, crossing the boundaries of friendship? No...... You think you're just asking for a normal request from a friend.
Spamton nodded: "I won't [fabricate lies] about anything related to [you] anymore." ”
"So, are you willing to answer the previous question?" You nod in satisfaction, then eagerly asked the question again. In fact, you always feel this topic is a bit risky, so you want to quickly change the subject.
At this moment, Spamton nodded. This question didn't mean much to him, so of course he was happy to answer, as long as you asked.
"I've seen [Twilight Moment] countless times at [Location: Junkyard Shop]. I think maybe the shadows of those [garbage heaps] I [longed for] would take on a different form, but the [garbage heap] is just a [garbage heap]." His explanation was simple and enough to answer your question.
And you just nodded thoughtfully: "I see...... After all, you've never seen what might happen during a demon encounter, so you never believed it. And I was only half-doubtful because I basically ignored this moment...... Honestly, it was right after work—who had time to look at so many random things? "You couldn't help but complain again.
Spamton fell silent, not saying a word for a moment, and you belatedly realized that precisely because his shop had few customers, he had so much free time to observe the dusk scene, and only so many times did he gaze at the shadows of the garbage heap and fall into despair again and again.
You try to change the subject to change the subject, so you cough twice and say, "By the way, why are you staring at those garbage heaps? Gold can't come out of the trash. Uh, although some people do throw valuables in there, you should observe carefully and pick up and sell that trash to make money......"
Before you could finish, you regretted it. What exactly are you talking about? You know exactly what Spamton lived before coming to this game world with you. Aren't you just stabbing someone's wound?
But to your surprise, Spamton actually lifted his head slightly to look at you. He didn't look like he had been stabbed at all; instead, he seemed to be glaring at you, making you shiver instinctively.
Then, a second later, you realize what exactly he was saying.
He said, "[You] are no less than [inferior], after all, there is also delicious food in the [garbage heap]. ”
…… When he mentioned it, you remembered again: in the previous world, to evade the police, you went into the trash to drink leftover bottled water and eat leftover chocolate and bread.
Hmm, and expired food dumped into trash bins and such.
You cleared your throat twice: "Wasn't it all forced by circumstances! And back then, we didn't have money to buy anything...... You talk as if you've never been through a pile of garbage!" "Now you've forgotten that you seem to be poking someone's wound, since he doesn't seem to care much about it.
"...... [different concepts]." Spamton's voice was dry. He hadn't intended to win this war of words; he just said that because he noticed your mood was off. He ...... Honestly, it's not that he doesn't care at all; it's just that now, it seems there's something more worth caring about. So the past matter...... In short, it's not something to be brushed off, but he doesn't want you to be cautious just because you're afraid of hurting him—that's not the way he wants to interact.
But Spamton felt that everything had changed now; everything he used to care about and hated could be brushed off as jokes. That was all. Although he still felt some pain when recalling those times, now everything seemed to be getting better.
Your reaction is always a bit slow, taking a few seconds to react. Maybe Spamton is telling you not to worry about this.
…… For some reason, you feel quite moved, a bit baffled.
In short, you didn't say how you felt, just coughed twice and said somewhat arrogantly, "Even if the concepts are different, aren't the actions and goals the same? We're all rummaging through trash cans looking for things just to make a living! Alright, let's sleep. Otherwise, if we keep chatting like this, who knows if we'll be sitting until early morning...... You happened to be a bit sleepy too, yawned, hugged the Spamton, and rolled back onto the bed, closed your eyes, and soon heard your steady breathing.
Spamton glanced at you speechlessly. You fell asleep instantly—your sleep quality was just too good. Then he closed his eyes and buried himself in your arms, falling asleep.
You only woke up after a good night's sleep, stretched lazily, then drove Spamton away to prevent him from seeing you change clothes. When you reached the door and was about to leave, Spamton finally came out after changing clothes. You picked him up and placed him on your shoulder, then led him out together.
It was still early, and breakfast wasn't anything special. You just bought two sandwiches, stuffed one into Spamton's mouth, then bought two bottles of milk and stuffed them into Spamton's hand.
After breakfast, you go your separate ways. You still have to go to the hospital for work, while Spamton naturally goes to his shop.
To be honest, you're feeling a bit lonely here. Or rather, you're not used to the feeling of being far away from Spamton...... To be honest, you two spent the first few months together. Although you didn't seem to say much most of the time, you had long since gotten used to having someone else around you. The hospital had been pretty busy for the past half month, and because of the workload, you forgot about these things. But now that things are quiet and you have nothing to do, you naturally start overthinking.
You're still a bit frustrated—why are you suddenly thinking about Spamton now? Looks like you really need to broaden your social circle...... But before you can follow that clue and think it through, your department manager comes over.
According to him, because there have been a few applicants for nursing positions recently, the number of nurses at the hospital is somewhat exceeding the standard. Plus, since you are a citizen of the Light, they plan to implement a shift system.
It was only then that you learned from the department supervisor that you were a citizen of light, and those people found it novel, so they came to check on all kinds of illnesses, both big and small. That's why you had so much work in the past half month. And now, to be honest, there are hardly any patients left, so all the people of darkness who could apply to come to the hospital have come to see you, a citizen of light, and to say a few words to you.
Honestly, you're a bit silent. How come you don't know that someone as ordinary as you can still sweep the dark world?
But the shift system is quite comfortable. You can come back to work on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday, and have holidays for the rest of the time. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, you can still go to Spamton's store to sit for a while, and on weekends you attend classes at the adult school...... With this plan in mind, you agreed to the supervisor's request.
You always feel like the department head left excitedly, but you just stared blankly at his back.
Anyway...... After work today, you can go to Spamton's shop tomorrow to sit down...... Uh, damn, why are you still excited about something like this? You just feel something doesn't quite make sense.
You took two deep breaths, trying to calm your inexplicable excitement. When you got off work and clocked in to go home, you found Spamton already sitting on the sofa waiting for you. Waving your fingers, you grinned: "Next, I have some great news to tell you!" Do you want to guess what it is? ”
Spamton shook his head as if it were natural. Of course, he knew you couldn't hold back your words. No matter what you answered, you'd always reveal the answer yourself.
Sure enough, you put your hands on your hips and said proudly, "Anyway, the hospital changed its shift system. I'm off tomorrow—uh, so I decided to hang out at your shop." After you finished, you coughed twice, feeling something was off for some reason.
…… Well, it doesn't seem strange at all—after all, that's just how you talk! You shook your head, shaking those inexplicable thoughts away.
Spamton didn't know why you shook your head for no apparent reason, but that didn't stop him from understanding your meaning, so he just nodded to show he understood: "Alright, so tomorrow's [your] [destination] is [Navigation: Shop]?" ”
You nodded as if it were only natural, but there wasn't much time left for small talk—anyway, you quickly finished the bread you bought on the way to treat it as your dinner, then hurriedly said goodbye to Spamton and returned to the world of light to attend class.
At the same time, you cut off countless calls from your parents, canceled notifications from chat apps, and finally turned off silent on your phone.
When you get home from class, you're exhausted from the day, so you just yawn, hug Spamton, collapse onto the bed, and fall into a deep sleep.
Spamton quietly glanced at you twice, not knowing what he was thinking. In the end, he closed his eyes and drifted off to sleep.
…… You don't know if he dreamed, and you don't really care about that. You only know you dreamed again. This time, you saw the same salesman in a red suit, the one Spamton had become before he was now, and you finally understood what he was saying...... Well, actually, you heard clearly at the time, but you thought this guy was really a weirdo. You couldn't agree to his request, and you didn't even understand what he wanted—a heart-shaped object. Surely he couldn't really want your heart, right? That would be a matter of your life. Although you didn't really care about your own life, yesterday you finally managed to grab a limited edition free dessert and it was still in the fridge without eating—at least you had to finish it! And you haven't spent all your money either. Thinking about it, you even throw the rest of your money back at him, then take advantage of his distraction to return to the passage and slip back into the world of light.
In short, it's hard to say whether it's for saving your life with money or something else...... Anyway, you should remember the money he owes you. Whether he really owes you or not, it's up to you...... But since you won't go to the Dark World on your own, after a while you'll forget that this matter doesn't matter to you.
As for Spamton...... He really did have a dream. There was nothing else in the dream, just that he was still in this house, even on this bed, just you and him—there would have been only you and him, and then you carefully and respectfully held him, kissed his forehead, and then moved down, all the way to the corner of his mouth, gently kissing him—and then he woke up startled.
He looked at you frowning, feeling very uneasy even in his sleep, smoothing your forehead. You seemed to mumble something twice, but he couldn't hear clearly. You just fell asleep peacefully. He looked at your face and, without realizing it, fell asleep.
After that, he dreamed all night.
You get up refreshed again, toss Spamton to the bathroom to change as usual, then wait until you reach the door to sit on your shoulder and only go out to buy breakfast.
After buying breakfast, you found a café and sat down at a table outside, finished your freshly bought sandwiches, and finished your milk before leaving. This time, you confidently patted your chest: "Alright, I'll definitely find my way to your shop. This time, I won't need your navigation!" ”
You always feel like Spamton just smiled, but when you turn your head to look at him again, he's still wearing the same smile as usual, no difference. You can't see anything different, and in the end, you can only turn away with suspicion.
Because of last night's dream, you suddenly remembered that it wasn't just that he deceived you...... Or maybe it was because of your inexplicable thoughts—you felt he owed you something, so you really thought about clinging to him. But looking back now, that kind of thought makes you feel embarrassed...... Anyway, the money is settled, so it doesn't really matter. Besides, you're friends now, and even partners. After completing the game system tasks, you'll probably part ways...... In short, you know you're just daydreaming. You feel like you need an answer. Do you actually want the connection between you two not to be severed?
You don't know, you just feel this stretch of road is too quiet, so quiet it makes you feel a bit awkward. Although Spamton probably isn't much, you think you should find something to talk about to break the awkwardness. Otherwise, you really can't stand it.
So you cleared your throat twice and said, "Speaking of which, I noticed you weren't looking well this morning. Did you have a nightmare?" ”
Spamton remembered last night's dream and looked at you again, momentarily speechless. Of course, he couldn't just tell you directly what he had dreamed about. What if you thought his dream was disgusting...... Well, he shouldn't dwell on such questions. After all, he knew you weren't that kind of person.
But Spamton didn't want to tell you the real answer, so he just shook his head: "No, I think...... Maybe I did [dream of something], but I [have no archived memory at all]. "He lied, but he actually remembered it clearly. He had already planned not to deceive you about anything related to you...... But this is different.
But there are some things he really shouldn't keep hiding from you anymore.
You didn't doubt it, just nodded with an 'oh' and said, "Mm...... Not remembering what happened in a dream is actually quite common, and you can't even remember what you actually dreamed about...... Hmm, that's not important. Anyway, I dreamed about you last night. "You were just saying it offhand, but Spamton suddenly lowered his head, not daring to look at you anymore, because his shoulder swayed twice and the noise was quite loud. You glanced at Spamton strangely, but didn't notice anything unusual."
It was probably just adjusting your posture or something. Maybe the previous position wasn't very comfortable, so you guessed casually, not caring whether your answer was correct. You didn't really expect Spamton to answer your question.
After all, your thinking is quite scattered, and sometimes you really do have a lot of ideas.
And where you don't see it, Spamton's face is flushed—or rather, a flushed color. If you turn your head and look again, you'll definitely be surprised and panicked, wondering why the little puppet's face is so red, and there's smoke coming from its head—is it sick?
Good thing you haven't turned to look at him now, Spamton thought.
You just keep wandering, lost in thought, and instinctively follow your memory and instincts toward the junkyard until Spamton suddenly says something that pulls your thoughts back.
He said, "[I like you.] ”
You snapped back to reality, thought for a moment, and just responded with a couple of 'oh ohs': "Like me?" I like myself too...... Uh, yes, I like you too. "You might think he's just expressing feelings between friends, since even if you don't know, you occasionally pass by pairs of girls from the past, and they often say such sweet words.
So you quickly made your position clear. After all, although he lied to you before, you really do like your friend. But in Season 2, he really helped you a lot. Continuing like this isn't bad.
Spamton looked a bit helpless. Looking at your confused expression, it was obvious you didn't understand what he meant at all, so he had to repeat and emphasized the words 'like': "I mean, I [like] [you], different from [friendship], I'm talking about [romantic feelings]." ”
You blinked, your mouth agape, looking a bit dazed. To be honest, you never imagined that some things would happen like this, that some words would suddenly be spoken. The questions that had been troubling you seemed to have answers. In short...... It seemed that in that instant, the chaotic thoughts were cleared.
Then, belatedly and naturally, you blushed. You coughed awkwardly twice, turned your head slightly, trying to ease the awkwardness, or simply to look busy with something to do. In any case, you ruffled your hair with your fingers, stammering awkwardly: "Uh...... Oh! So that's what you meant...... I get it. ”
“…… Well, I guess I actually like you quite a bit...... "You hadn't even thought about what else to say next when you felt Spamton pinch your earlobe. After all, your ears are now red and burning hot.
You turned your head to look at him, a bit embarrassed and angry, and pinched his cheek hard—of course, in the end, you still held back, though you didn't really use much force.
"What are you doing! I'm just being shy, why do you have to expose me!" As you spoke, you poked his cheek, still a bit annoyed. Of course, you're just using a little excuse to vent your anger...... Uh, or is it actually being cute? You're not really sure, since you've never done that before. And actually, you don't really understand what he likes about you to bring up all these things about love and romance.
But since he said he likes you, then if you throw a little tantrum or something, he'll just accept it. You think this with a clear conscience.
Spamton just poked your cheek as well. He didn't actually say 'really', but you always felt like he said everything. Anyway, you cleared your throat twice and straightened up: "Alright...... I didn't really mean to blame you, you get it, right? "You scratched your head.
Spamton nodded. Of course he knew that if you really scolded him, you definitely wouldn't be in that tone. After all, your tone just now was actually a bit softer than usual, and ...... How should I put it, there was actually a hint of unreasonable teasing.
“…… But honestly, I think confirming the relationship between men and women isn't that important. Isn't it enough to just stay together and always be with the other person? Isn't it the same with friends? Only when the other person dies of old age does this friendship truly end...... Something like that. "You don't really think there's any difference between them.
Spamton helplessly poked your cheek again. He didn't know what to say, but you just puffed out your cheeks and looked at him: "...... I really don't understand what's the difference between this. It's just being there for the other person, being willing to think of each other's interests, hoping their life will get better going forward. Isn't that the very meaning of friendship? ”
"...... [idiot], what you said about 'dying peacefully' is 'growing old together,' and what you said about 'companionship' is 'love.'" He poked your cheek again, but this time you grabbed his hand, only poking his cheek in return.
"So what...... Friendship, family, love...... Isn't it all love? I don't see any difference between them. "You tilt your head, not understanding this.
Although you were wandering leisurely, you were still quite close to the shop entrance. From a distance, you could see some Dark People lining up at the entrance. I wonder what kind of promotion Spamton did after you left.
"...... [friendship] can't do this kind of thing, but [relationships between men and women] can." He didn't know how to explain it to you anymore, so he leaned in closer. You happened to be looking at him, so he leaned in and kissed you on the lips.
At this moment, you were still standing behind a pile of garbage, and the Dark People lining up on the street hadn't seen you. You touched your lips, eyes wide in disbelief. You felt like your heart was sick—otherwise, why was it beating so fast at this moment? You could even hear your heartbeat pounding, as if it might burst out of your chest at any moment. If he wanted that damn heart-shaped object right now, maybe you could give it to him, because you felt your heart would jump out at any moment.
…… Well, you probably already understand what the heart-shaped object he wants is.
But now, you're just pressing your chest, trying hard to calm your mood so your heart doesn't beat so fast. You just mutter, "Alright...... Then I think I understand what you really mean. But...... Why is my heart beating so fast? I feel like I'm sick? ”
You're starting to ramble a bit, then you stare intently at Spamton and suddenly realize, saying, "...... Oh. You're the cause of the illness. ”
You hear Spamton sigh helplessly, then press your head and push you forward, staring straight ahead, signaling you to hurry over.
You took a step forward, but you still heard Spamton whisper softly in your ear. You kept feeling a stream of air brushing past your ear, making it itch. Of course, your heart was itching too, and it didn't stop—instead, it beat even harder.
He said, "I'm [sick] too. I have a fever called [you]. ”
You turned your head to fan your increasingly heated ears and face, then grabbed Spamton's face and tugged hard, frowning: "How can you say something so ...... Uh, saying something cheesy? You said it gave me goosebumps, it felt strange...... "Honestly, you still weren't used to it. It took you a while to realize what he really meant."
Well, you admit your reaction is pretty slow.
“…… So, [you] don't [like]? "He just said calmly.
You stroked your chin, not knowing what to say for a moment. Say you like it, but honestly, you find it cheesy and don't like it that much. Say you don't like it...... This seems like a normal conversation between couples? Given how you are now, you should be considered a couple, right?
…… Forget it, you're still a bit out of touch. You just touch your arm and shake your head: "Mm...... It's not like you don't like me at all, I just can't get used to it. So do you think we're a couple now?" As you spoke, you stroked your chin again. You just wanted to double-check—if it wasn't, that would be a disaster.
Spamton almost rolled his eyes at you speechlessly, but in the end, he just poked your cheek. This time, he was a bit harder, making you exclaim and glare at him.
"What are you doing? Didn't you know I'm not very smart...... You can't really say that, I don't know what to say. Basically, I'm just trying to confirm!" As you spoke, you became even more confident.
"Of course, or rather, I think [you] need to [confirm the terms of caution]." He finally said that. He thought, alright, I'll tell you one more time.
You grunted and didn't react much, because by now you had already reached the shop entrance. The other Dark People started chattering noisily when they saw you, the Light Citizens. The scene became chaotic, and you were annoyed by their noise. You quickly brought Spamton inside and sat down together.
Many people came just to see the Light People, buying some small items on the spot. Once they've bought them, they leave. Most customers are quickly dealt with, and it's supposed to be a way to train your skills. Spamton sent you to greet those guests, and you're sweating profusely. I have no idea what Spamton said to those people, but before you leave, the Dark People who come to buy goods have to sign for a sign before leaving, making you look like a big star. Your hands are sore from signing, and your muscles are almost instinctively reflexive.
After finally dealing with those Dark Tribe customers, you wiped the sweat from your forehead and leaned back in your seat. Honestly, you originally wanted to relax a bit...... You still don't know how things ended up like this.
But after a brief moment of relaxation, you finally turned to look at Spamton, who happened to meet your gaze. You cleared your throat twice, feeling a bit awkward, but in the end you spoke seriously: "I...... Hmm, what I promised you, how did I say it? Pay attention to the terms, I clicked confirm...... Uh, I mean, I agreed to ...... with you." At this point, you started stammering again. That word didn't mean much to you, but for some reason, it felt so hot to your mouth that you couldn't say it for a long time.
You've never been in love before, heavens, this is the first time you've done something like this! And it's with a Dark Folk at that—that's really bold...... You don't even know what to do; maybe just being like before is enough. After all, no matter what, you'll always consider his feelings. You don't want him to get hurt.
Spamton just nodded: "Yes, I know. Right now, we're in a [relationship between men and women], or rather, during the dating period." "He didn't think much of it, just ...... At this moment, he couldn't help but think about some future matters; some things really should be put on the agenda. He definitely didn't want him to stay in the dark world, waiting for you to come back every day and catch a glimpse of him.
He hoped to return to his former status, or rather, to advance further...... Not to be weak and powerless like he is now.
Of course, he certainly wouldn't ask for your heart-shaped item again; that time he only met the only Lightborn, and he did so because he was eager to fulfill a request.
…… Unfortunately, he ultimately couldn't fulfill that request, and the call was never reached again.
Thinking of this, his attention was briefly distracted, his glasses turned into a mosaic again, while you bent down, picked up Spamton, and sat him on your lap, looking at him curiously: "How did you end up like this after you said that...... It's not like I rejected you, so why do you suddenly look so down? ”
He quickly snapped back to reality, his glasses turning yellow and pink again, but he just shook his head: "No, [this] [doesn't matter]." ”
You pursed your lips. Judging by how quickly he denied it, none of this was insignificant. But it's better to ask later, because after crossing the trash heap, you see a new customer walking over.
That person looks human, different from all the dark people, meaning it's actually a light being...... Anyway, you don't know how those dark people can tell the difference; you only know that you can only make such rough judgments.
It looked like he was the only one walking over alone. There were no other customers at the door. Just as you were about to skillfully use your previous lines to deal with the other Dark People to deal with this guest, Spamton shoved you, covering your mouth to signal you not to speak.
Then you hear Spamton's voice, crackling with electric currents and sharp laughter: "Oh, Kris!" ”
It seems Spamton wants to negotiate a deal with the Lightfolk. Although I don't know why he doesn't ask you, the Lightfolk, now is not the time to argue. It's better to ask later. So you clear your mind and start daydreaming.
The other party seemed surprised by your existence, the Citizen of Light. He seemed to ask Spamton some questions about you, but Spamton brushed them all off. As for their other conversations, you didn't pay attention to them. It was only after he left that Spamton finally relaxed and let go of your mouth. He lowered his head in confusion and looked at him: "What exactly happened just now? Why didn't you let me speak?" ”
Spamton hesitated for a moment, unsure whether he should tell you about his plan...... Is it really okay to tell you? For now, you two are quite close.
You rubbed your chin. Although Spamton remained silent, you at least understood a bit of what he meant, so you nodded thoughtfully: "...... Could this matter be related to that insignificant matter you mentioned earlier?" "You're just making wild guesses—after all, for now, these are the only things that can be connected in the short term. Whether it's intuition or something, that's what you think."
Sure enough, Spamton glanced up at you, and you stared at him intently. You wouldn't miss it. In that instant, his eyes widened, probably surprised by it.
So you just shrugged: "I'm just guessing. Of course, if you don't tell me, it's fine. After all, everyone has secrets, and this probably isn't really about me. It's okay if I don't know...... I'm just a little sad, really, just a little. After all, we're a couple now, so I have to get to know you better. Just think of it as my curiosity." As you spoke, you held up two fingers and pinched them, leaving only a small gap, saying this matter wasn't important.
…… It doesn't matter anymore, my foot. You're dying of curiosity. If he really refuses to tell you anything, not even a little, then you'll be heartbroken.
But Spamton suddenly raised his hand and wrapped his arms around your neck. He spoke with some seriousness: "This matter isn't entirely unrelated to you. If necessary, I would still [force] the [heart-shaped item]. But not yours, it was the [People of Light] from earlier. ”
Your face scrunched up. Although you don't really think much about murder, because your presence is special, having a scapegoat or something else just feels a bit off...... You struggled internally for a long time, while Spamton was watching you intently. Honestly, he was a bit nervous too. What if you thought his actions were too harsh and left in a fit of anger? But he also understood that this matter shouldn't be hidden from you, because...... Although he had been planning this for himself long ago, your appearance changed his mind, and you moved him up the plan.
…… Or rather, he selfishly moved up this plan, but after all, it wasn't entirely because of you; it was just Spamton's own wish.
In the end, you sighed. At least the worst case was that Spamton really found a scapegoat for you. You still need to think about this situation carefully. You might find it quite annoying now, but you shouldn't be angry. After all, other people's lives and futures have nothing to do with you, and you are biased. In this situation, you naturally care more about Spamton's situation.
“…… Well, fine, so can you not give up that damn heart-shaped object?" In the end, you still managed to say it with difficulty. If he really needs ...... Then just pretend you don't know he found a scapegoat!
He shook his head: "It's not a [necessity], but it's an [important guarantee]." "If only that set of armor would be enough to succeed...... Of course, things probably aren't that simple.
"Alright...... Well, but maybe I can help. Do you need my help with something? "After thinking it over, you've decided not to change Spamton's plan, but if his plan goes wrong, then everything will be ruined. You don't want this to happen yet.
“…… Perhaps, for the Queen's Mansion's Underground Abyss, can you navigate to it on foot? ”
And you blink at him, completely unfamiliar with the way, not even knowing where this so-called Queen’s mansion actually is. But after spending a long time together, you understand him a little bit, and based on his words, you can still infer a little of what he means: "Are you asking if I can go to the basement of the Queen's mansion?"
Spamton just nodded, affirming your words.
You continue to look at him blankly: "But I don’t know the way! I have no idea how to get there!"
To be honest, you really are unfamiliar with the route; the streets in the cyber city are so winding and frustrating, and you’re terrible with directions. If Spamton hadn’t guided you before, you’d probably get lost even with navigation.
Spamton stared at you for a while, then sighed helplessly: "I might [at that time] be unable to [act as] [your] [navigation system], so I will first [navigate: in the direction of the Queen’s mansion], and get [you] familiar with the [route]."
You nod: "Okay… then I’ll trouble you. Will you take me there now?"
Spamton nodded as well. You lifted him onto your shoulder, seated, and then closed the shop. Honestly, since you’ve walked around this junkyard a lot, you’re familiar with the roads here and could leave without his navigation. But for some reason, the routes Spamton was pointing out were all in obscure alleys… Your eyes were spinning, though you felt this path would be faster since you reached the destination quickly. Still, you looked at Spamton, rubbing your temples in headache: "Can we switch to the main road…? You only choose alleys, I don’t recognize any of them! How am I supposed to get there! Sounds like you want to go by yourself… If I don’t know the way, I can’t support you, right!" You spoke confidently, even putting your hands on your hips to boost your courage. You already felt as if you had accepted that you were playing a villain role, and Spamton might do something bad while you acted as his accomplice.
"…It’s not [support]." Spamton was at a loss; he just hoped you would witness it, and if possible, help out? Even if you didn’t help, it was fine. He arrogantly believed everything was perfect, and as long as the plan was followed, everything would turn out fine. He didn’t need the wish granted by the game system.
You pouted: "You’re going to steal someone else’s heart-shaped item, which is basically murder. How is that not support…"
Before you could finish speaking, both of your faces turned pale in unison. In a panic, you grabbed Spamton to your chest and ran deeper into the alley. At this point, you were actually glad the route had been through alleys.
A familiar white light flashed in front of you, and before losing consciousness, you only managed to say: "Weren’t we supposed to have a month off? It’s only been two days—"
But the game system didn’t respond to what you meant.

content:
[Main Quest: Unraveling the Reason for the Avenger's Revenge] Reward: One month of rest and life protection
[Side Quest: From the moment you enter the game, stop those who are killed by the Avengers] Reward: 100,000 gold + 100,000 Dark Coins
You sat on the ground, still shaken with your Spamton, hugging you. Honestly, you might even be a bit confused about what was happening...... The promised one-month rest was so special that you were suddenly forced back into the game world the next day. And for some reason, the game screen in front of you was damaged, and faintly emitted a strange crackling electric current, giving you a sense of unease and chills, making you shiver instinctively.
Spamton murmurs in your arms, "It seems ...... the Heavenly Wishing Machine might be completely destroyed after we achieve all our objectives." "For some reason, he also felt uneasy, but what followed was more trembling and excitement. Perhaps, at least if he couldn't achieve that ultimate goal, then the game system would help him achieve it." Although it didn't seem like anything good...... Maybe.
You looked down at Spamton in surprise. Muttering, "You actually call it the Heavenly Wishing Machine...... That doesn't sound like a good name. I just call it the Game System." "Although we previously communicated via text messages on the screen saying that after completing all tasks, it would grant you a wish, you didn't fully believe it. Compared to so-called vague wishes, you still trusted your own power and your choice to move forward. Maybe you could change something, maybe make a difference."
But it seems Spamton believes more than half of it; otherwise, why would it be called the Heavenly Wishing Machine?
But now, you don't have time to study this, because side quests track progress as soon as you enter the game. This time, the side quest is the opposite—the progress bar is actually 100%. In just the time you say a few words, it has already reached 90%. You quickly looked up to take in your surroundings. You didn't realize until you looked, and when you looked, you were shocked. You were both in a desolate wilderness, seemingly in a small grove. After all, the environment was dim, and you could faintly hear the rustling of leaves—the rustling of leaves in the wind. Not far ahead, there was a faint light, shining straight on a tree ahead. That was probably a headlight. You also saw a car parked there, with 'Taxi' written on it—it was a taxi. You were about to stand up and walk straight ahead, since the taxi was parked here with its lights on, and you couldn't tell if someone was inside. But the sound that followed made you stop in your tracks.
It was the man's screams and gasps, the woman's sobs and sharp screams, and her helpless cries for help, faintly mixed with a hint of desecration. You didn't even need to walk over to know what was happening. You couldn't help but feel a bit nauseous. Then, instinctively, you covered Spamton's eyes, only quickening your pace toward the spot. Those small hands belonging to puppets also covered your eyes. You wanted to sigh helplessly, but then you heard the woman's increasingly painful and weak moans. Your face grew even paler, just hoping you could run a little faster—fast enough to prevent that tragic scene from happening.
…… But the distance was too far. You couldn't change anything. When you finally reached a place where you could see the scene clearly, the puppet's small hand instinctively lowered itself. You stared blankly at the man's hand gripping the woman's neck, his face twisted with excitement and twisted expression, making your heart tremble uncontrollably. The woman just weakly tilted her head to the side, clearly dead. Her lower skirt was torn to shreds, and you could vaguely see the liquid flowing from below. The man only pulled up his pants, finally showing a look of relief, and spat at the woman's corpse with a look of disgust. Under the glaring white light of the car headlights, you could barely see that the man's arms were covered in scratches left by the girl's nails, some too deep, tearing the skin and still bleeding.
You feel guilty for failing to save the girl, and at the same time, you think she's done too well. Somehow, you actually see what seems to be white smoke...... Or a cyan light—in short, that bluish-white, semi-transparent soul drifting out from the woman's body. Her face still shows confusion, mixed with instinctive pain and hatred. As the taxi driver ahead is about to leave, she instinctively stretches out her claws, trying to attack the man. But the ghost only pierces through his body and doesn't harm him at all. Perhaps sensing the ghost's chill, the driver instinctively shivered.
You poked Spamton's cheek in your arms and whispered, "Did you see any ghosts?" ”
Spamton just shook his head, you know, he didn't see anything.
Alright, looks like only you can see this ghost...... So this side quest depends on you to complete, but you think this revenge is fair and just, and there's nothing to stop — well, but a vigilante justice can't completely make her feel pain, so it's better to stop her actions. Although you don't care whether the other person lives or dies, you still feel that the other person should fully realize their mistakes before voluntarily choosing punishment. That is true repentance and true revenge.
Just as you were lost in thought about these questions, you noticed the pale ghost floating in front of you, as if it noticed you could see her. She pleaded with her hands clasped together, making a prayerful gesture. You felt a bit troubled, but you understood what she meant—she hoped you could help her get revenge on the taxi driver.
Then, unexpectedly, the woman spoke. Her voice was cold and carried the hoarseness left after a long scream: "...... If possible, I hope I can kill him right here." ”
You were a bit stunned when you heard her voice, then started to struggle. Honestly, if it were just a simple report and the other party would accept punishment, it wouldn't matter, but...... You want to kill the other party? You don't want your hands stained with blood yet.
Spamton watched you standing there in a daze, looking ahead as if you were reacting something, and anxiously poked your cheek. Because the ghost you mentioned earlier was afraid you might be trapped in some illusion and unable to escape, and besides that, he couldn't help much.
You finally snap back to reality, shake your head at her, and try to say something else, but the woman seems to have lost her senses, and the anger and dissatisfaction on her face become even more obvious. She actually charges straight at you—then you widen your eyes because you realize your perspective is actually overhead. You can see your body casually tossing the spamton from your arms and picking up an iron pipe that had fallen from the ground—probably what used to be some kind of junkyard. "I just hope [you] pay attention to [your physical safety], and also don't [ignore] me." Spamton sighed. Actually, it didn't matter if he ignored it; he was already used to it. He was just ...... maybe a bit unwilling, nothing more.
You propped your chin up and looked at him, nodding thoughtfully: "...... I understand, I understand. If you need to, I'll do this. Besides, I haven't ignored you. I called you to run with me. Hmm, or are you afraid that one day I'll even forget you? Then you're overthinking it. No matter what, I will never ignore you. After all, you are very important to me. "As you spoke, you thoughtfully stroked your chin. Honestly, you always felt this line was a bit strange, but you couldn't quite put your finger on it. After all, this is what you truly want. Maybe one day things will change, but at least not for now."
"I can't promise I'll always be like this, but if one day I want to completely ignore you and stop caring, I'll tell you." In the end, you could only make such a promise. After all, the word 'forever' is too heavy, and you wouldn't dare say it out loud. You're afraid you won't be able to do it.
And Spamton seemed to only need your words. He looked into your eyes and simply nodded: "Then, I won't be on the day my application is approved." ”
"Who knows what the future holds? Just keep your feet on the ground and move forward...... Alright, I roughly understand what you're afraid of. I just promise what I said above; I won't promise you anything else." You randomly ruffled Spamton's hair, tapped her legs again, and stood up.
Then you notice the ghost watching you quietly, its expression unreadable. You don't know how long it has been watching you. Anyway, you instinctively touch the goosebumps on your skin, feeling a chill down your spine. You ask, "What's wrong with you?" Besides kicking those two people into the lake, is there anything else? ”
“…… Hmm, I just remembered the past—my boyfriend—no, now he should be considered that scumbag. He once swore eternal vows to me, vowing to love only me, to always protect me, never let pain come to me. But privately, I found out he was actually that kind of person...... Seeing you like this, I can't help but feel a bit conflicted. "From the moment she brought it up until now, she hadn't been in much of a good mood. She realized maybe she was mistaken. Feeling inexplicably angry is part of love, and inexplicably feeling uneasy seems to be a manifestation of love. But when she used to feel uneasy about this relationship, that scumbag would just brush her off with a perfunctory "be good" and ignore her.
You were stunned for a moment, then shrugged helplessly: "Such an oath, which sounds impossible at first glance, shouldn't have been believed from the start. He deceived you, so you should feel angry. He betrayed you, so retaliating is the right move." ”
“…… I don't know, but feeling angry and uneasy, feeling anxious and insecure—is that a problem with my personality? "She nodded, but immediately asked you this question. She didn't seem to want a definite answer, maybe just hoping for affirmation.
You picked up Spamton, wiped the water off him with dry clothes, and although you didn't look at her, you still answered seriously, "This isn't your problem. It's that you two aren't compatible, or he doesn't give you enough security." ”
Although he couldn't hear the ghost's words, Spamton could still hear you. He looked up at your face, and you were watching him, intently wiping the raindrops off his body.
He hesitantly asked, "...... Have I given you enough 'security'? ”
You blinked, not quite understanding why he suddenly asked this question, but still answered honestly: "I can give myself enough security—ah, you said, of course, after all, I trust you. So don't lie to me like last time." You puffed up your cheeks as you spoke, still holding a grudge over what happened before.
Spamton didn't respond to your question, because the rain gradually stopped, the clouds in the sky slowly dispersed, and even a rainbow appeared in the drifting rain. After all, sunlight had appeared, and the brilliant light illuminated this gray area. Perhaps it should now be called a sun rain. Against the backdrop of fine raindrops, a rainbow appeared on the horizon from the mix of light and rain, like a long corridor. Although the ghost didn't react to the glaring light, she still closed her eyes as if uncomfortable, just two beats slower than a normal person. You squinted, casually covering Spamton's eyes, since the sun would just shine under the eaves of your area, and the light was indeed very glaring.
Spamton didn't reach out to push your hand away. After all, although he felt dull now, he could still feel the slight heat, even scorching sensation of the light on his body, making him shrink back and move closer to your arms.
You pause for a moment, realizing Spamton probably dislikes light a bit, so the jacket comes in handy. You had just used the still dry spot to wipe Spamton's water, but now it was covering his head, almost like an umbrella. So Spamton finally didn't react as harshly, but you happened to let go. At that moment, Spamton looked at you, and you felt his gaze was a bit complicated. Unfortunately, before you could figure out what that look meant, you saw Spamton's glasses had turned into two mosaic pieces again. You couldn't tell if he was deliberately hiding it from you or if he was genuinely upset.
You didn't have time to identify these things, because the ghost was excited beside you but lowered its voice and said, "Those dog guys finally got out!" I knew it, when the rain clears up, they'll definitely come out. Hurry up and kick them twice! ”
You feel a bit helpless: "It's sunny now, and there's not much wind. Even though they're by the lake, kicking them down might not necessarily make them catch a cold......"
But just as he finished speaking, the wind that had just blown raindrops swirling picked up again, and the leaves rustled. You shut your mouth, and there really was nothing more to say. So you quickly walked around and quietly walked behind the two men, then took a deep breath and kicked their butts hard—probably in the middle of the lake. Thinking this, you grabbed Spamton and hurried into the forest.
The two dogs didn't even know who had kicked them off. They didn't even hear a sound, grumbled and flailed in the middle of the lake for a long time before finally climbing ashore. Maybe the weather wasn't on their side, or maybe the heavens were unhappy with them. The sparse raindrops just moments ago started to intensify, the rain grew heavier, and the sun was once again blocked by dark clouds. Accompanied by the wind, the rain struck them, a lightning bolt that shook their hearts as they streaked by, followed by rumbling thunder. You watched the two of them cursing and trembling as they ran into the villa, then glanced at the curious ghost beside them, and couldn't help but laugh along with her.
And as you start laughing, Spamton laughs too.
You stopped your voice, just looked at Spamton with a somewhat strange expression, while the ghost silently stared at him. Even though Spamton couldn't see it, he couldn't help but feel a chill down his spine, shivering, and asked, "...... What's wrong? ”
You silently looked at him for a while, hesitated for a moment, but finally decided to tell the truth. Then you cleared your throat: "It's nothing, just that your smile sounded a bit harsh." ”
Now it was Spamton's turn to fall silent. You two stared at each other for a while, and finally the ghost next to you couldn't take it anymore: "Alright, stop staring at each other. Besides, you're way too blunt!" ”
You blinked innocently at her: "Have I always spoken so bluntly?" ”
The ghost was out of options, just raised both hands in a surrender gesture: "I spoke out of turn. I didn't expect you to be like this......" Her expression was somewhat complicated.
And you just shrugged, looking at the main quest on the slightly broken and crackling light screen that appeared, saying the main quest was 75% complete. You don't know why it's not 100%—while the side quest was 66.7%, which looks like two-thirds of the way. So, you're still missing one last piece of the puzzle...... Probably.
"Alright, anyway, this is basically the end of the revenge. So, where are you going next?" You cleared your throat and decided to change the subject directly.
“…… Just pick any internet café and you'll be fine. I think you can find out what happens next online directly...... And as long as you use the internet, you can get your revenge. ”
Her tone became a bit light, as if she still couldn't believe she had come this far.
At this moment, you were standing under a large tree with lush branches and leaves. The rain hadn't really wet you much. You looked up and said, "Then let's wait for the rain to clear up, then go downstairs to find an internet café." ”
When the rain finally stopped, the sky was still gloomy. Before leaving, you returned to the villa to take a look. Both of you were collapsed on the sofa, their faces flushed, looking like they had a fever. No matter how good their health was, after what happened just now, it was hard not to get sick. Not only that, they also showed panicked expressions and started arguing. You nodded in satisfaction before following a smooth mountain path down the mountain. To be honest, the mountain road leading directly to this villa was indeed gentle and smooth enough. Before long, you reached the foot of the mountain.
It seems to be in the suburbs, far from the nearest town. Although it's still close from the mountain, you have no choice but to find a nearby tricycle carrying goods to give you a ride. That tricycle happens to be heading into the city.
As soon as you enter the city, you get off the bus. It's easy to find an internet cafe. This time, you also found one that was completely free to access an hour ago—otherwise, you wouldn't be able to get in because you didn't have money at other cafes.
You grabbed the Spamton, rushed into an empty corner, and turned on a computer. The ghost had already told you what her name was, telling you to just search for her name. So you turned on the computer, opened the browser, and entered her name. You fell into a daze for a second.
Searching her name brings up news. If you casually scroll a few times with your mouse, the top headlines all have the same meaning.
[Online rumors claim that xx company’s CEOxxx had sexual relations with his own daughter xxx, suspected of incest and breaking the law]
[xx Company Stock Plunges Sharply Due to Scandal Between CEO and His Daughter]
[CEOxxx and his daughter xxx publicly denied the rumors]
You don't even need to click in to see what the content is; just by seeing the headline, you can roughly understand what is going on. You casually search for the company's name...... It really is just as you thought—it's considered a top-tier company in this country. Moreover, although you haven't looked it up, this is from the same company as the ubiquitous ads in the world of light where you are. Even when you log into other social media accounts, you use your account password.
At this moment, you have to admit that this world is indeed connected to the real world of light, and you don't know what kind of impact it will have after you do these things.
You just look at the silent ghost floating nearby and softly ask, "So, is the incest really true?" ”
You can hardly believe that such a disgraceful thing could happen to such a young girl. Of course, if it weren't for the game's interference, you probably would never have known about it. At this moment, you feel complicated about the system that forces you to participate in the game.
…… Well, looking at it this way, maybe the so-called horror game is just an excuse for you to save the world? If that's the case, how should we explain the zombie world?
But that's not something you need to worry about right now, because the ghost nodded gently and gave you an answer: "Yes, you're right. When I was 14, my father had sex with me, and it was my own involuntary behavior." Her tone was calm, but her clenched fists and slightly trembling voice proved she was far from as calm as she appeared. She was expressionless, but just stared intently at the search results, because you had just casually searched for her father's name.
“…… Everything was glamorous. Her father flatly denied what had happened that night, saying he had only lost consciousness after drinking. But I knew he was sober, and if he really was drunk, that thing wouldn't have ......." She took a deep breath, as if trying to vent her anger, but in the end, she just let go of exhaustion, looking as if she had lost the strength to resist. But you know, maybe this was just a sign of an outbreak.
“…… As for me, at 14, I didn't have the strength to resist all this, so I had to attend the press conference with him and deny the truth of the matter. After that, I found my current boyfriend. You could say he's just a scumbag. He kept promising to do so, and I thought he would help me forget the hurt I'd suffered before and start a new life. But later, I overheard him and a friend on the phone. It turned out he was just tempted by my identity and money, and I saw him have sex with his friend. "Her voice was still so calm, and you just stared blankly at her, not knowing how to react. Maybe quietly listening was actually the better choice. In a moment of distraction, you pinch Spamton's cheek, and he only pokes your cheek in displeasure, snapping you out of it and listening more carefully to what the ghost says next.
"That taxi driver...... What I know is that my father wanted someone to get rid of me, so he found someone and ordered him to kill me, promising to pay him a hush money. Coincidentally, that day I asked to go out to find my boyfriend, so the taxi driver stepped in. And the reason he wanted to kill me was probably because ...... I was no longer a useful pawn in my father's eyes. He wanted me to marry into a marriage alliance, but I resisted his arrangement. "Finally, her body began to tremble...... Then she crouched down. Perhaps after recounting the whole process, she finally lost all strength and no longer had the strength to keep going. Do ghosts cry too? You don't know about this, and you don't know how to comfort her, so you just stay silent, looking down at her, listening to the ghost's faint sobbing.
But Spamton, on the other hand, broke free from your embrace and climbed onto the computer desk. You widened your eyes, trying to stop him, but saw that he had downloaded the pages you had just browsed, looked through them carefully several times, and then highlighted some of the keywords in red. Somehow, he was actually quite skilled at this aspect. You blinked in astonishment as you looked at his screenshots—those seemed to be the parts of the reports that felt out of place and conflict. Then he logged onto your social media, edited the copy, and sent it out.
Fortunately, his copy didn't have those strange boxes or embedded text, so you breathed a sigh of relief, but still decided to seriously ask the ghost: "...... So, you've completely given up on taking my body to kill him?" "After all, she didn't kill that boyfriend either, and you think she's actually pretty easy to talk to."
But unexpectedly, she lifted her head and gave you a twisted, sinister smile that made you shiver: "No...... He is the source of all wrongdoing. If I want to kill him, of course I will kill him!" She seemed to have lost her mind again, and you widened your eyes, trying hard to concentrate, but the ghost's will at this moment was incredibly fierce. She lunged straight at you, then entered your body.
Once again, you floated in the air, anxiously watching your body stagger out of the internet café, then walk toward the street, picking up a discarded water pipe.
Only then did you notice that today was the time to deliver the election speech, meaning people would visit every street and alley. Her father planned to enter politics and advance his career, so naturally he would attend the speech today. Right now, just as he was about to pass by.
The ghost occupying your body remains silent, just hides behind a corner, raises the hose, and waits for the right moment.
You are anxious, but even when you reach out, you can only pierce your own body, unable to return. From the moment you suddenly get up and leave your seat and leave the internet café, Spamton realizes something is wrong. He knows your body is probably possessed by that so-called ghost once again. And this time, he must do more to take your body back; perhaps things are not as simple as last time.
He rushed out and stood next to you. "You" looked down at Spamton, but this time didn't react much—just pursed his lips and gave him a gentle kick, signaling him not to get in his way.
Spamton saw that the election speech line was about to arrive. He had just noticed when downloading those pages that the ghost's father would participate in the parliamentary election and deliver a speech tonight.
Seeing that the group was about to reach this street, "your" breathing grew excited. Clearly, everything seemed to be becoming unstoppable. Spamton's mind began to spin urgently, but he didn't have any other tools to help you regain your body and regain control. Maybe...... Only the election team was going to make a move? But in such a short time, maybe he didn't have time to do anything else.
Finally, his gaze swept over the trash bins in the alley—not just one, but several. He took a deep breath and ran over, pushing down the first bin, then the second, then the third......
After finishing all this, his clothes became a bit dirty and picked up the rotten smell from the garbage heap. But Spamton just crawled out of the pile and carefully returned to your side, while "you," standing at the alley entrance, pinched your nose in frustration. He knew that since the ghost was more or less a young lady, it would definitely find the smell of trash hard to bear. Either way, it had a mental shocking effect.
Coincidentally, the sanitation workers responsible for cleaning up the garbage did not come over, but the election team was walking over...... And getting closer and closer. The spamton climbed onto "you" at the same time. No matter what, the smell of rotting garbage rushed straight into "yours." "You" almost vomited outright, but as the election team approached, "you" gritted her teeth and tried to swing the hose, too late to care about the spamton hanging on her body. It wasn't until he crawled to "yours" chest that "you" could clearly smell a stench that somehow had stuck to his hair. Unable to help but retch twice, just as she was about to swing the hose, you took a deep breath and burrowed into your body. At that moment, her mind was completely shaken, and she regained control of her body.
Before that, you had also tried countless times, but each time you just passed straight through her body. It seemed that her will for revenge was far firmer than you had imagined, and the power of her hatred made you fearful. Then you hugged Spamton tightly as he climbed onto your chest, threw the water pipe forward, pretending it was just an accident, and ran with Spamton into the depths of the alley. Coincidentally, a sanitation worker came by at that moment, so the water pipe you had thrown was only blamed by the enraged candidate for the sanitation worker’s fault, and he could only bow humbly and apologize.
Although you felt a little sorry for the sanitation worker… you could only apologize quietly in your heart, while the ghost you had squeezed out of your body angrily accused you: “Why are you stopping me from taking revenge? As long as that person dies, everything will end!”
“…No, [wrong measure] will cause [you] [to be trapped].” Spamton, however, just looked at you seriously. You knew this sentence was meant for you to hear, and also for her.
She was stunned and didn’t know what to say for a moment. Perhaps some rationality had finally returned. After a while, she solemnly bowed to you and apologized: “I’m sorry, I… in my sudden rage, I didn’t think about your future…”
You were taken aback but just soothingly patted Spamton’s head. Although he was a little dirty, you didn’t mind. After all, you were used to the smell of trash—his shop was right next to a garbage dump, and you didn’t understand why some of the Darklings insisted on coming over despite holding their noses.
Then you shook your head: “It’s okay, nothing has really happened yet, so I won’t blame you… Also, Spamton, you’re amazing, you saved me again.” Saying this, you lifted Spamton up and spun him around twice. He seemed embarrassed and coughed loudly, then spoke with a slight hint of annoyance: “[Place: Ground Coordinates]!”
So you set him back on the ground. Spamton glared at you angrily, didn’t say much, but began to explain: “[The lone wandering ghost’s] [biological mother] died because of [the biological father]. [The lone wandering ghost] is not the [CEO’s] [biological child], so the [CEO] decided to kill the [non-biological child], and his additional [biological children] were obtained through [extra sexual relationships].”
You didn’t know how he got so much information from those reports. Maybe he was good at picking up clues. In any case, after he finished speaking, he looked ahead following your gaze—in other words, he was also looking at the ghost.
She was stunned for a moment, then showed a bitter smile and lowered her head. She knew the truth, and perhaps she felt a sense of relief. Her body actually began to dissipate. Yet she still spoke without expression: “Thank you for letting me know the truth… but he must pay the price.”
Alright, twenty-four hours had just passed. Perhaps this was also just the limited time she could stay. You looked at the broken light screen, which showed both the main and side quests had reached 100%, about to exit the game world. You looked at Spamton, and he nodded to signal that he had taken care of everything. You nodded back, trusting that he could definitely handle it—probably by releasing the truth just now.
Then you looked at the somewhat cracked, fizzing game system light screen, deciding to make a deal with it.
You cleared your throat and said before leaving this world: “You glitching out stole a month of our vacation, so I think I should ask for some compensation… in my opinion, just make the information Spamton just sent become a trending topic on social media, and it can’t be undone no matter what.”
The system didn’t respond, just fizzed twice. The light screen seemed brighter, and your intuition told you that everything had succeeded. So you closed your eyes calmly, waiting for the burst of light to come and take you away from this world.
