content:
You let out a long breath and sat up abruptly in bed. After all, you barely realized what had happened...... However, it was still a familiar rental apartment, so it looked like you had returned to your original residence after finishing a game.
You even glanced at the time on your phone you bought in the Dark World, and it didn't change—it seemed like only a second had passed before you disappeared. So you can be sure that the time in this game is completely virtual and won't affect the real world.
But your shoulders did feel lighter. Instinctively, you looked to the side and saw Spamton, who was also sitting up. Hmm, sure enough, your status refreshes after leaving the game. You just miss the axe you used to handle in just a few hours.
But this time the reward was a lot, so you checked it out and found your portion was paid to you by check. As for Spamton's part, you don't know and have no interest in inquiring. You're just excited that you can finally do what you want.
It just so happened that it was time to get up and head out, so you stood up, grabbed your clothes, and headed to the bathroom, planning to handle everything quickly. As your voice inevitably carried a cheerful tone, you said, "...... I'm going out today, so I'll be leaving soon! You don't have to wait for me! ”
Spamton wanted to ask where you were going, but just as he saw you come out and was about to speak, he saw you hurrying toward the front door and then opening it to leave.
So he only had time to speed up his speech and say, "Goodbye, belatedly. Also, when will the return operation begin?" You paused as you walked out, hesitating for a few seconds, realizing he was asking roughly when you would return.
So you thought for a moment and gave a rough answer, just shrugged: "Uh...... Around the afternoon? Don't worry, I'll definitely be back anyway. I won't waste the house I spent half the money I spent on renting it." At this point, you gritted your teeth again, feeling like your heart was bleeding.
If you hadn't asked for the exact requirements back then, you wouldn't have paid so much...... In short, it's all Spamton's fault. You thought this with a clear conscience, closed the door, and headed toward the place where you traversed the world of light and darkness—the very direction you came from.
You were in a good mood, even humming an off-key tune. You were thinking about what to do after submitting the money with a check. First, signing up for the exam. There was still a month before the exam, which happened to be the time set by the game system, so you should be able to leave after the exam. As for the actual result, it would probably be revealed soon after the exam.
You pushed open the door and stood again on the streets of the Light World. At first, you felt a bit dazed—after all, it had been over a week since you last saw this world. And the next second, the noisy ringtone of your phone, belonging to the Light World, began. Impatiently, you picked up your phone and glanced at it. Sure enough, it was a familiar number—it was your own parents. After hesitating for a moment, you chose to put it on silent. After all, hanging up directly would be even more troublesome. You didn't want your parents to come here only to find you gone, and then cry and pretend to be pitiful, to report to the police or the news station. You just felt that those fake feelings and insincerity were unbearably disgusting.
After all, you will never forget the harm they caused you.
After putting your phone on silent, you glanced at the missed call record and smiled with relief. No one else has ever called you; only your parents kept calling you. You just know it's just because your ATM suddenly ignored them and you got nervous. Messages kept popping up from the pop-up at the top. You glanced at the message—at first it was just a greeting, then indirectly asked when you'd send money this month. Later, it bluntly questioned why you didn't answer their calls, saying you were not filial at all and that you should obediently give them the money. Recently, you've been cursing them, saying you're really getting bold and itching to behave, and if you don't behave, you'll get a good scolding......
That's probably it. You quickly scrolled through the messages with a blank expression, turned off your phone, which was still vibrating, and followed the path from memory to the adult self-study exam registration point. To be honest, you've long remembered the roads here. You've long wanted to finish reading the books you never finished. After all, you can't stay in the same place forever, but...... Your work is too hard and exhausting, and you've never had time to settle down and study. At the same time, you don't have enough money to support yourself with exam registration and study.
So now, timidly, you sat down, filled out the registration form, paid the tuition, and prepared to wait for the exam after some time—you eagerly looked forward to that day. After leaving the registration point, you first went to the bank to exchange the check. Because the amount was large, the bank clerk gave you a strange look but said nothing. It was just extra. You opened a bank card to deposit the remaining money, keeping some as cash.
Afterwards, you also go to a nearby bookstore to buy lots of study materials and exercises, planning to pick up the knowledge you've lost, and you think you should go further.
Maybe part of what you're thinking is actually going against your parents, wanting to prove yourself to them, to show them you're not useless, and to prove that you can do the same. And you clearly know what you can do.
After buying all these materials, it was almost noon. You deliberately picked a restaurant that looked pretty good, had a hearty meal, and then left slowly with those books in your arms. Your phone was vibrating again, but you didn't pay any attention, just hummed an off-key tune as you walked toward the entrance to the dark world.
You know...... Now it's time for you to go home. Oh, or as Spamton put it, a return voyage is fine too. Actually, you don't care how you describe it, but when you mention the word 'home,' you can't help but feel a warmth in your heart. Because you know, at least, that's probably how it is—someone else is waiting for you to go back—that kind of place should be called home.
So you are willing to call this brief residence home, even though it wasn't something you wanted at first, despite the deception and exchange of possibilities, even though you are merely partners living under the same roof, you clearly understand that he must be waiting for you no matter what.
So, belatedly, you start to look forward to the scene of going back. Your mood is no longer as irritable as when you first received so many calls, but instead a hint of joy, your steps become lighter, and you speed up.
Think about it, maybe you see him as a trustworthy partner under the same roof.
So you hold the pile of study materials and stand at the doorway again. You take a deep breath and push the door open.
Turning your head to avoid the tall study materials, you see Spamton climbing onto the sofa waiting for you without you noticing.
——
Actually, after you left in the morning, Spamton was unusually a bit lost. Sure, the fridge at home still had sandwiches and other things, so just a simple breakfast was fine. But your sudden departure left him a bit confused. Of course, he quickly settled on his goal.
So after finishing breakfast, he went out and took a detour to his little shop. It wasn't very far; he had paid special attention to this when choosing a location. But it seemed like he didn't care much, and in fact, he paid the rent somewhat foolishly, which was both amusing and exasperating.
He sat in his small shop. Now he didn't need to rummage through the trash bins, so apart from sitting here, he actually had nothing to do. Besides, hardly anyone came to the dump, or rather, no one. In fact, you were his first customer here—though you weren't here to buy anything, you were here to ask him for money.
But Spamton didn't sit here just for money; he wanted more, something more noble. Perhaps he still missed his former status and wealth, but there's nothing wrong with missing the past.
In short, no customers showed up. But Spamton was worried about what you mentioned about coming back in the afternoon, so in the end, he just closed the shop at noon and then returned home.
To be honest, he actually doesn't think there's any reason to wait for you. After all, you two are just business partners who met in the gaming world. In real life, aside from sharing a shared apartment, there's no other social interaction. But for some unknown reason, he still sits on the sofa waiting for you to return, just like when he tricked you into renting the apartment with him earlier.
That kind of unknown plot...... Maybe it's just because, in some way, you really do count as the number one customer of that shop in the junkyard.
Moreover, he always believed that with you, he could uncover more secrets, and that he could go to the world of light, or even go a step further.
Become a bigger, big-minded figure who can oversee everything.
So now, hearing the sound of the door opening, Spamton instinctively looked up and saw you—no, or rather, your figure hidden by those documents.
You chuckled awkwardly twice: "Ah...... I seem to have bought too many materials. I'll pile them all in your room later. You probably don't mind, since you're still lying on my bed sleeping...... Ah, I don't need your help, I can move over by myself! That's still a breeze. "As you spoke, you held the pile of books and headed toward Spamton's room, muttering a few words to him. Even if you accept that this place is home for a while, you won't forget the fact that he's taken up a part of your bed!
As for the last sentence, you hurriedly said it when you saw the little puppet suddenly jump off the sofa and walk toward you. You don't want these materials to crush him instantly.
…… Although that scene would probably be quite interesting, you even imagined it for a moment, and couldn't help but blurt out, "Honestly, I feel like just giving you a few books would make you collapse...... You can't really help me with that, can you?" "And you wouldn't even feel tired if you put another Spamton on your shoulder. Of course, you still didn't say that out loud."
You just walk over, put the study materials on the empty wooden bed, and stretch lazily.
You hear Spamton's voice coming from behind: "I don't think a few [books] could cause my [collapse]." You turn around, lower your head to meet Spamton's gaze, then raise your eyebrows, showing some interest in his words.
So you specially picked out three or five heavier books, crouched down, and handed them to Spamton: "Then why don't you try?" If you can carry these books, then I'll lose. ”
"[The Price of Victory or Defeat]?" Spamton was also somewhat interested in your proposal, so he asked.
You gasped, suddenly not knowing what to say. Honestly, a spur-of-the-moment gamble was just a passing whim; of course, you hadn't decided what to wager with.
So you and Spamton stared at each other for a while, then sighed softly: "I don't know...... I never even thought about what the bet should be. I was going to say that if I lost, you could just make a request, but I kept feeling you'd use the bet to trick me...... Spamton doesn't have much reputation with you.
Uh, even though you still trust him in some things, you inexplicably become cautious about this one, because you always have a bad feeling.
"As long as [you] think [it's inappropriate], you can end the [fulfillment] of the [bet]." he said.
Actually, Spamton wasn't sure what he'd do if he got a blank bet; he just felt he desperately needed it—or maybe a leverage, or maybe he needed you to feel indebted to him in some way. That way, you wouldn't forget about this little salesman who was once glorious in the underworld but is now down and out.
You were silent for a moment, making sure Spamton was serious, then reluctantly nodded: "Alright, it's settled then. If I lose, you can make any demand...... Of course, whether I do it as you say is up to me. ”
Even though you guess he'll definitely win the bet when he emphasizes the price, and even feel a bit regretful, since he's already said it, you're curious about what he'll actually ask—your damn curiosity.
So in the end, you agreed to his request.
"Alright, then let's give it a try." You shrugged and placed the book on his open hand—though he staggered a little, he didn't fall, just hugged the stack of books and shook for a while before steadying himself. You couldn't see his expression, but you knew it would probably sound like he had succeeded—though you had just guessed he would win.
So now, your mood actually started to flare up a bit. You grabbed those books, a bit angry, and said with a frustration and dissatisfaction you didn't even know what it was: "Alright, alright. I know you won." ”
But this anger came and went quickly; you quickly calmed it down, and at that moment, you even felt a bit embarrassed by your earlier outburst. After putting the book back, you turned around and squatted down to solemnly apologize to Spamton.
"Uh...... Sorry, I suddenly felt like losing my temper just now, and my tone probably wasn't very pleasant. "You scratched your head, gave an awkward laugh twice, and finally tilted your head.
Spamton glanced at you in surprise. In fact, he didn't think anything about this at all...... Or rather. He didn't think you did anything wrong. He'd heard plenty of words filled with disgust or resentment lately, and all he could do was grit his teeth, thinking that one day everyone would apologize to him, and that one day he'd have to trample those who mocked him underfoot—though he didn't think what had just been said at all, he hadn't expected to receive his first sincere apology since becoming like this.
So he looked up and met your gaze: "I [don't need] a sincere apology in return." More than that, I'm somewhat curious about the [reason for apology]. "So at this moment, Spamton was curious why you apologized at this moment.
You let out a long breath: "Mm...... It seems you don't mind at all...... Of course, this sentence also sounds like you're talking to yourself based on your own speculation, but personally, you think it's not a big deal.
So after a pause, you hesitated and managed to speak: "Hmm, even though you might not mind, I still want to apologize. After all, we're now business partners...... In a way, you're friends too? A trustworthy friend—ah, I'm not saying I trust everything you say." As you spoke, you didn't forget to patch yourself up.
"Although maybe reconciling after a conflict will take things further...... But hurt is hurt, and I don't want to hurt what really happened. So when I realized I might have hurt you, I apologized. Ah, maybe saying that might be overreacting...... "As you spoke, you felt awkward again, cleared your throat twice, stood up, and pretended to be busy to tidy up the books on the bed. Although there wasn't much to tidy up—you already categorized them when you bought them, so now it's just futile to sort them again.
Spamton didn't think you were doing it for that reason. Maybe, maybe, he said maybe. You really do take him seriously as a partner, even a friend...... Of course, he is the same.
Yes, he told himself, and so did he.
You were quiet for a moment, no longer dwelling on the previous topic. After haphazardly tidying up your books for a while, you suddenly remembered one more thing, so you turned to Spamton: "Hmm...... By the way, I didn't ask what you wanted to make if you won. Of course, if it's too complicated, I definitely won't help make it happen. ”
You even cautiously asked this question, and after saying it, you stared intently at Spamton—afraid he might bring up something you might find very difficult but was certainly achievable.
But what you didn't expect was that Spamton simply said, "[Discount Promise] [Future Fulfillment], I Haven't Thought of Suitable [Discount Content]." ”
You stared at each other for a while, and all you could catch was the innocence in his gaze. Although those dark pupils carried an inexplicable chill after staring for a long time, in the end you just looked away and cleared your throat.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll start reading first...... Don't disturb me!" As you spoke, you pulled out a book and walked toward the desk in your bedroom. Of course, to study well, you didn't forget to buy a new pen or something. You're ready now.
You hesitate for a moment, then turn on the desk lamp, really planning to start studying hard. But after just two pages, you start zoning out, unable to recall any of the content, and it's hard to reconnect now, causing you to search your mind for memories, wishing you had studied these things before. Otherwise, if you were asked to read them again...... You definitely wouldn't understand.
Just as you stared at your textbook, feeling deeply resentful, you felt your hem being tugged. In fact, ordinary force wouldn't be enough to wake you from deep thought, but ...... That force was a bit too much, maybe because you used a lot of force, causing you to lower your head and look at Spamton, who was tugging at your clothes.
“…… What else do you want? Didn't you say not to bother me? "The memory fragments you just retrieved are all messed up too. You're not very happy, puffing out your cheeks as you look at him."
"I think maybe we can [learn together]." He gave this kind of answer.
Your mouth twitched: "What ...... Why study together? Do you really need to take exams or something? I need exams, but you don't......
You have no idea what he's really thinking about making this request, but, well, since he made it...... It's not a big deal for you, and maybe having someone with you will make your studies even more efficient. Thinking this, you bent down and picked him up over his arm, then placed him on your lap, your chin naturally resting on his head. To be honest, it was a bit rough and not very soft, and that hair was a bit annoying...... You should take good care of your hair later, you muttered to yourself, but instead of doing much, you turned your attention back to your textbook.
Fortunately, you found part of your memory, so you just hurriedly finished that part of the problem and then flipped back, memorizing knowledge points you weren't familiar with.
You're hesitating and want to directly check your answers to see if there's anything wrong with your answer...... Well, this might sound like cheating, but you're really not confident enough in your answer. You still want to refer to the standard answer to see where you're really lacking.
But at that moment, you heard Spamton's voice again: "...... Can you [explain] this [question] [pay for me]?" As he spoke, he reached out his puppet's little hand and tapped the page. When you looked, it was exactly the same question you had just wanted to look up the answer to...... Well, anyway, you don't think flipping through the answer directly would make you wrong! So you just cleared your throat twice: "I'm not really sure about this question either...... Can we just look at the answer directly? ”
After saying this, you pondered for a moment and felt something was off, so you hurriedly said, "No—you really are seriously studying the question, but why do I have to explain it to you?" Since you can't see his eyes right now and can only stare at the back of his head, you silently ground your teeth but felt too embarrassed to slap the back of his head. Instead, you put down your pen and pinched his face, pulling the cheeks to the sides. Although you don't know why the puppet can be pinched like a normal face, with a gentle and soft feeling, you used this movement to vent the inexplicable anger rising in your heart and completely relaxed.
…… It seems that the sudden tension just now also relaxes at this moment, and you realize it belatedly.
But you didn't let go, so Spamton's tone changed a bit: "I [believe] I also have [learning rights], and you need [special benefits] [help]. ”
…… You don't know what exactly is going on between these two sentences, but you do let go and mutter, "Could you really guide me through other problems...... I never thought I'd need your help, would I......"
You really haven't thought about this. At this very moment, you remember you've never asked him about his educational level...... Uh, can you really describe the Dark People like that? Maybe for all the Dark Ones, there's really no educational level, because as far as you know, they're just incarnations of objects corresponding to the real world.
So you wisely choose to skip the question and instead ask, "Then tell me, what are you good at?" ”
Spamton fell silent, so long that you thought he hadn't heard your question clearly, and you even considered whether to repeat it—well, but just a second before you were about to repeat, you heard his answer.
"Maybe it's [the script] and the clever design of language?" He sounded uncertain either.
But you stroked your chin and nodded thoughtfully: "Oh, oh...... You mean reading comprehension questions? Uh...... And essays, I hate essays...... You mutter, your voice gradually fading.
Then you raised your voice again: "If that's the case, why should I explain this problem to you? You could have done it better yourself, right?" "You don't think he needs your help to solve this problem."
No, seriously, why is he really studying with you? You seriously suspect he was bored and came to bother you.
So you puffed up your words in anger—of course, you weren't that angry, just a bit of amusement and resentment: "Aren't you just bothering me? Maybe I should just throw you down?" "You think it's better to just quiet down and read alone. Although that might sometimes make you zone out and your study progress won't be fast, it's still better than spending time chatting like this and making no progress at all."
"No, it's not about [disrupting progress]. I think I can [help] [you] [understand the problem]."
You were stunned by his words, but when you came to your senses, you grabbed his face and snarled, "You mean I still need you to explain the problem to me?" What exactly are you thinking! Do I really need it! "Although you still felt a bit guilty as you said this, after all, you still had some clue about the question you just mentioned, and you had no idea how to answer the next one.
"I think [you] need [special services]." His voice was muffled, but you could still hear it clearly. You puffed out your cheeks, even though you knew in some ways he was indeed true.
"Alright, then you try it." In the end, you still said this reluctantly.
It turned out that his understanding and answers in this area were almost identical to the reference answers...... You have to admit, maybe you really need his help, but you still feel a strange sense of frustration. Of course, you quickly feel proud, since you soon switched to textbooks for other subjects. Spamton quieted down and said nothing more.
So you figured it out—he just couldn't figure it out...... Hmm, maybe he knows some basics. You really don't know what kind of academic level the People of Darkness really are.
So next, you happily continue your study process in a quiet environment, hmm...... Holding something in your arms does make you feel better, and you know you're not the only one suffering—that's enough.
It wasn't until you started to feel hungry that you instinctively glanced at your phone and saw it was almost six o'clock. You hurriedly put down your pen, stretched, and casually asked, "What would you like to have for dinner?" "Anyway, you have money now. After leaving the game world, you can split the rest of the money evenly. After all, you live in the dark world now, so there's no way you won't have a single dark coin to use...... Uh, of course, he probably won't need the currency of the light world.
Just split half of the bills in that box with him later! If he doesn't need you, he'll force you to buy and sell them! Although at this moment, you never expected that he would later use these bills to buy other things from you.
"Let [your] opinion be yours." Spamton simply said. He didn't have many demands when it came to food.
You thought for a moment, and since you've been craving it lately, you clench one hand and clap your other hand in applause: "Alright, let's go have hotpot!" You happily finalize your next schedule.
As for why hotpot...... Actually, you just feel craving it. When you go to sign up in the morning, you pass by a hotpot restaurant, and the aroma makes you want to have a meal yourself.
So you picked up the Spamton, slung it on your shoulder, and headed out. You glanced at yourself and sure you had locked the door, then happily walked out.
…… But you're not very familiar with the terrain of the Dark World, so after a few steps outside, you get stuck. You look down at Spamton on your shoulder: "Uh...... As for the Dark World, where is the hotpot restaurant?" "You asked sincerely, and your earlier arrogance quickly turned to lethargy."
Spamton silently watched you for a moment, then figured out the direction, then pointed you out: "[Direction Requirements], [Navigation] Go from here to obtain [Hot Pot Enjoyment Qualification]." In fact, in his memory, he had never been to a hotpot restaurant; in fact, there were hardly any hotpot restaurants in Cyber City...... After all, most Dark People couldn't get used to that taste. Compared to the tingling sensation of chili dancing on the tip of the tongue, it was more likely just a simple pain.
Of course, spiciness is always like that.
You didn't think much of it, just reached out and pressed Spamton's head lightly: "Oh, thanks." Then you happily walked in the direction he pointed to.
Soon, you arrive at the hotpot restaurant and glance at the nameplate. Good, it reads...... Uh, probably Chinese characters? They're all about to be wild, but you can barely make out what they are. But the English labels below make you realize this really is a hotpot restaurant, since the English letters are just plain printed type.
It was clear that there really weren't many hotpot restaurants in the Dark World, although in the Light World, there weren't many hotpot restaurants in his own area either...... You swallowed hard, as if that aroma was lingering in your nose again, so you eagerly walked in.
The waitress was also a member of the Dark Folk anyway, so you couldn't tell what she belonged to. She just found a seat under her guidance and casually placed Spamton across from her.
Then you look at his head, which is just a little above the table, and fall silent. Honestly...... When eating hotpot, holding him is inconvenient, since hotpot easily spills soup and broth.
You ordered a mandarin duck pot, the base came out quickly, you picked out your favorite dishes, then handed the menu to Spamton for him to order.
You rested your chin on your hand, hesitating as you looked at him, then at the table. You even doubted that even if you held him, he wouldn't be able to reach that pot. Only then did you feel a bit regretful—even though you could help him get food or something, wouldn't that be too much trouble?! And why should you help him with such things! Thinking about this, you couldn't help but feel a bit annoyed, but these thoughts were just fleeting in your mind and never showed them.
On the surface, you just looked at him calmly, pondering which chip would be best. In the end, you just took a deep breath: "...... Can you cook?" "Completely unrelated, but you still asked the question."
Spamton seemed stunned for a moment, hesitated for a moment, then hesitated before nodding.
The corners of your mouth lifted slightly, clearly satisfied, of course...... Uh, it's not that you don't know how, you just really don't have the energy. Besides, at this rate, you can't offset the dissatisfaction in your heart now—at most, it will only erase part of it.
But those things can be thought about later! For now, you just made the decision and said, "Alright—let's do it then! I'll serve you some food later, since I feel like you can't reach it anyway...... Don't look at me like that. If you don't believe me, try it yourself." ”
Spamton did try it himself. His poor puppet hand couldn't even touch the edge of the soup pot, and you just shrugged and kept muttering. Anyway, Spamton just happened to hear the voice: "Hmm...... Besides, I think you might not be able to reach either. I'll hold you while eating, it's such a hassle...... "You don't really like this kind of form."
After all, you're used to being alone.
Spamton silently glanced at you: "...... thank you for your generosity." He originally wanted to refuse, but was truly helpless, so he had no choice but to agree. However, he himself had no reason to refuse this deal.
Then you added, "Alright, I'll help you eat...... Uh, this sounds so strange, but as long as you understand, that's enough! Also, as a condition, you have to cook at home from now on. "As you spoke, you nodded, thinking your suggestion was really clever.
Spamton had no objections...... However, when he heard the word 'home,' the puppet's body still trembled slightly, and you didn't notice.
Soon, the pot boils, all the ingredients are served, and you happily get ready to cook, glancing at Spamton...... Then you notice the glasses are now shrouded in fog, and you can't see anything clearly.
You couldn't help but cover your mouth and try hard to hold back your laughter, but you couldn't help but laugh twice. After coughing a few times, you finally said, "Sorry...... I didn't mean to laugh out loud, I just ...... Pfft...... "Usually, you wear those glasses properly. Occasionally, you can see them change into other colors as if they reflect emotions, but you don't really care about what kind of emotional state those look like, nor have you asked. It seems like it's just a special ability of the Dark World."
But now, just like ordinary glasses, there's fog on them, which makes you laugh involuntarily. You thought the Dark People's glasses wouldn't fog up.
You hear Spamton's voice, of course, a bit flustered: "It's okay." ”
…… You don't think he's completely fine; it's just that you put away your smile, bring over his plate, and then pick up the cooked slices of meat and similar items to portion...... It was only then that you remembered that because you had been laughing all along, you had put the wrong pot. What should have been half white broth and half red broth was now all made red broth by you.
So you cough twice, scratch your head, and meet Spamton's gaze—though you don't know why the fog on his glasses has cleared.
"Uh, I made the wrong choice...... So can you eat it spicy? "You carefully confirm.
Spamton nodded; there was nothing he couldn't do...... After all, he had eaten a bit of everything.
So you nod as well, then get up and pick him up, sit him on your lap, and say boldly, "Alright! Then you eat first!" ”
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then picked up his chopsticks somewhat unskillfully...... He was simply imitating your movements, but he had already done it well, then picked up a piece of meat and put it in his mouth.
…… Burning hot, painful, just like before, he couldn't taste anything else. So, with unskillful movements, he put down his chopsticks but didn't move again.
You glanced down at Spamton, unable to see his expression, so you couldn't help but gently pat his hair: "Alright, it looks like you can't eat it. I'll make you some plain soup—" As you spoke, you prepared to pick up another plate, each serving half.
But your movement was stopped by Spamton's voice.
"[No need], I can endure [scorching heat], [pain], and [spicy meal]." Even so, he still added many adjectives...... Even though his original intention was indeed to use pain to remind himself of something.
You twitched the corner of your mouth and poked Spamton's cheek: "At this point, you shouldn't eat anymore. You'd better treat yourself better. There's no need to hurt yourself...... "Although you don't know why he suddenly acted so strangely, and you never asked him.
…… You don't have a hobby of poking other people's wounds.
So you insisted on adding half white and half red broth, then smiled and asked, "But do you need any special service?" Like feeding you or something...... After all, you seem very unskilled with chopsticks. "You didn't even consider this when you spontaneously decided to eat hotpot."
Then you looked at the little puppet and shook your head, so you just shrugged and didn't ask further.
Unexpectedly, Spamton's next move was almost flawless. You belatedly think, this guy's learning ability is really strong...... You can't help but feel a bit envious, since studying is painful for you, and absorbing and digesting knowledge takes a long time.
So you just prop your chin up and pick up food, watching the little puppet eat, and take a few bites yourself. For a moment, it was very quiet, with no other sounds.
You thought it would all pass quietly, but unexpectedly, Spamton suddenly spoke up: "I [think] maybe [you] will be curious about that [burning memories]. ”
You slowed your movements in surprise: "Ah, it's not that bad. After all, if you don't want to take the initiative to ask, I wouldn't ask first. Your past should still be considered your privacy...... I don't really want to pry into it." "But Spamton has already taken the initiative to ask about your past. If you ask him, it might be a kind of courtesy, right?" That's what makes it fair.
So you think for a moment, then cautiously ask: "Well, if you're willing to talk, what exactly is your past?" "Even though you're not particularly curious.
…… But the fact that the Dark People can shrink is definitely intriguing. After all, the salesperson you met before was about your height, unlike now, who is only half your height.
You see him stop what he's doing, probably not very willing to speak. Then you wait a moment before hearing his voice break the silence.
His voice was very calm, though you could still hear a slight trembling in it. It was clear he wasn't, or rather, was very unwilling to recall that past, but he still told you. Think about it, this really is a case of reciprocity...... Well, actually, when you talk about your own past, it's not that you don't care at all; it's just that there are more things you should care about. You just shouldn't keep getting caught up in those feelings, so you end up letting the feelings that once erupt be pushed away.
And you hear Spamton briefly recount his past. Once a member of Addison, he never sold anything, until one day he received a phone call that changed his fate, even moving into the Queen's mansion...... Until one day, the magic that changed his fate failed, he was no longer a big shot, kicked out, and even thrown into a pool of acid.
You think at the wrong time, it's like some magic that fails at midnight, except the price is heavy. When he finishes, you just pat his head, think for a moment, and say, "Alright then...... Looking at it this way, fate is indeed unpredictable, and even unfair. But everything is already in the past, and there are still many things we can do, don't we? Maybe we can always change our fate. "You think maybe you don't need much comfort at this moment, or maybe when you say it, he just needs someone to listen.
In fact, maybe no one had heard this story before… Hmm, so you said half-jokingly, ‘Anyway, if you encounter something upsetting, share it with me. Maybe I can help somehow… Uh, after all, we are still partners, so I suppose we can count as friends, right…?’ You weren’t quite sure.
And you didn't hear Spamton's answer, only saw him nod. You scratched your head, feeling a bit guilty—after all, you didn't know if that was even appropriate. This was the first time you'd tried to say something so comforting. Spamton's spare you, you don't have many friends.
When the hotpot was almost finished, you yawned and prepared to pay, only to hear Spamton speak. In contrast, you even felt the voice was serious, though mixed with unpleasant electric shocks and a sharp, inexplicably rising and falling recording: "[Thank you] for your [contributions], offering you a [great discount]. Maybe [you] also need my [help]." ”
You glanced at Spamton, just hugged him and stood up, muttering, "Ah...... I understand, but most of the emotions can be processed by myself...... "You think saying it out loud would make things difficult for others."
‘It’s not 【trouble】.’ It was only when you heard his reply that you realized you had unconsciously said that last sentence as well.
You cleared your throat twice, scratched your ears that felt a bit hot for some reason, quickly settled the bill, and picked up Spamton, heading home. The days that followed were no different from before—doing exercises, not particularly nervous about the exam—until the day of the test.
And when the results were released, you were happy to see that you had been admitted to the adult university, and most of the questions were very simple.
Next, a month-long deadline arrived, and you also prepared to enter the next game.
Tuesday· END

title: Horror Game Port 5 - Doomsday Game

content:
[Main Quest: Survived for seven days and survived] Reward: One month of rest and safety guarantees.
[Side Quest: Find the Truth About the Zombie Appearance and Solutions] Reward: 100,000 Gold + 100,000 Dark Coins
…… Hmm, the rewards are the same as last time, but looking at the text displayed on the screen, you can't help but frown and mutter, "Uh...... This mission looks much more complicated than before...... Just surviving for seven days is already quite challenging. When you arrived in this world, you even took a look. You landed in an abandoned parking lot, with scattered vehicles around, which would make it easier for you to find a place to get around.
But looking around, all around was withered grass and trees, cold and deserted, with no one around. It was clear no one had been here for a long time. Combined with the side quest mentioning zombies, even a fool would know what was happening here.
Just then, you feel a heaviness on your body and realize that the axe you got from the previous world has come along with you. You can't help but wonder: "...... So equipment and such automatically follow?" "The light screen didn't mention this either. You only found a small line of text at the bottom, saying that completing seven tasks would completely free you from the system and grant a reward for fulfilling a wish."
Spamton tugged at your shirt, signaling you to take another look at your clothes. You opened the clothes that had somehow become heavy for some reason, glanced at them, and then were shocked—why were they all tied with grenades!
Then you instinctively glance at Spamton and notice he has a grenade strapped to his body, and now you feel relieved. Although carrying a grenade with it always makes you a bit creepy...... But having a weapon puts you at ease, especially since you have an axe.
So you casually lift Spamton onto your shoulder and sit down: "Hmm, looks like we have to leave this place first. I wonder if the cars here are still usable...... Sigh! "Instinctively, you block the claws attacking you with your axe, then turn around, frowning and covering your nose.
The one attacking you is a zombie, seemingly crawling out of the car...... It seems everyone here has become infected and become that kind of zombie. Perhaps this place should be called a zombie parking lot too. A thin layer of dust still settles on the surface of the car, so you can tell it hasn't been here for long. However, the door has slumped down. Judging by your gaze, the marks are very new—the zombie had just grabbed them...... After all, there are even claw prints on them. If you're not mistaken, there are even bloody handprints inside the car. Perhaps they struggled and tried to break free before turning into zombies, but unfortunately...... That was the outcome he had.
You glanced at the zombie, trying to suppress the urge to vomit...... After all, he carried a foul stench of rot, a lingering stench of death, accompanied by the scent of death and a stifling stench. A large hole was torn open in his abdomen, his internal organs were dripping down, and the thick, now bluish-purple blood flowed down, dripping down, looking like some rotten, suppurative liquid. And he was raising his paw—though called a claw, it was just that his fingers had become abnormal, longer than a normal person's, and his nails had become sharp.
Just now, you hadn't even had time to carefully examine those cars. Now, while fending off the zombies' attacks, you instinctively looked around—wow, about four-fifths of the vehicles were filled with zombies, starving and drooling, trying to break through the doors and head toward you. You can't imagine what fate awaits if you collapse here. You decisively sever the zombie's neck in front of you, watching him collapse limp on the ground but still slowly crawling toward you.
You take two steps back, then run toward a car that is intact and has no zombies inside, grabbing Spamton's shoulder tightly: "...... You can drive, right? "After all, you don't know how to drive. It's nothing like before, when you just need to drive out. You need to break through the zombies' pursuit and blockade and open a new path for survival. In other words...... You have to escape, but you still have to head in the right direction. After all, you still want to complete the side quest, and Spamton probably needs it too.
“…… Of course, [mastering it] is a basic skill. "Actually, Spamton was surprised that you couldn't drive, but if you hadn't suddenly brought it up, he probably wouldn't have directly connected it to that incident.
But in the end, he managed to escape that direction, and Spamton doesn't intend to dwell on what he experienced at that time.
You gave an awkward laugh twice, but you weren't that guilty. You just opened the door, got into the driver's seat, closed the door, and sped off on the gas. Luckily, the car still had gas.
You placed Spamton on your lap and solemnly announced, "Uh, then controlling the steering wheel is up to you! I'm just responsible for pressing the clutch, the accelerator, and the brakes...... If you need to shift gears, just let me know." "You think you're quite considerate, since you already considered that the puppet's little hands probably can't reach you. Otherwise, you could just throw him over and drive—why sit here by yourself—
Speaking of which, you casually picked up a water pipe. You just found it in front of this car. I don't know who threw it here. Maybe someone here tried to deal with those zombies and realized that relying solely on the pipe wouldn't work...... Anyway, you're really getting a bargain. You were just worried that if you kept chopping with an axe, the blade would get bent. If the weapon broke, that would be a disaster.
So you step on the gas, watching Spamton start frantically gripping the steering wheel to steer the car forward, then glance at the zombies outside the window speeding toward you—you have no idea how those zombies can be so fast, since they were moving slowly just now. Now you feel like they've broken a world record, but you can barely catch footage of the zombies moving. Soon, several leading zombies arrive at the window.
This didn't look as bad as the zombie from before. They now only had snow-white skin that clearly didn't belong to humans or even had any color, only a bluish-white skin hinting at deathly intent. There were even faint blood-red or black spots spreading across them, and a ring of black marks on their necks, looking like bruises, probably exposing their weaknesses...... Or perhaps it simply meant they were no longer human. Their abdomen also had a large hole open, but through this hole you saw nothing. It looked as if their internal organs had been hollowed out, and through that opening, only a faint black, unknown liquid seeped out. You didn't even know what it was. But the stench had faded quite a bit; at least you felt like you could catch your breath.
So you take a moment to glance at the gear shift, shift to the highest gear, and the car's speed suddenly skyrockets. You hear Spamton's somewhat distorted voice: "[You] [behavior]—please hand over your [answer sheet]!" ”
You grinned twice: "Aren't zombies chasing us from behind...... Uh, anyway, I'll help handle it, but you have to drive properly." You reminded him of this, then stuck your head out the car window and swung the hose to strike the heads of the zombies chasing up. Because of your strikes, their speed clearly slowed down, but they still chased the vehicle at a speed beyond human speed. You clicked your tongue irritably. Honestly, if you hadn't stolen a car just now, things would probably have been even more troublesome...... However, the car keys were still on the car at the time, so it seemed the owner had already met with misfortune.
So you turn your head again, look at Spamton, who is nervously steering the wheel, and ask, "Can you find a way to shake off these zombies behind you...... Even though you've left the parking lot, these zombies keep chasing!" As you spoke, you couldn't help but frown. You really hated this sense of urgency. Even though it looked exciting and made your adrenaline soar, if you kept doing it for a long time, you'd just feel exhausted.
"Maybe ...... choose another path, I'll do my best." You heard Spamton's slightly distorted reply...... Well, it was still as unpleasant as ever, so you didn't pay much attention and just kept leaning out to deal with the zombies chasing from behind.
To be honest, the zombies chasing after you aren't like the previous two. Maybe you're driving down a wide street now, so the other zombies are chasing after you, trying to wipe you out because of the fresh human scent. You glance at them quickly. These zombies still have pale skin, or rather, a deathly pale color without blood, but without any black spots. Instead, they unexpectedly bloom with red, decaying flowers on their necks and all over their bodies. The hollow in their abdomen is the same, where new flowers are still growing and blooming.
You widened your eyes in surprise, but your hands didn't stop. You raised the hose and struck the zombie's neck hard, but the zombie's movement only paused for a second. Then it moved even faster, its claws even reaching for the car window.
You hurriedly dodged the attack, switched to the axe, and forcefully chopped his neck. Then you wiped the cold sweat from your forehead, thinking this would probably be enough.
…… Then you widened your eyes because you realized that despite losing the head, the corpse was still moving forward, and it was waving its paws at you with perfect accuracy, as if it could see your direction.
You were thinking about just throwing a grenade, but throwing a grenade at such close range was useless. Just then, you heard Spamton's voice: "His [abdomen]. That area where the flower sea blooms is his [weak spot]. "He hurriedly turned the steering wheel, only occasionally glancing at the rearview mirror when he heard the sound of something like a thud behind him. Fortunately, the mirror wasn't damaged. And with that one glance, Spamton noticed the problem.
Although you don't understand why, you naturally choose to trust Spamton unconditionally, so you pound the zombie's abdomen hard with the hose, crushing some of the blooming flowers. The flowers quickly rot, wither, and fall away, and the zombie's speed slows down.
You quietly breathed a sigh of relief. The remaining zombies were all chasing after them, so you finally took a grenade out of your clothes, bit it down, unplugged the safety bolt, and threw it toward the back. Come on, you really don't want to deal with those zombies anymore.
Speaking of which, even though all the zombies had white skin, it was obvious they had lost all vitality and were filled with the scent of death, yet Spamton still showed vitality...... At least if the same doll were placed in front of you, you would undoubtedly believe Spamton still existed and survived, and you wouldn't even know why you made that choice.
But anyway, it didn't really matter. You muttered to yourself, then sat back down quietly. Then, catching your breath, you instinctively looked ahead, eyes wide open—ahead, the cliff was just a cliff a bit farther away! You could vaguely see the vast sea below!
At the same time, you heard the sound of an explosion behind you. You glanced back and confirmed that everything behind was quiet, leveled to the ground, with no zombies chasing you anymore. Only then did you anxiously speak: "Wait, wait, wait, are we about to fall into the sea? We can stop for now—" You still don't want to die here! Even though even if you fall into the sea, nothing will happen, and you can see it. Although most of the zombies were just killed by your explosion, a small number still stubbornly chased after you. If you slow down, they might catch up soon, but you're confident you can take care of those few.
"[No], since [speed has been increased to the highest gear], we can't [stop perfectly] now." Spamton said this calmly, though he was a bit nervous—after all, he had other ways, as long as he drove into a nearby building and forced the car to stop, the price would be that the car would be scrapped, and they might get injured as a result.
Hearing this, you grit your teeth, suddenly grip the steering wheel, and sharply straighten the wheel—after all, Spamton had exactly that plan to turn earlier, and now you hold his hand and redirect the vehicle's direction to straight. Because you can see that although there is a cliff directly ahead, what lies behind is a broken, isolated overpass, connecting to the passage to the other city.
So you press the clutch and accelerator tightly: "Alright, it seems this method is more reliable now—get a feel for what it feels like to fly!" You cheered. Anyway, you don't know the specific rules for driving a car, so you're just acting recklessly.
The car leapt high, crossing a perfect arc. Spamton froze in place, too scared to move, while the zombies chasing behind lost their direction due to the cliffs and ocean ahead, wandering in confusion.
Then, the car fell and stopped on the broken overpass at the other end, with a bang. Fortunately, the car was not completely destroyed at that moment.
You coughed twice, exhaled, and stretched lazily. The car was already over, so of course you didn't press the clutch or accelerator; it was just that the vehicle itself moved forward thanks to inertia. At that moment, having shaken off those chasing zombies, your mood instantly lifted.
“…… Phew, since we're leaving that place anyway, let me think. Surviving for seven days or something means we still have to search for food, right? "As you spoke, you rubbed your stomach. Honestly, you're not sure if there's any food left here. After all, you can't just go eat zombies.
Spamton looked around, then finally held up a pinky finger in a direction: "Maybe we can hold a [Free Food Sale] event." "You follow the direction he pointed and see it's a supermarket."
So you nod thoughtfully, "Alright, I don't know and there's nothing left. Let's go check it out first." So you grabbed the Spamton and got out of the car, taking a quick look at the car as you got out...... Ah, the tire had broken from the recent big jump incident and was still leaking. After all, these aren't reinforced race car tires, so flattening is normal, but that also means the car is scrapped.
So you quietly looked away, hesitated for a moment, and then said, "Uh, looks like we'll have to find a new car soon...... After all, this car is definitely unusable."
Spamton certainly noticed this, but he just glanced at you silently. In fact, he was surprised by your approach, even a bit grateful, since he never expected to do that.
…… He also didn't want to admit he didn't have the skills to speed.
You didn't care, just grabbed Spamton and sat on your shoulder, took a deep breath, pointed at the supermarket, and shouted, "Alright, let's head out now!" ”
After saying that, you felt a bit embarrassed yourself, coughing awkwardly twice. You felt like your earlier actions were just like any kids going on an outing......
But Spamton didn't care about that. He just poked your cheek and asked, "I don't have a [weapon] yet. Maybe [you] should [notify you of safety precautions]." "Although giving him a weapon probably wouldn't be enough for him."
Now you've come to your senses, pat your head, and mutter, "That's true...... I'll find them for you together later! For now, forget it, hmm. "After all, you don't have any other weapons besides the hose and axe, and you can't give these to Spamton—they're just a burden to him.
The supermarket isn't too far; you arrived in no time. This supermarket looks quite well preserved, but the glass door on the outside bears zombie paw prints, suggesting someone hiding inside the supermarket. You guess from that point and carefully push open the glass door and walk into the dim room. The power and water have long been cut off, so naturally, there is no lighting inside.
Coincidentally, the supermarket shelves still have drinking water, apparently left behind because you can't carry so much weight. You breathe a sigh of relief and grab several bottles of purified water, including large buckets, which should last at least seven days.
…… Uh, anyway, I just happened to see a car outside, so I'll just move it up first.
So you put those buckets of purified water on the back seat of the car, and after trying it out, the car can still start, which makes you feel relieved.
But gasoline is a serious matter...... You crawled back into the supermarket, patted your aching back, and said to Spamton, "The car outside can still start, but there's not much gasoline left. We'll probably need to find something else, or maybe just abandon the car and move light. Of course, cooping up in the car for seven days is fine, but what about side quests...... you muttered.
Spamton suggested, "Maybe we can carry items on foot when we run out of fuel, and then retake the vehicle when we find the next loaded item." Also, we should go to other places where the People of Light gather, and maybe have clues for side quests." ”
You blinked and pouted, admitting that he did make some sense, so you couldn't help but nod: "That's true, let's do it as you suggested. Speaking of which, the car radio should still work...... Let's give it a try." Saying this, you didn't rush back to the car to check, but continued rummaging through the supermarket shelves. You found the leftover instant noodles and all sorts of random cookies and desserts, which seemed to have been left behind because they weren't very convenient to carry. Of course, all the compressed biscuits were taken away.
You didn't hold back, grabbed a few plastic bags and started packing cookies, then packed the other snacks too. When full, you tied a knot and stuffed them into Spamton's hands for him to hold onto. Before you knew it, you had packed several bags. When you wiped your sweat and looked at Spamton beside you, you realized the little puppet couldn't carry those bags anymore and was sitting on the ground.
…… You coughed twice, then picked him up, not forgetting to thank him: "Uh...... Alright, thank you for helping hold these bags all the time. Sorry to trouble you." "If you hadn't noticed he was still holding those bags while holding them, you wouldn't feel so guilty. But that really makes things much easier...... Although it's much heavier for you, holding Spamton plus all the weight is still a breeze.
Then you put Spamton on the back seat, signaled him to put down the bags, and carried them a few more times in the same way. Soon, the back seat was full. Of course, besides these snacks, you also took convenient instant noodles and other convenient foods, except for those that needed refrigeration or freezing.
The last time, while passing by, you handed Spamton a Swiss Army knife. You thought a short knife was probably more convenient for his size. So you comfortably handed him the short knife, whistling, ignoring Spamton's quiet look at you when he saw the dagger.
Anyway, after packing up and checking the essentials...... And grabbing some tissues and towels before you start driving. Oh, you press the accelerator and clutch, while Spamton handles the steering wheel.
As you sit in the driver's seat holding him, you awkwardly scratch your head: "Sigh, even though we can abandon the car and walk...... But we have too much stuff. Wouldn't it be better to find gasoline? "You'd rather keep riding in this car than smuggling and hauling lots of things to another mode of transportation.
“…… Maybe? There might be a [Gas Station: Short Stop Point for Car] ahead. "Spamton glanced at the road sign, and as you pressed the accelerator, you turned the steering wheel and drove in that direction.
You nodded thoughtfully and turned on the car radio, wanting to hear what else the radio would say. Fortunately, the car radio was still working for now. Although it sounded like a sizzling sound—probably because the signal wasn't great—you could understand the current environment.
"Ssszz...... Dear listeners...... Breaking urgent news, zombies are now on the roam, and ...... more than ten cities have been captured. Now, the remaining survivors, please head to City A. The military will provide you with shelter...... Sssss......" Then this urgent news report kept repeating. You turned off the broadcast and lowered your head to pat Spamton's head.
"Looks like we can only go to that place called City A now." You said casually, but for some reason, your mood felt a bit heavy.
"Maybe we can find [further] [intelligence]." Spamton simply said this. Of course, he also knew that place might have nothing at all...... And for some reason, when he heard the word 'military', he instinctively felt a bit panicked. It was an overwhelming emotion, and of course, it quickly faded away.
You only heard a hint of nervousness in his words and didn't quite understand what he was so nervous about. In any case, you instinctively hugged him a little tighter: "Uh, alright, let's head over to City A first!" But we need to go to the gas station first...... You don't need to be too nervous. I think this task should be achievable in seven days...... "Forgive me, maybe you're nervous too, and you've been talking too much. At least you nagged for a long time before suddenly realizing something, hurriedly covering your mouth, since Spamton hadn't spoken for ages."
So you cleared your throat twice: "Alright, I talked a bit too much just now. Do you want to say something else?" You asked this question with utmost care. You couldn't see Spamton's expression, only that he shook his head with his back to you. Somehow, you suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.
Then you secretly laugh at yourself, wondering what exactly you're so nervous about. You clearly don't need to panic about it...... You really don't need to worry too much about his emotions.
But you still subconsciously care about his emotional state. Why is that? Is it just that partners need to consider each other's feelings? Or maybe...... Is it because they are truly trustworthy friends that they act this way? Is there anything else besides that? There probably isn't much else besides that. So for some reason, you feel at ease.
Then you sneer inwardly, wondering, why feel anxious and insecure about this? Why force yourself to change your habits because of this?
