content:
[Main Quest: Get one of them cleared and leave smoothly] Reward: One wish, and the game system will end forever.
[Side Quest: Restoring the Truth of the Accident] Reward: 100,000 gold + 100,000 Dark Coins.
You scratched your head. The system's light screen cracked even further. At this moment, the crackling sound of electricity grew louder, and the flickering light flickered as if it might explode at any moment. Those glaring white words were firmly etched into your eyes. You believe this was true for Spamton as well—because at this very moment, you were rarely together.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one else was in the room, you quickly took a look at what it looked like. A cold, dark iron table and walls. Although there were a few windows on the walls, you couldn't see outside. You were also handcuffed, probably to guard against sudden uprising. You turned to look behind you—it was the door to this closed room. You noticed a flashing red dot in the corner—probably a surveillance camera. Just as you turned your head, the door opened, and a rugged face you didn't recognize walked in, dressed in a police uniform. At this point, you clearly knew what to do next. It was basically the kind of scenario where you were the one being interrogated.
When the officer saw you turn and face the main door, his expression grew even colder. He slammed his baton the table: "Who gave you permission to turn around? Turn around now!" ”
You obediently turn around. You don't want to get hit with a baton. Unless necessary, you still don't want to get hurt.
The officer was satisfied. He pulled over a chair and sat across from you, tapping his knuckles lightly on the table twice, raising an eyebrow: "Go ahead, what exactly happened that day?" ”
You swallowed hard and belatedly realized that to you, you actually knew nothing—after all, although you had come to this game world, you had no memories of the past, and of course, you had no idea what had happened.
However, it was too late to try to pretend to have amnesia to fool the officer. After all, from the moment you entered, you hadn't disguised yourself and accepted your identity as a matter of course. Only then did you realize that you shouldn't have accepted the new environment and integrated so easily—it was all the game world playing tricks. You cursed silently in your heart, but on the surface you still looked obedient, just gently shaking your head. That confused expression wasn't an act—after all, you really didn't know anything.
"Are you talking about which day it was, officer?" So you asked.
The officer frowned, snorted coldly, and simply tossed a few photos in front of you: "Stop pretending. You were standing at the accident scene at the time, and your clothes were stained with blood. There's no way you're completely uninvolved in this case. The forensic doctor has examined you, and the blood on your body matches that of the two victims." ”
You casually glance at the photos the police officer had thrown onto the table, then your eyes widen—oh my god, if you're not mistaken, the two deceased lying on the ground in those photos are your parents, your father's face twisted with rage, and you can even imagine what he said before he died—probably expressing regret for giving birth to someone like you. Meanwhile, your mother's face showed an instinctive fear of death, probably...... She wasn't prepared to accept death right now.
You were silent for a moment, though you didn't know whether their deaths were related to you—even though you instinctively believed this case was your doing—you still looked up, blinked, and tried to put on an innocent expression, just like you had seen earlier at Spamton—well, though you might think that expression was not only innocent but also cunning, otherwise why did the police officer across from you look so disgusted?
And you just obediently said, "Yes, officer, with a little investigation, you'll know these two are my biological parents...... It's only natural that I became a suspect, but I have no reason to kill my biological parents. No matter what, they raised me, and I still remember this kindness. Filial piety is more than enough—how could I possibly kill them?" "You almost feel sick when you hear that."
After all, their attitude toward you before was indeed decent, but there was always neglect and disrespect. After all, you were never as favored as their later sons. Although there was some dissatisfaction, it was still tolerable. But when they gave up on sending you to university and instead made you go straight to work, everything changed. They started blatantly demanding money from you, and if you couldn't give them a satisfactory amount, they would insult you over the phone. Honestly, you have endured this kind of life for a long time. Sooner or later, you won't be able to hold back, and it's normal to do such things driven by anger.
But I don't know why...... You feel a bit out of place at this scene. You just want to get away from your parents, and it's not yet enough to kill them. What exactly happened? If that's the case, maybe you're just being framed by someone else?
But the police officer just sneered twice and took out a sealed plastic bag. Looking over, it was the collected evidence. It was a knife—a kitchen knife, still stained with blood. You looked at the photo—a kitchen knife was stuck in your father's chest, probably the same knife. The mother's abdomen was cut wide, making it look like she died from excessive blood loss. That's why her face showed a fear of death...... Feeling her body grow cold and her consciousness fading, not everyone can endure this and have the willpower to do so. Facing the fear of death is probably the most instinctive kind of fear in humans.
You stared at the evidence in silence for a moment, then the police officer took out several autopsy reports and spread them out on the table. He asked coldly, "The autopsy report shows your mother, that is, Mr. X, died from excessive blood loss, with only an external wound to the abdomen. Your parents, Mr. Y, died from fatal wounds to the chest, and the kitchen knife stabbed his heart. In addition, both of them had the same drug ingredient. Since this drug is unheard of, the forensic doctors are still conducting tests. ”
You stared blankly at the autopsy report and the kitchen knife. Honestly, you thought it would be better to just confess now. After all, the evidence was so solid, it would be false to say you knew nothing...... But if you were the one committing the crime, at least you would hide this overly conspicuous evidence, which would only delay for a while. If you were still caught then, you'd have to accept your bad luck. But now, everything was so conspicuous, maybe to cover something up, like...... To cover up the drug in their bodies.
However, the main quest requires someone to clear their name...... You don't know what's really going on with Spamton at the moment, so maybe you should confess to all the crimes, since doing so might help you complete the main quest. As for the side quests, you always get a feeling that they don't make sense...... What other truth could there be?
But before that, you still have some doubts: "So, does this kitchen knife bear my fingerprints?" "With such obvious evidence, you probably wouldn't keep it, especially since the police didn't show it, so you have no choice but to take a gamble."
As it turned out, you bet right. The officer's expression stiffened, and he snorted coldly: "Yes, indeed, no fingerprints were found. There was nothing left on the knife handle, and even the bloodstains were streaked. We have reason to suspect that the suspect, you, was wrapped in a protective device like a glove to hold the knife, then stabbed it into Mr. Y's chest." ”
You sighed. Honestly, remembering nothing was the biggest mistake in this situation; otherwise, you could try to refute something. And now, you looked at the photos on the table. Besides the scene of the crime, you also saw the surroundings of the crime scene and saw a river not far away. At the same time, you glanced at the autopsy report. The body was sent at 5 p.m., and it was estimated to be four to six hours ago, which was roughly lunchtime.
Your eyes darted around, and unexpectedly, you came up with a good idea. Then you smiled and said, "Yes, yes, officer, I killed the people. I killed both of them. I never thought I could escape legal judgment. From the moment I killed them, I was determined to die." ”
The officer probably didn't expect you to confess so easily. His eyes widened slightly. You guessed that before you entered this game, "you" absolutely refused to give up. You know, this is the world of light. Perhaps all of this will be your ultimate fate there. You just can't figure out why, if that's the case, this matter would drag Spamton into it again.
Then the police came back to their senses and slammed the table hard. You naturally fell silent, just staring at him with a terrified expression. After clearing his throat, he said with authority, "I'm not asking you to confess your crimes. You should ask the priest to do these things. What we need to do now is record your confession and explain the details of your crime." ”
You feel a bit helpless, and you don't know how the police are dragging their feet. As long as they throw you in court and present the evidence, you'll admit guilt. Why is the process so complicated now? Maybe it's because you never thought about being a police officer, and naturally haven't understood how the law works.
But at this point, it's quite difficult to make up a complete story based on these fragmented contents. So you stay silent for a long time, while the police officer leans on the table and watches you. You can feel him staring at you intently, and you feel a bit awkward.
After much effort, you come up with a logically flawless story. You cough twice to signal that you are about to start recounting your "crime process." The officer clapps his hands, and you hear the door behind you creak open. You look a bit surprised as a recorder sits in another empty seat across the table.
Then the officer nodded, signaling that you could speak now. So you took a deep breath and began to tell the story you had just compiled: "...... At that time, I rarely went back to my parents' home because they kept calling to scold me and ask for money. I really couldn't hold back. The real purpose of this trip was to put a little medicine in those dishes, to make them feel pain for a while, so they would remember the lesson and stop bothering me again. ”
The recorder was writing swiftly on paper. You wondered if his writing speed could really keep up with your speaking speed. The officer crossed his arms, still staring at you, probably afraid you'd lose his temper at this moment. You couldn't help but complain inwardly—only a fool would attack a police officer at a time like this. You're just a bit a bit unsmart—you're not a fool.
"That drug is just an ordinary sleeping pill. I just wanted to teach them a lesson......" You remembered earlier that you couldn't find out the ingredients of this drug, so you added another sentence. After all, you had to make up the story look more perfect. But for some reason, the recorder suddenly chuckled, making you hesitate and glance at him again.
The officer just nodded and glanced at the recorder, telling him not to speak further. The recorder immediately lowered his head and fell silent. The officer signaled for you to continue. You took a deep breath, trying to stay calm and continue telling the story. After all, when you made it up earlier, you knew your parents would definitely do that. So you couldn't help but feel anger, your hands trembling, and your body trembling. You forced a smile, a hint of madness, and said, "I drugged you, I brought the food to the table, but to my surprise, at the table, my father insulted me again and this time told me to hand over the money face to face." My mother, on the other hand, was my father's accomplice. She joined in insulting me, but played the good cop on the side, urging me to take out money to honor them as the true act of filial piety. I couldn't take it anymore. When I went home to visit them and prepare lunch, I was already furious, and now I was even more fired up. ”
At this point, you pause again, because you realize that everything now really feels like a made-up story rather than a testimony. You regret it a little. If you'd known you'd chosen another way to tell your story, this one definitely wouldn't have passed. The recorder stopped writing, looked up at you, and gave him an awkward smile. The officer raised his hand, signaling you to continue.
…… Since he thinks there's no problem, you can keep talking for now. After all, no matter how bad things are, they can't get worse than the current situation.
"So I picked up the kitchen knife. My mother tried to stop me. Maybe she realized what I was trying to do, and at first, I didn't intend to hurt them. After all, I just wanted to teach them a lesson, so I only left a moderate wound on her abdomen while dodging her attack, and it was bleeding." You paused, looking at the police officer who seemed unresponsive, and then continued speaking.
“…… Then, seeing this, my father panicked, scolded me, cursed at me, and tried to snatch the kitchen knife from my hand. Perhaps in a fit of rage, I slashed straight at my father's chest, the knife piercing straight into his chest, and then he collapsed to the ground...... My mother was terrified too, collapsed to the ground, unable to move, and blood splattered onto my clothes. I stared blankly at the scene, trying to erase some evidence, so I hurriedly took off my gloves and threw them into a nearby river. But I didn't run any farther before being caught by the police. ”
Finally completing the entire story, you breathed a slight sigh of relief in your heart. You have to understand, you had to put in a lot of effort to tell such a story. Normally, you wouldn't have come up with a story that at first glance seemed logically sound.
But the officer just frowned, tapped his fingers on the table, signaling the recorder to stop. You quieted down, and in the silence, for a moment, you could only hear your own heartbeat—pounding like a drum. You were nervous, not knowing what else he wanted to say, which is why he ordered you to be quiet.
But the officer just lowered his head; you couldn't understand his expression, maybe it was just pure ...... Not very clear? But you clearly heard his voice, one tinged with mockery and pity. You didn't know where his pity came from, nor did you have time to think—you could only hear his voice.
He said, "I'm lying. Actually, you turned yourself in. You asked the police to send someone to take you away, but you refused to tell us the details of the case, so we had to question you." ”
…… So that's why you didn't go to court in the first place? You're a bit dazed.
"I thought you'd give a real testimony today, but it turns out you're lying...... Stay here for now." The officer pressed his brow, looking a bit tired. Then, you heard the door creak open behind you, and a police officer came in and roughly pulled you up. You quietly followed behind him, and then...... You arrived at a detention cell, where you were locked up.
To be honest, the environment in the detention room is actually pretty good, at least better than your rental apartment...... The downside is that the detention room actually has bunk beds, and you don't know who will be living with you.
Just as you were looking around, you heard a familiar voice: "Very happy to see you again." Although he said he was happy, his voice always sounded a bit gloomy.
You looked toward the sound, looked up, and spotted a little puppet sitting on the edge of the bed, swinging its legs. To be honest, you were a bit surprised, since you had been worrying about how to see him in the detention cell, so you greeted him happily: "Spamton!" ”
Then you finally notice the clothes he was trying hard to hide...... If you hadn't stood on tiptoe when greeting him, you probably wouldn't have noticed him, but you would have noticed he was wearing a blue princess dress, which was probably the source of his gloom.
Anyway, you fell silent, twitched your lips, and pointed at Spamton: "...... Why are you wearing a princess dress? ”
His voice now carried a tone of frustration and anger: "I didn't [agree to all terms and security conditions], but maybe to [share] private intimate moments with [you], I [forced] agreed to [registration terms and security matters]." When I [woke up] in this world, I was already dressed like this. ”
…… You twitched your lips again, helplessly rubbing your forehead: "Alright, maybe that's just some kind of twisted humor from some game system...... But since we're in the same room, at least we have to dress you in a set of clothes so you don't look so obvious at first glance. Although I'm curious how they actually completed the investigation process. ”
As he spoke, Spamton jumped off the bed. You had no idea what he was up to, and even if the puppet fell from that height, it wouldn't be damaged. In any case, you caught him and held him in your arms. And in your embrace, Spamton's previously tense body relaxed.
Well, it seems he just wants you to give him a hug. You shrugged and just sat down on the lower bunk holding him. Honestly, you actually don't know where to start right now.
Instead, Spamton spoke first: "[Question:] Did the police just ask you about [related illegal acts]?" ”
You paused for a moment, then nodded instinctively. Then you realized that if you did this, he probably wouldn't notice. So you cleared your throat and replied seriously, "Indeed, the police just asked me for my testimony...... Unfortunately, without memories of your previous self, the fabrication was indeed not reliable enough." As you spoke, you repeated the story you had just told the police. You watched Spamton listen and nod, clearly listening carefully to your account.
And in the end, you end with one sentence: "But the police said I turned myself in...... I really don't know what was going on, but anyway, after that, I was sent here. Looks like you've been asked about your testimony too? I want to hear what your side is like. ”
But speaking of which, you just took a moment to glance at the game's light screen. Although it did look like it was about to shatter, it still gave you feedback on the current state of the game. Of course, the main quest is still at 0% at this stage, but the side quest has suddenly dropped to 35%. It means that some of what you said earlier was actually correct, but you don't know which ones are wrong.
Spamton was silent for a moment. Now he was sitting on your lap with his chest against you, and honestly, this position was quite comfortable...... But indeed, if you want to complete the main quest, you have to piece together and verify your testimony.
"The first thing that came up was a 'linguistic hermeneutics problem.' The police found it hard to understand my 'wording,' so they only half-understood and made notes." The police probably understood the exact meaning of his words...... But he still couldn't help feeling a bit frustrated, nothing more.
You listened quietly, just grabbing the little hand of the puppet and fiddling with it wildly, while you felt Spamton glare at your hand, but you didn't really care, just glanced away.
"Then, I began to present [specific case information]. They presented [relevant autopsy reports], [reasonable speculation about the drug content], and [evidence: photos of residual gloves]." Spamton continued, but your brows furrowed. This was completely different from the evidence you saw. It seemed they used different evidence to interrogate you to prevent your collusion.
So the story you made up probably seems full of flaws in their eyes...... You tugged at the corner of your mouth, wanting to say something, but in the end just sighed: "Forget it, fine...... I don't know why the evidence on both sides is different. They told me there were no fingerprints on the knife handle, and I really came up with the hypothesis that the glove fell into the river. ”
Spamton was silent for a moment before saying, "As far as I know, [Gloves: Original Location] is [Navigation: Right side of the table], not [Navigation: Rushing River]. ”
You slapped your forehead and sighed, "I really was completely fooled by the police." ”
"What they probably need is [real intelligence], which is why they [present contrary evidence] to lure us into [providing relevant story content]."
"Yeah, for them, that's just a story...... I wasted all my effort and even made up such a perfect story for them. By the way, do you have fingerprints on your gloves? "You just sank for a moment and quickly pulled yourself together. After all, you still have to find a way to get at least one person out of prison. Getting both out of prison or something...... Come on, the evidence is solid now, so only one of you can do it. After all, others have no grudges against your parents, and maybe you're even accomplices or something. Of course, that's just your imagination.
"[Gloves: fingerprint evidence] is indeed [indisputable], but ......" Spamton dragged out his voice as if hesitating, and you couldn't help but hesitate, urging, "But what?" ”
“…… The [fingerprint evidence] on it is [you] and me. "Finally, he said.
And you widened your eyes, never imagining it would turn out like this. Although you apologize for making up a flawed story to the police without knowing anything, since you still follow the law...... But if you committed the crime, why did Spamton's fingerprints end up on it? To be honest...... You don't think a little puppet can handle a kitchen knife and do so much.
Then you suddenly realized, grabbed the puppet's small hand and touched it: "Wait, if it were someone like the Dark Folk, there shouldn't be fingerprints, right? And I remember hearing you say before that when you were kicked out of the Queen's mansion, you were thrown into an acid pool, which is why you ended up looking like this puppet. If it was concentrated acid...... Your fingerprints should have been worn down long ago. "As you spoke, you carefully raised Spamton's hand to observe it. He seemed a bit embarrassed and annoyed, wanting to pull his hand back, but didn't.
With no other choice, he had no choice but to answer your question: "[Indeed, that's true.] ”
You nodded in satisfaction, but then remembered he still couldn't see your expression, so you quickly stopped and casually said, "So, logically, your fingerprint shouldn't be recorded on it...... Besides, you haven't registered in the Light World, so how do they know those are your fingerprints?" ”
Although you don't know what's going on in this world now, you can still be sure of this, since Spamton is a Dark Folk.
"...... [System Entry] does contain my [fingerprint content]." His tone was a bit confused; clearly, he hadn't figured it out either.
You really have a wild imagination. Even though it probably doesn't fit logically, you still said, "Hmm...... Alright, then I roughly get it. Maybe this world is actually another timeline, where you and I are both citizens of Light...... But before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you.
This time, he firmly denied your words: "Impossible, I will only be the [People of Darkness], and I can only be the [People of Darkness]." At this point, his mood sank again.
You blinked, but didn't insist that you were all people of Light, just said, "Ah...... That's possible. Actually, I was a citizen of light, accidentally entered the Dark World, and then gave my soul to you, so I brought you to the world of light. Naturally, your fingerprint was logged into the system, after all...... At that time, you hadn't suffered what happened afterward, so of course you couldn't be an invisible person without an identity in the world of light. ”
This time, Spamton didn't argue with you. It seems he accepted your opinion, and you quietly breathed a sigh of relief in your heart.
"It's just for now. Because we need to complete the mission assigned by the system, we used our own bodies when we crossed over to this world, so you don't have fingerprints right now...... Is that about right?" "You've finally finished your guess."
Finally, Spamton replied gloomily, "But the Dark People never have a [fingerprint authentication program]." ”
You nod your chin and shrugged: "Maybe you'll have it after coming to the Light World, which isn't surprising." And relying on fingerprints for investigations and such...... That's something the Light World would do. The Dark World probably doesn't have such strict procedures, right? After all, they're all just objects. ”
Spamton nodded in agreement: "Yes, of course. Most of the Dark People follow their own [object instincts]. ”
"That is, relying on physical instinct...... Well, what else besides that? ”
“…… And [Medicinal ingredient: potassium cyanide]. " he said.
You widened your eyes: "This isn't some drug ingredient that needs further investigation...... You even lied to me about what it was because we couldn't figure out what it was yet, which made me think for a long time about what to say. ”
No wonder the recorder laughed at that moment...... They must have known exactly what the drug is to mock themselves! You widened your eyes, then weakly drooped your shoulders: "Really...... I don't even know why you lied to me...... I said that drug was a sleeping pill. ”
"Maybe it's for your 'true, reliable' testimony." Spamton said, he probably knew the real reason for separating you for interrogation—just hoping to get real testimony. But this time it failed, probably because neither of your accounts matched up, or rather, it clearly didn't match.
You take a deep breath: "But I have no idea—well, so what kind of testimony did you give them at the time?" ”
"I told the [Officer] that first, [Medication: Potassium cyanide] was my [Delicious Seasoning] in the food. Then, the [Hurt Guide] was that I couldn't bear to see [you] suffer [cruel treatment], so I wrapped the [knife handle] with [gloves]. The first strike only injured your mother's abdomen due to the height issue. The second stab was because your father was pushed down by you, so I inserted the [kitchen knife] into the chest." He briefly recounted the testimony from that time. Although the police and the recorder showed little reaction after hearing it, they simply walked out and left the interrogation room alone, and only about an hour later did they take him away and lock him back in the detention cell.
"So I boldly speculate: [You] will have [the time of the interrogation] after me. And [Mr. Police] acted this way to ensure our [testimony system] is [accurate]. "He added another sentence after that.
You nodded, indicating you probably understood...... Well, it's not okay not to understand, since the main quest is still at 0%. You can't think of any good way to escape, and strictly speaking, this isn't really a horror game—it's more like a kind of ...... A time-travel experiment? You know very well, you have a feeling—if it weren't for the events in the Dark World, if there hadn't been the game system...... Right now, you're just thinking about getting away from your parents, but there's no guarantee that with nothing and under their oppression, you won't do such things. Maybe this is just a crime committed by your future self in another timeline, and as for Spamton, she's probably just dragged into it for no reason.
You fell into deep thought, thinking about this while still thinking about how to revise your testimony, when suddenly Spamton spoke: "I know very clearly, that [drug ingredient: potassium cyanide] was the one I put in." ”
You shivered and instinctively opened the game screen to check. The side quest had just been at 40%, but now it had dropped to 50%. Spamton was right. You realized this, but doubt quickly crept up in your heart.
"But if that's the case...... Why did you appear in the world of light with me, and commit a crime with me? "Although you just made a guess about fingerprints, in the end, those guesses were just casual talk. In other words, you never considered that the crime involved his own part.
“…… Maybe it's because of the [Light World Fingerprint]? Maybe it's because of [your] [heart-shaped object]? Maybe it's the ultimate reward from the game system? "Obviously, he wasn't very clear either, so all three in a row were written in a questioning tone. Even so, he probably knew exactly what kind of deal he had made with the game system.
You shrugged: "Fingerprints and stuff are just my guesses...... But if you say that, maybe something like this really will happen in the future. Looks like I can only make that wish." The door quickly opened, and behind them appeared the so-called witches you had let go that day. They signaled you to run quickly, leaving all future troubles to them.
You nodded gratefully, seemingly unable to hear the heavy footsteps, but you still refused to let your guard down. Although you didn't know why the sky was approaching dusk, you still crossed the bridge ahead—a bridge that only appears at moments of demon encounters.
Soon after, the journey reached its end. You finally reached the judge. Before you could make your next move, you watched as the soul of the girl from the previous world playfully winked at you, pulled her eyelids into a funny face, then slipped onto the judge, knocked down the wooden rope, and shouted heavily: "I hereby declare Miss Y/N and Mr. Spamton innocent!" ”
Everything is over. Everything behind you turns blank, and your eyes go blank. You see the game's light screen showing 100% of the main quest. Then, a flash of bright light passes before your eyes. You hold Spamton and sit back down on the ground. The Dark People come and go, seemingly unaware of you.
But you know it's all over because you hear the crisp cracking sound. You try to summon the game screen again, but it can't be summoned anymore.
You hugged Spamton tightly, saying nothing.
Judgment of Sin· END

Spamton pinched your cheek. You let out a hiss, looking at him pitifully. Honestly, he was a bit rough now, but it didn't hurt much—you were just pretending.
Then he shook his head: "It's not about this precaution, but that world is extremely dangerous, so we really need to be extra cautious." "Although he felt that you had no chance of re-entering that world either.

“…… But [you] [imagine: I have no chance of leaving smoothly.] "His expression was serious, and his tone was also very serious.
You frowned and just shook your head: "I won't allow that to happen. If you keep sleeping, trapped in dreams, I will definitely find a way to enter that dream." ”
"And......" You scratched your hair and tilted your head slightly, not looking directly at Spamton. After all, you felt a bit embarrassed. "I trust you. "Your words sounded perfectly reasonable and confident, leaving Spamton a bit speechless." He stared straight at you and didn't say a word for a long while. You thought you might have said something wrong and quickly added another sentence afterward.
"Ahem...... And before you wake up, at least I can guarantee that nothing will happen to me," you said, giving a thumbs-up and praising yourself with a hint of pride, "Look, I did very well in court too!" ”
Spamton just sighed. To be honest, his heart—maybe the heart—gently swayed with your words, and he was about to get lost in it. But he knew it wasn't the issue; what he desperately wanted to share with you was not this topic.
So he simply knelt on your knees, cupped your face, and met your gaze. He said something he hadn't said before, but you actually had some vague feelings: "[You] didn't [discover consciousness], and our [separation ritual] was deliberately done by the [Heaven's Wishing Machine]?" ”
You stared into Spamton's eyes. Honestly, even if you noticed something, you wouldn't dare say this guess. After all, who knows if all of this is real or not? What if everything before you is just an illusory dream? You don't dare to gamble. But after he said this, everything around remained the same, as usual. Suddenly, you realized again that everything was just reality.
You sighed, cupped Spamton's face as well, and nodded solemnly: "...... Actually, I vaguely realized that from the very beginning, everything was an accident. Clearly, if the police had kept investigating, we could have gotten results, but suddenly a different cop had changed and pushed us into trial...... Clearly, neither of us was good at what we were about to face, yet we were still cruelly separated, forced to face what was before us alone. Clearly, cooperation between you and me was the most advantageous thing—but at this moment, the game system cut off the possibility of our cooperation. "As you spoke, you couldn't help but laugh again. To be honest, you didn't understand why the game system did this, as if it deliberately didn't want you to pass the final level.
“…… And if we hadn't completed the [Side Quest] before, then [End of the Game] would have been a dead end. "Spamton thought about it. In the end, it felt like a relay race, with parts of every previous game—or perhaps parts of fantasy or reality—appearing to help you, and I still feel a bit scared. Without those people, you probably wouldn't have escaped.
You scratched your head and chuckled twice: "Trust me—it definitely won't be a dead end. Even without that help, I can still find a way to escape. And at worst, I'll just fight that guy. I might not lose; maybe he just looks scary." "You're saying that a bit carelessly. You even want to try carrying an axe now. Maybe it really works."
“…… Don't talk about 'freedom of speech.' And Spamton just covered your mouth, and you blinked a bit innocently at him.
"In any case, fortunately, we have the [other side's capital]." He sighed and finally reached this conclusion.
You removed his hand from covering your mouth, tilted your head, and looked at him in confusion: "I must have learned a lot from you...... Speaking of which, I should thank you. But you haven't learned much from me either, have you? ”
After all, what you have is just brute force or something like that, not something suitable for learning. Saying this, you feel a bit guilty, since aside from that, you really don't have any other strengths.
But Spamton shook his head, his tone inexplicably more serious than before: "No, [you] have made me [benefit a lot]." After saying this, he looked at you with a complicated expression. To be honest...... Actually, Spamton even felt a sudden sense of guilt. After all, if it weren't for you, he probably wouldn't have escaped his predetermined fate, nor would he have had a second choice. But your appearance only showed him new possibilities. So, at that moment, he made such efforts.
“…… How did I end up benefiting so much? Why don't you tell me yourself?" You shook Spamton, trying to get an answer from him, but Spamton just shook his head and refused to say more. You puffed out your cheeks, a bit dissatisfied, but in the end gave up on pressing further.
"Alright...... Anyway, I still thank you. If it weren't for you, what happened in that game world would probably be what I really had to face, probably my future. "You let go of Spamton's shoulders and just smiled sincerely.
Spamton opened his mouth to say something, but just then, your stomach growled, proving you were hungry. So now you two stared at each other, feeling a bit awkward for no reason.
You cleared your throat again: "Alright...... Let's go out and find any restaurant to eat! Two game worlds in a row really exhausted me...... "But if you really ignore that brief night of gaming, maybe three. Anyway, you need to get some good rest. It's decided. After dinner, go submit your resignation and tell the hospital you plan to quit."
And then...... In fact, you can survive in any world, since you have plenty of capital. Lost in thought, you carry Spamton into that familiar hotpot restaurant again.
Spamton was speechless. To be honest, he didn't want every meal to be hotpot...... Although he didn't care what he ate, he didn't want his glasses always getting foggy with white fog.
So he spoke: "[You] don't plan to [change the shop]?" ”
You only snapped out of it when you heard his voice, glanced at the hotpot restaurant in front of you: "...... But in the game world, we haven't had any good food. If we had hotpot, it would be a treat for us, right? ”
Spamton closed his eyes and casually pointed in a direction. After all, this street was full of restaurants, so no matter what, it wouldn't be bad: "Then let me select a [shop location]." ”
You nodded as if it were only natural: "You're a hero too—fine, then today I'll eat whatever you choose. But let's be clear, tomorrow it's my choice." ”
Spamton nodded without objection, and you glanced in the direction he pointed, your expression a bit subtle. Hearing you remain silent for a while, Spamton opened his eyes and followed your gaze, then noticed that the direction of his finger happened to be the Cyber BBQ Restaurant.
Spamton fell silent. To be honest, he couldn't guarantee he wouldn't run into old friends at this shop, nor could he guarantee anything else would happen afterward. But since it was like this, and he hadn't tasted barbecue for a long time, he just said expressionlessly, "Yes, it's the location of this shop." ”
You hesitantly glanced down at Spamton, only to see him nod at you. You sighed and still carried Spamton into the cyber barbecue restaurant. Fortunately, there weren't many people around noon. You found a seat by the window and sat down, casually placing Spamton next to you. When he sat down, his head could only barely stick out of the table.
As a waiter, the Dark People quickly brought over the menu. After checking out what you wanted, you handed it to Spamton, then propped up your chin, looking at the restaurant's facilities with some boredom. As your gaze casually swept over, you noticed a table not far away—although your ability to recognize people was poor, you could still tell it was a table full of Addisons, and it seemed the pink one was the representative?
You weren't very clear about this, just lowered your head to look at Spamton, who was still seriously ordering, and quietly asked, "Your former colleagues are all sitting there. Want to move somewhere else?" ”
After all, Spamton's mood is more important, even though you prefer your current position.
Spamton also looked up, and the puppet's face seemed to have turned paler even more—well, he was already white, so you couldn't see any changes. You stared at Spamton, and he just shook his head: "No need for [Location: Transfer permissions]." ”
After all, although ...... He did avoid these guys a bit, or rather, had a certain fear, disgust, and anger, but he couldn't go on like this forever. Moreover...... Spamton knew that everything was no longer what it used to be.
You chose to respect Spamton's choice, so after ordering, you called the waiter to take the menu, and the Addisons at the table looked over at your call. When they saw Spamton, their expressions and bodies froze.
You nervously swallowed nervously, glanced at Spamton, and saw the little puppet flash a cocky grin, then flip the middle finger at the table of Addisons.
You choked up for no reason, then you saw that pink Addison seemed furious, wanting to rush over and beat Spamton or something. I wasn't sure if you were mistaken, but you felt the veins on his head bulge. The other Addisons stopped him, grabbing his arm to tell him not to act rashly. You seemed to hear some kind of persuasive voice.
You were speechless for two seconds and simply chose to cross your arms and watch the show. After all, it wasn't really your business—this was Spamton's previous lingering interpersonal relationship and dispute. Honestly, you didn't fully understand his personality.
You just saw that pink Addison also give Spamton the middle finger, and then your mouth twitched. You hummed softly twice and whispered to Spamton, "Eat your food properly! Stop doing such childish things." "As you spoke, you gently shoved him.

You pat your forehead, feeling a bit tired for some reason. Fortunately, the shop quiets down afterwards, and after you finish your meal, you leave the Cyber BBQ restaurant with Spamton.

After all, they still had to advertise everywhere, so of course they couldn't start fighting inside the store—at most, they'd handle it privately. That's why he did it on purpose.
So Spamton simply said softly, "No, they [absolutely won't] [fight loudly]." ”
"Then it's just like you said...... You're not right, aren't these guys waiting for us up ahead!" You whispered to Spamton, cursing because you saw those Addisons blocking the alley in the knife housing district. You skillfully picked up a discarded steel pipe from the ground and placed Spamton on your shoulder.
"Alright, then I'll just give you a good beating. I can finally get your revenge." You beamed with excitement, then swung the steel pipe at Addison opposite you. You didn't care about turn-based combat in this world; what did it have to do with you? You're not a game in real life. Addison on the other side clearly hadn't expected you to play completely against the rules. After all, turn-based combat doesn't follow these rules. Then you knocked Addison on the neck, and out of kindness, you only knocked them out.
Then you casually tossed your hair, tossed the pole to the floor, and took big strides to walk forward. But before you could take two steps, you felt someone grab your pant leg. Impatiently, you glanced down and saw it was still the pink Addison. You patiently stopped, ready to hear what last words he had left. At the same time, you felt an itch to grab the pole from earlier.
And Addison just trembled as he gave Spamton another middle finger, then collapsed again without saying a word. You looked speechlessly at Spamton on his shoulder, but he just gave you an innocent glance. You sighed, brushed the nonexistent dust off your palm, and this time you really took Spamton and strode away.
By the way, you complained to him: "I told you to provoke those guys...... Now look, you still have to put in effort to make them submit. If it were only you, what would you do? This time, it's all thanks to me." ”
Spamton's demeanor was unusually obedient, making you hesitate and turn to look at him twice, but he simply said, "It's precisely because I know of your existence that I'm willing to step into the unknown." ”
It's precisely because he knows you're here, and that you won't let things unfold, that's why he does it.
You paused for a moment, because his words made you a bit embarrassed. You cleared your throat twice, scratched your head, then turned your head away and whispered, "Oh dear...... Alright, I get what you mean. You're right. I really wouldn't just leave you alone. "Of course, you wouldn't go causing trouble on your own initiative.
As you spoke, you cleared your throat seriously: "Alright, I plan to go back to the Light World first. I think my wish has already come true...... Do you need to go check somewhere? …… Maybe it's not for any special reason. Although they're stingy materially, it's not a bad treatment. "Your wish should have come true too...... I'm not sure either, but as long as it's a good thing, that's enough." You whistled out an off-key whistle and put away your phone. Honestly, you have nowhere else to go in the Light World, so it's better to take Spamton back to the Dark World.

You blink, a beat late, remembering that Spamton was talking about what happened in the game world. After all, those game worlds should have happened in the real world of light, so you still looked up those events in the order of the game world, since you were also somewhat curious about the outcome of those events.
You first looked up information related to the first world. After a long time, you only remembered the [Forest Murder Case] and something like that, but quickly came to the conclusion: [Thanks to the efforts of all the tourists, the serial murder case at the forest tourist resort has been officially closed. The police have uncovered the truth and learned that it is related to a recent wrongful conviction. The case has now been overturned, and the culprit will be punished......]
You blink, thinking this might be a good outcome, so you start looking into the second case...... Here, I remind everyone to have a compassionate heart and not to be evil or greedy......]
You exhaled and instinctively met Spamton's gaze on your shoulder. Although your names weren't on either case, you knew these were the gifts the world left behind after you completed the side quest.
You swallowed hard. Honestly, the third case should exist in an impossible future, so you didn't know what to search for. You just looked up the name of that research institute. Fortunately, you still remembered it.

[Shocking! A research member from a certain research institute actually conducted unauthorized research on the zombie virus without approval of the report application, causing multiple deaths and mutations into monsters! ]
You look at the monster pictures you posted and they really are the ones you defeated back then in the post-apocalyptic world.
Looking further down, you were eager to know what happened next.
[Fortunately, a member of the research institute discovered the cure for the zombie virus, saving the besieged institute, and even the entire world! The involved researchers have been apprehended and are awaiting further investigation...]
You exhaled and felt somewhat relieved. Although your names did not appear and everything was erased, you had truly done something to save the world, and at this moment, you felt happy about it.

[It is rumored that in the 17th century, angels descended to the world and released those 'witches' who were imprisoned and hopelessly awaiting death. The subsequent witch hunts ceased, reducing casualties, but the losses that had already occurred remained. Luckily, due to the immediate halt of the witch hunts, the visibly observable crop and meat harvests that year were higher than in previous years...]
You sighed in relief. Although not everyone had been saved, it seemed that the outcome was actually quite good.
So you confidently searched for the next item. You hesitated a bit, but in the end, you typed in the name of this hotel.
You opened the most sensational news.
[Public opinion conflict and war broke out! Revealed truths about a certain hotel sparked public outrage. The police have apprehended all involved personnel inside the hotel, but the disseminator of the information has not yet been found...]
When you got to this part, you swallowed hard and tapped your forehead. 'Oh no, I forgot to switch to a different account when sending the message back then.'
Including the second-to-last event, you also used your own account.
Spamton said nothing; he simply picked up the phone and typed in the name of XX company, which was your penultimate world.
You saw the latest report stating that the girl's father has been convicted of a crime and has been taken away for processing, while the person who posted the case still hasn't been found. The same person was at the previous hotel.
You cleared your throat: "I should register a new account...... and Spamton nodded in agreement.
'I can [provide help], [your] new account will have no connection to the [information disseminator],' he added.
You nodded, naturally agreeing: 'Alright, I’ll leave it to you.' Saying that, you took the phone back, hesitated for a moment, and finally entered your parents’ names.
There was all sorts of chaotic content, but nothing related to that case, and you smiled with relief, as all this had not yet actually happened.
By now, it was almost evening, and the moon was slowly rising. You put away your phone and stretched: "Alright, since you're in the world of light, come have dinner with me, then let's go to school together...... Maybe I can get you a diploma or something, but this year's recruitment period is already over, probably next year...... You muttered as you made plans, while Spamton just listened quietly.
Suddenly, he glanced at the sky and then said to you, '[The moonlight is beautiful tonight].'
You were momentarily stunned and instinctively looked up at the night sky, then wondered aloud, 'What, there aren’t any monsters falling from the moon either, what are you talking about?'
But today's moon was indeed beautiful—big and round. Thinking this, you naturally said, "But today's moon is indeed big and round, and tonight's moonlight is truly beautiful." "You don't have much education. If your classical prose skills were a bit higher, you would have written poetry based on the moonlight."
You hear Spamton sigh, so you look at him in confusion, then at the moon. Suddenly, you somewhat understand what he means—you just remember that someone across the East once said this as a subtle confession, and it spread widely. But at first, of course, you didn't react, since unless you spoke to you directly, you wouldn't realize it.
So you stroked your chin, hesitated at Spamton, and then said, "So what you actually mean is...... Are you saying you love me? "It seems there can't be any other meaning besides that."
Spamton nodded: "Of course." He didn't dwell on it too much, since if you really didn't understand...... He actually had no choice but to wait until one day you suddenly had an epiphany.
You nod blankly: "Uh, alright, I love you too, but why are you repeating this now...... Is it because everything has settled, so you want to confirm it again? ”
You hear him sigh again, and you scratch your head, unable to figure out what you've misunderstood this time.
"No, I just want to repeat 'I love you' again, 'That's all.'" You can't see his expression clearly; you just hear his voice in the night. It seems that as the night shifts, his voice also becomes somewhat elusive—after all, the neon lights happened to flicker at that very moment.
For some reason, you suddenly feel that if he couldn't reach the world of light today, he wouldn't repeat that sentence, and might even try to do the same thing as before...... Taking a gamble seems both clever and foolish. You look down at him for a moment, then suddenly pick him up, then hold him up and meet your gaze.
"Mm-hmm...... I love you too. Although I don't know if my feelings for me at this moment will change in the future, if they do, I'll tell you. Well, maybe this is something you don't expect to happen. "You mutter, after all, you've seen his expression change—you always feel like his smile has disappeared.
So you cleared your throat twice and decided to skip the topic for now: "Alright, let's not talk about that—are you planning to return to the Dark World first, or find a place to live in the Light World?" To be honest...... The rental for the Dark World apartment is still a long time away, and I really can't bear to part with it...... You muttered to yourself, counting on your fingers, suddenly realizing that less than half a year had passed since this trip, yet you felt as if you had already lived a lifetime. Or rather, you felt that what you've experienced over these six months is far richer than anything you've ever experienced before. Of course, including this little puppet in your hand. Before this, you never imagined that you might have any story with the salesman you once met in the Dark World—it would be a romantic one.
"That [house lease] can [provide refund services]." Spamton said. Actually, he probably didn't care where he actually lived; after all, in the Dark World, there wasn't much worth holding onto...... He was still considered a Dark Citizen, only able to use his body in the Dark World to enter and exit the Light World. In fact, he didn't understand the game system, or rather, how the Heaven Wishing Machine managed it, but he didn't regret his current fate.
You nodded, glanced at Spamton again, and asked again, "So you plan to live with me in the world of light?" ”
"Maybe it will be quite helpful for your [Adult University academic questions]?" He wasn't entirely sure, so this was just a question.
But you burst out laughing: "No, I can go to school in any environment...... Oh, and I have to remind you to sign up, but how do you solve your ID issue? You're basically entering illegally now...... You started muttering this, starting to worry. Spamton was silent for a moment, then touched his own pocket. Though he said it was a pocket, only the pocket of his jacket was worth looking at, and he really did pull out a driver's license from inside.
Above, it still neatly wrote his name: SPAMTON G. SPAMTON.
Not only that, but there were even birth dates, issuance dates, and resident numbers. You glanced at the documents, and sure enough, they weren't fake. You stroked your chin and nodded, "Alright, then there's no problem...... But it's too late today. Tomorrow we'll go check out the house and rent it. Since there's nothing to move in anyway, let's just go on a big shopping spree! ”
Besides, you still have to attend class first, so you don't have time to deal with anything else. Fortunately, the teacher just thought Spamton was a doll or something and didn't interfere. You took Spamton to class all night, and he was so frustrated pretending to be a well-behaved doll in your arms.
After class, you took Spamton back to the Dark World. You were already very tired, and after a quick wash and tidying up, you hugged Spamton and lay down on the bed. Half-awake, you heard Spamton in his arms ask you a question.
"If you didn't have the [Heaven Wishing Machine], what would you do?"
You think he's just asking what he already knows, but you still yawn and force yourself to answer: "What's there to talk about...... As for me, I was probably just struggling in society, working hard to earn some money, and then one day I couldn't help but fall out with my family. That's all there is to it." "But you probably wouldn't kill anyone...... So, it was probably just your brother framing you, but you actually don't have any hope of surviving yourself.

——
In short, luckily you rented a place, otherwise you really wouldn't know where to go after storming out of the hotel. You absolutely won't return to the world of light; you don't want to see your parents again...... You also don't want to face that possible blind date. These are things you absolutely don't want to go back. Maybe you're just sulking, maybe one day you'll understand your parents, but it definitely won't be now.
As for Spamton...... You don't want to think of him for now. Honestly, although you still can't help but think of that name, even though you subconsciously recall his face and all those related memories, of course, now all that's left is beautiful nostalgia. Even when you hear a similar tone, you always think of his name.
Now he had become the one you wanted to forget. You stormed back to the rented apartment, slammed yourself onto the bed viciously, rolled a few times, looked at the ring on your hand, pulled it out with anger and sadness, and threw it against the wall. Honestly, you don't even know what you're doing. All you can do is watch the innocent ring clatter to the floor, the pink gem still reflecting.
After hesitating for a moment, you picked up the ring and put it in your pocket, planning never to look at it again.
Never again.
In the following week, you visited the same band again. The band's leader warmly welcomed you, and your performance was very well received. Gradually, besides Spamton's contact info, you had several pages of contact numbers on your phone, and you buried his contact information at the bottom.
You arranged a set of lyrics for the orchestra, and after being invited, performed it with other instruments. Listening to the lead singer's elegant and soaring melody and the vibrant timbre, you felt your life was thriving.
Clearly, your fame isn't just because you're a citizen of light, but also because your music is popular. Your songs have a unique charm that immerses you in the music, and every performance ends with thunderous applause.
Although you have gained fame, you don't need it. You often wonder if you should continue living in this state, since you clearly aren't happy right now. Maybe one day you'll think you've always been happy, just never realized it before. But at least not now.
You just plan to devote your life to this music career now, because you have no other desires. If there's anything in this world that makes you love more and invest more emotionally, it is probably music. Although you entered university with this feeling in mind, unfortunately, you don't have much talent and can't compare to those prodigies. So even if you're being praised now, you don't think you're incredibly strong; you're just striving upward.
In short, you're currently thinking about an opera, or a musical, that works too...... You don't know what to write or have a fixed theme yet, so you might need to start with the necessary plot and songs......
You absentmindedly ponder this question, not knowing where you're headed. Anyway, when you come to your senses, you find yourself in a remote alley with a trash bin in front of you.
You're confused—this is clearly a remote alley, so why is there a trash bin here? Could it be because the area ahead is more bustling? If you think about it this way, you can understand.
But there wasn't much to see in this place, and the dark places didn't make it easy for you to keep thinking. So you planned to turn and leave. But as you turned, you heard rustling sounds behind you. Instinctively, you got goosebumps, feeling like there were ghosts behind you. Even though you told yourself there were lights ahead and there was nothing to fear, and it wasn't pitch black and you couldn't see anything—that would be scary. But you couldn't help but glance behind you to make sure there was nothing there. Only after seeing the trash bin placed there did you catch your breath.
Luckily, there was nothing...... Wait, could the sound actually come from the trash bin? Could it be that the trash bin has become a spirit?
You were startled by your suspicion and simply turned around and backed away. Soon after, you heard sounds coming from the garbage heap—rustling sounds, accompanied by the clattering of bells.
Swallowing hard, you feel a bit scared—more like you're getting more and more afraid. But you also feel curious, because you firmly believe that if you go see what is making the sound, once you learn the true form of this unknown fear, you won't be afraid anymore.
So you hesitate, your inner scale calculating, thinking about what to do.
In the end, you steeled yourself and decided to get closer for a closer look—not just out of curiosity, but because you didn't want to scare yourself anymore. So you decided to reveal the answer and confirm what it really was.
You walk forward, open the lid of the trash bin, and deliberately step back two paces to make sure no shadow or shadow suddenly jumps out to startle or attack you, then you dare to look inside.
You fell silent because there was actually a little thing rummaging through the trash bin. Well, so you were just picking up trash. Then you wouldn't be scared, since everyone has their own ambitions, and everyone has their own way of living. After all, everyone chooses different paths......
Muttering something, you planned to close the trash bin lid and leave, and you did do close the lid and leave, ignoring the sudden stiffness of that little thing.
But after a few steps outside, you belatedly recall the familiar feeling you just felt—mainly because the hairstyle looked familiar, and you kept feeling like you had just seen something in the blink of an eye.
After hesitating for a moment, you stopped, took out your phone, and found the number you had deliberately hidden at the bottom—now marked with an *. You knew it was Spamton's phone number.
You glanced toward the trash bin again before dialing the phone. Sure enough, after a while, you heard the phone ringing from inside the bin. Alright, now you're sure who that little thing really is.
For some reason, you just feel both angry and amused. Of course, your previous anger can't just disappear overnight. If you're angry at his deception, don't make decisions on your own under the guise of thinking of you or for your own good, even sacrificing yourself. You don't need anyone to make sacrifices for you at all, and in the end, they use that sacrifice to hold you hostage.
Of course, you also know that he probably doesn't want to morally blackmail you; he might just want to make you angry, make you completely forget, and make you ignore him.
…… But even so, you can't completely forget. How could the emotions piled up in your heart be completely forgotten with just a few words? How could just a few days of time wear them down? In short, you look at that quiet, lifeless trash bin, hang up the unanswered phone, then take a deep breath and walk toward the bin, open it, and pull this dirty, messy little thing out by the back of your neck.
You looked down at him from above, and at that moment noticed he had put the yellow gemstone ring on the ring finger of his left hand. Although you didn't really know what it meant, you just had a strange feeling. Anyway, you calmed your breathing and tried hard to keep your voice calm: "So, is this the reason you said you wanted to end the hookup relationship?" ”
You actually want to laugh a little, but for some reason, at this moment, you feel tears streaming down your cheeks. What exactly does this sadness mean? You don't know either.
Spamton's glasses blocked his emotions, and his voice had become hoarse, always giving people goosebumps: "I [thought] we were no longer [friends]." ”
“…… It's okay to start being friends again now." You cleared your throat twice, put the little thing on the ground, and took out the ring from your pocket that you had promised never to see again. Then you put it on the ring finger of your left hand, shaking it a little.
"Alright, we're still friends now. Let's go...... Well, that doesn't mean I've forgiven you. I just feel there's still room for things to change. "You added again.
Of course, you feel that this little thing looks at you with a complicated expression, but you don't mind. Because you dislike how slow he walks, you simply grab him by the back of the neck and start walking again. Soon, you're back at your current rental apartment, and then you throw him into the bathroom.
"Take a shower...... Change clothes, and eat...... You can do these yourself, I won't worry about you, I have other things to do...... You muttered, closed the bathroom door, and continued sitting at your desk. In fact, you had your latest burst of inspiration, and you urgently needed to record all those ideas right now. So of course, you couldn't care about Spamton's situation anymore.
By the time you finally record all these inspirations and string them together with notes, and take your attention away from the score with satisfaction, more than two hours have passed. Only then do you realize you're a bit hungry and hurriedly glance back...... Uh, Spamton is sitting on the sofa, staring at your back.
You scratched your head and took a closer look. After all, you knew your current residence didn't have suitable clothes, so now you could see clearly—this was like a shirt piled up under your wardrobe.
…… Hmm, actually you remember there were some blankets and the like on top, but with his current height, it seems he can't reach them. Alright then.
"I'll just make some dinner...... You just stay here...... You muttered twice as you walked toward the kitchen, took out butter steak and pasta from the fridge, made two servings of steak with black pepper on the plate, and a big bowl of pasta with ketchup. Then you took them out and placed them on the dining table. You watched as Spamton climbed onto the chair across from you, but your head barely sticks out of the table.
You rub your chin and pause for two seconds: "Maybe...... Let me see if there's anything else...... You walk away on your own, and soon return, holding two cushions, then you call Spamton down.
You watched him climb down from his seat, and after putting on the cushion, you picked up Spamton and nodded in satisfaction.
"Mm, that's good enough. But I'm too lazy to cook, so this is usually the only way. I'll just make do." Actually, your parents had specially trained you in cooking before. Even though you got hurt countless times in the kitchen, you still managed to cook well. But you really didn't want to spend time on that. With that time, you could write a few more graceful notes.
The dinner was very quiet because you were daydreaming, thinking about what to do next in your score, while Spamton kept hesitating, probably wondering whether to tell you.
It wasn't until you were almost done eating and saw Spamton that you finally remembered what you'd prepared to say earlier. So you cleared your throat and sat up straight: "Ahem, I won't ask about what happened before...... I'm not really curious. Since you never intended to tell me before, I probably don't want to tell you now, so I won't ask. But since we're friends, I still hope you can tell me about your troubles and the difficulties you've faced. Maybe I can find a way. Of course, you don't need to feel guilty here now. After all, when I was in the Dark World, I spent all your money, right? So let's just treat it as ...... Hmm, repay? Besides, we're friends, so there's no need to worry about this money. ”
Spamton hesitated for two seconds, and only answered when he met your gaze, which, though not very urgent, was still filled with genuine anxiety: "...... Yes, we'll always be [friend added]. Maybe I won't [hide] it anymore. ”
You just waved your finger: "Not maybe, it's definitely. I hope you remember this, otherwise you might as well leave now. I'm telling the truth." ”
“…… Then, [definitely]. This time, he answered immediately.
You nodded in satisfaction, seemingly without any objections. So after finishing dinner and tidying up the dishes, you simply sat down at the desk holding Spamton.
Come on, your sheet music isn't even finished yet. Your chin rested on Spamton's head, staring blankly at the sheet music in front of you. Honestly, you got a bit stuck, probably because you didn't have lyrics. But after sorting out your thoughts, you finally decided how you should write it.
Spamton seemed stiff too. He hadn't expected you to do that. He thought he'd just keep sitting on the sofa, staring blankly at your back. But now, he's fine—he's working with you in your arms, but he can't read the sheet music at all, so he can't offer any suggestions for you.
You didn't care about all that, or rather, when you got absorbed in the score, you got so excited that you forgot that Spamton was actually in your arms. In short, after working for another two or three hours, you finally snapped out of this state, instinctively cleared your throat, and then collapsed onto the bed holding Spamton.
You look at the ceiling and mutter, "Alright...... It's time to sleep......
Then you roll over, curl up, and hold Spamton in your arms. Honestly, this position feels very reassuring, because it lets you feel the emptiness in your heart being filled. A few days ago, you barely fell asleep hugging a pillow, but now you don't need one anymore. Soon, you've fallen into a light, drifting dream.
Spamton glanced at you, was silent for a moment, then closed his eyes and fell asleep in your arms.
Until dawn.
You tell Spamton you have to go to the orchestra, and he can just stay inside the house. He'll probably be back around dinner time, and today he has some work to handle. After saying that, you take the draft of the score and head out. You show the director the draft with great enthusiasm.
In the end, you decided to create a musical, since opera tends to be a bit too high and sparse. Although it still has an audience, musicals are much more mainstream. The director praised your first draft, then noticed the ring on your hand and hesitated for a moment to ask about your recent relationship status.
You hesitated for a moment and said you had just made up with a friend you had a previous fight with. The organizer just nodded and said nothing more, but you noticed that after that, it seemed that all the musicians and collaborators with you were women. Although you didn't understand exactly what had happened, you were still very happy.
Of course, you still got home as promised, right at dinner time, just a few minutes later than expected.
You close the door, pondering what to do for lunch today, only to hear Spamton ask you a question: "[You] plan to [anchor here] and never [return]?" If you [anchor] for a long time, perhaps darkness will [drown] the light. ”
You thought for a moment and easily understood that he was asking if you didn't plan to return to the Light World, so you just shrugged: "Stay here and never go back...... Of course, I intend to do that, and I can only do it. Going back is meaningless; I just want to leave there. Are you saying the world will be destroyed like this? Even if the world becomes pitch black, even if the world is destroyed because of it, I don't care. If the world is destroyed, so be it! ”
"Actually, I've already planned how to live with you, and I've already figured out what else I can do in this world. If you want to leave my side...... Where would I have a place to belong in this world? Whose side can I keep breathing steadily and experience what it feels like to be alive again? Then I'd rather die. "You crouched in front of Spamton and whispered.
"—So, if the world is destroyed, so be it! Maybe we'll get to see a nice fireworks show. ”
As he said this, the dark street lit up, and outside the window, fireworks lit up, reaching high into the sky before blooming, illuminating your faces in and out of the light.
End.
