This is an extra chapter to the hookup relationship story, part of an if-line, purely self-created content. Anyway, I enjoyed writing it, and I like this YN (?).
——
You hugged a few books and a stack of sheet music, muttering to yourself as you walked forward in the hallway, lost in thought. You were still worried about how the piano lesson would turn out—you had never been good at this, and could only barely keep up with the pace, playing music like everyone else, but the teacher was always dissatisfied and said there was no emotion in your music.
…… Honestly, you're troubled by what the teacher is talking about emotion. You are already very invested and prepare every performance with care, but every time it ends up like this. Violin lessons are better, but the teacher often says that if you have mastered the technique but lack emotional investment, the piece becomes just a magnificent shell.
The more you think about it, the more you start to zone out, recalling the sheet music you just got familiar with yesterday, to the point that you bump into someone without even noticing—you don't even realize there's someone ahead!
You let out an 'ouch' and slammed down the ground, your first reaction being to apologize: "I'm really sorry...... I didn't see the road clearly. I didn't notice someone ...... ahead."
Of course, books and sheet music are scattered on the floor, and you're frustrated that you'll have to spend a long time cleaning up next, especially since class isn't going to be long before.
"It's okay." When you hear his voice, for some reason, it feels strange—overall, it doesn't sound like a normal person's tone.
So you can't help but look up at him...... Your first reaction is, why is this person so fair-skinned? The second is, oh, maybe he's not really human? You accept this well, since there are plenty of odd-looking people anyway.
"Anyway, I still have to apologize. I've really caused you trouble, wasted your time, and wasted your energy...... Ah, I don't need your help picking it up! I'll do it myself!" You were just about to stand up from the ground, still mumbling about to apologize. This is the phrase you often use to apologize—if you make someone unhappy, you apologize.
I just don't know why someone's expression changed after hearing your apology.
Before you could finish speaking, you saw him picking up the scattered sheet music for you, and he didn't forget to reach out a hand, probably waiting for you to help him stand up.
To be honest, against the light, you can't really see the expression on his face, so you hesitate.
His hand was still there, not withdrawing just because you hadn't moved, only adding, "I already said it's okay." And I should [apologize] too. I also didn't notice that [you] were [moving]. ”
You were stunned, hesitated for a moment, then took his hand and stood up, then bowed earnestly: "Ah...... Alright, thank you! Sorry to trouble you to pick up the sheet music, so I'll do it myself......"
"The [distance] and [class start time] are very close? I think [you] need [help]. "But he said this.
Indeed, if you pick up each sheet yourself, you'll definitely be late and have to apologize to the teacher...... So after hesitating for a while, you don't refuse and just join in picking up the sheet music.
"Alright, then thank you so much! It's just a pity I probably can't do much for you, so I can only say thank you verbally......
After picking up the sheet music, you glanced at the time—there were only two minutes left until class! You only had time to wave to him and hurried off to the classroom.
In fact, you might have thought it was just a minor episode that you could soon forget about.
She just didn't expect to see him again in a few days.
That day, you were eating in the school cafeteria. The food was cheap, affordable, generously portioned, and tasted good. It was always crowded, almost overcrowded. You finally managed to get a quiet spot against the wall early and no one disturbed you. Happy to relax, you simply ate there. In fact, you usually came here before, unless sometimes classes ended late and there were no seats left by the time you arrived.
You are immersed in your own world, lost in your own thoughts, thinking about the assignments for the arrangement class, wondering what kind of score to write to satisfy the teacher, when you hear the crisp clatter of a plate hitting the table.
Subconsciously, you lifted your head. You noticed that the person opposite you had first put down a plate. You felt a bit strange—would anyone actually come to such a secluded place? Soon, you realized a bit belatedly that if all the other tables were full, then it would indeed make sense for someone to come over, and the seat opposite you happened to be empty. However, most people wouldn't just want one vacant seat, because they usually come in pairs; few people would be alone like you.
Putting down the fork, you look up and realize that the person sitting across from you is the one you've met once before.
You scratched your head, feeling a bit embarrassed. In this situation, you didn't know what to say. You preferred being alone, and in this situation, you just wanted to finish your meal and leave—after all, there weren't many bites left.
"Can I sit here? There are no other available seats." You heard him say.
You quickly nodded, "Sit down, sit down, do as you please, I'll be leaving soon." ”
You feel the smile on his face seems to fade a little, which makes you feel a bit strange.
"In fact, I don't [mind] [you] sitting here. I hope [you] don't [mind] either." He added.
You scratched your head awkwardly; since he said so, you actually felt a bit embarrassed to leave. You even started to feel a bit resentful—if he hadn't said anything, you could have left happily right now.
But you still sat still, exhaling deeply and comforting yourself, "Alright, I...... I'm fine! But you can leave later. It's better to sit a bit after eating, which is better for your stomach......
"In fact. I think maybe we can [swap] [contact information]? Our [Academy] usually ends classes [later than usual], so I hope we can ...... [table sharing]? ”
"On the other hand, if there is an opportunity, I will help you secure the table. Maybe this would be a reasonable deal."
But before you could calm yourself down, you heard him rambling on a long string of words, speaking very fast, leaving you stunned, but you still understood what he meant.
So you point to this table: "Is this the seat?" ”
The other party nodded.
You never asked why he didn't ask others for help. There must be other friends, right? You consider yourself very respectful of others' privacy, so naturally you won't pry around.
After hesitating for a while, you still feel tempted. After all, sometimes having nowhere to sit or only sitting in lively places is really uncomfortable. Compared to that, just tolerating another breath from across the street is acceptable......
So in the end, you nodded heavily and added, "It's possible, but if I'm not satisfied, then this deal will be canceled...... By the way, which college are you from? ”
"[School of Media]."
You nodded knowingly. No wonder, you've heard that the class scheduling at this academy is pretty crazy. And no wonder they managed to organize a string of language that sounds quite reasonable so quickly...... At least you can't find anything to criticize.
In any case, you exchanged contact information. You had never asked his name before, but now you finally knew—his name was Spamton. Besides that, you compared class schedules and were surprised to find that your schedules hardly overlapped: when he had class, you were free, and when you had class, he happened to be available. So reserving a table… seemed feasible.
With a worried heart, you decide to check the situation first.
Unexpectedly, things actually went quite well. At first, you felt a bit uncomfortable, because you were used to eating alone. Now, with Spamton sitting across from you, you had to adjust to his presence.
…… Fortunately, he's very quiet, and when we eat together, he doesn't make any other noises. This actually makes you forget about his presence, and when you look up and see him again, you'll only realize it belatedly, and then you start to feel a bit guilty.
Always being this quiet doesn't seem like a good thing...... You sometimes think this way, but you really enjoy this quiet and don't want to break it for now. You find that having others by your side feels pretty good; even without speaking, it sounds good.
So you don't want to speak for now. But sometimes, when the teacher scolds you too harshly, you sit there feeling depressed, with your fork stuck in your food, and you lose your appetite for a while.
After a while, Spamton finally sat down across from you. Seeing your movement, he couldn't help but ask, "Aren't you going to [eat]?" In this way, [food] might not be able to [eat]. ”
You were a bit slow to realize that Spamton had come. Thinking that he wasn't actually your classmate, just a familiar stranger, and that chatting casually was fine without worrying too much, you mumbled and spoke up: "It's nothing, really. I just don't feel like eating. At worst, I'll buy a bread from the convenience store later… sigh, I lost my mood to eat because the teacher scolded me, which is normal."
“…… No matter what you do, eating on time should be a good choice. ”
You shrugged and stopped what you were doing: "Ah, I know. Thanks for the reminder." But I was very frustrated. Even though I had tried so hard, the teacher was always dissatisfied, saying my music lacked emotion and wasn't up to standard......
"Perhaps, you could experience your emotions alone?" suggested Spamton.
You nervously looked up at him, then lowered your head again: "...... In fact, maybe I really don't have much emotion, because to avoid excessive sadness, I almost sealed away all those feelings. ”
If you want to express emotion, originally cheerful music will overflow with sadness, and you don't want that to happen. At least you think it's better to preserve the original beauty of music.
“…… Maybe [you] can [consider] and show [sadness]? Maybe I can [help] you [bear] it. "You heard him say that.
Looking up at his expression, you were sure he wasn't lying. After hesitating for a moment, perhaps the familiar identity of a stranger made it easy for you to speak, so you couldn't help but pour out your complaints.
You talk about things at home, saying you followed their demands to win their favor, that you resolutely applied for university majors, but you find that studying is still very tough; As you talk, you recall details of what your parents once said, the fear and grievances you once felt. Even now, when you recall those things, you still feel wronged and sad, and as you speak, tears uncontrollably flow from your eyes, accompanied by sobs.
But emotions keep changing, sadness isn't complete, and the crying isn't satisfying—sometimes you speak with a sobbing tone, sometimes you calm down. But when it's over, you'll find your emotions are still calm, and the previously sealed inspiration seems to flow back again.
Spamton just quietly listened, and after you had finished speaking, he finally smiled: "Now, we should celebrate your survival."
You nodded blankly, wiped away the tears dripping from your eyes, and quickly finished lunch—after all, you still had to rush to class.
By the time piano class came in the afternoon, the teacher surprisingly noted that your music carried an extra layer of emotion. Although it was merely a melancholy tone, it was even more touching. You realized this really helped… and you felt a bit restless.
After all, they're just familiar strangers, so it doesn't matter what else you say. You comfort yourself like this.
In the following period, you gradually became friends. You would complain about family issues, and the new messages from your parents would make you uncomfortable. Occasionally, you would vent about troubles in class or worry about how to complete the next assignment. Sometimes, you would share interesting things you saw, whether it was cats and dogs on the street, oddly shaped clouds, or a new idea that came to mind. You would record these and send them to Spamton.
Maybe you treat his chat window as a memo...... But is that really okay? After hearing it, he won't blame you; he'll even give you suggestions. You think that's enough and don't expect more. Of course, all the messages you send get serious replies, even if it's just meaningless venting. Later, you notice he also posts all sorts of messy stuff to send you.
In short, you have become very good friends! At least, that's what you think, but you don't dare to ask—what if they don't treat you as a friend? That would make you very sad. You don't want to give so much and only to find out you're just a stranger in their life.
Later, the teacher said that the pieces you played became more lively, which was a good thing, and she was pleased for you. You still didn’t really know where the emotions in your music came from, but you felt that perhaps having Spamton, the friend you considered, had made you feel lighter all over.
However, before you know it, those years pass in the blink of an eye, and you graduate too.
You were still fantasizing about your future work, wondering what kind of music to write next, but when you got home, you received terrible news.
Your parents decide to arrange blind dates for you because they believe girls should get married at this age and find someone to rely on; otherwise, it will be harder to go on.
Honestly, you dislike getting married, and even feel a bit reluctant. You think marriage is unhappy, and of course, so-called romance is the same, so you never considered this arrangement before...... You just didn't expect your family to say that.
However, to satisfy your parents, you still compromised and agreed.
Only when meeting Spamton did you inadvertently complain: "My family insists on setting me up on blind dates, saying this is definitely a very good match. After meeting, they expect us to get married in a short time. How annoying—I don’t want to marry… Just thinking about marrying a complete stranger makes me instinctively scared…"
You raised your milk tea cup and took a big sip, not noticing that Spamton’s hands, which had been resting together, suddenly clenched, with veins bulging.
He only wore a smile and said, "Maybe...... "Could you [know] the exact wedding date for me then?" ”
“…… Of course you can. I'll tell you when the time comes." You muttered, for some reason you felt a heavy weight in your heart, as if some emotion was falling away. Maybe you just misunderstood it, comforting yourself like this.
After that, you went through the blind date procedures arranged by your parents, prepared for the wedding, and set the date. When putting on the wedding dress, you didn’t quite feel used to it, but you still followed through and sent the schedule to Spamton as promised. He did not reply.
With a strange mix of melancholy and relief, you walked down the red carpet. The priest was about to give the opening words for the ceremony. You scanned the crowd below, but did not see Spamton, intensifying the strange feeling.
Just as you are preparing to face a boring and despairing life, suddenly you hear screams from the audience. Before you can see what is happening, you feel yourself lifted up and leave the red carpet and the stage where you were standing.
Honestly, at this moment, your mood unexpectedly became lighter. This subconscious lightness was something you had only felt beside Spamton. When you looked up, you realized Spamton was holding you as he ran out.
…… Ah, you realize what you call a wedding kidnapping? Although everything got chaotic, you couldn't help but smile from the heart, then hugged him tightly and buried your head beside his neck.
"I'm truly grateful to you, but unfortunately, I probably can't do anything for you...... Otherwise, this time I'll hand me over to you. ”
End.

In short, your previously listless mood improved a bit.
Turning your head, you see a ...... At least someone who really does look like a person is standing there holding an umbrella, reaching out a hand toward you, probably signaling you to put it on it.
You hesitated for a moment, a bit uneasy: "Wouldn't that be too much trouble for you? I'll just wait here for the rain to stop, no need for you to see me off......"
…… And it's just a chance encounter—why help you? You can't help him at all, you have nothing to express gratitude with, and if he feels guilty if he feels indebted, it's better never to have ever done it at all.
So you just shake your head and put on a distant smile—well, maybe it's pretty stiff, since you're completely unused to smiling. Even though your parents often say you have to smile to make everyone happy and happy yourself, you've only learned to smile mechanically.
This is the first time you've tried to make a different expression. From the stiff corners of your mouth, you can sense that you have probably failed.
Spamton naturally noticed your somewhat stiff expression, but he said nothing, just continued reaching out his hand on his own: "It's not [troublesome], I'm very happy to [serve you]." ”
…… Even if you say that, what do you think in your heart? Maybe it's a different approach? Thinking this, you stared blankly at the hand he reached out, then at his still smiling face, tilted your head, and asked, "Uh...... Sir, we have never met. Why do you want to help me? Maybe there won't be any reward at all. ”
"I don't [need] [payment], nor do I have many [reasons]. I just [hope] to provide [help] to [you]." He was still very patient. In fact, he had thought you might be very cautious, and had thought you might reject him once or twice, but definitely not a third time. Spamton was still confident in this.
You take a deep breath and look seriously into his eyes this time, but you can't see them. He has his eyes closed, just squinting and smiling, so you can't tell what emotions he's really feeling. Or maybe you can't understand other people's emotions either.
“…… Then why me? "You murmured, to be honest, you don't know what answer would satisfy you, or maybe you just want to hear an answer. Whatever it is, it doesn't matter.
You hear him chuckle: "It's just because it's [you]." ”
You stopped speaking, but for some reason, tears slid down your eyes. You didn't intend to care anymore. Maybe this sudden downpour was just like your mood—sad and endless, you didn't know where to go, and you had nowhere to go.
…… Maybe you just want to be chosen once, or maybe you just want to know you still have a reason to stand here.
So in the end, you still held his hand and softly said, "Thank you for your trouble. ”
Watching the tears dripping down your cheeks, Spamton's throat swallowed again, and he could clearly hear the sound of swallowing. To be honest, he really wanted to kiss the tears on your cheeks, then kiss your lips, and then swallow everything—whether sweet or bitter, he would accept it with a smile. But he also knew he absolutely couldn't do that now, or else you'd definitely leave far away.
After hearing this, Spamton's smile deepened a little, becoming even more genuine. He always knew that it couldn't be more than three times, and you would still refuse this transaction...... No, this wasn't even a transaction, just a gift. As for the payment for the transaction, it was naturally repaid after the debt was owed.
"In that case, 'ladies first', I'll make sure [you] try not to be attacked by [Rain]." As he said this, he stretched the umbrella over your head, leaving most of his body exposed.
…… The suit can be changed later; what's more important now is the situation. He doesn't want to lose you in a flash and never find you again. It's better to seize the opportunity and make sure you remember him forever.
You looked blankly at the umbrella hanging over your head. To be honest, it was very small—even if just one person held it in such heavy rain, it would be a struggle, so you couldn't help but feel a bit guilty. At that moment, you saw that most of his body was exposed, and quickly pushed the umbrella toward him: "How can this be? If you keep getting wet, you'll get sick...... Besides, you helped out for free, so I shouldn't have let you get wet......
You're really embarrassed. If you hadn't already walked a distance, you'd want to run back under the eaves and just hold the umbrella for yourself.
"No, I'm serving you. As long as you're comfortable, that's all that matters." Of course, you didn't push the umbrella; you just shook it, and a string of raindrops poured down from the tip, soaking the clothes on his shoulder. You didn't dare move at all.
“…… Alright, then if you want to make me feel comfortable, I'm too embarrassed to see you get caught in the rain......" you whispered, then you saw only innocence in his eyes, and he didn't respond to your words. In any case, you hesitated for a moment, but still gritted your teeth and closed the distance between you.
You don't really like interacting with the opposite sex; it's just an instinctive aversion, but it's not impossible. So now, carrying that restless feeling, you keep the distance between you, and you feel your shoulders bumping into each other as you walk. To be honest, you're not used to this.
And although it had improved a bit, you could still see half of his body exposed. The rain was just a bit lighter than before, so it didn't look so scary.
“…… Why don't you just hold an umbrella by yourself? Just drop me off somewhere I can stand in the rain. I'm really sorry." You muttered as you spoke.
"[No need], I'll take you to an excellent [home]. And it's not [far]. It's just around the corner." And that's all Spamton said.
You hesitated for a moment. There really wasn't much place nearby to take shelter from the rain. This area was all brick walls, not a single eave, and you weren't familiar with the roads of the other world, so you didn't know if he was leading you to some remote road. But there were still cars passing by on the street, and you could see pedestrians passing by, so it was probably just a less busy street.
So in the end, you didn't continue. You just turned to look at him again, hesitated for a moment, and honestly, you thought of an idea, but you didn't know if you could do it. In the end, after hesitating for a moment, you still crawled in front of him, though it was a bit farther than when you were in your arms and close to your chest. You felt you couldn't do that, probably just a hint of intuition...... You didn't know what harm it would bring.
But now, maintaining that posture, your body feels a bit stiff, so you quicken your pace a bit, since you don't want to bump into his footsteps. The umbrella moves along your head, so now it covers both of you. You feel his hand lightly resting on your shoulder, probably not wanting to slip up all at once.
Maybe it was the inexplicable awkwardness, but in any case, both of you fell silent. No one spoke anymore, and you just quickened your pace and moved forward.
Spamton, on the other hand, only looked at the occasional exposure of the fair skin on your neck from your hurried steps, at the wet and transparent white skirt that had been stained by raindrops from earlier haste, his thoughts a bit confused. In the end, he chose to look away a little, otherwise all the heat would probably gather together.
I don't know how much time passed, maybe just a moment, but it was really close, because you were standing under the eaves, with a residence in front of you. Then you watched as Spamton took out his keys, opened the door in front of him, and gestured invitingly toward you.
…… So the perfect place he said was his home? But you really have nowhere else to go here, so you hesitantly walked in, standing at the doorway, then looked at Spamton, who was closing his umbrella: "Hmm...... May I ask your name? I really feel bad for getting wet because you got wet. Maybe someday I'll make it up to you......" your hand nervously clasped together.
"spamton.g.spamton, if you need [compensation service], maybe...... Add [Contact Information]? ”
You paused, a bit embarrassed to realize later. You don't have any phones in this other world.
So your voice grew even softer: "...... Ah, I don't have a phone." You feel like you're about to cry again, so you lower your head.
You feel his voice seem a bit closer to you: "Maybe I can [help] [you] [buy a phone]." ”
Tbc.

title: The Prequel to Buddy-in-the-Bath Relationship 2
path: articles/en/spt/我们是泡友关系 end/泡友关系前传2.html
content:
Sptx, you count OOC as me, it's a prequel, so it's still from the Big Guy era
——
You hesitated for a moment, looking at Spamton approaching you, a bit puzzled: "Hmm...... But sorry, I've already troubled you. Isn't it a bit inappropriate to spend your money again? And aren't you getting too close to me......
"I thought this was just a normal social distancing routine. Besides, this isn't a hassle. You're a Citizen of Light, and I'm happy to help you, that's all." His smile deepened a little. Even though he wasn't sure if you'd believe him, he still said it. In short, whether you accept it or not, it makes him seem flawless. Spamton believes he's done it perfectly.
You looked at Spamton with skeptical eyes, feeling like he was almost standing right in front of you. Holding the umbrella earlier was just a special occasion...... Although you weren't quite used to it, you could accept it. But now, maybe it's not really appropriate?
But if he says this...... To be honest, you haven't actually had any contact with other men, except when you're doing group assignments, so maybe that's normal?
You hesitate for a moment, accept this explanation, and only raise a new question: "People of Light?" Are you talking about me? What does that mean? ”
Seeing that you didn't raise any objections, Spamton understood you a bit better. Maybe when it comes to influencing you, all of this is actually quite easy. But now he was honest and took the initiative to help you explain: "This world is the [Dark World]. The source of your place is the [Light World]. The residents of the [Light World] where you are the [People of Light], and the inhabitants of the [Dark World] are the [People of Darkness]. ”
You nodded half-understandingly, half understanding, probably understanding it, but you still had some doubts: "So the Dark People need to help the Light Tribes?" Why? Aren't they just residents of two worlds? There shouldn't be any contact, right? ”
"Because the [People of Darkness] like to help the [People of Light] and are willing to provide services to them, so I like to help [you] and am happy to provide [services] to you. All of this is [free] and [free]." Spamton said.
Of course, saying this doesn't mean he's so willing to serve other people of light—to be honest, he believes that whether it's people of light or darkness, for him it's only mutually beneficial. If they can't be used, it's fine to turn a blind eye; if they can't provide value, then there's no need to offer convenience. But when it comes to you, what he says is true, because he is indeed willing to help you free of charge.
…… Of course, whether he will receive extra payment after this gratuitous payment is up to him. You don't need to know this; at this point, just be a little lamb kept in the dark.
You nodded thoughtfully. Although you understood what he meant, you still felt conflicted: "Although I'm happy to help, I think this is too much trouble for you, so maybe I can think of other ways......" Before he could finish, Spamton interrupted him.
"No, [no need], I'm more than happy to provide [help] to you, no matter when or where, regardless of [value]." That's what he said.
You hesitate, glance again at his wet suit, and finally close your eyes. In the end, guilt prevails: "Alright...... Alright, then could you please take me to buy a phone? Of course, I'll compensate you for the suit later, but it might take a while, because I have nothing in this world right now......
"[It's okay], I don't set normative restrictions on [time], so you can [as much as you want] delay." In fact, Spamton actually hoped you would keep holding onto debts and not pay them back, so you'd remember this matter and come back to him because you still owe something. Besides, this suit was nothing to him, so it didn't matter if you didn't pay compensation.
…… So in the end, you still don't remember to compensate for the suit—after all, so much time has passed, and you've long forgotten.
"Alright then...... Let's wait until the rain stops before heading to the phone shop. For now, I'll stand here for a while. "You scratched your hair a bit shyly. To be honest, your hair was a bit wet just now, so you still feel uncomfortable now. Plus, you only realized your clothes were getting soaked too.
"It's okay, my [room] has spare [shoes] and [clothes] for [you]." His voice was still smiling. Of course, Spamton couldn't say that the room was actually just his own clothes. He couldn't possibly prepare extra clothes for someone who was searching for him somewhere; today was purely a coincidence. At that moment, he saw you through the rain, and it was also at that moment that he felt his body's desire surge, his soul trembling, as if he was screaming inside that he had to do something.
“…… "This isn't a bit much, is it a hassle for you to take me to buy a phone? Now you want to change shoes or something......" Although she said this, she was still soaked, and the weather wasn't exactly hot, so you couldn't help but shiver.
"It's okay, I think you need a timely hot water service, and you should use the bathroom for timely rinsing." He looked you up and down, thinking about whether his words were wrong.
…… Based on your previous behavior, you probably lack common sense in this area, so you should have accepted what he said without much suspicion, just being overly cautious. But perhaps later you can tell that none of this can be done casually; it's just that things with him can be done casually, because no one will criticize you......
Perhaps, friends, you can establish such a relationship vocabulary. Spamton decides in a brief moment of thought what he should do, then continues to smile at you.
And as expected, you didn't suspect much, only hesitantly asking, "Wouldn't this be too much trouble for you?" ”
You really can't think of that much, since you've never experienced any of this before—this is just the first time. Maybe it's because you're too obedient and obedient, or maybe it's just pure fear. In any case, you haven't even had contact with any men. Even if you do occasionally, you usually run away when you get closer. You just can't stand that state.
…… But Spamton was an exception. Maybe it was his words that convinced you, or maybe the guilt he felt when he saw him still in his soaked suit, or maybe the gratitude from the experience of holding the umbrella earlier, and the moment your heart skipped a beat when you saw him walking toward you with the umbrella—in any case, you didn't really want to refuse him.
Besides, you really didn't catch any questions, so you hesitated for a moment, looking at him, your heart wavering, waiting for his answer.
Then you looked at him and shook your head. Only then did you exhale deeply and nod vigorously: "Mm, I'll go then. Thank you so much." As you spoke, you tried hard to force a smile, but then you realized you had definitely failed, since that smile was definitely ugly. But Spamton didn't say much, just smiled and nodded at you.
Only then did you relax, take small steps and run quickly, awkwardly tugging at a white shirt that could cover you completely, then run to the bathroom.
You took a proper hot shower and didn't change your underwear. You still felt embarrassed to leave these in someone else's house, but you changed out of the wet skirt and put on that white shirt that just covered your lower body. You tied up your freshly washed hair, and you searched to see if you found a hair dryer in the bathroom, so you opened the door and quietly asked, "Um...... I want to ask, where is your hair dryer?" ”
Spamton glanced over; you had just finished showering, your face still flushed. He swallowed again, then pointed you in the right direction and turned away without saying a word.
Although you were a bit puzzled as to why he hadn't said a word, you still politely thanked him, then took the hairdryer and walked back into the bathroom. Soon, a dull sound came from inside the closed door.
Spamton only pressed his face down, and he could feel it was a bit hot. In fact, when he heard the faint sound of water coming from the bathroom just now, although he tried hard to suppress his thoughts, he couldn't help but start recalling that scene. Moreover, he had just seen your flushed face poking your head out, probably still wearing his clothes...... So now he could only stare blankly through his fingers at the piece of fabric standing upright beneath him, then silently hoped to calm the restless feeling quickly, otherwise he wouldn't be embarrassed to turn to face you later.
You had no idea what Spamton was thinking. After blow-drying his hair, he walked out feeling refreshed, since his whole body was dry and warm now. Putting the hairdryer back down, you glanced out the window; the rain had eased a bit, but hadn't completely stopped.
You hesitated for a moment, then turned to Spamton: "Ah...... Looks like I'll probably stay at your place for a while longer? Do you mind? "You stammered, feeling a bit nervous.
Then you see Spamton turn around and smile at you: "Of course, I don't mind at all. As long as you're willing, you can wait as long as you want, and there's no problem." After all, I believe that we are friends. ”
You tilted your head. You probably know a bit about the word 'friend,' but you've never been a friend before, so you're a bit confused now: "...... friend?" "We're friends?" "You thought for a moment. You've only known each other for half a day, so does that count as friendship?"
Then you see Spamton nod affirmatively: "I [believe] we meet the [Definition: Friends], so I'm happy to provide [everything] for [you]. ”
"Oh, oh...... your mind is still a bit confused. Although you've heard about it, you haven't had friends before, so after a brief moment of confusion, this feeling turns into a pleasant surprise. So you nod happily, thinking you fully understand.
"I see, it's a friend! So, you're happy to help, and I enjoy your help?" "In fact, when you asked this question, you were a bit timid, since you weren't sure if you could understand it that way, and you thought it wasn't good to always trouble friends to help you solve problems.
But when you see Spamton nod firmly, you can't help but breathe a sigh of relief. Then you hear him add, "So, [you] don't [need] to continue using [honorifics]." ”
After thinking about it, you realize it makes sense, so you give up those vague honorifics: "Well, I think the rain will take a while before it stops. Can I sit on your bed for a while first?" ”
"Of course, no need to feel restrained." You hear his confident voice. Of course, for some reason, Spamton is sitting with his back to you.
Anyway, you let out a small cheer in your heart, then sat down on Spamton's bed. You hugged your knees, daydreaming, and after a while, your head slowly moved, your chin resting on your knee as you fell asleep.
When he heard your shallow breathing, Spamton lowered his voice. He just turned to glance at you, and with just one look, the part that had just calmed down stood up again. He cleared his throat gently, stood up, and walked over to you. You sat very close to the edge of the bed, so he could easily touch you.
But he just bent down, kissed your forehead, and then walked to another bathroom in the bedroom—the one you had just used in the living room. In short, it was probably to avoid waking you, or maybe simply to avoid sensing your presence.
Then he took a cold shower in the bathroom.
When he came out after changing clothes, he found you hugging your knees, lost in thought. You weren't sleeping very soundly, probably because it was an unfamiliar place, but you were still grateful for the spamton that gave you a brief rest.
Seeing Spamton come out, his previously confused mind finally restarted, and perhaps his previously empty and confused heart was filled once again. You don't know what it feels like.
Anyway, you hurriedly got out of bed and said urgently, "The rain has stopped. I'll change my clothes back first, let's go buy a phone." ”
Spamton responded softly, watching you run back into the bathroom. He even felt a bit regretful—why couldn't this rain last longer? Why not just last a day and night? That way, he could have kept you here forever.
End.

title: Casual Friends Relationship: Prequel 3

content:
But he just kept smiling, sitting there and nodding at you: "[Sure]." ”
…… You don't even know why you want to ask for his opinion. Thinking about it, it seems you don't really need to do that. Well, maybe it's because he's the owner of this room?
Anyway, you should quickly get to the bathroom and change into the dried skirt again.
After changing into your own clothes, you finally breathe a sigh of relief and completely relax. You walk out the door and look at him: "Alright, let's go out." ”
Spamton didn't dare look at you anymore. He just stood up with his back to you and walked toward the door, not even saying a word. Although you thought he was acting a bit strange, I'm afraid other beings might have some quirks or something, and you wouldn't disturb them. After all...... Parents always tell you to respect others' decisions, respect their thoughts, and not trouble others. If you must trouble others, you should thank them afterward...... You are still following these words now, since you don't think there's anything wrong with it.
After all, those aren't the people you care about, so what decisions and actions you take are none of your concern. If there really is someone you care about...... Then think about it: at that moment, you absolutely won't respect their thoughts and choices. If they go against your expectations and wishes, if their so-called happiness turns out to be a great misfortune for you, then perhaps you absolutely won't accept it.
But these things are just thoughts; you don't really believe such a person exists, since you seem to care about no one and have no contact with anyone.
But you watch Spamton's back ahead and hesitate for a brief second. Just now, you, who had no contact with anyone, now reconsider this so-called friend. So, maybe you still have contact with others? At least have some connection with him?
So, how exactly is the concept of a friend defined...... But you do long to have a friend, since other relationships are fleeting to you, but only friends are probably permanent.
Your thoughts were a bit chaotic. You didn't say anything along the way, just went to a phone shop. Spamton picked out a phone for you, paid for it, then opened the phone and saved your contact information. He even set it to the pin and gave an asterisk. He also helped you get a SIM card, then stored your number on his phone and quietly pinned it at the top, just giving you a heart when making a note.
Of course, for a long time, your phone actually only stored this one number.
After entering the number, Spamton handed you the phone and gave you a flawless smile: "[Done]." From now on, [you] can [use] this [phone] to your heart's content. ”
You took the phone with both hands, glanced at it, and nodded solemnly to Spamton: "Thank you for your generous help." You said this quite formally, and Spamton couldn't help but laugh. You felt that although the smile wasn't as perfect as before, it carried a touch of authenticity.
"No need to be restrained; this is what I should do for my friends." He simply repeated this point persistently.
You tilted your head to look at Spamton, then at the time, and realized it was almost dinner time. You exclaimed, "Ah, it's already this late...... I have to go first. I don't even know if I can go back to where I came before......" You muttered, giving Spamton an apologetic look.
"Sorry, I should have thought of a way to make it up to you first, but I'm afraid I have to leave first......
He still shook his head: "No need to apologize." ”
In fact, Spamton felt you apologized far too many times...... But he also knew that since your personality was like this, he wouldn't feel uncomfortable, so he just kept correcting you. After all, why should you apologize for something like this? If you need to apologize, that's probably his own thing; it's just that Spamton feels there's absolutely no need to do that.
…… Of course, in some ways, he also hopes you can rely on and trust him a little more. Although Spamton also finds your crying funny and wants to kiss and chew you in that moment, at this moment, he actually hopes you can genuinely smile as well.
And in the next moment, he sees your genuine smile.
You pause and hesitate for a moment. In fact, you think you should apologize if you cause trouble for others, and your parents' reminders are the same...... But maybe friends don't need to think so much about it? You guessed it, but you decided to apologize a few times in the future.
At least, you don't need to be so nervous about friends, right? You guessed it, so at this moment you smiled, probably from the heart, because now you feel your expression is no longer stiff.
You nod firmly: "Alright." ”
Then, you bring Spamton to the place where you appeared in this dark world. Fortunately, the door can now open again, so you wave goodbye to Spamton and return to your original world.
When you returned, your excitement fell to the ground again, turning into anxiety, fear, and sadness. Even though you were very reluctant, you still moved your feet toward home.
Spamton watched your figure disappear through that door, unable to describe it, feeling a sense of loss. In the end, he turned around and went back to his own business, but he couldn't help but wonder when you'd contact him again.
You eventually returned home. Unsurprisingly, it wasn't a good place to return to you, but you still needed to go home, and perhaps you still needed the poison called love from your parents. At least, you really needed these.
Even at this moment, they are merely speaking the truths you must accept in the name of love, and then, when you achieve their goal, give you another reward called love.
But at today's dinner table, it seems a small argument broke out again, probably just your own assumption, because apart from that, there is only silence and repression, only their dark eyes staring at you. After that angry shout, you feel fear again, finally sit back down, say nothing, and end the dinner.
By the next day, you left home early. As for where to go, you hadn't decided yet. Usually, you would just hang out in a nearby park, daydreaming and ending the day. But now, you had a new place to go—you thought of the Underworld, you wanted to chat with the friends you had met yesterday.
Or maybe you just desperately need an outlet, even if you say nothing, just quietly accompany you for a while.
So you crossed that door, and after the familiar dizziness, arrived at the Dark World. Looking at the familiar yet unfamiliar streets, you hesitated for a moment and took out the phone Spamton had bought you yesterday—this phone wouldn't light up again in the world of light. Now it's fine, probably because the worlds are different. At that moment, you even feel a bit lucky to have arrived in another world, grateful to have made your first friend.
So you dial Spamton's phone number and tell him to come to the place where you left yesterday to pick you up.
Spamton was actually a bit surprised. Although he had felt a bit disappointed yesterday, he quickly composed himself. Since he was quite patient, he didn't mind waiting a bit longer. He just didn't expect that you would contact him the very next day.
When you arrived, seeing your expression on the verge of tears, Spamton belatedly realized something. Ah, probably for you, his friend is now the only one you can rely on.
So, it's okay. You can rely on him a bit more. He won't mind accepting your emotions, since all of this has to be devoured to be considered delicious. But right now, he can't act so eager.
But seeing your expression, Spamton couldn't help but suggest, "Maybe ...... [you] need a [place to relax]?" ”
He still doesn't want to see that expression linger on your face for too long.
You paused, instinctively wanting to ask Spamton how he figured it out, but belatedly realized, actually, your expression was written all over your face, but your family probably didn't care at all. After all, they didn't care about your emotions at all; they just thought you were still young, didn't have other emotions, and didn't have much recognition ability, so you could only follow the path they arranged. The choice of major for university was the result of your first rebellious choice...... But they didn't seem to care much about what kind of major you actually had.
So you just took a deep breath, tried hard to turn your brain, but your mind was empty. At this moment, you couldn't think of anything, so you just looked at Spamton as if seeking help: "Ah...... I-I don't know where to relax. Do you have any recommendations?" "And in fact, in such a sad moment, you just want to sit there and sit blankly for a while, not wanting to do anything, because you don't have the energy to do anything."
Spamton observed your confused expression and suggested, "Maybe, an amusement park?" Given your current situation, this should be a good choice. I think maybe you need a meal, then rest well, and finally go to relax. ”
You look at him blankly, then instinctively grab his arm and nod: "Hmm, probably okay. I really do need to rest for a while...... Just do whatever you say. I don't want to think about these things anymore." "You just want to clear your mind."
Spamton glanced at your hand holding his arm, subtly raised it, then held yours and continued smiling: "Well then, today I'll be in charge. I'll make sure you're in a good mood." ”
You feel his hand seems a bit cold, but the moment one hand touches it, you feel a bit of warmth and reassurance, so you can't help but nod.
Spamton took you to the amusement park. He bought two tickets and brought you in. There weren't many people at the amusement park today, but then he took your hand, bought two marshmallows, and slipped one into your hand, pulling you to sit down on a nearby chair.
"Get some good rest first. Maybe you should [enjoy] some sweets." He said, looking at you.
You paused, biting into the marshmallow a bit without appetizing the food. Honestly, you'd never been to an amusement park before, only heard of this place, so the facilities were unfamiliar and uneasy, including the candy-like yet fluffy item in your hand. Actually, you hadn't tried it before.
Then that sweet, cloying taste bursts in your mouth. The tears you've been holding back start to drip from your eyes. You freeze for a moment, then quickly let go of the hand you've been holding and wipe your tears: "...... Sorry." ”
You clearly promised to apologize less, but at this moment, you can't help but say sorry. After all, on a phone you don't use often, typing the right subconscious association is just saying sorry.
"No need to [apologize]. If you want to [cry], [you] certainly have the right to [cry]." You hear Spamton's voice, and at the same time, you feel his hand gently wiping away your tears.
Blinking, you just stammered, "But my parents said you can't cry, that crying looks too ugly...... And seeing it makes others unhappy, so I should be smiling." "Even so, you really can't laugh right now, and in fact, you want to cry even more because of it."
“…… Besides, after I got home yesterday, my mother said the pieces I made were all insignificant, completely meaningless. Rather than continuing to try composing, I should try something else...... She said I had no talent at all...... As you spoke, you couldn't help but lower your head and move the cotton candy a bit farther away. You didn't want your tears to soak the candy.
Only after saying it do you realize you might never have said it at all. Why do you have to reveal these things about yourself? So you just wipe your tears and hurriedly say, "Sorry, I shouldn't have said this......
"No need to apologize. Friends can [listen] everything, so you can [tell me] all of this." Spamton said. You still felt embarrassed to leave these in someone else's house, but you changed out of the wet skirt and put on that white shirt that just covered your lower body. You tied up your freshly washed hair, and you searched to see if you found a hair dryer in the bathroom, so you opened the door and quietly asked, "Um...... I want to ask, where is your hair dryer?" ”
Spamton glanced over; you had just finished showering, your face still flushed. He swallowed again, then pointed you in the right direction and turned away without saying a word.
Although you were a bit puzzled as to why he hadn't said a word, you still politely thanked him, then took the hairdryer and walked back into the bathroom. Soon, a dull sound came from inside the closed door.
Spamton only pressed his face down, and he could feel it was a bit hot. In fact, when he heard the faint sound of water coming from the bathroom just now, although he tried hard to suppress his thoughts, he couldn't help but start recalling that scene. Moreover, he had just seen your flushed face poking your head out, probably still wearing his clothes...... So now he could only stare blankly through his fingers at the piece of fabric standing upright beneath him, then silently hoped to calm the restless feeling quickly, otherwise he wouldn't be embarrassed to turn to face you later.
You have no idea what Spamton is really thinking. After blow-drying your hair, you step out feeling refreshed. After all, you're dry and warm all over. Putting the hairdryer back down, you glance out the window—the rain has eased a bit, but hasn't completely stopped.
You hesitated for a moment, then turned to Spamton: "Ah...... Looks like I'll probably stay at your place for a while longer? Do you mind? "You stammered, feeling a bit nervous.
Then you see Spamton turn around and smile at you: "Of course, I don't mind at all. As long as you're willing, you can wait as long as you want, and there's no problem." After all, I believe that we are friends. ”
You tilted your head. You probably know a bit about the word 'friend,' but you've never been a friend before, so you're a bit confused now: "...... friend?" "We're friends?" "You thought for a moment. You've only known each other for half a day, so does that count as friendship?"
Then you see Spamton nod affirmatively: "I [believe] we meet the [Definition: Friends], so I'm happy to provide [everything] for [you]. ”
"Oh, oh...... your mind is still a bit confused. Although you've heard about it, you haven't had friends before, so after a brief moment of confusion, this feeling turns into a pleasant surprise. So you nod happily, thinking you fully understand.
"I see, it's a friend! So, you're happy to help, and I enjoy your help?" "In fact, when you asked this question, you were a bit timid, since you weren't sure if you could understand it that way, and you thought it wasn't good to always trouble friends to help you solve problems.
But when you see Spamton nod firmly, you can't help but breathe a sigh of relief. Then you hear him add, "So, [you] don't [need] to continue using [honorifics]." ”
After thinking about it, you realize it makes sense, so you give up those vague honorifics: "Well, I think the rain will take a while before it stops. Can I sit on your bed for a while first?" ”
"Of course, no need to feel restrained." You hear his confident voice. Of course, for some reason, Spamton is sitting with his back to you.
Anyway, you let out a small cheer in your heart, then sat down on Spamton's bed. You hugged your knees, daydreaming, and after a while, your head slowly moved, your chin resting on your knee as you fell asleep.
When he heard your gentle breathing, Spamton also lowered his voice. He just turned to look at you, and just a glance at you. The part that had just faded stood up again. He cleared his throat gently, stood up, and walked over to you. Your seat was very close to the edge of the bed, so he could easily touch you.
But he just bent down, kissed your forehead, and then walked to another bathroom in the bedroom—the one you had just used in the living room. In short, it was probably to avoid waking you, or maybe simply to avoid sensing your presence.
Then he took a cold shower in the bathroom.
When he came out after changing clothes, he found you hugging your knees, lost in thought. You weren't sleeping very soundly, probably because it was an unfamiliar place, but you were still grateful for the spamton that gave you a brief rest.
Seeing Spamton come out, his previously confused mind finally restarted, and perhaps his previously empty and confused heart was filled once again. You don't know what it feels like.
Anyway, you hurriedly got out of bed and said urgently, "The rain has stopped. I'll change my clothes back first, let's go buy a phone." ”
Spamton responded softly, watching you run back into the bathroom. He even felt a bit regretful—why couldn't this rain last longer? Why not just last a day and night? That way, he could have kept you here forever.
Tbc.
[3]
But he just kept smiling, sitting there and nodding at you: "[Sure]." ”
…… You don't even know why you want to ask for his opinion. Thinking about it, it seems you don't really need to do that. Well, maybe it's because he's the owner of this room?
Anyway, you should quickly get to the bathroom and change into the dried skirt again.
After changing into your own clothes, you finally breathe a sigh of relief and completely relax. You walk out the door and look at him: "Alright, let's go out." ”
Spamton didn't dare look at you anymore. He just stood up with his back to you and walked toward the door, not even saying a word. Although you thought he was acting a bit strange, I'm afraid other beings might have some quirks or something, and you wouldn't disturb them. After all...... Parents always tell you to respect others' decisions, respect their thoughts, and not trouble others. If you must trouble others, you should thank them afterward...... You are still following these words now, since you don't think there's anything wrong with it.
After all, those aren't the people you care about, so what decisions and actions you take are none of your concern. If there really is someone you care about...... Then think about it: at that moment, you absolutely won't respect their thoughts and choices. If they go against your expectations and wishes, if their so-called happiness turns out to be a great misfortune for you, then perhaps you absolutely won't accept it.
But these things are just thoughts; you don't really believe such a person exists, since you seem to care about no one and have no contact with anyone.
But you watch Spamton's back ahead and hesitate for a brief second. Just now, you, who had no contact with anyone, now reconsider this so-called friend. So, maybe you still have contact with others? At least have some connection with him?
So, how exactly is the concept of a friend defined...... But you do long to have a friend, since other relationships are fleeting to you, but only friends are probably permanent.
Your thoughts were a bit chaotic. You didn't say anything along the way, just arrived at a phone shop. Spamton picked out a phone for you, paid for it, then opened the phone and saved your contact info. He even set it to the top and gave an asterisk. He also helped you get a SIM card, then stored your number on his phone and quietly pinned it to the top, just giving you a heart when making a note.
Of course, for a long time, your phone actually only stored this one number.
After entering the number, Spamton handed you the phone and gave you a flawless smile: "[Done]." From now on, [you] can [use] this [phone] to your heart's content. ”
You took the phone with both hands, glanced at it, and nodded solemnly to Spamton: "Thank you for your generous help." You said this quite formally, and Spamton couldn't help but laugh. You felt that although the smile wasn't as perfect as before, it carried a touch of authenticity.
"No need to be restrained; this is what I should do for my friends." He simply repeated this point persistently.
You tilted your head to look at Spamton, then at the time, and realized it was almost dinner time. You exclaimed, "Ah, it's already this late...... I have to go first. I don't even know if I can go back to where I came before......" You muttered, giving Spamton an apologetic look.
"Sorry, I should have thought of a way to make it up to you first, but I'm afraid I have to leave first......
He still shook his head: "No need to apologize." ”
In fact, Spamton felt you apologized far too many times...... But he also knew that since you were probably like that, he wouldn't feel uncomfortable about it, so he kept correcting you over and over. After all, why should he apologize for something like this? If he needed to say sorry, it was probably because of him. Spamton just felt there was no need to do it.
…… Of course, in some ways, he also hopes you can rely on and trust him a little more. Although Spamton also finds your crying funny and wants to kiss and chew you in that moment, at this moment, he actually hopes you can genuinely smile as well.
And in the next moment, he sees your genuine smile.
You pause and hesitate for a moment. In fact, you think you should apologize if you cause trouble for others, and your parents' reminders are the same...... But maybe friends don't need to think so much about it? You guessed it, but you decided to apologize a few times in the future.
At least, you don't need to be so nervous about friends, right? You guessed it, so at this moment you smiled, probably from the heart, because now you feel your expression is no longer stiff.
You nod firmly: "Alright." ”
Then, you bring Spamton to the place where you appeared in this dark world. Fortunately, the door can now open again, so you wave goodbye to Spamton and return to your original world.
When you returned, your excitement fell to the ground again, turning into anxiety, fear, and sadness. Even though you were very reluctant, you still moved your feet toward home.
Spamton watched your figure disappear through that door, unable to describe it, feeling a sense of loss. In the end, he turned around and went back to his own business, but he couldn't help but wonder when you'd contact him again.
You eventually returned home. As expected, this wasn't a good place to return to you, but you still needed to go home, and perhaps you still needed the poison called love that your parents gave you. At least, you really needed these things.
Even at this moment, they are merely speaking the truths you must accept in the name of love, and then, when you achieve their goal, give you another reward called love.
But at today's dinner table, it seems a small argument broke out again, probably just your own assumption, because apart from that, there is only silence and repression, only their dark eyes staring at you. After that angry shout, you feel fear again, finally sit back down, say nothing, and end the dinner.
By the next day, you left home early. As for where to go, you hadn't decided yet. Usually, you would just hang out in a nearby park, daydreaming and ending the day. But now, you had a new place to go—you thought of the Underworld, you wanted to chat with the friends you had met yesterday.
Or maybe you just desperately need an outlet, even if you say nothing, just quietly accompany you for a while.
So you crossed that door, and after the familiar dizziness, arrived at the Dark World. Looking at the familiar yet unfamiliar streets, you hesitated for a moment and took out the phone Spamton had bought you yesterday—this phone wouldn't light up again in the world of light. Now it's fine, probably because the worlds are different. At that moment, you even feel a bit lucky to have arrived in another world, grateful to have made your first friend.
So you dial Spamton's phone number and tell him to come to the place where you left yesterday to pick you up.
Spamton was actually a bit surprised. Although he had felt a bit disappointed yesterday, he quickly composed himself. Since he was quite patient, he didn't mind waiting a bit longer. He just didn't expect that you would contact him the very next day.
When it was time to wait, seeing your expression on the verge of tears, Spamton finally realized something belatedly. Ah, probably for you, his friend is now the only one you can rely on.
So, it's okay. You can rely on him a bit more. He won't mind accepting your emotions, since all of this has to be devoured to be considered delicious. But right now, he can't act so eager.
But seeing your expression, Spamton couldn't help but suggest, "Maybe ...... [you] need a [place to relax]?" ”
He still doesn't want to see that expression linger on your face for too long.
You paused, instinctively wanting to ask Spamton how he figured it out, but belatedly realized, actually, your expression was written all over your face, but your family probably didn't care at all. After all, they didn't care about your emotions at all; they just thought you were still young, didn't have other emotions, and didn't have much recognition ability, so you could only follow the path they arranged. The choice of major for university was the result of your first rebellious choice...... But they didn't seem to care much about what kind of major you actually had.
So you just took a deep breath, tried hard to turn your brain, but your mind was empty. At this moment, you couldn't think of anything, so you just looked at Spamton as if seeking help: "Ah...... I-I don't know where to relax. Do you have any recommendations?" "And in fact, in such a sad moment, you just want to sit there and sit blankly for a while, not wanting to do anything, because you don't have the energy to do anything."
Spamton observed your confused expression and suggested, "Maybe, an amusement park?" Given your current situation, this should be a good choice. I think maybe you need a meal, then rest well, and finally go to relax. ”
You look at him blankly, then instinctively grab his arm and nod: "Hmm, probably okay. I really do need to rest for a while...... Just do whatever you say. I don't want to think about these things anymore." "You just want to clear your mind."
Spamton glanced at your hand holding his arm, subtly raised it, then held yours and continued smiling: "Well then, today I'll be in charge. I'll make sure you're in a good mood." ”
You feel his hand seems a bit cold, but the moment one hand touches it, you feel a bit of warmth and reassurance, so you can't help but nod.
Spamton took you to the amusement park. He bought two tickets and took you inside. There weren't many people at the amusement park today, but then he took your hand, bought two marshmallows, and even stuffed one into your hand, pulling you to sit on a nearby chair.
"Get some good rest first. Maybe you should [enjoy] some sweets." He said, looking at you.
You paused, biting into the marshmallow a bit without appetizing the food. Honestly, you'd never been to an amusement park before, only heard of this place, so the facilities were unfamiliar and uneasy, including the candy-like yet fluffy item in your hand. Actually, you hadn't tried it before.
Then that sweet, cloying taste bursts in your mouth. The tears you've been holding back start to drip from your eyes. You freeze for a moment, then quickly let go of the hand you've been holding and wipe your tears: "...... Sorry." ”
You clearly promised to apologize less, but at this moment, you can't help but say sorry. After all, on a phone you don't use often, typing the right subconscious association is just saying sorry.
"No need to [apologize]. If you want to [cry], [you] certainly have the right to [cry]." You hear Spamton's voice, and at the same time, you feel his hand gently wiping away your tears.
Blinking, you just said a bit hesitantly, "But my parents said you can't cry, that crying looks too ugly...... And it makes everyone unhappy, so I should be smiling." "Even so, you really can't smile right now, and in fact, you want to cry even more because of it."
“…… Besides, after I got home yesterday, my mother said the pieces I made were all worthless and meaningless. Rather than continuing to compose music, I should try something else...... She said I had no talent at all...... As you spoke, you couldn't help but lower your head and move the cotton candy a bit farther away. You didn't want your tears to soak the candy.
Only after saying it do you realize you might never have said it at all. Why do you have to reveal these things about yourself? So you just wipe your tears and hurriedly say, "Sorry, I shouldn't have said this......
"No need to apologize. Friends can [listen] everything, so you can [tell me] all of this." Spamton said. At this moment, he didn't have many extra thoughts, just thought that if you were willing to reveal everything, it meant he was getting closer to you, and maybe after saying all this, you could show a genuine smile once again.
You paused for a moment, said nothing, just stared blankly and took a bite of the cotton candy.
Seeing your still sorrowful and anxious expression, he suggested, "Then, maybe we should go visit the [Drop Tower Machine]?" ”
“…… Why? "You haven't heard of this project, but just hearing the name gives you an idea of what it looks like.
"Because if you are at the boundary between excitement and fear in a moment, you might [abandon] all sadness and disappointment, leaving only that moment of experience. I think that might help you temporarily forget your sadness." ”
Tbc.
[4]
The moment you hear this, you feel your heart leap high—a joy tinged with sadness. Maybe you really can cast away all your sadness in that instant. Maybe, as long as you're by his side, you can stay happy? You're not sure.
So, you tilted your head and thought for a while. That probably made sense, and you couldn't help but nod: "Hmm, then I believe what you said, but before that...... Can I lean on your shoulder and rest for a while? ”
Naturally, you are very timid when making this request. You don't know whether Spamton will agree or think this is not something friends should do, because you have never made friends and lack common knowledge about this. You simply cannot imagine what friendships should be like.
"Of course, you can. You can rely on me at any time." Spamton said. In fact, he was actually a bit surprised. Although taking advantage of your sadness might seem too cunning and sinister, Spamton didn't mind; he was just working hard for that goal. Still, he thought that perhaps having someone to rely on would actually be better for you personally.
So of course, he won't refuse you; he'll fulfill every request you make. And when the time comes, it's a huge deal, so the reward he'll ask for will be huge. But all these rewards require patience to get, and he doesn't lack that kind of patience.
You softly hummed, finished biting into the remaining cotton candy in your hand, letting the sweet and greasy taste linger in your mouth. Then you leaned on Spamton's shoulder and gently closed your eyes.
You wish you could think of nothing now, just sleep in the darkness like this, never waking up again, and you wish you could never wake up again. So you ignore the noisy sounds in the amusement park. Gradually, those sounds leave you, leaving only the rain in your heart. Maybe it's raining outside, or maybe it's just pure crying, because you feel tears sliding down your cheeks.
Then, in a daze, you fall asleep. You don't even know why you fall asleep in such a situation. Maybe you just fell asleep because you were so unconscious that you fell asleep, or maybe leaning next to the spamton made you feel safe.
Spamton looked at your sleeping face, thought for a moment, and took off his suit and draped it over you. Of course, he was very cautious, since you were sleeping with your head resting on his shoulder. Then, he cupped your face and carefully kissed those tears. To be honest, they tasted salty, but he didn't mind that much. Once the tears disappeared from your cheeks, he quietly kissed your forehead.
Then, he sat quietly on the bench for a while, waiting for you to wake up. Of course, the sky kept changing.
You slept deeply, and to be honest, it was rare to sleep so peacefully. You didn't even have a single dream, and only after waking up did you fully wake up after a while.
Then you look at the suit draped over you, smile shyly, and return the suit to Spamton: "Ah, I think I slept for a long time...... "Well, thank you for lending me your shoulder." You remembered you had decided to say a few fewer apologies, so you swallowed your original apology, took back the words you felt apologetic, and instead thanked your friend.
When you say this, you feel a sudden sense of clarity, and your mood lifts considerably. Indeed, perhaps this is how it should be.
Spamton simply nodded lightly: "This is all the help I should provide to you. You can rely on it as much as you want." ”
You nodded too, and once again laughed sincerely and heartily: "Mm, I know. I'll definitely rely on you!" "Although you think this sentence sounds a bit off, you probably don't mind. As long as the meaning is right, that's enough."
So now you grab Spamton's sleeve and stand up: "Mm...... So, should we go to the drop tower? Seems like you've slept too long; the amusement park feels almost empty now...... You scratch your head awkwardly.
Spamton just shook his head: "No [connection], just no one is [disturbing]." ”
"Hmm...... You're right...... You muttered as you walked toward the drop tower machine, completely unaware that Spamton grabbed your hand again. As your hand landed, he grabbed it directly, but his movements were so gentle that you couldn't notice any of it.
"So, after the [Drop Tower] ends, we go to the [Ferris Wheel]?" You hear Spamton's suggestion.
"Ferris wheel, what's that?" This is another project you haven't heard of, so you ask Spamton, and then you see it pointing you in a direction.
So you understood—the slowly circling and towering facility that seemed to touch the sky was called the Ferris wheel, and you nodded.
"Then let's go with the Ferris wheel. It'll help you relax a bit more, and then I'll be heading home again......" At this point, you start to feel down again.
Spamton watched your expression, quickened his pace, and before you could be sad for long, you arrived in front of the drop tower.
You blinked, and luckily there weren't many people left at the amusement park, so very few people would sit on the drop tower ride, so you and Spamton sat next to each other.
The drop tower machine started, and at first it was just slowly rising. Watching the ground get farther and farther away, you couldn't help but feel nervous. To be honest, it even felt unreal, so you couldn't help but grip the device strapped to your body for immobilization. When you reach the very top, after a two-second pause, you see Spamton seem to turn its head and say something to you, but you don't hear it clearly, because the next second you suddenly fall. All that's left in your ears is the howling wind, the sound of wind and more wind, passing through your eyes with blurry fragments of the scene, and the screams of a few people nearby. So you can't help but scream, as if this can release all your emotions. The accumulated sadness is replaced by a fleeting thrill and a slight sense of panic, so much so that when the drop tower machine ends, you still can't react.
Until Spamton grabs your hand and says, "It's already 'over', we should go to the Ferris wheel." ”
Only then did you nod as if a beat too late: "Oh, oh, then let's go." Then you let Spamton hold your hand and walk forward, while you seemed a bit distracted. You stared at Spamton's back, suddenly feeling an urge to say something, but also timid. Maybe you didn't know what to say, or maybe you thought that saying those words would only make everything fall apart, making you wonder if it was real, or if it was just a deception you imagined?
Maybe, at least the feelings are real, so you chose to believe in all this, at least to leave you a paradise. And now, for you, this paradise is right beside Spamton.
So you just remain silent, saying nothing, because just maintaining the status quo makes you very satisfied, even fearing that change might cause you to lose it. But now, just by doing this, you feel as if the empty part of your chest has been filled again.
As for the sentence you didn't hear clearly before...... Spamton actually said it because he was sure you probably wouldn't hear it on the drop tower machine, and he also thought you probably wouldn't ask further. He understood your mindset and probably knew you would feel anxious and embarrassed, thinking it was your fault for not hearing clearly, so he wouldn't ask further.
That's why, at that moment, he said words like 'I like' you with the wind. No matter how you react, at least at that moment, Spamton's heart was satisfied. Although using your psychology might not be ideal, Spamton knew it was probably only this once, because you definitely wouldn't do it again.
He won't allow you to maintain this state any longer, but being able to shape you freely is probably one reason he likes you more.
No matter what, you all arrived at the Ferris wheel, and there weren't many people around. So you got into a carriage and sat on the same side. You looked out the window. As night approached, fireworks exploded in the sky, dazzling and colorful. You pulled open the window, watching the buildings below slowly rise with the rocking curiosity. This was the first time you'd experienced it. Honestly, it was incredibly fresh.
Then you feel a light sensation on your face, with a hint of softness and moisture. Just as the Ferris wheel reaches its highest point, you touch your cheek and sluggishly turn to look at Spamton.
"Hey, what does that mean?" You don't quite understand, but you can probably imagine that his lips had just touched his face, because when you turned around, you could still see Spamton turning around.
"This is a way to express 'closeness' and 'friendliness.' It's said that doing this when the Ferris wheel reaches its 'peak' can preserve the 'friendship' forever." Spamton made up a lie without blinking, and he was confident in it. After all, it wasn't entirely lying, so half-truths and half-lies were the hardest to tell if they were lies.
So you just blinked and looked at Spamton, then suddenly understood, leaned over and carefully touched his cheek with your lips. You were sure you had touched him, because you felt a different sensation, and only then did you pull back.
You awkwardly touch your lips, then start curling your hair: "Ahem...... So, friendship lasts? "You say this uncertainly.
Of course, Spamton said nothing; he just quietly watched you, and you watched him too. Unconsciously, the Ferris wheel stopped, you reached the finish line, and it was time to go down
To be honest, when you get down, you feel a bit reluctant: "I've slept too long, so many things I haven't tried yet......"
Spamton just shook his head: "It's okay, there will be many chances later." ”
So you smile and nod: "Mm!" ”
Although you have to go home afterward, you are not so panicked because new hopes are ignited in your heart, because you know that when you arrive in another world, your friends will be waiting for you on that end.
So after that day, unless there's anything else, you'll go to the Dark World to find Spamton, from the very beginning of college all the way to graduation.
Hand in hand, you finally finished experiencing all the attractions in the amusement park. Amid the rides that were sometimes thrilling, sometimes innocent and fun, you laughed heartily, releasing all the emotions accumulated in the world of light. At least for that moment, you didn't mind at all, and once again on the Ferris wheel, your lips touched each other's faces.
Or Spamton treats you, inviting you to try new desserts at a dessert shop. You've hardly ever tried those desserts before, so gradually, you visit the shop more often. Most of the time, Spamton watches you eat. Only when you really can't eat enough will Spamton take your spoon, pick up the leftover desserts, and help you finish that part.
Sometimes, if you have nowhere else to go, you'll walk down the street. Spamton will casually buy some snacks and stuff them into your hand. If you don't like them, you'll put them in his mouth, then look at him with a triumphant expression—so frustrated and struggling that he can't even spit them out.
Of course, in the dark world, you also experience many feelings you never experienced in the world of light, trying many things you never did in the world of light. At Spamton's invitation, you tried alcohol for the first time, and after the first drink, you collapsed dizzily onto the table. Luckily, it was noon, and you slept the whole afternoon before coming home. You were invited by Spamton to KTV, but honestly, you didn't really like music, so you just sat there awkwardly listening to Spamton sing. Then, gathering your courage, you picked up the microphone and shyly joined in.
Gradually, you stop worrying so much. Whenever something happens, you just tell the spamton with a gloomy face, saying that as long as it quietly stays by your side, it's fine. If something interesting happens, you can share it with the spamton. In such cases, sometimes the first thing you think of is actually spamton.
As for Spamton? Of course, he really liked this situation, and subtly, he felt he was about to succeed.
So on that day, your parents talk about the blind date, and you complain to Spamton about it again, feeling frustrated.
Then Spamton felt that this was the time to carry out the plan, or else everything would be too late. He felt that this moment was crucial and could not be missed.
So he smiled and suggested a [hookup relationship].
End.
