Ggdwx you, ooc count me in. From Bai Pan to ggdw, three ideas were blended (1. Picking up spt2.ggdw from the trash to pretend to be innocent 3. Daily saying 'I like you' only to get a blunt response)
——
You found that white Addison in a pile of trash.
Actually, you've seen many Addisons, since they always sell you all kinds of products. But this is the first time you've seen Addis whose white ones are noticeably smaller than other Addisons...... And you don't even know why he looks so dejected, or rather, sitting in a pile of trash with tears streaming down his face.
You can't just leave this Dark Folk here, even though that has nothing to do with you, the Citizen of Light...... What does the end of anything else have to do with you? But maybe he looked too pitiful and cute, or maybe his silent, tearful and cautious look made your heart ache. Anyway, you crouched down, grabbed his hand, and pulled him out of the trash heap. He was covered in filth, looking as if he'd spent days in the trash, with a coffee cup on his head, brown stains dripping down.
You glanced at him several times, and he carefully pried your fingers away, nervously pulling your hand back behind your back: "Thank you...... But I'm not very clean. ”
You crossed your arms, tilted your head to look at him, rubbed your chin, and then asked, "...... Could it be that you have an infectious disease or something? After all, you just came out of that place." You always speak bluntly, and you pointed directly at the pile of garbage nearby.
He seemed stunned for a moment, then quickly shook his head and hurriedly took down the coffee cup from above him: "No...... Although I'm a bit dirty, I'm very clean." He stammered, probably not knowing how to explain, so he could only look up and look at you anxiously.
You were silent for a moment. To be honest, you hadn't intended to bother with him at first...... At most, you'd just pull him out and stuff in some dark coins. You believed nothing would be unbearable, but the way he looked at you with that admiring gaze made you blush a little, and you couldn't help but cough lightly.
"Alright, I know. You're the white, pure Addison." You gently pat his head, though there were coffee stains on it, but you didn't mind.
His head rubbed against your palm, and you were a bit stunned. Then you heard him say, "Yes, I'm pure white...... But my colleague thought I should have color, so he gave me this cup of coffee." His tone was very innocent, as if he had no idea how much interest this was about. When you heard this, you couldn't help but frown. If that were the case, maybe just giving him some money to go back would have been snatched away by other Dark Ones.
But you still blurted out, "Then why are you in the garbage heap?" "You heard his stomach growling, so you guess he's been in the garbage heap for several days."
"Hmm...... Because another colleague said that besides the color, I should have some smell, so they sent me into the trash heap. "He said.
Looking at him, you decide not to ask why he was crying and staying in the garbage heap at first. You know those two sentences were probably lies he made up...... But he decided he had to face his past head-on. Although the future now was what he hoped for, he still felt something was missing...... Maybe it was the past he once desperately wanted to deny was missing. But it was precisely because of his unbearable past that you kept him.
But no matter what...... At least, maybe he hopes your involvement can save the lost and helpless self he once was. He can change the past that has been repeated. He can ...... Let him choose to accept himself again, or in other words, be willing to love the person he once was because of your love.
The Addisons exchanged glances again, nodded, and said in unison, "Got it," then walked out of the meeting room. Once again, only Spamton remained in the room, and he felt the coldness and suddenly became genuinely afraid—afraid that when he showed you his achievements and the dark coins he earned, you'd laugh and say he could stand on his own, live on his own, and in a way, kick him out—even if your intentions were just good.
He simply pushed these chaotic and complicated thoughts aside, walked out of the meeting room, and only felt at ease as he watched the rising Dark Coin accumulation. But when he thought of you, he felt a bit empty inside. He transferred the dark coins from the vase art he sold today into another account, planning to show you this account when he got back, show it off to you, and then get a few compliments from you. Thinking of this, Spamton couldn't help but curl his lips, feeling delighted again.
So he returned home in such a pleasant mood, and it wasn't until he stood at the door of his house that he swallowed nervously and felt timid again. Ultimately, he carefully opened the door. You were sitting across from the dining table, with a freshly made, still steaming pizza laid out on it.
When you saw Spamton cautiously peek inside as he opened the door, you couldn't help but feel that it was somewhat amusing, but you just smiled and said, 'Welcome home.'
Spamton paused for a moment, pushed the door open, hung his coat on the rack, and set down his bag, nervously adjusting his hair that wasn't even messy—he just wanted to maintain a good image in your eyes, always.
You quietly watched him. Spamton cleared his throat and sat down on the chair opposite you, also smiling, 'Hmm, I'm back.'
Then he placed his arm on the table, unintentionally revealing a wound on his forearm—actually, this wound was caused earlier during his inspection on the shopping street, when Yellow accidentally bumped into him and knocked over a vase. The broken ceramic pieces caused this cut. It was a minor wound, easily healable with any healing magic Addison had. But he stopped Yellow from trying to fix it afterward and didn't use magic himself, intending to elicit a bit of your sympathy with this small injury.
So he just covered it with a black shirt, but naturally, when he rested his arm on the table and the shirt pulled back slightly with momentum, the wound became partially visible.
Of course, you noticed and hurriedly stopped his arm. You carefully stood up, grabbed his arm, and rolled up the sleeve, seeing the wound still oozing blood and not yet fully clotted. It looked alarming and was a long cut, but actually wasn't serious since it didn't go very deep.
Still, you furrowed your brow, understandably feeling concerned because he was hurt.
'...Don't rush to eat yet. Let's take care of the wound first!' you said, running to your room to pull out a first-aid kit from under your bed, something you had prepared long ago but never used. You also glanced at the similarly dust-covered alley nearby, finally lowering your eyes.
...Those were memories from your past that you hadn't opened. You only wanted to start a new life, somewhat avoiding touching your past, even though it was equally important to you.
Shaking off these thoughts, you ran out and dipped a cotton swab in iodine, carefully cleaning his wound, your voice tinged with worry and reproach: 'How did it... get such a long wound? It looks so scary.'
Spamton just lowered his head, softly answering your question, 'It's just... those Addison saw that my items sold well and wanted to take them, then we argued, and we broke a vase...'
You sighed, reaffirming your resolve, vowing to talk to those Addison properly next weekend. You wrapped Spamton's arm in bandages, then ruffled his hair: 'You dare to resist, dare to face these injustices. My Spamton is amazing!'
...No, you had no idea of the truth. Spamton thought about this with rare bitterness.
TBC.

title: down
content:
You leaned back slightly on the sofa, watching as Spamton seriously moved over a new pot, then poured in the soil and carefully transplanted the already wilted tulip. You looked at the flowerpot and couldn't help but get a bit distracted. It was bought when Spamton first became interested in gardening. As for why he was interested, it was probably because you told him at the time you wanted to see a sea of lavender.
Although I don't know why flowerpots are still sold in the Dark World...... Maybe it's because some people of darkness really like to plant fake flowers, and you can't help but smile when you look at the patterns on the pots.
I don't know why he acts so serious, as if afraid the flowers might be hurt in the slightest by his actions. But you look at him and can't help but be a bit lost in thought. In the end, you quietly return to your room, pick up your brush and a piece of drawing paper again, and decide this time to just sketch him simply.
So you simply returned to the sofa and quietly began tracing his figure on paper. For a moment, the room fell silent, with no other sounds.
After sketching and tracing his form, you began to carefully sketch on paper, no longer looking at spamton. You got so absorbed that you quietly walked to your side and admired it for a long time without noticing.
Until you were almost done with the painting and were about to lift your head to stretch out your arms for a lazy stretch, you widened your eyes at Spamton, who had appeared at some point and happened to meet your gaze.
Maybe because he saw you were so focused on drawing, he didn't disturb you. Even if he really did, you wouldn't say anything......
At that moment, he tilted his head, excitedly leaning close to you, his head pressed against yours, staring at the sketch. You instinctively felt a bit embarrassed and wanted to put the sketch away, but then you heard Spamton's voice again, as if he was acting spoiled, his voice a bit sticky: "Y/N." "Can I have this painting?" ”
“…… But it's just a sketch, nothing particularly good. How about I draw a new one for you?" You scratched your head, though giving this painting to Spamton wouldn't be a problem...... No, it does matter. Although Spamton praised your drawing and your colleagues said you did too, you still felt a bit insecure. After all, it was just your improvisation. If possible, you would still hope you could give Spamton the best.
Spamton just felt that whatever you drew was excellent in his eyes, and that didn't stop him from showing off, saying his Y/N had painted a picture for him—it was beautiful. And even if it was just a casual drawing, he could feel a warm emotion in the painting, as if it was enveloping him completely.
"This one is fine, and the previous one is fine too...... Ah, that one is already a gift for me, right? Y/N wants to draw me a new one—no, many, lots and lots of new ones! Y/N must really like drawing me too, right? "Spamton immediately went back to sitting on the sofa, but his eyes sparkled as he looked at you.
And you can't help but laugh: "Yes, of course I'll draw lots and lots of pictures for you...... Or rather, besides you, I probably don't have any other models." When you said this, you hesitated a little, because you couldn't be sure either...... After that, there would only be Spamton, the model. What if you need to draw someone else later?
But Spamton was almost making a fuss, grabbing your arm and shaking it, his eyes shining as he looked at you: "So, it's settled? Whether among the People of Light or Darkness, I'm the only model in Y/N!" ”
You were momentarily stunned, and before you could answer, Spamton puffed out his cheeks, looking a bit angry. You couldn't help but poke his cheek, then ruffle his hair, and softly say, "Of course, I will only have you as a model." ”
At this point, you decide, and indeed you can only paint him. Besides landscape oil paintings, the main character in the painting can only be him. Probably you still don't have the courage to paint other characters; you're afraid your painting will be criticized by those people, but only Spamton accepts it wholeheartedly.
And...... He has become another protagonist in your life. If you don't portray him, who else can you paint? Of course, the first protagonist in life is yourself. Everyone thinks about themselves and lives for themselves. As for him...... Spamton's presence was already present in the original future plans.
He rubbed contentedly against your palm, grabbed your hand, and rubbed it against his cheek, while Spamton just squinted and let out a slight purring sound similar to satisfaction.
"Alright, then Y/N's future paintings will all be mine...... Oh right, maybe Y/N should consider exhibiting them. I guarantee all the Dark People will come to see your masterpiece!" He said excitedly.
You feel a bit troubled. Honestly, seeing his sparkling eyes and hopeful expression, you feel a bit embarrassed to refuse, but...... You think, if it were your own will and choice, you probably wouldn't be so eager for the exhibition.
So in the end, you just quietly replied, "But holding a solo art exhibition is meaningless, and I don't want to be famous in the dark world." "You just need to honestly and steadily get through your lower half. You don't have many desires, nor any desires. You just ...... I just hope you and he can both spend the rest of your lives peacefully."
But Spamton, now the main advertiser, seems to really enjoy liveliness and fame.
Spamton was stunned for a moment, opening his mouth but not knowing what to say. From his perspective, he really did want you to become famous, to hold an art exhibition, so he could proudly announce to everyone that you were extremely, extremely amazing, and that you were his favorite Light Citizen. But...... He also knew that you should respect your wishes. If you didn't want to, although he might feel a bit disappointed and sad, he wouldn't say much.
So in the end, he just lowered his head, the two tufts of hair on the front of his head drooping a little, looking gloomy.
"If Y/N really doesn't want it, then forget it......" the voice was muffled.
You were stunned for a moment, not knowing how your Addison had ended up like this again. To be honest, you could feel that he was eager for you to hold an art exhibition. If it was for him, you would indeed be willing to hold one...... You thought for a moment, patted his head, and softly said, "Don't be sad." But if it were an art exhibition themed around you, I think I'd be willing. ”
You don't want to exhibit your past works. Although confirming this theme means rushing to produce a huge number of paintings, even though you don't know when you'll be able to finish them—you admit, personally speaking, you also hope more people of light and darkness will see Spamton, and perhaps the exhibition is a good opportunity.
Then Spamton's eyes suddenly lit up again. He dawdled down next to you, eagerly saying, "Then Y/N will hold an exhibition tomorrow!" I believe the tickets will definitely sell out overnight! ”
You helplessly flicked his forehead, and Spamton let out a loud "Ouch" as if in pain, then clutched his forehead and looked at you in grievance.
"It's not that easy. Preparing for the exhibition will take at least a week, and ...... I have far fewer paintings. "At most, if you count two paintings, I can only hang them at the entrance. The rest are just empty walls, nothing to look at.
"Then Y/N will treat me as a free model. I'll allow you to leave many portraits of me! There must be many Dark People coming to admire my heroic figure to visit your art exhibition!" Spamton slightly raised his head, speaking proudly.
You sighed and replied somewhat perfunctorily, "Alright, alright." ”
At the same time, you picked up the paper and left a portrait of him sitting upright as if spreading his screen.
Over the past few days, you feel like you can see Spamton striking seductive poses wherever you go. Whenever you pass by with a canvas, Spamton immediately stops and strikes a pose, sneaking glances at you out of the corner of his eye as if he's trying to see what you're doing.
If you really stop to paint, he'll look away and continue with that pose seriously, but after a while, he'll sneak another glance at you. If you're still focused on painting, he'll immediately turn his head and pretend he hasn't done anything. If you've finished, he'll lean in to look at your masterpiece and shout that your painting is beautiful, every time he's sincerely complimenting you, making your face blush and a bit embarrassed.
If his peripheral vision meets your gaze and you happen to meet your gaze, Spamton will blush, turn his head back, and try to be a responsible model.
If you haven't stopped, then Spamton can only look disappointed, tuck away that nonexistent tail feather that seems to be spreading its tail, then slunk behind you, eagerly waiting for your free moment, so he can continue modeling for you.
Recently, the staff in the advertising world have been troubled by the situation. For some reason, when Spamton recently comes to the company, they always look cheerful, with less difficulty and workload, but the boss's rambling noticeably increases.
A pippins, who wished to remain anonymous, shared a story about their own experience: "At the time, I was just delivering some documents to the boss's office. Just because I glanced at the oil painting behind the boss for a couple of seconds, the boss cheerfully shared with me, 'How did you know this was a gift from my Y/N,' and even nagged me for ages, bragging about how Y/N made this painting and how genius Y/N was!" ”
The other Dark People also expressed that what Pippins said was true, and that was exactly how they felt right now.
You didn't know about it; you just carefully left traces of his painting, recording his upright posture behind the dining table waiting for you, his falling asleep after waiting too long, his excitement as he watched blooming flowers, his eager expression as he leaned close to you to admire the painting, his face earnestly praising you, his face showing him lying on the sofa complaining about work, his glasses wearing glasses sitting at the table studying data, his apron around his apron flustered in the kitchen cleaning up dishes, and his skillful stir-frying of dishes......
You record these scenes, and the number of oil paintings accumulates, and this quantity is finally enough to hold an art exhibition.
So you take these oil paintings to discuss with the gallery owner, and the color card manager quickly agrees to your exhibition request.
TBC.
The exhibition is tentatively scheduled for half a month later, for a week-long show, so you have plenty of time to prepare before then. There's still another artist's exhibition going on, about a week away, and in a week, you'll be preparing to set up. At the same time, tickets will be available for reservation and go on sale.
You went home and shared this with Spamton. His eyes sparkled as he listened, then he excitedly waved his arms and legs: "I knew it—Y/N, you were absolutely right to hold this exhibition, especially great!! And I believe many dark people from the advertising world come to the exhibition just to admire my style, and maybe many dark folk from other worlds visit the exhibition out of curiosity about advertising!" ”
He kept shouting to himself, "You always see something behind him, like there's a tail, and it's already raised." You try to hold it in but still can't laugh, and you're too embarrassed to expose Spamton's beautiful imagination. After all, you think you're just an unknown artist, and printing so many tickets probably won't get you out. But the gallery owner insists on holding a week-long exhibition, and has printed a lot of tickets—twice the number of tickets from your last week-long exhibition...... You're worried about whether these tickets will even sell.
Besides, the advertising world probably wouldn't be particularly interested in seeing what the owner of this world is like in daily life. After all, almost all the people of darkness below are his employees, and they rarely see each other in daily life.
"Hmm...... Not really, my paintings are really just average, so don't flatter me like that. "You scratched your cheek a little shyly.
Spamton suddenly leaned in, his face enlarging in front of your eyes, making you involuntarily lean back: "...... What's wrong? ”
But he just looked at you seriously, then cupped your face with both hands: "Y/N, you need to be confident." Of course...... It's okay if you're not confident, I'll help you feel confident! I'll help you love your own ......." As he spoke, he covered his mouth, looking at you a bit helplessly, since he hadn't intended to say that out loud at a time like this.
But you just smiled and gently rubbed his head: "...... Yeah, I know. After all, it's because of you that I'm willing to accept my past." "Otherwise...... You'd probably never be able to pick up a paintbrush. The moment you do, you'll see that torn painting in half—one half of your parents, the other half your painting.
You can also hear the voices of those days—pointing at your paintings, looking at you with disappointment, saying that even if you spend your time on these hobbies, they wouldn't mind, but you can't achieve exquisite realms in those hobbies as well.
But now, when you pick up your brush, all you see is the half-painted spamton's shadow and the painting holding your hand together, and all you hear is his noisy chatter, saying that even if it's just a hobby, it's something impressive.
A bit noisy and noisy, always playing around, making the house a bit noisy, but you don't find it annoying; instead, you find him very cute.
"That's right, so Y/N is really impressive! Don't always be so humble. When you should be proud, just admit it. As long as you're proud, that's enough!" As he spoke, he first lifted his head proudly. You looked at him with a smile, and tried lifting your head yourself.
"You see, as long as you accept praise proudly, everything will become beautiful, right? And...... Just accept others' praise proudly! Because that's definitely what you deserve! ”
This statement sounds a bit unreasonable, after all...... Not everyone comes to praise your work with a completely appreciative gaze; maybe they're just being polite and giving a perfunctory answer.
But you still nodded: "...... I understand, I'll try to do this, right?" Your words carried a hint of hesitation.
Spamton just leaned in and leaned on your shoulder: "It's not about trying, it's about making sure — but if you're not used to it, I'll listen to what they say and then relay it to you!" He waved his finger, but of course, if he relayed it—he'd definitely praise you to the brim!
“…… Alright, but if you hear anything nasty, you have to tell me. You don't have to help me listen to these things—I'll handle it all myself." You fiddled with his fingers, playing with them casually, muttering this line under your breath.
He just waved his other hand in front of your eyes, mumbling unhappily, "What? If it makes you sad, you definitely shouldn't listen! Don't worry, no one will ever say anything bad about you!" Spamton patted his chest and promised you.
Even though you want to say more, seeing him make such a firm promise, you end up holding back your words. Think about it, maybe it's better not to spoil the mood, even though you don't think many people will praise you or anything...... Most of the time, aren't they just casually glanced around and then left?
But right after, you hear Spamton say, "But...... Y/N, you still need to build some confidence. How about this, I'll just praise you a few times every day from now on. After a month, you'll definitely be fine!" He nodded proudly as he spoke.
"Do you need it? But I think maybe you don't need it anymore, after all, you've always been like a proud peacock." You couldn't help but smile and gently rub your head against Spamton's head—fluffy and a little ticklish.
Spamton choked up, then suddenly raised his voice: "Of course I need—"
Of course, he really needs Y/N's praise! Although he usually seems very confident—part of the reason is that, as the creator of the advertising world, he can't be without confidence. Of course, there are also other reasons...... Maybe he's been by your side too long. Although Spamton still remembers the past, the pain of the past has long been something he can let go of, so gradually, he has become more confident.
But of course he needed it, or rather, needed even more!
You blink, rub his head with both hands, and his head obediently sways in direction with your movements.
"Mm...... Good, Spamton is amazing—it raised its own flowers! That's awesome! "You said with a cheerful smile.
"Y/N is amazing too! You've painted so many pictures...... For me, even being able to draw a single picture is already pretty rare. "Spamton immediately jumps in after you.
You coughed lightly, feeling your cheeks flushed a little, feeling a bit embarrassed...... So you patted your cheeks and quietly turned your head: "I...... I'll go get you a drawing paper. You try drawing too." You were just clumsily changing the subject, and then you hurriedly and somewhat in a panic went into the room to fetch a sheet of drawing paper and a set of crayons.
Spamton, looking at your background, also patted his slightly flushed face. He muttered softly twice, relieved that you probably couldn't hear what he was saying—even though he was just watching your back and whispering, 'I like you the most.'
Then, he saw you come out again. At that moment, the warmth on your faces had faded, and you handed Spamton both the drawing paper and crayons.
Spamton glanced at you cautiously, and you just nodded gently, smiled, and gave him an encouraging look.
Spamton took a deep breath and began to paint. He decided to paint that day, when you stand in front of him and take his coffee cup—that would be just so—cool!
Unfortunately, whether from excitement or nervousness, his hand trembled a little, but he still tried hard to draw his figure—a white Addison's shadow, your figure, the heroic figure standing in front of him to take the coffee cup—and the less important NPC opposite, who just sketched those shadows with crayons of different colors, yet carefully traced you. Even though you didn't have those, Spamton forcibly added luxurious clothes and exquisite decorations to you. In his eyes, you deserved the best of everything.
And after finishing the last stroke, he excitedly raised the drawing paper to show you. Although his lines were a bit crooked and not very good, you immediately recognized it — this was what it looked like that day at the cyber barbecue restaurant—you still remember that day, after all, you remember everything your white Addison had suffered.
You took the painting, stroking the brushstrokes on it. Out of the corner of your eye, you saw Spamton sitting upright, nervously waiting for your comment, while you suddenly laughed: "Spamton is really amazing!" Although it might be his first time painting or something...... But this painting is very vivid, and I really like it! It must have been that day at the Cyber Barbecue Restaurant. You've worked hard all along. "As you spoke, you bent down slightly and rubbed Spamton's head. He squinted slightly and rubbed against your palm, snoring twice before answering your question.
“Y/N…… That's impressive too! That day was so brave, standing in front of me without hesitation! If only one day, I could become a Dark Citizen as brave as Y/N! He patted his chest and said enthusiastically.
You always feel a bit embarrassed and turn your face away, but the slightly reddened tips of your ears still reveal your emotions.
"Ahem...... Y-I know...... But feeling scared is normal, and you don't have to be that brave. I'll protect you. "You sat back down on the sofa, and Spamton leaned closer to your side, pressing close to yours. Hearing this, he shook his head sternly.
"You can't always protect me...... I'm the advertiser now! Don't worry, maybe I'm protecting you more often! "Spamton promised.
"Then we'll just wait and see. But in the best...... I still hope you don't get hurt. "As for you...... If you get hurt, it's fine; you don't really care much about these things.
"You can't get hurt either. If you are...... Then I—I'll help you get revenge! ”
"Alright, alright. But I've heard that if you're injured, just a breath and the pain will fly away...... Of course, that's probably just for kids." You shook your head helplessly, then nodded, casually changing the subject.
"So you're hurt." Spamton's voice suddenly tensed and turned serious.
You were stunned for a moment, then had to roll up your sleeve to reveal that long line of wounds. It looked scary, but in reality, it was just a little bleeding at the time.
"It's okay, this little wound is just a minor issue. It'll heal in a couple of days...... And it was also my own carelessness that cut the doorframe. ”
But in the next second, Spamton cupped your arm and carefully blew on your wound, while his other hand behind his back quietly cast a healing spell. The wound healed quickly with his soft, warm breath, regrowing fair skin.
You widened your eyes in surprise, while Spamton just raised an eyebrow and looked at you proudly: "Look, just blow on it and the pain will fly away!" ”
TBC.
Of course, you wouldn't believe such childish things. You believed that just blowing on the wound would heal it, but seeing Spamton's smug expression, you naturally noticed his hand behind his back—you guess, this must be some kind of spell from the Dark People or something. You didn't say a word to expose him, just pretended to be surprised and widened your eyes: "It's actually healed—Spamton, you're amazing!" How on earth did he do this? Can I learn it too? ”
Spamton just pretended to be mysterious and mysterious, shaking his finger and head: "No, this is my exclusive secret manual, it's a secret! However...... Only you know this little secret." As he spoke, he winked at you mysteriously.
He would never use this kind of spell on other Dark Folk or Lightfolk — but there was no need! Besides, Spamton wouldn't want to cast spells on others. Although this kind of spell was nothing to him, if other Dark Folk insisted on using it, he would definitely take a hefty profit.
You sighed. This time, you genuinely felt a bit regretful. Honestly, you inevitably had some bumps and scrapes. If only there were such spells, how great it would be—you could heal yourself with one click and no longer have to worry about getting hurt.
Spamton, however, seemed to see right through your thoughts and said seriously, "Don't think that having this kind of spell as a backup doesn't mean the extent of the injury doesn't matter...... This usually only works on surface injuries. So, you must be careful, absolutely careful. ”
You looked away a little guiltily, not daring to look at him, and Spamton just turned your head to look straight at him, his tone a bit fierce: "Did you hear that?" ”
"I heard you, I heard you—don't be so harsh with me." You puffed out your cheeks and pretended to be wronged, and Spamton's arrogance quickly softened. He let go, just scratched his head and coughed dryly twice.
"I...... I'm not really being harsh with you!" He emphasized, his voice a bit weak.
"I know. Don't worry......" You tugged at his face and couldn't help but laugh, and he followed behind you, laughing too.
It's a brief moment of affection at home, and after that, you'll still have to work at a gallery, and Spamton will be his big boss at the company. Honestly, he really wants to be with you forever, even if it's just a doll that can only stay in your pocket, or just a parrot that always flies around you—even if he's by your side and does many, many other things.
But he can't. He's the master of the advertising world, so of course he can't just leave this place behind. But if he had to choose between you and his career, his first reaction would be to want both, and if he could only pick one, he'd grit his teeth and pick yours.
…… After all, if you lose your career, you can just try hard later. But if he loses you, there's no way he'll find the exact same Lightfolk again, and there's no chance he'll ever meet you again.
So—for this goal, to stay with you all the time, he has to work hard! Spamton pulled himself together, held another meeting, then stood on the high platform and began to order: "Y/N's solo art exhibition is about to open in the gallery. All the People of Darkness, buy a ticket, and during this period, all advertisements will be replaced with something related to the Y/N exhibition. We want more People of Light to see and click on them, and sell more tickets." ”
The employees looked at each other. Recently, because Spamton has been showing off the paintings you made for her, they've become numb to hearing your name. Admittedly, your paintings are well-chosen in color and beautifully brushed, worth admiring, but no matter how stunning they are, seeing them every day can make them feel a bit bored and irritated.
Yellow twirled his ankle boredly and asked, "What is the theme of this Y/N art exhibition, and what kind of promotional images do we need to use for advertising?" ”
This question left Spamton a bit stunned, since he didn't know exactly what kind of painting would be best to display...... After all, you've already taken the paintings to the gallery for display, and there's nothing left at home.
But he still looked up proudly, and the staff all heard a boastful tone: "The theme of this exhibition is, of course—the most dazzling person in the advertising world, SPAMTON G. SPAMTON!" ”
Moreover...... This time, he ordered his staff to buy tickets and even advertised for you—things you didn't know about. If he asked you for a preview of the artwork, wouldn't that be exposing himself!
Finally, his eyes darted around as he recalled the sketch you had promised to give him and had been hanging it on the wall at home for him to admire. He clapped his hands, and a pop-up appeared showing the images he had taken from all angles of that sketch before.
"As for promotional footage, let's use this!" He sent out countless identical pop-up windows, afraid that the Dark People behind wouldn't notice, and even made several pop-ups bigger.
Orange hesitated and clicked the pop-up window: "...... But, boss, are you sure a sketch is enough? If I remember correctly, Y/N is holding an oil painting exhibition, right? ”
Thanks to Spamton, all Dark People employees know that sooner or later you'll hold an oil painting exhibition.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then reluctantly pointed to the oil painting behind him: "If that's not enough, let's use this one as promotional material too." ”
"So you never told Miss Y/N about advertising her art exhibition?" The other Dark People hesitated. Although the boss had become much easier lately, they still didn't dare say anything to their faces. If Spamton lost his temper in anger, the consequences would be extremely serious. Still, Blue quietly spoke up to reveal the truth.
…… If he didn't say anything soon, the pink next to him would explode! He definitely didn't want to see what was once a good event turn into a mess and a complete mess.
But now, Pink just stood there with his arms crossed, staring expressionlessly at Spamton.
Spamton coughed twice, probably because this time it wasn't advertising his own product, so Addison was a bit reluctant. Besides, there wasn't much commission for the ad page—he closed his eyes and said painfully, "Here's the deal: I'll give you 520 Dark Coins a day." ”
…… As for why it was 520, he was still too embarrassed to say it.
The chattering noise below had quieted down a lot, and the pippins were all satisfied.
Only Blue was still quietly staring at Spamton, along with his former colleagues.
Seeing this, Spamton was a bit embarrassed and angry, and as if she was losing her temper, she shouted back to them: "Alright—I admit, I advertised her without her knowing! Because I hope more people of light and darkness will come to support her! I didn't charge her advertising fees, so I rented these ads out of my own pocket. Alright! ”

Spamton didn't even know...... When did you record all this? It was only then that he realized that you had seen everything.
After all, there are two more paintings, probably just your imagination—the first shows Spamton in a conference hall, directly commanding the other Dark People. Of course, this meeting room is just your imagination, completely different from the one he was in.
The second painting was of him proudly patrolling the shopping street. The small shop that used to be white Addison had been closed, and he was standing there, seemingly pointing and talking about other Addison shops.
Spamton turned his back to you, he's a bit afraid to turn his head to look at you, but his voice was a bit dry: "...... When did you paint it? How come I have no idea at all? ”
You rubbed your chin and thought for a moment: "Most of it was drawn in my own room...... After all, you've never seen it in my room before, so it's normal not to know, right?" "Except for that time, when you brought Spamton into your room, he hasn't gone in since. You know, that's respecting your privacy. Of course, you never tried to find out what exactly he was preparing, after all...... You would respect his thoughts, no matter how curious you are, you wouldn't sneak a peek!
Spamton remained silent, just walking down the corridor filled with paintings, until he finally stopped in front of that ...... Your family portrait. The term 'family portrait' was actually Spamton's own name. After all, your family only had you as a citizen of light and a person of darkness as well.
He looked at himself in the painting, smiling carefreely, and suddenly smiled too. He turned around and smiled at you: "I have an idea. Right in front of this painting, how about we take another photo together?" ”
You nod as if it were only natural: "Of course you can." ”
You might think, maybe he also wants to leave a little memory in this disappearing advertising world.
The store manager volunteered to step forward, holding an instant camera to take photos of you.
So Spamton puts his arm around your shoulder, and together with you, smiles at the camera, taking a precious photo together—of course, his current height has lost the advantage of being the master of this dark world, and he's reverted to the same state as he did in Addison, so he has to stand on tiptoe just to put his arm around your shoulder.
You suppress your laughter, and when you see other Addisons also come to the gallery to view the exhibition, you wave to them, and they come closer, gathering around you.
Pink looked impatient, but still said, "Alright, you want to take a photo together, right? We happened to be here today." ”
Blue glanced at Pink, then at Spamton: "I was clearly worried Spamton would come to the gallery......" But before he could finish, Yellow covered his mouth.
"Well, looking at it now, it actually seems like a good thing." Orange tried to smooth things over, skillfully sidling with Spamton.
You smiled, hugged Spamton, rested your head on his head, four other Addisons surrounded you, and then with a "click," the group photo was taken and washed out from the polaroid.
Of course, this group photo was copied four times and given to the other four Addisons. Spamton was a bit reluctant but still gave it away. And for your group photo, you used that family portrait as the background, framed in a photo frame, and placed it in the most prominent spot in the living room.
A week isn't long either, but not too short. The art exhibition ended, the gallery closed, and this dark world was about to disappear. In the end, Spamton hesitantly tugged at your sleeve and whispered, "...... Go to the shopping street. I told them that when they arrive at the time of the transaction, a Lightfolk will come looking for them. ”
You nod and head to the shopping street, where waiting for you are two Dark People, one human, and the other ...... Seems like monsters? You're not sure either, since the community you live in is still mostly human.
The purple girl who looked a bit like a dinosaur greeted you cheerfully, while the other blue boy didn't say a word.
She tells you that all the Dark People can live in Castle Town; you just need to move the corresponding objects from the Light World there.
You suddenly realize that you have left this dark world, and they have sealed the dark fountain of this world. You can no longer enter this dark world.
Feeling a bit disappointed? Indeed...... But with a bit of anticipation and a smile, you set out again on the road back to your original home. You no longer cared about those voices; after all, none of them mattered to you anymore.
You push open the door again, and your parents' gazes immediately turn toward you.
His mother was the first to shout: "You've called so many times and you still won't answer. I told you, you're old enough to find a place for your future. I've worried so much that my hair turned white over you, and you don't even glance at me. You must feel sorry for your parents!" ”
My father sighed too: "We've worried about you since we were little. Whatever you want, we haven't given it to you...... Look at this room—aren't these all the things you've been loudly trying to get? And only when you go to a good family can you focus on painting, right? ”
You ignore their voices, just walk into your room, bring out that computer, and you know Spamton survives on the spam stored in your mailbox.
When you walk out of the bedroom, your mother's voice suddenly rises: "Why won't you listen at all! We're doing this for your own good......"
You stopped in your tracks and turned to look at them. Although you tried hard to stay calm, your voice was still choked: "No, you ...... It's not love for me at all. You say it's for my own good, but it's really just to satisfy ...... Your own vanity. ”
Mother opened her mouth, her voice sharp: "Not at all—"
And you interrupted her: "That's it. You don't love me, you're just manipulating me. You don't see me as a child, a child worthy of your love, so I don't need parents like you either; I no longer need your love." ”
Sobbing and choking up, you feel your vision blur, and you just step back toward the door, smiling: "I won't come back. This isn't my home either. I'm going back to my own home now." ”
There is spamton, sunshine, smiles, eyes that always wait for you and anticipate you, voices that affirm you no matter what, your lover and your eternal family.
You closed the door, shutting out your parents' noise, feeling a sense of relief in your heart, and your steps becoming lighter. You beamed with a smile, leaving the past behind. You were about to walk toward your own future. This time, it was a future entirely decided by you—no scolding from your parents, no manipulation after superficial discussion. Now, you were going home.
You arrive at the address the purple girl gave you, put the computer inside, and then arrive in Castle Town. Having just experienced dizziness, you open your eyes when Spamton hugs you tightly.
"Welcome home!" Even though you were just standing on the streets of Castle Town, while other Dark Folk passing by were looking at you strangely, Addison only chuckled. The employees originally from the advertising world passed by, gave you and Spamton a flirtatious look, and then walked off again.
And you just sniffed, hugged Spamton back, and buried your head in his neck: "Mm, I'm back." ”
That day, while you were tidying up your new residence in Castle Town, you found the artwork Spamton had once shown you, along with some unsold fake flowers. You smiled and carefully stored those things away in the cabinet. As for that slightly wilted sunflower...... You took good care of it and placed it on the windowsill. As the sunflower grew and bloomed facing the sun, it was as if a small seed had been planted in your heart, growing and blooming.
Spamton, for some reason, transplanted those flowers to the square in the center of Castle Town, confidently surprised you, and solemnly took out a pot of roses he had grown to confess to you.
That sea of flowers still remains in the square, and you have simply returned home with Spamton. The future is still long, very long, and you will walk into the future together with Spamton.
So...... Welcome home.
END.

title: middle
content:
But he only dared to lower his head, staring blankly at the bandage you had just bandaged, lost in thought. He didn't dare let you see his expression, nor the unease and bitterness he might be revealing. He stared at the bandage, staring at the small wound that could have been healed with just a spell, barely sorting out his tangled and complicated emotions.
Do you regret deceiving you? Maybe not...... Because he's afraid that once you know the truth, he won't show him such genuine care anymore, and he's afraid he won't be able to feel love from you again.
But maybe always deceiving you isn't a good thing, but trying to explain everything from the beginning is hard to begin. Spamton opened his mouth, about to reveal the whole truth, but your voice interrupted him again.
"By the way, how is your fake flower art selling going?" Actually, you didn't really know what to say. You just felt it wasn't good to let the room sink into silence, so you spoke up and randomly picked a question.
Spamton snapped back to reality, perked up again, and answered your question with a big smile: "It sold very well, a full hundred copies!" "And it was exactly the number of employees under his command...... Yes, aside from those he forced to buy and sell, nothing else was sold.
But he believes that with commissions as an attraction, there will always be employees who make sales. As for commissions...... Speaking of which, it should be considered part of the fairness you want, right? Spamton can't be sure.
And the truth he had just instinctively wanted to blurt out was buried by him. He thought, since that's the case, he'll wait until next time, when he's sure he's ready to speak, and then tell you. Unfortunately...... Spamton wasn't sure if there was still such an opportunity.
You tilted your head, a bit puzzled, probably not expecting this so-called artwork to actually sell, nor to expect so many copies to exist.
"All of these...... Are they all sold by you? Do you have that much stock? Do you need my help...... You look a bit worried. Although you haven't done any art or handicraft work in a long time, you think it shouldn't be too hard to pick it up again for him.
Spamton was a bit stuck. He was a bit annoyed—if he'd known, he wouldn't have said 100 servings so directly—his shop didn't have that many!
But he cleared his throat and came up with another lie, unusually feeling guilty because it was completely false: "I sold them all! There are only five or six items left in stock, so the rest are pre-orders. I'll come pick them up in a few days...... I don't need your help, I can handle it myself!" He smiled to hide his panic.
You stared at him for so long that Spamton almost thought maybe he was wrong and that you might expose his lie. Feeling genuinely uneasy, you gently nodded and leaned in to ruffle Spamton's head: "I see...... Business is booming, Spammy is amazing at coming up with this. ”
You smiled, despite ...... You had already realized that this sentence was probably a lie. After all, when he spoke, his eyes didn't even dare look directly at you, drifting upward to the left, clearly just fabricating the scene from before. But you still chose to follow his words.
Sometimes you can't figure it out—he could have told you the truth, so why lie again? Even if you're willing to believe his lies, because most lies hide genuine emotions, revealing past fears and fears, anxiety, and grievances. You've been waiting for the day he is willing to tell you the truth. If it's always a lie, that's fine.
…… You are willing to favor him, tolerate him, and accept the lies he says.
Maybe at first it was just a simple exploitation...... You guess that's how it is, but for some reason, this somewhat twisted relationship has persisted until now.
You rub his head, and Spamton instinctively rubs his furry head against your palm. You hear his voice full of affection and joy: "I like you the most!" ”
You're a bit distracted—is that really true? But...... But why did things end up like this? You don't understand.
So, this statement is probably false. You immediately put it out of your mind, only responding with a slow "Mm."
Spamton's movements finally slowed down, though still rubbing slowly against your palm: "By the way, Y/N, we promised you were treating my colleagues to dinner...... They set the venue at Cyber BBQ." By the end, his voice gradually softened.
You nod gently, then remembered Spamton was looking down and couldn't see your movements, so you replied, "Alright, I know." ”
“…… That place is where they once threw a coffee cup at my head. "He grabbed your hand, but this time rested it on your chin, and he looked up at you, showing a pitiful expression.
"So...... The place where they said they would throw you into the trash was also that place? "You paused for a moment, then recalled the first time we met, while Spamton just blinked at you and said nothing.
"I know...... Although I can't guarantee I'll help you get revenge, I can make sure they don't do it again. "You scratched his chin, assuring him.
Actually, even if you hadn't said anything, those Addisons wouldn't dare do anything to him anymore—after all, he was a big boss. But Spamton just blinked and said nothing, after all...... What he hoped for wasn't the present, but the past—the past he once didn't want to face, even hated, to be changed.
You scratched his cheek again before getting back to the seat opposite him. You had been waiting for Spamton to come back and hadn't even had dinner yet. Bandaging the wound wasted some time, and the pizza was already a bit cold.
But it's still edible, so you plan to pick up a piece and eat it directly.
But Spamton held your hand down: "Some have cooled down. I'll heat them up before you eat." ”
You paused for a moment and instinctively said, "No need to go to such trouble......" After all, you've had dinner like this many times in the world of light. Many times, even when dinner got cold, your parents still hadn't come home. Many times, they broke their promise from yesterday.
But Spamton had already walked into the kitchen carrying that plate, and you heard the sound of the heating plate and microwave, so you could only sigh softly. Even though you were sighing, the corners of your mouth couldn't help but lift. You touched the corner of your mouth, a bit dazed.
While you were still dazed, the microwave stopped, and Spamton came out carrying the pizza again, placing it in front of you. You touched it—the temperature was just right.
Spamton secretly felt proud. Previously, just in time for you to come home, he had prepared a steaming dinner just right, and he had studied the heat control of each item. So heating the pizza to this temperature for a long time was just right.
He doesn't think about how you might react; he just instinctively lifts his cheeks and looks at you with sparkling eyes, begging you to praise him.
And you naturally curved your eyes: "The temperature is just right, thank you, spammy...... You're really amazing! ”
You see him lift his head proudly and can't help but laugh too.
And so, dinner ended happily. After dinner, Spamton tidied up the leftover bowls and chopsticks, then sat on the sofa and started making art pieces with those mineral water bottles.
…… He really did regret it a little. If he'd known, he wouldn't have mentioned pre-ordering earlier. He just told you that giving them counterfeit or inferior products would be better than doing handicrafts here...... Alright, you'll definitely say that way.
Although Spamton only plans to make a few for show, leaving the rest to the staff themselves, at worst they just pay and get a picture. After all, the actual product doesn't necessarily match the pictures.
You sighed and sat down next to Spamton. Spamton felt the sofa sink in one spot, and when he turned to look at you, you picked up several bottles of mineral water as well.
"Almost 100 servings? How can you finish it? Let me help you." You said softly, picking up scissors and glue to start working.
Spamton didn't know whether to tell you that what he just said was just deceiving you—but he didn't want to bother you, because under your command, what used to be something he had just haphazardly assembled had now truly become a work of art.
You cut off the base of the bottle, glue the mouth together, and trim some plastic strips from the sides of the bottle as decoration. Soon, a piece of art resembling a sunflower appeared in your hands.
Spamton stares at you blankly, even forgetting to continue what he's doing. You glance at him with some confusion: "Stop staring at me all the time...... Hurry up and do it." ”
"Oh, oh......" He lowered his head to fiddle with the half-finished "artwork" in his hands, but his mind was nowhere to be found. He kept thinking, you clearly have the talent and the interest to do other art-related work, but you were just an ordinary gallery employee. He thought, he has no right to interfere with what you think or choose, but Spamton still feels sorry for you.
You wouldn't think so much about it, just staring at the "sunflower" in your hand and getting a bit lost in thought—you recall your previous painting imitating that sunflower, but unfortunately, that painting is now tucked away at the very bottom of the box, probably never to be republished in this lifetime.
So you pick up a few bottles of mineral water and repeat the previous work, planning to make a few more sunflowers. You think, maybe if something else happens, you won't remember those previous paintings anymore.
But even though you made several more sunflowers, you couldn't hide your earlier thoughts, so you thought, maybe something else could distract you. So you looked at Spamton again, only to find with amusement that he hadn't even finished the one in his hand.
"spammy, don't you know what shape to tie it into?" You put down the scissors and glue, stretched lazily, and said lazily.
Spamton shivered instinctively, feeling a bit distracted and guilty at being caught by you: "Hmm...... Ah, right, I don't know what shape to tie it up. "Then he gave you a cautious smile.
You rubbed his head and thought casually: "Alright, then you can do sunflowers like me. Look, the examples are all right here. You just need to do a quick pom." ”
Spamton nodded. Although he didn't do as well as you, he managed to manage a few things.
When he turns his head with sparkling eyes, hoping for your praise, he finds you already asleep on the back of the sofa, your head tilted and resting on his shoulder.
Spamton was silent for a moment, then got up, carefully carried you to bed, tucked you in, and then gazed at your peaceful sleeping face for a long time before leaving.
TBC.
On the weekend, at the agreed time, you showed up at the Cyber BBQ Restaurant with Spamton. As soon as you entered, you saw the other Addisons. They were sitting by the window, so you grabbed Spamton's hand and sat right across from them. Honestly, I don't know why they happened to make room across from you, but all four Dark Folk had to squeeze in...... You didn't quite understand, but Pink spoke first.
"It was Spamton who snatched my stuff first, so of course I have to get it back." He spoke righteously and confidently, arms crossed. Of course, since Spamton was right there, Pink couldn't just say it was Spamton who first snatched his stuff and then let him snatch it back, so he could show you this scene.
Pink was grinding his teeth in hatred. He kept thinking to himself, Spamton clearly doesn't like flattering the Lightfolk, yet he's so scheming at it—he must have learned it all for you.
You're a step too slow. According to Pink, Spamton was indeed at fault, but you just waved your hand: "I think we should hear from the parties involved and the witnesses around us about this." "You're very serious. Honestly, you feel like a judge in one of the courtroom games you used to love—honestly, it's pretty fun."
Spamton, on the other hand, just cautiously grabbed your arm, not daring to use too much force, just holding it weakly: "Because...... Pink said bad things about you, and I was upset, so I wanted to steal his stuff. I want to get back at you......
You were stunned again, surprised that Spamton would admit to the matter but explain the reason. Honestly, seeing his head lowered and his weak voice, you couldn't help but soften.
Pink was at a loss for words. He really wanted to say that Spamton was just twisting the truth and talking nonsense—back then, he had only mocked Spamton for being good at winning your favor, so why not try to please the other Light Folk and make the advertising world better? Then Spamton targeted him like this.
And you just gently rub Spamton's head, look up at the other Addisons, and ask, "So what did you see at the time?" ”
"I was quite far away. Spamton did indeed steal Pink's stuff, so later Pink went to the Spamton shop to rob something." Blue said.
“…… Well, anyway, what Pink said back then wasn't very pleasant. "yellow hesitated, obviously not expecting Spamton to twist the facts so much.
"But later, all the customers went to Pink, and we were busy grabbing clients, so we didn't pay attention to this matter." Orange added.
You nodded, then patted Spamton's head. Well, now it seems he was indeed at fault—but you chose to favor him, and besides, he acted for you. If you don't support him, who else will?
So you spoke up, slowly saying, 'Okay, I understand… spammy is indeed at fault, but first, pink spoke unpleasantly, so I think, no matter what, spammy’s actions can only be considered self-defense.' You admitted that you were also quite unreasonable, after all, robbery carries much heavier criminal liability than a few words of dispute… but you believe spamton was not wrong.
How could your Spamton possibly have any major issues?
Pink rolled his eyes helplessly. He thought you and Spamton were just as unreasonable as you were, and he didn't understand why you two thought each other was just so close.
But then he heard what you said next: "...... So, I want to know, who poured coffee on my Spammy earlier?" You said with a smile, showing no sign of anger, but the other Addisons all shivered.
Then they all looked at Pink, who was a bit annoyed: "Why are you all staring at me!" ”
And you just tilted your head, looking at Pink as well: "So...... Do you know anything? ”
Pink picked up the coffee cup on the table and took a sip, probably feeling it was getting cold. Instinctively, he threw the cup out—right in the direction of Spamton.
…… Well, actually, before coming, Spamton had already reminded them to reenact the scene from that time. Although they didn't understand what Spamton was really trying to do, they had no choice but to comply. After all, Spamton said they would be given extra overtime pay, which was rare. Normally, they would have paid them out of pocket.
You reached out to catch the coffee cup and held it in front of Spamton. Fortunately, only a few drops spilled and splashed onto you. You placed the cup on the table and said calmly, "So, it really was you." ”
Spamton hid behind you, cautiously poking his head out to look at the other Addisons, then pulled his eyelids into a funny face and grinned at the others. Pink was so angry he nearly fainted.
He rolled his eyes, annoyed: "Yes, it's me. I asked Spamton to make coffee, but he didn't do it properly. The coffee got a bit cold and tasted bad. Is there something wrong with me inviting him to drink it?" ”
“…… You shouldn't have poured coffee on him." You just said slowly. Honestly, you're starting to feel sorry for Spamton again...... Although this is ultimately just a small matter, you can't imagine how many such small incidents have happened before. And often, these little things pile up enough to completely change the course of a life.
“…… He doesn't have coffee anyway, so what's the point of me treating him?" Pink crossed his arms and rolled his eyes again.
"At that time, Spamton volunteered to make us coffee. The other temperatures were just right, except for Pink's cup, which had issues." Yellow added a seemingly considerate comment from the side, but Pink always felt he was a bit gloating.
…… So today the only one being the punching bag is him, who was pushed out to be the punching bag? Pink was a bit annoyed, so he quickly added.
"Do you want to know what happened when he was thrown into the trash heap?"
You nodded. Of course you wanted to know about this...... To be honest, you came here just to find a place for your Spamton. You know this barbecue restaurant probably contains all of Spamton's grievances and sad memories, and you have no idea how much courage it took for him to dare to walk in.
"It was that guy Yellow. When they saw Spamton with a coffee cup on his head, they thought he was better suited to staying in the trash heap, and ...... Spamton couldn't sell a single thing, had no results at all, so treating him as trash was more suitable. "Pink squinted, also speaking with a hint of schadenfreude, thinking that the gloating Yellow just now definitely wouldn't get away.
Now yellow fell silent, just lowered his head, not daring to look at you.
You sighed: "No one should stay in a garbage heap, and no one should be trash. Besides, he's a righteous businessman of the Dark. Even if he doesn't do as well as you, you have no reason to target him." ”
The Addison didn't say anything. Honestly, with Spamton's pitiful look...... They hadn't thought he could be that formidable at first. But now, they just lowered their heads and didn't say a word.
Spamton just cautiously poked your waist. You turned to look at him, and he whispered, "...... That's enough. After all, they're all my colleagues, so there's no need to make things too awkward. We'll all get along in the future......" As he spoke, he lowered his head again, his voice sounding a bit aggrieved.
You gently wiped his cheek with affection, then looked up: "Alright, anyway, I'm here today...... I just want you to know that I'm the one who protects him, so don't think about doing anything bad anymore." As she spoke, she lightly tapped the table with her knuckles.
The Addisons exchanged glances, thinking to themselves, how could they dare...... Now Spamton is the master of the advertising world, above all the Dark People. It's already good if Spamton doesn't turn around and target them.
They just nodded eagerly: "We know, we know." ”
Even though the play wasn't over yet—because Pink had interrupted and revealed Yellow's previous actions—Spamton still slightly lifted his head, looking at your back with a complicated expression—yes, he knew you'd pass by there, which is why he stayed in the garbage heap for days. Back then, he couldn't imagine the current scene or the chaotic, complicated emotions of today.
His eyes reddened, and he silently wiped away the tears swirling in his eyes with his other free hand. Maybe...... From the start, he wished someone could stand before him. After all, who hasn't thought about being hurt? If only someone had stopped it then.
…… Only when there is no hope or hope do you stumble and get up on your own, trying every possible way and crawling to protect yourself. He once thought that once he became strong, he would take revenge, but now, seeing you standing in his way, he felt ...... This isn't so bad.
Because ...... He was no longer alone; he had something to rely on, no longer having to grit his teeth and complete everything on his own.
And ...... Having someone to rely on feels so good. He thought, he could finally face all of this and stop caring, since what he cared about now was you. Spamton thought, he could truly love the once down-and-out self and the self now full of lies. After all...... He also wanted to give you this love.
You sighed, not noticing the change in Spamton's expression behind you, but Blue did, showing a somewhat complicated expression.
"So...... Is there anything else? If not, let Spamton handle it herself. "You nod, and just as you finished speaking, Orange picked up your words.
"Ah, I used to put on a little dress for Spammy...... To be honest, he actually looks pretty good in a little dress." Orange rubbed his hands with a smile. Anyway, he didn't think he did anything wrong, and you paused for a moment, instinctively turning to look at Spamton, and indeed began to assess what he would look like if he wore a dress......
Spamton, rarely blushing, covers your eyes and whispers close to your ear, "Y/N, you...... If you want to see, I'll wear it alone for you later. ”
You want to say you don't want to see this kind of scene, but you honestly nod—well, maybe you still want it, and you remember, some skirts you bought before that you haven't worn are probably just right for spamton. As for why you stop wearing skirts...... It's just for some personal private reasons.
Spamton glanced at you with some awkwardness. Well, he doesn't mind showing you wearing a skirt...... If others see it, that's not acceptable, especially since advertising for the Light People doesn't require him to risk everything and wear a skirt.
Blue didn't speak, only softly adding when the surroundings had quieted: "From now on, I won't just stand there and watch." ”
…… Bystanders are also accomplices.
You felt everything had been clarified, so you nodded approvingly and said, 'Alright, in any case, my spammy also troubles you!'
The meal was basically over. Next, you ordered some barbecue inside the shop. The atmosphere was quite harmonious, and you were very satisfied.
TBC.
You returned home as usual. Indeed, having to chat with Addison and analyze the truth about past events is exhausting for you. You just leaned wearily on the sofa, watching Spamton unusually serve you tea and pat your shoulders on the sofa, which made you want to laugh a little—though you can't say he was exceptionally attentive; rather, it was usually the same. It was just that today's excessive attention made you feel a bit flattered.
So much so that even though you took a sip of tea, you couldn't help but marvel at whether it was just the right temperature or just the right flavor to your liking. You couldn't help but ask out of curiosity: "...... Why are you so attentive today? Did you do something to let me down?" ”
Speaking of which...... The temperature of the tea was just right. He wondered how many cups of coffee he had brewed before, and how many cups of coffee had been thrown by those Addisons. Thinking of this, you seemed a bit distracted, but quickly snapped back to reality, just shook your head, and tossed those thoughts out of your mind.
Spamton's pat on your shoulder stiffened for a moment. If he hadn't recognized that your tone was just pure curiosity, he might have thought you really knew something.
You felt the movement behind you stop, and no sound came from you. You turned to look at Spamton in confusion, and he quickly turned your face away, cleared his throat, and pretended to be deep.
"What are you talking about...... Of course I haven't done anything to betray you! If I really did, I'd rather punch myself......" His voice sounded a bit pitiful, sounding aggrieved as he said this, though the first half was pretending to be relaxed. You could tell he was speaking sincerely, but Spamton seemed nervous, so much so you wanted to tease him for a moment.
"So that's how it is...... you dragged out your words, turned to look at Spamton, and Spamton quickly nodded in agreement.
You cupped his cheek, sighed softly, and gently stroked his cheek: "You don't need to do that. Besides, I trust you. You won't do anything to betray me." "These words come from the heart. You truly believe this. You trust Spamton...... It seems like the first time since that time in the Light World that you've trusted anyone other than yourself so much. You were slightly distracted, but quickly gathered your thoughts and gently stroked his face once more.
"But...... So, you can't tell me you're hiding something from me, are you?" You tilted your head. You're pretty sure Spamton hasn't told you the whole truth, but you don't really care...... After all, sometimes, when he's saying this and that, even if you see him showing a fake smile or a pitiful, miserable expression, beneath that, in his voice, you hear the hidden lines—no matter what, he looks like he's about to cry, and you can only hear and feel his sadness.
So no matter what he said, this sadness was real...... You were willing to believe him. Although the facts may be fabricated, the emotions behind them are definitely not fake.

He stared blankly at the pot of flowers and asked, "In that case...... Just illuminate all the flowers, or rather, just place a lamp in the middle of a cluster of flowers, wouldn't that be enough? ”
Your mouth twitched, feeling like this was some kind of greenhouse replica—well, not entirely, just a bit similar. You cleared your throat, feeling you should answer seriously, but your words inevitably showed a hint of amusement.
Because you find his serious demeanor surprisingly cute.
"Ahem...... Even a single lamp couldn't cover such a large area! If the equipment were big enough, it could indeed be done, but this is just a small lamp—how could it have such a big effect? ”
"And precisely because it's small enough, the coverage isn't that big, so it's easier to sell more." You wink at him innocently and smile.
Spamton was taken aback, quickly understanding what you meant, and couldn't help but laugh along.
"That's perfect—then, for a scale of this size, we'll sell for a thousand Dark Coins. If it's a large ...... Then ten million Dark Coins! Spamton shook his finger and started talking nonsense.
You didn't break his imagination. Even though you thought buying ten million Dark Coins and the Dark People would be a fool, a fantasy, you just clapped and smiled: "That's right, that's exactly what I meant. If it were large, it would definitely be even more expensive." ”
Spamton's thoughts were pulled back again. He was a bit unhappy about the person interrupting his memories, but seeing it was Blue, he felt embarrassed to lose his temper. As the master of advertising, he wouldn't get angry with a patient!
He was already taught a lesson by you yesterday, and now he's super proud thinking he's done very well.
"So, what is the price of this lamp?" Blue simply asked calmly.
He felt a bit helpless. If it weren't for the growing voices of the Dark People at the scene, and if some pippins had even sneaked up betting while Spamton was lost in thought or even sneaking in from below, Blue wouldn't know why they were still thinking about gambling at a time like this—especially how long it would take for Spamton to say something next.
…… In fact, the reason he was now calling out for Spamton was because Orange, who loved drama, dragged him into the gamble too. And Blue definitely didn't want to lose.
Orange winked at him, while Pink glared at him, probably because he was also involved. But since Blue spoke up, he probably lost the bet—Blue was just pretending not to notice.
"Only five units...... Each Dark Citizen is limited to buying one. As for the price, let's set it at 10,000 Dark Coins per lamp! Spamton's eyes darted around as he popped up a large pop-up displaying the price, which also showed "50% off."
"Not only that, but I want to tell everyone this is a limited-time offer. If it expires, it will return to the retail price of 20,000 Dark Coins in a week."
Then he popped up another pop-up window, countless arrows pointing to the image of the full-spectrum plant lamp he had imagined.
"If you can't catch the first generation, you can wait for the second, but the second generation's functionality isn't as strong as the first, so it was only sold for 5,000 Dark Coins. It's also a limited-time first-week discount, and after that, the original price will return to 10,000."
He loudly announced that the price he told you was obviously lying...... Now was the retail price he had truly considered!
TBC.
The employees looked around, glanced at each other, then nodded randomly. After all, the price was decided by Spamton, the big boss, and had nothing to do with them.
Spamton saw that all the employees below nodded in agreement, with no objections, and nodded in satisfaction. He said so, there would never be anyone among the Dark People who thought their decision was bad!
Of course, there are certainly some Dark People who think this way, but for them, they simply don't have the courage to challenge Spamton's opinion.
But Spamton still remembers what you said. You pinched his cheek and told him, since you're already the master of the advertising world and a big boss, you should carefully ask the employees if they have any opinions. If they just don't dare to say anything—you wouldn't go to work with him, and of course you wouldn't be able to find his mistakes in time. And you always feel that sometimes Spamton will keep things from you and won't tell the truth.
At this moment, he was smugly thinking that he had already done quite well, and the employees below didn't even have a single objection! But he still obediently listened to you and decided to ask again.
So he just cleared his throat and said arrogantly, "Ahem, do you have any other suggestions? If there are no objections, the meeting is adjourned. Next up is this publicity plan!" He clapped his hands and announced.
At this moment, Blue raised his hand again: "I think, if it's the second batch, the pricing might be a bit high. Maybe we should lower the price?" Not many Dark People have savings in Dark Coins. ”
Spamton's face immediately fell, knowing he shouldn't have asked. That way, he could go home and show off to you how right his decision was, but not a single Dark Civilian objected.
He opened his mouth, but before he could answer, Orange raised his hand and gave his answer: "I think if the second batch of lanterns is set at 10,000 Dark Coins, then we should give them more time to discount, or at least give them an event one month in advance before sales start so those Dark People can reserve purchases. After the sale officially starts, we can give them another month of promotion. That way, those Dark People can accumulate enough Dark Coins, and then we can all make a profit from them." Orange said this while winking and winking.
Spamton puffed out his cheeks, wanting to say that just doing as he said would be fine, but he had to admit his former colleague did have some point...... And he remembered what you said—he needed to listen to the opinions of other employees.
To be honest, he actually didn't want to do that; it was only because you said that he was reluctantly willing to give it a try. But now Spamton realized that this did have some benefits, since there were some areas he didn't do well. Although being a dictator is great and comfortable! But he also wants to do better. As long as he becomes more impressive, you'll surely drown him in all kinds of boasting and exaggerated praise. Just thinking about this makes Spamton feel delighted.
So at this moment, Spamton just waved his hand impatiently: "You make a good point...... Then let's adjust according to your proposal. First, lower the price from 10,000 Dark Coins to 5,000 Dark Coins. Next, start a one-month promotional event. During the promotion period, pre-orders will be priced at the 1,000 Dark Coin event price. Once the promotion ends, after the product launches, there will be a month-long promotion, and then the price will be set at 2,500 Dark Coins!" "Anyway, it doesn't really matter how many Dark Coins you set at the price. Everything is up to him," Spamton thought to himself, hands on hips. However, after all, most of the Dark Coins owned by the other Dark People in the advertising world were actually under his control, so it didn't matter if he controlled everything.
Then Spamton waved his hand, signaling the meeting to end. The employees swarmed out of the meeting room, where the pippins were still whispering, discussing how the boss had changed his temper these past few days. Not only did they hardly bother with their gambling—otherwise, they wouldn't have started gambling so brazenly while Spamton was daydreaming. They were sure Spamton must have known, just ignored them.
But it didn't matter—it just meant their lives had gotten better, and they could be more uninhibited. So those pippins just happily jumped out, Shadow Guy was happily playing tunes, extremely excited, and this time it was a stirring saxophone track. Zapper, on the other hand, just bounced a few times without saying much.
Spamton just sat quietly in the now-quiet conference room for a while, and he started missing you again, because when he was alone in the room, he only felt bored or even afraid, completely alone, as if he had been abandoned by all the Dark People. No, he would never be like before, alone and alone. He knew he had a home, and he knew you were always there waiting for him. He knew...... He probably knew, or rather, he insisted on thinking that way, that you would always be by his side and never abandon him.
He simply got up and walked out of the meeting room, returning to the strike room, letting these thoughts wander freely. He simply squatted down, looking at the roses and tulips planted with some worry. ，
Although he secretly bought a few full-spectrum plant lamps from you, under his care, these plants still looked wilted. He just didn't kill them, but they weren't much better either. Spamton was always worried. He wanted to plant them properly and show them to you, to surprise you. But now...... He couldn't possibly give you a withered, wilted flower either.
Spamton frowned worriedly and couldn't help watering a little more, but the flowers wilted even more. He closed his eyes for a moment, then finally picked up a pot of tulips—he decided to go home and ask for your opinion. What exactly are these trade secrets? He had no idea! Luckily, he didn't intend to treat this pot of flowers as a surprise or anything, so it was fine to show it to you casually.
Today, he had been busy in the office with the ringing of bells for a while. The other employees had no idea what he was doing, but Spamton just kept a stern face, holding the listless tulip as he went home. He had come home a bit late. To be honest, all that time had been spent flipping through books in the office, trying to find some information to see if there was anything useful among the useless piles of just pretty books.
…… It turned out there weren't. They were all economics books he didn't even read, because he found them boring and only covered key points he had already mastered.
He took a deep breath and opened the door. You were already sitting at the dining table waiting for him. Seeing that he hadn't come home today, you simply reheated the frozen pizza in the fridge. After all, this has quite a lot and is convenient to eat. You really enjoy tinkering with it.
The steaming hot pizza was on the dining table. You wanted to say more, but when you looked up at Spamton, you couldn't help but pause—you had just been anxiously scrolling on your phone because Spamton had come home late, not knowing what to do. In short, you were just constantly refreshing the chat page. After all, if you really wanted to calm down and look at something, you wouldn't be able to stand it anymore.
But you didn't expect Spamton to bring back a potted flower...... It was a wilted sunflower.
