Your mouth twitched, and you could tell the flower had been watered too much. Spamton was probably too nervous, and sometimes even too nervous wouldn't work...... But it's hard to maintain a relaxed mood.
You were momentarily distracted by the last payment, but still spoke with a smile: "Put that pot down for now. We'll talk about it after we have a good dinner." By the way, it's probably just that you watered too much. Usually, once a day is enough, and some plants require different amounts of irrigation depending on the variety. ”
You probably explained it to him, and Spamton just nodded half-understandingly; he probably didn't really get it.
You just sighed and chose to break it open to explain: "Anyway, first pour out the water that has accumulated in the basin. Then I suggest you change the soil, to a dry environment, and make sure to irrigate once a day. As long as the soil is slightly moist, it'll be fine." ”
Spamton nodded repeatedly and was about to find a new pot, but you quickly grabbed him: "Plants are very resilient. It's fine to leave them a little longer...... You should eat first. You're coming back so late—you must be really hungry." ”
Spamton scratched his cheek, his face slightly flushed. Indeed, he could hear the rumbling of his stomach, so he finally put down the flowerpot and obediently sat down across from you to start eating.
You nod in satisfaction, glanced at him, and couldn't help but add, "Do you have any other cultivations...... Different flowers have their own cultivation methods. ”
But Spamton just shook his head frantically; for now, he still doesn’t want you to see it. After all, he plans to give you a surprise, and he also intends to make an effort himself—he must grow lavender successfully to give you a surprise, and then watch your eyes light up as you praise him, saying that Spamton is really amazing.
Seeing him like this, you can tell that he’s definitely hiding something from you again, but it doesn’t really matter. After all, you know, and sooner or later you’ll find out exactly what he’s been keeping from you.
After all, what he’s hiding is all meant for you to see. You know this very well, so you can’t help but start looking forward to it.
What might he be preparing? Could it be a carnation, meant to express gratitude and friendship? But you don’t need such things. You just voluntarily, spontaneously, want to be kind to him. It’s not because he has done something that deserves it; you just feel that he also deserves these things, that he is entitled to his own happiness.
After all, no one is born to suffer, even if… your past hasn’t been happy, you’re also willing to make an effort to create what can be considered a warm and beautiful present for him. After all, you believe his future will also be bright and shining—though you haven’t considered this for yourself. You just feel that it doesn’t matter what happens to you.
After you finished dinner, he tidied up the dishes as usual, and now you are both sitting on the sofa.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 1 (swapsptx you)
content:
Ggdwx you, ooc count me in. From Bai Pan to ggdw, three ideas were blended (1. Picking up spt2.ggdw from the trash to pretend to be innocent 3. Daily saying 'I like you' only to get a blunt response)
——
You found that white Addison in a pile of trash.
Actually, you've seen many Addisons, since they always sell you all kinds of products. But this is the first time you've seen Addis whose white ones are noticeably smaller than other Addisons...... And you don't even know why he looks so dejected, or rather, sitting in a pile of trash with tears streaming down his face.
You can't just leave this Dark Folk here, even though that has nothing to do with you, the Citizen of Light...... What does the end of anything else have to do with you? But maybe he looked too pitiful and cute, or maybe his silent, tearful and cautious look made your heart ache. Anyway, you crouched down, grabbed his hand, and pulled him out of the trash heap. He was covered in filth, looking as if he'd spent days in the trash, with a coffee cup on his head, brown stains dripping down.
You glanced at him several times, and he carefully pried your fingers away, nervously pulling your hand back behind your back: "Thank you...... But I'm not very clean. ”
You crossed your arms, tilted your head to look at him, rubbed your chin, and then asked, "...... Could it be that you have an infectious disease or something? After all, you just came out of that place." You always speak bluntly, and you pointed directly at the pile of garbage nearby.
He seemed stunned for a moment, then quickly shook his head and hurriedly took down the coffee cup from above him: "No...... Although I'm a bit dirty, I'm very clean." He stammered, probably not knowing how to explain, so he could only look up and look at you anxiously.
You were silent for a moment. To be honest, you hadn't intended to bother with him at first...... At most, you'd just pull him out and stuff in some dark coins. You believed nothing would be unbearable, but the way he looked at you with that admiring gaze made you blush a little, and you couldn't help but cough lightly.
"Alright, I know. You're the white, pure Addison." You gently pat his head, though there were coffee stains on it, but you didn't mind.
His head rubbed against your palm, and you were a bit stunned. Then you heard him say, "Yes, I'm pure white...... But my colleague thought I should have color, so he gave me this cup of coffee." His tone was very innocent, as if he had no idea how much interest this was about. When you heard this, you couldn't help but frown. If that were the case, maybe just giving him some money to go back would have been snatched away by other Dark Ones.
But you still blurted out, "Then why are you in the garbage heap?" "You heard his stomach growling, so you guess he's been in the garbage heap for several days."
"Hmm...... Because another colleague said that besides the color, I should have some smell, so they sent me into the trash heap. "He said.
Looking at him, you decide not to ask why he was crying and staying in the garbage heap at first. You know those two sentences were probably lies he made up...... But it's okay, you still choose to believe him and pretend nothing happened. You definitely don't want to watch this poor little thing go back and suffer again.
So you still held his hand and walked toward your home. You lowered your voice and said, "Then...... Come back with me first. You need to get yourself properly cleaned first. ”
At the same time, you're wondering how to teach those Addisons a lesson.
Spamton just shook his head in panic: "No...... No need to trouble yourself! I have my own home! Thank you so much for today, I don't want you to worry anymore. ”
“…… Yes, and I have a name—I'm SPAMTON G. SPAMTON!" When he mentioned his name, he actually tilted his head back slightly, looking a bit proud, making you want to scratch his chin.
"So, besides you, are there any other Dark People in your family?" You asked, holding his hand as you slowly walked forward. He showed no intention of resisting you.
"I and the other Addison live in different rooms in the same house." He answers your question in a low voice.
What kind of staff dormitory does that sound...... No matter what, you really can't let him go back for now. You don't want this poor little one to go back and be bullied again.
"Then come with me first. There's no one else in my house. Get yourself ready before you leave...... I suppose you don't want to go back like this either, right?" You said softly, turned your head, blinked at him twice, and couldn't help but pat his hair again.
Spamton, naturally, nods at you. You take his hand with satisfaction and walk toward your own home.
Naturally, you miss Spamton's expression when you turn your head. Although he's still smiling at your back, that smile now carries a hint of triumph.
Getting splashed with coffee and thrown into a pile of garbage is real, and he can crawl back. But after spending several days in the garbage heap, crying just seeing you is fake. He knows there's a Citizen of Light working in this city, and he knows you pass by here on your way home from work, so he deliberately created this state. After all, he hopes to get to know you, the Citizen of Light...... Of course, now he wants to stay by your side—maybe it's his natural admiration for the light, maybe it's just fear of being taken by others, or maybe it's his own purpose—he hopes to find some way to succeed through you.
He definitely didn't want to stay in this state forever!
Of course, you have no idea what he's thinking. After you get home, you push him into the bathroom, then take out two shirts and pants you've worn before, measure them to fit Spamton.
After he finished washing, he was once again a clean white addison, with a slight blush on his face. He pulled the clothes you had prepared and sat down next to you, stammering, "Then...... I'll be leaving now. Goodbye." As he spoke, his eyelashes drooped slightly, perfectly creating a slightly aggrieved look on his face.
You quickly grabbed his hand: "Ah, let's have a meal first...... My house still has a guest room, and you can stay there too. I think you shouldn't go back for now. ”
After all, you always feel guilty if you let him back in that environment—besides, your house happens to have an extra empty room, so having an Addison is no problem at all.
"Can I really do it?" He blinked, held your hand, and asked cautiously.
And you shook your head: "Of course you can. Anyway, my house is my decision!" You put your hands on your hips and said proudly, and Spamton applauded you, making you even happier.
Anyway, he volunteered to cover three meals and handed over dark coins, saying, "Then...... This is a friend fee, I want to be good friends with you." He spoke with his head down.
You pushed the money back: "I don't need a friend fee...... Since I let you stay here, I already consider you a friend! You just need to live here peacefully!" "And you've taken care of the three meals that have always troubled you, which makes you absolutely happy."
After all, he often prepares different dishes for you. If it were for you, you'd probably have coffee and bread every meal.
Living at home with an Addison really feels different. Now, every day when you come home, you can see Spamton wearing an apron, brewing coffee, handing you a cup, and smiling, saying, "Welcome home." ”
If you weren't so clear that you two have no other relationship, you'd probably think you're actually husband and wife...... Of course, he's his wife.
You find a moment to grab a sack to wrap up the other Addisons, then give them a good beating, treating it as a secret way to vent your anger on Spamton, then wipe your hands and toss them into the trash.
Days passed like this, until one day Spamton realized his opportunity had come. He gained the ability to use data to filter and understand the preferences of the Light Tribe. Using this ability, he earned a lot of dark coins and eventually took over a neighboring dark world called the Advertising World. His former Addison colleagues all became his employees.
Those Addison never understood how Spamton became the main advertiser, nor why they got beaten up that day, and even less knew who did it.
But Spamton still stays at your home, waiting for you to come back, then smiles and says, "Welcome home." ”
But now his appearance had changed. He had changed into a white suit, but had taken off his sunglasses. He seemed to have grown taller somehow. Somehow, you noticed Spamton was actually taller than you.
…… And you probably have some quirky habits. But you have a good acceptance of your own Addison's quirky preferences.
But having a big trash bin in the room is still too strange! Although this trash can is very clean, it looks like a sanitation bin, even though flowers are planted inside...... But using a trash can to grow flowers is still too strange!
You rubbed your brow and asked, "Spamton, can we ...... just change the flowerpot?" You feel a bit annoyed. If only you hadn't told Spamton last time you wanted to see the lavender field, he wouldn't have been planting flowers in the trash can.
"Our family can still afford a big flowerpot." But a simple trash can is indeed cheaper.
You don't even know when you started to see Spamton as part of your family...... Maybe when he says 'Welcome home,' and your heart is touched by it. The place where someone is waiting for you to return is truly home, and at that moment, because of Spamton, you feel a sense of belonging there, and naturally you treat Spamton as your own family.
“…… But growing flowers in trash bins is more environmentally friendly. If you don't want to see it, we can just throw this trash bin downstairs!" Spamton said proudly, thinking his idea was brilliant.
You can't touch his head anymore, just scratch his chin, and he instinctively squints and lifts his head.
"Of course I want to see it. Wouldn't a different flowerpot look better?" You tried to persuade Spamton.
No one knew why he puffed out his cheeks, but instead seemed to be throwing a tantrum: "No, I want this trash can! I think the trash can looks better! How come it's not a flowerpot!" ”
He gritted his teeth and persisted, as if playing with a child's temper, insisting on this point.
You sigh and can only follow along with the hair: "Alright, alright, then let's plant flowers in the trash can." ”
His eyes squinted with laughter, his cheek rubbing against your palm as he laughed, "That's wonderful! I love you the most, Y/N! ”
You paused, instinctively lowering your head to look at him, realizing he was probably just speaking casually, and your previously fluttering heart slowly quieted down.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 2 (swapsptx you)
content:
Ggdwx you, ooc count me in. From Bai Pan to ggdw, three ideas were blended (1. Picking up spt2.ggdw from the trash to pretend to be innocent 3. Daily saying 'I like you' only to get a blunt response)
——
Think about it, he was probably just saying it offhand, so he just gave a soft "mm."
Spamton's instinctively rubbing against your palm paused for a moment, as if his body stiffened for a moment. Then he maintained his half-kneeling posture and looked up at you, his expression very serious: "Y/N, I will definitely give you this lavender sea of flowers." ”
A flower field planted in a trash can? That's quite creative...... Actually, you don't think the flowers and plants in the trash bin are particularly noteworthy, but when you look down at Spamton's serious expression, you can't help but freeze for another two seconds. You remember the first time you encountered Spamton, you remember that it was also in a pile of trash, where a pure white and clean Addison could grow.
Because of these memories, you couldn't help but chuckle softly, though half-perfunctorily responding with a couple of "mm-hmm" and gently nodding.
"I get it, so go ahead and give it a try." You patted Spamton's head, and once again his cheek rubbed against your palm, making purring sounds as if he was enjoying it.
"Of course—I'm the most powerful Addison, a big shot!" He jumped up again, happily returning to the small flower field, carefully observing the lavender that had wilted for some reason.
You didn't look at him anymore. Seeing his serious expression, he was probably really figuring out what to do. Suddenly, you had a bit of a bad idea, but didn't plan to tell him directly what to do based on your experience in the world of light.
You like peace, so you cultivate many flowers and plants and read many related books, including gardening and a messy collection of art books. Although you can't find a horticulture-related job in the Dark World, the art knowledge you learn is enough to work as an ordinary staff member in a gallery.
You always feel that everything around you is noisy...... But maybe after spending so much time together, with your tacit approval, Addison, who was cautious at first, finally lets go, and even at home there is noisy. Occasionally, but very occasionally, when you can't hear his voice, you actually feel the surroundings are very quiet, even a bit lonely.
After all, you don't really know what he's done. Sometimes he comes back very late, but always swaggers like a proud peacock.
And during this period, he's always leaving early and coming home late, and I don't know what he's busy with. Although he always prepares breakfast for you, he doesn't have dinner at all. You're often the one who gets home earlier, and sometimes you want to ask him, "Do you want to come home for dinner?" But you just simply prepare dinner, use the few recipes you only know, then sit at the table and eat quietly, facing the empty seat across from you.
Finally, you see Spamton push open the door and come back. His hair is standing on end, and he looks like a little bird with a messy feather, a bit restless. When he sees you sitting at the dining table waiting for him, Spamton's movements freeze. He awkwardly touches his hair and quickly tidies it up to barely keep his look in place.
You blinked, put down your knife and fork, and softly said, "Welcome home." "This was something he used to say to you almost every day. Now that you said it himself, you found it a bit novel."
Spamton pursed his lips, lowered his head, and didn't dare look at you: "...... Mm, mm! I'm back!" He forced himself to perk up, looking as lively as he was.
"Today, the boss kept us here to work overtime...... Because our performance wasn't enough. Work is so tough, so we came back a bit late. You clearly didn't have to wait for me...... I—I'll try to finish my work as soon as possible in the future. "He looked up again, looking at you with wet eyes. Alright, actually, he was the one who instructed the other employees to check on the cultivation methods of Guang World Flowers, which is why he's come back so late these days.
…… Thanks to his efforts, he had successfully planted three pots of flowers in the family's office, but he wasn't satisfied. After all, although the lavender at home was a bit wilted, it was still growing just fine!
Of course, it could also be thanks to you. You can't bear to do it, so when you pass by, you water it and apply some fertilizer appropriately, which is why it lasts until today.
You didn't mean to blame him at first, just sighed helplessly: "Got it, hello, boss is bad, work is bad!" "Although you think what he said is most likely not entirely true...... But you choose to pretend you don't know about this suspicion.
After all, no matter what, as long as Spamton uses a sincere heart when facing you, isn't that enough?
"Yes, work is bad!" He shouted too, then pushed some dark coins over to you.
You looked at him without understanding, while spamton just turned his head away again without looking at you: 'Um... this is this month's friend fee!' So, he wants to stay here forever, always staying by your side. When saying this, he was a bit uneasy; he didn’t know if you would accept the money, if you would accept his idea, if you would... accept him, this originally hopeless addison. After all, it’s embarrassing to say, that although he volunteered to cook for you, actually all the household financial matters were still handled by you.
And although he became the master of advertising, he didn't want to move elsewhere; he just wanted to live with you. Well, maybe, he had become a family lover, he thought.
You shook your head and pushed the dark coins back. Spamton swallowed again, growing even more nervous. He didn't know what you meant, just stared at you wide-eyed.
“…… No need for a friend fee. "You're not short of money. The gallery pays a lot, so supporting an Addison is more than enough. Yes, although Spamton has changed clothes and seems even more impressive, you still treat him as an ordinary Addison from your family.
"So, are you going home for dinner tomorrow?" Looking at Spamton's nervous expression, you find it a bit amusing. Honestly, I don't know why he sometimes gets so sensitive about these issues. You haven't even planned to let the pet Addison go. No matter what, after spending so much time together, there's still affection. Besides, you brought him back because you saw how pitiful and cute he was. If he had been released and then returned to the trash heap looking pitiful, you'd be worried about him every day.
He nodded vigorously, and as soon as you finished speaking, he eagerly agreed, even patting his chest to promise, "Of course, this is my home. Of course I have to come home for dinner!" ”
Spamton finally returned to his cheerful demeanor, sitting proudly across from you, grabbing a sandwich and starting to eat.
He started chattering again.
"Today's work is so tough! We're actually selling flowerpots...... How many Dark People use flowerpots in the Dark World! I've been selling for half a day and visiting many households, but haven't sold a few. "Spamton complained.
It's fake. In fact, he ordered the advertising world to start advertising for flowerpots, since he wanted to pick the one he liked most and transplanted lavender to give to you.
You nod gently and say "Mm," indicating you heard what he said.
"And my colleagues, the other Addisons, are also hard to get along with...... They always bully me! But it's not as extreme as before; they just keep coming to steal my customers. " As he spoke, he started waving his arms and legs, vividly showing you how fierce the other Addison was.
If Addison heard this, he would definitely complain that Spamton was completely the opposite. They wouldn't dare to steal Spamton's customers; Spamton would be the one casually walking up to pull out a card reader and snatching their customers, then assigning them tasks that were obviously unfinished.
As for what he said at the beginning—the boss in his words was, of course, himself! But he automatically transferred your 'bad boss' to other colleagues, since he's not the boss you mentioned anyway.
You stop what you're doing and start watching Spamton perform. He first stands on the left, playing the fierce colleague, the pink he shouts about.
"You still have the nerve to grab such a good client? Your sales skills aren't as good as mine, so let me handle it! You just go serve tea and water!" ”
Then he moved to the right side, bowing and bowing as he started playing the role: "Sorry...... I—I didn't mean to do this. I just wanted to close the order, so I approached this customer's ......."
Of course, the roles should have been swapped; otherwise, how could he have acted so vividly? As for his so-called self-remarks...... They were actually fabricated.
In short, you can't see any mistakes or omissions. Knowledge Base nodded indignantly: "Your colleagues are really terrible. You can't find clients yourself, so you want to steal yours? I remember you never managed to find many clients. ”
As you spoke, you stood up, walked over to Spamton's side, and affectionately rubbed his head, while his head rubbed against your palm.
"Exactly...... But, but, after all, they're older than me, so I have to give them some ......" His voice was sticky, a bit aggrieved, as if he was acting cute with you.
Anyway, you just ruffled his hair again: "But you're colleagues now, competitors. Don't care so much about seniority! Business will only come out if you fight for it!" You started lecturing him with your hands on your hips. Spamton obediently nodded.
Of course he knows this—after all, if it weren't for the constant fighting and fighting, maybe the one you brought home back then wouldn't be him, and maybe even now, you're still all alone.
"Yes, I promise I'll work hard to meet the targets, and I'll try to come back early tomorrow! That's why I want to say welcome home!" You sat back down in your seat, and he said this animatedly, once again like a peacock spreading its feathers.
"Y-yes, I'll wait for you to say that to me." You nodded. Actually, you didn't think that was very important. But as long as your own Addison is happy, that's what matters.
The gallery was rarely busy for a while, because today a famous artist from the Dark World was exhibiting. The people of darkness came and went endlessly, and you were so busy you barely had time to rest, so naturally you got home late. Hungry, you pushed open the door and saw a steam rising from the room.
Spamton is sitting across the table, waiting for you: "Welcome home." ”
After he finished, his eyes sparkled as if asking for praise. You couldn't help but walk over and rub his head, your eyes curved into a smile: "Mm, I'm back." ”
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 3 (swapsptx you)
content:
Ggdwx you, ooc count me in. From Bai Pan to ggdw, three ideas were blended (1. Picking up spt2.ggdw from the trash to pretend to be innocent 3. Daily saying 'I like you' only to get a blunt response)
——
He really did what he said, coming back earlier than you today and even saying that. But you know very well that this is just his nature—he's always a bit eager to accomplish something. That's pretty cute, isn't it?
You sat across from him and began enjoying dinner today. For a moment, the room fell silent, leaving only a warm atmosphere...... At that moment, you heard Spamton speak, but in a mysterious tone: "Ahem,...... After dinner, I'm going to surprise you! "Although it was a surprise, judging by the expression on his face, it was all about to praise me for doing well. You probably couldn't hide that surprise either."
But you still kept asking, "Hmm?" What surprise? ”
He just proudly lifted his head, then shook it mysteriously: "I told you it's a surprise—so, this is a secret!" "Saying that, he quickly resumed dinner, even urging you to eat.
"You should eat quickly too. You want to know what the surprise is sooner, right?" He said this with a lively expression, but look, he was the one really anxious...... You're not in a hurry; you're even starting to guess.
"Yeah, right, I'm curious about what surprise is." But you still followed his lead, even though ...... You weren't that curious; you just didn't want to disturb his joy and excitement.
"I knew it! Y/N, I guarantee you'll love the surprise I prepared!" As he spoke, he started gesturing again, not even eating properly.
"Then you should eat well too." You just shrugged and said.
He shut up, even exaggeratedly covering his mouth with both hands and making a proper cross to signal himself to be quiet. You couldn't help but laugh again and quickened your eating. You weren't that curious about what the surprise was, just curious...... What was he going to say to you then?
When dinner ended, Spamton cleared away all the dishes and then mysteriously circled behind you, covering your eyes. His voice was full of enthusiasm and impatience: "Y/N, come with me, I'm going to show you the surprise!" ”
"You're covering my eyes, how am I supposed to get out?" You chuckled. Although the darkness left your vision made you a bit panicked, you knew it was Spamton's hand, so you relaxed, wanting to see what tricks he could pull.
Spamton seemed a bit stuck. He let out an "uh," thought about the question, then confidently said, "I'm watching the road! You just need to keep moving forward!" Even so, he still lowered one hand, covering your eyes with just one hand. You could see the faint light filtering through your fingers, while his other hand rested on your shoulder, carefully pushing you away to signal you to move forward.
You really do follow his instructions and just go straight.
Then you hear his nervous voice: "We can't go straight anymore, we have to turn left here, turn left!" As he spoke, he grabbed your shoulders but didn't dare to use too much force, only signaling you to turn left.
You know ...... Turn left and you'll find his room. I don't know why he's so nervous, turning the house into a maze in the dark. Even though he wants to play, you let him do as he pleases. Now you're a bit curious about what surprise he's about to show you will look like
But you still responded with a couple of "mm-hmm" and followed him left turn. You felt as if you had entered his room, and you felt the hand on your shoulder loosen as if he had flipped some switch. Then, as if for a sense of ceremony, that hand rested on your eye again.
Compared to you, Spamton, who was preparing a surprise, was naturally more nervous: "I'm going to let go, 3—2—1!" He counted out, then let go. You seemed to hear the door close, and his room seemed pitch black, with only the curtains drawn.
And in the very center of the room, you see the trash can filled with lavender—no, now it's just a large flowerpot, after all, the lavender is in full bloom, and you can't tell it was originally a trash bin. And around the floor, just bypassing the bed, are also densely packed with lavender—no, if you look closely, they're just fake flowers, since the floor is still flickering with lights, otherwise you wouldn't be able to see the vibrant lavender in the center. Of course, there are also colorful lights hanging from the ceiling. If you didn't know there was nothing special today, you'd think it was a holiday.
Immediately after, Spamton's voice rang out again: "Looks great, right? I've been preparing for a long time! The lavender field you said you wanted before—why don't we make today a holiday, let's call it ...... Hmm, the day flowers bloom!" He said proudly, standing beside you, his eyes sparkling as he looked at you, waiting for you to say something.
"Hmm?" "Because today happens to be the day I found you a year ago?" "If you consider this day as your rebirth day, that would be fine." "You naturally let your mind wander, and you still remember this matter clearly.
And although you know he's planning to surprise you with the lavender sea you mentioned before...... But you never expected he would actually prepare so much in such a small room. Even though the flowers on the floor are all fake, it's hard to imagine how much he put into it.
Spamton, of course, was embarrassed to say it because all the plants he had secretly planted had all died, so he could bring over fake flowers...... After all, he understood that he probably really couldn't grow a pot of flowers well. And the lavender in the central trash bin was so lush, not only because he was carefully tending it, but also because of your occasional care, and you even occasionally gave Spamton a few hints.
And when he heard your words, he was momentarily stunned. Of course, he still remembered that day a year ago—a day when he could restart his life. He just didn't expect you to remember it too. For a moment, he opened his mouth but was speechless.
But you didn't hear Spamton's answer, and turned to look at him in confusion: "What's wrong?" Speaking of which...... I really like this surprise. Although I got off work late today and didn't have time to celebrate with you, I can still say to you now: Happy Birthday. ”
As you spoke, you instinctively reached out, your eyes curved with a smile, wanting to touch his head. But then you realized he was a bit taller than you now, and you couldn't quite reach his head. So you turned to touch his chin and gently scratched it twice.
Looking at your sincere smile and feeling the warmth of your fingers on your chin, he was momentarily stunned, then gently rubbed his chin against your palm, tilted his head, and rubbed his cheek against it, still beaming with excitement: "I told you, I'm very—amazing!" ”
"Yeah, our Spamton is the best." You said casually, then gently scratched his cheek and stroked it.
He paused for a moment, then bent down, his furry hair pressing against your palm. You heard Spamton's muffled sound, though of course, it was also cheerful.
"I like you the most." As he said this, he knew a warmth spreading across his cheeks, a bit hot. Because of this, he kept his head down, not daring to let you see or touch him.
You didn't think much of it. You know he was probably just saying it offhand, just like last time. So you just gently patted the top of his head, then dragged out your voice and asked, "I really like it—this small but very carefully crafted lavender field. But how are you going to deal with these fake flowers?" ”
Think about it: if you were simply surrounded by a sea of lavender, you'd only marvel at such a vast field—surely the owner put a lot of thought into it. Maybe...... Indeed, surprises depend on who prepared them.
He paused for a moment, then finally raised his head, eyebrows raised. The room was a bit dark, so you couldn't see his expression clearly. He was glad you couldn't see the blush on his cheeks: "I was thinking, if I put these fake flowers in a tiny pot that looks like a trash can, then I could sell them under the guise of art!" ”
…… Sure enough, it's still that same Addison. You twitched the corner of your mouth, stood on tiptoe, and flicked his head hard, while he held his forehead, pretending to be in pain and looking at you with a pitiful expression, tears welling up in his eyes. Even though you only used very gentle force.
"Can this really be sold?" Although you think...... That can't really be called true art, and you still doubt that no one actually buys it.
Hearing this, Spamton got excited. He waved his hand and swiped to open several pop-up windows, all filled with various trash cans. Another pop-up was about a regular flowerpot and a price, with a price ...... Hmm, a Dark Coin. It seems the Dark People don't really like planting flowers.
He turned on the light and enthusiastically began to introduce you: "The People of Darkness aren't really good at growing living creatures...... Including me." As he said the last few words, he lowered his voice. If the room weren't so quiet, you wouldn't have heard clearly.
Then he straightened his chest again: "But! These fake flowers actually sell very well! From what I suspect, planting fake flowers in pots could easily make a hefty deal—ahem, and besides, our flowerpots are dual-purpose. If you don't need to arrange flowers, you can use them as trash bins. If you want to change your home environment, the trash can can be transformed into a flowerpot! ”
You listen to his excited words, hesitating to speak. Anything like a container can be used as a flowerpot or a trash can, right? Or is it that salespeople can say anything just to sell products?
But in the end, you still haven't broken his imagination. Although you don't know what the problem is, his sales have always been poor, and Addison has always been at the bottom. Out of concern for his pride, you never asked him similar questions or inquired about his life.
Now, you understand a bit—anyone smart probably wouldn't be convinced by his rhetoric, right? Even if he was so serious, it seemed as if a lie could come true.
You just nodded, "Alright, alright, I know...... Then let's do it this way. Do you want me to help? ”
"No need, I can do it all by myself! Don't you believe me...... I'll prove it to you! He declared with hands on hips. After all, he was the master of advertising. Even if some people didn't like it, he could still force those Dark People to buy it!
He decided to announce tomorrow that every dark person in the advertising world would buy one...... Well, as for that festival, forget it—only you and him know.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 4 (swapsptx you)
content:
Spamton left proudly early the next morning. You packed up and went to work. Although you were a bit curious about how Spamton sold the fake flowers and pots he mentioned—you were busy with work today and didn't have time to check out Spamton's shop.
As for Spamton, after arriving at the advertiser's office, he immediately held a meeting. Once the other Dark People had arrived, he boldly announced what he would be selling next: "Next, we're going to heavily promote the artworks." ”
The employees looked around and whispered among themselves, probably curious about how the advertiser, who originally wasn't very interested in art, had started caring about artworks.
In the end, Blue stepped forward, probably because he was the calmest among the Addisons. Like the others, he squinted, but when he looked at Spamton, he had a hint of submissiveness—even though he used to be their colleague, he had now become their superior.
“…… So, what style of artwork should we promote? "Blue asked, and the other employees all looked at him with admiration, making Blue break out in a cold sweat.
When asked this question, Spamton was a bit stuck. He really knew that you really like art...... Or something with aesthetic appeal? Otherwise, he wouldn't have placed so many decorations in that cramped home, nor put flower arrangements on the living room table, even if they were just fake flowers. He actually couldn't appreciate those arts because he simply couldn't understand them.
So the advertiser rarely fell silent for a moment. In the past, no matter what meeting he held, he would talk endlessly with almost no other employees getting a chance to speak. But today, he fell into a rare silence, making the staff below start to feel uneasy. Blue even began to wonder if he had said anything wrong.
In the end, the advertiser just waved his hand: "...... Promote any art! As long as it's beautiful, that's enough! ”
"But first, what we want to advertise is the flower-arranging pots made from trash cans—those bins are designed in artistic styles, so these bins are repurposed, can be used as artworks or as ordinary trash bins......" He finally began to introduce them enthusiastically, beaming with excitement, much longer than the string I mentioned yesterday. At the same time, he opened several pop-ups and began displaying all kinds of trash bins and his so-called flower arrangement artworks.
Blue hesitated, actually wanting to say that these trash bins probably had no real selling value—very few people would actually buy them.
But this time, yellow was the first to raise his hand and speak. He also opened a pop-up window displaying a black-and-white photo, also a work of art shaped like a urinal.
“…… Boss, do we want to promote this kind of art too?" yellow asked, magnifying the pop-up several times and pointing it right in front of Spamton.
Spamton originally wanted to scold Yellow a bit, but when he saw this so-called installation artwork, he fell silent—he was completely! No! He saw a bit of beauty in this thing!
In the end, he waved his hand and flicked the pop-up window with a big cross: "No, don't promote this kind of thing." At this point, he had to admit that maybe he couldn't quite understand the aesthetic of the Lightfolk...... And judging from the data he had, there were even many Lightfolk who pursued this kind of art. Spamton didn't understand, and he also thought you probably wouldn't like these things.
But...... There are still quite a few people of light who chase after these things? So he hesitated for a moment, then changed his tune: "Forget it, if it's art...... We can also promote it, as long as it's art-related. But things that look beautiful to the naked eye should be heavily promoted, like the flower arranging I just mentioned." He was quite justified, opening several more pop-up windows. Besides the flower arrangements from the trash can earlier, there were also some paintings he knew were popular among humans, such as "Sunrise," "Sunflowers," and "Starry Night."
…… Of course, there were also some abstract paintings he really couldn't understand, and Spamton wasn't sure why the People of Light liked such things. But since they liked them, they could just promote them.
"If there's no problem, then adjourn. I think you all understood what I just said, right?" He waved his hand, ready to send them away.
At that moment, pink stepped forward: "...... Boss, I don't think flower arranging from trash bins has any promotional value. From what I know, the People of Light usually only use slender bottles for flower arranging. ”
“…… But this kind of dual-purpose bucket should suit the preferences of the Lightfolk, since such a slender container has no other use. Spamton stuck to his point. Not only did he hate being disobeyed, but he also wanted to prove himself—his proposal was indeed effective, and you'd definitely see him make a fortune!
"No, but the People of Light probably wouldn't buy it. After all, their families usually already have similar ......," Pink hadn't finished speaking before Spamton interrupted, who looked very impatient.
"Stop talking, they'll definitely buy it. Also, I think your family probably lacks art decorations too. How about this: for now, buy a pot of flowers for each household based on the Dark Citizen unit." He declared fiercely, completely unconcerned about the expressions of the employees below. Some employees glared at him through gritted teeth, while others just trembled and lowered their heads. The addisons exchanged glances, probably sending some signal with their eyes, but in the end, they just lowered their heads in agreement.
Spamton, on the other hand, didn't care at all. After all, he was the master of the advertising world, and whatever the world wanted was up to him.
So he nodded in satisfaction, though he was a bit annoyed...... No matter what, he hated hearing his words contradicted, especially now with these employees he looked down on. He started to miss you, the taste of home, the warmth of your palm, your faint smile.
…… Now, Spamton suddenly really wants to go home. Just seeing you and talking to you is enough.
But he knows you're not home, so the little bit of anger he's built up can only turn into unspeakable grievance, waiting for you to come home and complain to you.
"Alright, meeting adjourned!" Spamton waved his hand, signaling the other Dark People to leave. He didn't want to see those people for the time being, so he drew a big cross to cover his face, so he wouldn't see those annoying guys again. At the same time, he created another pop-up displaying the price of flower arrangements in the trash can. Each pot was half-price for a limited time, only 250 Dark Coins!
On this day, the advertiser pulled out a card reader and slaughtered the dark coins of his employees. He looked at his income with joy, ready to show off to you when he got home.
Even though the flower arrangement in the trash can ads were broadcast, it seemed there were no pop-ups clicking on the Light Citizens.
Meanwhile, you are busy with your daily work in the gallery, cleaning the dusty frames and preparing to display the artworks for the next exhibition. Just then, a colleague nearby seems to notice something and starts coming over to gossip with you.
"Ah, our tickets for this exhibition sold out really fast! It seems like the promotion lasted less than three hours and tickets were already sold out! The store manager is still considering whether to put out more tickets!" It said this while winking and making faces.
Your speed of cleaning the frame has slowed down. Actually, selling tickets doesn't really concern you, but the more tickets you sell, the higher your share will be. But usually, tickets sold out have to be pulled and given away, and you have to figure out how to give away some before you can barely sell out in half a month. How come this time it sold out in less than three hours? You always find this a bit strange.
“…… Is that so? Maybe the artist in this exhibition is very famous? "You answer absentmindedly, starting to wonder how Spamton's work is going and whether other colleagues will make things difficult. Although he tells you he'll definitely sell it, you don't really believe it, and now you're worried he'll be harassed by other colleagues again.
If only I had known...... I would have reminded him a few more times yesterday.
Actually, ever since you first started cleaning the frame, you've been worried something was off, which is why you've been cleaning it for so long.
The colleague smacked her lips in dissatisfaction: "No, this time it's just an unknown little painter!" Extremely unknown, the store manager was worried that less than half of the tickets might not sell, but now they were sold out. She was overjoyed. ”
Then she tugged at you again: "You've been wiping this frame since earlier, distracted. Tell me, is something wrong?" "She started making faces with you."
You coughed awkwardly twice, released the frame you'd already polished from the past, and started wiping the next one: "...... No, I don't have any issues. You know very well. I'm a citizen of light, and in the dark world, I don't know anyone except you. ”
Lying. You know you're lying, and you know your lies aren't very sophisticated, which makes you a bit nervous.
But your colleague just dragged out her words with an "Oh," seemingly not suspecting you: "I knew it, you don't look like you'd be looking for a boyfriend either." As she spoke, she moved a bit farther away from you and started tidying up the curtains and screens used for the exhibition on that side.
You paused for a moment and stopped what you were doing. She hadn't realized you were lying...... Maybe after spending so much time with Spamton, you've become a bit of a liar? You're not really sure.
But she's right—you don't want to find a boyfriend, nor do you want to be in a romantic relationship. For you...... That's an unlikely thing.
You lowered your eyes, recalling the food that had been placed on the table until it cooled, the argument that day, the moment you couldn't bear it anymore, covering your ears and instinctively running out, wanting to get as far as possible, and in the end, like Alice who had stumbled down a rabbit hole, you fell into this dark world.
To you, the dark world is much better than the light world. Think about it, your family's Addison wouldn't be like this, and when you think of Spamton, the corners of your mouth can't help but lift slightly. If your colleague saw this, they'd be shocked—they'd definitely ask who you're thinking of to make you so happy.
Maybe you want to go home, you want to see Spamton, even knowing he might be lying, you still want to hear his voice. At that moment, you start looking forward to the end of work, as if you can hear Spamton's words "Welcome home" again.
But when he says he likes you the most...... He probably just said it casually. Or maybe it's just that you haven't thought it through.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 5 (swapsptx you)
content:
The store manager happily announced that she could leave early today—since the urgently printed tickets were sold out, she waved her hand and said, "You all got a three-day holiday." The other colleagues were very happy, because sometimes they had to stay until dinner time before leaving work, leaving them starving when they got home.
And you couldn't help but pause. Although you were just as happy, you also felt a bit worried. You won't have to go to work these days...... This means you'll have to wait at home for him to come home in vain, which makes you feel a bit anxious.
But when it was time to get off work, you reluctantly greeted the colleagues who were happily saying goodbye, then returned to your expressionless face and walked toward home. You pushed open the door as usual, only to see Spamton carrying a tray toward the table. He felt a bit flustered seeing you come back, since you had never come back so early before, so he quickly put down the plate, wiped his hands on his apron, quickly tidied his messy hair from rushing around the kitchen, and put on a big smile on his face.
"Welcome back—did you get off work early today?" He greeted you warmly again, hanging your coat on a nearby coat rack, and placed your freshly taken briefcase on the coffee table.
"Well, because the art exhibition tickets sold quickly, the manager gave us a day off and even gave us three days off." You nodded, instinctively scratching Spamton's chin, and he paused for a moment before resting his chin on your palm and gently nuzzling. Yes, he really did crave this warmth—though, as the advertiser, he shouldn't have these trivial and subtle emotions anymore, or rather...... It wasn't suitable for his current status.
But he knows that in this home, he's just your addison. You tacitly stop talking about extra work matters, because for you, coming home is just a place to relax.
"So, I'm back, and barring any surprises, I'll probably be waiting for you to come home for the next few days." You said this in a pretending lighthearted tone, but the thought of waiting for him made you uneasy. Often, the one waiting holds the greatest hope, and also works the hardest, just like you did before.
So you can't help but pat Spamton's head again: "I know you work hard every day......" You want to say more, but Spamton can't wait to interrupt you.
"It's not hard! Y/N works out every day, so it's hard to support this family...... I've only done a small thing for you." Spamton shook his head. He knew very well...... The reason you were able to leave work early and still have three days off is probably because of the meeting he hosted this morning, which called for vigorous promotion of the art industry. Because of this, many people of darkness and light probably bought tickets for the exhibition.
If ...... It would be great if you could be so relaxed every day. But he also knew very well that he couldn't let you fall into that state. If you had to wait every day for his return with hope and fear—he wouldn't want that. As long as he could feel this feeling, that would be enough.
So even though he was stunned for a moment, he didn't say much, just said with a smile, "Then I absolutely have to finish my day's performance quickly, then come home early to find you!" He said this with absolute confidence, and you didn't take it seriously, just patted his head again.
"I know, but your job is tough too...... If you really have to work late, that's fine. ”
Out of sight, Spamton's eyes darted around as he pondered some questions—finally deciding to wait a few days.
"Well, if you come back late...... I'll tell Y/N." His head rubbed against your palm, then naturally led your hand to sit at the table, sitting across from you.
Spamton naturally complained to you again: "Let me tell you...... Although today's performance was all completed, it's still annoying! My Addison colleagues really are annoying! ”
"Yeah, I know they're annoying, after all, you're competitors too...... But that's already considered unfair competition. "You nodded, picked up a spoonful of pasta with your fork, and ate it.
"They say my proposal is simply impossible—nonsense! The ad I proposed will definitely attract many Light users to click into the pop-up window!" As he spoke, he started gesturing. Spamton gestured animatedly, probably trying to recreate the scene from back then. He even opened several densely packed pop-up windows filled with all kinds of trash bins and flower arrangements, all priced at 250 Dark Coins.
You looked at the price and held back, but didn't laugh. You just waved the pop-up window in front of you—it was almost crowding in front of you and interrupting your meal. Spamton noticed your actions and hurriedly shrank the pop-up window.
"So, how's the sales?" You just calmly asked, even though through the pop-up window, you couldn't see Spamton's expression.
But his voice sounded hesitant: "...... Today's sales are pretty good!" Although he raised his voice to emphasize this, you still felt a bit guilty about it.
But you didn't press further, since he said it was good...... At least a few pieces were sold, and that's what you know about the white Addison at home. Even though you don't know, he's changed a lot.
Spamton, of course, wouldn't tell you that the only sales today were forcibly sold to employees by selling those flower arrangements, and for now, no Lightminers have checked this ad pop-up. Of course, the rest of the business is pretty good—though some fraudulent practices have led to constant criticism, and many people still fall for it. Of course, the expected effect is still there, just not as flashy as the ads say—and it's much more expensive than ordinary products.
"Yeah, as long as sales are good...... So what your colleague said isn't quite right either. "Across the table, you can't comfort Spamton's head by patting him, but you're already thinking about whether one day you can treat these addisons to a meal...... And teach them a lesson, since at least you need to let these addisons know that their own addisons aren't easy to bully. After all, you're a protective person.
Thinking this, you also asked, "Otherwise, when will you ...... organize a dinner together? Let me meet the other Addisons? ”
Spamton's body stiffened instinctively, those pop-up windows disappeared, and his expression was somewhat blank. His first reaction was, what if you discovered his lie then—the second thought: what if you don't want him and instead keep another Addison at home? At that moment, he suddenly felt an overwhelming sense of panic, and because of this, he planned to hide his identity even better, at least for now...... He still couldn't let you find out.
If you know what Spamton is thinking, you'll probably just smile and say that's fine. You've already guessed he's lied to you, but that's okay. After all, what he says may be fake, but the emotions he expresses are never fake—so the favoritism you give him isn't fake either.
And you noticed Spamton was momentarily stunned, a bit puzzled, and finally waved his hand in front of him: "Hey, Spammy, what's wrong?" "You don't know why he's daydreaming again now, and you're a bit worried about him."
So you ask again: "...... So is there a problem somewhere? If you can't call another Addison, then forget it. "You choose to give him another path first, after all, it's not easy to face someone you used to fear. If Spamton doesn't have the courage to do such a thing, then forget it.
Spamton snapped back to reality and quickly shook his head: "No...... No, it's fine. I was just thinking, uh, just thinking about something...... Y/N, you're not blaming me, are you? "He lowered his head, his voice pitiful, making it hard for you to ask what he was really thinking. Maybe he was recalling something related to those Addisons.
You sighed and softened your voice: "Of course I won't blame you...... I will never truly blame you." Your words were very serious, and to you, this was indeed a very sincere promise—you thought you'd never have the chance to say the word 'forever' in your lifetime, but now, it flowed so smoothly that you were momentarily stunned.
…… Probably, it doesn't matter. That's how you think about it.
Spamton nodded vigorously, still keeping his head down, silently rolling up the pasta and eating. He didn't want you to see his eyes suddenly redden—that would be terrible. He just wanted to show you his beautiful face. He didn't say anything more; he was afraid you would notice anything unusual.
You also seemed a bit distracted, and for a moment, the dining table fell silent, with only the sound of knives and forks clashing with ceramics.
After dinner, Spamton got up as usual to start clearing the table. You stood up too, ready to help him tidy up. After all, you hadn't worked hard today, and besides, starting tomorrow, you have a three-day holiday.
But Spamton held your hand down. For some reason, his words even carried a hint of seriousness: "Leave these things to me, you don't need to come to the kitchen." ”
You paused, then looked up at him—yes, now you have to look up at him. You don't even know when it started.
"Why?" You simply asked three words.
Spamton hesitated; he admitted that this did sound a bit like a bit of a presumptuous opinion...... Or rather, he was just making a pure assumption. When he first learned you worked at a gallery, he thought you would also do some painting work, but no matter how he looked at it, he couldn't see the tools or you were doing what he thought he was.
But...... He rarely shows a bit of a childish temper, or maybe he's always had a similar temperament—he just blocks your hand, popping up countless crossed pop-up windows.
"There's no reason! No means it's not allowed!" You heard Spamton's voice, and for some reason, it sounded a bit annoying, making you laugh uncontrollably. It seemed like you heard your laughter, and you felt Spamton glare at you through those pop-up windows.
And you put away your smile: "Alright, alright, I know it's not allowed." ”
Only then did he happily withdraw those pop-up windows. In fact, not letting you go to the kitchen was just a childish excuse—he didn't want you, who had done so much, to have your time occupied by these trivial matters. He also didn't want your smile, your hands, everything about you to be completely altered by the passage of time or other such reasons.
Just maintain the status quo, as long as it stays as it is—at least, that's what Spamton hopes for.

title: Shi Xing 6 (swapsptx you)
content:
Although you don't know why he won't let you into the kitchen—you still go in a few times without him seeing. Sometimes you see he hasn't come back to prepare dinner for him; other times, it's just for the sake of ...... You're a bit hungry, so you go to the kitchen to see if there's anything else edible. Although the countertop doesn't have many items, when you open the fridge door, you'll always find the fridge door packed to the brim...... Basically, it's all for tomorrow's food and your favorite foods. Chocolate, fruit candy, brownies, tiramisu...... Everything is there, and you can't tell if he bought them from outside or made them himself. In any case, you still casually pick up the candy and toss it into your mouth, the corners of your mouth lifting involuntarily.
Usually, Spamton doesn't really eat these kinds of cakes...... He just smiles, props his chin up as he watches you eat, and in a daze, you feel like you're seeing a peacock spreading its tail again, since he's smugly begging for praise.
And often, you'll laugh and say, "Spamton's craftsmanship is amazing!" Then pat his head again.
And he would lift his head, squint his eyes, looking thoroughly satisfied, while secretly hiding his burned fingers from cooking behind his back. He wouldn't tell you all this was made after studying the recipes for days...... He even blew up several kitchens on his office building's side.
In short, you just sat on the sofa, listening to the sound of running water from the kitchen, treating it as white noise. You casually took a book from the shelf and started flipping through it. After reading tens of pages intently, you yawned, and the sound of running water in the kitchen seemed to fade, and you covered the book with it on your lap. You closed your eyes and slowly drifted off to sleep.
When you wake up again, you find a soft pillow and bed beneath you—and the blanket has been thoughtfully covered, with your outer clothes taken off. No doubt, it's obvious Spamton did this. He could have woken you up, probably thinking you were sleeping too soundly.
You got up, changed your clothes, glanced at the time, and then walked out of the bedroom door, yawning. Of course, Spamton wasn't there, but there was still a steaming hot breakfast on the table. I guess he had hurriedly prepared it for you not long ago before leaving again.
You sat down munching on some bread, a bit annoyed. You had hoped to get up a bit earlier today, at least ...... After all, you had a day off and nothing much to do. Of course, you could have gotten up earlier to see him out and wait for him to come home in the evening. Maybe work had been too exhausting these past few days, and you hadn't been woken up by any noise.
Of course you don't know, in the morning Spamton closed the door and kitchen door as if it were a serious matter, studied it quietly, and lowered the voice, afraid of disturbing your sleep.
But since it's a holiday and there's nothing to do, why not go shopping? Although I haven't asked about Spamton's work status, it's fine to take a quick look at the shopping street, since Addison works there.
So after packing up, you head out, heading to the commercial street.
There, what you see is still the familiar Addison—pink, blue, yellow...... But there is no white one. You strolled casually down the commercial street, a bit surprised—why did every shop display those flower arrangements in trash bins, and ...... There were ads for half price, limited to 250 Dark Coins.
Well, whoever buys this flower arrangement is a fool...... You muttered to yourself, but still walked over, casually walked into the blue Addison shop, picked up a bucket of flower arrangements, and casually said, "I'll buy this...... By the way, I remember there's a white Addison among your Addisons. Where is he? ”
Seeing it was you, Blue forced himself to suppress the urge to complain. After all, Spamton kept insisting that if he saw you, he definitely wouldn't tell you that he was now the master of the advertising world—he even posted your photos for them and would brag about it every few days, pretending to casually show how much you cared about him. Blue felt that he insisted on saying he had something even without it.
But...... Hearing your question, he hesitated for a moment. Spamton's earlier nervousness and panic flashed through his mind. He also knew Spamton had been trying to cultivate flowers and plants in the office every day, but had failed every time. All that resentment and confusion were vented on them. Later, he suddenly made a bunch of fake flowers to take away. Now it seemed it was all for you.
Maybe out of compassion, or out of pity, Blue decided to keep it secret for Spamton, so he said something insincere, and in the meantime, put another colleague down.
"You mean spamton?" He...... He didn't come to work today. "As he spoke, Blue placed the tub of flower arrangements into your hand.
He didn't say much, but it was actually a lie. The advertiser had already been sitting in his office early today, and was even asking them to hurry out and advertise these things, even if no Light Citizens clicked.
You blinked, and understood automatically. After all, this so-called trash can flower arrangement was now sold by all Addisons and seemed quite popular...... Spamton lost its business, so it was normal it didn't come to the commercial street. But if it wasn't here, where could it go? You suspected this, so you could only thank you anxiously, pay 250 Dark Coins, then wandered around the commercial street holding the tub of floral arrangements, but indeed didn't see Spamton.
And you even went to the trash bin where you had found Spamton earlier, but didn't see him. You started to get a bit anxious, since you didn't know where else Spamton could go besides these places.
But unknowingly, you notice that the city in the dark world has also changed. What used to be connected skyscrapers have now somehow turned into island-like cities. Maybe the owners have changed. Thinking this way, a flash of inspiration flashes through you, but you don't catch it, or maybe...... You actually think of something, but you find it a bit ridiculous.
Could such a small, pitiful Addison become the master of this world? And if so, why not tell yourself? You would only feel joy and pride in his success, after all, a domesticated Addison is amazing, able to achieve such great accomplishments.
You suppress your anxiety and still go home with that bucket of flowers. You have no mood to stay on the commercial street any longer...... To be honest, you went there just to secretly check on Spamton's current situation, and now that he's not here, you don't need to go anymore.
And this anxiety peaks when you receive a text saying Spamton will be back late today, so you don't have to wait for him. Where exactly did he go? What exactly was he doing? A mess of thoughts swirled in your mind. He didn't go to work today, so...... Could it be that he actually argued with another Addison? Will he win? Will he be bullied? These thoughts swirl in your mind, and in the end, all you can do is anxiously take out a fast pizza from the freezer, heat one for yourself as dinner, then heat another for Spamton—what if he can come back sooner?
But at first, you sat upright by the table, waiting. Then you got a bit tired, propped up your head, yawned, forced your eyes open, and finally fell asleep on the desk, not even waiting for Spamton to come back.
There was even a moment when you worried he would never return, just like the two people you waited for before—clearly your parents, your family, but never truly listened to you, nor truly fulfilled the request you once promised. Then came arguments, wiping away tears and crying bitterly as you fled, until you didn't know where you were and finally arrived in the dark world, until you found Spamton, the family you now think of.
So you tell yourself, no, after all...... This is your home.
Then, you hear the door open. Instinctively, you look up and see Spamton standing outside, panting heavily. He looks like he's just running back, his hair still bristling. When he opens the door and sees you sleepy, he instinctively scratches his head, returns to his usual self, smiles, closes the door, and says softly, "Didn't I tell you not to wait for me? Look...... I came back very late. ”
After a pause, he added, "But I'm back." "As if emphasizing." After all, this was his home—how could he not come back to rest?
You just rubbed your eyes, forced yourself to perk up, and said, "Welcome home." ”
Then there was a moment of silence between you. He sat nervously in the chair across from him, saw the pizza on the table, and instinctively wanted to pick up a piece and eat it. Even though it was already completely cold.
But you stopped his hand: "It's cold...... Go to the kitchen and warm it up before you eat. ”
Spamton softly replied with an "Oh." Even though he was back so late, you were still waiting for him here, which made him feel a bit guilty.
"I did this voluntarily. I wanted to wait for you to come back." You just forced a smile, now feeling a bit relieved. It turned out you had bet right...... He would come back.
"I'll definitely be back. You're just too tired waiting here all this time......" He instinctively wanted to argue, but before he could finish, you interrupted him.
"No, I'm not tired." You shake your head. He's here waiting here every day...... For him, the daily waiting and restlessness must have been exhausting.
But for some reason, that restless feeling vanished the moment you saw him. You probably think he was the same.
Spamton shut his mouth and said nothing more, just picked up his plate and headed to the kitchen, then noticed the bucket of flowers you placed on the counter.
His expression stiffened for a moment. At that moment, he was relieved to have turned his back to you, so you couldn't see his expression.
Spamton's voice was a bit dry as he asked, "Why did you buy this bucket of flower arrangements?" ”
"Ah...... I wanted to go shopping on the commercial street today. I saw that the shops were all displaying these flower arrangements from trash bins, and they even advertised. "You glanced at the flower arrangement bucket, a bit puzzled as to why Spamton's tone was so stiff now. Maybe he wasn't happy seeing other Addison sell items with the same idea as him?"
"If you don't like me, just put it away...... Oh, right, so where did you go today? That blue Addison said you didn't go to work. I went to the garbage heap to find you, but I didn't see you. ”
You see him shake his head, firmly but with a hint of panic: "No, no need, flower arrangements look pretty nice in the living room...... As for where I went, it's a bit late. Can we talk about this tomorrow?" For some reason, his tone carried a hint of caution.
You nodded matter-of-factly: "Of course...... Speaking of which, the flower arranging business should be pretty good, right? ”
Since it's almost time to sleep, let's casually find some topics to chat.
"Hmm...... Otherwise, why would they steal my business! Spamton's voice rose again; he was probably in the kitchen, and his voice sounded a bit muffled.
It's fake—actually, only you—and the only one among the people of light who bought this flower arrangement.
But you don't know, just yawn, lie face down on the table, and fall asleep again.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 7 (swapsptx you)
content:
Early the next morning, Spamton didn't even bother to count your wake-up time. After preparing breakfast for you, he hurried out and left you a note with a messy handwriting, clearly written in a hurry. The gist was that he had urgent matters to attend to and had to leave early today and couldn't accompany you.
Last night, he was anxious for ages, but when the hot pizza came out, he found you had fallen asleep again, leaving him with mixed emotions. Half guilty and guilty, half a sense of relief—at least he didn't have to think about how to explain it to you on the spot. But seeing you wait for him for so long and probably worry all day, Spamton felt heartbroken.
No matter what, he still carried you to bed, then carefully covered you with the blanket and took off your outer clothes. He didn't want you to catch a cold the next day just because you slept in the living room.
As for what he meant by urgency—naturally, he was making the most of the time to hold a meeting and have the employees follow his instructions. He had made up his mind. Today, he was going to reopen the shop he hadn't run for a long time. It was covered in quite a bit of dust, which would make his lie seem a bit more credible.
So Spamton went to the meeting room and urgently notified his employees to come and hold a meeting.
The other Dark People were all muttering among themselves, wondering what the boss was up to again. They had just held a meeting a couple of days ago, so why was it happening again today?
Spamton calculated the expenses and couldn't help but grit his teeth. Even though maybe it could cost nothing......
He placed his hand on the table, stood up, and looked at the other Dark People announced, "Today, Addison is still working normally on the commercial street, while the other Dark Folk will be going to Addison's shops to buy flower arrangements." ”
The previously noisy Dark People now quieted down. Pippins instinctively wanted to argue, since they didn't have extra money to buy them! Previously, an employee was forced to buy a single flower arrangement and had already used up all their savings...... But that wasn't the case.
Shadow Guy played the saxophone, producing a discordant sound, while Zapper bounced in place, seemingly wanting to say something but holding back.
Immediately after, Spamton displayed a panel labeled 250 Dark Coins: "I'll transfer the corresponding Dark Coins to your accounts. Just go buy them then." ”
He cleared his throat again: "Also, I'll be opening my own shop on the commercial street...... You won't be visiting my shop then." Saying this, he glanced around at the Addison below. The Addisons instinctively tensed up. Judging by the situation, Spamton would probably be making things difficult for them. Blue felt a bit helpless. He had thought yesterday's matter was over, but Spamton looked like he was going all the way to the end.
He clearly dislikes the custom of the People of Darkness instinctively trying to please the People of Light...... But he keeps trying to please you.
If you asked Spamton about this, he'd probably just be stunned, then slowly turn red from his neck to his face.
"So, as my former colleagues and current subordinates, you still have to make things difficult for me just like before." He snorted coldly twice, clearly reluctant, and held his head high.
Pink gritted his teeth a little, but still lowered his head and nodded in agreement: "I understand." ”
Yellow and Orange exchanged glances and could only nod in agreement. Blue, worried, looked up at Spamton, but unfortunately, Spamton was holding his head high, unable to see the expressions of the other employees. Meanwhile, Shadow Guy, who was listening to the boss pay the bill, played a joyful saxophone tune this time. Pippins happily hopped and left when Spamton announced the end of the meeting.
The meeting ended, and the entire room fell silent. Only Spamton was still resting his hands on the table, silent for a moment. In this rare quiet environment, he thought carefully for the first time. Actually, it was fine if he didn't do these things, nor did he need to explain to you. After all, although they lived under the same roof, even though you took him in and raised them from the start, and had maintained peace and harmony until now—but now that he was the advertiser, what could he want? Even if ...... Even if he used his identity as the advertiser to force you, a citizen of light, to stay in this world, it didn't matter.
But whenever he thought of that scene, his heart tightened sharply, even making him feel a bit painful. But can a dark citizen turned from spam have a heart too? He didn't know. Spamton just instinctively clutched his chest. He admitted he was afraid—afraid of seeing your disappointed eyes, hearing your helpless and disappointed sighs, and he was afraid too...... He would never see that pure joy, or pure love, in you.
Yes, your unconditional compassion and love are exactly what he needs, so he is willing to spend so much effort doing all this. But he...... Yet he can't believe that all of it is unconditional, yet he fears it will be lost so easily.
Spamton straightened up again, dashed out of the meeting room, and walked to the commercial street. Just like yesterday when he rushed home to see you, he was filled with anxiety and nervousness, the hair on his head standing on end.
He reopened his shop and brought over a few pots of flowers from another Addison. The other Addison was angry but didn't dare speak out. Spamton also changed into the same clothes as the other Addisons, striking Addison's signature gesture and smile, waiting for your arrival.
And you yawned, still a bit groggy when you got out of bed. You knew it was probably because you were asleep, and Spamton carried you in...... You woke up a bit later today than yesterday, maybe because you waited too long yesterday.
After getting dressed and walking to the living room, the breakfast had already cooled down. When you took it to reheat it, you naturally saw the note left by Spamton, and even an emoticon at the end. You couldn't help but chuckle softly before reheating it and eating breakfast.
In the end, after hesitating for a moment, you put on your bag and decide to head to the shopping street again. You don't even know if you'll see Spamton today...... Just to take a look. After all, you definitely don't want your Addison to be bullied again.
By the time you arrived at the commercial street, Spamton had already spotted you. He gave the other Addisons a look, signaling them to start acting. Pink was a bit at his limit, veins on his forehead nearly scrunching up, but he still wore a smile and used the same sales pitch as usual, making deals with the Dark People they all knew were just paid posters hired by Spamton.
Looking left and right, you were surprised to find that the other Addisons' entrances were packed with crowds, crowded with many Dark People. To be honest, you didn't really know these kinds of Dark People...... You only knew it seemed as if they had suddenly appeared in this world one day, and you also saw that the entrance to Spamton was completely empty. He looked noticeably smaller than the other Addisons, and was also shouting loudly, advertising the flower arrangement for 50% off, saying it was now 125 Dark Coins per basin, but still no one paid him any attention, only cold sweat dripping down his forehead.
In fact, the other Dark People were starting to break out in a cold sweat. After all, what you see as a pitiful little brat is, in their eyes, a big boss. They could feel Spamton's gaze sweeping over them with a deathly gaze.
So in your eyes, it's just those Dark People just glancing at Spamton and then ignoring it. You even hear some Dark People probably talking about pippins saying they've never seen this white Addison before, and now it's still half price. Who knows what they're up to—maybe it's just a low-quality product.
You can't stand it anymore and quicken your pace as you walk to Spamton's store. Only then do you realize his shop is more than just rundown—you could say it was just hauled back from a scrap collection station. The shop is run-down, and the goods inside are covered in dust. It's obvious no one has visited for a long time, or rather, it's been cleaned. However...... If you follow what you heard yesterday about the blue Addison, and Spamton hasn't come to work, and hasn't been there for a long time, then his shop really will end up like this.
You swallowed nervously, suddenly timidly approaching, wanting to tell Spamton you didn't mean to watch him make a fool of himself, nor did you mean to see him in such a disgraceful state—you just came with that original intention, hoping to protect his original intention.
So you walk up to his shop, lower your head, not daring to look at his expression, just greeting: "...... Hi." ”
Then you hear Spamton's equally guilty moans, which somehow makes you breathe a sigh of relief.
“…… Y/N, what are you doing here?" He was panicking, and you heard something moving. When you looked up, you were surprised to find he had placed everything in front of everything that looked clean and shiny, blocking the flower arrangement.
"I'm just casually browsing. Since it's rare to have a day off, I wanted to go out shopping." You were speaking sincerely, since you really were thinking that way. Yesterday, going to the shopping street was an accident, but today you came straight to the commercial street with a clear purpose.
You see this white Addison open his mouth in front of you, and surprisingly, he doesn't use the usual sales jargon. He just lowers his head, and you hear his somewhat aggrieved moan: "But...... But I probably don't have anything here worth buying for you...... You can go check out the shop next door......
You interrupted him: "Who said you don't have anything I can buy here?" "As you spoke, you brought out that bucket of flower arrangements, but the fake flowers inside weren't lavender, but sunflowers."
"I want to buy this. 125 Dark Coins, pretty cheap, isn't it?" You smiled and decided to put this bucket of flowers in the living room when you got back. The previous bucket of flower arrangements...... Just casually place them in the corner.
Spamton looked up at you in surprise, his voice stammering: "You...... You don't need to ......"
And you just gently pat his head, wondering why he's gotten shorter, not realizing he's deliberately shortened just to be like before.
"I think it's necessary. If you don't have customers, let me be your first customer." You said casually, paying him 125 Dark Coins.
Spamton opened his mouth, speechless. As the owner of advertising, he had closed countless orders, but when he was addison...... You were indeed the first customer to visit him.
So he could only lower his head, his voice growing muffled as he tried to hold back the tears welling up in his eyes.
"But a whole pot of flowers...... It won't help me meet today's performance requirements......
And you replied without hesitation, "Then I'll buy everything in your shop." ”
As soon as he said this, Spamton was stunned.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 8 (swapsptx you)
content:
He wanted to say something more, flustered and trying to hide his emotions—but unfortunately, it was too late. By then, Pink had already walked up to you with confidence.
You instinctively glanced at the pink Addison, but he didn't look at you.
