He just put his hands on his hips and looked at Spamton, who was a head below him, his tone fierce: "Give me your flower arrangement. I don't think any Lightfolk will come to buy your stuff. You must have tampered with the flowers." ”
You blinked, just about to stop him, but then Pink swaggered into Spamton's shop, grabbed the remaining two pots of fake flowers, and didn't even glance at you. He gritted his teeth, thinking to himself, if it weren't for Spamton's instructions, why would he have gone into Spamton's shop to snatch things—but that was also a way to vent his anger.
After all, Spamton suddenly became their direct superior, and Addison had been displeased with him for a long time.
As for you—he doesn't dare look at you. He knows you're the precious Light folk targeted by Spamton. If anything really happens, they're doomed.
Spamton just lowered his head, shrank back, and didn't dare to make a move. He simply whispered, "...... But I didn't tamper with the flower arrangement! This is, this is something I sold myself......" he said, and he didn't dare to fight over the two pots of flowers.
You take two deep breaths, trying to calm yourself. Well, even though you know your Addison sometimes lies—you don't really care about that. After all, what he says is actually secondary; the emotions he reveals are genuine, so you're willing to trust him.
And now, all of this is happening right before you—it's all unbearable. You assess your size. To be honest, you know that once the People of Light enter the Dark World, they can more or less manifest some weapons and abilities, but that doesn't matter.
Confirm that there was probably no problem, and you didn't need to actually start the fight. You stepped forward and snatched the two flower arrangements from Pink's hands.
Your tone was also cold and indifferent: "Doing such a thing to your face...... Are you brazenly thinking I would ignore it? I can't bear to see any injustice happen. ”
Pink glared at you and Spamton in annoyance. He even pretended to try to snatch the flower arrangement you were holding, but he couldn't match your strength. In the end, he just spat and said, "Tch, acting like I care about his flower arrangement...... Without these, I could still sell very well." With that, he proudly lifted his head and puffed out his chest as he walked back. Indeed, in front of his shop stood a long line of Dark People.
You quietly gazed at his back, saying nothing more, just looking back at Spamton. You visibly shivered, and you thought he was scared again, so you quickly spoke up to comfort him: "Spammy, don't worry, I've already snatched your things back...... By the way, do you need me to help you clean up? ”
What you don't know is that Spamton just remembered that he was already the owner of advertising. He realized that under his leadership, there was no fairness at all—more accurate than exploitation. If you knew all this, how would you react?
However, he had long been used to oppressing those employees, so...... He couldn't bring much change because of this. But perhaps there were still things he could accomplish.
Spamton remembered the leave request he had sent back that morning, and swallowed nervously again. Hearing your question, he quickly shook his head, looked up, and gave you a genuine smile: "No, having you here already makes me feel at ease...... No need to trouble you, I can handle all of this! ”
No matter what, as long as he's by your side, all that tension and anxiety vanish like smoke...... Maybe your side is the harbor he's always hoped for.
You stared at Spamton a few times, making sure he was telling the truth, then nodded: "Alright, I understand. But if you have any questions, you have to tell me." As you spoke, you poked Spamton's forehead, and he quickly nodded in agreement.
"Of course—of course I'll tell you! I promise I'll tell you everything in detail when I get back today." By the end, his voice gradually faded again.
In the end, you just gently pat his head and walk into his shop to see if there's anything else worth taking. Spamton instinctively tries to stop you, but you just gently push his hand away—in fact, neither of you really does it.
"Let me see what you're really selling...... I should at least get a sense of your work situation, right? "Although you wouldn't ask directly—seeing is believing. You saw other Addison snatching Spamton's stuff today, so you felt a bit uneasy, so you insisted on checking out his shop."
Spamton opened and closed his mouth, unable to argue with you. In fact, he probably couldn't refuse you at all...... In short, you still walked into the store and gently wiped the dust off the painting. It seemed to be a landscape painting, but it was quite similar to the "Sunrise" painting in the world of light. For some reason, it was black and white—maybe because Spamton itself was white...... Or rather, this was actually a counterfeit and inferior product.
But when you take down the painting and prepare to buy it, you are surprised to find that the original black-and-white painting has regained its vitality, lifelike and lifelike. Now, it looks almost indistinguishable from the original.
…… Maybe it's simply because you're a citizen of light. You turned to look at the other items in the shop, which were also black and white. Only those two pots of flower arrangements were colorful. You didn't say much, just walked past the goods one by one, gently touched them, and watched as the originally black and white items regained their vitality under your hands, becoming vibrant again. Even the entire shop was now in a dazzling state.
Spamton opened his mouth, suddenly at a loss for words—he didn't know that these things would turn into color again in your hands. And you were thoughtful. No wonder Spamton's ads were out and no Lightmin came to buy them—after all, black-and-white products are obviously fakes, and Lightfolks probably wouldn't click on those junk scam ads.
At this moment, you see some Dark People getting a bit tempted and heading toward Spamton's shop, while Yellow and Orange, for some reason, made them stop and return to their shops to continue waiting in line.
You feel sorry for Spamton, and at the same time, you're disappointed in his Addison colleagues. You count the dark coins on you—buying more things is more than enough. So you roll up the painting, grab another tea set, and go to pay Spamton.
"I'll buy these two things. It's a pity I don't usually come to the shopping street and missed out on a lot of ......," you sigh as you say.
"Ah...... All of this is 500 Dark Coins! If it's Y/N, 250 Dark Coins would be enough...... As he spoke, he lowered his voice again, probably feeling that this number was a bit off.
You sighed and handed him 500 Dark Coins, along with the 125 Dark Coins you had previously discounted: "No, you can't just give me a half-price discount just because of me...... I know, you all have merit. And why keep giving me discounts? A deal is a deal." ”
He puffed out his cheeks, took only 250 Dark Coins, and forced the rest into your hands.
"No...... Exchanges and exchanges are what make a deal. I hope you come again next time. Besides, I've been living at your place for so long, I'm a bit embarrassed...... His voice was still very low, his voice light and airy.
"That's your home too. No need to be shy." You replied matter-of-factly, slipping the money back again.
"And...... Even without discounts, I would still come. I like these things that have been revived because of me, as if they've been revived. "You look into the shop; those items have now returned to black and white, with only the paintings and tea sets in your hands still shining brightly.
Spamton didn't refuse anymore, just silently accepted your money. He ...... Actually, it seemed his eyes were a bit moist again, so he just lowered his head, his voice a bit muffled: "Thank you for your support, and you're welcome to visit again next time!" ”
This is probably addison's unified marketing tactic. You didn't take it too seriously, just smiled and nodded: "Yes, of course I'll come again." ”
Then you slowly left the commercial street holding the things you bought, returned home, and placed the bucket of floral arrangements on the counter. As for the original lavender flower wipe...... You hesitated for a moment, but still placed it in the corner. You hung the painting in a prominent spot in the living room, and you placed the tea set on the coffee table as well.
You glanced at the time, had a quick lunch, and decided to go out for a few more casual walks on the street. After all, it's still not his end time, so you can't just sit here waiting forever.
You decide to check out another snack street. Coincidentally, you're starting to crave something, since you've been off work these past couple of days and have been making a quick lunch for lunch.
Meanwhile, Spamton watched you walk away, finally exhaled, dropped the smile on her face, returned to the height of the advertiser, and changed into that exquisite white suit.
Then he swaggered around the Addison stores, and to vent his anger, he started bossing around without hesitation, especially at Pink's shop.
"The items displayed here aren't in line with the rules! You have to put the same kind of items in the same area, and you need to display them in a way that looks beautiful. Otherwise, how can we advertise them? How would those people of Light even look at our stuff?" He pointed and pointed without hesitation, and Pink gritted his teeth and nodded in agreement, then placed the same kind of porcelain and tea sets together.
Then Spamton shook his head again: "Still not right!" It looks so ugly like this, just rearrange it. ”
Pink gritted his teeth and indeed repositioned those goods to the maximum extent possible according to his aesthetic...... He did his best.
But Spamton rubbed his chin and kept nitpicking: "How could that big tea set be placed on it? Big head and small body, it's terrible—rearrange it!" "Actually, arranging it like this already looks great. Or rather, he shouldn't interfere with how other people's things are placed; he was just finding an excuse to pick a fight."
Piink resisted the urge to roll his eyes and readjusted his strategy.
Now Spamton was finally satisfied and relieved, so he walked out with his head held high, staying cautious this time and only returning to the office when Addison was about to get off work. If you make a surprise attack on the shopping street and don't see Spamton, things could get a big deal...... Although he could explain it too.
And after work, he just found Blue alone, shoved the leave slip signed with his name into his hand, and said without looking back, "...... I've approved your leave slip." ”
The justice you want...... Let's start from here, okay? Thinking this, he walked home in a cheerful mood.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 9 (swapsptx you)
content:
However, as he hurried home and stood at the doorstep, he became timid again. Spamton swallowed twice, placed his hand on the doorknob but hesitated to press it, and naturally didn't put the key into the lockhole.
He was thinking that if you were waiting for him at home right now, how would he explain it—well, although he quickly came up with the reasons, he felt he couldn't keep deceiving you like this, and he always felt a bit guilty. He also felt uneasy, even feeling that it wasn't worth it for you.
…… But if only by doing this could you always keep your eyes on him. If only doing this would earn your favor.
So he steadied himself and decided to keep going like this. After all...... He wasn't really lying to you about anything. In a sense, everything he said was the truth.
Spamton finally opened the door. As soon as he did, he greeted him with a message: "I'm back!" But all he was greeted was a vast, quiet living room—no you. After a moment of hesitation, he realized you hadn't come home yet. At that moment, he suddenly felt a bit relaxed and relieved. After all, he no longer had to anxiously figure out how to answer your questions. But what followed was a sense of emptiness, loneliness, and loss. He didn't know if you felt this way when you were alone at home, but every day before, waiting for your return, he was always the same loneliness and longing.
And today...... The reason he felt disappointed was because he didn't see you. Spamton patted his cheek, opened the fridge first, and started preparing dinner for you, just like every other day. He set the steaming hot food on the table, then went to his room to sort things around—just moments ago, he came up with a new plan, and this time it was sure to sell a fortune!
Of course, ideals are grand, but reality is harsh. He just tied up a mineral water bottle and stuffed it full of fake flower arrangements. Although he thought it was very artistic when imagining...... But he didn't know how you would actually view this object.
Spamton just wanted something with an artistic touch to make you happy, and now, looking at the finished product, he felt uncertain.
In the end, he still sat at the dining table, staring blankly at the steaming food, just like every day he always had, waiting for your return.
Then, he heard the door open. Spamton knew it was you coming back, so he straightened up again, smiling: "Welcome home!" ”
And when you opened the door, you were still holding snacks you planned to share with spamton, some CD bagels, and dark candies. You smiled as you looked at the exquisite hairstyle he had specially styled for yourself, but didn't expose him: "Mm, I'm back." ”
You know he styled his hair just to wait for you...... But you clearly came back right on time for Addison's usual work-off time, so you don't know why Spamton came back so early. You were actually hoping to bump into him at the door.
So naturally, you asked, "Did you get off work early today?" You closed the door, put things on the cabinet, took off your coat, and sat at the table to enjoy dinner. Spamton's dinner was as pleasing as ever, even though you had no idea how many kitchens he had blown up in private.
He had already prepared the answer to this question, just smiled at you and nodded: "Yes, because Y/N bought goods from me...... My performance quickly met my target, and after you left, several Dark People still visited my shop." "However, as soon as they touch those things, the prices turn black and white again. But that doesn't stop them from clicking their tongues in amazement—objects touched by the Light Folk actually change color."
"Maybe it's the influence you've left behind...... Y/N is truly my lucky star—I like you the most! "He added with a cheerful smile, then pushed your favorite dish toward you—he had specially prepared it for you today."
Spamton also knew you probably wouldn't take it seriously, so this time he didn't lower his head. He just looked you straight in the eye and said this directly, though he still felt a bit disappointed when he realized you weren't taking it seriously.
You nodded with a smile: "Mm." "I see, so you said Addison actually has performance targets every day...... Those past few days when you came home late was because colleagues made things difficult and you couldn't meet the targets, so you came home late. Just like the previous two days, that's how you thought.
"Well...... So what happened a couple of days ago? "You know very well, Spamton would probably say he was bullied by a colleague, robbed a customer and took something. Actually, you know this might not have happened a couple of days ago, but it definitely happened. Otherwise, he wouldn't have recounted it so vividly, so vividly, so emotionally.
And sure enough, upon hearing that, Spamton immediately started pointing fingers, indignant: "It's just like what you saw today! It was that guy Pink who led the way in moving all the flower arrangements from my shop...... So now their shop is full of those lavender flower arrangements, and many people of darkness and light come to see them." At this point, his tone turned aggrieved again.
"And yellow and orange are great at attracting customers...... So the few Dark People I managed to keep were all tricked by them into going over to buy things. Still, no Dark People came to my shop, nor did any Light Folk click on my ad pop-ups...... As he spoke, he lowered his head. Even if you couldn't see, you could imagine the look of grievance on his face.
"That's why I came home late last night...... It was to deal with this issue. Although I didn't snatch back those few buckets of flower arrangements, I managed to get them!" He looked up again, his tone excited, his eyes sparkling as he looked at you.
You couldn't help but laugh, even though what he said sounded a bit ridiculous...... But you still applauded and chose to offer some encouragement: "Hmm, our Spamton is the best. He actually got the courage to snatch things from those guys who bullied you before. That's amazing." ”
Spamton scratched his cheek a little embarrassedly. Actually, he had come home late last night...... It wasn't because of this, but the flower grabbing was real, since he had secretly tried planting flowers in the office again. This time, he planted sunflowers, and the sunflowers quickly withered. Pink couldn't stand it anymore and snatched the pot away, swearing he would definitely be able to keep them alive. Spamton only brought back one pot because he wanted to plant it in the pots in his shop.
Naturally, the sunflower eventually died, and Yellow and Orange took the opportunity to recruit Pink's customers, leaving Pink furious all day. But seeing Spamton, whose status was so high, could only suppress his anger.
You hesitated for a moment, wanting to ask why you hadn't gone to work one day before, but Spamton answered first: "And then...... I didn't go to work the day before yesterday because I was always bullied by colleagues and was unconvinced, wanting to find the ruler of the dark world to back me up. So I didn't go to work that day but waited under his office building." Spamton's voice grew quieter as he spoke. You saw his fingers resting on the desk restlessly stirring together, looking extremely nervous.
Across the table, you couldn't touch his head, so you just tilted your head and whispered, "I see...... My Spamton is really amazing, and he's brave, daring to fight against injustice." "You smiled warmly. Although you had doubts before, wondering who the master of this world really was, no matter how you looked at it, it was just an absurd guess. The master of this dark world had nothing to do with your own obedient yet frail Addison."
Hearing the word 'unfair' you said, Spamton lowered his head, pressed his lips together, and once again felt relieved that you couldn't see his expression—after all, at this moment, his face was full of confusion and unease. He was afraid you would know that all that injustice was actually caused by him...... And not something that had always been inflicted on him.
So he quickly changed the subject: "Anyway, the next day, the owner of this advertising world backed me up!" That's why I got back to work in the shop...... Oh right, they took away my flower arrangement idea and business, so I came up with a new idea! Let me show you! With that, Spamton ran back to his room.
You opened your mouth to say something but held back, honestly...... You originally didn't think anyone would actually come to this so-called fake flower business, but judging from today's queue of Dark People, it seems business is really booming? You don't know that you are the only real customer; everyone else is just paid trolls hired with Dark Coins.
And ...... The advertising world...... You don't even have time to think about the word before Spamton pulls out a ...... made up of countless bottles of mineral water connected together. It looks like a piece of art, and the bottle is filled with fake flowers.
…… You probably wouldn't buy anything like this from the Dark or Light folk, unless someone has a peculiar taste. At least based on your taste, you wouldn't even glance at it.
But you still wait for Spamton to explain it to you.
He said excitedly, "I was thinking, maybe changing the vessel would be different—although the content is similar, the artistic forms formed by different vessels and corresponding vessels still have visual value!" ”
"So I think...... "You can defeat the other Addisons!" After saying this, his eyes sparkled, as if asking for praise.
You sigh and still reluctantly pat his head, but at his current height, you can only scratch his chin: "Yeah, yes, very beautiful. Spamton can definitely beat other Addisons, sell the most, and become a big shot." ”
You might think, these so-called vessels can be considered works of art by casually tying leftovers and arranging flowers, so why bother buying something to take them home?
However...... Maintaining a consistently poor state isn't a good thing, so you still asked, "Speaking of which...... I plan to have a meal with your Addison colleagues and have a good chat. Do you think that's okay? ”
Spamton's expression stiffened for a moment, and you tilted your head in confusion as you looked at him.
He quickly shook his head: "Of course there's no problem! It's just ...... The exact time is probably hard to agree on...... "Meeting your gaze, his voice quieted down again, and he dejectedly put down the so-called artwork.
"Then let's do it next weekend. If we really can't spare the time, then let's discuss it again." ”
Spamton nodded, thinking he needed to get his "good colleagues" to finish their work ahead of time and free up the weekend's events.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 10 (swapsptx you)
content:
The advertiser is holding another meeting. Judging by the frequency of meetings, this isn't that strange, but if you look at the content of the meetings...... At least, no other employees have seen these things.
After all, this time, their boss was cheerfully showing off a piece of art made from countless bottles of mineral water, which looked like a work of art, and the bottle was filled with fake flowers.
Spamton just raised an eyebrow and announced, "Next, we're going to advertise this...... The theme is probably that you can grow flower arrangements using different vessels!" As he spoke, he weighed the items in his hand again.
"Anyway, it's probably something like this kind of artwork! If you have any good ideas, you can let me know. If the artwork really succeeds, we can promote it further." ”
He didn't think the brand he promoted couldn't sell—besides, based on his investigation of the Citizens of Light, humans do prefer these strange works of art, just like the urinal Addison showed him last time. As long as they sell or advertise under the guise of art, the Citizens of Light will always click in and take a look.
…… Even though he himself felt the vase had little aesthetic value. Calling it a vase was just a bunch of mineral water bottles stacked together for flower arrangements, and to prevent fake flowers from loosening, he had filled each bottle with flowers, which made them look even less aesthetic and just bloated.
Pink couldn't hold back and retorted, "But this doesn't look like art at all. There won't be any pop-up pop-ups for the Light folks to buy......
Before he could finish, Spamton interrupted him. Spamton just raised his eyebrows high; his meeting would not allow any other Dark People to object. No matter what, he was the ruler of this world.
"But my Guangzhimin says it looks great, Y/N says I'm amazing, and whatever I make will definitely sell very well!" Spamton said cheerfully, not caring what you said in the first place—that's probably what you meant...... Even though he sensed it yesterday too, and you probably said those things just to coax him. But Spamton didn't care; he only listened to what he wanted to hear, and he really did hear you say that!
Even if it's just a lie...... He's willing to believe it, because you said it yourself.
The Dark People's eye twitched; no matter how you listened, it sounded like Spamton was showing off. Honestly, they found it hard to believe that was the truth...... These employees had more or less seen you before, so of course they knew you probably said that to appease the advertiser.
As for exposing his identity with you? They wouldn't dare do that. In this world, Spamton determines their fate...... Even if you speak, he won't do anything to your face, but what about behind your back? They wouldn't dare imagine what Spamton would do behind your back.
Yellow's eyes darted around. Since that's the case, it was better to follow Spamton's words. So he created a pop-up window and made up a pattern—probably stacking discarded cardboard boxes and arranging fake flowers on top: "Then I think we can take it further!" For example...... He advertised that all these artworks were recycled from waste, and that some people of light with compassion would definitely click in to take a look. ”
Spamton nodded in satisfaction, while the other Addisons glared angrily at Yellow. Of course, he could think of anything he could think of, but he had already taken the initiative and spoke out first.
"Yeah, Y/N's taste is really great! Our upcoming theme is waste recycling—let's give it a fresh look!" Orange followed along with a cheerful smile, adding a bit of praise just like Spamton.
Spamton's brows relaxed, his mood lifted, and he looked much more beautiful. He waved his hand grandly: "Then let's follow Orange's instructions. Next is the topic!" By the way, each employee should buy one to take home first. ”
As soon as he said this, the staff below started complaining again. Shadow Guy couldn't speak, so he could only play a saxophone tune expressing anger and resentment. The pippins thought for a moment, then their eyes darted around and went to negotiate with the other Addisons. The gist was that if multiple groups bought together, could the final total price be a bit cheaper?
Unfortunately, Spamton also heard the murmurs below. He waved his finger, looking serious: "Group purchases won't offer discounts! Each one can only be paid at the original price." He emphasized the last few words, and the pippins quieted down, still trying to struggle until they heard Spamton's next sentence.
"Besides that, for every artwork promoted to the People of Light, they get a 50 Dark Coin commission. Including the previous trash can flower arranging." "Spamton knows that the Light Tribe never clicked on pop-ups before; they must have treated it as spam. As for now...... He just wants to make the sales look better, so he can show you the number of transactions and the Dark Coins he earned.
After saying this, the meeting was about to end, but just before Addison left, Spamton remembered what he said yesterday and added, "By the way, my good colleagues, next weekend my Y/N is treating you to dinner, so you need to finish your performance early." His words carried a hint of teasing and schadenfreude. He knew none of his former colleagues dared to tell you the truth—if they did, Spamton would let these "good colleagues" experience what it feels like to be dead...... Well, just kidding.
Addison and the others were all stunned for a moment. They glanced at each other, but for a moment, no one spoke. In the end, it was Blue who spoke: "...... Where will the location be then? ”
This was something neither you nor Spamton had considered, so he stood with his hands on his hips, a bit stunned. Honestly...... Of course, the first option is to pass your place. He definitely doesn't want these Addisons to come over; he always feels a bit unfairly uneasy.
He pondered for a moment, then finally said, "...... Cyber BBQ Restaurant, right? Yes, just go there, it's just right." As he spoke, it sounded like he was murmuring, but in fact...... He actually didn't want to go back to that place either.
But he decided he had to face his past head-on. Although the future now was what he hoped for, he still felt something was missing...... Maybe it was the past he once desperately wanted to deny was missing. But it was precisely because of his unbearable past that you kept him.
But no matter what...... At least, maybe he hopes your involvement can save the lost and helpless self he once was. He can change the past that has been repeated. He can ...... Let him choose to accept himself again, or in other words, be willing to love the person he once was because of your love.
The Addisons exchanged glances again, nodded, and said in unison, "Got it," then walked out of the meeting room. Once again, only Spamton remained in the room, and he felt the coldness and suddenly became genuinely afraid—afraid that when he showed you his achievements and the dark coins he earned, you'd laugh and say he could stand on his own, live on his own, and in a way, kick him out—even if your intentions were just good.
He simply pushed these chaotic and complicated thoughts aside, walked out of the meeting room, and only felt at ease as he watched the rising Dark Coin accumulation. But when he thought of you, he felt a bit empty inside. He transferred the dark coins from the vase art he sold today into another account, planning to show you this account when he got back, show it off to you, and then get a few compliments from you. Thinking of this, Spamton couldn't help but curl his lips, feeling delighted again.
So he returned home in such a pleasant mood, and it wasn't until he stood at the door of his house that he swallowed nervously and felt timid again. Ultimately, he carefully opened the door. You were sitting across from the dining table, with a freshly made, still steaming pizza laid out on it.
When you saw Spamton cautiously peek inside as he opened the door, you couldn't help but feel that it was somewhat amusing, but you just smiled and said, 'Welcome home.'
Spamton paused for a moment, pushed the door open, hung his coat on the rack, and set down his bag, nervously adjusting his hair that wasn't even messy—he just wanted to maintain a good image in your eyes, always.
You quietly watched him. Spamton cleared his throat and sat down on the chair opposite you, also smiling, 'Hmm, I'm back.'
Then he placed his arm on the table, unintentionally revealing a wound on his forearm—actually, this wound was caused earlier during his inspection on the shopping street, when Yellow accidentally bumped into him and knocked over a vase. The broken ceramic pieces caused this cut. It was a minor wound, easily healable with any healing magic Addison had. But he stopped Yellow from trying to fix it afterward and didn't use magic himself, intending to elicit a bit of your sympathy with this small injury.
So he just covered it with a black shirt, but naturally, when he rested his arm on the table and the shirt pulled back slightly with momentum, the wound became partially visible.
Of course, you noticed and hurriedly stopped his arm. You carefully stood up, grabbed his arm, and rolled up the sleeve, seeing the wound still oozing blood and not yet fully clotted. It looked alarming and was a long cut, but actually wasn't serious since it didn't go very deep.
Still, you furrowed your brow, understandably feeling concerned because he was hurt.
'...Don't rush to eat yet. Let's take care of the wound first!' you said, running to your room to pull out a first-aid kit from under your bed, something you had prepared long ago but never used. You also glanced at the similarly dust-covered alley nearby, finally lowering your eyes.
...Those were memories from your past that you hadn't opened. You only wanted to start a new life, somewhat avoiding touching your past, even though it was equally important to you.
Shaking off these thoughts, you ran out and dipped a cotton swab in iodine, carefully cleaning his wound, your voice tinged with worry and reproach: 'How did it... get such a long wound? It looks so scary.'
Spamton just lowered his head, softly answering your question, 'It's just... those Addison saw that my items sold well and wanted to take them, then we argued, and we broke a vase...'
You sighed, reaffirming your resolve, vowing to talk to those Addison properly next weekend. You wrapped Spamton's arm in bandages, then ruffled his hair: 'You dare to resist, dare to face these injustices. My Spamton is amazing!'
...No, you had no idea of the truth. Spamton thought about this with rare bitterness.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 11 (swapsptx you)
content:
But he only dared to lower his head, staring blankly at the bandage you had just bandaged, lost in thought. He didn't dare let you see his expression, nor the unease and bitterness he might be revealing. He stared at the bandage, staring at the small wound that could have been healed with just a spell, barely sorting out his tangled and complicated emotions.
Do you regret deceiving you? Maybe not...... Because he's afraid that once you know the truth, he won't show him such genuine care anymore, and he's afraid he won't be able to feel love from you again.
But maybe always deceiving you isn't a good thing, but trying to explain everything from the beginning is hard to begin. Spamton opened his mouth, about to reveal the whole truth, but your voice interrupted him again.
"By the way, how is your fake flower art selling going?" Actually, you didn't really know what to say. You just felt it wasn't good to let the room sink into silence, so you spoke up and randomly picked a question.
Spamton snapped back to reality, perked up again, and answered your question with a big smile: "It sold very well, a full hundred copies!" "And it was exactly the number of employees under his command...... Yes, aside from those he forced to buy and sell, nothing else was sold.
But he believes that with commissions as an attraction, there will always be employees who make sales. As for commissions...... Speaking of which, it should be considered part of the fairness you want, right? Spamton can't be sure.
And the truth he had just instinctively wanted to blurt out was buried by him. He thought, since that's the case, he'll wait until next time, when he's sure he's ready to speak, and then tell you. Unfortunately...... Spamton wasn't sure if there was still such an opportunity.
You tilted your head, a bit puzzled, probably not expecting this so-called artwork to actually sell, nor to expect so many copies to exist.
"All of these...... Are they all sold by you? Do you have that much stock? Do you need my help...... You look a bit worried. Although you haven't done any art or handicraft work in a long time, you think it shouldn't be too hard to pick it up again for him.
Spamton was a bit stuck. He was a bit annoyed—if he'd known, he wouldn't have said 100 servings so directly—his shop didn't have that many!
But he cleared his throat and came up with another lie, unusually feeling guilty because it was completely false: "I sold them all! There are only five or six items left in stock, so the rest are pre-orders. I'll come pick them up in a few days...... I don't need your help, I can handle it myself!" He smiled to hide his panic.
You stared at him for so long that Spamton almost thought maybe he was wrong and that you might expose his lie. Feeling genuinely uneasy, you gently nodded and leaned in to ruffle Spamton's head: "I see...... Business is booming, Spammy is amazing at coming up with this. ”
You smiled, despite ...... You had already realized that this sentence was probably a lie. After all, when he spoke, his eyes didn't even dare look directly at you, drifting upward to the left, clearly just fabricating the scene from before. But you still chose to follow his words.
Sometimes you can't figure it out—he could have told you the truth, so why lie again? Even if you're willing to believe his lies, because most lies hide genuine emotions, revealing past fears and fears, anxiety, and grievances. You've been waiting for the day he is willing to tell you the truth. If it's always a lie, that's fine.
…… You are willing to favor him, tolerate him, and accept the lies he says.
Maybe at first it was just a simple exploitation...... You guess that's how it is, but for some reason, this somewhat twisted relationship has persisted until now.
You rub his head, and Spamton instinctively rubs his furry head against your palm. You hear his voice full of affection and joy: "I like you the most!" ”
You're a bit distracted—is that really true? But...... But why did things end up like this? You don't understand.
So, this statement is probably false. You immediately put it out of your mind, only responding with a slow "Mm."
Spamton's movements finally slowed down, though still rubbing slowly against your palm: "By the way, Y/N, we promised you were treating my colleagues to dinner...... They set the venue at Cyber BBQ." By the end, his voice gradually softened.
You nod gently, then remembered Spamton was looking down and couldn't see your movements, so you replied, "Alright, I know." ”
“…… That place is where they once threw a coffee cup at my head. "He grabbed your hand, but this time rested it on your chin, and he looked up at you, showing a pitiful expression.
"So...... The place where they said they would throw you into the trash was also that place? "You paused for a moment, then recalled the first time we met, while Spamton just blinked at you and said nothing.
"I know...... Although I can't guarantee I'll help you get revenge, I can make sure they don't do it again. "You scratched his chin, assuring him.
Actually, even if you hadn't said anything, those Addisons wouldn't dare do anything to him anymore—after all, he was a big boss. But Spamton just blinked and said nothing, after all...... What he hoped for wasn't the present, but the past—the past he once didn't want to face, even hated, to be changed.
You scratched his cheek again before getting back to the seat opposite him. You had been waiting for Spamton to come back and hadn't even had dinner yet. Bandaging the wound wasted some time, and the pizza was already a bit cold.
But it's still edible, so you plan to pick up a piece and eat it directly.
But Spamton held your hand down: "Some have cooled down. I'll heat them up before you eat." ”
You paused for a moment and instinctively said, "No need to go to such trouble......" After all, you've had dinner like this many times in the world of light. Many times, even when dinner got cold, your parents still hadn't come home. Many times, they broke their promise from yesterday.
But Spamton had already walked into the kitchen carrying that plate, and you heard the sound of the heating plate and microwave, so you could only sigh softly. Even though you were sighing, the corners of your mouth couldn't help but lift. You touched the corner of your mouth, a bit dazed.
While you were still dazed, the microwave stopped, and Spamton came out carrying the pizza again, placing it in front of you. You touched it—the temperature was just right.
Spamton secretly felt proud. Previously, just in time for you to come home, he had prepared a steaming dinner just right, and he had studied the heat control of each item. So heating the pizza to this temperature for a long time was just right.
He doesn't think about how you might react; he just instinctively lifts his cheeks and looks at you with sparkling eyes, begging you to praise him.
And you naturally curved your eyes: "The temperature is just right, thank you, spammy...... You're really amazing! ”
You see him lift his head proudly and can't help but laugh too.
And so, dinner ended happily. After dinner, Spamton tidied up the leftover bowls and chopsticks, then sat on the sofa and started making art pieces with those mineral water bottles.
…… He really did regret it a little. If he'd known, he wouldn't have mentioned pre-ordering earlier. He just told you that giving them counterfeit or inferior products would be better than doing handicrafts here...... Alright, you'll definitely say that way.
Although Spamton only plans to make a few for show, leaving the rest to the staff themselves, at worst they just pay and get a picture. After all, the actual product doesn't necessarily match the pictures.
You sighed and sat down next to Spamton. Spamton felt the sofa sink in one spot, and when he turned to look at you, you picked up several bottles of mineral water as well.
"Almost 100 servings? How can you finish it? Let me help you." You said softly, picking up scissors and glue to start working.
Spamton didn't know whether to tell you that what he just said was just deceiving you—but he didn't want to bother you, because under your command, what used to be something he had just haphazardly assembled had now truly become a work of art.
You cut off the base of the bottle, glue the mouth together, and trim some plastic strips from the sides of the bottle as decoration. Soon, a piece of art resembling a sunflower appeared in your hands.
Spamton stares at you blankly, even forgetting to continue what he's doing. You glance at him with some confusion: "Stop staring at me all the time...... Hurry up and do it." ”
"Oh, oh......" He lowered his head to fiddle with the half-finished "artwork" in his hands, but his mind was nowhere to be found. He kept thinking, you clearly have the talent and the interest to do other art-related work, but you were just an ordinary gallery employee. He thought, he has no right to interfere with what you think or choose, but Spamton still feels sorry for you.
You wouldn't think so much about it, just staring at the "sunflower" in your hand and getting a bit lost in thought—you recall your previous painting imitating that sunflower, but unfortunately, that painting is now tucked away at the very bottom of the box, probably never to be republished in this lifetime.
So you pick up a few bottles of mineral water and repeat the previous work, planning to make a few more sunflowers. You think, maybe if something else happens, you won't remember those previous paintings anymore.
But even though you made several more sunflowers, you couldn't hide your earlier thoughts, so you thought, maybe something else could distract you. So you looked at Spamton again, only to find with amusement that he hadn't even finished the one in his hand.
"spammy, don't you know what shape to tie it into?" You put down the scissors and glue, stretched lazily, and said lazily.
Spamton shivered instinctively, feeling a bit distracted and guilty at being caught by you: "Hmm...... Ah, right, I don't know what shape to tie it up. "Then he gave you a cautious smile.
You rubbed his head and thought casually: "Alright, then you can do sunflowers like me. Look, the examples are all right here. You just need to do a quick pom." ”
Spamton nodded. Although he didn't do as well as you, he managed to manage a few things.
When he turns his head with sparkling eyes, hoping for your praise, he finds you already asleep on the back of the sofa, your head tilted and resting on his shoulder.
Spamton was silent for a moment, then got up, carefully carried you to bed, tucked you in, and then gazed at your peaceful sleeping face for a long time before leaving.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 12 (swapsptx you)
content:
On the weekend, at the agreed time, you showed up at the Cyber BBQ Restaurant with Spamton. As soon as you entered, you saw the other Addisons. They were sitting by the window, so you grabbed Spamton's hand and sat right across from them. Honestly, I don't know why they happened to make room across from you, but all four Dark Folk had to squeeze in...... You didn't quite understand, but Pink spoke first.
"It was Spamton who snatched my stuff first, so of course I have to get it back." He spoke righteously and confidently, arms crossed. Of course, since Spamton was right there, Pink couldn't just say it was Spamton who first snatched his stuff and then let him snatch it back, so he could show you this scene.
Pink was grinding his teeth in hatred. He kept thinking to himself, Spamton clearly doesn't like flattering the Lightfolk, yet he's so scheming at it—he must have learned it all for you.
You're a step too slow. According to Pink, Spamton was indeed at fault, but you just waved your hand: "I think we should hear from the parties involved and the witnesses around us about this." "You're very serious. Honestly, you feel like a judge in one of the courtroom games you used to love—honestly, it's pretty fun."
Spamton, on the other hand, just cautiously grabbed your arm, not daring to use too much force, just holding it weakly: "Because...... Pink said bad things about you, and I was upset, so I wanted to steal his stuff. I want to get back at you......
You were stunned again, surprised that Spamton would admit to the matter but explain the reason. Honestly, seeing his head lowered and his weak voice, you couldn't help but soften.
Pink was at a loss for words. He really wanted to say that Spamton was just twisting the truth and talking nonsense—back then, he had only mocked Spamton for being good at winning your favor, so why not try to please the other Light Folk and make the advertising world better? Then Spamton targeted him like this.
And you just gently rub Spamton's head, look up at the other Addisons, and ask, "So what did you see at the time?" ”
"I was quite far away. Spamton did indeed steal Pink's stuff, so later Pink went to the Spamton shop to rob something." Blue said.
“…… Well, anyway, what Pink said back then wasn't very pleasant. "yellow hesitated, obviously not expecting Spamton to twist the facts so much.
"But later, all the customers went to Pink, and we were busy grabbing clients, so we didn't pay attention to this matter." Orange added.
You nodded, then patted Spamton's head. Well, now it seems he was indeed at fault—but you chose to favor him, and besides, he acted for you. If you don't support him, who else will?
So you spoke up, slowly saying, 'Okay, I understand… spammy is indeed at fault, but first, pink spoke unpleasantly, so I think, no matter what, spammy’s actions can only be considered self-defense.' You admitted that you were also quite unreasonable, after all, robbery carries much heavier criminal liability than a few words of dispute… but you believe spamton was not wrong.
How could your Spamton possibly have any major issues?
Pink rolled his eyes helplessly. He thought you and Spamton were just as unreasonable as you were, and he didn't understand why you two thought each other was just so close.
But then he heard what you said next: "...... So, I want to know, who poured coffee on my Spammy earlier?" You said with a smile, showing no sign of anger, but the other Addisons all shivered.
Then they all looked at Pink, who was a bit annoyed: "Why are you all staring at me!" ”
And you just tilted your head, looking at Pink as well: "So...... Do you know anything? ”
Pink picked up the coffee cup on the table and took a sip, probably feeling it was getting cold. Instinctively, he threw the cup out—right in the direction of Spamton.
…… Well, actually, before coming, Spamton had already reminded them to reenact the scene from that time. Although they didn't understand what Spamton was really trying to do, they had no choice but to comply. After all, Spamton said they would be given extra overtime pay, which was rare. Normally, they would have paid them out of pocket.
You reached out to catch the coffee cup and held it in front of Spamton. Fortunately, only a few drops spilled and splashed onto you. You placed the cup on the table and said calmly, "So, it really was you." ”
Spamton hid behind you, cautiously poking his head out to look at the other Addisons, then pulled his eyelids into a funny face and grinned at the others. Pink was so angry he nearly fainted.
He rolled his eyes, annoyed: "Yes, it's me. I asked Spamton to make coffee, but he didn't do it properly. The coffee got a bit cold and tasted bad. Is there something wrong with me inviting him to drink it?" ”
“…… You shouldn't have poured coffee on him." You just said slowly. Honestly, you're starting to feel sorry for Spamton again...... Although this is ultimately just a small matter, you can't imagine how many such small incidents have happened before. And often, these little things pile up enough to completely change the course of a life.
“…… He doesn't have coffee anyway, so what's the point of me treating him?" Pink crossed his arms and rolled his eyes again.
"At that time, Spamton volunteered to make us coffee. The other temperatures were just right, except for Pink's cup, which had issues." Yellow added a seemingly considerate comment from the side, but Pink always felt he was a bit gloating.
…… So today the only one being the punching bag is him, who was pushed out to be the punching bag? Pink was a bit annoyed, so he quickly added.
"Do you want to know what happened when he was thrown into the trash heap?"
You nodded. Of course you wanted to know about this...... To be honest, you came here just to find a place for your Spamton. You know this barbecue restaurant probably contains all of Spamton's grievances and sad memories, and you have no idea how much courage it took for him to dare to walk in.
"It was that guy Yellow. When they saw Spamton with a coffee cup on his head, they thought he was better suited to staying in the trash heap, and ...... Spamton couldn't sell a single thing, had no results at all, so treating him as trash was more suitable. "Pink squinted, also speaking with a hint of schadenfreude, thinking that the gloating Yellow just now definitely wouldn't get away.
Now yellow fell silent, just lowered his head, not daring to look at you.
You sighed: "No one should stay in a garbage heap, and no one should be trash. Besides, he's a righteous businessman of the Dark. Even if he doesn't do as well as you, you have no reason to target him." ”
The Addison didn't say anything. Honestly, with Spamton's pitiful look...... They hadn't thought he could be that formidable at first. But now, they just lowered their heads and didn't say a word.
Spamton just cautiously poked your waist. You turned to look at him, and he whispered, "...... That's enough. After all, they're all my colleagues, so there's no need to make things too awkward. We'll all get along in the future......" As he spoke, he lowered his head again, his voice sounding a bit aggrieved.
You gently wiped his cheek with affection, then looked up: "Alright, anyway, I'm here today...... I just want you to know that I'm the one who protects him, so don't think about doing anything bad anymore." As she spoke, she lightly tapped the table with her knuckles.
The Addisons exchanged glances, thinking to themselves, how could they dare...... Now Spamton is the master of the advertising world, above all the Dark People. It's already good if Spamton doesn't turn around and target them.
They just nodded eagerly: "We know, we know." ”
Even though the play wasn't over yet—because Pink had interrupted and revealed Yellow's previous actions—Spamton still slightly lifted his head, looking at your back with a complicated expression—yes, he knew you'd pass by there, which is why he stayed in the garbage heap for days. Back then, he couldn't imagine the current scene or the chaotic, complicated emotions of today.
His eyes reddened, and he silently wiped away the tears swirling in his eyes with his other free hand. Maybe...... From the start, he wished someone could stand before him. After all, who hasn't thought about being hurt? If only someone had stopped it then.
…… Only when there is no hope or hope do you stumble and get up on your own, trying every possible way and crawling to protect yourself. He once thought that once he became strong, he would take revenge, but now, seeing you standing in his way, he felt ...... This isn't so bad.
Because ...... He was no longer alone; he had something to rely on, no longer having to grit his teeth and complete everything on his own.
And ...... Having someone to rely on feels so good. He thought, he could finally face all of this and stop caring, since what he cared about now was you. Spamton thought, he could truly love the once down-and-out self and the self now full of lies. After all...... He also wanted to give you this love.
You sighed, not noticing the change in Spamton's expression behind you, but Blue did, showing a somewhat complicated expression.
"So...... Is there anything else? If not, let Spamton handle it herself. "You nod, and just as you finished speaking, Orange picked up your words.
"Ah, I used to put on a little dress for Spammy...... To be honest, he actually looks pretty good in a little dress." Orange rubbed his hands with a smile. Anyway, he didn't think he did anything wrong, and you paused for a moment, instinctively turning to look at Spamton, and indeed began to assess what he would look like if he wore a dress......
Spamton, rarely blushing, covers your eyes and whispers close to your ear, "Y/N, you...... If you want to see, I'll wear it alone for you later. ”
You want to say you don't want to see this kind of scene, but you honestly nod—well, maybe you still want it, and you remember, some skirts you bought before that you haven't worn are probably just right for spamton. As for why you stop wearing skirts...... It's just for some personal private reasons.
Spamton glanced at you with some awkwardness. Well, he doesn't mind showing you wearing a skirt...... If others see it, that's not acceptable, especially since advertising for the Light People doesn't require him to risk everything and wear a skirt.
Blue didn't speak, only softly adding when the surroundings had quieted: "From now on, I won't just stand there and watch." ”
…… Bystanders are also accomplices.
You felt everything had been clarified, so you nodded approvingly and said, 'Alright, in any case, my spammy also troubles you!'
The meal was basically over. Next, you ordered some barbecue inside the shop. The atmosphere was quite harmonious, and you were very satisfied.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 13 (swapsptx you)
content:
You returned home as usual. Indeed, having to chat with Addison and analyze the truth about past events is exhausting for you. You just leaned wearily on the sofa, watching Spamton unusually serve you tea and pat your shoulders on the sofa, which made you want to laugh a little—though you can't say he was exceptionally attentive; rather, it was usually the same. It was just that today's excessive attention made you feel a bit flattered.
So much so that even though you took a sip of tea, you couldn't help but marvel at whether it was just the right temperature or just the right flavor to your liking. You couldn't help but ask out of curiosity: "...... Why are you so attentive today? Did you do something to let me down?" ”
Speaking of which...... The temperature of the tea was just right. He wondered how many cups of coffee he had brewed before, and how many cups of coffee had been thrown by those Addisons. Thinking of this, you seemed a bit distracted, but quickly snapped back to reality, just shook your head, and tossed those thoughts out of your mind.
Spamton's pat on your shoulder stiffened for a moment. If he hadn't recognized that your tone was just pure curiosity, he might have thought you really knew something.
You felt the movement behind you stop, and no sound came from you. You turned to look at Spamton in confusion, and he quickly turned your face away, cleared his throat, and pretended to be deep.
"What are you talking about...... Of course I haven't done anything to betray you! If I really did, I'd rather punch myself......" His voice sounded a bit pitiful, sounding aggrieved as he said this, though the first half was pretending to be relaxed. You could tell he was speaking sincerely, but Spamton seemed nervous, so much so you wanted to tease him for a moment.
"So that's how it is...... you dragged out your words, turned to look at Spamton, and Spamton quickly nodded in agreement.
You cupped his cheek, sighed softly, and gently stroked his cheek: "You don't need to do that. Besides, I trust you. You won't do anything to betray me." "These words come from the heart. You truly believe this. You trust Spamton...... It seems like the first time since that time in the Light World that you've trusted anyone other than yourself so much. You were slightly distracted, but quickly gathered your thoughts and gently stroked his face once more.
"But...... So, you can't tell me you're hiding something from me, are you?" You tilted your head. You're pretty sure Spamton hasn't told you the whole truth, but you don't really care...... After all, sometimes, when he's saying this and that, even if you see him showing a fake smile or a pitiful, miserable expression, beneath that, in his voice, you hear the hidden lines—no matter what, he looks like he's about to cry, and you can only hear and feel his sadness.
So no matter what he said, this sadness was real...... You were willing to believe him. Although the facts may be fabricated, the emotions behind them are definitely not fake.
Spamton just blinked twice, suddenly afraid to look at you. But when you cupped his face and met his gaze, he couldn't avoid it and could only look at you.
“…… Of course not, it's all sincere and sincere. "He stammered, looking a bit guilty, his eyes darting around, but he didn't dare look you in the eye. Even as he said that, his heart was pounding wildly, because...... From the moment we first met, he hadn't really told you the truth.
Spamton wasn't sure what he'd think if he told you the truth...... Would you be disappointed, would you be sad? Thinking of this, he couldn't help but feel heartache...... He couldn't figure out whether he was afraid of being exposed, that he lost his home, or that he didn't want to see your disappointed and sad face, or that he didn't want to see you hurt.
You stared at Spamton, watching his eyes roll around, but in the end, you didn't expose him. You thought, fine, then wait until he will tell you—or when you have to face the truth. And until then, just pretend you know nothing.
So you just patted Spamton's head, your eyes slightly curved: "I see...... Then our Spammy is so well-behaved! What reward do you want? "Actually, you were just saying it offhand, and for some reason, it always feels like you're coaxing a kid...... Well, it's understandable.
Spamton rubbed his head against your hand, his voice a bit muffled again. In fact, he was a bit flattered—after all, before this, he had never thought that doing well would come with rewards. It seemed like doing well was just a given. Now he made the same demands for his subordinates, so Spamton reflected and decided he should give employees more rewards and the like...... He was just copying your methods.
"I...... I don't want anything, just hope you can stay with me a little longer. His voice was muffled and a bit light, just holding your hand and pressing it against his cheek, then gently rubbing against it.
You looked at him and scratched his cheek: "Mm...... Then I'll try to come home a little earlier. Also, I'll be with you all day today. ”
He still didn't look at you, just nodded firmly, then hurriedly changed the subject and said, "By the way, I haven't finished the artworks those people ordered yet—I have to get busy with this first!" ”
At this moment, he felt a bit relieved about the reservation he had told you earlier; otherwise, he wouldn't have known what to say at this moment.
You nodded and let go: "Alright, you go ahead and get back to work. I'll go do my own things first...... But I'll always be at home." You emphasized the last sentence, then moved a little away, just sitting on the sofa resting your chin on your hand and watching Spamton.
Spamton let out a light breath. He took a few bottles of mineral water from the coffee table, cut them open with scissors to look proper, then poured water and glued them together to make something resembling a sunflower. However, his craftsmanship wasn't very good, so the results were a bit crooked.
You look at him boredly for a while, then swallow hard...... You suddenly feel an impulse, but this impulse makes you nervous and uneasy. You haven't done this in a long time, so you don't know how your craft is now—you've given up so long that you think you'll never pick up a paintbrush again.
But if that's the case, why did you find a way to buy art supplies on your very first day in the Dark World, but only lock those old paintings along with the supplies in a small box? Maybe you didn't have the courage before, but now you've gathered a bit of courage and are willing to open that box again.
You squatted by the bed, looked up at Spamton, and gazed into the distance...... So focused, undistracted. You know, it was because of him that you decided to open the box again and take out your painting supplies.
So you quietly opened the box, set up the oil rack, and held the canvas—since you only wanted to paint a quick one, you didn't use a very large canvas. Then, you took out brushes of different sizes, squeezed out the still-dried paint, squinted your eyes, pointed the pen at Spamton to quietly measure the proportions, and then used a small piece of paper and pencil to sketch a small draft—your technique hadn't faded; it was still as vivid and lifelike as ever.
After finishing your draft, you sneak a glance at Spamton, seeing that he's still absorbed in the so-called artwork, clearly uninterested in what you're doing. Only then do you quietly breathe a sigh of relief, grab your brush and palette, and begin smearing and sketching on the canvas, sketching his silhouette.
You don't know how much time has passed. By the time you come to your senses, your figure has already appeared hastily on the canvas, just waiting to dry it completely. You feel a bit guilty, glance at the time as dinner approaches, hurriedly put down your brush, hurriedly walk out, and deliberately close the door, then sit down on the sofa.
The sofa collapsed in one spot. Of course, Spamton felt it. He looked at you, and at the same time regretted it—he really hadn't paid attention to your whereabouts that afternoon! Still, it's that so-called artwork that drew his attention, but...... Your craftsmanship and creativity are truly impressive. Even though the sunflowers you made are so lifelike, Spamton doesn't understand why you're only satisfied with your current small job, but he's too embarrassed to ask you more—what if you happen to be asking about something you dislike?
If you hear it, you'll just smile and answer, and that's okay. Even if you ask about something you dislike, you won't blame Spamton—after all, it's just that you didn't make it clear at first.
At this moment, he panicked and looked up, checked the time, then patted his head in frustration: "...... Oh no, I forgot to prepare dinner for you in advance......" After saying that, he carefully watched your expression and noticed your tightly closed door, pausing for a moment.
You just wave your hand: "It's fine, just eat something casually...... There's still instant pizza in the fridge anyway, how about that? ”
Spamton puffed out his cheeks: "Eating fast food all the time isn't healthy......" Then you lean in and poke his cheek. The puffed cheeks quickly shrink back, and he just touches his own cheek and glances at you with a hint of complaint.
"But it's just an occasional meal, so it's fine!" He understood what you meant, so Spamton announced loudly.
You nod in satisfaction and got up to head to the kitchen for a hot pizza, but Spamton's next sentence made you stop in your tracks.
"Well...... I'm a bit curious, just curious! "This sentence sounds like some kind of supplement, "Exactly, why did you close your door?" ”
You don't even need to look back to know Spamton is probably looking a bit guilty at her finger at this moment, which makes you laugh a little. But you still hold back and slowly reply, "Ah, my room...... Because you prepared a surprise for me recently, I plan to prepare a surprise for you too. ”
Actually, this is the reason you just came up with: you feel proud of your brilliant whims—well, it's just that you don't dare show it to him right now. You don't want anyone to know or be involved in your past, for now...... It's enough for you to face those things alone.
Or maybe one day, you'll be able to openly reveal your past to him. But at least not now.
So, before you're fully prepared to show him, isn't that a surprise? One day you'll let him see it, and you believe in that.
Spamton was momentarily stunned, his voice rising: "Surprise?! I—I'm really looking forward to it!" He really started imagining what kind of surprise you'd prepare for him.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 14 (swapsptx you)
content:
You scratched your cheek, feeling a bit embarrassed seeing him so excited and his eyes sparkling. You just cleared your throat, cleared your throat, cleared your throat, and added, "You said it was a surprise...... Maybe, not that surprising? I don't know if you'll like it...... As you spoke, your tone was a bit hesitant. You really didn't know what Spamton's preferences were. It seemed like he liked everything you gave him, but in contrast, he seemed to know your preferences quite well.
Spamton just shook his head: "It's fine, as long as it's prepared by you, I'll like whatever it is." He swore with absolute certainty, and he also believed that you wouldn't prepare anything that was truly hard for him to accept—he believed that what you would bring him would definitely be something wonderful and a wonderful experience.
You cleared your throat twice, a bit embarrassed: "...... Not necessarily...... But before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you.
"Definitely!" He raised his voice, "I think what Y/N prepared is the best!" ”
And he looked so proud, as if his feathers had lifted up.
You blink and glance at him a few times, then can't help but smile and nod: "Alright, I know. Then I'll look forward to seeing you react with such a surprise." "You think it's because Spamton is here that you start looking forward to tomorrow, the day after, and every day to come...... Originally, you just thought this day was just passing through casually, so what else was there to look forward to, or what meaning was there? But...... Maybe from the very first day you found him, the gears started turning again, and you started looking forward to the next day.
Spamton nodded vigorously, his face beaming with a smile: "Of course, I'm looking forward to that surprise too!" ”
Because of your and his expectations, after the meal you hurriedly finished that painting—but you hesitated looking at it, still not daring to show it directly to Spamton. Because, after all this time, you still don't know how your drawing skills have become. You think maybe you should show it to the other Dark People first, confirm that the painting is truly impressive, and then show Spamton this surprise.
If ...... If everyone thinks it's not good, then just draw a new one. It doesn't matter how many you make—after all, you have to prepare well for this surprise for your own Spamton. So until the other Dark People sigh, you won't take out your painting.
But if the other Dark People have seen the painting, it's not just a surprise for Spamton. Even though you didn't say it at first, you still felt it wasn't very good. After thinking it over...... Maybe you'll have the courage to take out the remaining paintings later. No one but you and your parents has seen them, so giving them to Spamton as a surprise is just right.
Thinking this, you can't help but smile, pack up the other art supplies, and step out with the oil painting—coincidentally, the gallery is recently holding an exhibition of works about different Dark People's perceptions of beauty, and many Dark People have submitted their works. Think about it, you can submit too. This painting...... It probably represents your understanding of beauty.
So you hang this painting on an empty spot on the wall, step back a couple of steps to admire it, and indeed, it looks quite nice here, not out of place at all.
Your colleague noticed your actions and came over curiously, glanced at the painting on the wall, then stiffened a bit, and his voice was dry: "Uh...... Who is the artist of this painting? ”
You tilted your head in confusion: "I drew it...... What's wrong? ”
You're still a bit nervous, wondering what to do if your paintings aren't good—but then you hear something unexpected about it.
“…… Do you know who you painted? "My colleague hesitated, just staring at you.
You tilted your head in confusion: "Hmm...... Spamton, huh? What's so special? Oh, right, he's not very famous for Addison, right? After all, he can't sell anything, so it's normal you don't know about him...... You can't help but start muttering.
"But he's a very good Dark Citizen. Although he can't grow flowers, he still seriously prepared a surprise for me—even though it was made with fake flowers, and he even said he wants to sell the idea of flower arranging from the trash can. It seems like business is going well, and his colleagues have even come to snatch his stuff......" As you continue, you don't notice your colleague quieting down, just looking at you with a hesitant expression.
"Recently, he suddenly had an idea to make a creative flowerpot or something. I made a demonstration of making a sunflower for him, and he imitated it, so that's why I recorded this scene...... I don't even know if the painting looks good, but anyway, this is my understanding of beauty...... Because of him, I started looking forward to tomorrow, I began to ......" You opened your mouth, but felt too shy to say the rest. Honestly, you didn't dare say things to Spamton, but here you boasted and told others...... You blamed yourself in your heart.
"Anyway, I want to give this painting to Spamton as a return gift, but I don't know how my painting skills have improved after all this time, so I put it on the gallery for exhibition. I want to hear what other Dark People have to say." You cleared your throat twice and summed up for yourself. After all, you can't keep talking about it forever. Although you could probably talk about Spamton for a few days and nights, even if your mouth is dry, that's fine.
The colleague sighed, then stepped forward to cover your mouth, nervously looking left and right. You tried to pry his hand away, but your colleague just lowered his voice and said, "...... Don't you know that name can't be mentioned casually in the Underworld? ”
You were confused for a moment, then instinctively shook your head. You'd never heard such a thing before. Could it be that Spamton was asking other Dark People to use other names to address him? Or was his reputation so big that even the other Dark People didn't dare call him by that name? Somehow, you subconsciously rejected that possibility—maybe you just didn't want to believe it.
A colleague's voice was tense: "It's Spamton......! His name can't be called casually, otherwise he'd be very upset. I can't even say what methods he might use to punish the other Dark People...... But it's fine to whisper a few words occasionally; he can't hear you. "He finally let go, but still stared at you, probably afraid you'd say something inappropriate again.
You hesitate for a moment, but finally ask, "So how do you usually address him?" ”
“…… The master of advertising, or the king of advertising." The colleague's voice was soft, but still enough for you to hear those two words clearly. You were silent for a moment, and although you quickly understood—but you still found it hard to believe, how could things turn out like this, how could the truth be like this?
Your voice became a bit dry: "So...... Is he the master of this advertising world?" "When you ask this question, although you feel a bit nervous, you also feel a bit relieved...... You think about it, you really have already guessed it, but you just haven't been sure of this answer.
The colleague nodded solemnly, looked at the painting again, and scratched his cheek: "I don't dare comment on anything else...... Anyway, your brushwork is excellent, your color choices are just right, and the whole painting feels warm and inviting. That's all there is to it. ”
Then he hurriedly left his place. You silently watched the back of this Dark Citizen, then glanced at the oil painting hanging on the wall, staring at Spamton in a daze. At that moment, you felt very close to him, yet somehow inexplicably far away. No matter what kind of Dark Citizen he was, no matter what identity he was, to you he was just a weak, pure white Addison who needed care.
…… Alright, maybe he doesn't really need care. But you think he still needs it. Otherwise, if he, a Dark Commoner, is so high and mighty, how lonely must that be? It's okay to pretend you know nothing and just go back like this, right?
But you still want to ask him, that's just ...... Simply ask him, even if you think this matter isn't important, since he's kept it from you for so long, there must be a reason. You just want to know the reason.
On this day, you were working in the gallery as usual, but...... No Dark People came to admire the painting; most only glanced at it from afar and then walked away in fright. Only a few dared to come over and take a closer look, but they left in a hurry after leaving with a few words of praise. You had hoped to hear some sincere advice, but now you can't help but worry.
When the gallery closed for hours, the last few Dark Folk who came in were left with nothing but praise. You sighed and took down the oil painting to take home. Since that's the case, you can only show it directly to Spamton.
At that moment, another colleague came over again. She didn't seem so afraid of this advertiser—he was a Renwu management girl. You glanced at her twice, and she smiled warmly: "I want to know, what's his relationship with you?" ”
You were stumped by that question. Honestly, you hadn't considered this question at all. Maybe you've been together for so long—you've gotten used to it, and you're used to spamton being with you.
"Uh...... It's just ordinary friends, right? But since we live together and know each other well, it's roughly ...... ...... like family? "You say this, but for some reason, you can't help but feel a bit melancholy, as if you're completely dissatisfied with this answer.
She let out a meaningful "Oh—" and you couldn't help but shiver. Not knowing what else she wanted to say, you could only widen your eyes and watch her warily.
"Then...... What do you think of him? "She asked.
You tilt your head and answer without thinking, "My Spamton is definitely the best." After saying this, you belatedly cover your mouth, remembering that his name shouldn't be said carelessly...... Of course, no other dark people heard it either.
She just said meaningfully, "Oh—" twice, waved the braid she was holding, and smiled: "Then...... I hope you two can stay together for a long time. ”
You blink and nod: "Of course...... Yes, we will. After all, that's our home. "So of course you both will go home.
And she didn't say anything more, just walked away. You hugged the painting and also walked toward home. You began to ponder: should you show Spamton this surprise first, or ask him the advertiser's question first, so he could find out why he's been hiding it from you all along?
In the end, you decide to show him the surprise first—after all, what he hides from you isn't really important; the surprise is what matters.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 15 (swapsptx you)
content:
When you got home and opened the door, you indeed saw Spamton wearing an apron, placing steaming hot dishes on the table. Seeing you come back, he smiled and said, "Welcome home!" ”
You nodded and couldn't help but smile: "Mm...... I'm back. The surprise I have prepared for you is right. But let's wait until after the meal to come and see for yourself!" Before you went home, you even pulled a piece of cloth to cover the oil painting. After all, surprises always have to leave some suspense. As for the question...... Wait until later. You hope that at least during dinner, he can be happy and looking forward to it, that's all.
Sure enough, you see Spamton's eyes instantly light up, as if he can't wait to get close and circle around you.
"Now...... Can't you know what the surprise really is? "He bent down slightly, looked up at you, and looked at you with a hint of pity.
But you just shook your head and made a gesture to be quiet: "No, that's not allowed. Let's wait until after dinner to see what the surprise is!" ”
Spamton nodded, eagerly returning to his seat, and also invited you to take a seat: "Then let's hurry up and eat!" "He really wanted to know what surprise you had prepared for him."
And you just smiled and placed the oil painting on the sofa. You want ...... You really are happy to show him this surprise, since at least the brand new present and future are something you both walked out together. So treating it as a surprise, as a keepsake and a memento of his past moments, is just right.
…… As for the past ones, you're not ready to reveal them to him. So, this dinner is just a rare quiet meal. Usually, Spamton would dawdle and want to chat with you a few more times, but today he ate quickly for once, because he was eager to find out what the surprise was. On the other hand, you still maintained a slow, almost normal pace, as if deliberately hanging him around, while Spamton could only look at you eagerly, but didn't dare to urge you.
Finally, you finished your meal. He quickly cleared the dishes and headed to the kitchen, then sat beside the oil painting covered with a layer of cloth, looking at you expectantly: "So, do I know what the surprise is now?" ”
You also sat on the sofa, just on the other side of the painting, gently nodding with a smile: "Of course, you can open it yourself and take a look." "Do you think that if he lifted the canvas and saw the truth himself, the sense of surprise and happiness would be even stronger?" You wouldn't be sure.
Spamton swallowed nervously, unusually nervous, but also a bit disappointed and uneasy—after all, he saw you walk in carrying this thing. What if you just casually bought some landscape painting or decoration as a surprise to brush him off? Although—although he really does feel happy no matter what you give him, if you brush it off like that, he would inevitably feel a bit disappointed too.
So at this moment, his hands were trembling a little, and Spamton was even a bit annoyed. Why did he have to reveal the final answer? You could have told him directly—though that surprise wouldn't be a surprise, and he knew he was just making a fuss.
In the end, he closed his eyes, held his breath, lifted the cloth, and then slowly opened them—only to see himself sitting on the sofa that day, focused on his not-so-nimble handiwork. Spamton's eyes widened instantly. He knew only you had seen this scene, and only you could see it—and almost no one in the advertising world dared to paint him, so this painting was probably, no, or rather, definitely by your own hands.
But if you find someone else—and his heart is on high alert—what if you learn something from those Dark Civilians that you didn't know before? Because of this, the joy that came from the surprise was now somewhat washed away by nervousness and unease.
But joy and happiness still prevailed, and precisely because of this, Spamton held the oil painting, his eyes sparkling as he looked at you: "Is this ...... Did you paint this? You painted me! ”
You nodded, and Spamton secretly breathed a sigh of relief in his heart, but for some reason, he still felt uneasy.
