"Yes, I drew this...... Actually, I haven't painted in a long time, so I don't know if what I created now suits your taste...... You scratched your head, but before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you.
"No, it's fine, I really like it!" He shook his head and nodded again, then added, trying to make up for it, "I'm not saying your painting isn't good...... It's just that even though I don't know much about painting, I can tell you've put your heart into this work. Whether it's the colors or the shape design, it's excellent...... His hands gestured wildly, but when it came to the moment, he couldn't find the right adjective.
Moreover, he could tell that you had invested emotion into the painting...... Or rather, you had invested emotion into the person in the painting; at least at this moment, he could feel himself surrounded by that warm feeling. Although...... He didn't understand, or rather, couldn't believe what kind of emotion you were projecting in the painting. Maybe it was warm love......? He thought of that word, but then dismissed it himself. Spamton didn't dare to believe these things easily.
You watched him waving his arms and feet and couldn't help but chuckle, while Spamton leaned in and gently rubbed his head against your cheek—fluffy and a bit ticklish, but not uncomfortable. You paused, then gently tugged his cheek with your hand: "As long as you like it...... But I have a few questions I want to ask you too. ”
Spamton's body stiffened for a moment; he didn't realize that his voice had become a bit hoarse and tinged with bitterness: "What is the problem?" Anything I know, I'll tell you. ”
You blink gently, turn your head and only see the furry top of his head, while you simply reach out and gently stroke his cheek: "Hmm...... Do you know who the real owner of this dark world, this advertising world? ”
Spamton wanted to say, of course he didn't know! After all, he was just a lowly addison; how could he possibly have any contact with the lofty master of the advertising world? But then he remembered the lie he told you before, when he said he wanted the owner of the advertising world to back him up, so he could return to the shopping street to do business. If that were the case...... The two would be at odds, and he grew increasingly nervous, wanting to quickly come up with a good excuse to cover up the previous lies. Maybe lies just keep piling up.
But at this moment, he was extremely nervous, his mind completely blank, unable to come up with any good excuse, so he stammered, "N-I don't know." As soon as he finished speaking, his heart sank; he knew he would definitely tell this was a lie.
You just silently stared at the top of his head, knowing he was lying, and you could choose to expose him right now—but you still let it go gently, slowly saying, "Do you really not know who it is?" ”
“…… Alright, I know, but if I say it, you probably wouldn't recognize me either......" His voice grew quieter and his speech quickened, afraid you'd keep pestering this question.
"Do I really not recognize him? What exactly is the name of that advertiser?" You scratched the top of his head, gently rubbed—in other words, you came with an answer—which might not be ideal, but you also want to hear Spamton admit his lie.
Spamton fell silent. At this point, if you call yourself the advertiser, he knows you must know the truth—if you keep hiding it, you might lose all patience and expose his clumsy lies. In the past, he always thought he could easily fool you, but this time, it seemed impossible to fool you no matter what.
He didn't realize that most of those easy things in the past were just your indulgence.
“…… Spamton G. Spamton。 In the end, he reluctantly said his name.
Then he closed his eyes, as if awaiting the final judgment. He was very anxious. After learning the truth, you might have been furious or exhausted, and you might have kicked him out of the house—even though this was already a place he deeply cherished and reluctant to part. But your reactions were completely different from what he expected.
You just gently pat his head: "So...... You are the master of this advertising world. "Your voice is certain, after all, for you...... This is something you already know the answer to.
Spamton silently nodded gently. The calmer your reaction, the more nervous he became—he didn't know exactly what you would do; he just felt it was all over.
"Our Spamton is really something—he actually managed to become the master of the Dark World." And you just cupped his face, rubbing his cheek with the top of your head—fluffy.
Spamton stared blankly open, still a bit incredulous, but hesitantly asked, "You...... Aren't you blaming me? Aren't you angry? ”
You poked his head: "I told you, I will never truly blame you." As for being angry—that is indeed a little. "You dragged out your words, watching his expression turn tense and confused.
But you just poked his forehead again: "Why didn't you tell me you were angry and faced all this alone? You, a little Dark Citizen, have reached such a high position. How exhausting must it be? How lonely it must be to stay there." Angry is that you're still putting on a show in front of me...... Do you want to hide your true self? That must be so exhausting, how exhausting. This is clearly your home, you can relax a little. ”
Spamton stared at you in a daze. You didn't understand why his eyes were red, or why tears were streaming down his cheeks. You couldn't figure out what emotions were flickering in his eyes at that moment. You just gently wiped the tears from his cheeks: "At least...... You're home. I hope you can let go and be yourself, okay? ”
He shook his head and wiped away his tears in a daze: "No...... Everything is real, because...... I ......" He said this but fell silent again. He was too embarrassed to tell you, but in fact, Spamton just wanted to find a place where he could freely release his fear and unease, and say things he hoped for pity without restraint...... Or rather, he could receive your care without restraint.
You touched his cheek and softly asked, "...... Alright. But if that's the case, why hide it from me? Wouldn't it have been better to tell me from the start? ”
His hands held yours and rubbed against them: "...... Because, because I don't want you to throw me away...... Spamton whispered this. And you could feel all the unease and panic in that sentence.
“…… I will never abandon you." You only instinctively promised this, but you yourself were momentarily stunned.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 16 (swapsptx you)
content:
He just lowered his head and didn't look at you anymore, almost hugging his knees—after all, his body was trembling at this moment, and his voice was soft: "I don't know...... I don't know what you're thinking. I'm just afraid, afraid you'll hate me...... I'm afraid you'll think I'm terrible, bad, afraid you'll be afraid of me...... Spamton didn't know what he was talking about; maybe he was just ...... afraid you'd stop projecting your own love onto him. Even though he wasn't sure if that counted as love, since it made him feel warmth and attachment, reluctance, and happiness...... Then it should be.
You were silent for a while, and because you hadn't gotten an answer, Spamton nervously looked up. At that moment, you cupped his cheek and shook your head solemnly: "No, why would I be afraid of you, hate you, or hate you? You're my favorite Addison...... You're really amazing. You've become the master of the advertising world and managed to hide it from me for so long, which shows you've worked really hard! "You smile brightly, even though you don't know it yourself...... Why did you say that word so smoothly?
What is liking? And what is love? You have no idea; you only judge based on your only rational logic that you should give your home the addison and other things.
He stared at you blankly. For some reason, you felt the spot where your palm touched seemed a bit hot, and you could only tilt your head in confusion. Spamton broke free from your hand, hurriedly turned his head, and seemed to pat his cheek with his hand, stammering, "Mm, I like you the most, Y/N!" ”
You touch your chest, not knowing why...... Every time you hear him say that, you can actually feel the heart in your chest beating faster. But this time, that feeling becomes especially obvious. You can't help but wonder: could he actually have an infectious disease, which is why his heart is beating so fast?
Thinking this, you couldn't help but ask, your tone very serious: "Do you really have some infectious disease bacteria on you? Otherwise, why would my heart be beating so fast?" ”
And for some reason, your heart seems to be beating faster, and you feel like it's about to jump out of your throat the next second—of course, that's probably just your imagination.
Spamton turned to look at you, looking straight into your eyes and biting his lip—after all, when he heard what you said, his first reaction was ecstasy, but then he just found it a bit funny. After all, it turns out you don't understand anything either.
He simply nodded solemnly: "Yes, I probably have an infectious disease on me, because my heart is beating very fast." "Even if—even as a Dark Citizen, he couldn't be sure there was this organ in his body—Spamton could still feel that mysterious object in his chest was thumping with a thumping sound.
You hurriedly asked, "What is the name of this infectious disease? I can buy some medicine to cure both of us. And since you have an infectious disease...... Then you've definitely been sick for even longer, so you need to get treatment sooner...... You grumbled, your brows furrowed tightly, leaving only anxiety.
But Spamton just shook his head: "The name of this infectious disease...... It's Y/N. ”
You froze when you heard this answer, the anxious look on your face faded away, and you stared at him in a daze. You didn't expect to hear this answer—and you only felt your cheeks start to burn, your heart seemed to beat faster. You always felt as if you had already received some answer, but you didn't dare to ask further—even though the answers were right in front of you, you just found it somewhat ridiculous.
So you hastily changed the subject, planning to show Spamton your past later, but now your mind is even stronger. He has already let you know his past, present, and future, so to be fair, you should let him know too.
Or rather, you originally wanted him to know.
So you cleared your throat, just turned your head, got up, and walked toward your own room: "...... Ahem, ahem, I—the surprise I prepared still has the second half. Come to my room and take a look." Your voice became a bit stammered, but in your panic, you quickened your pace.
Spamton scratched his cheek, which had finally cooled down, and couldn't help but laugh at your flustered and helpless back. He felt a bit pleased, but also a little disappointed—maybe because you hadn't given him a direct answer, but he longed to hear that sentence from your mouth? Maybe it was because he longed for it, even though he had already gained so much from you, he was insatiable and only wanted more. Spamton himself knew this wasn't a good habit, but under your indulgence, he had become what he was today.
He followed you into your room. To be honest, he had never set foot before, only sneaking glances when you were there. Of course, Spamton was just there to see you.
And just today, he finally stepped into your room and followed you down by the bed. Spamton didn't know what you were trying to do until he saw you dragging a dusty box out from under the bed.
That box...... It was covered in dust, with no marks or patterns on it—just a pure white box, as if waiting for someone to dye it. Spamton had never seen this box before, not even once since he started living in your house.
His voice was also a bit dry, probably carrying a fear even he didn't know: "This...... What's inside the box? "Maybe it's like Pandora's box—once opened, there's no going back.
You didn't look at Spamton, just quietly lowered your head to look at the box and whispered, "...... It's my past, the past I once buried with my own hands. ”
"Do you hate your past? Well, then you don't have to treat these as part of the surprise to show me—" Spamton's eyes widened, hurriedly waving his hand, while you simply held his hand and placed it on the lid.
You gently shook your head: "...... Come open the box. It's okay, I ...... too. You don't really hate your past, do you?" Your voice was dry. You knew it was a heartfelt remark, and you believed Spamton could tell through it.
He blinked at you, his hand resting on the lid of the box without moving: "...... But why? ”
You propped your chin on your hand and thought seriously for a moment, then spoke uncertainly: "Hmm...... Because you actually showed me your past too? I think I should show you mine too. And...... After all this time, I should let go, and I should let go of my obsession with the past. "Your voice was soft, but it sounded heavy to Spamton's ears. He turned his head blankly to look at you.
“…… Because I should also move toward the future. I want to walk into the future with you." You still didn't look at him, and you didn't know why, at this moment, you didn't dare turn around to look at him. Spamton stared at your profile, but in the end said nothing, just opened the box.
What greeted him was a complete set of painting supplies, a dozen oil paintings, unfinished works, and several graffiti-like artworks—the brushstrokes were immature, yet full of creativity and creativity.
You didn't say a word, nor did you watch Spamton's movements; you just listened to the rustling sound beside you, like turning pages, and nervously swallowed hard.
He flipped through your paintings one by one, quietly admiring each one, his eyes growing brighter and brighter.
Then you hear his voice: "This painting is imitating that 'Sunflowers', right?" The brushwork and coloring are very delicate...... Also, the shapes are more vivid. Although I'm not sure how to comment on the painting, this painting feels very warm and cozy, and I think it's even better than the original! ”
You opened your mouth, wanting to say, how is that possible? The original is so famous, but he just flipped to the next oil painting: "This one...... Is this your self-portrait? The painting definitely doesn't look as good as yours...... But it's quite interesting—breaking into many petals like this—is it a way to observe yourself from different angles? ”
You closed your mouth and quietly watched him flip through the next oil painting: "Is this a still life sketch...... I'm not sure, but that's probably the title. Y/N's fundamentals are really good! "He said with a cheerful smile.
You want to interrupt him, but Spamton just keeps going, "And this one...... Ah, it looks like just a depiction of natural scenery—is it a maple forest? Or yellow or red leaves, giving off a very bleak autumn atmosphere! ”
It's clear he doesn't analyze the artwork; he's just speaking based on his feelings. Yet Spamton still flips through your artwork one by one, earnestly giving his commentary, until he finally finds your childhood doodles.
You instinctively want to snatch that painting away, since showing your childhood doodles is somewhat embarrassing—you just couldn't help but take away this graffiti, which once represented your imagination and creativity, while packing up at home.
Spamton tilted his head to look at the painting and also seriously commented, "Countless cars traveling through space...... Some cars carry the sun, some carry the moon, and some carry stars? It looks very much like a modern mythological story! The brushstrokes in this painting are very inexperienced, but it still perfectly captures the unique characteristics of each vehicle...... "Even if it's just a doodle."
You silently looked at him, suddenly remembering—that day, your parents tore your painting in half, saying they wanted to keep half as a keepsake, and only half remained in the box, only ...... Only the half of you was drawn, and besides that, later you added a white shadow beside it. You don't know who this is, nor do you know...... When will you finish this incomplete painting?
And the day your painting is torn in half is the day before you go to college to register.
You swallowed hard and didn't stop Spamton. He flipped to the last half-incomplete painting, stared at the white shadow, then picked up a black crayon from the box and smeared a pair of sunglasses crookedly.
"Only Y/N...... That's too lonely. That white shadow standing next to you must be me! But without sunglasses, it doesn't really look like ......," he muttered, admiring his work with great pride.
But you didn't say anything, just reached out and hugged him tightly. You didn't want him to see you crying, didn't want him to see the redness in your eyes. Even though tears were streaming down your cheeks, they still soaked his clothes.
Spamton was momentarily stunned, but just gently patted your back with his hand.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 17 (swapsptx you)
content:
At that moment, you silently embraced. Spamton lowered his brows, thinking—since you've treated him so well, he should repay you with equal respect. He thought it was only natural, but hadn't expected you to cry—after all, warm tears were now soaking your clothes.
And at this moment...... It seemed a strange emotion surged in his chest—no, not entirely unfamiliar—he knew it was heartache for you. Besides that, Spamton didn't know much about your past, but from your half-torn painting, he could tell your past was bleak...... Or rather, it was similar to his? What followed immediately was an inexplicable sense of emotion.
…… After all, your past probably wasn't beautiful. For you, finding him, deciding to bring him home, and deciding to live with you—are those things really beautiful? Even so...... He can still sense a love from you that isn't very smooth, even a bit awkward and awkward.
He didn't know...... No, Spamton can now be sure your life must have changed a lot, definitely become better! After all, you just said he's your favorite Addison! Spamton perked up again, and he also wanted to show off to the other Dark People by showing them his own Y/N paintings—although he couldn't see anything extra, he could feel that every painting carried your emotions, and each one only made him marvel at that kind of beauty.
So he gently patted your back again and asked, "...... Y/N, have you considered holding a solo exhibition of your paintings? ”
You were stunned for a moment, lowered your eyes, and said nothing. You never imagined your paintings could be held for exhibitions—after all, you're not a famous artist; these are just your hobbies. Just like your parents said, it's just a hobby.
So you said it too: "...... It's just a hobby. If you take it out, there's no one to look at, right?" Your voice was a bit hoarse.
Moreover, although you let Spamton see these paintings, you weren't prepared to let other Darkfolk come to see them as well.
"So what if it's a hobby? As long as you want, you can show these paintings to everyone to see!" Spamton shouted, almost feeling like someone who didn't come to see the painting was actually losing out.
You let go, just sat on the ground and looked him in the eye, hesitating for a moment before saying, "Alright...... Then shall I think about it? ”
Spamton's eyes lit up, and he persistently said, "Hurry up and think about it! And if you say these paintings are created by the People of Light, there will definitely be a lot of people of Darkness coming to see them!" "He shakes your arm, probably acting spoiled, but you can see his eyes sparkling as he looks at you."
You cleared your throat twice, a bit embarrassed, and changed the subject: "...... If other Dark People came over eagerly to take a look, only to find that the Light Folk only made artworks of this level, they'd be disappointed...... "Before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you."
"No, your painting is beautiful. Not a single Dark Folk would find it ugly!" Spamton promised you with absolute confidence.
He'd already thought it through, and when the time came...... At worst, he'd just spend some dark coins to buy tickets himself, have his employees go, and just praise your artwork!
And you just quietly watched him, as if you had already guessed what he was thinking: "Don't even think about hiring your employees to come to my art exhibition...... No, I haven't even agreed to hold an art exhibition yet." "No matter how you feel like I've already been drawn into it...... You rubbed your forehead in frustration.
“…… Me. I'm not hiring employees......" His gaze drifted, clearly showing that Spamton had been thinking about this just now.
You sighed, just rubbed his head, and pulled him up from the ground: "Alright, let's talk about this another time." "If we keep discussing, you'll really have to blindly follow his words and start an art exhibition."
"No. I think Y/N, you really should hold an art exhibition—show all these paintings out there! I'll help you advertise a bit, and then all the People of Darkness will be able to see them—"How wonderful it is to see your own People of Light!" Thinking of this, Spamton couldn't help but feel proud again.
And you interrupted him again: "No...... No need. I don't need you to help with advertising. "Advertising is not like hiring employees to come to an art exhibition; it's all about forcing your own dark people to come.
The hair on his head drooped again, and his head drooped as he said gloomily, "...... Oh. ”
You couldn't help but ruffle his head again, then grabbed his hand and walked out, softly asking, "Alright...... So, what you told me before, you sold 100 ...... Hmm, artworks—are they real? "You thought you should quickly change the subject, so Spamton wouldn't keep looking gloomy, and he wouldn't keep getting hung up on the art exhibition. After all...... You haven't decided yet. You want to wait until you can truly make your own choices. You don't want Spamton to coax and push you into holding an art exhibition with just a few words—that won't make you happy.
Only the rewards you receive after sincere choices will make you happy—of course, you chose to pick up this Addison from the trash, brought him home to live together, and made this place his home too, which was naturally a heartfelt choice.
The hair on his head stood up again, and he patted his chest to promise you, "Of course! I really sold a hundred portions!" "Although all of them were sold to his employees."
You just whispered softly, "Oh?" and he mysteriously said, "This ...... is all business secrets! ”
You stopped, turned around, and quietly stared at him. Spamton, because you suddenly stopped, almost bumped into your arms, his nose just a tiny step away from your chest. He instinctively widened his eyes, stopped abruptly, and stammered as he asked, "Suddenly ...... Why did you suddenly stop......" He felt a bit uncertain, his voice gradually fading, and he lowered his head, not daring to look at you anymore.
You hold his face, making him lift his head to meet your gaze, while his eyes just roll around, not daring to look at you.
You just repeat once more: "Is it really true?" ”
He raised his voice: "Of course it's true! And I told them that if they sell an extra copy, they'll get a commission of 50 Dark Coins!" ”
"Our Spamton is really great...... But those 100 portions—aren't you really the one selling them to your employees? "Your voice is light, after all, last time it was 100, and this time it's 100, so of course it arouses your suspicion.
“…… It really is sold to the employees." Spamton's voice was muffled, and his voice lowered. He still admitted to you about it, then raised his voice again, "But—but as long as they sell a few more copies, they can make it back, since there's a commission anyway!" ”
"Yeah, I know there's a commission...... You should also reward outstanding employees. But besides this hundred, do you have any other achievements? ”
You pulled Spamton to sit on the sofa and asked softly. Spamton pulled his hand back and began fiddling with the fingers of both his hands, his voice a bit dry: "...... That's all. ”
This answer is within your expectations. You don't think this so-called artwork will sell much, but looking at it this way...... Spamton actually didn't tell many truths, although he did tell part of it, but only about half.
But you just rubbed his head: "Hmm...... Are you planning to do these business again, or rather, to advertise these artworks? Ah, including the previous trash can flower arrangements and such. ”
Spamton nodded suddenly. Of course he wanted to, after all, he thought you actually liked it, so he naturally assumed that the other Dark and Light folks would like it too—even though it was just unreasonable. He just rubbed his head back and forth against your palm, muttering softly, "But the ads are flying everywhere, and there are still hardly any customers...... It feels like it's basically useless." But he didn't want to give up just like that. He even planned to show you the jaw-dropping sales figures to make you happy.
You reached out and hooked his chin again, watching Spamton squint his eyes, resting his chin in your palm, head slightly raised, looking thoroughly enjoying it. After thinking for a moment, you said, "In that case...... Have you considered a more relaxed way to promote it, or simply changed the product to a different level? ”
He shook his head and nodded again: "I've changed my marketing approach, even tried bundled sales, or price reductions, but still no Dark or Light folks have seen these products...... As for switching to another product, Spamton has never considered it.
You narrowed your eyes slightly and smiled as you offered your suggestion: "Is that so...... Then, how about selling real flowers directly? ”
Spamton was taken aback. He recalled the few pots of flowers he had raised dead in his office before, and it seemed he had never heard of any cases of keeping flowers alive...... As for the trees that existed in the Dark World Plains, they seemed to have existed for a long time as well. No one knew how those trees came to be or how they grew, since they could still bear dark candy.
"But...... If it's a real flower, it's hard to keep it alive......" he whispered. For example, he never succeeded; only that pot of lavender you occasionally tended to it managed to grow and produce clusters of tiny purple flowers.
You waved your fingers and made a wink: "Ah...... Because the Dark World lacks sunlight, it's normal that they can't survive. But I have a special formula here. ”
Saying that, you walked back to your room. When you came back, you had a touch light in your hand—a simple full-spectrum plant lamp you developed long ago to successfully plant flowers in the Dark World...... Although you don't need it now.
You shoved the full-spectrum plant lamp into Spamton's hand, resting your chin on your hand: "With this, you can keep it alive." But I don't make much of this myself, so it's limited—first come, first served! ”
You seem to have some talent for business, or maybe after spending a lot of time with Spamton, you've learned a bit more.
Then you waved your hand again: "However, if you want plants to grow better, you'll need a secret recipe...... And different plants need special treatment, and each plant has its own requirements." But at this point, you didn't say anything more.
Spamton blinked. Honestly, your words had piqued his interest, so he couldn't help but ask, "And then?" ”
And you just smile and wave your hand: "Well...... Business secret! ”
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 18 (swapsptx you)
content:
Spamton puffed out his cheeks: "Alright...... Secret is confidential!" Although he didn't press further, he still felt a bit unwilling. Spamton fiddled with the full-spectrum plant lamp, studied it roughly, and figured his staff should be able to replicate it too—whether it works or not, it has to be done. Although he couldn't understand it, he believed that among all those Dark People, there must be someone who could figure it out.
So he asked, "Exactly...... Y/N, if I take this thing and replicate it, it should be fine, right?" "After all, no matter what, it's still something you created...... He can't just copy it casually. If it's someone else's thing, he doesn't care; if he uses it freely, he won't blame him for any trouble. But this is yours, Spamton believes he should show you enough respect.
You paused for a moment, touched your chin, and said, "Hmm...... Are you thinking of doing some promotions? For example, these are the first batch of limited edition treasures, and after that are regular batches or something? ”
Spamton nodded heavily. That's exactly what he thought—after all, doing this would earn him more Dark Coins, so why not do it?
You nodded thoughtfully: "It's possible, but after all, this isn't my invention. I just replicated it using materials available in the Dark World. So if you want to recreate it, just go ahead and do it!" ”
Spamton raised both hands and cheered like a child: "Yay—"
You couldn't help but chuckle, patted his head, and he nuzzled your palm against it.
Now, he no longer spoke in a pitiful tone, and simply said directly: "Y/N!" Let me tell you—the queen of the Dark World next door is really annoying. Clearly, our advertising world wouldn't steal business from the cyber world, yet she still wants a piece of the pie, thinking our flower arranging business must have made a lot of money, and even wants to secretly learn our craft and sell it. "Although Addison really did come from the cyber world...... But Spamton didn't care. When he felt wronged, he wanted to tell you, even though sometimes he thought it was just unreasonable trouble.
You just scratched his chin thoughtfully: "So, how do you want to solve this?" ”
Spamton closed his eyes comfortably, even making snoring sounds. He just mumbled a little unclearly, "Well, of course we hid our exclusive business secrets. Anyway, she definitely won't be able to sell them!" He said confidently.
Then he opened his eyes and saw your smiling face, his voice involuntarily lowered: "But we don't have any exclusive business secrets...... But only after you suggested did he finally master the trade secrets again. Before this, it was only because he pressured employees to buy, and those employees pressured the Dark People of the advertising world to buy them, which was why sales seemed higher.
You just tilted your head and scratched the soft, sparse hair beside his cheek: "Hmm, don't we already have some business secrets?" "If that's the case, you should keep the trade secrets safe." ”
Spamton nodded vigorously again: "I understand—" He dragged out his voice, as if being playful.
"Hmm...... But if the neighboring dark world wants a piece of the pie, it might not be a bad idea. "You thought it over for a moment.
Spamton just puffed out his cheeks again: "Isn't it only a limited edition fashion item from the Dark World that looks better? That way, I can raise the price too!" ”
You gently flicked his forehead, and even without force, Spamton pretended to be in pain, clutching his forehead tightly, then looked at you with tears in his eyes, making you laugh again.
"Think about it, if there's only one dark world to sell, then if the people of other dark worlds want to get these limited fashion items, they'll either have to go to this world to buy them, or they'll have to drag the people who can travel between them...... Most of the people of darkness probably don't have the ability to do that, right? Wouldn't that just let middlemen profit from the price difference and resell them? ”
"Then I'll just have the Dark People with that ability sell in other dark worlds......" Anyway, the Dark Coins he earned ended up in his own pocket, Spamton thought, without much conscience.
You shook your finger and shook your head seriously: "Not good. Even if your employees hold up huge banners and advertise, it's hard to convince other Dark Folk to believe them...... And if you do that, even more Dark People won't see it." ”
Spamton raised his voice: "The ad pop-up will appear on all the Lightfolk computers—no one will miss seeing it!" He swore confidently.
Seeing him like this, you seem a bit distracted and suddenly recall the ad pop-ups you used to see on your computer and all those random spam emails filled with all kinds of ads. You can't help but be curious: "By the way, do you manage all the ad pop-ups and spam emails?" ”
Spamton immediately fell silent. He cautiously looked up at you, suddenly feeling a bit embarrassed to speak...... Back when he was just an ordinary addison, just a regular spam-sending addison, he really did like to visit your computer. Although the cyber world is built on another laptop—in a sense, they can roam among the computers of the Lightfolk.
And you...... Your computer inbox is never emptied, so it can fool itself by telling yourself maybe you saw those emails, maybe you saw those ads. You just don't know when you deleted all those emails.
Probably the day before he heard that a Light Folk had arrived in the Dark World.
Spamton just shook his head and nodded: "Pretty much, so all the spam and ads are managed by us...... I'm really something!" He was feeling proud again, though he couldn't help but feel a bit guilty. If he wasn't online, he wouldn't be able to touch that computer either.
You just smiled and patted his forehead: "Spamton is amazing—it can manage ads on so many computers!" ”
Spamton also looked up. Looking at him now, he looked a bit like a peacock happily spreading its feathers, and you couldn't help but laugh again.
"So...... Are those spam emails on my computer also sent by you? "You asked softly.
Spamton was a bit stuck. He glanced at you timidly, then lowered his head again: "I'm not going to post ads anymore! It's all the Dark People under my command who are posting them—I just need to set up the overall strategy!" ”
…… Now, no one should be placing ads in your inbox anymore. After all, ever since you arrived in the Dark World, Spamton has never been able to enter that familiar computer anymore.
You nodded, drowning out your "Oh—" sound. Seeing his somewhat guilty expression, you couldn't help but ask again: "So, which Dark Citizen is actually responsible for placing ads in my email?" ”
Spamton lowered his head, unusually a bit afraid to look at you. He just whispered, "...... Yes, when I was still Addison, I always sent emails to your mailbox...... After you came to the Dark World, I never delivered anymore. "I can't deliver anymore."
You blink, then your pupils widen. You don't realize that before that, you had already encountered Spamton—though you don't clear those emails, you also don't click in to view them. It wasn't until you decided to leave home and erased all traces of the past that you shredded and deleted all those emails, because you never intended to recover them.
At this moment, Spamton gestured again: "But I should just be a Dark People who exist because of concepts...... Probably not because of any physical object? But I think, since I've sent so many emails into your mailbox, in a way, it can be considered a concept that makes up my own business! But I'm the master of advertising! I certainly don't lack these conceptual components! ”
You couldn't help but nod and patted his head again. You probably get it...... In a way, he exists because of you. In a way, it's precisely because of your presence that he was able to get through the years gone by.
"Alright, alright, I get it—I feel like the topic is a bit off-topic, but regarding the other dark worlds just trying to learn from your methods, I can offer some of my opinion." You cleared your throat and said seriously.
"So what advice does Y/N have to give? I'll definitely listen!" Spamton said eagerly, sounding a bit eager to answer. If other Dark People gave him advice, he definitely wouldn't even pay attention! But he would listen to you...... Even if he occasionally found it unpleasant, he would keep listening. Of course, you wouldn't take it seriously or say anything unpleasant.
Because he knows you care about him, you care for him, and that's why he says those things. It's also because you don't want him to be sad that you won't say anything hurtful.
And he...... He cares about you and cares about your words, so no matter what you say, he listens. After all, Spamton knows this is something you painstakingly came up with for him.
Bad or unpleasant words or sad things can be discussed properly. Of course, he believes you won't do this, and he can't do it either, because he cares about you the most.
"Hmm...... Although I think having your employees sell in other dark worlds is a good idea, it's still a bit troublesome, and if too many people buy it, your staff won't be able to keep up, right? So you can cooperate with other dark worlds—you handle supply, they handle sales—and if it sells well, then you get a commission! "You waved your finger.
Spamton simply leaned on your shoulder, playing with your fingers, acting affectionately, and neither of you thought it was a problem. He just said excitedly, "Y/N is so smart! I never even thought of such a solution!" ”
…… Actually, when we were chatting and discussing earlier, he thought of this too, but didn't say it out loud. Well, he just wanted to compliment you.
You cleared your throat, your cheeks rarely flushed, and just waved your hand: "...... I don't think I'm anything special. You must have thought about that just now, right? ”
You still know your Addison very well...... Of course, he can think of such a simple thing as well.
Spamton just shook his head: "I did think of it...... But you're still amazing. Look, you know gardening, you can draw, and you can develop this kind of plant lamp...... You know a lot! Even if you don't do it well in some areas, you're already an impressive person! "He was counting on his fingers and carefully listing your strengths.
You blinked sluggishly, then rubbed your slightly reddened eyes, and just muffled a "Mm."
You never thought that before, your parents only scolded you for having a hobby that wasted your spirit...... Now you can be praised as amazing.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 19 (swapsptx you)
content:
Temporarily ordered during a break in the comic convention...... OOC apologies. This GGDW is pretty ...... Childish (? )
——
Spamton had to admit, what you said was indeed somewhat useful—whether it was that full-spectrum plant lamp or the proposed operation to cooperate with other Dark World distributors. After all, he was sitting in his office at this moment, seriously pondering the issue.
…… To be honest, he doesn't want to sell a single copy; he wants to collect everything about you himself. But he also knows that you do this for the sake of his career—there's no real career at all; it's just imitating the Light folk playing house, but he does feel a bit proud and self-satisfied from it.
While muttering to himself, Spamton still set a time for the meeting.
He was the last to enter the meeting room. The other Dark People had already arrived, whispering about what unreasonable request the boss was about to make this time. Then Spamton walked in, and all the Dark People quieted down, looking at each other, afraid that Spamton would catch them speaking up.
After all, Spamton's face was expressionless at the moment, looking quite intimidating. No one knew who had provoked him.
He was still a bit reluctant to share your stuff—but when he took the main seat, his expression immediately changed, looking cheerful or proud: "Now I have some great news to tell you—"
All the Dark People fell silent, each pondering what he intended to say.
“…… That is, we can now cultivate plants from the true Light World in the Dark World!" Spamton said, raising a finger to the sky and proudly announcing the event.
"How is that possible? The environment of the dark world itself isn't suitable for ......," pink instinctively wanted to argue, but Spamton interrupted him.
"Don't argue with me. There's no need to object; what I say is the truth." Spamton raised his head and raised his voice to announce the matter, since he wanted all the Dark People to know.
In fact, this unwritten rule had long been in place. All the Darkfolk under his rule knew it, except for his former colleagues. Addison occasionally argued with him, which greatly displeased Spamton.
Pink fell silent, though he still felt a bit resentful inside. He remembered clearly—Spamton was now all high and mighty, nothing had happened, yet he still called on the Lightfolk to back him up. Now, almost every Dark People in the advertising world knew that Lightborn, since Spamton liked to show off his own Light Folk so often.
"In short, my family's Lightfolk are amazing! My Y/N is the best! This full-spectrum plant lamp was developed by her, but only a few of them." Spamton enthusiastically introduced it, and casually brought out a pot of plants. The plant was thriving—a sunflower, but without any light, its petals closed.
When Spamton took out a full-spectrum plant lamp and skillfully turned on a few switches, the sunflower slowly began to bloom, revealing petals that revealed the sun-facing center, even though it was now only directed at that plant lamp.
…… Actually, there were originally ten portions, but due to his selfishness, he withheld several portions. He planned to carefully nurture a few more pots of flowers, and this time he definitely wouldn't let them die!
He wanted to grow some lavender and forget-me-nots, as mentioned before...... Ah, maybe tulips and roses too.
Spamton wants to carefully cultivate a lavender sea again. This time, there are no fake flowers—he's going to give you a real surprise.
Spamton also wants to cultivate some roses well, so he can happily present the pot to you, tell you he's succeeded, tell you...... He probably likes you.
Because Spamton does not want to leave you, just as light and darkness actually coexist; without light, where would darkness come from? So...... Darkness exists by relying on light, irreplaceable, and Spamton depends on you to survive as it is now.
Because he likes how shining you are, because he wants all the Dark People to know you're powerful, that you're strong—but deep down, he doesn't want the other Dark Folk to know just how good you really are. He doesn't want them to steal you away.
What does 'like' mean, and what does 'love' mean? He doesn't know; he just knows that when he's with you, Spamton vaguely thinks that's probably what love feels like, since he feels light and warm throughout.
So he feels that he probably, no, definitely, he definitely likes you.
He lowered his brows and eyes without speaking, while the Dark People below started making a fuss. Spamton deliberately didn't make a sound to stop them; he wanted the noise to last a little longer, even though his heart was unexpectedly quiet now. And none of the outside noise could disturb his calm or the warmth that came back when he thought of you.
…… Maybe it's only when he thinks of you that he becomes so quiet. Spamton's lips couldn't help but curl upward. Blue, who hadn't spoken until now, noticed this, but only watched.
Spamton remembered that day again. It was the day after he took the full-spectrum plant lamp from you. To be honest, Spamton always thinks you're amazing, and he sincerely praises you—whether gardening or painting—to him, it's just the art he has no access to, and things he can't grasp.
But he can feel genuine beauty in it, feel the effort you put in, and feel warmth from it. So Spamton knows it must be beautiful.
But he also knew that only he was the one from the Dark People expressing affirmation...... You probably wouldn't fully believe it, even if he was already the master of the Dark World and the boss of the advertising world, you might not fully believe it. So Spamton wanted you to hold an art exhibition; he wanted more and more Dark People to see you and see how shining you were.
Then he could brag that this was their Y/N, their Light Folk were really powerful!
But at that time, even though he was thinking about all this mess, he didn't say much. He just carefully brought back the already wilted flower he had brought back from the office—a pot of flowers he had almost nurtured to death again.
However, when the light was turned on, the sunflower flower unfurled its petals again, revealing a warm and soft inner self. Just like him, it also revealed its soft inner self in front of you.
He stared blankly at the pot of flowers and asked, "In that case...... Just illuminate all the flowers, or rather, just place a lamp in the middle of a cluster of flowers, wouldn't that be enough? ”
Your mouth twitched, feeling like this was some kind of greenhouse replica—well, not entirely, just a bit similar. You cleared your throat, feeling you should answer seriously, but your words inevitably showed a hint of amusement.
Because you find his serious demeanor surprisingly cute.
"Ahem...... Even a single lamp couldn't cover such a large area! If the equipment were big enough, it could indeed be done, but this is just a small lamp—how could it have such a big effect? ”
"And precisely because it's small enough, the coverage isn't that big, so it's easier to sell more." You wink at him innocently and smile.
Spamton was taken aback, quickly understanding what you meant, and couldn't help but laugh along.
"That's perfect—then, for a scale of this size, we'll sell for a thousand Dark Coins. If it's a large ...... Then ten million Dark Coins! Spamton shook his finger and started talking nonsense.
You didn't break his imagination. Even though you thought buying ten million Dark Coins and the Dark People would be a fool, a fantasy, you just clapped and smiled: "That's right, that's exactly what I meant. If it were large, it would definitely be even more expensive." ”
Spamton's thoughts were pulled back again. He was a bit unhappy about the person interrupting his memories, but seeing it was Blue, he felt embarrassed to lose his temper. As the master of advertising, he wouldn't get angry with a patient!
He was already taught a lesson by you yesterday, and now he's super proud thinking he's done very well.
"So, what is the price of this lamp?" Blue simply asked calmly.
He felt a bit helpless. If it weren't for the growing voices of the Dark People at the scene, and if some pippins had even sneaked up betting while Spamton was lost in thought or even sneaking in from below, Blue wouldn't know why they were still thinking about gambling at a time like this—especially how long it would take for Spamton to say something next.
…… In fact, the reason he was now calling out for Spamton was because Orange, who loved drama, dragged him into the gamble too. And Blue definitely didn't want to lose.
Orange winked at him, while Pink glared at him, probably because he was also involved. But since Blue spoke up, he probably lost the bet—Blue was just pretending not to notice.
"Only five units...... Each Dark Citizen is limited to buying one. As for the price, let's set it at 10,000 Dark Coins per lamp! Spamton's eyes darted around as he popped up a large pop-up displaying the price, which also showed "50% off."
"Not only that, but I want to tell everyone this is a limited-time offer. If it expires, it will return to the retail price of 20,000 Dark Coins in a week."
Then he popped up another pop-up window, countless arrows pointing to the image of the full-spectrum plant lamp he had imagined.
"If you can't catch the first generation, you can wait for the second, but the second generation's functionality isn't as strong as the first, so it was only sold for 5,000 Dark Coins. It's also a limited-time first-week discount, and after that, the original price will return to 10,000."
He loudly announced that the price he told you was obviously lying...... Now was the retail price he had truly considered!
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 20 (swapsptx you)
content:
The employees looked around, glanced at each other, then nodded randomly. After all, the price was decided by Spamton, the big boss, and had nothing to do with them.
Spamton saw that all the employees below nodded in agreement, with no objections, and nodded in satisfaction. He said so, there would never be anyone among the Dark People who thought their decision was bad!
Of course, there are certainly some Dark People who think this way, but for them, they simply don't have the courage to challenge Spamton's opinion.
But Spamton still remembers what you said. You pinched his cheek and told him, since you're already the master of the advertising world and a big boss, you should carefully ask the employees if they have any opinions. If they just don't dare to say anything—you wouldn't go to work with him, and of course you wouldn't be able to find his mistakes in time. And you always feel that sometimes Spamton will keep things from you and won't tell the truth.
At this moment, he was smugly thinking that he had already done quite well, and the employees below didn't even have a single objection! But he still obediently listened to you and decided to ask again.
So he just cleared his throat and said arrogantly, "Ahem, do you have any other suggestions? If there are no objections, the meeting is adjourned. Next up is this publicity plan!" He clapped his hands and announced.
At this moment, Blue raised his hand again: "I think, if it's the second batch, the pricing might be a bit high. Maybe we should lower the price?" Not many Dark People have savings in Dark Coins. ”
Spamton's face immediately fell, knowing he shouldn't have asked. That way, he could go home and show off to you how right his decision was, but not a single Dark Civilian objected.
He opened his mouth, but before he could answer, Orange raised his hand and gave his answer: "I think if the second batch of lanterns is set at 10,000 Dark Coins, then we should give them more time to discount, or at least give them an event one month in advance before sales start so those Dark People can reserve purchases. After the sale officially starts, we can give them another month of promotion. That way, those Dark People can accumulate enough Dark Coins, and then we can all make a profit from them." Orange said this while winking and winking.
Spamton puffed out his cheeks, wanting to say that just doing as he said would be fine, but he had to admit his former colleague did have some point...... And he remembered what you said—he needed to listen to the opinions of other employees.
To be honest, he actually didn't want to do that; it was only because you said that he was reluctantly willing to give it a try. But now Spamton realized that this did have some benefits, since there were some areas he didn't do well. Although being a dictator is great and comfortable! But he also wants to do better. As long as he becomes more impressive, you'll surely drown him in all kinds of boasting and exaggerated praise. Just thinking about this makes Spamton feel delighted.
So at this moment, Spamton just waved his hand impatiently: "You make a good point...... Then let's adjust according to your proposal. First, lower the price from 10,000 Dark Coins to 5,000 Dark Coins. Next, start a one-month promotional event. During the promotion period, pre-orders will be priced at the 1,000 Dark Coin event price. Once the promotion ends, after the product launches, there will be a month-long promotion, and then the price will be set at 2,500 Dark Coins!" "Anyway, it doesn't really matter how many Dark Coins you set at the price. Everything is up to him," Spamton thought to himself, hands on hips. However, after all, most of the Dark Coins owned by the other Dark People in the advertising world were actually under his control, so it didn't matter if he controlled everything.
Then Spamton waved his hand, signaling the meeting to end. The employees swarmed out of the meeting room, where the pippins were still whispering, discussing how the boss had changed his temper these past few days. Not only did they hardly bother with their gambling—otherwise, they wouldn't have started gambling so brazenly while Spamton was daydreaming. They were sure Spamton must have known, just ignored them.
But it didn't matter—it just meant their lives had gotten better, and they could be more uninhibited. So those pippins just happily jumped out, Shadow Guy was happily playing tunes, extremely excited, and this time it was a stirring saxophone track. Zapper, on the other hand, just bounced a few times without saying much.
Spamton just sat quietly in the now-quiet conference room for a while, and he started missing you again, because when he was alone in the room, he only felt bored or even afraid, completely alone, as if he had been abandoned by all the Dark People. No, he would never be like before, alone and alone. He knew he had a home, and he knew you were always there waiting for him. He knew...... He probably knew, or rather, he insisted on thinking that way, that you would always be by his side and never abandon him.
He simply got up and walked out of the meeting room, returning to the strike room, letting these thoughts wander freely. He simply squatted down, looking at the roses and tulips planted with some worry. ，
Although he secretly bought a few full-spectrum plant lamps from you, under his care, these plants still looked wilted. He just didn't kill them, but they weren't much better either. Spamton was always worried. He wanted to plant them properly and show them to you, to surprise you. But now...... He couldn't possibly give you a withered, wilted flower either.
Spamton frowned worriedly and couldn't help watering a little more, but the flowers wilted even more. He closed his eyes for a moment, then finally picked up a pot of tulips—he decided to go home and ask for your opinion. What exactly are these trade secrets? He had no idea! Luckily, he didn't intend to treat this pot of flowers as a surprise or anything, so it was fine to show it to you casually.
Today, he had been busy in the office with the ringing of bells for a while. The other employees had no idea what he was doing, but Spamton just kept a stern face, holding the listless tulip as he went home. He had come home a bit late. To be honest, all that time had been spent flipping through books in the office, trying to find some information to see if there was anything useful among the useless piles of just pretty books.
…… It turned out there weren't. They were all economics books he didn't even read, because he found them boring and only covered key points he had already mastered.
He took a deep breath and opened the door. You were already sitting at the dining table waiting for him. Seeing that he hadn't come home today, you simply reheated the frozen pizza in the fridge. After all, this has quite a lot and is convenient to eat. You really enjoy tinkering with it.
The steaming hot pizza was on the dining table. You wanted to say more, but when you looked up at Spamton, you couldn't help but pause—you had just been anxiously scrolling on your phone because Spamton had come home late, not knowing what to do. In short, you were just constantly refreshing the chat page. After all, if you really wanted to calm down and look at something, you wouldn't be able to stand it anymore.
But you didn't expect Spamton to bring back a potted flower...... It was a wilted sunflower.
Your mouth twitched, and you could tell the flower had been watered too much. Spamton was probably too nervous, and sometimes even too nervous wouldn't work...... But it's hard to maintain a relaxed mood.
You were momentarily distracted by the last payment, but still spoke with a smile: "Put that pot down for now. We'll talk about it after we have a good dinner." By the way, it's probably just that you watered too much. Usually, once a day is enough, and some plants require different amounts of irrigation depending on the variety. ”
You probably explained it to him, and Spamton just nodded half-understandingly; he probably didn't really get it.
You just sighed and chose to break it open to explain: "Anyway, first pour out the water that has accumulated in the basin. Then I suggest you change the soil, to a dry environment, and make sure to irrigate once a day. As long as the soil is slightly moist, it'll be fine." ”
Spamton nodded repeatedly and was about to find a new pot, but you quickly grabbed him: "Plants are very resilient. It's fine to leave them a little longer...... You should eat first. You're coming back so late—you must be really hungry." ”
Spamton scratched his cheek, his face slightly flushed. Indeed, he could hear the rumbling of his stomach, so he finally put down the flowerpot and obediently sat down across from you to start eating.
You nod in satisfaction, glanced at him, and couldn't help but add, "Do you have any other cultivations...... Different flowers have their own cultivation methods. ”
But Spamton just shook his head frantically; for now, he still doesn’t want you to see it. After all, he plans to give you a surprise, and he also intends to make an effort himself—he must grow lavender successfully to give you a surprise, and then watch your eyes light up as you praise him, saying that Spamton is really amazing.
Seeing him like this, you can tell that he’s definitely hiding something from you again, but it doesn’t really matter. After all, you know, and sooner or later you’ll find out exactly what he’s been keeping from you.
After all, what he’s hiding is all meant for you to see. You know this very well, so you can’t help but start looking forward to it.
What might he be preparing? Could it be a carnation, meant to express gratitude and friendship? But you don’t need such things. You just voluntarily, spontaneously, want to be kind to him. It’s not because he has done something that deserves it; you just feel that he also deserves these things, that he is entitled to his own happiness.
After all, no one is born to suffer, even if… your past hasn’t been happy, you’re also willing to make an effort to create what can be considered a warm and beautiful present for him. After all, you believe his future will also be bright and shining—though you haven’t considered this for yourself. You just feel that it doesn’t matter what happens to you.
After you finished dinner, he tidied up the dishes as usual, and now you are both sitting on the sofa.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 21 (swapsptx you)
content:
You leaned back slightly on the sofa, watching as Spamton seriously moved over a new pot, then poured in the soil and carefully transplanted the already wilted tulip. You looked at the flowerpot and couldn't help but get a bit distracted. It was bought when Spamton first became interested in gardening. As for why he was interested, it was probably because you told him at the time you wanted to see a sea of lavender.
Although I don't know why flowerpots are still sold in the Dark World...... Maybe it's because some people of darkness really like to plant fake flowers, and you can't help but smile when you look at the patterns on the pots.
I don't know why he acts so serious, as if afraid the flowers might be hurt in the slightest by his actions. But you look at him and can't help but be a bit lost in thought. In the end, you quietly return to your room, pick up your brush and a piece of drawing paper again, and decide this time to just sketch him simply.
So you simply returned to the sofa and quietly began tracing his figure on paper. For a moment, the room fell silent, with no other sounds.
After sketching and tracing his form, you began to carefully sketch on paper, no longer looking at spamton. You got so absorbed that you quietly walked to your side and admired it for a long time without noticing.
Until you were almost done with the painting and were about to lift your head to stretch out your arms for a lazy stretch, you widened your eyes at Spamton, who had appeared at some point and happened to meet your gaze.
Maybe because he saw you were so focused on drawing, he didn't disturb you. Even if he really did, you wouldn't say anything......
At that moment, he tilted his head, excitedly leaning close to you, his head pressed against yours, staring at the sketch. You instinctively felt a bit embarrassed and wanted to put the sketch away, but then you heard Spamton's voice again, as if he was acting spoiled, his voice a bit sticky: "Y/N." "Can I have this painting?" ”
“…… But it's just a sketch, nothing particularly good. How about I draw a new one for you?" You scratched your head, though giving this painting to Spamton wouldn't be a problem...... No, it does matter. Although Spamton praised your drawing and your colleagues said you did too, you still felt a bit insecure. After all, it was just your improvisation. If possible, you would still hope you could give Spamton the best.
Spamton just felt that whatever you drew was excellent in his eyes, and that didn't stop him from showing off, saying his Y/N had painted a picture for him—it was beautiful. And even if it was just a casual drawing, he could feel a warm emotion in the painting, as if it was enveloping him completely.
"This one is fine, and the previous one is fine too...... Ah, that one is already a gift for me, right? Y/N wants to draw me a new one—no, many, lots and lots of new ones! Y/N must really like drawing me too, right? "Spamton immediately went back to sitting on the sofa, but his eyes sparkled as he looked at you.
And you can't help but laugh: "Yes, of course I'll draw lots and lots of pictures for you...... Or rather, besides you, I probably don't have any other models." When you said this, you hesitated a little, because you couldn't be sure either...... After that, there would only be Spamton, the model. What if you need to draw someone else later?
But Spamton was almost making a fuss, grabbing your arm and shaking it, his eyes shining as he looked at you: "So, it's settled? Whether among the People of Light or Darkness, I'm the only model in Y/N!" ”
You were momentarily stunned, and before you could answer, Spamton puffed out his cheeks, looking a bit angry. You couldn't help but poke his cheek, then ruffle his hair, and softly say, "Of course, I will only have you as a model." ”
At this point, you decide, and indeed you can only paint him. Besides landscape oil paintings, the main character in the painting can only be him. Probably you still don't have the courage to paint other characters; you're afraid your painting will be criticized by those people, but only Spamton accepts it wholeheartedly.
And...... He has become another protagonist in your life. If you don't portray him, who else can you paint? Of course, the first protagonist in life is yourself. Everyone thinks about themselves and lives for themselves. As for him...... Spamton's presence was already present in the original future plans.
He rubbed contentedly against your palm, grabbed your hand, and rubbed it against his cheek, while Spamton just squinted and let out a slight purring sound similar to satisfaction.
"Alright, then Y/N's future paintings will all be mine...... Oh right, maybe Y/N should consider exhibiting them. I guarantee all the Dark People will come to see your masterpiece!" He said excitedly.
You feel a bit troubled. Honestly, seeing his sparkling eyes and hopeful expression, you feel a bit embarrassed to refuse, but...... You think, if it were your own will and choice, you probably wouldn't be so eager for the exhibition.
So in the end, you just quietly replied, "But holding a solo art exhibition is meaningless, and I don't want to be famous in the dark world." "You just need to honestly and steadily get through your lower half. You don't have many desires, nor any desires. You just ...... I just hope you and he can both spend the rest of your lives peacefully."
But Spamton, now the main advertiser, seems to really enjoy liveliness and fame.
Spamton was stunned for a moment, opening his mouth but not knowing what to say. From his perspective, he really did want you to become famous, to hold an art exhibition, so he could proudly announce to everyone that you were extremely, extremely amazing, and that you were his favorite Light Citizen. But...... He also knew that you should respect your wishes. If you didn't want to, although he might feel a bit disappointed and sad, he wouldn't say much.
So in the end, he just lowered his head, the two tufts of hair on the front of his head drooping a little, looking gloomy.
"If Y/N really doesn't want it, then forget it......" the voice was muffled.
You were stunned for a moment, not knowing how your Addison had ended up like this again. To be honest, you could feel that he was eager for you to hold an art exhibition. If it was for him, you would indeed be willing to hold one...... You thought for a moment, patted his head, and softly said, "Don't be sad." But if it were an art exhibition themed around you, I think I'd be willing. ”
You don't want to exhibit your past works. Although confirming this theme means rushing to produce a huge number of paintings, even though you don't know when you'll be able to finish them—you admit, personally speaking, you also hope more people of light and darkness will see Spamton, and perhaps the exhibition is a good opportunity.
Then Spamton's eyes suddenly lit up again. He dawdled down next to you, eagerly saying, "Then Y/N will hold an exhibition tomorrow!" I believe the tickets will definitely sell out overnight! ”
You helplessly flicked his forehead, and Spamton let out a loud "Ouch" as if in pain, then clutched his forehead and looked at you in grievance.
"It's not that easy. Preparing for the exhibition will take at least a week, and ...... I have far fewer paintings. "At most, if you count two paintings, I can only hang them at the entrance. The rest are just empty walls, nothing to look at.
"Then Y/N will treat me as a free model. I'll allow you to leave many portraits of me! There must be many Dark People coming to admire my heroic figure to visit your art exhibition!" Spamton slightly raised his head, speaking proudly.
You sighed and replied somewhat perfunctorily, "Alright, alright." ”
At the same time, you picked up the paper and left a portrait of him sitting upright as if spreading his screen.
Over the past few days, you feel like you can see Spamton striking seductive poses wherever you go. Whenever you pass by with a canvas, Spamton immediately stops and strikes a pose, sneaking glances at you out of the corner of his eye as if he's trying to see what you're doing.
If you really stop to paint, he'll look away and continue with that pose seriously, but after a while, he'll sneak another glance at you. If you're still focused on painting, he'll immediately turn his head and pretend he hasn't done anything. If you've finished, he'll lean in to look at your masterpiece and shout that your painting is beautiful, every time he's sincerely complimenting you, making your face blush and a bit embarrassed.
If his peripheral vision meets your gaze and you happen to meet your gaze, Spamton will blush, turn his head back, and try to be a responsible model.
If you haven't stopped, then Spamton can only look disappointed, tuck away that nonexistent tail feather that seems to be spreading its tail, then slunk behind you, eagerly waiting for your free moment, so he can continue modeling for you.
Recently, the staff in the advertising world have been troubled by the situation. For some reason, when Spamton recently comes to the company, they always look cheerful, with less difficulty and workload, but the boss's rambling noticeably increases.
A pippins, who wished to remain anonymous, shared a story about their own experience: "At the time, I was just delivering some documents to the boss's office. Just because I glanced at the oil painting behind the boss for a couple of seconds, the boss cheerfully shared with me, 'How did you know this was a gift from my Y/N,' and even nagged me for ages, bragging about how Y/N made this painting and how genius Y/N was!" ”
The other Dark People also expressed that what Pippins said was true, and that was exactly how they felt right now.
You didn't know about it; you just carefully left traces of his painting, recording his upright posture behind the dining table waiting for you, his falling asleep after waiting too long, his excitement as he watched blooming flowers, his eager expression as he leaned close to you to admire the painting, his face earnestly praising you, his face showing him lying on the sofa complaining about work, his glasses wearing glasses sitting at the table studying data, his apron around his apron flustered in the kitchen cleaning up dishes, and his skillful stir-frying of dishes......
You record these scenes, and the number of oil paintings accumulates, and this quantity is finally enough to hold an art exhibition.
So you take these oil paintings to discuss with the gallery owner, and the color card manager quickly agrees to your exhibition request.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 22 (swapsptx you)
content:
The exhibition is tentatively scheduled for half a month later, for a week-long show, so you have plenty of time to prepare before then. There's still another artist's exhibition going on, about a week away, and in a week, you'll be preparing to set up. At the same time, tickets will be available for reservation and go on sale.
You went home and shared this with Spamton. His eyes sparkled as he listened, then he excitedly waved his arms and legs: "I knew it—Y/N, you were absolutely right to hold this exhibition, especially great!! And I believe many dark people from the advertising world come to the exhibition just to admire my style, and maybe many dark folk from other worlds visit the exhibition out of curiosity about advertising!" ”
He kept shouting to himself, "You always see something behind him, like there's a tail, and it's already raised." You try to hold it in but still can't laugh, and you're too embarrassed to expose Spamton's beautiful imagination. After all, you think you're just an unknown artist, and printing so many tickets probably won't get you out. But the gallery owner insists on holding a week-long exhibition, and has printed a lot of tickets—twice the number of tickets from your last week-long exhibition...... You're worried about whether these tickets will even sell.
Besides, the advertising world probably wouldn't be particularly interested in seeing what the owner of this world is like in daily life. After all, almost all the people of darkness below are his employees, and they rarely see each other in daily life.
"Hmm...... Not really, my paintings are really just average, so don't flatter me like that. "You scratched your cheek a little shyly.
Spamton suddenly leaned in, his face enlarging in front of your eyes, making you involuntarily lean back: "...... What's wrong? ”
But he just looked at you seriously, then cupped your face with both hands: "Y/N, you need to be confident." Of course...... It's okay if you're not confident, I'll help you feel confident! I'll help you love your own ......." As he spoke, he covered his mouth, looking at you a bit helplessly, since he hadn't intended to say that out loud at a time like this.
But you just smiled and gently rubbed his head: "...... Yeah, I know. After all, it's because of you that I'm willing to accept my past." "Otherwise...... You'd probably never be able to pick up a paintbrush. The moment you do, you'll see that torn painting in half—one half of your parents, the other half your painting.
You can also hear the voices of those days—pointing at your paintings, looking at you with disappointment, saying that even if you spend your time on these hobbies, they wouldn't mind, but you can't achieve exquisite realms in those hobbies as well.
But now, when you pick up your brush, all you see is the half-painted spamton's shadow and the painting holding your hand together, and all you hear is his noisy chatter, saying that even if it's just a hobby, it's something impressive.
A bit noisy and noisy, always playing around, making the house a bit noisy, but you don't find it annoying; instead, you find him very cute.
"That's right, so Y/N is really impressive! Don't always be so humble. When you should be proud, just admit it. As long as you're proud, that's enough!" As he spoke, he first lifted his head proudly. You looked at him with a smile, and tried lifting your head yourself.
"You see, as long as you accept praise proudly, everything will become beautiful, right? And...... Just accept others' praise proudly! Because that's definitely what you deserve! ”
This statement sounds a bit unreasonable, after all...... Not everyone comes to praise your work with a completely appreciative gaze; maybe they're just being polite and giving a perfunctory answer.
But you still nodded: "...... I understand, I'll try to do this, right?" Your words carried a hint of hesitation.
Spamton just leaned in and leaned on your shoulder: "It's not about trying, it's about making sure — but if you're not used to it, I'll listen to what they say and then relay it to you!" He waved his finger, but of course, if he relayed it—he'd definitely praise you to the brim!
“…… Alright, but if you hear anything nasty, you have to tell me. You don't have to help me listen to these things—I'll handle it all myself." You fiddled with his fingers, playing with them casually, muttering this line under your breath.
He just waved his other hand in front of your eyes, mumbling unhappily, "What? If it makes you sad, you definitely shouldn't listen! Don't worry, no one will ever say anything bad about you!" Spamton patted his chest and promised you.
Even though you want to say more, seeing him make such a firm promise, you end up holding back your words. Think about it, maybe it's better not to spoil the mood, even though you don't think many people will praise you or anything...... Most of the time, aren't they just casually glanced around and then left?
But right after, you hear Spamton say, "But...... Y/N, you still need to build some confidence. How about this, I'll just praise you a few times every day from now on. After a month, you'll definitely be fine!" He nodded proudly as he spoke.
"Do you need it? But I think maybe you don't need it anymore, after all, you've always been like a proud peacock." You couldn't help but smile and gently rub your head against Spamton's head—fluffy and a little ticklish.
Spamton choked up, then suddenly raised his voice: "Of course I need—"
Of course, he really needs Y/N's praise! Although he usually seems very confident—part of the reason is that, as the creator of the advertising world, he can't be without confidence. Of course, there are also other reasons...... Maybe he's been by your side too long. Although Spamton still remembers the past, the pain of the past has long been something he can let go of, so gradually, he has become more confident.
But of course he needed it, or rather, needed even more!
You blink, rub his head with both hands, and his head obediently sways in direction with your movements.
"Mm...... Good, Spamton is amazing—it raised its own flowers! That's awesome! "You said with a cheerful smile.
"Y/N is amazing too! You've painted so many pictures...... For me, even being able to draw a single picture is already pretty rare. "Spamton immediately jumps in after you.
You coughed lightly, feeling your cheeks flushed a little, feeling a bit embarrassed...... So you patted your cheeks and quietly turned your head: "I...... I'll go get you a drawing paper. You try drawing too." You were just clumsily changing the subject, and then you hurriedly and somewhat in a panic went into the room to fetch a sheet of drawing paper and a set of crayons.
Spamton, looking at your background, also patted his slightly flushed face. He muttered softly twice, relieved that you probably couldn't hear what he was saying—even though he was just watching your back and whispering, 'I like you the most.'
Then, he saw you come out again. At that moment, the warmth on your faces had faded, and you handed Spamton both the drawing paper and crayons.
Spamton glanced at you cautiously, and you just nodded gently, smiled, and gave him an encouraging look.
Spamton took a deep breath and began to paint. He decided to paint that day, when you stand in front of him and take his coffee cup—that would be just so—cool!
Unfortunately, whether from excitement or nervousness, his hand trembled a little, but he still tried hard to draw his figure—a white Addison's shadow, your figure, the heroic figure standing in front of him to take the coffee cup—and the less important NPC opposite, who just sketched those shadows with crayons of different colors, yet carefully traced you. Even though you didn't have those, Spamton forcibly added luxurious clothes and exquisite decorations to you. In his eyes, you deserved the best of everything.
And after finishing the last stroke, he excitedly raised the drawing paper to show you. Although his lines were a bit crooked and not very good, you immediately recognized it — this was what it looked like that day at the cyber barbecue restaurant—you still remember that day, after all, you remember everything your white Addison had suffered.
You took the painting, stroking the brushstrokes on it. Out of the corner of your eye, you saw Spamton sitting upright, nervously waiting for your comment, while you suddenly laughed: "Spamton is really amazing!" Although it might be his first time painting or something...... But this painting is very vivid, and I really like it! It must have been that day at the Cyber Barbecue Restaurant. You've worked hard all along. "As you spoke, you bent down slightly and rubbed Spamton's head. He squinted slightly and rubbed against your palm, snoring twice before answering your question.
“Y/N…… That's impressive too! That day was so brave, standing in front of me without hesitation! If only one day, I could become a Dark Citizen as brave as Y/N! He patted his chest and said enthusiastically.
You always feel a bit embarrassed and turn your face away, but the slightly reddened tips of your ears still reveal your emotions.
"Ahem...... Y-I know...... But feeling scared is normal, and you don't have to be that brave. I'll protect you. "You sat back down on the sofa, and Spamton leaned closer to your side, pressing close to yours. Hearing this, he shook his head sternly.
"You can't always protect me...... I'm the advertiser now! Don't worry, maybe I'm protecting you more often! "Spamton promised.
"Then we'll just wait and see. But in the best...... I still hope you don't get hurt. "As for you...... If you get hurt, it's fine; you don't really care much about these things.
"You can't get hurt either. If you are...... Then I—I'll help you get revenge! ”
"Alright, alright. But I've heard that if you're injured, just a breath and the pain will fly away...... Of course, that's probably just for kids." You shook your head helplessly, then nodded, casually changing the subject.
"So you're hurt." Spamton's voice suddenly tensed and turned serious.
You were stunned for a moment, then had to roll up your sleeve to reveal that long line of wounds. It looked scary, but in reality, it was just a little bleeding at the time.
"It's okay, this little wound is just a minor issue. It'll heal in a couple of days...... And it was also my own carelessness that cut the doorframe. ”
