But in the next second, Spamton cupped your arm and carefully blew on your wound, while his other hand behind his back quietly cast a healing spell. The wound healed quickly with his soft, warm breath, regrowing fair skin.
You widened your eyes in surprise, while Spamton just raised an eyebrow and looked at you proudly: "Look, just blow on it and the pain will fly away!" ”
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 23 (swapsptx you)
content:
Of course, you wouldn't believe such childish things. You believed that just blowing on the wound would heal it, but seeing Spamton's smug expression, you naturally noticed his hand behind his back—you guess, this must be some kind of spell from the Dark People or something. You didn't say a word to expose him, just pretended to be surprised and widened your eyes: "It's actually healed—Spamton, you're amazing!" How on earth did he do this? Can I learn it too? ”
Spamton just pretended to be mysterious and mysterious, shaking his finger and head: "No, this is my exclusive secret manual, it's a secret! However...... Only you know this little secret." As he spoke, he winked at you mysteriously.
He would never use this kind of spell on other Dark Folk or Lightfolk — but there was no need! Besides, Spamton wouldn't want to cast spells on others. Although this kind of spell was nothing to him, if other Dark Folk insisted on using it, he would definitely take a hefty profit.
You sighed. This time, you genuinely felt a bit regretful. Honestly, you inevitably had some bumps and scrapes. If only there were such spells, how great it would be—you could heal yourself with one click and no longer have to worry about getting hurt.
Spamton, however, seemed to see right through your thoughts and said seriously, "Don't think that having this kind of spell as a backup doesn't mean the extent of the injury doesn't matter...... This usually only works on surface injuries. So, you must be careful, absolutely careful. ”
You looked away a little guiltily, not daring to look at him, and Spamton just turned your head to look straight at him, his tone a bit fierce: "Did you hear that?" ”
"I heard you, I heard you—don't be so harsh with me." You puffed out your cheeks and pretended to be wronged, and Spamton's arrogance quickly softened. He let go, just scratched his head and coughed dryly twice.
"I...... I'm not really being harsh with you!" He emphasized, his voice a bit weak.
"I know. Don't worry......" You tugged at his face and couldn't help but laugh, and he followed behind you, laughing too.
It's a brief moment of affection at home, and after that, you'll still have to work at a gallery, and Spamton will be his big boss at the company. Honestly, he really wants to be with you forever, even if it's just a doll that can only stay in your pocket, or just a parrot that always flies around you—even if he's by your side and does many, many other things.
But he can't. He's the master of the advertising world, so of course he can't just leave this place behind. But if he had to choose between you and his career, his first reaction would be to want both, and if he could only pick one, he'd grit his teeth and pick yours.
…… After all, if you lose your career, you can just try hard later. But if he loses you, there's no way he'll find the exact same Lightfolk again, and there's no chance he'll ever meet you again.
So—for this goal, to stay with you all the time, he has to work hard! Spamton pulled himself together, held another meeting, then stood on the high platform and began to order: "Y/N's solo art exhibition is about to open in the gallery. All the People of Darkness, buy a ticket, and during this period, all advertisements will be replaced with something related to the Y/N exhibition. We want more People of Light to see and click on them, and sell more tickets." ”
The employees looked at each other. Recently, because Spamton has been showing off the paintings you made for her, they've become numb to hearing your name. Admittedly, your paintings are well-chosen in color and beautifully brushed, worth admiring, but no matter how stunning they are, seeing them every day can make them feel a bit bored and irritated.
Yellow twirled his ankle boredly and asked, "What is the theme of this Y/N art exhibition, and what kind of promotional images do we need to use for advertising?" ”
This question left Spamton a bit stunned, since he didn't know exactly what kind of painting would be best to display...... After all, you've already taken the paintings to the gallery for display, and there's nothing left at home.
But he still looked up proudly, and the staff all heard a boastful tone: "The theme of this exhibition is, of course—the most dazzling person in the advertising world, SPAMTON G. SPAMTON!" ”
Moreover...... This time, he ordered his staff to buy tickets and even advertised for you—things you didn't know about. If he asked you for a preview of the artwork, wouldn't that be exposing himself!
Finally, his eyes darted around as he recalled the sketch you had promised to give him and had been hanging it on the wall at home for him to admire. He clapped his hands, and a pop-up appeared showing the images he had taken from all angles of that sketch before.
"As for promotional footage, let's use this!" He sent out countless identical pop-up windows, afraid that the Dark People behind wouldn't notice, and even made several pop-ups bigger.
Orange hesitated and clicked the pop-up window: "...... But, boss, are you sure a sketch is enough? If I remember correctly, Y/N is holding an oil painting exhibition, right? ”
Thanks to Spamton, all Dark People employees know that sooner or later you'll hold an oil painting exhibition.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then reluctantly pointed to the oil painting behind him: "If that's not enough, let's use this one as promotional material too." ”
"So you never told Miss Y/N about advertising her art exhibition?" The other Dark People hesitated. Although the boss had become much easier lately, they still didn't dare say anything to their faces. If Spamton lost his temper in anger, the consequences would be extremely serious. Still, Blue quietly spoke up to reveal the truth.
…… If he didn't say anything soon, the pink next to him would explode! He definitely didn't want to see what was once a good event turn into a mess and a complete mess.
But now, Pink just stood there with his arms crossed, staring expressionlessly at Spamton.
Spamton coughed twice, probably because this time it wasn't advertising his own product, so Addison was a bit reluctant. Besides, there wasn't much commission for the ad page—he closed his eyes and said painfully, "Here's the deal: I'll give you 520 Dark Coins a day." ”
…… As for why it was 520, he was still too embarrassed to say it.
The chattering noise below had quieted down a lot, and the pippins were all satisfied.
Only Blue was still quietly staring at Spamton, along with his former colleagues.
Seeing this, Spamton was a bit embarrassed and angry, and as if she was losing her temper, she shouted back to them: "Alright—I admit, I advertised her without her knowing! Because I hope more people of light and darkness will come to support her! I didn't charge her advertising fees, so I rented these ads out of my own pocket. Alright! ”
Because his volume suddenly increased, the Dark People below were startled. Pippins and Zapper didn't dare speak and calmed down. Shadow guy originally couldn't speak...... But they didn't dare make a sound anymore, even holding up their saxophones and not daring to move.
"But would she be willing for you to do this?" Pink rolled his eyes, his tone a bit harsh. Logically, he shouldn't have contradicted Spamton's opinion, since whatever the advertiser says goes. But he just couldn't help but want to retort.
Spamton choked up. He wanted to say firmly not to make unnecessary comments and just follow what he said—but before he could speak, he remembered your earlier advice and told him to listen to the opinions of other Dark People.
So in the end, he took back that sentence and said somewhat gloomily, "...... I don't know. ”
He really doesn't know—but no matter how he guesses, it's obvious you definitely wouldn't want him to advertise. Convincing you to start an art exhibition was already quite a challenge.
But right after, he perked up a bit, his eyes beaming as he said, "But...... It's fine, after all, I voluntarily bought the ad for her! I paid for it voluntarily, so you can go ahead and do it! ”
The Dark People below didn't say anything more. With Spamton's wave of his hand, they announced the end of the meeting and had no choice but to leave the meeting room.
Spamton was the last to leave the meeting room. Before leaving, he turned to look at the oil painting hanging on the wall. The painting was simple, just a flower arrangement from the trash can. That flower was real, nurtured with your help. He brought it back to the office and carefully tried to care for it, but with the help of the plant lamp, it only looked wilted.
After your last reminder, Spamton focused on reducing the water content, which actually improved a lot—at least it wasn't as wilted, but it didn't grow too well.
…… He thought, maybe he's just like that flower. Without your love and help, he'll just grow crookedly. Even if he might survive in the end, he won't live a good life.
Spamton lowered his eyes, closed the conference room door, and walked straight to his office without looking back.
Of course, he didn't have much else to do. Back in his office, he just squatted down to observe the growth of those potted flowers. Hmm, it looked better than yesterday.
As for you...... You're running around the gallery to the point of exhaustion. Normally, there wasn't much to do, since during the previous artist's exhibition, you didn't have much work, but the boss insisted on printing your exhibition tickets and selling them early.
You thought there wouldn't be much sales, but who knows what happened? Those tickets were printed out and displayed at the entrance to be distributed, but they sold out not long after.
And now, many Dark People were lining up at the entrance, and the owner was urgently printing more tickets. Anyone who didn't know better would think there were many Dark People coming to visit this art exhibition.
And you can't help but feel a bit blacked. With so many tickets sold, just checking tickets for the exhibition will be a huge task!
But I'm not sure if it's just your imagination...... Most of the Dark People coming to buy tickets are pippins and zappers, plus Shadow Guy, who can't speak and only plays the saxophone to express his joy. You always feel these Dark People ...... A bit like Spamton's employees. After all, he admitted before that trash can flower arranging and art pieces was all his hired subordinates as paid posters. Maybe this time Spamton called them over too.
You start to get suspicious and plan to ask Spamton about it properly when you get home.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 24 (swapsptx you)
content:
But since the number of tickets increased, the boss urgently printed another batch of tickets—luckily, there was no event review or registration system in the Dark World, which meant that no matter how many Dark People showed up, even if it was packed, it would be normal.
You held your aching back, your face stiffening from selling that batch of newly printed tickets, even later than usual after work. You sighed, packed up your things and went home. Though it was a bit late...... It was still within normal hours. But you still felt a bit guilty, because you had just noticed several missed calls from Spamton—all of them called when you were so busy and dizzy, after you got home normally. Probably worried you wouldn't come home.
In short, you still walked to the door, panting, and then pushed open the door. What caught your eye was Spamton's anxious expression. He looked serious, looking like he was on the phone, seemingly about to give instructions. When he saw you, his expression relaxed, and he put down his phone. Instinctively, he spoke in a coquettish tone.
"You're back...... Why are you only just getting back! The food I made got cold! And I've called you so many times, and you never answered—" He grew more anxious, and you just interrupted him.
“…… Ah, there's no rush about this, right? It's fine if the food gets cold or hot. I didn't answer the call because I'm working overtime...... "You don't know what you're talking about, but you still answered his question. As you walked over, you stood on tiptoe and gently patted his head. He obediently lowered his head, so you don't have to stand on tiptoe anymore."
"As for why I'm only back now, it's because I'm working overtime. As for why I'm working overtime, it's because so many Dark People suddenly came to buy tickets. We've been working overtime to handle ticket sales all this time...... As for why there are so many Dark Citizens, I think those people are a lot like your employees. "You just mentioned this casually, not at all that serious.
But Spamton's face froze. He was relieved that since he was lowering his head now, you couldn't see his expression, and he was also a bit annoyed. Although he knew this was just another round of unreasonable troublemaking—those employees really didn't know their place, even though they were still lining up to buy tickets during their own off-work hours! Because of his Y/N coming home so late, he was worried to death!
However, he still muttered, "You can just dump your work on other Dark People. Why do you have to work overtime? You're a Light Citizen...... after all."
You flicked his head, and Spamton covered his forehead and took two steps back. He didn't weigh much, but I don't know why his eyes suddenly filled with tears, looking so pitiful and aggrieved.
"Even if I am a citizen of light, I can't use my status to oppress other people of darkness." You still leaned in, stood on tiptoe, and gently blew on his forehead. That warm, gentle, and moist breath brushed against Spamton's cheeks, making Spamton's face flush. He hurriedly covered his face, but spoke a little shyly.
“…… Well, Y/N did the right thing, so I want to learn from you too! "Spamton raised his voice as he spoke.
"Just keep being yourself, why are you copying me?" You chuckled, poked his forehead again, then picked up the food on the table that had already cooled down and headed to the kitchen.
"Alright, I'll heat up the food first."
"Me too, I'll do too." Spamton hurriedly picked up another plate and walked into the kitchen as well.
By the time you sit down at the table and start your formal dinner, it will be about ten minutes later.
You didn't press him further, since your words were already there. You know Spamton definitely understands, you've already guessed something, so—he'll definitely speak up later. You don't know why you're so sure, probably...... It's just out of trust and understanding of him.
Spamton's fork had been stirring in the bowl for ages, hesitating and a bit nervous, unsure whether he should speak up. He was a bit afraid to look you in the eye, and a bit too afraid to speak. Because he knew very well that you would never allow this—he was basically using his position for personal gain.
But in the end, he still took a deep breath, lifted his head, and looked into your eyes. He saw all the tolerance and care in your eyes—without any blame. For some reason, his heart suddenly felt lighter; he just felt he could speak more easily.
So Spamton admitted: "...... Alright, I admit I had my staff buy tickets. But, but I paid them advertising fees and commissions! I was just volunteering to advertise for you...... He met your gaze, his voice growing quieter and quieter.
You take a simple bite of pasta, watching him toss the noodles and ketchup in his bowl all over the place, and finally you can't help but chuckle: "So he volunteered to buy ads for me...... Actually, I don't need Spamton to do that. ”
Although in reality they still hire employees as paid posters, it's still a bit different.
Spamton nodded and shook his head again: "I know...... But I did it willingly. I think all the people of light and darkness should see your masterpiece!" He said this with his head held high, as if feeling very proud and honored because of you.
You feel a bit embarrassed by what he says, your cheeks flushing a little. You instinctively scratch your face: "Not that bad...... I'm not that impressive...... "You're still a bit lacking in confidence, or rather, this is your self-perception. Your self-recognition as your own works is pretty average."
Spamton, on the other hand, just shook his finger seriously: "No. Y/N's artwork is really great—actually, when I called in the meeting at the time, only 100 Dark People were called in, so only those 100 Dark People would go buy tickets. Are there still a lot of Dark People going to buy tickets today? ”
You paused, indeed...... About 200 tickets were sold out at once today. Although the advertising might have had a huge effect, and the dark people of the advertising world probably wouldn't buy it after seeing it, you still find it a bit ...... Unbelievable.
Or rather, you're feeling a bit carried away. You didn't expect your paintings to be so popular?
You cleared your throat and told yourself not to get complacent. Maybe there weren't that many Dark People attending the exhibition during those days, and maybe many of them bought tickets just for the sake of the advertisement. Maybe...... Maybe it's because the tickets themselves aren't expensive—just 50 Dark Coins.
“…… Hmm, about two hundred tickets were sold today. Maybe it's the effect of the advertising...... You nodded your chin, your voice still a bit hesitant.
"Of course, I gave them a commission of 520 Dark Coins per day! Their ads must be very thoughtful!" Spamton was very proud. He had taken a look at their ads on purpose; their ads really made people want to buy tickets, but Spamton was very satisfied.
520 Dark Coins......? You blinked, unsure if Spamton meant that, but judging by his expression now, he probably ...... It was probably just a casual remark. Just like the old line "I like you the most," it's just a habit, as if reminding yourself to feel this way.
So you just overlooked the price, but for some reason, at that moment, you felt a slight sense of disappointment, mostly a sense of disappointment.
"Hmm...... But I still hope that those who come to visit the exhibition genuinely want to appreciate the artworks. "You try hard to ignore that feeling, just forcing a smile at the corner of your mouth as you continue to say this.
Spamton could see your reluctance too. He frowned deeply: "Y/N...... What's wrong? Are you unhappy? How about I have them take down the ad......" His voice was a bit cautious, though of course, a bit reluctant. Spamton really wanted to promote you. He wished all the Dark and Light folk could see how beautiful your drawings were, and then proudly announce that he was your only Dark Citizen! And this was drawn by his Y/N, who is the best!
He just thought you were unhappy, and you really did feel a bit uncomfortable for reasons you didn't even understand. You didn't know why you were unhappy, but it definitely wasn't for that, so you just shook your head: "No need to take down the ads...... Actually, I'm actually very happy that so many people of darkness can come and recognize my paintings." "Even if you couldn't believe it at first.
"Ah...... Then I'll add a line in the ad! I'll also tell the other Dark People that if they don't want to go, they don't need to go...... Spamton fiddled with his fingers, still a bit uneasy. He could feel that your mood was still not very pleasant, even though he didn't know why.
"Mm, that's good enough." You finally breathed a sigh of relief and nodded.
Spamton puffed out his cheeks slightly, a bit displeased, but the next day he urgently called a meeting, calling over all the employees who had been reluctant and had met for the past week and solemnly announced, "Ahem, if you really don't want to attend the exhibition, give me the tickets right now. I'll compensate you separately based on the ticket price." ”
The employees looked at each other, unsure what trick the boss was up to—maybe he had reclaimed the tickets and sold them at a high price. But in the end, more than half of the employees gradually stepped forward and exchanged their tickets for genuine Dark Coins.
Who cares? If the boss wants to be a scalper, go ahead. They can't control it! Pippins happily ran off with the dark coin in hand, then set up a new betting game. Zapper jumped a few times in place, hesitated for a moment, but still had some tickets left unsold. Shadow Guy was the same.
However, after painfully exchanging a large number of tickets with dark coins, Spamton just carefully put away the tickets with excerpts from your paintings and exhibition titles. Although collecting these things is useless—but... he just wants to collect everything related to you, collect all traces of you.
Time passed quickly, and the day of the exhibition was almost here. Because you were the artist, you didn't stand at the entrance to check tickets. You just sat there, nervously tugging at the hem of your clothes, waiting for the visitors to come in. If they had any questions, you would introduce the corresponding paintings.
Do you remember...... A few nights ago, Spamton even swore he'd come every day! So you're also waiting for Spamton's arrival. It's understandable that you're a bit nervous, after all...... Spamton probably just thinks you've only drawn a few of his designs.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 25 (swapsptx you)
content:
You sit in your chair, watching the person who enters from the door as if you're not careful. You want to see the familiar Addison, but unfortunately...... You wait for ages, and with every minute, the anticipation grows. You wait anxiously, every second feels like a year, but all you walk in are a few pippins smiling broadly, a zapper bouncing around, and a shadow guy who only plays the saxophone quietly because the gallery forbids loud noise. Besides that, there are some Dark People you don't know—Spamton's ads really do work, and after those Dark People walk in, they silently admire your artwork. You can see their expressions shift from indifference and indifference to slight shock and admiration—which makes you feel a bit elated and in a much better mood.
You think, yes, that's right, just like Spamton said...... You really are amazing, because the other Darkfolk also greatly appreciate your artwork.
But what about him? You nervously stared at the front door, waiting for that white Addison, waiting for Spamton, but all you saw was Blue walk in.
…… Even when the last Dark Folk walked into the gallery and ticket checks stopped at the entrance, you still hadn't seen that Dark Folk pounding their chests and vowing that they would come to your art exhibition every day.
You suppress your inner disappointment and regret, trying to keep the corners of your mouth upward and avoid showing excessive sadness, but your eyebrows still droop. Anyone can see you're in a bad mood—it's all just forced smiles.
You lowered your head, feeling gloomy. Actually...... It didn't matter to other Dark Civilians watching you; you only confirmed one thing. You really seem impressive and will earn the admiration of many. But all this silent effort was never seen by the Dark Civilians you most wanted to see...... You were a bit distracted, but at that moment you heard a somewhat familiar voice calling your name.
You look up and see Blue standing in front of you with a smile: "Could you tell me the background of these paintings? Under what circumstances did you create them?" He asked.
But he just saw you were in a bad mood and wanted to pick a random topic to cheer you up. He thought, after all, mentioning Spamton should lift your spirits...... There weren't many Dark People here today, since many employees had exchanged tickets with Spamton for money, and Spamton...... To be honest, he was probably caught up in some matters related to you, which is why he didn't have time to rush over.
But Blue still obediently bought the ticket. First, he was genuinely curious about what your exhibition would look like, and second...
… He also wants to know how your relationship with Spamton is. He's just gossiping—after all, Spamton's attitude is already obvious. He wants everyone to know how amazing you are, how good you are to him, how much he likes you, how much he loves you...... Love you.
So Blue was a bit curious: what exactly do you think about Spamton?
You paused for a moment, but still put away your expression and put on the smile you usually use for business. You stood up and looked at the recent painting—Spamton was carefully tending to a plant.
So you couldn't help but smile: "Ah, this is the first painting I made for Spamton...... At the time, he was tending to the plants as I said, a bit flustered. I thought this one was cute, so I painted it." As you spoke, your eyes went blank for a moment. You remembered what happened back then, so you didn't pay much attention to the guests nearby. When you came to your senses, you looked at Blue with a brick and bowed flusteredly: "Ah, sorry...... I forgot, I should have introduced you. ”
Blue just shook his head: "It's fine, that's it. I really like hearing it." "At least by looking at your expression, seeing the smile you make when you mention Spamton...... He knows you must love Spamton, otherwise why would you instinctively smile when you mention him? At least thinking of him makes you happy.
You walk up to the second painting. You look up at it—it's Spamton carrying dishes to the dining table. Seeing you drawing, you instinctively smile. You clear your throat: "This ...... It was the day I decided to start painting Spamton, the day I decided to make him the theme of this exhibition. Because he was smiling at me, I recorded that rare smile as well. ”
Because most of the paintings you paint behind his back, he usually doesn't have much of a smile on his face.
The third painting shows Spamton operating a hand-cranked coffee machine, focused on grinding coffee beans, wearing an apron. Your voice stammered for a moment: "This is me...... I secretly drew it for him. I thought this scene was especially warm and beautiful, so I couldn't help but draw it. Because our family has a habit of drinking coffee, he gets up in the morning to grind coffee beans. He doesn't know that I am already awake by this time and is secretly watching him. You couldn't help but laugh as you spoke.
Blue looked at your expression, silent as well. From your tone and your expression, everything revealed joy, as if the gloom that had just wrapped around you had already lifted.
You feel nothing, just keep walking forward. Looking up, you see a fourth painting—a profile of Spamton on the phone. He is talking to someone or something, and you can't even remember what you were feeling at the time: "This painting...... I probably wanted to capture some of his usual work scenes, so I painted this picture of him on the phone. But since he usually doesn't work at home, I only kept this painting. ”
“…… He usually doesn't make phone calls outside of work hours. The only time he did was to talk to us about your situation and to pay more attention to the preferences of the People of Light. "Blue suddenly interrupted.
You paused for a moment, instinctively glancing at the blue Addison beside you, but he only added with a calm expression, "Because recently he heard that other Lightfolk have descended into other dark worlds. Let's keep an eye on them." ”
In fact, he didn't understand that Spamton already had the ability to check the preferences of the Light Tribe...... Or was it that he couldn't check your computer or shopping history at all, or did he simply not want to look?
You pursed your lips and turned your head in a bit of panic. For some reason, you just felt your ears turn red, and you just muttered softly, with a hint of complaint: "...... He just needs to ask me...... "You'll definitely tell him everything."
But does this also prove that he actually likes you very much? You pause for a moment, then suddenly realize: why do you care whether he really likes you, and whether what he says is true?
You haven't thought much about it yet, but you only hear Blue add: "Because he cares about you a lot." He was also smiling the whole time on the phone. ”
You look at that painting...... Indeed, upon closer inspection, you realize the corners of his mouth are indeed upturned, and you unconsciously record it.
Because Spamton cares deeply about all of Y/N's feelings, and cares deeply about whether you are truly happy, he secretly prepares a gift for you. That is probably...... It's not just a thank-you gift, but also his long-standing gratitude, and also his love. He wants to wait until that sea of flowers is truly planted, with flowers blooming, wanting to hold the gift and solemnly tell you about his long-standing feelings, telling you that he really likes you and ...... loves you.
In front of you, even though he is now the master of the dark world, whatever he does, he is still as cautious and sincere as the pure white Addison once was.
You paused, wiping away the tears that suddenly welled up in your eyes: "Alright, I'll continue introducing you to the next painting." ”
The next painting...... It shows him in the kitchen, preparing dinner. He didn't notice you, and you only drew his profile. You looked at the painting and softly said, "This painting...... It was because I wanted to record my daily life, so I went home a bit earlier that day and painted it while he was making dinner. That day, I went home early, and he was very happy, and so was I. ”
Because even you can see that he still has a smile on his face.
And so, unconsciously, you reached the end of the introduction. Standing in front of the last painting, you belatedly felt parched, but you looked up at the painting and shyly cleared your throat, because the painting showed you and him smiling: "This painting...... It's basically our family portrait. Yes, our whole family consists only of him and me—one citizen of light and one of the people of darkness. This is a photo left to commemorate him for raising the first pot of flowers, and I redrew a picture based on that photo. ”
Think about it, you really don't care so much about your parents tearing up your painting anymore. When you finish the final stroke on this painting, that heavy past just disappears.
But there are still more, more pasts you still don't want to recall.
"Mm, thank you for the introduction." Blue smiled slightly at you and nodded.
He already knows very well, maybe you haven't fully realized it yet, but no matter what...... You also care about him deeply, or rather, love him.
So, Blue thought, he didn't need to say anything more; the rest was up to you guys!
But before turning to leave, he smiled and added, "Then I wish you two a happy family forever, to stay together for a long time." ”
You reply without hesitation, "Of course." ”
Then you paused, not even understanding why you said that, but Blue had already walked far, so you had no choice but to return to your previous chair and sit down, resting your chin on your hand and staring blankly at the door. You know the ticket inspection period is over, but what if? What if...... He will show up at the main gate later, then watch the blocked entrant entering the passage, looking pitifully. Then you will definitely quietly let him in.
But you waited, waited, until most of the Dark People had already left the gallery, until the other colleagues looked at you worriedly and left, the gallery was about to close, and the boss was urging you to go home, but you still didn't see him show up at the door.
You left gloomily, closed the gallery door, and walked out, while you kept looking around. You thought, what if, maybe he was just late? Wouldn't you be sad seeing the gallery closed?
But even when you returned home, you still didn't see him. Carefully opening the door, all you saw was darkness.
…… He wasn't home.
For some reason, your heart sank.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 26 (swapsptx you)
content:
You stood at the doorway, looking at the pitch-black interior. Unconsciously, the sensor lights in the corridor had gone out. After waiting a few more minutes, your hand trembled slightly as you took out your phone. The screen became the only source of light in the darkness.
For some reason, you have a bad feeling about this—and this feeling peaks when you see Spamton's empty message page. Normally, he'll message you and complain a lot, but today there's nothing.
Nothing at all.
You tentatively dial a number, but the missed ringtone and the beeping echo echoing in the stairwell...... Then comes the "number you dialed is temporarily unanswered."
You put down your phone, thinking, maybe it was just delayed for a moment?
But five minutes, ten minutes, half an hour passed, and you were still the only one standing at the door. You called again, but no one answered, and the message sent half an hour ago was still unread.
Taking a deep breath, you closed the door, then turned around and left resolutely.
No matter where he suddenly goes, you have to find him and make sure he comes home with you. You still have so many things left undone...... There are still promises you once made that haven't been fulfilled, and so many things you want to say......
And no matter who it was, everyone needed to go home.
You arrive at the gallery door again, thinking maybe he just finished work in a hurry and wants to hurry to the exhibition to surprise you. But the gallery is empty, very quiet and quiet. You simply leave in silence.
You arrive at the shopping street, thinking that maybe the big boss occasionally feels like reliving the old job—though most of the shops on the shopping street have already closed, and it's about time to close down. But those few Addisons are still standing there, probably maintaining their old habits.
You walk over, and Yellow greets you first, forcing a smile: "Hello. Do you know where Spamton is now?" ”
Yellow was stunned for a moment, because he actually didn't know where Spamton had gone. All day today, he felt the boss was acting all secretive, but he still gave you his answer: "I'm not sure, but you can go ask Pink at the company. Spamton invited us to a meeting this morning." ”
And he was only responsible for the shopping street side...... He didn't know how things were going elsewhere.
"A meeting?" "Another ...... Did something happen?" You kept feeling that Spamton's absence from home might be related to this, so you couldn't help but press further, your face showing nervousness and anxiety, and your body instinctively leaning forward.
Yellow couldn't help but lean back, his tone a bit awkward: "I'm not sure either, but today two people of Light and one of Darkness did come by...... They stayed on the shopping street for a while before leaving. ”
As for what happened back then, he doesn't need to repeat it to you.
You nodded, anxiously twisted your ankle, and rubbed it on the ground: "Alright, I understand." ”
Then you hurried toward Spamton, the advertising company. You know, as long as you keep going like this, you'll always find more clues, piece together the truth, and find his final whereabouts.
Even though you're deeply nervous and worried, your brows furrowed, and you haven't even noticed the small stone under your feet, you almost stepped on it and tripped.
You stumble a bit, but don't care about that. Looking at the company so close, you can't help but run. You suddenly realize that if Spamton were by your side right now, he'd definitely grab you, carefully check if you're hurt, and then ramble on for a long time—but you don't have time to think further.
You just grabbed Pink's arm as he was about to leave. Pink looked at you in confusion, panting: "What's wrong? Why aren't you home with Spamton? What are you doing here?" He couldn't help but retort with a hint of sarcasm.
You took a few breaths before you finally felt a bit better, closed your eyes for a moment, then opened them again: "Spamton...... Not at home. You...... You really don't know...... Where is he now? ”
Pink's mouth twitched. He wanted to say, if Spamton hadn't gone to find you, then where else could he be? But then he remembered those three guys who appeared in the advertising world today, and finally withdrew his words, stammering, "...... I don't know! He disappeared after giving us the order this morning! ”
Then he shook off your arm and hurried off, somehow feeling like he was fleeing in panic.
The trail seemed to end here, and you stood there dazed for a moment, blinking lightly. In the end, without holding much hope, you decided to go back to the other end of the garbage heap where you initially found spamton to look again.
Sure enough...... There were no Dark People on this side, and the garbage heap was just a garbage heap. You crouched down, letting the frustration, distress, and anxiety sweep over you. You took out your phone to check—the message was still unread.
Spamton…… Where exactly is he? Is he hoping he can suddenly appear before him right now? Is he feeling helpless? Does he also want to go home? You take a deep breath, and this belief supports your body again. You stand up, rub your eyes, which are dark and blurred from the sudden up, and then you notice that behind the pile of garbage, there is actually a crooked little path...... Usually, when you take a shortcut this way, you never notice this path; maybe this path only appeared later.
After all, it's a rare ...... You see a slightly wilted lavender growing crookedly beside the path. You don't know how this path came to be, but you still walk up with a bit of curiosity.
Then, the flowers lining the road gradually disappeared, replaced by ...... A thin layer of snow. The further you went, the thicker the snow accumulated, the road became cold, and when the wind blew by, there was a bone-chilling cold.
You grit your teeth and walk forward. Think about it, what if...... After all, this is a place you've never been before. What if, what if, what if you can see Spamton? What if it's just a heavy snowstorm and poor signal?
Until you reach the end of the road, squinting to block a howling cold wind, you open your eyes again and see ...... Spamton, lying there, head and body apart, with his back to you—somehow, like the opening of an email, his upper body was severed.
You widened your eyes and instinctively took a step forward, about to run toward him, but his next words froze your steps in place.
He was crying—you couldn't see his expression, but through his sobbing voice, through his tearful words, you could still feel it.
"No—don't leave me alone—" he shouted loudly in the blank void, the snow-covered clearing, perhaps even knowing that no one could hear him.
You see, the phone screen was lit up and landed not far away, and he struggled to move a small part of his body, which had no limbs, only a swirling viscous liquid flowing from the cut, probably trying to touch the phone.
"I can ...... I can reveal all my business secrets...... Don't just leave me here...... Please...... "Ugh......" Then came another round of sobbing.
You were silent for a moment, wanting to lift your foot and walk toward him again, but then you heard his next words: "I want to ...... I want to call Y/N...... Yes, she definitely won't just ignore me......
He was trying hard to move toward the phone, but after struggling for a long time, he only managed to move a short distance. The slug that dripped down gathered in the snow and disappeared without a trace.
You silently lowered your footsteps, but fortunately, your footsteps were light and light. He couldn't hear your footsteps, probably because he was muttering to himself.
"But...... But Y/N will definitely dislike me when she sees me like this...... I'm useless, I don't look good anymore...... Maybe she'll soon abandon me and find another addison...... "No, no, no, no......" he nervously repeated.
You open your mouth, you want to say you'll never despise him, you'll never leave him, you'll only feel heartache for it—but you know he definitely wouldn't want you to see you like this, and you know he definitely wouldn't want you to hear those words. So you just stand there, saying nothing.
Only then do you suddenly realize that all along...... That's what he was thinking. Maybe he acted too relaxed on the surface, so you overlooked all this.
Your heart tightens, and you regret it. If only you'd found out sooner...... You'll tell him that no matter what, it doesn't matter, as long as he's still him.
Then you hear him mutter to himself, whispering softly, "No...... If it were Y/N, he would definitely be heartbroken...... She ...... She wouldn't despise my ...... She probably just thinks those Lightfolk are bad, and the Howling Knight is bad, that's why I ended up like this. Sorry...... Me...... I'll tell you all the business secrets, okay...... Let me go home...... Go home...... By the end, his voice was just intermittent sobbing, and he stopped trying to touch the phone that had fallen to the ground.
"Y/N must be very worried...... Let me ...... Go home...... he said softly, intermittently.
You lowered your brows and eyes, silently wiped away the tears that had fallen from your eyes, gave him one last deep look, and then turned to walk back the way you came.
You vaguely remember that the People of Darkness are all made up of objects from the Light World...... So, there is definitely a way to save Spamton in the Light World, and a way to bring him home safely. You plan to return to the Light World, to that home you haven't visited in a long time, and when you think back, it only feels darker than the Dark World.
You quickly left the trail, then quickened your pace, gradually started running, faster and faster. You knew that if you just went faster, faster, Spamton could get home sooner.
Near the entrance to the world of light, there was also a pile of garbage, and your steps gradually slowed because you saw Addison standing on one side of the road, with his back to you.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 27 (swapsptx you)
content:
You were silent for a moment, not knowing what to say—they probably had a reason to stand here. But you just slowly stepped forward and asked, "...... What are you doing here? ”
None of the Addisons answered your question; you just saw Pink, standing at the very front and closest to you, glance at you lightly before speaking.
"I still remember that Spamton guy, he's really annoying...... Ah, although I admit I did deliberately bully him before, it was because he couldn't sell a single thing, which was a huge embarrassment for Addison—the café incident did happen before, but the time you came with him, he made me act, so that's why he threw the coffee cup at you. "Although there was still a hint of anger in his words, Pink was already very calm, almost maintaining a cold attitude as he said this. Even though he had his back to you, you could still feel the gritted teeth on his face.
And you just nod gently at his back: "Mm. I know...... I get it, it's probably just a performance. But he really went through those things, so I really feel heartache too. ”
You know very well what is true and what is false.
Pink was momentarily stunned, but then added, "And back when we were on the shopping street before—he also forced me to act, making me steal his flowers to show off, so you could play the hero and save the damsel." As he spoke, he snorted coldly again.
You recall how he might act arrogantly outside, and that his arrogance was actually just to cover up some vulnerabilities inside...... You couldn't help but smile.
Whether it's pretending or real, you're willing to accept that he may be hypocritical or weak, not that strong, nor that formidable.
So you just nodded again: "Mm." I know, it's okay. ”
You walked a few steps past Pink's shadow, and at the same time, Orange, standing a bit ahead, shrugged and spoke, his tone a bit careless: "That Spamton guy does a lot of things behind your back just to please you. He's cooking really well now, right? ”
You paused: "Indeed." ”
Back when he was still that little poor Addison, although he could cook, it was very simple. He didn't know when he started...... His cooking skills suddenly improved.
Orange snorted coldly: "That guy, because he's the big boss of the company, relying on no one daring to say no, he tried out in the company's kitchen. He blew up four or five kitchens and always came out looking disheveled." ”
You want ...... You remember the look on his guilty face after blowing up the kitchen, and you also imagine his ecstatic look after he might succeed. You recall a few times when he would nervously and guiltily serve you food, twisting his fingers and saying this was his new creation, asking you to try it. And every time, after trying a few bites, you would give him a thumbs-up and say Spamton was amazing. Whenever that happened, he would put on a genuine smile. So you let out a gentle laugh.
"Is that so...... I thought he could do it after just one try. "Trying so clumsily several times actually makes him stubborn and endearing.
You walk forward, and Orange's moan makes you stop again: "It's not that he's not smart, right?" He really knows how to catch the preferences of the Lightfolk's preferences for advertising, and can come up with all sorts of ways to make them watch ads—when he came up with some brilliant slogans for your exhibition, he also came up with some brilliant slogans. However, Spamton forced us to buy all the fake flowers and exhibition tickets related to you, and only this time did the exhibition refund us. ”
You lowered your eyes, recalling Spamton's reluctant expression after telling him that he wanted to refund the ticket money for someone who didn't want to attend the exhibition. He was throwing a little tantrum with you again.
You think, whether clumsy or clever, whether forced...... or gentle, it's all a reflection of a side of his personality. You don't care about these things, you know them...... Of course, you're willing to accept the truth.
So you just nod and shake your head: "I know, but it's okay...... No matter what, Spamton is the best in my heart. ”
You murmured, not knowing why you said that.
And you just keep walking forward, Orange, with his back to you, stops talking, while Yellow, standing not far ahead, speaks.
"Because the Dark People can hardly grow real flowers, Spamton would prepare fake flowers for you, right? That guy secretly planted flowers in the office before, and even planted several pots—but every one he planted died, and in the end, I secretly took the pot and threw it away." He complained, though it wasn't entirely a complaint.
Your smile stiffened for a moment—you didn't know, you only knew that the pot of lavender he planted at home almost died, and in the end, you quietly helped out a little, so the pot didn't die.
Suddenly, you recall that pure white Addison from back then...... Without your help, I might have just been obscure, withering in the darkness, like a flower left uncared for.
And you only murmured softly, "I don't even know...... He had tried so many times in secret. "If only I'd told you earlier, you definitely would have helped him...... But maybe that would break the special nature of surprises.
Yellow whistled, "Of course you don't know, that Spamton kid never intended to tell you." Speaking of which, he's been preparing a surprise again lately, but—" Just before he could say it, he hurriedly stopped the car again. What was supposed to be a surprise was spamton repeatedly reminding them not to say it, so Yellow thought, better give Spamton some face and stop talking.
"Surprise...... "I'll look forward to it." You instinctively want to ask, but you also know you need to keep the mystery of the surprise.
You know, whatever the surprise is, you'll love it, because it's prepared by Spamton. Whatever it is, whatever it looks like, or whether good or bad, you'll love it.
So, whether good or bad, success or failure, you care about Spamton, because you're willing to give it complete favoritism.
Thinking of this, you notice the sound of your chest thumping becoming even more intense. Puzzled, you clutch your chest, feeling your heart beating and wondering, could it be that I'm sick, which is why my heart is beating so fast?
You just press your chest and keep moving forward; the last Addison is blue.
He also turned his back to you, but spoke as if telling a story: "That day, I gave Spamton my leave request without much hope. I thought he wouldn't approve it, because he often says there's nothing to take leave for the Dark People—he never gets sick, he's in great health, and nothing else matters." ”
But at the end of that day, Spamton silently returned the leave request to me, which was stamped for the first time and passed it through...... Later, Spamton gradually changed. He was no longer as ruthless or unscrupulous, demanding that all his employees obey him without question. He began to listen to their opinions, even though his lips were always downward, I think...... He probably wanted to get closer to you. ”
You think about it too, you think...... Maybe Spamton just wants to be fair to you at first glance. No, that's definitely what he thinks, so he awkwardly went awkward.
And you just choked up once, then softly replied with a soft "Mm."
"Lately, that guy has been showing off your paintings to us, intentionally or not. He hangs them on the meeting room wall and also on his own office wall. Before we report to him, we always have to hear his praise a few times before he gets back to the current topic."
You imagine him swaggering and laugh again, your resolve growing even stronger. You want him to go home, you want him to bounce around again, you want to hear his sticky voices...... Even if it means returning to the home you once ran away from, returning to that noisy, restless world that constantly makes you feel restless.
Whether it's his childish past, or now he's a bit mature but still very childish, you still want to see him again, to keep witnessing and accompany him through the journey of change and growth. You want to see him, whether he changes or not, he's doing well. After all, that's your family's Addison.
"Yeah, I get it...... He's really adorable. "You sighed softly and kept walking forward.
Then you hear Blue's voice: "Hurry up and go...... I still remember your family photo. I still remember, when I threw him into the trash heap, I turned to look at him, and he was silently hugging his knees and crying. And in that family photo, he was laughing carefree...... I hope Spamton can do the same in the future, so go find him. Go get his smile back. ”
When he smiles carefreely, he is secretly watching you; Spamton's heart and eyes seem to be filled with you.
You silently wiped away the tears at the corner of your eyes, hurriedly responded with a "Mm," then stepped into the light. After a wave of dizziness, you uncomfortably covered your ears, blocking out the noisy crowd.
You step out and see people waiting at the bus stop. The noisy sounds mixed with occasional curses surround you, but you frown, avoid the crowd, step onto the pedestrian bridge, and squeeze into the subway station...... The ticking of machines and the dense footsteps of the crowd hit your eardrums, and you hurriedly check your phone and enter the station, standing at the edge, waiting for the subway to arrive.
Accompanied by the sound of the subway passing through the tunnel and the announcement of announcements, countless people get off the train, and you squeeze onto the train with the crowd. Although no one is making a loud noise on the subway, the constant announcement of arrival still makes you instinctively want to cover your ears, just to clearly hear your next destination, yet you still do nothing.
Gradually, your restless heart quiets a little with the noise of the city. You recall the fragments you heard from those Addisons, and you begin to piece together Spamton's image outside, so you can't help but laugh softly.
You think, maybe all of this no longer seems so scary. You've grown up. You can protect Spamton, and protect your former self. You're no longer just crying helplessly under the strange gazes of others in a noisy marketplace, nor will you be forcefully dragged away only to be scolded sternly and scolded.
You look up, your expression clear, and as the announcement of the subway arrives at the station, you follow the crowd, walking off the subway with head held high.
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 28 (swapsptx you)
content:
Following the surging crowd, you sighed and walked out of the subway station with your head held high. Looking at the familiar yet strange street scene, passersby were still chattering about something, the street vendors still stood out, but you just lowered your head, your trembling hands opening your phone. Looking at the wallpaper still showing a photo of Spamton and you, both beaming with smiles, you couldn't help but take a deep breath, strengthen your resolve, and move forward.
Walking through the crowd, your pace quickens and faster. Just a little faster, a little faster, you don't want him to be left alone for too long, and ...... What if you drag on for too long and he can no longer get help?
You fumble for your keys in your pocket and suddenly start running down the street. Some people look at you in surprise, and you hear neighbors gossiping, saying you must be some kind of young lady, so unmannered, and don't even know to stop and apologize to them.
Indeed, you only had time to quickly say sorry and then dash forward. You only had time to glance around quickly to make sure you hadn't gone the wrong way. Until you, panting and holding your knees, stood at the doorstep—no, that was already your old home. You were panting heavily at the door of your old home, your hand trembling as you reached out, and after several times, you inserted the key into the keyhole, then gently twisted it, and the door creaked open.
First and foremost was the sound of the coffee machine spinning at high speed, along with the constant spinning of the soy milk machine beside it. The noisy noise made you frown deeply, and then you opened the door and walked in.
Your parents were sitting at the table enjoying dinner, then faced your mother at the door and saw you, who was the first to confront you: "You still know to come back? After graduating from college, you ran off without a word, didn't reply to messages or answer your calls. I told you long ago that after graduation, you could just get married right away. Mom has watched over several promising local youths for you, but you didn't say a word. Now look, those promising youths each have their own families. What will Mom do now—"
You frown, a wave of irritation rising in your heart. You look at the vase on the counter at the door, wanting to suddenly throw it at your mother's head. But your good sense of morality still lets you hold back—you tell yourself you don't need to say a word, just endure, just endure and get through it.
And you clench your fists, just walking toward your own room.
My mother suddenly raised her voice: "What's your attitude toward your mom? You just say hello when you get home and don't call her?" So rude—"
Her father quickly spoke up: "Good girl, didn't we agree? After you graduate from college, you can stay at home. You can continue with your hobbies and interests. Our family can afford to support you, but you really should consider other ......."
"And even if you get married, after a long day of work, you can still draw your lousy drawings, do whatever you want. Why don't you even listen to your parents—" your mother grumbled, then followed behind and said another sentence.
You shook your head, a bit annoyed, but didn't plan to talk back. It was never agreed; they just insisted you should go home after graduation, since your major wasn't suitable for working outside anyway.
They never negotiated; they just used the pretense of negotiability to push you to offer an offer you couldn't refuse.
In the end, you just put your hand on the doorknob and replied calmly, "Mm." Of course, it was just a perfunctory response. Then you hurriedly opened your own door, entered, and locked it, blocking out their cursing outside the door.
Soon after, you hear your parents arguing again, but that doesn't matter anymore. You just hurriedly walk over and turn on your computer, feeling a rare sense of comfort and relaxation in the quiet of the room.
While waiting for the computer to turn on, you might daydream, thinking that marrying those promising young men your mother mentioned is definitely not a good choice. They always hope you achieve greater things, yet still blame you for making small mistakes in daily life. Once, you only felt wronged about this, but later, you listened coldly, skillfully closing the door to briefly block out the noise — until you reached the dark world that the noise finally faded.
Think about it, if you really want to get married, your partner might be spamton—wait, why do you think that?
You clutch your chest in confusion, feeling your heart racing up, and you can't care about anything else, because the computer has just turned on.
You skillfully connect to the internet, then open your email, dig through the trash bin, dig through the spam folder, and choose to restore each folder one by one.
Think about it, these emails were probably sent to you by Spamton—after all, the subject lines of these emails all say [Limited Time Offer] [50% OFF].
And some more...... If you accidentally click in, you'll see emails about [valued at only $4.99] and [Bodybuilding Physique], and some are [Only 250 Dark Coins] [Limited-time special offer].
You, unusually patient, calmly clicked through emails one by one, checked them, and then restored them. Fortunately, they weren't deleted forever.
Some emails were about promoting coffee, some were about fake potted flowers, and others were all kinds of imitation paintings—without exception, these emails were spam and ignored.
You restored each of these emails one by one, then breathed a sigh of relief, rekindling hope in your heart—you hoped that when you returned, you could see Spamton still alive and well, standing there perfectly fine. If ...... If the Dark People lost their carrier and could no longer survive, then you hoped you could provide them with a small carrier. You hoped that these restored, deleted, and broken spam emails could be pieced together into a complete Spamton.
And just as you recover all your emails and are about to shut down your computer and return to the Dark World, you hear a "ding" sound from your computer, indicating that a new email has arrived.
Check your inbox. Time...... It's just now, and the subject of this email is: Hello, do you need a [100% success rate] [Confession card]?
Your hand trembled as you swallowed twice—you knew this email was sent to you by Spamton, probably because your computer was turned on, so you received it. Your heart was beating faster and faster. Did you have some kind of cure-all-in-the-middle illness? Anyway, the mouse moved, and I still clicked on the email.
[Hello, may I ask if you need a [100% success rate] and a [confession card]?
Dear Ms. Y/N, we sincerely thank you for choosing to order the [spam] service.
We are now promoting our store with a 100% positive review rate, a limited-time special confession card!
The content is: [I love you], this love is [known by everyone].
I dedicate all my loyalty and passion to the respected and dear Miss Y/N.
I hope to spend this life and grow old together with you.
This [Confession Card] is currently priced at only 520 Dark Coins! ]
You swallowed hard, staring blankly at the email. Clutching your chest, you felt the pounding of your heart. Suddenly, you understood—
You murmured, "Ah, so ...... I'm not sick at all. ”
You just love him, and it seems you love him very much. You don't really know what love is...... But you think that perhaps this is how it should feel.
You wiped away the tears streaming down your eyes, looked at the letter carefully once again, then smiled slightly and silently answered in your heart, "Yes, I love you too."
Then you shut down your computer, reopened the door, and walked out.
You ignore your parents' angry voices, ignore those voices that seem to be for your own good but actually control and oppress you, ignore the noise in the room, and ignore the noise of the crowd. At this moment, all you can hear is the sound of your heart beating in your chest. All you can think of is that letter, Spamton's smiling face, that he might be carefully but smiling as he prepares this card, his excited expression when the flowers bloom and his joy as he can't help but hug you, his nervous, anticipatory look as he carefully serves you freshly made desserts, his eyes shining as he rubs against your palm, and the occasional time when you come home late, He hugged you tightly, as if afraid of something. Thinking of you sleeping half-awake in the middle of the night with a fever, seeing Spamton sleeping on your bedside, and how he had gone several kilometers away to queue for two hours just to bring you a snack because of a single sentence......
With these memories, you step off the subway, walk against the crowd, ignore their discussions, and return to the boundary between light and darkness, then, following the blinding white light and a wave of dizziness, you return to the dark world.
The roadside addison disappeared, and you hurried back to the place where the garbage pile was, only to find that the road to the icy cliff, filled with withered lavender and heavy snow, had also vanished.
You return home with a nervous yet slightly excited mood. It's already late, and you open the door. It's the bright lights, and Spamton, sitting at the dining table, bored, waiting for you, boredly writing your name on paper.
When he saw you return, his eyes suddenly lit up. He ran over and hugged you, and you instinctively opened your arms to catch him.
Spamton's fluffy head rubbed against your neck, as if complaining and acting spoiled, "Why did you just get back...... I almost thought you wouldn't come back. That scared me, I called you but didn't answer...... And didn't reply to your messages. Hmm, I replied to your texts, you can take a look! ”
As he spoke, he lifted his head as if trying to take credit, his eyes sparkling as he looked at you. Whether it was his imagination or not, he seemed a bit shorter, but he was about the same as during his earlier Addison days.
You take out your phone and see that he really did send you a message, basically saying he's sorry he was busy and didn't reply. Now he's home, but he hasn't seen you and asks where you've been.
You rubbed his head and softened your voice: "Mm, I'm back...... As for where you asked where I went, I can answer now—I went to the world of light. ”
Spamton's body stiffened, and he stammered, "You...... What are you doing in the Light World? ”
TBC.

title: Shi Xing 29 (swapsptx you)
content:
You lowered your gaze and didn't answer his question, instead of asking, "During the time you didn't reply to my messages...... What were you doing? ”
Spamton was a bit flustered. He clasped his hands behind his back and lowered his head, not daring to look at you. He knew very well that he was lying.
"Nothing...... It's just that a few people of light visited the advertising world, and I'll handle them. "Of course, it's not entirely a lie.
You were silent for a while, just lightly and lightly. Spamton couldn't hear the emotion in your words; he only knew you said one sentence: "Is that so?" ”
…… Well, for some reason, he was a bit afraid you'd get angry, he ...... Still afraid you'd abandon him because of those lies? Spamton was a bit stunned, then remembered you had promised him you would never truly reject him, so he finally lifted his head, puffing out his cheeks, a bit aggrieved and angry.
“…… It was indeed to deal with those Lightborn, but later they wanted to seal the dark fountain that made up this dark world, so I stopped them...... The Howling Knight doesn't keep his word! I clearly held off those Lightborne for quite a while! But in the end, he still slashed me twice! "As he spoke, he tugged at his collar to show you those two wounds, just like the sealed mail seals, but now the wounds had become extremely faint.
Your fingers gently stroked those two wounds, then you lowered your head and softly blew a couple of breaths on them. Spamton was stunned for a moment, his cheeks instinctively flushed, his eyes darting left and right: "I...... It doesn't hurt anymore. ”
So, you don't need to blow on the pain anymore; it can fly away.
But you just touched the wound and said seriously, "But it must have hurt a lot at the time. I hope...... This can soothe the pain in your memories. So what happened afterward? How could your injury be okay and come home? ”
Spamton was stunned for a moment, but still answered instinctively, "Mm...... I don't know what happened either. All I know is that I've been lying in that snowy patch for a very, very long time, and I'm almost losing consciousness...... In a daze, the two separate halves rejoined again, and my mind returned a bit. Although there were still scars, I was much better......
You patted his head: "So in this situation, Spammy insisted on going home to prepare dinner for me?" Spammy is very strong, truly impressive. "You squinted slightly and scratched his chin again. Spamton instinctively squinted in response to your movement, making a purring sound. Then he suddenly opened his eyes, looked up at you, and his tone was a bit fierce: "No, don't think you can change the subject just because of this. You haven't answered my question yet!" ”
But...... You don't seem to need to answer his question? After all, between you two...... Is it necessary to know these details? Spamton was stunned for a moment, his heartbeat suddenly erratic. Once again, he didn't dare look at you, just lowered his head.
You just sighed, patted his head, then tried hard to hold back the tears in your eyes and suddenly hugged Spamton.
Your voice was still tinged with tears: "I saw everything, I saw everything...... You lay alone in the snow. I thought going back to the world of light might help you get better, so I went back. As it turned out, you really did get better." Your words were fairly calm, but Spamton's eyes also turned red.
He hugged you tightly as well, his voice still a bit stammering: "But...... But? Don't you really dislike the Light World...... "After all, although you are a citizen of Light, you have never mentioned the Light World. Spamton naturally assumed you hated the Light World very much, and of course, he never mentioned it in front of you.
"I really hate the world of light, but you're more important...... So, going back for you or something like that feels totally worth it." As you spoke, you buried your head between Spamton's fluffy shoulders and neck, wiping away the tears streaming from your eyes. Spamton's shoulders felt a bit moist, and your voice was muffled.
He fell silent for a moment, opened his mouth but didn't know what to say, and finally just smiled and said, "Ah, Y/N is really impressive, like saving me again—though I don't know how you did it, the reason I'm standing here perfectly fine is because of Y/N! I like you the most! ”
The first ...... was to take him out of the garbage heap. From then on, his destiny changed, like a flower blooming with new vitality. And this time...... Once again, he escaped the environment that only made him cry, helpless, and powerless to escape.
Maybe this sentence was just a casual remark, or maybe it was ...... Every time it was sincere, his heart pounding, every time, every time it was like this. And seeing you just respond with a hum after hearing that, Spamton would only suppress his downward mood, lift his face again, and smile at you.
But this time, you only gently patted his back and softly said, 'Mm, I like spammy the most too, no... I love you the most.' You finally responded to a line that sounded somewhat like a joke, yet also somewhat like a heartfelt confession. This time, you chose to believe what he said, you chose... to believe in an unknown promise.
You are willing to re-entrust this unknown emotion, perhaps called "love," to Spamton.
Spamton's face flushed again. He was relieved that they were embracing at this moment. You couldn't see his expression, but you could still feel his body stiffening slightly.
"Ah...... Huh? Mm, I, I love you. "He felt a burning heat at this moment, his mind almost crashed, and he simply didn't know what he was saying. He thought this time the answer would be another 'mm'...... But now, his heart was blooming with joy, just holding you tightly, feeling the sudden joy and pleasure rising in his chest. The pounding sound in his chest seemed to pierce through his skin, and that sincere and warm emotion enveloped him, so much so that at this moment, Spamton only felt sweetness, even if it was just a simple hug.
"Y/N is the best...... I love you the most. "He murmured, repeating the sentence. His head rubbed against your neck too, fluffy and a bit ticklish.
And you let go of his tight embrace: "I know, I like you the most. Our Spammy is the best—I just tried to restore those spam ads in the trash bin, and now you can stand here again. That's great." ”
As you spoke, you picked up the food on the table, planning to heat it up yourself.
Spamton patted his cheeks, which had not yet fully lost his warmth, and followed behind you into the kitchen: "Wait a moment, let me take care of things!" Y/N, you just need to sit there! ”
His heart was still pounding, although he also doubted whether the Dark People really had such a thing...... But if he said it existed, then it did! He couldn't help but smile at the corner of his mouth, and now...... In other words, his existence as a Dark Folk in the Light World's manifestation, or rather its carrier...... was actually the spam mail you restored. He then remembered that, when he was unconscious, he had once tried sending mass advertising emails to users of the Light World. Of course, he also knew one of them had been sent to your computer. Even though your computer hadn't been turned on for a long time, and hadn't been connected to the internet for a long time......
So, he must have voluntarily chosen those spam emails as carriers. Even though it's just spam...... But you really value all of it.
Spamton silently lowered his head, picked up his tray, and walked into the kitchen. You didn't notice his expression, just raised your voice and replied, "I have to do something too. Spammy should be sitting there and resting. You're seriously injured......"
Spamton insisted, "But Y/N made a special trip to the Light World just for me, which must have been tough too...... You're tired too, right? Leave these things to me! ”
You two held out for a while, then looked at each other and suddenly burst out laughing.
In the end, you all just did some work as usual.
At the dinner table, Spamton hesitated for a moment, but finally spoke up. This time, his voice was somewhat serious: "Y/N...... Although I was happy and felt it was inappropriate to talk about these sad things at a time like this, I still had to say, this world is about to disappear. ”
You stopped eating, just looking at Spamton with a hint of confusion: "Are you going to disappear?" "But you're still sitting here perfectly fine?"
He cleared his throat: "Not today, not now, but in a week...... I made a deal with those Lightfolk. I won't stop them from sealing the Dark Fountain, but on the other hand, they won't be able to act until a week later. ”
As he spoke, his voice grew quieter: "So...... I'm no longer the advertiser. After seven days, when this dark world completely disappears, I won't be anymore. ”
"But you'll always be spamton, so it's okay." You just curved your eyebrows slightly.
Spamton was stunned for a moment. He lowered his head, not letting you see his reddened eyes: "Mm...... Mm! I promised beforehand that I would come see your art exhibition every day, but I missed my appointment and didn't go today...... So I specifically took a week to properly visit your exhibition! ”
"Alright, I'll introduce everything to you in detail, one by one. But after this week, where are we going to go? ”
Spamton pouted, clearly not very happy: "Specifically, the other two Lightfolk will tell you later. Anyway, from now on, we'll all have to move to Castle Town to live." ”
"Alright, I know...... Then when the time comes, you and I will both have to find new jobs, right? "You think seriously about this question.
Spamton just nudged your arm: "Let's talk about this later. For now, focus on your meal, or the food will get cold later!" ”
You understand, this is just a very forced excuse to change the subject...... Maybe Spamton is still more or less worried about the future? But you haven't exposed this, since in the days to come, you'll always be there for him, no matter what happens.
So you just smiled and softened your voice, replying, "Alright, alright." ”
TBC.

title: Time Walk 30 (end) (swapsptx you)
content:
After dinner, as usual, Spamton went to the kitchen with the dishes to wash them, while you sat on the living room sofa, lost in thought, thinking about the future and what to do next. At that moment, your phone lit up, and you realized it was a message from the gallery owner.
You glanced at your phone screen—it was telling you that the gallery would close in seven days, and you'd have to settle your wages for the month. You know, it's because this dark world is about to disappear that the gallery will close. You put away your phone and let out a gentle breath.
And the next morning, Spamton was syncing with you, sticking with you all the way to the gallery. He said righteously, "Anyway, this dark world is about to disappear, and he's no longer the owner of ads—he's basically an unemployed vagrant. Of course, he can go wherever he wants!"
You followed him into the gallery, and at first he just excitedly shouted, "I'm about to see the painting Y/N drew for me...... I'm so nervous. I wonder if many people of darkness will come to see ......."
It wasn't until he entered the gallery that he fell silent, widening his eyes at the paintings hanging on the walls—he thought there would only be a few, he thought you would show other old paintings too, because Spamton thought those paintings should also be seen by other dark people. But he didn't know—you had painted so many, and all the main characters were him. Looking around, all kinds of ...... His silhouette, the fragments of his life with you.
He quietly walked forward, the first painting ...... He still had some impressions—it was that day when he was tinkering with the flowers, and you drew it on a whim—probably the first painting. Later on, some were scenes of him busy in the kitchen, some dozing off on the sofa, some grinding coffee, and some of his sparkling eyes showing off the newly made desserts. Spamton didn't even know...... When did you record all this? It was only then that he realized that you had seen everything.
After all, there are two more paintings, probably just your imagination—the first shows Spamton in a conference hall, directly commanding the other Dark People. Of course, this meeting room is just your imagination, completely different from the one he was in.
The second painting was of him proudly patrolling the shopping street. The small shop that used to be white Addison had been closed, and he was standing there, seemingly pointing and talking about other Addison shops.
Spamton turned his back to you, he's a bit afraid to turn his head to look at you, but his voice was a bit dry: "...... When did you paint it? How come I have no idea at all? ”
You rubbed your chin and thought for a moment: "Most of it was drawn in my own room...... After all, you've never seen it in my room before, so it's normal not to know, right?" "Except for that time, when you brought Spamton into your room, he hasn't gone in since. You know, that's respecting your privacy. Of course, you never tried to find out what exactly he was preparing, after all...... You would respect his thoughts, no matter how curious you are, you wouldn't sneak a peek!
Spamton remained silent, just walking down the corridor filled with paintings, until he finally stopped in front of that ...... Your family portrait. The term 'family portrait' was actually Spamton's own name. After all, your family only had you as a citizen of light and a person of darkness as well.
He looked at himself in the painting, smiling carefreely, and suddenly smiled too. He turned around and smiled at you: "I have an idea. Right in front of this painting, how about we take another photo together?" ”
You nod as if it were only natural: "Of course you can." ”
You might think, maybe he also wants to leave a little memory in this disappearing advertising world.
The store manager volunteered to step forward, holding an instant camera to take photos of you.
So Spamton puts his arm around your shoulder, and together with you, smiles at the camera, taking a precious photo together—of course, his current height has lost the advantage of being the master of this dark world, and he's reverted to the same state as he did in Addison, so he has to stand on tiptoe just to put his arm around your shoulder.
You suppress your laughter, and when you see other Addisons also come to the gallery to view the exhibition, you wave to them, and they come closer, gathering around you.
Pink looked impatient, but still said, "Alright, you want to take a photo together, right? We happened to be here today." ”
Blue glanced at Pink, then at Spamton: "I was clearly worried Spamton would come to the gallery......" But before he could finish, Yellow covered his mouth.
"Well, looking at it now, it actually seems like a good thing." Orange tried to smooth things over, skillfully sidling with Spamton.
You smiled, hugged Spamton, rested your head on his head, four other Addisons surrounded you, and then with a "click," the group photo was taken and washed out from the polaroid.
Of course, this group photo was copied four times and given to the other four Addisons. Spamton was a bit reluctant but still gave it away. And for your group photo, you used that family portrait as the background, framed in a photo frame, and placed it in the most prominent spot in the living room.
A week isn't long either, but not too short. The art exhibition ended, the gallery closed, and this dark world was about to disappear. In the end, Spamton hesitantly tugged at your sleeve and whispered, "...... Go to the shopping street. I told them that when they arrive at the time of the transaction, a Lightfolk will come looking for them. ”
You nod and head to the shopping street, where waiting for you are two Dark People, one human, and the other ...... Seems like monsters? You're not sure either, since the community you live in is still mostly human.
The purple girl who looked a bit like a dinosaur greeted you cheerfully, while the other blue boy didn't say a word.
She tells you that all the Dark People can live in Castle Town; you just need to move the corresponding objects from the Light World there.
