You suddenly realize that you have left this dark world, and they have sealed the dark fountain of this world. You can no longer enter this dark world.
Feeling a bit disappointed? Indeed...... But with a bit of anticipation and a smile, you set out again on the road back to your original home. You no longer cared about those voices; after all, none of them mattered to you anymore.
You push open the door again, and your parents' gazes immediately turn toward you.
His mother was the first to shout: "You've called so many times and you still won't answer. I told you, you're old enough to find a place for your future. I've worried so much that my hair turned white over you, and you don't even glance at me. You must feel sorry for your parents!" ”
My father sighed too: "We've worried about you since we were little. Whatever you want, we haven't given it to you...... Look at this room—aren't these all the things you've been loudly trying to get? And only when you go to a good family can you focus on painting, right? ”
You ignore their voices, just walk into your room, bring out that computer, and you know Spamton survives on the spam stored in your mailbox.
When you walk out of the bedroom, your mother's voice suddenly rises: "Why won't you listen at all! We're doing this for your own good......"
You stopped in your tracks and turned to look at them. Although you tried hard to stay calm, your voice was still choked: "No, you ...... It's not love for me at all. You say it's for my own good, but it's really just to satisfy ...... Your own vanity. ”
Mother opened her mouth, her voice sharp: "Not at all—"
And you interrupted her: "That's it. You don't love me, you're just manipulating me. You don't see me as a child, a child worthy of your love, so I don't need parents like you either; I no longer need your love." ”
Sobbing and choking up, you feel your vision blur, and you just step back toward the door, smiling: "I won't come back. This isn't my home either. I'm going back to my own home now." ”
There is spamton, sunshine, smiles, eyes that always wait for you and anticipate you, voices that affirm you no matter what, your lover and your eternal family.
You closed the door, shutting out your parents' noise, feeling a sense of relief in your heart, and your steps becoming lighter. You beamed with a smile, leaving the past behind. You were about to walk toward your own future. This time, it was a future entirely decided by you—no scolding from your parents, no manipulation after superficial discussion. Now, you were going home.
You arrive at the address the purple girl gave you, put the computer inside, and then arrive in Castle Town. Having just experienced dizziness, you open your eyes when Spamton hugs you tightly.
"Welcome home!" Even though you were just standing on the streets of Castle Town, while other Dark Folk passing by were looking at you strangely, Addison only chuckled. The employees originally from the advertising world passed by, gave you and Spamton a flirtatious look, and then walked off again.
And you just sniffed, hugged Spamton back, and buried your head in his neck: "Mm, I'm back." ”
That day, while you were tidying up your new residence in Castle Town, you found the artwork Spamton had once shown you, along with some unsold fake flowers. You smiled and carefully stored those things away in the cabinet. As for that slightly wilted sunflower...... You took good care of it and placed it on the windowsill. As the sunflower grew and bloomed facing the sun, it was as if a small seed had been planted in your heart, growing and blooming.
Spamton, for some reason, transplanted those flowers to the square in the center of Castle Town, confidently surprised you, and solemnly took out a pot of roses he had grown to confess to you.
That sea of flowers still remains in the square, and you have simply returned home with Spamton. The future is still long, very long, and you will walk into the future together with Spamton.
So...... Welcome home.
END.

title: Full text of the times
path: articles/en/spt/时行 end/时行（swapsptx你）/时行全文.html
content:
Blank page
[1]
You found that white Addison in a pile of trash.
Actually, you've seen many Addisons, since they always sell you all kinds of products. But this is the first time you've seen a white Addison that's noticeably smaller than the others...... And you don't know why he looks so dejected, or rather, sitting in a pile of trash with tears streaming down his face.
You can't just leave this Dark Citizen here, even though that has nothing to do with you, the Citizen of Light...... What does the end of anything else have to do with you? But maybe he looked too pitiful and adorable, or maybe his silent, tearful and cautious demeanor made your heart ache. As you spoke, you picked up the food on the table, planning to heat it up yourself.
Spamton patted his cheeks, which had not yet fully lost his warmth, and followed behind you into the kitchen: "Wait a moment, let me take care of things!" Y/N, you just need to sit there! ”
His heart was still pounding, although he was also skeptical about whether the Dark People really had such a thing...... But if he said it existed, then it did! The corners of his mouth couldn't help but curl up. Now...... In other words, his existence as a Dark Tribe in the form or carrier of the Light World...... was actually the spam mail you had restored. Only then did he remember that, when he was unconscious, he had once tried sending mass advertising emails to users of the Light World. Of course, he also knew one of them had been sent to your computer. Even though your computer hadn't been turned on for a long time and hadn't been connected to the internet for a long time......
So, he must have voluntarily chosen those spam emails as carriers. Even though it's just spam...... But you really value all of it.
Spamton silently lowered his head, picked up his tray, and walked into the kitchen. You didn't notice his expression, just raised your voice and replied, "I have to do something too. Spammy should be sitting there resting well, even though you're seriously injured......"
Spamton insisted, "But Y/N made a special trip to the Light World just for me, which must have been tough too...... You're tired too, right? Leave these things to me! ”
You two held out for a while, then looked at each other and suddenly burst out laughing.
In the end, you all just did some work as usual.
At the dinner table, Spamton hesitated for a moment, but finally spoke. This time, his voice was somewhat serious: "Y/N...... Although I was happy and felt it was not appropriate to talk about these sad things at a time like this, I still had to say, this world is about to disappear. ”
You stopped eating, just looking at Spamton with a hint of confusion: "Are you going to disappear?" "But you're still sitting here perfectly fine?"
He cleared his throat: "Not today, not now, but in a week...... I made a deal with those Lightfolk. I won't stop them from sealing the Dark Fountain, but on the other hand, they won't be able to act until a week later. ”
As he spoke, his voice grew quieter: "So...... I'm no longer the advertiser. After seven days, when this dark world completely disappears, I won't be anymore. ”
"But you'll always be Spamton, so it's okay." You just curved your eyebrows slightly.
Spamton was stunned for a moment. He lowered his head, not letting you see his reddened eyes: "Mm...... Mm! I promised beforehand that I would come see your art exhibition every day, but I missed my appointment and didn't go today...... So I specifically took a week to properly visit your exhibition! ”
"Alright, I'll introduce everything to you in detail, one by one. But after this week, where are we going to go? ”
Spamton pouted, clearly not very happy: "Specifically, the other two Lightfolk will tell you later. Anyway, from now on, we'll all have to move to Castle Town to live." ”
"Alright, I know...... Then when the time comes, you and I will both have to find new jobs, right? "You think seriously about this question.
Spamton just nudged your arm: "Let's talk about this later. For now, just focus on your meal, or the food will get cold later!" ”
You understand, this is just a very forced excuse to change the subject...... Maybe Spamton is more or less worried about the future? But you haven't exposed this, since in the days to come, you'll always be by his side, no matter what happens.
So you just smiled and softened your voice, replying, "Alright, alright." ”
After dinner, as usual, Spamton went to the kitchen to wash the dishes, while you sat on the living room sofa, lost in thought, thinking about what to do next. At that moment, your phone lit up, and you realized it was a message from the gallery owner.
You glanced at your phone screen—it was telling you that the gallery would close in seven days, and you'd have to settle your wages for the month. You know, it's because this dark world is about to disappear that the gallery will close. You put away your phone and let out a gentle breath.
And the next morning, Spamton was syncing with you, sticking with you all the way to the gallery. He said righteously, since this dark world is about to disappear, he's no longer the advertiser—he's basically an unemployed vagrant, so of course he can go wherever he wants!
You followed him into the gallery, and at first he just excitedly shouted, "I'm about to see the painting Y/N drew for me...... I'm so nervous. I wonder if many people of darkness will come to see ......."
It wasn't until he walked into the gallery that he fell silent, staring wide-eyed at the paintings hanging on the walls—he thought there would only be a few, and that he would show his other past paintings, because Spamton believed those paintings should also be seen by the other Dark Dwellers. But he didn't know—you had painted so many, and all the main characters were him. Looking around, they were all kinds of ...... His silhouette, fragments of his life with you.
He quietly walked forward, the first painting ...... He still had some impressions—it was that day when he was tinkering with the flowers, and you drew it on a whim—probably the first painting. Later on, some were scenes of him busy in the kitchen, some dozing off on the sofa, some grinding coffee, and some of his sparkling eyes showing off the newly made desserts. Spamton didn't even know...... When did you record all this? It was only then that he realized that you had seen everything.
After all, there are two paintings, probably just your imagination—the first shows Spamton in a conference hall, issuing orders to the other Dark People. Of course, this meeting room is your imagination and completely different from the one he is in.
The second painting shows him proudly patrolling the shopping street. The small shop originally owned by Addison in white was closed, and he was standing there, seemingly pointing and pointing at other Addison shops.
Spamton turned his back to you, he's a bit afraid to turn his head to look at you, but his voice was a bit dry: "...... When did you paint it? How come I have no idea at all? ”
You rubbed your chin and thought for a moment: "Most of it was drawn by me in my own room...... After all, you've never seen it in my room before, so it's normal not to know, right?" "Except for that time, when you brought Spamton into your room, and after that, he hasn't gone in since. You know, that's respecting your privacy. Of course, you never tried to find out exactly what he was preparing, after all...... You would respect his thoughts, no matter how curious you are, you wouldn't sneak a peek!
Spamton remained silent, just walking down the corridor filled with paintings, until he finally stopped at that ...... Your family portrait. The term 'family portrait' was actually Spamton's own name. After all, your family only had you as a citizen of light and a member of darkness.
He looked at himself in the painting, smiling carefreely, and suddenly smiled too. He turned around and smiled at you: "I have an idea. Right in front of this painting, how about we take another photo together?" ”
You nod as if it were only natural: "Of course you can." ”
You might think, maybe he also wants to leave a little memory in this disappearing advertising world.
The store manager volunteered to step forward, holding an instant camera to take photos of you.
So Spamton puts his arm around your shoulder, smiling at the camera with you, taking a precious photo together—of course, his current height has lost the advantage of being the master of this dark world, and he's reverted to the same state as he did in Addison's days, so he has to stand on tiptoe just to put his arm around your shoulder.
You suppress your laughter, and when you see other Addisons coming to the gallery to view the exhibition, you wave to them, and they come closer, gathering around you.
Pink looked impatient, but still said, "Alright, you want to take a photo together, right? We happened to be here today." ”
Blue looked at Pink again and then looked at Spamton: "Obviously, you're only coming to the gallery because you're worried about Spamton..." But before he could finish speaking, Yellow covered his mouth.
"Well, anyway, it seems like a good thing now," Orange tried to mediate, naturally leaning over to Spamton's side.
You smiled, hugging Spamton, resting your head on his, while the other four Addisons gathered around you. Then, with a click, a group photo was taken and developed from the instant camera.
Of course, this group photo was copied four times and given to the other four Addisons. Spamton was somewhat reluctant but still handed it over. Your copy of the photo, using the family photo as the background, was framed and placed in the most prominent spot in the living room.
A week may feel long yet short; the art exhibition ended, the gallery closed, and this dark world was about to disappear. At the end, Spamton hesitantly tugged at your sleeve and whispered, "...Go to the shopping street. I told them, when you arrive at the moment of the transaction, a Light citizen will come to meet them."
You nod and head to the shopping street, where waiting for you are two Dark People, one human, and the other ...... Seems like monsters? You're not sure either, since the community you live in is still mostly human.
The purple girl who looked a bit like a dinosaur greeted you cheerfully, while the other blue boy didn't say a word.
She tells you that all the Dark People can live in Castle Town; you just need to move the corresponding objects from the Light World there.
You suddenly realize that you have left this dark world, and they have sealed the dark fountain of this world. You can no longer enter this dark world.
Feeling a bit disappointed? Indeed...... But with a bit of anticipation and a smile, you set out again on the road back to your original home. You no longer cared about those voices; after all, none of them mattered to you anymore.
You push open the door again, and your parents' gazes immediately turn toward you.
His mother was the first to shout: "You've called so many times and you still won't answer. I told you, you're old enough to find a place for your future. I've worried so much that my hair turned white over you, and you don't even glance at me. You must feel sorry for your parents!" ”
My father sighed too: "We've worried about you since we were little. Whatever you want, we haven't given it to you...... Look at this room—aren't these all the things you've been loudly trying to get? And only when you go to a good family can you focus on painting, right? ”
You ignored their voices and simply walked into your room, taking out the computer. You knew that Spamton survived by the spam emails in your inbox.
When you walk out of the bedroom, your mother's voice suddenly rises: "Why won't you listen at all! We're doing this for your own good......"
You stopped in your tracks and turned to look at them. Although you tried hard to stay calm, your voice was still choked: "No, you ...... It's not love for me at all. You say it's for my own good, but it's really just to satisfy ...... Your own vanity. ”
Mother opened her mouth, her voice sharp: "Not at all—"
And you interrupted her: "That's it. You don't love me, you're just manipulating me. You don't see me as a child, a child worthy of your love, so I don't need parents like you either; I no longer need your love." ”
Sobbing and choking up, you feel your vision blur, and you just step back toward the door, smiling: "I won't come back. This isn't my home either. I'm going back to my own home now." ”
There, there was Spamton, sunlight, laughter, those sparkling eyes that always await and expect you, voices affirming you no matter what, your beloved, and your eternal family.
You closed the door, shutting out your parents' noise, feeling a sense of relief in your heart, and your steps becoming lighter. You beamed with a smile, leaving the past behind. You were about to walk toward your own future. This time, it was a future entirely decided by you—no scolding from your parents, no manipulation after superficial discussion. Now, you were going home.
You reached the address the purple girl had told you about, put the computer inside, and then went to Castle Town. Having just experienced dizziness, you barely opened your eyes before Spamton held you tightly.
"Welcome home!" Even though you were just standing in the streets of Castle Town, other Dark citizens passing by looked at you strangely, and those Addisons just giggled. The employees who originally belonged to the advertising world passed by, gave you and Spamton an ambiguous look, and then ran off.
You just sniffled, hugged Spamton back, and buried your head in his neck: "Mm, I'm home."
That day, while tidying up your new place in Castle Town, you discovered the artwork Spamton had shown you before, as well as some unsold fake flowers. You smiled and carefully stored them in a cabinet. As for the somewhat droopy sunflower... you took good care of it and placed it on the windowsill. As the sunflower grew and bloomed toward the sun, it was as if a small seed was planted in your heart, growing and blossoming.
Spamton, for some reason, transplanted those flowers to the square in the center of Castle Town, confidently surprised you, and solemnly took out a pot of roses he had grown to confess to you.
The sea of flowers still remained in the square, but you just returned home with Spamton. There is still a long, long future ahead, and you will walk toward it together with Spamton.
So...... Welcome home.
END.

content:
[1]
You found that white Addison in a pile of trash.
Actually, Addison, you've seen a lot of them already; after all, they are always trying to sell you all sorts of products. But the white one, which is relatively smaller than the other Addisons, is something you've never seen before... and you also don't know why he sits among the garbage with a forlorn face, or rather, with tears streaming down his face, silently crying.
You can't just leave this Dark Folk here, even though that has nothing to do with you, the Citizen of Light...... What does the end of anything else have to do with you? But maybe he looked too pitiful and cute, or maybe his silent, tearful and cautious look made your heart ache. Anyway, you crouched down, grabbed his hand, and pulled him out of the trash heap. He was covered in filth, looking as if he'd spent days in the trash, with a coffee cup on his head, brown stains dripping down.
You glanced at him several times, and he carefully pried your fingers away, nervously pulling your hand back behind your back: "Thank you...... But I'm not very clean. ”
You crossed your arms, tilted your head to look at him, rubbed your chin, and then asked, "...... Could it be that you have an infectious disease or something? After all, you just came out of that place." You always speak bluntly, and you pointed directly at the pile of garbage nearby.
He seemed stunned for a moment, then quickly shook his head and hurriedly took down the coffee cup from above him: "No...... Although I'm a bit dirty, I'm very clean." He stammered, probably not knowing how to explain, so he could only look up and look at you anxiously.
You were silent for a moment. To be honest, you hadn't intended to bother with him at first...... At most, you'd just pull him out and stuff in some dark coins. You believed nothing would be unbearable, but the way he looked at you with that admiring gaze made you blush a little, and you couldn't help but cough lightly.
"Alright, I know. You're the white, pure Addison." You gently pat his head, though there were coffee stains on it, but you didn't mind.
His head rubbed against your palm, and you were a bit stunned. Then you heard him say, "Yes, I'm pure white...... But my colleague thought I should have color, so he gave me this cup of coffee." His tone was very innocent, as if he had no idea how much interest this was about. When you heard this, you couldn't help but frown. If that were the case, maybe just giving him some money to go back would have been snatched away by other Dark Ones.
But you still blurted out, "Then why are you in the garbage heap?" "You heard his stomach growling, so you guess he's been in the garbage heap for several days."
"Hmm...... Because another colleague said that besides the color, I should have some smell, so they sent me into the trash heap. "He said.
Looking at him, you decide not to ask why he was crying and staying in the garbage heap at first. You know those two sentences were probably lies he made up...... But it's okay, you still choose to believe him and pretend nothing happened. You definitely don't want to watch this poor little thing go back and suffer again.
So you still held his hand and walked toward your home. You lowered your voice and said, "Then...... Come back with me first. You need to get yourself properly cleaned first. ”
At the same time, you're wondering how to teach those Addisons a lesson.
Spamton just shook his head in panic: "No...... No need to trouble yourself! I have my own home! Thank you so much for today, I don't want you to worry anymore. ”
“…… Yes, and I have a name—I'm SPAMTON G. SPAMTON!" When he mentioned his name, he actually tilted his head back slightly, looking a bit proud, making you want to scratch his chin.
"So, besides you, are there other Dark People in your family?" You asked, holding his hand as you slowly walked forward. He had no intention of resisting you.
"I and the other Addison live in different rooms in the same house." He answers your question in a low voice.
What kind of staff dormitory does that sound...... No matter what, you really can't let him go back for now. You don't want this poor little one to go back and be bullied again.
"Then come with me first. There's no one else in my house. Get yourself ready before you go back...... I suppose you don't want to go back like this either, right?" You said softly, turned your head, blinked at him twice, and couldn't help but pat his hair again.
Spamton, naturally, nods at you. You take his hand with satisfaction and walk toward your own home.
Naturally, you miss Spamton's expression when you turn your head. Although he's still smiling at your back, that smile now carries a hint of triumph.
Getting splashed with coffee and thrown into a pile of garbage is real, and he can crawl back. But after spending several days in the garbage heap, crying just seeing you is fake. He knows there's a Citizen of Light working in this city, and he knows you pass by here on your way home from work, so he deliberately created this state. After all, he hopes to get to know you, the Citizen of Light...... Of course, now he wants to stay by your side—maybe it's his natural admiration for the light, maybe it's just fear of being taken by others, or maybe it's his own purpose—he hopes to find some way to succeed through you.
He definitely didn't want to stay in this state forever!
Of course, you have no idea what he's thinking. After you get home, you push him into the bathroom, then take out two shirts and pants you've worn before, measure them to fit Spamton.
After he finished washing, he was once again a clean white addison, with a slight blush on his face. He pulled the clothes you had prepared and sat down next to you, stammering, "Then...... I'll be leaving now. Goodbye." As he spoke, his eyelashes drooped slightly, perfectly creating a slightly aggrieved look on his face.
You quickly grabbed his hand: "Ah, let's have a meal first...... My house still has a guest room, and you can stay there too. I think you shouldn't go back for now. ”
After all, you always feel guilty if you let him back in that environment—besides, your house happens to have an extra empty room, so having an Addison is no problem at all.
"Can I really do it?" He blinked, held your hand, and asked cautiously.
And you shook your head: "Of course you can. Anyway, my house is my decision!" You put your hands on your hips and said proudly, and Spamton applauded you, making you even happier.
Anyway, he volunteered to cover three meals and handed over dark coins, saying, "Then...... This is a friend fee, I want to be good friends with you." He spoke with his head down.
You pushed the money back: "I don't need a friend fee...... Since I let you stay here, I already consider you a friend! You just need to live here peacefully!" "And you've taken care of the three meals that have always troubled you, which makes you absolutely happy."
After all, he often prepares different dishes for you. If it were for you, you'd probably have coffee and bread every meal.
Living at home with an Addison really feels different. Now, every day when you come home, you can see Spamton wearing an apron, brewing coffee, handing you a cup, and smiling, saying, "Welcome home." ”
If you weren't so clear that you two have no other relationship, you'd probably think you're actually husband and wife...... Of course, he's his wife.
You find a moment to grab a sack to wrap up the other Addisons, then give them a good beating, treating it as a secret way to vent your anger on Spamton, then wipe your hands and toss them into the trash.
Days passed just like that, until one day, Spamton realized his opportunity had come. He gained the ability to use data to understand the preferences of the people of light, and with this ability, he earned a lot of Dark Coins, eventually taking over a nearby dark world called the Advertising World. Even his former Addison colleagues became his employees.
Those Addisons never really understood how Spamton became the Lord of Advertising, nor did they understand why they got beaten that day, or even who beat them.
But Spamton still stays at your home, waiting for you to come back, then smiles and says, "Welcome home." ”
But now his appearance has changed. He is wearing a white suit, just taking off the sunglasses he used to wear, and he seems to have grown taller. Somehow, you realize that Spamton is now taller than you.
…… And you probably have some quirky habits. But you have a good acceptance of your own Addison's quirky preferences.
But having a big trash bin in the room is still too strange! Although this trash can is very clean, it looks like a sanitation bin, even though it contains fresh flowers...... But using a trash can to grow flowers is still too strange!
You rubbed your brow and asked, "Spamton, can we ...... just change the flowerpot?" You feel a bit annoyed. If only you hadn't told Spamton last time you wanted to see the lavender field, he wouldn't have been planting flowers in the trash can.
"Our family can still afford a big flowerpot." But a simple trash can is indeed cheaper.
You don't even know when you started to see Spamton as part of your family...... Maybe when he says 'Welcome home,' and your heart is touched by it. The place where someone is waiting for you to return is truly home, and at that moment, because of Spamton, you feel a sense of belonging there, and naturally you treat Spamton as your own family.
"...But planting flowers in a trash can is more environmentally friendly. If you don’t want to look at it, we can just throw this trash can downstairs!" Spamton said proudly, looking like he thought his idea was genius.
You can't touch his head anymore, just scratch his chin, and he instinctively squints and lifts his head.
"Of course I want to see it. Wouldn't a different flowerpot look better?" You tried to persuade Spamton.
No one knew why he puffed out his cheeks, but instead seemed to be throwing a tantrum: "No, I want this trash can! I think the trash can looks better! How come it's not a flowerpot!" ”
He gritted his teeth and persisted, as if playing with a child's temper, insisting on this point.
You sigh and can only follow along with the hair: "Alright, alright, then let's plant flowers in the trash can." ”
His eyes squinted with laughter, his cheek rubbing against your palm as he laughed, "That's wonderful! I love you the most, Y/N! ”
You paused, instinctively lowering your head to look at him, realizing he was probably just speaking casually, and your previously fluttering heart slowly quieted down.
Think about it, he was probably just saying it offhand, so he just gave a soft "mm."
Spamton's instinctively rubbing against your palm paused for a moment, as if his body stiffened for a moment. Then he maintained his half-kneeling posture and looked up at you, his expression very serious: "Y/N, I will definitely give you this lavender sea of flowers." ”
A flower field planted in a trash can? That’s quite creative... Actually, you didn’t really think there was anything remarkable about the flowers and plants in the trash can. But when you looked down at Spamton’s serious expression, you couldn’t help but pause for two seconds. You remembered the first time you met Spamton, and you remembered that it was also in a pile of garbage, where a pure white, clean Addison also grew.
Because of these memories, you couldn't help but chuckle softly, though half-perfunctorily responding with a couple of "mm-hmm" and gently nodding.
"I get it, so go ahead and give it a try." You patted Spamton's head, and once again his cheek rubbed against your palm, making purring sounds as if he was enjoying it.
"Of course—I'm the most powerful Addison, a big shot!" He jumped up again, happily returning to the small flower field, carefully observing the lavender that had wilted for some reason.
You didn't look at him anymore. Seeing his serious expression, he was probably really figuring out what to do. Suddenly, you had a bit of a bad idea, but didn't plan to tell him directly what to do based on your experience in the world of light.
You like peace, so you cultivate many flowers and plants and read many related books, including gardening and a messy collection of art books. Although you can't find a horticulture-related job in the Dark World, the art knowledge you learn is enough to work as an ordinary staff member in a gallery.
You always feel that everything around you is noisy...... But maybe after spending so much time together, with your tacit approval, Addison, who was cautious at first, finally lets go, and even at home there is noisy. Occasionally, but very occasionally, when you can't hear his voice, you actually feel the surroundings are very quiet, even a bit lonely.
After all, you don't really know what he's done. Sometimes he comes back very late, but always swaggers like a proud peacock.
And during this period, he's always leaving early and coming home late, and I don't know what he's busy with. Although he always prepares breakfast for you, he doesn't have dinner at all. You're often the one who gets home earlier, and sometimes you want to ask him, "Do you want to come home for dinner?" But you just simply prepare dinner, use the few recipes you only know, then sit at the table and eat quietly, facing the empty seat across from you.
Finally, you see Spamton push open the door and come back. His hair is standing on end, and he looks like a little bird with a messy feather, a bit restless. When he sees you sitting at the dining table waiting for him, Spamton's movements freeze. He awkwardly touches his hair and quickly tidies it up to barely keep his look in place.
You blinked, put down your knife and fork, and softly said, "Welcome home." "This was something he used to say to you almost every day. Now that you said it himself, you found it a bit novel."
Spamton pursed his lips, lowered his head, and didn't dare look at you: "...... Mm, mm! I'm back!" He forced himself to perk up, looking as lively as he was.
"Today, the boss kept us working overtime...... Because our performance wasn't enough. Work is so tough, so we came back a bit late. You clearly didn't have to wait for me...... I—I'll try to finish my work as soon as possible in the future. "He looked up again, looking at you with wet eyes. Well, actually, he was the one who instructed the other employees to check the cultivation methods of Guang World Flowers, which is why he's come back so late these days.
…… Thanks to his efforts, he had already managed to plant three pots in the family's office, but he wasn't satisfied. After all, although the lavender at home was a bit wilted, it was still growing just fine!
Of course, it could also be thanks to you. You can't bear to do it, so when you pass by, you water it and apply some fertilizer appropriately, which is why it lasts until today.
You didn't mean to blame him at first, just sighed helplessly: "Got it, hello, boss is bad, work is bad!" "Although you think what he said is most likely not entirely true...... But you choose to pretend you don't know about this suspicion.
After all, no matter what, as long as Spamton uses a sincere heart when facing you, isn't that enough?
"Yes, work is bad!" He shouted too, then pushed some dark coins over to you.
You looked at him without understanding, while spamton just turned his head away again without looking at you: 'Um... this is this month's friend fee!' So, he wants to stay here forever, always staying by your side. When saying this, he was a bit uneasy; he didn’t know if you would accept the money, if you would accept his idea, if you would... accept him, this originally hopeless addison. After all, it’s embarrassing to say, that although he volunteered to cook for you, actually all the household financial matters were still handled by you.
And although he became the master of advertising, he didn't want to move elsewhere; he just wanted to live with you. Well, maybe, he had become a family lover, he thought.
You shook your head and pushed the dark coins back. Spamton swallowed again, growing even more nervous. He didn't know what you meant, just stared at you wide-eyed.
“…… No need for a friend fee. "You're not short of money. The gallery pays a lot, so supporting an Addison is more than enough. Yes, although Spamton has changed clothes and seems even more impressive, you still treat him as an ordinary Addison from your family.
"So, are you going home for dinner tomorrow?" Looking at Spamton's nervous expression, you find it a bit amusing. Honestly, I don't know why he sometimes gets so sensitive about these issues. You haven't even planned to let the pet Addison go. No matter what, after spending so much time together, there's still affection. Besides, you brought him back because you saw how pitiful and cute he was. If he had been released and then returned to the trash heap looking pitiful, you'd be worried about him every day.
He nodded vigorously, and as soon as you finished speaking, he eagerly agreed, even patting his chest to promise, "Of course, this is my home. Of course I have to come home for dinner!" ”
Spamton finally returned to his cheerful demeanor, sitting proudly across from you, grabbing a sandwich and starting to eat.
He started chattering again.
"Today's work is so tough! We're actually selling flowerpots...... How many Dark People use flowerpots in the Dark World! I've been selling for half a day and visiting many households, but haven't sold a few. "Spamton complained.
It's fake. In fact, he ordered the advertising world to start advertising for flowerpots, since he wanted to pick the one he liked most and transplanted lavender to give to you.
You nod gently and say "Mm," indicating you heard what he said.
"And my colleagues, the other Addisons, are also hard to get along with... They always bully me! But it’s not as extreme as before, they just always come to steal my customers." As he said this, he gestured animatedly, vividly demonstrating how fierce the other Addisons were.
If Addison heard this, he would definitely complain that Spamton was completely the opposite. They wouldn't dare to steal Spamton's customers; Spamton would be the one casually walking up to pull out a card reader and snatching their customers, then assigning them tasks that were obviously unfinished.
As for what he said at the beginning—the boss in his words was, of course, himself! But he had automatically transferred your 'bad boss' to other colleagues, since he's not the boss you mentioned anyway.
You stop what you're doing and start watching Spamton perform. He first stands on the left, playing the fierce colleague, the pink he shouts about.
"You still have the nerve to grab such a good client? Your sales skills aren't as good as mine, so let me handle it! You just go serve tea and water!" ”
Then he moved to the right side, bowing and bowing as he started playing the role: "Sorry...... I—I didn't mean to do this. I just wanted to close the order, so I approached this customer's ......."
Of course, the roles should be reversed; otherwise, how could he have acted so vividly? As for his so-called self-...... It was actually fabricated.
In any case, you can't see any mistakes or omissions, just nod indignantly: "Your colleague is really terrible. You can't find clients yourself, so you want to steal yours? I remember you always can't find many clients." ”
As you spoke, you stood up, walked over to Spamton's side, and affectionately rubbed his head, while his head rubbed against your palm.
"Exactly...... But, but, after all, they're older than me, so I have to give them some ......" His voice was sticky, a bit aggrieved, as if he was acting cute with you.
Anyway, you just ruffled his hair again: "But you're colleagues now, competitors. Don't care so much about seniority! Business will only come out if you fight for it!" You started lecturing him with your hands on your hips. Spamton obediently nodded.
Of course he knows this—after all, if it weren't for the constant fighting and fighting, maybe the one you brought home back then wouldn't be him, and maybe even now, you're still all alone.
"Yes, I promise I'll work hard to meet the targets, and try to come back early tomorrow! That's why I want to say welcome home!" You sat back down in your seat, and he said this to you with a lively expression, once again like a peacock spreading its feathers.
"Y-yes, I'll wait for you to say that to me." You nodded. Actually, you didn't think that was very important. But as long as your own Addison is happy, that's what matters.
The gallery was rarely busy for a while, because today a famous artist from the Dark World was exhibiting. The people of darkness came and went endlessly, and you were so busy you barely had time to rest, so naturally you got home late. Hungry, you pushed open the door and saw a steam rising from the room.
Spamton is sitting across the table, waiting for you: "Welcome home." ”
After he finished, his eyes sparkled as if asking for praise. You couldn't help but walk over and rub his head, your eyes curved into a smile: "Mm, I'm back." ”
He really did what he said, coming back earlier than you today and even saying that. But you know very well that this is just his nature—he's always a bit eager to accomplish something. That's pretty cute, isn't it?
You sat across from him and began enjoying dinner today. For a moment, the room fell silent, leaving only a warm atmosphere...... At that moment, you heard Spamton speak, but in a mysterious tone: "Ahem,...... After dinner, I'm going to surprise you! "Although it was a surprise, judging by the expression on his face, it was all about to praise me for doing well. You probably couldn't hide that surprise either."
But you still kept asking, "Hmm?" What surprise? ”
He just proudly lifted his head, then shook it mysteriously: "I told you it's a surprise—so, this is a secret!" "Saying that, he quickly resumed dinner, even urging you to eat.
"You should eat quickly too. You want to know what the surprise is sooner, right?" He said this with a lively expression, but look, he was the one really anxious...... You're not in a hurry; you're even starting to guess.
"Yeah, right, I'm curious about what surprise is." But you still followed his lead, even though ...... You weren't that curious; you just didn't want to disturb his joy and excitement.
"I knew it! Y/N, I guarantee you'll love the surprise I prepared!" As he spoke, he started drawing again, and couldn't even eat properly.
"Then you should eat well too." You just shrugged and said.
He shut up, even exaggeratedly covering his mouth with both hands and making a proper cross to signal himself to be quiet. You couldn't help but laugh again and quickened your eating. You weren't that curious about what the surprise was, just curious...... What was he going to say to you then?
When dinner ended, Spamton cleared away all the dishes and then mysteriously circled behind you, covering your eyes. His voice was full of enthusiasm and impatience: "Y/N, come with me, I'm going to show you the surprise!" ”
"You're covering my eyes, how am I supposed to get out?" You chuckled. Although the darkness left your vision made you a bit panicked, you knew it was Spamton's hand, so you relaxed, wanting to see what tricks he could pull.
Spamton seemed a bit stuck. He let out an "uh," thought about the question, then confidently said, "I'm watching the road! You just need to keep moving forward!" Even so, he still lowered one hand, covering your eyes with just one hand. You could see the faint light filtering through your fingers, while his other hand rested on your shoulder, carefully pushing you away to signal you to move forward.
You really do follow his instructions and just go straight.
Then you hear his nervous voice: "We can't go straight anymore, we have to turn left here, turn left!" As he spoke, he grabbed your shoulders but didn't dare to use too much force, only signaling you to turn left.
You know ...... Turn left and you'll find his room. I don't know why he's so nervous, turning the house into a maze in the dark. Even though he wants to play, you let him do as he pleases. Now you're a bit curious about what surprise he's about to show you will look like
But you still responded with a couple of "mm-hmm" and followed him left turn. You felt as if you had entered his room, and you felt the hand on your shoulder loosen as if he had flipped some switch. Then, as if for a sense of ceremony, that hand rested on your eye again.
Compared to you, Spamton, who was preparing a surprise, was naturally more nervous: "I'm going to let go, 3—2—1!" He counted out, then let go. You seemed to hear the door close, and his room seemed pitch black, with only the curtains drawn.
And in the very center of the room, you see the trash can filled with lavender—no, now it's just a large flowerpot, after all, the lavender is in full bloom, and you can't tell it was originally a trash bin. And around the floor, just bypassing the bed, are also densely packed with lavender—no, if you look closely, they're just fake flowers, since the floor is still flickering with lights, otherwise you wouldn't be able to see the vibrant lavender in the center. Of course, there are also colorful lights hanging from the ceiling. If you didn't know there was nothing special today, you'd think it was a holiday.
Then Spamton spoke again: "It looks great, right—I’ve been preparing for a long time! The lavender field you said you wanted—why don’t we make today a holiday and call it... hmm, Flower Bloom Day!" He said proudly, standing beside you, his eyes sparkling as he looked at you, waiting for you to say something.
"Hmm?" "Because today happens to be the day I found you a year ago?" "If you consider this day as your rebirth day, that would be fine." "You naturally let your mind wander, and you still remember this matter clearly.
And although you know he's planning to surprise you with the lavender sea you mentioned before...... But you never expected he would actually prepare so much in such a small room. Even though the flowers on the floor are all fake, it's hard to imagine how much he put into it.
Spamton, of course, was embarrassed to say it because all the plants he had secretly planted had all died, so he could bring over fake flowers...... After all, he understood that he probably really couldn't grow a pot of flowers well. And the lavender in the central trash bin was so lush, not only because he was carefully tending it, but also because of your occasional care, and you even occasionally gave Spamton a few hints.
And when he heard your words, he was momentarily stunned. Of course, he still remembered that day a year ago—a day when he could restart his life. He just didn't expect you to remember it too. For a moment, he opened his mouth but was speechless.
You hadn’t heard Spamton’s question, so you turned to him with some curiosity: "What is it? By the way... I really like this surprise. Although I had to work late today and didn’t have time to celebrate with you, I can still say this now: happy birthday."
As you spoke, you instinctively reached out, your eyes curved with a smile, wanting to touch his head. But then you realized he was a bit taller than you now, and you couldn't quite reach his head. So you turned to touch his chin and gently scratched it twice.
Looking at your sincere smile and feeling the warmth of your fingers on your chin, he was momentarily stunned, then gently rubbed his chin against your palm, tilted his head, and rubbed his cheek against it, still beaming with excitement: "I told you, I'm very—amazing!" ”
"Yeah, our Spamton is the best." You said casually, then gently scratched his cheek and stroked it.
He paused for a moment, then bent down, his furry hair pressing against your palm. You heard Spamton's muffled sound, though of course, it was also cheerful.
"I like you the most." As he said this, he knew a warmth spreading across his cheeks, a bit hot. Because of this, he kept his head down, not daring to let you see or touch him.
You didn't think much of it. You know he was probably just saying it offhand, just like last time. So you just gently patted the top of his head, then dragged out your voice and asked, "I really like it—this small but very carefully crafted lavender field. But how are you going to deal with these fake flowers?" ”
Think about it: if you were simply surrounded by a sea of lavender, you'd only marvel at such a vast field—surely the owner put a lot of thought into it. Maybe...... Indeed, surprises depend on who prepared them.
He paused for a moment, then finally raised his head, eyebrows raised. The room was a bit dark, so you couldn't see his expression clearly. He was glad you couldn't see the blush on his cheeks: "I was thinking, if I put these fake flowers in a tiny pot that looks like a trash can, then I could sell them under the guise of art!" ”
...It really is that Addison. You twitched the corner of your lips, stood on tiptoe, and gently tapped his head, and he held his forehead, pretending to be hurt, looking at you pitifully, even a few tears welling up in his eyes. You had clearly used only a very, very light touch.
"Can this really be sold?" Although you think...... That can't really be called true art, and you still doubt that no one actually buys it.
Hearing your words, Spamton got excited. With a wave of his hand, he quickly opened several pop-up windows full of all sorts of trash cans. One window showed ordinary flower pots and their prices, priced at... hmm, one Dark Coin. It seemed the Dark People did not really like planting flowers.
He turned on the light and enthusiastically began to introduce you: "The People of Darkness aren't really good at growing living creatures...... Including me." As he said the last few words, he lowered his voice. If the room weren't so quiet, you wouldn't have heard clearly.
Then he straightened his chest again: "But! These fake flowers actually sell very well! From what I suspect, planting fake flowers in pots could also lead to a hefty deal—ahem, and besides, our flowerpots are dual-purpose. If you don't need flower arranging, you can use it as a trash bin. If you want to change your home environment, the trash can can also be transformed into a flowerpot! ”
You listen to his excited words, wanting to speak but holding back. Anything like a container can be used as a flowerpot or a trash can, right? Or is it that salespeople can say anything just to sell products?
But in the end, you still haven't broken his imagination. Although you don't know what the problem is, his sales have always been poor, and Addison has always been at the bottom. Out of concern for his pride, you never asked him similar questions or inquired about his life.
Now, you understand a bit—anyone smart probably wouldn't be convinced by his rhetoric, right? Even if he was so serious, it seemed as if a lie could come true.
You just nodded, "Alright, alright, I know...... Then let's do it this way. Do you want me to help? ”
"No need, I can do it all by myself! Don't you believe me...... I'll prove it to you! He declared with hands on hips. After all, he was the master of advertising. Even if some people didn't like it, he could still force those Dark People to buy it!
He decided to announce tomorrow that every dark person in the advertising world would buy one...... Well, as for that festival, forget it—only you and him know.

title: Time Passes (Seven)
