content:
[2]
Spamton left proudly early the next morning. You packed up and went to work. Although you were a bit curious about how Spamton sold the fake flowers and pots he mentioned—you were busy with work today and didn't have time to check out Spamton's shop.
As for Spamton, after arriving at the advertiser's office, he immediately held a meeting. Once the other Dark People had arrived, he boldly announced what he would be selling next: "Next, we're going to heavily promote the artworks." ”
The employees looked around and whispered among themselves, probably curious about how the advertiser, who originally wasn't very interested in art, had started caring about artworks.
In the end, Blue stepped forward, probably because he was the calmest among the Addisons. Like the others, he squinted, but when he looked at Spamton, he had a hint of submissiveness—even though he used to be their colleague, he had now become their superior.
“…… So, what style of artwork should we promote? "Blue asked, and the other employees all looked at him with admiration, making Blue break out in a cold sweat.
When asked this question, Spamton also hesitated a bit. He did know that you really liked art… or things with aesthetic appeal? Otherwise, you wouldn't have placed so many decorations in that somewhat cramped home, nor set up flower arrangements on the living room table, even if they were just fake flowers, and he actually couldn't appreciate such art at all, because he simply didn't understand it.
So the advertiser rarely fell silent for a moment. In the past, no matter what meeting he held, he would talk endlessly with almost no other employees getting a chance to speak. But today, he fell into a rare silence, making the staff below start to feel uneasy. Blue even began to wonder if he had said anything wrong.
In the end, the advertiser just waved his hand: "...... Promote any art! As long as it's beautiful, that's enough! ”
"However, the first thing we want to advertise is flower arrangements and potted plants made from trash cans—those bins are usually designed in artistic styles, so these bins are reusable, serving as artworks or as ordinary trash bins...... He finally began to introduce them enthusiastically, beaming with excitement, much longer than the string I told you about yesterday. At the same time, he opened several pop-ups to display all kinds of trash bins and his so-called flower arrangement artworks.
Blue hesitated, actually wanting to say that these trash bins probably had no real selling value—very few people would actually buy them.
But this time, yellow was the first to raise his hand and speak. He also opened a pop-up window displaying a black-and-white photo, also a work of art shaped like a urinal.
“…… Boss, do we want to promote this kind of art too?" yellow asked, magnifying the pop-up several times and pointing it right in front of Spamton.
Spamton originally wanted to scold Yellow a bit, but when he saw this so-called installation artwork, he fell silent—he was completely! No! He saw a bit of beauty in this thing!
In the end, he waved his hand and flicked the pop-up window with a big cross: "No, don't promote this kind of thing." At this point, he had to admit that maybe he couldn't quite understand the aesthetic of the Lightfolk...... And judging from the data he had, there were even many Lightfolk who pursued this kind of art. Spamton didn't understand, and he also thought you probably wouldn't like these things.
But...... There are still quite a few people of light who pursue these things? So he hesitated for a moment, then changed his mind: "Forget it, if it's art...... It can also be promoted as long as it's art-related. But things that look beautiful to the naked eye should be promoted more enthusiastically, like the flower arrangement I just mentioned." He was quite confident and opened several more pop-up windows. Besides the flower arrangements from the trash can earlier, there were also some paintings he knew were popular among humans, such as "Sunrise," "Sunflowers," and "Starry Night."
…… Of course, there were also some abstract paintings he really couldn't understand, and Spamton wasn't sure why the People of Light liked such things. But since they liked them, they could just promote them.
"If there's no problem, then adjourn. I think you all understood what I just said, right?" He waved his hand, ready to send them away.
At that moment, pink stepped forward: "...... Boss, I don't think flower arranging from trash bins has any promotional value. From what I know, the People of Light usually only use slender bottles for flower arranging. ”
"...But these multipurpose buckets should really suit the tastes of the Light Folk, after all, such slender containers don’t really have any other use." Spamton insisted on his point of view. Not only did he hate being opposed, but he also wanted to use this to prove himself—that the plan he proposed was indeed effective, and you could surely imagine the scene of him making a fortune!
"No, but the People of Light probably wouldn't buy it. After all, their families usually already have similar ......," Pink hadn't finished speaking before Spamton interrupted, who looked very impatient.
"Stop talking, they'll definitely buy it. Also, I think your home could probably use some art to decorate, so here’s what you’ll do: you first buy one flower arrangement per household based on the Dark Folk units." He announced domineeringly, completely ignoring the expressions of the employees below. Some employees gnashed their teeth in anger at him, while others just trembled and lowered their heads. The few Addisons exchanged glances, probably sending signals with their eyes, and eventually just lowered their heads in agreement.
Spamton, on the other hand, didn't care at all. After all, he was the master of the advertising world, and whatever the world wanted was up to him.
So he nodded in satisfaction, though he was a bit annoyed...... No matter what, he hated hearing his words contradicted, especially now with these employees he looked down on. He started to miss you, the taste of home, the warmth of your palm, your faint smile.
…… Now, Spamton suddenly really wants to go home. Just seeing you and talking to you is enough.
But he knows you're not home, so the little bit of anger he's built up can only turn into unspeakable grievance, waiting for you to come home and complain to you.
"Alright, meeting adjourned!" Spamton waved his hand, signaling the other Dark People to leave. He didn't want to see those people for the time being, so he drew a big cross to cover his face, so he wouldn't see those annoying guys again. At the same time, he created another pop-up displaying the price of flower arrangements in the trash can. Each pot was half-price for a limited time, only 250 Dark Coins!
On this day, the advertiser pulled out a card reader and slaughtered the dark coins of his employees. He looked at his income with joy, ready to show off to you when he got home.
Although advertisements for flower arrangements in trash bins are advertised, it seems there aren't many clicks from the people of light.
Meanwhile, you are busy with your daily work in the gallery, cleaning the dusty frames and preparing to display the artworks for the next exhibition. Just then, a colleague nearby seems to notice something and starts coming over to gossip with you.
"Ah, our tickets for this exhibition sold out really fast! It seems like the promotion lasted less than three hours and tickets were already sold out! The store manager is still considering whether to put out more tickets!" It said this while winking and making faces.
Your speed of cleaning the picture frame has slowed down. Actually, selling tickets doesn't really concern you, but the more tickets you sell, the higher your share will be. But usually, the tickets released have to be pulled and given away, and you have to find ways to give away some before you can barely sell out in half a month. How come this time it sold out in less than three hours? You just find this a bit strange.
“…… Is that so? Maybe the artist in this exhibition is very famous? "You answer absentmindedly, starting to wonder how Spamton's work is going and whether other colleagues will make things difficult. Although he tells you he'll definitely sell it, you don't really believe it, and now you're worried he'll be harassed by other colleagues again.
If only I had known...... I would have reminded him a few more times yesterday.
Actually, ever since you first started cleaning the frame, you've been worried something was off, which is why you've been cleaning it for so long.
A colleague clicked her tongue in dissatisfaction: "No, this time it's just an unknown little painter!" Unknown, the store manager was worried that less than half of the tickets might not sell, but now they were sold out. She was overjoyed. ”
Then she tugged at you again: "You've been wiping this frame since earlier, distracted. Tell me, is something wrong?" "She started making faces with you."
You coughed awkwardly twice, released the frame you'd already polished from the past, and started wiping the next one: "...... No, I don't have any issues. You know very well. I'm a citizen of light, and in the dark world, I don't know anyone except you. ”
Lying. You know you're lying, and you know your lies aren't very sophisticated, which makes you a bit nervous.
But your colleague just dragged out her words with an "Oh," seemingly not suspecting you: "I knew it, you don't look like you'd be looking for a boyfriend either." As she spoke, she moved a bit farther away from you and started tidying up the curtains and screens used for the exhibition on that side.
You paused for a moment and stopped what you were doing. She hadn't realized you were lying...... Maybe after spending so much time with Spamton, you've become a bit of a liar? You're not really sure.
But she's right—you don't want to find a boyfriend, nor do you want to be in a romantic relationship. For you...... That's an unlikely thing.
You lowered your eyes, recalling the food that had been placed on the table until it cooled, the argument that day, the moment you couldn't bear it anymore, covering your ears and instinctively running out, wanting to get as far as possible, and in the end, like Alice who had stumbled down a rabbit hole, you fell into this dark world.
To you, the dark world is much better than the light world. Think about it, your family's Addison wouldn't be like this, and when you think of Spamton, the corners of your mouth can't help but lift slightly. If your colleague saw this, they'd be shocked—they'd definitely ask who you're thinking of to make you so happy.
Maybe you want to go home, you want to see Spamton, even knowing he might be lying, you still want to hear his voice. At that moment, you start looking forward to the end of work, as if you can hear Spamton's words "Welcome home" again.
But when he says he likes you the most...... He probably just said it casually. Or maybe it's just that you haven't thought it through.
The store manager happily announced that she could leave early today—since the urgently printed tickets were sold out, she waved her hand and said, "You all got a three-day holiday." The other colleagues were very happy, because sometimes they had to stay until dinner time before leaving work, leaving them starving when they got home.
And you couldn't help but pause. Although you were just as happy, you also felt a bit worried. You won't have to go to work these days...... This means you'll have to wait at home for him to come home in vain, which makes you feel a bit anxious.
But it was also time to get off work. You gave a reluctant greeting to colleagues who were cheerfully saying goodbye, then returned to your expressionless demeanor and headed home. As usual, you pushed open the door and saw Spamton placing trays on the table. He was a bit at a loss seeing you come back, as you never returned this early before, so he quickly set down the tray, wiped his hands on his apron, hurriedly tidied up his slightly messy hair from rushing around the kitchen, and put on a big smiling face for you.
"Welcome back—did you get off work early today?" He warmly came over again, hanging your coat on a nearby coat rack, and placed your freshly taken briefcase on the coffee table.
"Well, because the art exhibition tickets sold quickly, the manager gave us a day off and even gave us three days off." You nodded, instinctively scratching Spamton's chin, and he paused for a moment before resting his chin on your palm and gently nuzzling. Yes, he really did crave this warmth—though, as the advertiser, he shouldn't have these trivial and subtle emotions anymore, or rather...... It wasn't suitable for his current status.
But he knows that in this home, he's just your addison. You tacitly stop talking about extra work matters, because for you, coming home is just a place to relax.
"So, I'm back, and barring any surprises, I'll probably be waiting for you to come home for the next few days." You said this in a pretending lighthearted tone, but the thought of waiting for him made you uneasy. Often, the one waiting holds the greatest hope, and also works the hardest, just like you did before.
So you can't help but pat Spamton's head again: "I know you work hard every day......" You want to say more, but Spamton can't wait to interrupt you.
"It's not hard! Y/N works out every day, so it's hard to support this family...... I've only done a small thing for you." Spamton shook his head. He knew very well...... The reason you were able to leave work early and still have three days off is probably because of the meeting he hosted this morning, which called for vigorous promotion of the art industry. Because of this, many people of darkness and light probably bought tickets for the exhibition.
If ...... It would be great if you could be so relaxed every day. But he also knew very well that he couldn't let you fall into that state. If you had to wait every day for his return with hope and fear—he wouldn't want that. As long as he could feel this feeling, that would be enough.
So even though he was stunned for a moment, he didn't say much, just said with a smile, "Then I absolutely have to finish my day's performance quickly, then come home early to find you!" He said this with absolute confidence, and you didn't take it seriously, just patted his head again.
"I know, but your job is tough too...... If you really have to work late, that's fine. ”
Out of sight, Spamton's eyes darted around as he pondered some questions—finally deciding to wait a few days.
"Well, if you come back late...... I'll tell Y/N." His head rubbed against your palm, then naturally led your hand to sit at the table, sitting across from you.
Spamton naturally complained to you again: "Let me tell you...... Although today's performance was all completed, it's still annoying! My Addison colleagues really are annoying! ”
"Yeah, I know they're annoying, after all, you're competitors too...... But that's already considered unfair competition. "You nodded, picked up a spoonful of pasta with your fork, and ate it.
"They say the plan I proposed is absolutely impossible—nonsense! The advertising plan I proposed will definitely get lots of Light Citizens to click on the pop-ups!" While speaking, he gestured wildly, spamton waving his arms and hands, probably trying to recreate the original scene for you. He even opened several dense pop-ups, filled with many photos of various trash cans and flower arrangements, all priced at 250 Dark Coins.
You looked at the price and held back, but didn't laugh. You just waved the pop-up window in front of you—it was almost crowding in front of you and interrupting your meal. Spamton noticed your actions and hurriedly shrank the pop-up window.
"So, how's the sales?" You just calmly asked, even though through the pop-up window, you couldn't see Spamton's expression.
But his voice sounded hesitant: "...... Today's sales are pretty good!" Although he raised his voice to emphasize this, you still felt a bit guilty about it.
But you didn't press further, since he said it was good...... At least a few pieces were sold, and that's what you know about the white Addison at home. Even though you don't know, he's changed a lot.
Spamton, of course, wouldn't tell you that the only sales today were forcibly sold to employees by selling those flower arrangements, and for now, no Lightminers have checked this ad pop-up. Of course, the rest of the business is pretty good—though some fraudulent practices have led to constant criticism, and many people still fall for it. Of course, the expected effect is still there, just not as flashy as the ads say—and it's much more expensive than ordinary products.
"Yeah, as long as sales are good...... So what your colleague said isn't quite right either. "Across the table, you can't comfort Spamton's head by patting him, but you're already thinking about whether one day you can treat these addisons to a meal...... And teach them a lesson, since at least you need to let these addisons know that their own addisons aren't easy to bully. After all, you're a protective person.
Thinking this, you also asked, "Otherwise, when will you ...... organize a dinner together? Let me meet the other Addisons? ”
Spamton's body stiffened instinctively, those pop-up windows disappeared, and his expression was somewhat blank. His first reaction was, what if you discovered his lie then—the second thought: what if you don't want him and instead keep another Addison at home? At that moment, he suddenly felt an overwhelming sense of panic, and because of this, he planned to hide his identity even better, at least for now...... He still couldn't let you find out.
If you know what Spamton is thinking, you'll probably just smile and say that's fine. You've already guessed he's lied to you, but that's okay. After all, what he says may be fake, but the emotions he expresses are never fake—so the favoritism you give him isn't fake either.
And you noticed Spamton was momentarily stunned, a bit puzzled, and finally waved his hand in front of him: "Hey, Spammy, what's wrong?" "You don't know why he's daydreaming again now, and you're a bit worried about him."
Then you asked, "…So what’s the problem? If you can’t get other Addisons, then forget it." You chose to give him another option first, after all, facing someone you were once afraid of is not easy. If Spamton couldn’t muster the courage to do it, then that’s fine.
Spamton snapped back to reality and quickly shook his head: "No...... No, it's fine. I was just thinking, uh, just thinking about something...... Y/N, you're not blaming me, are you? "He lowered his head, his voice pitiful, making it hard for you to ask what he was really thinking. Maybe he was recalling something related to those Addisons.
You sighed and softened your voice: "Of course I won't blame you...... I will never truly blame you." Your words were very serious, and to you, this was indeed a very sincere promise—you thought you'd never have the chance to say the word 'forever' in your lifetime, but now, it flowed so smoothly that you were momentarily stunned.
…… Probably, it doesn't matter. That's how you think about it.
Spamton nodded vigorously, still keeping his head down, silently rolling up the pasta and eating. He didn't want you to see his eyes suddenly redden—that would be terrible. He just wanted to show you his beautiful face. He didn't say anything more; he was afraid you would notice anything unusual.
You also seemed a bit distracted, and for a moment, the dining table fell silent, with only the sound of knives and forks clashing with ceramics.
After dinner, Spamton got up as usual to start clearing the table. You stood up too, ready to help him tidy up. After all, you hadn't worked hard today, and besides, starting tomorrow, you have a three-day holiday.
But Spamton held your hand down. For some reason, his words even carried a hint of seriousness: "Leave these things to me, you don't need to come to the kitchen." ”
You paused, then looked up at him—yes, now you have to look up at him. You don't even know when it started.
"Why?" You simply asked three words.
Spamton hesitated; he admitted that this did sound a bit like a bit of a presumptuous opinion...... Or rather, he was just making a pure assumption. When he first learned you worked at a gallery, he thought you would also do some painting work, but no matter how he looked at it, he couldn't see the tools or you were doing what he thought he was.
But...... He rarely shows a bit of a childish temper, or maybe he's always had a similar temperament—he just blocks your hand, popping up countless crossed pop-up windows.
"There's no reason! No means it's not allowed!" You heard Spamton's voice, and for some reason, it sounded a bit annoying, making you laugh uncontrollably. It seemed like you heard your laughter, and you felt Spamton glare at you through those pop-up windows.
And you put away your smile: "Alright, alright, I know it's not allowed." ”
Only then did he happily withdraw those pop-up windows. In fact, not letting you go to the kitchen was just a childish excuse—he didn't want you, who had done so much, to have your time occupied by these trivial matters. He also didn't want your smile, your hands, everything about you to be completely altered by the passage of time or other such reasons.
Just maintain the status quo, as long as it stays as it is—at least, that's what Spamton hopes for.
Although you don't know why he won't let you into the kitchen—you still go in a few times without him seeing. Sometimes you see he hasn't come back to prepare dinner for him; other times, it's just for the sake of ...... You're a bit hungry, so you go to the kitchen to see if there's anything else edible. Although the countertop doesn't have many items, when you open the fridge door, you'll always find the fridge door packed to the brim...... Basically, it's all for tomorrow's food and your favorite foods. Chocolate, fruit candy, brownies, tiramisu...... Everything is there, and you can't tell if he bought them from outside or made them himself. In any case, you still casually pick up the candy and toss it into your mouth, the corners of your mouth lifting involuntarily.
Spamton usually isn’t much into eating these cakes… He would just smile and rest his chin while watching you eat, and for a moment, you felt like you saw a peacock spreading its feathers, as he was beaming with pride, craving praise.
And often, you'll laugh and say, "Spamton's craftsmanship is amazing!" Then pat his head again.
And he would lift his head, squint his eyes, looking thoroughly satisfied, while secretly hiding his burned fingers from cooking behind his back. He wouldn't tell you all this was made after studying the recipes for days...... He even blew up several kitchens on his office building's side.
In short, you just sat on the sofa, listening to the sound of running water from the kitchen, treating it as white noise. You casually took a book from the shelf and started flipping through it. After reading tens of pages intently, you yawned, and the sound of running water in the kitchen seemed to disappear, and you covered the book with it on your lap. You closed your eyes and slowly drifted off to sleep.
When you wake up again, you find a soft pillow and bed beneath you—and the blanket has been thoughtfully covered, with your outer clothes taken off. No doubt, it's obvious Spamton did this. He could have woken you up, probably thinking you were sleeping too soundly.
You got up, changed your clothes, glanced at the time, and then walked out of the bedroom door, yawning. Of course, Spamton wasn't there, but there was still a steaming hot breakfast on the table. I guess he had hurriedly prepared it for you not long ago before leaving again.
You sat down munching on some bread, a bit annoyed. You had hoped to get up a bit earlier today, at least ...... After all, you had a day off and nothing much to do. Of course, you could have gotten up earlier to see him out and wait for him to come home in the evening. Maybe work had been too exhausting these past few days, and you hadn't been woken up by any noise.
Of course you don't know, in the morning Spamton closed the door and kitchen door as if it were a serious matter, studied it quietly, and lowered the voice, afraid of disturbing your sleep.
But since it's a holiday and there's nothing to do, why not go shopping? Although I haven't asked about Spamton's work status, it's fine to take a quick look at the shopping street, since Addison works there.
So after packing up, you head out, heading to the commercial street.
There, what you see is still the familiar Addison—pink, blue, yellow...... But there is no white one. You strolled casually down the commercial street, a bit surprised—why did every shop display those flower arrangements in trash bins, and ...... There were ads for half price, limited to 250 Dark Coins.
Well, whoever buys this flower arrangement is a fool...... You muttered to yourself, but still walked over, casually walked into the blue Addison shop, picked up a bucket of flower arrangements, and casually said, "I'll buy this...... By the way, I remember there's a white Addison among your Addisons. Where is he? ”
Seeing that it was you, Blue forced himself to resist the urge to make a sarcastic comment. After all, Spamton had repeatedly ordered that if he saw you, he should definitely not tell you that he was now the master of the advertising world—he even posted your photo for them to see, and every once in a while would show off, pretending to nonchalantly indicate how much you cared about him. Blue felt he was just making things up.
But...... Hearing your question, he hesitated for a moment. Spamton's earlier nervousness and panic flashed through his mind. He also knew Spamton had been trying to cultivate flowers and plants in the office every day, but had failed every time. All that resentment and confusion were vented on them. Later, he suddenly made a bunch of fake flowers to take away. Now it seemed it was all for you.
Maybe out of compassion, or out of pity, Blue decided to keep it secret for Spamton, so he said something insincere, and in the meantime, put another colleague down.
"You mean spamton?" He...... He didn't come to work today. "As he spoke, Blue placed the tub of flower arrangements into your hand.
He didn't say much, but it was actually a lie. The advertiser had already been sitting in his office early today, and was even asking them to hurry out and advertise these things, even if no Light Citizens clicked.
You blinked, and understood automatically. After all, this so-called trash can flower arrangement was now sold by all Addisons and seemed quite popular...... Spamton lost its business, so it was normal it didn't come to the commercial street. But if it wasn't here, where could it go? You suspected this, so you could only thank you anxiously, pay 250 Dark Coins, then wandered around the commercial street holding the tub of floral arrangements, but indeed didn't see Spamton.
And you even went to the trash bin where you had found Spamton earlier, but didn't see him. You started to get a bit anxious, since you didn't know where else Spamton could go besides these places.
But unknowingly, you notice that this city in the dark world has also changed. What used to be connected skyscrapers have now somehow turned into island-like cities. Maybe it's a change of owners. Thinking this way, a flash of inspiration flashes through your mind, but you don't catch it, or maybe...... You actually think of something, but you find it a bit ridiculous.
Could such a small, pitiful Addison become the master of this world? And if so, why not tell yourself? You would only feel joy and pride in his success, after all, a domesticated Addison is amazing, able to achieve such great accomplishments.
You suppress your anxiety and still go home with that bucket of flowers. You have no mood to stay on the commercial street any longer...... To be honest, you went there just to secretly check on Spamton's current situation, and now that he's not here, you don't need to go anymore.
This sense of anxiety reached its peak when you received a text saying Spamton would be home late today and you didn’t need to wait for him. Where had he gone, and what was he doing? All these messy thoughts swirled in your mind. Since he didn’t go to work today… could it be that he was now arguing with other Addisons? Would he win, would he be bullied? These thoughts kept circling in your mind, and you could only anxiously take a frozen pizza from the freezer, heat one for yourself as dinner, and then thought to heat another one for Spamton in case he came back early.
But at first, you sat upright by the table, waiting. Then you got a bit tired, propped up your head, yawned, forced your eyes open, and finally fell asleep on the desk, not even waiting for Spamton to come back.
There was even a moment when you worried he would never return, just like the two people you waited for before—clearly your parents, your family, but never truly listened to you, nor truly fulfilled the request you once promised. Then came arguments, wiping away tears and crying bitterly as you fled, until you didn't know where you were and finally arrived in the dark world, until you found Spamton, the family you now think of.
So you tell yourself, no, after all...... This is your home.
Then, you hear the door open. Instinctively, you look up and see Spamton standing outside, panting heavily. He looks like he's just running back, his hair still bristling. When he opens the door and sees you sleepy, he instinctively scratches his head, returns to his usual self, smiles, closes the door, and says softly, "Didn't I tell you not to wait for me? Look...... I came back very late. ”
After a pause, he added, "But I'm back." "As if emphasizing." After all, this is his home—how could he not come back to rest?
You just rubbed your eyes, forced yourself to perk up, and said, "Welcome home." ”
Then there was a moment of silence between you. He sat nervously in the chair across from him, saw the pizza on the table, and instinctively wanted to pick up a piece and eat it. Even though it was already completely cold.
But you stopped his hand: "It's cold...... Go to the kitchen and warm it up before you eat. ”
Spamton let out a soft "Oh." Even though he was back so late, he was still waiting for him here, and he felt a bit guilty.
"I did this voluntarily. I wanted to wait for you to come back." You just forced a smile, now feeling a bit relieved. It turned out you had bet right...... He would come back.
"I'll definitely be back. You're just too tired waiting here all this time......" He instinctively wanted to argue, but before he could finish, you interrupted him.
"No, I'm not tired." You shake your head. He's here waiting here every day...... For him, the daily waiting and restlessness must have been exhausting.
But for some reason, that restless feeling vanished the moment you saw him. You probably think he was the same.
Spamton shut his mouth and said nothing more, just picked up his plate and headed to the kitchen, then noticed the bucket of flowers you placed on the counter.
His expression stiffened for a moment. At that moment, he was relieved to have turned his back to you, so you couldn't see his expression.
Spamton's voice was a bit dry as he asked, "Why did you buy this bucket of flower arrangements?" ”
"Ah...... I wanted to go shopping on the commercial street today. I saw that the shops were all displaying these flower arrangements from trash bins, and they even advertised. "You glanced at the flower arrangement bucket, a bit puzzled as to why Spamton's tone was so stiff now. Maybe he wasn't happy seeing other Addison sell items with the same idea as him?"
"If you don't like me, just put it away...... Oh, right, so where did you go today? That blue Addison said you didn't go to work. I went to the garbage heap to find you, but I didn't see you. ”
You see him shake his head, firmly but with a hint of panic: "No, no need, flower arrangements look pretty nice in the living room...... As for where I went, it's a bit late. Can we talk about this tomorrow?" For some reason, his tone carried a hint of caution.
You nodded matter-of-factly: "Of course...... Speaking of which, the flower arranging business should be pretty good, right? ”
Since it's almost time to sleep, let's casually find some topics to chat.
"Hmm...... Otherwise, why would they steal my business! Spamton's voice rose again; he was probably in the kitchen, and his voice sounded a bit muffled.
It's fake—actually, only you—and the only one among the people of light who bought this flower arrangement.
But you don't know, just yawn, lie face down on the table, and fall asleep again.

title: Time Practices (Five)
path: articles/en/spt/时行 end/时行（swapsptx你）/时行（五）.html
content:
[5]
You returned home as usual. Indeed, having to chat with Addison and analyze the truth about past events is exhausting for you. You just leaned wearily on the sofa, watching Spamton unusually serve you tea and pat your shoulders on the sofa, which made you want to laugh a little—though you can't say he was exceptionally attentive; rather, it was usually the same. It was just that today's excessive attention made you feel a bit flattered.
So even though you took a sip of tea, you couldn't help but marvel at whether it was just the right temperature or just the right flavor to your liking, and you couldn't help but ask curiously: "...... Why are you so attentive today? Did you do something to let me down? ”
Speaking of which...... The temperature of the tea was just right. He wondered how many cups of coffee he had brewed before, and how many cups of coffee had been thrown by those Addisons. Thinking of this, you seemed a bit distracted, but quickly snapped back to reality, just shook your head, and tossed those thoughts out of your mind.
Spamton’s action of patting your shoulder stiffened for a moment. If he weren’t able to tell that your tone was purely curious, he might have thought that you actually knew something.
You felt the movement behind you stop, and no sound came from you. You turned to look at Spamton in confusion, and he quickly turned your face away, cleared his throat, and pretended to be deep.
"What are you talking about...... Of course I haven't done anything to betray you! If I really did, I'd rather punch myself......" His voice sounded a bit pitiful, sounding aggrieved as he said this, though the first half was pretending to be relaxed. You could tell he was speaking sincerely, but Spamton seemed nervous, so much so you wanted to tease him for a moment.
“Ah, I see…” you dragged out your voice, looking back at Spamton, and Spamton quickly nodded in confirmation.
You cupped his cheek, sighed softly, and gently stroked his cheek: "You don't need to do that. Besides, I trust you. You won't do anything to betray me." "These words come from the heart. You truly believe this. You trust Spamton...... It seems like the first time since that time in the Light World that you've trusted anyone other than yourself so much. You were slightly distracted, but quickly gathered your thoughts and gently stroked his face once more.
"But...... So, you can't tell me you're hiding something from me, are you?" You tilted your head. You're pretty sure Spamton hasn't told you the whole truth, but you don't really care...... After all, sometimes, when he's saying this and that, even if you see him showing a fake smile or a pitiful, miserable expression, beneath that, in his voice, you hear the hidden lines—no matter what, he looks like he's about to cry, and you can only hear and feel his sadness.
So no matter what he said, this sadness was real...... You were willing to believe him. Although the facts may be fabricated, the emotions behind them are definitely not fake.
Spamton just blinked twice, suddenly afraid to look at you. But when you cupped his face and met his gaze, he couldn't avoid it and could only look at you.
“…… Of course not, it's all sincere and sincere. "He stammered, looking a bit guilty, his eyes darting around, but he didn't dare look you in the eye. Even as he said that, his heart was pounding wildly, because...... From the moment we first met, he hadn't really told you the truth.
Spamton wasn't sure what he'd think if he told you the truth...... Would you be disappointed, would you be sad? Thinking of this, he couldn't help but feel heartache...... He couldn't figure out whether he was afraid of being exposed, that he lost his home, or that he didn't want to see your disappointed and sad face, or that he didn't want to see you hurt.
You stared at Spamton, watching his eyes dart around, but in the end, you didn’t expose him. You thought, alright, then you’ll tell me when the time comes — or when I have no choice but to face the truth. Until then, I’ll just pretend I don’t know anything.
So you just patted Spamton's head, your eyes slightly curved: "I see...... Then our Spammy is so well-behaved! What reward do you want? "Actually, you were just saying it offhand, and for some reason, it always feels like you're coaxing a kid...... Well, it's understandable.
Spamton rubbed his head against your hand, his voice a bit muffled again. In fact, he was a bit flattered—after all, before this, he had never thought that doing well would come with rewards. It seemed like doing well was just a given. Now he made the same demands for his subordinates, so Spamton reflected and decided he should give employees more rewards and the like...... He was just copying your methods.
"I...... I don't want anything, just hope you can stay with me a little longer. His voice was muffled and a bit light, just holding your hand and pressing it against his cheek, then gently rubbing against it.
You looked at him and scratched his cheek: "Mm...... Then I'll try to come home a little earlier. Also, I'll be with you all day today. ”
He still didn't look at you, just nodded firmly, then hurriedly changed the subject and said, "By the way, I haven't finished the artworks those people ordered yet—I have to get busy with this first!" ”
At this moment, he felt a bit relieved that he had told you about the reservation earlier; otherwise, he wouldn't have known what to say at this moment.
You nodded and let go: "Alright, you go ahead and get back to work. I'll go do my own things first...... But I'll always be at home." You emphasized the last sentence, then moved a little away, just sitting on the sofa resting your chin on your hand and watching Spamton.
Spamton let out a light breath. He took a few bottles of mineral water from the coffee table, cut them open with scissors to look proper, then glued them together to make something resembling a sunflower. However, his craftsmanship wasn't very good, so the results were a bit crooked.
You look at him boredly for a while, then swallow hard...... You suddenly feel an impulse, but this impulse makes you nervous and uneasy. You haven't done this in a long time, so you don't know how your craft is now—you've given up so long that you think you'll never pick up a paintbrush again.
But if that's the case, why did you find a way to buy art supplies on your very first day in the Dark World, but only lock those old paintings along with the supplies in a small box? Maybe you didn't have the courage before, but now you've gathered a bit of courage and are willing to open that box again.
You squatted by the bed, looked up at Spamton, and gazed into the distance...... So focused, undistracted. You know, it was because of him that you decided to open the box again and take out your painting supplies.
So you quietly opened the box, set up the easel, and clamped the canvas — since you just wanted to sketch something quickly, you didn’t use a large canvas. Then, you took out brushes of different sizes and squeezed out the still-wet paint. Squinting, you aimed your brush at Spamton and quietly measured the proportions. Then you made a small sketch on a piece of paper with a pencil — your skill hadn’t faded; it was still as vivid as ever.
After finishing your draft, you sneak a glance at Spamton, seeing that he's still absorbed in the so-called artwork, clearly uninterested in what you're doing. Only then do you quietly breathe a sigh of relief, grab your brush and palette, and begin smearing and sketching on the canvas, sketching his silhouette.
You don't know how much time has passed, but when you come to your senses, your figure has already appeared hastily on the canvas, just waiting to dry it all. You feel a bit guilty, glance at the time—it's almost dinner. You hurriedly put down your brush, hurriedly walk out, even close the door behind you, and then sit down on the sofa.
The sofa collapsed in one spot. Of course, Spamton felt it. He looked at you, and at the same time regretted it—he really hadn't paid attention to your whereabouts that afternoon! Still, it's that so-called artwork that drew his attention, but...... Your craftsmanship and creativity are truly impressive. Even though the sunflowers you made are so lifelike, Spamton doesn't understand why you're only satisfied with your current small job, but he's too embarrassed to ask you more—what if you happen to be asking about something you dislike?
If you hear it, you'll just smile and answer, and that's okay. Even if you ask about something you dislike, you won't blame Spamton—after all, it's just that you didn't make it clear at first.
At this moment, he panicked and looked up, checked the time, then patted his head in frustration: "...... Oh no, I forgot to prepare dinner for you in advance......" After saying that, he carefully watched your expression and noticed your tightly closed door, pausing for a moment.
You just wave your hand: "It's fine, just eat something casually...... There's still instant pizza in the fridge anyway, how about that? ”
Spamton puffed out his cheeks: "Eating fast food all the time isn't healthy......" Then you lean in and poke his cheek. The puffed cheeks quickly shrink back, and he just touches his own cheek and glances at you with a hint of complaint.
"But it's just an occasional meal, so it's fine!" He understood what you meant, so Spamton announced loudly.
You nod in satisfaction and got up to head to the kitchen for a hot pizza, but Spamton's next sentence made you stop in your tracks.
"Well...... I'm a bit curious, just curious! "This sentence sounds like some kind of supplement, "Exactly, why did you close your door?" ”
You don't even need to look back to know Spamton is probably looking a bit guilty at her finger at this moment, which makes you laugh a little. But you still hold back and slowly reply, "Ah, my room...... Because you prepared a surprise for me recently, I plan to prepare a surprise for you too. ”
Actually, this is the reason you just came up with: you feel proud of your brilliant whims—well, it's just that you don't dare show it to him right now. You don't want anyone to know or be involved in your past, for now...... It's enough for you to face those things alone.
Or maybe one day, you'll be able to openly reveal your past to him. But at least not now.
So, before you're fully prepared to show him, isn't that a surprise? One day you'll let him see it, and you believe in that.
Spamton was momentarily stunned, his voice rising: "Surprise?! I—I'm really looking forward to it!" He really started imagining what kind of surprise you'd prepare for him.
You scratched your cheek, feeling a bit embarrassed seeing him so excited and his eyes sparkling. You just cleared your throat, cleared your throat, cleared your throat, and added, "You said it was a surprise...... Maybe, not that surprising? I don't know if you'll like it...... As you spoke, your tone was a bit hesitant. You really didn't know what Spamton's preferences were. It seemed like he liked everything you gave him, but in contrast, he seemed to know your preferences quite well.
Spamton just shook his head: "It's fine, as long as it's prepared by you, I'll like whatever it is." He swore with absolute certainty, and he also believed that you wouldn't prepare anything that was truly hard for him to accept—he believed that what you would bring him would definitely be something wonderful and a wonderful experience.
You cleared your throat twice, a bit embarrassed: "...... Not necessarily...... But before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you.
"Definitely!" He raised his voice, "I think what Y/N prepared is the best!" ”
And he looked so proud, as if his feathers had lifted up.
You blink and glance at him a few times, then can't help but smile and nod: "Alright, I know. Then I'll look forward to seeing you react with such a surprise." "You think it's because Spamton is here that you start looking forward to tomorrow, the day after, and every day to come...... Originally, you just thought this day was just passing through casually, so what else was there to look forward to, or what meaning was there? But...... Maybe from the very first day you found him, the gears started turning again, and you started looking forward to the next day.
Spamton nodded vigorously, his face beaming with a smile: "Of course, I'm looking forward to that surprise too!" ”
Because of your and his expectations, after the meal you hurriedly finished that painting—but you hesitated looking at it, still not daring to show it directly to Spamton. Because, after all this time, you still don't know how your drawing skills have become. You think maybe you should show it to the other Dark People first, confirm that the painting is truly impressive, and then show Spamton this surprise.
If ...... If everyone thinks it's not good, then just draw a new one. It doesn't matter how many you make—after all, you have to prepare well for this surprise for your own Spamton. So until the other Dark People sigh, you won't take out your painting.
But if the other Dark People have seen the painting, it's not just a surprise for Spamton. Even though you didn't say it at first, you still felt it wasn't very good. After thinking it over...... Maybe you'll have the courage to take out the remaining paintings later. No one but you and your parents has seen them, so giving them to Spamton as a surprise is just right.
Thinking this, you can't help but smile, pack up the other art supplies, and step out with the oil painting—coincidentally, the gallery is recently holding an exhibition of works about different Dark People's perceptions of beauty, and many Dark People have submitted their works. Think about it, you can submit too. This painting...... It probably represents your understanding of beauty.
So you hang this painting on an empty spot on the wall, step back a couple of steps to admire it, and indeed, it looks quite nice here, not out of place at all.
Your colleague noticed your actions and came over curiously, glanced at the painting on the wall, then stiffened a bit, and his voice was dry: "Uh...... Who is the artist of this painting? ”
You tilted your head in confusion: "I drew it...... What's wrong? ”
You're still a bit nervous—what if someone says your paintings aren't good or something—but you hear an unexpected question.
“…… Do you know who you're drawing?" My colleague hesitated, just staring at you.
You tilted your head in confusion: "Hmm...... Spamton, huh? What's so special? Oh, right, he's not very famous for Addison, right? After all, he can't sell anything, so it's normal you don't know about him...... You can't help but start muttering.
"But he's a very good Dark Citizen. Although he can't grow flowers, he still seriously prepared a surprise for me—even though it was made with fake flowers, and he even said he wants to sell the idea of flower arranging from the trash can. It seems like business is going well, and his colleagues have even come to snatch his stuff......" As you continue, you don't notice your colleague quieting down, just looking at you with a hesitant expression.
"Recently, he suddenly had an idea to make a creative flowerpot or something. I made a demonstration of making a sunflower for him, and he imitated it, so that's why I recorded this scene...... I don't even know if the painting looks good, but anyway, this is my understanding of beauty...... Because of him, I started looking forward to tomorrow, I began to ......" You opened your mouth, but felt too shy to say the rest. Honestly, you didn't dare say things to Spamton, but here you boasted and told others...... You blamed yourself in your heart.
"Anyway, I want to give this painting to Spamton as a return gift, but I don't know how my painting skills have improved after all this time, so I put it on the gallery for exhibition. I want to hear what other Dark People have to say." You cleared your throat twice and summed up for yourself. After all, you can't keep talking about it forever. Although you could probably talk about Spamton for a few days and nights, even if your mouth is dry, that's fine.
The colleague sighed, then stepped forward to cover your mouth, nervously looking left and right. You tried to pry his hand away, but your colleague just lowered his voice and said, "...... Don't you know that name can't be mentioned casually in the Underworld? ”
You were confused for a moment, then instinctively shook your head. You'd never heard such a thing before. Could it be that Spamton was asking other Dark People to use other names to address him? Or was his reputation so big that even the other Dark People didn't dare call him by that name? Somehow, you subconsciously rejected that possibility—maybe you just didn't want to believe it.
Your colleague’s voice was nervous: “It’s Spamton…! You shouldn’t just shout his name; otherwise, he would get upset, and I can’t say what measures he might use to punish other Darks… but saying a few words quietly now and then is fine; he can’t hear it.” He finally let go of your hand but still kept staring at you, probably afraid you’d say something inappropriate again.
You hesitate for a moment, but finally ask, "So how do you usually address him?" ”
“…… The master of advertising, or the king of advertising. "The colleague's voice was soft, but still enough for you to hear those two words clearly. You were silent for a moment, and although you quickly understood—but you still found it a bit hard to believe: how could things have turned out this way, how could the truth be like this?
Your voice became a bit dry: "So...... Is he the master of this advertising world?" "When you ask this question, although you feel a bit nervous, you also feel a bit relieved...... You think about it, you really have already guessed it, but you just haven't been sure of this answer.
The colleague nodded solemnly, looked at the painting again, and scratched his cheek: "I don't dare comment on anything else...... Anyway, your brushwork is excellent, your color choices are just right, and the whole painting feels warm and inviting. That's all there is to it. ”
Then he hurriedly left his place. You silently watched the back of this Dark Citizen, then glanced at the oil painting hanging on the wall, staring at Spamton in a daze. At that moment, you felt very close to him, yet somehow inexplicably far away. No matter what kind of Dark Citizen he was, no matter what identity he was, to you he was just a weak, pure white Addison who needed care.
…… Alright, maybe he doesn't really need care. But you think he still needs it. Otherwise, if he, a Dark Commoner, is so high and mighty, how lonely must that be? It's okay to pretend you know nothing and just go back like this, right?
But you still want to ask him, that's just ...... Simply ask him, even if you think this matter isn't important, since he's kept it from you for so long, there must be a reason. You just want to know the reason.
On this day, you were working in the gallery as usual, but...... No Dark People came to admire the painting; most only glanced at it from afar and then walked away in fright. Only a few dared to come over and take a closer look, but they left in a hurry after leaving with a few words of praise. You had hoped to hear some sincere advice, but now you can't help but worry.
By the time the gallery closed, the last few Darks who entered only left words of praise. You sighed, took down the oil painting, and prepared to take it home. Given that, you had no choice but to show it directly to Spamton.
At that moment, another colleague came over again. She didn't seem so afraid of this advertiser—he was a Renwu management girl. You glanced at her twice, and she smiled warmly: "I want to know, what's his relationship with you?" ”
You were stumped by that question. Honestly, you hadn't considered this question at all. Maybe you've been together for so long—you've gotten used to it, and you're used to spamton being with you.
"Uh...... It's just ordinary friends, right? But since we live together and know each other well, it's roughly ...... ...... like family? "You say this, but for some reason, you can't help but feel a bit melancholy, as if you're completely dissatisfied with this answer.
She said meaningfully, "Oh—", and you couldn't help but shiver. Not knowing what else she wanted to say, you could only widen your eyes and watch her warily.
"Then...... What do you think of him? "She asked.
You tilt your head and answer without thinking, "My Spamton is definitely the best." After saying this, you belatedly cover your mouth, remembering that his name shouldn't be said carelessly...... Of course, no other dark people heard it either.
She just said meaningfully, "Oh—" twice, waved the braid she was holding, and smiled: "Then...... I hope you two can stay together for a long time. ”
You blink and nod: "Of course...... Yes, we will. After all, that's our home. "So of course you both will go home.
And she didn't say anything more, just walked away. You hugged the painting and also walked toward home. You began to ponder: should you show Spamton this surprise first, or ask him the advertiser's question first, so he could find out why he's been hiding it from you all along?
In the end, you decide to show him the surprise first—after all, what he hides from you isn't really important; the surprise is what matters.
When you got home and opened the door, you indeed saw Spamton wearing an apron, placing steaming hot dishes on the table. Seeing you come back, he smiled and said, "Welcome home!" ”
You nodded and couldn't help but smile: "Mm...... I'm back. The surprise I prepared for you is just for you. But let's come back after dinner!" Before you went home, you even pulled a piece of cloth to cover the oil painting. After all, surprises always have to leave some suspense. As for the questions, I'll ask them later. You hope that at least during dinner, he can be happy and looking forward to it, that's all.
As expected, you saw Spamton’s eyes light up instantly; he practically couldn’t wait and ran around you in circles.
"Now...... Can't you know what the surprise really is? "He bent down slightly, looked up at you, and looked at you with a hint of pity.
But you just shook your head and made a gesture to be quiet: "No, that's not allowed. Let's wait until after dinner to see what the surprise is!" ”
Spamton nodded, eagerly returning to his seat, and also invited you to take a seat: "Then let's hurry up and eat!" "He really wanted to know what surprise you had prepared for him."
And you just smiled and placed the oil painting on the sofa. You want ...... You really are happy to show him this surprise, since at least the brand new present and future are something you both walked out together. So treating it as a surprise, as a keepsake and a memento of his past moments, is just right.
…As for the things going further back, you weren’t ready to reveal them to him yet. So tonight, you both just had a rare quiet dinner. Spamton, who usually dragged out his meals and always wanted to chat with you, ate quickly tonight because he was so eager to know what the surprise was. On the other hand, you maintained your usual slow pace, as if teasing him, and Spamton could only look at you longingly, unable to urge you to hurry.
Finally, you finished your meal. He quickly cleared the dishes and headed to the kitchen, then sat beside the oil painting covered with a layer of cloth, looking at you expectantly: "So, do I know what the surprise is now?" ”
You also sat on the sofa, just on the other side of the painting, gently nodding with a smile: "Of course, you can open it yourself and take a look." "Do you think that if he lifted the canvas and saw the truth himself, the sense of surprise and happiness would be even stronger?" You wouldn't be sure.
Spamton swallowed hard, unusually nervous, but also a bit disappointed and uneasy—after all, he saw you walk in carrying this thing. What if you just casually bought some landscape painting or decoration as a surprise to brush him off? Although—although he really does feel happy no matter what you give him, being brushed off like that does make him feel a bit disappointed too.
So at this moment, his hands were trembling a little, and Spamton was even a bit annoyed. Why did he have to reveal the final answer? You could have told him directly—though that surprise wouldn't be a surprise, and he knew he was just making a fuss.
In the end, he closed his eyes, held his breath, lifted the cloth, and then slowly opened them—only to see himself sitting on the sofa that day, focused on his not-so-nimble handiwork. Spamton's eyes widened instantly. He knew only you had seen this scene, and only you could see it—and almost no one in the advertising world dared to paint him, so this painting was probably, no, or rather, definitely by your own hands.
But if you find someone else—and his heart is on high alert—what if you learn something from those Dark Civilians that you didn't know before? Because of this, the joy that came from the surprise was now somewhat washed away by nervousness and unease.
Yet joy and happiness prevailed, and for that reason, Spamton hugged the oil painting, his eyes sparkling as he looked at you: “This… you drew this? You painted me!”
You nodded, and Spamton secretly breathed a sigh of relief in his heart, but for some reason, he was still a bit uneasy.
"Yes, I drew this...... Actually, I haven't painted in a long time, so I don't know if what I created now suits your taste...... You scratched your head, but before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you.
"No, it's fine, I really like it!" He shook his head and nodded, then added, trying to make up for it, "I'm not saying your painting isn't good...... It's just that even though I don't know much about drawing, I can tell you've put your heart into this work. Whether it's the colors or the shape of the work, it's all excellent...... He gestured wildly with his hands, but when it came to the moment, he couldn't find the right adjective.
Moreover, he could tell that you had invested emotion into the painting...... Or rather, you had invested emotion into the person in the painting; at least at this moment, he could feel himself surrounded by that warm feeling. Although ...... He didn't understand, or rather, couldn't believe what kind of emotion you were projecting in the painting. Maybe it was warm love......? He thought of the word, but then dismissed it himself. Spamton didn't dare to believe these easily.
You watched him waving his arms and feet and couldn't help but chuckle, while Spamton leaned in and gently rubbed his head against your cheek—fluffy and a bit ticklish, but not uncomfortable. You paused, then gently tugged his cheek with your hand: "As long as you like it...... But I have a few questions I want to ask you too. ”
Spamton's body stiffened for a moment; he didn't realize that his voice had become a bit hoarse and tinged with bitterness: "What is the problem?" Anything I know, I'll tell you. ”
You blink gently, turn your head and only see the furry top of his head, while you simply reach out and gently stroke his cheek: "Hmm...... Do you know who the real owner of this dark world, this advertising world? ”
Spamton wanted to say, of course he didn't know! After all, he was just a lowly addison; how could he possibly have any contact with the lofty master of the advertising world? But then he remembered the lie he told you before, when he said he wanted the owner of the advertising world to back him up, so he could return to the shopping street to do business. If that were the case...... The two would be at odds, and he grew increasingly nervous, wanting to quickly come up with a good excuse to cover up the previous lies. Maybe lies just keep piling up.
But at this moment, he was extremely nervous, his mind completely blank, unable to come up with any good excuse, so he stammered, "N-I don't know." As soon as he finished speaking, his heart sank; he knew he would definitely tell this was a lie.
You just silently stared at the top of his head, knowing he was lying, and you could choose to expose him right now—but you still let it go gently, slowly saying, "Do you really not know who it is?" ”
“…… Alright, I know, but if I say it, you probably wouldn't recognize me either......" His voice grew quieter and his speech quickened, afraid you'd keep pestering this question.
"Do I really not recognize him? What exactly is the name of that advertiser?" You scratched the top of his head, gently rubbed—in other words, you came with an answer—which might not be ideal, but you also want to hear Spamton admit his lie.
Spamton fell silent. At this point, if you call yourself the advertiser, he knows you must know the truth—if you keep hiding it, you might lose all patience and expose his clumsy lies. In the past, he always thought he could easily fool you, but this time, it seemed impossible to fool you no matter what.
He didn't realize that most of those easy things in the past were just your indulgence.
“…… Spamton G. Spamton。 In the end, he reluctantly said his name.
Then he closed his eyes, as if awaiting the final judgment. He was very anxious. After learning the truth, you might have been furious or exhausted, and you might have kicked him out of the house—even though this was already a place he deeply cherished and reluctant to part. But your reactions were completely different from what he expected.
You just gently pat his head: "So...... You are the master of this advertising world. "Your voice is certain, after all, for you...... This is something you already know the answer to.
Spamton silently nodded gently. The calmer your reaction, the more nervous he became—he didn't know exactly what you would do; he just felt it was all over.
"Our Spamton is really something—he actually managed to become the master of the Dark World." And you just cupped his face, rubbing his cheek with the top of your head—fluffy.
Spamton stared blankly open, still a bit incredulous, but hesitantly asked, "You...... Aren't you blaming me? Aren't you angry? ”
You poked his head: "I told you, I will never truly blame you." As for being angry—that is indeed a little. "You dragged out your words, watching his expression turn tense and confused.
But you just poked his forehead again: "Why didn't you tell me you were angry and faced all this alone? You, a little Dark Citizen, have reached such a high position. How exhausting must it be? How lonely it must be to stay there." Angry is that you're still putting on a show in front of me...... Do you want to hide your true self? That must be so exhausting, how exhausting. This is clearly your home, you can relax a little. ”
Spamton stared at you in a daze. You didn't understand why his eyes were red, or why tears were streaming down his cheeks. You couldn't figure out what emotions were flickering in his eyes at that moment. You just gently wiped the tears from his cheeks: "At least...... You're home. I hope you can let go and be yourself, okay? ”
He shook his head and wiped away his tears in a daze: "No...... Everything is real, because...... I ......" He said this but fell silent again. He was too embarrassed to tell you, but in fact, Spamton just wanted to find a place where he could freely release his fear and unease, and say things he hoped for pity without restraint...... Or rather, he could receive your care without restraint.
You touched his cheek and softly asked, "...... Alright. But if that's the case, why hide it from me? Wouldn't it have been better to tell me from the start? ”
His hands held yours and rubbed against them: "...... Because, because I don't want you to throw me away...... Spamton whispered this. And you could feel all the unease and panic in that sentence.
“…… I will never abandon you." You only instinctively promised this, but you were stunned for a moment.

title: Time Travels (Eight)

content:
The exhibition is tentatively scheduled for half a month later, for a week-long show, so you have plenty of time to prepare before then. There's still another artist's exhibition going on, about a week away, and in a week, you'll be preparing to set up. At the same time, tickets will be available for reservation and go on sale.
You went home and shared this with Spamton. His eyes sparkled as he listened, then he excitedly waved his arms and legs: "I knew it—Y/N, you were absolutely right to hold this exhibition, especially great!! And I believe many dark people from the advertising world come to the exhibition just to admire my style, and maybe many dark folk from other worlds visit the exhibition out of curiosity about advertising!" ”
He kept shouting to himself, "You always see something behind him, like there's a tail, and it's already raised." You try to hold it in but still can't laugh, and you're too embarrassed to expose Spamton's beautiful imagination. After all, you think you're just an unknown artist, and printing so many tickets probably won't get you out. But the gallery owner insists on holding a week-long exhibition, and has printed a lot of tickets—twice the number of tickets from your last week-long exhibition...... You're worried about whether these tickets will even sell.
Besides, the Dark People of the Advertising World probably wouldn't be particularly interested in seeing what the master of this world is like in daily life. After all, almost all the Dark People below are his employees, and they rarely see each other in daily life.
"Hmm...... Not really, my paintings are really just average, so don't flatter me like that. "You scratched your cheek a little shyly.
Spamton suddenly leaned in, his face enlarging in front of your eyes, making you involuntarily lean back: "...... What's wrong? ”
But he just looked at you seriously, then cupped your face with both hands: "Y/N, you need to be confident." Of course...... It's okay if you're not confident, I'll help you feel confident! I'll help you love your own ......." As he spoke, he covered his mouth, looking at you a bit helplessly, since he hadn't intended to say that out loud at a time like this.
But you just smiled and gently rubbed his head: "...... Yeah, I know. After all, it's because of you that I'm willing to accept my past." Otherwise...... You'll probably never be able to pick up a paintbrush. The moment you do, you'll see that painting torn in half—one half of your parents, the other half of your painting.
You can also hear the voices of those days—pointing at your paintings, looking at you with disappointment, saying that even if you spend your time on these hobbies, they wouldn't mind, but you can't achieve exquisite realms in those hobbies as well.
But now, when you pick up your brush, all you see is the half-painted spamton's shadow and the painting holding your hand together, and all you hear is his noisy chatter, saying that even if it's just a hobby, it's something impressive.
A bit noisy and noisy, always playing around, making the house a bit noisy, but you don't find it annoying; instead, you find him very cute.
"Yeah, that's why Y/N is really impressive! Don't always be so humble. When you should be proud, admit it properly. As long as you're proud, that's enough!" As he spoke, he first lifted his head proudly. You looked at him with a smile, and tried lifting your head yourself.
"You see, as long as you accept praise proudly, everything will become beautiful, right? And...... Just accept others' praise proudly! Because that's definitely what you deserve! ”
This statement sounds a bit unreasonable, after all...... Not everyone comes to praise your work with a completely appreciative gaze; maybe they're just being polite and giving a perfunctory answer.
But you still nodded: "...... I understand, I'll try to do this, right?" Your words carried a hint of hesitation.
Spamton just leaned in and leaned on your shoulder: "It's not about trying, it's about making sure — but if you're not used to it, I'll listen to what they say and then relay it to you!" He waved his finger, but of course, if he relayed it—he'd definitely praise you to the brim!
“…… Alright, but if you hear anything nasty, you have to tell me. You don't have to help me listen to these things—I'll handle it all myself." You fiddled with his fingers, playing with them casually, muttering this line under your breath.
He just waved his other hand in front of your eyes, mumbling unhappily, "What? If it makes you sad, you definitely shouldn't listen! Don't worry, no one will ever say anything bad about you!" Spamton patted his chest and promised you.
Even though you want to say more, seeing him make such a firm promise, you end up holding back your words. Think about it, maybe it's better not to spoil the mood, even though you don't think many people will praise you or anything...... Most of the time, aren't they just casually glanced around and then left?
But right after, you hear Spamton say, "But...... Y/N, you still need to build some confidence. How about this, I'll just praise you a few times every day from now on. After a month, you'll definitely be fine!" He nodded proudly as he spoke.
"Do you need it? But I think maybe you don't need it anymore, after all, you've always been like a proud peacock." You couldn't help but smile and gently rub your head against Spamton's head—fluffy and a little ticklish.
Spamton choked up, then suddenly raised his voice: "Of course I need—"
Of course, he really needed Y/N's praise! Although he usually appeared very confident—part of the reason was that, as a master of the advertising world, he couldn't afford to be insecure. Of course, another part of the reason… might be that he had spent too much time around you. spamton still remembered the past, but the pain he once felt had long since been something he could let go of. So, gradually, he also became more confident.
But of course he needed it, or rather, needed even more!
You blink, rub his head with both hands, and his head obediently sways in direction with your movements.
"Mm...... Good, Spamton is amazing—it raised its own flowers! That's awesome! "You said with a cheerful smile.
"Y/N is amazing too! You've painted so many pictures...... For me, even being able to draw a single picture is already pretty rare. "Spamton immediately jumps in after you.
You coughed lightly, feeling your cheeks flushed a little, feeling a bit embarrassed...... So you patted your cheeks and quietly turned your head: "I...... I'll go get you a drawing paper. You try drawing too." You were just clumsily changing the subject, and then you hurriedly and somewhat in a panic went into the room to fetch a sheet of drawing paper and a set of crayons.
Spamton, looking at your background, also patted his slightly flushed face. He muttered softly twice, relieved that you probably couldn't hear what he was saying—even though he was just watching your back and whispering, 'I like you the most.'
Then, he saw you come out again. At that moment, the warmth on your faces had faded, and you handed Spamton both the drawing paper and crayons.
Spamton glanced at you cautiously, and you just nodded gently, smiled, and gave him an encouraging look.
Spamton took a deep breath and began to paint. He decided to paint that day, when you stand in front of him and take his coffee cup—that would be just so—cool!
Unfortunately, whether from excitement or nervousness, his hand trembled a little, but he still tried hard to draw his figure—a white Addison's shadow, your figure, the heroic figure standing in front of him to take the coffee cup—and the less important NPC opposite, who just sketched those shadows with crayons of different colors, yet carefully traced you. Even though you didn't have those, Spamton forcibly added luxurious clothes and exquisite decorations to you. In his eyes, you deserved the best of everything.
And after finishing the last stroke, he excitedly raised the drawing paper to show you. Although his lines were a bit crooked and not very good, you immediately recognized it — this was what it looked like that day at the cyber barbecue restaurant—you still remember that day, after all, you remember everything your white Addison had suffered.
You took the painting, stroking the brushstrokes on it. Out of the corner of your eye, you saw Spamton sitting upright, nervously waiting for your comment, while you suddenly laughed: "Spamton is really amazing!" Although it might be his first time painting or something...... But this painting is very vivid, and I really like it! It must have been that day at the Cyber Barbecue Restaurant. You've worked hard all along. "As you spoke, you bent down slightly and rubbed Spamton's head. He squinted slightly and rubbed against your palm, snoring twice before answering your question.
“Y/N…… That's impressive too! That day was so brave, standing in front of me without hesitation! If only one day, I could become a Dark Citizen as brave as Y/N! He patted his chest and said enthusiastically.
You always feel a bit embarrassed and turn your face away, but the slightly reddened tips of your ears still reveal your emotions.
"A-okay… I know… but it’s normal to feel scared, and you don’t always have to be so brave. I’ll protect you." You sat back down on the sofa, and Spamton leaned closer to your side, pressing tightly against you. Hearing your words, he shook his head in righteous disapproval.
"You can't always protect me...... I'm the advertiser now! Don't worry, maybe I'm protecting you more often! "Spamton promised.
"Then we'll just wait and see. But in the best...... I still hope you don't get hurt. "As for you...... If you get hurt, it's fine; you don't really care much about these things.
"You can't get hurt either. If you are...... Then I—I'll help you get revenge! ”
"Alright, alright. But I've heard that if you're injured, just a breath and the pain will fly away...... Of course, that's probably just for kids." You shook your head helplessly and nodded, casually changing the subject.
"So you're hurt." Spamton's voice suddenly tensed and turned serious.
You were stunned for a moment, then had to roll up your sleeve to reveal that long line of wounds. It looked scary, but in reality, it was just a little bleeding at the time.
"It's okay, this little wound is just a minor issue. It'll heal in a couple of days...... And it was also my own carelessness that cut the doorframe. ”
But in the next second, Spamton cupped your arm and carefully blew on your wound, while his other hand behind his back quietly cast a healing spell. The wound healed quickly with his soft, warm breath, regrowing fair skin.
You widened your eyes in surprise, and Spamton, with raised eyebrows, looked at you triumphantly: "See? One blow makes the pain fly away!"
Of course, you didn’t believe such childish things, like healing a wound by blowing on it. But looking at Spamton’s smug expression, you also noticed his hands behind his back—you thought this might be some spell of the Dark Folk or something. You didn’t reveal his trick and just feigned surprise, opening your eyes wide: "It really worked—Spamton is amazing! How did you do it? Can I learn too?"
Spamton just pretended to be mysterious and mysterious, shaking his finger and head: "No, this is my exclusive secret manual, it's a secret! However...... Only you know this little secret." As he spoke, he winked at you mysteriously.
He would never use this kind of spell on other Dark Folk or Lightfolk — but there was no need! Besides, Spamton wouldn't want to cast spells on others. Although this kind of spell was nothing to him, if other Dark Folk insisted on using it, he would definitely take a hefty profit.
You sighed. This time, you genuinely felt a bit regretful. Honestly, you inevitably had some bumps and scrapes. If only there were such spells, how great it would be—you could heal yourself with one click and no longer have to worry about getting hurt.
Spamton, however, seemed to see right through your thoughts and said seriously, "Don't think that having this kind of spell as a backup doesn't mean the extent of the injury doesn't matter...... This usually only works on surface injuries. So, you must be careful, absolutely careful. ”
You looked away a little guiltily, not daring to look at him, and Spamton just turned your head to look straight at him, his tone a bit fierce: "Did you hear that?" ”
"I heard you, I heard you—don't be so harsh with me." You puffed out your cheeks and pretended to be wronged, and Spamton's arrogance quickly softened. He let go, just scratched his head and coughed dryly twice.
"I...... I'm not really being harsh with you!" He emphasized, his voice a bit weak.
"I know. Don't worry......" You tugged at his face and couldn't help but laugh, and he followed behind you, laughing too.
It's a brief moment of affection at home, and after that, you'll still have to work at a gallery, and Spamton will be his big boss at the company. Honestly, he really wants to be with you forever, even if it's just a doll that can only stay in your pocket, or just a parrot that always flies around you—even if he's by your side and does many, many other things.
But he can't. He's the master of the advertising world, so of course he can't just leave this place behind. But if he had to choose between you and his career, his first reaction would be to want both, and if he could only pick one, he'd grit his teeth and pick yours.
…… After all, if you lose your career, you can just try hard later. But if he loses you, there's no way he'll find the exact same Lightfolk again, and there's no chance he'll ever meet you again.
So—for this goal, to stay with you all the time, he has to work hard! Spamton pulled himself together, held another meeting, then stood on the high platform and began to order: "Y/N's solo art exhibition is about to open in the gallery. All the People of Darkness, buy a ticket, and during this period, all advertisements will be replaced with something related to the Y/N exhibition. We want more People of Light to see and click on them, and sell more tickets." ”
The employees looked at each other. Recently, because Spamton has been showing off the paintings you made for her, they've become numb to hearing your name. Admittedly, your paintings are well-chosen in color and beautifully brushed, worth admiring, but no matter how stunning they are, seeing them every day can make them feel a bit bored and irritated.
