Yellow twirled his ankle boredly and asked, "What is the theme of this Y/N art exhibition, and what kind of promotional images do we need to use for advertising?" ”
This question left Spamton somewhat stunned since he wasn’t sure what visual display would be best… After all, the paintings you wanted to exhibit were already taken to the gallery, so there were none left at home.
But he still proudly raised his head, and the employees heard a tone of boastfulness: "Of course, the theme of this exhibition is—the brightest star of this advertising world, SPAMTON G. SPAMTON!"
Moreover...... This time, he ordered his staff to buy tickets and even advertised for you—things you didn't know about. If he asked you for a preview of the artwork, wouldn't that be exposing himself!
Finally, his eyes darted around as he recalled the sketch you had promised to give him and had been hanging it on the wall at home for him to admire. He clapped his hands, and a pop-up appeared showing the images he had taken from all angles of that sketch before.
"As for promotional footage, let's use this!" He sent out countless identical pop-up windows, afraid that the Dark People behind wouldn't see them, and even made several pop-ups wide open.
Orange hesitated and clicked the pop-up window: "...... But, boss, are you sure a sketch is enough? If I remember correctly, Y/N is holding an oil painting exhibition, right? ”
Thanks to Spamton, all Dark People employees know that sooner or later you'll hold an oil painting exhibition.
Spamton hesitated, then reluctantly pointed to the oil painting behind him: "If that's not enough, use this one as promotional material too." ”
"So you never told Miss Y/N about advertising her art exhibition?" The other Dark People hesitated. Although the boss had become much easier lately, they still didn't dare say anything to their faces. If Spamton lost his temper in anger, the consequences would be extremely serious. Still, Blue quietly spoke up to reveal the truth.
…… If he didn't say anything soon, the pink next to him would explode! He definitely didn't want to see what was once a good event turn into a mess and a complete mess.
But now, Pink just stood there with his arms crossed, staring expressionlessly at Spamton.
Spamton cleared his throat twice. Perhaps since this wasn’t an ad for his own product, some of the addison employees were displeased, and besides, there was no commission in advertising—he closed his eyes and endured, saying: "So, I’ll give 520 Dark Coins per day as commission."
…… As for why it was 520, he was still too embarrassed to say it.
The chattering noise below had quieted down a lot, and the pippins were all satisfied.
Only Blue was still quietly staring at Spamton, along with his former colleagues.
Seeing this, Spamton was a bit embarrassed and angry, and as if she was losing her temper, she shouted back to them: "Alright—I admit, I advertised her without her knowing! Because I hope more people of light and darkness will come to support her! I didn't charge her advertising fees, so I rented these ads out of my own pocket. Alright! ”
Because his volume suddenly increased, the Dark People below were startled. Pippins and Zapper didn't dare speak and calmed down. Shadow guy originally couldn't speak...... But they didn't dare make a sound anymore, even holding up their saxophones and not daring to move.
"But does she want you to do that?" Pink rolled her eyes, speaking a little sharply. Normally, he shouldn’t argue with Spamton since what the master of advertising said was law, but he couldn’t resist giving a small retort.
Spamton choked up. He wanted to arrogantly say not to make unnecessary comments and just follow what he said—but before he could speak, he remembered your earlier advice and told him to listen to the opinions of the other Darkfolk.
So in the end, he took back that sentence and said somewhat gloomily, "...... I don't know. ”
He really doesn't know—but no matter how he guesses, it's obvious you definitely wouldn't want him to advertise. Convincing you to start an art exhibition was already quite a challenge.
But right after, he perked up a bit, his eyes beaming as he said, "But...... It's fine, after all, I voluntarily bought the ad for her! I paid for it voluntarily, so you can go ahead and do it! ”
The Dark People below didn't say anything more. With Spamton's wave of his hand, they announced the end of the meeting and had no choice but to leave the meeting room.
Spamton was the last to leave the meeting room. Before leaving, he turned to look at the oil painting hanging on the wall. The painting was simple, just a flower arrangement from the trash can. That flower was real, nurtured with your help. He brought it back to the office and carefully tried to care for it, but with the help of the plant lamp, it only looked wilted.
After your last reminder, Spamton had reduced the water content in his work, which helped—it wasn’t so droopy anymore, though it hadn’t flourished much.
…… He thought, maybe he's just like that flower. Without your love and help, he'll just grow crookedly. Even if he might survive in the end, he won't live a good life.
Spamton lowered his eyes, closed the conference room door, and walked straight to his office without looking back.
Of course, he didn't have much else to do. Back in his office, he just squatted down to observe the growth of those potted flowers. Hmm, it looked better than yesterday.
As for you...... You're running around the gallery to the point of exhaustion. Normally, there wasn't much to do—after all, during the previous artist's exhibition, you didn't have much work, but the owner insisted on printing your exhibition tickets and selling them in advance.
You thought there wouldn't be much sales, but who knows what happened? Those tickets were printed out and displayed at the entrance to be distributed, but they sold out not long after.
And now, many Dark People were lining up at the entrance, and the owner was urgently printing more tickets. Anyone who didn't know better would think there were many Dark People coming to visit this art exhibition.
And you can't help but feel a bit blacked. With so many tickets sold, just checking tickets for the exhibition will be a huge task!
But I'm not sure if it's just your imagination...... Most of the Dark People coming to buy tickets are pippins and zappers, plus Shadow Guy, who can't speak and only plays the saxophone to express his joy. You always feel these Dark People ...... A bit like Spamton's employees. After all, he admitted before that trash can flower arranging and art pieces was all his hired subordinates as paid posters. Maybe this time Spamton called them over too.
You start to get suspicious and plan to ask Spamton about it properly when you get home.
But since the number of tickets increased, the boss urgently printed another batch of tickets—luckily, there was no event review or registration system in the Dark World, which meant that no matter how many Dark People showed up, even if it was packed, it would be normal.
You held your aching back, your face stiffening from selling that batch of newly printed tickets, even later than usual after work. You sighed, packed up your things and went home. Though it was a bit late...... It was still within normal hours. But you still felt a bit guilty, because you had just noticed several missed calls from Spamton—all of them called when you were so busy and dizzy, after you got home normally. Probably worried you wouldn't come home.
In short, you were still panting as you reached the doorway, then pushed open the door. What met your eyes was Spamton’s anxious expression. He looked serious, on the phone, seemingly giving some instructions. When he saw you, his expression relaxed a bit, and he put down the phone, unconsciously speaking in a coaxing tone.
"You're back...... Why are you only just getting back! The food I made got cold! And I've called you so many times, and you never answered—" He grew more anxious, and you just interrupted him.
“…… Ah, there's no rush about this, right? It's fine if the food gets cold or hot. I didn't answer the call because I'm working overtime...... "You don't know what you're talking about, but you still answered his question. As you walked over, you stood on tiptoe and gently patted his head. He obediently lowered his head, so you don't have to stand on tiptoe anymore."
"As for why I'm only back now, it's because I'm working overtime. As for why I'm working overtime, it's because so many Dark People suddenly came to buy tickets. We've been working overtime to handle ticket sales all this time...... As for why there are so many Dark Citizens, I think those people are a lot like your employees. "You just mentioned this casually, not at all that serious.
However, spamton's expression stiffened. He was relieved that by looking down at that moment, you couldn't see his face, but he was also slightly frustrated. Although he knew very well that this was just another instance of unreasonable fuss—those employees really were ungrateful, queuing to buy tickets during someone else's off-duty time! It caused Y/N from his household to come back so late, he was extremely anxious!
However, he still muttered, "You can just dump your work on other Dark People. Why do you have to work overtime? You're a Light Citizen...... after all."
You flicked his head, and Spamton covered his forehead and took two steps back. He didn't weigh much, but I don't know why his eyes suddenly filled with tears, looking so pitiful and aggrieved.
"Even if I am of the Light Folk, I shouldn’t abuse my position to oppress other Dark Folk." You leaned closer, gently standing on tiptoe, and blew on his forehead. That warm, gentle, slightly moist breath brushed against Spamton’s cheek, making his face flush, and he quickly covered it with his hands, opening his mouth a bit shyly.
“…… Well, Y/N did the right thing, so I want to learn from you too! "Spamton raised his voice as he spoke.
"Just keep being yourself, why are you copying me?" You chuckled, poked his forehead again, then picked up the food on the table that had already cooled down and headed to the kitchen.
"Alright, I'll heat up the food first."
"Me too, I'll do too." Spamton hurriedly picked up another plate and walked into the kitchen as well.
By the time you sit down at the table and start your formal dinner, it will be about ten minutes later.
You didn't press him further, since your words were already there. You know Spamton definitely understands, you've already guessed something, so—he'll definitely speak up later. You don't know why you're so sure, probably...... It's just out of trust and understanding of him.
Spamton had been stirring the noodles in his bowl for a long time, hesitating and nervous, unsure whether he should even speak. He was reluctant to look at you and reluctant to speak because he knew you would definitely not allow it—he was, in a way, trying to gain personal advantage through work matters.
But in the end, he still took a deep breath, lifted his head, and looked into your eyes. He saw all the tolerance and care in your eyes—without any blame. For some reason, his heart suddenly felt lighter; he just felt he could speak more easily.
So Spamton admitted: "...... Alright, I admit I had my staff buy tickets. But, but I paid them advertising fees and commissions! I was just volunteering to advertise for you...... He met your gaze, his voice growing quieter and quieter.
You took a simple bite of spaghetti, watching him mix the noodles and tomato sauce into a mess, and couldn’t help but laugh: "So you volunteered to buy advertising for me… Actually, I didn’t need you to do this, Spamton."
Although in reality they still hire employees as paid posters, it's still a bit different.
Spamton nodded and then shook his head: "I know...... But I did it willingly. I think all the people of light and darkness should see your masterpiece!" He said this as he lifted his head, as if feeling very proud and proud because of you.
You feel a bit embarrassed by what he says, your cheeks flushing a little, and you instinctively scratch your face: "Not really...... I'm not that impressive...... "You're still a bit lacking in confidence, or rather, this is your self-perception. Your self-identification as your own works is just average."
Spamton, on the other hand, just shook his finger seriously: "No. Y/N's artwork is really great—actually, when I called in the meeting at the time, only 100 Dark People were called in, so only those 100 Dark People would go buy tickets. Are there still a lot of Dark People going to buy tickets today? ”
You paused, indeed...... About 200 tickets were sold out at once today. Although the advertising might have had a huge effect, and the dark people of the advertising world probably wouldn't buy it after seeing it, you still find it a bit ...... Unbelievable.
Or rather, you're just a bit carried away. You didn't expect your paintings to be so popular?
You cleared your throat and told yourself not to get complacent. Maybe there weren't that many Dark People attending the exhibition during those days, and maybe many of them bought tickets just for the sake of the advertisement. Maybe...... Maybe it's because the tickets themselves aren't expensive—just 50 Dark Coins.
“…… Hmm, about two hundred tickets were sold today. Maybe it's the effect of the advertising...... You nodded your chin, your voice still a bit hesitant.
"Of course, I gave them a commission of 520 Dark Coins per day! Their ads must be very thoughtful!" Spamton was very proud. He had taken a look at their ads on purpose; their ads really made people want to buy tickets, but Spamton was very satisfied.
520 Dark Coins......? You blinked, unsure if Spamton meant that, but judging by his expression now, he probably ...... It was probably just a casual remark. Just like the old line "I like you the most," it's just a habit, as if reminding yourself to feel this way.
So you just overlooked the price, but for some reason, at that moment, you felt a slight sense of disappointment, mostly a sense of disappointment.
"Hmm...... But I still hope that those who come to visit the exhibition genuinely want to appreciate the artworks. "You try hard to ignore that feeling, just forcing a smile at the corner of your mouth as you continue to say this.
Spamton could see your reluctance too. He frowned deeply: "Y/N...... What's wrong? Are you unhappy? How about I have them take down the ad......" His voice was a bit cautious, though a bit reluctant. Spamton really wanted to promote you. He wished all the Dark and Light folk could see how beautiful your drawing was, and then proudly announce that he was the only Dark Folk in your family! And this was drawn by his Y/N, who is the best!
He just thought you were unhappy, and you really did feel a bit uncomfortable for reasons you didn't even understand. You didn't know why you were unhappy, but it definitely wasn't for that, so you just shook your head: "No need to take down the ads...... Actually, I'm actually very happy that so many people of darkness can come and recognize my paintings." "Even if you couldn't believe it at first.
"Ah...... Then I'll add a line in the ad! I'll also tell the other Dark People that if they don't want to go, they don't need to go...... Spamton fiddled with his fingers, still a bit uneasy. He could feel that your mood was still not very pleasant, even though he didn't know why.
"Mm, that's good enough." You finally breathed a sigh of relief and nodded.
Spamton puffed out his cheeks slightly, a bit displeased, but the next day he urgently called a meeting, calling over all the employees who had been reluctant and had met for the past week and solemnly announced, "Ahem, if you really don't want to attend the exhibition, give me the tickets right now. I'll compensate you separately based on the ticket price." ”
The employees looked at each other, unsure what trick the boss was up to—maybe he had reclaimed the tickets and sold them at a high price. But in the end, more than half of the employees gradually stepped forward and exchanged their tickets for genuine Dark Coins.
Who cares? If the boss wants to be a scalper, go ahead. They can't control it! Pippins happily ran off with the dark coin in hand, then set up a new betting game. Zapper jumped a few times in place, hesitated for a moment, but still had some tickets left unsold. Shadow Guy was the same.
However, after exchanging a lot of tickets with Dark Coins and feeling heartache, Spamton carefully stored the tickets printed with your painting excerpts and the exhibition name. Although collecting them wasn’t really useful—he just wanted to collect everything related to you, collecting every trace of you.
Time flew by, and the day of the exhibition was almost up. Because you were the artist, you weren't standing at the gate to check tickets. You just sat there, nervously tugging at the hem of your clothes, waiting for visitors to come in. If they had any questions, you would introduce the corresponding paintings.
Do you remember...... A few nights ago, Spamton even swore he'd come every day! So you're also waiting for Spamton's arrival. It's understandable that you're a bit nervous, after all...... Spamton probably just thinks you've only drawn a few of his designs.

title: Time Practices (Six)
path: articles/en/spt/时行 end/时行（swapsptx你）/时行（六）.html
content:
[6]
He just lowered his head and didn't look at you anymore, almost hugging his knees—after all, his body was trembling at this moment, and his voice was soft: "I don't know...... I don't know what you're thinking. I'm just afraid, afraid you'll hate me...... I'm afraid you'll think I'm terrible, bad, afraid you'll be afraid of me...... Spamton didn't know what he was talking about; maybe he was just ...... afraid you'd stop projecting your own love onto him. Even though he wasn't sure if that counted as love, since it made him feel warmth and attachment, reluctance, and happiness...... Then it should be.
You were silent for a while, and because you hadn't received your answer, Spamton nervously lifted his head. At that moment, you cupped his cheek and shook your head solemnly: "No, why would I be afraid of you, hate you, or hate you? You're my favorite addison...... You're really amazing. You've become the master of the advertising world and managed to keep it from me for so long, which shows you've worked really hard! "You smile brightly, even though you don't know yourself...... Why did you say that word so smoothly?
What is liking? And what is love? You have no idea; you only judge based on your only rational logic that you should give your home the addison and other things.
He stared at you blankly. For some reason, you felt the spot where your palm touched seemed a bit hot, and you could only tilt your head in confusion. Spamton broke free from your hand, hurriedly turned his head, and seemed to pat his cheek with his hand, stammering, "Mm, I like you the most, Y/N!" ”
You touch your chest, not knowing why...... Every time you hear him say that, you can actually feel the heart in your chest beating faster. But this time, that feeling becomes especially obvious. You can't help but wonder: could he actually have an infectious disease, which is why his heart is beating so fast?
Thinking this, you couldn't help but ask, your tone very serious: "Do you really have some infectious disease bacteria on you? Otherwise, why would my heart be beating so fast?" ”
And for some reason, your heart seems to be beating faster, and you feel like it's about to jump out of your throat the next second—of course, that's probably just your imagination.
Spamton turned to look at you, looking straight into your eyes and biting his lip—after all, when he heard what you said, his first reaction was ecstasy, but then he just found it a bit funny. After all, it turns out you don't understand anything either.
He simply nodded solemnly: "Yes, I probably have an infectious disease on me, because my heart is beating very fast." "Even if—even as a Dark Citizen, he couldn't be sure there was this organ in his body—Spamton could feel that mysterious object in his chest was thumping and thumping.
You hurriedly asked, "What is the name of this infectious disease? I can buy some medicine to cure both of us. And since you have an infectious disease...... Then you've definitely been sick for even longer, so you need to get treatment sooner...... You grumbled, your brows furrowed tightly, leaving only anxiety.
But Spamton just shook his head: "The name of this infectious disease...... It's Y/N. ”
You froze when you heard this answer, the anxious look on your face faded away, and you stared at him in a daze. You didn't expect to hear this answer—and you only felt your cheeks start to burn, your heart seemed to beat faster. You always felt as if you had already received some answer, but you didn't dare to ask further—even though the answers were right in front of you, you just found it somewhat ridiculous.
So you hastily changed the subject, planning to show Spamton your past later, but now your resolve is even stronger. He has already let you know his past, present, and future, so to be fair, you should let him know too.
Or rather, you originally wanted him to know.
So you cleared your throat, just turned your head, got up, and walked toward your own room: "...... Ahem, ahem, I—the surprise I prepared still has the second half. Come to my room and take a look." Your voice became a bit stammered, but in your panic, you quickened your pace.
Spamton scratched his cheek, which had just cooled down, and couldn't help but laugh at your flustered back. He felt a bit pleased, but also a little disappointed—maybe because you hadn't given him a direct answer, but he longed to hear those words from you? Maybe it was because he longed for it. Even though he had already gained so much by your side, he was insatiable and only wanted more. Spamton himself knew this wasn't a good habit, but under your indulgence, he had become what he was today.
He followed you into your room. To be honest, he had never set foot before, only sneaking glances when you were there. Of course, Spamton was just there to see you.
And just today, he finally stepped into your room and followed you down by the bed. Spamton didn't know what you were trying to do until he saw you dragging a dusty box out from under the bed.
That box...... It was covered in dust, with no marks or patterns on it—just a pure white box, as if waiting for someone to dye it. Spamton had never seen this box before, not even once since he started living in your house.
His voice was also a bit dry, probably carrying a fear even he didn't know: "This...... What's inside the box? "Maybe it's like Pandora's box—once opened, there's no going back.
You didn't look at Spamton, just quietly lowered your head to look at the box and softly said, "...... It's my past, the past I once buried with my own hands. ”
"Do you hate your past? Well, you don't have to treat these as part of the surprise to show me—" Spamton's eyes widened, hurriedly waving his hand, while you simply held his hand and placed it on the lid.
You gently shook your head: "...... Come open the box. It's okay, I ...... too. You don't really hate your past, do you?" Your voice was dry. You knew it was a heartfelt remark, and you believed Spamton could tell through it.
He blinked at you, his hand resting on the lid of the box without moving: "...... But why? ”
You propped your chin on your hand and thought seriously for a moment, then spoke uncertainly: "Hmm...... Because you actually showed me your past too? I think I should show you mine too. And...... After all this time, I should let go, and I should let go of my obsession with the past. "Your voice was soft, but it sounded very heavy to Spamton's ears. He turned his head blankly to look at you.
“…… Because I should also move toward the future. I want to walk into the future with you." You still didn't look at him, and you didn't know why, at this moment, you didn't dare turn around to look at him. Spamton stared at your profile, but in the end said nothing, just opened the box.
What greeted him was a complete set of painting supplies, a dozen oil paintings, unfinished works, and several graffiti-like artworks—the brushstrokes were immature, yet full of creativity and creativity.
You didn't say a word, nor did you watch Spamton's movements; you just listened to the rustling sound beside you, like turning pages, and nervously swallowed hard.
He flipped through your paintings one by one, quietly admiring each one, his eyes growing brighter and brighter.
Then you hear his voice: "This painting is imitating that 'Sunflowers', right?" The brushwork and coloring are very delicate...... Also, the shapes are more vivid. Although I'm not sure how to comment on the painting, this painting feels very warm and cozy, and I think it's even better than the original! ”
You opened your mouth, wanting to say, how is that possible? The original is so famous, but he just flipped to the next oil painting: "This one...... Is this your self-portrait? The painting definitely doesn't look as good as yours...... But it's quite interesting—breaking into many petals like this—is it a way to observe yourself from different angles? ”
You closed your mouth and quietly watched him flip through the next oil painting: "Is this a still life sketch...... I'm not sure, but that's probably the title. Y/N's fundamentals are really good! "He said with a cheerful smile.
You want to interrupt him, but Spamton just keeps going, "And this one...... Ah, it looks like just a depiction of natural scenery—is it a maple forest? Or yellow or red leaves, giving off a very bleak autumn atmosphere! ”
It's clear he doesn't analyze the artwork; he's just speaking based on his feelings. Yet Spamton still flips through your artworks one by one, earnestly giving feedback, until he finally finds your childhood doodles.
You instinctively want to snatch that painting away, since showing your childhood doodles is somewhat embarrassing—you just couldn't help but take away this graffiti, which once represented your imagination and creativity, while packing up at home.
Spamton tilted his head to look at the painting and also seriously commented, "Countless cars traveling through space...... Some cars carry the sun, some carry the moon, and some carry stars? It looks very much like a modern version of a mythological story! The brushstrokes in this painting are quite immature, but they still perfectly capture the unique characteristics of each vehicle...... "Even if it's just a doodle."
You silently looked at him, suddenly remembering—that day, your parents tore your painting in half, saying they wanted to keep half as a keepsake, and only half remained in the box, only ...... Only the half of you was drawn, and besides that, later you added a white shadow beside it. You don't know who this is, nor do you know...... When will you finish this incomplete painting?
And the day your painting is torn in half is the day before you go to college to register.
You swallowed hard and didn't stop Spamton, but flipped to the last half-incomplete painting. He stared blankly at the white shadow, then picked up a black crayon from the box and wobbly smeared it on a pair of sunglasses.
"Only Y/N...... That's too lonely. That white shadow standing next to you must be me! But without sunglasses, it doesn't really look like ......," he muttered, admiring his work with great pride.
But you didn't say anything, just reached out and hugged him tightly. You didn't want him to see you crying, didn't want him to see the redness in your eyes. Even though tears were streaming down your cheeks, they still soaked his clothes.
Spamton was momentarily stunned, but just gently patted your back with his hand.
At that moment, you silently embraced. Spamton lowered his brows, thinking—since you've treated him so well, he should repay you with equal respect. He thought it was only natural, but hadn't expected you to cry—after all, warm tears were now soaking your clothes.
And at this moment...... It seemed a strange emotion surged in his chest—no, not entirely unfamiliar—he knew it was heartache for you. Besides that, Spamton didn't know much about your past, but from your half-torn painting, he could tell your past was bleak...... Or rather, it was similar to his? What followed immediately was an inexplicable sense of emotion.
…… After all, your past was probably not beautiful. For you, finding him, deciding to bring him home, and deciding to live with you—are those things truly wonderful? Even so...... He can still sense a love from you that isn't very smooth, even a bit awkward and sluggish.
He didn't know...... No, Spamton can now be sure your life must have changed a lot, definitely become better! After all, you just said he's your favorite Addison! Spamton perked up again, and he also wanted to show off to the other Dark People by showing them his own Y/N paintings—although he couldn't see anything extra, he could feel that every painting carried your emotions, and each one only made him marvel at that kind of beauty.
So he gently patted your back again and asked, "...... Y/N, have you considered holding a solo exhibition of your paintings? ”
You were stunned for a moment, lowered your eyes, and said nothing. You never imagined your paintings could be held for exhibitions—after all, you're not a famous artist; these are just your hobbies. Just like your parents said, it's just a hobby.
So you said it too: "...... It's just a hobby. If you take it out, there's no one to look at, right?" Your voice was a bit hoarse.
Moreover, although you let Spamton see these paintings, you weren't prepared to let other Darkfolk come to see them as well.
"So what if it's a hobby? As long as you want, you can display these paintings for everyone to see!" Spamton shouted, almost imagining that if someone didn't come to see the painting, it would be a loss for them.
You let go, just sat on the ground and looked him in the eye, hesitating for a moment before saying, "Alright...... Then shall I think about it? ”
Spamton's eyes lit up, and he persistently said, "Hurry up and think about it! And if you say these paintings are created by the People of Light, there will definitely be a lot of people of Darkness coming to see them!" "He shakes your arm, probably acting spoiled, but you can see his eyes sparkling as he looks at you."
You coughed awkwardly twice, a bit embarrassed, and changed the subject: "...... If other Dark People came over eagerly to take a look, only to find that the Light Folk only had this level of painting, they'd be disappointed...... "Before he could finish, Spamton interrupted him.
"No, your painting is beautiful. Not a single Dark Folk would find it ugly!" Spamton promised you with absolute confidence.
He'd already thought it through, and when the time came...... At worst, he'd just spend some dark coins to buy tickets himself, have his employees go, and just praise your artwork!
And you just quietly watched him, as if you had already guessed what he was thinking: "Don't even think about hiring your employees to come to my art exhibition...... No, I haven't even agreed to hold an art exhibition yet." "No matter how you feel like I've already been drawn into it...... You rubbed your forehead in frustration.
“…… Me. I'm not hiring employees......" His gaze drifted, clearly showing that Spamton had been thinking about this just now.
You sighed, just rubbed his head, and pulled him up from the ground: "Alright, let's talk about this another time." "If we keep discussing, you'll really have to blindly follow his words and start an art exhibition."
"No. I think Y/N, you really should hold an art exhibition and show all these paintings! I'll help you advertise a bit, and then all the Dark People will be able to see them—"How wonderful it is to see their own Light Folk then!" Thinking of this, Spamton couldn't help but feel proud again.
And you interrupted him again: "No...... No need. I don't need you to help with advertising. "Advertising is not like hiring employees to come to an art exhibition; it's all about forcing your own dark people to come.
The hair on his head drooped again, and his head drooped as he said gloomily, "...... Oh. ”
You couldn't help but rub his head again, then grabbed his hand and walked out, softly asking, "Alright...... So, what you told me before, you sold 100 ...... Hmm, artworks—are they real? "You think you'd better quickly change the subject, so Spamton doesn't keep looking gloomy, and he won't keep getting hung up on the art exhibition. After all...... You haven't decided yet. You want to wait until you can truly make your own choices, and don't want Spamton to get coaxed and push you into holding an art exhibition—that won't make you happy.
Only the rewards you receive after sincere choices will make you happy—of course, you chose to pick up this Addison from the trash, brought him home to live together, and made this place his home too, which was naturally a heartfelt choice.
The hair on his head stood up again, and he patted his chest to promise you, "Of course! I really sold a hundred portions!" "Although all of them were sold to his employees."
You just whispered softly, "Oh?" and he simply said mysteriously, "This ...... is all business secrets! ”
You stopped, turned around, and quietly stared at him. Spamton, because you suddenly stopped, almost bumped into your arms, his nose just a tiny step away from your chest. He instinctively widened his eyes, stopped abruptly, and stammered as he asked, "Suddenly ...... Why did you suddenly stop......" He felt a bit uncertain, his voice gradually fading, and he lowered his head, not daring to look at you anymore.
You hold his face, making him lift his head to meet your gaze, while his eyes just roll around, not daring to look at you.
You just repeat once more: "Is it really true?" ”
He raised his voice: "Of course it's true! And I told them that if they sell an extra copy, they'll get a commission of 50 Dark Coins!" ”
"Our Spamton is really great...... But those 100 servings—aren't you really the one selling them to your employees? "Your voice was light, after all, last time it was 100, and this time it's 100, which naturally arouses your suspicion.
“…… It really is sold to the employees." Spamton's voice was muffled, and his voice lowered. He still admitted to you about it, then raised his voice again, "But—but as long as they sell a few more copies, they can make it back, since there's a commission anyway!" ”
"Yeah, I know there's a commission...... You should also reward outstanding employees. But besides this hundred, do you have any other achievements? ”
You pulled Spamton to sit on the sofa and asked softly. Spamton pulled his hand back and began fiddling with the fingers of both his hands, his voice a bit dry: "...... That's all. ”
This answer is within your expectations. You don't think this so-called artwork will sell much, but looking at it this way...... Spamton actually didn't tell many truths, although he did tell part of it, but only about half.
But you just rubbed his head: "Hmm...... Are you planning to do these business again, or rather, to advertise these artworks? Ah, including the previous trash can flower arrangements and such. ”
Spamton nodded sharply. Of course he wanted to, after all, he thought you actually liked it, so he naturally assumed that the other Dark and Light folks would like it too—though that was just unreasonable. He just rubbed the top of his head back and forth against your palm, muttering softly, "But with all the ads flying everywhere, there are still hardly any customers...... It feels like it's completely useless." "But he doesn't want to give up just like that. He even plans to show you the jaw-dropping sales figures to make you happy."
You reached out and hooked his chin again, watching Spamton squint his eyes, resting his chin in your palm, tilting his head slightly up, looking thoroughly enjoying it. After thinking for a moment, you said, "In that case...... Have you considered changing the promotional approach, or simply switching to a different product? ”
He shook his head and nodded: "I've changed my marketing approach, even tried bundled sales or price reductions, but still, no Dark or Light folks have seen these products...... As for switching to another product, Spamton never considered it.
You narrowed your eyes slightly and smiled as you offered your suggestion: "Is that so...... Then, how about selling real flowers directly? ”
Spamton was taken aback. He recalled the few pots of flowers he had raised dead in his office before, and it seemed he had never heard of any cases of keeping flowers alive...... As for the trees that existed in the Dark World Plains, they seemed to have existed for a long time as well. No one knew how those trees came to be or how they grew, since they could still bear dark candy.
"But...... If it's a real flower, it's hard to keep it alive......" he whispered. For example, he never succeeded; only that pot of lavender you occasionally tended to it managed to grow and produce clusters of tiny purple flowers.
You waved your fingers and made a wink: "Ah...... Because the Dark World lacks sunlight, it's normal that they can't survive. But I have a special formula here. ”
Saying that, you walked back to your room. When you came back, you had a touch light in your hand—a simple full-spectrum plant lamp you developed long ago to successfully plant flowers in the Dark World...... Although you don't need it now.
You shoved the full-spectrum plant lamp into Spamton's hand, resting your chin on your hand: "With this, you can keep it alive." But I don't make much of this myself, so it's limited—first come, first served! ”
You seem to have some talent for business, or maybe after spending a lot of time with Spamton, you've learned a bit more.
Then you waved your hand again: "But if you want plants to grow better, you'll need a secret recipe...... And different plants need special treatment, and each plant has its own requirements." But at this point, you didn't say anything more.
Spamton blinked. Honestly, your words had piqued his interest, so he couldn't help but ask, "And then?" ”
And you just smile and wave your hand: "Well...... Business secret! ”
Spamton puffed out his cheeks: "Alright...... Secret is confidential!" Although he didn't press further, he still felt a bit unwilling. Spamton fiddled with the full-spectrum plant lamp, studied it roughly, and figured his staff should be able to replicate it too—whether it works or not, it has to be done. Although he couldn't understand it, he believed that among all those Dark People, there must be someone who could figure it out.
So he asked, "Exactly...... Y/N, if I take this thing and replicate it, it should be fine, right?" "After all, no matter what, it's still something you created...... He can't just copy it casually. If it's someone else's thing, he doesn't care; if he uses it freely, he won't blame him for any trouble. But this is yours, Spamton believes he should show you enough respect.
You paused for a moment, touched your chin, and said, "Hmm...... Are you thinking of doing some promotions? For example, these are the first batch of limited edition treasures, and after that are regular batches or something? ”
Spamton nodded heavily. That's exactly what he thought—after all, doing this would earn him more Dark Coins, so why not do it?
You nodded thoughtfully: "It's possible, but after all, this isn't my invention. I just replicated it using materials available in the Dark World. So if you want to recreate it, just go ahead and do it!" ”
Spamton raised both hands and cheered like a child: "Yay—"
You couldn't help but chuckle, patted his head, and he nuzzled your palm against it.
Now, he no longer spoke in a pitiful tone, and simply said directly: "Y/N!" Let me tell you—the queen of the Dark World next door is really annoying. Clearly, our advertising world wouldn't steal business from the cyber world, yet she still wants a piece of the pie, thinking our flower arranging business must have made a lot of money, and even wants to secretly learn our craft and sell it. "Although Addison really did come from the cyber world...... But Spamton didn't care. When he felt wronged, he wanted to tell you, even though sometimes he thought it was just unreasonable trouble.
You just scratched his chin thoughtfully: "So, how do you want to solve this?" ”
Spamton closed his eyes comfortably, even making snoring sounds. He just mumbled a little unclearly, "Well, of course we hid our exclusive business secrets. Anyway, she definitely won't be able to sell them!" He said confidently.
Then he opened his eyes and saw your smiling face, his voice involuntarily lowered: "But we don't have any exclusive business secrets...... But only after you suggested did he finally master the trade secrets again. Before this, it was only because he pressured employees to buy, and those employees pressured the Dark People of the advertising world to buy them, which was why sales seemed higher.
You just tilted your head and scratched the soft, sparse hair beside his cheek: "Hmm, don't we already have some business secrets?" "If that's the case, you should keep the trade secrets safe." ”
Spamton nodded vigorously again: "I understand—" He dragged out his voice, as if being playful.
"Hmm...... But if the neighboring dark world wants a piece of the pie, it might not be a bad idea. "You thought it over for a moment.
Spamton just puffed out his cheeks again: "Isn't it only a limited edition fashion item from the Dark World that looks better? That way, I can raise the price too!" ”
You gently flicked his forehead, and even without force, Spamton pretended to be in pain, clutching his forehead tightly, then looked at you with tears in his eyes, making you laugh again.
"Think about it, if there's only one Dark World to sell, then if the Dark People from other Dark Worlds want to get these limited fashion items, they'll either have to go to this Dark World to buy them, or have to rely on Dark People who can travel between them...... Most Dark People probably don't have the ability to do that, right? That would just let middlemen profit and resell them, wouldn't they? ”
"Then I'll just have the Dark People with that ability sell in other dark worlds......" Anyway, the Dark Coins he earned ended up in his own pocket, Spamton thought, without much conscience.
You shake your fingers and shake your head seriously: "Not good. Even if your employees hold up huge banners and advertise, it's hard to gain the trust of other Dark People...... Besides, even more Dark People won't see it." ”
Spamton raised his voice: "The ad pop-up will appear on all the Lightfolk computers—no one will miss seeing it!" He swore confidently.
Seeing him like this, you get a bit distracted and suddenly recall the ad pop-ups and all those random spam emails with all kinds of ads on your computer before. You can't help but be curious: "By the way, do you manage all the ad pop-ups and spam emails?" ”
Spamton immediately fell silent. He cautiously looked up at you, suddenly feeling a bit embarrassed to speak...... Back when he was just an ordinary addison, just a regular spam-sending addison, he really did like to visit your computer. Although the cyber world is built on another laptop—in a sense, they can roam among the computers of the Lightfolk.
And you...... Your computer inbox is never emptied, so it can fool itself by telling yourself maybe you saw those emails, maybe you saw those ads. You just don't know when you deleted all those emails.
Probably the day before he heard that a Light Folk had arrived in the Dark World.
Spamton just shook his head and nodded: "Pretty much, so all the spam and ads are managed by us...... I'm really something!" He was feeling proud again, though he couldn't help but feel a bit guilty. If he wasn't online, he wouldn't be able to touch that computer either.
You just smiled and patted his forehead: "Spamton is amazing—it can manage ads on so many computers!" ”
Spamton also looked up. Looking at him now, he looked a bit like a peacock happily spreading its feathers, and you couldn't help but laugh again.
"So...... Are those spam emails on my computer also sent by you? "You asked softly.
Spamton was a bit stuck. He glanced at you timidly, then lowered his head again: "I'm not going to post ads anymore! It's all the Dark People under my command who are posting them—I just need to set up the overall strategy!" ”
…… Now, no one should be placing ads in your inbox anymore. After all, ever since you arrived in the Dark World, Spamton has never been able to enter that familiar computer anymore.
You nodded, drowning out your "Oh—" sound. Seeing his somewhat guilty expression, you couldn't help but ask again: "So, which Dark Citizen is actually responsible for placing ads in my email?" ”
Spamton lowered his head, unusually a bit afraid to look at you, and just whispered, "...... Back when I was still Addison, I always sent mail to your mailbox...... After you came to the Dark World, I never sent mail again. "I can't send it anymore."
You blink, then your pupils widen. You don't realize that before that, you had already encountered Spamton—though you don't clear those emails, you also don't click in to view them. It wasn't until you decided to leave home and erased all traces of the past that you shredded and deleted all those emails, because you never intended to recover them.
At this moment, Spamton started drawing again: "But I guess I'm just a Dark People who exist because of concepts...... Probably not because of some physical object? But I think, since I've sent so many emails to your mailbox, in a way, it can be considered a concept that makes up my body! But I'm the master of advertising! I definitely don't lack these conceptual components! ”
You couldn't help but nod and patted his head again. You probably understand...... In a way, he exists because of you. In a way, it's precisely because of you that he has been able to get through the years gone by.
"Alright, alright, I get it—I feel like the topic is a bit off-topic, but regarding the other dark worlds just trying to learn from your methods, I can offer some of my opinion." You cleared your throat and said seriously.
"So what advice does Y/N have to give? I'll definitely listen!" Spamton said eagerly, sounding a bit eager to answer. If other Dark People gave him advice, he definitely wouldn't even pay attention! But he would listen to you...... Even if he occasionally found it unpleasant, he would keep listening. Of course, you wouldn't take it seriously or say anything unpleasant.
Because he knows you care about him, you care for him, and that's why he says those things. It's also because you don't want him to be sad that you won't say anything hurtful.
And he...... He cares about you and cares about your words, so no matter what you say, he listens. After all, Spamton knows this is something you painstakingly came up with for him.
Bad or unpleasant words or sad things can be discussed properly. Of course, he believes you won't do this, and he can't do it either, because he cares about you the most.
"Hmm...... Although I think having your employees sell in other dark worlds is a good idea, it's still a bit troublesome, and if too many people buy it, your staff won't be able to keep up, right? So you can cooperate with other dark worlds—you handle supply, they handle sales—and if it sells well, then you get a commission! "You waved your finger.
Spamton simply leaned on your shoulder, playing with your fingers, acting affectionately, and neither of you thought it was a problem. He just said excitedly, "Y/N is so smart! I never even thought of such a solution!" ”
…… Actually, when we were chatting and discussing earlier, he thought of this too, but didn't say it out loud. Well, he just wanted to compliment you.
You cleared your throat, your cheeks rarely flushed, and just waved your hand: "...... I don't think I'm anything special. You must have thought about that just now, right? ”
You still know your Addison very well...... Of course, he can think of such a simple thing as well.
Spamton just shook his head: "I did think of it...... But you're still amazing. Look, you know gardening, you can paint, and you can develop this kind of plant lamp...... You know a lot! Even if you don't do well in some areas, you're already an impressive person! "He was counting on his fingers and carefully listing your strengths.
You blinked sluggishly, then rubbed your slightly reddened eyes, and just muffled a "Mm."
You never thought that before, your parents only scolded you for having a hobby that wasted your spirit...... Now you can be praised as amazing.

title: Time Practices (Ten)
path: articles/en/spt/时行 end/时行（swapsptx你）/时行（十）.html
content:
[10]
Following the surging crowd, you sighed, held your head high, and walked out of the subway station. Looking at the familiar yet unfamiliar street scene, the people passing by were still chatting and gossiping, and the street vendors’ calls were still so attention-grabbing. You just lowered your head, your trembling hands unlocking your phone, looking at the wallpaper which was still a photo of Spamton and you, both smiling broadly. You couldn't help but take a deep breath, reinforce your conviction, and move forward.
Walking through the crowd, your pace quickens and faster. Just a little faster, a little faster, you don't want him to be left alone for too long, and ...... What if you drag on for too long and he can no longer get help?
You fiddled with the keys in your pocket and suddenly started running down the street. Some people looked at you in surprise, and you overheard the neighbors gossiping, saying you must be some kind of young lady, so ill-mannered, and didn't even know to stop and apologize properly.
Indeed, you only had time to quickly say sorry and then dash forward. You only had time to glance around quickly to make sure you hadn't gone the wrong way. Until you, panting and holding your knees, stood at the doorstep—no, that was already your old home. You were panting heavily at the door of your old home, your hand trembling as you reached out, and after several times, you inserted the key into the keyhole, then gently twisted it, and the door creaked open.
First and foremost was the sound of the coffee machine spinning at high speed, along with the constant spinning of the soy milk machine nearby. The noisy noise made you frown, and then you opened the door and walked in.
Your parents were sitting at the table enjoying dinner, then faced your mother at the door and saw you, who was the first to confront you: "You still know to come back? After graduating from college, you ran off without a word, didn't reply to messages or answer your calls. I told you long ago that after graduation, you could just get married right away. Mom has watched over several promising local youths for you, but you didn't say a word. Now look, those promising youths each have their own families. What will Mom do now—"
You frown, a wave of irritation rising in your heart. You look at the vase on the counter at the door, wanting to suddenly throw it at your mother's head. But your good sense of morality still lets you hold back—you tell yourself you don't need to say a word, just endure, just endure and get through it.
And you clench your fists, just walking toward your own room.
My mother suddenly raised her voice: "What's your attitude toward your mom? You just say hello when you get home and don't call her?" So rude—"
Her father quickly spoke up: "Good girl, didn't we agree? After you graduate from college, you can stay at home. You can continue with your hobbies and interests. Our family can afford to support you, but you really should consider other ......."
"And even if you get married, after a long day of work, you can still draw your lousy drawings, do whatever you want. Why don't you even listen to your parents—" your mother grumbled, then followed behind and said another sentence.
You shook your head, a bit annoyed, but didn't plan to talk back. It was never agreed; they just insisted you should go home after graduation, since your major wasn't suitable for working outside anyway.
They never negotiated; they just used the pretense of negotiability to push you to offer an offer you couldn't refuse.
In the end, you just put your hand on the doorknob and replied calmly, "Mm." Of course, it was just a perfunctory response. Then you hurriedly opened your own door, entered, and locked it, blocking out their cursing outside the door.
Soon after, you hear your parents arguing again, but that doesn't matter anymore. You just hurriedly walk over and turn on your computer, feeling a rare sense of comfort and relaxation in the quiet of the room.
While waiting for the computer to turn on, you might daydream, thinking that marrying those promising young men your mother mentioned is definitely not a good choice. They always hope you achieve greater things, yet criticize the small mistakes you make in daily life. Once, you only felt wronged because of this, but later, you listened coldly, skillfully closing the door to briefly block out the noise — until you reached the dark world, and that noise finally faded away.
Think about it, if you really want to get married, your partner might be spamton—wait, why do you think that?
You clutch your chest in confusion, feeling your heart racing up, and you can't care about anything else, because the computer has just turned on.
You skillfully connect to the internet, then open your email, dig through the trash bin, dig through the spam folder, and choose to restore each folder one by one.
Think about it, these emails were probably sent to you by Spamton—after all, the subject lines of these emails all say [Limited Time Offer] [50% OFF].
And some more...... If you accidentally click in, you'll see emails about [valued at only $4.99] and [Bodybuilding Physique], and some are [Only 250 Dark Coins] [Limited-time special offer].
You, unusually patient, calmly clicked through emails one by one, checked them, and then restored them. Fortunately, they weren't deleted forever.
Some emails feature promotions about coffee, some contain fake potted flowers, and others contain all kinds of imitation paintings—without exception, these emails are spam and ignored.
You restored each of these emails one by one, then breathed a sigh of relief, rekindling hope in your heart—you hoped that when you returned, you could see Spamton still alive and well, standing there perfectly fine. If ...... If the Dark People lost their carrier and could no longer survive, then you hoped you could provide them with a small carrier. You hoped that these restored, deleted, and broken spam emails could be pieced together into a complete Spamton.
And just as you recover all your emails and are about to shut down your computer and return to the Dark World, you hear a "ding" sound, indicating that a new email has arrived.
Check your inbox. Time...... It's just now, and the subject of this email is: Hello, do you need a [100% success rate] [Confession card]?
Your hand trembled as you swallowed twice—you knew this email was sent to you by Spamton, probably because your computer was turned on, so you received it. Your heart was beating faster and faster. Did you have some kind of cure-all-in-the-middle illness? Anyway, the mouse moved, and I still clicked on the email.
[Hello, may I ask if you need a [100% success rate] and a [confession card]?
Dear Ms. Y/N, we sincerely thank you for your willingness to order the [SPAM] service.
We are now promoting our store with a 100% positive review rate, a limited-time special confession card!
The content is: [I love you], this love is [known by everyone].
I dedicate all my loyalty and passion to the respected and dear Miss Y/N.
I hope to spend this life and grow old together with you.
This [Confession Card] is currently priced at only 520 Dark Coins! ]
You swallowed hard, staring blankly at the email. Clutching your chest, you felt the pounding of your heart. Suddenly, you understood—
You murmured, "Ah, so ...... I'm not sick at all. ”
You just love him, and it seems you love him very much. You don't really know what love is...... But you think that perhaps this is how it should feel.
You wiped away the tears streaming down your eyes, looked at the letter carefully once again, then smiled slightly and silently answered in your heart, "Yes, I love you too."
Then you shut down your computer, reopened the door, and walked out.
You ignore your parents' angry voices, ignore those voices that seem to be for your own good but actually control and oppress you, ignore the noise in the room, and ignore the noise of the crowd. At this moment, all you can hear is the sound of your heart beating in your chest. All you can think of is that letter, Spamton's smiling face, that he might be carefully but smiling as he prepares this card, his excited expression when the flowers bloom and his joy as he can't help but hug you, his nervous, anticipatory look as he carefully serves you freshly made desserts, his eyes shining as he rubs against your palm, and the occasional time when you come home late, He hugged you tightly, as if afraid of something. Thinking of you sleeping half-awake in the middle of the night with a fever, seeing Spamton sleeping on your bedside, and how he had gone several kilometers away to queue for two hours just to bring you a snack because of a single sentence......
With these memories, you step off the subway, walk against the crowd, ignore their discussions, and return to the boundary between light and darkness, then, following the blinding white light and a wave of dizziness, you return to the dark world.
The roadside addison disappeared, and you hurried back to the place where the garbage pile was, only to find that the road to the icy cliff, filled with withered lavender and heavy snow, had also vanished.
With a mixture of nervousness and slight excitement, you returned home. It was already very late. You opened the door to your house. It was bright inside, and there was Spamton sitting idly at the dining table, writing your name on a piece of paper in boredom, waiting for you.
When he saw you return, his eyes suddenly lit up. He ran over and hugged you, and you instinctively opened your arms to catch him.
Spamton's fluffy head rubbed against your neck, as if complaining and acting spoiled, "Why are you only coming back...... I almost thought you weren't coming back. That scared me, I called you but didn't answer...... And didn't reply to your messages. Hmm, I replied to your texts, you can take a look! ”
He spoke and then raised his head as if seeking approval, his eyes sparkling as he looked at you. Perhaps it was just an illusion, but he seemed a little shorter, more like he was during the earlier Addison period.
You take out your phone and see that he really did send you a message, basically saying he's sorry he was busy and didn't reply. Now he's home, but he hasn't seen you and asks where you've been.
You rubbed his head and softened your voice: "Mm, I'm back...... As for where you asked where I went, I can answer now—I went to the world of light. ”
Spamton's body stiffened, and he stammered, "You...... What are you doing in the Light World? ”
You lowered your gaze and didn't answer his question, instead of asking, "During the time you didn't reply to my messages...... What were you doing? ”
Spamton was a bit flustered. He clasped his hands behind his back and lowered his head, not daring to look at you. He knew very well that he was lying.
"Nothing...... It's just that a few people of light visited the advertising world, and I'll handle them. "Of course, it's not entirely a lie.
You were silent for a while, just lightly and lightly. Spamton couldn't hear the emotion in your words; he only knew you said one sentence: "Is that so?" ”
…… Well, for some reason, he was a bit afraid you'd be angry, he ...... Still afraid you'd abandon him because of those lies? Spamton was a bit stunned, then remembered you had promised him you would never truly reject him, so he finally lifted his head, puffing out his cheeks, a bit aggrieved and angry.
“…… I really was dealing with those Lightfolk, but later they wanted to seal the dark fountain that made up this dark world, so I stopped them...... The Howling Knight doesn't keep his word! I clearly held off those Lightfolks for quite a while! But in the end, he still slashed me twice! "As he spoke, he tugged at his collar and showed you those two wounds, just like the sealed mail seals, but now the wounds had become extremely faint.
Your fingers gently stroked those two wounds, then you lowered your head and softly blew a couple of breaths on them. Spamton was stunned for a moment, his cheeks instinctively flushed, his eyes darting left and right: "I...... It doesn't hurt anymore. ”
So, you don't need to blow on the pain anymore; it can fly away.
But you just touched the wound and said seriously, "But it must have hurt a lot at the time. I hope...... This can soothe the pain in your memories. So what happened afterward? How could your injury be okay and come home? ”
Spamton was stunned for a moment, but still answered instinctively, "Mm...... I don't know what happened either. All I know is that I've been lying in that snowy patch for a very, very long time, and I'm almost losing consciousness...... In a daze, the two separate halves rejoined again, and my mind returned a bit. Although there were still scars, I was much better......
You patted his head: "So in this situation, Spammy insisted on going home to prepare dinner for me?" Spammy is very strong, truly impressive. "You squinted slightly and scratched his chin again. Spamton instinctively squinted in response to your movement, making a purring sound. Then he suddenly opened his eyes, looked up at you, and his tone was a bit fierce: "No, don't think you can change the subject just because of this. You haven't answered my question yet!" ”
But...... You don't seem to need to answer his question? After all, between you two...... Is it necessary to know these details? Spamton was stunned for a moment, his heartbeat suddenly erratic. Once again, he didn't dare look at you, just lowered his head.
You just sighed, patted his head, then tried hard to hold back the tears in your eyes and suddenly hugged Spamton.
Your voice was still tinged with tears: "I saw everything, I saw everything...... You lay alone in the snow. I thought going back to the world of light might help you get better, so I went back. As it turned out, you really did get better." Your words were fairly calm, but Spamton's eyes also turned red.
He hugged you tightly as well, his voice still a bit stammering: "But...... But? Don't you really dislike the Light World...... "After all, although you are a citizen of Light, you have never mentioned the Light World. Spamton naturally assumed you hated the Light World very much, and of course, he never mentioned it in front of you.
“I really dislike the Light World, but you’re more important… so, going back once for you is worth it.” As you said this, you buried your head in Spamton’s fluffy neck and shoulders, rubbing away the tears in your eyes. Spamton could feel a bit of wetness on his shoulder, and your voice was muffled.
He fell silent for a moment, opened his mouth but didn't know what to say, and finally just smiled and said, "Ah, Y/N is really amazing, like saving me again—though I don't know how you did it, the reason I'm standing here fine is because of Y/N! I like you the most! ”
The first ...... was to take him out of the garbage heap. From then on, his destiny changed, like a flower blooming with new vitality. And this time...... Once again, he escaped the environment that only made him cry, helpless, and powerless to escape.
Maybe this sentence was just a casual remark, or maybe it was ...... Every time it was sincere, his heart pounding, every time, every time it was like this. And seeing you just respond with a hum after hearing that, Spamton would only suppress his downward mood, lift his face again, and smile at you.
But this time, you only gently patted his back and softly said, 'Mm, I like spammy the most too, no... I love you the most.' You finally responded to a line that sounded somewhat like a joke, yet also somewhat like a heartfelt confession. This time, you chose to believe what he said, you chose... to believe in an unknown promise.
You are willing to re-entrust this unknown emotion, perhaps called "love," to Spamton.
Spamton's face flushed again. He was relieved that they were embracing at this moment. You couldn't see his expression, but you could still feel his body stiffening slightly.
"Ah...... Huh? Mm, I, I love you. "He felt a burning heat at this moment, his mind almost crashed, and he simply didn't know what he was saying. He thought this time the answer would be another 'mm'...... But now, his heart was blooming with joy, just holding you tightly, feeling the sudden joy and pleasure rising in his chest. The pounding sound in his chest seemed to pierce through his skin, and that sincere and warm emotion enveloped him, so much so that at this moment, Spamton only felt sweetness, even if it was just a simple hug.
"Y/N is the best...... I love you the most. "He murmured, repeating the sentence. His head rubbed against your neck too, fluffy and a bit ticklish.
And you let go of his tight embrace: "I know, I like you the most. Our Spammy is the best—I just tried to restore those spam ads in the trash bin, and now you can stand here again. That's great." ”
As you spoke, you picked up the food on the table, planning to heat it up yourself.
Spamton patted his cheeks, which had not yet fully lost his warmth, and followed behind you into the kitchen: "Wait a moment, let me take care of things!" Y/N, you just need to sit there! ”
His heart was still pounding, although he was also skeptical about whether the Dark People really had such a thing...... But if he said it existed, then it did! The corners of his mouth couldn't help but curl up. Now...... In other words, his existence as a Dark Tribe in the form or carrier of the Light World...... was actually the spam mail you had restored. Only then did he remember that, when he was unconscious, he had once tried sending mass advertising emails to users of the Light World. Of course, he also knew one of them had been sent to your computer. Even though your computer hadn't been turned on for a long time and hadn't been connected to the internet for a long time......
So, he must have voluntarily chosen those spam emails as carriers. Even though it's just spam...... But you really value all of it.
Spamton quietly lowered his head, picked up the tray, and walked toward the kitchen, while you didn’t notice his expression, just raising your voice to respond: “I also need to do something. Spammy should be sitting there and resting properly, you’ve obviously suffered a serious injury…”
Spamton insisted, "But Y/N made a special trip to the Light World just for me, which must have been tough too...... You're tired too, right? Leave these things to me! ”
You two held out for a while, then looked at each other and suddenly burst out laughing.
In the end, you all just did some work as usual.
At the dinner table, Spamton hesitated for a moment, but finally spoke up. This time, his voice was somewhat serious: "Y/N...... Although I was happy and felt it was inappropriate to talk about these sad things at a time like this, I still had to say, this world is about to disappear. ”
You stopped eating, just looking at Spamton with a hint of confusion: "Are you going to disappear?" "But you're still sitting here perfectly fine?"
He cleared his throat: "Not today, not now, but in a week...... I made a deal with those Lightfolk. I won't stop them from sealing the Dark Fountain, but on the other hand, they won't be able to act until a week later. ”
As he spoke, his voice grew quieter: "So...... I'm no longer the advertiser. After seven days, when this dark world completely disappears, I won't be anymore. ”
"But you'll always be spamton, so it's okay." You just curved your eyebrows slightly.
Spamton was stunned for a moment. He lowered his head, not letting you see his reddened eyes: "Mm...... Mm! I promised beforehand that I would come see your art exhibition every day, but I missed my appointment and didn't go today...... So I specifically took a week to properly visit your exhibition! ”
"Alright, I'll introduce everything to you in detail, one by one. But after this week, where are we going to go? ”
Spamton pouted, clearly not very happy: "Specifically, the other two Lightfolk will tell you later. Anyway, from now on, we'll all have to move to Castle Town to live." ”
"Alright, I know...... Then when the time comes, you and I will both have to find new jobs, right? "You think seriously about this question.
Spamton just nudged your arm: "Let's talk about this later. For now, focus on your meal, or the food will get cold later!" ”
You understand, this is just a very forced excuse to change the subject...... Maybe Spamton is still more or less worried about the future? But you haven't exposed this, since in the days to come, you'll always be there for him, no matter what happens.
So you just smiled and softened your voice, replying, "Alright, alright." ”
After dinner, as usual, Spamton went to the kitchen with the dishes to wash them, while you sat on the living room sofa, lost in thought, thinking about the future and what to do next. At that moment, your phone lit up, and you realized it was a message from the gallery owner.
You glanced at your phone screen—it was telling you that the gallery would close in seven days, and you'd have to settle your wages for the month. You know, it's because this dark world is about to disappear that the gallery will close. You put away your phone and let out a gentle breath.
And the next morning, Spamton was syncing with you, sticking with you all the way to the gallery. He said righteously, "Anyway, this dark world is about to disappear, and he's no longer the owner of ads—he's basically an unemployed vagrant. Of course, he can go wherever he wants!"
You followed him into the gallery, and at first he just excitedly shouted, "I'm about to see the painting Y/N drew for me...... I'm so nervous. I wonder if many people of darkness will come to see ......."
It wasn’t until he entered the gallery that he hushed, eyes wide, staring at the paintings on the wall—he thought there would only be a few; he thought you would display the other past works as well, since Spamton believed those paintings should also be seen by the other Dark World residents. But he didn’t know—you had actually made so many, all starring him. As far as the eye could see, there were all kinds of… his silhouettes, pieces of life he shared with you.
He quietly walked forward, the first painting ...... He still had some impressions—it was that day when he was tinkering with the flowers, and you drew it on a whim—probably the first painting. Later on, some were scenes of him busy in the kitchen, some dozing off on the sofa, some grinding coffee, and some of his sparkling eyes showing off the newly made desserts. Spamton didn't even know...... When did you record all this? It was only then that he realized that you had seen everything.
After all, there are two more paintings, probably just your imagination—the first shows Spamton in a conference hall, directly commanding the other Dark People. Of course, this meeting room is just your imagination, completely different from the one he was in.
The second painting was of him proudly patrolling the shopping street. The small shop that used to be white Addison had been closed, and he was standing there, seemingly pointing and talking about other Addison shops.
Spamton turned his back to you, he's a bit afraid to turn his head to look at you, but his voice was a bit dry: "...... When did you paint it? How come I have no idea at all? ”
You rubbed your chin and thought for a moment: "Most of it was drawn in my own room...... After all, you've never seen it in my room before, so it's normal not to know, right?" "Except for that time, when you brought Spamton into your room, he hasn't gone in since. You know, that's respecting your privacy. Of course, you never tried to find out what exactly he was preparing, after all...... You would respect his thoughts, no matter how curious you are, you wouldn't sneak a peek!
Spamton remained silent, just walking down the corridor filled with paintings, until he finally stopped in front of that ...... Your family portrait. The term 'family portrait' was actually Spamton's own name. After all, your family only had you as a citizen of light and a person of darkness as well.
He looked at himself in the painting, smiling carefreely, and suddenly smiled too. He turned around and smiled at you: "I have an idea. Right in front of this painting, how about we take another photo together?" ”
You nod as if it were only natural: "Of course you can." ”
You might think, maybe he also wants to leave a little memory in this disappearing advertising world.
The store manager volunteered to step forward, holding an instant camera to take photos of you.
So Spamton puts his arm around your shoulder, and together with you, smiles at the camera, taking a precious photo together—of course, his current height has lost the advantage of being the master of this dark world, and he's reverted to the same state as he did in Addison, so he has to stand on tiptoe just to put his arm around your shoulder.
You suppress your laughter, and when you see other Addisons also come to the gallery to view the exhibition, you wave to them, and they come closer, gathering around you.
Pink looked impatient, but still said, "Alright, you want to take a photo together, right? We happened to be here today." ”
Blue glanced at Pink, then at Spamton: "I was clearly worried Spamton would come to the gallery......" But before he could finish, Yellow covered his mouth.
"Well, looking at it now, it actually seems like a good thing." Orange tried to smooth things over, skillfully sidling with Spamton.
You smiled, hugged Spamton, resting your head on his, with the other four Addisons surrounding you. Then, click, a photo was taken, captured as a keepsake, developed from the instant camera.
Of course, this group photo was copied four times and given to the other four Addisons. Spamton was a bit reluctant but still gave it away. And for your group photo, you used that family portrait as the background, framed in a photo frame, and placed it in the most prominent spot in the living room.
A week isn't long either, but not too short. The art exhibition ended, the gallery closed, and this dark world was about to disappear. In the end, Spamton hesitantly tugged at your sleeve and whispered, "...... Go to the shopping street. I told them that when they arrive at the time of the transaction, a Lightfolk will come looking for them. ”
You nod and head to the shopping street, where waiting for you are two Dark People, one human, and the other ...... Seems like monsters? You're not sure either, since the community you live in is still mostly human.
The purple girl who looked a bit like a dinosaur greeted you cheerfully, while the other blue boy didn't say a word.
She tells you that all the Dark People can live in Castle Town; you just need to move the corresponding objects from the Light World there.
You suddenly realize that you have left this dark world, and they have sealed the dark fountain of this world. You can no longer enter this dark world.
Feeling a bit disappointed? Indeed...... But with a bit of anticipation and a smile, you set out again on the road back to your original home. You no longer cared about those voices; after all, none of them mattered to you anymore.
You push open the door again, and your parents' gazes immediately turn toward you.
His mother was the first to shout: "You've called so many times and you still won't answer. I told you, you're old enough to find a place for your future. I've worried so much that my hair turned white over you, and you don't even glance at me. You must feel sorry for your parents!" ”
My father sighed too: "We've worried about you since we were little. Whatever you want, we haven't given it to you...... Look at this room—aren't these all the things you've been loudly trying to get? And only when you go to a good family can you focus on painting, right? ”
You ignore their voices, just walk into your room, bring out that computer, and you know Spamton survives on the spam stored in your mailbox.
When you walk out of the bedroom, your mother's voice suddenly rises: "Why won't you listen at all! We're doing this for your own good......"
You stopped in your tracks and turned to look at them. Although you tried hard to stay calm, your voice was still choked: "No, you ...... It's not love for me at all. You say it's for my own good, but it's really just to satisfy ...... Your own vanity. ”
Mother opened her mouth, her voice sharp: "Not at all—"
And you interrupted her: "That's it. You don't love me, you're just manipulating me. You don't see me as a child, a child worthy of your love, so I don't need parents like you either; I no longer need your love." ”
Sobbing and choking up, you feel your vision blur, and you just step back toward the door, smiling: "I won't come back. This isn't my home either. I'm going back to my own home now." ”
There is spamton, sunshine, smiles, eyes that always wait for you and anticipate you, voices that affirm you no matter what, your lover and your eternal family.
You closed the door, shutting out your parents' noise, feeling a sense of relief in your heart, and your steps becoming lighter. You beamed with a smile, leaving the past behind. You were about to walk toward your own future. This time, it was a future entirely decided by you—no scolding from your parents, no manipulation after superficial discussion. Now, you were going home.
You arrive at the address the purple girl gave you, put the computer inside, and then arrive in Castle Town. Having just experienced dizziness, you open your eyes when Spamton hugs you tightly.
"Welcome home!" Even though you were just standing on the streets of Castle Town, while other Dark Folk passing by were looking at you strangely, Addison only chuckled. The employees originally from the advertising world passed by, gave you and Spamton a flirtatious look, and then walked off again.
And you just sniffed, hugged Spamton back, and buried your head in his neck: "Mm, I'm back." ”
That day, while you were tidying up your new residence in Castle Town, you found the artwork Spamton had once shown you, along with some unsold fake flowers. You smiled and carefully stored those things away in the cabinet. As for that slightly wilted sunflower...... You took good care of it and placed it on the windowsill. As the sunflower grew and bloomed facing the sun, it was as if a small seed had been planted in your heart, growing and blooming.
Spamton, for some reason, transplanted those flowers to the square in the center of Castle Town, confidently surprised you, and solemnly took out a pot of roses he had grown to confess to you.
