That sea of flowers still remains in the square, and you have simply returned home with Spamton. The future is still long, very long, and you will walk into the future together with Spamton.
So...... Welcome home.
END.

title: Time Practices (Part 4)

content:
[4]
The advertiser is holding another meeting. Judging by the frequency of meetings, this isn't that strange, but if you look at the content of the meetings...... At least, no other employees have seen these things.
After all, this time, their boss was cheerfully showing off a piece of art made from countless bottles of mineral water, which was filled with fake flowers.
Spamton just raised an eyebrow and announced, "Next, we're going to advertise this...... The theme is probably that you can grow flower arrangements using different vessels!" As he spoke, he weighed the items in his hand again.
"Anyway, it's probably something like this kind of artwork! If you have any good ideas, you can let me know. If the artwork really succeeds, we can continue promoting it. ”
He definitely didn't think there was anything about the brand he was putting out that couldn't sell—moreover, based on his research on the Lumens, humans do indeed prefer these inexplicable art pieces, just like that urinal Addison showed him last time. As long as he sold it under the banner of 'art' and advertised it, some Lumens would inevitably click to take a look.
…… Even though he himself felt the vase had little aesthetic value. Calling it a vase was just a bunch of mineral water bottles stacked together for flower arrangements, and to prevent fake flowers from loosening, he had filled each bottle with flowers, which made them look even less aesthetic and just bloated.
Pink couldn't hold back and retorted, "But this doesn't look like art at all. There won't be any pop-up pop-ups for the Light folks to buy......
Before he could finish, Spamton interrupted him. Spamton just raised his eyebrows high; his meeting would not allow any other Dark People to object. No matter what, he was the ruler of this world.
"But my Lumens at home said this looks great! Y/N said I'm really amazing, whatever I make will definitely sell well!" Spamton said cheerfully. He didn't care about the wording you originally used; it was basically the same meaning… Although he also felt yesterday that you probably only said those things to flatter him. Yet Spamton didn't care at all; he only heard what he wanted to hear, and indeed, he had heard you say it!
Even if it's just a lie...... He's willing to believe it, because you said it yourself.
The Dark People's eye twitched; no matter how you listened, it sounded like Spamton was showing off. Honestly, they found it hard to believe that was the truth...... These employees had more or less seen you before, so of course they knew you probably said that to appease the advertiser.
As for exposing his identity with you? They wouldn't dare do that. In this world, Spamton determines their fate...... Even if you speak, he won't do anything to your face, but what about behind your back? They wouldn't dare imagine what Spamton would do behind your back.
Yellow's eyes darted around. Since that's the case, it was better to follow Spamton's words. So he created a pop-up window and made up a pattern—probably stacking discarded cardboard boxes and arranging fake flowers on top: "Then I think we can take it further!" For example...... He advertised that all these artworks were recycled from waste, and that some people of light with compassion would definitely click in to take a look. ”
Spamton nodded in satisfaction, while the other Addisons glared angrily at Yellow. Of course, he could think of anything he could think of, but he had already taken the initiative and spoke out first.
"Yeah, Y/N's taste is really great! Our upcoming theme is waste recycling—let's give it a fresh look!" Orange followed along with a cheerful smile, adding a bit of praise just like Spamton.
Spamton's brows relaxed, his mood lifted, and he looked much more beautiful. He waved his hand grandly: "Then let's follow Orange's instructions. Next is the topic!" By the way, each employee should buy one to take home first. ”
As soon as he said this, the staff below started complaining again. Shadow Guy couldn't speak, so he could only play a saxophone tune expressing anger and resentment. The pippins thought for a moment, then their eyes darted around and went to negotiate with the other Addisons. The gist was that if multiple groups bought together, could the final total price be a bit cheaper?
Unfortunately, Spamton also heard the murmurs below. He waved his finger, looking serious: "Group purchases won't offer discounts! Each one can only be paid at the original price." He emphasized the last few words, and the pippins quieted down, still trying to struggle until they heard Spamton's next sentence.
"Besides that, for every artwork promoted to the People of Light, they get a 50 Dark Coin commission. Including the previous trash can flower arranging." "Spamton knows that the Light Tribe never clicked on pop-ups before; they must have treated it as spam. As for now...... He just wants to make the sales look better, so he can show you the number of transactions and the Dark Coins he earned.
After saying this, the meeting was almost over, but before Addison could leave, Spamton suddenly remembered what you said yesterday and added: "Oh right, my dear colleagues, next weekend Y/N is treating you all to a meal, so you have to complete your respective targets in advance." There was a hint of jest and schadenfreude in his tone. He knew these former colleagues wouldn't dare to tell you the truth—if they did, Spamton would let these 'good colleagues' taste the feeling of misery… well, joking, of course.
Addison and the others were all stunned for a moment. They glanced at each other, but for a moment, no one spoke. In the end, it was Blue who spoke: "...... Where will the location be then? ”
This was something neither you nor Spamton had considered, so he stood with his hands on his hips, a bit stunned. Honestly...... Of course, the first option is to pass your place. He definitely doesn't want these Addisons to come over; he always feels a bit unfairly uneasy.
He pondered for a moment, then finally said, "...... Cyber BBQ Restaurant, right? Yes, just go there, it's just right." As he spoke, it sounded like he was murmuring, but in fact...... He actually didn't want to go back to that place either.
But he decided he had to face his past head-on. Although the future now was what he hoped for, he still felt something was missing...... Maybe it was the past he once desperately wanted to deny was missing. But it was precisely because of his unbearable past that you kept him.
But no matter what...... At least, maybe he hopes your involvement can save the lost and helpless self he once was. He can change the past that has been repeated. He can ...... Let him choose to accept himself again, or in other words, be willing to love the person he once was because of your love.
The Addisons exchanged glances again, nodded, and said in unison, "Got it," then walked out of the meeting room. Once again, only Spamton remained in the room, and he felt the coldness and suddenly became genuinely afraid—afraid that when he showed you his achievements and the dark coins he earned, you'd laugh and say he could stand on his own, live on his own, and in a way, kick him out—even if your intentions were just good.
He simply pushed these chaotic and complicated thoughts aside, walked out of the meeting room, and only felt at ease as he watched the rising Dark Coin accumulation. But when he thought of you, he felt a bit empty inside. He transferred the dark coins from the vase art he sold today into another account, planning to show you this account when he got back, show it off to you, and then get a few compliments from you. Thinking of this, Spamton couldn't help but curl his lips, feeling delighted again.
So he returned home with such a happy mood. It wasn't until he stood at the door that he swallowed nervously, feeling nervous again. In the end, he carefully opened the door. You were sitting across the dining table, on which was a freshly made, still steaming pizza.
And seeing Spamton cautiously peek inside as he opened the door for a look, you couldn't help but feel it was somewhat funny, but you just smiled warmly and said, "Welcome home."
Spamton paused for a moment, pushed the door open, hung his coat on the rack, and set down his bag, nervously adjusting his hair that wasn't even messy—he just wanted to maintain a good image in your eyes, always.
You quietly watched him. Spamton cleared his throat and sat down on the chair opposite you, also smiling, 'Hmm, I'm back.'
Then he placed his arm on the table, unintentionally revealing a wound on his forearm—actually, this wound was caused earlier during his inspection on the shopping street, when Yellow accidentally bumped into him and knocked over a vase. The broken ceramic pieces caused this cut. It was a minor wound, easily healable with any healing magic Addison had. But he stopped Yellow from trying to fix it afterward and didn't use magic himself, intending to elicit a bit of your sympathy with this small injury.
So he just covered it with a black shirt, but naturally, when he rested his arm on the table and the shirt pulled back slightly with momentum, the wound became partially visible.
Of course, you noticed too, hurriedly stopped his hand, then carefully lifted up, grabbed his arm, rolled up his sleeve, and saw the wound still bleeding, not yet fully healed. It looked scary, a long wound, but in reality, it wasn't a big deal—after all, it hadn't gone very deep.
Still, you furrowed your brow, understandably feeling concerned because he was hurt.
'...Don't rush to eat yet. Let's take care of the wound first!' you said, running to your room to pull out a first-aid kit from under your bed, something you had prepared long ago but never used. You also glanced at the similarly dust-covered alley nearby, finally lowering your eyes.
…… Those are your old memories, but you have never opened them. You only want to start a brand new life, even avoiding touching on your past. Even if the past is just as important to you.
Shaking your head, you discard those thoughts, run out, take out a cotton swab dipped in iodine to carefully wipe his wound, and with a hint of concern and reproach, say, "What's going on...... Such a long wound looks terrifying. ”
Spamton just lowered his head, softly answering your question, 'It's just... those Addison saw that my items sold well and wanted to take them, then we argued, and we broke a vase...'
You sighed, reaffirming your resolve, vowing to talk to those Addison properly next weekend. You wrapped Spamton's arm in bandages, then ruffled his hair: 'You dare to resist, dare to face these injustices. My Spamton is amazing!'
...No, you had no idea of the truth. Spamton thought about this with rare bitterness.
But he only dared to lower his head, staring blankly at the bandage you had just bandaged, lost in thought. He didn't dare let you see his expression, nor the unease and bitterness he might be revealing. He stared at the bandage, staring at the small wound that could have been healed with just a spell, barely sorting out his tangled and complicated emotions.
Do you regret deceiving you? Maybe not...... Because he's afraid that once you know the truth, he won't show him such genuine care anymore, and he's afraid he won't be able to feel love from you again.
But maybe always deceiving you isn't a good thing, but trying to explain everything from the beginning is hard to begin. Spamton opened his mouth, about to reveal the whole truth, but your voice interrupted him again.
"By the way, how are your fake flower art products selling?" Actually, you didn't really know what to say. You just felt it wasn't good to let the room sink into silence, so you spoke up and randomly picked a question.
Spamton snapped back to reality, perked up again, and answered your question with a big smile: "It sold very well, a full hundred copies!" "And it was exactly the number of employees under his command...... Yes, aside from those he forced to buy and sell, nothing else was sold.
But he believes that with commissions as an attraction, there will always be employees who make sales. As for commissions...... Speaking of which, it should be considered part of the fairness you want, right? Spamton can't be sure.
And the truth he had just instinctively wanted to blurt out was buried by him. He thought, since that's the case, he'll wait until next time, when he's sure he's ready to speak, and then tell you. Unfortunately...... Spamton wasn't sure if there was still such an opportunity.
You tilted your head, a bit puzzled, probably not expecting this so-called artwork to actually sell, nor to expect so many copies to exist.
"All of these...... Are they all sold by you? Do you have that much stock? Do you need my help...... You look a bit worried. Although you haven't done any art or handicraft work in a long time, you think it shouldn't be too hard to pick it up again for him.
Spamton was a bit stuck. He was a bit annoyed—if he'd known, he wouldn't have said 100 servings so directly—his shop didn't have that many!
But he cleared his throat and came up with another lie, unusually feeling guilty because it was completely false: "I sold them all! There are only five or six items left in stock, so the rest are all pre-orders. I'll come pick them up in a few days...... I don't need your help, I can handle it myself!" He smiled to hide his panic.
You stared at him steadily, long enough that Spamton began to wonder if maybe he had said something wrong and you were about to expose his lie, feeling genuinely uneasy, and then you lightly nodded and leaned in to ruffle his hair: "I see… business is booming, Spammy who came up with this is really amazing."
You smiled, despite ...... You had already realized that this sentence was probably a lie. After all, when he spoke, he didn't even dare look you in the eye, constantly glancing to the upper left. It was obvious he was just fabricating the scene from before. But you still chose to follow his words.
Sometimes you can't figure it out—he could have told you the truth, so why lie again? Even if you're willing to believe his lies, because most lies hide genuine emotions, revealing past fears and fears, anxiety, and grievances. You've been waiting for the day he is willing to tell you the truth. If it's always a lie, that's fine.
…… You are willing to favor him, tolerate him, and accept the lies he says.
Maybe at first it was just a simple exploitation...... You guess that's how it is, but for some reason, this somewhat twisted relationship has persisted until now.
You rub his head, and Spamton instinctively rubs his furry head against your palm. You hear his voice full of affection and joy: "I like you the most!" ”
You're a bit distracted—is that really true? But...... But why did things end up like this? You don't understand.
So, this statement is probably false. You immediately put it out of your mind, just a beat too late to respond with a "hmm."
Spamton's movements finally slowed down, though still rubbing slowly against your palm: "By the way, Y/N, we promised you were treating my colleagues to dinner...... They set the venue at Cyber BBQ." By the end, his voice gradually softened.
You nod gently, then remembered Spamton was looking down and couldn't see your movements, so you replied, "Alright, I know." ”
“…… That place is where they once threw a coffee cup at my head. "He grabbed your hand, but this time rested it on your chin, and he looked up at you, showing a pitiful expression.
"So...... The place where they said they would throw you into the trash was also that place? "You paused for a moment, then recalled the first time we met, while Spamton just blinked at you and said nothing.
"I know...... Although I can't guarantee I'll help you get revenge, I can make sure they don't do it again. "You scratched his chin, assuring him.
Actually, even if you hadn't said anything, those Addisons wouldn't dare do anything to him anymore—after all, he was a big boss. But Spamton just blinked and said nothing, after all...... What he hoped for wasn't the present, but the past—the past he once didn't want to face, even hated, to be changed.
You also scratched his cheeks before sitting back across from him. You had been waiting specifically for Spamton to return; dinner hadn't even been eaten yet, and bandaging his wound wasted a bit of time, so the pizza had cooled off slightly.
But it's still edible, so you plan to pick up a piece and eat it directly.
But Spamton held your hand down: "Some have cooled down. I'll heat them up before you eat." ”
You paused for a moment and instinctively said, "No need to go to such trouble......" After all, you've had dinner like this many times in the world of light. Many times, even when dinner got cold, your parents still hadn't come home. Many times, they broke their promise from yesterday.
But Spamton had already walked into the kitchen carrying that plate, and you heard the sound of the heating plate and microwave, so you could only sigh softly. Even though you were sighing, the corners of your mouth couldn't help but lift. You touched the corner of your mouth, a bit dazed.
While you were still dazed, the microwave stopped, and Spamton came out carrying the pizza again, placing it in front of you. You touched it—the temperature was just right.
Spamton secretly felt proud. Previously, just in time for you to come home, he had prepared a steaming dinner just right, and he had studied the heat control of each item. So heating the pizza to this temperature for a long time was just right.
He doesn't think about how you might react; he just instinctively lifts his cheeks and looks at you with sparkling eyes, begging you to praise him.
And you naturally curved your eyes: "The temperature is just right, thank you, spammy...... You're really amazing! ”
You see him lift his head proudly and can't help but laugh too.
And so, dinner ended happily. After dinner, Spamton tidied up the leftover bowls and chopsticks, then sat on the sofa and started making art pieces with those mineral water bottles.
…… He really did regret it a little. If he'd known, he wouldn't have mentioned pre-ordering earlier. He just told you that giving them counterfeit or inferior products would be better than doing handicrafts here...... Alright, you'll definitely say that way.
Although Spamton only plans to make a few for show, leaving the rest to the staff themselves, at worst they just pay and get a picture. After all, the actual product doesn't necessarily match the pictures.
You sighed and sat down next to Spamton. Spamton felt the sofa sink in one spot, and when he turned to look at you, you picked up several bottles of mineral water as well.
"Almost 100 servings? How can you finish it? Let me help you." You said softly, picking up scissors and glue to start working.
Spamton didn't know whether to tell you that what he just said was just deceiving you—but he didn't want to bother you, because under your command, what used to be something he had just haphazardly assembled had now truly become a work of art.
You cut off the base of the bottle, glue the mouth together, and trim some plastic strips from the sides of the bottle as decoration. Soon, a piece of art resembling a sunflower appeared in your hands.
Spamton stares at you blankly, even forgetting to continue what he's doing. You glance at him with some confusion: "Stop staring at me all the time...... Hurry up and do it." ”
"Oh oh…" He lowered his head to fiddle with the 'art piece' he was working on halfway, but his mind wasn't on it. He kept thinking, you clearly had the talent and interest to do other art-related work, yet you just worked as an ordinary gallery employee. He thought he had no right to interfere with your thoughts and choices, but Spamton still felt sorry for you.
You wouldn't think so much about it, just staring at the "sunflower" in your hand and getting a bit lost in thought—you recall your previous painting imitating that sunflower, but unfortunately, that painting is now tucked away at the very bottom of the box, probably never to be republished in this lifetime.
So you pick up a few bottles of mineral water and repeat the previous work, planning to make a few more sunflowers. You think, maybe if something else happens, you won't remember those previous paintings anymore.
But even though you made several more sunflowers, you couldn't hide your earlier thoughts, so you thought, maybe something else could distract you. So you looked at Spamton again, only to find with amusement that he hadn't even finished the one in his hand.
"spammy, don't you know what shape to tie it into?" You put down the scissors and glue, stretched lazily, and said lazily.
Spamton shivered instinctively, feeling a bit distracted and guilty about being caught by you: "Hmm...... Ah, right, I don't know what shape to tie it into." Then he gave you a cautious smile.
You rubbed his head and thought casually: "Alright, then you can do sunflowers like me. Look, the examples are all right here. You just need to do a quick pom." ”
Spamton nodded. Although he didn't do as well as you, he managed to manage a few things.
When he turns his head with sparkling eyes, hoping for your praise, he finds you already asleep on the back of the sofa, your head tilted and resting on his shoulder.
Spamton was silent for a moment, then got up, carefully carried you to bed, tucked you in, and then gazed at your peaceful sleeping face for a long time before leaving.
On the weekend, at the agreed time, you showed up at the Cyber BBQ Restaurant with Spamton. As soon as you entered, you saw the other Addisons. They were sitting by the window, so you grabbed Spamton's hand and sat right across from them. Honestly, I don't know why they happened to make room across from you, but all four Dark Folk had to squeeze in...... You didn't quite understand, but Pink spoke first.
"It's Spamton who first stole my stuff, so of course, I had to take it back," he said vigorously, arms crossed. Of course, because Spamton was right there, Pink couldn't openly say that Spamton had first taken his stuff and then he took it back, conveniently performing this scene for you.
Pink was grinding his teeth in hatred. He kept thinking to himself, Spamton clearly doesn't like flattering the Lightfolk, yet he's so scheming at it—he must have learned it all for you.
You're a step too slow. According to Pink, Spamton was indeed at fault, but you just waved your hand: "I think we should hear from the parties involved and the witnesses around us about this." "You're very serious. Honestly, you feel like a judge in one of the courtroom games you used to love—honestly, it's pretty fun."
Spamton, on the other hand, just cautiously grabbed your arm, not daring to use too much force, just holding it weakly: "Because...... Pink said bad things about you, and I was upset, so I wanted to steal his stuff. I want to get back at you......
You were stunned again, surprised that Spamton would admit to the matter but explain the reason. Honestly, seeing his head lowered and his weak voice, you couldn't help but soften.
Pink was at a loss for words. He really wanted to say that Spamton was just twisting the truth and talking nonsense—back then, he had only mocked Spamton for being good at winning your favor, so why not try to please the other Light Folk and make the advertising world better? Then Spamton targeted him like this.
And you just gently rub Spamton's head, look up at the other Addisons, and ask, "So what did you see at the time?" ”
"I was quite far away. Spamton did indeed steal Pink's stuff, so later Pink went to the Spamton shop to rob something." Blue said.
“…… Well, anyway, what Pink said back then wasn't very pleasant. "yellow hesitated, obviously not expecting Spamton to twist the facts so much.
"But later, all the customers went to Pink, and we were busy grabbing clients, so we didn't pay attention to this matter." Orange added.
You nodded, then patted Spamton's head. Well, now it seems he was indeed at fault—but you chose to favor him, and besides, he acted for you. If you don't support him, who else will?
So you spoke up, slowly saying, 'Okay, I understand… spammy is indeed at fault, but first, pink spoke unpleasantly, so I think, no matter what, spammy’s actions can only be considered self-defense.' You admitted that you were also quite unreasonable, after all, robbery carries much heavier criminal liability than a few words of dispute… but you believe spamton was not wrong.
How could your Spamton possibly have any major issues?
Pink rolled his eyes helplessly. He felt that you and Spamton were both equally unreasonable; he didn’t understand how you two could think the other was just absolutely great.
But then he heard what you said next: "...... So, I want to know, who poured coffee on my Spammy earlier?" You said with a smile, showing no sign of anger, but the other Addisons all shivered.
Then they all looked at Pink, who was a bit annoyed: "Why are you all staring at me!" ”
And you just tilted your head, looking at Pink as well: "So...... Do you know anything? ”
Pink picked up the coffee cup on the table and took a sip, probably feeling it was getting cold. Instinctively, he threw the cup out—right in the direction of Spamton.
…… Well, actually, before coming, Spamton had already reminded them to reenact the scene from that time. Although they didn't understand what Spamton was really trying to do, they had no choice but to comply. After all, Spamton said they would be given extra overtime pay, which was rare. Normally, they would have paid them out of pocket.
You reached out to catch the coffee cup and held it in front of Spamton. Fortunately, only a few drops spilled and splashed onto you. You placed the cup on the table and said calmly, "So, it really was you." ”
Spamton hid behind you, cautiously poking his head out to look at the other Addisons, then pulled his eyelids into a funny face and grinned at the others. Pink was so angry he nearly fainted.
He rolled his eyes again and said irritably: "Yes, it was me. I asked Spamton to make coffee, but he didn't brew it right. The coffee got a bit cold and tasted terrible. What's wrong with me asking him to drink it?"
“…… You shouldn't have poured coffee on him." You just said slowly. Honestly, you're starting to feel sorry for Spamton again...... Although this is ultimately just a small matter, you can't imagine how many such small incidents have happened before. And often, these little things pile up enough to completely change the course of a life.
“…… He doesn't have coffee anyway, so what's the point of me treating him?" Pink crossed his arms and rolled his eyes again.
"At that time, Spamton volunteered to make us coffee. The other temperatures were just right, except for Pink's cup, which had issues." Yellow added a seemingly considerate comment from the side, but Pink always felt he was a bit gloating.
…… So today the only one being the punching bag is him, who was pushed out to be the punching bag? Pink was a bit annoyed, so he quickly added.
"Do you want to know what happened when he was thrown into the trash heap?"
You nodded. Of course you wanted to know about this...... To be honest, you came here just to find a place for your Spamton. You know this barbecue restaurant probably contains all of Spamton's grievances and sad memories, and you have no idea how much courage it took for him to dare to walk in.
"It was that guy Yellow. When they saw Spamton with a coffee cup on his head, they thought he was better suited to staying in the trash heap, and ...... Spamton couldn't sell a single thing, had no results at all, so treating him as trash was more suitable. "Pink squinted, also speaking with a hint of schadenfreude, thinking that the gloating Yellow just now definitely wouldn't get away.
Now yellow fell silent, just lowered his head, not daring to look at you.
You sighed, "No one should stay in a garbage heap, and no one should be treated as trash. Besides, he's a righteous businessman of the Dark. Even if he doesn't do as well as you, you have no reason to target him." ”
The Addison didn't say anything. Honestly, with Spamton's pitiful look...... They hadn't thought he could be that formidable at first. But now, they just lowered their heads and didn't say a word.
And Spamton just carefully poked your waist. You turned to look at him, and he whispered softly: "…That's enough. After all, they are my colleagues too, no need to make things too awkward. We'll still be interacting in the future…" Saying this, he lowered his head again, his voice slightly pitiful.
You gently wiped his cheek with affection, then looked up: "Alright, anyway, I'm here today...... I just want you to know that I'm the one who protects him, so don't think about doing anything bad anymore." As she spoke, she lightly tapped the table with her knuckles.
The Addisons exchanged glances, thinking to themselves, how could they dare...... Now Spamton is the master of the advertising world, above all the Dark People. It's already good if Spamton doesn't turn around and target them.
They just nodded eagerly: "We know, we know." ”
Even though the play wasn't over yet—because Pink had interrupted and revealed Yellow's previous actions—Spamton still slightly lifted his head, looking at your back with a complicated expression—yes, he knew you'd pass by there, which is why he stayed in the garbage heap for days. Back then, he couldn't imagine the current scene or the chaotic, complicated emotions of today.
His eyes reddened, and he silently wiped away the tears swirling in his eyes with his other free hand. Maybe...... From the start, he wished someone could stand before him. After all, who hasn't thought about being hurt? If only someone had stopped it then.
…… Only when there is no hope or hope do you stumble and get up on your own, trying every possible way and crawling to protect yourself. He once thought that once he became strong, he would take revenge, but now, seeing you standing in his way, he felt ...... This isn't so bad.
Because ...... He was no longer alone; he had something to rely on, no longer having to grit his teeth and complete everything on his own.
And ...... Having someone to rely on feels so good. He thought, he could finally face all of this and stop caring, since what he cared about now was you. Spamton thought, he could truly love the once down-and-out self and the self now full of lies. After all...... He also wanted to give you this love.
You sighed, not noticing the change in Spamton's expression behind you, but Blue did, showing a somewhat complicated expression.
"So...... Is there anything else? If not, let Spamton handle it herself. "You nod, and just as you finished speaking, Orange picked up your words.
"Ah, I used to put on a little dress for Spammy...... To be honest, he actually looks pretty good in a little dress." Orange rubbed his hands with a smile. Anyway, he didn't think he did anything wrong, and you paused for a moment, instinctively turning to look at Spamton, and indeed began to assess what he would look like if he wore a dress......
Spamton, rarely blushing, covers your eyes and whispers close to your ear, "Y/N, you...... If you want to see, I'll wear it alone for you later. ”
You want to say you don't want to see this kind of scene, but you honestly nod—well, maybe you still want it, and you remember, some skirts you bought before that you haven't worn are probably just right for spamton. As for why you stop wearing skirts...... It's just for some personal private reasons.
Spamton glanced at you with some awkwardness. Well, he doesn't mind showing you wearing a skirt...... If others see it, that's not acceptable, especially since advertising for the Light People doesn't require him to risk everything and wear a skirt.
Blue didn't speak, only softly adding when the surroundings had quieted: "From now on, I won't just stand there and watch." ”
…… Bystanders are also accomplices.
You felt everything had been clarified, so you nodded approvingly and said, 'Alright, in any case, my spammy also troubles you!'
The meal was basically over. Next, you ordered some barbecue inside the shop. The atmosphere was quite harmonious, and you were very satisfied.

title: Lucid Dream 1 (dnbsx you)
content:
Atypical detective ynx assistant DNBS and OOC apologize; this article leans toward authentic Japanese deduction.
——
Oh heavens—
You stood with your hands on your hips, looking triumphantly at the building before you—a detective agency you had just rented and renovated. You dreamed of owning a detective agency of your own, but unfortunately, this was too troublesome in the Light World. It might take you several years to have such a small office, so you came to the Dark World. All you needed to do was spend some money and say a few nice words to the queen, and she agreed to lease you part of the territory.
You're really happy, but the agency can't be run by just you; at the very least, it needs an assistant or something. After all, you can't let the detective handle all the work alone! You looked around, looking at this small office. After hesitating for a moment, you decided to go out and look around. After all...... Right now, no Dark People have come to your office, and you have no business at all. You have to go out and work hard to find some cases and bump into them, so you have to make the detective agency's reputation known.
As for the agency's sign—you've already thought it through, it's called Mingmeng Detective Agency. It helps people see through the darkness hidden beneath the light, discerns the reality within dreams, and distinguishes between dreams and falsehoods, and falsehood from reality. Just then, you heard the Queen tell you that there would be a large banquet in Cyber City today, with famous people attending. You were no less enthusiastic, using your identity as a Light Citizen to make others yield, and you walked straight in.
But when you arrive at this lively ball, everything puts you in a bit of a dilemma—you've never attended such a banquet before, after all, you're just an orphan. Although you have good grades, you've never been involved in high society in the Light World. But in the Dark World, as a Light Citizen, you are naturally treated with great respect. As an honored guest, you were invited directly to the seat of honor. Not only that, but you heard them bowing and bowing to welcome another person to take their seats. You looked curiously at the Dark Folk sitting next to you, named Spamton, who seemed to be called Hot Shot—probably a popular figure in the cyber world. Spamton also looked at you curiously. This Light Citizen, said to have arrived in the cyber world yesterday as a human, had even opened a detective agency in the Dark World with the queen's approval...... It seems to be called Mingmeng? But that has nothing to do with me.
You sized him up a few times, noticed his gaze, and met his gaze. But the next second, he smiled again, raised his glass to toast you, and said, "Welcome to the Dark World, Miss of the People of Light." ”
You glanced at your glass, which was filled with the orange juice you specifically requested. After all, you're not good at drinking, and you just hurriedly raised your glass and bumped it with him: "Um...... Thank you, I'm very happy to see you, Mr. Spamton. ”
You heard him chuckle softly: "I wonder if I have the honor to know your name?" You always felt his tone was a bit odd, or maybe the order of words was a bit odd, but you could understand it, so you didn't pay much attention to it.
You just said dryly, "Ah, my name is Y/N." After saying that, you hurriedly swallowed the orange juice in one gulp. You seemed to hear his laughter again, but when you turned to look at him, he was just smiling, as if everything just now was just your imagination.
But you're sure he just smiled, since the smile on his face now was genuine. Even though the curve of his smile and the angle of his eyes looked fake—you knew very well, it was real. Even though you couldn't see his pupils, you were clear about it. You glanced at him thoughtfully, but said nothing. After all, it was just your feeling, and it wouldn't be appropriate to say it out loud.
The banquet went on as usual, and soon you started to get bored. You thought there would be something else at the party, but you saw many Darkfolk going straight to the dance floor after finishing their food and drinks, while you sat there bored, propping up your head and yawning—you definitely don't want to see any of this. Is there any kind of heart-wrenching case happening right in front of you?
At that moment, Spamton turned his head to look at you: "I wonder if I have the honor to invite you to dance with me?" ”
You shivered and looked at the smiling Spamton. You thought he probably had ulterior motives, but you didn't really care what he was up to. You just said dryly, "I, uh, can't dance." After saying that, you gave a couple of awkward laughs.
But Spamton's smile deepened: "It's okay, Miss just needs to follow my movements." "As he spoke, he reached out his hand. You hesitated and looked at him. Well, he didn't mean to embarrass you...... So you held his hand and let him lead you away from your seat.
You walked to the center of the dance floor, the spotlight shining on you. Only then did you feel panic and call out to leave—you didn't want to embarrass yourself, nor did you want to be famous in public! You shouted, "Wait—"
But Spamton was already holding your hand and swinging it in the center of the dance floor. In a panic, you stepped on his foot. You felt a bit embarrassed and was about to say something when the lights in the banquet hall suddenly went out. You heard the panicked voices of the Dark People, the struggling and shouting of each other, and your eyes lit up—you smelled the smell of a case! This must be a case that had happened!
You tried to walk toward the place where the loud noise and glass shattering were coming from, but suddenly landed in a fairly warm embrace, almost a bit fluffy: "Miss Y/N, the lights suddenly went out. I'm afraid something might happen to you...... Sorry to offend you." It was Spamton's deep voice. You blinked and hadn't even said anything more when you saw, not far ahead, beside the banquet table, a Dark Commoner collapsed to the ground, cheeks flushed, even his skin touching the floor completely red...... Beside him fell a broken glass, the green clear liquor soaking the carpet. This Dark Folk seemed dead. In any case, the Dark Folk nearby were all exclaiming, and some were whispering among themselves. They were reciting the identity of the Dark Folk on the ground—it seemed to be an Addison. Then they quietly glanced at Spamton beside you. The moment the light came on, he had already let go of his embrace, but still gently held your hand.
"Quiet, quiet!" A few of the Sakaka butlers you saw in the Queen's villa came out, since this unusual banquet was organized by the Queen's order.
The color card butlers pushed aside the onlookers of the Dark Folk, then began checking the condition of the fallen Addison. After a brief investigation, they seemed to find nothing unusual. The slot stewards looked around, then looked at Spamton: "Mr. Spamton, you are currently the prime suspect among the Dark Folk." ”
Spamton just kept the upward curve of his lips, pointing to his tilted head, looking a bit confused.
But those color card butlers just continued, "This dead Addison is holding the badge on your chest. If you hadn't committed the crime, how could he have gotten your badge?" ”
Spamton just smiled: "But my badge is still hanging perfectly fine on my tie. How can I prove that the badge in his hand is mine?" He shrugged, looking innocent. And you just scanned the crowd, scrutinizing who was more suspicious. Hmm—the killer was hiding among the Dark People, trying to fish in troubled waters, because you had already seen that guy. But...... Right now, you have no evidence to identify the other party, which is your biggest headache. You can identify the culprit at a glance, but you can't provide solid evidence to identify them.
"No matter what, you here are the most suspicious Dark People, so we need to detain you for now." Those color card butlers said. Well, after all, the Dark World doesn't have a strict system like the Light World—there are no police. Instead, it's the butlers in the Queen's Mansion, who take over the police responsibilities.
While you were still lost in thought, you noticed that the Spamton beside you had been taken away by those color card butlers. Before leaving, he mouthed you: Miss Y/N, I believe you can prove my innocence. Your detective agency isn't just a free one, right?
You were stunned for a moment. You hadn't expected Spamton to trust you like this. You have no achievements at all right now. Surely it's just because you're a citizen of light? Although it's not impossible, you sighed, straightened your trench coat that had just fallen apart from dancing, and casually pulled out a chair to sit down.
You clear your throat: "Quiet, listen to me first!" ”
They all knew you, a Commoner of Light, a highly sought-after honored guest of the Queen, so all the Dark Ones quieted down, including the slot stewards escorting Spamton. You glanced around again, then nodded gently: "First of all, Mr. Spamton has always been with me. As the person sitting beside him and his dance partner, I know this very well." ”
"—Secondly, the killer is right in front of you, yet you caught the wrong person. It's just too funny." You said this and couldn't help but shake your head with a smile.
"Then, Miss of the People of Light, tell me, who exactly is the culprit?" One of the color card butlers asked. When he heard Spamton had no time to commit the crime, his mother looked at each other and decided to let him go. After all, he was a well-known figure in the cyber world, and if they really caught the wrong person, it would be extremely awkward.
You glanced at those color card butlers and casually commanded, "Yes, the killer is right next to you—it's that guy." ”
As you spoke, you pointed to one of the Love-Sticker Walls, who was dressed as a waiter and dressed as another Dark Commoner. You brought him a glass of wine. The Dark Commoner noticed where you pointed and trembled, shattering the glass in his hand.
"Do you have any evidence?" The color card butler asked.
Here it comes, and this is also your biggest headache—evidence. Of course, you're not good at that, since you're only good at analyzing the psychology of criminals. You barely studied those courses back then.
So you just shrugged: "Evidence...... I, uh, suggest you send this Addison for a body examination...... Well, I don't know if there's such a test in the Dark World. Anyway, I have no other evidence, but this guy definitely touched Addison's wine glass lying on the ground. "You said this with conviction. Indeed, on the surface, there seems to be no evidence for this case. The Saka's butler, who collected the alcohol for the examination, quickly returned to report. The alcohol only contains trace amounts of absinthe's own toxins, which aren't fatal at all—at most a bit addictive."
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 2 (dnbsx you)
content:
Now those scan card butlers are all looking at each other, not daring to make any further moves, and you can only scratch your head...... Uh, after all, you can't give any other clues. You can only quickly determine who the culprit is by relying on speculation and the criminal psychology knowledge you once studied.
So for a moment, the arena fell into an awkward silence. Perhaps even the Color Card Butlers didn't know what to do. Originally, they just needed to take away the suspect, Spamton, but now the esteemed Light Tribe stepped forward and said things weren't like that. No matter what, they couldn't refuse to give the Light Tribe some face.
And you hesitated, looking at the Dark People present. None of them said a word, just stared at you, waiting for you to say something next—which made you suddenly tense up, because you really didn't have much to say to these people...... Uh, or maybe you don't even know what to say. Yeah, that's just how it is.
At that moment, you suddenly hear Spamton's voice. You look at him in surprise, but Spamton simply replies, "Hmm...... You've heard the facts this Miss of the Lightfolk stated. I now request to join her in the investigation, so I can clear my name. Secondly...... A noble Lightborn is my guardian, so you can feel at ease, don't you? "He said slowly. Although his words might sound a bit off, he was indeed very clear. At least you don't think there's anything inappropriate."
The slot managers exchanged glances again, but in the end nodded in agreement. They released Spamton's grip and brought her back to your side.
You were still a bit stunned, but Spamton simply walked back to your side with his hands behind his back, smiling as he said, "Next, I will be your [temporary assistant]. Please take care of me, Miss Y/N." "It's also the first time you've heard his voice mixed with this sizzling sound, as if it's just a piece separated from some recording—uh, although you can still understand, right? And you really do need an assistant. You're wondering what to do, and then Spamton comes knocking—you really need an assistant, preferably smart and capable, because you can only name who the killer is, but can't provide complete evidence."
So you looked gratefully at Spamton and whispered, "...... Thank you for your help, Mr. Spamton. I happen to be short of an assistant. ”
His smile only deepened, as if it had become more sincere: "No, I should be the one thanking Miss Y/N, thanking you for clearing my name—though this freedom is only temporary, limited edition." ”
You cleared your throat twice. In any case, you were used to his tone, so you simply said, "Then let's start now, no time to waste." Then you looked at the slot butlers and asked politely.
"Is there a map of the banquet hall? Or could you tell us which locations this banquet hall is divided into?" ”
The color card butler who seemed to be the leader bowed slightly: "This banquet hall is divided into two floors above ground and one underground...... However, during the banquet, only the first floor of the main hall is open to the guests. Moreover, the basement contains warehouses and wine storage, containing only the necessary and backup facilities for the banquet. The second floor of the banquet hall has four separate private rooms and three servants' rooms. The other servants are all hired externally. ”
You nod, there's no time to lose...... You should investigate quickly. You can't stand being stared at by these dark citizens here, so you hurriedly grabbed Spamton's hand and headed up the hallway: "Alright, then we'll start the investigation now. Your banquet can continue." ”
Even though you said that, no one seemed to have any intention of hosting a banquet anymore; they just sat in small groups, drinking and chatting casually. And whether it was your imagination or not, you kept hearing Spamton chuckle behind you, and when you looked back, all you could see was his smiling face...... Hmm, maybe it was just your imagination. Thinking this, you followed Spamton to the second floor. The signs on the second floor were quite clear: to the left was the servants' room, to the right were the small private rooms reserved for distinguished guests.
You looked around and expressed your opinion: "I plan to go to the servant's room first." ”
"Of course, no objections." Spamton looked at you with interest, noticing the nervousness on your face and the youthful vibe that radiated vitality. In fact, he didn't care at all, because he knew very well that his crime was falsely accused. The Queen certainly wouldn't deal with him, a hot figure in Cyber City, just that with the skills of these Color Card butlers, they couldn't find the real culprit.
It's just ...... You stepped forward. He originally approached you just because of your identity as a Light Citizen, at least leaving you with some impression, for better or worse—as long as you remember him, and if you remember him later, you can offer him a little help. But now, you've stepped forward. Although he's still a suspect, he won't be taken away directly. He's very curious...... How exactly did you figure out who the real killer is? And he's also curious if you can find any evidence. So he chose to be your temporary assistant.
Because he was just too curious.
You really don't know how many things Spamton has on his mind, because he's always smiling. You can't see his shadow, and naturally, you can't understand what he's thinking. You just dragged Spamton into the first room. This was the butler's room, not very big...... Well, it didn't seem anything special, just a pocket watch hanging on the wall.
So you took Spamton's hand and led him into the second room. This was the maid's room. Unexpectedly, it was a large communal bed with about ten beds arranged here. You pressed your forehead, reluctantly feeling through each bed, then checked the nightstands. Finally, you found the same mail-shaped badge on one of the nightstands, identical to the one Spamton's chest wore—also gold. You weighed the badge in your hand; the weight seemed a bit off, as if it was a bit light...... But before you could think it over and examine it carefully, Spamton took the badge. He weighed it twice as well, then glanced at it in the light—it was somewhat translucent. Spamton calmly told you, "This badge isn't made of the same material as mine; it's probably a replica...... It has a translucent property, while my badge is made of pure gold. ”
Finding a counterfeit badge here means the one downstairs might also be a forgery. You glance at Spamton: "So, do you think the badge they seized is real or fake?" "You can't figure it out, so you might as well throw it to Spamton to figure out the answer—well, you're not very good at this process of gathering evidence, and Spamton just smiles."
"That one is fake, it's a replica, absolutely authentic." Because at the moment he was captured, he saw the light shining through that badge, so...... That badge was made of exactly the same material as the one he was holding.
"Also, I'm afraid there are at least two real culprits behind the scenes...... Or maybe that guy wants to frame someone." "He reminded you.
And you just shook your head without thinking. You'd seen all the dark people present in the banquet hall at the time, unless there was someone you hadn't noticed: "There's no other culprit, he's the only one." Hmm...... After all, he—he showed the kind of expression and gesture only a murderer would have...... "As you spoke, you gestured, unsure how to describe your intuition, but in any case, it was a feeling you had."
You were troubled that you might not be able to explain yourself, but Spamton just smiled and nodded: "Mm, I believe you." ”
You stop what you're doing in surprise and look at Spamton—does he really believe you so easily? You were racking your brains trying to figure out how to gain his trust. So you can't help but ask, "Do you really trust me that much?" ”
Spamton just tilted his head innocently, still smiling brightly. Your attention flickered for a moment, and you thought, he really looks good like that...... Ahem, beauty can be misleading, and you've sworn to be a towering detective—don't let beauty fool you!
So you shook your head twice, trying to shake the thought out of your mind. Spamton watched your actions and found it a bit amusing. He said nonchalantly, "Hmm, [absolutely true], but Miss Y/N, what's wrong? Are you feeling a bit of a headache?" ”
But you just shook your head in a panic, hurriedly turned around, and patted your slightly flushed face twice, warning yourself that she was just here to help you investigate clues and clear up suspicion, not to smile at you because she likes you. Don't overthink it! There will never be an ending between the People of Light and the People of Darkness! After reminding yourself like this, you felt much better, but hurriedly walked toward the servant's room, mumbling a bit carelessly: "Ah, it's nothing...... I just think you look a bit good...... Uh, no, no, no, there's nothing interesting in the maid's room, so let's hurry to the next room and take a look! ”
As you spoke, you hurried toward the servant's room. Spamton just chuckled softly and slowly followed behind. The smile in his eyes grew even wider—Hmm, you look like an interesting little girl, a very interesting lightborn. He even wants to spend a little more time with you, because pretending to be innocent teasing you a couple of times is especially fun.
But he still followed you into the room. This time, you entered the last servant's room, which was also the waiter's room. This room also had ten beds, but all were bunk beds, making it feel even more crowded. The nightstand was basically full of items, so you had to search one nightstand at a time, rummaging through the messy items, but after looking for a long time, you couldn't find anything suitable as evidence. By the end, your mouth was a bit parched, and you reached the last nightstand. Instinctively, you wanted to grab the glass cup filled with a clear liquid on the table, but before you could act, Spamton's expression changed and he knocked over the glass in your hand.
The sound of glass shattering echoed clearly through the room once again. You were a bit stunned, still standing still, and you heard Spamton's slightly reprimanded voice: "Don't rush to drink every liquid, like this one...... It must be poisonous. ”
You nodded blankly, and you broke out in a cold sweat belatedly—as expected, your social experience was still too limited.
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 3 (dnbsx you)
content:
You take a deep breath, trying hard to avoid recalling the poisoned wine—but you can't help but squat down to observe the liquid that has been spilled. You just squat down and take a sniff, your brows furrow. You whisper something, or rather, this smell is so common, often seen in novels—you can of course recognize it: "Bitter almond flavor...... This is sodium cyanide. "Your voice was faint, not very loud.
Spamton, also squatting down beside you, glanced at the broken glass cup and said, "These are not the cups used at this banquet...... If I remember correctly, they are the same set of cups used at the last banquet. ”
You were stunned when you heard this; you hadn't noticed this at all...... But on closer inspection, it was indeed that the cup had a smaller diameter.
"So that attendant wanted to kill someone as soon as he entered the banquet?" Then why not deal with that...... "But before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you."
"Because he hopes this banquet will be the same [container]." He shrugged as he spoke, but still smiled warmly.
"Alright...... Let's check out another room. "You sighed and stood up. Maybe because you were getting up a bit quickly, a sudden noise appeared before your eyes, making you shake uncontrollably. But Spamton just grabbed your arm, just the right time, and let go once you steadied yourself.
You only heard his slightly low voice: "Are you alright?" With a hint of concern...... You almost felt dazed listening to it.
You just shook your head quickly and forced a smile at Spamton: "I'm fine, I stood up too fast and got a bit dizzy...... Thank you, Mr. Spamton." With that, you hurried out the door. You patted your slightly flushed cheeks again, warning yourself in your heart, Y/N, oh Y/N, don't overthink it, I'm just being very polite!
You walked toward the small private room reserved for distinguished guests. The first room had nothing, or rather, the lights hadn't been turned on at all—you had pressed the light switch and almost blinded your eyes by the light here. In short, after you snapped out of it and looked around, the room only had a cold fireplace, a luxurious sofa, a glass table, and a pendant lamp above made of glass. In short, there was no sign that anyone had used it.
You walk toward the second room, and Spamton follows behind you unhurriedly. Unexpectedly...... The door to the second room is actually closed. You push it a bit but find it won't open, then notice the door is locked from the outside using a combination lock—a common one. You have no choice but to go downstairs and ask the color card butlers about the locks. However, after entering the password 6699 as the color card butler told you, the door didn't open—just popped up with an error notification sound.
You frowned, went downstairs to call the color card butlers, and the wall-attached prisoner they were suppressing to go upstairs together. Soon, the group of Dark People came to the ground, noisy and noisy. You pointed the door lock to them: "Here's it. Entering the password you just told me won't open the door successfully." ”
Spamton quickly added, "Hmm, so...... Someone changed the type of [combination lock]. "He was still smiling, as if what was happening now had little to do with him. For some reason, seeing his smile made you shiver, feeling a bit cold for no reason.
You just quickly shifted your gaze to the others. Hmm, those color card butlers looked at each other, probably unaware of anything. Only the one who loved to stick to the wall showed panic, but he quickly hid it.
Just as you were thinking about what to say to get the real culprit to speak the truth, Spamton spoke up: "So...... This door lock was installed by our suspect, right? ”
You look at the Dark Citizen, who just anxiously shakes his head: "It has nothing to do with me. I'm just a lowly waiter. How could I possibly come to the second floor to serve such a distinguished guest!" ”
You didn't say anything, while Spamton just kept looking at the slot card butler and said, "Mm...... But if I remember correctly, these waiters are colleagues serving the first and second floors, right? "As he spoke, he tilted his head slightly, and the slot card butlers quickly nodded.
“…… How could I possibly be a suspect? But you, who put on a righteous face, are even more suspicious! Your badge appeared in the victim's hand, and ...... Besides, you and Addison have a grudge! Killing out of hatred makes sense, right? "That suspect suddenly started shouting. You stepped forward, cleared your throat, and felt it was time for you to step in. How can a detective let his assistant shine so much?
"That badge is fake, and we also found one in the maid's room...... I'm afraid you're planning to blame the other Dark People if this attempt fails, right?" You put your hands on your hips and said confidently—of course, you saw Spamton secretly applauding you, and you couldn't help but glare at him again. Who told him to do something like this!
"So, can you tell us about your process of action?" Spamton stepped forward and pressed further.
"I...... First, I welcome guests at the main entrance, then I serve all kinds of drinks to the guests at the banquet. There's nothing else. "The one who loves to lean against the wall stammered.
"So, which area are you mainly responsible for the liquor?" You asked.
“…… The area near the corridor entrance. Of course, I never went up to the second floor. "Ai Pressie continued.
"Are you lying? If you hadn't been upstairs, why would you be coming down from the second floor when the lights were on and you were identified?" Spamton just smiled and pointed out the mistakes in his language. You glanced at Spamton in surprise, then started to think...... Hmm, it seems he really is suited to be your assistant, since he's very good at interrogating testimonies and such...... Probically. But it's hard to say. After all, he's a popular figure in Cyber City. If it weren't for this incident, you two wouldn't be standing together now. Some things are obviously just daydreams, so you just need to think about them, just think about them.
The one who loved pressing against the wall showed emotions of resentment, confusion, and even anger. If those color card butlers hadn't stopped his actions, he probably would have pounced on him. He was roaring, "It's still you! If you hadn't shown up, the person the Queen would have chosen might have been me...... Yes, I killed that Addison, but so what? Anyway, he hasn't turned to ashes; the same Dark People will only appear somewhere in the previous spot one day! If only you could be ruined because of this...... But at this moment, someone will still come out to help you! ”
"And that person is even a Citizen of Light! Gaining the favor of the Beings of Light was once my dream. Why did you get it without doing anything?! Why should I......" He seemed to have fallen into madness, but by the end he was exhausted. At this point, he was telling everyone that he was indeed the murderer, while you just calmly looked at him, not understanding why reality was still like a novel...... The killer would also confess everything on his own. Maybe that's some kind of killer law? You don't really care; you have only one question.
"So what's the password for this room?"
“…… 8912。 "The truth has been exposed; the one who loves sticking to the wall is now weak and weak. You unlock the door, push it open, and walk in. But not long after you enter, your face darkens and you step back. The furnishings in the room are the same as the previous one, except this one's fireplace is lit, emitting a warm glow. You notice several burning plastic bags next to the burning matches—on the table is an opened bottle of absinthe, a tray, and most importantly, the smell in the room.
You walk out the door, close it, pinch your nose, and look a bit grim: "The whole room smells of carbon monoxide...... I think you did this on purpose, didn't you? The carbon monoxide toxin promotes the flow of neurotoxins in the blood, causing oxygen deprivation and then partial congestion, which is why his skin touching the ground appears blood-red—and when Addison realized something was wrong and tried to go downstairs, the poison took effect and he died. And that badge was also something you slipped into his hand. Otherwise, if he had pulled the badge off, Spamton's chest would have left a mark. "You can still smell the carbon monoxide...... You're very familiar with this smell. Fortunately, there hasn't been an explosion in the current sealed space. You have directed the color card butler to quickly extinguish the fire.
"Quick, put out the fire inside first." As you spoke, several Color Card butlers carried buckets inside. It was probably oxygen mixed with carbon monoxide, plus a flame. Soon, a rumbling sound erupted from the room. Your expression changed, and the explosion echoed with bricks falling. Spamton instinctively threw himself onto you, his arms resting on either side of your body, not touching you. You just heard him groan twice, and then you saw blood slowly trickling from his temple, dripping onto your cheek. Still, he was still smiling.
You stared blankly at all of this, thinking, this is a big problem...... Fortunately, just as Ai Ping said against the wall, those color card butlers didn't turn to ashes and revived somewhere else. The queen was furious at the butlers and attendants because the banquet was ruined, especially since this incident even dragged you, a popular figure from the People of Light and Cyber City, into this. You thought the queen would also punish you, but she just raised it high and gently set it down.
In short...... The banquet ended with this explosion. You returned to the Mingmeng Detective Agency in a daze, planning to tidy yourself up and go to sleep, but saw Spamton standing outside smiling, his head still covered in blood, just a bit congealed. You startled him—after all, he looked like a ghost. Anyway, you opened the door to the detective agency and asked, "It's over, you're innocent, is there any problem, Mr. Spamton?" ”
"Of course there's a problem. I got hurt to protect you...... At this hour, it's not convenient for me to go to a medical institution. Could you help me treat my wound?" He said this as he looked at you with a somewhat pitiful expression.
You hesitated for a moment, but still put Spamton inside. Luckily, you had a medical kit and had learned a bit about wound dressing before. You carefully treated his wound with hydrogen peroxide, then wrapped it in bandages. Then you started to send him away: "The bandaging is done. It's getting late. Why don't you go back and rest?" ”
But Spamton just frowned—you couldn't read his expression, since his skin was already pale. He just softly cried out in pain and said, "It feels a bit uncomfortable...... I feel it's not very convenient for me to go back now. Could you take me in for now? ”
…… Actually, you might think his wound wasn't that serious, but in the end, you still allowed him to rest in the living room for a night, and you even brought him a mattress and a mattress.
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 4 (dnbsx you)
content:
And so, for some reason, you took Spamton in and stayed at your detective agency for a night...... Of course, he slept in the living room. After all, although your detective agency has other rooms, those were meant for the assistant, not for an outsider! Thinking this, you huffed as you walked to your own room, but at that moment, Spamton called out to you from behind.
"Please wait a moment, Miss Y/N." His voice was as gentle and unhurried as ever, but it carried a gentle and unhurried tone.
You turned to Spamton in confusion, and he calmly tugged at the thin quilt you had thrown him. Then you watched his finger point to the empty room and ask, "If I'm not mistaken, that should be a guest room?" My injuries are truly [painful]. May I rest in your guest room for a night? ”
He smiled warmly, as if he was certain you wouldn't refuse. You gave him a strange look, really not understanding how Spamton could push his luck...... But that didn't matter.
You glanced at the empty room over there and hesitated for a moment...... Well, anyway, you don't have an assistant yet! And to be honest, you're a bit envious of his abilities...... The case solved so easily last time, so I suppose your cooperation would be a perfect match...... You thought for a moment and casually said, "If...... If you're willing to be my temporary assistant for a week, that room could even be for you to stay for a night." You felt like you were making such an outrageous request, though you were also a bit anxious and worried—what if Spamton refused to accept you?
Then you thought, if you don't agree, so be it, anyway...... You can solve the case on your own anyway! He's just a bit of a good talker, that's all! Thinking this, you puff out your chest again, looking very proud.
Spamton just glanced at you and nodded with a smile. That was exactly what he wished for—he was indeed curious about how far you, a detective from the world of light, could go, and he was curious how you were right—after all, in the last case, he suspected there were two people, but from start to finish, according to your deduction, only one person was involved. He was also very curious—what kind of citizen of light you really are.
If at first approaching you was mainly to leave a good impression on the People of Light and gain their favor and help, now that he approaches you, it's more out of curiosity—curious about what kind of person you are, what your daily life looks like, what your daily life is like...... Well, of course, he naturally won't let you know about his curiosity.
He just smiled at you, and you didn't expect him to actually nod. Look at his expression—he didn't seem to be lying at all...... Just, just...... He actually agreed to your request like that? You still find it a bit hard to believe.
So you couldn't help but repeat it again, asking, "You're just a temporary assistant for a week, not just for a day. Are you sure you're sure?" ”
Spamton just nodded again, smiling and repeating, "Yes, again, and of course...... [absolutely]." As he spoke, he bowed to you in a proper manner. You hesitated and glanced at him twice, and seeing his smile, you felt your face flush again. You couldn't help but think to yourself, this guy was just too good-looking...... Fortunately, you were standing in the dark at the moment, so he probably couldn't see clearly. You patted your cheek and said flusteredly, "Alright, fine, then I'll allow you to rest in that room for a night!" With that, you hurriedly turned and walked toward your own room. Little did you know, behind you, Spamton's face only wore a mysterious smile.
Anyway, he tidied up and lay comfortably in the room next to yours—if he's not mistaken, this should be the room you prepared for the assistant. Of course, since he's staying here...... You shouldn't even think about having another assistant.
For the next few days, he still stayed in your guest room. From the first day of waiting, eagerly waiting for the Dark Folk to find you, to the later days of sighing and lying on the table, it only took time to pass. However...... Spamton took care of your three meals a day, even the cleaning duties inside the detective agency, which made you feel a bit embarrassed. You really don't know...... You really don't know whether to pay him or not! But you also take care of his food and lodging...... Hmm, and he never mentioned his salary, so you might as well just pretend you don't know.
Finally, on the fifth day, sighing as you leaned over the counter, you looked up, your gaze turning resolute: "No, we can't just sit and wait for death—since the case won't come knocking, let's go out and look for it, or let the case come to us!" ”
Your eyes were sharp and focused, making Spamton momentarily lose focus—he had been wondering what you would do, and sure enough, just as he expected, you decided to go out and try your luck, to actively seek out a case.
So Spamton put down the broom in his hand—the bandages on his head had long been removed. In fact, he wasn't seriously injured at all, and on the second day at your detective agency, he removed the bandages. You wanted to say something but stopped trying to drive him away, but you were bribed by his daily meals and the spotless detective agency, so you felt embarrassed to say 'kick him out' and had to wait for Spamton to leave on his own—but Spamton certainly had no intention of leaving; he just slept in your guest room as usual, or rather, in the room you prepared for your assistant, and then took care of your daily affairs.
"Then I'll go with you too." He said simply. He was looking forward to it...... Actually, although you don't know, Spamton goes out every day to buy a newspaper and then gather information. Of course, Spamton knows Cyber City has been quite unsettled lately, with a case that hasn't been resolved...... Moreover, it seems other Dark People are using this incident as an excuse to cause trouble. Spamton isn't quite sure about the specifics; he just hopes you'll get involved in that case.
You put your hands on your hips, glanced at Spamton thoughtfully, then nodded cheerfully: "Alright, then come with me, my temporary assistant." ”
"Let's go!" You waved your hand and then walked out the door with great enthusiasm, looking proud, but soon you bent down, no longer showing the same demeanor you had before. Because although you said you were going to look for a case...... But you were completely unfamiliar with the roads of the Underworld, and you didn't know where to find a case better.
So at this moment, you stand at a crossroads, looking around and looking around, really not knowing where to go...... Hmm, you really don't know where the scent of the case is even more, so at this moment, you close your eyes and sniff carefully, okay...... Everywhere smells the same. You slump your shoulders in defeat and have no choice but to pick a random path and walk through.
Spamton glanced at you, clearly struggling with where to go...... He glanced to the side, checked which street he had heard about the case earlier, then pointed and said, "It should be this way. This side has a stronger [case vibe]." "He was quite serious. While staying at the detective agency these past few days, he often heard you mumbling strange words, and after a while, he remembered them."
You just finished pointing and happened to spot the road Spamton had just mentioned. You glanced at him with some doubt, since you still didn't quite believe it...... But Spamton kept smiling at you, showing no other emotion, so you just confirmed he was telling the truth.
So you mumbled as you stepped forward: "Alright...... I understand! I understand, then let's go here. Hopefully, we'll find the case—of course, if you're wrong, then...... Then......" You racked your brains over what kind of request you should make, and in the end, you excitedly clenched your left fist and pounded your right palm.
"Then make me grilled lamb chops tonight!" You've only tasted this dish on his first day, and since then, you've been craving it ever since. You kept thinking about the taste, walking forward with great enthusiasm, looking so eager that it was hard to tell if you were heading to a mysterious case or a possible grilled lamb chop.
Spamton watched your back, sighed softly in his heart, and followed your steps forward. Alright, you always seem so carefree...... He thinks he probably understands you now, but you always smile, you're always sunny, as if nothing seems to you, you're always cheerful and lively, and he can't help but laugh when he gets infected...... At first, he just wanted to hide in the shadows and watch you, but with the excuse of getting hurt for you, it's actually easier to get close to you.
A sudden longing arose in his heart, a strange hope—if only he could get a little closer to you, would the radiant warmth and joyful warmth you give him would melt him? He thought the answer was no, but Spamton truly wanted to appreciate your happiness and joy, to embrace your smile, to get close to your warmth.
…… After all, that feeling was completely different from what he had experienced. He was just too curious—could it be that the so-called People of Light really are like rays of light?
Spamton didn't know the answer to that question; he just watched you hop forward, as if nothing could affect your mood. He smiled again and followed behind you deeper down the road.
You were indeed half skeptical...... But when you reached the end of the road, you saw a spot pulled up by the yellow line, where several color card butlers acting as guards were staking out nearby. You leaned in and asked with an unabashed smile, "Is something happening here?" It looks like some kind of case has taken place...... Are you guarding the scene? ”
One of the color card butlers recognized you. He nodded at you and then explained, "Although we really dislike those creatures...... But if something really happens, we can't just ignore it. There was a mouse attacked, and his wife was also attacked. But unlike that mouse, he wasn't actually killed; his wife only had some wounds. ”
You nod thoughtfully, not sure if you'll be able to convince these color card butlers to let you see the scene......
But you still asked with a bit of hope: "Would you mind letting us see the scene?" ”
The color card stewards looked at each other, clearly not very convenient—well, since it's already blocked here, it's only natural that it's inconvenient. You think this, but it seems these scan card stewards seem quite easy to talk to. Maybe we could negotiate some leniency......
While you're still thinking about what to say, Spamton walks up with a big smile, standing in front of you—you don't know why he's doing this, but Spamton is still carrying a bag. You watch him take out a few sandwiches from it, and only then do you realize what he had suddenly disappeared for—so he was out shopping.
His tone was also smiling: "Ah, in that case...... Everyone, how about a few sandwiches? I bet you've been standing here for a long time for this case...... You must be exhausted, right? But the case sounds a bit suspicious...... Why don't we go take a look? After all, as you all know, we are the Light and Dark People who solved that case at the banquet not long ago. ”
The slot stewards looked at each other again, and finally one of them took the sandwich from Spamton's hand, then handed it to the other scan stewards beside him, saying, "Alright...... Let's just pretend we didn't see anything. You all hurry inside, and come out quickly. ”
As he spoke, the scan card butlers stepped aside, leaving you a single entrance just the size of one person. Besides, if you didn't look at you any longer, you'd still be a bit dazed. Spamton simply grabbed your hand and led you inside, softly saying, "Alright, now it's time to solve the case." He didn't say it out loud, but Spamton was eager to see what surprises you'd bring him.
You blinked, and as Spamton pulled you into the scene, you immediately got into character: "I understand. Leave the task to me, I guarantee I'll get it done." As you spoke, you patted your chest, looking especially proud and pleased.
Spamton glanced at you out of the corner of his eye, and he couldn't help but chuckle twice, but his laughter was so soft that you didn't hear it. He took your hand and walked into the scene, then let go. The courtesy was just right—at least you shouldn't blame him for it—of course, you wouldn't have done that anyway. He brought you into the scene, and you could hardly be happy.
You simply observed the scene with excitement—well, the husband's body was still lying on the ground. To be honest, it looked like just a tiny rat, but upon checking, it was a wound running through the abdomen. The wound in the abdomen looked larger, while the wound running through the body to the back was smaller. You looked around the scene and saw nothing matching the shape of the murder weapon...... However, what was strange was that this was probably a rest area or something similar, with a row of benches and various blue, pink, purple, and yellow glass panels. The yellow glass appeared to be shattered, with countless yellow fragments falling to the ground.
You walk over and take a look. The surface of the glass is uneven, making it impossible to tell how the glass was broken or the direction of the blow...... You hesitate for a moment, probably thinking about what to do, and at that moment, Spamton walks up behind you. He crouches down to observe the broken glass, then suddenly says, "Or...... I think Miss Y/N, we can [give it a try.'" As he spoke, he picked up a piece of broken glass, and then Spamton raised his hand to place the broken glass against the window shattered marks.
"I think there must be some glass shards here that can't be fitted together." he said.
You rubbed your chin and gave Spamton a thumbs up: "Oh, I just remembered that—thank you, Spamton!" Then you squatted down excitedly and started the glass puzzle game with Spamton. Soon, you finished the glass shards that matched the cracks on the window, but besides that, there were still some yellow glass shards left. You felt a bit puzzled, but could only try to piece something together again using these fragments.
