Finally, through your joint efforts, these fragments came together to form a cheese shape with extremely sharp edges and tops—semi-transparent yellow, so the glass was mixed in and hard to tell, and now you understand why the yellow glass broke.
Spamton made a deduction first: "The killer used this cheese-like object to lure the victim closer, then attacked him with it, causing his death, and also creating the scene of a shattered window, mixed with the shattered glass cheese...... making it impossible to tell what the murder weapon was. ”
You put your palms together: "That's a good deduction—I thought so too. It's just a pity I still don't know who the killer is, since there are no other Dark People present...... You feel a bit regretful, but still go out first to find the Sekka butler.
"We've already seen the scene. Would you mind letting us go check on the suspect again?" You said confidently.
The color card butlers were about to shake their heads and refuse, but Spamton stepped forward again, blocking your way. He just smiled and said, "I think we've already guessed and understood the course of the case—so the [suspects] we'd like to see might help you solve this case. I guess this case has puzzled you for quite some time—maybe it's just a matter of the past few days, but if it can't be solved, you'll definitely be blamed. And now, we're willing to help you solve this case. ”
You hide behind Spamton, pursing your lips. You have to admit...... He really is more eloquent than you are. Just now, it seemed like these color card butlers were about to refuse you, but now they exchanged glances. In the end, one of them led you toward the police station.
In the police station, besides the Color Card butler, there was also Manager Renwu, probably the staff here. You saw the Color Card butler step forward and say something, then they took you to meet the suspect in the case, and of course, the victim—the mouse wife, who was also sitting there as a witness.
After leading you inside, the Seka butler stood guard at the door. You glanced around, frowned slightly, then pointed directly at the wife, your tone tinged with disbelief: "Wait—that guy is the murderer, huh? How did you manage to let her sit there for no reason, even acting as a witness?" "You really find it unbelievable...... Is the police organization in the underworld really this messed up? It looks no different from playing house......
The color card butler at the door was stunned for a moment, his voice a bit muffled: "But you need to provide evidence when you speak." ”
In other words, he still didn't believe the mouse was the real culprit.
You hesitated, but now your head is stuck again, and you don't know what to say...... You plan to first share your previous speculations, first about the method of committing the crime, then discuss her motives and the like...... The mouse was also saying, "Yes...... Please show me the evidence. The deceased was my dear husband, how could I possibly lay a hand on him?" As you spoke, you also heard her crying. Honestly, this made things a bit complicated...... You scratched your head in frustration, just about to step forward and say something, but Spamton reached out to stop you. He stepped forward as usual, blocking you and speaking on your behalf.
"Yes...... We certainly know how heartbroken you are. After all, if you were recognized as the murderer, you wouldn't be able to inherit your husband's estate. Spamton said with a smile. At least you only heard his disdainful tone and smiling voice, and the mouse's crying briefly faltered.
You tugged at Spamton's sleeve and whispered in a breathy voice, "You...... How did you know? ”
Spamton also replied in a breathy voice: "Ah, I checked before coming...... You know, phones are convenient. I found out the real identity of that corpse is a famous entrepreneur. ”
You half understood, but...... Spamton is indeed impressive; these details are often overlooked by you. You just quietly hide behind him, listening as he continues to confront his wife.
"No...... It's only because my husband has died and his business has become a tangled mess, that's why I'm so grief-stricken...... That Dark Citizen was still arguing her case, clearly determined not to confess.
Spamton just said slowly, "Ah, it's because they only brought negative income to your husband's assets, right? Is it because you're eager to close this case so you can inherit your husband's business?" ”
The Dark Tribe was at a loss again, looking somewhat speechless. The Color Card butler standing at the door watched the current hot figures and witnesses in Cyber City confronting each other but didn't dare to interrupt. After all, you and he are now the hottest figures under the Queen's command and neither dares to provoke them. If you and he still dare to talk back...... Spamton's words were not appropriate for the Color Card butler to say more, after all...... After all, they were more or less aware of Spamton's methods.
The mouse Dark Citizen couldn't say anything for now, and you peeked in from behind Spamton, starting to interject: "Hmm...... I know the perpetrator doesn't want to admit it, but the truth is, the killer deliberately broke the yellow glass to make it look like someone had broken in, to avoid suspicion. Then you used the cheese made of glass to lure your husband closer, and then stabbed him with this weapon with a sharp front and wide back. You broke the cheese, mixing it with the glass, and injured yourself to further avoid suspicion—after all, you were the first person to discover the case, and the victim's closest Dark Citizen, his wife...... You naturally face the highest level of suspicion. But now, you disguised yourself as the victim, and thus you escaped the fate of being suspected. "You conclusively and unequivocally explained the entire crime process, and you believed there was nothing wrong with your words...... But that guy still refused to confess; she kept defending herself.
"So, if someone broke into our warm little home and then used something like this to stab my husband, wouldn't that make sense?!" She defended herself, while you were speechless. You really didn't know the time of the incident or anything like that......
At that moment, Spamton gently tugged your hand, then smiled and said, "If that's the case, madam, who do you think the perpetrator could be?" His expression was quite calm. You glanced at Spamton silently, but you couldn't tell anything...... Well, it really seemed he was just asking a serious question.
But the mouse immediately said, "Yes, it's that scheming Wall-Sticker ......! He's always wanted my husband's fortune, and he wants me ......" You look at the Wall-Sticker guy, clearly confused too, unable to help but point at yourself with a puzzled face.
“…… I think this case has nothing to do with him. Look at his expression—he's clearly wandered into this turmoil." You said casually, flipping through the records left on the table, and soon found the page where you loved to stick to the wall.
"That guy who loves sticking to the wall had no time to commit the crime, even though he had a motive...... But at the time of the crime, he was on the commercial street, and other Addison could testify for him. "Spamton also saw the transcript you were flipping through and said casually.
"As for you...... There are absolutely no other Dark People who can be your witnesses. According to your account, you were present at the time of the crime, and it was the suspect who broke in, killed your husband, and then stabbed you. But why didn't the suspect kill you, who saw the whole thing? If all of this is as you say, then you can definitely identify who the suspect is and explain the course of the case...... But you didn't do that; you can't explain the details of the initial crime at all. At the same time...... Your husband's face showed no sign of shock, probably only surprise. Judging by his expression, it was probably just someone familiar with the crime...... So, by this inference, the only possible killer is you—do you agree? Spamton smiled warmly, stepped forward a few paces, and pressed the poor lady who seemed completely unsuspected. The mouse's expression immediately changed, and his voice became a bit sinister.
“…… Things have come to this. Alright, I admit, I committed this crime...... My husband deserves to die. Why should he seize his property and not give me a thing? How struggling I have been living—I really couldn't take it anymore, so I killed him to inherit his fortune, and after all, he didn't turn to ashes...... In other words, he will be reborn later, so what's wrong with killing him so I can enjoy it for a while?! "After she finished speaking, the case was solved, and he let the other Sakaka butlers take her away in utter despair...... Despite stubbornly resisting for a while, she still couldn't escape the fate of being caught.
With this case solved, when you and Spamton walked out, you could hear the Dark People passing by whispering, probably talking about the Light Folk and detectives...... You couldn't help but hold your head high because you were very proud.
But what about solving a case...... Spamton has put in a lot of effort. After all, if it weren't for him, you wouldn't even know how to convince the killer...... You really don't have the ability, or maybe you just haven't met enough people!
You look at Spamton again, beaming: "Thank you, Spamton. If it weren't for you, I probably wouldn't have ...... these two cases." Although I can find the culprit, I have absolutely no way to convict them, and even if I do, I can't get them to confess......" As you spoke, you scratched your hair in frustration and chuckled awkwardly.
"It's fine, after all, you gave even more. The one who found the real [killer candidate] is you...... I'm just playing your assistant." Spamton chuckled softly. He really thought so—hmm, he just found you a Light Tribe getting more and more interesting. At first, besides becoming famous through the Light Tribe members, he had other motives...... Even if that probably wasn't that important? After all, right now, he didn't really need that one entirely.
"Yes...... I think I really do need an assistant...... You mutter, sneaking another glance at Spamton—Hmm, think about it, if only you hired him as your assistant, you really do need someone like that...... You really need someone who can help you persuade the other Dark People. You really don't have much eloquence.
So after hesitating for a moment, you nervously clasped your hands behind your back and said, "Mm...... Well, so, cough cough...... I'm officially applying to be your assistant. What do you think, what do you think? "You feel a bit nervous and awkward, so your voice involuntarily starts to stammer...... Oh my god, you're completely, completely unused to this...... After all, you're just a freshly graduated, clear-headed and foolish college student.
You can't imagine what kind of answer Spamton will have...... So you can't help but lower your head, not wanting to see his expression anymore, afraid of disappointing yourself. You know that...... Spamton is a popular figure in Cyber City; he's not short of money, and naturally, he doesn't lack a job either. You think you can't just let him stay that easily. You haven't received his answer for a long time, your heart sinking—haha, you know he probably won't agree, so you lift your head and force a smile, wanting to just laugh it off and let it go.
But just as you were about to speak, Spamton spoke up: "I think I can [agree to the notes], but......" He deliberately paused here, not finishing, and just gave you a rather suggestive glance, making you feel a bit awkward. After all, he was just opening his eyes, looking you up and down...... Even though you didn't know exactly what he was looking at, you just instinctively widened your eyes, lifted your chest, and looked at him nervously.
Spamton chuckled softly, just leaning in a little closer—he wasn't sure what kind of emotion he was feeling, maybe just curious about what light was like, maybe just curious about what you really were, so he couldn't help but lean in, and he saw his own reflection in your pupils—his own reflection—only feeling something pounding in his chest even faster. He didn't know what it felt like; Spamton just knew very well...... The more he felt like this, the less he wanted to leave you, just wanted to hear the pounding of two hearts beside you, or rather, the trembling of two souls...... He looked at you, gazed at you, sighed...... He couldn't tell what kind of feeling this was, but he just wanted to get close to you. Maybe...... Spam recalled a description he had read in a book before; this symptom seemed somewhat similar to so-called love.
So he continued, "...... But I want to go on a date with you. I want to ...... I think I'm not satisfied with being an assistant, so give me your [heart], or—after everything is over, give me your [heart-shaped object]. "As he spoke, he reached out his hand to you, returning to that smiling expression, while you just widened your eyes, looking at him in surprise.
Honestly, although you think Spamton is very beautiful and you are somewhat attracted to his beauty...... But you have never experienced anything like this before. After all, you are just an honest student attending school and have never dated other boys...... And Spamton, for you, seems to be the first person you fall for.
At least you don't really want to refuse him. Although you don't really understand what dating looks like, well—you don't dislike Spamton's request; in fact, you feel a bit of excitement. Ah, you think you're willing, but you just don't quite understand what he meant by the latter sentence.
So you look up at him, then tilt your head slightly: "Mm...... I don't think I would refuse you, but I don't quite understand what you meant by that sentence at the end. ”
"Ah...... That question seems a bit hard to answer," Spamton seemed troubled, but he wasn't upset by your question; instead, he felt a bit pleased—he knew you would ask, he knew you would definitely ask, so he didn't say it clearly. Yet now he still maintained a smile on his face and answered your question with a smile, "I mean...... Give me your [love], or at the end, give me your [soul]. ”
...... soul? You don't know what Spamton wants this for, but it sounds almost like some kind of demonic deal. You hesitate at him for a few moments, feeling confident you'll choose the previous option, as if it's some kind of trick. Uh, well, maybe it's just your imagination. You can't think of him in such a bad way.
So in the end, you swallowed hard but still nodded: "Alright, I agree...... Hmm, giving you my love—basically, it means dating you, and going on a date...... I've never dated before, so I don't know where to go, and I don't have experience with it, so you should suggest where to go." As you spoke, you tilted your head again, looking a bit embarrassed...... Honestly, this was your first time dating, and you were really curious about what it felt like. You don't know, right now you just feel your heart pounding when you see Spamton, as if you're a little happy. Of course, you're still a bit excited. You look forward to seeing Spamton's next words.
Spamton tilted his head and spoke with an innocent look: "If you don't want to date me, of course, you can choose to give me your [soul] later...... I don't mind. As for a date, how about that dessert shop on the way here? Hmm...... You could say it's a café. I think the desserts and coffee there taste pretty good. Want to give it a try? ”
You nodded and then shook your head. Although you didn't know what Spamton wanted your soul for, and you couldn't figure out his intentions, you still felt it wasn't a good thing, so you couldn't possibly agree to it.
"Uh...... If it's about dating or dating, it can take as long as you want, but I don't think I'd give you that damn soul you mentioned." "You thought about it, and you don't even know how to get rid of this thing...... Hmm, is it to break open your chest and pull out your heart while blood is dripping everywhere? After all, he was talking about a heart-shaped object. That seemed a bit too bloody, and you shivered involuntarily, deciding to temporarily set aside the matter.
So you just added, "Anyway, I think it's probably unlikely...... I really don't know how to do it. Let's go on a date first!" You said, squeezing Spamton's hand tightly and leading him toward the agreed café. Hmm, his hand felt a bit cold, and you couldn't quite get used to it...... But with your cheeks flushed red, that cool temperature was just right—at least you really liked it.
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 5 (dnbsx you)
content:
You hold Spamton's hand and head to the café. After all, we're supposed to have a date, though you don't really know what the date will be like...... But if you're with Spamton, you can't help but feel a bit excited.
You sat by the window, and it just so happened to be afternoon tea event. There were quite a few people who came—most had ordered a dessert tart, followed by champagne, coffee, or black tea to pass the time.
You were no exception—flipping through the menu, ordering dessert, then a pot of lemon black tea, while Spamton ordered a bottle of champagne. He slowly sipped the golden wine in his glass—at least you couldn't tell it...... He showed signs of being drunk; all you saw was his pale face and his usual smiling eyes.
You hesitate for a moment, then tentatively ask, "Is the champagne good?" You regret it after saying that, and you simply don't understand why you could ask such a question—even though Spamton doesn't seem to care what exactly you ask.
He just smiled and answered your question: "Hmm, it tastes pretty good...... I think it's perfect for a drink at this moment. After all, we've just finished a case right now, so it's time to celebrate, isn't it? ”
You scratched your head, unsure what to say, so you patted your slightly flushed cheeks, casually picked up some macarons from the plate, and popped them into your mouth. As soon as you took a bite, you frowned at the overwhelmingly sweet taste. Well, you really can't quite get used to some desserts.
"I wonder if you like this date, Y/N? I'm really curious about your thoughts...... Spamton stared at you, making you feel a bit embarrassed. Maybe not awkward, just a flushed cheek, a bit restless. You gave a couple of awkward laughs.
"Ah, me, me? I like it, right? Yeah, I like it." "You're not sure when you say it, but staying here really makes you feel at ease, and ...... You also really enjoy being with Spamton; it's a very comfortable feeling.
Spamton pursed his lips slightly at your uncertain answer. He wasn't very happy, but he just stared at you. You didn't know what he was planning, just that his gaze was a bit strange about you...... Is it just a feeling that makes you uncomfortable? You look at him, and at that moment, Spamton just opens his eyes a little. Through his line of sight, you always sense he is plotting something.
But what is he plotting? There's nothing about you worth scheming about...... After racking your brains and thinking it over, you're probably the only one you possess—the ability to instantly see through the criminal—that's what Spamton wants.
In that instant, you seem to understand. So Spamton isn't genuinely trying to date you; he has another agenda—he's trying to get close to you and make you lower your guard! It's to put you at ease, so he can use those sweet words to win over your heart, and then, when you're completely unguarded, get your exclusive skills!
You put on a serious face, because you suddenly understood what Spamton was trying to do next, and Spamton was looking at you with a bit of confusion. For some reason, your expression suddenly became especially serious...... He could only sense that you were probably thinking something, but he wasn't really sure what it was. After all, he's not some worm in your belly—he can figure out your every move.
He just tidied his hair, about to say something else, but you just stood guarded, crossed your arms, leaned back, and said seriously, "I get it. You don't really want to date me, nor do you really want to date me. You just want to learn how I can spot the killer at a glance, how can you solve a case so quickly?" ”
Spamton was stunned. He looked at you awkwardly curled up in your seat and couldn't help but chuckle—why would he try to trick you into taking your skills? That thing was completely useless to him. The only person he was interested in was you...... As for your soul, the light to him, whether he couldn't have it now didn't matter; it wasn't a necessity for him. He was already very satisfied with this kind of life.
"I'm going on a date with you sincerely, and I just sincerely want to date you...... How could I possibly want to steal your exclusive skills?" He smiled as he sat down on your side, deliberately moving a little closer. You swallowed hard and instinctively shifted back a little—now you're pressed against the window, and Spamton was pressed close to you, smiling at you. Your cheeks flushed red again, and you couldn't help but swallow hard. You couldn't help but think, he's just too good-looking...... No way, beauty can be misleading!! You clearly wanted to refuse him, so why have you turned out like this now?
You stammered, even you couldn't quite figure out what you were talking about: "So...... Um, I...... Uh, but, but I don't like you. How could I—how could I date you? "As you spoke, you still felt a bit guilty. After all, even though you don't know what liking feels like, you know you're happy to be with spamton. Maybe that's a kind of liking, right? You don't understand these things.
Spamton's smile seemed even brighter: "Ah...... But I really like Miss Y/N. Do you really not like me at all? Do you hate being with me? You...... Are you unhappy because of being with me? Are you unhappy? "Are you dissatisfied?" As he spoke, he put on a pitiful, somewhat sad expression, and as he spoke, his head kept lowering his head, and all you could see was tears dripping down his cheeks...... Probably so. You don't know that Spamton secretly put some eye drops on himself as tears to win your sympathy.
Seeing him like this, your heart clearly softened, and you stammered, "No, of course not. I—I don't mean to hate you, nor am I unhappy just because I'm with you...... I'm very pleased that you can be by my side, as my assistant." You stammered as you finished speaking, not even knowing what you were talking about, but at that moment, Spamton suddenly grabbed your hand.
He lifted his head, smiling at you, showing no sign that he had been crying—anyway, you couldn't tell, and you hadn't realized that Spamton might be pretending to be pitiful to trick you, and Spamton simply held your hands sincerely and said, "So you're so happy to be with me?" ”
You nodded in confusion.
"Do you feel relaxed and comfortable staying with me?"
You think about it and realize the answer is yes, so you nod again.
He pressed on, asking, "Then...... Do you want to stay with me? ”
You're not very sure about this answer. After thinking for a while, if Spamton isn't by your side, you'll need a capable assistant...... And he's helped you a lot in daily life, so your life might really not be possible without him.
So you just nodded affirmatively and said, "Definitely...... Yes, I want to stay with you. "What if he's not by your side, what if something suddenly happens?! You can't guarantee that you'll handle the case perfectly by yourself...... But if Spamton is here too, then you two definitely can do it. You promised yourself this, thought about it.
Spamton's smile only deepened, and he moved a little closer to you. You stared blankly at his face so close. Honestly, you wanted to step back, but you were already leaning against the window glass, with nowhere left to retreat.
He just smiled and said, "Then, Y/N, you say you like me, so...... Let's date, shall we?" He felt his chest pounding excitedly; he was really...... He really wanted to get close to you, to be close to a being of light, and ...... Not only that, he did see the shadow of light in you. He was certain, very certain that he liked you because he wanted to get close to the light, he wanted to get close to ...... The legendary sun.
And he found this in you, so...... So, he wants to get close to you, at all costs. He's certain he likes the light in you, the light shining in your eyes, and the innocent yet sunny side you show.
He likes you, Spamton is so sure.
You stuttered again, really not understanding what Spamton meant by getting so close. You just felt a bit dizzy and once again despised yourself. This is really beauty that misleads...... If it weren't for Spamton's behavior, you wouldn't have agreed to him in such a daze.
You're just dizzy, your eyes darting around, but you'll see Spamton's face no matter what. He's waiting for your answer, and you just stammer, "Uh...... Is that so?? Alright, alright then, let's ...... Let's fall in love! The last sentence was spoken after you made up your mind, closing your eyes. Then you felt a damp, shallow kiss fall on your cheek. You blinked, about to open your eyes to look, only to find your head being cupped. That moist, shallow kiss landed on your eyes, his movements careful, without a hint of recklessness. Spamton simply cupped your cheek and gently kissed your face again.
You carefully open your eyes, not knowing what to do, just glancing around and not daring to look at Spamton. Spamton's voice was very soft, and he leaned close to your ear, whispering as if deliberately, "So...... Great, Y/N and I are now a couple. The breath you exhaled as you spoke brushed against the tips of your ears, making them burn and turn red. You didn't dare look at Spamton, didn't know how to respond, so you gave him a sudden push, making him sit properly back down. Then you looked at the dessert in front of you, losing interest in tasting it, just sipping black tea to calm yourself. Your eyes still darted around, not at Spamton, but at your own faint reflection on the window glass.
"So...... Um, I, uh...... Alright, spammy? I, uh...... Alright, are we a couple now? Right. I think I can call you that now? "You stammered out that sentence.
Then you look at Spamton's reflection, who is smiling at the glass, or rather, smiling at you, and you nod at that reflection.
Your face suddenly turns red again, and you feel a bit flushed—oh my god, he, he, he...... Anyway, you're still a bit unaccustomed, so you have to cover up and drink another cup of tea to calm your nerves. Honestly, why did things end up like this...... You want to know why, but, but...... Uh, you still don't quite understand...... Forget it, you don't know what you're just daydreaming about, and you choose to give up. You don't want to think about it any longer. You grab a sandwich from the shelf, ready to take a bite, but just then, you hear a scream echoing throughout the café—your expression instantly freezes, because you smell the smell of the case, and you know clearly that something must have happened.
Spamton, standing nearby, also looked at you. He slightly opened his eyes and asked with a smile, "Should we go over now?" ”
You nodded without hesitation—of course you wouldn't miss any case! No matter what the case was, you definitely had to be present! So you held Spamton's hand, looking regretfully at the pastries on the table that hadn't been finished yet...... You've probably only wiped out about a third of them. Hopefully, you'll still be able to enjoy these pastries when you get back! Meanwhile, Spamton, whose date had been interrupted nearby, was smiling but also extremely unhappy. He really couldn't imagine so many incidents in the cyber world within just a few days.
By the time you arrived, the venue was already surrounded by several color card butlers—well, those scan butlers recognized you and nodded to let you through, automatically clearing a path for you. You finally entered the scene, but before you even stepped inside, you tensely led Spamton out again. The reason was simple: the temperature inside the room was just too high, or rather, walking in felt like stepping into a furnace, about to be scorched. One of the corpses—seemingly a brutally killed one that loved to stick to the wall—still flickered with fire, but its whole body was charred black, peeling debris with a popping sound. Not only that, but there were also some scorch marks beneath its feet—yet for some reason, the corpse was still slightly rising, and there was no spark on the dining table, only a slight burnt mark where it touched the chair. At first glance, it seemed like some natural event...... The windows inside were tightly shut, so the scorched heat and the inexplicably rich fragrance lingering in the room wouldn't dissipate.
Your gaze shifts to the Dark People who had just cried out—a Ren Wu Administrator Princess...... She was anxiously watching the situation inside the door. You also saw her paw, which had also become somewhat charred, with bright red blisters on it—clearly a remnant from earlier. After all, the wound looked very fresh. You took a quick closer look. The temperature of the door was indeed very high, so such burns and wounds seemed normal.
Just as you were about to ask something, the Ren Wu manager girl spoke first: "My friend...... I was only out for a short while, how did I end up like this...... I really shouldn't have left, otherwise you wouldn't have suffered such a great ordeal...... She said, sobbing softly.
You also frowned, a bit puzzled. You nodded at her and said, "But...... You're the murderer behind the crime, aren't you?" "You don't quite understand how she managed to make all this up in such a vivid way, speaking as if it were true, as if some god or ghost was involved in all of this."
The Ren Wu manager girl stiffened for a moment, then continued to sob, covering her face and said, "I...... How could that be? He's my best friend. Why would I go after him? There's no reason for that......
Spamton stepped forward, stepping in front of you, smiling as he said, "So...... Can you produce an alibi? Can someone testify for you? ”
The manager Ren Wu pointed at the waiter inside the café, who was the Seka butler nearby: "Of course, they can testify for me. Testify that I did leave this room halfway and just got back." ”
You blink, tug at Spamton's shirt, and whisper, "Spammy, I think we need to find some evidence...... Otherwise, there's no way the suspect will confess." "Even if you've identified who the killer really is. But no, no, no—let's go check the room first.
Spamton nodded as well, letting you lead him into the room. You were the first to pinch your nose and open the window—after all, the smell inside was just too unpleasant—then you discovered the source of such a strong fragrance: an incense burner. You walked over and saw that the incense was almost fully lit, perhaps to cover up what was happening inside.
You circled the room again, finally stopping next to the corpse that still made faint beeping sounds as fragments peeled down. You glanced over, and for some reason, next to the seat of the corpse was a large book box...... You opened it and looked inside. For some reason, all the books inside were related to the Light World, like the domineering Light People falling in love with me, and all sorts of random ways to win the favor of a Light Foreign—hmm, this seems to be the love that should have been taken away as the murderer at the recent banquet, but somehow it was released on the wall. You flipped through these books, and beyond that, there were all kinds of books related to the Light Citizens...... You really didn't know where he got such a strong interest in the Light Citizens.
You flipped further back to the last book, and with some surprise, you found another layer of iron in the box—you gave Spamton a look, and together you emptied all the books out. Finally, you pulled out a large iron frame, which looked big enough to fit a Dark Civilian unless the Dark Civilian was exceptionally tall.
And the books that had been poured out still had some dents and wrinkles on the edges—clearly, these books had stuffed the bookcase to the brim before. You didn't quite understand why this happened, but Spamton just reached out and touched the pages. Although the pages were cold, the corners and corners around them felt as if they had been ironed and still carried a hint of warmth. He slightly opens his eyes and tries to flip over the entire bookbox, pressing it onto the burning-out love wall, just enough to envelop it. You glance at him in confusion, but Spamton has no intention of speaking. He just walks to the window and looks again. The café's windows are all single-sided mirrors, meaning guests inside can see the outside world clearly from one side, while outsiders can't see what's inside—of course, the light or darkness is still noticed.
You squatted there, blinking innocently. To be honest, aside from that person being the culprit, you knew almost nothing. But at that moment, Spamton turned around, smiling and saying, "I already know the truth about the cause of everything." ”
"Ah...... Hmm? You already know?? What exactly is it...... "You grumble, a bit unhappy. Normally, this is when you, as a detective, should be showing off your power. Why is this time you're your assistant showing off your power...... Well, after all, he's already your boyfriend, so you magnanimously think that if he stands out, it means you're the one too! You happily convince yourself, then nod deeply, signaling Spamton to start his performance.
Spamton's smile deepened, seeming a bit more genuine. He pulled you to stand up and quietly whispered in your ear: "I think the killer set the victim on fire before leaving the private room, then covered the victim with that iron box. That way, other Dark People outside wouldn't notice anything strange about the room, wouldn't notice the flames were lit, and the killer's hand touched the iron box that conducts the same temperature, so he would get burned." It's not that touching a hot door means you can get burned—ah, and besides, the killer took the iron box and put the books back inside, so the corners of the books were slightly warm from touching the still-warm iron box—of course, ordinary people wouldn't notice this, and because of the rush, the corners of these books had some wrinkles. Although it was unclear how the original Dark People treated these books—those wrinkles were clearly new, and if they were old, they would often show yellow marks. ”
He carefully explained his reasoning to you, and you nodded thoughtfully. Just now, you still hadn't come up with such a bizarre killing method...... Hmm, I guess I still lacked a bit of imagination, probably. You comforted yourself like this, while Spamton just whispered, "This process is probably correct. Are you going to lend the details of the case to those Dark People outside, or should I handle it?" ”
You coughed twice and waved your hand: "Go ahead—well, after all, I can't steal the fruits of your intellectual labor......" You grumble as you still don't seem very happy.
But then you lift your head and puff out your chest, shouting loudly: "Hmm, but no wonder you're my assistant. Even without my help, you managed to deduce the course of this case! You really have the honor of a detective like me!" You announced loudly, cheerfully, while Spamton just looked at you with a gentle smile. He thought you looked cute like this and just kept nodding.
"Yes, yes, I know my Y/N is the best. The detectives at Mingmeng Detective Agency are the world's number one super invincible detectives!" He followed up on your words and praised you twice. You chuckled awkwardly twice, just puffed out your chest, showing no sign of embarrassment.
Then Spamton gently let go of your hand. You instinctively felt a bit disappointed, but you understood he was just going out to confront other Dark People and explain the real details of the case. You followed behind Spamton and walked out. You saw him with his hands behind his back, and at first, with a mysterious tone, said, "I've already figured out what happened in the case. Even if I'm just a small assistant—the process of this case is just too simple." ”
The remaining Dark People all fell silent and looked at Spamton, probably waiting for him to say what he would say next. You noticed that Ren Wu Manager Ji's expression suddenly became tense and tense, as if she was afraid of something—the culprit must be him, that's definitely true.
And you quietly followed him out a bit. If your assistant gets troubled, then it's time for you, the detective, to step in—well, though you probably won't have that kind of moment, you touch your nose and realize you somehow have an indescribable trust in Spamton...... Hmm, what exactly is the reason? You can't quite say, but in any case, you were just eagerly watching the scene.
“…… This case was probably quite simple—after all, it was just the body of the Dark People being set ablaze, and now it's turned into this state. The process is somewhat similar to the crematorium in the World of Light, since it's all burned to ashes or something. Spamton said with interest. You might think he was just teasing someone—after all, the conversation ended abruptly here. He had no intention of continuing, just waiting for someone to speak.
Finally, a color card steward standing opposite spoke up, cautiously asking, "What if a flame is lit...... Although we can't see it from outside, there is glass inside, and those dark folk passing by outside will notice it too. If that's the case, why hasn't anyone noticed this and told us? ”
Spamton smiled warmly, clapped his hands, and continued with the question: "That's a really good question—indeed, no matter what kind of burning it is, it emits light and heat when ignited, naturally producing a light that the outside world must notice. Hmm, if it's just burning...... then the Dark People outside will probably notice and stop it. However, as long as the burning love is pressed against the wall, the outside world won't notice the bright light of the flames. ”
You blinked, thoughtfully glancing at the room's layout—the curtains by the window showed no signs of being opened or lowered, the windowsill was clean and dust-free, and scanning the entire room, the only thing that could serve as a shield was that book box. In an instant, you understood: as long as you ignite that person's body and fasten the metal book box, nothing will be discovered by the other dark folk outside. However, metal is still heat-conductive. Touching this metal book box—or rather, the person who was the murderer at the time—must have burn marks on their body, most likely by hand.
Once you get the answer, you cross your arms and lean against the doorframe, waiting for Spamton to continue.
The color card butler then asked, "If that's the case...... Except for the things he came into close contact with, nothing else was burned. How should we explain that? ”
At that moment, you spoke up: "That's simple. Just make sure it doesn't interact with the outside world while burning. Of course, since he's in that position, it's naturally preserved in an unusual way—well, as for the answer to this question, I think it's already clear after seeing the scene." ”
Spamton squinted slightly and started to chime in with you: "The answer is simple—it's that metal book box, with a layer of metal inside the outer wooden book box, probably just for moisture protection at first." But...... The metal has a high ignition point, so it can certainly stop the burning from going on, and the books that should be neatly arranged in the box have some wrinkles at the edges, and the areas where they touch the metal frame are still getting warm. "He deliberately paused here, as if waiting for the question from the other side, or simply waiting for your words.
You glanced at him, and Spamton gave you a wink. You immediately understood and continued in sync with his words: "Hmm...... As for the killer, he wanted to hold such a huge metal frame and suffocate someone who was burning, but the victim was completely unprepared in that posture. This only shows that the killer was someone familiar and close to the victim—and since they had to press down the metal box to prevent the victim from escaping, wanting to burn him completely clean, their hand had to touch the heat-conducting metal box, and at the same time, the body was burning very hot—so the killer must have burn marks on his body. "As you spoke, you looked at the Renwu Administrator Ji, who had instinctively put her hand behind her back.
“…… Although you have found evidence, we believe that just the fact that the books in the bookcase are still somewhat warm and the corners of these books have wrinkles are difficult to convict." The Seka butler said, looking at you with difficulty, since your words sounded quite reasonable...... However, they found it difficult to accept your somewhat mysterious testimony.
"If you don't believe what we're saying, you can investigate it yourself...... After all, this evidence is indeed hard to convince. "You nodded, indicating you accepted the Seka butler's opinion. Hmm...... Honestly, this case is a bit too strange, so at first you couldn't figure out a way to commit it. In this regard, you suddenly wondered if Spamton might be better suited to be a detective than you—no, no, no, no, you immediately dismissed your own idea. If he wanted to be a detective, he could easily start his own business. Since he was still at Mingmeng Detective Agency, it meant he was willing to work for me! Thinking of this, you couldn't help but puff out your chest proudly again. This is your assistant, he really gives you honor!
The color card butlers also sent someone to check the private room. Soon, that person came out and nodded to the other scan stewards—hmm, it seems they believe your evidence is indeed reasonable and well-founded. The scan card stewards didn't say anything more, but one of them asked, "If that's the case, who is the culprit?" ”
You quickly spoke up: "I've made myself clear—the culprit is that Ren Wu Manager Ji." ”
But the Renwu manager just calmly spoke: "...... I am a friend of the deceased; I absolutely would not have harmed him. If you ask me, this young lady might have identified the wrong culprit, or rather...... You never had any abilities to begin with? "She said casually. Those Colored Card butlers looked at each other, but in the end, they didn't dare to cast a suspicious gaze at you, only silently lowering their heads.
You took a deep breath, put your hands on your hips, and just said to yourself, "Alright, then Miss Ji, Ren Wu, do you dare to stretch out your hands and show us?" ”
"Of course I dare, why not?" She revealed her hands—her right palm was covered with a burn mark mixed with blisters, a shocking sight. The nearby color card butlers couldn't help but sigh, probably feeling regret.
Spamton had just observed for a moment. He knew you were absolutely right, since your reasoning matched his. Only now did he leisurely ask, "May I ask, miss, what caused such terrifying burn marks?" ”
“…… When I rushed back earlier, I bumped into the door handle and found that the doors were all pitted and scorching hot, radiating a scorching heat. I instinctively wanted to open the door, but it was too hot and burned my hand, and at the same time...... This door wouldn't open, that's exactly it. "Manager Ren Wu murmured. As she spoke, tears still fell from her cheeks. She instinctively reached out to wipe them away, probably from the pain of losing a close friend or family.
“…… So, may I ask the others, when Ren Wu managed Miss Ji returning, did they notice the burn marks on her right hand?" "You asked, while the color card butlers looked at each other in confusion, then finally shook their heads.
"Well, solving this is simple. We just need to access the surveillance footage." Spamton suggested with a cheerful smile. In the end, you all gathered in the café's management room and waited for the color card manager here to turn on the surveillance footage.
The surveillance footage began playing. Visibly, Miss Ji, Manager Ren Wu, left the room around eleven thirty, closed the door, and then returned to the front of the door around twelve. Just as she was about to reach out to touch the door, she abruptly withdrew her hand and turned straight to find the Seka butler.
Zooming in on the surveillance footage from that moment, you can clearly see that Miss Ji, Manager Renwu, didn't touch the door. Her lie was exposed on its own—from the moment she discovered the scorching room, to calling you two to finish the case, she never touched that door. So how did the burn come about? This time, you all looked at Manager Renwu, Miss Ji, who still calmly kept lying: "Ah, I wanted to go to the kitchen at that time to see if I could prepare some food...... I accidentally got burned by the flames. I remembered wrong." ”
"Did you remember wrong, or was it a lie? I think you know very well in your heart...... You are the culprit. You emptied the books in the bookbox, covered it with a metal box, then set this love sticker against the wall, causing the tragedy. As for that strong incense—you probably hoped someone discovered he was dead before you did. You hoped someone would notice the scent. Unfortunately, the game was a misstep, and in the end, it was you who cleaned up the mess and told the Seka butler. You originally thought this case would end as a cold case—but unfortunately, someone would eventually discover your little scheme. Spamton smiled and gave his conclusion, confident that this Renwu manager girl wouldn't argue anymore.
Sure enough, she lowered her head, almost gritting her teeth as she said, "Exactly...... The Addison he killed was the one I loved. Although the Dark People can be resurrected, after resurrection, it's always different. Why...... Why should he still be alive and well? I want him to taste the pain of death too...... You and Spamton exchange a glance, and only then do you realize that this Love-Sticking Girl is the one who tried to frame Spamton at the banquet before. And this Renwu Manager Ji was also escorted away by the other Color Card butlers. You returned to your previous seats. Although the taste of the snacks hadn't changed, you really weren't in the mood to taste them anymore.
With no other choice, you take a sip of the tea that had become a bit bitter from the cold and say gloomily, "It feels like this date was a complete failure...... Next time, let's find a new place to date......
Spamton didn't mind; anything was fine for him, and he naturally nodded with a smile: "Alright, then next time let's move somewhere else." ”
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 6 (dnbsx you)
content:
You pulled Spamton back to the detective agency...... Of course, before that, you first saw a roadside grocery store, so you went in and started buying all sorts of snacks. You bought two bottles of grape soda with sugar, two bags of strawberry fruit gummies, then you crawled into the shelves to grab a few Alps lollipops, grabbed two bottles of chewing gum, and finally, because it was fresh, bought two more spicy strips. After that, you stuffed all these things into Spamton's arms, while you took two popsicles from the freezer in front of the store, stuffed one into your mouth, and then stuffed another into Spamton's mouth.
You kept biting on the popsicle, mumbling unclearly, "Mm...... Let's head back first. I think this popsicle tastes pretty good. Maybe we can buy a Xiaoice box at our office to display these things......
Spamton glanced at you holding a big bag of things, then smiled and said, "But isn't there already a big refrigerator inside the office? Just put everything there...... Well, of course, if you want to buy a separate refrigerator, that's fine too, as long as you like it. ”
"Not really, but you're right. If you put nothing in that fridge, leaving it there would just be a waste...... Hmm, I'll buy some more things to put in there!" You said enthusiastically, and once you got back to the office, you could just calm down this big pile of stuff and then drag Spamton to the supermarket.
"By the way, you can cook, right? What are you better at? I'll buy some vegetables to put in the fridge. Hmm, I also need to buy some frozen dumplings and pizza and the like...... Ah, these tangyuan look good, and that bun is ...... "You curiously study the pre-made dishes in the storage cabinet, even though you don't really like the taste of thawed frozen foods...... But it's okay to eat once in a while, and you're quite curious about what these strawberry-flavored buns actually taste like.
But just as you reached out to put these things into the shopping cart, Spamton first stopped you, smiling and saying, "You only need to buy a few cents for an emergency...... Besides, I can cook, so I don't need to keep a lot of frozen food at home." He naturally called the agency 'home' since it's where you two live together, and now you've acknowledged your legal relationship with him...... Of course he would say that, but Spamton didn't admit it was just a little trick of his own. As long as you don't mind, it's fine.
In fact, you really don't care—probably, well, you think the agency is home anyway, and you two live there, right? It seems like hardly anyone comes to your office usually, so it's fine to be casually a little extravagant...... Anyway, you pulled your hand back from trying the strawberry bun and pushed the shopping cart forward.
"Then, it doesn't matter what you eat. As long as it's something you like, I can learn the recipes...... It doesn't matter. Well, as long as you think it's tasty, that's all that matters. " he said.
And when you hear this, you perk up, your eyes starting to light up: "Really?! Then I want to eat cauliflower...... Before, I wanted to try it, but I could never find a proper Chinese restaurant...... In short, in the end, I could only grit my teeth and eat a big lump of something that didn't taste great...... You couldn't help but feel a bit down, but honestly, you really did want to try it...... In the end, you gave an awkward smile.
"But I've heard that growing cauliflower is hard to learn. If you really can't learn it, forget it. I'm not particularly interested in eating it......" you patched up yourself, while Spamton just smiled and listened to you, asking.
"It's fine, it's not very difficult for me—so what do you want to [taste delicious] more?" He had also looked at some Chinese recipes, and for him, it wasn't particularly difficult; he just needed to spend time trying a few more times...... Well, it really depends on what flavor you prefer.
You thought for a moment, hesitated for a moment, and said, "Um...... Strawberry Mapo Tofu? ”
Spamton's expression stiffened for a moment, but he forced himself to keep his smile and said, "...... Strawberry Mapo Tofu is just an invention by other Lightfolk people. It's not a proper Chinese dish. The proper one is Mapo Tofu, but this one is spicy. I wonder if you can accept that...... He started explaining to you at length, maybe because he usually liked spicy food. You got a bit tired of hearing it, couldn't help but cover one ear, and whispered, "Alright, alright, I know...... But I really don't like spicy food; I prefer something lighter, sweeter, and tastier...... I like sweet things. ”
Spamton opened his eyes slightly, glanced at you, and smiled, saying, "Are you a child?" You actually prefer sweet ......" Speaking of which, you just bought a lot of candy, and it seems you really do prefer sweets.
Your cheeks flushed, but you muttered, "Yeah, I just prefer sweet things! I like sugar, cake, milk tea—what's wrong with that!" Eating sweets releases dopamine and makes you feel happier—hmm, of course, eating carbohydrates and such can also help regulate your mood...... In short, eating sweets is really good for your health! "You spouted a bunch of twisted logic, sounding so convinced, then stood on your hands with your hands on your hips, looking at Spamton with your chin slightly raised, as if he'd make a scene if he didn't agree."
"Besides, I'm just a kid anyway...... I just graduated from college! It's fine to call yourself a kid. Oh, right...... I want to try what would happen if chicken, duck, fish, and meat were made sweet. Let's make fish for today. "The topic jumped quickly, and you quickly decided what to eat next. Happily, you instructed Spamton to pick out food for you.
After you've finally finished buying everything, you go home and slowly fill the fridge with all sorts of things. Spamton looked at the top shelf and thought for a moment: "Vegetables can't really be put in here. Tomorrow I'll make a soup with all these vegetables for you." ”
You were exhausted, sitting on the sofa. Hearing this, you glanced at the fridge and looked a bit puzzled: "Hmm...... Let's stew soup together? Will it taste good...... "From what I remember, the last soup you drank was Russian red soup. As for the taste, there's no need to say more—it's just very warm."
Spamton just nodded firmly, closed the fridge, and sat down across from you: "Of course, leave it to me. Don't worry, my sweetheart. Tomorrow, just enjoy my cooking." He smiled at you, and as he looked at his face, you couldn't help but blush a little—well, you really think beauty can be misleading! You hurriedly grabbed whatever was in the bag on the table, opened it, and took a bite. Then you hurriedly pulled open the soda can lid and gulped down several mouthfuls, but unfortunately, the spiciness lingered in your mouth and wouldn't fade. You coughed twice, the blush on your face refusing to go down. Looking down, you didn't know how you had just picked up a bag of spicy strips. You have no choice but to open it and pop a lollipop into your mouth to calm your nerves. Even so, your mood isn't great, since it's just too spicy—plus the soda's stimulation, making you feel like something is jumping in your mouth, constantly stimulating your nerves.
…… You don't know how to describe this feeling. With reddened eyes, you look pitifully at Spamton, who is trying to hold back a laugh and somehow brings you a glass of frozen milk. You unceremoniously bring it over and gulp it down.
…… Hmm, now your mouth feels much better, just a little sticky and rich sweetness. You smile again and sincerely say, "This feels much better...... Thank you, spammy. I like the taste of this milk. Maybe next time we go to the mall, we can buy a little more...... "I was just planning to have a few sips at breakfast to get by, but it turned out to be pretty good. At least you really like it." You don't know if Spamton will like this taste.
Spamton took a couple of sips from the glass of milk you'd already drunk, nodded in agreement: "It really tastes great. Next time you go to the mall, you can buy more...... Hmm, if it's just to relieve the spiciness, drinking milk will have a pretty good effect." He said this, and you just nodded thoughtfully. You really don't understand a lot of everyday knowledge...... After all, you're just a weirdo immersed in your own world.
Then you look at the can with a loop on the table, your eyes darting, and suddenly an idea pops into your head. You lean closer, a bit mysterious and somewhat anticipatory, and say, "Stretch out your left hand." ”
Spamton blinked twice in confusion, then you picked up the iron ring and slipped it onto his left ring finger, hands on hips as you looked at your masterpiece, excitedly saying, "Ta-da-da~ Now you're marrying me, spammy! So, do you like this ring?" ”
Spamton was stunned for a moment, glanced at the ring on his finger, then at you, and finally just curved his eyes and said, "Of course, I like everything about you. Whatever you give me, I'll like it, my sweetheart." ”
You blink, your eyes darting around. You pat your cheek to calm yourself down, then simply sit down on the sofa next to him. You hug him hard, hugging him hard and hard, even rubbing against his neck. You think about a movie you've seen before and imitate a line from the movie: "Then I'll give you a basket of hugs—"
Maybe he'd seen that movie too, maybe he hadn't. Spamton just turned around and hugged you back, gently pressing his cheek against yours, then softly kissed yours. So barely noticeable, his lips brushed against the corner of your mouth. You felt your ears start to burn, your arms went weak. You didn't push him away, or rather, you didn't have the strength to push him away—or rather, you simply couldn't bear to push him away.
You feel the breath from his mouth brush against your ear. Beside your ear, he softly whispers in a faintly electric sizzling voice, "Then I want to give you a basketful of kisses." As he spoke, he leaned in and kissed your forehead again.
Then he looked at your lips and softly mouthed: So, can I do it?
You blushed and nodded, the smile at the corner of his mouth seemed to grow bigger and more obvious. Then he cupped your cheek, and you could feel that warm, slightly cool yet moist touch on your lips.

title: Bright Dream 7 (dnbsx you)
content:
Your face suddenly flushed again, and you were so nervous you didn't know whether to close or open your eyes...... You really didn't know what to do. Your eyes darted around, and when the kiss ended, Spamton looked up at you with a smile, but your eyes still darted around, refusing to look up at Spamton. You covered your lips, instinctively recalling the feeling from earlier...... During that kiss, you were mostly distracted, only remembering the warm, cool touch...... In short, it was very comfortable.
You took a deep breath, blushing as you cupped Spamton's face. You stammered as you asked, but still tried hard to meet his eyes: "Um...... That! I—I'm going to kiss you! "You announced loudly, and by the end, your cheeks turned bright red. Spamton just smiled, probably looking at you with a hint of encouragement...... He nodded gently, then you took another deep breath, closed your eyes, and lowered your head to bite his lips again. But you only gave a gentle suck. The feeling of skin-to-skin contact seemed quite nice...... You vaguely thought this, but in the end, you were held by Spamton. Then he pressed your head, his tongue pried open your lips, and as he advanced, he took your tongue into his mouth, licking the soft flesh inside your mouth, entwining your tongue. You stammered, since you still didn't know how to breathe. When Spamton finally let go, you were still gasping for breath.
Then you covered your cheeks and lips and suddenly got up and ran toward your own room. You really felt a bit embarrassed...... You just glanced at Spamton with a playful look and stammered, "Well, anyway, you're still staying in the room next door...... I-I'll head back first!" With that, you rushed back and slammed your own door shut. After closing the door, you squatted down again, muttering to yourself, "So...... So that's how you kissed like that......"
You...... That was definitely your first experience! But the experience was pretty good. You threw yourself onto the bed, wrapped yourself tightly in the blanket, and started rolling around, letting out meaningless howls under the covers...... Fortunately, Spamton wouldn't hear you, so you could scream in your room without worry.
Of course, the next day when you meet, it's like nothing happened. You're still a serious detective, but you'll secretly tilt your head to look at your assistant, then quietly nuzzle him to kiss the corner of his mouth, and when Spamton looks back, he'll just lie on the table and grin foolishly. He seems to enjoy it too, always finding ways to kiss him back. In short, it seems like he's been going through this for several days in a row.
It's just ...... Your detective agency's reputation should have already been established. Logically, a client should have come knocking, but...... Not a single Dark Commoner has come knocking. You lie on the table, bored and starting to feel a bit restless.
"Ahhh...... Why are there no customers here? This shouldn't be right...... Spammy, go find some customers for me! "You've started directing your assistant to go outside to solicit customers, but you don't believe that even after taking the initiative, there still aren't any customers!
Spamton tilted his head slightly; he had come up with an idea...... Hmm, although this seemed a bit like a bad idea, it could definitely help you attract clients, so he just smiled and nodded, "Of course you can. No problem, I'll go help you solicit clients...... Or rather, we should be the ones who actively chase after the tail end of the case." With that, he walked toward his own room. You lay boredly on the table, still holding a lollipop in your mouth...... Hmm, this kind of life really has no hope! You don't like living this kind of life at all. You didn't look up, so naturally you didn't know Spamton had switched to a bunny girl outfit...... Uh, or rather, wearing the bunny boy's clothes, he went out. His outfit was quite frivolous and revealing, which might have caused a stir among the passing Dark Commoners, since they had no idea that a popular figure in the cyber world could look like this—but since there were no sexual characteristics, even if he walked out naked without clothes, those Dark Folk wouldn't even glance at him, since it really had nothing to do with them, and besides, it was just a common occurrence.
But the Dark People understood exactly what the bunny girl's outfit meant in the world of light—so when Spamton walked down the street in such a daring outfit, the Dark People couldn't help but cast a few more glances at him, and more and more people gathered in front of the Ming Meng Detective Agency, most of them just to watch the spectacle. Spamton's face was full of smiles, and in his hand he was holding a handful of flyers from who knows where, all printed with the Ming Meng Detective Agency's special edition: "Extra, extra, the detective agency urgently needs cases—or rather, wrongful convictions, and difficult cases. Please leave them all to us at Ming Meng Detective Agency!" "Just rest assured—our detectives can determine the culprit with just a word and action." As for me, the great detective's assistant—you can discover the truth from the tiniest clues, and of course, everyone is welcome to give it a try! The experience we offer will not disappoint you. ”
Some people did gather because of the special edition, while others were ...... Because Spamton was a popular figure in Cyber City, and now he was dressed like that, it was truly shocking and made people want to investigate.
In any case, Spamton was a success...... Because it had indeed attracted many people, and many of the Dark People had heard the name of Mingmeng Detective Agency. Whether that name was good or bad was something he couldn't guarantee. In short...... Because the entrance was so noisy, you couldn't help but look up, and then your pupils began to tremble.
Oh my god—Spamton, wearing a bunny boy outfit and standing at the door to attract customers?? Those who know know you're a legitimate detective agency, just specializing in handling cases. If you don't, you'd think you're some kind of brothel...... And there's even a male waiter standing at the door to attract clients!
You hurriedly got up, wanting to do something to stop this from going on, but just as you stood up, Spamton walked in at the door, holding a pile of documents...... Uh, I wonder what kind of case could have such a thick stack of documents. You saw him seem to have said something to someone outside, then he smiled and opened the door, walked in, and placed the documents in front of you: "I just went to promote the reputation of our detective agency...... Many people are willing to trust us, and now I have ten cases in total. There's no time to investigate. I'll bring the suspects for each case over to you soon. You just need to judge whether they're guilty—this is pretty simple for you, right? "He said this, smiling and raising his eyebrows at you. You nodded instinctively. If that's the case, it would indeed be a very simple matter for you...... But wait, how did he manage to get so many cases involved? Thinking this, you couldn't help but ask.
"Hmm...... After all, lately, our detective agency run by the Light Folk has really become quite famous, and today I wore this outfit to attract some clients...... To be honest, this kind of publicity is quite effective; at least more people come just because of its reputation. ”
As he said this, you looked at Spamton's clothes with a hint of difficulty—honestly, for your aesthetic, this was a bit too much, though you had to admit that this outfit was just really good...... Spamton probably noticed your gaze, even giving you a flirtatious glance, leaning down toward you, and in a slightly coquettish, almost hoarse voice said, "How about it...... My sweetheart, do you like this outfit? If you do, I'll wear it for you every day in private. ”
Your coughing grew louder, your eyes darting around. You really had no idea what was going on with this guy...... But I have to admit, you do like how he dresses. Maybe people have a bit of a lustful heart.
Anyway, no matter what, you still quietly mumbled, "Um, I...... I like it, cough cough." As you spoke, your eyes still darted around, probably satisfied. Spamton's lips curled into a smile, which deepened. Then he waved toward the door and placed the documents on your desk—the case summary.
This is a jewelry theft case: a set of jewelry stored in the Queen's Mansion for display in the reception hall has gone missing, and the suspect is a color chart butler from the Queen's Mansion. You look at him several times, first recognizing his appearance—not much different from other swatch butlers, except his expression, probably because he's a suspect, now seems a bit flustered.
You simply asked, "Where were you when the jewelry was stolen?" ”
His eyes darted wildly from side to side, and before he could give you an answer, you waved your hand as if losing interest: "Alright, he's the culprit in this case. Take him away." Whether recalling or making things up, you didn't let him say it, because when his eyes darted around, everything became very obvious...... And his hand lingered behind his back, unwilling to take it out. He was guilty, trying to tell some lies to escape his crime.
And when you were found guilty, his expression changed—probably in disbelief, but this guy was escorted away by Spamton...... No one knew where he got the handcuffs from.
In any case, he waved and led the next suspect inside. This time, the suspect was a female Dark Citizen. You glanced at her and found she looked very confused...... Probably because she really didn't understand why she was here. You opened the files in your hand and glanced at it—this case was an Addison poisoning case...... Ah, one of those Addison loved drinking tea and was poisoned while drinking it, so they turned their suspicious gaze to the woman preparing the tea.
You glanced her up and down, not even asking her a single routine question, just waved your hand: "This young lady is innocent. Let's let her go first. In any case, she has nothing to do with this case." "As for why that Addison was poisoned...... That's none of your business. You're only responsible for finding the culprit, not solving the case. Spamton told you earlier, so maybe those Addisons were fighting among themselves and secretly poisoned another Addison...... Well, that guess is a bit malicious, but it's not without reason.
Basically, you just sit here, propping up your chin, watching Spamton wave and call the next person in.

title: Bright Dream 8 (dnbsx you)
content:
This time, the person who walked in was a love-sticker who loved to stick against the wall...... You glanced briefly and thought, hmm, this time it was a murder case. The victim was a manager named Ren Wu, and the crime scene was a small alley. The injuries on the victim's body hadn't been thoroughly investigated, but she still had this stick-in-the-wall token on her, which is why he was brought in as a suspect...... You glanced over the file and then looked up at the love-sticker in front of you. His eyes darted around, not daring to look at you, and his face seemed a bit pale compared to his, as if he couldn't see clearly—except he was slowly floating here, looking indeed weak or guilty.
You just put down the materials and asked a question, which seemed unrelated to the case—except the current estimated time of the incident was around this time: "Between nine and ten the night before last...... How was the performance at the dance hall? I heard the wine there was really good. ”
The one who loves sticking to the wall instinctively said, "That day, we happened to invite the famous diva from all over Cyber City...... It was just too beautiful. As for the wine there, I was responsible for transporting it over, and my family is responsible for brewing and making the liquor...... He seemed about to keep boasting and continuing his conversation, but you just interrupted him.
"Alright, he's not the culprit in this case...... But he's probably the culprit in another case. Let's take him to the side for now." Only then did the wall-hungry man realize what was happening. He shouted that he was innocent, but no one paid him any attention. He was handcuffed and escorted to the side by Spamton, then welcomed the next suspect into your venue.
You checked the records, and this time it was the same ...... Well, the church children's disappearances probably happened around evening, when the children playing near the church all disappeared together. A group of anxious Dark Folk called the police. As for the one being detained, it looked like an Addison dressed as a priest...... You weren't interested in understanding why they were dressed like this. You just flipped through the documents again, then looked up at the Addison in front of you. He had his eyes closed, still smiling, holding a cross—uh, his expression somewhat resembled Spamton's, making you turn to glance at Spamton, who just tilted his head curiously as if looking at you. You quickly turned your head again, looked at the documents again, hesitated for a moment, and then gave your judgment: "This guy is innocent." He didn't kidnap these children...... As for where the children went, let's look again; maybe they're nearby. "Of course, that's just your speculation. You know kids like to run around everywhere, maybe they just got lost.
The case was solved, the suspect was acquitted and walked out, and then another suspect was brought in. This time, it was a virus...... Well, it's not very common. When you glance at the files in your hand, you can't help but feel exasperated. Invic is a virus, and the victim's computer was hacked, so they sued their neighbor's virus...... The virus looked completely justified, as if it didn't matter at all. You looked at him, unable to tell if he was guilty or not, so as usual, you asked a question.
"What do you think about being accused of hacking your neighbor's computer?" Because you really can't think of anything else to ask...... So that's all you can ask. I hope he can give you an answer that satisfies you.
"Him?" His computer's firewall is so bad that I wouldn't even bother attacking him—there's absolutely no need for that. Why would I attack his computer? It wouldn't do me any good, so this definitely wasn't my doing. Maybe that guy just misread things! "This Dark Citizen said with absolute certainty.
You nodded and waved your hand: "This guy isn't the culprit in this case, but probably someone from another case...... Detain him and take him aside for now, next person! ”
The next to walk in was Manager Ren Wu, whose face was full of anger. You hadn't even had time to read the materials, and she was already rambling: "Honestly, I'm just a front desk manager. How could I possibly be involved in the poisoning case? I didn't even go inside—isn't that just slandering me?!" She was indignant, but when you heard her words, you perked up and picked up the documents to glance at them.
This case was a nightclub poisoning incident. Reportedly, there were no casualties, but all the Dark Citizens present who had been drinking were poisoned. So they jointly reported the nightclub staff, and in the end, the receptionist was charged.
You glanced at her twice, then at the documents, and finally at Ai-Wall-Sticker, who was being detained by Spamton: "You really aren't the murderer of the poisoning case, because the killer is someone else—this Ai-Wall-Sticker...... As for you, you killed your good colleague in the alley behind you, another Ren Wu Manager Ji, right? "You lifted your eyes slightly, resting your chin on your hand as you said with great interest, and Ren Wu's expression immediately changed. She was naturally taken away, and as for the Ai-Wall...... Yeah, she was taken away too. Of course, although they weren't the murderers of the accused case, they were the ones in another case. You weren't interested in figuring out their motives and methods, since you were dealing with the next case.
The next person to come in was an ordinary Addison, blue in color. Take a look at the accused case—it was actually a bakery bread that had spoiled...... The victim insisted she ate expired bread and demanded compensation, and even found a necklace inside. This is simply outrageous!
Your expression suddenly became hard to describe...... Well, in short, there was nothing else to say. You looked up at the addison, who took the initiative to speak: "Ah, all the bread in my house is freshly baked every morning, and I check each ingredient one by one to ensure there's no problem, so this case has nothing to do with me." "And as you looked down at the documents in your hand, you naturally didn't notice the undercurrents between Spamton and this addison.
You just tapped your knuckles on the table and said, "Mr. Addison, now you're not only charged with spoiled bread, but also with jewelry theft. You are the culprit, so—next!" You waved your hand to beckon him, and Addison's face turned pale, and Spamton grabbed him, handcuffed him, and took him away. And the next one who walked in—or rather, the one who drifted in was also a virus.
You first checked the information. In this case, the Queen's villa's security system had completely failed, and everything was hacked. Because of this, the Seka butler caught the person acting suspiciously near the villa, accused him, and brought him before you as a suspect.
You roughly take a look—it's about the access controls—each room's own restrictions, the basement lock, and the office access controls—all have been breached...... The queen was furious, and the remaining color card butlers naturally followed her orders to quickly find the culprit. However, there was currently no other evidence to help accuse the virus.
Ni Kan paused for a moment, then asked, "Do you know what the access control inside the Queen's Villa is like? Is it easy to conquer?" ”
His voice trembled as well: "I-I don't know! To me, that would be like a natural chasm—it's just too dangerous...... Even if I had a hundred times the courage, I wouldn't dare do something like this! Miss, you probably misunderstood me. I'm a citizen of the Three Good Darkness...... I would never casually hack into someone else's equipment, unless it's absolutely necessary...... He rambled on, and you found yourself getting a headache coming on. You gestured for him to be quiet, then looked at the virus imprisoned nearby and asked with a smile.
"So, what do you think of the access control inside the Queen's Villa?"
The virus quickly replied, "A piece of cake, it's a piece of cake. It's really easy, not difficult at all." After instinctively speaking, he realized what he'd just said in his rush, hurriedly shut his mouth, and then you turned to look at the virus in front of you, equally terrified, and couldn't help but laugh.
"Don't be so nervous, they're just accomplices—though I don't know why you broke into that Dark People's computer, maybe something important. In short, one of you is responsible for hacking into that poor neighbor's computer, the other is in charge of hacking into the security system inside the Queen's villa, and in the end, the virus pretends the person involved is caught, so you can both escape charges at the same time...... Unfortunately, you were caught together anyway. Forget it, take them down, next one! "You wave your hand, Spamton also handcuffs the virus, and then both viruses are escorted out together, looking utterly defeated. You wait for the next person to come in, and take a look at the files for the next case.
The case was simple, except it also happened in a nightclub, where the Dark Folk were accused of poisoning and murdering another Dark Citizen. You don't even need to look closely to know this guy is innocent, since it was the same poison he had stuck under the wall before. The Dark Folk probably died from the poisoning because they drank a bit too much—sure enough, the documents clearly state that the victim was extremely addicted to alcohol and drank excessively that night.
So when the next defendant walks into the detective agency, you simply wave your hand directly: "Alright, you're innocent. Go home, next ......."
Honestly, although you really enjoy solving cases, solving ten cases in a row is just too exhausting. You've gone from being passionate at first to now just lazily sprawling on your desk, always feeling like your brain has been drained...... Of course, it could also be your imagination.
The last Dark Clan who walked in seemed to have stopped acting. You could still see the unique bloodstains of the Dark Clan on him—like yellow-purple vortex-shaped marks. Of course, the area wasn't very large, and he was holding a small knife. Oh heavens, this knife is still dripping blood?! Where did you find the murderer?! You command Spamton in terror: "This guy is the murderer! Hurry and seize him and take him out!! ”
Spamton agreed to your words and took the guy out, and when he returned, he saw you sprawled over the table, sighing, "So tired...... Don't take on so many jobs next time, I wish I wouldn't open for a whole week...... you muttered plaintively.
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 9 (dnbsx you)
content:
Even though you feel completely burned out, the case shows no sign of letting you off. Probably because ...... What happened yesterday made your detective agency stand out. After all, you've solved ten cases in a row without making any mistakes, and you can even give some justified reason. Anyone would care about this, and the next morning, the color card butler came knocking.
You lay listlessly on the table, letting Spamton greet the guests...... Oh my god, you wished the case had come knocking a little later, but you never expected something would happen the very next day.
The color card butler respectfully addressed you, "After hearing about the reputation of this detective agency and the presence of the People of Light, we have unanimously agreed to seek your help...... There has been a case that has troubled us for several days. We hope you can assist us in solving it. ”
As he spoke, he bowed deeply to you again, respectfully, and of course, didn't forget to bow to Spamton. You yawned, feeling a bit lazy.
