The exhaustion in your body kept weighing you down, but your curiosity about the case and the excitement you felt from it were involuntarily stirred. You looked up and asked.
"So, could you first give us a general overview of this case? What kind of case has troubled you all for so long?" "You can't help but be a bit curious; you don't know what these people really are...... Hmm, what exactly is going on?
The Seka butler bows to you again, then begins to explain the general situation of the case: "Here's what happened. During this period, we've been discovering their own bodies in different households...... Because their bodies had decomposed and deformed, their neighbors held them tightly, because they noticed a strange smell. However...... What's quite strange is that some of the Dark People were missing parts—some lost legs, some lost arms, and one was a Dark Commoner...... All the skin on their bodies was stripped off, along with their hair. ”
Just hearing the descriptions makes these people seem strange. You fall into deep thought, but the saka butler continues, "We're not sure if any other cases will happen next, nor who the suspects are. These three dead Dark People have nothing in common." ”
"So, you can confirm their identities and their social networks?" You confirmed, and the color card butler nodded.
You pondered for a second, then asked, "So, can't you find a single suspect, even if it's only related to one of them?" ”
But the color card butler just shook his head: "We can't find them. These three dead Dark People are all out of touch with society, with little social connection. That's why their neighbors discovered them and reported it." ”
You fell into deep thought, while Spamton was the first to stand up, smiling as he said, "We roughly understand some details of the case...... You still need to go back and take care of other things, right? Why don't you go first? Later, we'll head to the police station. Don't worry, we'll definitely help find the culprit." ”
So the color card butler walked out. Of course, he was probably still a bit uneasy, glanced back at you two more times, while you rested your chin on your hand, staring at the desk, lost in thought. Spamton walked back over to your side, pulled out a chair and sat down. He smiled and said, "Sweetheart, do you have any thoughts on this case?" ”
You scratched your head: "Hmm...... The killer must target people who live in isolation and isolation. Anyone can see that, so there's no need to say more." Spamton nodded, his hands also resting on the table, waiting for your answer. You're not very clear about the distribution of people in the Dark World; Spamton probably knows more about that.
So you looked at Spamton with extra sincerity: "This time, my assistant needs to make a big contribution too—I'm not very familiar with the distribution of these dark people in the Dark World, so I guess you'll need to step in." ”
He just shrugged as well: "Well...... I'm not really that clear either. If anyone knows about it, no one knows this better than the police, right? Anyway...... I understand, I'll help. Of course, I think in some respects, I still understand this dark world better than the police. ”
After some discussion, you packed up and headed to the police station. Of course, most of your stuff was packed by Spamton, and before leaving, he stuffed a lollipop into your mouth. Then he gently held your hand, and you got into a taxi to the police station. You were smiling the whole time, secretly sneaking glances at Spamton, while he just turned to look at you, even making a wink gesture at you—you instantly blushed, quickly turned away, and patted your cheek. You felt so embarrassed that you felt embarrassed.
Spamton paid the taxi driver, then pulled you out. Throughout the whole process, you were still a bit dazed. Spamton helplessly shook your hand: "Alright, fresh and awake now. We've arrived, we've arrived at our [destination]." As he said this, you finally snapped back to reality. But even after you did, you still looked very embarrassed, stammering and not daring to look at Spamton anymore. He walked ahead of you, grabbed you, and led you into the police station. When those color card butlers saw you walk in, they all bowed respectfully toward you, and you nodded awkwardly. Spamton greeted them with a bright smile.
Then he asked, "Could you first show us the condition of the victims' bodies?" We need to understand the details more clearly before we can conduct a reasonable analysis. "The color card butlers naturally nodded and led you to the entrance of the autopsy room. You pushed open the door and walked in. The first thing that hit you was a cold air—probably to help preserve the bodies. The cold air made you shiver instinctively before entering. Spamton followed behind you, facing the three corpses you had described earlier. Even though you had prepared in advance, you couldn't help but retch twice. Although unlike the bodies of the People of Light, the limbs of the People of Darkness do not bleed. Unlike the People of Light, what flowed out was a thick, swirling liquid with alternating yellow and red alternating forms. At this moment, the two corpses with severed legs and arms still bore the marks of circular drawings, while the last corpse, stripped of skin, was completely deprived of intact skin, with only the thick, blood-like liquid continuously oozing out.
You frowned and stepped forward, carefully sizing up these Dark People. To be honest, you could hardly tell who they really were—maybe that wasn't important, since the forensic report pages weren't anything special...... Their deaths were all due to external injuries and excessive blood loss, with their bodily functions unable to keep up.
You squatted down and carefully examined their wounds; there seemed nothing special, as if they had been severed with sharp blades...... Then you looked at their pale skin, then at the broken area, and immediately frowned.
You quietly beckoned to Spamton, and he squatted beside you. Then you quietly pointed to the marks on his skin and said, "His ...... There is this strange mark on the skin of the broken wound." If it weren't for the slight reflection, you probably wouldn't have noticed it, since it's a pattern subtly outlined through the texture of the skin.
It seemed to spread outward along the surrounding lines, and at the wound site, only half of an eye-like pattern remained, with the other half probably cut off, along with the severed leg. After examining the wound, you began examining the next corpse. Sure enough, at the severed arm, you found only a small fragment of a damaged mark. It didn't look like a tattoo pattern, since it wasn't very obvious...... It just looked like a randomly drawn pattern. As for the third corpse, it had no skin left, so naturally there was nothing to look at.
You furrowed your brows and thought for a moment. You did have some guesses about this eye-like design, but you weren't entirely sure. You just whispered to Spamton, "In the world of light, these eyes look like patterns surrounded by knots and vines, representing faith in Pan...... If I remember correctly, Pan is also another name for the Black Holy Mother. It's said that some believe she can bless them and resurrect their loved ones...... That's probably how it is. ”
But you know very well that this belief probably never reached the Dark World...... If that's the case, who exactly is spreading this belief, or even using it?
“…… The Dark World had never heard of such a thing, or rather, the Dark People simply didn't believe in it. Spamton just shrugged; he really hadn't heard of this, of course...... He didn't pay much attention to it, but this case was probably related to these marks.
"Hmm...... There are two possibilities now. The first is that someone spread the teachings and beliefs of the Black Madonna in the dark world, then recruited followers and eventually killed them. That's why these people's social networks seem completely unrelated. The second is that when they killed them, they also painted these patterns on their bodies...... I don't understand why they would do that. ”
As you spoke, you felt a bit lost. After all, you really couldn't understand why the killer did this, and you couldn't come up with anything in a short time.
Anyway, you still stood up: "Anyway, let's first tell them the results of our investigation." "But maybe you stood up too quickly, your vision went black and started to sway—you felt dizzy, then fell into Spamton's arms. He happened to stand up too, watching you slovel and almost fall, instinctively supporting you, then softly asked, "You...... Are you okay? My sweetheart. ”
What you see is Spamton's face, looking at you with concern. You instinctively blush again, grab his arm, and reluctantly stand up to steady yourself. Then you turn your flushed face away from him to keep him from seeing, just waving his hand at him, your voice as cheerful as ever: "What could possibly happen to me?" I'm fine—alright, let's go out and tell those color card butlers what we've found! "You shouted loudly, walking out hand and foot in hand, while Spamton looked at you and couldn't help but chuckle.

title: Bright Dream 10 (dnbsx you)
content:
Of course, you didn't notice his laughter, because you stepped out first, and his laughter was hidden behind it. Spamton gazed at your back, and in the end, he followed your steps out the door. He knew very well that these things needed to be explained to those scan card butlers, since it was up to these guys to figure out who the suspects really were. He really wasn't lying; in this dark world, it must be these guys acting as police officers who know who exactly is there.
You walked out, and naturally, all the color card butlers inside the police station looked at you. Faced with so many stares, you instinctively took two steps back and hid behind Spamton—oh my god, you really can't get used to having to talk after facing a crowd of people. You hate this attitude, or maybe you're just just nervous...... Besides, the police station is very noisy. Think about it, it's probably easier for you to solve a series of problems in a quiet environment.
Spamton turned around, gently patted your head, and said softly, "Alright, it's okay. I'll go tell you about what you just discovered...... No need to be so nervous, no one will eat you." He said half-jokingly, and under his reassurance, your mood did improve a lot, though you were still hiding behind Spamton, tugging at the hem of his clothes...... Hmm, think about it, maybe you were just too nervous. Now, with his reassurance, your mood was clearly much better.
You take a deep breath. Spamton takes your hand and leads you to the scan card butlers. You widen your eyes, trying hard to maintain a serious and focused expression, while Spamton smiles and says, "We just checked the condition of these bodies...... To be honest, the situation is truly tragic, and I feel sorry for it first...... Secondly, the wounds of these people all have half-scar marks, like one eye with knots or vines spreading out. If you don't look closely, you might not notice it...... I think you should know this clue. ”
The color card stewards looked at each other, probably talking for a while. Finally, one of the stewards seemed to be the leader...... Stepping forward two steps, it signified that the sectarians nodded at you. Seeing the other scheat stewards leave, you finally dared to speak: "I'm not sure if that mark has other meanings in the Dark World, but in the Light World, it represents faith in the god Pan, that is, the Black Holy Mother...... I suppose the Dark World probably doesn't have such a thing, right?" ”
Naturally, the color card butler shook his head: "In the Dark World, there are no such ...... Or rather, we have no faith at all. After all, everyone in the Dark World is originally Dark People transformed from objects. Those so-called gods and the like also become ...... along with the incarnations of objects. Hmm, some other types of Dark People. "The Color Card Butler explained to you what form the Dark People actually take in the Dark World.
You nodded: "The third corpse was skinned and can't be clearly seen, but the first two bodies have this mark near the wound section...... I'm sure the third corpse has a similar mark as well. Also...... I think this mark can't just exist out of thin air in the Dark World, so I want to ask, have there been any new churches lately? "As you spoke, I recalled the priest I saw yesterday while handling a case...... Anyway, there really are some alternative beliefs in the Dark World.
The color card steward thought for a moment, then shook his head: "Any facility requires registration here for any setup. As far as I know, there hasn't been such an organization recently...... Of course, there wasn't one before. ”
You blinked, secretly tugged at Spamton's clothes, and quietly leaned close to his ear to ask, "If that's the case...... Where did that priest Addison from yesterday come from? ”
“…… There really are churches like this in this dark world. Have you really not received any reports?" Spamton thought for a moment, then double-checked with the color card steward. This time, the sword steward still shook his head.
"We have surveillance footage that proves that Addison yesterday was indeed a clergyman's outfit...... So, they must be either a secret society or some kind of underground organization...... We have requested to search the shop where Addison operates. "As he spoke, Spamton took out his phone, which had real-time records of all the surveillance footage. Then he switched to that time yesterday and showed the Seka butler the footage of him entering the detective agency dressed in priestly robes.
The color card butler's expression grew even more serious—you think that's about it, but he's actually quite fast, probably because the Dark World doesn't really have many rules. After all, it's more like he's just imitating the Light folk playing pretend toy, nothing more. The search warrant came down quickly. The two color card butlers followed you, while you and Spamton walked ahead. He was clearly familiar with Addison's usual habits and walked straight to the door of the addison to hand him the search warrant. Although somewhat unwilling, he could only step aside to let you in and start searching the shop. This addison mainly sells shoes. Most of the items inside the store are all kinds of shoes, including various shoeboxes and full-length mirrors for customers to check how the shoes look when worn. Besides these, there are quite a few tall boots and similar items...... There are also rain boots.
Of course, because of all this, there are still a few raincoats and other items on the shop racks, along with all sorts of cloaks that can leave you a bit stunned.
Spamton, on the other hand, accepted this very well. He directly examined the wall and floor tiles, tapping them to check for any gaps and to see if there was a switch. You reached out and gently tugged at him, softly saying, "Usually...... Suspects wouldn't hide their mechanisms in particularly conspicuous places, though sometimes the most dangerous place is the safest place...... Kind of thing, like this. "As you spoke, you glanced around the shop, finally fixing your gaze on a small plate placed on the cashier counter ahead.
It seems to be a small sample or something, with a bamboo skewer stuck in the top and a shoe that looks very, very small...... Uh, it looks more suitable for eating rather than trying it on to see how it works.
You walked straight over and twisted the little shoe. Sure enough, you pressed it and spun it. Then, a rumbling sound came from somewhere—it was loud and quite frightening. You saw Addison, who had been smiling, turn pale. You looked him over and finally gestured for Spamton to help. He easily lifted the counter and set it aside, revealing a staircase leading downward—half a solid floor, and the other half a deep, invisible passage leading down. You turned on your flashlight and eagerly walked down, while Spamton turned around and waved to the two color card butlers to come down together, following your steps down.
The further you go, the wider your view becomes, and it's no longer gloomy darkness. Instead, candles are lit around you. You turn off your flashlight, instinctively tighten Spamton's hand, and then move forward...... Further ahead, a vast expanse opens up, with candlesticks burning all around. Directly above, a crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, and you see the sparkling stained glass windows and the silver-white interior of the church...... It seems to be just a small chapel, with many benches, but at this moment, there are no Dark People on the benches. Directly ahead stands a statue, which looks like a goddess...... But this doesn't match any statue you've seen in the world of light. The goddess held a mirror in her hand, and at her feet were several goat statues beside her, seemingly spinning around. Directly ahead was probably the priest's alms platform for preaching...... On top lay a messy book half-turned. You don't intend to look at what the book is, nor do you intend to make a sound, because before you stand countless Dark People kneeling on the ground, praying something...... It sounds like they are murmuring something.
You and Spamton exchanged a glance, still hesitating about what to do, but Spamton just winked at you, signaling you to leave everything to him. Then he shoved you and the color card butler to the door, telling you to stay outside, while he just walked in with a smile and spoke lightly, "Everyone...... What are you doing? My friend invited me to join this church...... But he dropped me off and left. I really didn't know what to do, so I had to ask you all. ”
His tone carried a hint of pitifulness, and as you looked inside the church, those dark people instinctively became wary upon hearing Spamton's voice. But then they realized he was a popular figure in Cyber City and also an Addison, so they didn't think much of it and excitedly introduced Spamton: "Ah...... It's you! It's simple—just pray to the Holy Mother, pray for our long-lasting peace, and for the loved ones to be safe for long! The Goddess will see your sincerity and help you fulfill your wish...... The Holy Mother really will manifest! Otherwise, how could there really be a resurrection happening before us! ”
Their voices were feverish, and Spamton watched their waving hands, naturally seeing the eye-shaped marks on their arms or other parts of their bodies...... Well, they were exactly the same as the marks left on the corpses.
Then Spamton pretended to be troubled and said, "I see...... But I heard that a few regular visitors have gone missing recently? He told me that a few regular customers haven't come lately...... He suspects those people have gone missing. He said these people are also faithful followers of the Virgin Mary. ”
As soon as these words were spoken, the Dark People exchanged glances, whispering among themselves, probably pondering what to say. Finally, the first Dark Folk at the front spoke: "Here's the situation...... Recently, three people who regularly visit the church have indeed gone missing. No one knows where they really went......
"They probably just don't believe it, that's all. What's there to talk about!" Another Dark Civilian was indignant.
"Anyway, the three of them are all alone, so praying to the Holy Mother won't help much......" some muttering sounds. In short, everyone started talking at once.
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 11 (dnbsx you)
content:
"If you pray to the Virgin Mary to protect yourself, it might still work...... The believers were still chattering at once. Spamton just stood quietly to the side, listening to their argument, not intending to interrupt—after all, he knew nothing about this underground church and needed to investigate thoroughly.
"What's the use? Didn't the Bishop say before that people who believe in religion tend to bring more sins?" Another Dark Folk lowered his voice and spoke urgently, sounding anxious, and speaking softly, as if he didn't want anyone to hear—like Spamton.
Spamton didn't react much, just a more obvious smile at the corner of his lips. He pretended not to hear, just waiting for the followers' reaction, while he just stood there pretending to be confused: "So...... What should I do next? The Bishop, my friend, told me that the Dark People with nothing to rely on are more suitable to join here...... He decided to take a gamble. After all, if the few Dark People who died before heard news about something like a sin or something like a possible death, then Duan would never join here, let alone leave a mark belonging to the followers.
The Dark People looked at each other, probably half-believing that Spamton hadn't heard anything. Only then did the leading Dark Folk beam and say, "Ah, that's right. Because the Dark Folk here are all very kind, homeless people who come here can treat this place as their own home...... After all, even the Dark Folk still need the warmth of family. I think any Dark Folk would agree with that......
Spamton nodded in agreement: "Of course, even someone as popular as me would agree with that...... Although we are just people of darkness, we also need care from those of darkness, and naturally, attention from them...... Hmm, if possible, it would be great if more and more of us noticed our people of darkness and light. " His tone sounded especially innocent, and he must have heard the gritted teeth of those people of darkness, probably saying that he still wasn't satisfied enough to satisfy that kind of ...... However, although the leader of the dark folk gritted his teeth, he still nodded in agreement.
"Yes, it's said that as long as we believe in the Saintess, she will listen to our wishes...... The Saintess will make our wishes come true, and it's said that this statue of the Saintess is once the incarnation of a Citizen of Light." As he spoke, he nodded devoutly and knelt down on the ground again...... It seemed he truly believed it.
Spamton thought, this case probably isn't that simple...... He wondered if these Dark People might be accomplices or something, which is why they were also involved in the case. Moreover, they weren't telling the truth; instead, they were trying to lure him into joining the church as well.
Although Spamton was thinking this...... He just knelt on the ground like a fellow believer who had been deceived, praying together with the other Dark People. Of course, he saw those Dark People whispering among themselves, then their faces lit up with joy—hmm, maybe he was glad he actually took the bait. In fact, Spamton had already guessed the possible culprit. Normally, the Dark People of Cyber City wouldn't dare make a move against him. After all, no matter what, he had won the Queen's favor and was still admired. No matter what, if he suddenly disappeared, the Queen would surely be furious.
So, anyone who dares to make a move on me...... Or they've been blinded by jealousy, just like the one who was caught at the previous banquet and stuck to the wall, and have framed me. Although the technique isn't clever, if he really succeeds...... That definitely wouldn't be a good thing. It would indeed cost him the queen's favor, and then he might not even be able to keep his current position. But this is absolutely unacceptable. No matter what, he must remain this popular figure. No matter what, he has an even bigger and swelling ambition. He wants the fame and status he currently holds to reach new heights. He wants ...... to become more popular, more noticed, bigger and more famous than he is now.
So, this was indeed one of the reasons he initially wanted to come to you—to become more famous through the People of Light. But now, this simple desire is mixed with indescribable emotions, because he is curious about you, because he likes being with you. No matter the reason, he likes you, the Citizen of Light. Likewise, no matter what, Spamton knows you also enjoy being with him...... Spamton knows very well that, although he doesn't know whether this ambiguous feeling should be called love, he really likes you, truly enjoys being with you, indeed...... He really likes being by your side, likes touching you, likes looking at you, likes everything about you, likes you.
So what does it matter whether it's love or not—after all, he really likes you, loves you, and that's enough.
Although these thoughts made him feel a bit distracted, in reality, he was still properly imitating the prayer lines of other Dark Folk reciting, while his mind was filled with other thoughts.
Getting back to the topic, he likes being with you, and that can help his career advance — of course, there are also people jealous enough to want to kill him, like the addison in the top shop. Spamton knows very well, so currently the only person he suspects is this addison. Other than that...... Maybe other addisons also want to make a move against him, but they haven't found the right opportunity yet.
You nervously watch everything happening inside the church. Honestly, you're worried that Spamton might be in danger...... Well, although it seems nothing happens inside this underground church, and you think it's better to worry about others than about Spamton getting hurt...... Even though you say that, you're still worried about Spamton. It's probably just a nonsensical thing, simply worried about your lover's safety.
It was at this moment that you subconsciously realized you were indeed very worried about Spamton, no matter the reason—even if it was just because he was your assistant, that worry had already gone beyond what was necessary...... And it was not just worry about the assistant; more importantly, it was indeed a concern for your lover.
You also start to zone out, lost in thought, while Spamton inside is also pondering a question—since you choose to join the church and choose this faith, that faith will surely leave a mark on you. It might look like a tattoo that looks inconspicuous but stands out here very noticeably. Maybe it's because the candlelight here is special.
…… He didn't want the tattoo, but to pretend that believers were hiding in the church, maybe he still needed it. Spamton began to think about how to keep the tattoo somewhere on his body without actually damaging his own skin.
Finally, after reciting the Lord's Prayer, he rolled up his sleeve, revealing a layer of white tight clothing, or rather, artificial skin, on his white arm below. After becoming a popular figure, Spamton often did this, because he wasn't sure if someone would suddenly target him or try to erase him. At least this fake skin could give him a chance to escape, although he never imagined it would come in handy—well, at least it was useful. He frankly stretched out his arm, and the Dark Citizen didn't notice, simply placing the pattern of faith on Spamton's arm. Everyone gathered around Spamton, congratulating him for joining the church, congratulating him for becoming a member, and for having a new home. You watched those people celebrate around Spamton for quite a while. Finally, Spamton shook them off, left the church, and walked back to you. The Dark People probably didn't realize what was happening...... Nor did they notice a group of people hiding outside watching them, and as soon as Spamton came out, you grabbed his arm and pulled him aside. You nervously sized him up: "Are you alright? Those Dark People probably didn't do anything to you...... You got that tattoo...... Does it hurt you badly? ”
Spamton was stunned for a moment, looked you up and down several times, then said with a mischievous smile, "You're really that worried about me?" That's truly an honor...... But don't worry, that pattern didn't actually catch my scent; it just so happened that I was wearing bionic skin today, just in case...... I didn't expect to actually use it, look. "As he spoke, he pulled aside the tight bionic skin, revealing the truly pale skin underneath...... You touch it casually—it's cool, yet a bit warm. You can't quite say what it feels like—it's a bit like a doll, but also like a puppet. But you clearly remember Spamton isn't a doll or a puppet of the sort...... Alright! Anyway, whether it's a puppet or a puppet, you don't really know what kind of existence the Dark People will become—just like the Sakaka butler next to you. You can't figure out what that thing is. In any case, you withdrew your hand, nodded gently at Spamton, then pulled him back onto the ground.
At this moment, Addison was still sitting there. You didn't say anything. Instead, the Color Card Butler began searching his shop and finally found a set of clergy clothing. The Card Butler sentenced him to the crime: "This Addison has opened a church underground without permission and held church activities, without reporting the location or related activity plans. He is hereby detained for one week for disturbing public order and fined 10,000 Dark Coins." ”
Addison nodded reluctantly and was taken away by the color card butlers. You were stunned for a moment, not expecting it to end like this...... The real culprit still hasn't been found. Spamton just gently tugged your hand and said softly, "Alright, let's head back to the detective agency first. I've been running all day, I'm already hungry...... I suppose you're very hungry too, right? His voice was soft, with a hint of coquettishness, so you couldn't help but nod along, and together with Spamton, you walked toward the agency. Soon, you were back in front of the Mingmeng Detective Agency. You took a deep breath, pushed open the door, and walked in with Spamton. Then you collapsed onto the sofa—even though Spamton was basically in charge of everything today, you still felt tired.
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 12 (dnbsx you)
content:
You lay down on the sofa, but still felt that posture was uncomfortable. So you changed positions, and now you lay comfortably on the sofa, lying flat—no need to think about anything, just lying there blankly. Time was peaceful, and for a moment, everything around was very quiet. You truly enjoyed the environment, squinting slightly and softly sighing. Then you turned over and saw Spamton sitting there leisurely, smiling at you.
You gave a couple of awkward laughs, which was quite unreasonable, and said, "I'm so tired, and I don't have any cases right now. I should be fine with a break, right?" You said confidently, and Spamton just nodded and smiled.
"Of course no problem, my sweetheart. You can rest as long as you want." Spamton pondered. The Addison store had been temporarily sealed off, meaning this case should be closed for a while, with no further follow-up...... So during this time, you can rest as much as you want. Of course, he too.
"However, sleeping on the sofa can easily catch a chill...... My [suggestion] is that you go back to your room and rest. " he added.
To be honest, lying here makes you a bit lazy to move, since lying on the sofa is quite comfortable...... Well, but maybe it's better to lie back in bed. You rolled around on the sofa a few times, rolled your eyes, and said with a cheeky grin, "No. I'm too lazy to move anymore, I don't want to walk back...... Unless you carry me back." As you spoke, you laughed and watched Spamton's reaction. You thought he would do as you said, but in reality, you weren't entirely sure...... So you were still a bit nervous—what would Spamton's reaction be to be nervous?
Spamton did indeed walk up to you, then slowly bent down. A smile hung on his face, looking no different from before, except that his smile was even more sincere. Then he gently lifted you up from the sofa, bent your legs, and wrapped it around your arms. It was a classic princess carry. You instinctively exclaimed, wrapping your arms tightly around his neck. Your cheeks were so close that you blushed red. You couldn't say a word for a long time, while Spamton just smiled and leaned in to kiss your lips.
You pressed your lips together, your eyes darting around. Finally, when Spamton carried you to your room, you leaned in and gently kissed the corner of his mouth, very quickly. After all, you were still somewhat shy, and you hadn't really been a couple for long—but Spamton just leaned over, laid you on the bed, then rested his arm next to your head, deepening the kiss. He traced your lips, gently sucked, then bit your lips, then bit your tongue. It seemed like you were exchanging saliva. You were dizzy from the kiss, and even as he let go, you still looked at him with a hazy gaze—Spamton instinctively wanted to pull away, but you just instinctively grabbed his arm, because kissing it felt a bit cool. It felt so comfortable in this summer, you couldn't help but lower his head and then lean in to kiss him. You bit his lip, savoring the slightly cool taste almost in bliss.
At first, Spamton just bent down to let you bite your lip. In the end, he lay on the bed too, the summer blanket rolling beside you, and you wrapped around him like an octopus, savor the coolness from his body, blissfully nestled in his arms.
Spamton hugged you tightly in return, though he still pulled a thin blanket over you both...... Usually, when you covered yourself with this blanket completely, you would feel warm and want to kick it away. But today, you lay under the blanket with Spamton, feeling a bit intoxicated. You couldn't help but think this was just right—oh my, you can't even bear to leave Spamton's side or this bed, which is usually the feeling you only experience in winter.
You nestled in his arms, hugging him tightly with both hands and feet, then burying your head in his chest, half-asleep and half-awake. You really did feel exhausted, but to be honest, handling ten cases in one day in the past two days was practically draining you dry. You think you'd need several days to recover to your best condition, otherwise you'd probably be so listless these days.
You were drowsy and about to fall asleep...... You imagined lying here for the next few days, nestled in his arms, and enjoying the coolness of summer. But the good times didn't last long. A rapid knocking on the door woke you from your sleep. You opened your eyes unhappily and glanced at Spamton. He seemed to have never fallen asleep, just kept watching you. He looked at you a little embarrassed, nudging you, his voice soft and soft as his hazy pajamas: "You...... Spammy, go open the door. I wonder what exactly is going on this time. Let me lie down a little longer......" As you spoke, you turned over, kicked off the blanket, and only covered your belly. Then you closed your eyes and pretended to sleep.
Spamton sighed helplessly, reluctantly letting go of you. He really wanted to hold you tighter a little longer, to look at you a little longer—he didn't know who was disturbing their sweet dreams, but Spamton, feeling a bit annoyed, walked over and opened the door.
But when he opened the door, he found it was another color card butler, and this one looked quite anxious. Spamton's expression turned serious. He didn't know exactly what had happened, but it seemed like a serious problem—he asked, "Did something happen?" ”
The Seka butler nodded, looking panicked, and spoke rapidly, "Just now, we received a report that another Dark Commoner with no relatives or friends was found dead at home...... The time of death wasn't very long; it was probably an hour before we went to Addison to investigate." ”
Spamton's expression grew serious. In other words, killing three Dark People wasn't enough; maybe he needed more bodies...... But what use was he having so many corpses? Spamton couldn't figure it out, but he knew that if you were to handle this, you'd probably figure it out quickly...... However, he didn't want to disturb you right now. After all, he already had a suspect in this case. As long as he caught that killer first, it wouldn't matter. The remaining evidence and testimonies could be found slowly. He knew what you needed now was to rest for a while, not anything else...... He knew all you needed was rest.
So Spamton said, "I get it. I think that Addison is probably the killer. Have you managed to control him?" ”
But the Seka butler just nodded and shook his head: "He did pay a fine of 10,000 dark coins according to regulations, and after that, he left the police station. After that, we don't know where he went...... No matter what, we couldn't find his whereabouts. ”
Spamton pondered for a moment: "I remember there are surveillance cameras, but I can't find them either?" ”
The Color Card Butler nodded but shook his head again: "Indeed, but he doesn't carry any internet-connected devices, so we can't locate him or check the upcoming surveillance data. We've already searched every possible direction he might be heading, but haven't found any trace of him." ”
“…… What about the sewers? Spamton asked again. He remembered that Cyber City's sewer system was quite complex, and because of that, many passages were dirty. But for easier cleaning and maintenance, the Cyber City's sewers were enough to stand for a Dark Civilian and, of course, enough for Addison to escape...... Coincidentally, there was a sewer not far outside the police station.
The Color Card butler's expression also grew serious: "We haven't investigated along the sewers yet...... But the cyber city's sewer pipeline system is very complex, with countless forks, making it really hard to find targets or confirm where they actually go......
“…… Hmm, let's search along the line first. Maybe we'll find some clue left behind. "Spamton nodded and said.
Maybe the discussion had been going on for too long, and the noise was a bit loud. Even after tossing and turning, you could still hear faint sounds outside. You couldn't fall asleep, so you straightened your clothes, pushed open the door, and walked out as well. You yawned, "What exactly happened?" Tell me so I can hear it. ”
The Seka butler and Spamton exchanged a glance. Spamton hadn't intended to wake you, but now that you were awake, he could only sigh and say, "It's nothing serious, just that the possible culprit from that case this morning escaped—that Addison." ”
You stopped yawning, seriously thought about the morning discovery, then nodded: "Hmm, that guy really is the mastermind, but there are accomplices...... We just need to catch those accomplices first." You said.
"Accomplices?" The Seka butler clearly didn't understand, and you finally came to your senses a little. You began gesturing with both hands and said, "Yes, it's all the Dark People in his secret church. All those Dark Folk are his accomplices. Hmm, although their hands might not be stained with blood...... But you can arrest those Dark Folk first. ”
"As for the mastermind...... In any case, he did this with a purpose, probably for that purpose. So, if we can't catch him, we can first think about where his next destination might be......
“…… The newly discovered victim's body also lost both legs, so what exactly is the mastermind's goal? "The Seka butler bowed slightly and asked you for advice.
Think about it: the faith of the Black Holy Mother, the goals behind it, and the statue of the Saint in the small chapel that looks like the People of Light...... Ah, and the mark near their wounds......
You shared your idea: "I think the killer collecting these broken limb parts probably wants to resurrect that Lightfolk. After all, there's a legend that says six legs can grant immortality or something...... Although this doesn't mean six legs—he's probably a bit uneducated. But I think once the killer's purpose is confirmed, it'll be easy to find." You said confidently, and the color card butler and Spamton didn't notice anything wrong. They exchanged glances, then nodded, and Spamton pushed you back to the bedroom.
"Alright, my sweetheart, detective, get some rest. Your assistant will be able to solve this case...... You've already told us all the necessary parts of the case, so for now, you can relax and enjoy your leisure time. "Spamton told you to stay and rest, and you naturally collapsed onto the bed.

title: Bright Dream 13 (dnbsx you)
content:
You closed your eyes, listening to the office's doors opening and closing...... Hmm, the faint sounds of their conversation faded into the distance. Although he had already received the answer from you, Spamton continued to question the Color Card Butler.
"I'm a bit curious...... Among these followers, are there any Dark People who meet the target? If there are, I'm afraid he'll speed up the crime, for example, commit it today...... After all, the underground church has already been sealed off, and this path is cut off. "Spamton hopes to use clues to stake out him and then arrest him. That way, it's simple—just wait outside his possible destination."
The Seka butler thought for a moment and answered, "Indeed, there is one Dark Folk who happens to meet these targets...... I'm afraid the killer's next target will be this Dark Commoner. We can send enough personnel to stake out, hoping to catch the killer as soon as possible. ”
"Yes. But if he discovers the stake plan, I'm afraid he'll run far away again...... Did the Dark People in the underground sewers send any clues back? "Spamton admitted he was a bit anxious; he wanted to handle the case quickly so you could rest comfortably for a whole day, or not just a whole day, but even longer—he did regret finding so many cases for you, considering you wanted Mingmeng Detective Agency to make a name for itself, but didn't consider it...... You might not be able to handle so many things in one day. Even so, you still managed to get it all done.
He felt a bit guilty and guilty. He wanted to handle this case properly so he wouldn't have to worry. Hearing the Seka butler's response, he instinctively grew serious and paced back and forth, circling several times.
“…… No, the Dark People we sent down to investigate haven't found any clues. Although they've searched all the passages thoroughly, they haven't found any traces left by the killer. Are you sure the killer is lurking in the sewers?" The Color Card butler asked, his voice tinged with doubt.
Spamton took a deep breath, warning himself to stay calm, or none of the clues would match up. He only forced a smile as usual, looking almost unchanged. He said with absolute certainty, "No, I'm pretty sure the killer must have been going back and forth in the sewers...... Keep searching, and you'll find some clues. After all, aside from the sewer passage, he suddenly disappeared from the surveillance screen, so it could only be ...... He had entered the sewer, since there were no surveillance cameras inside. Spamton said, confident that after all, the sewer system in Cyber City is extremely complex, with extensive access in all directions—well, probably for easier maintenance, the sewers are also at a height suitable for the Dark Folk to pass through, making them no different from narrower passages. Well, at least this is much better than the sewers in Paris. At least there won't be mud or backwatering after heavy rain. Otherwise, the Queen would have sent people to fix the sewers long ago.
"Alright, we will send more Dark Folk to search the sewers...... Additionally, we will send Color Card Butlers to carry out stakeout plans outside the corresponding Dark Folk homes, hoping to stake out the culprit on the Dao. We hope Mr. Spamton can also participate in this plan. "The Color Card Butler nodded and said.
Spamton nodded as well. He had no objections, since he wouldn't follow those Dark People to search the sewers. The smell was terrible, and he cared about his image in front of you...... Well, even though you probably wouldn't care about that anyway.
The remaining possibility, the victim, lived in a building. This was a fairly decent neighborhood. At least the security guards at the entrance guarded the entrance and wouldn't let any Dark People in in easily. Spamton and the other Color Card Butlers had to show police credentials to enter smoothly. Some Color Card Butlers were lying in wait in the community's bushes, while others and Spamton were staking out in the corridor of the building. Although the setup was a bit simple, it was generally fine—just enough to guard Addison, who had little counter-surveillance awareness. Besides that, according to Spamton's arrangements, some Color Card Butlers were hiding on the street, guarding the nearby sewer entrances and exits. After all, if the killer appeared here, it would be easier for them to make arrests.
They staked out on the stairs, and for a while, there was no movement. They held their breath, because if the killer appeared, no one wanted him to notice anything and suddenly flee.
Just then, the color card butler crouching next to Spamton answered a phone call. His color seemed to have changed, shifting from orange to red, clearly very excited. Spamton looked at the color card butler with some confusion, his eyes questioning what had happened. The slot card butler lowered his voice and said, "We found traces left by the killer at a remote sewer exit, and the surveillance camera did capture the scene of him coming out of the sewer...... Your judgment is correct, Mr. Spamton. ”
Hearing this, Spamton couldn't help but smile as well, and at the same time breathed a sigh of relief: "Hmm, I guessed right. That guy was relocated through the many sewers in all directions." ”
"Indeed, everything is just as you said...... Hmm, maybe if we keep watch here a bit longer, we can finally reach the target. " The Color Card butler nodded, clearly now very convinced of Spamton.
Spamton nodded, naturally accepting the sash butler's praise, though for some reason, he couldn't help but feel a bit uneasy...... He always felt that things weren't that simple, but he forced himself to suppress that unease. Perhaps it was just his imagination.
As for the other side—you lay comfortably in your own room. Since Spamton wouldn't let you interfere, you decided not to get involved. For now, it's more important to get some good rest. You lay there peacefully, drowsy and asleep for quite a while, only to be woken up by another voice.
That was the sound of the firm's door opening. At first, you thought Spamton had just finished her business and returned, so you turned over and shouted loudly, "Spammy, you're back?" "If you're back, come over to me. Let's rest together for a while......" As you spoke, you couldn't help but yawn again. But you didn't get any response. At first, you thought some other client had come knocking, but you remember clearly that when Spamton and the Seka butler left, the firm's front door had already been put up with a closed sign. However, the security environment in the dark world was relatively decent, and you didn't lock the door.
…… So you quickly realize—this isn't your newly arrived Spamton, nor is it some real client or live police officer who came knocking. Otherwise, why would the footsteps keep spreading toward your room?
—That was clearly a criminal who had broken into the office. You suddenly opened your eyes, got up, got out of bed, and took out the dagger you had hidden under your pillow. Fortunately, you usually have this habit, otherwise today would have been troublesome. After all, although you have learned a bit of flashy moves and moves, when facing criminals, that skill is useless—a knife is worse.
You rolled over cautiously and hid under the bed. You guessed the criminal hadn't seen you yet. Although he heard your voice and was heading toward your room, you still had a chance to strike first. You curled up under the bed, telling yourself to stay calm, but your heart was still pounding wildly. You see him walk into your room. He seems a bit puzzled, probably wanting to hear your voice. You must be lying in bed. Then he starts searching your room—well, he's searching for you, because you hear the sound of the wardrobe door opening and the clothes inside rummaging around. You just turn sideways, climb closer to the wardrobe, and calmly watch his back—he seems eager to find you and doesn't notice the movement behind him. You just crawl out from under the bed and step forward, with you pressing the knife against his neck.
You did your best to stay calm, or your hand would tremble—then you wouldn't have any intimidation at all! Fortunately, the knife in your hand didn't cut his throat, and you just calmly said, "Don't move. I think you must have come to find me where exactly I am, right? I'm right behind you now...... It's just a pity you never get the chance to catch me. ”
His voice was low and hoarse, as if his presence had inexplicably stirred a little excitement. You weren't sure if it was just your imagination: "That's not necessarily true, miss, but it's not over yet." ”
Before you could react, this guy grabbed the knife with his hand and twisted it slightly, forcing you to loosen your grip. Your expression changed—you didn't know this guy could go this far, just instinctively rolled on the spot, since Addison had also pulled out a knife. Fortunately, the bedroom was still quite plagued by obstacles, so you still had the strength to fight him. Although you were only a bit skilled, you could still block his attack for a while.
You finally get your phone at another flash, then you dial the emergency contact—it's Spamton's number.
You hurriedly said, "Spammy, hurry back to the detective agency." After saying that, you threw your phone aside, because that Addison across from you was crazy, even risking his injuries to cut your phone down, or rather, to subdue you. You really couldn't figure out what this guy was trying to do, but all you could do was fight back with all your might and dodge. Soon, you were left with several wounds on your body as well.
You were out of breath, your stamina quickly waned, and you gradually fell behind. All you could do was pray they could arrive soon.
Meanwhile, after receiving your call, Spamton's expression darkened. Then he heard the color card butler hurry over and report: "The latest surveillance footage we obtained shows the killer climbing up the sewer exit near the Mingmeng Detective Agency, and judging by the direction, they headed back toward the agency." ”
His expression grew even uglier. He suddenly got up and ran downstairs, heading toward the agency. He felt regret. You were the only one at the office. If something happened to him, what would he do? He felt a lingering fear. If he'd known, he should have arranged for a color card butler to protect you too. How could he have fallen into their trap so easily?
He ...... He didn't know; he was just wildly throwing toward the agency. At that moment, there was a traffic jam, and he was running much faster than the car was coming, and he kept telling himself to go faster, faster.

title: Bright Dream 14 (dnbsx you)
content:
Rushing along, Spamton felt sweat pouring down his face, his hair almost damp, and he finally arrived at the firm's entrance. The firm's doors were wide open, and the lobby had become a mess. You held the small knife, enduring the pain from wounds on your arm and leg, struggling with all your might against the guy in front of you. As blood spilled from the wound, you felt your head spinning, but you still tried your best to stay conscious, because there were only the two of you inside. You had to hold out until rescue arrived—because the room was cramped and there was nowhere to hide, so you moved to the lobby.
You were panting heavily, and when you saw Spamton rushing in through the gate, your face lit up. Instinctively, you wanted to wave and greet him, but in that moment of distraction, the knife Addison was holding in front of you nearly slashed your neck. Spamton's expression changed, he quickly stepped forward to shield you, stabbing the knife hard into his chest. Expressionless, he reached out and twisted Addison's wrists, using his strength to subdue the guy in front of him. He kicked Addison again, knocking him to the ground and unable to get up. Spamton, holding handcuffs from who knows where, cuffed Addison's hands behind his back. Then he turned around, put on a smile again, and looked at you: "Phew...... I came a bit late, sweetheart, are you okay? ”
You lowered your arm, looking at Spamto's small knife still stuck in her chest, your face pale: "It's okay, at most I have some external injuries, just look a bit messy. But you, spammy, this ...... on your chest." Indeed, you love wearing trench coats because you think it would look cooler in this outfit, so your clothes and hem were marked with many scratches, making you look quite disheveled. But aside from the wounds on your arms and legs, you didn't suffer any other injuries...... However, the wound on your leg was a bit deep, so you couldn't help but sit on the floor, and then Spamton helped you onto the sofa to sit down.
He looked at the dagger stabbing into his chest, just smiled indifferently, then pulled the dagger out. Immediately, a stream of yellow, mixed with red swirling mucus began to flow out from the wound—thick and bloody. Then Spamton sat down next to you: "Is this it?" Anyway...... Hmm, it's not that serious, you know. I'm a Dark Citizen, so this doesn't mean much to me. "He seemed indifferent, but you still looked at him with concern, and without giving him a chance to explain, started tugging at his clothes.
"But this won't do. At least bandage it first......" you muttered, rummaging through the coffee table drawer a roll of bandages, then opened Spamton's clothes to bandage him. Spamton, helpless, could only pull his own clothes out. He looked at your wounds, which clearly looked even scarier and more shocking, but...... Alright, since it was your decision, of course he wouldn't go against it.
He simply said softly, "But my sweetheart, your wound is also very serious. I'll help you bandage it later, okay?" "After all, your wound is still bleeding little by little from the bottom."
“…… Alright. Sorry, spammy. Sorry, I didn't want you to get hurt before. "Your voice was a bit muffled, with some guilt. If only you hadn't been distracted just now, Spamton wouldn't have gotten hurt. As long as you cooperate and catch that guy, that's enough."
"You can't say that. It's already dangerous for you to be injured. For you, even a little injury from me is nothing." Spamton said softly.
While you are here with affectionate affection, the murderer thrown on the ground is ignored. He tries to say something, but then Spamton casually stuffs some discarded gauze into his mouth, leaving the criminal with only a few stammering sounds.
After you finished bandaging Spamton, he started treating your wound. Your wounds needed to be disinfected. Spamton took hydrogen peroxide and iodine from the drawer, applying iodine to the wound on your arm. Although your face was a bit pale, you just gritted your teeth and said nothing, letting him use iodine to wipe away the dirt on the wound, then bandaged it.
Next, he poured hydrogen peroxide onto the wound on your leg—after all, the wound was quite deep, and you couldn't help but have tears in your eyes. You stammered a little, pitifully saying, "It hurts so much...... As you spoke, you tried to pull your leg back from Spamton's legs, but Spamton held your leg down and wouldn't let you move, smiling as he said, "You know it hurts?" Then don't let yourself get hurt next time. ”
You mutter, "Isn't this a special case...... Normally, I wouldn't let myself get hurt, but this time is special. I didn't expect the killer to attack the agency......
"No, it's my fault. I was only thinking about pursuing and intercepting you, but forgot that the detective agency should have left some people to observe and protect your situation...... Spamton sighed.
I'm afraid you keep making you keep shirking responsibility and taking responsibility, and you can't finish talking all day. But when you talk to him, your attention is indeed shifted. When you come to your senses, the wound on your leg is already bandaged, but there are still traces of blood on the gauze. After a while, you'll need to change the bandage and bandages.
Now that you've finally dealt with everything, you look at the criminal tied to the ground by you and unable to move. After a moment's hesitation, you ask, "Um...... What should we do with this guy?" "After all, we can't just let this criminal stay here forever. You take out your phone, wanting to call the Color Card Butler. But before that, Spamton presses your hand and smiles slightly: "Ah, don't worry about this guy...... Those Color Card Butlers should be here soon." As he spoke, he showed you the text message displayed on his phone. It was sent by the Color Card Butler, who said they had left some people to wait there, and others had already driven toward the detective agency.
Then Spamton shrugged again: "But...... Well, after all, the roads are really congested for some reason. I guess those police will probably get there soon.
You nodded, probably understanding Spamton's meaning. Then you looked back at the Addison on the floor, turned on your phone's recording function, and said calmly, "In that case...... Let's interrogate this guy first. I'll turn on the recording, and I'll just send it directly to the scan card manager later. ”
Spamton nodded as well, finally taking out the thing that had been gagging his mouth. Then you squatted in front of Addison. You glanced at Spamton, feeling a bit troubled because you didn't know where to start asking. But Spamton just winked at you, probably telling you not to be afraid, just ask aloud.
Thinking about it, it makes sense...... You took a deep breath to calm yourself down a bit, then looked back at Addison, who was wearing a face of refusal to surrender. Hmm, he looked ...... Yes. You remained silent, saying no more, only asking, "Are you planning to resurrect someone?" Judging by the state of those corpses, he probably hoped to resurrect someone to do these things. And according to the doctrinal beliefs, this was probably the only way.
He was silent for a moment, but only nodded without saying a word.
You glanced at Spamton again, feeling troubled, but Spamton calmly spoke: "The one you want to resurrect is the statue you enshrined in the church, the People of Light, right? Let me guess, you want to use the limbs and bodies of these People of Darkness to form her torso, and then attack Y/N...... Because she's a People of Light, right? She probably carries something you want? Probably...... You think the People of Light are more suitable for them, right? ”
Addison's head lowered. Maybe Spamton hit the nail on the head, and you were stunned for a moment. You didn't expect him to attack you because you had something suitable for him to resurrect that Lightkin.
So you can't help but ask, "What do you want from me?" Is it...... Is it the ever-flowing blood unique to the People of Light, the heart that beats endlessly, or ...... Or is it that bright, dazzling soul that belongs only to the People of Light, dazzling in the light? "You really can't understand what this guy is thinking...... After leaving the body of the People of Light, aside from the small chance that the soul remains, there is really no way to preserve them. Once removed, it means death or exhaustion.
“…… I need it all. She can't stand up anymore, because she lacks a heart that continuously supplies her blood, lacks blood throughout her body, and lacks the soul that allows her to make decisions on her own...... Soul. "That Addison was silent for a moment, then spoke in a somewhat hoarse voice. You paused as you listened, then sighed.
"Listen, the dead cannot be brought back to life. Once blood and heart leave the body, they can never survive, and the soul ...... If the soul leaves my body, I will die. You probably don't know about this, do you?" You said these words as if relaxed, shrugging afterward, but in reality, you couldn't help but feel a bit afraid—if you had relaxed even a little before, death would have awaited you.
Addison was stunned for a moment, said nothing, and simply lowered his head again.
Spamton then asked, "So, why did your Light Folk die?" ”
“…… She died of old age, but she was terminally ill and could only live that long. From what she had told me before, I discovered the Black Madonna faith—a belief that might be useful—so I started church activities in private...... Those believers also knew I wanted to resurrect her, and some chose to help me. You won, and things have come to this. Arrest me, and those followers. " His voice was listless, and after hearing this, Spamton's expression grew serious—he died peacefully. It sounded like a good word, but he couldn't imagine that on the day you died of old age, he might still look like this...... He instinctively felt anxious. He always felt as if there was something he couldn't grasp, and when he looked at you, you were just holding your phone and mumbling, as if you hadn't noticed.
The Saka butler arrived quickly, escorted this guy away, and Spamton was staring at you at this moment, not daring to relax for a moment.
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 15 (dnbsx you)
content:
…… He didn't dare imagine this possibility, couldn't imagine that he might never change from beginning to end, while you would have to age with the passage of time. Originally, Spamton hadn't considered these things—maybe he just thought none of it mattered, or maybe he just blindly believed he had a way to solve it. But now, Addison's words laid the problem right in front of him, and he had no choice but to think about it...... Think about the possibility that you might die before that. So he kept staring at you, a bit scared, afraid that maybe somewhere he couldn't see, you might suddenly face death.
Before leaving, Addison gave him a rather provocative look. It was clear there was only one intention: ...... His provocative meaning was that Spamton was also falling in love with the Citizens of Light, so one day, the situation Addison faced was exactly the same one Spamton would face.
And you probably haven't noticed this. You're just busy contacting the Scard butlers to confirm they have indeed caught the culprit and taken him back to the police station. Meanwhile, the Sakaka butlers who were staking out have also caught other Dark People who came to commit a crime—the same believers from that small church that once began. Now they've caught all the other believers, and it seems the matter has indeed come to an end. You put down your phone and let out a long breath. Only then do you notice Spamton was staring at you for some reason. You turned to him in confusion and tilted your head slightly: "Hmm, Spammy, what's wrong? Why are you staring at me all the time?" I'm sitting here perfectly fine, and I won't suddenly get hurt or anything. You said half-teasingly, leaning over and leaning against Spamton, gently patting his head.
"Do you have something troubling you? Why not tell me? I'm a great detective who can definitely help you solve it!" You pointed at yourself with a cheeky grin. Clearly, you hadn't realized that Spamton was thinking about something that might be very serious.
Spamton wanted to say something. He instinctively wanted to tell you what troubled him, but then he stopped—well, it's fine if he was worried about this. He shouldn't have told you about it, he ...... Telling you would only add to your troubles. Do you really know how to handle it?
So he just gave you a smile as usual and winked: "Ah, it's nothing major, just thinking about that arrested Addison...... Well, but there's no need to think too much about it. ”
You glanced at Spamton hesitantly, feeling like he was hiding something from you, since his smile looked a bit fake. Anyway, it was just your intuition guessing. Maybe it really is just as Spamton said.
So you didn't dwell on it any further, just shrugged: "Ah, that Addison?" There's nothing much to say about him, right? Anyway, his crime is already settled, so there's no need for any more evidence. We've solved this case so it's basically closed...... Ah, I really need to rest well these next few days. "You yawned as you spoke. It was clear you were a bit tired from everything that happened these past few days. Spamton knew very well that we shouldn't be looking for any more cases for you at this point."
Spamton just nodded and then shook his head: "How should I put it? What I'm thinking about is the statue of the Virgin Mary enshrined in that church...... That is, that Lightborn. If a Lightborns appeared in Cyber City, I would definitely not know, but I have no impression of them at all......" He hesitated, unless this Lightborne came to the Dark World a long time ago, when he was still a small white Addison, before he became a popular figure. In that case, her arrival would be considered quite early.
So he changed the subject: "Unless she came to the Dark World long ago before that." "That's the only possibility...... Spamton couldn't think of any other possibilities. And you blinked, reacted for a moment, and rubbed your chin.
"So, when I first started high school, I did hear about a missing person case, but that family had no intention of searching further, so the case was dropped. But now that I think about it, the description of the missing person was similar to the statue of the Virgin Mary enshrined...... "You recalled events from a few years ago. To be fair, your memory is pretty good. You remember everything that happened back then, and your description of that girl, you remember everything clearly."
“…… How did you get to the Dark World?" Spamton suddenly asked, his question sounding completely unrelated to what he had just said. You paused, thought for a moment, and replied, "Hmm...... One day, I saw a door that suddenly appeared in my house, and the door was painted with a cyber city pattern. Out of curiosity, I pushed it open and then entered the Dark World. As for how that Citizen of Light ended up in the Dark World...... I don't know about that. "As you spoke, you shrugged and casually explained where you came from.
"Then my sweetheart, take me there to see it. How about it?" He was still smiling, but only he knew that deep down there was a sense of tension. In fact, he wasn't as calm as he appeared on the surface. He was thinking, he really was thinking that if he could travel between the light world and the dark world through that entrance, if he lived with you in the light world, would everything change? Then...... Would he, like you, grow old together and then pass away together?
Although you didn't understand why Spamton suddenly wanted to see the passage you came from, you still held Spamton's hand and went along. That place was in a rather remote alley in Cybercity. You clung to Spamton, winding through twists and turns before finally entering and reaching the destination.
You point to a door on the wall in front of you, with a sign for your bedroom drawn on it: "Yes, this is the door. I came here from here." As you spoke, you stepped forward, wanting to open the door and show Spamton, but Spamton grabbed your arm, his face looking even paler—even though he was already bloodless.
“…… I didn't see the door you mentioned." He said softly. He had thought that once he found the passage, he could leave. He tried his best to ignore the things he had heard before, but...... But just as he had heard before, the People of Light possess souls, or rather light, so they are free. They are born in the world of light, completely different from those born in the dark world. After all, in the end, they are just ordinary objects...... They are just ordinary objects transformed, carrying their own thoughts and ideas.
The foundation of this dark world is probably the laptop in your room, after all, he still remembers a few times...... He once saw you on that computer screen, witnessed everything in reality.
Although this was something he once didn't want to admit, now he had no choice but to admit it. He ...... It's just a collection of spam emails your computer receives.
He was just an ordinary Dark Citizen, or rather, he could never become like the Light Citizen—unable to have freedom, autonomy, or to become completely famous. What he called popularity and fame now was only built upon the foundation of this dark world.
…… Spamton can't be with you forever; he fully understands this, then feels anxious and helpless, and tightly grabs your arm.
You frowned and looked at his hand, muttering, "You scratched my arm in pain." You don't know what's wrong with him, why he's suddenly using so much force. You don't know what he's thinking when he frowns, but it's definitely something bad.
Spamton instinctively relaxed his grip, but he still gently held your hand and softly said, "...... Sorry. I hurt you by grabbing you. I was just distracted. ”
You stared at him carefully, stepped closer to him, and stared intently at his face. Spamton, however, couldn't help but take a step back. He stared at you, gave an awkward smile, and asked, "What's wrong?" "Although he lost his composure a bit, he believed his disguise was flawless and shouldn't arouse your suspicion."
You just nodded and shook your head, looking at him and softly saying, "It's nothing, it's just that you look ...... a bit strange. Rather, ever since that killer was taken away, you've been acting a bit strange. What's wrong with you? ”
Spamton just showed his usual smile, squinting so you couldn't tell what kind of mood he was feeling. You stared at him, seeing that Spamton probably had no intention of answering. You took a deep breath and stepped closer to him again, this time your face was even closer. Spamton instinctively took another step back, then leaned against the wall, with nowhere left to retreat.
You rubbed your chin, stared at him, and narrowed your eyes slightly: "The questions you asked today all seem strange, and you yourself seem a bit off...... Let me guess—are you thinking about something related to that Citizen of Light?" His expression didn't seem to change much, but it seems that's not the case. You came up with it.
So you shrugged and continued to ask, "Then...... Is it something related to the People of Light? Or is it related to me? "This time, you noticed Spamton's expression change slightly. In short, he blinked slightly and looked at you like that. I think you probably guessed part of the correct answer."
So you keep asking, "That's about me, and also about the People of Light...... You hesitate for a moment, unsure whether to continue, because you always feel your guess is a bit absurd.
But to figure out what Spamton was really hiding from you, you continued to voice your suspicions: "Hmm, so probably...... Because you're different from me, you're just a Dark Citizen. Can't you become a Light Citizen? "You said this as you looked at Spamton.
Spamton sighed, raised both arms in a surrender pose: "I really lost to you...... You're pretty much right. Since that's the case, I'll tell you the truth. ”
As he spoke, he cleared his throat and decided to tell you everything that had just made him uneasy.

title: Bright Dream 16 (dnbsx you)
content:
You blinked at him, making a serious look as if you were listening, while Spamton just sighed. He took your hand and slowly walked toward the detective agency. For a while, he didn't speak, and you waited for him to say something, but didn't take the initiative either. You didn't know what he wanted to say—was it about the case just now, about him, or just about the underworld, or ......
Your wild thoughts haven't even reached a conclusion, but you've already heard Spamton's voice. His voice sounds a bit light, as if ...... It's not meant for you to hear, but you can hear it clearly. You turn to look at Spamton, but he doesn't look at you, just ahead, though his gaze seems unfocused...... At least, you can't see where his gaze is falling. You look at his profile, and it's just the same as usual, with an elusive smile...... But you know that smile is fake.
"You know, I'm a citizen of darkness, and you're a citizen of light, right?" He didn't speak with a questioning tone, but with certainty. You tilted your head in confusion, but still responded with a 'yes.'
“…… The People of Darkness are all transformed from objects. In essence, we are not true living beings, so when we go to the world of light, we only take on the form of various objects, because we do not truly exist." Spamton's tone was very calm, but you could sense that none of this was as calm as his voice suggested; he was just...... Probably just pretending to be calm.
You don't know what to say, nor what kind of answer he wants to make, but no matter how he seems to be emotionally at the moment, it doesn't seem good...... You say, "Well, I didn't know before, but you told me, so now I know...... Alright, so what does it matter? Although you don't really exist...... Maybe that's how it is, but the feelings we feel right now aren't false—that's what is real. ”
"Yes, I know, we're still standing here, so we are real. After all, at least feelings can't be faked...... But, you know, we're objects, so unless we've suffered great damage, unless we can't restore ourselves, we can't die easily. "Spamton stopped, turned to look at you, and unlike usual, there was no smile on his face, replaced by ...... It seemed to be a bitter taste. He slowly smiled again, but in the end, only a faint bitter smile appeared.
“…… However, there was a recent news saying that some of the dark people from the neighboring dark world really turned to dust, and it was impossible for them to become dark people again. "You followed his words and naturally continued. Of course, you didn't consider what Spamton meant by saying that; you hadn't thought about yourself at all.
You look at Spamton and sigh helplessly. He doesn't seem to want to say much more about this, but he goes along with your words: "Yes, that Dark Folk will never be able to come back to life. He must have suffered a very serious injury. And my own carrier is mail...... So, it must be very difficult to suffer this level of harm. ”
Before you could speak, he changed the subject: "But that's not what I really meant. What I really want to say is, in theory, as long as the carrier of the object in the world of light hasn't been suddenly destroyed, the people of darkness cannot truly die...... Unless they have suffered excessive harm in the dark world, I still have reservations about that. As for the people of light, it's clear that you have specific bodies, specific ages, and specific ages...... living beings. When you are hurt, all you can do is wait for treatment. As time passes, you change, and as time passes, you ...... In the end, you will face death. " He said this, his tone somewhat heavy. Clearly, he was not prepared to accept your possible fate.
But you already knew this...... This matter didn't matter to him, so you just smiled and said, "Ah, I knew I would die one day—in fact, if I hadn't discovered the Dark World, if I hadn't discovered my dream here, maybe I would have chosen death long ago," your tone was cheerful, as if you weren't discussing something big, just the usual jokes, "after all...... In the world of light, some things I see through too clearly, it's just too boring! So living and dying probably make no difference. But in the world of the underworld, it's different. I've encountered all kinds of new things, and there are so many mysteries here I just can't figure out...... Ah, I even met you, just like you said. I like you, I like you, I like you, so I like being with you, so I like staying here...... That's all! "You rambled on, your voice cheerful. This matter probably isn't a big deal for you.
Spamton was stunned for a moment. He lowered his head and stopped looking at you, only speaking in a low voice: "...... The People of Light possess souls, but the People of Darkness do not, so I can't see the door you came through, nor can I go with you to the world of light. This means I will always be a citizen of darkness, and you will always be just a citizen of light...... Your lifespan and mine are not the same." His tone became somewhat obscure.
You had just lazily yawned, but when you heard him say this, your expression grew more serious. You looked at him: "I understood this when you just said it." So what? I don't feel regret. Even though as time passes, my figure changes, my voice probably won't be clear, and I won't stand by your side like this anymore, I won't regret it. I'll only be proud of having solved those cases, and I will only be happy because of your growth...... I will be moved and surprised to see you like this when I'm older, as if time has never passed. But what about you? Do you regret it? Because my youth is gone? ”
You look at him seriously, but Spamton's expression only grows more complicated. He sighs, wondering what exactly he is afraid of. He ...... It seems he is afraid that he won't grow old with you, or even die, that you will be afraid and hate him. He probably worries that you will despise him because of his identity as a Dark People...... He, well, to be honest, is selfish. He cannot accept your departure; he will probably keep missing you for years to come. He probably ...... He is not worried about your appearance or other things no longer as before, but that your inner self is no longer what it used to be. He longs for the times when he could walk side by side with you, not just to look down at you.
"I...... I'm not worried about that." His voice sounded a bit hesitant, but under your gaze, in the end, he could only answer your question. He felt a bit uneasy. Spamton hoped you wouldn't keep asking, but he knew very well that you would only keep asking. The moment you said it, he knew this wasn't the answer you wanted.
"Then what are you worried about again? Will you regret the possibilities of the future? Will you regret things that might or even never happen?" You keep asking, really curious about what Spamton is struggling with.
“…… But that's not a future that might not happen. From my perspective, it is probably a future that will definitely happen." Spamton said, unsure how to express his seemingly selfish thoughts...... To be honest, he didn't really want to show you his darker side.
But your eyes are so bright. When you look at him, your pupils are as clear as a mirror, as if they can illuminate everything in his heart. You look at him, you see the struggle and pain beneath his expression. Even though he squints and you can't see his eyes or his specific emotions, you still speak up based on your guess: "...... You think I will definitely die before you, and you will see my aging and my helplessness. Will you feel unwilling about this? Because you can no longer share those youthful and joyful years with me? Because I grow old with time, yet you still maintain your usual appearance? Will you miss the past because of this? So you are afraid, afraid you won't dare imagine the future anymore? As you spoke, you moved closer to him, staring at him intently, your breath swirling around you, as if you could see every detail on his face.
“…… So you regret it. Do you regret dating me?" You asked him in return, and your speech was fast—or rather, it was more like a pressing question. You stared at him intently, not wanting to miss any expression on his face. Then you saw traces of struggle and struggle on his face. You saw that he finally opened his eyes and stared at you intently.
