His hand gripped yours tightly, his voice trembling: "...... Yes, I admit, I'm a selfish guy. After you die, I will find a way to make sure you can appear before me again, for a long time, and if that doesn't happen, I'll be trapped forever in those memories of the past. If only there was a way, 'forever' would be enough. "In the end, his voice was almost a sigh...... He just looked at you with longing, and he realized that when he said those words, he didn't seem nervous at all; instead, he felt a sense of relief. Instead...... He thought, looking into your clear eyes, thinking, maybe you already knew.
Sure enough, you just shrugged: "Ah, spammy, I knew you were a selfish guy all along...... Otherwise, why would you be so close to me? Even if you're selfish, despicable, and mean...... I just really like being by your side. Well, after all, you said you like me, I like you. I just want to ask you, do you regret it? "You said this and lowered your eyes. In fact, your mood kept dropping after you asked that question. You know maybe your answer will decide everything between you two, so you slowly loosened your grip, wanting to let go of his.
But Spamton just squeezed your hand in return, you looked up in surprise, and he just cupped your head with one hand, biting your lips. In that tangled moment, you heard his breathy voice: "I never make a deal I regret." ”

title: Bright Dream 17 (dnbsx you)
content:
You smiled softly, then turned around and hugged him tightly: "Well, of course I won't regret it either—so let's go home." Your voice was soft. You felt Spamton nod gently, then you took his hand and walked toward the detective agency. The way back didn't seem very long; anyway, neither of you made much noise, just headed in that direction. When you pulled Spamton into the detective agency, you let go of his hand and walked straight into your room, lay down on the bed, yawned, and let out a long breath: "Oh no, I'm exhausted. I hope I can rest well these next few days......" You mumbled, probably because it really wasn't very comfortable.
And just as you wished, there haven't been any cases these past few days. While you were playing Gomoku with Spamton, you suddenly received a call from the Seka butler—well, it's been almost a week since the last case, and you happened to be looking for a new one, so you answered the call.
"Is there something you need?" You asked casually, still playing Gomoku with Spamton while distracting yourself to the voice on the phone. Sure enough, you did lose because of it, since he was fully focused on playing against you.
“…… For the past week, there have been daily disappearance cases. Most of the missing Dark People are young and middle-aged people working hard outside, some have wives and children, but for some reason, not a single Dark Citizen has reported it. The relevant units only reported it after discovering that the Dark People hadn't come to the company for several days. Moreover, the missing persons are still happening. Just now, we received a new report...... We hope to receive your and Mr. Spamton's help. ”
You raised your eyebrows. To be honest, you hadn't expected this case, like the last one, to be a serial case. Although you're not very good at this kind of case, since it's not convenient to find the culprit all at once, ...... Well, you're still very interested in cases like this, so no wonder the Seka butler came to you. After all, you're the only detectives making a big splash in the dark world right now.
So you simply responded and hung up, then pulled the spamton, gave him a kiss as a reward for the winner of the game, and then excitedly pulled him outside.
You said enthusiastically, "Hmm, there's a new case this time, probably a serial disappearance case. Once we get to the police station, those color card butlers will explain the situation to you!" But I don't know how those victims are doing now, and ...... Hmm, I don't know why the victims' relatives are in such a state. ”
"In short, those people have disappeared, but their relatives haven't reported it; instead, they have kept it hidden...... I think there must be more to the story, and maybe those relatives benefited from it...... Well, of course, there's also the possibility that they were threatened and didn't dare to speak up, but I don't think it's that simple...... "In short, you talked on and on for a long time, looking quite interested, while Spamton just smiled quietly as you chattered, only speaking again when you were almost silent.
"I wonder, do those missing individuals share any common traits?" Spamton asked. Of course, you're currently taking a regular taxi in Cyber City. To avoid leaking case information, you speak in a low voice.
You hesitated for a moment and answered Spamton's question: "I don't know. I didn't ask the color card butler about that. Let's ask carefully when we arrive later, okay?" ”
Spamton nodded, then took your hand proactively. Although you didn't know what he meant, you still shook his hand in return...... After a while, you finally arrived at the police station.
Spamton took your hand and got out of the car, then you entered the police station one after the other. You cleared your throat twice and put on a serious expression: "So what exactly is going on? Do these cases have specific details, and do you have statements and statements from those involved?" ”
"Of course, I think the most important thing is to show us the case summary first." Spamton followed you and said, and upon hearing this, you crossed your arms and nodded vigorously.
The color card butler bowed to both of you and then handed you a set of documents. I suppose this document was probably the case summary—but since there was only one summary, you and Spamton had to huddle together to look at it. Halfway through, your heads almost bumped into each other, but your furry heads were still leaning together.
The case summary is very simple, showing that over the past week, a total of seven Dark People have gone missing—exactly one per day. According to the current timeline prepared by the Color Card Butler from the parties involved, these seven Dark People have disappeared at different times.
The seven missing Dark Folk were listed in order: wireless fast charging, color card butler, Renwu Admin Ji, mouse, virus, wall attachment, and an orange Addison...... It was still unclear which Dark folk would disappear next, but none of the missing ones had repeated, and their habits were completely different. For a moment, it was hard to guess what they had in common.
"Hmm...... Is there any similarity between the last sighting locations, the last witness, and their outfits when they disappeared...... "You start to interrogate them, though you think it probably won't help—after all, the Dark People have different builds, so it's hard to find any similarities, and their clothes are hard to find similarities either."
Sure enough, the color card butler shook his head: "Their outfits before disappearing aren't much in common. After all, the clothes of these Dark People are different, and the last witness was also different...... But the places where they were sighted seem to have some similarities." ”
"So where are the similarities?" Spamton pressed.
"Hmm...... It's all a remote alley, so I don't think there's much to say about that. After all, it's common knowledge that cases are more likely to happen in remote alleys. ”
"So, is there any surveillance footage near the spot where you witnessed it?" Spamton pondered for a moment, then asked another question, while you blinked and just curled up beside him, quietly observing the color card butler's expression. Well, he wasn't lying; he really believed it...... Well, it seems there's no need to pursue this clue further.
But you still follow behind Spamton to check the surveillance footage from that time. The equipment looks a bit old, since the footage is even a bit blurry in black and white, which isn't very suitable. Curious, you watch these images. These footage are usually from the alley entrance, and after the missing Dark People are captured entering the alley entrance, there are no other footage.
"We've investigated those alleys; they're all dead-end roads, and we haven't found anything around them...... So, maybe those people just vanished into thin air. " the color card butler added.
Spamton stared at the surveillance footage, rubbing his chin. Maybe he was lost in thought, but you looked at Spamton curiously, gently tugged at his sleeve, and softly said, "What are you thinking about now? Do you already have some thoughts about this case?" ”
Spamton turned his head and nodded gently at you, softly saying, "Yes, I already have some ideas." Then he pointed to the surveillance footage, having the color card butler bring him a map of the cyber world, and with his pen, circled the locations of the seven alleys on it.
Looking at the positions of these seven alleys alone, there was no repetition, or rather, they seemed chaotic and completely unfounded; it was just that coincidentally, these alleys were all close to one of the locations...... Hmm, or rather, a certain place. When he drew them on the map, you could tell. You pointed to a dead end alley in the center of these alleys, a bit puzzled: "So will the next missing person case happen here?" ”
Spamton, however, shook his head. He drew the location of a door on that dead end and said softly, "No, do you remember? This is the location of the gate leading to the World of Light that you took me to last time...... I think maybe our movements were noticed by someone, and then that person tried to use these Dark People to get to the World of Light." ”
"Ah......" You opened your mouth wide, looking a bit dazed, "So when we get to that spot, is there a chance we'll find something?" ”
At this moment, the Seka butler chimed in again: "We've also investigated this dead end, Miss Y/N. As it turns out, we found nothing. It's just a dead end, nothing worth seeing. But just in case, we've left the police nearby to prevent further disappearances. So far, nothing has happened over there." ”
You scratched your head, looked at the color card butler and Spamton, and finally suggested, "Um...... After all, I'm a citizen of light. What I see might be a bit different from yours. Anyway, let me take a look—maybe I'll discover some new clues. ”
So, at your request, you took the police station car and returned to that alley. You went in to see if there were any clues nearby that only you could notice.
Well, the facts proved...... Only you could see the door on that wall, and none of the surrounding Dark People could see it. You felt a bit frustrated, but still walked up carefully to observe, then your eyes widened—because you noticed that beside that door was a bloodstain unique to the Light Tribe. The color of the blood had already darkened, clearly not fresh enough, probably from several days ago. Not only that, you also saw the kind that only the Dark People had...... Yellow and red mixed together, swirling shapes, blood-like but also like slime.
You point to the marks and ask Spamton, "Can you see those marks?" "Those marks remain by the door, seeming to seep out from inside or simply splashing onto the door frame."
But Spamton just shrugged, shook his head, and told you he couldn't see at all. To be honest, he was starting to feel a bit restless at this point...... Why is it that you can see it, but he can't? What if this happens more often, and what if he has no chance to protect you—after all, he can't see at all?
TBC.

title: Bright Dream 18 (dnbsx you)
content:
Can't see ...... Your expression grew serious. Given the current situation, it's hard to say whether the perpetrator is a citizen of light or a citizen of darkness. Based on your judgment, the perpetrator is most likely a citizen of light...... You turned to look at the Seka butler and earnestly instructed, "Hmm, I don't know if such a disappearance case will happen again. In any case, I hope you can assign someone to guard this alley. Maybe you can catch the thug when he is trying to harm others......" You keep talking nonstop, completely unaware that Spamton is staring at you in a daze. His face is pale, even though he is naturally pale—only now he looks even paler. The smile that used to hang on his face has also disappeared.
At that moment, he suddenly realized—even if he didn't regret connecting with a Citizen of Light, the gap between them was still so long and impossible to cross. He looked at you, feeling a bit of bitterness for no reason. Maybe...... Maybe. Maybe things would be completely different later, even though he didn't believe in that—he only believed in what he had done himself.
The Saka butler didn't notice this, nodded seriously, indicating they would send people to guard this place. You glanced back at the place and finally reminded again, "Hmm, and the culprit in this case might be the People of Light, I don't know...... Do you have any corresponding punishments for the Light Folk's crimes?" "You really don't know about this, just seriously consulting the Saka Butler, while Spamton just stood behind you, staring at your back in a deep silence. He still didn't say a word."
The Color Card Butler answered your question: "Alright...... But the Dark World really doesn't have laws related to the People of Light. First, it's because very few People of Light can visit it, and second, because ...... The People of Darkness genuinely want to serve the People of Light, so I think this kind of use of them for crimes is probably the first time they've ever seen it...... His voice was a bit hesitant, probably after thinking about his words, and you nodded to show you understood.
"Then let's head back to the detective agency first...... If there are any new developments in the case, please notify us promptly. "After all, you can't stay at the police station forever; that would be outrageous. The Seka butler nodded and agreed to your request.
You took Spamton's hand and walked toward the detective agency. Only then did you notice that Spamton hadn't said a word earlier, and now when you turned to look at him, all you could see was his expressionless profile. Unlike before, he wasn't smiling...... You always felt that his mood was probably not very good, and you just tilted your head slightly to ask him, "Spammy, what's wrong with you?" ”
His voice sounded a bit muffled, probably tinged with unease, but at least you could sense it: "It's nothing, I'm just thinking about some things......
And naturally, you naturally continued asking: "What exactly is the problem?" "You don't know what exactly is wrong with him...... Well, ever since it started, he's been in a strange silence. Could it be because of this case? You thought of this and naturally wanted to ask, but before you could ask, he spoke up on his own.
"You guessed right, it's related to this case. Although I said before that I don't regret it, in the end, you are a citizen of light, and I am a citizen of darkness...... In the end, this point is completely different. You see the clues left by that person of light, while I only see the empty walls. "His voice was calm. You wanted to interrupt him, but Spamton just continued speaking to himself.
"So...... I admit, I'm afraid—afraid I can't protect you, afraid that if the People of Light show up, it could bring danger to you...... I only know about this dark world; I know nothing about the situation in the Light World. "As he spoke, he lowered his voice, letting you hear a pitiful tone—well, Spamton admitted he was just pretending to be pitiful, not that pitiful. He lowered his head, hiding the faint glimmer in his eyes...... Well, he was lying. He wasn't completely ignorant of the Light World. After all, his real carrier in the Light World was spam, which appeared in every household's mailbox. So in reality, he actually knew those families very well.
But aside from that, he didn't really understand much...... While he was still thinking, you leaned in and hugged him. Your gesture made Spamton momentarily dazed; he really didn't know what was wrong with you, but he instinctively hugged you tightly.
He heard your somewhat gloomy voice: "Ah...... So you were worried about this? Although I wanted to tell you not to worry, even though I wanted to tell you...... All of this is just not very important; I won't let anything happen to myself. But I can't promise you about this...... I'm sorry, spammy. Probably...... Maybe I can't dispel the fear in your heart. "Your mood really did sink after hearing his words...... Honestly, you hadn't thought about this before. It wasn't until now that Spamton put it in front of you that you're finally willing to think about it.
You...... You have to admit it. This matter was indeed your oversight, you really didn't consider your position, you really did get a bit carried away.
You hugged Spamton tightly, your voice still muffled: "Although I don't know if saying this will make you believe me, I can promise ...... If there's a problem, I'll definitely prioritize my own safety first, so you don't need to worry too much about that. I absolutely ...... I'll definitely survive well...... "Alright, honestly, you don't really know what you're talking about...... Your original intention was just to soothe Spamton's inner unease. As for the rest, you haven't really thought much about it.
"Well, I know, then my sweetheart...... I hope you can keep your word. Spamton's voice was soft; he truly hoped you could do everything you said, no matter what.
You bury yourself in his chest and nod gently, though you're not sure if he can sense your move. Anyway, you just say gloomily, "Well, I hope so...... I hope neither of us gets into danger. ”
With that, you finally explained the situation and returned to the detective agency. After that, there wasn't much else to do. The living room was still on a chessboard—the Gomoku you hadn't finished playing that morning. So you sat back down in front of the board, slid all the pieces down from the dining table, and said enthusiastically, "Let's abandon the previous chessboard. Let's start over!" ”
Spamton nodded too, holding the black stones and signaling you to go first. You placed the white pieces on the board first. This round didn't take much time, and the result was naturally expected—you won. You hummed happily, playing a tune that was off-key and not quite tuned, just re-slapping the pieces on the board and starting another round: "Alright, I won again—let's start over! Now you play white first." ”
This time, it's his turn to play first. Even so, you still won this round of Gomoku—you hummed happily, glanced at your phone, and saw that the Color Card Butler hadn't sent a message, which meant you now had free time to manage your time. You thought for a moment and suggested, "Mm...... No message from over there yet, let's go out for a date first! Just go anywhere to pass the time, and come over once you get notified. "A good mindset determines everything, anyway...... You don't have much of the mind, and you're not in a hurry at all. After all, rushing doesn't help—rushing doesn't make waste. You just pulled Spamton out the door, then you asked.
"Alright...... But where should we go to pass the time now? "As you spoke, you looked at Spamton curiously. Honestly, you haven't decided yet—after all, you don't fully understand the terrain here in the Dark World!
Spamton pretended to think seriously for a moment, then offered you a suggestion: "Well then...... Let's go to the commercial street. Taking a walk over there can help pass the time, and it'll also be convenient to get away when the color card manager comes looking for us. "Actually, he's wanted to take you to the commercial street for a long time, but the timing has never been right. He can't make this request with you, nor is it convenient to take you directly...... But now it's actually very convenient.
You had no objections and simply pulled Spamton toward the commercial street. The commercial street wasn't far from the detective agency. When you and Spamton arrived, the first thing you saw was the shop that had been sealed off in the previous case. You couldn't help but feel a bit sentimental. As you pulled Spamton inside, for some reason you saw other Addisons, and they were all looking at Spamton with a hint of hostility...... In short, that look wasn't very friendly. You quietly asked Spamton, "What's going on with them? Why are they all looking at you like that?" ”
Spamton glanced casually at those people, still smiling. His voice was neither too loud nor too soft, just enough for them to hear: "Ah, it's nothing major...... It's just that I used to be a spam spam who couldn't sell much, and sales were always at the bottom, so my colleagues looked down on me. But now, I've become a hot topic in Cyber City, with sales at its peak...... These people also look down on me, probably because they think I've somehow managed to reach my current status. ”
“…… So that's how it is...... You blinked, and if he said that, you would also be puzzled: "If that's the case, then you're actually a salesperson...... But when you were my assistant, I never saw you go out to sell things?" "You feel like he idly spends all day idly hanging around with you at the detective agency."
Spamton just shrugged: "This sales figure isn't the amount the People of Dark made with me, but the number of times the People of Light clicked on my pop-up, so of course you can't see me running around outside." ”
You nodded thoughtfully. Just then, your phone rang. You picked it up and glanced—it was a call from the color card butler. You answered the call, but before you could exchange any greetings with the color card butler, you heard his anxious voice.
"Y/N, we didn't see the culprit of the missing person, but just now, we saw a Dark Citizen...... He seemed to have no awareness of his own at all, walking inside. ”

title: Bright Dream 19 (dnbsx you)
content:
You subconsciously furrowed your brows—you hadn't considered that something like this could happen before. Logically speaking, to commit a disappearance case, the perpetrator would definitely find a way to kidnap the victim and then take them away. But you hadn't considered that something like this could happen, that such a thing could actually… happen, where the victim is unconsciously being controlled to walk towards the destination.
"What about that Dark One? Has he been brought under control now? Does he still have his own consciousness… If he does, does he even remember why he acted that way?" You furrowed your brows and spoke faster, just hurriedly asking about the current situation.
"We've got him under control. Now he has regained his self-awareness, but he himself doesn't know why he acted that way at the time. He has even lost the memories from before the incident and has no recollection of why he behaved like that," the Cieca butler explained. They had also suppressed the man for quite some time before this Dark Clan member finally came to and revealed the information he knew.
"And moreover, after our people blocked him, he still tried to walk toward that wall — it was only about fifteen minutes later that he finally came to his senses. We don't really know why, but in any case, we’ve confiscated all the suspicious items from him. Right now, we and this Darkfolk are still staying in this alley. Are you coming over?" The Color Card butler reported all this information to you. You hesitated for a moment, glanced back at Spamton, and then nodded in agreement. 

"Alright, then I’ll bring Spammy over now… It shouldn’t take too long, probably about ten minutes. But… won’t you first take that Darkfolk to the police station?" You responded, but also raised your own question. The other side seemed to go silent for a moment, and then another Color Card butler took over the call and spoke — presumably the overall person in charge of this incident.
"We hope you could take a look to see if there are any clues that we might have missed... that's about it. We hope you can provide the necessary assistance." His voice sounded quite polite, and after thinking for a moment, you still nodded in agreement in the end. Although you knew it was just a phone call and the person on the other end probably couldn't see your actions, you still did it out of habit.
"Okay, I understand. I will do my best... but I also don't know if there are any clues that I might have overlooked." After saying this, you hung up the phone. In fact, you were a little nervous. This case was different from the previous ones. In those earlier cases, the culprits were all members of the Dark Folk, and the clues were visible to everyone. Even if you didn't notice them, your reliable assistant Spamton would remind you and directly help you fill in that piece of evidence, allowing you to confidently deduce the culprit.
But this time is different. This time, the culprit is probably one of the people of light, which makes the situation particularly complicated. Moreover... some clues can only be seen by you, a person of light; no one else can see them, which makes things even more complicated. In this case, if you wanted to fabricate clues and accuse someone of being the culprit at random, wouldn't that become incredibly easy? Of course, naturally, you wouldn't actually do such a thing.
But... but you were still nervous. After all, you couldn't guarantee that you could truly meet the expectations of those color card butlers, couldn't guarantee that you could truly live up to the title of a great detective, and couldn't guarantee... that you could really catch the culprit. So you and Spamton hailed a taxi by the roadside, and after getting in, you still had that somewhat sullen expression. Spamton, smiling kindly, leaned close to you and asked softly, "My cute little sweetheart... what's wrong? Why do you look so down?" Even though he was actually nervous and uneasy too, Spamton didn't want you to develop any negative feelings because of it; he still hoped that you could be happy and joyful at all times.
You glanced at Spamton and quietly replied to him, "I'm a little worried... I'm a little worried about this case, you know, the clues are only visible to me, but what if I can't handle this case properly? What if I fail to find the crucial clue and waste everyone's time... what will I do then? Of course, such a thing might not even happen, but I'm just too scared, too scared, what if it really happens... I, I don't know..." As you spoke, a look of nervous unease and some guilt appeared on your face. You did feel a bit apprehensive, after all, you couldn't really be considered a truly skilled detective... It's just that because Spamton is by your side, solving the case seemed so smooth, and you were well aware of that.
"...It's okay, at least I will always believe in you. Even if we fall into the worst situation, I will still believe in you." Spamton froze for a moment. To be honest, he didn't expect you to have this kind of thought... You were actually worried about something so trivial in his eyes. After all, Spamton had done plenty of scams and tricks like this before. He had deceived others more than once. Of course, with you, he still maintained honesty. And precisely because the others he had tricked in the past, the Darkners, either didn't notice anything wrong or, even if they did notice, could only grit their teeth and swallow it, he simply didn't care about those things.
But... but you are probably too young, or perhaps, you are just too upright. Only people who are too upright would worry about possibly not doing well, only people who are too upright would worry about unforeseen events in the future, and only people who are too upright would worry about potential changes that might occur because of themselves.
You weren't particularly happy because of what Spamton said; you just sighed and said in a low voice, 'I know… of course I know, my spammy will believe me, but, but I don't believe myself.' Saying this, you gave a bitter smile… To be honest, the reason you came to the Dark World to open a detective agency was, first, because it was easier to set up such an institution in the Dark World, and second… because you had repeatedly messed things up in the Light World before, so no one would believe in your detective agency anymore.
After all, you only have the ability to see the murderer, but cannot directly prove it. As a result, once, twice, three times, the friends and relatives who originally supported you to become a detective drifted away, and no one was willing to pay attention to your detective agency that sounded like a scam.
However, you still opened a detective agency, and you still chose the name Mingmeng, because you hope that, with your help, those who might not have seen the truth will eventually be able to see it clearly.
So... so, although at first, your relationship seemed like a joke, as if it wasn’t very serious, you admit that the moment you touched your own heart racing, you told yourself that you truly liked Spamton… After all, after all, now he is standing right beside you, fully supporting all your decisions, believing in every word you say, and you can't help but be moved by this.
"But it's okay, really, spammy, you don't have to worry about me—I can take care of myself." You gave spamton a bright smile. Although that smile looked fake and you didn't seem genuinely happy, you didn't want spamton to be affected by your emotions. You... hoped that he could be happy, joyful, and content.
"No, it matters. How could your matters have nothing to do with me? Although I might not be able to help much, I will also do my best to assist you... because you are our famous detective." He gave you his usual smile. You blinked in response to his smile, your mind drifting somewhere for a moment, but in the end, you simply held Spamton's hand tightly, gave a faint smile, and then nodded firmly.
The taxi quickly arrived at the destination. You and Spamton got out of the car hand in hand. Spamton naturally paid the fare, and then you both walked toward the scene. You took a deep breath—you saw a Darkling sitting nearby wrapped in a blanket; it was Wireless Fast Charge. Then you saw the door on the wall, which was now half open… Your expression grew serious. You let go of Spamton's hand and walked toward the door. On that large door, you saw marks that weren’t there yesterday. So you turned to look at the others, standing there were Color Sample Butler and Spamton: 'Did you see anything?'
But they just exchanged a glance, then shook their heads. They really didn't see anything, only a wall, and you standing in front: 'We didn't see anything.'
You looked at the mark that appeared above the main gate... From the center of the circle as a starting point, three crooked lines extended outward. You, of course, knew what it was, but you just prayed that Kalksha wouldn’t appear in your dream... You hoped not.
You took out your phone and aimed it at the wall, wanting to capture the mark along with the half-open door, but strangely, you could only photograph the half-open door and not the mark—well, at least half of the tracing work was done.
You turned your head again to look at that member of the Shadow people who was sitting on the side, shivering. He was tightly clutching the blanket draped over him. You hesitated for a moment, half-crouched, and asked, 'Did you see anything on that wall?'
And the Dark Folk simply shook their head quickly: 'No.' You frowned, always feeling that he wasn't telling the truth... but for the moment, you didn't know exactly how to press this person for answers, and Spamton certainly noticed this too. He lightly furrowed his brows; he could tell that this Dark Folk was lying, but he had said too little... and there was no way to refute what little he had said.
"Alright, then his personal belongings should all be sealed as evidence, right? Can I take a look?" You chose to give up continuing to ask the witness for information for now, and instead turned around to first look at the color-coded housekeeper, who is the person in overall charge, and reached out your hand toward him.
And that color card steward also nodded, signaling the other color card stewards to bring up everything that had already been sealed in the evidence bags.
You glanced over it once, and at a rough look, there was nothing unusual. But why would something like... gold appear on a person who should be an ordinary Darkfolk worker? Even if it was just a small amount. You examined those tools, and besides that, there was something else rather suspicious: a leaflet that was entirely bright yellow, so bright it was almost dazzling.

title: Bright Dream 20 (dnbsx you) (end)
content:
But upon closer inspection, you notice the symbol on the flyer that bears a mark similar to the mark on the door, extending from the center of the circle in three crooked curved lines—though you don't know much about these, you do know this is Hastur's yellow seal, perhaps left by someone from the Carxa Brotherhood...... You don't know either.
You stand up, glance at the victim again, and suddenly ask again: "But I think what you saw, you saw...... A yellow symbol with three curves shooting out from the center, right? ”
The man's body stiffened for a moment, but he still stubbornly said, "What is it? I've never seen such a crooked mark before. I didn't see anything at all." ”
This time, the witness spoke a few more words, and Spamton finally managed to find his flaw—he looked at the Dark Citizen with a smile: "But you're lying! If you haven't seen it, how would you know it's a crooked mark?" ”
“…… And if you hadn't seen it before, hearing my description like this, you wouldn't have reacted like this. What exactly are you trying to hide?" You added, staring intently at this Dark Commoner. That Dark Folk lowered their heads, hunched over, as if giving up struggling, but bitterly told you the truth.
"Well, after seeing this symbol, I was uncontrollable, or maybe I didn't have any awareness of my own...... I came to this place. To be honest, a Citizen of Light did come to visit my home. He told us that as long as I served as an experimental subject, I could give my family a large sum of dark coins, and coincidentally, my family happened to be short of that coin...... So I agreed to his request. ”
You glanced at the Color Card Butler—this is indeed a major breakthrough for you now. The Color Card Butler has also ordered other Color Card Butlers to investigate who else in the cyber world is like this. Maybe they can catch them red-handed.
He turned to look at the Dark Folk: "Did you see what that Light Folk looked like?" ”
"No, he's wearing a yellow raincoat. I can't see what he really looks like." The Dark Citizen shook his head.
“…… If any new Lightfolk appear in the cyber world, please notify me immediately. That person might be the culprit." You told the Sakaka butler so seriously, then returned to your detective agency with Spamton. For some reason, you always have a bad feeling about this, and it turns out that this feeling did come true a few days later—the Sakaka butler tells you that they have been staking out this alley every day but haven't found any suspicious people.
You...... You don't know what to do either. You bite your thumbnail and feel like they don't trust you much, because no one has visited your detective agency lately. Of course, it's also possible that Cyber City has been relatively peaceful lately.
Feeling uneasy, you pulled Spamton out the door, wanting to find a random spot to clear your mind. But as soon as you stepped out, your attention was drawn to the other side—there was also a detective agency, and for some reason, the Dark People swarmed in, almost stomping the threshold to pieces.
You stared blankly at the detective agency, while Spamton gently tugged your hand. He curled his lips, though his smile looked a bit cold: "Ah...... "He's my former colleague. You look curious—do you want to see what's really like inside the shop now?" ”
You nodded. Of course, you wanted to see what your rival company was really like...... Fortunately, there weren't too many Dark People blocking the outside. After a while, you and Spamton squeezed in, planning to take a good look inside. But just as you got a clear look, your expression suddenly changed.
You lowered your voice and spoke to Spamton: "Inside...... There was also a Citizen of Light, the murderer of the recent disappearance case. "As you spoke, you swallowed twice and hesitantly looked at Spamton. After all, you had no evidence at the moment. You just timidly looked at Spamton and asked in a weak voice.
“…… No evidence, but, but that person is the culprit...... "You, do you believe me?" As you spoke, you swallowed twice more. Honestly, if Spamton didn't believe you, you wouldn't know what to do.
But you just nod gently at Spamton, his voice soft: "Of course I believe you. No matter what, I will trust you. We agreed on this before." As he spoke, he gazed at you. His eyes opened, and at that moment, his gaze was especially gentle, soothing the unease and restless emotions in your heart—you truly felt uneasy. You really didn't know how Spamton would react to you. But now, after hearing his words, your eyes lit up and you cheered with joy.
"Then we'll notify those color card butlers right now—hmm, hopefully there won't be any more missing persons from now on." You said as you dialed the color card butler. Although you were a bit puzzled as to why they hadn't informed you that new Lightfolk had arrived, maybe they just forgot—you told yourself.
However, the answer from the Color Card Butler surprised you: "That person is an honored guest of the Queen. We believe this Mr. of the People of Light would not do such a thing. Miss, please don't fuss over the detective agency's business." ”
You're stunned; you have no idea these color card butlers think this way—why do they think that way? You, you don't understand.
You hung up the phone, stared blankly at Spamton beside you, then lowered your head gloomily. Spamton tightened his grip on your hand and gently stroked your head, a mysterious smile once again appearing at the corner of his lips. You don't know what he's thinking; you only know that you're thinking, if...... If these color card butlers don't believe you either, wouldn't your fate be exactly the same as your current fate in the world of light? You can't accept this outcome. You hate being treated like this, even though you're not like this—
But before you could continue thinking, your thoughts were interrupted by Spamton.
"No need...... If they don't believe you, then just wait and see. I believe what you told me isn't wrong, so let's wait and see." Spamton shrugged, then hugged you tightly and gently kissed your forehead. The trembling you had just been trembling from fear and nervousness finally quieted down. You buried your head in Spamton's arms and gently rubbed against him. Think about it, maybe you really were just too nervous...... Or maybe, past fears have been lingering around you like shadows.
You and Spamton returned to the detective agency. No one knew what the other side had done, but lately all the Dark People had gone to the detective agency across the road, but not a single one had come to you. You kept staring at the detective agency across the street every day, not looking very happy.
But sure enough, just as Spamton said, after some time, the same disappearance case happened again—the relative of the Dark Folk made a big scene at the detective agency across the street, and the Saka butler went to the other side, but the case seemed to be progressing slowly...... In short, you neither saw nor heard about it until the Sakaka butler stepped into your detective agency once again.
He bowed respectfully to you and Spamton: "Sorry to disturb you both, but we need your help. The missing person case has flared up again in this city, and without your help, we probably couldn't solve it." ”
You pouted, though you were interested in the case...... But when you thought about how these color card butlers only came to you when they were truly in trouble, you didn't really want to lend a hand.
You just said in a calm voice, "Let me tell you, that Citizen of Light is the culprit behind the disappearance case...... Have you arrested him? ”
The color card butler paused, then finally answered your question: "They've already been arrested. I think we should trust your judgment. We spoke carelessly before, and we're truly sorry." ”
Although you still feel a bit sad, after receiving that apology, your mood improved significantly. You returned to your usual smiling expression and grabbed Spamton's hand: "Alright, then let's go to the police station now—hmm, I accept your apology!" Saying that, you held your head high and chest out, grabbed Spamton, and got into the police car. You quickly arrived at the police station, where another Dark Citizen from his detective agency—a pink Addison—was arrested along with the Light Citizen. When he saw Spamton, the pink Addison rolled his eyes at him with disdain, but Spamton just smiled and ignored him.
You looked at the Lightborn—well, you didn't recognize him, just a human, and you didn't know where he had fallen from. You cleared your throat and then found the same yellow mark on the hem of his clothes.
“…… Where did this mark come from? "You pointed at the hem of his clothes and asked.
And the people of light replied with a smile, "Of course, the Lord gave it to me." ”
You didn't answer his question. You remembered that you had previously done a bloodstain sampling by the door, and now you drew his blood as well. After testing and identifying both types of blood, you concluded that they came from the same person.
So you looked again at this Citizen of Light: "The evidence is conclusive, the blood test results are right here. I don't think you have any room to argue anymore." ”
He didn't seem to want to argue, just sighed softly: "Hey...... Alright, it was indeed what I did. Opening a detective agency is also to get back at you all, and secondly, it helps me find my next target. I want to study whether if the souls of the Dark People are strong enough to travel to the Light World. It's normal for experiments to cause death—it's just that before I get the results, you guys caught me first." He also looked a bit missing the experimental results he hadn't made yet...... You don't know why the People of Light and Dark have been studying this lately. They just nodded to the color card butler and then pulled Spamton outside.
You casually asked, "Do you want to go to the World of Light too?" ”
“…… Of course I thought. I don't think any Dark Clan wouldn't be attached to the world of light, wouldn't depend on them." Spamton still kept smiling.
You tilted your head slightly and thought for a moment: "...... Then maybe we can find a way to get you to the World of Light. The souls of the People of Light are strong enough. Maybe I can share a portion with you......
But before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you: "No, I don't need it, and I won't regret it...... I'd rather live in the dark world with you, just like I am now. ”
You blinked: "Alright then—hmm, Mingmeng Detective Agency will continue to open smoothly!" "Saying that, you stretched, and Spamton returned to the agency with you.
And sure enough, as expected, when it reopened the next day...... The customer was packed.
END.

title: [Part 1]
content:
You sat boredly on a trash can, swinging your legs. This was a remote alley, usually no one passed by, and as for you...... You couldn't remember what was going on. Or rather, you didn't know who you really were or why you were in this place. You only remembered that you seemed to have been sitting there for many days. For you, every day was just looking at that old advertisement posted on the wall across the street, with that blue ...... It seemed to be someone called the Queen, and you could recite the words written on that advertisement backwards.
In short, you only know you sit in the same place every day. You seem unable to get far from this place, because you have searched the entire commercial street, trying to find an exit, but...... You reach the edge but can only touch the wall of air. You cannot, nor can you leave this place. It seems you absolutely cannot leave this place...... This is what your intuition tells you.
…… You don't know what's the point of staying here forever. People on the commercial street can hardly see you. Sometimes you just walk by and sneak away things just thrown away by those addisons—sometimes unfinished barbecue, sometimes ice cream, sometimes ...... Some clothes that can't be sold and look cheaply made.
You enjoy it because no one here can see you; sometimes you swagger past them, watching these addisons, spitting, sweating, and introducing products to others.
You don't quite understand why you don't look much like these people. You also don't understand what you really are.
Most of the time, you sit on a trash can, lost in thought, until you see an Addison you've never seen come to the shopping street. He looks shorter than the other Addisons, and not only that, he's pure white—or rather—a bit translucent. Just looking at him makes you feel a bit closer, since you've even looked at yourself in the puddle during rain—otherwise, how would you know what you look like? In your impression, you seem semi-transparent too, a shadowless person.
So for once, you got a bit more interested, resting your chin on your hand and watching the shopping street, wanting to see what this new Addison would do. But...... Just a few minutes later, that guy who seemed to be called Pink disdainfully poured the coffee in his hand onto White's head. The originally mixed white and semi-transparent color turned coffee, startling you, who quickly jumped out of the trash can.
To be honest, this is the first time you've encountered something like this. Although you don't understand what it is, subconsciously you feel you deeply hate it all. Even if you don't know what it is, looking at the confusion and fear on that white Addison's face, you know this must be something bad. It's uncomfortable, so you have to find a way to stop it.
Before you could figure out what you should do, you saw Pink grab White's collar and raise his fist, clearly trying to vent his anger by treating his subordinate Addison like a human punching bag. Startled, you crawled over and put Orange's clothes on your head, picked up a pot of freshly brewed tea Pink had just brewed in the shop, and prepared to go play tricks and get back at Pink. Anyway, they can't see you, so you can pretend it's haunted. The pot isn't very hot, so pouring cold on Pink's head is just right to refresh and wake him up!
You planned all this, but when you turned around, you saw Pink had already slapped White. His originally white face now had a red handprint, and Pink was raising his hand, seemingly wanting to give him another blow. You quickly propped up the blue skirt and slipped it between the two Addisons. From Pink's perspective, it looked like a blue dress had flown over and blocked his view. Then, you tried hard to stand on tiptoe and poured the pot of tea at Pink.
He let out a sharp crackling sound, running back to his shop with the tea leaves on his head, and even snatched the teapot and the blue skirt away. You seemed to hear Pink and Orange arguing, apparently talking about the blue skirt. Then you watched as Pink reluctantly pulled out a dark coin and gave it to the smug-faced Orange.
You breathe a sigh of relief and plan to go back to the trash can and sit there, doing good deeds without leaving a name, especially since they can't even see you.
Just as you were about to leave, a timid voice rang out: "[Honored Miss], thank you for your generous offer. May I know your name?" ”
He seemed a bit incoherent, speaking anxiously, with a crackling sound of electricity. Even so, you could still understand what he was saying. Because of this, you turned your head in surprise to look at the little Addison in front of you. It was the first time you realized someone could see you.
So you instinctively pointed to yourself: "Are you talking about me?" "You also glanced around. Well, it seemed like there was no one else around here besides you. Probably because Pink was causing trouble here earlier, most people had dispersed."
He nodded without hesitation: "Honored Miss, that's you." ”
"I...... I don't have a name. Ah, I can't say that, I don't know what my name is. "You scratched your head, feeling a bit curious. This was the first time someone had ever seen you and talked to you. To be honest, you were pretty excited.
So you couldn't help but circle around him several times: "By the way, what's your name? Do you know those Addisons? Why are they bullying you? Are you unable to beat them? Why don't they fight back?" And then...... And if you want to open a shop on this commercial street, I can be your bodyguard! Look, I was just trying to scare him earlier, and he immediately ran off because of me. I'm very useful! ”
He looked like he was startled by you, his body stiff, and his expression very tense, but he still seriously answered your questions one by one: 'My [only title] is SPAMTON G.SPAMTON! I... am also a addison, and I have a [dwelling] similar to theirs. Probably because my [sales are zero] and... [body issues]? My [strength is unmatched], and I once tried [self-defense], but only ended up with [double losses]. Lastly... thank you, miss, for your [kind intentions]! But I cannot [award a salary], I... [have zero sales], [no one is interested].' He spoke very quickly as he explained to you, perhaps his education level wasn’t very high? Although it was a bit hard to understand, you could barely grasp what he was saying, though it left you a bit stunned.
After saying these words, he took a few deep breaths, his face flushed from holding back. It seemed that saying those words just now was quite difficult for him.
You quickly shook your head and waved your hand: "I don't need a salary! Even if you pay me, I can't spend it...... As you can see, after all, now only you can see me. Maybe I'm just a ghost!" After saying that, you laughed heartlessly.
Actually, you also want to know who you really are, you want to leave this place, you don't want to stay here forever. Actually, when you say this, your mood feels inexplicably heavy. You just instinctively let yourself smile carefreely.
Spamton looks at you, opens his mouth, hesitates, and finally instinctively reaches out to grab yours. And you widen your eyes because as he moves, you notice your hand slowly turning into a physical form.
You were so scared you pulled your hand back, and then it became semi-transparent again. You breathed a sigh of relief and patted your chest: "You scared me to death. I thought I had turned into a human." "Once you become human, it's not easy to grab things or run around freely. You have to find a place to live, a place to sleep, find something to eat, and spend money to buy clothes."
…… You definitely don't want to live like that, and besides, you don't know anything yet—how are you supposed to go out and find a job!
Spamton slightly raised his head to look at you, seeming somewhat puzzled: "I don't understand, [materialization] has many benefits." "He wanted to repay you, but didn't know how, which is why he said such things."
But you just shook your head seriously: "You don't get it, being a ghost is so much easier! If it materializes, then I'd have to think about a lot every day like you, you see." You pursed your lips and pointed toward Pink and Yellow walking toward you.
Pink probably had already snapped out of his earlier shock. He looked at Spamton and laughed, "Look at you. I told you, poor little rascal, you can't accomplish anything big. You still want to be a big shot, but now you're so crazy you're talking to thin air." ”
Spamton's eyes widened instinctively. He glanced at you, standing nearby with an innocent expression but a bit guilty, then at Pink standing in front of him, took a deep breath, and said, "I'm not in a 'mad state'; she is a real [Dark People]. ”
Yellow laughed too: "There's no other Dark Folk here, just the three of us standing here. Spamton, you're not just a drunken barbecue, are you? Why don't you go smell it in the trash heap and sober up?" ”
Spamton understood. Although he didn't know why, only he could see you; the other Dark People probably couldn't see you.
He took a deep breath and grabbed your hand again. You were watching the show and thinking about how to get these two Addisons to go, only to notice your hand materializing once more.
You blinked, and the hand you touched appeared in the air—for those two Addisons, it was a ghost hand suddenly appearing in the air.
Spamton just blinked innocently: "Hmm...... I said the person beside me is [real] and the evidence is conclusive." "As he spoke, he raised that hand.
Pink's expression stiffened. He poked yellow with his hand, his voice trembling slightly: "See, I told you there must be some hauntings next to Spamton, and you still don't believe me? You insist on having me confront you together." ”
Yellow didn't dare either: "What are you talking about, pink?" Wasn't it just now that you said you were upset by Spamton's counterattack and insisted on coming over to help you find a scene? Now I'm getting shot right in the middle, right? ”
You hesitated for a moment, saw the two Addisons arguing so fiercely, and decided to add fuel to the fire. So you leaned in and pressed your cheek against Spamton's. His face was icy cold, so much so that you, the cold ghost, couldn't help but shiver. Then you smiled and said to them, "Nice to meet them." ”
In their eyes, it was just a person with only half a face and a hand greeting them. Pink's teeth chattered, but he still dragged Yellow back and returned in defeat.
You found it interesting, turned to look at Spamton, and for some reason his cheeks flushed: "Do you get bullied by them all the time? Don't worry, as long as you're here on the shopping street, I won't let you get bullied!" You patted your chest as you spoke.
"What about the [Exploration Area] outside the [Shopping Street]?" He knew he shouldn't have that much curiosity, but he couldn't help but ask.
You pretended to be troubled, resting your chin on your hand and thinking for a moment: "Hmm...... But I've tried, I can't leave the commercial street. I remember...... This should be called an Earthbound Spirit? "You're not really sure, because you don't have much memory. Just now, the word 'Earthbound Spirit' just happened to pop into your mind.
"Speaking of which, what exactly are the People of Darkness? Aren't we all human?" As you spoke, you poked Spamton's cheek, a bit curious. After all...... You really don't know what this is. Ever since you woke up, you've been stuck here.
"...... [Honored Miss], don't you know about the [People of Darkness]?" He was also swept off the topic by you, looking at you in disbelief.
You stick out your tongue, a little embarrassed: "I really don't know...... I have no idea what kind of place this is, who am I, why am I here, or what do I need to do? ”
As you spoke, you reached out your finger again, poking his soft, slightly fluffy face again and again. Your fingers also flashed again and again, which was quite amusing.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then helplessly grabbed your hand and held it in his hand. Then you reached out with your other hand to poke him, and his other hand grabbed yours too. Now you were executed on the spot, puffing out your cheeks and looking at Spamton.
He cleared his throat. Although he felt a bit guilty, he pretended not to notice your angry expression and continued to himself, "Ahem...... The [People of Darkness] are objects that reflect the existence of [Light] in the midst of [extreme darkness]. The [People of Light] are ordinary beings that exist in the [Artificial World]. This world is the [Dark World], called the [Cyber World], a [world] constructed by the ruler [Queen]. This place is part of the [Cyber World]. ”
You listen carefully to what he finishes, and after Spamton's finish, his eyes sparkle as he looks at you. You smack your lips, trying hard to understand what he means, so you respond with a hum.
He replied with a 'hmm', still staring at you with sparkling eyes, eagerly awaiting your next answer.
"I didn't understand." You honestly shook your head. Honestly, this passage is a bit abstract, and it's normal for you not to understand.
Spamton sighed, his head drooping, looking quite disappointed. You couldn't help but break free from your hand, went up to pat his head, and after racking your brain, said, "I really didn't understand...... But I'm not saying you said it badly! It's just that I really haven't seen those so-called Lightfolk either......
"The People of Light are the objects of the [People of Darkness]'s pursuit, the users of the [Avatars of the Dark People], and the monsters and humans of [flesh and blood.'" Spamton tried to break down the meaning and explain it to you again.
You scratched your head, still a bit confused: "Are the bodies of the Dark People different?" ”
He nodded: "The [Dark People] do not have [true flesh and blood]. ”
You don't know exactly what the body structure of the Dark People looks like, and you can't have Spamton cut off a piece for you to study now, so you have to awkwardly change the subject.
"Then do you think I'm a Dark Clan or a Clan of Light?"
This time, Spamton sized you up for a long time, looking at you from head to toe. You cleared your throat twice, feeling a bit embarrassed by the stares.
“…… You should be the [People of Darkness]; you don't have [Unique Light] or [Heart-shaped Objects]. But you are an unprecedented [Human Type] of the [People of Darkness], only among the [People of Light] are humans." He said, frowning, clearly unable to figure out what exactly you should be regarded as.
You cough twice: "So you don't know?" ”
He nodded honestly, then asked, "[Honored Miss], you don't have any [reference answer] at all?" ”
“…… I don't know. I've always stayed here. I thought...... I'm just like those others—no, the Dark People." "You slumped your shoulders in despair, and now you have no idea who you really are.
"Not a single [clues]?" Spamton asked again. He didn't think that for a person, they would have no status at all.
You scratched your head: "Ah...... As for clues, I think there's a bit of it." "By now, you've gotten used to Spamton's slightly odd way of speaking—you're quite accustomed to it." You fumbled around and pulled out a black-and-white photo from your pocket. It was your profile picture—black and white, or maybe a memorial portrait to be more accurate.
"When I woke up, this was by my side, and only this was left. It was just a photo......" As you spoke, your voice quieted, since there were no other clues besides that.
Your face is printed on the photo, expressionless, and the black-and-white portrait leaves only a trace of sorrow.
“…… Maybe this represents a [death declaration]." Spamton said. After all, the black-and-white photo ...... still looks like this kind of expression, looking like a memorial portrait.
He reached out to take the photo and take a look, but just as he did, a black-and-white vortex appeared from the photo. Spamton was powerless to resist, feeling dizzy and swept into the vortex. You stared blankly at the scene, and only a blank photo fell from the spot. You didn't know what had happened. You just nervously picked up the photo and sat dazed on top of the trash can, staring blankly at the photo.
TBC.
This scene is quite a bit of personal bias...... And 'you' is used to refer to you in the dream, though I forgot to add it in some places.
—
As for Spamton—he dazedly passed through the whirlpool, then his entire Addison lay face down on the cold floor, dizzy for quite a while before finally coming to his senses. The small white Addison slowly climbed up from the floor, brushed off the dust on his clothes, and after trying hard to identify for a while, finally vaguely realized—he seemed to have somehow arrived in the world of light.
But how did a Dark Citizen suddenly come to the world of light? In the world of light, shouldn't he just be a junk mail? No consciousness, no form of self—but the cold wind struck his face, making Spamton's dizzy head clear again. He patted his cheek, finally snapping back to reality, and only then noticed his position—he was on a towering rooftop, so close it seemed he could touch the moon directly. He had never seen the moon in the dark world before.
Spamton stared in a daze, until he heard faint footsteps and snapped back to reality. Instinctively, he looked toward the source of the sound—the edge of the rooftop. Only then did he notice a girl standing at the edge of the rooftop, precarious and on the verge of collapse.
Spamton instinctively glanced down from the rooftop. The building was so tall that he felt a bit scared. He had never climbed to such a high place before, so wouldn't that girl feel scared standing there?
But—but, he raised his hand to look, but he didn't feel ...... He could pull the girl back from the stairs who might fall, but when he saw the girl spread her arms and fall toward the bottom of the rooftop, Spamton couldn't help but rush forward and reach out to grab the girl. It was only then that he realized the girl was ...... exactly the same as the one he had seen earlier.
Spamton didn't know what was going on. He just looked at [you] in silence for a moment before quietly asking, "What's the reason for your [behavioral patterns]?" ”
[You] tilted her head, not quite understanding what he was saying, but you still roughly understood what he meant, so [you] just tried to give him a faint smile—even though it didn't even look like a smile, at least in Spamton's eyes, it was just a smile tinged with sadness and tears.
His hand still tightly held onto [your], but the difference in strength was still overwhelming. Perhaps sweat had formed from nervousness in his palm, and [your] hand slowly descended.
“…… There's no particular reason, I just feel that this world has lost all meaning...... I've tried, it's all the same, and no one cares about me, so even if I leave this world, I won't have any attachments...... As you spoke, tears couldn't help but flow from your eyes, dropping one by one. Spamton opened his mouth, but didn't know what to say.
"I—I still care about you, [very much], so please hold on a little longer—" He didn't know what to do. Seeing that [you] had lost the will to survive, he said these words in a panic, and only after saying them did he feel a bit guilty. He ...... We've only known you for a few hours. Although he was grateful to you, he didn't really care that much.
But it's not that he doesn't care at all—at least he's now trying hard to pull your hand upward. Though he doesn't know exactly what happened, he can't just stand by and watch his savior die. It was only then in the dim night that he barely caught sight of the scars on your arm—some blue, some purple, some old, some new...... He hadn't seen anything on you now. Could it be that everything disappears after death?
[You] were stunned for a moment, then unusually burst out laughing: "I don't even know you...... You probably don't know me either. You don't have to say something like that just to save me, I know...... This might not be true. "In the end, all that remained was a murmured murmur while Spamton stared at you in a daze.
He instinctively asked, "Then ...... [your name]?" I ...... I am "sincerely." I will not [give up]. ”
"My name...... Y/N, hmm, but that doesn't matter anymore. You fell just to pull me, and it's not worth it. I don't want to lose another person's life because of me. "[You] tried hard to keep smiling, but couldn't help but sob, reaching out to pry Spamton's fingers apart. As [You] struggled, [your] body slowly sank.
Spamton tries hard to pull you up, but no matter how hard he tries, there's no way. Besides, [you] smile and willingly sink down.
"But, but—" He wanted to say that his life wasn't that important, after all, he was just an inconspicuous, small Addison in Cyber City. It didn't matter if he risked his life for [you], especially since you had truly saved him. He knew—
Yet, he could only watch helplessly as [your] fingers slipped away bit by bit. In the end, Spamton reached out and tried hard to touch yours, but it was all in vain.
Spamton could only watch helplessly as you fell, slowly leaning back, finally turning head-down, and finally...... He hadn't seen clearly, only feeling his vision blur. He returned to his previous spot on the rooftop, and that girl—you—was still standing there, as if the next second you would spread your arms and fall down.
