"So today, will you tell [your story]?" Spamton said.
"My story...... Actually, there's not much to say. You know, it's basically the same things every day. Oh right, didn't I use my mother's contact information to sneak into the class group chat? "You kicked the pebble under your feet and said excitedly.
"Hmm, [Continue Process]?"
"Hmm, not long ago, I don't know which classmate was so idle that they actually reported me for secretly doing homework and not paying attention in class...... Then the homeroom teacher started contacting my nominal mother, who is me. Luckily, I found an excuse to brush it off! Honestly, it doesn't matter whether you listen to the current classes or not...... "No matter what, you can still stay in the top ten. If you don't want to study anymore, just let it go." After all, staying at school every day is a torment for you. Back then, with Spamton around, at least you had some hope, but now you don't even have any.
Spamton nodded: "Y/N [extremely smart]." "Although he knew this probably wasn't a good thing, since you were so proud, he wouldn't spoil your mood. And he truly thought you were very clever.
You awkwardly rubbed the tip of your nose, chuckled twice, and changed the subject: "By the way, what did Spammy do during those three months of being gone?" "You're a bit nervous again, because you called out his nickname, and you don't know if he'll allow it."
Fortunately, he didn't mean to stop you, and Spamton just covered his slightly flushed face, cautiously glanced at you, and only relaxed a little after confirming you might just call out that casually.
"I...... Last time I mentioned that [People of Light] to you, because of their [honorable presence], I [made a name for myself]. ”
You glanced at Spamton, a bit puzzled: "How did you get so out? You look no different from before, huh? Or are you secretly living a good life behind my back and not taking me along?" As you spoke, you tugged at his cheek, sounding angry and accusing, but in reality, you were just laughing and complaining.
“…… I—that's not what I meant. It's just that the [Dark World] and the [Light World] don't connect, so I can't bring you a 'good life.'" Spamton scratched his head and stammered a little.
You snorted lightly and didn't dwell on it, just grabbed his arm and shook it again: "So what happened then? What happened next?" "You're still quite curious. You really want to know what wonderful news has appeared in another world you don't know about."
"Hmm...... I've become a big shot in the Cyber World. All those insults and ridicule I mentioned to you before have come to apologize to me. But I have no friends, only myself, and those "Dark Coins." However, because I'm now a big shot, my sales keep growing." "It's fake. Actually, it's all just lies he made up. He's always wanted to be a big shot, but unfortunately, he's always been a small Addison at the bottom of the cyber world. Maybe he'll never become a big shot."
"Then I moved into the Queen's Mansion and had a Dream Life......" he continued, but you interrupted him.
You just glanced at him calmly and softly said, "Are you lying...... Are you lying?" His expression was unnatural as he spoke, and you could tell that too. You hadn't interrupted him before, because you could feel that he truly hoped for it, but you could also sense that he couldn't keep making things up, and in the end, all that remained was empty rumors.
Spamton's expression stiffened for a moment, then he forced a couple of laughs and said, "[Sincere] [Honest and honest.] ”
He's so serious that you start to wonder if you're mistaken, or maybe ...... Is he just overthinking it?
But you still held his hand and said solemnly, "Alright, whether it's true or not, you don't have a single friend. You still have me, at least I'll always be your friend!" You promised that, your eyes sparkling as you looked at him. Spamton was stunned for a moment, then turned his head in panic and just responded with a hum.
But the time you cherish so much is always short-lived. No matter how reluctant you are, you still stand at your doorstep. After saying goodbye to Spamton as always, you open the front door. This time, you ignore your drunken father's rambling and loud shouting, simply sitting at your desk and starting a new day of anticipation.
After a while, your window was knocked, and Spamton handed you a candy—today it was orange-flavored. The window was closed again. You carefully washed the candy wrapper, folded a thousand paper cranes, and put them in the jar. Looking at the jar that was almost full, you made up your mind to give it to Spamton, and next time we met, you could give it to him.
But after a day, two days, countless days pass, and you still haven't seen him. You don't know if you'll never see him again. If you empty that jar of origami cranes and let everything start over, will you still be able to see him? You don't know about this, and you don't dare to guarantee it. The feelings of youth seem empty and unrealized, but they've always been buried deep in your heart, making you feel unbearably sad.
And Spamton, isolated behind the window of time, knocks on that window but never opens it, watching as you sink deeper day by day. He is anxious but helpless; he can do nothing.
It wasn't until half a year later that he finally stepped out of the barrier of time and stood again at the school gate, waiting for you to come out.
You were carrying your handbag and about to go home as usual, but then you saw Spamton.
Your eyes lit up, and all those past memories ran through your heart, making you think about it endlessly. You rushed forward and hugged Spamton, even though your other classmates were in serious trouble. You just inexplicably lunged toward the air, then hugged the air.
You sniff, trying hard to hold back your tears: "...... Long time no see, spammy. ”
Spamton's body stiffened for a moment, but in the end he hugged you back and whispered, "Mm, long time no see." ”
He sensed he was about to leave, so he didn't dare promise you anything more. On the way home, the streetlights cast your shadow, and for once, neither of you said a word. You nervously waited for him to knock on the window to send out that jar of origami cranes, while he was just lost in thought.
Spamton…… It's just a bit reluctant. He can't bear to part with these memories, and he still wants to walk with you, even though these are just memories and he can't change anything.
Unconsciously, he walked to your doorstep. Spamton waved at you, then, as usual, hid behind the wall. When he saw the faint light from the window, he timed it, touched the extra candy in his pocket, walked toward the windowsill, and stood on tiptoe to open the window.
And you've been waiting for this moment for a long time. Your heart is pounding nonstop. You hug the jar of origami cranes, then suddenly open the window, startling Spamton.
And you just took a deep breath, bent down, and solemnly said to him, "Spammy, I like you." ”
Spamton's eyes widened instinctively. He wanted to say that maybe this feeling was just an illusion born in your despair. He wanted to tell you there was still plenty of time, and you didn't need to make a decision right now. He wanted to say......
But before he could speak, he looked at you saying something else, but he couldn't hear clearly. All that remained was dizzying, and everything before him was black and white. When the dizziness faded, he realized he was back in the cinema. The screen turned pitch black, the headlights came on, and he slowly checked the movie ticket in his hand. The photo behind him had already turned color. For some reason, the girl was holding a jar of colorful origami cranes, exactly like the jar you had just given him.
TBC.
Spamton hesitated as he put away the movie tickets—or rather, the photos. He was the only one in the theater. He walked out in silence. There weren't many Dark People outside, probably because at this hour, no Dark People would come. Spamton was also puzzled why the cinema would have a movie about you, or rather...... It was a memory.
So he walked up to the ticket counter, stood on tiptoe slightly, looked at the color card butler, and asked, "May I ask, is there the [screening logic] for this movie?" As he spoke, he showed the movie ticket in his hand. Strangely enough, the ticket didn't even have a name on it.
The color card butler glanced at the ticket and patiently explained, "This movie ...... Our cinema was generated according to the Queen's film screening requirements, and the movie content comes from the storage and download of the People of Light. The related videos of this movie are stored in the movie-related folders, so the screening of this movie is probably about the lives of the People of Light. ”
Spamton nodded. In fact, he didn't understand the relationship between computer storage and you, but he did know the general principle behind the creation of the Dark People...... So, this might be a clip of audio casually tossed into a computer folder.
He took the movie ticket back, deciding to bring it to you. Although it wasn't too early and most of the Dark People had already gone home, only he went against the flow and returned to the commercial street. Most of the Dark People had left, including his colleagues and a few addisons.
And you're bored sitting on top of a trash can, with no one to play with, so you can only entertain yourself playing Gomoku with the board—playing by yourself, which is quite fun.
When you see Spamton arrive, your eyes light up. You shake the chessboard aside, jump off the trash can, and run toward him, grabbing his hand: "Did you find a new photo?" ”
Without hesitation, Spamton handed you the photo—or rather, a movie ticket, with only the image on the back. Curious, you took the colored ticket, then froze. Instinctively, you covered your head, feeling a slight pain and blurred vision. For a moment, you couldn't process what was happening—maybe it was the same as last time. Spamton instinctively supported you. You leaned against Spamton's chest, his body stiff, his eyes darting left and right, but he didn't know what to do.
Just like the last photo, you've recovered part of your memory, at least from after your high school years...... You seem to have figured it all out, but unfortunately, that jar of origami cranes seems to have disappeared in the end. It seems that after you handed it over that day, no one took the jar, nor did it capture your affection. So the jar fell to the ground and shattered, along with your heart. You finally admitted that that figure, that affection, might just be your illusion.
And now, looking at Spamton standing in front of you and holding you, unconsciously, tears streamed down your face. You clearly knew that now he was truly there; compared to that, you felt more like an illusion.
“…… So, are we lovers, spammy? "You sobbed a few times, and finally asked the question with a trembling voice.
And Spamton can't answer your question. In fact, when he hugs you, he feels his chest pounding, but...... He can't clearly say, what is a lover, and what is love? But if it's this feeling of holding you, if the complex emotions flowing in his heart are called love, then he can't deny you.
So in the end, he just shook his head and nodded, his voice a bit dry: "I ...... [I don't know], [system failure], unable to provide a [stable answer]." "He couldn't give a specific answer, nor did he dare to make any promises to you." In fact, at this very moment, he was actually afraid, but even he couldn't explain what he was afraid of.
You lift your head and silently look at him. Spamton instinctively reaches out to wipe the tears from the corner of your eyes: "Maybe ...... [soon] there will be a [definite answer]." ”
He wouldn't dare to say 'definitely to you' either.
"Yeah, I know. After all, it's just a phantom in my memory...... But still, thank you for helping me find this memory, and thank you for walking with me through that embarrassing time." You let go, let go of that embrace, and smiled at him. You only felt a little bit of loss, just a little bit.
"Speaking of which, you helped me recover two memories. So, do you look any different about me now?" As you spoke, you lifted your skirt and spun around in front of him twice, then looked at Spamton with anticipation.
"Your body...... It no longer looks like a "semi-transparent state," but rather a "physical form." "Spamton carefully observed you for a while before giving you this answer. He doesn't know if touching it will make any difference, since he has been able to touch you from beginning to end."
"Is that so? I wonder if the other Dark People will be able to see me...... If they could see me, wouldn't that be a bit boring? "You sighed and shook your head.
"You...... "Preset behavior?" "Spamton was a bit curious, what are you planning to do?"
“…… Hmm, if they couldn't see me, I could tease them a bit more. But if they did, there would be far fewer ways to tease them. "As you spoke, you shrugged, as if talking about something unrelated to yourself. Only Spamton knew how important this matter was to you.
…… If you are no longer invisible in Cyber City, then you will have more possibilities. You will definitely find ways to recover more memories, and perhaps you will find other dark people to help. What about him? Will his life change as well? If he does nothing, will he just watch you walk away? Spamton felt unwilling to accept this. Spamton didn't know what his future would become, but he knew that if he did nothing, nothing would change.
So this time, looking at you, he didn't hesitate but directly expressed his thoughts: "I think...... If a [People of Light] came to my stall to buy goods, it would cause a huge [public opinion effect]. ”
"So what do you mean by ......?" You followed his question and asked.
"What I mean is, come to my [stall] to buy [related goods], and the appearance of the [People of Light] and [goods procurement] can create a [public opinion effect], maybe even change my [class position]." He took a deep breath and spoke the plan he had just come up with. He really ...... The moment he realized your change, he made this decision. Not just to change his own life, but to deepen his entanglement with you. He hoped that the relationship between him and you would become indistinguishable.
He is not an ordinary addison who has achieved nothing; perhaps all addisons are ambitious dark people, but he is willing to seize the opportunity that appears before him and fight hard for it.
You were momentarily stunned, looking at him in disbelief and honestly...... You didn't expect the People of Light to be so important to the People of Darkness. But Spamton had already helped you a lot, and you had no reason not to help him, so you just smiled and nodded in agreement.
"Alright, then I'll just stroll around your shop tomorrow, buy some things, and leave some dark coins. That should be enough, right?" You confirmed his plan with Spamton again. You didn't mind that he was using your identity as a Light Clan to achieve his own goals, after all...... You also used him to achieve your own goals and recover more memories.
It's hard to say whether love or interests are more important at this moment, but either way, neither of you will give up what benefits you. Anyway...... Your future is already tangled at this moment.
Spamton nodded, agreeing with your point, and added a few more words: "And then...... You don't need to be "deliberately," just "spontaneous." "Actually, it doesn't matter what you buy; as long as public opinion is present, that's enough.
You tilted your head, not knowing why he said that, but still nodded. You couldn't leave the commercial street, so you just propped your chin up on the trash can, watching Spamton's back, watching him gradually walk away.
Then you yawn, casually lean against the wall to rest.
The commercial street grew silent as night fell. When you heard the slowly growing noise on the street, you slowly opened your eyes. You knew a new day had begun, and your spot was a blind spot—none of the Darkfolk could see it. You quietly poked your head out to observe them, curious—well, Spamton had already arrived at his shop early.
You fumbled through the remaining dark coins, tidied yourself up, and felt a bit nervous—after all, this was the first time you'd appeared before everyone since your death. Then, Chao casually walked out of the alley and strolled leisurely down the commercial street. All the Addisons, including the other Dark People on the street, stared at you, the suddenly appearing Lightkin, in shock, while you discreetly avoided the touches of passing Dark Folk to prevent them from discovering that your body could pass through.
You just pretend to be an ordinary customer, looking around the shopping street, then stop precisely in front of Spamton's corner shop, casually pick up a vase and start reading.
You and Spamton exchange an understanding glance. He starts smiling and recommends all sorts of things, including but not limited to antiques and daily necessities in his shop, or just some miscellaneous clothes and accessories. After searching for a while, you finally pick up a pretty goldfish-shaped accessory and put it on your head. Satisfied, you hand Spamton a dark coin, then walk away leisurely.
Other than that, you did nothing, and Spamton did nothing. Yet the passing Dark People all saw this scene and began whispering among themselves.
"A Citizen of Light actually visited his shop!"
"I saw it. The things that Light Tribe picked out look pretty nice. Maybe the other items in his shop are pretty nice too."
"Hmm...... Yeah, that shop is way too tucked away. No wonder I didn't notice it before. I have to go check it out. Are you going or not? ”
"I'm going too. I'm tired of browsing other shops...... I wonder if there's anything new or interesting in his shop. ”
For a moment, the Dark People wandering the streets and other Dark People outside the Addison store all gathered at the entrance of Spamton's store. These Addisons were almost twisted from anger, but could only try to keep smiling and continue shouting, hoping that the customers who had gathered at their door would return.
Meanwhile, the entrance of Spamton's shop was packed with people. He was so busy he barely touched the ground, his smile nearly stiffening. He thought, as expected—having you, a citizen of light, make an appearance is the perfect signboard. Although you don't have a physical presence yet, it's enough to at least pretend to be his customer and attract the attention of others.
He watched his sales keep rising, beaming with joy, his smile growing even more.
For several days in a row, Spamton's shop was in this state. Besides the initial Dark People, there were also those who came to join in the celebration after hearing about the Visit of the Light People. During this time, you saw Spamton seem to have answered a phone call. You don't know what they said, but all you know is that Spamton looks very happy. In the following days, the number of Dark People outside the Spamton shop increases, even forming long queues.
You know Spamton is happy. You watch his originally worn-out black short-sleeve shirt change into a refined black suit, and you see several other Addisons staring discontentedly in the direction of Spamton's store. Of course, you're happy for him—after all, you want your friend to be well.
You only have a little, just a little bit of frustration. You really want to talk a few more words with your friends; you miss them a little, and you want to ...... to ask them to reclaim more of their memories, but you watch him smiling and busy with his feet, while you just can't bring yourself to say the words.
Finally, that afternoon, you noticed there weren't many customers at the entrance of his shop. You tidied yourself up, found a spot, and stepped out. Your appearance as a Light Clan immediately drew the attention of other Dark Clowns, while you quietly lined up at the back of the line at Spamton's entrance.
The Dark People ahead were all very fast, probably knowing that you, the Citizen of Light, were there, and there were no other Dark Folk lining up behind you. So, you soon found yourself standing in front of Addison, now dressed in a brand-new black suit, a pure white figure.
He seemed a bit surprised to see you, stammering for a long time without getting the words to go, while you quietly took out a few dark coins and handed them to him, your voice sincere: "These are ...... payment. I hope you can help me find more photos, which are my memories. ”
Spamton was a bit surprised. He pushed your money back and said, "No [in-kind reward] is needed! You and I are already [Friend Added], and I'll provide [free support]. "At this point, he did feel a bit guilty. Although the time to leave after entering the photo doesn't change, there is still time to be spent searching for the photo."
And...... Indeed, he forgot to help you find photos. He's been so busy lately that he almost forgot about you. All he can do is think his sales are rising, and his views are increasing accordingly. He thinks that as long as things keep going like this, he'll eventually become the big shot he once was, just bold and ambitious. But...... But after that, he forgot about you. He couldn't help but feel a bit guilty.
You just shook your head, persisted, and stuffed those few dark coins into Spamton's hand: "Not a reward...... Or you can treat it as a commission fee. Anyway, I hope you'll accept it, because this is a transaction. "You said seriously.
Spamton opened his mouth, his expression complicated. He really didn't know what to do, but inexplicably, he had a feeling that if he accepted these dark coins today, if he treated everything between you as mere transactions, then the friendship he had only recently gained would be broken like this.
So he insisted and returned those few dark coins to you, his expression serious: "I won't charge any [commission fees] or [commission fees]. I will provide you with [free assistance] because you and I are already [added as friends], and I [care deeply] about you. This is sincere." Spamton held your hand, staring at you. You were stunned for a moment, but in the end, you put those dark coins back, speaking with a hint of complaint.
"What? I thought you'd completely forgotten me, so I wanted to use the dark coin to commission you with a task. I think you'll definitely accept it—but turns out you still remember me." You started making sarcastic remarks with a cheerful smile.
Spamton coughed dryly a few times, his gaze shifting slightly: "Yes, 'Never Forget.' I won't charge you any 'silver dollars.'" He said solemnly. Though he had been afraid of the promise before, at this moment, he could say it with ease. He thought maybe it was because he now had the confidence to do so. At the very least, he was no longer the useless Dark Folk he once was.
"Really? That's great. So I can take whatever stuff from your shop as you like?" You tilted your head slightly and began to look over the items in the shop. Although you weren't very interested in these things, some ...... Indeed, they really look pretty good. Maybe I could buy them myself and admire them properly. At worst, I could buy them and resell them to Spamton. You thought somewhat indifferently.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then realized he shouldn't, so he quickly nodded at you: "Yes, you can [take it freely]." ”
He has already taken a chance because of you—he thinks, he really needs to repay you.
TBC.

title: Part 2
content:
These days go on almost every day, yet almost every day is different. At least at Spamton, everything seems to be changing. And for some, this might just be the boring days of <你>elementary school days—except <你>now that I have a friend, life <你>is no longer as dull as before.
<你>They always pull Spamton along to play, which sometimes leads to them being <你><你>punished by standing together, but that's not really the case—after all, they just laugh and joke <你>around and it's gone again. Sometimes, Spamtons give <你>small gifts and <你>return the favor.
For example, this time, Spamton knew <你>that although the class might sometimes be hard to listen to, most of the time it was a good student who took notes, so he specially chose a notebook with hanging paper stars and origami cranes on the cover and gave it to him<你>.
But <你>having never used that notebook before, Spamton, out of curiosity, asked the question he had always asked: "<你>Why not use the [laptop]?" But he could still see the laptop <你>lying on the table.
<你>I tilted my head, thought for a moment, organized my words, then smiled and said, "Because this was a gift from Spamton! I can't bear to use it; if it breaks, that would be bad...... I also want to keep it as a keepsake, since seeing this notebook will remind me of it<你>. ”
I thought of those origami cranes in my dreams, and also of Spamtons in my dreams. Of course, no matter which Spamton, it <你>was the same for them—there was no real difference.
Spamton was taken aback, probably not expecting <你>to say that. He just smiled and said, "But I'll give <你>other [surprise gifts] later, right?" ”
He <你>just shook his head and said seriously, "That's not the same...... The <你>gifts I give in the future have nothing to do with this notebook now, anyway...... Hmm, <你>you'll find out in time. "<你>Scratching his cheek, he suddenly blushed. No matter how much Spamton asked, he refused to tell him, so Spamton had no choice but to give up."
But before he could <你>give him any other gifts, <你>they parted ways.
After all, time seems to move slowly and also seems to pass quickly. <你>We're already in sixth grade, almost graduation, and it's all about to do class regulars and similar things to preserve memories of our classmates.
<你>It was no exception. After all, a couple of days ago, when I passed by a newsstand with Spamton, I <你>took a liking to a really nice classbook and bought it.
That day, he came to school <你>excitedly with the class record, then carefully took down the first page and handed it to Spamton<你>: "It's my best friend. <你>Write it first!" Spamton picked it up and saw that it was exactly the same structure as the class journal he had taken from the shelf. He had a vague feeling that after this day, he might leave the dream built by this memory.
But he still carefully left his information on this classmate book, writing down his name, birthday, hobbies, and dreams—that is, to become a big shot, although it now seems that wish has already come true.
He <你>also tore off a piece of paper from the classmate book, wrote down his information, hesitated for a moment, and handed it to him along with the notebook he had once given him<你>.
Just then, Spamton finished writing this page of the classbook and returned it<你>. Seeing this, he was stunned for a moment, tugged at the corner of his mouth, hesitated for a moment, and asked, "Then...... That [notebook]—is it to be returned? ”
<你>But she just smiled and shook her head, saying mysteriously, "Oh no, that's not it, this is a <你>gift—but <你>you can't open it now to look! At least don't open it in front of me!" ”
Spamton nodded in confusion, <你>still smiling, but tears couldn't help but flow from his eyes. He wiped <你>his cheeks awkwardly, as if he knew what would happen in the future, but with a choked voice, he softly said, "You must...... Remember me forever. The <你>voice was very soft, yet still clearly reached his ears. He took <你>the pages of the classbook and notebook in his hands, wanting to say something more, but suddenly felt dizzy, followed by a sharp pain. Spamton instinctively closed his eyes, since all he saw was a patch of gray. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself still standing in front of that bookshelf, holding the yearbook and the notebook in his hands. The difference was that when he opened the yearbook, he found that the first page contained <你>information, while the second page contained Spamton's information. He was certain this was the one he had just written in his memory.
Spamton was silent for a second, then opened his notebook. Then his eyes widened, and he noticed that every page in the notebook was drawn with him, or playing with him, racking his <你>brains copying homework, standing in the hallway as punishment, and even chasing and playing...... All of these were <你><你>drawn, and then given back to Spamton as gifts.
He silently flipped through the notebook, and honestly, he ...... Some wanted to cry, but he knew that crying when not necessary was useless. Finally, he flipped to the last page of the notebook, and on it was a <你>slightly youthful handwriting: Oh dear...... Thank <你>you for reading to the end! Dedicated to my best, dearest, and most beloved friend, SPAMTON G. SPAMTON.
Spamton stared blankly at the two lines of writing, then finally couldn't hold back and covered his eyes with his other hand, so no Darkfolk would notice he was crying. He quickened his pace, took the two items back to his room, and flipped through his notebook again, barely letting any tears fall onto it.
He solemnly put away the notebook, deciding to take it out whenever he had free time. Then Spamton picked up the classbook and decided to return to the commercial street to hand it over to you. It probably encompasses your entire elementary school memories.
On the way to the commercial street, Spamton also passed by a barbershop. He walked in and had the staff dye his hair black. After all, he was now a thoroughly big shot—how could he still maintain his old image? Not appropriate.
After dying his hair black and giving it a refined look, Spamton happily walked out of the salon, deciding to let you admire his current look as well.
Meanwhile, you are sitting on a trash can, surrounded by those Addisons. After all, the Dark People saw your conversation with Spamton yesterday and told the others. Now, all these Addisons operating in the commercial street now know that there is a suspected soul of the Light Tribe lurking in the alleys of the street.
Pink looked at you and bluntly reached out his hand: "You were the one threatening me a few days ago, weren't you? I demand emotional compensation, and double compensation." ”
You pursed your lips and listened to the amount of Dark Coins he revealed. Where did you get so much money?
Orange also spoke up from the side: "You're deliberately pulling me and yellow down with you...... I still have to settle this score with you." ”
You look at these Addisons and don't feel like they're any easy guys. At this point, you start praying Spamton will come over soon.
Finally, Blue spoke, his voice tinged with worry: "He...... Spamton, I wonder how life is at the Queen's villa? ”
Pink snorted coldly, "Who cares about that guy? He ignored us when business was good before, and now he's even more likely to pretend he doesn't know us at all." ”
Yellow's gaze fell on you: "By the way, so you really are a Citizen of Light, right?" "Anyway, you can only be a Citizen of Light. Why don't you just visit our shop too? We don't want to see that Spamton guy succeed so well." He did smile warmly, while you couldn't help but shiver. You don't know if ghosts shiver, but you did shiver.
Before you could say anything more, you heard a voice you knew very well—it was Spamton's voice. His voice carried a hint of annoyance and confusion: "Are you guys [with unpredictable motives]?" "He seemed to be barely able to speak; you vaguely heard him still gasping heavily, probably rushing over just now.
You turn to look at Spamton, only to see him dyeing his hair black. For a moment, you barely recognize him, and then you hear Pink's mischievous laugh: "You're already a big shot, why are you still coming back to our little shopping street?" "With a hint of anger."
“…… I'm a [big shot], I'm a [successful person]. If you have any dissatisfaction or anger, you can vent it on me. Don't target my [close friends] or 'true love.' Spamton said as he walked over, shoved a classbook into your hand, and then stood in front of you. He was a head shorter than those Addisons, and used to have to timidly lower his head to look at the shadows on the ground. Now, gritting his teeth, he finally lifted his head to look at them.

In the end, he just stared wide-eyed at the ceiling, listening <你>to the shallow breathing on the bed, trying to clear his chaotic and complicated emotions...... Finally, after an unknown amount of time, he slowly closed his eyes and fell asleep.
TBC.

title: up
content:
You sat boredly on a trash can, swinging your legs. This was a remote alley, usually no one passed by, and as for you...... You couldn't remember what was going on. Or rather, you didn't know who you really were or why you were in this place. You only remembered that you seemed to have been sitting there for many days. For you, every day was just looking at that old advertisement posted on the wall across the street, with that blue ...... It seemed to be someone called the Queen, and you could recite the words written on that advertisement backwards.
In short, you only know you sit in the same place every day. You seem unable to get far from this place, because you have searched the entire commercial street, trying to find an exit, but...... You reach the edge but can only touch the wall of air. You cannot, nor can you leave this place. It seems you absolutely cannot leave this place...... This is what your intuition tells you.
…… You don't know what's the point of staying here forever. People on the commercial street can hardly see you. Sometimes you just walk by and sneak away things just thrown away by those addisons—sometimes unfinished barbecue, sometimes ice cream, sometimes ...... Some clothes that can't be sold and look cheaply made.
You enjoy it because no one here can see you; sometimes you swagger past them, watching these addisons, spitting, sweating, and introducing products to others.
You don't quite understand why you don't look much like these people. You also don't understand what you really are.
Most of the time, you sit on a trash can, lost in thought, until you see an Addison you've never seen come to the shopping street. He looks shorter than the other Addisons, and not only that, he's pure white—or rather—a bit translucent. Just looking at him makes you feel a bit closer, since you've even looked at yourself in the puddle during rain—otherwise, how would you know what you look like? In your impression, you seem semi-transparent too, a shadowless person.
So for once, you got a bit more interested, resting your chin on your hand and watching the shopping street, wanting to see what this new Addison would do. But...... Just a few minutes later, that guy who seemed to be called Pink disdainfully poured the coffee in his hand onto White's head. The originally mixed white and semi-transparent color turned coffee, startling you, who quickly jumped out of the trash can.
To be honest, this is the first time you've encountered something like this. Although you don't understand what it is, subconsciously you feel you deeply hate it all. Even if you don't know what it is, looking at the confusion and fear on that white Addison's face, you know this must be something bad. It's uncomfortable, so you have to find a way to stop it.
Before you could figure out what you should do, you saw Pink grab White's collar and raise his fist, clearly trying to vent his anger by treating his subordinate Addison like a human punching bag. Startled, you crawled over and put Orange's clothes on your head, picked up a pot of freshly brewed tea Pink had just brewed in the shop, and prepared to go play tricks and get back at Pink. Anyway, they can't see you, so you can pretend it's haunted. The pot isn't very hot, so pouring cold on Pink's head is just right to refresh and wake him up!
You planned all this, but when you turned around, you saw Pink had already slapped White. His originally white face now had a red handprint, and Pink was raising his hand, seemingly wanting to give him another blow. You quickly propped up the blue skirt and slipped it between the two Addisons. From Pink's perspective, it looked like a blue dress had flown over and blocked his view. Then, you tried hard to stand on tiptoe and poured the pot of tea at Pink.
He let out a sharp crackling sound, running back to his shop with the tea leaves on his head, and even snatched the teapot and the blue skirt away. You seemed to hear Pink and Orange arguing, apparently talking about the blue skirt. Then you watched as Pink reluctantly pulled out a dark coin and gave it to the smug-faced Orange.
You breathe a sigh of relief and plan to go back to the trash can and sit there, doing good deeds without leaving a name, especially since they can't even see you.
Just as you were about to leave, a timid voice rang out: "[Honored Miss], thank you for your generous offer. May I know your name?" ”
He seemed a bit incoherent, speaking anxiously, with a crackling sound of electricity. Even so, you could still understand what he was saying. Because of this, you turned your head in surprise to look at the little Addison in front of you. It was the first time you realized someone could see you.
So you instinctively pointed to yourself: "Are you talking about me?" "You also glanced around. Well, it seemed like there was no one else around here besides you. Probably because Pink was causing trouble here earlier, most people had dispersed."
He nodded without hesitation: "Honored Miss, that's you." ”
"I...... I don't have a name. Ah, I can't say that, I don't know what my name is. "You scratched your head, feeling a bit curious. This was the first time someone had ever seen you and talked to you. To be honest, you were pretty excited.
So you couldn't help but circle around him several times: "By the way, what's your name? Do you know those Addisons? Why are they bullying you? Are you unable to beat them? Why don't they fight back?" And then...... And if you want to open a shop on this commercial street, I can be your bodyguard! Look, I was just trying to scare him earlier, and he immediately ran off because of me. I'm very useful! ”
He looked like he was startled by you, his body stiff, and his expression very tense, but he still seriously answered your questions one by one: 'My [only title] is SPAMTON G.SPAMTON! I... am also a addison, and I have a [dwelling] similar to theirs. Probably because my [sales are zero] and... [body issues]? My [strength is unmatched], and I once tried [self-defense], but only ended up with [double losses]. Lastly... thank you, miss, for your [kind intentions]! But I cannot [award a salary], I... [have zero sales], [no one is interested].' He spoke very quickly as he explained to you, perhaps his education level wasn’t very high? Although it was a bit hard to understand, you could barely grasp what he was saying, though it left you a bit stunned.
After saying these words, he took a few deep breaths, his face flushed from holding back. It seemed that saying those words just now was quite difficult for him.
You quickly shook your head and waved your hand: "I don't need a salary! Even if you pay me, I can't spend it...... As you can see, after all, now only you can see me. Maybe I'm just a ghost!" After saying that, you laughed heartlessly.
Actually, you also want to know who you really are, you want to leave this place, you don't want to stay here forever. Actually, when you say this, your mood feels inexplicably heavy. You just instinctively let yourself smile carefreely.
Spamton looks at you, opens his mouth, hesitates, and finally instinctively reaches out to grab yours. And you widen your eyes because as he moves, you notice your hand slowly turning into a physical form.
You were so scared you pulled your hand back, and then it became semi-transparent again. You breathed a sigh of relief and patted your chest: "You scared me to death. I thought I had turned into a human." "Once you become human, it's not easy to grab things or run around freely. You have to find a place to live, a place to sleep, find something to eat, and spend money to buy clothes."
…… You definitely don't want to live like that, and besides, you don't know anything yet—how are you supposed to go out and find a job!
Spamton slightly raised his head to look at you, seeming somewhat puzzled: "I don't understand, [materialization] has many benefits." "He wanted to repay you, but didn't know how, which is why he said such things."
But you just shook your head seriously: "You don't get it, being a ghost is so much easier! If it materializes, then I'd have to think about a lot every day like you, you see." You pursed your lips and pointed toward Pink and Yellow walking toward you.
Pink probably had already snapped out of his earlier shock. He looked at Spamton and laughed, "Look at you. I told you, poor little rascal, you can't accomplish anything big. You still want to be a big shot, but now you're so crazy you're talking to thin air." ”
Spamton's eyes widened instinctively. He glanced at you, standing nearby with an innocent expression but a bit guilty, then at Pink standing in front of him, took a deep breath, and said, "I'm not in a 'mad state'; she is a real [Dark People]. ”
Yellow laughed too: "There's no other Dark Folk here, just the three of us standing here. Spamton, you're not just a drunken barbecue, are you? Why don't you go smell it in the trash heap and sober up?" ”
Spamton understood. Although he didn't know why, only he could see you; the other Dark People probably couldn't see you.
He took a deep breath and grabbed your hand again. You were watching the show and thinking about how to get these two Addisons to go, only to notice your hand materializing once more.
You blinked, and the hand you touched appeared in the air—for those two Addisons, it was a ghost hand suddenly appearing in the air.
Spamton just blinked innocently: "Hmm...... I said the person beside me is [real] and the evidence is conclusive." "As he spoke, he raised that hand.
Pink's expression stiffened. He poked yellow with his hand, his voice trembling slightly: "See, I told you there must be some hauntings next to Spamton, and you still don't believe me? You insist on having me confront you together." ”
Yellow didn't dare either: "What are you talking about, pink?" Wasn't it just now that you said you were upset by Spamton's counterattack and insisted on coming over to help you find a scene? Now I'm getting shot right in the middle, right? ”
You hesitated for a moment, saw the two Addisons arguing so fiercely, and decided to add fuel to the fire. So you leaned in and pressed your cheek against Spamton's. His face was icy cold, so much so that you, the cold ghost, couldn't help but shiver. Then you smiled and said to them, "Nice to meet them." ”
In their eyes, it was just a person with only half a face and a hand greeting them. Pink's teeth chattered, but he still dragged Yellow back and returned in defeat.
You found it interesting, turned to look at Spamton, and for some reason his cheeks flushed: "Do you get bullied by them all the time? Don't worry, as long as you're here on the shopping street, I won't let you get bullied!" You patted your chest as you spoke.
"What about the [Exploration Area] outside the [Shopping Street]?" He knew he shouldn't have that much curiosity, but he couldn't help but ask.
You pretended to be troubled, resting your chin on your hand and thinking for a moment: "Hmm...... But I've tried, I can't leave the commercial street. I remember...... This should be called an Earthbound Spirit? "You're not really sure, because you don't have much memory. Just now, the word 'Earthbound Spirit' just happened to pop into your mind.
"Speaking of which, what exactly are the People of Darkness? Aren't we all human?" As you spoke, you poked Spamton's cheek, a bit curious. After all...... You really don't know what this is. Ever since you woke up, you've been stuck here.
"...... [Honored Miss], don't you know about the [People of Darkness]?" He was also swept off the topic by you, looking at you in disbelief.
You stick out your tongue, a little embarrassed: "I really don't know...... I have no idea what kind of place this is, who am I, why am I here, or what do I need to do? ”
As you spoke, you reached out your finger again, poking his soft, slightly fluffy face again and again. Your fingers also flashed again and again, which was quite amusing.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then helplessly grabbed your hand and held it in his hand. Then you reached out with your other hand to poke him, and his other hand grabbed yours too. Now you were executed on the spot, puffing out your cheeks and looking at Spamton.
He cleared his throat. Although he felt a bit guilty, he pretended not to notice your angry expression and continued to himself, "Ahem...... The [People of Darkness] are objects that reflect the existence of [Light] in the midst of [extreme darkness]. The [People of Light] are ordinary beings that exist in the [Artificial World]. This world is the [Dark World], called the [Cyber World], a [world] constructed by the ruler [Queen]. This place is part of the [Cyber World]. ”
You listen carefully to what he finishes, and after Spamton's finish, his eyes sparkle as he looks at you. You smack your lips, trying hard to understand what he means, so you respond with a hum.
He replied with a 'hmm', still staring at you with sparkling eyes, eagerly awaiting your next answer.
"I didn't understand." You honestly shook your head. Honestly, this passage is a bit abstract, and it's normal for you not to understand.
Spamton sighed, his head drooping, looking quite disappointed. You couldn't help but break free from your hand, went up to pat his head, and after racking your brain, said, "I really didn't understand...... But I'm not saying you said it badly! It's just that I really haven't seen those so-called Lightfolk either......
"The People of Light are the objects of the [People of Darkness]'s pursuit, the users of the [Avatars of the Dark People], and the monsters and humans of [flesh and blood.'" Spamton tried to break down the meaning and explain it to you again.
You scratched your head, still a bit confused: "Are the bodies of the Dark People different?" ”
He nodded: "The [Dark People] do not have [true flesh and blood]. ”
You don't know exactly what the body structure of the Dark People looks like, and you can't have Spamton cut off a piece for you to study now, so you have to awkwardly change the subject.
"Then do you think I'm a Dark Clan or a Clan of Light?"
This time, Spamton sized you up for a long time, looking at you from head to toe. You cleared your throat twice, feeling a bit embarrassed by the stares.
“…… You should be the [People of Darkness]; you don't have [Unique Light] or [Heart-shaped Objects]. But you are an unprecedented [Human Type] of the [People of Darkness], only among the [People of Light] are humans." He said, frowning, clearly unable to figure out what exactly you should be regarded as.
You cough twice: "So you don't know?" ”
He nodded honestly, then asked, "[Honored Miss], you don't have any [reference answer] at all?" ”
“…… I don't know. I've always stayed here. I thought...... I'm just like those others—no, the Dark People." "You slumped your shoulders in despair, and now you have no idea who you really are.
"Not a single [clues]?" Spamton asked again. He didn't think that for a person, they would have no status at all.
You scratched your head: "Ah...... As for clues, I think there's a bit of it." "By now, you've gotten used to Spamton's slightly odd way of speaking—you're quite accustomed to it." You fumbled around and pulled out a black-and-white photo from your pocket. It was your profile picture—black and white, or maybe a memorial portrait to be more accurate.
"When I woke up, this was by my side, and only this was left. It was just a photo......" As you spoke, your voice quieted, since there were no other clues besides that.
Your face is printed on the photo, expressionless, and the black-and-white portrait leaves only a trace of sorrow.
“…… Maybe this represents a [death declaration]." Spamton said. After all, the black-and-white photo ...... still looks like this kind of expression, looking like a memorial portrait.
He reached out to take the photo and take a look, but just as he did, a black-and-white vortex appeared from the photo. Spamton was powerless to resist, feeling dizzy and swept into the vortex. You stared blankly at the scene, and only a blank photo fell from the spot. You didn't know what had happened. You just nervously picked up the photo and sat dazed on top of the trash can, staring blankly at the photo.
TBC.
This scene is quite a bit of personal bias...... And 'you' is used to refer to you in the dream, though I forgot to add it in some places.
—
As for Spamton—he dazedly passed through the whirlpool, then his entire Addison lay face down on the cold floor, dizzy for quite a while before finally coming to his senses. The small white Addison slowly climbed up from the floor, brushed off the dust on his clothes, and after trying hard to identify for a while, finally vaguely realized—he seemed to have somehow arrived in the world of light.
But how did a Dark Citizen suddenly come to the world of light? In the world of light, shouldn't he just be a junk mail? No consciousness, no form of self—but the cold wind struck his face, making Spamton's dizzy head clear again. He patted his cheek, finally snapping back to reality, and only then noticed his position—he was on a towering rooftop, so close it seemed he could touch the moon directly. He had never seen the moon in the dark world before.
Spamton stared in a daze, until he heard faint footsteps and snapped back to reality. Instinctively, he looked toward the source of the sound—the edge of the rooftop. Only then did he notice a girl standing at the edge of the rooftop, precarious and on the verge of collapse.
Spamton instinctively glanced down from the rooftop. The building was so tall that he felt a bit scared. He had never climbed to such a high place before, so wouldn't that girl feel scared standing there?
But—but, he raised his hand to look, but he didn't feel ...... He could pull the girl back from the stairs who might fall, but when he saw the girl spread her arms and fall toward the bottom of the rooftop, Spamton couldn't help but rush forward and reach out to grab the girl. It was only then that he realized the girl was ...... exactly the same as the one he had seen earlier.
Spamton didn't know what was going on. He just looked at [you] in silence for a moment before quietly asking, "What's the reason for your [behavioral patterns]?" ”
[You] tilted her head, not quite understanding what he was saying, but you still roughly understood what he meant, so [you] just tried to give him a faint smile—even though it didn't even look like a smile, at least in Spamton's eyes, it was just a smile tinged with sadness and tears.
His hand still tightly held onto [your], but the difference in strength was still overwhelming. Perhaps sweat had formed from nervousness in his palm, and [your] hand slowly descended.
“…… There's no particular reason, I just feel that this world has lost all meaning...... I've tried, it's all the same, and no one cares about me, so even if I leave this world, I won't have any attachments...... As you spoke, tears couldn't help but flow from your eyes, dropping one by one. Spamton opened his mouth, but didn't know what to say.
"I—I still care about you, [very much], so please hold on a little longer—" He didn't know what to do. Seeing that [you] had lost the will to survive, he said these words in a panic, and only after saying them did he feel a bit guilty. He ...... We've only known you for a few hours. Although he was grateful to you, he didn't really care that much.
But it's not that he doesn't care at all—at least he's now trying hard to pull your hand upward. Though he doesn't know exactly what happened, he can't just stand by and watch his savior die. It was only then in the dim night that he barely caught sight of the scars on your arm—some blue, some purple, some old, some new...... He hadn't seen anything on you now. Could it be that everything disappears after death?
[You] were stunned for a moment, then unusually burst out laughing: "I don't even know you...... You probably don't know me either. You don't have to say something like that just to save me, I know...... This might not be true. "In the end, all that remained was a murmured murmur while Spamton stared at you in a daze.
He instinctively asked, "Then ...... [your name]?" I ...... I am "sincerely." I will not [give up]. ”
"My name...... Y/N, hmm, but that doesn't matter anymore. You fell just to pull me, and it's not worth it. I don't want to lose another person's life because of me. "[You] tried hard to keep smiling, but couldn't help but sob, reaching out to pry Spamton's fingers apart. As [You] struggled, [your] body slowly sank.
Spamton tries hard to pull you up, but no matter how hard he tries, there's no way. Besides, [you] smile and willingly sink down.
"But, but—" He wanted to say that his life wasn't that important, after all, he was just an inconspicuous, small Addison in Cyber City. It didn't matter if he risked his life for [you], especially since you had truly saved him. He knew—
Yet, he could only watch helplessly as [your] fingers slipped away bit by bit. In the end, Spamton reached out and tried hard to touch yours, but it was all in vain.
Spamton could only watch helplessly as you fell, slowly leaning back, finally turning head-down, and finally...... He hadn't seen clearly, only feeling his vision blur. He returned to his previous spot on the rooftop, and that girl—you—was still standing there, as if the next second you would spread your arms and fall down.
Spamton's eyes that had been narrowing widened instantly. He rushed over, hugged [your]'s waist, and stammered, "You—you need to change your [Behavior Pattern Plan]." ”
[You] had been prepared, but suddenly reached out with both hands and hugged [you]. [You] heard a strange voice and was startled, losing her balance and about to fall forward. The guy behind her struggled to hold you around the waist and then pulled you firmly to the ground.
"I'm just jumping off a building, don't meddle in other people......" [You] mumbled, though she said that though she was a bit guilty. After all, jumping off a building isn't a trivial matter; it's something [you] made after careful consideration.
“…… It's not just [that]. I care about you, so please [survive]." If last time he said this feeling a bit guilty, this time he lied without blinking and said it out loud.
Maybe a lie can come true a thousand or ten thousand times over? He didn't know.
“…… Do you care about me? I don't even know who you are, and do you know me?" [You] blinked, feeling a bit amused, but also inexplicably wanting to cry. Even a stranger can show you kindness...... Why do people close only hurt you? Is it because you're close that you're numb, or because you're close, you take it for granted? You can't tell.
Well, although he doesn't look very human, he should be a monster.
After all, no human would look like this.
Spamton blinked and said, "I know you! Your name is Y/N! ”
He was a bit nervous. He only knew your name. He didn't know your preferences, what you're good at, your taste, or everything about you. But right now, all he could do was take a gamble.
“…… You actually know my name? Then do you know anything else?" [You] raised an eyebrow. At that moment, [you] had already decided: if he knew anything else, [you] would treat him like a stalker. If he knew nothing—then you would suspect he secretly followed after learning [yours]'s name.
Spamton's face flushed bright red. He truly knew nothing and could only shake his head repeatedly: "I didn't have [access permission], so I don't understand [extras]." ”
[You] looked at his flushed face and found it oddly novel, so you went up and poked him twice: "Hmm...... Alright, then who are you? "[You] had no impression of this person at all, but the way he seemed to recognize you made you start to wonder if you'd heard his name before. After all, [yours] social circle is still quite narrow.
Honestly, it was quite fun. His cheeks felt soft and a bit fuzzy, and for some reason a bit cool—perfect for holding him in summer to cool down. Then [you] coughed dryly twice, shaking the thought out of your mind. You really have nothing to do with him......
“SPAMTON G. SPAMTON！” He answered your question with full energy, his eyes sparkling for some reason, as if he was expecting something, but no matter how hard you thought about it, you couldn't figure out what the owner of this name had to do with you. After all, [you] had never even heard of that name.
[You] could only smile apologetically at him: "Sorry, I've never heard that name, nor have I met you, so who exactly are you?" ”
Spamton racked his brains; at this point, it seems he can only make up a story for you; otherwise, you won't believe him no matter what.
So he said, "I...... I am engaged in [sales service]! I am just a humble [salesperson], a [postman]...... I once received [your favor], so I want to repay you. ”
You pause, in your impression, have you really never helped such a character...... Or have you just forgotten? But none of that matters anymore.
[You] just smiled and shook her head: "Ah...... I don't remember, so maybe it's not that important. Is it worth remembering all the time? ”
This time, the little white salesman nodded vigorously: "Worth it, [absolutely worth it], that move changed the fate of playing." ”
Without you, he might just willingly but still endure the bullying of other addisons, since he can't fight back, and even if he does, it won't end better.
"Ah...... Is it really that important? Then thank you for always caring about me. "[You] smiled, then looked at him hesitantly. To be honest, [you]...... It was the first time I realized someone would remember your small kindness. You thought everyone was pretty much the same, just born numb and dying numb, and after more than ten years of being numb, you could only make this choice right now.
So [you] are a bit hesitant now; [you] don't want those who care about you to be sad or regretful because of you. Even if life is numb, maybe you can still hold on a little longer. Because...... At least, [you] seem to be the reason this little guy in front of you exists.
So you stand up, brush off your dusty clothes, and smile: "I've decided not to die today. If I die in this weather...... It won't look very pretty. Maybe I'll wait until next winter. ”
Spamton was taken aback. It was only then that he realized the wind brushing his cheek was a bit hot, and then, as if belatedly, he realized he might be sweating all over. Ah, so it's summer now.
"Oh...... Oh! Okay! "Spamton nodded instinctively.
Just when you thought it was all over, the rooftop door suddenly burst open with a loud bang, and a scruffy, flushed-faced man walked in. He was still holding a beer bottle, looking like he'd had too much to drink, and his body was swaying as he walked toward [you].
Although he didn't know exactly what was going on, Spamton instinctively stepped in front of you, even though his body was trembling. You looked at him with a complicated expression. To be honest, of course [you] knew exactly what [your] father was doing at this moment—probably to see if you were really dead. If he did, he would even feign a whine, crying to win the sympathy of the relatives.
So at this moment, the man just stepped forward and slapped Spamton away: "Where did this come from...... Little thing, burp, don't get in the way! ”
He shouted, trying to pull Spamton aside, but Spamton could only do his best to block his way, knowing this man would probably treat you badly.
"Behind you...... Um, hiccup, it's my daughter. Be sensible, don't get in my way...... Burp, handle the housework, understand?! ”
This time, the man raised a beer bottle, about to smash it on Spamton's head. [You] frowned deeply and pulled Spamton, who was so unguarded against you, to hide behind you.
"Dad, if you have something, just come at me. He's not part of your family. Hitting him is illegal." You took a deep breath and said. Although hitting you is also illegal, it is usually treated as a family matter.
"Ha! My dear daughter...... Didn't you say you were going to die? Then go die! Why are you still standing here? "His attack was immediately diverted, and he even gave you a fierce shove. You staggered, and Spamton hurriedly helped you steady yourself. Even so, you couldn't help but take two more steps toward the edge of the rooftop.
“…… Are you really going to let me die? Spamton stood behind you. He couldn't see your expression, but he could still hear your slightly trembling voice. He couldn't help but feel flustered—he had finally pulled you back from the brink of jumping, but would you still choose to do so?
"Isn't that what you think? Huh?! If you think life is meaningless, then just go die? Go jump off a building? Do you want me to send you to your death?! "As he spoke, the man gave you another hard push. There were no railings or handrails on the rooftop, so you all took two more steps toward the edge, precarious.
"......" Spamton realized you were silent, just crying, sobbing silently, while the man raised his hand, about to slap down. He hurriedly stepped in front of you, reaching out but unable to catch it, letting the slap fall on himself.
[You] widened your eyes, your mouth twitching slightly. Honestly, you thought...... He would leave just now, and you were prepared. At that moment, even if you were pushed down and died, it wouldn't matter. It's just a bit of a pity for this little guy who said you saved him and cared about you. He would probably cry bitterly for you.
"Why is it you again, you little rascal? I told you not to get in the way, don't get in the way!" The man irritably shoved Spamton, who was already close to the side. Spamton instinctively took two steps back, then missed his foot. His eyes widened as he realized he was falling.
However, [you] grabbed him, anxiously trying to pull him upward. Spamton shook his head; after all, he was just a Dark Citizen...... As long as the item was fixed, he could return, so he wanted to tell you not to worry about him. But when it came to the moment, he didn't know how to explain the Dark World to you.
The man also came over and kicked [you] hard: "You still want to save him? Then I'll grant you two miserable lovers' wishes. Anyway, you don't want to live anymore." His malicious words reached your ears, while [You] frowned, enduring the pain, your arm trembling. Looking at the scars on your arm, he felt even more upset, but right now, he could do nothing.
Your body was also sinking bit by bit. Your father laughed heartily while recklessly kicking you down. Finally, [you] also fell off the rooftop, grabbing Spamton's hand together.
Tears fell into the air, your voice torn apart by the howling wind. You looked at Spamton with a bitter smile and shouted loudly, "Sorry, I dragged you down too—"
Spamton just instinctively shook his head. During the descent, he felt dizzy again, closed his eyes uncomfortably, and when he opened them again, he was sitting foolishly on the cyber city floor, while you were sitting on a trash can, propping up your chin and borely, swinging your legs as you watched him.
"Welcome back, Spamton—hey, how did this photo turn into color?" You had just greeted him when you noticed the blank photo you had been holding in your hand had appeared in Spamton's hand, and the colored strokes were slowly appearing. Slowly, it gradually turned into a color photo, and it looked ...... About the same age as you are now, just with a sincere smile, different from the previous black-and-white photo.
Spamton rubbed his temples. Hearing this, he instinctively glanced at the photo in his hand, then shook his head: "I don't know......"

Even if you don't know what it is, looking at the confusion and fear on that white Addison's face, you know this must be something bad. It's uncomfortable, so you have to find a way to stop it.
Before you could figure out what you should do, you saw Pink grab White's collar and raise his fist, clearly trying to vent his anger by treating his subordinate Addison like a human punching bag. Startled, you crawled over and put Orange's clothes on your head, picked up a pot of freshly brewed tea Pink had just brewed in the shop, and prepared to go play tricks and get back at Pink. Anyway, they can't see you, so you can pretend it's haunted. The pot isn't very hot, so pouring cold on Pink's head is just right to refresh and wake him up!
You planned all this, but when you turned around, you saw Pink had already slapped White. His originally white face now had a red handprint, and Pink was raising his hand, seemingly wanting to give him another blow. You quickly propped up the blue skirt and slipped it between the two Addisons. From Pink's perspective, it looked like a blue dress had flown over and blocked his view. Then, you tried hard to stand on tiptoe and poured the pot of tea at Pink.
He let out a sharp crackling sound, running back to his shop with the tea leaves on his head, and even snatched the teapot and the blue skirt away. You seemed to hear Pink and Orange arguing, apparently talking about the blue skirt. Then you watched as Pink reluctantly pulled out a dark coin and gave it to the smug-faced Orange.
You breathe a sigh of relief and plan to go back to the trash can and sit there, doing good deeds without leaving a name, especially since they can't even see you.
Just as you were about to leave, a timid voice rang out: "[Honored Miss], thank you for your generous offer. May I know your name?" ”
He seemed a bit incoherent, speaking anxiously, with a crackling sound of electricity. Even so, you could still understand what he was saying. Because of this, you turned your head in surprise to look at the little Addison in front of you. It was the first time you realized someone could see you.
So you instinctively pointed to yourself: "Are you talking about me?" "You also glanced around. Well, it seemed like there was no one else around here besides you. Probably because Pink was causing trouble here earlier, most people had dispersed."
He nodded without hesitation: "Honored Miss, that's you." ”
"I...... I don't have a name. Ah, I can't say that, I don't know what my name is. "You scratched your head, feeling a bit curious. This was the first time someone had ever seen you and talked to you. To be honest, you were pretty excited.
So you couldn't help but circle around him several times: "By the way, what's your name? Do you know those Addisons? Why are they bullying you? Are you unable to beat them? Why don't they fight back?" And then...... And if you want to open a shop on this commercial street, I can be your bodyguard! Look, I was just trying to scare him earlier, and he immediately ran off because of me. I'm very useful! ”
He looked like he was startled by you, his body stiff, and his expression very tense, but he still seriously answered your questions one by one: 'My [only title] is SPAMTON G.SPAMTON! I... am also a addison, and I have a [dwelling] similar to theirs. Probably because my [sales are zero] and... [body issues]? My [strength is unmatched], and I once tried [self-defense], but only ended up with [double losses]. Lastly... thank you, miss, for your [kind intentions]! But I cannot [award a salary], I... [have zero sales], [no one is interested].' He spoke very quickly as he explained to you, perhaps his education level wasn’t very high? Although it was a bit hard to understand, you could barely grasp what he was saying, though it left you a bit stunned.
After saying these words, he took a few deep breaths, his face flushed from holding back. It seemed that saying those words just now was quite difficult for him.
You quickly shook your head and waved your hand: "I don't need a salary! Even if you pay me, I can't spend it...... As you can see, after all, now only you can see me. Maybe I'm just a ghost!" After saying that, you laughed heartlessly.
Actually, you also want to know who you really are, you want to leave this place, you don't want to stay here forever. Actually, when you say this, your mood feels inexplicably heavy. You just instinctively let yourself smile carefreely.
Spamton looks at you, opens his mouth, hesitates, and finally instinctively reaches out to grab yours. And you widen your eyes because as he moves, you notice your hand slowly turning into a physical form.
You were so scared you pulled your hand back, and then it became semi-transparent again. You breathed a sigh of relief and patted your chest: "You scared me to death. I thought I had turned into a human." "Once you become human, it's not easy to grab things or run around freely. You have to find a place to live, a place to sleep, find something to eat, and spend money to buy clothes."
…… You definitely don't want to live like that, and besides, you don't know anything yet—how are you supposed to go out and find a job!
Spamton slightly raised his head to look at you, seeming somewhat puzzled: "I don't understand, [materialization] has many benefits." "He wanted to repay you, but didn't know how, which is why he said such things."
But you just shook your head seriously: "You don't get it, being a ghost is so much easier! If it materializes, then I'd have to think about a lot every day like you, you see." You pursed your lips and pointed toward Pink and Yellow walking toward you.
Pink probably had already snapped out of his earlier shock. He looked at Spamton and laughed, "Look at you. I told you, poor little rascal, you can't accomplish anything big. You still want to be a big shot, but now you're so crazy you're talking to thin air." ”
Spamton's eyes widened instinctively. He glanced at you, standing nearby with an innocent expression but a bit guilty, then at Pink standing in front of him, took a deep breath, and said, "I'm not in a 'mad state'; she is a real [Dark People]. ”
Yellow laughed too: "There's no other Dark Folk here, just the three of us standing here. Spamton, you're not just a drunken barbecue, are you? Why don't you go smell it in the trash heap and sober up?" ”
Spamton understood. Although he didn't know why, only he could see you; the other Dark People probably couldn't see you.
He took a deep breath and grabbed your hand again. You were watching the show and thinking about how to get these two Addisons to go, only to notice your hand materializing once more.
You blinked, and the hand you touched appeared in the air—for those two Addisons, it was a ghost hand suddenly appearing in the air.
Spamton just blinked innocently: "Hmm...... I said the person beside me is [real] and the evidence is conclusive." "As he spoke, he raised that hand.
Pink's expression stiffened. He poked yellow with his hand, his voice trembling slightly: "See, I told you there must be some hauntings next to Spamton, and you still don't believe me? You insist on having me confront you together." ”
Yellow didn't dare either: "What are you talking about, pink?" Wasn't it just now that you said you were upset by Spamton's counterattack and insisted on coming over to help you find a scene? Now I'm getting shot right in the middle, right? ”
You hesitated for a moment, saw the two Addisons arguing so fiercely, and decided to add fuel to the fire. So you leaned in and pressed your cheek against Spamton's. His face was icy cold, so much so that you, the cold ghost, couldn't help but shiver. Then you smiled and said to them, "Nice to meet them." ”
In their eyes, it was just a person with only half a face and a hand greeting them. Pink's teeth chattered, but he still dragged Yellow back and returned in defeat.
You found it interesting, turned to look at Spamton, and for some reason his cheeks flushed: "Do you get bullied by them all the time? Don't worry, as long as you're here on the shopping street, I won't let you get bullied!" You patted your chest as you spoke.
"What about the [Exploration Area] outside the [Shopping Street]?" He knew he shouldn't have that much curiosity, but he couldn't help but ask.
You pretended to be troubled, resting your chin on your hand and thinking for a moment: "Hmm...... But I've tried, I can't leave the commercial street. I remember...... This should be called an Earthbound Spirit? "You're not really sure, because you don't have much memory. Just now, the word 'Earthbound Spirit' just happened to pop into your mind.
"Speaking of which, what exactly are the People of Darkness? Aren't we all human?" As you spoke, you poked Spamton's cheek, a bit curious. After all...... You really don't know what this is. Ever since you woke up, you've been stuck here.
"...... [Honored Miss], don't you know about the [People of Darkness]?" He was also swept off the topic by you, looking at you in disbelief.
You stick out your tongue, a little embarrassed: "I really don't know...... I have no idea what kind of place this is, who am I, why am I here, or what do I need to do? ”
As you spoke, you reached out your finger again, poking his soft, slightly fluffy face again and again. Your fingers also flashed again and again, which was quite amusing.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, then helplessly grabbed your hand and held it in his hand. Then you reached out with your other hand to poke him, and his other hand grabbed yours too. Now you were executed on the spot, puffing out your cheeks and looking at Spamton.
He cleared his throat. Although he felt a bit guilty, he pretended not to notice your angry expression and continued to himself, "Ahem...... The [People of Darkness] are objects that reflect the existence of [Light] in the midst of [extreme darkness]. The [People of Light] are ordinary beings that exist in the [Artificial World]. This world is the [Dark World], called the [Cyber World], a [world] constructed by the ruler [Queen]. This place is part of the [Cyber World]. ”
You listen carefully to what he finishes, and after Spamton's finish, his eyes sparkle as he looks at you. You smack your lips, trying hard to understand what he means, so you respond with a hum.
He replied with a 'hmm', still staring at you with sparkling eyes, eagerly awaiting your next answer.
"I didn't understand." You honestly shook your head. Honestly, this passage is a bit abstract, and it's normal for you not to understand.
Spamton sighed, his head drooping, looking quite disappointed. You couldn't help but break free from your hand, went up to pat his head, and after racking your brain, said, "I really didn't understand...... But I'm not saying you said it badly! It's just that I really haven't seen those so-called Lightfolk either......
"The People of Light are the objects of the [People of Darkness]'s pursuit, the users of the [Avatars of the Dark People], and the monsters and humans of [flesh and blood.'" Spamton tried to break down the meaning and explain it to you again.
You scratched your head, still a bit confused: "Are the bodies of the Dark People different?" ”
He nodded: "The [Dark People] do not have [true flesh and blood]. ”
You don't know exactly what the body structure of the Dark People looks like, and you can't have Spamton cut off a piece for you to study now, so you have to awkwardly change the subject.
"Then do you think I'm a Dark Clan or a Clan of Light?"
This time, Spamton sized you up for a long time, looking at you from head to toe. You cleared your throat twice, feeling a bit embarrassed by the stares.
“…… You should be the [People of Darkness]; you don't have [Unique Light] or [Heart-shaped Objects]. But you are an unprecedented [Human Type] of the [People of Darkness], only among the [People of Light] are humans." He said, frowning, clearly unable to figure out what exactly you should be regarded as.
You cough twice: "So you don't know?" ”
He nodded honestly, then asked, "[Honored Miss], you don't have any [reference answer] at all?" ”
“…… I don't know. I've always stayed here. I thought...... I'm just like those others—no, the Dark People." "You slumped your shoulders in despair, and now you have no idea who you really are.
"Not a single [clues]?" Spamton asked again. He didn't think that for a person, they would have no status at all.
You scratched your head: "Ah...... As for clues, I think there's a bit of it." "By now, you've gotten used to Spamton's slightly odd way of speaking—you're quite accustomed to it." You fumbled around and pulled out a black-and-white photo from your pocket. It was your profile picture—black and white, or maybe a memorial portrait to be more accurate.
"When I woke up, this was by my side, and only this was left. It was just a photo......" As you spoke, your voice quieted, since there were no other clues besides that.
Your face is printed on the photo, expressionless, and the black-and-white portrait leaves only a trace of sorrow.
“…… Maybe this represents a [death declaration]." Spamton said. After all, the black-and-white photo ...... still looks like this kind of expression, looking like a memorial portrait.
He reached out to take the photo and take a look, but just as he did, a black-and-white vortex appeared from the photo. Spamton was powerless to resist, feeling dizzy and swept into the vortex. You stared blankly at the scene, and only a blank photo fell from the spot. You didn't know what had happened. You just nervously picked up the photo and sat dazed on top of the trash can, staring blankly at the photo.
TBC.

title: Dark World Bound Spirit 2 (sptx you)
