content:
This scene is quite a bit of personal bias...... And 'you' is used to refer to you in the dream, though I forgot to add it in some places.
—
As for Spamton—he dazedly passed through the whirlpool, then his entire Addison lay face down on the cold floor, dizzy for quite a while before finally coming to his senses. The small white Addison slowly climbed up from the floor, brushed off the dust on his clothes, and after trying hard to identify for a while, finally vaguely realized—he seemed to have somehow arrived in the world of light.
But how did a Dark Citizen suddenly come to the world of light? In the world of light, shouldn't he just be a junk mail? No consciousness, no form of self—but the cold wind struck his face, making Spamton's dizzy head clear again. He patted his cheek, finally snapping back to reality, and only then noticed his position—he was on a towering rooftop, so close it seemed he could touch the moon directly. He had never seen the moon in the dark world before.
Spamton stared in a daze, until he heard faint footsteps and snapped back to reality. Instinctively, he looked toward the source of the sound—the edge of the rooftop. Only then did he notice a girl standing at the edge of the rooftop, precarious and on the verge of collapse.
Spamton instinctively glanced down from the rooftop. The building was so tall that he felt a bit scared. He had never climbed to such a high place before, so wouldn't that girl feel scared standing there?
But—but, he raised his hand to look, but he didn't feel ...... He could pull the girl back from the stairs who might fall, but when he saw the girl spread her arms and fall toward the bottom of the rooftop, Spamton couldn't help but rush forward and reach out to grab the girl. It was only then that he realized the girl was ...... exactly the same as the one he had seen earlier.
Spamton didn't know what was going on. He just looked at [you] in silence for a moment before quietly asking, "What's the reason for your [behavioral patterns]?" ”
[You] tilted her head, not quite understanding what he was saying, but you still roughly understood what he meant, so [you] just tried to give him a faint smile—even though it didn't even look like a smile, at least in Spamton's eyes, it was just a smile tinged with sadness and tears.
His hand still tightly held onto [your], but the difference in strength was still overwhelming. Perhaps sweat had formed from nervousness in his palm, and [your] hand slowly descended.
“…… There's no particular reason, I just feel that this world has lost all meaning...... I've tried, it's all the same, and no one cares about me, so even if I leave this world, I won't have any attachments...... As you spoke, tears couldn't help but flow from your eyes, dropping one by one. Spamton opened his mouth, but didn't know what to say.
"I—I still care about you, [very much], so please hold on a little longer—" He didn't know what to do. Seeing that [you] had lost the will to survive, he said these words in a panic, and only after saying them did he feel a bit guilty. He ...... We've only known you for a few hours. Although he was grateful to you, he didn't really care that much.
But it's not that he doesn't care at all—at least he's now trying hard to pull your hand upward. Though he doesn't know exactly what happened, he can't just stand by and watch his savior die. It was only then in the dim night that he barely caught sight of the scars on your arm—some blue, some purple, some old, some new...... He hadn't seen anything on you now. Could it be that everything disappears after death?
[You] were stunned for a moment, then unusually burst out laughing: "I don't even know you...... You probably don't know me either. You don't have to say something like that just to save me, I know...... This might not be true. "In the end, all that remained was a murmured murmur while Spamton stared at you in a daze.
He instinctively asked, "Then ...... [your name]?" I ...... I am "sincerely." I will not [give up]. ”
"My name...... Y/N, hmm, but that doesn't matter anymore. You fell just to pull me, and it's not worth it. I don't want to lose another person's life because of me. "[You] tried hard to keep smiling, but couldn't help but sob, reaching out to pry Spamton's fingers apart. As [You] struggled, [your] body slowly sank.
Spamton tries hard to pull you up, but no matter how hard he tries, there's no way. Besides, [you] smile and willingly sink down.
"But, but—" He wanted to say that his life wasn't that important, after all, he was just an inconspicuous, small Addison in Cyber City. It didn't matter if he risked his life for [you], especially since you had truly saved him. He knew—
Yet, he could only watch helplessly as [your] fingers slipped away bit by bit. In the end, Spamton reached out and tried hard to touch yours, but it was all in vain.
Spamton could only watch helplessly as you fell, slowly leaning back, finally turning head-down, and finally...... He hadn't seen clearly, only feeling his vision blur. He returned to his previous spot on the rooftop, and that girl—you—was still standing there, as if the next second you would spread your arms and fall down.
Spamton's eyes that had been narrowing widened instantly. He rushed over, hugged [your]'s waist, and stammered, "You—you need to change your [Behavior Pattern Plan]." ”
[You] had been prepared, but suddenly reached out with both hands and hugged [you]. [You] heard a strange voice and was startled, losing her balance and about to fall forward. The guy behind her struggled to hold you around the waist and then pulled you firmly to the ground.
"I'm just jumping off a building, don't meddle in other people......" [You] mumbled, though she said that though she was a bit guilty. After all, jumping off a building isn't a trivial matter; it's something [you] made after careful consideration.
“…… It's not just [that]. I care about you, so please [survive]." If last time he said this feeling a bit guilty, this time he lied without blinking and said it out loud.
Maybe a lie can come true a thousand or ten thousand times over? He didn't know.
“…… Do you care about me? I don't even know who you are, and do you know me?" [You] blinked, feeling a bit amused, but also inexplicably wanting to cry. Even a stranger can show you kindness...... Why do people close only hurt you? Is it because you're close that you're numb, or because you're close, you take it for granted? You can't tell.
Well, although he doesn't look very human, he should be a monster.
After all, no human would look like this.
Spamton blinked and said, "I know you! Your name is Y/N! ”
He was a bit nervous. He only knew your name. He didn't know your preferences, what you're good at, your taste, or everything about you. But right now, all he could do was take a gamble.
“…… You actually know my name? Then do you know anything else?" [You] raised an eyebrow. At that moment, [you] had already decided: if he knew anything else, [you] would treat him like a stalker. If he knew nothing—then you would suspect he secretly followed after learning [yours]'s name.
Spamton's face flushed bright red. He truly knew nothing and could only shake his head repeatedly: "I didn't have [access permission], so I don't understand [extras]." ”
[You] looked at his flushed face and found it oddly novel, so you went up and poked him twice: "Hmm...... Alright, then who are you? "[You] had no impression of this person at all, but the way he seemed to recognize you made you start to wonder if you'd heard his name before. After all, [yours] social circle is still quite narrow.
Honestly, it was quite fun. His cheeks felt soft and a bit fuzzy, and for some reason a bit cool—perfect for holding him in summer to cool down. Then [you] coughed dryly twice, shaking the thought out of your mind. You really have nothing to do with him......
“SPAMTON G. SPAMTON！” He answered your question with full energy, his eyes sparkling for some reason, as if he was expecting something, but no matter how hard you thought about it, you couldn't figure out what the owner of this name had to do with you. After all, [you] had never even heard of that name.
[You] could only smile apologetically at him: "Sorry, I've never heard that name, nor have I met you, so who exactly are you?" ”
Spamton racked his brains; at this point, it seems he can only make up a story for you; otherwise, you won't believe him no matter what.
So he said, "I...... I am engaged in [sales service]! I am just a humble [salesperson], a [postman]...... I once received [your favor], so I want to repay you. ”
You pause, in your impression, have you really never helped such a character...... Or have you just forgotten? But none of that matters anymore.
[You] just smiled and shook her head: "Ah...... I don't remember, so maybe it's not that important. Is it worth remembering all the time? ”
This time, the little white salesman nodded vigorously: "Worth it, [absolutely worth it], that move changed the fate of playing." ”
Without you, he might just willingly but still endure the bullying of other addisons, since he can't fight back, and even if he does, it won't end better.
"Ah...... Is it really that important? Then thank you for always caring about me. "[You] smiled, then looked at him hesitantly. To be honest, [you]...... It was the first time I realized someone would remember your small kindness. You thought everyone was pretty much the same, just born numb and dying numb, and after more than ten years of being numb, you could only make this choice right now.
So [you] are a bit hesitant now; [you] don't want those who care about you to be sad or regretful because of you. Even if life is numb, maybe you can still hold on a little longer. Because...... At least, [you] seem to be the reason this little guy in front of you exists.
So you stand up, brush off your dusty clothes, and smile: "I've decided not to die today. If I die in this weather...... It won't look very pretty. Maybe I'll wait until next winter. ”
Spamton was taken aback. It was only then that he realized the wind brushing his cheek was a bit hot, and then, as if belatedly, he realized he might be sweating all over. Ah, so it's summer now.
"Oh...... Oh! Okay! "Spamton nodded instinctively.
Just when you thought it was all over, the rooftop door suddenly burst open with a loud bang, and a scruffy, flushed-faced man walked in. He was still holding a beer bottle, looking like he'd had too much to drink, and his body was swaying as he walked toward [you].
Although he didn't know exactly what was going on, Spamton instinctively stepped in front of you, even though his body was trembling. You looked at him with a complicated expression. To be honest, of course [you] knew exactly what [your] father was doing at this moment—probably to see if you were really dead. If he did, he would even feign a whine, crying to win the sympathy of the relatives.
So at this moment, the man just stepped forward and slapped Spamton away: "Where did this come from...... Little thing, burp, don't get in the way! ”
He shouted, trying to pull Spamton aside, but Spamton could only do his best to block his way, knowing this man would probably treat you badly.
"Behind you...... Um, hiccup, it's my daughter. Be sensible, don't get in my way...... Burp, handle the housework, understand?! ”
This time, the man raised a beer bottle, about to smash it on Spamton's head. [You] frowned deeply and pulled Spamton, who was so unguarded against you, to hide behind you.
"Dad, if you have something, just come at me. He's not part of your family. Hitting him is illegal." You took a deep breath and said. Although hitting you is also illegal, it is usually treated as a family matter.
"Ha! My dear daughter...... Didn't you say you were going to die? Then go die! Why are you still standing here? "His attack was immediately diverted, and he even gave you a fierce shove. You staggered, and Spamton hurriedly helped you steady yourself. Even so, you couldn't help but take two more steps toward the edge of the rooftop.
“…… Are you really going to let me die? Spamton stood behind you. He couldn't see your expression, but he could still hear your slightly trembling voice. He couldn't help but feel flustered—he had finally pulled you back from the brink of jumping, but would you still choose to do so?
"Isn't that what you think? Huh?! If you think life is meaningless, then just go die? Go jump off a building? Do you want me to send you to your death?! "As he spoke, the man gave you another hard push. There were no railings or handrails on the rooftop, so you all took two more steps toward the edge, precarious.
"......" Spamton realized you were silent, just crying, sobbing silently, while the man raised his hand, about to slap down. He hurriedly stepped in front of you, reaching out but unable to catch it, letting the slap fall on himself.
[You] widened your eyes, your mouth twitching slightly. Honestly, you thought...... He would leave just now, and you were prepared. At that moment, even if you were pushed down and died, it wouldn't matter. It's just a bit of a pity for this little guy who said you saved him and cared about you. He would probably cry bitterly for you.
"Why is it you again, you little rascal? I told you not to get in the way, don't get in the way!" The man irritably shoved Spamton, who was already close to the side. Spamton instinctively took two steps back, then missed his foot. His eyes widened as he realized he was falling.
However, [you] grabbed him, anxiously trying to pull him upward. Spamton shook his head; after all, he was just a Dark Citizen...... As long as the item was fixed, he could return, so he wanted to tell you not to worry about him. But when it came to the moment, he didn't know how to explain the Dark World to you.
The man also came over and kicked [you] hard: "You still want to save him? Then I'll grant you two miserable lovers' wishes. Anyway, you don't want to live anymore." His malicious words reached your ears, while [You] frowned, enduring the pain, your arm trembling. Looking at the scars on your arm, he felt even more upset, but right now, he could do nothing.
Your body was also sinking bit by bit. Your father laughed heartily while recklessly kicking you down. Finally, [you] also fell off the rooftop, grabbing Spamton's hand together.
Tears fell into the air, your voice torn apart by the howling wind. You looked at Spamton with a bitter smile and shouted loudly, "Sorry, I dragged you down too—"
Spamton just instinctively shook his head. During the descent, he felt dizzy again, closed his eyes uncomfortably, and when he opened them again, he was sitting foolishly on the cyber city floor, while you were sitting on a trash can, propping up your chin and borely, swinging your legs as you watched him.
"Welcome back, Spamton—hey, how did this photo turn into color?" You had just greeted him when you noticed the blank photo you had been holding in your hand had appeared in Spamton's hand, and the colored strokes were slowly appearing. Slowly, it gradually turned into a color photo, and it looked ...... About the same age as you are now, just with a sincere smile, different from the previous black-and-white photo.
Spamton rubbed his temples. Hearing this, he instinctively glanced at the photo in his hand, then shook his head: "I don't know......"

content:
You blinked, looking at Spamton's confused face, then looked at the photo: "Then let's take it and study it." As you spoke, you took the photo from Spamton, but as soon as you took it, you frowned, covered your head, pressed your temples, and for some reason, you felt dizzy and had a headache, and your vision turned gray.
In Spamton's eyes, it's like you suddenly freeze after taking the photo, then your face turns pale—of course, for a ghost, no matter how pale it is, it's not all that pale. But you stumble and fall from the trash can. Spamton panics, rushes over to catch you, and the ghost starts to feel light at first, but as soon as it touches Spamton, it begins to take shape. Your heavy weight presses down on Spamton, and he tries to catch you, but you pin him to the ground as well. Still, he successfully acts as a cushion beneath you.
Your body was fully materialized, exactly like in the photo. The falling black hair brushed against Spamton's face, tickling a little. You truly felt a bit of pain. Only after realizing you were pressing on Spamton did you hurriedly get up, propping up your arms and looking down at Spamton. At this moment, your body returned to a semi-transparent state. For some reason, Spamton actually felt a bit regretful, but he swallowed hard and just instinctively called your name.
“…… Y/N……”
And you cheerfully chimed in: "Yes, I just remembered and saw that my name is this!" So I'm not someone without a name—ah, sorry, did I hurt you when I pressed down just now? I'm standing up now. "As you spoke, you quickly returned to floating there,
"After touching this photo again, I actually remembered my own name! And the memory I just recovered actually includes your presence. It's really amazing—ah, so you really care about me?" "At first, you were a bit excited because you had recovered some memories, but when you said the last sentence, you felt a bit uneasy. You used to ...... probably didn't know each other, so you know that in the memories that suddenly flashed through your mind, those words he said might have been just words to comfort you. Even if they were fake, you wouldn't be too surprised.
You will just feel a little bit of loss, just a little.
Spamton was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly waved his hand: "No [pain signals]—no need for [extra apologies], I just need to [thank you], and ...... [genuine and solid evidence]." ”
You listened in a daze, touched your chin, and nodded to show you understood: "Okay, but I still have to apologize to you. After all, it's because of me...... You fell to the ground. You actually don't need to catch me. After all, a ghost falling to the ground doesn't feel anything. "You smiled, bent down slightly, and looked at Spamton, who was sitting up straight. Unable to resist, you reached out and poked his face. Your hand flickered with each touch.
"...... the [body] doesn't have [pain perception], and the [heart-shaped object] doesn't have it either?" Spamton said somewhat gloomily.
You paused. Honestly, you didn't understand what the heart-shaped object he meant. Was it your heart?
So you asked, "Of course my body doesn't hurt, but what the hell is that heart-shaped object...... My heart? ”
Spamton only nodded slightly, then began shaking his head vigorously. He hesitated and said, "Your ...... [Perception System]?" ”
"Oh...... You mean, my soul? "You guess. If that's the case, it should be something that isn't material, but something that exists in consciousness.
This time, Spamton nodded vigorously, agreeing with your point.
You think for a moment, then just nod and shake your head: "Of course the body doesn't hurt, and neither does the soul, after all, I'm already used to it......" But why do you feel used to it? Why is that? You rarely have a question, but you just can't think of an answer.
“…… Don't get used to [pain perception]; [heart-shaped objects] might also be [damaged and degenerate]. "Spamton stood up, seriously shaking your shoulders, and raised both hands in a surrender gesture.
"I know, I know—alright, I can't just endure pain and say nothing. If I don't fight back at all and let others slaughter me, then what's that even then?" "You say you know, since he's been shaking your shoulders the whole time, and even ghosts still feel a bit dizzy.
But now that you're talking about it, you start to remember a bit and hurriedly ask, "But...... In my memory, you fell with me, it must have hurt a lot, sorry...... You looked at him with a hint of guilt. Knowing he truly cares about you, you're happy, but at the same time, you also feel guilty. You don't want to drag anyone else's ...... into it. Ah, wait, that's not a person—he's just a Dark Citizen.
Spamton just shook his head: "I had already [detached my memories] before, so it wasn't affected." ”
You patted your chest and finally let out a sigh: "It's okay, it's fine. If it hurts that much too, I'd be heartbroken......" You muttered softly, but Spamton didn't catch it. He couldn't help but want you to repeat it, but you just crossed your hands and made a big numbness sign and refused his suggestion.
"It's nothing important, why repeat it again......" you said this, your expression not very natural. Spamton slightly lifted his head to look at you, frowning as well. He didn't think it was a trivial matter.
He just tugged at the hem of your clothes and started playing the victim: "...... But I want to know, Y/N, can't you really [tell me a little]?" As he spoke, he slightly lifted his head to look at you, showing a slightly pitiful expression. You looked at him, opened your mouth for a moment, then closed it again. Honestly, because of Spamton's expression at that moment, you felt an inexplicable pang of guilt, but then you hardened your heart.
"No, no!" "I've already said it's not important, and if I don't want to talk, it means it's my privacy. You can't ask further, understand?" As you spoke, you poked Spamton's long nose. He covered his nose and instinctively took two steps back. Seeing him like that, you couldn't help but burst out laughing.
"Alright, anyway...... Thank you so much for helping me recover a piece of my memory. "You said softly.
Even though those were memories from before you died, and even though all that remained for you was sadness and helplessness, in that memory you saw Spamton, you heard his words, and you chose to believe him. At least, you realized that your existence still had some meaning, some necessity, and at least a small Dark Folk was watching over you.
Your voice was light and floaty: "Thank you too...... So you really care about me. But I don't understand—why? We just met today, so we're not that familiar. ”
Spamton was taken aback. He thought about the question for a moment, hesitated for a moment, and then answered you: "Because you are my [savior], and you are [full of kindness], I...... I want your [happy ending]. ”
As he spoke, he swallowed hard. Saying such things made him a little nervous, his chest seemingly pounding nonstop, while he just lowered his head, not daring to look up at you for a moment, his voice muffled: "I...... I think you're worth it, your [Heart-shaped Object] is worth it. ”
You paused, then sat back down on the trash can, looking down at Spamton. Actually, when you first asked why, you didn't expect him to give you a satisfactory answer, but...... But his answer made tears wellup in your eyes for no reason. You don't know why, but at that moment, you actually felt like crying. You felt it shouldn't be right, it seemed a bit weak, and you wanted to hold back your tears, but you didn't know why.
In the end, you only had two lines of tears on your cheeks, and nodded blankly: "I understand...... Thank you, thank you. ”
You didn't move; instead, that white, slightly furry hand reached out, gently touching you and wiping away the tears that had flowed down your face. Only then did you realize that these tears were not those of a ghost that no one cared about nor could see, but of the weakness and tears of the soul. At that moment, you were being treated with great care as a human.
“…… No, always switch to [crying mode]. "Spamton stammered, a little gloomily said. He doesn't really want to see you cry; you should always be smiling joyfully.
"I won't always be like this—but you, since you say so, you shouldn't keep crying. I saw you standing in the shop crying secretly because you couldn't sell them." You started pointing and whispering seriously, your legs swinging back and forth. To be honest, when you're stuck on the commercial street, you occasionally pick up dark coins or similar items left behind by the Dark People. After a while, you still have quite a few dark coins on you, but buying things is useless to you. So even though you watch them open their shop and this pure white Addison crying, you still haven't taken any action. And now, you feel a bit regretful.
Anyway, buying things doesn't really help you; you can buy anything you want...... You grumbled in your heart, thinking that you could just grab some things and toss the dark coins down. All you wanted was to see a smile on his face.
"I ......," Spamton scratched his face a little embarrassedly. When he was hiding there and secretly crying, he thought no one would notice, but unexpectedly, you did. Well, before this, no one knew there was a ghost on the commercial street—a groundbound spirit trapped here.
"Stop talking about you, huh? You still need to go back to your business, right? I'll go to your shop to get some stuff and leave you some dark coins to support the event." "You made the decision so happily with a wave of your hand, not caring whether Spamton agreed or not. Anyway, you said you would do it—who could stop a ghost like you?"
Spamton could only sigh helplessly. Calculating the time, it was about time for the shop to open in the afternoon, so he had to go back. But before leaving, he still turned around and said seriously, "I don't know the [pain index] of jumping from a building...... But you have the [autonomy] to cry. ”
You were stunned for a moment. Although you were still smiling, tears quietly fell down. You lifted the corners of your mouth and nodded heavily, your voice a bit muffled: "Mm." ”
You watch his back, watch him open the shop door, display some old, unremarkable items, and then shout out loudly, hoping even one of the Darkfolk will stop and buy his stuff.
But...... Not a single Dark Citizen stopped. They simply took what they wanted from other shops, paid the bill, and then left, not lingering even a single step in front of Spamton's shop, nor did they glance at the white Addison shop.
Spamton reluctantly withdrew his hand, then opened several large pop-ups, trying hard to attract attention. But other addisons did exactly that, because all addisons were trying to attract customers.
You pursed your lips, wondering whether to go over at this moment, but then noticed Addison walking over. It was Blue. He seemed to have handed Spamton a cup of tea. Spamton took it, nodded repeatedly, and then slowly began to drink his tea.
To be honest, you ...... You originally thought Blue was just looking for trouble, so you could only reluctantly withdraw your eager hand and continue observing his shop.
He sat at the shop entrance, sipping that cup of tea. For the moment, he probably didn't want to shout. Of course, his shop was also in a remote area, so...... With no more shouts, no Dark People would come to his shop door. You hesitated for a moment, but still grabbed the dark coins you had and got up, slowly walking toward his shop.
Spamton clearly noticed your actions too. He stopped drinking his tea and waved slightly at you, as if wanting to say something. But before he could speak, Pink, who had been staring at the nearby shop for a long time, walked over again, looking arrogantly at Spamton, and said arrogantly, "Oh, are you saying hello to some ghost friend of yours?" "I mean, you can't even sell your stuff. You're really embarrassing us addisons. If you ask me, you'd better pair up with your ghost friend. Just picking up trash every day is enough for you to survive." His words carried a hint of schadenfreude. When you heard that, your fists clenched and you aimed straight at Pink. Unfortunately, pink couldn't touch you; your hand passed right through Pink's body. He knew nothing, only Spamton saw it all. He covered his mouth, but in the end, he accidentally laughed.
Pink was a bit dissatisfied and confused, and couldn't help but want to kick him: "What are you laughing at? Do you think I'm funny, or do you think what I say is funny?" ”
You rush to the front of Spamton, holding a vase to block Pink's way. From Pink's perspective, it's just a vase mysteriously floating in midair, exactly like in the morning, as if haunted.
He shivered, his voice starting to tremble: "Let me tell you, I saw this thing this morning. Stop trying to scare me with tricks......" But before he finished speaking, you searched Spamton's stall for anything else and happened to find a dusty rag. You directly covered his face, and Pink, still barely silent, swallowed a mouthful of dust. He stammered, his face flushed, and took the rag off. But since he was already pink, his face was still flushed, but it wasn't very obvious.
Pink just snapped angrily, "What exactly did you do?! How did this dirty rag end up in my face? Apologize to me right now! ”
Spamton watched the whole thing. He didn't stop your actions, since he had long wanted to get back at these addisons. Now Pink angrily demanded an explanation, and only then did Spamton, innocently and somewhat pitifully, say, "I don't have [evidence of my actions]...... Other 【Dark People】 can [provide proof], like Blue. "As he spoke, he tilted his head back, still squinting. You could vaguely see a few tears, and you couldn't help but marvel. In fact, you don't think Spamton is that wronged or sad...... But at this moment, he still showed it.
So you simply held your vase and watched from the side. You saw blue rushing over, and then separating pink, who wanted to go up and punch spamton a few times, from pink, who was still sitting motionless in his original spot, and started playing the peacemaker: 'I saw everything, pink, you were the first to make a move, spammy just sat there and did nothing.'
"Then how do you explain the rag that fell on my face?" Pink pointed at the rag that had fallen on the floor, angrily lowering his voice into a low voice.
You can't help but start biting your nails, and for a moment, you suddenly realize that his nickname is spammy.
Blue got stuck for a moment, glanced at Pink, then at Spamton's innocent face, and started rambling: "Well...... It was probably just a sudden gust of wind blowing by, lifting that rag, and it just happened to fall on your face. ”
Pink rolled his eyes: "How could something that just happen? Besides, there was clearly no wind just now. Where would the wind come from in the Dark World?" ”
“…… Maybe it's because the weather is hot, and Yellow's shop has an electric hair dryer." Spamton said. He started to shift the traction, since Yellow's shop wasn't far from him.
You casually browse the shop where there are no Dark People guarding the time, then grab a piece of watermelon and sneak behind Spamton, watching the show while eating the melon. Spamton subtly shifts his seat, trying not to let them see the watermelon floating in the air.
Pink glared at Spamton with anger and walked back to his shop, while Blue sighed, picked up the rag, and placed it on Spamton's stall, then walked back to his shop as well.

content:
Watching them all leave, with no other Dark People standing in front of Spamton's shop, you swagger out from behind Spamton and continue gnawing on your watermelon.

After all, today seemed to be the shortest time they'd been here. Usually, their shop was empty, so they would take the opportunity to spend half a day muttering and judging their own shop. At the very bottom, Spamton, at the bottom, could only silently endure their humiliation.
But today, you appeared, and after that, everything changed. Spamton sometimes thought that maybe it was the greatest luck of his life that he happened to meet you, and that's why he ...... It felt like everything had changed.

But you still turned around and curiously asked Spamton, "I see your shop has all kinds of stuff. Your colleagues, do those Addisons sell the same stuff as you do?" ”

[Main business] includes [upper clothing products] and [lower clothing products], while [business side stories] are all sorts of things—almost everything. ”
You nod thoughtfully, then glanced at their shop. Honestly, it was deserted, and there really wasn't much to see. You could only shake your head helplessly and say, "I don't think their business is doing that well...... Why do I have to tell you about it? ”
“…… Maybe it's the 'first come, first served' principle? Or maybe I really have zero sales." Spamton hesitated a bit. To be honest, he couldn't really explain it, but...... It seemed he had always gotten used to all this.
You patted Spamton's head; to you, it was pretty fluffy, and since you hadn't made any direct contact, your hand was basically just touching the air, but you didn't get too upset.

"You silently snapped your fingers and started moving things excitedly inside Spamton's store. The vase you liked, birdcages, chessboards, and even all sorts of clothes that were on the shelves for some reason were all tucked away in the corners.
"Then...... Where do they return? "Spamton asked, after all, he knew very well that you have nowhere to put these things, and you don't even have a place to live. You can't just buy them and put them all in the trash, can you?" Wouldn't that be a waste?
You carefully put down the dark coins you had saved earlier. Hearing this, you paused. Looking at the pile of things in front of you, you thought carefully for a moment, and finally cautiously asked, "Then...... Do you have a woven bag on your side? Use the woven bag to pack these things and put them next to the trash bin for now. I'll move over when I find a place to stay. ”
You gave the order. Spamton ran to the corner of the shop and searched, and indeed found a woven bag. He squatted down and helped you pack the things inside. You almost felt a bit embarrassed and quickly refused his gesture: "I'm alone...... No, just one soul is enough. After all, I'm the one taking these things, so you don't have to help out. ”
Spamton just shook his head seriously: "No, I should provide you with [perfect service], after all, I accepted your [silver dollars]. ”
When he said this seriously, his expression was a bit funny, but you twitched the corner of your mouth, but in the end, you didn't laugh. After all, you still wanted to refuse him, but you didn't know how to do so.
In the end, after racking your brains, you finally came up with a solution: "I don't need you to help me with this...... How about this, let's make a deal? ”
Spamton didn't stop what he was doing; instead, he sped up a bit and asked, "What [Trade]?" ”
He really does seem interested, and you can't help but breathe a little easier.
"Exactly...... Color photos seem to help me recover my memory, but as you can see, before you touch them, the photos are black and white. And I only have one photo, so I don't know if there are any other photos in this dark world...... Maybe those are more memories I've lost, and since I can't leave the shopping street, I want to ask you to find the photos and bring them back to help me recover them. I'll give you some dark coins as payment for this, how about that?" "You trade with him with full confidence. Honestly, you're pretty sure he'll agree to your proposal, after all...... Now he seems desperate, and he probably has nothing else to do.
So after you finished speaking, you just looked at him with sparkling eyes, cupped your chin with both hands, and began pleading with him. After all, you really wanted to know more memories of the past, not just who you were, but knowing that you had died and that knowledge somehow remained in the dark world was enough. You were desperate to understand yourself.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, swallowed hard, and to him, it didn't seem like a ...... something worth refusing. And inside him, there was still a voice telling him, tempting him, telling him to agree to you.
So in the end, he still nodded: "I agree to your request." ”
You happily make a 'yeah' gesture in your heart, quietly throwing flowers, but your face doesn't show it, just that slightly smiling expression: "I knew you'd agree!" But it might be a bit troublesome, and I'm not sure if there will be other photos in this dark world...... Thank you for your trouble. ”
Spamton hesitantly nodded: "Maybe, if I find nothing, I'll consider going to other [Dark Worlds]. [Click to view details]." "Going to other Dark Worlds or something...... Although it would be a bit troublesome and risky, as long as he could leave smoothly before that, that was enough. Although he hadn't tried before, Spamton knew that if he really had to try, he wouldn't refuse or refuse.
"Then I'll leave it to you, spammy!" You happily patted his shoulder, though your hand was still flashing. For some reason, the white Addison in front of you seemed a bit red, but he lowered his head, and you couldn't see his expression clearly. He just scratched his cheek with his hand and mumbled a soft response.
You also slipped the rest of the items into the snakeskin bag while he wasn't looking, then placed the dark coins on the counter to the side. You happily carried the bag and headed outside. Spamton didn't stop you, and luckily, no other Dark People noticed you now. Although the snakeskin bag was a bit heavy for you, you only spent a little time slowly dragging it to the trash bin, then you started rummaging. Remember you brought yourself some little gadget that sneaks around and can also be used to pass the time.
Spamton was lost in thought for a moment, and when he finally came to his senses, he realized you had already left the shop and left the dark coins on the counter. He hesitated for a moment, then opened a notebook and recorded the only entry he made today. Now, when facing other Addisons, he wouldn't have to feel embarrassed about not having a single customer left.
Thinking this, Spamton's face lit up, and he couldn't help but smile. Today was almost closing time. After tidying up, he closed the shop door and walked out, waving goodbye to you, who was sitting on the trash can swinging your legs and idly playing with a yo-yo you had just gotten, then set off on his way home. Spamton had already made up his mind: once he got home and put his things down, he would go out to look for your photos. To be honest, he had always been stuck between two points and never noticed if any photos had been left behind.

He looked at the advertisement by the roadside. At this moment, Spamton was in the residential area of the Dark People in Cyber City. He felt there probably wouldn't be any photos left there.
Then his footsteps stopped. He saw a black-and-white scene playing on an advertisement outside the cinema at the front end of the residential area. It seemed to be you in a student uniform, walking down the street. It seemed to be a candid shot, since the focal length was a bit blurry and the outline was not clear, while you turned your head in shock to look at the camera. Then he stood on tiptoe and looked toward the color card manager sitting behind the ticket counter.

In the huge theater, he was the only one among the Dark People, which made him feel a bit flustered. However, the next second, the hall's headlights went out, leaving him no time to hesitate.
He took the movie ticket and found a central position to sit down. The next moment, the world spun, and a black-and-white vortex appeared before his eyes again. Although he had only come to watch a movie, the next second, Spamton rubbed his temples and found himself standing on the street. It was the same street that had appeared in the footage.
In a blink, he realized he was holding an instant camera, while Spamton looked up and saw you walking ahead, with a few bruises under your long sleeves, unintentionally blown by the wind.
Spamton swallowed, unable to figure out what he was thinking right now. He just had a gut feeling—he should be here, calling out to you.
So he raised his voice and shouted, "Y/N!" ”

But when [You] turned around, you did see something pure white, or rather, somewhat transparent...... It was probably a monster holding an instant camera, and then there was a click. You saw a photo developed by that instant camera, which looked like a color print of your own appearance when you turned your head earlier.
[You] looked at him blankly and asked, "Who are you?" ”
You don't know this person, but you can confirm that he has never appeared at your school, after all...... There are so many monsters and humans at school, and you've never seen something as pure white as this. The reason you've seen so many people in the school is because you're among the top in your grade, and you've even won some awards before, even giving a speech at the school assembly. You have a pretty good memory, at least you can remember some basic traits.
But after that, you never won another award. Thinking this, [you] silently let the wind-blown cuff slip down, covering the marks on your arm.
Spamton took down that photo, shivered, and answered your question in a loud voice: "SPAMTON G. SPAMTON!" "He doesn't expect you to remember him, since it looks like this is a story from before."
[You] thought for a moment and realized she hadn't heard of that name before, so in the end [you] just shook her head: "So, is there something you need?" ”
Spamton hesitated for a moment, unsure how to answer the question—should it be intuition? But...... He felt too embarrassed to say it to you directly, since you'd probably think he was just talking nonsense.
So in the end, he just scratched his head, gave a dry laugh, and said, "Because...... I [care about you a lot] so when I saw your [back portrait], I couldn't help but [call out loudly] to you. ”
[You] were a bit stunned listening to it. Honestly, you didn't quite understand why he spoke that way, but your habit of respecting others just nodded thoughtfully. Anyway, you roughly understood what he meant.
You then asked, "Then...... Why did you just leave a photo of me? "As you spoke, you pointed at the instant camera in Spamton's hand.
"I...... I wanted to keep a [commemorative footage], so I did [extra shooting]. "Spamton scratched his head awkwardly again and answered your question. He felt a bit guilty, since he was just lying, so he didn't dare lift his head to meet your eyes, afraid you'd expose his lie.
You blinked. Actually, you could tell he seemed a bit guilty, but you didn't really care, after all...... Everyone has secrets, and although [you] felt a bit offended, the reason he gave was acceptable to you, and [you] could understand. So in the end, [you] just nodded and softly said, "I see." I'm leaving. Goodbye. "You were delayed for a while, but you still had to hurry home, so after saying that, you turned around, planning to go home—no, maybe you could say it was just one of your accommodations."
Spamton's eyes widened in shock. He hadn't expected you to ask so simply and then walk back. He hurriedly chased after her, panting a bit heavily, and asked, "Could you agree to my [companion companionship service]?" ”
[You] paused for a moment, turned to look at Spamton, and instinctively wanted to nod. Then you recalled some things that had happened on the way home from school. Your expression turned unpleasant, and you shook your head in panic, lowering your brows and eyes, saying, "No need, thank you for your concern, but I want ...... I shouldn't walk with strangers." You politely declined him, even though from the very first moment you saw him, [You] felt an inexplicable sense of closeness. This was also one of the reasons you hadn't pressed him further just now about why he was taking photos.
However...... it's unlikely that [you] would agree. Not to mention that he was just a stranger you just met, other things might happen on the road ahead, and you wouldn't be embarrassed to let others see you.
"[Why]?" "Just [traveling together]?" "Spamton anxiously circled beside you. Since he hasn't left after taking this photo, it means other things might happen later. You're the main figure in all the events, so he should be following you closely."
“…… "No reason, I'm not used to strangers...... "You mutter softly, honestly, you already feel a bit annoyed and a bit embarrassed." [You]...... Not wanting anyone to see you, [you] quickened your pace, trying to shake off this pure white strange guy who had been clinging to you for some reason.
Who knew [you] quickened her pace, and he quickened her pace too, stubbornly following [you]. You looked at him with some trouble, while Spamton was sweating nervously in her heart. Honestly, he didn't know if [you] would drive him away, but in the dream of memory, he didn't have many chances. Since you didn't seem to react much, maybe that meant it was possible?
[You] just gave him a complicated look. Neither of you said anything more, but you just wondered, if [You] had someone else by your side, wouldn't those people be afraid when they saw you and wouldn't do much more? In the past, you always worked alone, and when you were alone, there was nothing you could do—you could only grit your teeth and get through it.
And now...... Spamton walked beside you, and for some reason, you felt much more at ease.

title: Dark World Bound Spirit 5 (sptx you)

content:
Silent all the way. You gradually ignore the fact that there is someone else beside you, lost in your own thoughts. You've gotten used to doing this, since you don't have many friends in class...... Your classmates haven't done anything to you, just ignored you as if nothing happened. Coincidentally, you don't want to make friends either.
Spamton hesitated. Actually, he wanted to ask you something, but he noticed you were a bit distracted, not knowing what you were thinking. So he hesitated for a moment and ultimately didn't ask any random questions. He wanted to ask you, to learn about your hobbies and daily life, although Spamton didn't know what it meant to know about these things.
However, this peaceful silence was eventually broken. Spamton stood with you at your doorstep, while your father was standing there, raising his wrist to check the time and sneering, "Saturday...... Normally I get home at 5:30, but today it's 5:40. What's going on? ”
Then he looked up at Spamton: "So this kid is the one who bothered you? Dad told me long ago, don't make friends with mediocre people. Just study hard and that's enough. I remember your monthly exam score was eighth in the class, right? When will you get first place? Tell me? ”
[You] moved your lips, wanting to say that the person behind you wasn't your friend, but for some reason, you didn't want to deny it. That inexplicable sense of closeness made you instinctively avoid answering.
So [you] calmly asked, "Then Dad, what exactly counts as not a shady person?" "Dad, I was just out with friends for a little while......"
Spamton was a bit surprised. He hadn't expected you to call him a friend, and just as he was about to say something, [you] tugged at his shirt, making him stand behind you. He hesitated to speak but stopped for a moment, but in the end, he said nothing.
But you just calmly looked at your father, who was furious: "Heavens is upside down! Your dad works hard every day to earn money for you, and I have to take care of your life and studies. Why don't you give me some peace of mind? What do you mean by that? How dare you talk back to me, stubbornly argue with me?" As he spoke, he slapped you across the face, knocking your head askew, and you just spoke calmly.
"I'm sorry, Dad." It's like you've said it a thousand times before, maybe...... You've been apologizing all along.
Spamton's eyes widened. He roughly understood where those wounds on your body came to be, because he saw your father grab a bottle of wine and try to smash it at you, saying, 'Today I'm going to teach you a lesson, you unfilial daughter.'
Spamton tugged at your clothes, instinctively running in the direction you came. You didn't resist, just let him hold your hand and run wildly down the road. [You] gazed at Spamton's back, and for some reason, it felt as if, long, long ago, or in a very distant memory, you saw this silhouette too, and saw Spamton pulling you along as she ran. But...... You don't remember anything like that happening. Maybe it's just your imagination, or maybe you're just building a friend for yourself in your illusion, and now, that friend has a tangible image.
Your voice was muddled by the wind, and Spamton could only barely hear what you were saying: "Run away now...... When we get back, Father will hit me even harder. ”
Spamton quickly stopped walking, and you, following behind, couldn't hold back for a moment, instinctively bumping into his back. Your nose tingled, and instinctive tears streamed down your face.
Spamton panicked. He thought the matter of escaping with you was upsetting you, so he quickly reached out to carefully wipe the tears from your cheeks and spoke weakly: "I ...... [very sorry], but started the [related process] without agreeing to all related matters." ”
But [you] just shook her head: "It's okay, I just bumped into you, that's why I'm crying...... No need to feel sorry, it's just that I should go home, you don't have to follow me anymore." You said this, showing a somewhat ugly smile. You know what you'll face when you get home. It's not that you haven't thought about resisting, but your resistance has only led to more retaliation.
"I...... "Together with you, I will implement security measures." Spamton said hurriedly. He probably knew what might happen after you returned, and he didn't want you to come back alone. Although this was just a memory that would never change further, Spamton hoped that, at least in places he could see and touch, you wouldn't suffer the slightest harm.
You pursed your lips, lowered your head, and whispered, "...... Even if you go back with me, nothing will change. He might hurt you too." ”
Spamton quickly shook his head: "I'm not afraid of [specific harm]." "He's already experienced similar hurts many times before; he wouldn't feel afraid. He's even more afraid of you getting hurt.
“…… But I don't want to see you hurt. So, please don't come with me...... You'll see me hurt too, and it will look terrible. Don't look at me like this, please...... "You plead softly, and as you speak, you gradually start to sob, your voice muffled and tinged with tears.
"...... [I promise you]." Spamton didn't know what to do. He hesitated for a moment, then finally answered you awkwardly. He didn't want to see you sad either, so he just continued to wipe the tears from your cheeks with his hands in vain.
You finally stopped sobbing, forcing a smile at Spamton: "Alright, I'll head back then." Next time...... Let's meet again if we get the chance. "You said that, waved at Spamton, then turned and ran toward your home. Spamton watched your back, gritted his teeth, and quietly followed behind you. Fortunately, this road had many forks leading to other alleys. Spamton quietly followed behind, poking his head out from behind the white wall to look at you. You probably didn't notice Spamton was following you, just running to your doorstep.
Your father was standing at the doorstep. When he saw [you] coming, he threw a bottle at you, followed by loud scolding. Even just hearing the sound made it clear what was happening to you. Spamton was just hiding behind the white wall, not daring to look anymore. His feelings were complicated. He thought, he was really cowardly. At this moment, he should have stood in front of you, because violence is an absolutely harmful act. Spamton could only hold onto a heavy and sorrowful heart, listening to each sound until no new sounds came through, only the sound of a door slamming.
Throughout the entire process, none of the neighbors showed any intention of stepping in.
Spamton poked his head out, looking over there with a complicated feeling. He couldn't see anything else because night was gradually falling, leaving only the light from the window and the faint sound of sobbing. He hesitated for a moment, touched his body, and was surprised to find a piece of candy in his pocket—he didn't know when it had appeared.
He no longer hesitated and strode toward the window that was shining with light. The window was a bit high, and Spamton had to stand on tiptoe to get there. He gently knocked on the window, and the sobbing behind it stopped for a moment. Then, [you] opened the window, revealing eyes red from crying. You were surprised to find that Spamton had come looking for you.
But before you can ask more, Spamton puts the candy he's been tucking into his palm on your desk, then stands on tiptoe and reaches out to wipe the tears from your cheek. Though it's still a mess, you pull open the wrapper, put the candy in your mouth, and then smile through your tears.
You whispered, "Thank you for your candy, and also ...... I'm sorry." "I'm sorry for letting him see such an embarrassing scene. You've already planned to let everyone see you in a glamorous way, because you don't want others' care to be wasted, don't want them to waste time for no reason, don't want them to feel guilty."
Spamton just shook his head, closed the window again, and left.
You were silent for a while, then stood up and quietly folded the candy wrapper into a thousand paper cranes, placing it on your desk, and then continued working on your homework.
As for Spamton...... He had just stepped down from the windowsill when the world spun around before his eyes. When he opened his eyes again, he found the night had fallen, the sky dark and tinged with a hint of blue and red, whether illuminated by the lights or something similar. He heard a commotion and looked up, realizing he was at the school gate. A few students were chatting and laughing as they left the campus. But among them, he spotted you at a glance—because you were the only one walking alone, and you alone in the scorching summer still wearing long sleeves.
He hurried over to you.
[You] noticed Spamton too, her eyes lit up as you quickened your pace toward him: "Why are you here? Didn't you say you didn't have to follow me anymore...... "You felt a bit embarrassed. You wanted to tug at his sleeve, but in the end, you just let go, tilting your head to brush your hair aside."
Just as Spamton was about to speak, a classmate passing by nearby exclaimed in surprise, "Y/N, who are you talking to? There's no one facing you at all. ”
You paused, then looked behind Spamton. Indeed, there was no one there, and Spamton hurriedly waved his hand to explain: "I'm not your [Illusion System]." ”
You just lowered your gaze in loneliness, smiled helplessly, and then walked forward. You think, so it really is true—you won't have any friends, and your only friend is just your own illusion. What are you thinking about now? Absolutely ...... It's simply impossible, not even if it's just such a simple wish, even if it's just a small request.
And you just keep walking forward on your own, while Spamton hurriedly chases after you. You don't know if the hallucination can be so realistic, but you instinctively slow down and turn your head to see Spamton, panting, running up.
Spamton instinctively touched his pocket, and this time he was surprised to find iodine tincture and bandages inside, though he had no idea what was going on.
You watch Spamton chase after you, just turn your head and silently walk forward again.
“…… I hope you, [show your wound], I want to perform the [bandaging service]." Spamton said cautiously. You hesitated for a moment. On this road, besides you and Spamton, there was no one else. In the end, you carefully rolled up your sleeve, revealing that slightly healed blood-colored wound and a clearly new bruise.
Spamton swallowed nervously and carefully wiped the wound with iodine. You silently drew in a breath but made no sound, just endured his movements. Slowly, he finished wiping your wound with alcohol, then carefully took out bandages and band-aids, applying them one by one.
During this process, you just silently walked forward, as if tacitly speaking. There was still some distance from your doorstep, just like every day before, afraid to step through the door, afraid to return to the place that should be called home. Whether it was the pain of the wound or the pain in your heart, tears instinctively flowed down your cheeks, falling to the floor with a faint tapping sound. Spamton put away the iodine tincture from where he didn't know where it came from, looked at you carefully, and finally asked, "Which [flavor choice] do you prefer?" ”
You paused, hesitated for a moment, and finally said, "That's probably ...... Blueberry." "You prefer this flavor.
Spamton nodded without saying much. He just carefully took your hand, pulled down his sleeve, and recovered the wound. He didn't know what to say, but felt he should say something casually, at least ...... to help your mood improve a little.
So he adjusted his mood and asked, "Your [School Agreement]?" As you can see, I don't attend classes at your school. ”
You followed the topic for a moment and really started answering his question seriously: "About my school...... Yeah, it's the best high school in the city, so it's normal for you not to attend there. "But if it's just your imagination, do you really not know which school you attend? But you don't mind; it's fine to pass the time with these conversations."
So you continued, "Hmm...... I had excellent grades in middle school and even ranked first. My father was very happy and ordered me to always be first. If I didn't do it, a bottle of alcohol would fall on me. In the end, I probably got into this high school with the third highest score in the city, but my father was still very dissatisfied, so he ...... Now he beats and scolds me every day, telling me to study harder. ”
You recounted with a blank expression, saying this was nothing to you. You had long since gotten used to it. Mom left because she couldn't stand your father's behavior, but she didn't take you along to see the departure; instead, she left you here alone.
Spamton opened his mouth and then closed it again. He couldn't say exactly what to do at this moment, but he could empathize with your experience, so he simply whispered, "I...... Same here. I'm "worthless," "zero sales," so my "relatives and colleagues" think I'm "unmotivated," "mocking and ridiculing," "[insulting and beating" me. ”
You were stunned for a moment. Could a hallucination really have such a detailed background? Maybe it did, but this was nothing like what you initially thought. You didn't know he actually had such a past.
You take a few deep breaths and gaze intently at Spamton, who then looks up at you.
No matter what, you solemnly declared this vow: "If ...... I find that if you are bullied by those relatives and friends you mentioned again, I will definitely stop them. Trust me, as long as I see it. ”
Spamton was a bit startled; at this moment, it seemed you overlapped with the image of the ghost on the trash can. He also knew that what you said meant you really meant it, so he nodded seriously: "Mm." ”
In just a few words, you finally reached the doorstep. Your body trembled slowly, then you let go of Spamton's hand. Silently, he hid behind the same wall as yesterday, listening to you unlock the door with your key, followed by drunken cursing. You seemed to have gotten used to it all. Spamton didn't hear your voice, just watched the window light up again. He touched his pocket; at some point, the iodine tincture and similar stuff had disappeared, replaced by a candy. Spamton took it out and glanced at it—it was actually a blueberry-flavored candy. He stood under your windowsill again, tiptoed to knock on your window. You opened the window, and as you expected, it was Spamton. He handed you a candy. You took it and looked—it was blueberry flavor.
So you smile and say, "Thank you, spamton." ”
Spamton blushed a little, scratched his cheek, lowered his head, closed the window for you, then jumped off the windowsill and left. You unwrapped the candy, and it fell onto your tongue. The sweet taste seemed to soothe the wounds on your body. You washed the candy wrapper, then, just like yesterday, folded a thousand origami cranes and placed them next to the crane from yesterday.
You think, days that once seemed hopeless now seem to be looking forward to something. You start looking forward to the candy handed to you every day, and to every night.
These days...... It's all the same. You walk out of the school gate, naturally take Spamton's hand and walk home. You start sharing your daily life at school, whether interesting or not, you listen to Spamton talk about the charm of another city, you wait for the sound of knocking on your window every night, and the number of little origami cranes on the windowsill grows and more. You've already planned that when you have a few more origami cranes, you can put them in the same jar and then give them to Spamton.

content:
But—just the next day after you had made your plans, when you walked out of the school gate, you didn't see Spamton. At that moment, you were very uneasy, thinking he was ...... Maybe it was just something temporary, and he would probably come back at night. But you waited expectantly all night, still not seeing anyone.
…… Maybe it's just that something happened to him that day. You know very well that everyone gets busy sometimes, and you just have a little disappointment, just a little. You tidy up your things and fall asleep; the dream is pitch black, nothing at all.
You still didn't see him. On the third day, still nothing. You bitterly thought maybe it really was just your imagination, but why...... When you felt some warmth and regained anticipation, did you take back the warmth you felt?
You just become more silent. Of course, since you don't have many friends at school and don't speak at home, no one notices anything is wrong with you.
It wasn't until a month later, when you had completely lost hope, when you felt that none of this really mattered, that you saw a figure gasping for breath.
—It's Spamton, who has reappeared before you. You can't imagine why he is ...... After you have completely lost hope, why does he reappear here to give you hope again?
Thinking this, you couldn't help but ask. Spamton was stunned for a moment, scratching his head a bit embarrassedly and muttering, "I'm sorry...... I'm very sorry. I won't be [suddenly missing] again." He couldn't explain exactly what had happened, but right now none of this was under his control. He could only watch as time changed, watch the smile that once hung on your face gradually fade, and he was powerless to do anything. It wasn't until today that he finally broke free from time's control and reappeared before you.
You stared at him for a moment, then just shook your head: "...... It's fine, but would you like to tell me what exactly happened?" After asking, you realized you might have been a bit too talkative. Actually, you two didn't seem that close, and it seemed you didn't really know each other's pasts. You only had the present, but who knew if there would be a future.
“…… I, [Time Flows], I can't [stop completely]." Spamton didn't know how to explain it to you, but seeing your calm expression, he felt an overwhelming ache and could only try hard to explain.
Of course, seeing your confused expression, he knows you probably didn't quite understand.
But that doesn't stop you from deciding to keep walking with Spamton. Maybe he'll show up next time, and you don't dare to gamble—just make sure to say whatever you want. After all, you don't believe he'll definitely be here tomorrow, so you don't dare to hold onto expectations.
“…… While you were away, I missed you very much. "At this point, you pursed your lips, a blush spreading across your cheeks. You felt a bit embarrassed to say such things, but you always felt that if you didn't say it now, it would be too late."
Spamton was stunned for a moment, then quickly nodded: "I miss you very much too, but I can't ...... participate in shared life." "Only today did Spamton finally break through the barrier and reappear before you."
"Hmm...... So what have you been doing during this time? "Honestly, it's precisely because you didn't understand that you decided to ask again.
Spamton tapped his fingers, not knowing what to say for a moment, but he thought, maybe at this moment, it would be better if he made up a lie for you.
So he cleared his throat and said solemnly, "I've returned to Cyber City, which I told you about before. Because my [balance is zero], I need to [accumulate wealth] again." ”
You nodded, signaling him to continue. Under the streetlight, your shadows were stretched out and short, but Spamton had no shadow. You had noticed this long ago, which is why you always suspected Spamton was just an illusion.
"Hmm, and then, what happened again?" You asked.
"I previously told about the [Dark World] and the [Light World]...... After that, the same "People of Light" visited my shop. "He thought, you probably just treat all of this as a story, but that's okay. After all, to ordinary people of Light, the Dark World is just a story.
You nod seriously, listening intently, even though you know maybe it's just a story you're making up for yourself. Because this world is too bitter for you, you always fantasize about another world, where you have an extraordinary life.
Spamton glanced at you, feeling a bit stuck. He had originally planned to make up a random Light Citizen, but for some reason, he just kept telling the truth, half-truth, half-lie.
“…… Then, there was a [Lightfolk] who was exactly like you. She came to my shop, or rather, [honorable presence], and bought the items that had once been [completely inconspicuous] [only value: gathering dust] in my shop. Spamton said slowly, "You walk home as you walk fast, yet also seem slow—at least enough for you to hear this story."
You were a bit surprised, but still nodded, thinking to yourself with self-mockery—it really was just an illusion of your imagination. The story you imagined had no other characters.
"Because of the [Citizens of Light]'s [grand visit], [shocking and alarming] all the [Dark People] of [Cyber City], they [flocked in] to [purchase goods], and I received a lot of [Dark Coins]."
"Hmm, I know what you mean by 'Dark Coin' is the currency used in the Dark World, but can this currency be used in the Light World?" You're a bit curious. This is a question you hadn't had time to ask before, but fortunately, it's still possible for now.
Spamton shook his head and then nodded: "It can't be established in objective theory, but it can be held by subjective will." ”
You didn't understand what he meant, so you could only nod blankly and say 'oh.'
The road seemed long, yet also short. Though reluctant to part, you still reached the door. Spamton skillfully hid aside, swallowing nervously, knocking on your door. No one answered. You were just used to this silence. Rather, it would be better if your father hadn't come back. You took out the key, opened the door, walked into your room, turned on the light, and started doing your homework.
You start looking forward to the moment he knocks on your window again. Sure enough, after a while, Spamton knocks on your window, gives you a blueberry-flavored candy, and then closes your window.
The candy was sweet, but for some reason, you felt a bit sour, as if you were feeling a sour taste in your heart. Wash the candy wrapper thoroughly and put it into the jar. There will probably be one or two left, and you can send out this jar filled with colorful origami cranes.
You carefully preserved the jar, a smile unconsciously playing at the corner of your lips as you continued working on your homework.
Spamton didn't notify you, and after school the next day, you didn't see him either, nor did you feel so disappointed—maybe you know...... Maybe one day, you'll see him again, and see this illusion again.
This time, it wasn't until three months later that you saw him again. He was still wearing that outfit, standing at the school gate waiting for you. When he saw you approach, his eyes lit up and he quickly waved at you.
You smiled and waved at him, then naturally ran up and took his hand. You were actually a bit nervous, but when you glanced at him out of the corner of your eye and saw he didn't say much, you finally relaxed.
You gently shook his hand, a hint of complaint, and said, "I can't see you every night now. It's just too boring......
Spamton nervously held your hand, glanced at you cautiously, and stammered, "Very ...... [boring to the core]?" ”
He only felt his chest throbbing wildly, unable to describe how he was feeling right now, just ...... He seemed very nervous.
"It's so boring. I don't have any friends at school, and I won't be able to chat with my father when I get home...... I've been holding back so much that I don't even know where to start." You pouted, not very happy.
"So today, will you tell [your story]?" Spamton said.
"My story...... Actually, there's not much to say. You know, it's basically the same things every day. Oh right, didn't I use my mother's contact information to sneak into the class group chat? "You kicked the pebble under your feet and said excitedly.
"Hmm, [Continue Process]?"
"Hmm, not long ago, I don't know which classmate was so idle that they actually reported me for secretly doing homework and not paying attention in class...... Then the homeroom teacher started contacting my nominal mother, who is me. Luckily, I found an excuse to brush it off! Honestly, it doesn't matter whether you listen to the current classes or not...... "No matter what, you can still stay in the top ten. If you don't want to study anymore, just let it go." After all, staying at school every day is a torment for you. Back then, with Spamton around, at least you had some hope, but now you don't even have any.
Spamton nodded: "Y/N [extremely smart]." "Although he knew this probably wasn't a good thing, since you were so proud, he wouldn't spoil your mood. And he truly thought you were very clever.
You awkwardly rubbed the tip of your nose, chuckled twice, and changed the subject: "By the way, what did Spammy do during those three months of being gone?" "You're a bit nervous again, because you called out his nickname, and you don't know if he'll allow it."
Fortunately, he didn't mean to stop you, and Spamton just covered his slightly flushed face, cautiously glanced at you, and only relaxed a little after confirming you might just call out that casually.
"I...... Last time I mentioned that [People of Light] to you, because of their [honorable presence], I [made a name for myself]. ”
You glanced at Spamton, a bit puzzled: "How did you get so out? You look no different from before, huh? Or are you secretly living a good life behind my back and not taking me along?" As you spoke, you tugged at his cheek, sounding angry and accusing, but in reality, you were just laughing and complaining.
“…… I—that's not what I meant. It's just that the [Dark World] and the [Light World] don't connect, so I can't bring you a 'good life.'" Spamton scratched his head and stammered a little.
You snorted lightly and didn't dwell on it, just grabbed his arm and shook it again: "So what happened then? What happened next?" "You're still quite curious. You really want to know what wonderful news has appeared in another world you don't know about."
"Hmm...... I've become a big shot in the Cyber World. All those insults and ridicule I mentioned to you before have come to apologize to me. But I have no friends, only myself, and those "Dark Coins." However, because I'm now a big shot, my sales keep growing." "It's fake. Actually, it's all just lies he made up. He's always wanted to be a big shot, but unfortunately, he's always been a small Addison at the bottom of the cyber world. Maybe he'll never become a big shot."
"Then I moved into the Queen's Mansion and had a Dream Life......" he continued, but you interrupted him.
You just glanced at him calmly and softly said, "Are you lying...... Are you lying?" His expression was unnatural as he spoke, and you could tell that too. You hadn't interrupted him before, because you could feel that he truly hoped for it, but you could also sense that he couldn't keep making things up, and in the end, all that remained was empty rumors.
Spamton's expression stiffened for a moment, then he forced a couple of laughs and said, "[Sincere] [Honest and honest.] ”
He's so serious that you start to wonder if you're mistaken, or maybe ...... Is he just overthinking it?
But you still held his hand and said solemnly, "Alright, whether it's true or not, you don't have a single friend. You still have me, at least I'll always be your friend!" You promised that, your eyes sparkling as you looked at him. Spamton was stunned for a moment, then turned his head in panic and just responded with a hum.
But the time you cherish so much is always short-lived. No matter how reluctant you are, you still stand at your doorstep. After saying goodbye to Spamton as always, you open the front door. This time, you ignore your drunken father's rambling and loud shouting, simply sitting at your desk and starting a new day of anticipation.
After a while, your window was knocked, and Spamton handed you a candy—today it was orange-flavored. The window was closed again. You carefully washed the candy wrapper, folded a thousand paper cranes, and put them in the jar. Looking at the jar that was almost full, you made up your mind to give it to Spamton, and next time we met, you could give it to him.
But after a day, two days, countless days pass, and you still haven't seen him. You don't know if you'll never see him again. If you empty that jar of origami cranes and let everything start over, will you still be able to see him? You don't know about this, and you don't dare to guarantee it. The feelings of youth seem empty and unrealized, but they've always been buried deep in your heart, making you feel unbearably sad.
And Spamton, isolated behind the window of time, knocks on that window but never opens it, watching as you sink deeper day by day. He is anxious but helpless; he can do nothing.
It wasn't until half a year later that he finally stepped out of the barrier of time and stood again at the school gate, waiting for you to come out.
You were carrying your handbag and about to go home as usual, but then you saw Spamton.
Your eyes lit up, and all those past memories ran through your heart, making you think about it endlessly. You rushed forward and hugged Spamton, even though your other classmates were in serious trouble. You just inexplicably lunged toward the air, then hugged the air.
You sniff, trying hard to hold back your tears: "...... Long time no see, spammy. ”
Spamton's body stiffened for a moment, but in the end he hugged you back and whispered, "Mm, long time no see." ”
He sensed he was about to leave, so he didn't dare promise you anything more. On the way home, the streetlights cast your shadow, and for once, neither of you said a word. You nervously waited for him to knock on the window to send out that jar of origami cranes, while he was just lost in thought.
Spamton…… It's just a bit reluctant. He can't bear to part with these memories, and he still wants to walk with you, even though these are just memories and he can't change anything.
Unconsciously, he walked to your doorstep. Spamton waved at you, then, as usual, hid behind the wall. When he saw the faint light from the window, he timed it, touched the extra candy in his pocket, walked toward the windowsill, and stood on tiptoe to open the window.
And you've been waiting for this moment for a long time. Your heart is pounding nonstop. You hug the jar of origami cranes, then suddenly open the window, startling Spamton.
And you just took a deep breath, bent down, and solemnly said to him, "Spammy, I like you." ”
Spamton's eyes widened instinctively. He wanted to say that maybe this feeling was just an illusion born in your despair. He wanted to tell you there was still plenty of time, and you didn't need to make a decision right now. He wanted to say......
But before he could speak, he looked at you saying something else, but he couldn't hear clearly. All that remained was dizzying, and everything before him was black and white. When the dizziness faded, he realized he was back in the cinema. The screen turned pitch black, the headlights came on, and he slowly checked the movie ticket in his hand. The photo behind him had already turned color. For some reason, the girl was holding a jar of colorful origami cranes, exactly like the jar you had just given him.

Our cinema was generated according to the Queen's film screening requirements, and the movie content comes from the storage and download of the People of Light. And you're bored sitting on top of a trash can, with no one to play with, so you can only entertain yourself playing Gomoku with the board—playing by yourself, which is quite fun.
When you see Spamton arrive, your eyes light up. You shake the chessboard aside, jump off the trash can, and run toward him, grabbing his hand: "Did you find a new photo?" ”

Instinctively, you covered your head, feeling a slight pain and blurred vision. For a moment, you couldn't process what was happening—maybe it was the same as last time. Spamton instinctively supported you. You leaned against Spamton's chest, his body stiff, his eyes darting left and right, but he didn't know what to do.
Just like the last photo, you've recovered part of your memory, at least from after your high school years...... You seem to have figured it all out, but unfortunately, that jar of origami cranes seems to have disappeared in the end. It seems that after you handed it over that day, no one took the jar, nor did it capture your affection. So the jar fell to the ground and shattered, along with your heart. You finally admitted that that figure, that affection, might just be your illusion.
And now, looking at Spamton standing in front of you and holding you, unconsciously, tears streamed down your face. You clearly knew that now he was truly there; compared to that, you felt more like an illusion.
“…… So, are we lovers, spammy? "You sobbed a few times, and finally asked the question with a trembling voice.

Orange, who had been staring at him, also laughed at the sound, walked back, patted Pink on the shoulder, and raised an eyebrow: "That's right, this guy is Spamton, but I just don't know how he ended up like this...... Kid, are you planning to come back and do business? His voice was mocking and mocking. Spamton hadn't intended to pay attention to these people, so he could only raise his head and glare fiercely at them, even though Spamton probably knew this wouldn't have any deterrent effect since he was just too young now.
Yellow also came over, snuggled up next to Pink, putting his arm around his shoulder, and looked at Spamton with schadenfreude: "Oh my...... I thought you'd have a better life, but in the end, you're worse off than us. Heaven really does come full circle. ”
Even before he finished speaking, Spamton knew this guy was mocking him, and he clenched his fists, but there was nothing he could do.
Listening to the noisy commotion outside, you were originally dozing off, but these guys woke you up. You stayed here waiting for Spamton to bring back your memories. Although he went to the Queen's villa, you believe that one day he will come back with what you need.
