You exhale and naturally release spamton's wrist, spamton instinctively try to grab your hand—at that moment, he feels a bit empty, but immediately restrained his movements, standing next to you with his pockets tucked in.
Of course, you didn't notice his expression at that moment. You just said to him, "Alright, this mechanism is basically broken. From now on, we just need to walk along this path—if we want to return the way we came, since we're not sure the road ahead is definitely a passageway, and if it's a dead end, we can still walk back." "You explained it like this, spamton just nodded casually behind you. He didn't understand the dungeon rules anyway, so he was just following you." You let go of spamton's hand, and now he leisurely followed behind you. Sure enough, after going a bit further, you saw a stone door—with a keyhole on it. Clearly, you needed to find the key on another road right now. You grabbed spamton's hand again: "Let's go back first. It looks like we need to find the key first before we can keep moving forward......" You said this, pulling spamton back to the starting point. The four roads here—if you look closely, they've already transformed into four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The winter road looks very cold, but as for spring and autumn...... Hmm, it looked like a very peaceful road, but Xia's road was now entirely water. Either swimming or rowing—there were probably only two solutions.
You reached out and poked spamton: "Alright, you choose. Which direction do you think we should go?" "After you poked twice spamton he was still a bit confused. He really didn't understand why you suddenly started asking about his thoughts now...... To be honest, he was just running after you.
Thinking this, he couldn't help but say, "...... I've never been to a dungeon before, I'm just a newcomer. If you have any ideas about where to go, shouldn't you leave it to you? Ahem, but if you leave it to me to decide, that would be a very wise choice—let's go with this one!" At first, he was a bit modest, but then his confidence soared—after all, you made him choose, and who is he? He's the king of this world! What is he afraid of! So he confidently pointed to a road—the one that looks very peaceful in spring.
You smiled and nodded, "Alright, let's head this way then. I also want to see what kind of choice newcomers can make when they just arrived in the dungeon." As you said this, you grabbed spamton's wrist and headed toward the path toward spring.
Grass grows and orioles fly, willow catkins drift everywhere, and you can even hear birdsong—the flowers blooming all around, bees flying around. No matter how you look at it, this place is very peaceful, with no sign of any traps or monsters at all. Even spamton watching this scene can't help but feel a bit extra thought. He straightforwardly leans in and asks, "Hey, hey, Y/N, I didn't just pick a final path to the end, did I? So does that mean we directly conquered this dungeon?" His eyes sparkled too, clearly showing he was very eager, and you nodded in response: "If that's really the case, that would be great!" Spamton luck is really good. If that's the case, I believe the next few dungeon runs' will go very smoothly!" "You say that, but your luck is actually terrible. Every time, you have to find the last path to find the real passage...... So now you can't help but feel a bit excited. After all, if you can break through this dungeon directly, that would be fantastic! You can't help but start looking forward to spamton luck, so you quicken your pace: "Let's hurry up. If we can really get out of this dungeon today, maybe we can have some fun outside......"
Spamton pouted: "What's so fun about those things......" Those were all paid projects he designed based on the things the Dark People were good at. Of course, playing requires payment—any entertainment requires payment!
And you just shrugged indifferently: "Hmm, I know...... Isn't it good to provide you with income? Anyway, having more money is definitely happier. ”
"That's perfect for you—" spamton's eyes darted around. He smelled money—maybe he could make a lot from you. So he couldn't help but put on the same smile he usually used to sell projects. "I believe you'll definitely experience the service experience of 'Supreme Delicious' here! Let me introduce it to you when the time comes!" ”
As you spoke, you unknowingly reached the end, and unexpectedly, it seemed there was a small house at the end.
TBC.

title: Employment Syndrome 1 (sptx you)
content:
Sptx, you, OOC counts me as me. And the full title of this story is 'Wasn't it supposed to be a thug? Why don't you want money and want to sleep with me?!' 》
I wonder how long it will be, just writing for fun.
——
Take a deep breath, and you roll around on your big bed. Turns out the saying 'don't want lots of money, lots and lots of love' isn't a joke...... No! You don't need love either. To you, love is useless; it can be changed at will, impossible to keep forever, love is completely unimportant. You only worry about how to use a pile of money, and even if you have money, you can't resist being foolish and insisting on getting close to it...... At least what you think is brainless.
After two seconds of contemplation, you suddenly sat up from the bed. You figured out how to deal with the money, and also how to stop the idiots from getting close to you and give you some peace. Why not just hire thugs? At worst, just beat up those idiots who came over and beat them up. If it really doesn't work out, sneak around and put a sack on them to beat them up. If anyone you dislike, beat them up too. That way, you'd feel refreshed.
You start to feel happy, but despite the wonderful idea, you don't really know what the call for hiring a messenger is. So reality is harsh. After two seconds of hesitation, you decide to post the commission, believing that as long as you pay enough, no one will come.
So you hastily wrote a recruitment commission for enforcers. As for the salary...... Uh, then one million Dark Coins per month will be fine. If that's not enough, add more. If no one comes in the next few days, you decide to add more Dark Coins.
Then write down your contact number and address. Make a few copies of this commission, since you don't want to leave home too far, so you only post a few near your home and a few in the alley behind. What if someone desperate wants to come and take a look...... Although you also have to be careful about murder and robbery.
Then you go home and lie in bed, happily imagining what happens next. You've made up your mind: look through the peephole, and if someone thinks it's no good at first glance, just don't open the door.
But before you can finish imagining the next wonderful scene, there is a knock at the door. You have no choice but to get out of bed in annoyance and peer through the peephole to see who is knocking. But when you first look outside, you can't see a single person there—surely it can't be haunted...... Then you hear another knock at the door, sounding like it's below the main door. So your gaze looks down and you really see a little short man through the peephole, and you also notice he is holding a stack of power of attorney letters...... Counting to ten, aren't these the ones you just printed?
But a little dwarf probably wouldn't pose much threat to you, so you comforted yourself like that and then opened the door.
And he tore down all ten commission letters—what kind of perseverance is that? Are you going to reprint and post them yourself? If so, you'd have to send this guy away first. You don't want to wait until he thinks no one has left, only to have all the new commissions he posted be torn up and knocked on your door again.
And his clothes were all sloppy, and there seemed to be some kind of smell from him...... In short, you quietly took a few steps away from him.
You put your hands on your hips, trying to look a bit more imposing, then look down at him from above: "...... Is there something you need?" ”
He waved the power of attorney and showed it to you: '[Hello], [self-introduction], I am Spamton.G.Spamton, and I am now applying for [your] [hitter position].'
You sighed. Sure enough, what is meant to happen will come. But what could such a tiny puppet possibly do? Could it be to go up and bite someone...... Anyway, you couldn't help but start laughing, first denying another thing: "Alright, even if you tore up ten authorization letters, I still can't give you ten times the price of one million." ”
Spamton nodded; actually, he knew about this. But when you posted your commission in the alley, he happened to be in the trash bin and saw you. After you left, he came out to see what was written on your commission, and then he was tempted. After all, he wouldn't give up a million silver dollars.
Tearing off all other commissions is obviously to prevent competitors from coming in. Since he has his eye on this position, it can only belong to him.
Now you stand with your hands on your hips, looking at him from head to toe, and finally shake your head regretfully: "But you're too small, you don't look good at all. I feel like I can't hire you...... Since I'm a hired enforcer, I have to find someone who looks really tough." ”
"No [relationship]. I'm not just [maintaining the status quo]. Before I fully become a [enforcer], as long as I obtain the [Abyss] [Body] of the [Queen's Mansion]'s [Fitness Body], I can become the [perfect enforcer]. "He sounds like he's trying hard to promote himself, while you just look at him with a strange expression, suspicious in your heart.
In short, you still know that the queen's basement really does have a set of mechas locked away...... Probably abandoned, you and her are pretty close—at least you're acquainted. After all, your family is so wealthy now partly because the queen appreciated it, so just spending money to buy a set of mechas she might not need isn't a big deal.
But...... You've only just met, and you don't even know this employee. Well, maybe he's a future employee. How will he work? Is he suited for the job? Why should you spend money on him?
That's what you think, so naturally you asked. You said, "I might have gotten that thing you mentioned by spending some money...... But you haven't done anything yet. I don't know how capable you really are, so why should I spend money for you?" You genuinely have this doubt.
"No [relationship]. [You] will find this is a [value for money] deal that will definitely make you [kill]. Besides, I don't think [you] care about this [money]. " he said.
You scratched your head. You couldn't see his expression clearly, so you didn't know what he was feeling right now. But Spamton was right—you really didn't care much about money, just afraid of trouble. So most things you could solve with money were too lazy to handle yourself. Now, being willing to chat with Spamton a bit longer was just boring.
So after thinking it over, you finally waved your hand grandly: "Alright, let's start with a one-month probation period. I won't pay you for this month, but you have to work hard...... Also, looking so sloppy, you can stay at my place first. Oh, there's a guest room there." As you spoke, you pointed toward another direction in the corridor.
Then you closed the door, grabbed the authorization letters from his hands and threw them on the table, returned to your room, lay down on the bed, and after a moment of dazing, remembered to call the queen. In any case, you paid and agreed to treat her to acid pie for a month. The queen generously agreed to your request, telling you to have the serocard butler deliver the mech to your residence the next day.
You hung up satisfied, rolled around on the bed a few times, then fell asleep again. It wasn't until dinner time that you got up and walked outside, rubbing your eyes as the butler brought you all kinds of delicious food. Honestly, you didn't have much of an appetite, so you just bored your fork with chicken in your fork. Then you saw Spamton climb over and sit across from you. You glanced at him and saw that the puppet's head couldn't even go above the table; you could only see the top of his head. You had to quickly call the butler to bring him a few more cushions, and now his head was visible on the table.
You didn't pay him any mind, just finished the dinner by yourself. In the spacious room, you did some walking and digestion, then went to the shower on time to wash up and rest...... But before you could rest, you were stopped, your leg was grabbed, and when you looked down, it was Spamton.
“…… I don't have a suitable [change of clothes]." He thought it over for a long time before coming to tell you. In fact, he really didn't have any clothes to change into. Even in this situation, he couldn't guarantee his own clothing or food.
You glanced at him in disbelief, your mind spinning twice, realizing that he had previously been rummaging through trash, so it was normal not to have it.
"Ah, you can talk to the butler about this kind of thing, and just ask me for reimbursement when the time comes." You thought for a moment and said. Thinking carefully, you don't really need that money, and you're genuinely curious about what kind of surprise this little puppet is making with such confidence.
"Anyway, if you need anything, just ask the butler to buy it. There's no need to come to me specifically for this kind of thing—I don't even know what to buy...... Unless you want to wear a doll dress, then I have a lot piled up over there." As you spoke, you couldn't help but yawn, because this was already your usual rest time.
As for why there are so many doll dresses...... Yeah, you used to really enjoy dress-up dolls. Of course, you've tried all kinds of games, and a bunch of dresses are just a collector's habit. In fact, you don't even bother to swap them—you just buy them and just toss them away.
"[Okay], I'm [already known]." Spamton nodded to show he understood. In fact, he was just looking for some opportunities to talk to you. He noticed that after half a day, he hadn't found any chance to talk to you, and instead talked the most when he first came in. After half a day, he decided to use this topic to test your attitude...... Hmm, it seems you don't really care.
And you just nodded randomly and went back to rest. Early the next morning, sure enough, the Sekka butler brought over that set of mechs. The Sekka butler said it was called Neo, but you didn't care what it was called—after all, the Queen had left them in the basement and abandoned them.
Then you watch Spamton tinker with the mech set. You have no idea what he's doing, you can't understand. In short, you insert the disk he mentioned into the Neo and see if nothing has changed. You simply ignore it and stand up, planning to head into the room.
But after just a few steps, you hear an even worse sound behind you. Of course, compared to Spamton's previous voice, it's rougher, and for some reason, the electric current sounds even louder. You can't stand it and can't help but turn back to see what Spamton is like now.
…… Wow, indeed, he looks quite tall now. At least you need to look up to see him now. You sigh a little, unable to help but smack your lips and ask, "So...... Looks like you can start working tomorrow?" "You even get a little excited."
Although he didn't know why his hands and feet were still shaking...... He also didn't know why there were some strange strings and puppet stands on top, but it seemed like there was nothing wrong with them.
You don't care about that; you just want more enforcers.
"Of course, no problem. Maybe you have a training ground, which allows me to show off my power?" He looked up, probably laughing heartily. You hesitated for a moment, thought about your home's layout, and finally spoke sincerely.
"Hmm...... As for the training ground, it does exist, but it's in the basement of my house. It's just that it's been a long time since I used it, and it's gathering dust. "You don't even know why your family has such a training ground. You don't even need that thing......
Spamton nodded; he didn't care where it was. So you hesitated for a moment, but eventually led the way, leading him to the basement and watching him raise his hand...... Ah, no, you could say you could have raised the laser cannon, but in any case, you used that shell to blast the wall.
“…… Wow. You rubbed your chin and couldn't help but sigh, starting to ponder the question. To be honest, you didn't really think a single thug could cause much harm. At most, you just got so angry you called the thug to beat him up. But now you feel that even has some killing power, which makes you hesitate.
And once you lose your temper, you can't help but wonder: do you really want the thug to deal with that person? Maybe it's just your own actions that went wrong at the time, or did you get angry just during the conversation with that person? Maybe there was a better way to solve it at that time? In short, you basically do this every time. After your initial anger passes, start reflecting on whether it was really your fault.
So you watch as Spamton, who has turned to face you, hesitantly starts to speak: 'I think... maybe that person, looking back now, doesn't necessarily need to be severely beaten...'
For some reason, the little puppet who you could originally only look down upon now advances with a sense of pressure. He is closing in on you, closing in on you, until you are forced to lift your head and look at him. And now he looks down at you, speaking in that hoarse, electric-blended voice: 'Do you really think that a severe beating is no longer necessary?'
You swallow and explain: 'It's just... maybe, I also did something wrong before, it's not purely that person's fault...'
'...Then, [tell] me, the full [picture of the whole matter].'
Tbc.

title: Employment Syndrome 2 (sptx you)
content:
Sptx, you, OOC counts me as me. And the full title of this story is 'Wasn't it supposed to be a thug? Why don't you want money and want to sleep with me?!' 》
I wonder how long it will be, just writing for fun.
——
You scratched your head, wanting to say something but holding back, and glanced at Spamton—well, to be honest, you're hesitating about whether to tell others. If you just swallow your pride and swallow your anger, that's fine, just a little longer......
Anyway, this kind of thing isn't the first or second time.
So now, you just looked away a little guiltily...... Hmm, hmm, you didn't dare meet his gaze for now, but you could still feel his gaze fixed on you.
In the end, you cleared your throat twice: "Alright, I'll organize my words and tell you. Before that, can you change back! It's too high, I'm tired from tilting my head back!" You started pointing and whispering, automatically ignoring his hesitant expression.
In the end, Spamton returned to his little puppet form. I don't know what he'd been messing with again. You looked down and saw him running to your leg. After thinking it over, you grabbed him by the back of the neck and went upstairs. You planned to put him down at the table before talking—just as long as you could stall, so you actually walked very slowly.
But Spamton struggled in your hands, and you almost lost your grip: "[Stop]! I can [move free], I don't need [futile] [help]!" ”
You let out a regretful 'ah' and had no choice but to put him on the steps, watching him climb up the steps. After all, he was much faster than you walked slowly, so you just watched his back with regret.
…… In fact, from your slow pace, Spamton could tell you probably didn't want to speak, or maybe you just didn't know what to say, so you wanted to stall for time—after all, you just said you wanted to tell him.
So he just climbed onto his seat, not in a hurry, just waiting for you to walk out slowly.
No matter how reluctant you are, this path still has an end, and you will eventually reach the end. So when you peek out from the basement, you spot Spamton sitting there—honestly, he looks like a tiny one, but why does he seem so oppressive? You only feel nervous and uneasy, a feeling similar to when you stammered with your parents about your mistakes before...... Or maybe you feel a bit uneasy about saying such things to strangers. After all, you can't possibly treat the person you just hired as your own parent!
…… It's just that I feel a bit guilty for no apparent reason. After all, you know that if you ignore those matters, you'll look very weak. Anyone who sees you will be disappointed that you haven't lived up to your talents.
But you gave him money, so as long as he doesn't tell anyone, it doesn't matter, right...... Thinking this, you finally dawdled and sat down opposite him.
You rested your chin on your hand, hesitated for a moment, and said, "Uh...... First, you must make sure that what you hear from me must not be leaked outside. "You coughed lightly twice, and your voice grew serious. After all, confirming this matter is still very important.
Spamton nodded matter-of-factly: "Of course." "He wouldn't do something so disgraceful, and spreading your story wouldn't do him any good."
So you took a deep breath, your fingers restlessly fiddling with each other. Probably conflicted, the room suddenly fell silent, leaving only the sound of light breathing. Only then did you finally make up your mind to speak.
“…… Actually, it's nothing much. I just had a friend I used to get along with—at least I think they were good friends—but recently they fell out with me and even turned around and accused me of bullying her behind their backs...... Honestly, I don't have that much time. Every day after finishing my work, I eat and sleep and I'm already very busy...... "Well, it's just that you're so slow." After all, you don't have much to do, so you take your time on everything.
“…… Moreover, she leaked what I had told her before to others, which led to many rumors about me outside. But because of my status, those rumors didn't dare come to me ...... "As you spoke, you pressed your temples in frustration. To be honest, what you told her back then wasn't a big deal, but she exaggerated the rumors, mixing those rumors with half-truths and falsehoods. You were a bit lazy to explain." At this point, your eyes reddened. After all, you had no idea that an old friend would do such a thing after turning against you.
After all, self-proving is the most troublesome part and often hard to explain.
"That's why I said from the start that you can't spread this matter outside...... Even if I pay a little more, it doesn't matter! After all, oh, we're just strangers who met by chance, and old friends could turn against each other...... "You muttered to yourself."
"I have [professional ethics], so I naturally wouldn't engage in such [behavior]. Also...... I think [you] shouldn't [let go so easily]. Maybe the [beating] behind the scenes is necessary for [you]. "Spamton finished speaking without changing his expression. To be honest, he didn't know how you managed to endure it. Could it be that you don't like going out, so naturally you can't hear those things?
You scratched your head and awkwardly chuckled twice: "Ahaha...... Well, after all, I might have had issues too, otherwise we might not have fallen out back then...... After all, maybe I did say something wrong and then spoke inappropriate...... You were still racking your brains over your own reasons when Spamton interrupted you.
"No, maybe [you] have a problem, but it's not the main reason. It's the other party who caused you [harm] and caused you [distress]. Moreover, the [behavior] itself is [wrong], so I believe [revenge] is [reasonable]. ”
…… You scratched your hair again. The already messy hairstyle was completely messed up by you. Looking over through Spamton's glasses, you couldn't see his expression, so in the end, you took a deep breath, though still a bit hesitant.
“…… But precisely because I probably have issues too, I feel I can't fully blame her......" you hesitate and whisper softly, but the room is so quiet that Spamton can hear everything clearly.
He almost wants to knock on your head to see what kind of brain your brain is actually constructed. Of course, at first, it's just for money, so he plans to ask a few more symbolic questions. Even if you might be at fault, he can hype you up and make you look like a victim.
But now, it sounds like you're both the victims—just not perfect, you have your own problems.
Spamton just sighed: "I think your only [problem] is that you gave your heart inappropriately. That person is clearly [not worthy] [you] [giving your heart], and obviously, [you] shouldn't casually [tell outsiders] certain things. ”
You listened in a daze, wanting to argue something, but then Spamton paused and continued: "Besides, when facing a [problem], [you] shouldn't be too harsh on yourself, but rather reflect on the other person's [problems]. ”
You blinked, though you didn't quite agree, but you still felt a guilty sense of being taught, so you instinctively placed your hands on your knees and sat up straight: "Oh oh...... Oh oh oh......
"[Understood]?" You heard him ask, probably feeling somewhat satisfied seeing your reaction.
You hesitated for a moment, then shook your head, hesitated for a moment, and then nodded again: "Uh...... Then could you please go beat her up? ”
You heard him sigh heavily. So you nervously smiled instinctively, pressing your lips together. Although you probably understood something, in reality you still didn't, so you felt embarrassed to continue.
After all, even if he says that, you'll probably still be like this next time...... Maybe you never learn.
But at this point, you actually became more alert and glanced at Spamton: "By the way, I just told you about it...... You can't tell anyone about it! Besides, I paid you—I'm your employer. If you tell anyone, I'll ...... ...... Forget it, I really can't do anything about it. "As you spoke, your shoulders slumped too, feeling a bit deflated.
Spamton thought to himself that if you really told others, it would make you look like a victim. Public opinion was overwhelmingly one-sided, unless he cleverly tweaked his wording, saying it was just because he had a falling out with a friend that he planned to hire thugs to get revenge on an ex-friend...... But that didn't help him at all.
So he simply added, "[Don't worry], enough [money] can keep me 'tight-lipped.'" ”
"Oh...... Then I'll give you a little later!" You clenched your fist and high-fived excitedly, thinking you understood something.
…… Actually, that's not what he meant, but if you gave him more money, of course he wouldn't mind—in fact, he was quite pleased.
"So, continue with the [Thug Agreement]?" he suggested. That topic just now was settled.
"Oh...... Yes, actually, I had the butler investigate too. There's information about where she appears whenever she comes in, and she usually appears at fixed times every day. So you just need to use the information to sack her and beat her up! "Speaking of which, you were quite interested, feeling around the cabinet nearby, then took out a plate of documents and handed it to Spamton.
He roughly glanced at your file, knowing where you needed to take action, and that you could get it done this afternoon. So Spamton closed the file. But then he looked up at you again: "Do you need a [photo as a keepsake]?" ”
You hesitated for a moment. To be honest, you didn't really want to see the other party's miserable state, but having photos would definitely confirm that Spamton had really done the work...... Hmm, so your expression finally turned serious: "Ah, then let's take a photo as a keepsake!" After all, I need to confirm your mission status so I can pay you...... Oh right, regarding what I just said, I'll give you 100,000 Dark Coin hush money......
Muttering to yourself, you somehow pull out a checkbook and write a check slip to Spamton.
He put the check away, nodded, then suddenly took out a phone—hmm, it looks like an old model? It probably hasn't been replaced in many years.
"So, [Add] [Contact Information]?" He asked.
You thought for a moment and gave a string of your phone numbers, watching Spamton type them into your phone. For some reason, you felt relieved, probably just ...... Confirm that everything is going smoothly.
Although you are still hesitating about whether you should hit the other person, at this point, you should fight! Otherwise, you will feel uncomfortable whenever you think about this matter, and you should try something else to distract your attention!
Just as you were thinking, you heard his voice again: "Maybe, the afternoon timing is just right." ”
You blinked sluggishly and looked at Spamton. Fine, you still couldn't figure out his expression, so you cautiously asked, "Uh...... Is it really that urgent? ”
"It's not an emergency, it's just that I think this kind of matter should be handled first."
You nodded half-understandingly, half-understanding. Actually, you thought it wouldn't matter to delay it until later, since you had been delaying for a while anyway, so you just muttered quietly, "Well...... Actually, I also delayed about half a month before finding your ......" But looking into his eyes, you don't know why you don't dare to continue.
Actually, you can't see his gaze clearly; in that moment, you feel as if he's throwing you a sharp, cold look—probably a reproach, so much so that you shut your mouth.
"No other [questions]?" he asked.
And you quickly shake your head: "No, no, no." ”
Spamton nodded in satisfaction, jumped off his seat, and headed toward the basement. You leaned on the table watching him walk out, put on that mech or something like that, and then staggered out the door. You yawned, probably busy with some things to handle. After lunch, just as you lay drowsy in bed, your phone suddenly vibrated.
You held back the yawn you were about to let out, checked your phone, and found that it was a photo sent by Spamton. It was the former friend you mentioned in the morning, and at that moment she was lying on the ground with her face bruised.
Somehow, although you felt a little vindicated, you also felt a bit wistful. At the same time, you had a sense of relief that someone had finally stood up for you—although that, too, had been hired with money.
So you just sent Spamton a string of thumbs-up emojis, threw your phone aside, and completely fell asleep.
At dinner, Spamton turned into that little puppet again and sat at the table, probably considering that you weren’t used to it. In any case, you ate this dinner feeling refreshed, and afterward, the rumors died down; it’s said that the person went out to clarify or something like that.
Spamton wouldn’t tell you that he had threatened the other person into doing it. He was just providing you with some extra services, after all, you had paid way too much money.
End.

title: Employment Syndrome 3 (sptx you)
content:
You just feel a bit relieved, thinking that person will eventually repent......
So one day at dinner, you couldn't help but bring this up to Spamton: "Speaking of which, that person hasn't been spreading rumors lately. It seems he's repented...... Hmm, or maybe he changed his mind or something? "Your mind wandered, recalling a game you played when you were bored.
Seeing you so enthusiastic, Spamton didn't dare interrupt you, just kept munching on his sandwich and continued talking excitedly.
"I knew it, even though I gave my heart a bit wrong, at least I have a decent eye for people. She's not someone who admits her mistakes and doesn't change...... "You're in a pretty good mood, and it's obvious you're happy."
Spamton couldn't help but interject: "No, I [requested] her [to keep quiet.] ”
You blinked, like a deflated balloon inflated, and slumped unhappily on the table: "Ah...... Alright. Actually, I don't have many friends; I've only made friends with sincerity. I didn't expect she would be that kind of person...... "You're a bit down."
But you still want to insist you're not someone who judges people, after all...... You've only made such a good friend! You don't know anyone else. You don't like having a wide social circle, so aside from that, you only have a few acquaintances.
Spamton looked at you speechlessly: "Maybe you could consider making friends through [Money Transactions]. ”
You tilted your head, still leaning on the table, watching the little puppet across from you slowly gnaw on a sandwich, and just sneered, "Buying friends with money?" I'm not stupid. How could a friend bought with money be genuine...... Most of the time, it's just for the money. "You muttered to yourself.
"I will be 'sincere.'" You wanted to say more when you heard Spamton's voice, and you couldn't help but widen your eyes in surprise at him.
His voice became stammering: "W-what are you saying, you mean I can pay you to buy you as a friend?" As you spoke, you couldn't help but size up Spamton again, but all you could tell was that he was serious.
You hesitated for a moment: "...... Are you sure? You probably don't know me very well, but you can be friends just because of money. How valuable do you think that is?" Although you were a little tempted, you still forced yourself to suppress the urge inside.
Spamton looked at you, put down his sandwich, and immediately said, "You hate [trouble], hate [handling affairs], and prefer [getting things without effort]. You hate [conflict], because you hesitated for half a month before deciding to [hire] someone to resolve [the issue]. In summary, [you] are somewhat [weak] in personality, or rather, [gentle in temperament]. You are [introverted], dislike [crowds], and [you] do not have other [friends]...... At the same time, you should [prefer] [minimalist style], but at the same time, [you] will try other [styles] out of your own [preference]. You prefer [sweets]......"
Before you could finish, you made a gesture for me to be quiet, making you a bit embarrassed: "Stop, stop, stop...... How can you analyze so much? I've confessed, I've confessed. That's it. I agree you can be my friend. I'll give you the money later." "You'd better use the money to shut him up."
Spamton closed his mouth, looking very enthusiastic. Actually, he said so much not because he wanted more money; it was only at the moment he left the mouth that he realized he already understood you—and so he was confident.
Well, at least for now, he simply wants to be friends with you.
You sighed, resting one hand on your chin, wondering how much money to give, but then saw Spamton suddenly jump off the table and run toward you. You stared at him, then saw him pick up the hand you had put down and seriously kiss the back of your hand—well, actually, you didn't feel any wetness, only heard the sound of a kiss, and you somewhat dumbly realized it was a hand-kissing gesture. Your mind was a bit confused for a moment, because you didn't know why he was doing it.
"Then, you and I will always be [friends added] [relationship]. I will help you clear away [troubles], resolve [conflicts], and listen to [troubles]. "You listened in a daze, not knowing why he said that.
So you can only nod awkwardly: "Oh oh...... Oh oh oh...... Uh, how much money do you need? "In the end, you still get cautious. After all, if you're that loyal, it definitely requires a lot of money, right?
You see Spamton look up at you. Somehow, you catch a bit of a bit of speechlessness through his glasses, so you rub your nose a little guiltily: "After all...... This is just friendship bought with money, or something like that. ”
Besides, this was your hired enforcer. Although to make it easier for you to have him live under the same roof and see you every day, looking up and down every day...... Ah, wait, it's only when you look down every day that you see him, but you think you're far from that close, and you can't naturally become friends.
Spamton was silent for a moment. Well, he knew you were just that kind of person...... After all, a couple of days ago he heard you complain about how you fell out with your previous friend. He said he liked you very much, but you didn't understand and said you liked him too. So he thought you had agreed to confess and planned to kiss you, but instead, you blamed him for not doing such things because you were just friends......
So in a way, he thinks you should be purebred wood.
So at this moment, he just looked at you speechlessly: "...... [Friend Fee]?" Then, one hundred [silver dollars] per day. "Actually, one hundred silver dollars isn't much to him, since you've given me too much other money. That one hundred silver dollars is just an extra tip to answer your question. He was seriously suggesting becoming friends with you, but in the end, he didn't want you to overthink it.
You nod thoughtfully, but somehow, you feel a bit disappointed because of it...... You start to blame yourself, thinking you shouldn't have such feelings. After all, you're just making a cold monetary transaction, so friendship and loyalty that can be gained with just money aren't necessarily bad.
"Alright...... Then just treat it as pocket money! Hey, is that right...... It doesn't seem quite right...... "You mutter, then pull out a 100-dollar dark coin bill from your pocket and hand it to Spamton.
Then you cheerfully say, "Here, today's friend fee is yours!" Let's be friends! "But this way, you have a real friend too—even though it was bought with money, thinking about it lifts your spirits again.
Spamton took the pocket money, placed it on his body, then looked up at you: "So, what about today's dinner?" "What do you need? I'll notify the butler." "Since Spamton arrived at your house, you all ate together during mealtime, so you simply handed Spamton the instructions for the butler's next meal. Anyway, this wasn't a trouble for him.
You rubbed your chin and let out an 'ouch' before you remembered the incident.
"Ah...... Well, I won't be having dinner at home. There's a banquet tonight, you know, it's the kind of gathering where the upper class hangs out. I have to go. "You shrugged.
After all, the family's status is there, so it's hard to refuse to go, and this gathering was organized by the queen.
Spamton nodded: "Understood, then I will wait for you to return." ”
You nodded in satisfaction. After finishing this lunch, you carefully picked out your evening dress and put on some light makeup, then took the vehicle that came to pick you up and headed to the banquet venue.
Dinner was enjoyed by Spamton sitting alone at the table. Usually, he would add a bit of what he needed after listing the dishes he needed. And since your appetite wasn't large, he usually only ate part of it and then had to take care of the rest, so Spamton didn't dare to order too much. In short, every meal was tailored to your taste, which made him very familiar with what tastes you liked and what dishes you liked.
But today, since you went out, it was rare that Spamton ordered only your favorite flavors. He actually enjoyed dinner, then casually found a spot in the living room to wait for you to come back.
You were still excited before leaving, but when you came back, you were puffed up, your eyes red, and you even wiped your eyes, looking like you weren't about to cry. You stormed in, then threw yourself into the sofa and sat down hard. The sofa caved in and bounced back up several times, and Spamton started sliding as you sat on it—after all, it was a very smooth leather sofa—and then it slid beside you.
You were still feeling a bit stifled, feeling a cool sensation beside your arm. Looking down, it was Spamton. You simply picked him up and held him in your arms, while your other hand started ruffling his hair, a bit displeased as you said, "I'm really stuffed with anger...... I barely ate anything! Maybe I'll have to go have a late-night snack later...... Ah, forget it, none of that matters. Go beat him up for me!" You started showing off your fangs and claws, lying on the sofa and gesturing casually.
"What happened at the gala tonight?" Spamton asked.
…… There was nothing either, so he just jumped down to the coffee table, grabbed a candy, handed it to you, and then climbed back onto your knees.
You feel his movements tickle you, so you simply lift him up and sit on your lap.
"Sigh...... There have been rumors about it recently, but most people know about it to some extent. It's just that most people don't care—at most, it's just gossip behind the scenes. And there are plenty of people who simply don't believe it...... "As you chewed the candy, your tone finally calmed down a bit, though your words were a bit unclear.
As you talk, you get a little angry and want to cry: "Besides, I was in a bad mood before, which is why I told my ex-friend that I dislike the opposite sex...... After all, when I used to go out occasionally, I would run into guys staring at my chest with lecherous eyes. That would be one thing, but some people even asked me why I wore a bit of something and even wanted to touch them!" As you spoke, you pressed Spamton's head hard again.
Spamton's body stiffened for a moment. Actually, he hadn't paid attention to this before...... It was only when you mentioned it that he realized your chest was indeed soft, and ...... Uh, maybe he just leaned back and touched it?
"Anyway, I really don't know what the rumors are exaggerating to the point...... But today I met a man who first looked me up and down with a critical attitude, then said that considering my family background and figure, he could barely marry me? And he said that with those rumors around, probably no one would be interested in me? "You didn't care about these things and just kept rambling about your experience tonight, since you were really about to be furious.
And saying such things in public is almost an insult, which is why you're so upset.
"Oh my god...... Actually, I had genuinely liked that person before. After all, I thought his manners were elegant and interesting, and we got along well before. But I never expected him to say that in public...... "You still find it hard to believe. But after you said all this, you felt much better, and in the end, you just let out a heavy breath.
"Ha...... Phew, forget it, maybe he didn't mean it sincerely. Anyway, I saw clearly what kind of scumbag that person was. I probably don't need you to beat him up; I just need to be a bit more careful with my words and actions...... You muttered.
"So. [Sincerity] again [misplaced]?" "After hearing your rambling, he asked this question first.
Your smile stiffened for a moment, then you chuckled awkwardly: "Alright, I admit I misjudged people. I swear I've learned my lesson." ”
…Actually, making a deliberate pact with him is probably also a case of misjudging people, after all, his intentions aren’t simple. Thinking this way, Spamton, of course, didn’t speak; he just continued the topic: “Well, I think your ‘beating plan’ has no ‘problems,’ or rather… is ‘exceptionally reasonable.’”
Hearing this, you actually hesitated a bit: “But at the very least, it’s a noble family, right? Unlike before, it won’t be easy to handle, and they won’t just let it slide without investigation. This time, if they investigate, it’ll be troublesome…”
“Don’t worry, I won’t give them any chance to investigate,” you hear Spamton say.
You blink dully, about to say something, but then you see Spamton turn around, and the puppet’s finger touches your forehead. The force isn’t heavy, but your head instinctively tilts backward.
“Don’t hesitate, and don’t feel sad. This is completely their problem; there’s no need to blame yourself.” Saying this, Spamton actually just hopes that you won’t hesitate. Watching you get excited at first to teach the other party a lesson but then hesitate to go through with it, he can’t help but feel a little disappointed at your lack of resolve.
Tbc.

title: Employment Syndrome 4 (sptx you)
content:
You hesitated for a moment, not knowing why you felt you couldn't deny it again, otherwise you might be the one who got beaten first—no, you're the employer yourself! Though you probably wouldn't hit that hard—no! In the end, you just feel guilty, right?
Why are you feeling guilty? You're the one who pays! Thinking of this, you felt a bit more justified, but when you saw Spamton staring into your eyes, your shoulders still slumped. You really couldn't muster up the courage to come.
So you just lowered your voice and whispered, "Uh...... Well then, then I'll leave it to you to give him a beating. But don't get caught...... "Your voice was very soft. Honestly, if the living room weren't quiet enough, Spamton wouldn't have been able to catch your voice."
"Don't worry, there won't be any mistakes. I will perfectly complete the mission." Spamton said this.
After hesitating for a moment, you finally nodded, responding to his answer.
The butler quickly handed over the intelligence you and Spamton had gathered. In fact, since the other party was from the upper class, the investigation was easier, since many of the information about your whereabouts had been leaked. Early the next morning, after breakfast, you watched Spamton go to the basement, then drifted out wearing that NEO outfit. You watched him leave, gazing at his back, lost in thought.
Well, you don't even know what you're really thinking. It's just that once you've made up your mind, some things shouldn't be said unless they've been carefully considered, or they'll only bring trouble upon yourself. For those small things, at worst, just endure them......
Well, that's what it is. You decided on your own and collapsed back onto the sofa.
It was probably around lunchtime when Spamton came back. He didn't look badly hurt, just went back to the basement on his own, then reverted to that little puppet climbing onto your leg. Watching him crawl around was really troublesome, so you simply scooped him up and put him on your lap.
"What's wrong...... Oh right, the agreed payment—I'll give you a check later, plus today's friend bonus...... You muttered to yourself, but first slipped a 100-denomination Dark Coin to Spamton. He accepted it without hesitation.
"[Compensation][Never in a hurry]. I just need to [report] [today's situation]. "Because you hold him so you can't see his expression clearly, you only hear him say that, so you nod twice, oh, and you can't help but feel a bit confused—isn't it better to just tell yourself when reporting? Why do you have to sit down?"
"Then go ahead, I want to see what kind of fate that person really has." You said this somewhat indifferently, but in fact, you didn't really care what kind of outcome the other person would get...... Hmm, you feel like you've already come up with a better solution, and you even think you're pretty smart!
His chin rested on Spamton's head, and you watch him open his phone, lingering on a few photos, even videos—though I don't know how it was filmed, but the video shows him putting that person in a sack and then beating him, while the remaining photos show him crying and begging for mercy.
You glanced at it twice, and you have to admit, seeing the other person getting beaten and crying and begging for mercy was incredibly happy. But...... I was still a bit worried.
"Come to think of it, did he see your face? Isn't it a bit troublesome to fix things like this...... "You're worried about that."
"It's okay. If the injury doesn't leave a trace, he can't [sue]. ”
You're still a bit worried, but if he explains it like that, you probably don't need to worry anymore—after all, if the other party really wants to sue you, you don't know how to keep your own henchman. Come on, at least he's pretty useful, right?
But at this point, you suddenly remembered something and felt energized: "By the way—actually, I think just getting beaten up isn't satisfying. People like this may look glamorous on the surface, but probably aren't that great in private. So this morning, I carefully reviewed the intelligence I got from yesterday's investigation—"
Before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you: "[You] plan to [attack the other party] with public opinion?" ”
You pouted, a bit unhappy: "At least let me finish speaking...... But that's the point—I'm planning to use public opinion to attack him! Hmph, don't you think I'm a certain kind of person just because you hear rumors? Now that his rumors are spreading, he'll probably be scared to death first. "As you spoke, you hummed in satisfaction.
And this also helps divert attention, but if you spread rumors...... You have to carefully select the candidates. If the other side traces and finds out the rumors are on your side, it's a disaster.
Of course, if you can bring down the other party's company, you don't need to worry about that, but it's probably still a bit difficult......
Spamton didn't say anything, because you often give a long sentence and want to explain every aspect clearly, so he interrupted you first to summarize for you. But he still listened carefully to what you said next, and of course, he understood your intention.
However, before that, he chose to confirm again: "So, what kind of [public opinion] do you intend to [fabricate]?" ”
You thought for a moment. This morning, you came up with such an idea, thinking you were clever and went off in high spirits, but of course, you hadn't figured out what to do next. So now you just stammered and scratched your head: "Uh...... Exactly, I read those reports and found that he often goes to private with civilian women...... Are I planning to make a move from that angle? But before that, I should first send a statement to his family, explaining what happened to me and strongly demanding an apology. "As you spoke, you let out a deep sigh.
Spamton turned to look at you: "So, how do you plan to [write] the [Declaration Letter]?" ”
Actually, you only just remembered this incident. Yesterday, you got so angry that you even sent Spamton to hit someone. Today, after calming down a bit and regaining your ability to think, you only realized that you should have seriously declared that you should cut ties with his family. After all, before that, your two families had a pretty good relationship.
And you've already thought about how to organize your words this morning, so now you're confidently pulling over a piece of paper: "I'll write it for you right now!" ”
Spamton watched your movements, watching your hand slip past him and start writing the letter on the coffee table, watching the ink you dripped onto the paper without much hesitation, but the more he looked, the more his brows furrowed.
As for how you wrote it—
[Dear XX Family:
At last night's ball, I was insulted by xxx and felt I could not bear it. I ask your family to stay away from me from now on. I am sorry that I cannot continue to associate with your family. If any additional losses are caused, I will naturally compensate you, but I sincerely ask that you and your family not disturb you in the future. In return, I will also stay away from your family. I do not wish to associate with your family anymore, and only wish to cut off all contact from now on. I hope we will meet again and never get to know each other. ]
To be honest, the letter wasn't very long, and you were quite satisfied with it. You thought your tone was polite and distant, so it probably didn't matter.
"It's okay, but honestly, this is my first time writing a letter like this. If it weren't for the relationship between the other party and my family, it would've been okay...... You were a bit confident at first, but by the end, you started to feel uneasy again. To be honest, if you hadn't been really angry last night, maybe you could have just tolerated something within the normal range. After all, you didn't plan to fall out with them, and besides, our relationship was decent—seeing each other all the time, and if you saw it and it was a falling out, how awkward would that be?
You were still wondering whether to change your words when you felt a stab on your forehead—not gently, but with a bit of force. You instinctively covered your forehead, looking at Spamton with teary eyes. You saw it clearly—he had just withdrawn his finger!
So you couldn't help but start complaining to him: "What are you doing...... I didn't, and I never said I wouldn't send this letter! I've already done very well, haven't I!" After you finished, you paused. You felt something was off. What are you feeling guilty about now?
Spamton sighed silently. He finally understood that, to some extent, you could actually be considered weak and easy to bully...... Or rather, you were too soft, always subconsciously thinking of people in the positive light.
He turned his back to look at your letter, cleared his throat: "[No.] [Honest Explanation:] [Very Problematic]. [You] used [overly euphemistic.] "He commented on your letter.
You pouted, still holding your forehead. Even though it didn't hurt anymore, you still had to pretend to pitifully for a while. So now, you covered your forehead and leaned in to read the letter, your chin once again resting on Spamton's head: "Alright, so where exactly is the problem?" ”
"First, you shouldn't be seeking compensation; you should make a claim. Second, you can change your honorifics; you don't need to be so respectful. You're the victim, so you naturally have higher authority and don't need to be so cautious." Spamton said this, rarely giving you a long explanation.
And you just nod half-understandingly. To be honest, you don't really get it—uh, but you probably already know how to revise it!
So you confidently pulled another piece of paper and started writing another letter, assuring yourself, "I get it, I roughly know how to write it!" ”
Spamton leaned in again to see how you had written it, and then fell silent again.
[xxx family:
I want to cut off all contact with your family. I believe I cannot tolerate the humiliation from your noble son, xxx, so I earnestly ask your family not to associate with mine in the future, and I will also avoid seeing anyone from your family. ]
This letter was much shorter, and the wording was less tactful. You wiped the unexpected cold sweat from your forehead, then asked, almost as if asking for praise: "...... What do you think of this letter? ”
Oh my god, you really are asking for praise, your tone carrying a barely noticeable nervousness and anticipation. Honestly, before this, you never imagined you would turn out like this.
"[Barely passed]. However, [delete] your [plea]. This should be your [request], not [pleading]...... Forget it. [You] [took the letter again] and [began writing according to what I [informed]. ”
You let out a couple of disappointed 'oh-ohs', though that initial sentence barely got through helped lift your mood a little—but now, you just gloomily put the paper aside, pull out another one, listen to Spamton's report, and sullenly finish writing the letter according to his dictation.
[To xxx Family:
I am very doubtful about your family's education, or rather, the overall quality of your family. At yesterday's ball, your esteemed son xxx blatantly and openly insulted me, and countless outsiders witnessed this farce. ...
I demand compensation from your side, and after that, we sever all contact. Whether it is close visits or business cooperation, all will be suspended or even terminated. ]
You have to admit, this letter is indeed written much better than yours, mixed with sarcasm and some belittling, while also trying to match your tone...... Well, maybe you really did lower your stance when writing the letter.
So after writing this letter, you just mumble quietly, "Well, it seems I don't have much talent for this matter......
"No, it's just that your talent isn't here. If you were [writing poetry or literature], or [expressing respect], your [letter content] would be extraordinary." Then you noticed Spamton turned and sat facing you.
So you rekindled your hope, even if it wasn't real, and it didn't matter: "Oh, oh...... Then I'll give it a try!" You pulled yourself together again.
“Moreover, you control the business and have the management rights of the company.” He added this, and you couldn't help but nod. Indeed, to be honest, you are quite experienced in managing a company. You don’t have any innate talent; it’s just that you worked hard to learn and mastered these skills.
“Learning and striving to take control, and persisting, can also be a kind of talent.” Before you could say anything else, he added.
So you exhaled: “Sorry… I clearly didn’t need it, yet I still let you comfort me. Actually, in this kind of situation, I just need to process it myself…” After all, it’s normal not to have talent, and it’s normal to feel disappointed; you just need to adjust. It’s something you really shouldn’t have said out loud.
“It’s okay, we are now friends. Also, the special report on public opinion will be handled by me.”
Then your mood, which had just started to improve, sank again, and you gloomily said, “Oh… got it!”
Tbc.

title: Employment Syndrome 5 (sptx you)
content:
Spamton looked at your gloomy expression but didn't bother to explain. After all, he thought it would be more efficient if he took full control—after all, the salary you offered was so high, he wouldn't mind doing more for you.
But you quickly patted your cheeks and felt energized. After all, you know everyone has things they're good at and things they're not, so you're just not good at it. Knowing how to use people is also a very important skill! You cheered yourself on like this, and soon pulled yourself together.
But the topic was finally over, and at that moment, you furrowed your brows slightly, thought for a moment, and then hesitantly said, "Uh, but there's a ball tonight, so why not send the letter after the ball is over?" "If things get messed up now, the party tonight will definitely be even more awkward."
Spamton, however, was firm: "No, [now], immediately, [immediately], don't [delay]." "And for some reason, you can see a certain determination from the little puppet."
Well, actually, you didn't insist too much. If he said so, then so be it. After all, he wrote the letter, so you had no need to argue. So you called the steward over and instructed someone to deliver the letter to that mansion.
Then you let out a little breath, but still felt a bit worried: "The letter was delivered." But...... What about the evening ball? Wouldn't meeting up be awkward, and if we did, it would be troublesome if they questioned me or something? "You hate these troublesome things...... Actually, you didn't really want to write that letter. You hoped to get their attention and apology, but for you, it was also troublesome. You needed social skills and social etiquette, and you weren't very comfortable with it.
…… So in the end, Spamton couldn't take it anymore and took on the writing of letters and opinion articles, which made you very happy. If you don't need to make arrangements later, that's fine; at worst, just give them a bit more money.
"Then, tonight's [Ball] will be with me, [you]."
While you were still worrying, you heard this sentence, so you couldn't help but lower your head and glance at Spamton in surprise—though you could only see the back of his head. You couldn't help but mutter, "Why would I take you there...... Alright, alright, I'll just take you with me!" Because as you said this, Spamton shot you a fierce glare, suddenly turning to look at you, so you quickly changed your tune.
"But what kind of image do you want to use to get there? If it's neo, people will definitely recognize you, and uh...... It's too big, it's not convenient for me to bring you over. "As you spoke, you couldn't help but fall into deep thought.
"Just the current [appearance]." Sure enough, he gave this answer. Actually, you weren't that surprised, so you just nodded.
"Alright, but before that, I think maybe you should change your outfit...... you muttered. The outfit Spamton was wearing was the first time you saw him. You suspect it was washed and put on.
Visibly, Spamton, who had been relatively relaxed, now froze, mechanically turning his head to look at you: "[Sorry], then [Change Plan]?" ”
You rubbed your chin, seeing how nervous he was. Your eyes darted around, and suddenly your playful spirit sparked: "Ah! If you hadn't asked me, I almost forgot—cough, cough! Here's the thing: actually, I still have quite a few Lolita dresses left over from playing with dolls in my wardrobe. My height and size should be about the same...... But before you could finish, Spamton interrupted you.
His hands made a big cross over his chest. Of course, watching the little puppet strike that pose was quite comical; you were trying hard not to laugh out loud.
So you just cleared your throat seriously: "Ah, just kidding. I think you just need to change into a clean suit...... I think the butler hasn't prepared anything for you. ”
This time, Spamton just glanced at you hesitantly and slowly said, "There are quite a few [Reserves] in the [Wardrobe]. ”
And you shrugged casually, "That's enough, isn't it?" "Let's change into suits and come over together tonight." ”
As for what exactly her identity was...... Uh, she could only be called your male companion, so what else could she do? You were thinking absentmindedly, without making any excessive associations based on that word.
After all, you're just simple friends measured by money.
Time flew by and evening arrived. You changed into a new evening gown, this time a white and purple outfit. Countless pearls hung down the hem, with lily patterns at the ends. The upper body was a small cloak, and you were wearing lace gloves.
"...Actually, these kinds of balls usually happen twice a quarter. Most of the time, they are used for families to communicate and discuss upcoming cooperation matters, or for arrangements of marriages between the younger generation..." But no one would dare come to seek a marriage alliance with you, after all, you are the head of the family. Muttering to yourself, you bent down and picked up spamton, placing him on your shoulder to sit.
To be honest, this made his shoulders feel a bit heavy, and ...... Well, sitting on your shoulder would make him look a bit taller. But you definitely didn't want to hold him; holding him would tire your hands even more, so you just used your other hand to pat his head: "Sit still and don't fall off." "Saying casually, you got into the car and soon arrived at your destination.
The lights were brilliant. Facing the glow reflected in the hall, you lifted your skirt slightly and walked inside. The butler at the entrance bowed slightly. Although he maintained good manners and said nothing—perhaps because he was more experienced—you wouldn't miss the slight twitch on his face when he saw Spamton.
"Welcome, Miss. So...... Who is this? He looked at Spamton.
You reach out and pat Spamton's head again, casually saying, "Ah, this is my male partner...... No problem, right? ”
The butler quickly nodded, "Of course there is no problem. Then, ladies and gentlemen, please come in." As he spoke, he stepped aside to make room.
So you swaggered in with Spamton. To be honest, you didn't come to the ball to dance, although you usually wore very glamorous evening gowns—simply because too many people were staring at you, you wouldn't lower your status; you still wanted to leave a good impression, otherwise the gossip the next day would turn into shock, and xxx might have gone bankrupt.
So since it's not for dancing—you actually come to the ball to eat. Every time, you deliberately avoid the dance floor, since you prefer to eat the food placed on the next stage. Even though the portions are small, people don't really eat it and often waste it. Many people come after finishing their meal early. But you always come here empty-stomached.
This time, you quickly greeted the people gathered around and laughed it off, then gathered at the nearby banquet, picked up a plate with roasted squab, tore off a pigeon leg, and ate it with great enjoyment. Thinking Spamton hadn't eaten dinner either, you mercifully tore off a pigeon wing and gave it to Spamton.
Spamton hesitated for a moment, grabbed the wing with both hands, and began to nibble on it.
He hadn't even finished eating before you finished eating the pigeon leg and moved on to the next plate. This time, it was a crispy fried lamb chop. You grabbed a fragrant, oily roasted lamb chop and popped it into your mouth, glancing at Spamton's condition. Hmm...... He barely finished gnawing on that wing, so after thinking for a moment, you simply handed him the roasted potato slices you didn't eat.
Spamton glanced at you in surprise, and you looked over with confidence. You pay a hundred Dark Coins a day as a friend fee, so what's wrong with helping you with some meals you can't eat? So you proudly put your hands on your hips, then mouth-sync Spamton, saying 'friend fee'.
That somewhat ridiculous friend was ...... Spamton, of course, understood this very well. In fact, he felt that if you kept emphasizing this, it would make you seem especially naive and easy to fool. But he would still accept the money with a clear conscience.
As long as you think the money is useful, that's enough.
So in the end, he still took the roasted potato slices, but this time he ate quickly, since vegetables and meat are different.
You leisurely gnaw on the grilled lamb chop, and after Spamton had almost finished the potato slices, you grabbed a smaller grilled lamb chop for him. Then you moved on to the next area—honestly, you're almost full, since lamb chops are really greasy, and you grabbed several pieces. So after finishing that grilled lamb chop, you eat some leftover onions and move on to the dessert section. After all, the stomachs for a main meal and a stomach for dessert are two different stomachs!
Spamton had barely finished eating the grilled lamb chop when the small cake you suddenly handed him was filling his mouth again. He cupped it with both hands, nibbling into the cake in small bites—this was probably tiramisu—and he watched you bite by bite, smacking his lips in the end, still wanting more, ready to grab a plate.
You were still eagerly comparing which dessert tasted better, completely unaware that a resentful gaze was staring at you from across the crowd. Spamton noticed but didn't remind you, just followed his gaze and realized it was the same person from the morning—the one he had beaten up. I suppose it was because of that letter, wanting to come to cause you trouble but not daring to continue.
So Spamton naturally didn't intend to remind you; he just suddenly spoke up: "I want to [try] the [dessert] over there." As he spoke, he pointed to a plate on another table. It wasn't too far from you, but just right behind this banquet, meaning it just happened to block that person's line of sight.
You didn't think much of it—just take whatever he wanted to eat. So you bypassed the banquet in front of you, grabbed the plate, and handed Spamton a small cake. You glanced at it and saw that these cakes were actually chocolate brownies, which seemed pretty tasty too, so you happily started eating them too.
For the next half hour or so, Spamton would point at a certain dish, and you would happily go over to grab it, because you found he picked something you liked too...... Well, he really knows your preferences.
But by the end, you were too full and a bit tired, so you had to stop and quietly ask, "Uh, I'm full. Should we just stop moving?" "You check the time—the ball will still be over for an hour. Go find some champagne and drink it slowly......
Besides, it's rare to have company today. You don't think you'll feel bored at all—just chat casually with him!
"[Yes]. I think [you] need [rest]. "Spamton said.
You nodded casually: "Mm-hmm, I think I need to rest too." After saying that, you walked around to the table at the back and picked up a glass of champagne, slowly sipping it. Since an hour had passed, your shoulders were feeling sore, so you simply picked up the Spamton and set it on the floor.
After that, you felt completely relaxed. You planned to check out your gossip at the ball to pass the time, since you'd been through so many balls before.
When you're tired of standing, you squat down and whisper to Spamton, who is standing next to you: "Look at that woman over there. Her dance partner is her husband. Actually, the two of them were still talking about divorce recently, and now they're pretending to be close to their business cooperation to avoid affecting their business cooperation...... Actually, more or less, everyone knows their relationship isn't harmonious. ”
As you spoke, you pointed to a pair of dance partners on the right side of the hall: "Hmm, that couple over there are victims of a business marriage. Actually, the woman doesn't love the man at all; she likes someone else—Nuo. Her eyes are still fixed on that person, but I'm not sure if she's cheated in private. I can't be bothered to investigate that." You pouted as you spoke.
And following the direction of your finger, Spamton indeed saw the woman frequently looking at another man, and they were making some sort of eye contact. Her husband across from her looked quite ordinary, and unexpectedly, he seemed to be completely tolerating all of this.
You casually glanced around the scene and were about to say something else when you saw the young lord who had insulted you at yesterday's ball walking toward you.
You quickly stood up, adjusted the folds of your skirt that had become creased from squatting earlier, and held your champagne glass cautiously as you watched the young lord approaching you. Honestly, you had already cut ties with him, so why was he coming over?
"Yo, isn't this the unmarried young lady? Hiding here all alone, feeling sorry for yourself?" the young lord said lightly.
Your eyebrows furrowed, and you really wanted to curse—after all, even if you didn't get married, it didn't matter. You had plenty of wealth and power, so why force yourself to marry? It seemed that many people's mindset was still that men could control everything better. Although you were not omnipotent, you had your shortcomings…
Just as you were about to say something, Spamton spoke up first: "This gentleman is [rude and offensive]."
You lowered your head and realized that Spamton had actually positioned himself in front of you, and for a moment, you felt a swirl of mixed emotions.
